TITLE: Amabuki Yamahai Omachi Junmai Sake
Amaro Lucano Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: Amaro, Italian for bitter, is an herbal liqueur produced by macerating dried herbs, roots, flowers, bark and citrus peels in alcohol and then blending it with a mixture of sugar, alcohol and caramel. An ideal after dinner drink that can also be served mixed in cocktails.

TITLE: Ambassador 12 Year Old Straight Bourbon Barrel Proof
DESCRIPTION: This is another bourbon brought to market by David Schmier of Dynamic Beverages who brought us the Redemption Rye and Bourbon series. The Redemption line was sold off and now David bottles the Dead Wood Series of Bourbon and Rye. The ambassador bourbon represents a new venture in a higher end direction. The bourbon itself is sourced from MGP in Indiana and is following a number of other remarkable and very noteworthy Bourbons actually that Mr. Schmier has found in the long rows and archive that make MGP an overlooked treasure - it represents a beautiful merchant bottling of Bourbon. The barrel selected for this bottling represents some of the finer Bourbons available on the open market for bottling. The Ambassador is a straight Bourbon whiskey at barrel proof (105.7 (or 52.85 %) and 12 years old, which is where the sweet spot for a lot of bourbons is. Bourbon can get very woody beyond 12 to 15 years old depending on where it is stored and under what conditions. The production run of this bourbon is very limited. If you want a bottle of this you better grab one now while you can as availability is extremely limited.

TITLE: American Distilling Co Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Light and young, this is a great summertime sipper, and surprisingly smooth and delicious. Light notes of vanilla with a lightly-spiced banana bread finish. As its moniker suggests, it is, of course, made in America.

TITLE: American Highway Reserve Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Global country music superstar Brad Paisley launched "American Highway" Bourbon this month (Nov 2021), a whiskey aged in barrels stored in a 53-foot semi-trailer that followed his 2019 nationwide tour for 7,314 miles across 25 states, from coast to coast. "Bourbon is like songwriting, it's a blend of things coming together to make something incredible," said Paisley. "These are really special barrels that saw more of the United States than most people I know." The fluctuating climate of the barrels' journey expanded and contracted their staves, imparting oak and char that cultivate the characteristics flavors of America's native spirit. This well-traveled batch was then blended with three-year, 13-year, and 15-year-old Kentucky bourbons to create the final product. The next batch, to be released in 2022, was aged on the Rolling Rickhouse during Paisley's 2021 tour. Paisley sums up the creative process that derived his bourbon: "It's so similar to what goes into a great guitar. The right woods, the right craftsmanship, the right alchemy that makes this intangible, magical thing, and that's what makes this so great to me." "American Highway's" literal path-to-market wasn't the only unique aspect of its creation: Rather than just sourcing whiskey and lending a celebrity name to it, Paisley worked closely with award-winning bourbon distiller Bardstown Bourbon Company to create the final blend. Located in Bardstown, Kentucky the "Bourbon Capital of the World," this modern bourbon distiller creates custom whiskey, bourbon, and rye for more than 30 different brand-owners worldwide and has won critical acclaim for its releases.

TITLE: Ameztoi Getariako Txakolina
DESCRIPTION: Ameztoi Txakolina is one of the top producers of Getariako Txakolina. They own 20 hectares of vines in the best location. From the vineyards one can see the town of St. Sebastian and understand the influence of the Atlantic Ocean on local viticulture.Ignacio Ameztoi constitutes the seventh generation to carry on the tradition of making Txakolina in the province of Getaria. Made from the indigenous grape varieties of Hondarribi Zuri and its red companion Hondarribi Beltza. The wine is fermented in stainless steel and bottled with residual carbonic acid that gives the wine its natural spritz. Grapes: 90% Hondaribi Zuri & 10% Hon-darribi Beltza. Vine age: 20-25 years Soil: Sand and clay. Farming: Sustainable Vinification: Fermented in stainless steel. In the traditional style of Getaria, this light and crisp wine is bottled with a little bit of residual carbon to give it its signature natural spritz. Anchovies, sardines, shellfish, grilled vegetables.

TITLE: Ampeleia Costa Toscana Bianco di Ampeleia
DESCRIPTION: The 1st vintage of Bianco di Ampeleia was 2016. A neighbor's vineyard had old vines of a local biotype of Trebbiano Toscano; Ampeleia used its cuttings and starting planting in 2013, between Ampeleia di Mezzo and Ampeleia di Sopra (300-600m with varied soil composition). The vineyards were planted to 90% Trebbiano, 5% Ansonaco (aka Ansonica aka Inzolia), and 5% Malvasia. In true field-blend fashion, the three varieties are interspersed through the vineyard. The grapes were co-harvested at yields of 50hl/ha in mid-September and co-fermented in concrete vats, with 7-10 days contact with the skins. It aged on its lees for 6 months in concrete. 12,000 bottles made.

TITLE: Ampeleia Unlitro Toscana
DESCRIPTION: This wine is a blend of varieties originating from the Mediterranean Basin-80% Alicante Nero (aka Grenache) and 20% Carignano.sourced from vineyards at 180-250 meters above sea level. The fruit was harvested from the 10th to the 25th of September at yields of 60hl/ha. The varieties were harvested and vinified separately. A small part of the harvest undergoes carbonic maceration, the rest is either done whole berry or crushed. Macerations lasted 5-7 days. Aged 6 months in cement tanks.

TITLE: Amrut "Aatma" Sauternes Finish Indian Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Amrut "Aatma" Sauternes Finish Indian Single Malt Whisky is an exquisite expression from the pioneering Amrut Distilleries in Bangalore, India's vibrant city. Crafted from unpeated Indian barley and matured in an ex-Sauternes cask, this single malt uniquely combines Indian distilling craftsmanship and French wine cask sophistication. The whisky has been aged in Bangalore's tropical climate at 3,000 feet above sea level, where it matures approximately 3.5 times faster than in Scotland. Bottled at a robust 56.5% ABV, this collector's series whisky is a testament to Amrut's dedication to producing world-class single malts with a distinctive Indian character.

TITLE: Amrut "Greedy Angels" 12 Years Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This Special Offering Comprises A Bottle And Two Branded Glencairn Crystal Tasting Glasses. We Have Matured Our New Make Spirit In An Ex-PX Sherry Cask For Over 6 Years First Before Transferring Them Into Ex-Bourbon Casks, A Reversal Of Our Usual Process And An Unusual One. The Result Is Gratifying And One Will Find Notes Of Prunes, Dark Chocolate, Honey, Coconut, Marzipan, Sweet Oranges And Tropical Fruits. This Single Malt Whisky Is Extremely Palatable At 60% ABV And Very Soft On The Nose And The Palate.

TITLE: Amrut Aatma Fusion X Indian Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Aged for an astounding 10yrs in the intense climate of India, this special tribute bottling features whisky aged in ex-PX Sherry Butts and limited to an edition of 1,010 bottles for the world. A concentrated, powerful, and deeply complex dram that will defy what you think you know single malt to be capable of.

TITLE: Amrut Aatma Indian Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Amrut Distilleries was founded in Bangalore, India in 1948. its initial business was the production of Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL), which is the government-required term for non-indigenous spirits, such a vodka, rum, and of course, whisky. The current distillery building was built in 1987, and the Amrut single malt brand was launched in 2004 after years of experimenting with whisky production that would closely mirror the output of Scotland's Speyside region. Amrut is now a highly regarded single malt, owing in no small part to several catalytic reviews and awards from Jim Murray over the years. The bottle is part of the Aatma Collector Series and was made exclusive to the United States. The release received an impressive 94 point score from Whisky Advocate. One of 360 bottles.

TITLE: Amrut Cask Strength 8 Year Port Pipe Aged  ‘Private Cask X PLDC Exclusive’ Indian Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Overview Experience the legacy of Indian whisky with Amrut Cask Strength 8-Year Port Pipe Aged ‘Private Cask X PLDC Exclusive’ Indian Single Malt Whisky, the pioneering distillery that has redefined the perception of single malts outside Scotland. Amrut, derived from Sanskrit meaning "nectar of the gods," embodies the essence of premium whisky, often called the "water of life." Distillery Heritage Founded in 2004, Amrut Distillery has quickly become India's best-known distillery, renowned for producing world-class single malts. While the market is flooded with inexpensive, no-name whiskies, Amrut stands out with its commitment to quality and craftsmanship. Aged to Perfection Amrut primarily utilizes American white oak casks for maturation but has expanded its repertoire to include Sherry casks and other specialty casks, reflecting the distillery's growing international reputation and rising demand. This versatility allows Amrut to create unique flavor profiles that appeal to whisky enthusiasts worldwide. This 75th Anniversary Barrel Selection honored the distillery's 75th anniversary. This exceptional whisky captures the rich history and dedication to quality that has defined Amrut. It has been aged for 8 years in a humid Indian climate, where most expressions tend to 'mature' faster and then finish in the port pipe cask. The expression was then bottled at robust 120 proof. Don't be put off by "peated" monicker. The mashbill is 75% unpeated and only 25% peated malt. Tasting Notes: Nose: Amrut Peated 8-Year-Old pours a rich amber hue in the glass, displaying its age and maturity. It has a captivating depth and clarity, with rich golden highlights glistening in the light. As you bring the glass to your nose, a delicate wisp of smoke gently greets you, followed by the enticing aromas of black tea and sea salt. The peat influence is evident but not overpowering, allowing other intriguing notes to emerge. Hints of vanilla pudding add a creamy sweetness to the mix, while the underlying essence of freshly brewed coffee adds depth and richness. The fragrance of bright cherries completes the aromatic symphony, adding a touch of fruity elegance to the overall experience. Palate: Upon your first sip, the whiskey reveals a delightful interplay of flavors on the palate. The peat smoke becomes more prominent, providing a robust, earthy foundation that harmonizes with the other elements. The flavors of black tea and sea salt intertwine, creating a captivating combination of saltiness and tannins that offer a unique and refreshing sensation. As the whisky coats your mouth, the creamy essence of vanilla pudding emerges, adding a velvety smoothness to the overall texture. The notes of coffee continue to linger, providing a pleasant bitterness that complements the other flavors. The bright cherry flavors return triumphantly towards the end, offering a fruity sweetness that balances the smoky undertones. Finish: The finish is satisfyingly long and lingering. As the sweet cherry flavors gradually fade, the smoke becomes a lasting presence, leaving a warm and smoldering sensation. When a few drops of water are added, it brings forth an additional layer of smoky complexity, intensifying the peat and creating a more pronounced smoky profile. The flavors become more integrated, and the whisky takes on a seductive character, enticing you to explore its depths further. Overall, the Amrut Single Malt Peated 8-Year-Old is a captivating expression that showcases the skillful balance of peat, smoke, and complementary flavors. Its complex interplay of black tea, sea salt, vanilla, coffee, bright cherry, and smoke creates a unique and memorable tasting experience. Whether enjoyed neat or with a touch of water, this whisky offers a journey through layers of flavors that will delight peat enthusiasts and those seeking a refined and well-crafted single malt.

TITLE: Amrut Cask Strength Indian Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Amrut Cask Strength Indian Single Malt Whisky is a captivating expression from the renowned Amrut Distilleries, nestled in the vibrant city of Bangalore, India. This no-age-statement whisky is distilled from barley sourced from the fertile regions of Haryana, Punjab, and Rajasthan. It is aged in a blend of new American oak and seasoned bourbon barrels, with the intense Indian climate significantly accelerating the maturation process. Bottled at a potent 61.8% ABV, this whisky is a testament to the distillery's pursuit of crafting profound and characterful spirits.

TITLE: Amrut Cask Strength Peated Indian Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Amrut Peated Cask Strength Indian Single Malt Whisky is a bold and intense spirit distilled in the cosmopolitan city of Bangalore, India. Crafted with peated barley sourced from Scotland, this whisky features a phenol level of 23 ppm, delivering a distinctive smoky character. Matured in American oak casks, this cask strength offering is bottled at an impressive 62.8% ABV, presenting a rich, earthy profile interlaced with fruity undertones. The daring character of this whisky is balanced by its approachable nature, allowing connoisseurs to unlock its full spectrum of flavors with just a dash of water.

TITLE: Amrut Distilleries Bagheera Sherry Cask Finish Indian Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Amrut Bagheera is a single malt to cherish. This single malt exhibits vibrant fruity notes with a tone of dried fruits and peach complemented with mild orangey citrus, vanilla, and toffee. This is a special limited release - single malt sherry cask finish, with 2 Amrut glasses.

TITLE: Amrut Distilleries Fusion Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Amrut Fusion Single Malt Whisky is a distinctive and innovative offering from Amrut Distilleries, showcasing a fusion of Indian and Scottish barley. Aged in the unique climate of Bangalore, India, this whisky matures rapidly, offering a complexity that belies its years. This whisky has garnered numerous accolades, including being named the Third Finest Whisky in the World by Jim Murray’s Whisky Bible 2010 with a rating of 97/100. It's a testament to the craftsmanship and innovation of Amrut Distilleries, offering a unique taste experience that marries the bold flavors of Indian whisky with the classic peatiness of Scottish barley. Whether you're a seasoned whisky enthusiast or a curious newcomer, Amrut Fusion Single Malt Whisky promises a remarkable and unforgettable journey for your palate

TITLE: Amrut Indian Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Amrut Indian Single Malt Whisky, crafted in Bengaluru, India, is a testament to the finesse and quality of Indian single malts. The first single malt whisky to be made in India, Amrut has garnered global acclaim, including prestigious awards like the Liquid Gold Award in Jim Murray’s Whisky Bible 2010 and accolades in the Malt Maniacs Award. Amrut Indian Single Malt Whisky is an excellent representation of the ingenuity and passion of Amrut Distilleries, showcasing the potential and unique characteristics of Indian whisky. It is a remarkable choice for whisky enthusiasts looking to explore beyond traditional whisky region.

TITLE: Amrut Rye Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Amrut Rye Single Malt Whisky represents a rare and exceptional offering from Amrut Distilleries, crafted in the heart of Bangalore, India. This exquisite spirit is meticulously produced using 100% European rye, marking Amrut's entry into the exclusive world of distilleries that specialize in rye single malt. Aged for five years in new American oak barrels, this whisky embodies a harmonious blend of tradition and uniqueness. With its robust proof of 100 and a distinct mashbill solely comprising rye, Amrut Rye Single Malt is not just a whisky but a testament to the distillery's commitment to excellence and innovation.

TITLE: Amrut Spectrum Indian Single Malt Whisky 004
DESCRIPTION: Nose : Raisins, rum, nougat, figs, oranges, tiramisu, cocoa, caramel, coffee, dried fruit, burnt rubber. Taste : Sherry, rum, butterscotch, chocolate, prunes, molasses, pecans, walnuts, almonds, English wine gum. Finish : Caramelized almonds, old cognac, apricots, Brazil nuts.

TITLE: Ancient Age Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Features aromas of corn, caramel, toffee and vanilla. Follows through with many of the same but with a hint of spice and a lingering finish hinting of toffee and citrus.

TITLE: Ancient Age Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Features aromas of corn, caramel, toffee and vanilla. Follows through with many of the same but with a hint of spice and a lingering finish hinting of toffee and citrus.

TITLE: Andalusia Whiskey Stryker Smoked Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Smoky whisky has traditionally been the domain of Islay scotch, but Andalusia makes its own version in Texas Hill Country. Rather than using peat, the malted barley is treated like brisket—bathed in oak, applewood, and mesquite smoke. It has a caramel nose, and a sip reveals notes of Irish breakfast tea, pine, and loads of vanilla and caramel, along with solid hardwood smoke and mineral notes. The finish is long and mentholated, reminiscent of an herbal aperitif. A big, delicious Texas whiskey.

TITLE: Andre Blush Rose Blend
DESCRIPTION: Pairs well with Goat cheese, Salmon, Barbecue, Lobsters, Spaghetti with red sauce.

TITLE: Andre Extra Dry California Champagne
DESCRIPTION: Our André Extra Dry California champagne is a semi-dry blend of varietal whites with pear and apple aromas, sweet hints of fruit and a crisp finish.

TITLE: Angel's Envy "Cellar Collection Release No. 2" Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Tawny Port Wine Casks
DESCRIPTION: The whiskey began with a 10-year-old Kentucky Straight Bourbon, that was then finished for 10 months in tawny port wine barrels. Just a bit of water was added before it was bottled at 111.6 proof

TITLE: Angel's Envy "Cellar Collection Release No. 3" Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Madeira Casks
DESCRIPTION: Madeira is heated as it ages, which results in the oxidation necessary for the wine’s desired flavors and colors. Historically, as these barrels were shipped from Madeira to the New World, the heat of the tropical sun sped up this process, creating an uncommonly delicious wine. For the third Cellar Collection Release, distillery chosen the sun and barrel icon to honor the old craft and celebrate new discoveries.

TITLE: Angel's Envy "Cupid's Share" Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished In Port Wine Barrels The Prime Barrel Pick #16
DESCRIPTION: The last selection of 2021 is a venerable Angel's Envy single barrel. For 2021, the Angel's Envy Private Selection program was coming out hot and spicy. Each barrel we were sent had a distinctly different profile with varying fruit and port influence levels. What also makes this program different is that Angel's Envy does not allow the barrel strength bottling, presumably to not complete with their flagship cask strength edition. The company proofs down single barrel selections slightly, and the amount of the "proof down" varies for each selection based on each market. In New York, the proof down effect is less than in any other market, and this selection came in at 108 proof (the sample we tasted was 113.5 Proof) The winning barrel (#2980) stood out for several reasons. First, it has an incredible nose (more on that below) - it just blew other samples we tasted away right from the get-go. Second, the' very bold flavor. Even though this is a manageable 108 Proof (by single barrel standards), it does drink a lot bolder than that. More specifically: Nose: Superb and complex. Port influence is very much there, and you also get distinct notes of maraschino cherries, raisinets, caramelized banana, marzipan. If you are a Starbucks drinker, you'll get notes of their banana nut bread. Palate: Spice bomb! You'll get allspice, dry orange peel/zest, white pepper, cocoa bibbs, and even bold espresso flavor. Finish: Medium to long. That spice stays with you for a minute. Overall, if you are a fan of the brand or enjoy bold, high-proof bourbons (think Booker's), you'd enjoy this one. The nose sets the tone for the winter season, and the palate takes it home. We could see ourselves savoring a cigar on a cold night on a back/front porch and enjoying this dram. This is also the first selection with a communal sticker. One of our supporters suggested the Cupid's Share theme and it was voted as the best by the rest of you. The person who suggested it will receive a FREE bottle of this selection! We will do something similar again in 2022, so please send us your suggestions when you see a survey. Moreover, this is the first lenticular sticker - it gives an illusion of depth and changes the image when viewed from different angles! Check out the video to see it in action. We will continue to donate $5 from each bottle to the Western Kentucky Tornado Relief Fund. This was a no-brainer after seeing the devastation to the region all whiskey enthusiasts have a connection to

TITLE: Angel's Envy "Devil's Advocate" Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished In Port Wine Barrels The Prime Barrel Pick #54
DESCRIPTION: This is our second AE pick, and yet again, each barrel we were sent had a distinctly different profile with varying fruit and port influence levels. All samples provided by Angel’s Envy were, without question, some of the best samples we tasted last year. This program also differs from others due to Angel's Envy not allowing barrel strength bottling, presumably not to compete with their flagship cask strength edition. The company slightly proofs down single barrel selections anywhere from 100 to 110 proof, and the "proof down" amount varies for each selection based on each market. In New York, the proof-down effect is less than in most markets to 108 proof (the barrel we selected was originally tasted at 118.3 proof, then at 108 proof after proofing it down according to instructions from Angel's Envy) We tasted several, and all could have been winners. We settled on the complete barrel - Barrel 172C - unique nose, complex palate, and an excellent finish. More specifically: Nose: subtle sweetness, browned butter and maple syrup, red apple, some woody smells like cedar. Palate: fruity, cherries, currant, maple syrup Finish: slightly toasty, and a touch of nuttiness We will donate $5 from each bottle we sell in March to the Women of the Vine & Spirits Foundation, the all-encompassing global membership organization dedicated to fostering diversity, equity & inclusion in beer, wine, and spirits, launched its charitable arm, Women of the Vine & Spirits Foundation, Ltd.501(c)3 in 2017.Created, to help further Women of the Vine & Spirits’ larger mission of assisting individuals in advancing their careers within the traditionally white male-dominated alcohol beverage industry, the Foundation provides annual scholarships and awards to deserving applicants interested in continuing their professional development and education for careers within the food, wine/spirits, and hospitality sectors. If the cause is closer to you than others, please donate more by clicking their logo below!

DESCRIPTION: The 12th Annual Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey from Angel's Envy is a masterful creation by Master Distiller Owen Martin. DESCRIPTION: Angel's Envy 2023 Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey marks the first-ever release of a limited-edition rye whiskey at cask strength from the brand. This innovative whiskey is a blend of two rye whiskeys, one finished in Sauternes casks and the other in toasted oak barrels, offering a distinct and complex flavor profile. The limited-edition Cask Strength Rye comes in a newly designed glass bottle featuring embossed wings on the face, gold foil labels, and a collectible engraved cork metal medallion, making it a desirable item for collectors.

TITLE: Angel's Envy Ice Cider Cask Finish Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Three hundred and sixty-four days. That’s how long our rye whiskey waited in Ice Cider Casks, mingling with the oak until it got a perfect, crisp apple finish. This rare spirit grabs your attention with bold peppery and cinnamon notes, and then soothes your tastebuds with a sweet finish of brown sugar, apple and warm oaky undertones. This perfect winter whiskey is our first rye Cellar Collection release and is available for a limited time.

TITLE: Angel's Envy Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Angel’s Envy Kentucky Straight Bourbon is finished in port wine casks for an award winning spirit. We guide each batch’s conditioning, blending our handcrafted bourbon in small batches of 8 to 10 barrels at a time. It’s typically aged for up to 6 years. While we lose about 5% of the spirit each year to evaporation, or “the Angel’s Share,” what’s left behind after we’re done is truly worthy of envy. Once it’s deemed ready, we finish our bourbon in ruby port wine casks, adding subtle nuances that enhance the flavor without challenging it. Our port finishing process lasts between three to six months depending on taste. We use 60-gallon ruby port barrels made from French oak and imported directly from Portugal. This creates a whiskey of unprecedented smoothness, sweetness and balance.

TITLE: Angel's Envy Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: As malcontents, we’re particular about our whiskey. When we decided to release a rye, we knew it had to be something special to live up to the amazing response received by our bourbon finished in port barrels. Angel’s Envy Rye Finished in Rum Barrels is genuinely special and worthy of Lincoln Henderson’s legacy. Lincoln had been considering a rum cask finish, and the taste profile of rye whiskey was a perfect fit. After sampling over 100 rums to find the right flavor to complement rye whiskey, the team’s decision was unanimous. Our vintage barrels began as small-batch French cognac barrels, which were then used to age and finish Plantation XO Rum. Angel’s Envy Rye spends up to 18 months finishing in these Franco Caribbean rum casks, resulting in an immensely complex whiskey. The mingling of raw, spicy and earthy rye with the mellow sweetness of rum finishing creates an incomparably smooth and drinkable whiskey, even at 100 proof.

TITLE: Angel's Envy Straight Bourbon Single Barrel Finished in Sherry Casks
DESCRIPTION: Angel's Envy Straight Bourbon Single Barrel Finished in Sherry Casks is a limited-edition, hand-selected bourbon that undergoes a second finishing period in sherry casks, adding an extra layer of complexity and richness to its already exquisite profile. Known for its innovative approach to finishing, Angel’s Envy delivers a unique bourbon experience with this single-barrel expression, offering robust flavors influenced by the sweet and fruity notes of the sherry casks. Bottled at a high proof, this bourbon is designed for those who appreciate both the craftsmanship of single-barrel selections and the nuanced flavors brought out by sherry cask aging.

TITLE: Angeline Winery Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: The new line of Angeline wines is composed of an array of varietals sourced from renowned California wine regions like Russian River Valley, and other notable appellations within Sonoma County; as well as Napa Valley, Mendocino County, Santa Barbara County and the Paso Robles and Santa Maria Valley wine regions. Head winemaker, Bryan Davison, is no stranger to Sonoma County and has made wine for over twenty years. Bryan’s intuitive approach to winemaking nurtures the perfect conditions where wines develop naturally. The Angeline wines embody a commitment to produce structured, elegant wines, which are abundant with layers of fruit. Wine & Spirits, June '06, named Angeline as one of the 15 Top American Value Brands. Try it with mushroom risotto or roasted duck.

TITLE: Angels Envy Triple Oak Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Angel's Envy Triple Oak Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a meticulously crafted limited-edition whiskey that elevates the bourbon aging process to new heights. This expression undergoes a unique three-stage oak maturation using Hungarian, Chinquapin, and French oak barrels, giving it unparalleled layers of complexity and flavor. Initially aged in charred American oak barrels, the bourbon is then finished in Hungarian and Chinquapin oak, which impart a richer, spicier profile. The final stage of aging occurs in French oak casks, adding an elegant, smooth finish with subtle sweetness. The result is a smooth, decadent bourbon with an extraordinary depth of flavor, showcasing notes of spice, dark fruit, and vanilla. Every sip of Angel's Envy Triple Oak reflects the brand’s masterful blend of tradition and innovation, making it a must-have for any serious whiskey connoisseur. As a highly sought-after limited release, this bourbon combines Angel's Envy's signature approach to finishing with the complexity of triple oak aging. Expect bold, intricate flavors that evolve with each sip, making it perfect for savoring on special occasions.

TITLE: Angel’s Envy Breaking Bourbon “Questionable Gaze” Port Cask Finished Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: The Angel’s Envy private select program is relatively new, beginning in late 2020. Barrels are bottled between 100-110 proof, which is close to the cask strength of approximately 120 proof, but not quite. This slight reduction in the proof is potentially due to the fact that Angel’s Envy releases a limited edition Cask Strength release annually, and if single barrels were released at the same proof, the lines between the two versions could easily be blurred. With that in mind, the most interesting aspect of the barrel we selected is that it does not taste like previous editions of Angel’s Envy Cask Strength, in which we have typically observed a very heavy (and arguably dominating) port finish influence. Instead, the finished bourbon tastes like an amplified version of the standard product in all of the right ways. In fact, going back and reading Jordan’s review of the standard version a common thread is present - the standard version is good, it just lacks intensity and impact. This higher-proof version brings the desired intensity, allowing the flavors to come forward with the intensity they really deserve. At the same time, it does not have the heavy port influence Angel’s Envy Cask Strength typically exhibits, instead leaning more towards the bourbon flavors with well-integrated accents from the port. It’s a great display of flavor and will satisfy anyone who likes Angel’s Envy Port Finished Bourbon, but wants a deeper intensity. Tasting Notes: Nose: Sweet cinnamon bun | Syrup | Vanilla custard | Creme brulee | Spicy oak | Full & inviting Palate: Integrated cinnamon/maple/oak | Raisin | Stewed fruit | Leather | Vibrant & full flavored | Delicious Finish: Stewed cherries | Mild spice | Light custard on backend | Leather | Dry oak | Medium length Overall: Well integrated overall, no single flavor dominates, really good at this proof point, well balanced with perfect intensity

TITLE: Angel’s Envy Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished In Japanese Mizunara Oak Casks
DESCRIPTION: in 2010, Wes Henderson and his dad filled their first port barrels with the bourbon that would eventually become Angel’s Envy, In celebration, they wanted to release something special to honor Wes dad’s incredible legacy, how far Angel’s Envy has come, and their exciting future ahead. They chose this release for the tenth anniversary because Wes' dad, having taken on several consulting roles in Japan during his career, always had a deep appreciation for the country and its distilling community. This release, finished in Mizunara casks made from this rare, 200-year-old wood, felt fitting for such a special milestone for Angel’s Envy.

TITLE: Anita & Hans Nittnaus Blaufränkisch Kalk And Schiefer
DESCRIPTION: Dark ruby with purple reflexes, fine water edge. Delicately smoky underlaid dark berry fruit, delicate leafy spiciness. Tart blueberry & limestone nose, slightly meaty, white-peppery and herbaceaous. The white pepper of Blaufränkisch is joined here by rounder spices of oak. A very quintessential Blaufränkisch, this boasts a light-footed balance of cherry, dark berries, sprightly acidity and medium body in a sleek and elegantly silhouetted frame, with ripe, soft tannins. Lean and transparent on the palate. Refreshing, with bright acidity and a salty mineral finish, albeit a bit short on fruit. At 12,5% this is a food companion (ideal with poultry, beef, pork, and venison), and of course a thirst quencher. Shows purity and typicity for the Leithaberg area in a cool vintage. Needs a bit of fat and salty charcuterie on the plate to round things out.

TITLE: Anne Pichon Sauvage Orange
DESCRIPTION: Experience a wild and captivating journey with Anne Pichon Sauvage Orange, a unique and expressive wine that pushes the boundaries of tradition. Crafted by the esteemed Anne Pichon winery in France, this orange wine embodies the spirit of experimentation, blending tradition with innovation. Immerse yourself in the untamed flavors and vibrant hues of this Sauvage Orange wine.

TITLE: Anne Pichon Vaucluse Vermentino Sauvage
DESCRIPTION: 100% Vermentino. Not so much sauvage as soft and easy-drinking vermentino. Its flavors of lime and cream and silky texture keep you coming back for another sip. Anne Pichon uses all organic practices in both the vineyards and the cellar and is seeking certification.

TITLE: Ant Moore Estate Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Clean and pure with low residual sugar. The citrusy drop opens with refreshing lemon and lime with nice weight on the palate due to extended time on lees. Grapes come from estate vineyards in the Waihopai and Wairau Valleys to provide a balanced flavor profile. Fermentation occurred over 4 weeks between 11 and 15 degrees Celsius using selected aromatic yeasts to contribute to texture and roundness. After blending, the wine was stabilized without the need for additional fining before filtration and bottling.

TITLE: Antichi Vigneti di Cantalupo Agamium Colline Novaresi
Antique Pelinkovac Herbal Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: With the quality of our products we continue on and enrich our opulent tradition that was inherited from renowned companies such as Pokorny, Patria, Arko and Badel Vinoprodukt. We are a synonym for spirit drinks in Croatia and the wider region and with five wineries within our portfolio we interlace the entire wealth of wine regions in Croatia. In addition to our own production, we are exclusive distributors for world known producers of spirit drinks such as Tradall, Marie Brizard, Borco and Underberg. Vision: We want to be the leading company in the production of spirits and wines on the domestic and regional market. Mission: In accordance with our slogan “Drink less, but of the best!” , we have been with our consumers for over a century and a half , supporting them in the most important moments of their lives and nurturing a culture of pleasure in spirits and wines.

TITLE: Antiyal Pura Fe Valle del Maipo Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Arguably the most heralded winemaker in South America today, Alvaro Espinoza is one of the foremost biodynamic winemakers in the world. His celebrated wine Antiyal is often referred to as Chile's first "garage wine". Antiyal produces a little more than 300 cases of wine a year in the sleepy Maipo Valley town of Alta Jahuel.

TITLE: Antonelli Umbria Baiocco Rosso
DESCRIPTION: Antonelli Umbria Baiocco Rosso is a medium-bodied red wine from Italy's Umbria region. It is made from a blend of Sangiovese and Merlot grapes, and is aged for 12 months in stainless steel tanks. The wine is a deep ruby red color with aromas of red fruits, such as cherry, plum, and raspberry. On the palate, it is fruity and balanced, with soft tannins and a pleasant acidity. The finish is long and lingering.

TITLE: Antonio Lopes Ribeiro Vinho Tinto Maresia 19
DESCRIPTION: Vinhao (90%), Borracal (aka Caino Tinto) (5%) and Loureiro (5%) From 30 year old vines planted on 1 hectare of granite soils in Vinho Verde. The grapes are hand harvested end of September and selectively sorted in the vineyard, de-stemmed and spends 5 hours on the skins. Spontaneous fermentation lasts for two weeks with indigenous yeasts in stainless steel tanks under temperature control. Perfect with roast pork, grilled sausage, pizza, and cheese.

TITLE: Antoniolo Bricco Lorella Gattinara Rosato
DESCRIPTION: This amazing rose made in the northern reaches of Piedmont offers a redolence of mountain air, fresh cut herbs, spicy red fruit and salty minerals.

TITLE: Antxiola Getariako Txakolina Blanco
DESCRIPTION: Varietals : Hondurrabi Zuri and Hondurrabi Beltza. Vinification : Alcoholic fermentation takes place in stainless steel with indigenous yeast. Aging : No aging of the wine. It is bottled while still young to capture some of the natural CO2 left in the wine giving it a slight effervescence.

TITLE: Antxiola Getariako Txakolina Rosado
DESCRIPTION: Antxiola pronounced (ahn-cho-la) is a txacoli wine made by Bodegas Zudugarai. The winery was founded in 1989 the same year that the DO of Getaria txakolina was founded. The Errasti family has been growing grapes and making wine from these vineyards for over 40 years working with the local varieties of Hondarrabi Zuri and Hondarrabi Beltza. The vineyards and winery are near the coast line among rolling hills at about 90 meters above sea level. The sunniest and windiest slopes are the ones planted to vines so that the grapes can get ripe and also remain dry and avoid fungal and rot issues. All work in the vineyards is done by hand including harvest. Fermentation takes place naturally in stainless steel tanks over a period of about 20 days. The wine is then bottled while young to retain some of its natural effervescence.

TITLE: Apaltagua Valle de Colchagua Rose of Carmenere
DESCRIPTION: From 85% Carmenere and 15% Syrah, made by consultant wine guru Alvaro Espinoza. Hand harvested at a natural high acidity, and aged on the lees for 3 months. Apaltagua is producing one of the best Chilean Rose wines out there. This really reminds me of Provencal Roses' with the crisp refreshing dryness and wonderful array of light berry flavors.

TITLE: Apaltagua Valle del Curico Pinot Noir Reserve
DESCRIPTION: Vineyards: Our entire vineyard is carefully tended with affection and with respect for the natural surroundings. The grapes in our Apaltagua Reserva Pinot Noir come from our own vineyard, called Manantiales, in the sector of El Turco in the San Antonio Valley, a place with extraordinary natural conditions required for the development of grapevines. Climate: The San Antonio Valley has a Mediterranean-style climate with a cold, rainy winter and a warm, dry summer. Marked temperature differences between day and night make ideal conditions for the growth of our wine grapes. Vinification: The grapes are harvested by hand in March when they have reached optimal maturity, with care given to select the best bunches of grapes. In order to extract color and aromas, the must is interfused with its skin for three days at low temperatures. The must is then fermented for ten days in stainless steel tanks with selected yeasts at temperatures ranging from 24° to 26°C (75° to79°F). Then, 30% of the wine is aged in oak barrels for six to eight months. Finally, the wine is cellared in bottles for six additional months before its launch on the markets.

DESCRIPTION: Vineyards: Our entire vineyard is carefully tended with affection and with respect for the natural surroundings. TITLE: Aperol Aperitivo Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: Aperol's unique flavour and colour is achieved through a subtle blend, with a perfect balancing of different herbs and roots. The ingredients' quality allows a very low alcoholic strength: 11%Vol. A secret recipe that has been unchanged since its first creation in 1919. Please note: the bitter and sweet Aperol taste is not a banality, it is perfectly "aperitivo". Bottle a laughable 11%, Aperol backs all the punch of its big brother Campari without the headaches. Traditionally served in a Spritz, add 2-3 oz of Aperol to a glass full of ice. Top with Prosecco and an orange wheel. Enjoy over and over!

TITLE: Aperol Aperitivo Select Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: In Italy, Aperol is a beloved bottle — the bright red, bittersweet amaro that’s the star of its namesake Aperol Spricolort every region of the country has its own preferred aperitivo. In Venice? That’s Aperitivo Select. While it shares the low proof and mellow sweetness of Aperol, Select is quite a bit more complex, with pleasant notes of vanilla and a nice bitter edge. Pick up a bottle and use it anywhere you’d use Aperol. SELECT’S harmonious taste is characterized by a unique balance. With just the right amount of sweetness, an intense color and scent and a well-balanced flavor.

TITLE: Aperol Aperitivo Select Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: In Italy, Aperol is a beloved bottle — the bright red, bittersweet amaro that’s the star of its namesake Aperol Spricolort every region of the country has its own preferred aperitivo. In Venice? That’s Aperitivo Select. While it shares the low proof and mellow sweetness of Aperol, Select is quite a bit more complex, with pleasant notes of vanilla and a nice bitter edge. Pick up a bottle and use it anywhere you’d use Aperol. SELECT’S harmonious taste is characterized by a unique balance. With just the right amount of sweetness, an intense color and scent and a well-balanced flavor.

TITLE: Aphros Phaunus Pet Nat Vinho Verde
DESCRIPTION: Aphros produces wines that are an expression of their region, reflecting the unique soil conditions and varietals that are exclusive to the Vinho Verde region of Portugal. Vasco Croft leads this project as winemaker, with Rui Cunha as a consultant winemaker. The Aphros team harvests from 3 different Quintas, the oldest of which dates back to the 16 century. The sites are farmed using biodynamic techniques, producing harmony between soil, plants, animals, and human activity. No artificial chemicals are added to the soil and only natural compost and manure is used for fertilization. The wines that result from this care of the land are part of the “Slow Wine Movement” that is happening across Portugal.

TITLE: Aphros Vinho Verde Pan Sparkling Rose
DESCRIPTION: Named after the ancient Greek god of shepherds, flocks, and rustic music, this is one of the most unique and delicious sparkling wines we have tasted. Produced from 100% Vinhao (one of the very rare grapes with red flesh), only the briefest of macerations (practically direct to press) earns it a mesmerizing magenta hue. Traditional method– aged 26 months on the lees after primary fermentation before disgorgement.

TITLE: Arcane Distilling Fernet
DESCRIPTION: Arcane Fernet Liqueur is a Italian-style Amaro with a slightly new-world approach, making it the best mix of old and new. Arcane Fernet is crafted from a base spirit distilled from New York State grain and 20 traditional herbs with an unusual addition of American grown hops to bring out the smoothness to the spirit.

TITLE: Ardbeg "Arrrrrrrdbeg!" Limited Edition Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Ardbeg "Arrrrrrrdbeg!" is a special edition whisky from Islay, celebrating Mickey Heads, the Distillery Manager of Ardbeg, who retired in late 2020. The label, designed by Brazilian artist Butcher Billy, portrays Mickey Heads as a pirate, symbolizing his adventurous spirit. This whisky is the first Ardbeg release fully matured in ex-rye casks.

TITLE: Ardbeg "Grooves" Limited Edition Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: From the experimental folk at Ardbeg, comes this intensely mellow dram – Ardbeg Grooves. Here at Ardbeg, we’ve always been passionate about the benefits of an alternative lifestyle. We dig peat. But we also dig crofting, crocheting, Celtic crosses and campfires. And for this Limited Edition bottling, we’re rolling back the years to an Islay time gone by – back to village of Peat & Love. Produced using our grooviest casks ever, aromas of smoked spices combine with distant bonfires fading into a mellow haze of apple and smoked pear.

TITLE: Ardbeg "Monsters Of Smoke" Gift Set
Ardbeg "Wee Beastie" 5 Years Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The youthful age statement may take many scotch drinkers by surprise, but don’t let double-digit bias prevent you from enjoying this exciting yet easy-drinking peat bomb. Salt water and seaweed, smoke and sweet peat tussle on the nose, while vanilla, fresh berries, and ample nuttiness spread out and take hold. The structured, balanced palate is creamy, nutty, and spiced, showcasing brown-sugar bacon, smoked salt, milk chocolate, pepper, and well-integrated oak, all wrapped up like a cigar with flakes of ash and sustained smoke. This precocious youngster shows more complexity than some whiskies twice its age, making it a remarkable find

TITLE: Ardbeg 10 Year Old Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Ardbeg Ten Years Old is revered around the world as the peatiest, smokiest, a most complex single malt of them all. Yet it does not flaunt the peat; rather it gives way to the natural sweetness of the malt to produce a whisky of perfect balance. Typically most whiskies are chill-filtered and reduced to a strength of 40% ABV. Ardbeg Ten Years Old, however, is non-chill-filtered and has a strength of 46% ABV, thus retaining maximum flavor, at the same time giving more body and added depth. It’s a whisky with none of the goodness taken out!

TITLE: Ardbeg 19 Years Old Traigh Bhan Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Aroma: On the nose, faint ripples of sweet wood smoke and tart crème fraîche flow gently into bold notes of savoury fennel, celeriac and roasted tea leaves. Plunge further and discover alluring aromas of charcoal and lightly burnt toast.Taste: An intensely salty mouthfeel shifts like the tides in to soothing medicinal notes, followed by salted peanut brittle, smoked pineapple and lime juice. Waves of aniseed lap over the palate, before rich fudge, birch tar and peat smoke crash down wildly.Finish: Savoury and smoky notes collide in a sharp, intense, yet satisfyingly long finish.

TITLE: Ardbeg Anamorphic Committee Release 2023 Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Unveiling the Ardbeg Anamorphic Committee Release 2023, a true masterpiece from the renowned Ardbeg distillery nestled on the captivating Isle of Islay in Scotland. Crafted with precision and dedication, this limited edition whiskey pays homage to Ardbeg's legacy, offering enthusiasts a journey into the peaty depths of Islay's terroir. Embrace the exclusivity of the Committee Release, where tradition meets innovation in every sip.

TITLE: Ardbeg Anthology 13 Years Old Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the exceptional Ardbeg Anthology 13 Years Old Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky, a testament to the legacy and craftsmanship of the renowned Ardbeg distillery on the captivating Isle of Islay in Scotland. This limited edition release, aged for 13 years, offers a unique journey into the peaty depths and complex flavors that define Ardbeg's distinctive character.

TITLE: Ardbeg Auriverdes The Ultimate Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Distilled with equal measures of skill and passion, Ardbeg Aurivedes-golden whisky (auri), unmistakable green bottle (verde)-is destined to be the star of Ardbeg Day this year. The dram is rumoured to be a of a hot head on account of its toasted cask lids. The Ardbeg team is renowned for its technical expertise and Auriverdes is a winning example if this, with the toasted lids producing a mocha coffe flavour at one end, flowing into creamy vannila at the other-a match made in heven.

TITLE: Ardbeg Bizarrebq Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: You start with a hare-brained idea; you bring together three unique casks, two masters in their own right, and a lot of heat and smoke… what do you get? You get the Distillery’s first-ever barbecue-inspired whisky – Ardbeg BizarreBQ. Cooked up by renowned Master Distiller Dr. Bill Lumsden alongside the bonafide god of the grill, Christian Stevenson (AKA DJ BBQ), this mouth-watering malt packs a meaty, peaty punch. As with grilling, fire is a vital element in creating our first BBQ-inspired malt. Toasting a selection of three casks, double charred oak casks, Pedro Ximénez sherry casks, and BBQ casks, this combined recipe brings a sweet, tangy, smoky flavor… perfect for BBQ!

TITLE: Ardbeg Corryvreckan Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Ardbeg Corryvreckan takes its name from the famous whirlpool that lies to the north of Islay, where only the bravest souls dare to venture. Swirling aromas and torrents of deep, peaty, peppery taste lurk beneath the surface of this beautifully balanced dram. Like the whirlpool itself, Corryvreckan is not for the faint-hearted! Awarded The World’s Best Single Malt in 2010 by the World Whiskies Awards. Color: Deepest amber. Aroma: Heady, intense and powerful. Taste: Plunge into the whirlpool and taste the mysterious depths of Corryvreckan. Torrents of taste well up on the palate; deep, peppery and chewy, bombarding the tongue with its intense tastes and textures. Finish: Long, deep and remaining powerful into the finish with black tarry coffee, chocolate coated cherries and hot pepper sauce, the lingering memories of your mysterious and daring journey into Corryvreckan.

TITLE: Ardbeg Heavy Vapours Committee Release Islay Single Malt Scotch
DESCRIPTION: It is said that the merest whiff of classic Ardbeg transports you to another time and place. However, the aroma of this formidable smoky malt takes you to another dimension altogether. For it answers the improbable question: how would Ardbeg be without the pivotal influence of its legendary purifier? You’re about to find out. For this dram is the most full-blown Ardbeg ever. Take a deep breath, then a sip. And follow Agent 46 into the ARDverse.

TITLE: Ardbeg Heavy Vapours Islay Single Malt Scotch
DESCRIPTION: It is said that the merest whiff of classic Ardbeg transports you to another time and place. However, the aroma of this formidable smoky malt takes you to another dimension altogether. For it answers the improbable question: how would Ardbeg be without the pivotal influence of its legendary purifier? You’re about to find out. For this dram is the most full-blown Ardbeg ever. Take a deep breath, then a sip. And follow Agent 46 into the ARDverse.

TITLE: Ardbeg Scorch Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Matured in ex-bourbon American oak casks and heavily charred, Ardbeg Scorch (46% ABV) is said by the brand to give off aromas of soot and smoke while grilled fare and black licorice mingle with bold notes of a medicinal lozenge.

TITLE: Ardbeg Uigeadail Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: In 2009, Jim Murray’s Whisky Bible named Ardbeg Uigeadail ‘World Whisky of the Year’ – in praise of its “utter silky brilliance” and “complexity on a level only a handful of distilleries in the world can even dream of reaching.” Pronounced ‘Oog-a-dal’, it’s a special vatting that marries Ardbeg’s traditional deep, smoky notes with luscious, raisiny tones of old ex-Sherry casks. Ardbeg Uigeadail was voted by the 120,000+ strong Ardbeg Committee as their favourite Ardbeg.

TITLE: Ardmore 9 yrs Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Bottled in March 2018 at a strength of 46% ABV, it was aged in a pair of bourbon barrels.

TITLE: Ardnamurchan Distillery Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: An impressive start from one of Scotland’s newest single malt distillers, located on the remote Ardnamurchan (ard-na-murkan) peninsula in the western Highlands. Ardnamurchan Distillery produces both a peated and non-peated whisky and then combines the two. The result is a soft, pretty, honeyed profile, with gentle notes of lemon, poached pears, sea salt, and light drifts of peat smoke. Vanilla cream, ripe peaches, and apricot jam at the finish closing with a final note of peat. Artfully made, most notably with its subtle integration of smoke.Distilled at one of Scotland’s greenest distilleries, this is the first single malt released by Ardnamurchan to be available in the US. Each bottle is equipped with a blockchain-enabled QR code that enables a thorough exploration of the whisky’s provenance from grain to bottle. Single Malt Whisky distilled at Ardnamurchan (ard-na-murkan) Distillery on the westernmost peninsula of the Scottish Western Highlands (north of the Isle of Mull and south of the Isle of Skye) This bottling is entitled AD/03.21:02, 50/50 split of peated and unpeated malt in the mash bill Aged in ex-bourbon (65%) and ex-sherry (35%) casks Non-chill filtered; 46.8% ABV

TITLE: Armand Heitz Julienas
Armas de Guerra Bierzo Mencia Rosado
DESCRIPTION: A historic winery founded in 1879, making wines with old vines 50+ years old, from dry-farmed vineyards. In addition Guerra controls one-third of all the vineyard land in Bierzo (1,000 ha or 2,471 acres) and only makes wine with the best 10% of the grapes harvested. 100% Mencia. Vines planted since 1963. Tended in river stone and clay soil at 525 m (1,722 ft) elevation. The free-run juice is drained at low temperature without previous maceration and under an inert atmosphere. Alcoholic fermentation in stainless steel tanks for 12 days at 12C. 100% unoaked. This is a vegan wine.

TITLE: Armida Winery "Poizin" California Zinfandel
DESCRIPTION: Meat Pairings - Try pairing with lighter meats including Quail, Turkey, Pork, Bacon, Ham and Veal. Zinfandel works well with Barbecue red meats and lamb. Spices and Herbs - Ginger, Garlic, Rosemary, Curry, Turmeric, Cayenne, Clove, Nutmeg, Cinnamon, Vanilla, Cocoa, Black Pepper, Coriander, Fennel, and Saffron. Cheese Pairings - Look for hard and richly flavored cow’s and sheep’s milk cheeses such as Manchego, Bandage-wrapped Cheddar and Trentingrana. Vegetables & Vegetarian Fare - Use highly flavored vegetables to bring out the fruitiness in Zinfandel such as roasted tomato, red peppers, carmelized onion, roasted squash, apricot, peach, cranberry, spiced apple, and beets.

TITLE: Arndorfer "Anina Verde"
DESCRIPTION: Gruner Veltliner fermented on Riesling skins for ten days to gain more fruit expression and complexity. (To underline the labor-intensive quality of the way this wine is made: after the Riesling grapes are pressed whole-cluster, the Arndorfers take the pressed bunches out and separate the skins from the stems by hand.) Aged for four months in 2/3 stainless steel and 1/3 in used French oak barrels. 8 mg/l SO2 added before bottling. Unfined, unfiltered, and handled by gravity. One of three newer, experimental natural wines named after Martin’s three daughters, a way for him to continue pushing the limits of his winemaking.

TITLE: Arnot-Roberts Sonoma Coast Syrah
DESCRIPTION: From four Sonoma Coast vineyards located in cool, difficult conditions around Sebastapol and Petaluma Gap, resulting in a tense, edgy Syrah. A complex, concentrated wine to be enjoyed over the next 10 to 15 years with food.

TITLE: Arnot-Roberts Watson Ranch Chardonnay
DESCRIPTION: Elevate your wine experience with Arnot-Roberts Watson Ranch Chardonnay, an exquisite white wine crafted by the esteemed Arnot-Roberts winery. Sourced from the renowned Watson Ranch in California, this Chardonnay is a testament to precision winemaking and the unique terroir that defines the region.

TITLE: Art in the Age "Root"
DESCRIPTION: In the 1700’s, it was called "Root Tea.” An herbal remedy made with sassafras, sarsaparilla, birch bark and other wild roots and herbs. Native Americans taught the recipe to colonial settlers. As it was passed it down from generation to generation, it grew in potency and complexity. Particularly in the Pennsylvania hinterlands, where the ingredients naturally grow in abundance. At the close of the 19th century, as the Temperance movement conspired to take the fun out of everything, a Philadelphia pharmacist removed the alcohol from Root Tea and rechristened it (ironically) "Root Beer”. He did this so that hard drinking Pennsylvania coal miners and steelworkers could enjoy it in place of true alcoholic refreshment. He introduced his "Root Beer” in a big way at the still legendary 1876 Centennial Exhibition in Philadelphia. The rest, as you know, is flaccid history Here at Art in the Age, we thought it would be interesting and fun to turn back the clock and recreate a true pre-temperance alcoholic Root Tea. We’ve even made it certified organic, since back then, everything was organic. This is the opposite of corporate culture. It’s a genuine experience rooted in history and our own landscape. It is a truly interesting and contemplative quaff. Certainly like nothing else we have ever tasted before. It is NOT Root Beer flavored vodka or a sickly sweet liqueur. INGREDIENTS Birch Bark Just like the Root Teas that came before it, birch bark gives ROOT its pleasantly strong backbone of full-bodied aroma and flavor. Harvested from white birch trees, the bark is first subjected to a slow destructive distillation process that yields a crude birch tar. This tar is then steam distilled to produce a pure sap that is mixed in with ROOT’s cane sugar base. Black Tea Our smoked black tea gives ROOT its distinctive tea notes, burnished rose-gold hue, and delicate hints of smokiness. Instead of being dried in the sun like most other teas, the organic lapsang souchong tea we use is smoked over a pine fire to impart the necessary flavor requirements. Cane Sugar ROOT is distilled from a pure organic cane sugar base. Not excessively sugary, the cane sugar allows for great clarity in the finished spirit and accommodates ROOT’s earthier, slightly bitter undertones and its clean finish. Sassafras A couple hundred years ago, all the colonists made their Root Teas with sassafras root. However, scientists later found that the ingredient posed certain risks to the liver, and the FDA banned it as a food ingredient in the 1960s. No worries though, we’ve mighty close to approximating sassafras unique flavor with a mixture of organic citrus fruits, spearmint, and wintergreen. Citrus We use American-grown, pesticide-free, certified-organic lemons and oranges to give ROOT a subtle touch of citrus aroma and flavor that comes out when mixed, and to closely mimic the taste of sassafras root. Allspice Produced from the dried, unripe fruit of the Pimenta diocia plant, allspice was a favorite of many colonists who felt that the spice combined the flavors of several aromatic spices and added a desired layer of complexity to their Root Teas. Anise Aniseeds lends ROOT its licorice notes, which combine especially well with the sprits birch and sassafras flavors. Cloves A spice produced from the dried flower buds of clove trees, clove was another favorite ingredient in colonists’ highly spiced Root Teas. Native Americans also found the spice to relieve tooth pain. Cinnamon Cinnamon, much like ROOT’s birch flavoring, is harvested from the bark of the cinnamon tree through a similar process. Along with clove and nutmeg, it gives ROOT its pleasant baking spice flav Nutmeg The seed of a type of evergreen tree, nutmug, along with clove and cinnamon, contributes heavily to ROOT’s distinctive, highly spiced taste. Cardamom A member of the ginger family, cardamom’s strong, unique flavor is a welcome addition to ROOT’s well-rounded spiciness.

TITLE: Art in the Age "Snap" Ginger
DESCRIPTION: What would happen, we asked,if we took a traditional German "Lebkuchen” and distilled the ingredients into an organic spirit? What is a lebkuchen, you ask? A ginger snap! But not the mass-market, high-fructose junk at the supermarket. We’re talking a real Pennsylvania Dutch (which actually means Pennsylvania German, not Dutch. Many years ago, someone apparently misheard "deutsch” for "dutch”) ginger snap made with hearty blackstrap molasses and fresh ginger. The kind our mothers, grandmothers, and great-great-great-grandmothers used to make. "Lebkuchen” was invented by German monks in the 12th century and first appeared in America in the late 1600s when German Anabaptists looking for religious freedom came to Pennsylvania to be part of William Penn’s "Holy Experiment.” Although most people don’t know it, the Pennsylvania Dutch are a diverse and tolerant bunch, encompassing a mix of religions and the non-religious. What they all had in common was a strenuous work ethic and a robust culinary tradition. Because these early Germans were rustic farmers, they baked with hearty blackstrap molasses rather than refined sugar. Back then, this was considered backward and unsophisticated by the "English,” but today we know otherwise. Blackstrap molasses retains the natural goodness that gets stripped away by the refining process. It also provides a very distinct and earthy flavor. Of course, the Pennsylvania Dutch didn’t distill a Lebkuchen spirit. That was our idea. But we think it is a delicious one. There are other alcoholic ginger products on the market, but they are either sickly sweet liqueuers or artificially flavored vodkas. This is a sophisticated organic spirit based on authentic folk history designed for people who know how to drink. It’s the kind of genuine experience we wish there was more of in the world. Try it and you will say "nix besser,” which is Pennsylvania Dutch for "none better."

TITLE: Art of The Spirits  "Heroes" 19 Year Old Wheated Single Barrel Bourbon The Prime Barrel Pick #105
DESCRIPTION: Introducing the Art of the Spirits 19-Year-Old Straight Bourbon Whiskey, a rare and distinguished expression crafted with a mash bill of 51% corn, 45% wheat, and 4% malted barley. Aged to perfection for 19 years and bottled at a robust 121.6 proof, this bourbon is a true masterpiece from an undisclosed Missouri distillery. The nose opens with rich aromas of caramel corn, beautifully complemented by the whiskey's elegant gold hue. On the palate, expect a sweet, velvety caramel corn flavor balanced by subtle notes of smooth, earthy oak that linger on the finish. This special release features a beautifully designed label honoring firefighters, embodying the bravery and dedication of those who serve. In conjunction with the launch of our 14-year-old "Honored To Serve" expression, which pays tribute to fallen police officers, we're proud to release this bourbon just in time for the 9/11 anniversary. A portion of the proceeds from each bottle sold will be donated to the Tunnel to Towers Foundation, supporting a cause that deeply resonates with the spirit of this release. Celebrate a timeless spirit while giving back to a meaningful cause with the Art of the Spirits 19-Year-Old Straight Bourbon Whiskey.

TITLE: Art of The Spirits "Honored To Serve" 14 Year Old Single Barrel Bourbon The Prime Barrel Pick #104
DESCRIPTION: Introducing the Art of the Spirits 14-Year-Old Straight Bourbon Whiskey, a genuinely exceptional expression crafted with a unique 65% Corn / 17.5% Wheat / 17.5% Rye mashbill. Aged for 14 years in new 53-gallon American oak barrels, this bourbon is a testament to time-honored craftsmanship. Unlike MGP-sourced spirits, this unique distillate hails from an undisclosed Missouri distillery, ensuring a distinctive character that sets it apart. At robust 133.4 proof, the nose offers rich aromas of caramel corn, beautifully complemented by an elegant golden hue. On the palate, expect a sweet, indulgent caramel corn flavor, perfectly balanced by a hint of smooth, earthy oak on the finish. In honor of the upcoming 9/11 anniversary, we're proud to launch this special bourbon alongside our 19-year-old "Heroes" expression. A portion of the proceeds from each bottle sold will be donated to the Tunnel to Towers Foundation, supporting a cause that truly resonates with the spirit of this release. Elevate your collection while giving back to a worthy cause with the Art of the Spirits 14-Year-Old Straight Bourbon Whiskey.

TITLE: ArteNOM 1549 Organic Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: This valley-agave selection (elev. 4,200’) comes from El Arenal, where Ramón Sandoval carefully distills this delicious un-aged tequila from certified-organic agave. The valley growing conditions lend this spirit a distinctive herbaceous flavor with warm aromatics, and a fresh, vegetal bouquet with intriguing notes of cacao and subtle spice

TITLE: ArteNOM Seleccion 1579 Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: The mountain town of Jesús-María (elev. 6,079’) is tequila’s highest altitude agave region, and the El Pandillo Distillery is arguably one of the most forward-thinking and sustainable distilleries in the business. There, Felipe Camarena masterfully crafts this bright, aromatic tequila from stressed hillside agave plants, slowly roasted in brick ovens and macerated intact with fiber for a pronounced agave flavor.

TITLE: Artomana Txakolina Xarmant Txakoli
DESCRIPTION: In Spain’s coastal Basque Country, “Xarmant” (char-mant) means ‘charming’ and txakoli is the joyous, light, white wine shared amongst friends with northern Spain’s legendary cuisine. Xarmant is made from the highest quality, sustainably-farmed, estate vineyards from the verdant Amurrio valley in the Basque Country, close to the Bay of Biscay on Spain’s rugged, green northern coast. Its proximity to the Atlantic Ocean creates a unique, ideal microclimate to produce this ‘charming’ wine.

TITLE: Asabiraki Suijin Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Asabiraki is one of the most awards winning sake breweries in Iwate pref. Their brew master has honor of WINNING GOLD MEDALS 12 YEARS RUNNINGS at the National New Sake Competition. That has proved the constant quality work of Asabiraki sake.Like a Water Dragon, the God of Water, Asabiraki Sujijin is smooth, strong & dry profile Junmai sake. Suijin is a great supporter to bring up every flavour of your meal. Almost like premium water. If you would like to drink sake during a meal, doesn't matter its Japanese dish or not, this sake will definitely make your meal at least twice taste better. Drink chilled in a hot summer day or drink warm (45 degree) in a cold winter time.

TITLE: Asabiraki Yukiwatari Nigori Sake
DESCRIPTION: Dry and rich unfiltered sake with smooth taste, aged a cool temperature for 6 monts.

TITLE: Asahi Shuzo Dassai 23 Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: With its rice milling of 23% which is the highest milling of all commercial sake has been received very well around the world.

TITLE: Asahi Shuzo Dassai 39 Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: It can truly be said that DASSAI Beyond was more than a decade-in-the-making. The origins of this rare and extraordinary sake began with a simple, yet most challenging ambition: to handcraft a sake that would surpass the excellence of DASSAI 23, widely praised by critics as a "perfect" sake. And so, driven by the passion of DASSAI's founder, Hiroshi Sakurai, he and his small group of the finest sake artisans began their quest to improve upon perfection at DASSAI's tiny, countryside brewery in Yamaguchi prefecture. With its rice milling of 39%, it is a second best quality defined by its rice milling after 23%. It has smooth and mellow taste with refreshing finish.

TITLE: Asahi Shuzo Dassai 45 Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Milling Rate: 50% Alcohol: 15.5% Rice: Yamadanishiki Sake Meter Value: +3 Acidity: 1.5

TITLE: Asahi Shuzo Dassai 45 Nigori Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Unlike most other nigori sakes, this sake is not too sweet and leaves no clogging finish. Instead, this nigori sake is a full-flavored, refreshing, semi-dry sake. Milling Rate: 50%Alcohol: 15.5%Rice: Yamadanishiki Sake Meter Value: +3 Acidity: 1.6

TITLE: Asahi Shuzo Kubota Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1830 with the motto of "quality first". Brewing sake is making rice. Not only do they focus on obtaining high quality sake rice, they dedicate time and effort in their labs to increase said rice's quality. Their efforts do not stop there however - in order to help sustain the environment, they implement the ISO14000 system of environmental sustainability, and also participate in various activities to preserve their natural surroundings. Additionally, they hold tea ceremonies, concerts, and cultural events for the local community. The goal is to make a fun, sustainable, and ultimately enjoyable environment with sake. Caprese, Oyster, Nanban pickled smelt, Marinated salmon.

TITLE: Asamai Shuzo Ama No To Heaven's Door Tokubetsu Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: The epitome of the “local” farm-to-table movement, this sake is made only with rice, water, and labor from its own prefecture. Ama No To translates to “Heaven’s Door,” referring to the prefecture which is at the northernmost tip of Japan. The label image is an icon of good fortune from Amaterasu, the Shinto Sun Goddess who is believed to have brought light to the world and cultivated Japan’s first rice fields. Try it with game birds, pork ribs, or wild mushrooms. It is also the perfect pairing for pickled and fermented foods.

TITLE: Asnella Single Vineyard Vino Verde
DESCRIPTION: Asnella is a single vineyard Vinho Verde that exposes an unexplored side of the Vinho Verde DOC. In addition to the delicious, lightly effervescent aperitif-style wines that are most frequently exported from this part of Northern Portugual, there is a whole category of terroir-driven, artisan wines that has heretofore gone unnoticed. The vineyard where Asnella is grown is on the border between the Southern side of the Vinho Verde DOC and the Northern edge of the Douro. This vineyard a fault line that separates two very different soil types – the schist of the Northern Douro and the granite of the Douro, as noted on either side of the label. The blend of these two parcels in the vineyard imbues the wine with a profound minerality and weight uncommon for Vinho Verde.

TITLE: Astarbe Sagardotegia Sidra Natural
DESCRIPTION: Refreshing, fruity and Txinparta cider. A dry finish, which cleans the mouth and ask for another sip

TITLE: Astral Tequila Anejo
DESCRIPTION: Astral Tequila presents the Añejo, an embodiment of Mexico's rich tequila-making heritage, brought to life through meticulous craftsmanship and tradition. Produced in Jalisco, this tequila is aged in oak barrels, giving it a deep amber color and complex profile enthusiasts will relish. Astral Tequila Añejo is a spirit that truly exemplifies the finesse and character of the blue agave, intensified by the time it matures in the oak. The Astral Tequila Añejo, with its complex flavor profile, is an excellent partner to a broad array of dishes. Its sweet and woody character pairs well with hearty meat dishes like slow-roasted pork or grilled steak. It also complements spicier fare, like enchiladas with a rich mole sauce. On the sweeter side, it pairs nicely with desserts featuring caramel, dark chocolate, or dried fruits. A cheese board with a range of creamy to sharp cheeses would beautifully reflect the tequila's complexity. To fully appreciate the Astral Tequila Añejo, consider enjoying it neat, allowing its depth and balance to be savored without distraction.

TITLE: Astral Tequila Blanco
DESCRIPTION: Astral Tequila is made with 100% Blue Weber agave, slowly nurtured by the cyclical passing of warm daylight skies and cool luminous nights, where the sun and the stars meet.

TITLE: Astral Tequila Reposado
DESCRIPTION: Astral Tequila brings a magnificent Reposado, a spirit that perfectly encapsulates the traditional tequila-making practices of Jalisco, Mexico. Astral Tequila Reposado is a tequila connoisseur's delight with its deep golden hue and rich flavor profile. The tequila is aged in oak barrels, imparting it with its distinctive color and a complex blend of flavors that elevate the taste of the blue agave from which it's made. The Astral Tequila Reposado pairs wonderfully with a wide variety of foods. Its sweet and spicy profile complements Mexican cuisine exceptionally well, pairing beautifully with enchiladas, grilled fish tacos, or a rich mole. The tequila's sweetness also makes it a great match for caramel or vanilla desserts. A cheese board with a mix of sharp and creamy cheeses, such as Manchego or a creamy Brie, can complement the tequila's complex flavors. Alternatively, savor the Astral Tequila Reposado to appreciate its depth and intricacies fully.

TITLE: ASW Distillery “Duality” Cask Strength Double Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A delicious symphony of rye and cherry-smoked malted barley, for the World's 1st Double Malt and Georgia's 1st Ever Double Gold Whiskey. It was a "happy accident" or "experiment gone right", depending on who you ask.

TITLE: ASW Distillery “Duality” Double Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A delicious symphony of rye and cherry-smoked malted barley, for the World's 1st Double Malt and Georgia's 1st Ever Double Gold Whiskey. It was a "happy accident" or "experiment gone right", depending on who you ask.

TITLE: Atago No Matsu "Waiting Love" Tokubetsu Honjozo Sake
DESCRIPTION: A remarkably elegant honjozo popular with local Miyagi drinkers, this is made from premium Yamada Nishiki rice milled to 60%.

TITLE: Atelier del Maestro Tequilero Extra Añejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Atelier del Maestro Tequilero Extra Añejo comprises tequilas aged in small barrels of American white oak and oak from Europe. This añejo spent 36 extra months resting in toasted French oak barrels. The cooking process is slow and meticulous. Derived from the French "Atelier," Atelier del Maestro is a project celebrating Oaxacan artisan masters. Each bottle is hand-painted with the same technique used to make the traditional alebrijes of Oaxaca — a brightly colored Mexican folk art sculpture of a mythical creature. This limited edition extra añejo has a mix of unmistakable aromas such as cooked agave, vanilla tones, dried fruits, spices, and a delicate touch of toasted almond.

TITLE: Atilia Montepulciano d'Abruzzo
DESCRIPTION: Jasci family has been producing wine for three generations, focusing all efforts on the pursuit of the absolute quality of every bottle. A passion for wine that was born with grandfather Pasquale and his wife Maria in the '60s, growing over the years thanks to his son Giuseppe and his wife Irma, who gave the historic turn of the organic in 1980, handed down since the early '90s to Donatello Jasci and his wife Piera, who lead the company with the help and participation of their predecessors who still bring experience and wisdom.

TITLE: Attitude by Pascal Jolivet Vin de Pays du Val de Loire Pinot Noir Rose
DESCRIPTION: Attitude Rose is the result of traditional wine making techniques from grapes grown in the Loire Valley. The vineyard soils are chalky and calcareous clay, with the potential to give Attitude lovely fruit aromas and freshness on the palate. The Attitude Rose is a blend of press wine and juice obtained using the saignée method, where some of the juice of wine macerated on the skins has been bled off. The juice is produced from grapes that are macerated that have not been sorted or de-stemmed.

TITLE: Au Bon Climat Santa Barbara County Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Santa Barbara County Pinot Noir is a blend of Pinot Noir from six vineyards: Bien Nacido, Rancho Vinedo and Le Bon Climat which are all in the Santa Maria Valley, two vineyards in the Los Alamos Valley: Los Alamos Vineyard and Kick-On Vineyard, and one in the Santa Rita appellation: Pence Ranch. There is also 5% Mondeuse from Bien Nacido blended into this vintage. We kept most small lots of Pinot Noir separate for the first 6 months. Pinot Noir takes at least 6 months to reveal itself and until the wine can be effectively evaluated, we don’t blend, but the 2014 Pinots tasted delicious from the start. In its youth, match this wine with lamb or dried meats. After a few years as the flavors coalesce, it will pair better with Salmon or mild red sauce with pasta. The possible food pairings are almost endless.

TITLE: Auchentoshan 17 yrs Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Gaelic for “the field of the corner,” Auchentoshanis found in western Scotland’s Lowland region. Located in the foothills of Kilpatrick, the distillery has been dubbed “Glasgow’s Malt Whisky” due to it’s close proximity to the city. The distillery’s triple distillation process gives the malts a delicate, sweeter flavor.

TITLE: Auchentoshen 2000 Bourbon Barrel Cask16 yrs Lowland Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Gaelic for “the field of the corner,” Auchentoshan is found in western Scotland’s Lowland region. Located in the foothills of Kilpatrick, the distillery has been dubbed “Glasgow’s Malt Whisky” due to its close proximity to the city. TITLE: Augusta Distillery Buckner's 10 Cask Strength Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Limited Edition, Gold Medal Winner, Cask Strength Bourbon Experience the exceptional Buckner's 10, a limited edition, single-barrel Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey from Augusta Distillery. This 2024 San Francisco World Spirits Competition gold medal winner boasts a rich, complex flavor profile.
