TITLE: Augusta Distillery Buckner's 17 Cask Strength Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Augusta Distillery Buckner's 17 Cask Strength Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a rare and exceptional bourbon that exemplifies the artistry and craftsmanship of Augusta Distillery. Aged for 17 years and bottled at cask strength, this single barrel expression offers bourbon enthusiasts a bold and complex whiskey that reflects the rich heritage of Kentucky bourbon. With each barrel bottled individually, the nuances of flavor in every release are unique, making Buckner's 17 a prized collector's item. The high proof, typically around 125-130, delivers an intense yet well-balanced experience, showcasing the depth of flavor achieved through careful aging.

TITLE: Augusta Distillery Old Route 8 Cask Strength Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Discover Augusta Distillery's inaugural bourbon, Old Route 8, a gold medal winner at the 2024 San Francisco World Spirits Competition. This single-barrel Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey is sourced from an undisclosed Kentucky distillery (rumored to be Heaven HIll) and bottled at cask strength. Tasting Notes: Lush aromas: maple sugar candy, smoked cedar, dehydrated lemon Palate: crème brûlée, saltwater taffy Finish: arugula, white pepper Crafted with Precision: Mash bill: 78% corn, 13% rye, 9% malted barley Aged 8 years in new charred American oak Non-chill filtered Unique Characteristics: Single barrel expression, ensuring distinct nuances Bottled at cask strength (127.3 Proof)

TITLE: Aultmore 10 Years Speyside Hogshead 86 Proof Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
Auntsfield Single Vineyard Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Auntsfield Estate aims to produce a distinctive style of Sauvignon Blanc, defined by a riper flavor spectrum and textural palate (both derived from the rich clay soils of the vineyard) with an underlying minerality. The 2018 season was characterized by regular rainfall at key growth stages. A very dry and warm early summer was followed by wetter more challenging conditions with vineyard work focused around reducing yields and keeping the canopies open and dry. This allowed the fruit to ripen in the cooler conditions of early autumn to optimum ripeness. A season that rewarded vigilance, open canopies and fruit that ripened before the Autumn rains. Handpicked estate fruit. Cool fermentation with cultured yeast in stainless steel tanks was utilized to retain the fresh varietal aromatics. This was balanced by a portion of the fruit subjected to traditional winemaking practices: whole bunch pressed and fermented in seasoned oak barrels, adding texture and length to the wine. The result is a hand-crafted wine combining the bright fresh fruit characters with an underlying minerality and fine structure.

TITLE: Austin Hope Westside Red Troublemaker Red Rhone Blend
DESCRIPTION: Bean-based dishes, beef: roast, black bean sauces: with Asian dishes, boar: wild, brisket, cheddar, cheddar: sharp: 5 years - 12 years, cheddar: smoked, chicken: butter, cold meats, curries: creamy, curries: spicy, jack: garlic & onion, jack: garlic dill, kangaroo, lamb kebabs with vegetables, lamb shank, lasagna, mackerel, paella, pasta with bolognese sauce, pasta with herbed tomato sauce, pizza: combination, pork chops, pork tenderloin, rabbit, romano, sauce: cranberry, Spanish dishes, steak au poivre, tourtiere.

TITLE: Avalon Cabernet Sauvignon California
DESCRIPTION: We believe that a good bottle of wine should cost about the same as a one-day ticket to Woodstock in 1969. Only by using grapes from around the state can we deliver on that promise. Coastal vineyards impart the core of intense fruit flavors found in our wines year after year. Blending also provides the layers of flavors that sing more like a band than a solo act. - Winery Rosemary and garlic lamb chops, Cornbread Dressing with Roasted Fall Vegetables, Roasted spiced sweet popato, French onion and olive tart, Beef vegetable soup.

TITLE: Averna Amaro
DESCRIPTION: Averna has always been a guarantee of high quality and reliability, and thanks to its wide product range, it is suitable to have any time of day with its harmonious tastes joining tradition and modernity. The delicate taste of the herbs, synonymous of balance and naturalness, alternates with modern and dynamic tastes. Averna keeps up the range and the standard of its products.

TITLE: Aviation Deadpool Limited Edition American Gin
DESCRIPTION: Aviation Deadpool Limited Edition American Gin is a special release from the acclaimed House Spirits Distillery in Oregon, USA. This limited edition gin celebrates the iconic character Deadpool, blending the signature smoothness of Aviation Gin with a playful twist. Crafted using a unique blend of botanicals including juniper, cardamom, and lavender, this American gin is known for its balanced and nuanced flavor profile. Perfect for mixing in your favorite cocktails or enjoying on its own, Aviation Deadpool Limited Edition Gin combines quality craftsmanship with a touch of comic book fun.

TITLE: Aviation Wolverine Limited Edition American Gin
DESCRIPTION: Aviation Wolverine Limited Edition American Gin is a bold and distinctive spirit that captures the adventurous spirit of the Wolverine character. Crafted in Oregon by House Spirits Distillery, this limited edition gin is a testament to precision and craftsmanship. Using a blend of unique botanicals, Aviation Gin offers a smooth and balanced profile that stands out in any cocktail. Whether enjoyed neat, in a classic gin and tonic, or as the base for creative cocktails, Aviation Wolverine Limited Edition American Gin delivers an unparalleled taste experience.

TITLE: Avinyo Petillant Penedes Blanc Vi d'Agulla
DESCRIPTION: Avinyo Petillant is a vi d’agulla, the Catalan term for a prickly wine bottled with a little natural effervescence retained from the winemaking process. This vibrant and refreshing wine is the traditional summertime quaffer of the Penedes region of Catalonia, and it’s perfect for drinking out of a porrón. Petillant is made with a blend of two organically-farmed, estate vineyards. Finca La Guardia is the highest, most rugged vineyard on the property at 350 meters; here muscat de Frontignan was planted in 2003 in the stony calcareous-clay soils. Macabeo and xarel-lo are grown in the Finca Can Fontanals vineyard, planted from 1978 to 1988.

TITLE: Avion Tequila Silver
DESCRIPTION: Avion was born from a love of tequila and its rich robust agave flavor. Founder Ken Austin embarked on a journey to fulfill his dream and create a tequila that would celebrate the highlands’ agave flavor. This led Ken to Jesus Maria, where the world’s best agave is grown and where the Lopez family lovingly manages the land. Together in collaboration Ken and the Lopez family spent years blending old-school tequila making techniques with a philosophy of never cutting corners and focusing on the art of creating tequila. Every step of the process works to preserve and enhance the natural, rich, roasted flavors of the Avion agave. This is Avion, which bartenders, consumers and experts describe as, quite simply, delicious.

TITLE: Ayres Vineyard Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: The wines at Ayres are comprised primarily of Pinot Noir’s crafted from Dijon and Pommard clones. From the entry level Willamette Valley to the single vineyards, the Pinots from Ayres are textured and have clarity of fruit with a balancing freshness. In addition, Brad has become very fond of Gamay and is making a bright, crunchy version that will grow in production. Small amounts of Pinot Blanc and Rose are also produced.

TITLE: Az. Agr. Costadila Bianco Frizzante Col Fondo Cru 330 slm
DESCRIPTION: Costadila ('the hillside over there') was founded by Ernesto Cattel and a group of partners in 2006. Though Ernesto has now quit his full time job to focus entirely on the operation, everything started as a labor of love. The Costadilà project's goal is to valorize and rejuvenate Tarzo's rich agricultural traditions by reintroducing natural farming to the region. The scope goes well beyond wine, with a strong emphasis on polyculture: a farm where vines, fruits, vegetables, cereals and livestock coexist on the same plots of land. Completing the cycle, the produce grown from Costadila land is then used and sold in local businesses. By creating this "model farm" for the region, Ernesto and his partners hope to show a successful example to other farmers trapped in a monoculture economy.

TITLE: Az. Agr. Costadila Bianco Frizzante Col Fondo Cru 450 slm
DESCRIPTION: 450 refers to the elevation of this parcel in Zuel, Combai, planted 1953

TITLE: Az. Agr. Costadila Colli Trevigiani 280 slm
DESCRIPTION: The grapes for this wine are sourced from organic vineyards located 280 meters above sea level (hence the “280”). Maceration in stainless steel tanks then fermented and aged in demi-muids. Re-fermented in bottle with must from the same vintage. Never disgorged. nextSectiobIt’s aromatic and cloudy, with loads of pear and apple skin and a yeasty undertone. And though it’s far less funky than it looks, it definitely is not your all-purpose, party-pounding Prosecco. This is seriously cool wine that deserves to be taken seriously.

TITLE: Az. Agr. Costadila Moz Vino Frizzante Bianco
Az. Agr. Costadila O-X Vino Bianco Frizzante
Az. Agr. Costadila Vino da Tavola Rosso
Azienda Agricola COS Terre Siciliane Zibibbo in Pithos
DESCRIPTION: Embark on a sensory journey with Azienda Agricola COS Terre Siciliane Zibibbo in Pithos, an extraordinary white wine that reflects the essence of Sicily. Crafted by the esteemed Azienda Agricola COS, this Zibibbo is a testament to tradition, innovation, and the unique aging process in clay amphorae known as "Pithos."

TITLE: Azienda Agricola Flavia Alle Catarratto- Zibibbo Terre Siciliane Bio LITER
DESCRIPTION: 80% Catarratto, 20% Zibibo Elegant and majestic, the Flavia Allè Catarratto Zibibbo is produced with 80% Catarratto and 20% Zibibbo, manually selected from the historic vineyards owned by the Rallo family since 1860. Using native yeasts and no filtering or fining bring out the essence of the terroir. The proximity to the Riserva dello Stagnone and the Saline of Marsala, the maturation in French oak barrels and the refinement in the bottle personalize the greatness of this wine, endowed with elegance and intense aromas. The Allè Catarratto Zibibbo has a bright straw yellow color with orangish reflections.

TITLE: Azienda Agricola Flavia Etna Rosso
DESCRIPTION: Azienda Agricola Flavia Etna Rosso Bio LITER is a bold and flavorful red wine from the Etna region of Sicily. It is made from 100% Nerello Mascalese grapes, which are known for their intense flavor and structure. This wine has a deep ruby color and aromas of ripe black fruit, spice, and leather. On the palate, it is full-bodied and tannic, with flavors of black cherry, plum, and licorice. The wine has a long and lingering finish. Azienda Agricola Flavia Etna Rosso Bio LITER is a versatile wine that can be enjoyed with a variety of foods. It is particularly well-suited to grilled meats, pasta dishes, and stews. It can also be enjoyed on its own as a digestif.

TITLE: Azienda Agricola Flavia Terre Siciliane Alfara Orange Wine
DESCRIPTION: Azienda Agricola Flavia Terre Siciliane Alfara Skin Contact Bio Liter is a unique and delicious orange wine from the Sicily region of Italy. It is made from Grillo grapes, which are typically used to make white wine. However, for this wine, the grapes are left in contact with their skins for a period of time, which gives the wine its orange color and unique flavor profile. This wine has a hazy amber color and aromas of orange peel, apricot, and spice. On the palate, it is dry and medium-bodied, with flavors of orange, peach, and spice. The wine has a long and refreshing finish. Azienda Agricola Flavia Terre Siciliane Alfara Skin Contact Bio Liter is a versatile wine that can be enjoyed with a variety of foods. It is particularly well-suited to grilled fish, poultry, and pork dishes. It can also be enjoyed on its own as an aperitif.

TITLE: Azienda Agricola Monteversa Primaversa
DESCRIPTION: Coming from 20 year old vines grown on chalky, clay soils, this sparkling wine is a fun little bubbly. Hand-harvested, the grapes are pressed lightly and fermented naturally in tanks. Unfermented juice is added back to the wine, resulting in a secondary fermentation in bottle. Undosed, unfined, unfiltered and unsulfured, this is a fun breezy bubbly that's closed with a crown cap.

TITLE: Azienda Agricola Panzanello le Piazzole Toscana IGT
DESCRIPTION: The 2009 Panzanello ‘Le Piazzole’ is 70% Sangiovese and 30% Merlot and was fermented and aged entirely in stainless steel. Sangiovese pairs with a wide range of foods because of its medium weighted body and savory character. Use Sangiovese’s savory as a congruent flavor with herbs and tomatos. This technique will actually bring out more fruity flavors in the wine. A Sangiovese with high tannins will work perfectly with rich roasted meat, cured sausages and hard cheeses. Vegetarians Delight! - when pairing Sangiovese wine with vegetarian fare, be sure to work with lipids like butter and olive oil so that the richness in the fat helps cut through the wines’ tannins. Also, use less sugar on braised or roasted veggies to ensure the wine tastes fruitier.

TITLE: Azienda Agricola Sofia Etna Rosso Gioacchino
DESCRIPTION: Carmelo Sofia runs the winery along with his sister, Valentina. This wine is named after his father, Gioacchino, who helps out - mainly in the vineyard. The vehicle on the label is called Ape Piaggio in Italian or Lapa in Siciliano. Piaggio is the same company that makes the Vespa Scooter.

TITLE: Azimut Penedes "Brisat Orange"
DESCRIPTION: “Brisa” means pomace in Catalan, hence “Brisat” is the traditional term for skin contact wines in the Penedés area.

TITLE: Azimut Penedes Negre
DESCRIPTION: Vineyard: a 5-hectare plot at 250 meters of altitude, that has a southern exposure with a slight slope, with Mediterranean breezes in the morning and afternoon. 20-year-old vines on calcareous clay. Varieties: 40% Ull de Llebre(Tempranillo), 20% Garnatxa, 20% Monastrell, 10% Syrah, 10% Samsó (Carignan) Vinification Method: Vinified in 15,000-liter stainless steel tanks for 20 days with only indigenous yeasts. After which, the wine goes into concrete tanks for 8-15 months for malolactic fermentation and battonage for 3 months. The wine is unfined and goes through a soft paper filter to remove tartaric particles. It is lightly sulfured at bottling.

TITLE: Azuma Rikishi Junmai Ginjyo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Azuma Rikishi Junmai Ginjyo is brewed from Gohyakumangoku sake rice. It is a Cave-Aged sake that is charcoal filtered only once prior to bottling to produce a mellow, moderately fruit-forward. It has a subdued brightness, a mildly fruit-forward moderate body with a sharper finish.

TITLE: Bacardi Superior White Rum
DESCRIPTION: Originated in 1862, Bacardi Superior rum is the original, mixable, light-bodied rum aged between one to two years in carefully selected oak barrels. After ageing, the rums are blended and passed through a second charcoal filtration to achieve maximum clarity and characteristic Bacardi smoothness. Cuba Libre Cocktail How do you make it? Ingredients: 1 1/2 ounce Bacardi Superior Light Rum Coca-Cola Instructions: Pour rum into a rocks glass with ice. Top with cola and garnish with a lime wedge. How would you describe its taste? Sweet, like caramel. When is it best to drink? Evenings, as a pre-meal cocktail. Who drinks it? Everyone! It's a popular classic.

TITLE: Bacardi Superior White Rum Limited Edition Heritage Bottle
DESCRIPTION: A very smart Bacardi modelled on an original bottle and label design used by the company in 1909 when operations were still in Cuba. Released to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the Daiquiri's arrival in the USA, this has been bottled at the original strength of 44.5% for a much fuller flavour than the standard Carta Blanca.

TITLE: Bacaro Veneto Pinot Grigio
DESCRIPTION: Bacaro is a collaboration brought to us by Bacchanal Wine Imports, and it represents the direct involvement of Bacchanal’s family into the selection of the wines. This unique advantage guarantees consumers the highest quality for the best price. The selection is made in strict collaboration with the wine maker and the producer each year so that consistency is maintained year after year. Grilled vegetables, seafood first courses, and light, salted fish. It is exceptional with lasagna, pasta dishes and with crab salad and crab spread. Great with the typical Venetian Cuisine.

TITLE: Bacchus Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: David Gordon has been the wine director at Tribeca Grill, the famed New York City restaurant since 1990. Owned by restaurateur Drew Nieporent and actor Robert DeNiro, Tribeca Grill features a dynamic wine program with a list of over 1800 selections and is a Grand Award winner from the Wine Spectator-one of only 6 in New York City. David created the Bacchus label to offer great value California wine by utilizing the many contacts he has in Napa and Sonoma to source the finest grapes available. Producers such as Caymus, Lewis Cellars and Miner Family provided grapes and helped with the winemaking for earlier cuvees. The wineries that are currently used wish to remain anonymous, but the quality has remained very high.

TITLE: Bacchus Ginger's Cuvee Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Source - 85% Monterey, 15% Sonoma Winemaking - 50% fermented in tank, 50% fermented in neutral oak Aging - 8 months in large neutral oak Alcohol- 13.8%

TITLE: Badia A Coltibuono Chianti Classico Roberto Stucchi
DESCRIPTION: The parcels are vinified separately, blended and aged for a few months in French oak barrels and barriques. After bottling, the wine rests for a few months before release. When you think of pairing Chianti with food, most people think of pasta with a red sauce but there is so much more that you can pair with Chianti. It’s a great compliment to strong tasting poultry dishes, spiced lamb, or even beef (as long as its not overly fatty). If you are looking for a good wine with pizza, Chianti is your choice.

TITLE: Baileys Original Irish Cream
DESCRIPTION: Baileys Irish Cream is an Irish whiskey and cream based liqueur, made by Gilbeys of Ireland. It has a declared alcohol content of 17% alcohol by volume. Probably the best known irish cream in the World. It is made from a mix of cream, eggs, chocolate and Irish whiskey.Bailey's Irish Cream can either be served straight, on the rocks or be used as a mixer.

DESCRIPTION: Baileys Irish Cream is an Irish whiskey and cream based liqueur, made by Gilbeys of Ireland. It has a declared alcohol content of 17% alcohol by volume. Probably the best known irish cream in the World. TITLE: Baker's 13 Year Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Baker's 13 Year Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a rare and exceptional expression from the James B. Beam Distilling Co. This single barrel bourbon, aged for a full 13 years, offers a deep and complex flavor profile that highlights the time-honored tradition of Kentucky bourbon-making. Bottled at 107 proof, this bourbon delivers robust flavors and a bold character, perfect for those who appreciate well-aged, high-proof whiskeys. Each bottle is hand-selected, ensuring a unique tasting experience that showcases the nuances and depth of every barrel. Whether enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in a classic cocktail, Baker's 13 Year is a must-try for bourbon enthusiasts and collectors alike.

TITLE: Baker's 7 Years (Old Label)  Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Baker’s Bourbon is named after Baker Beam—the grandnephew of Jim Beam himself. So it comes at no surprise that Baker’s Bourbon is a subsidiary of Beam Suntory. It is one of their four “small batch series” Bourbons, all of which are highly rated, delicious, and pack a unique character. This Mahogany-colored dram is aged for 7 years and comes out of the bottle at 53.5% ABV (107 proof). The strength fits the dram like glue... but it does go well with some ice. Don't overthink it. Pour yourself a drink, take a second to steel yourself and then cast your calm gaze upon the envious eyes of all the wannabes and pretenders at the party.

TITLE: Baker's 7 Years Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Baker's 7-Year Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a unique expression within the bourbon world, representing the next evolution of Baker’s brand. Originally a small batch product, Baker’s transitioned to a single barrel offering towards the end of 2019, providing a distinct experience with each bottle. Baker's Bourbon is part of the Small Batch Collection from Jim Beam, named after Baker Beam, grandnephew of Jim Beam. The bourbon is crafted individually, with each barrel finding its own special spot in the rickhouses, aging patiently for a minimum of seven years. This process extracts rich vanilla tones from the charred oak, contributing to the bourbon’s full-bodied flavor profile.

TITLE: Baker's 7 Years Single Barrel Kentucky Straight High Rye Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Baker's 7 Years Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a distinguished expression from the renowned Jim Beam Distillery. This bourbon is aged for a minimum of seven years, allowing it to develop a deep and complex character. As a single barrel release, each bottle offers a unique taste profile, capturing the individual nuances of the barrel it matured in. Bottled at a robust 107 proof, Baker's delivers a rich and full-bodied experience that honors the legacy of Baker Beam, grandnephew of the legendary Jim Beam. With its carefully crafted mashbill and meticulous aging process, this bourbon stands as a testament to the timeless traditions of Kentucky bourbon-making.

TITLE: Balance Boldly Brut
Balblair 15 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The second whisky in the Balblair Collection, Balblair 15 Year Old is a full-bodied, velvety single malt that has been matured in ex-bourbon casks and finished in first-fill Spanish oak butts. This creates a rich, sweet whisky with spicy aromas of honey, gingerbread and prunes. The palate is velvety-smooth and full of dark chocolate, tropical fruit, and warm spice notes.

TITLE: Balcones Bottle-In-Bond Pot Distilled Straight Whiskey Rye 100 Proof
DESCRIPTION: Balcones Bottle-In-Bond Pot Distilled Straight Whiskey Rye is a fine expression of Texan craftsmanship, distilled and aged in Waco, Texas. This rye whiskey showcases the distillery's commitment to creating complex spirits under the rigorous standards of the Bottled-in-Bond Act. It features a 100% rye mashbill, offering a bold and spicy profile that is both unique and deeply satisfying.

TITLE: Balcones Cataleja Texas Single Malt
DESCRIPTION: Elevate your whiskey experience with Balcones Cataleja Texas Single Malt, a true testament to the artistry of the Balcones distillery nestled in the heart of Texas. Crafted with passion and precision, this Single Malt expression is a harmonious blend of tradition and innovation, offering a distinctive taste of Texas terroir and the unique Cataleja process.

TITLE: Balcones Distillery "Rumble"
DESCRIPTION: A spirit that defies categorization from Waco’s own Balcones Distillery. Made from local wildflower honey, mission figs, and turbinado sugar, this unique spirit has elements of rum, cognac, or even tequila. Great for cocktails (substitute this in an old-fashioned!) it has pleasant notes of honey, cinnamon, tea tree oil, and citrus fruit with a spicy finish.

TITLE: Balcones Distillery Baby Blue Corn Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Not the first Texas Bourbon on the market since Prohibition, but quite probably the only blue corn whisky made anywhere. It pays homage to the American whisky tradition while adding something new and innovative. Balcones Baby Blue is made from 100% roasted Hopi blue corn.

TITLE: Balcones Distilling Brimstone Smoked Whisky
DESCRIPTION: At the Balcones Distillery in Waco, TX, proprietor and head distiller Chip Tate marries innovation with traditional distillation methods to create premium, artisanal spirits that pay homage to America's whiskey tradition. His passion for handcrafted spirits is evidenced by his attention to detail. “By building our own condensers, wash stills, heat exchangers, hot liquor tank, etc. we were able to build exactly the equipment we wanted to use to make spirits. We became extremely familiar with the tools of our trade. The equipment itself is one more level of the distilling process that we get to craft with our own hands,” says Tate. After careful inspection and approval of every stage of the production process, Chip and his team hand-dip each bottle of Balcones with wax as a seal of their approval. 106º Proof, made from 100% blue corn, this whiskey is smoked using Texas scrub oak rather than traditional Scottish peat.

TITLE: Balcones Distilling Texas Single Malt Whisky
Balcones Lineage Texas Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Experience traditional Scotch single malt ethos melding with Texan ingenuity in Balcones Lineage Texas Single Malt Whiskey. This distinguished whiskey is a union of Scottish Golden Promise and Texas-grown malted barley, offering a unique take on single malt tradition. Matured in a combination of new and refilled oak barrels, Lineage celebrates whiskey-making heritage while embracing American innovation. This American single malt is pot distilled and boasts an alcohol volume of 47%, showcasing a well-balanced profile that's both rich and inviting.

TITLE: Balcones Mirador Eclipse Texas Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Balcones Mirador Eclipse is a limited edition American Single Malt inspired by the solar eclipse, embodying the spirit of innovation at Balcones Distilling in Texas. This whiskey explores new depths of flavor by integrating unique yeast strains—red wine and rosé—alongside traditional malt whisky yeast, creating a complex profile of soft red berry and fruits-of-the-forest notes.

TITLE: Balcones Texas Blue Corn Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Balcones Texas Blue Corn Bourbon is a unique and flavorful whiskey made with 100% blue corn. It is aged in new charred oak barrels for a bold and complex character. The whiskey is full-bodied with a rich midpalate, coating mouthfeel, and long finish.

TITLE: Balmenach Hogshead 25 yrs Speyside Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: In the heart of whiskey country, Balmenach is nearly 200-years-old, and one of Speyside’s first legally operated distilleries. Rarely sold as independent malts, Balmenach’s spirits can be found in blends, such as Johnnie Walker. AGED: 25 years DISTILLED ON: October 18, 1988 BOTTLE ON: September 17, 2014 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 2820 ALC: 54.9%

TITLE: Balvenie 14 Years Caribbean Cask
Balvenie 30 Year Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Balvenie Thirty is a rare and especially fine single malt for which David Stewart selects only exceptional casks that were laid down over thirty years ago. By marrying The Balvenie slowly aged in traditional oak whisky casks with that aged in European oak sherry casks, David creates a rich, mellow Scotch whisky with unusual depth and complexity. ‘Thirty’ is bottled at 47.3% abv to capture all the signature characteristics of The Balvenie.

TITLE: Balvenie Doublewood 12 Year Old Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Balvenie Doublewood Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a 12 year old single malt which gains its distinctive character from being matured intwo woods. During its period of maturation The Balvenie Doublewood is transferred from a traditional oak whisky cask to a first fill Spanish oak sherry cask. Each stage lends different qualities to the resulting single malt - the traditional casks, having previously held bourbon, soften and add character, whilst the sherry wood brings depth and fullness of flavor.

TITLE: Balvenie Doublewood 12 Year Old Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Balvenie Doublewood Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a 12 year old single malt which gains its distinctive character from being matured intwo woods. During its period of maturation The Balvenie Doublewood is transferred from a traditional oak whisky cask to a first fill Spanish oak sherry cask. Each stage lends different qualities to the resulting single malt - the traditional casks, having previously held bourbon, soften and add character, whilst the sherry wood brings depth and fullness of flavor.

TITLE: Baptiste Nayrand Coteaux du Lyonnais Vesanie
DESCRIPTION: Certified organic. 100% Gamay. Whole-cluster fermentation in fiberglass tank, élevage as well; around six months. Comes from a 1ha parcel called ‘Les Brosses,’ on soils of deep clay with galets; vines planted in the ‘70s. It’s the flagship red wine at the domaine and one that combines an easy-drinking quality with the structure that’s the hallmark of Gamay in this place between the southern cru of Beaujolais and the intensity of the northern Rhône. Unfined, unfiltered, no added SO2.

TITLE: Barale Fratelli "Le Rose" Dolcetto d'Alba
Barale Fratelli Barolo Vendemmia
DESCRIPTION: Vinification: soft crushing of the grapes with de-stemming; static fermentation in oak casks with indigenous yeasts selected from our vineyards; maceration for about 30 days, frequent basting of the skins. Food pairings: roasted and braised red meats, game, bourguignon, aged cheeses.

TITLE: Barbara Lebled "Cheers"
Barbara Lebled Gamay "Sans Toi"
DESCRIPTION: Introducing the 2021 Barbara Lebled Gamay "Sans Toi", a delightful and expressive red wine hailing from the renowned Loire Valley region in France. Barbara Lebled, a passionate and innovative winemaker, is dedicated to creating high-quality wines that reflect the unique characteristics of the Loire Valley terroir. The "Sans Toi" Gamay is made from the vibrant and lively Gamay grape variety, which is meticulously cultivated and harvested to produce a wine that showcases the essence of the region. This charming red wine exhibits the fruit-forward character and elegance typical of the Loire Valley.

TITLE: Barbara Ohlzelt G'Mischter Satz "Kitz"
DESCRIPTION: Barbara Öhlzelt is turning the region’s paradigm completely on its head. Instead of the unctuous, powerful and masculine wines of the famous large estates, Barbara’s wines emphasize focus and a quiet, simmering intensity. They are fine, clearly delineated, precisely-etched renditions of Grüner Veltliner and Riesling with just as much depth and persistence as the big boys, but on a lighter, more refreshing frame. They really are like the wines of Weiser-Künstler, but translated into the dialect of the Kamptal – loess, granite and sandstone, rather than slate. It should go without saying, but of course the wines are loaded with mouth-watering acidity and the alcohol levels are carefully restrained. Barbara is soft-spoken but intense; the wines are not unlike their shepherd. These are racy, delicate wines of purity and energy, and are exactly what the next chapter in the story of Austrian wine should be.

TITLE: Barbara Ohlzelt Gruner Leader
DESCRIPTION: Barbara Ohlzelt Grüner Leader is a dry white wine made from 100% Grüner Veltliner grapes grown in the Kamptal region of Austria. The wine has a light straw color and aromas of white peach, citrus fruits, and white pepper. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with crisp acidity and flavors of white peach, grapefruit, and white pepper. The finish is long and clean, with a lingering minerality.

TITLE: Barbi Il Ruspo Umbria Sangiovese
DESCRIPTION: Vinification: Fermentation in stainless steel vats. The maceration on the skins lasted about 12 days. Refining: in underground cellars, first in stainless steel vats, then in American oak barrels for 6 months, lastly in bottle.

TITLE: Barbolini "Lancillotto" Lambrusco Grasparossa di Castelvetro
BarBox Negroni Craft Cocktails
DESCRIPTION: Crafted with gin, bitter liqueur, white wine with natural flavors, and Cochineal extract. Legend has it that in 1919 Florence, Italy, Count Camillo Negroni asked his bartender Forsco Scarsello, to replace the soda water in his Americano with gin. An orange garnish was added, creating the first known Negroni, and the rest is history. 52 Proof • 26% ALC/VOL • 1.75 L

TITLE: Bardstown  Bourbon Company Origin Series Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey Finished in Toasted Cherry Wood and Oak Barrels
DESCRIPTION: A celebration of innovation, our rye whiskey is finished in hybrid American oak and cherry wood barrels for up to 6 months. Alternating cherry wood and oak staves toasted to custom specifications in the second finishing barrel, provides this 95% rye with unique bursts of flavor and represents the best of our collaborative, creative spirit

TITLE: Bardstown  Bourbon Fusion Series #1 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Fusion Series #1 is a blend of 60% of Bardstown Bourbon Company’s two-year-old wheated and high-rye Kentucky bourbons along with 40% of 11 years 7-month bourbon from Kentucky to create a smooth, complex pour. 98.9 Proof

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Collaborative Series Amrut Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bardstown Bourbon Company Collaborative Series Amrut Straight Rye Whiskey is a unique and bold expression born from a collaboration between two acclaimed distilleries: Bardstown Bourbon Company in Kentucky and Amrut Distilleries in India. This limited release combines the best of both worlds by finishing Bardstown Bourbon’s rye whiskey in casks that previously held Amrut’s Indian single malt whisky. Bottled at 110 proof, this rye whiskey offers a rich and complex flavor profile that beautifully marries the spicy character of American rye with the exotic, nuanced notes imparted by the Indian whisky casks. This collaborative series is a testament to the innovation and craftsmanship of both distilleries, making it a must-try for whiskey enthusiasts.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Collaborative Series Blend of Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Silver Oak Cabernet Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Bardstown Bourbon Collaborative Series Blend of Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Silver Oak Cabernet Barrels is an exquisite expression that highlights the innovative spirit of the Bardstown Bourbon Company. As part of their Collaborative Series, this limited-edition bourbon combines carefully selected straight bourbons, which are finished in barrels that previously held the renowned Silver Oak Cabernet Sauvignon. The result is a richly layered whiskey that combines the depth of traditional bourbon with the lush, fruit-forward flavors imparted by the Cabernet cask. Bottled at 108 proof, this whiskey offers a unique and luxurious experience for bourbon and wine lovers alike.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company "Chateau Doisy Daene" A Blend Of Straight Whiskies Finished In Sauternes Barrels And Toasted Oak Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Discover the exquisite craftsmanship of Bardstown Bourbon Company's "Chateau Doisy Daene," a harmonious blend of straight whiskies that transcends the ordinary. This exceptional release marries the rich heritage of Kentucky bourbon and Indiana rye with the unique influence of Sauternes barrels from the renowned Chateau Doisy Daene in Bordeaux, France. Aged initially for 10 years (bourbon) and 6 years (rye), these whiskies are expertly finished in Sauternes barrels for 7 months, followed by an additional 4 months in new toasted oak barrels. This intricate process yields a whiskey of unparalleled depth and complexity, exclusively available from the distillery​.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company "Discovery Series #4" Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The unifying concept in Discovery Series #3 is three aged bourbons blended to create a smooth and unique expression, including two 13-year-old bourbons and a 10-year-old bourbon.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company "Discovery Series #5" Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bardstown Bourbon Company Discovery Series #5 - a blend of straight bourbon whiskies. Discovery Series #5 is a blend of 31% 13-Year Kentucky Whiskey, 25% 17-Year Tennessee Whiskey, 25% Kentucky Whiskey aged 7-Year, and 19% Kentucky Whiskey aged 6-Year. This blend is bottled at 52.35% ABV at Cask Strength.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company "Discovery Series #7" Blended Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Discovery Series #7 is a blend of 31% Kentucky 12 Year, 25% Kentucky 12 Year, 21% Ontario 12 Year, 15% Indiana 7 Year, and 8% Tennessee 17 Year. Bottled at 114.5 Proof.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company "Discovery" Series #1 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This Discovery Series #1 is a very limited release showcasing Bardstown Bourbon’s blending expertise. Spice and oak with a berry and vanilla sweetness. Rich, lush notes of fruit followed by a lingering spicy finish. 121.21 Proof.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company "Discovery" Series #2 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The unifying concept in Discovery Series #2 is a 12-year-old Kentucky bourbon combined with light accents of older and younger Kentucky bourbons. BLEND: 44% Kentucky, 10 years, corn 75, rye 13, malted barley 12 39% Kentucky, 12 years, corn 74, rye 18, malted barley 8 17% Kentucky, 14 years, corn 78, rye 10, malted barley 12

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company "Discovery" Series #3 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The unifying concept in Discovery Series #3 is three aged bourbons blended to create a smooth and unique expression, including two 13-year-old bourbons and a 10-year-old bourbon. 110 Proof.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company "Steve's Legacy" Kentucky Straight Bourbon Finished in French Oak Barrels
DESCRIPTION: 2022 marks the 50th year of Steve Nally's storied career in the bourbon industry. Steve is one of the few remaining Bourbon Hall of Fame Master Distillers currently working in this capacity, and along with his wife Donna, are the only living husband and wife couple in the Bourbon Hall of Fame. Steve began his career at Maker's Mark in 1972. where he filled every position in the distillery. In 1988 he was named Master Distiller, a position Steve held until 2003 when he assumed the role of GM/Master Distiller for Wyoming Whiskey. In 2014, Steve returned to Kentucky as the first member and Master Distiller of Bardstown Bourbon Co. Here he co-designed the production facility, developed the team that quadrupled production in just 4 years, crafted more than 50 unique mash-bills, released 30 products, and became one of the top 10 distillers of Bourbon, Rye, and Whiskeys in America. Steve remains a respected voice and an integral part of the Bardstown Bourbon Co. fabric. TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company "T8ke Two" Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon The Prime Barrel x R-Bourbon Pick
DESCRIPTION: A bruiser that's loaded with char, tobacco, and cola, the high rye pulls no punches on this barrel with a sprinkle of ethanol and then a deep dive into sweet cola, black pepper, pipe tobacco, orange peel, and cherries, a hint of root beer, tobacco, and ginger. The palate is rich and viscous; the heat fades with a moment of air time, bringing loads of cherry, cola, fat, spicy pepper, a creamy texture on the palate, and a long, oaky, peppery finish. It's rich through and through and while I'm salty the angels took more than their share, the yielding bottles are divine.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company "West Virginia Great Barrel Company" Blended Rye Whiskey Finished in Infrared Toasted Cherry Oak Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Our first cooperage collaboration celebrates the forward-thinking West Virginia Great Barrel Company. Our synergy in modern production led to a custom blend aged in cherry wood barrels toasted with infrared technology. This truly unique flavor exemplifies the potential of two brands at the forefront of innovation.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company "Wonderwall" 7 Year Old Single Barrel Kentucly Straight Bourbon The Prime Barrel Pick #75
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in a whimsical journey of flavors with our exclusive Prime Barrel selection of Bardstown Bourbon Company's Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon, fondly named "Wonderwall." This distinctive name pays a playful homage to being just two days shy of a 7-year maturation period, adding a touch of whimsy to your whiskey experience ("two days was gonna be the day!"). Selected during one of our adventurous barrel-picking expeditions earlier this year, this gem is among the first BBC Single Barrels to grace the market nationally. With its 126.2 proof, it's a bourbon that's best appreciated slightly below its proof level to unveil the full spectrum of its rich, nuanced character. As you delve into this fine bourbon, the nose invites you to warmly embrace caramel and toffee intertwined with rye grassy notes, vanilla, and a hint of oak spice. The palate is a delightful continuation of this aromatic narrative, offering a very viscous, smooth encounter with floral and sweet flavors of caramel, ripe apple, and vanilla. The journey concludes with a medium to long finish, leaving a lingering taste of mastery that beckons for another sip. This "Wonderwall" edition is a rare opportunity to savor Bardstown Bourbon Co.'s renowned quality in a singular, unblended form. This is one of the very first single-barrel expressions available on the market.Barrel Info: Barrel #: 16-2503 Proof: 126.2 Age: 7 Years (2 days shy) Mashbill: 60% corn, 36% rye, 4% malted barley Floor: 6

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company Chateau de Laubade Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bardstown Chateau de Laubade is a straight bourbon whiskey finished in Chateau de Laubade Armagnac barrels. The result? A rich palate ofo apricot with honey, espresso, and cinnamon, a sublime, balanced finish quickly becomes the star of this transatlantic partnership.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company Chateau de Laubade Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bardstown Chateau de Laubade is a straight bourbon whiskey finished in Chateau de Laubade Armagnac barrels. The result? A rich palate ofo apricot with honey, espresso, and cinnamon, a sublime, balanced finish quickly becomes the star of this transatlantic partnership.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company Collaborative Series Foursquare Rum Barrel Finish Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Experience Barbados like never before! Enjoy this custom blend of 7-year rye and 17-year bourbon, curated to accentuate Barbado's exquisite flavor. Aged for 23 months in Foursquare rum barrels, this whiskey bursts with tropical flavor and makes for one exceptional pour. On the nose, plantain, toasted almond, and clove meld with tropical coconut, orange zest, and raisin. A vibrant palate balances rye spice with aged oak, leading to an enveloping, complex finish of baked fruit, lingering spice, and elegant caramel sweetness.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company Collaborative Series Kentucky Straight Bourbon Finished in Goose Island Bourbon County Brand Stout Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Discover the innovative spirit of Bardstown Bourbon Company with this exceptional release in their Collaborative Series. This unique expression features a bespoke blend of 6 and 7-year Kentucky Straight Bourbon, further aged for 12 months in freshly emptied Goose Island Bourbon County Brand Stout barrels. The result is a rich, complex bourbon with deep chocolate, coffee, and roasted malt notes, balanced by the traditional sweetness of Kentucky bourbon. A must-have for enthusiasts of bourbon and stout alike, this limited-edition bottle embodies the creative fusion of two iconic American brands.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company Collaborative Series Plantation Rum Barrel Finish Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 93, #15 on the Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 List Bardstown Bourbon Company has proven itself among the most innovative masters of blending and finishing, with little regard for tradition. This is not as adventurous as some of their experiments, but it is no less successful. This 10-year-old Tennessee bourbon spent 22 months in Plantation rum barrels. The result offers savory herbs balanced with caramel on the nose, flavors of dark chocolate, roasted coffee, and red fruit before a finish with generous baking spices and leather. Mashbill: Corn 84% Rye 8% Malted Barley 8%

It remains there for 20 months before bottling at 60.2% ABV.

DESCRIPTION: Bardstown Bourbon Company Collaborative Series – Ferrand is a blend of seven and 11-year-old Kentucky bourbons aged in Maison Ferrand Cognac barrels for eight months. TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company Kentucky Straight Bourbon MGM Resorts Reserve
DESCRIPTION: Bardstown Bourbon MGM Resorts Reserve is an exceptional 10-year-old straight bourbon finished in Revana Family Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon Barrels for added complexity and style.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company Origin Series 6 Years Old Bottled-In-Bond Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Honoring tradition and authenticity, our Origin Series Wheated Bottled-in-Bond 6-year expression presents the best locally-sourced Kentucky corn and wheat grains. This expression features 20% wheat in the mash bill, creating a modern expression of beautifully balanced bourbon. 100 Proof.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company Origin Series 6 Years Old High Wheat Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Experience the exceptional craftsmanship of Bardstown Bourbon Co. with their latest release in the Origin Series: High-Wheat Bourbon. Crafted from a distinctive mash bill featuring 53% corn, 39% wheat, and 8% malted barley, this bourbon offers a smooth, rounded flavor profile that stands out in American whiskey. Aged to Perfection: This bourbon has been carefully aged for six years, allowing the unique high-wheat mash bill to develop deep and complex flavors. Bottled at 106 proof, it strikes the perfect balance between approachability and bold character, making it a must-have for both seasoned connoisseurs and those new to bourbon.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company Origin Series 6 Years Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whisky
DESCRIPTION: An exquisite high-rye bourbon with extraordinary flavor. Our Origin bourbon whiskey is a 36% high-rye mash bill that showcases the best of classic bourbon with a burst of rye spice. Perfect at a unique pour or the foundation for a premium craft cocktail. 96 Proof.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company Phifer Pavitt Reserve Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This Phifer Pavitt Reserve Bourbon is the first release for Bardstown Bourbon Company (BBCo) under the brand's Collaborative Series. They partnered with Napa Valley's Phifer Pavitt Winery who supplied the cabernet sauvignon wine barrels for the bourbon to finish its aging in. BBCo took 9-year-old Tennessee straight bourbon and aged the whiskey in these French oak wine barrels for 19 months further. This limited edition release is available in spring 2019.

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey Finished in Toasted Cherry Wood and Oak Barrels The Prime Barrel x R-Bourbon Pick
DESCRIPTION: We recently made our way back to Bardstown Bourbon Company on an early spring day, and let me tell you, it was an experience. With seven members in tow, we were on a mission to pick out a single-barrel finished rye that stood out from the crowd. If you haven't been to the BBC campus, it's something special. Built-in 2016, it's a modern gem among Kentucky distilleries. We started things off with a lunch at their Kitchen and Bar (highly recommended) and then got a full tour, complete with the history of how they've grown. The highlight, though, was getting to taste and select our barrel in a cozy private bar, where we were joined by Nick Smith, BBC's Director of Distillation and Head Distiller. We tasted rye barrels similar to those in BBC’s Origin Series, with a 95% rye/5% malted barley mashbill. After aging in new charred oak for six years, they were re-barreled in unique finishing barrels made of toasted cherry wood and oak for another eight months. These barrels aren't your usual fare—they’re constructed in a cool zebra pattern and get an infrared toasting instead of a traditional char, which brings out deep flavors without too much tannin. We had four barrels to choose from, and after many back-and-forth, two stood out. Barrel 1 had this light toast with more fruity and floral notes, while Barrel 3 leaned into the classic spicy, peppery rye vibes. Ultimately, we went with Barrel 1 because it wasn’t your everyday rye—the fruity influence from the finishing barrel made it shine. Nick Smith was all in on our choice, too, noting that Barrel 1 had the best nose and a sweet, floral profile he’d love to take home. It’s got a nose full of spearmint, citrus, and spiced apple, with a palate that’s sweet, a little floral, and even has a hint of cinnamon roll icing. The finish is long and smooth, with caramel, pie spice, and just the right amount of peppery kick at the end. This could be your jam if you're into trying something a little different. It’s got that unique twist without losing the rye character we all love. Key Details: Mashbill: 95% Rye / 5% Malted Barley Age: 6 years in new charred oak, plus 8 months in light toast cherry and oak finishing barrel Proof: 119.8 Tasting Notes: Nose: Spearmint, citrus, orange peel, rye spice, baked apple, brown sugar, cinnamon Palate: Sweet, floral, fruity notes, cinnamon roll icing, oak, trace of coffee Finish: Long, with sweet caramel, pie spice, menthol, peppery apple cider

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Company The Prisoner Wine Co Finish
DESCRIPTION: 9-year-old Tennessee bourbon finished in The Prisoner Wine Company’s French oak red wine barrels. A complex, welcoming bouquet of blackberry and black cherry blended with aromas of rich honey, vanilla, and baking spices. Hints of the original premium grape blend take the lead on the palate with a touch of sweetness, turning to a ringing, balanced finish. 100 Proof

TITLE: Bardstown Bourbon Fusion Series #3 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bardstown Bourbon "Fusion Series" #3 combines 60% Bardstown Bourbon's own Spirits across two different mash bills (one 20% wheat, the other 36% rye) with 40% thirteen-year-old Kentucky Bourbon that is 18% rye. The combination gives this dram an interesting youthfulness coupled with age and smoothness coupled with spice. And it is bottled at an oddly precise 49.45% ABV — but when a Whiskey tastes this good we don’t ask too many questions.

DESCRIPTION: Distillery says that this gin is a celebration of their special connection to the land. They use pure grain spirits as a canvas to showcase juniper berry and raw northern honey. The distillery, on the banks of the Lamoille River in the Northeast Kingdom, is rooted in the agriculture of Vermont. Hardwick, Caledonia Country, is a community inspired by farms where the production of milk, cheese, timber, grains, honey, seeds, and herbs are part of their lives and help define their place.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #006
DESCRIPTION: Hand-churned buttercream and freshly dipped pralines in the nose invite deeper notes of baked peach cobbler and pan toasted chestnuts. The 122.9 proof heat dissipates quickly into savory bursts of brown butter dipped cornbread lathered in stone fruit preserves. Elongated notes of still steaming cinnamon toast lightly dusted with raw sugar. Brightly aromatic tangerine and blood orange beckon with each sip eventually leading to a lengthy caramel coated popcorn finish. Straight Bourbon Whiskey Distilled and aged in Tennessee 122.9 proof cask strength bottling Aged for 8 years, 6 months in charred white oak barrels Mash bill: 70% corn, 26% rye, 4% malted barley

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #007B
Barrell Bourbon Batch #008B
DESCRIPTION: Appearance: dark amber with a deep mahogany core and narrow edges of golden sunlight.Turns of the wrist create tantalizing combinations of molten copper. Nose: Caramelized Granny Smith apple pie with orange zest and Madagascar vanilla paste. Tangy Yuzu, aged saddle leather, and warm dark chocolate ganache. Palate: Velvety across the palate with salvos of grey Brittany sea salt. Hot sweet summer corn creamed pudding with butter and honey tumbles around the mouth. Finish: Sweet tobacco smoke lightly brushed with buckwheat honey give way to salty condensed milk before yielding to butterscotch candy and the generous multi-minute conclusion.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #009
Barrell Bourbon Batch #010
DESCRIPTION: Bursts of sea salt and slowly cooked peach preserves give way to smoldering Turkish tobacco across your tongue. Dark toasted English Muffins served sizzling hot, smeared with both lemon marmalade and sweet French butter immediately comes into view. This sweetness dissipates into dried licks of cedar-tinged lead pencil shavings. There is assertiveness to each sip; this whiskey is both sophisticated and confident

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #011
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Bourbon Batch 011 is the culmination of a 2 year long barrel sorting project focused on highlighting a particularly rare and bright flavor note found in only select barrels of Bourbon.The base of this blend is 6-year-old barrels but it contains older barrels as well. Raw honey drenched Bing cherries atop toasted sweet corn pudding. Hearty Russian Rye toast soldiers sprinkled with sea salt slathered in maple butter and summer fruit compote. The rich and flavorful grains plunge into soft creaminess and recollects state fair caramel popcorn in the finish, belying the 114.8 proof heat.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #012
DESCRIPTION: Batch 012 is a high rye bourbon comprised of 9-year-old barrels and selected old bourbon stocks, most of which were aged in the lower sections of the rick house. This gentler aging style makes Batch 012 a fruit-forward bourbon that shows its spice in the mid-palate, and its drawn out complexity in a long, layered finish. Straight Bourbon Whiskey Distilled and aged for 9 years in Tennessee Crafted and bottled in Kentucky 108.5 proof cask strength bottling Aged for 9 years with selected older barrels Aged in American white oak barrels Mash bill: 70% corn, 25% rye, 5% malted barley

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #013
DESCRIPTION: Thick slabs of smoked bacon, tiny curls of cedar wood shavings, bitter chocolate pastilles and Georgia peach preserves wash over the palate in rapid succession. Subtle notes of open fire cooked cornbread dusted in zesty chili powder give way to crumbles of dehydrated oranges. Hints of salty crushed minerals and delicious lemon curd round out this bourbon. Distilled and aged in Tennessee and Indiana Crafted and bottled in Kentucky Selection of 5 and 8-year-old barrels Aged in American white oak barrels 113 proof cask strength bottling Mash bill: corn, rye (high and low), malted barley

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #014
DESCRIPTION: We reserved a portion of Barrell Bourbon Batch 012 in the original barrels, which became the foundation for Barrell Bourbon Batch 014. We then selected additional 9-year-old bourbon barrels for their fruit notes, as well as a number of 14-year-old high rye barrels to deliver a bit of spice and oak. The result is complex and thoughtful - a nicely balanced spicy bourbon.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #015
DESCRIPTION: We selected 9.5, 10 and 11 year old barrels from different distilleries and rickhouse locations. The barrels were carefully blended, resulting in a sophisticated, balanced bourbon loaded with apple, gingerbread and honeyed corn notes.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #016
DESCRIPTION: Bourbon Batch 016 is a blend of barrels set aside over the past year for their extremely fruity flavor profile. The ages range from 9 year 9 months to 15 years old. Deeply concentrated but not too oaky, this bourbon is unique due to the barrels being selected for similar qualities despite being different ages and coming from different distilleries.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #017
DESCRIPTION: Batch 17 is an homage to a style of bourbon we love, which has become increasingly hard to find. It’s the typical 10-year-old: high proof and balanced, oak-driven but complex. This batch is our tribute to the fine bourbons of the past. An autumnal nose of mulled cider and cherry pie leads to an unexpectedly complex and tropical palate. Steely minerality lends tension to a whiskey that is at once rich and delicate.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #018
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Bourbon Batch 018 is a cinnamon bomb of a bourbon. We began with a juicy and tropical 11-year-old blend and layered in more structured and spice-driven 14 and 15-year-old barrels to give this batch a serious amount of character and bite. Distilled and aged in Tennessee and Kentucky Selection of 11, 14 and 15-year-old barrels Aged in American white oak barrels Crafted and bottled in Kentucky 111.56 proof cask strength bottling Mash bill: corn, rye and malted barley

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #019
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Bourbon Batch 019 is a study in complexity. Barrell Craft Spirits sorted a careful selection of 9.5 to 14-year-old barrels from Kentucky and Tennessee into 5 groups, then blended portions of those 5 groups together to maximize the unique qualities of each. Barrell bourbon batch 019 is a classic bourbon. The sweet opening notes give way to nutty and herbaceous nuance, all overlaid by a lattice of barrel spice.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #020
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Bourbon Batch 020 was blended from a selection of barrels from Tennessee and Kentucky. We started with 10-year-old barrels with a lush, prominent fruit profile and balanced them with 14-year-old oak-forward barrels resulting in a complex bourbon with an engaging brightness.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #021
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Bourbon Batch 021 is the culmination of two separate projects used to contrast one another. The first is a blend of 10-year-old barrels from TN, IN, and KY. These barrels were sorted into 3 groups by their most defining characteristics: one group of the most corn-forward and buttery barrels, one group of the woodiest barrels, and one group of easy-drinking lower proof barrels. The result was three different ingredients, each designed to bring a particular aspect to the final product. ​ The balancing of these three ingredients proved difficult as the woodier ingredient so easily dominated the other two but also brought a viscosity and mouth feel that we found very intriguing. Ultimately, folks behind the brand chose to integrate 18 carefully chosen 14-year-old barrels into the final blend. This allowed keeping the dry, woody, and palate-coating characteristics in the 10-year-old blend by accenting them with a fruitier, gentler 14-year-old component. The result, Barrell Bourbon Batch 021 is a wonderfully autumnal bourbon, built on a dry toasty backbone with hints of butter and fruit layered in for complexity and contrast.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #022
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Bourbon Batch 022 is a marriage of two separate and iconic styles of Bourbon: Classily dry and woody Kentucky Bourbon, and floral, herbaceous, and sweet Indiana Bourbon. The final blend was constructed from four separate lots, each with its own nuanced family of flavors. Much like Batches 007, 011, and 013, Batch 022 incorporates the freshness of some carefully chosen, younger barrels to bring a more extensive set of flavors and aromas to the table.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #023
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Bourbon Batch #023 is a blend of bourbons aged 10, 12, and 15 years from Tennessee, Kentucky, and Indiana, bottled at 107.78 proof. It offers a profile of brown sugar, caramel, oak, and baking spices, with a palate that includes spicy notes, summer fruit, and black peppercorns, leading to a finish with cinnamon spice and dry leather notes​.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #024
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Bourbon Batch 024 is a marriage of high Rye Bourbons ranging in age from 9 to 15 years old. The 9, 10, and 13-year-old barrels were chosen for their peppery assertiveness, making this "spice box" marriage wonderfully robust yet a little rough around the edges. We refined the blend by adding in citrus-forward, lower proof, 15-year-old barrels bit by bit, ensuring that the rye forward base would continue to shine while delivering a lush mouthfeel. A blend of straight Bourbon Whiskeys Distilled and aged in Tennessee, Kentucky and Indiana Selection of 9, 10, 13, and 15-year-old barrels Aged in American white oak barrels Bottled in Kentucky 113.9 proof cask strength bottling

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #025
DESCRIPTION: Batch 025 highlights the unique additions that secondary grains contribute to aged bourbon. 13 to 15-year corn-forward bourbons and 5 to 9-year-old wheated bourbons were slowly layered in with a selection of 9-year-old high-rye bourbons, revealing notes from the entire spectrum of available flavors. A portrait of finely tuned blending, Batch 025 is citrusy and peppery, without losing the opulence and oaky ease of the older ingredients. A blend of straight Bourbon Whiskeys Distilled and aged in Tennessee, Kentucky, and Indiana Selection of 5.5, 9, 13, and 15-year-old barrels Aged in American white oak barrels Bottled in Kentucky 113.4 proof cask strength bottling

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #026
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Bourbon Batch 026 was created by combining 9, 10, 11, 13, and 15-year-old barrels in several blending steps. The first was a fusion of 9-year-old high rye barrels peppery and pointed on the palate, 10-year-old oak forward barrels, and sweet, toasty 11-year-old barrels for mouthfeel and classic baking spice notes. The second balanced citrus-forward 10, 12, and 15-year-old barrels with spicy, floral 9-year-old high rye barrels. These two blends were gradually co-mingled resulting in an intriguing bourbon that dances between fruit and spice long into its finish. A blend of straight Bourbon Whiskeys Distilled and aged in Tennessee, Kentucky, and Indiana Selection of 9, 10, 11, 13, and 15-year-old barrels Aged in American white oak barrels Bottled in Kentucky 112.64 proof cask strength bottling

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #027
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Bourbon Batch 027 started with 6-year-old fruit-forward barrels from Tennessee and 5-year-old spice forward barrels from Indiana. After these were blended together, 13 and 15-year-old barrels with more wood tannin and depth were layered in and a select number of 9-year-old barrels with a higher rye content were blended in for spice and assertiveness. Finally, 5 and 8-year-old wheated bourbon barrels were added to soften the batch, brighten the front palate, and solidify a cohesiveness to an otherwise extremely complex flavor profile. A blend of straight Bourbon Whiskeys Distilled and aged in Tennessee, Kentucky, and Indiana Selection of 5, 6, 8, 9, 13, and 15-year-old barrels Aged in American white oak barrels Bottled in Kentucky 115.7 proof cask strength bottling

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #028
DESCRIPTION: The bourbon begins with bright citrus, heady florals, and lively minerals. Sweetness is kept in check by a preponderance of opposing forces. That balance vanishes on the finish when it explodes with tropical fruits then gently fades away leaving only smoked sea salt at the end. ​

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #029
DESCRIPTION: The base of Barrell Bourbon Batch 029 is an herbal and viscous blend of Indiana bourbons. The blend was expanded with 6 and 7-year-old rye-grain Kentucky bourbon, chosen for its exotic cinnamon spice note and floral 9 and 10-year-old wheated bourbon. Finally, a small amount of 6, 14, and 16-year-old Tennessee bourbon was added for a fruity nose and a long, oxidative finish. A blend of straight Bourbon Whiskeys Distilled and aged in Kentucky, Tennessee, and Indiana Selection of 6, 7, 9, 10, 14, and 16-year-old barrels Aged in American white oak barrels Bottled in Kentucky 115.88 proof cask strength bottling

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #030
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Bourbon Batch 030 began with a group of tropical fruit-forward 5-year-old Indiana barrels, a group of stone fruit-forward 10-year-old high-rye Tennessee barrels, and a group of nutty 6, 9, 11, and 15-year-old barrels. After mingling separately for a month, they were carefully blended together. Finally, wheated bourbon from Kentucky and Wyoming was added to enhance the complexity of the blend. A blend of straight Bourbon Whiskeys Distilled and aged in Tennessee, Kentucky, Indiana, and Wyoming Selection of 5, 6, 9, 10, 11, and 15-year-old barrels Aged in American white oak barrels Bottled in Kentucky 117.32 proof cask strength bottling

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #031
DESCRIPTION: A perfect autumn release, this batch’s notes of shortbread cookie, pumpkin pie, peppermint latte, and pine needles match the mood of sweater weather.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #032
DESCRIPTION: Batch 032 began with a balance of two sets of barrels: a selection of 5 and 6-year-old barrels with a creamy and tropical profile and a selection of 6, 7, and 10-year-old barrels vatted for their complex, old, woody character. These two sets of barrels were slowly blended over three months. A small group of spice-driven 7-year-old barrels with notes of cinnamon toast, coffee bean, and chocolate were then carefully added to complete the blend. The result is a decadent and rich bourbon with layers of spice and nuttiness. A blend of straight Bourbon Whiskeys Distilled and aged in TN, KY, and IN Selection of 5, 6, 7, and 10-year-old barrels Aged in American white oak barrels Bottled in Kentucky 115.34 proof cask strength bottling

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #033
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Bourbon Batch 033 is a marriage of high-rye barrels and high-corn barrels ranging in age from 5 to 9 years old. The high-rye barrels were chosen for their distinct stone fruit, black pepper, and nutmeg notes. The high-corn barrels were chosen for their rich butterscotch, coffee, and citrus notes. Two sets of barrels mingled for two months, then the balance was adjusted for the optimal combination.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Batch #035
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Bourbon Batch #035 is a masterful blend of straight bourbon whiskeys aged between 6 and 13 years, sourced from Indiana, Kentucky, and Tennessee. Bottled at cask strength, 117.5 proof, this batch presents a compelling mix of richness, depth, and complexity. With a mash bill comprising 78% corn, 18% rye, and 4% malted barley, Batch #035 exemplifies the meticulous craftsmanship Barrell Craft Spirits is renowned for. This blend showcases the distillery's innovative approach to creating unique, high-quality bourbon with each batch.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon Cask Series Finish Amburana
DESCRIPTION: Amburana casks are challenging to work with, as they impart strong cinnamon, nutmeg, clove, and vanilla spice notes. True blending expertise is required to enhance the bourbon with Amburana and maintain balance. The BCS blending team created a bourbon blend of two mashbills with different char levels finished in Amburana casks. A vatting of individual casks without finishing was layered in to add depth, richness and complexity, ensuring the bourbon shines through first and foremost. An intense baking spice character centered around cinnamon fills every nook and cranny of the tasting experience. It’s a veil through which one experiences the aromas of chocolate, walnut, and toasted sourdough. The palate also has a narrative driven by cinnamon and spicy ginger beer with cameos from marmalade, tarragon, and hefeweizen. A healthy splash of water foregrounds passionfruit, goldenrod, and honeycomb. BLEND COMPONENTS: Indiana Bourbon whiskeys: 5, 6, 7, & 10 years old Kentucky Bourbon whiskeys: 5 years old DERIVED MASHBILL: 75% Corn / 21% Rye / 4% Malted Barley

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon New Year Limited Edition 2023
DESCRIPTION: New Year. New beginnings. New traditions. BCS creates a unique blend of bourbons every autumn to toast the coming year. Barrell New Year Bourbon 2024 is a tribute to the fresh possibilities and sense of optimism that every new year brings. The 2024 edition of New Year Bourbon contains the largest selection of states and bourbons in a single release that the brand has created this year and celebrates some of the most exciting bourbon being distilled across the US. New Year 2024 is bright and rich on the nose, with a bouquet of fresh and baked fruit followed by syrupy desserts. On the palate, the freshness evolves to a silky concentration of baked goods and dark chocolate. A touch of water enhances the cinnamon, creating notes of snickerdoodle, stroopwafel, and caramelized fruit. Derived Mash bill Corn: 72% Rye: 22% Malted Barley: 5% Wheat: 1% States and Ages Kentucky Bourbon: 8 years old Indiana Bourbon: 5, 6, & 9 years old Tennessee Bourbon: 8 & 15 years old Wyoming Bourbon: 11 years old New York Bourbon: 5 years old Texas Bourbon: 5 years old Ohio Bourbon: 5 years old Maryland Bourbon: 5 & 6 years old The 2024 edition of New Year Bourbon contains the largest selection of states and bourbons in a single release in 2023. By creating this blend, the brand looks to celebrate some of the most exciting bourbon being distilled across the US.

TITLE: Barrell Bourbon New Year Limited Edition 2024
DESCRIPTION: New Year. New beginnings. New traditions. BCS creates a unique blend of bourbons every autumn to toast the coming year. TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits "Armida" Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Pear Brandy, Rum, and Sicilian Amaro Casks
DESCRIPTION: Armida is a blend of three Straight Bourbon Whiskeys finished separately in Pear Brandy, Jamaican Rum, and Sicilian Amaro Casks. The ripe, floral pear notes provide a soft entrance into a whiskey that is adorned with hints of spice and arid citrus derived from the Amaro casks (and also the toasty bourbon itself). This mélange of flavor is framed by the tropical sweetness found in rum finished whiskeys. Armida is a journey for the palate: from a brisk northern orchard to an ancient island, it ends up exactly where we intended, with an immensely complex and satisfying whiskey.

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits "Seagrass" Rye Whiskey Finished in Martinique Rum, Madera and Apricot Brandy Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Rye whiskey finished in Martinique Rhum, Malmsey Madeira, and Apricot Brandy casks Distilled in Canada and Indiana; blended and bottled in Kentucky Blended to evoke memories of time spent next to the ocean Sun-ripened apricot and tarragon on the nose transition to a sweet and lush palate of orchard fruit, amontillado sherry, fresh grapefruit, and rosehip; all focused with a sharp, rye backbone and a haunting finish full of salinity and daydreams of the seaside A compelling and unique selection for any rye lover or fan of other BCS blends with multi-cask finishes, i.e., Dovetail or Armida Non-chill filtered; 59.2% ABV

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Barrell Foundation Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Step into refined taste with the Barrell Foundation Bourbon, a hallmark creation from Barrell Craft Spirits. This standout bourbon encompasses a wealth of richness and complexity, mirroring the high-quality craftsmanship Barrell Craft Spirits is celebrated for. It's a multifaceted treasure, ideal for savoring neat, on the rocks, or as the heart of a cocktail. Over a decade, Barrell Craft Spirits has broadened its horizons with a modern blending facility and a new rickhouse in Kentucky. This strategic expansion has birthed a bourbon that's equally splendid for sipping and cocktail mixing. Its sturdy character makes it a dependable choice for daily enjoyment, and shines brilliantly when mixed in cocktails. The Barrell Foundation Bourbon is a new entry point expression from the brand, at a price point that's inviting to all. Offered at a friendly $59, it's a slice of luxury that doesn't demand a premium. This exquisite blend showcases a spectrum of aged bourbons: 8-year old Kentucky, 5, 6, & 9-year old Indiana, 8-year old Tennessee, and 5 & 6-year old Maryland Bourbon Whiskeys. The concoction reveals a derived mash bill of 73% Corn, 23% Rye, and 4% Malted Barley, making the Barrell Foundation Bourbon a well-rounded journey of flavors awaiting your exploration.

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Bourbon Cask Finish Series Mizunara
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Craft Spirits Bourbon Cask Finish Series Mizunara is a limited-edition release that uniquely combines bourbons aged six to fourteen years from Indiana, Kentucky, and Tennessee. These are expertly blended and then matured for an additional eighteen months in rare Mizunara oak casks, known for imparting distinct flavors of sandalwood, coconut, and herbal spices.

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Bourbon Cask Finish Series Tale Of Two Islands
DESCRIPTION: Experience a riveting journey of flavors with Barrell Craft Spirits Bourbon Cask Finish Series Tale Of Two Islands. This remarkable bourbon tells a tale of craftsmanship and innovation, as bourbons from Maryland and Indiana are meticulously blended and finished in casks that previously embraced Jamaican Rum and Islay Whisky. The result is a bold, complex bourbon that narrates a story of two islands through its unique taste profile. The Tale Of Two Islands bourbon is part of Barrell Craft Spirits' illustrious Cask Finish Series, showcasing the brand's prowess in blending and finishing to create something truly distinctive. This bourbon, with an aggregate post-blending mashbill of 73% corn, 23% rye, and 4% malted barley, takes you on a flavor expedition from the sweet corn fields of the USA to the smoky atmosphere of Islay, and the tropical vibe of Jamaica. The bourbons, aged between 5 to 9 years, are finished in the exotic casks that once cradled Jamaican Rum and Islay Whisky, imparting a unique sweetness and a hint of smoky sophistication to the robust bourbon base. This exceptional bourbon is bottled at a cask strength of 118.22 proof, embodying a daring spirit ready to explore uncharted territories of taste

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Limited Edition  Gold Label Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Craft Spirits Gold Label Bourbon is a blend of 16- and 17-year-old straight bourbons. Barrels for this release were selected from four different collections: cherry bomb barrels with a rich mouthfeel, nutty oak-forward barrels, high proof, and high complexity barrels, and barrels with pronounced milk chocolate notes. The last group underwent a secondary maturation in toasted virgin American oak casks before being added to this intricate and seductive blend. 113.5 proof

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Limited Edition Dovetail Gray Label  Cask Strength Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Dovetail is blended to highlight some of our favorite flavors. Woody bourbon; terroir driven Dunn Cabernet; toasted French oak; Late Bottled Vintage Port pipes; black strap molasses casks; all working together to create a buttery and deep whiskey as unique as it is delicious. Over the past several years, Barrell Dovetail has become a well-known expression within Barrell’s portfolio of products and the American Whiskey world. Recently, Barrell’s blending team decided to approach the concept of “Dovetail” with some of its older stocks. The result is BCS Gray Label Dovetail, featuring a blend of American Whiskey finished in rum, port, and Dunn Vineyards cabernet barrels and uses the same finishing and blending method. The difference is that Barrell uses older and rare barrels for Gray Label products. The component whiskeys, distilled in Indiana, Tennessee, and Canada, are aged up to 20 years. Gray Label Dovetail is then bottled at 131.54 proof cask strength.

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Limited Edition Gold Label Dovetail Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Craft Spirits Gold Label Dovetail represents the pinnacle of blending and finishing, showcasing an ultra-premium whiskey that has been meticulously crafted. This limited edition whiskey, distilled in Indiana, Tennessee, and Canada, has been aged in the US and Canada, achieving a remarkable proof of 140.18. It combines the oldest and rarest stocks from Barrell Craft Spirits, undergoing extended finishing in rum, port, and Dunn Vineyards cabernet barrels for an unparalleled complexity and depth. Crafted and bottled in Kentucky, this whiskey is a testament to the art of blending and finishing, offering a unique and intense flavor profile that stands out in the world of American whiskey.

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Limited Edition Gold Label Seagrass Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rye whiskey finished in Martinique rhum, Madeira, and apricot brandy casks.Matured for 20 years​Distilled in Canada​Crafted and bottled in Kentucky​128.12 proof cask strength bottling. Two sets of 20-year-old 100% Canadian Rye barrels were used as the foundation of Gold Label Seagrass - one with bright citrus notes and the other with earthy notes. A portion of the first group was finished in Apricot Brandy casks, a portion of the second group was finished in Martinique rhum barrels, and a blend of the first and second groups was finished in Malmsey Madeira barrels. When each set of secondary maturation flavors peaked, those casks were pulled and slowly married into the final blend.

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Limited Edition Gray Label Bourbon 2022
DESCRIPTION: A nose of chalk dust and wood smoke, with subtle notes of toasted marshmallow and warm honeycomb • Initial sweetness on the palate, checked by moderate heat and dry wood tannin, with abundant cola, allspice, fennel seed, and peppermint • Finishes rich and dry, with notes of pipe tobacco, walnut, and iced coffee Matured for 15 years Distilled and aged in Indiana, Kentucky, and Tennessee Crafted and bottled in Kentucky 50.2% ABV

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Limited Edition Gray Label Rum
DESCRIPTION: Jamaican rums can be at once endlessly rewarding in their complexity but a challenge to grapple with, so blending in Barbados and Demerara rums allows each of the distinct aromas to shine while focusing the profile around the berry fruit and peppery spice shared by all of these styles. Patience and a splash of water reward the drinker with boundless entertainment: innumerable tropical fruits, maritime minerals and heady florals. A blend of Jamaican, Guyanese Demerara, and Barbados Rums Crafted and bottled in Kentucky 129.4 proof cask strength bottling 14 years old Release #2

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Limited Edition Gray Label Whiskey 750ml  #1
DESCRIPTION: BCS Gray Label Whiskey began with two selections of 24-year Canadian whiskey barrels: one set was fruit-forward and tropical, and one was woody, with a light floral aroma. A portion of the fruit-forward blend was transferred into Oloroso Sherry barrels and a portion of the floral and earthy blend was transferred into Armagnac casks. The remaining whiskey from the two groups was then combined to mingle. When the timing and flavor from the finishing casks peaked, the three components were carefully blended together. ​ The mature, spicy whiskey is front and center, reminiscent of wheat fields edged with wildflowers. There is a rare and noteworthy concentration of aroma, enriched with a candy sweetness and leafy earthiness from the finishing casks, that calls to mind a toasty Belgian waffles.
