TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Limited Edition Seagrass Gray Label Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Craft Spirits has introduced BCS Gray Label Seagrass which features 100% Canadian rye whisky aged for 16 years, meticulously sourced and finished in Martinique Rhum, Madeira, and Apricot Brandy Barrels, and bottled at 130.82 proof (65.41% ABV)

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Private Release "Cranky Kong" Rye Whiskey Finished in Oloroso Sherry Barrel The Prime Barrel Pick #74
DESCRIPTION: The Barrell Private Release Series is a project in detailed blending on a scale small enough to allow extreme precision.​ The Private Release Series lets the brand exercise its blending expertise while maintaining a single barrel-like scale controlled entirely by hand and palate. The goal is always to maximize the best attributes of each component. Every ounce of every ingredient changes the overall character of these blends, as does the barrel in which each one is aged. For that reason, these barrels take months to polish and perfect. While the recipe for each release may not be replicated, the unique nature of each ingredient and the barrel they are married in makes every bottling singularly unique. Each release of the Private Release Whiskey is a unique blend of whiskeys. Once created, these blends are married in single casks, many of which were previously used for other spirits and/or wines. In our experience, we have had a Private Release Bourbon introduced previously, which was perfected in a PX Sherry cask, marking one of our finest selections in 2022. The Private Release Rye Whiskey is a fresh addition to the series, offering various finishing cask choices. We had the privilege of tasting variations finished in Armagnac, Tokaji, and Oloroso Sherry casks. Among these, the Oloroso Sherry cask finish stood out remarkably, adding a refined touch to the Private Release series with a contrasting sherry finish. Barrel Details: Distillate Region: Indiana and Canada Proof: 127.8 Blend# 1L13 Finish: Oloroso Sherry Tasting Notes: Color: Golden hay Nose: Citrus, tangerine peel, orange zest, buttery honey, a touch of sherry, ripe cantaloupe Palate: Oak well integrated with honey, medium sweet, melon, cantaloupe Finish: Lengthy with Meyer lemon note, peppery, spicy

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Private Release "J807" Cask Strength Rum
DESCRIPTION: The Barrell Private Release Series is a project in detailed blending on a scale small enough to allow extreme precision. This is the first time in our company’s history that we have offered “micro” blends to the public. ​ The Private Release Series lets us exercise our blending expertise while maintaining a single barrel-like scale controlled entirely by hand and by palate. Our goal is always to maximize the best attributes of each component. Every ounce of every ingredient changes the overall character of these blends, as does the barrel that each one is aged in. For that reason, these barrels take months to polish and perfect. While we may be able to replicate the recipe for these releases, the unique nature of each ingredient and the barrel they are married in makes every bottling singularly special. ​ Each release of our Private Release Rum is a unique blend of rums from Barbados, Jamaica, and Guyana, as well as Rhum Agricôle from Martinique. Once created, these blends are married in single casks, many of which were previously used for other spirits and/or wines. The base rum, which is from Jamaica, makes up 80% of the final blend. The marrying and finishing were done in a Calvados Cask.

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Private Release Kentucky Whiskey Finished in a St. Agrestis Brooklyn Amaro Cask
DESCRIPTION: The Barrell Private Release Series is a project in detailed blending on a scale small enough to allow extreme precision. This is the first time in the company’s history that they have offered “micro” blends to the public. Each release of our Private Release Whiskey is a unique blend of Kentucky Whiskey, the oldest being 18 years old. Once created, these blends are married in single casks, many of which were previously used for other spirits and/or wines. Each Private Release Whiskey series has slightly different base whiskeys and was entered into finishing casks at different times. This release in particular is a blend of KY Whiskeys, the largest component being 18-year-old KY whiskey, finished in a St. Agrestis Brooklyn Amaro Cask.

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Private Release Kentucky Whiskey Finished in Cognac Cask
DESCRIPTION: The Barrell Craft Spirits Private Release AQ48 is a unique whiskey with a Cognac cask finish, boasting a 61.87% ABV. This expression from Barrell Craft Spirits is known for its full-bodied aromas, rich and balanced flavors, and complex, impressive finish. It's a product that promises to please discerning whiskey connoisseurs, offering an unforgettable tasting experience

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Private Release Kentucky Whiskey Finished in Hermann J. Wiemer Noble Select Riesling Barrel
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Barrell Whiskey Private Release BH11 Finished In A Hermann J. Wiemer Noble Select Riesling Barrel is a limited edition whiskey from Barrell Craft Spirits. This whiskey is made from a blend of two straight whiskeys, one aged in new American oak barrels and the other aged in used bourbon barrels. The whiskey is then finished in a Hermann J. Wiemer Noble Select Riesling barrel, which imparts a unique flavor profile. Noble Riesling is a big, syrupy, and concentrated dessert riesling in a beerenauslese style with honey, honeycomb, and exotic tropical fruit flavors supported by assertive natural acidity. Very strong botrytis influence. This whiskey takes after that influence and has notes of honey, apricot, and citrus, with a smooth finish. This whiskey is bottled at cask strength.

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Private Release Kentucky Whiskey Finished in Jamaican Rum Cask
DESCRIPTION: The Barrell Whiskey Private Release CH01, finished in a Jamaican Rum Cask, is a blend of Kentucky Whiskeys, with the oldest being 18 years. It has an ABV of 57.13%. This release is noted for its full-bodied aromas, rich and balanced flavor, and a smooth, delicate finish.

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Private Release “Donkey Kong” Kentucky Whiskey Finished in PX Sherry Barrel The Prime Barrel Pick #30
DESCRIPTION: The Barrell Private Release Series is a project in detailed blending on a scale small enough to allow extreme precision.​ The Private Release Series lets the brand exercise its blending expertise while maintaining a single barrel-like scale controlled entirely by hand and palate. The goal is always to maximize the best attributes of each component. Every ounce of every ingredient changes the overall character of these blends, as does the barrel in which each one is aged. For that reason, these barrels take months to polish and perfect. While the recipe for each release may not be replicated, the unique nature of each ingredient and the barrel they are married in makes every bottling singularly unique. Each release of the Private Release Whiskey is a unique blend of whiskeys. Once created, these blends are married in single casks, many of which were previously used for other spirits and/or wines. In our case, our whiskey was finished in a PX Sherry cask. Each Private Release Whiskey series has a slightly different base whiskey and is entered into a finishing cask at a different time. If we had to describe this release in one sentence, it would be "the dessert in the glass". The PX Sherry influence is most definitely there in the most beautiful way possible. It enhances the base spirit and gives it a ton of layers that reveal themselves the deeper you get into your glass.Here's what you can look forward to: Nose: Toffee, oak, tanning leather, cigar, toasted coconut, roasted macadamia, almond skin, vanilla, burnt orange Palate: Caramel custard, pine sap, tangerine peel, meringue, maple syrup Finish: Molasses and Sichuan peppercorn For the sticker, our Discord community came up with an excellent idea - Donkey Kong throwing barrels. We made them "Barrell Whiskey" barrels and turn the sticker into a lenticular one (Google it) - the result is one unbelievably creative sticker that will please any collector. As always, each of our selections supports charity suggested by our Discord community. $5 from each bottle sold will go to support the Autism Speaks charity. Autism Speaks is dedicated to promoting solutions, across the spectrum and throughout the life span, for the needs of individuals with autism and their families. They do this through advocacy and support; increasing understanding and acceptance of people with autism, and advancing research into causes and better interventions for autism spectrum disorder and related conditions.

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Single Barrel Bourbon "Z5K7 - 9th Floor"
DESCRIPTION: This bourbon feels uncharacteristically EXPENSIVE because it tastes like the least affordable snacks: macadamia nuts and Valrhona chocolate cake dusted in gold leaf, decadently enjoyed from the comfort of a personal cedar barrel sauna (strategically placed in a picturesque clearing of an alpine forest—Google it: it’s a thing). Deep, dark, and dusted with imported teas and cigar smoke, Barrel #Z5K7 is a pampering whiskey for sure.

TITLE: Barrell Craft Spirits Vantage Cask Strength A Blend Of Straight Bourbon Whiskeys
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 95, #3 on the Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 ListEstablished in the blending world, Barrell Craft Spirits has demonstrated its finishing prowess with a series of creative releases that marry different cask types. Vantage is the most recent and, to us, the most successful. The nose has a bake shop sweetness, with aromas of sugar cookies, nutty chocolate brownies, Funfetti cake, earthy dried tobacco leaves, and strawberry candies underneath. The creamy palate delivers rich chocolate, Red Hots, and with water added dried leaves and snickerdoodles. The big cinnamon spice on the finish ties this one up beautifully.

TITLE: Barrell Dovetail
DESCRIPTION: Dovetail is blended to highlight some of our favorite flavors. Woody bourbon; terroir-driven Dunn Cabernet; toasted French oak; Late Bottled Vintage Port pipes; blackstrap molasses casks; all working in tandem to create a buttery and deep whiskey as unique as it is delicious. Dovetail took almost a year to get right, from blending to labeling, all coming together in a seemingly perfect point. 10-year-old whiskey distilled in Indiana and finished in Dunn Vineyards Cabernet barrels 11-year-old bourbon distilled in Tennessee finished in black strap rum casks and LBV Port Pipes Crafted and bottled in Kentucky

TITLE: Barrell Private Release Rum "B750 - 9th Floor"
DESCRIPTION: B750 is a blend of rums from Barbados, Jamaica, Martinique, and Guyana with the largest component, Barbados Rum, making up 75% of the final ratio. The marrying and finishing were done in a Pear Brandy barrel.

TITLE: Barrell Rum "Tale Of Two Islands" Cask Strength
DESCRIPTION: We filled previously used Islay Single Malt Whisky casks with a small amount of Barrell Rum Batch 001. We let it mature and the result is a deeply intense Jamaican rum with just a touch of misty peat smoke. Blended to be harmonious, it speaks to the place it was distilled, and to the home of the casks. Please enjoy the small amount we have to offer. Lift your spirits.

TITLE: Barrell Rum Cask Strength Batch #1
DESCRIPTION: Full-flavored and seductive, this rum evokes the sun-drenched breeze traveling across recently rained on tropical forests. Dried lemongrass in hue with freshly dried hay across the surface. This flirtatious liquid begs to be sipped and savored with the heat present but not overpowering. The bourbon barrel finishing is complementary to the rum, adding a woody sweetness and a unique pungency.

TITLE: Barrell Rye Whiskey Batch #001
DESCRIPTION: Malty and spicy with a small hint of corn sweetness. Grassy fresh notes and dill on the palate when water is added. Finish is has a bitter lemon quality to it.

TITLE: Barrell Rye Whiskey Batch #002
DESCRIPTION: Rye Batch 002 is our second release that expands on our interpretation of a traditional rye whiskey, combining two very diverse ryes. We selected barrels of a 100% malted rye distilled and aged in Poland for 5 years in new charred #3 oak barrels from World Cooperage. We then blended it with an Indiana high malted barley rye that was aged in Indiana and Kentucky for over 5 years. The Polish Rye is dry, with a rich nutty flavor, and pairs beautifully with the lush Indiana Rye, resulting in a sweet and savory balance of malted chocolate and roasted cashews.

TITLE: Barrell Rye Whiskey Batch #003
DESCRIPTION: Rye Batch 003 is a blend of rye whiskeys from Indiana, Poland, Tennessee and Canada, all with distinct personalities and varying ages. We started with Tennessee Rye barrels with caramel and dried fruit notes and added the Polish Rye for its nuttiness and mouthfeel. We then carefully layered in 13-year Canadian Rye to bring out earthy notes of grass, spearmint, and apple. The Indiana Rye was the finishing touch to highlight the candied fruit and spiciness you expect from rye. DOUBLE GOLD winner at 2020 San Francisco World Spirits Competition. A blend of straight Rye Whiskeys Distilled and aged in Indiana, Tennessee, Poland, and Canada Selection of 4 to 14-year-old barrels Crafted and bottled in Kentucky 116.7 proof cask strength bottling

TITLE: Barrell Rye Whiskey Batch #004
DESCRIPTION: 10-year-old Indiana Rye barrels with notes of brown sugar and a touch of smoke had 5 and 6-year-old barrels layered in for fruit and spice character. 14-year-old Canadian barrels were added for their dry herbal notes. The result is fruit-forward rye with layers of depth. This rye blend highlights rye's earthier side, featuring notes of tobacco, leather, and mole poblano. Its stewed fruit and wilder savory character recall the syrahs of France's Rhône valley: blackberry and tapenade on the nose followed by a sweet meaty finish with a hint of black pepper. BLEND COMPONENTS Indiana Rye: 5, 6, & 10 years old Tennessee Rye: 5 years old Kentucky Rye: 6 years old Canadian Rye: 14 years old DERIVED MASH BILL Rye: 89% Corn: 7% Malted Barley: 4%

TITLE: Barrell Whiskey American Vatted Malt
DESCRIPTION: Brand's first-ever Barrell Whiskey American Vatted Malt. This bottling is a blend of exclusively American single malt whiskeys. Folks at Barrell partnered with small and large producers across the country to select whiskeys that express the full diversity of American terroir and style. The resulting blend is remarkable, and we are proud to be the first to showcase the growing category of American single malt in this way. Some of the collaborators have asked to remain anonymous, but the core group of participants includes: Balcones Distillery, Waco, Texas Hamilton Distillers Del Bac, Tucson, Arizona MGP, Lawrenceburg, Indiana Harvest Distillery, Valatie, New York Santa Fe Distillery, Santa Fe, New Mexico Kings Country Distillery, Brooklyn, New York

TITLE: Barrell Whiskey Batch # 1 Barrel Strength
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Whiskey Batch 001 is made from a bourbon mash of corn, rye and malted barley. The whiskey was distilled in Indiana and matured in Kentucky for seven years in ex-bourbon barrels. While using ex-bourbon barrels (as opposed to new American oak barrels) means the whiskey cannot be called bourbon, the used barrels allow the expression of many subtler, complex flavors masked by the abundant wood sugars in new barrels. Each Barrell batch is different with a limited release. Once sold out it’s gone forever.

TITLE: Barrell Whiskey Batch # 2 Barrel Strength Sherry Cask
DESCRIPTION: This nine-and-a-half-year-old whiskey, which won Double Gold at the 2016 San Francisco World Spirits Competition, is bottled at a punchy 123.8 proof and finished in Sherry Cask (4-6 months in 20th century Hungarian Oak/Oloroso Sherry). Mash bill is 70% Corn, 25% Rye, and 5% Malted Barley + a little bit of 70% Corn, 26% Rye, and 4% Malted Barley

TITLE: Barrell Whiskey Batch #005
DESCRIPTION: Barrell Whiskey Batch 005 is a spice driven blend of 9 year-old whiskeys finished in Amaro barrels, American Brandy barrels, Bourbon barrels, and Cognac casks. We finished each whiskey separately and assembled a final blend that also includes Straight Bourbon. This finish then blend technique allows us to focus on the key flavors of each component first, and then on harmony and precision while blending. We believe that this batch is far greater than the sum of its parts.

TITLE: Barrell Whiskey Infinite Barrel Project 750ml  #2
DESCRIPTION: The tradition of keeping an infinity bottle is well known to whiskey collectors and aficionados around the world. Take the last ounces of each whisk(e)y bottle as you finish it, and pour them into a bottle you’ve set aside. Barrell Craft Spirits is honoring the Infinity bottle tradition in our own way by introducing the Infinite Barrel Project.Crisply textured, richly aromatic and seemingly hand-polished, the Barrell Whiskey Infinite Barrel Project combines and delivers different styles of whiskey into a racy and cerebral dram. The whiskey is piquant with overlaying sheets of sweet condensed milk caramels and copper pot cooked blackberry jam with hints of crushed fall leaves and long winters. The prolonged and enigmatic finish is reminiscent of saline drenched staves of toasty, charred oak and ladles of flor rich, Oloroso Sherry.

TITLE: Barrika Basque Country Cider
DESCRIPTION: Acidity lends itself to a great pairing with fish and cured cheeses. Alternatively, Barrika can provide an interesting contrast to heavier foods such as burgers and as it is frequently enjoyed in Basque Country, with steak.

TITLE: Bash! California Rose Sparkling
Basil Hayden "Subtle Smoke" Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: NextSectionColor - Deep, rich amber with copper undertones Aroma - A mellow smoke character with a hint of sweet vanilla Flavor - Soft char with a light sweetness reminiscent of butterscotch and maple Finish - Crisp yet delicate smokiness with light toasted hickory wood.

TITLE: Basil Hayden Red Wine Cask Finish Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This ultra-premium, limited-time offering highlights the refined and light flavor profile of Basil Hayden, while delivering distinctive red wine flavor in a unique & sophisticated way. Red Wine Cask Finish is a blend of the classic Basil Hayden high-rye mash bill and bourbon partially aged in Californian red wine casks. Perfectly balanced, Basil Hayden Red Wine Cask Finish is layered & complex, yet approachable & inviting. Our bourbon is ideally served in aperitif-style sipping cocktails that complement the versatility of the liquid. It lends itself to an exploration of classic and bartender-inspired cocktails that are best enjoyed as the “first sip” of any occasion.

TITLE: Basil Hayden Toast Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The latest permanent release from Basil Hayden consists of an entirely new brown rice mashbill and a secondary finish in toasted barrels. The result is a bourbon with less spice, and deepened notes of sweet caramel with a bright, light mouthfeel.

TITLE: Basil Hayden's 10 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The new Basil Hayden’s 10-Year-Old Bourbon is a special, extra aged seasonal offering that is made available as a limited edition whiskey each holiday season. Bottled at 80 proof, the extra maturation of this high rye bourbon in American oak barrels offers an additional layer of complexity that delivers heightened oak aromas along with hints of char and vanilla while maintaining Basil Hayden’s trademark spice in every sip.

TITLE: Basil Hayden's 10 Years Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Basil Hayden's new LTO launching May 2020. The mashbill features a slightly spicy, yet approachable, rye resulting in an elegantly complex taste profile and a golden honey hue. Bottled at 80 proof, this light, yet full-flavored, rye is sure to please any palate.

TITLE: Basil Hayden's Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Basil Hayden's Bourbon has a lighter flavor than most traditional bourbons. This product of the Jim Beam family uses around twice the amount of rye that is used in other bourbons. The effect on the flavor softens the sweet, traditional corn base and brings out spicier notes. The clean, light finish warms you up, leaving a fresh after taste (must be the hint of peppermint.) This bourbon comes in at 80 proof and can be sipped neat or enjoyed in a cocktail.

TITLE: Basil Hayden's Caribbean Reserve Rye
DESCRIPTION: Crafted as an approachable whiskey expression to enjoy during the warm summer months, Basil Hayden’s Caribbean Reserve Rye takes inspiration from the sweet and spicy contrast between rye whiskey and rum. The limited-time offering features a blend of 8-year-old Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey and 4-year-old Canadian Rye Whisky, which bring to life layers of flavor, including distinct spice, toasted oak, and vanilla notes. The blend is then finished with the addition of Black Strap Rum which ties the rye whiskey pairing together with sweet notes of brown sugar and molasses. The result is a balanced whiskey that remains approachable to discover at 80 proof. TastingNotes AROMA: Rich caramel and brown sugar complemented by back notes of soft rye and vanilla TASTE: A balanced blend of sumptuous rye and brown sweets with an ample woody accent FINISH: A pleasant, long lingering warmth

TITLE: Basil Hayden's Dark Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Producer info: Blending is an art form, and our Dark Rye is your chance to own what might very well be a masterpiece. It all begins with Kentucky Rye, providing a firm foundation of spice, oak, dried fruit and subtle molasses undertones for this release to build upon. From there, Canadian Rye from our award-winning Alberta Distillery is skillfully layered in. A touch of California Port, and its complementary notes of ripe fruit, provides the third and final layer to a whiskey just as at home on the rocks as it is in a cocktail. Full in flavor, yet delicately nuanced, you’d be wise to grab a bottle of our Dark Rye to experience this magical blend for yourself

TITLE: Basil Hayden's Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Basil Hayden’s Rye Whiskey, according to those behind it, is a Kentucky straight rye whiskey that’s been influenced by a so-called unique, re-barreled rye. More specifically, this re-barreled rye begins life as a 4-year-old traditional rye, which is then dumped from its aging barrels and further aged an additional seven years in a newly charred quarter cask oak barrels. A portion of it is then blended with traditional Kentucky straight rye whiskey to craft the final product.

TITLE: Basil Hayden's Two By Two Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Drawing on the spirit of the original high-rye bourbon recipe, folks at Basil Hayden doubled down with this balanced blend of two Rye and two Bourbon Whiskies, creating an uncommonly smooth, slightly sweet profile. This exclusive release marries two Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskies with two Kentucky straight Bourbon Whiskies creating a golden spirits rich in aromas of caramel, brown sugar, and vanilla. At a smooth 80 proof, the rye spice is balanced with a rich sweetness and notes of wood. With a pleasant, lingering finish, this uncommon spirit is perfect for enjoying any way you like.

TITLE: BCN Prior Barcelona Dry Gin
DESCRIPTION: The profile of BCN Gin is explosively fragrant, with an abundance of fruit and herbaceousness. The palate shows fresh herbs like mint and anise, bright candied red and tropical fruits, and subtle spice notes like sumac and pink peppercorns.

TITLE: Beattie's Potato Vodka
Beattie's Sweet Potato Vodka
Bebame El Dorado County Red Wine
DESCRIPTION: Varietal/Blend: 93% CABERNET FRANC, 7% GAMAY Farming: practicing organic Fermentation: Stainless Steel Aging: SETTLED FOR FOUR MONTHS IN STAINLESS STEEL Alcohol: 12.0% Soil: Clay, granite Vine Age: 8 - 15 years old Yeast: indigenous producer info: We love transparent, delicious, easy, characterful, and deeply flavorful wines that are finely structured and relatively low in alcohol: Chinon, Bourgeuil, Beaujolais, Mondeuse, Marzemino, Lagrein, Barbera, Albarino, Vermentino, Txakolina . . . . you get the idea. What we don’t understand is why this style of wine is rarely made in the New World. While there is a school of thought that says New World wine has to be richer, higher in alcohol, and riper, we don’t buy it. We believe that if the grapes are planted on cool, appropriate sites, well-farmed, picked ripe at reasonable sugar levels, and truly minimally handled in the cellar, we can make just such wines without compromise in the New World.

TITLE: Beckmen Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Founded in 1994 by father/son team Tom and Steve Beckmen, Beckmen Vineyards is a family-run, estate winery located in Santa Barbara County's Santa Ynez Valley. And, while they have largely specialized in the production of Rhône varietals, their Estate Cabernet is consistently noteworthy, and this is no exception.

TITLE: Beckmen Vineyards Cuvee Le Bec
DESCRIPTION: Beckmen Vineyards wines never lack for fruit or texture, yet show beautiful poise and length, especially in these cooler vintages. This big wine needs the big flavors of brisket, stew, beef steak, lamb, venison, and maybe pork chops if the sauce isnt' too acidic.

TITLE: Bedell Cellar First Crush First Crush Merlot Cabernet Franc
DESCRIPTION: First Crush is a unique red blend made with sustainably farmed young vine fruit, and aged in stainless steel to preserve its easygoing character. 60% Merlot, 40% Cabernet Franc. Pair with poultry, lasagna, couscous with meat, Middle Eastern fare, veggie pizza, and Greek cuisine.

TITLE: Bedrock Wine Company Old Vine Zinfandel
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the heritage of California winemaking with Bedrock Wine Company Old Vine Zinfandel, a distinguished red wine crafted by the renowned Bedrock Wine Company. This Zinfandel is a tribute to the rich history of old-vine vineyards, showcasing the depth and complexity of California's wine legacy.

TITLE: Beer Barrel Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1997, NHBC has grown from a scrappy two-man start-up to a thriving regional microbrewery, recognized for its creativity and artistry. In 2005, NHBC excitedly announced the launch of New Holland Artisan Spirits, the brewery’s line of spirits produced in the company’s new micro-distillery. Beer Barrel Bourbon is first aged in new American oak barrels for several years, before a three-month beer-y slumber. The beer-barrel aging lends biscuity notes and a smooth malt character to the robust whiskey tones of toffee and caramel.

TITLE: Bellande Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: 100% Pinot Noir from organically farmed vineyards within the Willamette Valley. The majority of the blend is from Finnigan Hill Vineyard - a higher elevation site in the Chehalem Mountains AVA. Other vineyard sources include Claygate Vineyard in Ribbon Ridge AVA, Johan Vineyard in Van Duzer Corridor AVA, as well as Roshni and Cassin Vineyards in McMinnville AVA. Fermented with native yeasts and matured in neutral French oak.

TITLE: Belle Glos Pinot Noir Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Belle Glos showcases distinctive Pinot Noirs produced from some of California’s top wine-growing regions. The vineyard locations can all be described as coastal, but the climate differences are significant, depending on the amount of fog, wind, sunlight, and soil type at each site. Each wine is crafted to distill the purest essence of the vineyard into elegant expressions of California Pinot Noir. Winemaker Joseph Wagner chose the name Belle Glos (pronounced BELL GLOSS) to honor his grandmother, Lorna Belle Glos Wagner, a co-founder of Caymus Vineyards. This is a bespoke rosé in that the Pinot Noir grapes were grown specifically with the intention of making a rosé wine. Pale pink with a copper hue, this wine has a classic “eye of the partridge” color. Grilled Lamb Chops, Salmon, Seafood

TITLE: Belle Meade Bourbon 9 Year Oloroso Sherry Cask Finish
DESCRIPTION: A proprietary blend of well aged Bourbon. Rested in used Oloroso Sherry casks to finish. High-rye content (30% rye). 90.4 proof is the ideal sweet spot for depth of character. Never chill-filtered to retain maximum flavor.

TITLE: Belle Meade Bourbon Finished in XO Cognac Cask
DESCRIPTION: Belle Meade Bourbon Finished in XO Cognac Cask is production process starts with distillery seeking the perfect casks for the project because like any other ingredient, the finishing cask must be exceptional in order to achieve exceptional results. They use casks made of French Limousin Oak that have been used for 12 years to age one of the world's premiere Fine Champagne XO Cognacs. One smell of these casks tells you that they hold truly magnificent potential as finishing barrels. They then fill the casks with a blend of Bourbons ranging in age from 6-9 years to coax the best results from the casks. The younger barrels pair with the spice and fruit characteristics of the cask while the rich depth and complexity of the older barrels play perfectly with the soft, luxurious flavors of the well-aged Cognac that once inhabited the French oak. Belle Meade Bourbon Finished in XO Cognac Cask is the perfect way to wind down the day when sipped neat, with a splash of water, or on the rocks. A proprietary blend of barrels ranging from 6-9 years old. The blend is then rested to finish in XO Cognac that were used for 12 years. High Rye Content (30%) Non-chill filtered 90.4 Proof

TITLE: Belle Meade Bourbon Honey Cask Finish Gift Set
DESCRIPTION: For this release, Belle Meade partnered with folks at TruBee Honey Farm in Arrington, TN. They fill empty Belle Meade Bourbon barrels with local wildflower honey and allow it to age to produce a Barrel-Aged Honey—some of the most delicate nectar around. Once the TruBee process is complete, Belle Meade takes the "honey barrels" back and fill them with the proprietary blend to finish for an additional 6-8 months. The result is one of Nelson's Green Brier Distillery's most celebrated creations: Belle Meade Bourbon Honey Cask Finish. Perfection! Bottled at 106 Proof.The gift set also includes a jar of TruBee honey and a branded Glencairn glass

TITLE: Belle Meade Bourbon Madeira Cask Finish
DESCRIPTION: Belle Meade Bourbon Madeira Cask Finish showcases both a taste of America's Native Spirit and the Old World wine-making methods used in Madeira production. To finish this offering distillery selects casks which were used in the production of Malmsey Madeira. Malmsey is the richest and sweetest tasting of the Madeira styles and is renowned for the depth and complexity of its honeyed flavors. This is a result of the wine being "cooked," fortified, and aged in the time-honored traditions of winemaking on the island of Madeira. Distillery fills these casks with a blend of 6- and 9-year-old Bourbons. The robust flavors from the casks pair well with the spicy high rye content of the Bourbon and create a striking profile unlike any other whiskey in the world. Belle Meade Bourbon Madeira Cask Finish has been cut to 90.4 proof and, as with all of their products, is never chill-filtered. The result is a Bourbon of particular distinction and uncommon character. Have it neat, with a splash, over a sphere of ice, or create a distinguished twist on your favorite whiskey-based classic cocktail. However you drink it, you'll know you are enjoying a rare spirit made for the discerning whiskey drinker. A proprietary blend of barrels ranging from 6-9 years old. The blend is then rested to finish in Malmsey Madeira Casks. High Rye Content (30%) Non-chill filtered 90.4 Proof

TITLE: Belle Meade Cask Strength Reserve Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Belle Meade Bourbon Cask Strength Reserve is a premium full strength whiskey created to quench the growing demand for well-aged, higher proof bourbon. Folks at Belle Meade taste every barrel in the inventory and reserve the ones that taste good enough to be a Single Barrel but don't have a high enough proof to be a Single Barrel. They batch these reserve barrels with others barrels in the inventory that raise the proof of the batch while accentuating the flavors of those reserve barrels. When blended together, these barrels of well-aged bourbon create a product that is greater than the sum of its individual parts. Each small batch of our Reserve is just seven barrels of high rye content whiskey ranging in age from 7-11 years old. Bottled at Cask Strength Small batch: 7 barrels Barrels aged 7 - 11 years Not Chill-Filtered to retain maximum flavor High-rye content Batch 19.10 116.6 Proof TastingNotesWhile every batch is slightly different, all Belle Meade Bourbon Cask Strength Reserve is rich and full flavored. Showing vanilla, caramel, spice, and stone fruits.

TITLE: Belle Meade Sour Mash Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: To ensure that no other Bourbon in the world tastes like Belle Meade Bourbon, distillery created a proprietary blend using two different high-rye content mash bills and two complementary yeast strains from barrels aged between 6 to 8 years. Each batch of the proprietary blend consists of just 4 barrels and creates the signature flavor profile that makes Belle Meade Bourbon the award-winning Bourbon of choice for the discerning whiskey drinker. High-rye Content (30% rye). 90.4 proof is the ideal sweet spot for depth of character. Small Batch – 4 barrels per batch. A proprietary blend of barrels aged 6-8 years. Never chill-filtered to retain maximum flavor.

TITLE: Bellion Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Bellion Vodka is the world’s first “functional spirit”. Made with NTX Technology, Bellion addresses the common concerns of alcohol consumption without removing any of the desired effects. Bellion is naturally sweet and 6x distilled to bring functionality and flavor to every sip. Enjoy an additional layer of the essence in your traditional cocktails so you can eliminate the need for sugary mixers in your next drink. Made in Fairfield, CA 6x Distilled from corn Infused with NTX Gluten-Free 80 Proof | 40% ALC/VOL

TITLE: Beluga Noble Russian Vodka
Beluga Noble Russian Vodka
Belvedere Vodka
Ben Holladay Bottled In Bond 6 Year Old Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Ben Holladay Bottled In Bond 6 Year Old Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a testament to the rich distilling heritage of the Holladay Distillery in Weston, Missouri. This bourbon is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, using the same mash bill that was developed by Ben Holladay in 1856. The bourbon is aged for six years in level three charred Missouri white oak barrels and is non-chill filtered.

TITLE: Ben Nevis 23 yrs Sherry Butt Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Named after the Scotland’s highest peak, Ben Nevis sits at the base of its namesake mountain in the country’s Western Highlands. The distillery was opened by John MacDonald in 1825, and was passed down within the family for generations. In the early twentieth century, the distillery came under combined ownership with the nearby Nevis Distillery, and today remains one of Scotland’s most renowned producers of cask-finishes, limited editions, and independently bottled malts. AGED: 23 years DISTILLED ON: October 18, 1991 BOTTLE ON: February 19, 2015 MATURED IN: Sherry Butt CASK NO: 3717 ALC: 54.3%

TITLE: Ben Nevis 25 yrs Sherry Butt Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Ben Nevis sits just at the base of its namesake, Scotland’s highest mountain. A coastal distillery in the Western Highlands, Ben Nevis draws its water from the Allta’Mhuilinnwhich originates from two pools, CoireLeis and Coirena’Ciste, which are both sited a good way up the mountain. The distillery was founded in 1825, by the gloriously named ‘Long John’ MacDonald, for whom the renowned Long John blended Scotch was named. After Long John’s death in 1856, ownership was passed down to Donald McDonald, his son.

TITLE: Benchmark Bourbon Old No. 8 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The nose bears caramel notes with a delicate stone-fruit backdrop. A robust and sturdy palate with some fine leather notes mingling with dry tobacco, a touch of oak and a hint of dried cherries. The finish is smooth and calming.

TITLE: Benedicte & Stephane Tissot Cremant du Jura Blanc Non Dose
DESCRIPTION: As most of the sparkling wines from the region, the Crémants du Jura from Tissot are sold without vintage, which is a shame as some of them are really age-worthy; it would be great to be able to compare vintages and follow up on evolution. So we started with the NV Crémant du Jura Extra Brut that has a golden color with some pink tints, as it’s a blend of 50% Pinot Noir, 40% Chardonnay, 5% Trousseau, 5% Poulsard with half of the wine fermented in neutral oak barrique and with no dosage. Crémant can be 30% of the whole production of the Jura, and in Tissot, it is also 25%-30% of their volume. This is clean and with very strong aromas of apples, hints of fennel, and aniseed with very pleasant acidity and abundant bubbles. It’s very easy to drink and very pleasant with a mineral, sapid finish. This has to be one of the best Crémants from Jura and certainly a steal among sparkling wines.

TITLE: Benito Ferrara Aglianico Vigna Quattro Confini
DESCRIPTION: Gabriella Ferrara manages this small estate, that has been in her family for many generations, together with her husband Sergio. The major part of the vineyards (5.5 hectares) stands in the district of San Paolo within the commune of Tufo, which is considered the best zone for the Greco grape variety. The Aglianico vineyards (3.3 hectares) stand in the zone of Montemiletto. The altitude is ideal between 450 and 600 meters above sea level with southern exposure, the area is cool and airy, which naturally protects the vines against frosts and diseases. The Greco vineyards stand next to abandoned sulphur mines and sulphur rocks can be found amongst the vines: this gives the wines wonderful mineral notes. The cellar equipment is extremely modern. The talented oenologist Paolo Caciorna helps the Ferrara family make great wines that are appreciated worldwide. Wines such as this one that still retain the characteristics of the traditional style (i.e., massive black fruits, astringent and powerful tannins and laser acidity) demand very flavorful, hearty and rustic dishes such as a very rich and thick stew, grilled or braised meats or sausages, or liver. Think osso buco. This style of cuisine works to cut the tannins and acidity. Stay away from lighter or even more moderate weight dishes as the wine will roll over it, leaving you with no hint of the cuisine profile. If you’re game to pair Aglianico with cheese, go for hard ones such as pecorino, Gouda or Aged Manchego. Now envision sitting by a fire on a chilly winter day, enjoying your favorite warm dish of hearty stew or braised meat and a glass of Aglianico. Now THAT’s a wine and food pairing

TITLE: Benito Santos Igrexario de Saiar  Rias Baixas Albarino
DESCRIPTION: Maritime breezes mingle with the fruity aromas and a definitive floral component gently rises and captivates the imagination. The flavors are pure, clean and linger long after swallowing; allowing you to stare blissfully at the ocean in your real or imaginary deck chair and savor the experience before taking another sip. Simply brilliant.

TITLE: Benjamin Prichard's Double Chocolate Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Don't think of this as a 'flavored bourbon.' Benjamin Prichard’s Double Chocolate Bourbon is a very serious 90-Proof Bourbon. Infused with cocoa nibs (from Nashville-based artisanal chocolatier Olive & Sinclair), it begins with much of the sweetness typical to bourbon. Still, it is balanced with the bitterness of the pure chocolate to produce a better-balanced bourbon, belying its 90-proof character. Introducing the small quantity of chocolate into the finishing process is intended to influence and augment that natural hint of chocolate in good bourbons. A conscious effort is made not to overpower the wonderful flavor of the bourbon but simply reinforce what's already there. The result is a rich, full-flavored bourbon with natural chocolate flavors subtly enhanced.

TITLE: Benriach 1997 Cask Edition Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Personally selected by Master Blender Rachel Barrie from the Benriach eclectic cask collection, each Cask Edition is drawn from a single cask chosen for exceptional taste and character. Distilled on 7th July 1997 and aged for 24 years in a virgin oak barrel before bottling in 2021 at a cask strength of 53.2% abv and limited to 244 bottles.

TITLE: Benriach 2009 Cask Edition Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The BenRiach Distillery scores well with its single cask bottlings. The single malt whisky in this bottling matured for 11 years in a cask in which moscatel wine previously matured.

TITLE: Benriach Malting Season Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Many years ago, the BenRiach distillery defied convention and started to peat a proportion of our spirit, returning to the original Speyside character and flavour of malts typical of the nineteenth century. Matured in a combination of Oloroso Sherry casks and Bourbon barrels, Peated Cask Strength Batch 1 is non chill filtered, natural colour and bottled at 56%, so it can be experienced as if sampled from the source – straight from the cask. Warming oak, orchard fruits culminating in a sweet heather smoke.

TITLE: Benriach Malting Season Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Many years ago, the BenRiach distillery defied convention and started to peat a proportion of our spirit, returning to the original Speyside character and flavour of malts typical of the nineteenth century. Matured in a combination of Oloroso Sherry casks and Bourbon barrels, Peated Cask Strength Batch 1 is non chill filtered, natural colour and bottled at 56%, so it can be experienced as if sampled from the source – straight from the cask. Warming oak, orchard fruits culminating in a sweet heather smoke.

TITLE: Benriach Smoke Season Double Cask Matured Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Benriach Smoke Season has been double matured in both American virgin oak and bourbon casks and bottled at 52.8% abv. Spectacular stuff. The nose has orange peel, chocolate and rich caramel. The palate is decadently layered with sweetness from the virgin oak casks, with dark vanilla and stewed apple, alongside dry oak, woody smoke and gentle spice. The finish is nutty with a smoky peppercorn aftertaste.

TITLE: Benrinnes 11 Years Speyside Hogshead 86 Proof Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Distilled in June 2007, this Benrinnes was whacked straight into a pair of bourbon barrels for just over a decade. After 11 years of ageing, Signatory decided it was time to bottle the single malt in February 2019, and did so, bottling the Highlander at 43% ABV.

TITLE: Benrinnes 20 yrs "Signatory 30th Anniversary Limited Edition" 1997 Sherry Hogshead-Very Dark Single Malt
DESCRIPTION: 30th anniversary expression is packaged in a stunning gift box & includes two (2) signature tasting glasses.

TITLE: Benrinnes Hogshead 17 yrs Highland 86 Proof Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Benrinnes malt whiskey distillery has been producing its namesake whiskey since 1826. Though the original distillery was located on Peter Mckenzie’s farm, the factory was rebuilt in 1835 after a flood destroyed the property. Most commonly used in blends such as Johnnie Walker and J&B, independent bottlings of Benrinnes are rare. AGED: 17 years DISTILLED ON: February 27, 1997 BOTTLE ON: July 28, 2014 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 2130 ALC: 43%

TITLE: Berkshire Mountain Distillers Greylock Gin
DESCRIPTION: Berkshire Mountain Distillers' Greylock Gin is hand crafted in small batches at the Berkshire's first legal distillery since prohibition. Our proprietary blend of botanicals, packed into a gin head suspended over a pot still, infuses the distillate with its unique essence. We use this time honored and labor intensive method to bring you a London dry style gin of exceptional quality. Established in 2007, Berkshire Mountain Distillers (BMD) has created a line of award-winning artisanal spirits including Greylock Gin, Ethereal Gins, Ragged Mountain Rum, Ice Glen Vodka, Berkshire Bourbon and New England Corn Whiskey, currently available in 19 different states. All products are handcrafted in small batches in Great Barrington, Massachusetts at the Berkshire’s first legal distillery since prohibition. BMD is one of the founding members of the craft distiller movement and is embraced by several of the nation’s leading mixologists. Their products have received numerous high accolades including Gold Medal Awards from the Beverage Tasting Institute and San Francisco Spirits Competition and national praise from publications like GQ, Details, New York Times, Wine Enthusiast and Jim Murray’s Whiskey Bible. As supporters of local agriculture and business, BMD uses regional materials in many of their products, creating a truly authentic artisanal brand.

TITLE: Berkshire Mountain Distillers Shays' Rebellion American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Berkshire Mountain Distillers is revealing a ready-to-market expression that’s the result of a nearly three and a half year experiment with the Sam Adams brewery. What’s known as Shays’ Rebellion American Whiskey came about back in 2012, when the distillery had the idea to experiment with triple distilling a batch of Samuel Adams Cinder Bock, a fiery Rauch Bock beer. The resultant whiskey made from this beer was then aged in Samuel Adams Utopias casks for nearly three and a half years” before being ready for bottling at 86 proof. “The final battle of Shays’ Rebellion occurred only three miles from our distillery in Western MA,” said Chris Weld, Master Distiller at Berkshire Mountain Distillers, in a statement. “Two hundred and fifty years later, we’re working with our friends in the East to create a whiskey that celebrates Massachusetts’ spirit of independence.” “The aging process intensified the mature, complex flavors of this small batch whiskey. We’ve released a limited number of bottles, so I encourage folks to track down a bottle and enjoy this whiskey responsibly.” Shays’ Rebellion American Whiskey is being released as a limited bottling, with less than 3,000 bottles being made available. It is only available in Massachusetts, New York, New Jersey, Georgia, and Michigan, as well as the distillery’s retail store.

TITLE: Berkshire Mountain Distillers Smoke & Peat Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In making their smoke and peat series bourbon, distillery first started with their gold medal award winning Berkshire Bourbon that has been previously aged in Virgin American white oak barrels. Once it has been aged to perfection, they then transferred it to casks that have been freshly emptied of an Islay single malt Scotch. Distillers let the bourbon finish in these heavily peated and smoked casks for just the right amount of time. The resultant whiskey is sure to please, perhaps even bring together, two typically different types of whiskey drinkers.

TITLE: Berkshire Mountain Distillers Two Lanterns American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: After over four years in the making, Berkshire Mountain Distillers is finally releasing its Two Lanterns American Whiskey - the result of a collaborative effort with Samuel Adams. This whiskey has been triple distilled from Sam Adams’ flagship beer, Boston Lager, which was the cornerstone of the American craft beer revolution. This whiskey is the first whiskey ever legally to be distilled from Boston Lager, and its taste profile uncannily mirrors that from which it was distilled. Well, the apple does not fall far from the tree on this one. Toasted malt and caramel on the nose, with a floral quality reminiscent of green grape and lychee nut, probably a vestigial reminder of the perfectly blended hops used in making this beer. This is a very clean and light whiskey that is genetically tied to a historic lager - try a taste of history.

TITLE: Bernabeleva Camino de Navaherreros Blanco
DESCRIPTION: Bodegas Bernabeleva Camino de Navaherreros Blanco is a refreshing and aromatic white wine from the Madrid region of Spain. It is a blend of Albillo, Macabeo, Malvar, and Moscatel grapes, grown on steep, granite-rich slopes at an altitude of 750 meters above sea level.

TITLE: Bernabeleva Vinos de Madrid Camino de Navaherreros
DESCRIPTION: Robust, peppery Grenache from vineyards just outside Madrid.This is a limited release wine. The new vintage tends to release the end of the summer and sell out before the end of Spring.

TITLE: Bernard Baudry Chinon Rose
DESCRIPTION: While Domaine Bernard Baudry is a relatively young Chinon estate, it is certainly one of the stars of the appellations. Bernard began with 2 hectares in Cravant-lès-Coteaux fresh out of wine school in Beaune in 1982 and proceeded to build it to its current 32 hectares—90% of which is Cabernet Franc plus 10% Chenin Blanc—slowly but surely. Though Bernard has retired and allowed his son Matthieu, who began working at his side in 2000, to assume the lead role, together they continue to make wines which set the standard in Chinon. Extremely limited availability.

TITLE: Bernard Baudry Les Granges Chinon
DESCRIPTION: Starting with only two hectares in 1982, Bernard Baudry, now working side-by-side with his dynamic son Matthieu, has grown the domaine to its present area of 30 hectares. This size allows him to vinify each parcel separately and show the distinct terroirs in the area. The Les Granges, from sandy, gravelly soil is an excellent expression of Cabernet Franc, with great fruit and balance. The Grezeaux, from 50 year old vines planted in gravel and clay shows a distinct smoky, bacon-y and blueberry component. Clos Guillot is from clay over yellow limestone and is perhaps the finest and most elegant of Baudry’s wines. Finally the Croix Boisee, from 35-40 year old vines planted in chalky, white limestone soil, spends up to two years in barrel and always shows as the most structured cuvee.

TITLE: Bernheim Original 7 Year Old Kentucky Straight Wheat Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The first truly new American Whiskey to be introduced in many generations. Whereas others contain primarily corn, barley, or rye, Bernheim is the only type of straight whiskey which uses soft winter wheat. Whisky Advocate magazine rating: 92

TITLE: Bernheim Original Barrel Proof Kentucky Straight Wheat Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Coming in nearly 30 proof points higher than the standard version, Bernheim Original Barrel Proof Wheat Whiskey is a bigger, bolder version that improves upon the base version in nearly every way. This inaugural batch of Bernheim Original Barrel Proof Wheat Whiskey Barrel Proof is a welcome addition to Heaven Hill’s lineup but still leaves a lot of room for the brand to grow. It’s an improvement over the standard version in nearly every way, delivering a richer flavor profile from start to finish.

TITLE: Bertha Cava Brut Nature Reserva
DESCRIPTION: Without a doubt, the Brut Nature Reserva is the most emblematic cava in our collection because it represents 45% of our sells. The word reserva means that the cava needs to mature 15 months, at least. This cava is produced with macabeo, xarel·lo and parellada. It’s ideal to be served with aperitifs, starters, fish and white meat.

TITLE: BEX Riesling
DESCRIPTION: The Nahe Valley, pronounced Nah-heh, is 25 miles south of the Mosel Valley in southwest Germany. Nahe is known for its mild climate, moderate rainfall and diverse soils yielding Riesling with finesse, light spiciness and attractive mineral highlights. Not your average Riesling. Burst of lemon-lime at first taste with a crisp tangy finish. Enjoy as a perfect aperitif, accompaniment to light or spicy cuisine or as a finale served with dessert.

TITLE: Bib & Tucker Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This Tennessee bourbon’s packaging has an old-school look and name (referring to dressing up, perhaps in your Sunday best), but in reality, it’s rather new, first brought to market in 2014. Despite its lack of pedigree, at 6 years old this is lip-smacking whiskey, with a color of caramel, and an alluring aroma of sweet baking spices. There are bold, bracing tannins of cigar box and menthol that balance out the heavy sweetness of the orange jam and long-stewed fruit. Intense, tasty, no-nonsense bourbon.

TITLE: Bib and Tucker 12 Year Single Barrel Select Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Patiently aged for the bourbon connoisseur, this is a limited offering of our carefully crafted 12-year-old bourbon, where long aging has produced a stunningly smooth yet complex bourbon. Each barrel is being bottled individually at a warming yet rich 99 proof and non-chill filtered. Created to be collected and made to be loved, it is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy a bourbon at its finest.

TITLE: Bieler Family "Daisy" Columbia Valley Pinot Grigio
DESCRIPTION: A blend of four white grape varieties, co-fermented at the precise moment of optimal ripeness, Daisy opens with gorgeous aromas of grapefruit, lychee, licorice and summer flowers, framed by a flinty minerality. The palate delivers an intriguing interplay between rich, ripe notes and a firm acid backbone.

TITLE: Big House Wine Company Bootlegger White Lucky Luciano
DESCRIPTION: Pairs well with these dishes: Grilled Lemon Chicken Oven Roasted Tilapia Fresh Basil Tortellini Salad Sesame Chicken Parmesan Roasted Asparagus

TITLE: Big House Wine Company Cabernet Sauvignon Bugs Moran
DESCRIPTION: Pairs with wheat pasta with red sauce and ground Italian sausage, burgers, ribs off the grill, especially with some good, tangy BBQ sauce. Also pairs with short ribs, filet mignon, lamb chops, and spaghetti Bolognese.

TITLE: Big House Wine Company Chardonnay Bugsy Siegel Bib
DESCRIPTION: pairs well with braised scallops, pork tenderloin, roasted chicken or fresh pasta with olive oil and basil

TITLE: Big House Wine Company Pinot Grigio Polly Adler
DESCRIPTION: Pairs well with goat cheese pancetta and arugula pizza, thai chicken with basil, smoked trout, estoufee, grilled jumbo shrimp, spaghetti and clam sauce.

TITLE: Big House Wine Company Pinot Noir Nucky Johnson
Big House Wine Company Prohibition Red Scarface
DESCRIPTION: This wine pairs well with casual fare such as burgers, grilled pork chops, and pizza.

TITLE: Big House Wine Company Zinfandel Cardinal Zin Beastly Old Vines
DESCRIPTION: Grilled pork, pasta Bolognese, barbecued ribs or chops (pork, lamb)

TITLE: Billecart-Salmon Champagne Brut Rose
DESCRIPTION: The production secrets and the vinification method of this cuvee go back to the origins of the House of BILLECART-SALMON and have been handed down for seven generations. The Brut Rosé is a blend of Chardonnay, Pinot Meunier and Pinot Noir vinified as red wine.

TITLE: Bimber Distillery American Virgin Oak Cask Single Malt London Whisky Cask No. 95
DESCRIPTION: Drawn from an extraordinary single American oak virgin cask and bottled exclusively for the United States only 253 Bottles. Crafted for superior taste from an extraordinary single AMERICAN OAK VIRGIN CASK. The journey begins at our single farm, where 100% of our barley is grown. It is then traditionally floor malted, hand-mashed and fermented slowly for seven days in our wood washbacks that were hand-made at our own cooperage. We use direct fire to heat our small copper pot stills, and mature our spirit in hand-selected casks. Finally we bottled our whisky onsite at our distillery in October 2020. DESCRIPTION: Drawn from an outstanding single sherry cask and bottled exclusively for the United States only 293 Bottles. Crafted for superior taste from an outstanding single SHERRY CASK. Non-chill filtered, natural colour. The journey begins at our single farm, where 100% of our barley is grown. It is then traditionally floor malted, hand-mashed and fermented slowly for seven days in our wood washbacks that were hand-made at our own cooperage. We use direct fire to heat our small copper pot stills, and mature our spirit in hand-selected casks. Finally we bottled our whisky onsite at our distillery in October 2020. ABV 58.9%

TITLE: Bimber Distillery Single Malt London Whisky Ex-Bourbon Cask #154
DESCRIPTION: Drawn from a remarkable single ex-bourbon oak cask and bottled exclusively for the United States. 254 Bottles. Crafted for superior taste from a remarkable single EX-BOURBON OAK CASK. Non-chill filtered, natural colour. The journey begins at our single farm, where 100% of our barley is grown. It is then traditionally floor malted, hand-mashed and fermented slowly for seven days in our wooden washbacks that were hand-made at our own cooperage. We use direct fire to heat our small copper pot stills, and mature our spirit in hand-selected casks. Finally we bottled our whisky onsite at our distillery in October 2020. ABV 59.1%
