DESCRIPTION: USA EXCLUSIVE RELEASE OLOROSO FINISH 342 BOTTLESInitially matured in an ex-bourbon barrel before being finished in an outstanding single oloroso cask. The journey begins at our single farm, where 100% of our barley is grown. It is then traditionally floor malted, hand-mashed, and fermented slowly for seven days in our wooden washbacks that were hand-made at our own cooperage. We use direct fire to heat our small copper pot stills and mature our spirit in hand-selected casks. Finally, we bottle our whisky onsite at our distillery. 58.2% Alc./Vol. - 116.4 Proof.

TITLE: Bird Dog 10 Years Old Very Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bird Dog 10 Year Old Bourbon is crafted from the most sought-after, hand selected barrels. In the specific barrel selections of this very small batch, considerations of age, depth of character and flavor notes are paramount.

TITLE: Bird Dog 7 Years Old Very Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bird Dog Bourbon has an elaborate medley of corn, malted barley and rye that formulates into a distinctive gentle bourbon. With many layers of distinction, Bird Dog Bourbon flourishes with light undertones of honey and golden raisins which is complimented by the richness of caramelized wood sugar. Aged in traditional charred white oak bourbon barrels and bottled at 88 proof, Bird Dog Bourbon is an extremely enjoyable bourbon.

TITLE: Bishop's Peak Edna Valley Chardonnay
DESCRIPTION: Bishop's Peak wines are handcrafted by Talley Vineyards from grapes grown in the Talley family's vineyards as well as those purchased from growers who share the winery's commitment to quality. This portfolio of distinctive wines represents the diversity of the Central Coast growing region. This elegant chardonnay pairs well a wide variety of appetizers and light seafood dishes.

TITLE: Bisson Glera Vino Frizzante
DESCRIPTION: Experience the lively and refreshing bubbles of Bisson Glera Vino Frizzante. Originating from the picturesque Golfo del Tigullio in Liguria, Italy, this sparkling wine is crafted by the esteemed Bisson winery. Made from 100% Glera grapes, traditionally used in Prosecco, this Vino Frizzante showcases the bright and crisp character of the varietal. With its natural effervescence and vibrant flavor profile, Bisson Glera Vino Frizzante is perfect for any celebration or as an everyday indulgence.

TITLE: Bizen Maboroshi Junmai Ginjo Muroma Sake
DESCRIPTION: Multi-award winning sake from Sakura Muro Machi, winning three international awards in multiple years, including Monde Selection SPRL (5 gold and 3 silver medals), San Francisco International Wine Competition and International Review of Wine Competition This sake is highly recommended for lobsters – strong enough to withstand the briny, seafood taste of lobster and yet delicate enough not to overtake the taste. We also recommend this sake with sushi and sashimi.

TITLE: Black Button Distilling 10th Anniversary Four Grain Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Introducing the 10th Anniversary Straight Bourbon from Black Button Distilling, a testament to a decade of exceptional whiskey-making. This limited release, crafted by Founder & Master Distiller Jason Barrett, features a skillful blend of 6- and 7-year-old barrels aged in Rochester, New York. Bottled at 110 proof to honor both 10 years of distilling and 100 years of Jason’s family in the button business, this bourbon showcases a Four Grain mash bill. It offers a delightful combination of sweet caramel, new oak, fig, and earthy spice on the nose, a rich palate with bright cherry sweetness, hints of dry spice, and a smooth, easy finish with sweet and maple sap notes. Each bottle comes in a locally handcrafted wooden display, making it a collector's gem and a true celebration of Black Button Distilling's craft.

TITLE: Black Button Distilling Barrel Strength Empire Rye Straight Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Discover the bold and authentic flavor of Black Button Distilling's Barrel Strength Empire Straight Rye Whiskey. Crafted with 94% Danko Rye grown along Conesus Lake, this whiskey encapsulates the spirit of New York with its big, spicy grain profile. With a 116 proof and 58% ALC/VOL, this unfiltered whiskey delivers a potent yet smooth experience. The whiskey opens with a floral nose, balanced with rye spice and cedar. On the palate, enjoy notes of honey, baking spices, and dry wood, leading to a dry finish with a slightly warming exhale. This whiskey is best enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in a classic whiskey cocktail, making it a versatile addition to any collection.

TITLE: Black Button Distilling Bespoke Bourbon Cream
DESCRIPTION: Bourbon Cream is a love letter to New York State agriculture and dairy. The small-batch bourbon meets farm-fresh New York State cream and creates a warmer, more luxurious experience than an Irish Cream can. Trust us! Ultra-pasteurized, shelf-stable up to a year, and no need to refrigerate, this spirit just gives you even more reasons to add it to your bar collection. Bourbon Cream is delicious on its own or in any number of cocktails. Start your day with a Morning Cure by adding it to your favorite coffee. Pour it over ice with root beer and discover a creamy, velvety fizz sure to delight your taste buds (and your sweet tooth).

TITLE: Black Button Distilling Cask Strength Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Straight and uncut from the oak barrel, our cask strength bourbon is as true to old-world style as whiskey gets. Distilled from 60% Corn, 20% Wheat, 9% Rye, and 11% Malted Barley, this is a rare, smooth sipping treat for the fine whiskey connoisseur. Unfiltered to provide you with true and authentic flavor.

TITLE: Black Button Distilling Cask Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey "Cup of Unctuousness" The Prime Barrel Bespoke Blend
DESCRIPTION: We are proud to say that we always keep things fresh for our members (ask our very vibrant and engaging Discord community) and always try to push the envelope. Meet our latest endeavor - a bespoke blend specifically for our members - and you can become one by picking up a bottle of it. What is a "bespoke blend," you ask? First of its kind, this blend was created BY the members of The Prime Barrel club FOR the members of The Prime Barrel club. Together with four other members of our club and the Black Button's ambassador (brand partner on this project), we set out to blend a perfect whiskey. The process was as follows: Step 1 - come up with a target taste profile. Black Button Distilling has three separate tanks containing liquids: sweet-heavy, oak-heavy, and spice-heavy. Playing with different ratios of each, we identified the perfect combination that satisfied the blending panel of members. Step 2 - armed with the target taste profile, the distillery's master distiller used the base blend to come up with the final blending formula. Step 3 - there were eight different blends created, and the three best ones were identified as finalists. Those three blends were shipped to the same members that came up with the target taste profile. Step 4 - we jumped on another call with the brand's ambassador and went through all 3 to pick THE BEST one. You can check out the video of this final step here: Black Button Bespoke Blend Selection In the best possible way, the result was a far cry from where we started. Not being familiar with the brand, selecting committee folks were apprehensive about the selection to start. The first round of samples aimed at identifying a perfect tasting profile showed up at 94 proof, which did not help. That all changed with the final three blends we received upon blending completion. Folks at the Black Button Distilling performed some sort of voodoo (pardon the hyperbole). In reality, they made one fundamental change - they went with the cask strength whiskey to do final blends rather than the watered-down, 94-proof version. The change could not be more drastic. We could pick up rich oak notes on the nose and body, a beautiful expression of tannins with a nice strong finish. The final blend had ratios of 30% sweet, 29% spice, 26% oak, and 15% base and has Black Button's standard four-grain mash bill (60% corn, 20% wheat, 11% malted barley, 9% rye). Tasting notes are as follows: Nose: toasted rye spice, bubblegum, pipe tobacco Palate: leather, pepper, oak, clove, peach Finish: pepper long finish with a subtle sweetness on the end Overall, the final product is an exciting whiskey we all loved, and we hope you will also.

TITLE: Black Button Distilling Double Barrel Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This Double Barrel Bourbon Whiskey has an interesting story to tell. Four Grain Bourbon was set to age in barrels of New York State White Oak, hand charred over open flames, but after that first year, the wood proved too tight and began to split. Distillery decided to re-barrel into new, hand charred American White Oak from the Ozark Mountains in Missouri. As the barrel contributes so much to the flavor, this batch was destined to be a one of a kind spirit. A few years later, the distillery is delighted to share with you this unique and spicier version of the beloved signature Bourbon Whiskey.

TITLE: Black Button Distilling Empire Rye Straight Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Black Button Distilling's process is unique in that they use 94% Danko Rye grown on the shores of Conesus Lake. This big, bold, spicy grain captures the true spirit of the Empire State. Their temperature-controlled fermentation and proprietary pot, column distillation method all contribute to their unique flavor profile. And that is before being set to age in their custom charred barrels! The Empire Rye requirement to use local grains and barrel down at a lower proof, in combination with New York's harsh winters and hot humid summers, all contribute to the unique flavor of this product. Unfiltered to provide you with true and authentic flavor, this Rye is best enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in a traditional whiskey cocktail. Batch #10 96 Proof Aged 3 years

TITLE: Black Button Distilling Four Grain Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Black Button Four Grain Small-Batch Straight Bourbon is 60% Corn, 20% Wheat, 9% Rye, 11% Malted Barley and 100% NY state grown and distilled. With a big aroma of fresh oak, toffee, and leather along with light caramel and vanilla flavors and a clean finish, experience the product that captured Black Button founder’s heart and the reason he’s dedicated to craft distilling.

TITLE: Black Button Distilling Pre-Prohibition Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Made using Rochester style process, this unique spirit is an opportunity to travel back in time and experience how whisky was made before Prohibition in Rochester, NY. 80% Corn / 10% Rye / 10% Malted Barley 100 Proof

TITLE: Black Button Distilling Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey  Finished in Port Casks
DESCRIPTION: Black Button Port Finished Single Barrel Bourbon was initially aged for two years in an American White Oak Barrel, then finished for three years in freshly harvested Port Wine casks from Ports of NY Winery in Ithaca New York. Produced in extremely limited quantities, this amazing spirit is perfect for marking very special occasions. Bottled at 59.2% ABV, the whiskey presents notes of chocolate, cherry, stone fruit, oak, and corn to create a luscious palate that reminds of fine brandy or cognac.

TITLE: Black Button Distilling Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Apple Brandy Barrels
DESCRIPTION: This unique spirit was initially aged for two years in an American White Oak Barrel, then finished for 2 and a half years in a freshly harvested Apple Brandy barrel. Produced in extremely limited quantities, this amazing spirit has full-bodied notes of apple and honey. Bottled at 59.5% ABV.

TITLE: Black Button Distilling Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Tequila Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Made using the Rochester Style process, this unique spirit has been aged in an American White Oak Barrel, then matured in a freshly harvested Tequila Barrel. The spicy nose, smoky agave on the tongue, and the sharp bite of tequila add a distinctive finish to the favorite American spirit.

TITLE: Black Dirt Distillery New York Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Black Dirt Bourbon takes its name from the dark, fertile soil left by an ancient glacial lake that once covered thousands of acres of upstate New York. It is pot-distilled from 80% Black Dirt-grown corn, 12% malted barley, and 8% rye. Both the nose and palate offer pronounced notes of caramel, toffee, and chocolate, which merge with hints of oak and baking spice on the lingering finish.

TITLE: Black Dirt Single Barrel Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Distilled in the heart of the Black Dirt region of New York, each of our Black Dirt Single Barrel Bourbons has been crafted from distinct grain ratios, aged in new charred oak, and then hand-selected when it’s unique flavor is perfect for savoring.

TITLE: Black Elephant Vintners Two Dogs A Peacock & A Horse Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: A quintessential white wine calling for white meats, from fish and shellfish to chicken and pork.

TITLE: Black Maple Hill Oregon Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Black Maple Hill Oregon Bourbon is micro-distilled in small batches from the finest locally grown grains using high mountain glacier water. It is a blend of whiskies aged 4 to 5 yeras in new heavily charred American White Oak barrels. The Bourbon's mash bill is 75% corn and 25% barley.

TITLE: Black Maple Hill Oregon Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: An example of well-balanced, 95 Proof, Rye without the overwhelming bite. The nose exhibits sweet fruit and vanilla, while the rich velvety palate follows with caramel and spice. Toasted new oak wraps up the finish with a dash of tannin, butterscotch, and pepper medley.

TITLE: Black Maple Hill Single Barrel 18 Year Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Complex opening bouquet ranges from scents of burnt marshmallow to cigar box to whipping cream; air contact releases additional scents of cotton candy, candied almond, spicy grain, confectioner's sugar and maple. Palate entry is long, prickly, fruity and semisweet; at midpalate the oily, viscous taste profile surges forward, highlighting flavors of baked pear, apple crumble, toffee and buttercream. Finishes as stately as it began. A true superstar American whiskey.

TITLE: Black Maple Hill Single Barrel 23 Year Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Black Maple Hill is among the most coveted American whiskeys, with a history that connects it with some of the biggest names in Kentucky distilling. Like several other extremely limited-release brands from the early 2000s, Black Maple Hill did not make its own whiskey, or even bottle it. Rather, its owner, a California-based company called CVI Brands, hired Julian Van Winkle III to find high-quality barrels of whiskey and bottle it for them. At the time, Van Winkle was working out of the disused Hoffman Distillery in Lawrenceburg, Kentucky, where he bottled whiskey for his own brand, Old Rip Van Winkle, as well as for clients like CVI, all of which have long since achieved legend status among collectors. It is assumed that much of those early Black Maple Hill releases drew from Van Winkle’s barrels that he inherited from Stitzel-Weller, which his grandfather had helped found but which his father had been forced to sell. The rye whiskey he bottled for CVI at 23 years old came from a legendary batch made at the Bernheim distillery, the same whiskey that went into near-mythical bottlings like LeNell’s Red Hook Rye. Both the bourbon and the rye were released in minuscule amounts. Most of the releases were old, over twenty years old, and released in minuscule batches. By many accounts, it was some of the best bourbon whiskey ever sold, ranking with early releases of Old Rip Van Winkle, Olde St. Nick, and others legends.

TITLE: Blackadder Raw Cask 13 Years Old Panama Rum
DESCRIPTION: The Blackadder Raw Cask Rum Panama 13 years old 2007 is a Panama rum bottled by the independent bottler Blackadder. This rum was distilled on the 23rd of February 2007 and matured in cask PR4. It was bottled in November 2020 at a natural cask strength of 62.9% ABV as a limited single cask release of 220 bottles.

TITLE: Blackadder Raw Cask 15 Years Old Panama Rum
DESCRIPTION: Panama's finest 15-year-old rum, bottled in November 2020. Raw Cask is a special bottling system that allows you to have its sediment portion of natural oils and fats coming from the barrel to ensure that the maximum number of aromas is available in each individual bottle. Mahogany color, intense on the nose it gives notes of dark chocolate, sugar cane, and wet wood that takes us back to the holds of old ships. On the palate a toffee note of vanilla, then ripe pineapple, and again an elegant wood. Final with pleasant hints of chocolate and roasted coffee.

TITLE: Blackadder Raw Cask 20 Years Old Panama Rum
DESCRIPTION: As with Blackadder Scotch whiskies, thier rums are all strictly limited-edition releases. No exception to that rule, this is a limited edition, single cask release of 284 bottles of the finest Panama Rum. Matured in cask PR2 and was bottled in November 2020 at natural cask strength. Only 284 bottles worldwide. They are never chill-filtered (you will discover some of the cask sediment), nor do they add any artificial color.

TITLE: Blackened 72 Seasons Limited Edition A Blend of Straight Whiskeys Finished in Brandy Casks
DESCRIPTION: BLACKENED Whiskey celebrates Metallica’s highly acclaimed new album with the Limited Edition 72 Seasons Batch using the new album in the sonic-enhancement process. This limited edition bottle highlights elements inspired by the album including a striking yellow capsule with the signature Metallica M, and the 72 Seasons logo prominently displayed on the front of the bottle. BLACKENED is an award-winning whiskey that is a blend of the finest straight bourbon & rye whiskeys and uniquely finished and sonically- enhanced in brandy casks, using the BLACK NOISE process to extract more flavor from the wood.

TITLE: Blackened American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Blackened Whiskey is a collaboration between the rock band Metallica and late master distiller Dave Pickerell (of WhistlePig and Hillrock). It is a blend of straight whiskeys sourced from undisclosed North American distilleries. The whiskey is finished in "black brandy barrels" for a few weeks. Additionally, the barrels are sonically enhanced in a process called "Black Noise". Low hertz sound waves--playing Metallica's music of course--causes the whiskey to further interact with the wood. The inaugural batch is labeled 081, to signify the year the band formed. Each batch of 5000 bottles will come with an accompanying playlist on Spotify and Apple Music. Visit https://blackenedwhiskey.com/batch-playlists/ to listen to the unique playlist that each batch of Blackened Whiskey was pummeled by

TITLE: Blackened Cask Strength Limited Edition Blended Whiskey 115
Blackened Double Cask "Rye the Lighting" Kentucky Straight Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 93, #14 on the Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 ListThis whiskey, a spring 2022 release from Metallica and master distiller and blender Rob Dietrich, hits hard up front with an herbal and spicy nose. Fennel, anise cookies, and dank grains give way to dandelion and sweet grapes when water is added. The palate is crisp and spicy, showing a great balance between the whiskey itself and the cask finishing. Lightning strikes again on the finish, which is extremely long and ties the entire sip together. More spice, more fruit, just more.

TITLE: Blackened X Wes Henderson Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in the White Port Casks
DESCRIPTION: The second release in the BLACKENED Masters of Whiskey Series, BLACKENED x Wes Henderson Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Wine Port Wine Casks is the collaboration of Master Distillers Rob Dietrich of BLACKENED and Wes Henderson, Co-Founder of Angel’s Envy. Crafted from a 6-year old Kentucky straight bourbon and finished in white port wine casks, bottled at cask strength and non-chill filtered.

TITLE: Blackened X Willett Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: For the first release in the series, Rob Dietrich and Willett Distillery’s own Master Distiller, Drew Kulsveen, teamed up to create the BLACKENED X Willett Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey Finished in Madeira Casks.

TITLE: Blackwater Lazy Lucy Rose
DESCRIPTION: The blend consists of Cinsault, Grenache and Chenin Blanc. The Cinsault grapes are picked from a 25 year old dryland bushvine vineyard in Paarl and the Grenache is from a 10 year old block in Botriver. 50% of the Cinsault and all the Grenache is whole bunch pressed. The remaining Cinsault gets destemmed and pressed. The juice is co-fermented in stainless steel, racked off the lees after 4 weeks and then color adjusted with Grenache to get the desired color. Light fining and cold stabilization is performed prior to bottling.

TITLE: Blade and Bow 22 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Blade and Bow project started three years ago with intentions of honoring the heritage of the Stitzel-Weller Distillery site. There is currently no major distilling there today (a micro-still is in the works) but it does still have several warehouses, which is where Diageo ages most, if not all, of its North American whiskey. The name, Blade and Bow, comes from the anatomy of a key (the blade is the long section and the bow is the end or ornamental part) and the Five Key symbol that has always had a strong presence at Stitzel-Weller. The Five Key symbol stands for the five steps of making Bourbon (grains, yeast, fermentaion, distillation and aging) and was later used as a symbol of southern hospitality. The design of the bottle also honors the Five Key way of doing things. Five of its six sides are dedicated to the five steps of crafting Bourbon, leaving one side for the labeling. This Bourbon has already scooped up a couple major awards winning “Best Straight Bourbon” and a Double Gold at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition. The Bourbon inside this limited offering is not from Stitzel-Weller nor would the folks at Diageo tell us the exact name of the distilleries it came from. But they did share the juice is from two distilleries, one located on 17th and Breckinridge in Louisville (current address of the Bernheim Distillery) and the other one residing at 1001 Wilkinson Boulevard in Frankfort (current address of the Buffalo Trace Distillery). Mashbill of the limited release 22-Year-Old saying its around 15% rye, 7-10% malted barley and the rest corn.

TITLE: Blair Athol 11 yrs Highland Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
Blair Athol 23 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Blair Athol 23 Year Old Single Malt Whisky (750mL) is a limited edition, natural cask strength single malt. From the seldom seen Blair Athol Distillery at Pitlochry, Perthshire. A first release of Blair Athol in this series and the first new Blair Athol bottling since 2003. From ex-bodega European Oak butts filled in 1993.

TITLE: Blair Athol Hogshead 12 yrs Highland Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Founded in 1798, Blair Athol is one of Scotland’s oldest distilleries. Blair Athol whiskey, which are most famously found in Bell’s blends, use the water of the Allt Dourto to create their mellow, deep-toned malts. AGED: 12 years DISTILLED ON: February 3, 1999 BOTTLE ON: September 01, 2014 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 776 ALC: 46%

TITLE: Blair Athol Refill Butt 25 yrs Highland Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Founded in 1798, Blair Athol is one of Scotland’s oldest distilleries. Blair Athol whiskey’s, which are most famously found in Bell’s blends, use the water of the Allt Dourto to create their mellow, deep-toned malts. AGED: 25 years DISTILLED ON: September 28, 1988 BOTTLE ON: September 17, 2014 MATURED IN: Wine Treated Butt CASK NO: 6789 ALC: 54.9% nextSectiom COLOR: dark amber NOSE: subtle mix of earth and cake, with a bit of burnt sugar underneath. TASTE: sherry influence; layers of cake, bread and Christmas spices come quickly on the entry, moving into a round, resinous fruit flavor that coats the palate, revealing brandied cherries and oily, earthier notes. FINISH: long and earthy.

TITLE: Blankiet Estate Mythicus Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: The 2012 Mythicus is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon and a smaller cuvée of only 220 cases. It is close to perfection, for sure, with an inky purple color and a beautiful nose of smoldering embers intermixed with charcoal, blackberry, new saddle leather, crème de cassis, incense, and graphite. Full-bodied, with enormous extract and richness, but with a flawless integration of alcohol, acidity, tannin, and wood, this wine is still a baby, even for 2012, but promises to evolve for 25-30 years. 98 points by Wine Advocate / Robert Parker

TITLE: Blanton's 30th Anniversary Single Barrel Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Blanton's 30th Anniversary Bottle A (1 750ml) (oc) official bottling, to commemorate the 30th anniversary of Blanton's Single barrel, for the Japanese market.

TITLE: Blanton's Black Edition Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Blanton's for Japan market. It is most commonly bottled at 80 proof and has a black label.

TITLE: Blanton's Gold Edition Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Blanton’s Gold Edition was created for discerning connoisseurs who appreciate exceptional smoothness and clean finish in their bourbon whiskey. The rich taste of dark fudge, citrus, oak and cream combined with the spiciness of white pepper and rye lead to a long finish that challenges the world’s finest single malts and rarest cognacs in complexity and character. Best served neat or with a splash of water. TITLE: Blanton's La Maison Du Whisky 1998 50th Anniversary Bottling Single Barrel Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: 2007 La Maison du Whisky festival limited release, Blanton's Le Maison Du Whisky 1998 50th Anniversary Bottling is a rare (some might say unicorn) and exceptional bourbon that celebrates the 50th anniversary of Le Maison Du Whisky. Barreled in 1998, this bourbon has been aged n oak barrels, resulting in a complex and rich flavor profile. With notes of vanilla, caramel, and honey, this bourbon is smooth and easy to drink, making it a perfect choice for a special occasion or for anyone looking for a high-quality, premium bourbon. This limited edition bottling comes in a beautifully crafted bottle, making it a great addition to any liquor collection. Barrel 41 The neck label indicates the barreled date, not the dump date. No dump date on the bottle. PLEASE SEE THE PHOTOS OF THE LABEL CONDITION AND CRACK IN THE WAX (this is bottle was, after all, released 15 years ago)

TITLE: Blanton's La Maison Du Whisky 25th Anniversary 2022 Bottling Single Barrel Bourbon 100
DESCRIPTION: The Blanton's 2022 Collection LMDW Paris Edition is a remarkable Single Barrel Bourbon, part of an exclusive collaboration with La Maison du Whisky in Paris, France. This extraordinary edition is a tribute to Blanton's iconic Warehouse H, known for its metal walls which facilitate a unique aging process due to Kentucky's fluctuating climate. The bourbon is aged in Warehouse H, each barrel from a unique position within the warehouse, showcasing the depth and variety of flavors that can be achieved. This release is exceptionally rare, with only 204 bottles produced from Barrel No. 76, making it a sought-after collectible for enthusiasts​

DESCRIPTION: The Blanton's 2022 Collection LMDW Paris Edition is a remarkable Single Barrel Bourbon, part of an exclusive collaboration with La Maison du Whisky in Paris, France. TITLE: Blanton's La Maison Du Whisky River Edition 2023 Single Barrel Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Blanton's 2023 River Edition, a limited edition single barrel bourbon, is a collaboration between Buffalo Trace and La Maison du Whisky (LMDW), the renowned French spirits retailer. This exclusive release is inspired by the Frankfort, Kentucky, and Paris, France rivers, which share a commonality in influencing their respective cities. This edition is a testament to the art of bourbon-making and celebrates the rich heritage of both the Kentucky and Seine Rivers. Each barrel for this edition was specifically selected, resulting in variations in proof from 100 to cask strength, depending on the unique profile of each barrel.

TITLE: Blanton's Poland Special Release 2020 Single Barrel Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: A limited-edition annual release reserved exclusively for the Polish retail market, Blanton's 2020 Poland Edition Single Barrel Bourbon is one of the rarest, most sought after bourbon whiskeys in circulation. Bottled at a higher proof than the standard Original Single Barrel, the 2020 Poland Edition weighs in at a potent, punchy 117 proof and brings a depth and full-bodied complexity that is sometimes left wanting in the regular iterations, whilst retaining the iconic smoothness that Blanton's is renowned for. A stunning collector's item and a bottle deserving of a place on any connoisseur's top shelf, Blanton's 2020 Poland Edition is a must-have for bourbon whiskey buffs the world over.

TITLE: Blanton's Red Edition Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This is a variant of Blanton's (sometimes called "Blanton's Red") that is released for the Japanese market. Most Blanton's, including Blanton's Single Barrel, Gold and Straight From The Barrel are around six years old. This Blanton's, along with Blanton's Black, is around eight years old.

TITLE: Blanton's Silver Edition Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Originally produced for the Duty-Free market, this is a very rare higher-strength Blanton's that was produced in tiny quantities. Smooth & delicious.

TITLE: Blanton's Single Barrel 60th Anniversary La Maison Du Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Inspired by Colonel Albert Blanton Blanton's Single Barrel range was launched in 1984. Elmer T. Lee selected the finest barrels from Warehouse H, the same one that Col. Blanton used to select his personal favorites from, and these became the first American entry into the ultra-premium whiskey market. This limited edition bottling was released for the 60th anniversary of La Maison du Whisky.

TITLE: Blanton's Single Barrel Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: The finest bourbon in the world comes from a single barrel. That's how Colonel Albert B. Blanton first bottled his private reserve bourbon nearly a century ago. Blanton believed Warehouse H's "center-cut" or middle sections were the best for aging his bourbon. Personally tasting and choosing each barrel, these barrels were reserved and bottled for ambassadors, dignitaries, family, and friends, becoming the world's first single-barrel bourbon. His time-honored tradition lives on today as only a handful of barrels from the center of Warehouse H are selected to become Blanton's Single Barrel Bourbon. 50ml bottles do NOT have letters on the toppers!

Blanton's Single Barrel Bourbon La Maison Du Whisky Bourbon Street Edition
DESCRIPTION: Each LMDW bottling offers its own fair share of surprises and originality. This version, named “Bourbon Street”, is no exception to the rule. Bottle guides us through the rolling roads of Kentucky to breath in the fragrances and flavors seen in all the greatest bourbons, offering more fruit than usual. TastingNotesComplex and rich. It develops into notes of noble wood (cedar, oak) and stewed fruits (plum, greengage plum).

TITLE: Blanton's Single Barrel Bourbon La Maison Du Whisky Edition
DESCRIPTION: First introduced by then Ancient Age Distillery Master Distiller, Elmer T. Lee, Blanton's was the first single barrel bourbon popularised in the US. Ancient Age was renamed the Buffalo Trace distillery by the Sazerac company in 1999. Normally a 6 to 8-year-old bourbon, it is aged in Warehouse H at Buffalo Trace, which is the only metal-clad warehouse at the distillery, commissioned for construction by Albert B. Blanton, after whom the whiskey is named. The warehouse was built shortly after prohibition and being metal, transfers heat quicker than brick warehouses, allowing for more rapid aging. This is a 2018 bottling, dumped on the 23rd July and matured in barrel #884, which was specially selected for La Maison du Whisky in Paris. Stored on rick number 45 and bottled at 65%

TITLE: Blanton's Special Reserve Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Created as an introductory edition to our full lineup, Blanton’s Special Reserve is ideal for those new to single barrel bourbons. A sweet taste profile with a floral nose and light undertones of vanilla and citrus make it perfect for a premium cocktail or served on the rocks. 40% alcohol by volume. DESCRIPTION: Discover the unadulterated richness of Blanton's Straight From The Barrel Bourbon from the iconic Buffalo Trace Distillery in Kentucky, USA. TITLE: Blanton's Straight from the Barrel Dumped 2018  Greek Label
DESCRIPTION: Some countries have all the luck! Why do Greece, Poland, and France get special bottlings (even Germany got a 2006 release), and the rest of the world must search high and low even to find a regular bottle? Well, luckily, you can now get your very own. Only one barrel was dumped in 2018 for this release, so this is rare, with just over 200 bottles available. Bottled at 129.6 proof (64.8%), this is some barrel-strength stuff! Attention, collectors: This bottle has a tiny wax crack at a pull tab (see pictures). These types of imperfections are typical on older Balnton's bottles.

TITLE: Blanton’s Straight From The Barrel Suddeutsche Zeitung Magazin Edition
Blaum Brothers 12-year-old Fangled Knotter Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: We love everything about this bottle: Age, Source, Proof, Design. This awesome juice was sourced from MGP.

TITLE: Blonde Straight Whiskey
Blood Oath Bourbon Trilogy
DESCRIPTION: If you need further proof that great things come in 3’s, we present the second edition of the Blood Oath Trilogy! The first special limited release featured Blood Oath Pacts No.1, No. 2. and No. 3, while the 2021 release includes Pacts No.4, No. 5. and No. 6.

TITLE: Blood Oath Bourbon Trilogy
DESCRIPTION: If you need further proof that great things come in 3’s, we present the second edition of the Blood Oath Trilogy! The first special limited release featured Blood Oath Pacts No.1, No. 2. and No. 3, while the 2021 release includes Pacts No.4, No. 5. and No. 6.

TITLE: Blood Oath Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Pact 1
DESCRIPTION: Blood Oath Pact 1 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is an exceptional blend curated by the dedicated craftsmen at Lux Row Distillers. Pact 1, the inaugural release in the Blood Oath series, is an emblem of innovation and tradition, a covenant to create bourbons that stand out in a world of excellent spirits.Pact 1 - a blend of straight bourbons - is all about the blending. No finishes or high proof to hide behind, just the taste in the bottle. And I have to tell you - John Rempe, creator of the Blood Oath bourbon series and overseer of much of Lux Row’s portfolio - could pass for a Scotch blender. This is quality.

TITLE: Blood Oath Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Pact No.10
DESCRIPTION: Blood Oath Pact No. 10 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a unique and limited release from Lux Row Distillers, celebrating a decade of Blood Oath's distinctive blends. This special edition bourbon is a blend of two well-bred ryed bourbons and one finished bourbon, double-finished in Cabernet Franc and Merlot casks. This double-finishing process adds complexity and fruit-forward notes to the bourbon, making it a standout in the Blood Oath series.

TITLE: Blood Oath Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Pact No.2
DESCRIPTION: This is the second expression in the limited-release bourbon series and follows Blood Oath Pact No. 1.Pact No. 2 is a union of three bourbons ranging in age from seven to 11 years. The first, a seven-year rye bourbon finished in port barrels, is joined by an 11-year wheated bourbon and an 11-year rye bourbon. Bottled at 98.6 proof, Pact No. 2 is available in limited quantities in 750-ml bottles

TITLE: Blood Oath Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Pact No.3
DESCRIPTION: The 3rd release in Blood Oath series is a masterful union of well-bred bourbons. Taking the lead is a far-from-shy, sharp and floral rye, finished in Cabernet Sauvignon barrels for a dry, blackberry and espresso complexity. This, coupled with a well-seasoned, rye bourbon, rich with fragrant vanilla, toasted caramel, oranges, and oak. Be grateful for this fateful affair between Kentucky and California. BARREL DETAILS - Cabernet Sauvignon Barrel Finish: For the third chapter in the Blood Oath epic, distillery conspired with like-minded artisans in the heart of California wine country. Nestled in the Oakville region of Napa Valley—famous for its fertile, alluvial soil—Swanson Vineyard has been making nationally known and limited, small batch Bordeaux style wines for over three decades. These prized Cabernet barrels add an unforgettable layer of complexity to the whiskey.

TITLE: Blood Oath Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Pact No.4
DESCRIPTION: A masterful union of three well-bred bourbons, each bringing its own voice to the rich harmony found inside each bottle. The first, an extra-aged 12-year-bourbon, provides a mellow, smooth finish with deep oak undertones. The second, a rich 10-year-old bourbon, provides warm caramel and honey flavors. The third, a 9-year-old bourbon finished in toasted bourbon barrels, adds deep chocolate, vanilla with extra spice.

TITLE: Blood Oath Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Pact No.5
DESCRIPTION: Launched in 2015, a new unique Pact is released each year. For this 5th release, an 8-year-old rye bourbon was finished in Caribbean rum barrels for an additional 6 months. It was then blended with an 11-year-old wheated bourbon and a 13-year-old rye bourbon. The exact blend percentages are not disclosed. All bourbons used in the blend originated from Kentucky. The rum finishing is noticeable yet not overbearing, as a hint of molasses weaves its way throughout. The nose is sweet and enjoyable with vanilla, brown sugar, brown butter, light grain, and a touch of ethanol present. The juicy sip carries forward the molasses and also brings forward rye spice, pepper, vanilla, and oak. It finishes with a warming spicy rye heat, and vanilla, aged oak, brown sugar, and leather are sprinkled throughout. Blood Oath Pact No. 5 is a mix of sweet and spicy that results in an overall easy drinking and enjoyable sip. While the barrel finished 8-year-old bourbon has the biggest impact on the bourbon’s flavor profile, the 11 and 13-year-old bourbons help bring balance. As a result, this influence is an enhancer versus a dominating factor throughout the sip. For those who enjoy a slightly sweeter bourbon, Blood Oath Pact No. 5 will help scratch that itch

TITLE: Blood Oath Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Pact No.6
DESCRIPTION: A masterful union of well-bred bourbons-each on its own a ryed to be remembered. One, a 14-year-- dark with oak, leather and tobacco. Two, and 8-year—toasty warm with cinnamon, allspice and nutmeg. And three, a 7-year—full of roasted caramel and honeyed raisin, then rested and mellowed in Cognac casks for a finish that’s all Kentucky heat with a wisp of crème brulee sweet. A votre sante.

TITLE: Blood Oath Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Pact No.7
DESCRIPTION: A masterful union of three well-bred bourbons. One, a 14-year extra-aged ryed bourbon. Two, an 8-year ryed bourbon. And three, another 8-year ryed bourbon, finished in sauternes wine casks from the Bordeaux region of France for a balance of sweetness with additional spice.

TITLE: Blood Oath Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Pact No.8
DESCRIPTION: A masterful union of three well-bred bourbons. One, a 14-year ryed bourbon. Two, an 11-year ryed bourbon. And three, and 8-year ryed bourbon finished in Calvados casks from the Normandy region of France to impart slight apple on the nose with hints of vanilla and cinnamon. With each sip, feel transported to Northern France by way of Kentucky.

TITLE: Blood Oath Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Pact No.9
DESCRIPTION: A masterful union of three well-bred ryed bourbons. One, an oaky 16-year-old. Two, a luscious 12-year-old. And three, a 7-year-old finished in Spanish Oloroso Sherry casks which carries the aroma of sweet sherry while satiating the palate with dark fruit, molasses, chocolate and tobacco.

TITLE: Bloomer Creek Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: The 2019 Pinot Noir is a blend of two sites, the hillside Auten Vineyard and the slightly earlier ripening Morehouse Road Vineyard. All grapes were crushed and fermented with 100% stem inclusion for three to four weeks. After pressing, the wine was matured for 24 months in neutral French oak barrels.

TITLE: Bloomer Creek Riesling Barrow Vineyard "Skin-Contact"
DESCRIPTION: 100% Riesling from the Barrow Vineyard. Harvest times can vary considerably from the bottom to the top of the slope at Barrow, with the picking time for this bottling ranging from October 19th to November 11th. The grapes receive a two to three day "skin soak" before pressing. Fermentation takes place in stainless steel with a year maturation period before bottling.

TITLE: Bloomer Creek Riesling Skin-Fermented Auten Finger Lakes
DESCRIPTION: Outrageously delicious! This single vineyard Riesling Pet Nat has mouthwatering acidity, intense stone fruit flavor and lively mouthfeel. Spontaneously fermented on the skins for 2 weeks; unfined and unfiltered.

TITLE: Bloomer Creek Vineyard Cabernet Franc
Bloomer Creek White Horse Red
DESCRIPTION: Bloomer Creek is a true pioneer in natural winemaking in New York State, more specifically in the Finger Lakes Region. If you so much as mention working organically to New York winemakers, you will hear again and again that is an impossible feat, much as the first natural winemakers in the Loire valley and Burgundy heard from their peers. In spite of this, Kim Engle and Debra Bermingham have been crafting beautiful examples of natural wine anyway. They do not use insecticides, finding them to be unnecessary in a healthy vineyard, and herbicides have not been used in over 20 years. Fungus disease is controlled by the use of sulfur for powdery mildew and copper for downy mildew. Seaweed/fish and compost formulations are sprayed to aid in disease resistance and vine health.

TITLE: Blue Note 10 Year Old Single Barrel Reserve Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Limited run of B.R. Distilling Co's master distiller's single barrel selection/pick. The mash bill is 84% corn, 8% rye, and 8% malted barley. While this is most likely a Dickel distillate, it certainly does not taste like it (not that there is anything wrong with Dickel). 125.4 Proof. Strong notes of caramel and rich vanilla with an oak finish. The nose is butterscotch and light maple. The finish is smooth with lingering hints of vanilla at the very end.

TITLE: Blue Note 17 Year Old Barrel Proof Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Distilled by an Undisclosed TN distiller 17 years ago (wink) - we all know who that has to be - this bottling comes to us after bottling by the folks at Big River Distilling. If you're familiar with Blue Note, Blue Note Juke Joint Whiskey, and Riverset Rye, this is another piece of handiwork for the brand.There may be no better rollercoaster of expectation and realization than this 17yr Blue Note. Everything on paper screams that this should be a bitter, mineral forward, tannin bomb. What shows up, however, is a delightful fruit bowl of character, a rich chewy mouth feel, and the perfect amount of oak.

TITLE: Blue Note 9 Year Old Premium Small Batch Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Blues notes were born in the 1920s on the streets of Memphis, Tennessee, in the juke joints, and they have since found their way into almost every other form of music. You feel a blue note almost as much as you hear one. They are twangy notes that give a blues song its edge, providing the beat with personality, spirit, and soul. Blue Note Bourbon is artfully crafted to honor the Memphis Blues and its influence on music through the creation of rock ‘n’ roll. Like the blues, the bourbon is bold, yet smoother than smooth. MASH BILL: 84% Corn, 8% Rye, and 8% Malted Barley PROOF & FILTRATION: 93 Proof, Unfiltered AGED: A Minimum of 9 Years

TITLE: Blue Note Crossroads Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This release is a NAS 4yr MGP product with a mash of 60% corn, 36% rye, and 4% barley and was finished in Toasted French Oak. 100 Proof.

TITLE: Blue Note Crossroads Toasted French Oak Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Nose: Corn Flakes, Vanilla, Caramel Oak, and a hint of Leather Palate: Vanilla Bean, Custard, Honey, and Torched Sugar with a slight touch of Cinnamon Finish: Medium Linger with a very mild burn. Viscous and coats the throat.

TITLE: Blue Note Juke Joint Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Blues notes were born in the 1920s on the streets of Memphis, Tennessee, in the juke joints, and they have since found their way into almost every other form of music. You feel a blue note almost as much as you hear one. They are twangy notes that give a blues song its edge, providing the beat with personality, spirit, and soul. Blue Note Bourbon is artfully crafted to honor the Memphis Blues and its influence on music through the creation of rock ‘n’ roll. Like the blues, the bourbon is bold, yet smoother than smooth. MASH BILL: 70% Corn, 21% Rye, and 9% Malted Barley PROOF & FILTRATION: 93 Proof, Unfiltered

TITLE: Blue Note Juke Joint Uncut "Booze Cluez" Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #62
DESCRIPTION: Blue Note Juke Joint was born from the Blues and named after the places where blues made its name. A juke joint is a bar, tavern, or roadhouse featuring music played on a jukebox or live bands (associated with the blues) with space to dance. An opportunity to select this very approachable yet tasty barrel was music to our ears. This is our second barrel pick with the brand. First one was a rousing success with numerous rave reviews and folks calling the pick their whiskey of the year (2022). You can check these reviews in our Discord whiskey community. Barrel #18009 has a mashbill of 70% Corn, 21% Rye, 9% Malted Barley, and 123.5 proof. Nose: maple, sweet corn, touch of cereal Palate: caramel, vanilla, sticky toffee Finish: gingerbread, oily High-proof bourbon that drinks like anything but. You start with maple and sweet corn on the nose, followed by a whiff of cereal. In the mouth, you experience an explosion of caramel gently tempered by sticky toffee and vanilla. In the end, you're left with an oily finish on the tongue with remnants of gingerbread.

TITLE: Blue Note Juke Joint Uncut "Old School" Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #39
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 92, #7 on the Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 ListBlue Note Juke Joint is born from the Blues and named after the places where blues made its name. A juke joint is a bar, tavern, or roadhouse featuring music played on a jukebox or live bands (associated with the blues) with space to dance. An opportunity to select this very approachable yet tasty barrel was music to our ears.Barrel #17808 has a mashbill of 70% Corn, 21% Rye, 9% Malted Barley, and 123 proof. Tasting Notes Nose: green apple, marshmallow, burnt brown sugar, vanilla, peach pit, pastry crust Palate: peach pie, cinnamon, citrus peel, butterscotch, popcorn Finish: long, unctuous finish with notes of spearmint and white pepper $5 from every bottle will go toward support of The Endangered Species Protection Agency. The Endangered Species Protection Agency works within International Law and with local law enforcement to conserve and protect critically endangered and threatened species, including rhinos, elephants, gorillas, orangutans, tigers, and many others.

TITLE: Blue Run "Chosen" Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #79
DESCRIPTION: In February 2023, the Chosen program started with what they dubbed "The Scouting Season." Blue Run was on a mission, like Indiana Jones hunting for relics, but instead, they were looking for retailers and organizations that shared their wild passion for whiskey diversity. They were also busy spreading the word about the program within the whiskey community, like a bunch of whiskey-loving town criers. Then, just after the chaos of Super Bowl LVII on February 13 (where some folks were more interested in the commercials than the game), they unleashed "The Portal." It wasn't a mystical gateway or a sci-fi wormhole but a digital playground where whiskey enthusiasts could dive headfirst into a thrilling lottery-style adventure. The prize? Their very own Blue Run Whiskey barrels! Think of it as a whiskey lover's version of Willy Wonka's Golden Ticket. But the fun didn't stop there. Participants were free to let their creative juices flow like a fine bourbon. They could customize their bottle designs by changing the strip stamp, neck label, proof label, and even the color of the iconic Blue Run butterfly medallion. With more than 750 design combinations, it was like being a whiskey Picasso. We polled our Discord whiskey community and settled on a "blacked out" version of the bottle, with all customizable elements done in black. Fast forward to March 23, and it was "Draft Day" - not the NFL kind, but equally thrilling. Every lucky entry from "The Portal" got tossed into a digital lottery barrel, not a real one, mind you. The outcome? Sixteen lucky winners emerged, and they celebrated this digital draft extravaganza at the Bardstown Bourbon Company in Bardstown, KY. It was like the whiskey version of the Hunger Games, but with happier endings. These lucky few (including yours truly) then embarked on what they cheekily called "The Season." It was like being on a reality show but with fewer paparazzi. They teamed up with the brand and spent the spring to mid-summer season exploring their unique whiskey profiles. It was like Tinder for whiskey, with choices like picking a single barrel or crafting a micro-blend from a selection hand-picked by Blue Run Whiskey Director Shaylyn Gammon. These barrels were like the spice of life, varying in age, proof, and even mash bill, offering a smorgasbord of flavor possibilities. Our selection took place in person in Boston while working on another exciting blending project with the guys from Found North (this project will also be announced soon!). Six of us tasted through four different barrels, and the pick was almost unanimous (5 to 1). Unbeknownst to us, the whiskey was distilled by the one and only Willett Distillery and carries a custom mashbill of 74% Corn, 20% Rye, 6% Malted Barley. The selection is 7 years of age for those who are keeping score. The grand finale will be the Blue Run Butterfly Gala next week, an exclusive VIP launch party where the brand will let loose and show off its creative concoctions. Guests (including some of the premium members of our club) will get to taste a variety of this year's whiskeys, chat with fellow participants and draft entrants, and even compete for awards like the best barrel, best blend, and best design. It was a whiskey journey that will end with a bang and probably a few hangovers, too!

TITLE: Blue Run 'Reflection I' Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Blue Run “Reflection I” Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a small-batch whiskey contract distilled by Blue Run’s Liquid Advisor and Bourbon Hall of Famer Jim Rutledge. Jim distilled this batch of barrels at Castle & Key Distillery. The name “Reflection I” was chosen by two of Blue Run’s founders who faced personal challenges over the past two years, during the pandemic, and while trying to launch a whiskey company. Pulled from existing aging stocks, this approachable Bourbon, at this particular proof, is what they both enjoyed during this period, allowing them to reflect on what truly matters, starting first and foremost with family.

TITLE: Blue Run Aged 13 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The inaugural Blue Run Bourbon is an instant classic. This 113-proof small-batch temptation doesn’t need gimmicks or special finishes. It’s been aged directly into its sweet spot, delivering a mature, complex whiskey that offers an endlessly layered taste. Jim Rutledge, formerly of Four Roses, has put together as the first release a sourced 13-year-old, small batch bourbon that is said to feature all the “hallmarks of a Rutledge whiskey – exceptionally smooth and mellow, with a long, sweet and dry finish; little to no burn on the back end.”

TITLE: Blue Run Aged 13.5 Years Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Blue Run 13.5-Year-Old Single Barrel Cask Strength Bourbon comes in ten separate limited-edition bottlings from ten different barrels, each hand-numbered to denote the proof, barrel number, and bottling date, enticing whiskey sleuths to find the entire collection and whiskey enthusiasts around the country to discover their favorite flavor profile. Each bottle comes in a custom, handmade black lacquered wooden box, adding to the collectability. Between 104 to 150 bottles will be available from each barrel, with the proofs varying from 124 to 132. The secret to which barrel the Bourbon came from can be found on the hand-numbered label, which gives a hint at that whiskey’s particular characteristics and flavor profile: Barrel #1: Mellow sweet corn and brown sugar apple butter that develops into mellow oak tannins Barrel #2: Deep chocolate and honey-drenched s’more Barrel #3: Gorgeous crème brûlée with a burst of dark brown sugar and streaks of ginger Barrel #4: Creamy toffee with bites of cocoa and black pepper Barrel #5: Sultry black cherry and oak with clove honey Barrel #6: Decadent dark chocolate with a marshmallow frame and clove cascade Barrel #7: Layers of char smoke and rich vanilla wood sugar Barrel #8: Roasted pecan and nutty campfire smoke Barrel #9: Spice forward with bold black pepper and baking spices and an herbaceous wrap Barrel #10: Oak tannin and dark raisin combination with a whip of smoke on the finish

TITLE: Blue Run Aged 14 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A follow-up to their inaugural 13-yo expression, Blue Run 14-Year-Old Bourbon is aged 14 years and bottle at 113 proof.

TITLE: Blue Run Emerald Kentucky Cask Strength Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Blue Run Emerald Kentucky Cask Strength Straight Rye Whiskey emerges as a unique and spirited expression from the heart of Kentucky. Distilled with precision at Castle & Key and masterfully blended under the guidance of Blue Run's Liquid Advisor Jim Rutledge, this whiskey showcases the art of rye. Each bottle, part of a limited edition release, captures the essence of 189 rye barrels, each contributing to a complex and intriguing flavor profile. The whiskey is bottled at a robust 116.7 proof, delivering an authentic and unfiltered taste experience. The Emerald Rye, notable for its rich gold appearance and distinctive character, is a testament to Blue Run's commitment to excellence and innovation in the world of fine spirits.

TITLE: Blue Run Holiday Cask Strength Rye Gift Set
DESCRIPTION: Blue Run Holiday Rye Cask Strength is packaged with two custom Aged and Ore neat glasses in a limited edition collectors box. There are two different designs to choose from, our signature Blue Run insignia or the butterfly crest. Blue Run and Aged and Ore came together out of an appreciation for craftsmanship and thoughtful modern design. Aged and Ore have taken the glassware industry by storm with their innovative designs and attention to detail. Similarly, Blue Run has taken the whiskey industry by storm with our exceptional whiskeys and forward-thinking approach to the modern whiskey drinker.

TITLE: Blue Run Holiday Cask Strength Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Blue Run Holiday Rye Cask Strength features product from the same family of barrels as the recently released Blue Run Straight Golden Rye Whiskey, which won a Gold Medal at the San Francisco International Spirits Competition, but at Cask Strength, coming in at 106 proof. Each bottle features a “Pollock” treatment on the brand’s signature butterfly, making it easily identifiable on any back bar.

TITLE: Blue Run Kentucky Straight Golden Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Blue Run small-batch Golden Rye Whiskey is Blue Run’s inaugural Rye expression. Named for both the distinct color of the choice grains that were used in the creation process and the accolades that the whiskey has garnered. Most notably, Gold medal winner at the SF World Spirits Competition. 95 Proof / 47.5% ABV

TITLE: Blue Run Kentucky Straight High Rye Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: The first Blue Run Spirits whiskey made with bourbon legend Jim Rutledge serving as the contracted master distiller is now available. Blue Run Kentucky Straight High Rye Bourbon is distilled from a mash bill of 65% yellow corn, 30% rye, and 5% malted barley. Only 100 selected barrels went into this bottling, each toasted to a #4 alligator char and aged in Frankfort and Bardstown, KY. Blue Run High Rye Bourbon is 111 proof.

TITLE: Blue Run Kentucky Straight High Rye Bourbon Single Barrel Whiskey Red Hot Lollipop  117.6 Proof
DESCRIPTION: The Blue Run team has selected 12 different single barrels of their High Rye Bourbon, which was contract distilled at Castle & Key Distillery. Each barrel, which featured a #4 alligator char and was aged in Frankfort and Bardstown, KY, will have its own unique personality based on where it was in the rickhouse and how the whiskey reacted to the wood. They range from 115-117 proof and the color of the butterflies vary based upon the distinct flavor profile. RED HOT LOLLIPOP: Light brown sugar and saltwater taffy lead to strawberries and red-hot candies with a finish of honey crisp apples. 224 Bottle Yield. ISLAND SPICE CAKE: Granola and ripe banana introduce a mid-palate sweet and salty trail mix and caramelized apples finishing with anise and oak. 228 Bottle Yield. SUMMER MELON: A hint of watermelon rind gives way to hard cherry candy ending with charred oak. 231 Bottle Yield. PEANUT BUTTER & BANANA: A peanut butter and banana sandwich with deep, dark brown sugar finished with nutmeg and a kick of heat. 224 Bottle Yield. HOLY HONEY!: Sweetened honey almond cereal and honey bun cake with a lingering finish.230 Bottle Yield. CHOCOLATE CHIP GRANOLA BAR: Chocolate chip granola bar and orange marmalade lead the way followed by a warm, toasted oak finish. 224 Bottle Yield. HOLIDAY FRUIT BASKET: A combination of orange blossom, lemon, and a bit of maraschino cherry in the middle ending in a sprig of mint. 227 Bottle Yield. BREAKFAST BOURBON: Savory honey buttered wheat toast and kettle corn leading to grape jelly finishing with mild black pepper and lightly toasted oak. 227 Bottle Yield. BLUEBERRY PIE: Dark brown sugar and blueberry bubble gum on the nose leading to burnt sugar with new leather and a warm, dry oak finish. 229 Bottle Yield. APPLES & CINNAMON: Baking spice on the nose met by the mellowed-out taste of apples cooked in butter and brown sugar, ever-so-slightly caramelized and ready to pour into a pie before baking. Pronounced cinnamon to finish. 232 Bottle Yield. CHESTNUTS ROASTING: Pronounced nutty aroma of chestnuts followed brûléed citrus joined by a pop of heat on the back end to warm you all the way through. 228 Bottle Yield. SAUVIGNON BLANC: Cooked peaches and simple syrup on the nose followed by golden raisins and a Mutsu apple, vanilla, and dry oak finish. 231 Bottle Yield.
