This bourbon is a testament to their dedication, offering a taste that reflects the unique character of Colorado. With a 750ml bottle, it's perfect for any occasion, whether you're celebrating a special moment or simply enjoying a quiet evening at home. Visual Appeal The bottle itself is a work of art, with its sleek design and rich amber hue that hints at the depth of flavor within. It's a beautiful addition to any bar or collection, making it not just a drink, but an experience. Indulge in the exceptional taste of Breckenridge Bourbon Whiskey and elevate your spirits collection today!

TITLE: Breckenridge Dark Arts Whiskey Distilled From Malt Mash
Brenne French Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The first single malt in the word aged exclusively in French Limousin Oak and Cognac casks, Brenne Estate Cask is twice-distilled in a copper alembic still, and aged for a minimum of six years.

TITLE: Breuckelen "Glorious" Gin
DESCRIPTION: Distillery’s original gin recipe. Distilled from wheat grown in upstate New York.

TITLE: Breuckelen 77 Whiskey Local Rye & Corn
DESCRIPTION: 77 Whiskey – Distilled from Local Rye and Corn (previously known as White Wax) Distillery's 2nd whiskey is produced very much like the black wax whiskey, except they ferment a mash of rye and corn, rather than wheat. This grain combination benefits from some additional time in oak, so it tends to be a little older than the black wax. Local Rye and Corn is made from 90% rye and 10% corn. Like a loaf of fresh baked banana bread, Local Rye and Corn starts with bananas on the nose followed by flavors of vanilla, brown sugar and a bit of nuttiness.

TITLE: Breuckelen 77 Whiskey NY Wheat
DESCRIPTION: 77 Whiskey – Distilled from New York Wheat (previously known as Black Wax) This whiskey is produced the same way we make our wheat base spirit for our gin. That means we distill the grain in a manner to retain the character of the wheat. That flavor is then matched with the contribution of the barrel as it matures here in our space. Distilled from 100% wheat, aged a minimum of 4 months in new American Oak.

TITLE: Breuckelen Bourbon & Rye Straight Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Breuckelen Bourbon & Rye Straight Whiskey is a unique and innovative expression from Breuckelen Distilling in Brooklyn, New York. This whiskey represents a harmonious blend of straight bourbon and rye, each bringing its distinctive characteristics to the final product. The result is a balanced and flavorful whiskey that offers the best of both worlds – the sweetness and depth of bourbon combined with the spice and complexity of rye. A blend of at least 2 and 3-year-old bourbon and ryes bottled at 100-proof, Breuckelen Bourbon & Rye Straight Whiskey delivers versatile whiskey that can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in your favorite whiskey cocktails. It showcases the exceptional craftsmanship and innovation of Breuckelen Distilling. Mashbill: 70% Corn, 25% Rye, 5% Malted barley

TITLE: Breuckelen Distilling 77 Whiskey "The Borough of Breuckelen" 8 Year Collaboration Single Barrel Wheated Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: When the opportunity to taste an 8-year barrel-proof wheated bourbon came up, our first thought was, “wait...there’s someone offering an 8-year-old wheated bourbon...and it’s a single barrel...and it’s barrel proof?!” In some regard we were skeptical. With Breuckelen’s unique double pot distilled twist on this not-as-common bourbon mashbill, combined with extra time aging, we were admittedly pretty excited to taste these barrels. And so we did. We tasted four barrels which offered a wide range of flavor profiles and shockingly high proofs ranging from 136.2 to 140.2, which is technically considered a hazardous material, or HAZMAT for short, as the proof is so high you wouldn’t be allowed to carry it onto an airplane. We narrowed it down to two barrels and could have easily gone with either of them. The first, a more traditional approach - focus on oak against sweeter notes with a rich delivery of flavors, the perfect bourbon to pair with a cigar. The second, a rich slurry of cinnamon spice, chocolate, tobacco, creme brulee, aged oak, and so much more - a flavor profile that requires no introduction but one that is definitively unique. We enjoyed a deal of back and forth and re-tasting before making a decision. Would you go with the barrel that offers a great - but more expected - flavor profile or the barrel that offers something fantastically different? Ultimately everyone agreed, let’s be different. Hopefully, you enjoy this one-of-a-kind pick. It’s a rarity to have a chance at an 8-year-old high proof, barrel proof wheater, and even more rare when it comes from an unexpected place. Breuckelen Distilling knocked it out of the park with this one, and we can’t wait for the next. Nose: Baking chocolate | Charred oak | Sharp & punchy cayenne pepper | Maple sugar | Baking spice slurry | Warm & rich Palate: Rush of cinnamon spice | Cinnamon candies | Toffee | Tobacco leaf | Seasoned oak | Caramel chews | Creme brulee | Rich & delightful Finish: Big spice rolls over from the palate | Black licorice | Tobacco leaf | Long The charity this barrel selection will be supporting is the American Red Cross and donations will go towards helping people affected by Hurricane Ida. Donation Amount: $5 from each bottle sold

TITLE: Breuckelen Distilling Jews and Booze "Dramba" 7 Year Old  New York Wheat Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The next J&B barrel is called “Dramba” in honor of the delicious, peanutty Israeli snack, Bamba. It is a wheat whiskey distilled by Breuckelen Distilling that was was barreled on 2/11/2014 and bottled on 11/30/2021. It was aged for 7 years, 9 months in a 53 gal new charred American oak barrel from Kelvin Cooperage that was air dried for 2 years and had char #3. The barrel was stored in their East New York warehouse for 4 years and then in their warehouse on 19th Street in Brooklyn for the other 3+ years. It was bottled at 130 proof under their “The New York” label. The mash bill is 100% soft white wheat. Tasting Notes: Nose: This nose affords a term of experience rather than individual terms. It feels like breakfast, at least the sweet side of it. Mrs Butterworth’s comes in first, followed by distinct notes of blueberry pancake with a pad of butter. Cola typically isn’t breakfast but it’s in there too. Palate: This whiskey comes in fairly intensely with all of the sodas including that tingly mouth feel. There are notes of orange soda first, followed by cola in the mid-palate. That is joined classic wheat whiskey notes of caramel and butterscotch. The back of the palate has a brief foray into grape soda before moving towards brown butter. Finish: The flavors carry for a long time, showcasing the sweetness of the wheat. It also has a distinct buttery experience that persists long past the palate stage. Overall: If you’re a fan of wheat whiskies or wheated bourbon, this is a must own pick. It does what few wheat whiskies do in providing complexity in the palate beyond pure saccharine sweetness. Those folks that stand in line for hours waiting for that certain Frankfort, KY wheated bourbon don’t know what they’re missing. $5 from every bottle will be donated to Making Headway Foundation to provide care and comfort for children with brain and spinal cord tumors while funding medical research geared to better treatments and a cure.

TITLE: Breuckelen Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Breuckelen Straight Rye Whiskey is a distinctive and flavorful expression from Breuckelen Distilling, located in the heart of Brooklyn, New York. This straight rye whiskey is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, using a high rye mash bill that reflects the bold and spicy characteristics rye whiskey enthusiasts appreciate. Aged for at least two years in new American oak barrels, Breuckelen Straight Rye Whiskey offers a rich and complex flavor profile that stands out in rye whiskies. Bottled at 90 proof, this whiskey delivers a balanced and robust experience, perfect for sipping neat, on the rocks, or as the foundation for classic rye cocktails. Breuckelen Distilling's commitment to quality and innovation shines through in every bottle.

TITLE: Brisa Suave Vinho Verde Rose
Broadbent Selections Vinho Verde Sunflower
DESCRIPTION: The fruit was sourced from the Vinho Verde region, which stretches from the Spanish border to south of Oporto. The vines are planted on hillsides of acid rich, granite based soils with areas of schist or slate and clay. To preserve the trademark fizz of Vinho Verde, Bartholomew ships the wines in refrigerated containers. White Vinho Verde is high in acidity, which makes it ideal for pairing with all forms of seafood, particularly when complimented by a rich sauce or a coating of fried breadcrumbs; pork and potato dishes are also quite common. The fact is, Vinho Verde is great by itself, but if you are looking for an affordable white wine that’s delicious with light foods and all manners of sea creatures, you’ll definitely have a perfect pairing with this crisp, bright juice.

TITLE: Broc Cellars La Boutanche
DESCRIPTION: When we were first starting out, we quickly became disappointed with the lack of good natural wine in the $20 range. Not being the kind of people to say ‘well, it is what it is’, we got to work thinking about how we could remedy this situation. So, we started talking with our producers and, already knowing what we wanted - native yeast fermentations, low or zero SO2 additions, and the like; basically pure unadulterated glou glou that we could put into a liter-sized screw-top bottle and would be a great introduction to natural wine - it didn’t take long for us to find winemakers who were willing to partner with us on this project. All it needed was a name.

TITLE: Broc Cellars Le Clairet The Perfect Red
DESCRIPTION: Broc Cellars was nothing more than an idea not that long ago, about making wines that were “site specific”. Where the wines true character came from using only sustainably, organically, or biodynamically grown grapes from areas that most would consider marginal climates. Believing that vineyards develop ‘true’ character and complexity when they have to struggle to survive.This can come from many different aspects: poor nutrient and water holding capacity, steep slopes, cool temperatures, or from old vines that are dry farmed. In the cellar we try to continue this practice using minimal intervention, in an effort to let the grapes speak for themselves. Pizza night and red sauce dishes or braised pork.

TITLE: Broc Cellars Love Red Can
DESCRIPTION: Broc Cellars was nothing more than an idea not that long ago, about making wines that were “site specific”. Where the wines true character came from using only sustainably, organically, or biodynamically grown grapes from areas that most would consider marginal climates. Believing that vineyards develop ‘true’ character and complexity when they have to struggle to survive.This can come from many different aspects: poor nutrient and water holding capacity, steep slopes, cool temperatures, or from old vines that are dry farmed. In the cellar we try to continue this practice using minimal intervention, in an effort to let the grapes speak for themselves. We are a ‘low wattage’ winery in the sense that we have very little modern equipment. Grapes are pitchforked whole-cluster into the fermenters, fermentation is allowed to happen spontaneously, all wines are basket pressed, with little/no sulphur used in our wines until bottling. True asphalt winemaking, in an urban winery.

TITLE: Broc Cellars Love Rose
DESCRIPTION: The fruit was foot stomped and left on the skins for 12 hours. We pressed into stainless steel tank where all three varieties fermented together just over 18-21 days. Spice comes from the Zinfandel, acidity from the Valdiguié and texture from the Trousseau. This is a 100% finished wine, meaning it fermented until it went dry using only native yeasts and went through spontaneous malolactic fermentation. This wine is unfiltered and may contain some sediment.

TITLE: Broc Love Rose Can
DESCRIPTION: The fruit was foot stomped and left on the skins for 12 hours. We pressed the juice into stainless steel tank where all three varieties fermented together just over 14 days. The result is a 100% finished wine. This means it fermented until it went dry using only native yeasts and went through spontaneous malolactic fermentation.

TITLE: Brockman's Premium Gin
DESCRIPTION: Brockmans is like no other gin. For gin enthusiasts it is a revelation, for gin novices it is about discovering an unexpected individual taste. It stands proudly alone from the many other types of gin due to the unique recipe of exquisite botanicals and the patient steeping distillation process. Where the more traditional notes of gin are combined with a refreshing influence of citrus and aromatic wild blackberries and blueberries. This creates an intensely smooth gin taste that is sensual and daringly different.

TITLE: Broken Barrel Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished With Broken Barrel Staves
DESCRIPTION: Broken Barrel Bourbon features a unique blend of corn, rye, and barley that makes it perfectly balanced to infuse. They partnered with an incredible world-class Kentucky Bourbon distillery to select the finest bourbon base for their products before being incorporated into their Oak Bill™. WHAT IS THE OAK BILL? - ​After a minimum of two years in new charred oak barrels, the bourbon is dumped into steel tanks, where each batch of Broken Barrel is hit with new French oak staves, ex-bourbon barrel staves, and a blend of ex-sherry cask staves. ​​Mash Bill: 70% Corn 21% Rye 9% Malted Barley Oak Bill™ 40% French Oak Staves 40% Ex-Bourbon Cask Staves 20% Sherry Cask Staves

TITLE: Brook Hill 15 Years Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Brook Hill 15 Years Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a premium aged bourbon that offers a richly layered experience developed over 15 years in oak barrels. Sourced from a renowned Kentucky distillery, this bourbon delivers depth and character, featuring a balanced profile of caramel sweetness, oak, and spice. Bottled at 103 proof, Brook Hill Bourbon is crafted for those who appreciate a mature, full-bodied whiskey that’s ideal for sipping neat, on the rocks, or in a sophisticated cocktail.

TITLE: Brooklyn Gin
DESCRIPTION: Brooklyn Gin is a craft spirit made in New York with fresh citrus peels and hand-cracked juniper. Our gin is fresh, complex, and flavorful. It’s good enough to drink on its own and we’re proud of that. We use 100% fresh citrus peels and hand-cracked juniper. By hand-cutting the citrus fruit, and releasing the essential oils in the juniper berries, we make a more vibrant gin than the distillers who use frozen or dried citrus peels. We’re three guys with one Copper Pot Still. We take three days to make 300 bottles of gin. Unlike mass-produced factory gins, we do everything by hand. It takes more time and effort, but we believe you can taste it in your very first sip. In kinship with the craftsmen who embody the Brooklyn spirit – we set out to make a small-batch American gin by hand. We distill Brooklyn Gin using locally purchased fruit and 100% corn grown in upstate New York. At the end of the day, all we’re trying to do is make great gin that people can enjoy. We hope that people like it and have some great cocktail moments with it. We believe in the American tradition of the cocktail hour - and we believe we can enrich that experience with our gin.

TITLE: Brooklyn Kura "BYx Yamahai" Nama Yamahai Sake Limited Release
DESCRIPTION: In the name BYx Yamahai, BYx refers to the brewing year, and in the coming years Brooklyn Kura hopes to serve new iterations, all of which will have different flavor profiles based on the naturally occurring ambient yeast, lactic acid, and bacteria found at the brewery at any specific time.

TITLE: Brooklyn Kura "Grand Prairie" Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Grand Prairie is a Junmai Ginjo namachozo (bottle pasteurized) sake. We used 100% yamada nishiki (sake brewer's rice) milled to 60%. This sake was brewed with a single modern yeast strain. The result is dry and light with a hint of honeysuckle. ABV: 16% SMV (measure of residual sugar): 0 Recommended storage: white wine temperatures (about 55 degrees) Name: The location of the first place to grow Yamada Nishiki in the US.

TITLE: Brooklyn Kura #14 Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: All the rice is grown in the USA and milled in the USA. Koji rice is Yamada Nishiki (60% seimaibuai) Kakemai is Calrose (50%) Mizu is Brooklyn''s finest. Yeast is proprietary

TITLE: Brooklyn Kura Catskills Junmai Dai Ginjo Nama Genshu Chozo Sake Limited Release
DESCRIPTION: This is our second Dai Ginjo (our first was in collaboration with Nanbu Bijin--a 6th generation brewery). Dai Ginjo is considered a super premium style of sake due to the effort, time, and cost that goes into its production. We used 100% sake brewers rice (yamada nishiki), a single modern yeast, and didn't let the fermentation go above 11 degrees celsius. The result is intended to be delicate and luxurious.

TITLE: Brooklyn Kura Greenwood Kimoto Nama-Chozo Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Greenwood Kimoto is named after the very old and historic Greenwood Cemetery. This Ginjo is brewed using the traditional kimoto starter technique. Kimoto utilizes ambient microorganisms to create the ideal fermentation conditions for yeast. SMV +6, Acid 2.3.

TITLE: Brooklyn Kura Occidental Dry Hopped Junmai Ginjo Namazake Sake "Limited Release"
DESCRIPTION: This sake pours like a rose with the nose of an IPA. It was brewed 1) because we love it and 2) we want to continually attract fine wine and craft beer drinkers to sake and Occidental is a fun way to do just that. Occidental is a single yeast junmai. At the end of the fermentation process (post pressing) we gently dry-hop the sake to extract the aroma and character you would expect from hops.

TITLE: Brooklyn Winery Dry Rose
DESCRIPTION: This Dry Rose, made from Old Vine Grenache vines planted in the 1940's, displays both the elegance and the intensity the varietal is capable of. The light salmon hue invokes the pink wines made in the South of France, intertwined with a new world vibrancy that bursts from the glass. The fruit was hand-harvested in the dark and cool mornings that the west coast in known for, then brought to the winery where it was gently de-stemmed and lightly crushed. Maceration time was 3 to 7 hours, depending on the lot and color extraction rate, before being brought to the press. The juice was then fermented in Stainless Steel tanks at a very cool temperature, extending the primary fermentation over 4 weeks. Once dry, the wine was moved to various stainless tanks for extended aging while the Malolactic fermentation was inhibited. Bottled after 8 months aging in non-oxidative style.

TITLE: Brooks Winery Willamette Valley Riesling
DESCRIPTION: A perfect blend of rich fruit weight and texture, brought to live by vibrant acidity. Clearly this is one for the exotic food, definitely Indian, chicken tandoori or any curry dish.

TITLE: Brora 1977 Prima & Ultima 45 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Brora 1977 Prima & Ultima 45 Years Old is a singular expression from the historic Highland distillery, Brora. Distilled in the distillery's pivotal year of 1977, this whisky represents the culmination of Brora's 'age of peat', an era that defined its reputation. Matured for an impressive 45 years, this exquisite single malt is a testament to Brora's mastery in whisky making. The Brora 1977 is drawn from the final remaining American oak hogshead from that year, capturing a unique moment in time. This release is limited, with only 794 bottles available, making it a highly sought-after collector's item. The whisky encapsulates the essence of the Scottish Highlands, offering a distinct farmyard taste with subtle smoky notes, a hallmark of Brora's traditional style.

TITLE: Brother's Bond 7 Years Old Bottled-In-Bond Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Brother's Bond 6 Years Old Bottled-In-Bond Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a premium expression from the Brother's Bond brand, adhering to the strict regulations of Bottled-in-Bond standards. Aged for a full seven years and bottled at 100-proof, this bourbon showcases the brand's dedication to crafting exceptional, high-quality whiskey. The Bottled-in-Bond designation ensures that this bourbon is distilled and aged under strict government regulations, guaranteeing its authenticity and purity. With its rich flavor profile and robust character, Brother's Bond 7-Year Bottled-In-Bond is a must-try for bourbon enthusiasts looking for a well-aged and balanced whiskey.

TITLE: Brother's Bond American Blended Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A remarkable four-grain blended rye whiskey with a final mash bill of 77% Rye, 16% corn, with wheat and barley making up the rest. Made in small batches, this rye recipe combines our signature bourbon blended with a distinctive straight rye mash bill, aged in new, deep-charred oak barrels for a minimum of four years. The result is a well-integrated and complex rye whiskey full of robust flavors with a full-bodied mouthfeel and extra-long finish. Bottled at 47.5% ALC/VOL (95 proof) Color: Dark Gold Body: Rich, creamy, and full-bodied Length of Finish: 2:00 min

TITLE: Brother's Bond Cask Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This limited release of the original cask strength expression showcases Brother’s Bond Bourbon in its undiluted form, unfiltered and uncut at 115.8 proof. Influenced only by the barrel’s qualities, the passing of time, and the artful blending of three distinctive mash bills to create a four-grain straight bourbon original cask strength whiskey.

TITLE: Brother's Bond Regenerative Grain Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Brother's Bond Regenerative Grain Bourbon is a forward-thinking and sustainable bourbon that highlights the brand's commitment to both quality and environmental responsibility. Made using regenerative farming practices, this bourbon is crafted from grains that promote soil health and biodiversity, making it a whiskey with a purpose. Bottled at 95 proof, Brother's Bond Regenerative Grain Bourbon delivers a smooth and balanced flavor profile ideal for sipping or mixing. Perfect for those who care about sustainability and enjoy high-quality bourbon, this release represents a blend of tradition and innovation in whiskey-making.

TITLE: Brother's Bond Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The dawn of your new bourbon has arrived. Brother's Bond, created by Ian Somerhalder and Paul Wesley, known as "The Salvatore Brothers" from the famed TV series, "The Vampire Diaries." The true bonds of their friendship strengthened over drinking bourbon, both on and off-screen, for over a decade. The brand name is a nod to their on-screen characters, their shared love for great bourbon, and a reflection of the sense of brotherhood they have formed over the years. They crafted this hand-selected batch, distilled and aged in the tradition of all great bourbon. Time to bond. Cheers, Ian & Paul A four-grain, high rye bourbon whiskey; 65% corn, 22% rye, wheat, and barley is our secret. Copper column and copper pot-doubler distillation. Aged a minimum of 4 years in virgin American oak; barrel staves #4 char; barrel heads #2 char.

TITLE: Brotherhood Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Burgundian style pinot noir, light brick-red, dry and complex. Barrel-aged for 6 months, it has a berry nose and a hint of vanilla-oak. Well balanced, very soft in texture.

TITLE: BroVo Project Amaro NYC Black Squirrel
DESCRIPTION: Brian Bartels of Fedora collaboration Using the flavors and influences of their Black Squirrel hit like a lightning bolt, as those same ingredients (citrus, maple, toasted pecan, cinnamon) are elements to engage any time of the day! It’s worth mentioning how black squirrels are everywhere in Wisconsin, but they’re actually rare in most parts of the world. This is distillery’s way to celebrate them through the wonderful world of amaro.

TITLE: BroVo Project Amaro NYC Guffey
DESCRIPTION: Tonia Guffey of DRAM collaboration In Tonia's words: “The first amaro I tasted had a soft taste of sort of flat root beer and I always wanted to find something like that but more amplified. I felt that it was a natural flavor pairing to marry amaro and root beer considering they are both rooted in herbs and barks. Now, living in Williamsburg, Brooklyn at the height of the bespoke trend I can get artisanal root beer and sodas on every block.”

TITLE: BroVo Project Amaro NYC Simo/Wallace
DESCRIPTION: Joaquin Simo & Demario Wallace of Pouring Ribbons collaboration Ab-so-frickin-lutely delicious! Way greener and with a much bigger umami note, all without losing the fruit and spice. A nose of gentian, dijon mustard, stewed orchard fruit, thyme and an attack of Tarragon, baked apple, stemmy. Mid-Palate you notice a clove, gentian, damp earth, bright, pear tart with a long, rich, ginger/ galangal finish.

TITLE: BroVo Project Amaro NYC Tschetter
DESCRIPTION: Jacob Tschetter of The Jeffrey Beer Bar & Cafe collaboration This tastes like the Sierra Nevada smell in those moments when you step out on a granite ridge to stare into the distance. The breeze drenches your face in all the scents of the high country - sequoia, oak, creosote, and the small herbal flowers and succulents that thrive in tiny niches on the sun-warmed and wind-blown rock faces. It sticks to your lips. So, enjoy it when you can’t take the time to hike into the backcountry.

TITLE: Brownstone Winery Merlot
DESCRIPTION: This Merlot is medium-bodied with rounded red and dark fruit flavors, a gentle touch of oak and a smooth, satisfying finish

TITLE: Brugal Especial Extra Dry Rum
DESCRIPTION: The first is the Brugal method of distillation, which removes much of what other rums leave in, resulting in a spirit that is cleaner, dryer and less sweet. The second is an unwavering dedication to cask-aging every drop of Brugal, today using the same wood policy as the world’s finest Single Malt Scotch Whisky.

TITLE: Brugal Papa Andres "ODISEA" 2018 Edition Rum
DESCRIPTION: Spanish artist Javier Mariscal is the man behind the design of this limited edition decanter, only 1,000 of these unique bottles have been made. Named after the founder, Don Andres Brugal, this blend has been enjoyed by the Brugal family for five generations before ever being released for sale. Each limited edition is different from the last, and 2018’s edition ODISEA is designed to pay homage to the founder and celebrate 130 years of tradition. The decanter features an engraved metal collar alongside a hand-polished, sandblasted plaque and is presented in an elegant blue-jewel case featuring an intricate wave illustration design, symbolizing Don Andres’ journey across the Atlantic. Only 1,000 handmade decanters have been made for sale, making this one of the most unique and extraordinary rums you could ever enjoy.

TITLE: Bruichladdich "Black Art" Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky 750ml  11.1
DESCRIPTION: Bruichladdich Black Art 11.1 Edition is a 24-year-old unpeated single malt Scotch whisky, matured entirely on Islay. This edition, shrouded in secrecy, is the eleventh release in the limited edition Black Art series and the seventh crafted by Head Distiller Adam Hannett. The types of casks used in the vatting are undisclosed, with the recipe known only to the distiller. Matured in the finest oak, this whisky showcases a captivating marriage of traditional Scotch whisky-making with innovative maturation techniques.

TITLE: Bruichladdich 8 year old Islay Barley 2013
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 94, #9 on Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 ListThis expression, now in its eighth edition, showcases Bruichladdich’s commitment to Islay terroir. It’s an 8-year-old in a world of double-digit age-stated scotch, but you’ll never accuse this delightful whisky of being too young. Sweet biscuity aromas along with ripe peaches and pears lead to a creamy palate of lemon cake, candied orange, nougat, and vanilla, all balanced by the wood influence and hints of salinity. Water brings out sweet nectar and honey. The finish is graceful, long, and lively, making this a truly memorable dram.

TITLE: Bruichladdich Bere Barley 2010 Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Bere Barley is a six-row heritage variety that has long since been forgotten from the modern world of standardised whisky making. Its revival into present day has taken effort and resilience from an entire network of millers, growers and agronomists. Our Bere project is dedicated to those like-minded souls, who have preserved a legacy and found modern applications in flavourful food and drinks, whatever the odds. This Bruichladdich Bere Barley was distilled in 2010 from a 2009 harvest, brought home by Peter, John, Magnus, Sydney and Duncan on the Orkney Islands.

TITLE: Bruichladdich Hogshead 22 yrs Islay Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A 1992 vintage Bruichladdich from independent bottler Signatory as part of their Un-Chillfiltered Collection. Distilled on 20 November, it was aged in a pair of hogsheads for 21 years before being bottled on 14 April 2014.

TITLE: Bruichladdich Octomore 11.1 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Exposing the structural brilliance of our pure, unadulterated Octomore super heavily peated spirit, our 11.1 edition is powerful, understated and vibrant. Underpinned with a delicate balance of smoke and sweet vanilla from the ex-American oak casks, this single malt has spent just 5 years in contact with fresh first fill wood. The presence of peat on the palate is huge, and yet is incredibly balanced with clean fruit and floral notes. Distilled in 2014 from the 2013 harvest of 100% Scottish barley then filled into active ex-American oak, this high provenance, high peat single malt is a fitting embodiment of how quality ingredients demand less time to reach maturity.

TITLE: Bruichladdich Octomore 11.3 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Comparing Octomore 11.1 and 11.3 gives one of our finest lessons in stratospheric smoke and barley terroir. While both editions are malted to a Brobdingnagian 100+PPM reading, the differences in barley character from the respective growing region is ever present. Our Octomore Islay barley is grown each year by friend and farmer James Brown, on Octomore farm itself. It is harvested, malted and distilled separately, even from our other Islay barley harvests, in order to become a single field, single vintage single malt.

TITLE: Bruichladdich Octomore 12.1 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Nowhere is the dualism of our Octomore super heavily peated series more pertinent than in our .1 edition. Never as expected, delicate but powerful, this is unadulterated heavy smoke balanced with our vivacious and dynamic, fruity and floral distillate. While Octomore in itself does not conform to tradition, our Head Distiller Adam Hannett is inclined to mature Octomore .1 editions solely in ex-American whiskey casks for 5 vibrant years. Octomore 12.1 is the necessary control for the rest of the series, as experiments within an experiment, but our baseline should not be underestimated. Mainland grown Scottish barley is distilled in a patient and considered trickle.

TITLE: Bruichladdich Octomore 13.1 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Octomore 13.1 is as youthful and dynamic as its super-heavily peated predecessors. Distilled patiently from the 2015 harvest of 100% Scottish Mainland barley, this single malt is malted to a stratospheric 137.3 PPM and matured in the highest quality American oak casks.

TITLE: Bruichladdich Octomore 13.2 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Octomore 13.2 offers an alternative maturation to the structural brilliance delivered by its 13.1 counterpart. In an indulgent point of difference, the five-year-old spirit has spent its entire maturing life in Oloroso butts from Fernando de Castilla, Spain.

TITLE: Bruichladdich Octomore 13.3 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Octomore 13.3 demonstrates the phenomenal force of flavor when combining super-heavy peat with the variable harvests gathered from the island of Islay, raised by friend and farmer James Brown on one singular farm.

TITLE: Bruichladdich Octomore 14.1 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Bruichladdich Octomore 14.1 takes the mantle of being an extraordinary Single Malt Scotch Whisky from Islay, known for its unparalleled peat intensity. Distilled in 2017 from the 2016 harvest of 100% Scottish grown Concerto barley, this expression is a testament to the mastery of peat and precision. Aged for five years in first-fill ex-American whiskey casks, Octomore 14.1 boasts an astounding phenol level of 128.9 ppm, setting it apart as a super heavily peated whisky. This edition is not just about the peat; it's about showcasing how peat's profound intensity can coexist with elegance and complexity​.

TITLE: Bruichladdich Octomore 14.2 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Bruichladdich Octomore 14.2, dubbed "The Impossible Equation," is a testament to the innovative spirit of Islay's whisky making. TITLE: Buchegger Blauer Zweigelt
DESCRIPTION: Buchegger makes very classic style Kremstal wines. The wines are characterized by ripeness and power, but always without botrytis; Walter liked his wines to be clean, fruity, and easy to drink; complex, without being complicated. I tasted 2017’s at the VieVinum fair with Buchegger’s cellar master, Michael Nastl, who had worked at Brundlmayer in the Kamptal for many years before joining the Buchegger team in 2014. Holding back tears, we tasted through a gorgeous line up of 2016’s and 2017’s. Nastl described 2016 as a cool year with quite a bit of rain, which was beneficial to the wines as they are really pushed to absorb the minerals from the soil. He described 2017 as hot and dry. I found that the 2017’s had juicy ripeness and a nice, bright, savory minerality. 2016’s had a striking floral quality on the nose and the signature quality that Buchegger’s wines always have: an approachability that is full of fruit, yet with enough mouthwatering acidity to make you want another sip.

TITLE: Buchegger Rose Terrassen
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1893 with a full set of un-cloned vines, Buchegger is located in Austria's north-eastern region of Kremstal (about 30 miles north of Vienna). Today, the sixth generation under Walter Buchegger continues the ancestors' traditions on 25 acres inherited from his parents in 1994. Using a strict form of Austrian organic farming called 'Integrated Process', Walter eschews machinery in the vineyards and limits even natural remedies like copper sulfite. Terrassen is a blend of 50% Pinot Noir complemented with 25% each Zweigelt and Merlot. Pairs well with almost any summer food such salads, cold meats, and antipasti, as well as Asian and German fare.

TITLE: Bucklin Sonoma Valley Zinfandel Bambino Old Hill Ranch
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1852 near the town of Glen Ellen, Old Hill Ranch is one of California’s oldest vineyards. Our “Bambino” comes from a 10-acre block we planted on Old Hill in 1998. This young vine field-blend is patterned after the ancient vine field-blend for which Old Hill is known. The wine is a blend of several grape varieties - principally Zinfandel, but also Petite Sirah, Alicante Bouchet and Grenache to name a few. The 2009 bud-break started about one week earlier than average and we sustained light frost damage on the Grenache and Alicante Bouchet on April 4th. The summer was mild except for a weekend heat spell on August 20th. We were very fortunate that the vines held up through the heat and they weren’t ready for harvesting until more than a month later. We began harvesing the Zin on September 29 and finished with the Grenache mid-October. Given the early bud-break and the late harvest it was one of the longest growing seasons we have seen. The end of the harvest was punctuated by an unusually wet storm in mid-October but thankfully by that time we had finished harvesting all our grapes. The fermentations were relatively cool and long, a result of the use of indigenous yeast and the ripeness of the fruit. Pressing occurred after 12 days on the skins. The wine was bottled on January 2011 after 15 months aging in older French oak barrels. The winemaking techniques were gentle, and used minimal sulfites and no filtrations.

TITLE: Buffalo Trace "Kosher Rye Recipe" Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In partnership with the Chicago Rabbinical Council (cRc), Buffalo Trace Distillery produced this Rye Recipe Bourbon Whiskey. Made with the same high quality grains as Buffalo Trace Bourbon Whiskey, this Kosher spirit was aged in specifically designated Kosher barrels. In order to satisfy Passover requirements, these barrels were sold to a non-Jewish executive in a ceremony witness by a representative from the cRc. After aging for seven years, this Rye Recipe Bourbon was bottled at 94 proof after ensuring the bottling lines were cleaned beforehand and that no contact was made by non-Kosher spirits. Released after Passover each year, this Rye Recipe Bourbon is bold and independent, celebrating its heritage from America’s oldest continually-operating distillery.

You can enjoy it chilled, on the rocks, or pour it in a cup of coffee for an indulgent after dinner treat. TITLE: Buffalo Trace Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Buffalo Trace Distillery, located in Frankfort, Kentucky is the oldest running distillery in the United States. Records show distillation from this site since before the declaration of Independence 1776. The whiskey itself is named after the title given to the ancient Buffalo paths that crossed these lands leading explorers and settlers westward.It is no coincidence that the early settlers stopped here near the banks of the Kentucky river in a spot that is rich in limestone and river bottom loam, ideal qualities for making the grains that would be used for spirits. With their careful blending of organically grown corn, rye and superior malted barley, natural limestone filter water is added for the mash to be stored in center ring barrels of 70 to 80 year of age. The result is an exceptionally expressive whiskey that has a wonderful mouthfeel, drinking smoother than most bourbons in this price range. Hence, Buffalo Trace has won awards every year since its inception in 1999. Wine Enthusiast rating: 93

TITLE: Buffalo Trace Experimental 11 Year 9 Mths Rye Bourbon 115 Proof
DESCRIPTION: Only two barrels of this Buffalo Trace Experimental Collection release were bottled, making the Rye Bourbon 115 pretty limited. This experiment is an analysis of how barrel entry proof of rye bourbon mash #1 will impact bourbon’s flavor. The 115 barrel entry proof has light oaky flavors mingled with leather and palm sugar. Racy on the nose, with Madeira and Port-like notes. Bold on the palate, with notes of sherry, clove-studded orange, and vanilla caramel on the finish. Great balance here, with a rich, well-rounded body.

TITLE: Buffalo Trace Experimental Collection Seasoned Stave Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Buffalo Trace’s 22nd experimental whiskey release is all about barrel staves, and how longer seasoning affects the final product. The Experimental Collection first appeared on shelves back in 2006. Experimental bourbons tend to focus on one individual contributing factor, with the idea to see what impact a particular ingredient will have on the final whiskey. Past experimental releases have focused on aging conditions, grain types, and other factors. These new whiskeys were aged nine years in barrels made from extremely seasoned staves. “The bourbons, filled with Buffalo Trace’s mash recipe #1, were put away to age on October 27, 2009 in new barrels with staves that were seasoned for 36 months and 48 months,” Buffalo Trace explained in a press release this morning. “Most barrel staves air dry for six months, but these oak staves were allowed to season for much longer in hopes the barrels would offer a unique flavor, different than standard barrels.” Buffalo Trace says the difference between the two bottles is slight, but the difference between these experiments and traditional Buffalo Trace whiskeys is noticeable. “The 48 month seasoned stave barrels created a more mellow taste and holds less flavor from the wood,” stated Master Distiller Harlen Wheatley. “The 36 month seasoned stave bourbon is a little more flavorful with oak notes and caramel present.” We offer the 36 month expression.

TITLE: Buffalo Trace Prohibition Bourbon Collection
DESCRIPTION: The Buffalo Trace Prohibition Collection is a unique and historical release from Buffalo Trace Distillery, celebrating the era of Prohibition in the United States (1920-1933). Buffalo Trace, then known as the George T. Stagg Distillery, was one of the few distilleries permitted to produce medicinal whiskey during Prohibition. Collection Overview: Old Stagg: A barrel-proof whiskey with an ABV of 132.4, it offers earthy notes of tobacco leaf, charred oak, and Luxardo cherries, leading to a finish of dry oak, leather, and vanilla powder. Golden Wedding: A rye whiskey bottled at 107 proof, featuring herbal notes of fresh mint and spearmint, transitioning to dill and sweeter notes like pink bubblegum, with a thick mouthfeel and a lingering finish of baked pears and cinnamon. Three Feathers: A 100-proof bottled-in-bond whiskey with a rich nose of char and oak sugars, and flavors of butterscotch, malted milk balls, and dried apricot. It has a long finish with notes of sweet and dark chocolate. Walnut Hill: A high-rye bourbon at 90 proof, offering a surprisingly thin mouthfeel with flavors of peach, plum, and a hint of rye spice, leading to a smoky finish with medicinal cherry undertones. Spiritus Frumenti: A wheated bourbon at 110 proof, featuring a nose of medicinal cherry and dark fruits, with a palate of black cherry, citrus, and light molasses, finishing with cocoa powder, bold oak, and rye spice. Packaging: The collection is presented in a custom-made wooden display case, with each bottle featuring 1920s-inspired labels and back cartons displaying cut-outs of doctors' prescriptions for medicinal whiskey

TITLE: Buffalo Trace Single Oak Project Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Buffalo Trace Distillery CEO Mark Brown dubs this the "Holy Grail" of whiskey. This Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is aged in oak barrels made from a single tree. The Single Oak Project is the most extensive bourbon experiment ever undertaken. It all started with 96 individually selected American oak trees that differed according to the number of growth rings per inch and growing location. Each tree was then cut into two parts - top and bottom - yielding 192 unique tree sections. A single barrel was constructed from each unique section. Before construction distillery varied the stave seasoning times. The 192 barrels were then charred differently. These single oak barrels were then filled with different recipe whiskeys, at various entry proofs and aged in a variety of different warehouse styles. We believe that this experiment will allow you to directly compare the impact of 7 various critical variables across 192 bottles for a total of 1,396 taste combinations. None of the 192 bottles in the complete set are exactly alike

TITLE: Buffalo Trace White Dog Mash #1 Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In Kentucky, buffalo carved a pathway followed by America’s first explorers. Those brave pioneers distilled whiskey using traditional methods and drank it right off the still. They called it White Dog. This raw distillate was clear, un-aged and had a hint of sweet corn. Later distillers discovered this spirit was perfect for aging - creating what we know today as fine Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey. We’re still making whiskey on the spot where ancient buffalo once crossed the Kentucky River and following centuries of time-honored distilling tradition. Enjoy this White Dog the way Americans did more than 200 years ago.

TITLE: Buffalo Trace White Dog Rye Mash-Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Dating back to George Washington and the birth of a nation is a proud history of crafting whiskey. Some of the first whiskey distilled in America was Straight Rye. Keeping with the traditions of America’s founding fathers, Buffalo Trace Distillery offers this raw, clear, un-aged and high-proof distillate right off the still. The taste has a hint of spicy rye. This whiskey is known as White Dog. It was later discovered this spirit was perfect for aging and gave way to what we today know as Straight Rye Whiskey. Enjoy this White Dog the way early Americans did more than 200 years ago. Seriously spicy, with some corn sweetness and lingering earthiness.

TITLE: Buffalo Trace White Dog Wheated Mash Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: William Larue Weller was a distilling pioneer. He took a traditional bourbon recipe and substituted wheat where rye was generally used. This created a soft, mellow spirit perfect for sipping. Before this whiskey ever made its way into the barrel for aging it was drank straight off the still. It was called White Dog. This raw distillate was clear, un-aged and hinted of wheat and sweet corn. Enjoy this wheat recipe White Dog the way William Larue Weller and early Americans did more than a century ago.

TITLE: Bull Run 14 Years Barrel Strength  American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bull Run American Whiskey is a rich and flavorful expression crafted by Bull Run Distillery in Portland, Oregon. Known for its robust character and bold flavors, this American whiskey often blends sourced and locally aged whiskey, delivering a well-balanced and smooth profile. Bottled at varying barrel strength proofs, Bull Run American Whiskey exemplifies the distillery's commitment to quality and tradition while offering a unique Pacific Northwest twist. This whiskey is perfect for those who appreciate a smooth yet full-bodied spirit that showcases the craftsmanship of one of Oregon's finest distilleries. Base Ingredient/Mash: 99% corn and 1% malted barley purchased from Great Western Malting Still Size & Type: 700-gallon steel column still Distillation: Double-distilled Maturation: Aged for 14+ years in used Bourbon barrels Filtration: Chill-filtered Finishing: Proofed with water from Bull Run Reservoir Distiller: Lee Medoff

TITLE: Bull Run 15 Year Old "The Matador" American Whiskey Finished in Oregon Pinot Noir Cask The Prime Barrel Pick #72
DESCRIPTION: An exceptional single-barrel bourbon experience awaits. With a mashbill of 96% Corn and 4% Malted Barley, this American Whiskey from Bull Run has a respectable 15-year age stamp (with 26 months in a Pinot Noir Cask). The reason it's branded as an American Whiskey? Its intriguing journey began in an ex-bourbon barrel, aging there for several years before its wine cask adventure. This whiskey is far from ordinary, with its rich, 15-year heritage paired with a captivating flavor profile. It's a bottle we'd treasure for unique moments and sharing with fellow whiskey club enthusiasts. Its character doesn't tiptoe around - it's assertive and profound. Surprisingly, despite its age, it doesn't overwhelm with woody undertones; instead, it offers vibrant hints of fruit and candy. In summary, this Bull Run masterpiece is a must-have addition for lovers of bold single-barrel bourbon expressions. Barrel Info: Mashbill: 96% corn and 4% malted barley (purchased from Great Western Malting) Still Size & Type: 700-gallon steel column still Distillation: Double-distilled Maturation: Aged for 13 years in used Bourbon barrels + 26 months in Pinot Noir Cask Filtration: Chill-filtered Finishing: Proofed with water from Bull Run Reservoir Distiller: Lee Medoff

TITLE: Bull Run 5 Year Old "Ole!" Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Chinato Vermouth Cask The Prime Barrel Pick #73
DESCRIPTION: We proudly present the "Ole!" - a 5-Year-Old Straight Bourbon, exquisitely finished in Chinato Vermouth casks from Bull Run, a hallmark of artisanal spirits from Oregon. From a selection of four distinct samples, this one stood out prominently, throwing us a delightful curveball with its unique profile. At The Prime Barrel, we're particularly discerning when it comes to wine-finished bourbons, always seeking that impeccable balance. This selection didn't just meet our stringent criteria—it surpassed them. The bourbon's harmonious melding with the aromatic nuances of Chinato Vermouth has resulted in a singular expression we're ecstatic about. This pick not only excels when sipped neat but also shines as a splendid after-meal aperitif. And while the proof might seem light to some, don't be deterred. It's impeccably balanced for this expression, making it irresistibly "crushable." This gem has earned our "Selected by The Prime Barrel" stamp of approval, showcasing our commitment to curating only the finest.Tasting Notes: Floral, almost Irish spring on the nose. Buttery and nutty with a hint of fruit, on a palate with a long finish.

TITLE: Bull Run 8 Year Old Maple Infused American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bull Run Maple Infused American Whiskey is a unique and flavorful expression crafted by Bull Run Distillery in Oregon. This whiskey is infused with real maple, adding a rich sweetness and complexity to the traditional American whiskey profile. Bottled at around 90 proof, this infused whiskey perfectly balances the boldness of the whiskey with the sweetness of the maple, resulting in a smooth and indulgent spirit. Whether enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as the base for a creative cocktail, Bull Run Maple Infused American Whiskey is ideal for those who appreciate a whiskey with a sweet twist.

TITLE: Bull Run Aged 15 Years Oregon Pinot Noir Finished Casks American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bull Run Pinot Noir Finished American Whiskey is an exceptional expression from Bull Run Distillery. It is known for its innovation in blending traditional whiskey-making with the influence of Oregon’s renowned Pinot Noir wine. Bottled at 96 proof, this whiskey is first crafted from a blend of malt and grain whiskies before being finished in Pinot Noir casks, imparting a unique complexity and rich fruit character. The wine barrel finish adds layers of depth, including subtle fruity undertones, making this whiskey a standout for those who appreciate a distinctive and flavorful spirit.

TITLE: Bull Run Barrel Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bull Run Barrel Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey is an intense and robust expression from Oregon’s Bull Run Distillery. Bottled at barrel strength, this uncut and unfiltered bourbon offers a full-bodied, rich flavor profile that allows the whiskey’s natural character to shine. Aged for 4-6 years and typically bottled at proof levels between 114-125, Bull Run Barrel Strength Bourbon is perfect for bourbon lovers who appreciate the bold complexity and depth that comes from high-proof whiskey. This bourbon delivers a powerful yet balanced drinking experience, making it a great choice for sipping neat or with a splash of water.

TITLE: Bull Run Carlton Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bull Run Carlton Rye Whiskey is a bold and spicy expression from the Bull Run Distillery in Oregon, known for producing rich and full-bodied whiskies. Made with a high rye content, this whiskey showcases the robust, spicy character that rye enthusiasts love, while still maintaining a smooth, well-balanced profile. Bottled at 90 proof, Bull Run Carlton Rye offers a vibrant and complex flavor experience, perfect for sipping neat, on the rocks, or in classic rye-forward cocktails like the Manhattan or Old Fashioned.

TITLE: Bull Run Oregon Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bull Run Oregon Single Malt Whiskey is a unique and flavorful expression crafted by Bull Run Distillery in the heart of the Pacific Northwest. This single malt whiskey is made from 100% malted barley and reflects the distillery's commitment to quality and craftsmanship. Bottled at 90 proof, this whiskey offers a smooth and rich profile that showcases the influence of Oregon’s climate on the aging process. With a perfect balance of malt sweetness, oak, and subtle spice, Bull Run Oregon Single Malt Whiskey is ideal for those who appreciate a well-crafted, local whiskey with a distinct character.

TITLE: Bull Run Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bull Run Straight Bourbon is a rich and robust bourbon whiskey produced by Bull Run Distillery in Oregon. Aged for 4-6 years, this bourbon is crafted using a high-quality mashbill and offers a smooth, well-rounded flavor profile. Bottled at 91 proof, this bourbon embodies the spirit of traditional American whiskey with a unique Pacific Northwest twist. Bull Run Straight Bourbon is a versatile bourbon that can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in a variety of cocktails, making it an excellent choice for both bourbon enthusiasts and casual drinkers.

TITLE: Bull Run Temperance Barrel Strength Bourbon Whiskey 114 Proof
DESCRIPTION: Bull Run Temperance Barrel Strength Bourbon Whiskey is a bold, uncut, and unfiltered expression from Bull Run Distillery in Oregon. Bottled at 114 proof, this bourbon showcases the robust flavors that come with barrel strength, allowing whiskey lovers to experience its full-bodied richness. The high proof highlights the depth of flavors from the carefully selected barrels, offering a complex yet well-balanced profile perfect for those who enjoy robust bourbon. Aged between 4 and 6 years, Bull Run Temperance delivers a distinctive character embodying tradition and innovation.

TITLE: Bulleit 10 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
Bulleit 12 Years Straight American Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: From the pioneers of the North American Rye movement comes a limited release, 12 Year Old Aged Rye Whiskey. Using the same mash bill as our classic Bulleit Rye, this 95% rye and 5% malted barley whiskey is a balance of smoothness and spice. The pear-like fruitiness, dry, buttery oakiness and faintly spiced notes are best served neat, or on the rocks. Includes one 92 proof, 750 mL bottle of Bulleit Rye Aged 12 Years Whiskey. Bulleit Bourbon is still distilled and aged in the Bulleit family tradition. As Bulleit enthusiasts know, rye has always been our cornerstone. In this tradition, we're proud to present Bulleit Rye Aged 12 Years Whiskey.

TITLE: Bulleit Barrel Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Producer Info: To this day, Bulleit Bourbon is distilled and aged in the Bulleit family tradition. High rye content gives it a bold, spicy character with a distinctively smooth, clean finish. Kentucky limestone-filtered water provides a foundation for the bourbon's character, while charred American oak barrels lend a smoky backbone. Our aging philosophy is simple: we wait until our bourbon is ready.

TITLE: Bulleit Bourbon 15 Year “Cannonball” Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #66
DESCRIPTION: As many of you are aware, there's a widespread belief that aged Bulleit selections contain Four Roses distillate. While this theory is fascinating, we found it improbable when selecting this particular barrel. The character and flavor profile of this whiskey led us to believe otherwise. One of the most exciting discoveries was the age of this distillate - a staggering 15 years old. We confess, even we found it hard to believe at first. However, the rich, complex flavors and beautifully rounded profile made it an undeniable reality. To ensure that we weren't only captivated by the allure of its age, we put it to the ultimate test: a blind tasting. We're pleased to share that it prevailed with flying colors, demonstrating an exceptional character that stood head and shoulders above its competitors. The bourbon we've selected is not your standard Bulleit. It's richer, more complex, and has an intriguing depth of flavor that challenges preconceived notions. We're excited for you to taste it and discover its distinctiveness for yourselves. Barrel info: Barrel #: 2-B1-28 Barreled: 12/16/2006 Bottled 6/9/2022 104 Proof Tasting Notes: Nose: if we did not know better, we’d swear this thing was finished in a maple syrup cask. We opened the actual maple syrup next to it, and the resemblance was uncanny. In addition: Sherry, plum, figs, maraschino cherries, orange peel Palate: Same maple syrup presence and orange peel, but also baking spices, cocoa nibs, and Earl Grey tea Finish: Long, warming, and enticing to get another sip.

TITLE: Bulleit Bourbon Blenders Select Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Blender Eboni Major makes her mark with this limited-edition whiskey that incorporates three distillates, all at least 9 years old. The multiple flavor profiles and ages converge to create a hyper-charged bourbon with layers of flavor. A lively nose offers raspberry, chocolate, mint, confectioners’ sugar, and candied pecans. The palate is bold, with flavors of cherry, spearmint, dark chocolate, nougat, pepper, and polished oak. More mint follows on the finish, along with bitter chocolate, dark berries, and spice.

TITLE: Bulleit Bourbon “Bite The Bulleit” Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #14
DESCRIPTION: Any time a popular brand decides to release a barrel strength version of their standard product, people take extra notice. The common assumption is that barrel proof means better, simply because a higher alcohol concentration should bring enhanced flavors. While we've seen examples where this isn't necessarily the case, including Bulleit's own regular barrel strength expression, this particular release is anything but. The ability to pick from 4 different barrels really benefited our ability to select a cracker of a barrel and for the price point, you really are getting a super value. Bottled at 104 Proof, this is a great sipper neat and can also enhance any cocktail without overpowering it. More barrel specifics: Mashbill: 75% Corn / 21% Rye / 4% Malted Barley Yeast: Fruity and Creamy Age: 8 years For the sticker theme, the "Bite the Bullet" idea practically begged to be used and we've kept it very spartan, yet very colorful. The primary sticker really plays well with the color of the bottle and Bulleit's brand colors, and we hope you like it. Tasting Notes: Nose: Brown sugar, burnt sugar, caramel custard, cherry pie, sawdust, cigar box, and a very faint hint of tanning leather. Palate: Subtle notes of dates, raisins, and green apple upfront and very quickly goes into the more savory and spicy side of things. Lots of oak, leather, toasted barley, allspice, and freshly cracked black pepper on the midpalate. Finish: Long and dry with lingering notes of wintergreen mint, nutmeg, and bitter chocolate. The charity this barrel selection will be supporting is Gary's Sinise Foundation and donations will go towards creating and supporting unique programs designed to entertain, educate, inspire, strengthen, and build communities of defenders, veterans, first responders, their families, and those in need. Donation Amount: $5 from each bottle sold

TITLE: Bulleit Rye American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bulleit Bourbon is said to have originated in the 1830's, the product of a tavern owner near Louisville Kentucky by the name of Augustus Bulleit. Or so the legend goes. Whiskey history is by its very nature a good dose of folklore and romanticism wrapped around a few facts. As the legend goes, Augustus Bulleit arrived in New Orleans around 1800, an immigrant from France. It's unclear whether he arrived with family or alone. At any rate move ahead about 30 years and we find Augustus operating a tavern in Louisville, having along the way acquired the skills for making brandy. Experimentation lead to American style whiskeys which he created in small batches. Fast forward another 30 years or so and Augustus disappears while transporting his own whiskey to New Orleans. What became of him is unknown. Bulleit (bourbon) whiskey disappeared from the landscape soon thereafter. Enter Tom Bulleit, great great grandson of Augustus who reintroduced us to Bulleit Bourbon, in its current incarnation in 1999. Tom, a lawyer and veteran, who also apprenticed in distilleries in his younger years is said to have recreated the old family recipe that Augustus used in the 1800's. It is unlikely that we are drinking a whiskey replica from 150 years ago as there were, at the time, no standards for distilling whiskey and aging was virtually unheard of. Nonetheless there may be some similarities in that the rye content for Bulleit is 30% of the mash bill, high for a bourbon, but a grain that was probably the main ingredient during the period. Tom's version of Bulleit Bourbon started in Buffalo Trace Distillery. The brand was sold to Seagram and distilling was moved to Four Roses. When Seagram was bought out and divided up, spirits giant Diageo purchased the brand and continues to make Bulleit under contract at Four Roses.

DESCRIPTION: Bulleit Bourbon has always bottled their expertly distilled and aged, distinctly spicy spirit with the same design, until now. Their latest Frontier Works collaboration project is the Bulleit Bourbon Tattoo Edition series, which will feature the work of four radical tattoo artists on their signature frontier-style bottles. The Bulleit Bourbon bottle already has a badass, classic design, but the work of four talented tattoo artists, Shawn Barber of Los Angeles, Jess Mascetti of New York, Thomas Hooper of Austin and Jason Kundell of Portland, make the bottles collectible pieces of art once the last drop goes down the hatch. To make things even more interesting, each bottle has a scannable QR code that showcases an augmented reality experience to digitally bring each design to life. Bulleit gave each tattoo artist plenty of freedom to express the love for their respective city through their art, and the results are amazing. This is a Jess Mascetti bottle.
