TITLE: Bunraku Dress Bottle Junmai Ginjyo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Experience the exquisite craftsmanship of Bunraku Dress Bottle Junmai Ginjyo Sake. Produced in Saitama, Japan, this premium sake is crafted using the traditional Junmai Ginjyo method, where only the finest rice and purest water are used. Brewed by the renowned Bunraku brewery, this sake showcases a refined and elegant flavor profile with a delicate balance of fruity aromas and clean, smooth taste. Encased in a beautifully designed "dress bottle," this sake is perfect for those who appreciate both artistry and quality.

TITLE: Burgans Rias Baixas Albarino
DESCRIPTION: Burgans is a custom cuvee by Martin Codax, the largest cooperative in Rias Baixas founded in 1986 under the guidance of Luciano Amoedo. Over the last three decades, what started as 50 families and small plots of Albarino scattered around the village of Cambados has grown to include almost 600 families and well over 3000 small parcels of Albarino.

TITLE: Burgess Cellars Merlot
DESCRIPTION: A family owned and operated winery since 1972. When Tom purchased the 1870’s era winery in 1972 he established himself as a pioneer of mountain side wineries. At the time, there were only approximately 2 dozen wineries in operation in the whole of Napa Valley and he saw the potential of mountain vineyards to produce wines that evoke the French concept of terroir: that the grapes, and thus wines, should reflect the vineyard’s soil, exposure, and overall micro-climate Merlot wine matches with a wide variety of foods because of its position in the middle of the red wine spectrum. In general Merlot pairs well with chicken and other light meats as well as lightly-spiced dark meats. With medium tannin and not too much acidity you’ll find Merlot pairs well with many foods.

TITLE: Buried Cane Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Pairs well with grilled meats or pizza.

TITLE: Bushido Way of the Warrior Ginjo Genshu Sake
DESCRIPTION: Bushido is the ancient Japanese warrior code of moral values, loyalty and honor until death. Usually unuttered and unwritten, the code allows the violent existence of the samurai to be tempered by wisdom and serenity.

TITLE: Bushmills "The Rare Casks" Pedro Ximenez Cask Finish 29 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey Limited Release No 02
DESCRIPTION: Bushmills Rare Cask 29 Year Old Limited Release No 02 - Bushmills The Rare Casks Limited Release No. 2 is aged for 29 years and finished in Pedro Ximénez cask. Toffee and spice abound. Fantastic whiskey!

TITLE: Bushmills 12 Year Old Single Malt
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 93, #16 on the Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 List Layering a marsala wine-cask finish over Irish single malts matured in bourbon and oloroso sherry casks unleashes a visceral, full-bodied Bushmills into its core range, a dynamic juxtaposition from the easy drinking of the honey-sweet 10-year-old. Master blender Alex Thomas serves up a magnificently sturdy dram, primed with dark sweet delights and peppered with mixed peel, sultana, and walnut oil, offering tantalizing twists and turns of intensity through its honey, sweet fig, and black tea flavors.

TITLE: Bushmills 30-YEar-Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Immediately the longest-aged Irish whiskey available every day, Bushmills 30 Year Old has been aged in hand-selected bourbon barrels, Oloroso sherry casks, and PX sherry casks, creating a powerful and uniquely complex flavor profile, a richness that can only be achieved by 30 years in barrel. Just 775 bottles of this exquisite single malt have been created, making this 30-Year-Old single malt a scarce and elegant treasure. Triple-distilled from 100% malted barley, the inaugural release of the Bushmills 30 Year Old was first aged in hand-selected bourbon barrels and Oloroso sherry butts for 14 years along the cold north coast of Ireland. The whiskey was then married and further aged in Pedro Ximenez sherry casks for 14 years, casks that were seasoned for two years in Jerez's precious fortified wine.

TITLE: Bushmills Black Bush Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: NOSE - Big and full to start off with‚ quickly becoming light with a hint of a spicy fruit TASTE - Floats across your tongue to the back of your throat where it rests as a slight sherry sweetness FINISH - A lingering‚ smooth sweetness that flourishes into your cheeks.

TITLE: Bushmills Original Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This is a sampler bottle. Great way to taste something new without breaking the bank.

TITLE: Bushmills Red Bush Irish Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Irish whiskey makes a great option for thrifty handle purchases, with many of the major distillers offering the size, including this recent release from Northern Ireland’s oldest distillery. Aged exclusively in ex-bourbon barrels, this blend of single malt and grain whiskey is, not surprisingly, bourbon-like on the nose, with notes of molasses. A youthful dram-it’s thought to be just a little older than the legally required three years-the whiskey is a tad aggressive at just 40% ABV, but its spicy palate is balanced by cinnamon apples, cotton candy, and caramel, with a dry and woody finish.

TITLE: Bussola Amarone della Valpolicella Classico
DESCRIPTION: 65% Corvina and Corvinone, 30% Rondinella, 5% Other varieties; Tommaso Bussola began working at his uncle Giuseppe's estate in 1977. His uncle Giuseppe still works the vineyards.

TITLE: Buzzard's Roost Bottled In Bond Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Buzzard's Roost Bottled In Bond Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a carefully crafted expression that adheres to the strict standards of the Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897. This bourbon, aged for a minimum of four years and bottled at 100 proof, offers a perfect balance of tradition and bold flavor. Produced in a single distilling season, under government supervision, this straight bourbon reflects the classic American whiskey-making heritage with Buzzard's Roost's unique touch of barrel finishing expertise. Matured in specially toasted and charred barrels, this Bottled In Bond bourbon presents a harmonious blend of caramel, vanilla, and warm spice, all enhanced by the depth of the oak. The whiskey's smooth yet robust profile makes it ideal for sipping neat or as the base of an elevated cocktail.

TITLE: Buzzard's Roost Char #1 Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Buzzard's Roost Char #1 Whiskey exemplifies the brand’s dedication to pushing the boundaries of whiskey-making tradition. This whiskey undergoes a unique two-step aging process that sets it apart from traditional expressions. First, it is fully matured in charred new American oak barrels, followed by secondary aging in Buzzard's Roost’s exclusive newly toasted barrels, with the lightest Char #1 level. The innovation lies in the barrels themselves. In collaboration with their cooperage, Buzzard’s Roost developed 17 proprietary barrels with varying toasts, allowing for a rich range of flavor profiles. The combination of heavy toasting and light charring preserves the caramelized wood sugars, resulting in a whiskey that’s as complex as it is rich. This secondary aging process enhances the whiskey with layers of flavors—ranging from sweet and spicy to smoky—making every sip an exploration of nuanced taste. Available in both rye and bourbon expressions, Buzzard's Roost Char #1 showcases the mastery of blending innovative barrel techniques with classic whiskey traditions.

TITLE: Buzzard's Roost Char #1 Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Buzzard's Roost Char #1 Whiskey is a remarkable example of innovation meeting tradition. This whiskey undergoes a unique dual-maturation process that sets it apart from other rye and bourbon expressions. Initially aged in new charred American oak barrels, the whiskey is then transferred to Buzzard's Roost’s exclusive lightly toasted barrels. The secondary maturation features a light Char #1, allowing the whiskey to preserve the rich caramelized wood sugars, which introduce deeper complexity and flavor to each sip. Working closely with their cooperage, Buzzard's Roost developed 17 proprietary barrels with a range of toast levels. By altering both time and temperature during the toasting process, Buzzard’s Roost creates an array of flavor profiles—ranging from sweet and spicy to rich and smoky—before applying the light #1 char.

TITLE: Buzzard's Roost Toasted American Oak Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Buzzard's Roost Toasted American Oak Straight Bourbon Whiskey offers a unique spin on traditional bourbon with its distinctive use of toasted American oak barrels. Aged to perfection, this bourbon is then finished in proprietary barrels that have been precisely toasted and charred to unlock deeper, richer flavors. Bottled at 105 proof, this expression delivers a balanced blend of sweetness and spice, making it an ideal choice for both experienced bourbon drinkers and those looking to explore something new. The careful toasting of the American oak brings out nuances of caramel, vanilla, and spice, while the high proof ensures a bold and full-bodied drinking experience. Whether enjoyed neat or with a splash of water, Buzzard's Roost Toasted American Oak Straight Bourbon showcases the craftsmanship and attention to detail that defines the brand.

TITLE: Buzzard's Roost Toasted Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Buzzard's Roost Toasted Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey 105 Proof showcases the art of barrel finishing with a unique twist. After being aged in traditional barrels, this rye whiskey undergoes additional maturation in specially toasted barrels, which infuses the spirit with deeper, richer flavors of caramel, vanilla, and warm spices. The toasted oak enhances the rye's naturally bold and spicy profile, resulting in a whiskey that is both complex and smooth at 105 proof. This expression from Buzzard's Roost offers an elevated take on straight rye, with the toasted barrel finish adding layers of depth to an already robust spirit. Whether sipped neat or enjoyed in a rye-forward cocktail, this whiskey brings a satisfying blend of spice and sweetness to the glass.

TITLE: Buzzard’s Roost Barrel Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Buzzard's Roost Barrel Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey is an audacious expression crafted to highlight the power and complexity of bourbon at full barrel strength. This limited-edition release from Buzzard's Roost offers an intense, uncut experience, preserving the pure essence of bourbon from the barrel. Bottled at a bold 114 proof, this bourbon is rich and full-bodied, showcasing the distillery's commitment to crafting whiskey with intricate flavor profiles and character. Aged in specially prepared barrels that have undergone a unique toasting and charring process, the whiskey has developed deep layers of flavor. With each sip, the warmth and intensity will evolve, offering a sensory journey that bourbon enthusiasts will appreciate. This barrel-strength bourbon is perfect for those who enjoy bold and unfiltered whiskey.

TITLE: Buzzard’s Roost Barrel Strength Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Buzzard's Roost Barrel Strength Straight Rye Whiskey is an uncut and unfiltered expression that brings the full power of rye whiskey straight from the barrel. This bold and complex whiskey is crafted from carefully selected rye and aged to perfection, showcasing the signature spice and intensity of rye whiskey at its highest proof. With no water added, this barrel strength rye delivers rich, concentrated flavors with every sip, making it a favorite for whiskey enthusiasts seeking the purest expression of rye. The high proof offers a robust palate filled with spice, caramel, and dark fruit notes, while the expertly crafted finish in Buzzard's Roost signature barrels adds a layer of smoothness and complexity. Whether enjoyed neat or with a few drops of water, this rye whiskey is a bold testament to the art of barrel aging.

TITLE: C.H. Berres Wehlener Klosterberg Kabinett Riesling
DESCRIPTION: Since 1510 the Berres family has grown and made great Rieslings in the privileged sites of Ürzig, Erden and Wehlen. Markus Berres, 21st generation, succeeded his father Alfred in 2004. Following graduation from the Geisenheim Institute and one year in the New Zealand wine industry, Markus is relaunching his family’s nine-acre estate with updated wines and packages, including Stelvin closures on all bottles. Think Spice. Because of Riesling’s sweetness and acidity, it makes the perfect accompaniment to spicy food. Strong Indian and Asian spices are a perfect match with Riesling. A classic pairing with Riesling is spiced duck leg. Meat Pairings - Duck, Pork, Bacon, Chicken, Shrimp and Crab Spices and Herbs - Highly spiced and aromatic herbs including Cayenne Pepper, Ginger, Clove, Cinnamon, Allspice, Tumeric, Madras Curry, Sichuan Pepper, Shallots, Soy Sauce, Sesame, Marjoram, Basil, Rice Vinegar and Teriyaki Sauce. Cheese Pairings - Try it with less stinky and delicately flavored soft cow’s milk cheese and dried fruit. Vegetables & Vegetarian Fare - Roasted vegetables and veggies with natural sweetness including Coconut, Red Onion, Bell Pepper, Eggplant, Tempeh, Squash and Carrot.

TITLE: C.N. Kopke Fine Ruby Port
DESCRIPTION: Porto Kopke (Cop-key) is universally recognized as the first Port house in Port wine history. Kopke was founded in 1638 by the Germans Cristiano and Nicolaus Kopke. In 2014, Porto Kopke is celebrating 376 years of continuous production of fine wine with grapes from its famous Quinta São Luiz estate.

TITLE: C.N. Kopke Fine Tawny Port
Ca' dei Zago Prosecco Col Fondo
DESCRIPTION: Varietals: Glera from very old clones, small amounts of Verdiso, Perera, and Bianchetta from massale selection. Vinification Method: The grapes are harvested and selected by hand then pressed, using the delicate force of gravity. Grapes never pass through pumps. After a smooth pressing, the must rests and decants for 24 hours. At the end of the second day the must is racked off and fermentation begins in Concrete tanks, lasting about 10-20 days, depending on the year. The wine is poured and sulfer is added, to avoid oxidation. For the whole winter season the wine rests and is decanted in stainless steel tanks with periodical remuage, in order to keep it homogeneous and to let the yeasts work. The cellars are outside so the exposition of the wine to the winter cold in addition to the contact with the lees produces the natural tartaric and protein stability of Glera wine. When the wine is around 1% short of finishing fermentation, it is transferred to bottle, after a very light filtering, to finish its fermentation there. This 10% alcohol wine can be enjoyed with any food and at any time of day.

TITLE: Ca' del Baio Autinbej Barbaresco DOCG
DESCRIPTION: Ca' del Baio Autinbej Barbaresco DOCG is a prestigious and celebrated wine from the renowned Barbaresco region of Piemonte, Italy. Crafted by the historic Ca' del Baio winery, this wine embodies the elegance and complexity of Nebbiolo grown in sun-drenched vineyards.

TITLE: Ca'Donini Pinot Grigio
DESCRIPTION: The grapes come from selected vineyard parcels in Trentino and the Veneto, situated along the Adige valley, on very stony and well-drained alluvial soils, at around 200 meters elevation. The vines are pergola semplice trained with a southern exposition, and yields are kept below six tons per acre to encourage depth and complexity. This delicious Pinot Grigio is full of flavor with bright notes of honey, apple and wildflowers. It is fresh, clean and lively with a pleasing, lingering aftertaste of ripe pears. Ca’ Donini Pinot Grigio is an unbeatable value that exceeds expectations. Beautifully balanced to compliment a wide range of foods from white meats, shellfish, and freshwater.

TITLE: Ca'Donini Pinot Grigio
DESCRIPTION: The grapes come from selected vineyard parcels in Trentino and the Veneto, situated along the Adige valley, on very stony and well-drained alluvial soils, at around 200 meters elevation. The vines are pergola semplice trained with a southern exposition, and yields are kept below six tons per acre to encourage depth and complexity. This delicious Pinot Grigio is full of flavor with bright notes of honey, apple and wildflowers. It is fresh, clean and lively with a pleasing, lingering aftertaste of ripe pears. Ca’ Donini Pinot Grigio is an unbeatable value that exceeds expectations. Beautifully balanced to compliment a wide range of foods from white meats, shellfish, and freshwater.

TITLE: Ca'Donini Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: The story of Ca’ Donini begins at the turn of the 20th century, in a trattoria located at 7, Durini Street in Old Milan. Many of the regulars would stay after closing to chat with the owner, Signore Donini, while indulging in a good glass of wine. It was not long before he was appointed by his customers to select the best wines for their private cellars, and he began sourcing attractive ones to bear his own name. Later, his heirs decided to honor their father by trademarking Ca’ Donini, and thus a commercial enterprise was born. They chose a butterfly as the brand logo, in honor of their father’s passion for his butterfly collection. Today, Ca’ Donini offers a collezione, collection, of important and popular varietals and denominations that are distinctly Italian and offer extreme quality for price. This year, Ca’ Donini introduces an exciting new look: Ca’ Donini Collezione. Each wine type features a different butterfly and color, presented together as a “Collezione”. Although the packaging is new, the wine still has the same delicious, fresh taste and offers the same unbeatable value. Born on premise, Ca’ Donini remains a favorite of restaurants and their patrons.

TITLE: Cabeza Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: The vivanco family has been cultivating agave in the Los Altos region of Jalisco for five generations. They built their distillery El Ranchito on the edge of their 800-acre mountainside field in Arandas, where they now have been tequileros for 3 generations.

TITLE: Cabin Still Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Cabin Still was originally part of a line at the now legendary Stitzel-Weller distillery, along with W.L. Weller, Old Fitzgerald, and Rebel Yell. The brand name was purchased in 1993 by the Heaven Hill distillery at the same time as JW Dant and has remained in the company’s portfolio for the past two decades. It doesn’t really get the respect it deserves — not even a mention of it on Heaven Hill’s brands page. That’s a shame because at 36 months in age, this is not a bad bottle, especially when considering it has a purchase point of around $15 for 1L bottle.

TITLE: CALA Terre Siciliane Dario Serrentino Rosso
DESCRIPTION: 90% Nero d’Avola, a musky and widespread red-berried grape, and 10% Grillo, a white-berried grape native to Sicily. The vines are 20 to 60 year old bush vine plantings, that is untrained beside a stick to tie up the sprawling vines.Certified organic farming in the vineyards. The grapes were co-fermented, both the red and white berried varieties macerated for 6 days. All native yeasts for the ferment, aged in steel tanks and bottled unfined and a light filtering. The only addition being a small degree of sulfites. The resulting wine is a light red, best served chilled. The FUSO project was instigated by the Italian importer, Portovino. The idea is affordable, low intervention wines from organic growers. “Daily drinkers” as they put it. This bottling is from the Sicilian winemaker Dario Serrentino.

TITLE: Calabretta Cala Cala Rosso
DESCRIPTION: 95% Nerello Mascalese & 5% Nerello Cappuccio, A blend of the 2009, 2008 and 2005 vintages. Sourced from a mix of young and old vines. Cala Cala means "Gulp, Gulp" says Massimiliano, meaning you should gulp this one down because it's so tasty!

TITLE: Calcarius Orange Puglia
DESCRIPTION: A funky, cloudy liter of skin contact white from an organic farmer in southern Italy. Falanghina grown on limestone soils, given 5 days of maceration on the skins developing into a deeply hued orange wine. Fermented with indigenous yeast, no filtering or fining and a small addition of sulfites at bottling only

TITLE: Calera Central Coast Chardonnay
DESCRIPTION: Sourced from several to Central Coast vineyards including Scheid Vineyard-Monterey County, Lone Oak Vineyard - Monterey County, San Felipe Vineyard - Santa Clara County, Kellner Vineyard - Santa Clara County, Besson Vineyard - Santa Clara County After hand harvesting, the whole grape clusters were pressed and the juice was moved by gravity to Calera's cellar. Fermentation in barrels by native yeasts was followed by complete malolactic fermentation.The wine was aged without racking in French oak barrels, 10% new, for ten months. The separate vineyard lots were combined prior to bottling.

TITLE: Calle 23 Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Master Distiller Sophie Decobecq is something of an anomaly in the world of tequila, not just for being a woman in a male-dominated industry, but for her application of science to tequila production. She graduated from an eminent university in her native France in 1999 with degrees in biochemistry and engineering. After graduating she moved to Mexico where she studied the science of fermentation at the Polytechnics Institute of Mexico City. As part of her research she visited tequila distilleries in Jalisco, where a passion for the culture, people and tequilas of the region took hold. In 2003 she established a company, Imex International, with the goal of creating some of the finest tequilas in the world. The blue agave plants chosen for Calle 23 are hand-selected from Los Altos de Jalisco (Highlands), between Tepatitlan and Arandas. These fields are in conversion to organic farming. In this unique area, the agave plant benefits from hot and sunny dry periods, followed by heavy rainy seasons. The fertile soil, rich in minerals, produces agaves of exceptional quality which take seven to ten years to reach full maturity. The agave is carefully cooked in precision, stainless steel autoclaves. Sophie uses one base yeast for all her tequilas; a second one is also used for Calle 23 Blanco and Anejo, and a third for the Reposado. Fermentation takes place in stainless steel tanks over an average of 72 hours. Double distillation is done in stainless steel pot stills with copper serpentine steam elements. All the process water is drawn from the distillery's own well. The tequilas are filtered with cellulose after each distillation, the second time at low temperature.

TITLE: Calle 23 Reposado Tequila
DESCRIPTION: A pale straw color, the initial burst of menthol gives way to aromas of buttered toast, almond and creme brulee. The palate is wonderfully buttery, offering flavors of red pepper, honey and fresh fig.

TITLE: Calumet Farm 10 Year Old Single Rack Black Kentucky Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Bottled as the extremely small batch (19 barrels), Calumet Farm Single Rack Black 10-Year-Old Bourbon selects a specific center cut rack. Each chosen rack of charred white oak barrels provides the optimum level of temperature and humidity shifts, ensuring the best balance of flavor. The result of this bourbon craftsmanship is a bold, vigorous and luxurious Kentucky bourbon whiskey. Single Rack Black has a distinctly traditional bourbon mash bill of corn, rye, and malted barley, yet produces an extremely bold and soothing finish. This vigorous, luxurious Kentucky bourbon hints at honey and toasted oak notes while providing heralded complexity and depth throughout every sip. 92 Proof - 46% Alc/Vol

TITLE: Calumet Farm 12 Year Old Single Rack Black Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Bottled from an extreme small batch of 19 barrels, Calumet Single Rack Black Bourbon 12-year-old selects the specific center cut racks from the ideal maturation location and conditions inside the rick house. Each rack provides the optimum level of temperature and humidity shifts for the best balance of flavor extraction from the charred white oak barrel. The result of this bourbon craftsmanship is a bold, vigorous, luxurious Kentucky bourbon whiskey. Calumet Farm Kentucky Bourbon Whiskey also offers a 10-year-old Single Rack Black bottled at 92 proof

TITLE: Calumet Farm 14 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Calumet Farm Bourbon is a sourced Kentucky bourbon label that’s owned by Western Spirits Beverage Company, an outfit that also happens to own the Sam Houston bourbon brand, among others. Part of the Calumet line up focuses upon its higher end Single Rack Black series, and it is from this a new 14-year-old American whiskey has debuted. The new Calumet Farm Single Rack Black 14 Year Old Bourbon Whiskey, according to those behind it, is typical of the Single Rack Black line up in that it heralds from “extremely small batches of just 19 barrels” that are aged “in a single, center cut rack from the ideal maturation location and conditions inside the rick house.”

TITLE: Calumet Farm 15 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Calumet Farm Single Rack Black 15 Year Old Bourbon Whiskey is the pinnacle of the Calumet Farm Bourbon family. It represents the premium quality the brand is known for, as well as the hard-earned badge of patience. Allowing the bourbon to age slowly in Kentucky-only rick houses is a testament to doing things the right way - the way bourbon should be done. All barrels used to craft these rare batches are aged in a single, center-cut rack. This expression of the Calumet Farm Bourbon family is the most aged and highest proof to date. It is Non-Chill Filtered for added depth of character and color.52.5% ABV. Mashbill of 74% Corn, 18% Rye, and 8% Malted Barley

TITLE: Calumet Farm 16 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Calumet Farm Single Rack Black 16 Year Old Bourbon Whiskey is the pinnacle of the Calumet Farm Bourbon family. It represents the premium quality our brand is known for, as well as the hard-earned badge of patience. Allowing our bourbon to age slowly in Kentucky-only rick houses is a testament to doing things the right way - the way bourbon should be done. All barrels used to craft these rare batches are aged in a single, center cut rack. This expression of the Calumet Farm Bourbon family is our most aged and highest proof to date. It is Non-Chill Filtered for added depth of character and color.

TITLE: Calumet Farm 8 Years Old Single Rack Black Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Each very small batch (less than 50 barrels) of Calumet Farm 8-Year-Old Bourbon is crafted from hand-selected barrels of premium Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey. Mashbill:74% Corn, 18% Rye, 8% Malted Barley; 90 Proof

TITLE: Calumet Farm Small Batch Kentucky Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Calumet Farm Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey is distilled and aged in Kentucky - the heart of bourbon & horse country. It is aged in deeply charred (#4) oak barrels, then hand-selected for premium quality. Each small batch (50 barrels) is crafted from a blend of premium Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey: 25 barrels of 14-Year-Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey 25 barrels of 8-Year-Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Mash Bill: 74% Corn, 18% Rye, 8% Malted Barley; 86 Proof

TITLE: Cameronbridge 26 Years Single Grain Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Legends Untold Chapter 2 - Elusive Expressions Living up to the lore, this Cameronbridge expression is a regal spirit of abundant richness. Matured exclusively in refill American Oak casks, this Single Grain is sweet and smooth on the surface but with hot spices bubbling away beneath.

TITLE: Campari Bitter Aperitif
DESCRIPTION: If there was one cocktail that defined the point at which you had 'made it' into the realm of the cocktail enthusiast it would be the Negroni. Whilst there are exceptions to every rule, it would usually be considered an 'acquired taste', and thus unsuitable for those who are new to the world of cocktail imbibing. It is however, almost universally revered amongst those who would think of themselves as aficionados of the mixed drink. The 'acquired' part of its taste is the fact that it is a bitter-tasting drink on account of one of the ingredients, Campari. Produced to a secret recipe using an infusion of herbs, aromatic plants and fruit into a mix of neutral alcohol and water, Campari has been around since 1860 and shows no sign of disappearing any time soon. Mixing: There is no getting away from the fact Campari is bitter in taste, and many of the best cocktails in which it is found make use of this quality to full effect and are best consumed as an aperitif. The Negroni (recipe below) is quite possibly the most famous of all, and for good reason. Traditionally equal parts of gin, sweet vermouth and Campari, it is a great drink to experiment with and find your perfect balance of flavours. Signature Cocktail – Negroni 35ml gin, 35ml Campari, 35ml sweet vermouth Stir ingredients briefly over ice in a rocks glass and garnish with an orange slice. Signature Cocktail – Americano 50ml Campari Bitter, 50ml sweet vermouth, soda Add Campari and vermouth to a highball glass filled with ice and top with soda. Garnish with an orange slice.

TITLE: Campbeltown Loch Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: An unmistakable Campbeltown whisky: Initial sweet, softer notes of fruit, honey and butterscotch reveal more complexity with traditional maritime and spice notes combining with the subtlest touch of peat smoke.

TITLE: Can Can Cocktails White Linen
DESCRIPTION: The White Line was created in Sacramento California by Renne Dominguez. Renne was working at Ella Restaurant and Bar and the Shady Lady Saloon around 2008 when the drink took off. When we are going through our triple digit summers there is nothing better to drink. Now that light and fresh cocktail is ready to drink right now. To make the White Linen we take the freshest cucumbers we can find, infuse them in high proof vodka, add gin botanicals, elderflower, lemon, a little bit of cane sugar than carbonate the whole thing in our 1000L pressure tanks. Next it gets slipped into a can, labeled and sent off to a location close to you. Small batch cocktails made right in Sacramento CA.

TITLE: Can Sumoi Sumoll Ancestral Sparkling Rose
DESCRIPTION: Floral with super fresh black fruit aromas and flavors that are accented by saltiness and a slight (but pleasant) bitter note.

TITLE: Canadian Club 40 Year Old Whisky
DESCRIPTION: In 1977, Jack Farrell filled re-purposed char #4 American white oak barrels with corn-spirit. Canadian Club didn’t know when or how they were going to release it until now. With Canada’s 150th birthday comes the perfect occasion for this special release. This also makes Canadian Club 40 Year the oldest Canadian whisky to date (October 2017) with 7,000 bottles across Canada.

TITLE: Canadian Club 9 Year Old Reserve Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Canadian Club Whisky is the oldest and probably the most influential brand of Canadian Whisky in the world. It can be found in over 150 countries and boasts sales in Canada that are unmatched by any other premium whisky brand. Its popularity spiked during the days of Prohibition when Canadian Club was the whisky of choice for smugglers and whiskey runners, and it has even been reported that Canadian Club was the whisky of choice for Al Capone who is said to have smuggled thousands of cases of Canadian Whisky into the USA . The Canadian Club Reserve is a step up from the previously reviewed Canadian Club Premium. Still 'Blended at Birth', the whisky is a mixture of rye, rye malt, corn and barley spirits. Canadian Club Reserve Whisky will make nice long rye cocktails to drink on the deck on warm evenings after all the work is done. Here is a nice summer deck recipe: The Woodcutter 1 1/2 oz Canadian Club Reserve Whisky 3/4 oz Triple Sec 3/4 oz Lime Juice 4 large ice cubes dry apple cider Mix the first three ingredients in a tall Collins glass with ice. Lengthen the drink with dry apple cider.

TITLE: Canadian Club Chronicles 41 Years Old Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Canadian Club 41 Year is a limited edition Canadian whisky that was batched and barreled in 1977 and was blended with small additions of cognac, rye, and sherry.

TITLE: Canadian Club Chronicles 42 Years Old Whisky
DESCRIPTION: In 2017, Canadian Club, owned by spirits giant Beam-Suntory, launched a 40 year old whisky. The following year, the brand began its premium aged Chronicles series. The 2018, and inaugural expression, was a 41 year old Canadian Club named, “The Water of Windsor.” For the Chronicles Issue No. 2, Canadian Club presents a 42 year old whisky. Chronicles Issue No. 2, “The Dock Man,” pays homage to Canadian Club’s dock workers. During Prohibition, dock workers distributed Canadian Club across the river to Detroit. They ensured counterfeit whisky didn’t get into the hands of drinkers and bars since this was a rampant problem at the time.

TITLE: Canadian Club Chronicles 43 Years Old Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Canadian Club Chronicles Issue 3: The Speakeasy – a 43-year-old whisky has its own tale. Throughout American Prohibition, dockmen loaded crates of whisky onto freighters at Hiram Walker’s dock. If the paperwork was in order, anyone could load a ship with alcohol and set sail. Talented forgers would doctor paperwork, and the coastguard wouldn’t bat an eye. The boat would make a quick pitstop off the American shore to unload. From there the whisky quickly worked its way through underground distribution networks to be poured in illicit speakeasies in Detroit, Gotham, and beyond. In these speakeasies, the already famous Canadian Club whisky gained even more renown. The best part of this series is that the whisky chronicles a flavor story even more delicious than its astounding historical anecdotes. It’s a challenging task for a whisky to take you back to the future, but each year, here we are, enjoying another extraordinary Canadian Club. And The Speakeasy’s nose is precisely that. It speaks in flawless oak tones and murmured caramels setting up an easy-drinking palate. A hundred subtle flavors converge into a unified melting pot of orchard & dark fruits, and toffee & peppery spices that sit atop mellow but sturdy oak planks. A long finish then cascades from sweet to spicy to dry. A tiny splash of eleven-year-old rye that was blended into the whisky brightens it up, but without covering it in frills and glitz. It’s an exercise in class where the integrity of the old whisky never wavers.

TITLE: Candialle Toscano Ciclope Rosso
DESCRIPTION: Discover the exquisite flavors of Tuscany with Candialle Toscano Ciclope Rosso. This exceptional red blend hails from the prestigious Chianti Classico region, renowned for its rich winemaking heritage. Crafted by the esteemed Candialle winery, the Toscano Ciclope Rosso embodies the essence of the Tuscan terroir. This wine is a harmonious blend of Sangiovese, Merlot, and Syrah, aged to perfection to deliver a complex and well-balanced profile. Each bottle encapsulates the dedication to quality and tradition that defines Candialle wines. This wine exemplifies the artistry and passion of Tuscan winemaking, offering a refined and elegant taste that will delight wine enthusiasts and connoisseurs alike.

TITLE: Cannonball Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Try with barbecued short ribs or Portobello mushrooms.

TITLE: Canpagne Brut Rose
DESCRIPTION: Canpagne Brut Rose is made from premium California grapes sourced from small family-owned growers whose focus on quality and respect for the land comes through in the grapes. This proprietary blend of French Columbard and Pinot Noir delivers a drier style of sparkling wine with beautiful acidity and creamy mouthfeel. We are committed to making 100% Vegan and gluten-free products that everyone can feel good about drinking. Thier patent-pending canning method allows us to produce a sparkling wine with the highest level of carbonation in the canned wine market which makes for a delicious experience on its own right out of the can or in your favorite glass. Canpagne is also fabulous when mixed into a variety of sparkling wine cocktails like mimosas, bellinis, French 75s or anything else you can dream up. Pairs beautifully with creamy cheeses, salads, and smoked salmon.

TITLE: Canpagne Peach Mimosa Can
DESCRIPTION: Canpagne wine is made from premium California grapes and nothing else. Our all-natural wine has no added sugar or artificial flavorings. This all-natural beverage is certified Kosher, Vegan, and gluten-free so you can feel good about making any time during brunch time!

TITLE: Canpagne Rose Can
DESCRIPTION: Canpagne Bubbly Rose is a fun and convenient way to enjoy delicious sparkling wine anywhere you are. The wine exhibits notes of fresh ripe strawberries and tropical fruit with a great balance of sweetness and acidity. A unique canning process gives Canpagne nearly twice the bubbles of any canned sparkling wine on the market. Canpagne is certified Kosher, Vegan, and gluten-free.

TITLE: Cantina Colonnella Le Rue Passerina Brut Rose
DESCRIPTION: Italian sparkling rose made from 100% Montepulciana d'Abruzzo grapes. Charmat method. Ideal as an aperitif and goes perfectly with fish, light cheeses and fresh pastries.

TITLE: Cantina della Pioppa Lambrusco di Modena Biologico
DESCRIPTION: Cantina della Pioppa Lambrusco di Modena Biologico is a light and refreshing sparkling red wine from Italy. It is made from 100% Lambrusco Salamino grapes, grown in sandy-clay soils in the Emilia-Romagna region.

TITLE: Cantina Do Mogoro Il Nuraghe "Don Giovanni" Vermentino di Sardegna DOC
DESCRIPTION: Almost any seafood goes well as one would expect from any grape that hails from the island of Corsica. Also, pasta dishes that use Pesto pair well with Vermentino.

TITLE: Cantina Marilina "Cue" Moscato Terre Siciliane
DESCRIPTION: All wines are fermented with indigenous yeasts, un-refrigerated and lightly filtered with natural products. Moscato grapes are hand harvested from vines in white/calcareous soil, vinified and aged in concrete tanks for 5 months, followed by 2 months in the bottle before release.

TITLE: Cantina Marilina Terre Siciliane "Fedelie" Bianco Frizzante
DESCRIPTION: Estate: Cantina Marilina is an organic winery located in southeastern Sicily, with vineyards in 2 appellations; Noto DOC and Eloro DOC. Founded in 2001, today the winery is headed by sisters Marilina and Federica Paternò. Surrounded by a UNESCO World Heritage Site and wildlife sanctuaries, the sisters are steadfast in their determination to use low intervention, traditional, environmentally friendly methods to craft natural wines with a “strong territorial identity”. The wine bottles carry “zero environmental impact: light glass, natural cork stopper, recycled natural paper label, and no capsule”. Philosophy: Absolute respect for the earth. Winemaking: All wines are fermented with indigenous yeasts, un-refrigerated and lightly filtered with natural products, suitable for vegans. Hand-harvested grapes are from vineyards in the Noto region, in white, calcareous soil. Vinified in concrete tanks, then Méthode Ancestrale, [or Pétillant Naturel] is employed, bottling is before the end of fermentation, with the wine finished in the bottle.

TITLE: Cantina Marilina Terre Siciliane "Fedelie" Rosato Frizzante
Cantina Rotaliana Teroldego Rotaliano
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1931 in Trentino, Italy, Cantina Rotaliana di Mezzolombardo is a 395 acre property located in the valley floor between Rocchetta Pass and mountain ranges of Alto Adige. The vineyard straddles the Adige and Noce rivers, where moderate climates and fertile soils provide the ideal environment to grow Teroldego grapes. To encourage proper and even ripening, each vine is pruned so that there are only two fruitproducing canes. Further, no chemical fertilizers are used and veraison is routine. Hand-harvested fruit was destemmed and gravity fed to stainless steel tanks. The first fermentation occurred naturally with pump overs to encourage proper tannin extraction. After the first racking, malolactic occurred naturally and then the wine was racked a second time to remove solids and aerate the wine. After 5-6 months, the lots were blended and lightly filtered before bottling. Pairs well with: Beef Olives Caribbean cuisine Foods cooked via Braise/Soup/Stew Savory dishes Dishes to serve with Teroldego: Fennel sausage with dumplings Fresh pasta with speck and parsley Braised pork shoulder with brodo of tomato

TITLE: Cantina Zaccagnini Montepulciano D'abruzzo
DESCRIPTION: The farmstead of Zaccagnini was founded in 1978 as a family-run winery, and today produces about 500,000 bottles per year from 100% handpicked grapes. While Abruzzo doesn’t attract Hollywood celebrities fleeing the spotlight or even many tourists it has one claim to fame: Marcello Zaccagnini and his winemaker, Concezio Marulli, who are eliciting nectar from its rough hills. Marcello grew up as a farmer working in the vineyards owned by his father, growing grapes to sell to local winemakers. In 1977, barely into his twenties, Marcello determined that if no one would buy their grapes, he would work with his father to make the wine themselves. Cantina Zaccagnini is made of 100% Montepulciano and was aged traditionally in Slavonic oak. The resulting wines tend to be softer and more accessible than Chianti or Nebbiolo, with lower acidity and mild sweeter tannins.

TITLE: Cantine Barbera La Bambina Menfi Nero d'Avola Rosato
DESCRIPTION: To understand the wines of Cantine Barbera, you need to see the ocean. Vines that live this close to the ocean in southwestern Sicily turn the sea brine into vibrant tasty salinity. A third-generation farmer, Marilena Barbera farms the Inzolia that her grandfather planted in the 20's, just as she attends to the native varietals that are the new frontier of her generation: Perricone, Nerello, Alicante, Nero d'Avola, and Grillo.

TITLE: Cantine Barbera Menfi Ammano #4 Vino Bianco
DESCRIPTION: Ammano is made by the sea: thanks to its archaic, essential winemaking process, it releases in the glass the typical saline freshness and the intense aromatic profile of the grapes grown on the Mediterranean islands. Let the golden liquid flow gently in your glass, and let it breathe for all the time needed: the wine has been secluded in the bottle for many weeks, or even years, and he has lived together with the sediment that nurtures him, and that has also created a naturally reductive environment, protecting him from oxidation.

TITLE: Cantine Barbera Sicilia Ciatu Rosso
DESCRIPTION: To understand the wines of Cantine Barbera, you need to see the ocean. Vines that live this close to the ocean in south-western Sicily turn the sea brine into vibrant tasty salinity. A third generation farmer, Marilena Barbera farms the Inzoila that her grandfather planted in the 20's, just as she attends to the native varietals that are the new frontier of her own generation: Perricone, Nerello, Alicante, Nero d'Avola and Grillo. Alicante is a Spanish grape that was probably introduced in Sicily during the dominations of the XV-XVI centuries. Grown in several Mediterranean regions, it is known under different names such as Garnacha, Grenache and Cannonau.

TITLE: Cantine Le Grotte Nero di Troia Selva Della Rocca
DESCRIPTION: Cantine Le Grotte is located in Apricena, a town in the very northern reaches of Puglia, an area affectionately known as the spur of the boot of Italy. Their vineyards lie between the Adriatic Sea, the foothills of the Gargano National Park and the inland plateau of Foggia. Pasquale Dell’Erba founded the winery; their first vintage was 2013. Before even planting their first vines, though, they had to spend a year revitalizing and re-oxygenating the soil by digging up and then putting back in the same stony materials.

TITLE: Cantine Lunae Bosoni Colli di Luni Etichetta Grigia Vermentino
DESCRIPTION: LVNAE has been named after the ancient “Portus Lunae” (the Port of the moon), one of the most important cities and ports in the Northern part of the ancient Roman Empire and wants to recall the millenary tradition of winemaking in this area. LVNAE, established in 1966 by Paolo Bosoni, currently represents the largest winery in Liguria with an annual total production of more than 500,000 bottles. The winery has 45 Ha of vineyards, 3 of which are experimental vineyards studying and developing the characteristics of traditional vines, in collaboration with the Ligurian Region and the Natural Center of Research in Turin. To maintain the local wine tradition and micro-economy, Lunae has also chosen to work with 150 local growers, who supported by the company’s techincal staff, contribute their small grape production, keeping alive traditions and the unique quality of the wine. The Vermentinos are distinguished by selection of different vines and vinification, the red wines are an interesting blend of local varietals such as Massareta, Pollera Nera and interestingly also Sangiovese due to the location of the vineyards so close to Tuscany (2 km only to the border with Tuscany).

The only item this island lacks is an abundance of fresh water. Grapevines - which require less water than other plants - are a perfect fit and they thrive in the volcanic soils.

The recipe originated with the founder of this now 7th generation winemaking family. Appreciation of Cardoon and Blessed Thistle dates back to antiquity and today they remain popular in Piemontese regional cusine. TITLE: Casa Dasylirion Sotol Coyote Durango Blanco
DESCRIPTION: Like the coyotes that roam freely over northern Mexico’s arid Chihuahua desert, Sotol Coyote is the true essence of pure and natural wildness. It is handcrafted exclusively from 100% wild-growing and wild-harvested agavacea plants, a variety of the agave or maguey family. These plants are completely organic, growing naturally without the use of any herbicides, insecticides or fertilizers. And in this unforgiving desert climate, only the strongest and healthiest plants survive and are harvested to become Sotol Coyote. Wild grown prickly evergreen plants can take as many as 15 years to mature, storing vast amounts of natural energy before they are ready to be harvested by the “jimadores.” And each huge and magnificent plant will produce but a single bottle of Sotol Coyote!

TITLE: Casa Mariol Vermut Negre

The ingredients include green walnuts, thyme, rosemary, orange peel, cardamom and wormwood. The rest, in true vermouth fashion, are kept a secret. TITLE: Cascade Moon 'Mellow as Moonlight' Barrel Proof 15 Year Old Spirit Distilled From Grain Edition No. 3
DESCRIPTION: Nicole Austin, the GM, and distiller at Cascade Hollow - home of George Dickel Whiskey - has been doing incredible things since her tenure began. She has made Dickel a household name with major awards won for her whiskeys. Now she is pushing the envelope further with the newest Cascade Moon release. A line of spirits designed to start a conversation in the whisky world and highlight many unique aspects of the Cascade Hollow distillery, the No 3 release might be the most controversial thing any whisk(e)y producer can do: release something that isn't (technically) whisky. The distillery is home to single-story warehouses and is tucked into a unique geological setting. The result is that proof tends to go down in the Cascade Warehouses, not unlike Scotland. Add to that the distillery's low entry proof, and you've got many barrels that drop below the legally mandated minimum of 40%ABV to be called whiskey as they reach extreme ages. Usually, these would get just blended away by adding them to high-proof barrels and winding up with a batch somewhere in the middle (or proofed back to the desired target). Instead, Mrs. Austin has begun bottling and selling barrel-strength spirit that cannot be legally called whisky. Clocking in .1% below 40, this 39.9% ABV spirit should open a fascinating conversation regarding the bounds of whisky and stand in stark relief against the current craze for insanely high-proof barrel strength offerings.

TITLE: Castell'In Villa Rosato
Castello di Lispida "Terralba"
DESCRIPTION: Constructed in the 18th century, the cellar includes 9 tunnels with the potential capacity of 25,000 barrels, which is one of the largest in Veneto. Lined with terracotta bricks and un-plastered stones (trachyte), the cellar’s temperature is consistently maintained at below 18 degrees Celsius. Employing only natural yeasts, Alessandro ferments his wines in open vat wooden containers or (as of 1996) in buried terracotta amphorae. Racking the wine at spring equinox, Sgaravatti then rests it on its skins for six months inside of the dolia, before removing the skins and leaving the wine to age until the following winter.

TITLE: Castello di Stefanago Stuvenagh "Orangiosaurus"
DESCRIPTION: 90% Chardonnay, 10% Cortese From 30 year old vines planted to .86 hectares of clay, sand and silty soils. The grapes are hand-harvested between Sept 10 (Cortese) and Aug 30 (Chardonnay). All grapes are vineyard sorted and spend nine weeks macerating. Spontaneous fermentation follows in stainless steel under temperature control with ambient yeasts. The wine spends six months on the lees with stirring every week. Unfined & unfiltered.

TITLE: Castello di Tassarolo Orsola Gavi
DESCRIPTION: 100% Cortese di Gavi grapes are hand-harvested in small crates (maximum of 19 kg) in order to keep the grapes as intact as possible. The grapes are then immediately pressed in a pneumatic press, and the best part of the must is transferred to temperature-controlled vats for the start of the alcoholic fermentation, using only indigenous yeast. The wine is fined (vegan-friendly), filtered and a small amount of sulfur is added before bottling. Elegant and attention-worthy just like the lady on the label!

TITLE: Castello di Verduno Barbaresco
DESCRIPTION: Sourced from three vineyards: Rabaja, Rabaja-bas and Faset. Hand-harvested around in the first or second week of October. Practicing organic. Fermented in stainless steel for about twenty days with periodic punching down of the cap. Aged for 18 months in Slavonian botti grandi followed by three months in stainless steel and then 14 months in the bottle before release.

TITLE: Castello di Verduno Langhe Nebbiolo
DESCRIPTION: Castello di Verduno Langhe Nebbiolo is a wine made from Nebbiolo grapes grown in the Langhe region of Italy. Nebbiolo is a grape variety known for its complex flavors and structure. This wine has a deep ruby color and aromas of red fruits, sandalwood, and rose petal. On the palate, it is medium-bodied, with flavors of red fruits, spice, and earth. The wine has a long and lingering finish. Castello di Verduno is a winery located in the village of Verduno, in the Langhe region of Italy. The winery has been in operation since the 12th century. The current owners, Gabriella Burlotto and Franco Bianco, have been committed to producing high-quality wines that reflect the unique terroir of the region. Castello di Verduno Langhe Nebbiolo is a well-made wine that is perfect for pairing with roasted lamb, grilled steak, or hearty pasta dishes. It is also a good wine to enjoy on its own.

TITLE: Castello Monaci Piluna Salento Primitivo
DESCRIPTION: This 100% Primitivo is grown from vineyards surrounding the ancient Castello Monaci estate. Soils are a blend of dry clay, volcanic gravel and limestone. Vines are forced deep in search of water, leading to low yields and rich, fragrant wines. Harvest is done by hand prior to dawn to preserve sugar levels and avoid the hot sunlight. The grapes are vinified in small stainless steel tanks prior to 6 months of aging in 75% stainless steel and 25% 2nd and 3rd use French oak. 300,000 bottles produced. Quail, Turkey, Pork, Bacon, Ham and Veal.

TITLE: Castello Monaci Salice Salentino Liante
DESCRIPTION: Negroamaro can be enjoyed with simple pasta dishes or pizza but it is worthwhile trying to find something typical of Puglia or Southern Italy, such as antipasto, slow baked lamb and potatoes, pepperonata, or grilled tuna steaks

TITLE: Castellroig Corpinnat Brut Reserva
Castillo Perelada Cava Brut Rose
DESCRIPTION: Perelada has been producing wines since the fourteenth century. The castle and its estates has been owned by the Mateu family since 1923. Its founder Miguel Mateu passed away in 1972 and left his son-in-law Arturo Suque at the helm. Today Perelada is producing world class cava and superb still wines from its magnificent vineyards in Emporda and Priorat, Spain. Varietals: Garnatxa (74%), Pinot Noir (18%), Trepat (8%). Winemaking: Temperature controlled fermentation of the first must. Ageing: About twelve months in bottle, before disgorging.

TITLE: Castillo Perelada Emporda Rose Pescador
DESCRIPTION: Dry and rose, its suggestion of sparkle comes from a combination of the Trepat, Garnatxa and Merlot varieties and its second natural fermentation. Brilliant pink exquisiteness, warm, dry and very aromatic, like the Mediterranean summer.

TITLE: Castle & Key Restoration "Cola In The Rye" Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #41
DESCRIPTION: The last barrel selection we made on our first #barrelpickingexpedition back in April of 2022 is finally here! 119.5 Proof Barrel No. 1551 Mashbill: 17% Yellow Corn | 63% Rye | 20% Malted Barley Tasting Notes: Nose: toasted almonds, rose petals, baking spice, nutmeg, star anise, dates, caramelized apples Palate: leather, dates, toffee, oak, hints of cola Finish: long, spicy finish with notes of charred oak and cinnamon

TITLE: Castle & Key Roots of Ruin Kentucky Dry Gin
DESCRIPTION: 7-botanical blend sourced locally from Kentucky including chamomile, ginger, angelica root, lemon verbena, rosemary licorice root, coriander, & juniper

TITLE: Castle & Key Wheated Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey 750ml  2023-1
DESCRIPTION: Batch 1 of Castle & Key Distillery’s inaugural Small Batch Wheated Bourbon is a wheated straight bourbon whiskey produced in Frankfurt, Kentucky. Composed of a mash bill of 73% white corn, 10% wheat, and 17% malted barley, Castle & Key has reimagined the mash bill of their flagship Small Batch Straight Bourbon Whiskey, swapping out the spicy rye for wheat, resulting in a sweeter, creamier finish. Distilled in a Vendome copper column still, this is the oldest release yet from Castle and Key at 5 years.

TITLE: Castle & Key Wheated Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey 750ml  2023-2
DESCRIPTION: Batch 1 of Castle & Key Distillery’s inaugural Small Batch Wheated Bourbon is a wheated straight bourbon whiskey produced in Frankfurt, Kentucky. Composed of a mash bill of 73% white corn, 10% wheat, and 17% malted barley, Castle & Key has reimagined the mash bill of their flagship Small Batch Straight Bourbon Whiskey, swapping out the spicy rye for wheat, resulting in a sweeter, creamier finish. Distilled in a Vendome copper column still, this is the oldest release yet from Castle and Key at 5 years.

TITLE: Castro Candaz Ribeira Sacra Tinto
DESCRIPTION: This wine has never before been seen on US soil. It is a kitchen-sink blend of Mencia, Domingo Perez (Trousseau), Garnacha Tintorera (Alicante Bouschet), Mouraton, Caino and Brancellao from a few different sites within the Chantada and Ribeira do Mino zones of the Ribeira Sacra appellation. It was fermented with whole clusters in foudre and aged in a combination of foudre and 500L used barrels.

TITLE: Catoctin Creek "Ragnarok" Rye Whiskey (GWAR 2nd Annual Release)
DESCRIPTION: Rated 93 points by Wine Enthusiast Magazine, Catoctin Creek Ragnarök Rye is a 92- proof intergalactic rye whisky that is pot stilled, then aged in charred new white oak, sugar maple, and cherrywood. This year’s bottle includes new and improved collectible metal die-cast toppers representing all five band members: Blóthar the Berserker Balsac the Jaws of Death Jizmak da Gusha Beefcake the Mighty Pustulus Maximus The bottle’s new commemorative whisky label also matches the artwork from GWAR’s new album, “The New Dark Ages,” which was released digitally in June and will be available as a CD on July 15, and vinyl and cassette on Sept. 16 via the band’s label, Pit Records. Eons ago the members of the intergalactic shock rock band known as GWAR descended on this world as passengers on a flaming comet that would bring about the destruction of most life on Earth. The asteroid plowed into the continent of Antarctica with devastating force, melting the ice, setting much of the world ablaze, and leaving a massive crater filled with the purest Antarctic water and a strangely intoxicating ichor that flowed from the veins of the immortal GWAR. The legend recorded these events as the tale of Ragnarök, the end of days. But like all endings, it was also a beginning. Now, this blood of the gods, harvested from the great caldera, has been distilled and bottled by Catoctin Creek as Ragnarök Rye. “Ahh, such a powerful spirit,” said The Berserker Blothar of GWAR. “A delicious sacrament to drink in preparation for battle, and it’ll get you really, really crazy.” The mad scientists at Catoctin Creek conducted experiments on aging the blood of GWAR in barrels made from the different types of wood scorched by the comet's blast. They used the rarest of grains and watered their mash bill with the melted Antarctic ice to create a 92 strength rye whisky, pot stilled and then aged in charred new white oak. Members of GWAR then hurled the whiskey barrels into the orbit of the moon, causing contraction to take place as the barrels spun under the influence of the deathly coldness of space and the life-giving heat of the sun. The end result was Ragnarök Rye, an exquisite beverage graced with notes of cherrywood and sugar maple to produce subtle flavors unheard of in a traditional rye whisky
