TITLE: Catoctin Creek Distilling Company Rabble Rouser Bottled In Bond Rye Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Rabble Rouser is the latest rye whisky offering from Catoctin Creek. Distilled from 100% rye and bottled in bond, the Rabble Rouser differs from its cousin, Roundstone Rye, in that it is distilled at a lower proof, allowing lots of earthy goodness from the grain to come through in the spirit. The whisky is aged for four years, making it among the oldest craft whiskey in the United States presently, and twice the legal age requirement for "straight rye whiskey."

TITLE: Catoctin Creek Distilling Roundstone Rye 92 Proof
DESCRIPTION: Catoctin Creek® Distilling Company was founded by Becky and Scott Harris in 2009 as the first legal distillery in Loudoun County since before Prohibition. We are located in Purcellville, Virginia, in the heart of the Loudoun Valley. Loudoun County, often called D.C.'s Wine Country, is home to more than twenty vineyards and wineries, and it now has a distillery. The name "Catoctin" is a regional name. Pronounced Ka-TOCK-tin, the name derives from the Indian tribal name "Kittocton" which, legend has it, meant "place of many deer". Catoctin describes a range of mountains and the creek which flows picturesquely into the Potomac River and Chesapeake Watershed.

TITLE: Catskill Distilling Co. Defiant Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rye whiskey - the first whiskey to be distilled on this continent - became a defiant spirit in every sense during the Whiskey Rebellion of 1791, when the farmers who made it rebelled against our new government's attempt to tax it. It was this heroic act of defiance that forever defined and ensured our cherished right to protest. The tax eventually stood, but the rebels' spirit lives on in this Defiant Rye.

TITLE: Catskill Distilling Co. Most Righteous Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: A bourbon that is 70% corn, 20% rye, and 10% malt, this spirit was created by our distiller Dr. Monte Sachs and the world-renowned distiller Lincoln Henderson.

TITLE: Catskill Distilling Company Fearless Wheat Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Fearless Wheat whiskey is the silky and seductive neighbor you spied on through a window as she slowly peeled off her sundressÂ on a warm summer evening. At first glance It's soft and pretty, but time reveals a deeper and more complex situation: a Â suggestion of her naughtiness as she catches you in a mirror's reflection followed by a tacit but silent agreement between the both of you that it's all perfectly reasonable. Drink this whiskey with your lover.

TITLE: Catskill Provisions New York Honey Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: New York Honey Whiskey is our handcrafted rye infused with late-summer honey produced in the Northwest Catskill Mountains. Handcrafted 80 proof New York rye is infused with our late-summer honey for a smooth, wonderfully complex spirit with rich notes of toffee, vanilla and smoky spice. Sip it on its own or blend it into a memorable cocktail. With a hint of mellow sweetness that rounds out the edges, it’s a game-changer for those afraid of the dark.

TITLE: Cava La Carmela Hom Extra Brut Chardonnay
Cave Geisse Amadeu Rustico Nature
DESCRIPTION: A fun activity to do while sheltering in place. This sparkling wine is nondisgorged, and the yeast autolysis continues until the bottle is opened. This means that YOU decide the lay down time.

TITLE: Caves Cooperatives de Donnas Barmet Valle d'Aosta Nebbiolo
DESCRIPTION: Just northwest of Piemonte, you begin your ascent into the Alpine, bilingual French-Italian region of Valle d’Aosta. Donnas is the the first subregion along the Dora Baltea river and the name of a small, high-quality cooperative made up of 23 hectares and about 20 members. It’s Alpine wine (1300-1700 ft) in the largest game of Shoots and Ladders, cum-Vines-and-Trellising , you’ve even seen. The terraced vineyards are hewn from the granite and quartz mountain sides. It’s Nebbiolo as a Harpsichord (instead of the Barolo as cello) — earthy, spicy wines that make you want to put your hiking boots on and scale a frozen waterfall.

TITLE: Caves Vidigal Dos Amigos Syrah Reserva
DESCRIPTION: A remarkable Old World wine with a strong European style and satisfying taste. Comprising of an elegant blend of Tinta Roriz (70%), Castelão (20%) and Tinta Miuda (10%). Vinification: Classical maceration, fermentation in stainless steel tanks at a controlled temperature of 26ºC Awards: 2009 MundusVini Contest, Germany - Bronze 2007 MundusVini Contest, Germany - Silver 2005 Wine Masters Challenge - Silver White meats, roasts and intense flavoured cheeses.

TITLE: Cayeya Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Description Tequila Cayeya blanco is made using traditional production methods. Our female Master Destildora Zandra Gomez has developed a well-balanced blend of citrus and rich cooked agave to complete a unique and very special blanco tequila. Our bottle is hand-made from recycled Coca-Cola bottles at a family-owned artisanal glass factory in Jalisco, Mexico. Our corks, hang tags and labels are all produced from recycled materials making this package 100% sustainable. Take care of the land and the land will take care of you!

TITLE: Cayeya Single Barrel Reposado Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Cayéya Single Barrel Tequila is produced by way of traditional methods in the town of San Juanito de Escobedo, Jalisco, Mexico. Each bottle is marked with a specific batch and barrel number, and includes a signature from our female Master Destiladora, Zandra Gomez. We believe that less is more and take pride in quality over quantity. We champion our unique production methods and authenticity of our products. Through the night, stride by stride, he searched with unwavering forbearance. The terra-cotta sunrise would soon become an ordinary occurrence. Without a doubt the day would soon arrive. She was hidden, tucked away like a rare pearl. As the days turned to weeks, and the weeks to months, he wandered with unbearable aches and pains. The journey soon looked up as he gazed over the vast hills. She was calm, delicately perched beneath the chaste moon. As he approached, a feeling of infinite gratitude set in. He had discovered his crown jewel. Guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceitfully. To those who curse me let my soul be silent and let my soul be like dust.

TITLE: Cazadores Tequila Blanco
DESCRIPTION: Cazadores Tequila Blanco is a premium tequila crafted from 100% Blue Weber Agave, sourced from the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Distilled at Casa Tequilera de Arandas, this unaged tequila captures the pure essence of the agave plant, delivering a crisp and authentic flavor profile. Known for its smoothness and versatility, Cazadores Tequila Blanco is perfect for sipping neat, on the rocks, or as the foundation for exceptional cocktails like the classic Margarita or Paloma. Celebrate tradition and quality with every sip of this finely crafted tequila.

TITLE: Ca’Liptra  Amista Marche Rosso
DESCRIPTION: 90% Montepulciano and 10% Sangiovese from a 0.25ha parcel planted in 1985, facing east at 250m, on clay-limestone soil. The grapes are destemmed and crushed. Fermentation occurs spontaneously in stainless steel with a brief maceration of 3-4 days. Aging occurs in a 6500L stainless steel tank and two used 225L barriques. Amista is a literary form of amicizia, meaning friendship.

TITLE: Cedar Ridge The QuintEssential American Single Malt Whiskey Special Release Untitled Cigar Malt
DESCRIPTION: Cedar Ridge The QuintEssential American Single Malt Whiskey Special Release Untitled Cigar Malt is an extraordinary release that showcases the innovative craftsmanship of Cedar Ridge Distillery. Designed for pairing with fine cigars, this special edition American Single Malt Whiskey has been carefully aged and finished to deliver a rich, bold profile with a smoky complexity, making it an ideal companion for cigar aficionados. Bottled at cask strength, this whiskey offers deep flavors that perfectly complement the robust experience of smoking a premium cigar. This limited-edition release highlights the distillery’s commitment to creating distinctive American single malts with exceptional quality and character.

TITLE: Cedar Ridge The QuintEssential Single Cask American Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: From the Cedar Ridge "The Quintessential" single cask collection comes a single cask selection by Wing Woman Reserve, a brand where 100% of the profits of the barrel support UNITAS (unitas.ngo), an anti-human trafficking organization. Estate red wine cask finished Cask no.#17.W44 Cedar Rapids, IA Non-chill filtered 59.15% abv / 118.3 proof

TITLE: Cedarville Vineyard Estate Grenache
DESCRIPTION: Grenache, also known as Garnacha, is extremely food-friendly and can be paired with a wide range of foods, like eggs, mushrooms, and especially meats (beef, pork, lamb, chicken).

TITLE: Celler Frisach L'Abrunet de Frisach Terra Alta Negra
DESCRIPTION: Certified Organic. 60/40 Garnatxa & Cariñena.

TITLE: Celler Frisach L'Abrunet de Frisach Terra Alta Negre
Celler Tanca Els Ulls Garnatxa Negra
DESCRIPTION: Tanca Els Ulls is a young, Mediterranean red wine, 100% Black Grenache. Made by Cesc Boronat of Celler del Cesc, the man behind this small winery born in 2014.

TITLE: Cepas de Familia Malbec
DESCRIPTION: Cepas de Familia is located in what is known as the first viticultural area of Argentina, Lujan de Cuyo, which has achieved international recognition for the excellence of it's wines. The wines come from vineyards in the Lujan de Cuyo region as well as from the Uco Valley. Located in the town of Russell in the department of Maipu, Cepas de Familia grows 10 Ha of Malbec, 5 Ha of Bonarda, 2 Ha of Sangiovese and 1 Ha of Tempranillo. Most of this vineyard dates from 1960 and is driven by the parral system in order to preserve optimal production conditions, though they have been partially converted to Espaldero in order to lower yields and improve canopy management. The vineyards are irrigated using the traditional Surco method. In the district of General Ortega, which is also in the department of Maipu, lies "Finca Don Ortega", with a total of 14 hectares of Malbec planted in 1997 using a high espaldero system and drip irrigation. It pairs well with grilled red meat, stews and pastas.

TITLE: Cerro la Barca Vegas Altas Extremadura Ancestral
DESCRIPTION: Juan Sojo and Ángel Luis González are like brothers from different mothers. One minute they’re arguing and the next they’re toasting to another harvest. They studied oenology together and ever since have been making wines together. Ángel Luis comes from a background in agriculture while Juan comes from a background in chemistry. Both so different, but yet complement each other so well. They control and source grapes from 38 hectares of vineyards (some over 80 years of age) and have become the only organic wine producers in all of Extremadura. Following biodynamic principles and taking advantage of the night’s cooler temperatures, they reap their harvest under September’s full moon. Every grape cluster selected passes through their hands guaranteeing the highest quality and allowing them to limit the use of additives in the cellar.

TITLE: Champagne Alexandre Lamblot Champagne Brut Mouvance
DESCRIPTION: 12% Chardonnay, 22% Pinot Noir, 66% Pinot Meunier Complex and bright, Mouvance is a blend of Meunier, Pinot Noir and Chardonnay from old vnes plots in the villages of Vrigny and Chenay. The term "Mouvance" translates to "movement" and refers to the dependence of one phenomenon on another. From endless efforts in the vineyards to meticulous details in the cellar, Alexandre Lamblot is in constant motion and this wine is emblematic of the spirit of a domaine that is going places. To be enjoyed on its own or with country-style bread and fresh cheese or young Comté cheese.

TITLE: Champagne Coutier Tradition Brut
DESCRIPTION: 70% Pinot Noir, 30% Chardonnay; An excellent and racy bottle with the signature red fruit characteristics of Ambonnay. 6 grams dosage, disgorged May 2014.

TITLE: Champagne Doyard  Champagne 1er Cru Brut Blanc de Blancs Cuvee Vendemiaire
DESCRIPTION: From Vertus, this has a low dosage and is made from a blend of three years, with extended lees ageing.

TITLE: Champagne Fleury Blanc de Noirs Brut
DESCRIPTION: This gorgeous wine is 100% Pinot Noir, from a mix of 30% Reserve wine (a Solera of reserve wines from 2007-2012) and 70% 2013 base vintage, offering fruity and delicate notes. It's an elegant and long-lasting Champagne, classic, smooth and quite rich in style. The dosage is very low, with a wonderful black-cherry-fruit quality that reminds us that it is all Pinot. It is long and refreshing and very well balanced.

TITLE: Champagne Herve Rafflin 1er Cru La Nature'l Extra Brut
Champagne Laherte Freres Blanc de Blancs Brut Nature
Champagne Laherte Freres Extra Brut Ultradition
DESCRIPTION: The Grand Brut Ultradition is a subtle blending of three Champagne varieties and is representative of our terroirs. This Champagne comes from the Côteaux sud d’Epernay, Vallée de la Marne and Côte des Blancs. A fine and complex blending excellent for aperitif.Grape-varieties and vineyard:60% Pinot Meunier, 30 Chardonnay and 10% Pinot Noir.40% of which are reserve wines of past years kept in barrels.Selected parcels from 7 villages in Côte des Blancs and Vallée de la Marne.

TITLE: Champagne Laherte Freres Rose de Meunier Extra Brut
DESCRIPTION: This 50% 2012, 50% 2013 Rose de Meunier is a blend of 30% macerated Meunier, 60% white wine (immediately pressed Meunier) and 10% still red Meunier.

TITLE: Champagne Moutard Pere & Fils Champagne Brut Grande Cuvee
DESCRIPTION: This Blanc de Noirs Cuvee is the pillar of Moutard’s production as it is a blend of several of the best vintages. Pair with starters: vegetables, raw vegetables, green salad, terrines and foie gras, meat and sea products, cold cuts, fish. Dishs: white meat (poultry, veal), grilled white meat, white meat in sauce, red meat (beef, duck), grilled red meat, red meat in sauce, raw red meat, smoked meat.

TITLE: Champagne Paul Laurent Rose Brut
DESCRIPTION: A blend of 70% Pinot Noir and 30% Chardonnay, this wine follows traditional Champagne methods of vinification and is aged on its lees for a minimum of 18 months prior to release. The predominance of Pinot noir is apparent in the bright, berry fruit aromas and a rich, mouth-filling texture. The Chardonnay lends liveliness and provides its pleasantly long, clean finish.

TITLE: Champagne Pierre Moncuit Grand Cru Extra Brut Blanc de Blancs
DESCRIPTION: Made from 100% Gand Cru Le Mesnil fruit, this flagship Blanc de Blancs cuvee is a racy and transparent expression of this famed site and always a single vintage.

TITLE: Champagne Robert Barbichon Reserve 4 Cepages Extra Brut
DESCRIPTION: Elevate your celebratory moments with Champagne Robert Barbichon Reserve 4 Cepages Extra Brut, a masterpiece from the Champagne region in France. Crafted by the esteemed Champagne Robert Barbichon, this Extra Brut showcases a harmonious blend of four grape varieties. Encased in a distinctive bottle, this Reserve expression reflects the dedication and artistry of the winemaking tradition. Immerse yourself in the refined effervescence of this Champagne and experience the richness of its heritage.

TITLE: Champagne Ullens Champagne Brut Extra L.P.M.
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the luxurious effervescence of Champagne Ullens Brut Extra L.P.M., a masterpiece from the renowned Champagne region in France. Crafted by Champagne Ullens, this exquisite Brut Extra is a celebration of precision and elegance. Encased in a beautifully designed bottle, the L.P.M. expression signifies a commitment to craftsmanship and the pursuit of perfection. Elevate your moments with this extraordinary Champagne.

TITLE: Chamucos Tequila Blanco
Charbay R5 Clear Hop-Flavored Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Lots of tropical fruit on the nose and body. That funky white dog character is there, but it’s overpowered by fruit and sweetness. Creamy and seductive, it’s surprisingly easy-drinking and enjoyable for a white whiskey, with plenty of character to overpower any of the funk left behind from the white doggedness. Imagine an IPA while you’re drinking it and you’ll understand everything.

TITLE: Charbay R5 Hop Flavored Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: An amazingly flavorful whiskey, rich in flavor and a must-try for the whiskey enthusiast. Charbay's R5 is double-distilled from Bear Republic Brewery's award-winning Racer 5 IPA® beer (7% abv). This IPA was chosen for its upfront aromatic hops, a great dose of bittering hops, high-quality two-row barley, balanced and a smooth, clean finish. See if you can taste how each of these is revealed in the whiskey.

TITLE: Charbay Release III 1999 Collector's Series Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: What if? In 1999, distillers Miles and Marko became fascinated by the idea of distilling bottle-ready beer into whiskey - a first in the whiskey industry. They soon embarked on an amazing 3.5 weeks of distilling 24/7 in the family's classic 1000-gallon Alambic Charentais Pot Still. It took 20,000 gallons of great Pilsner to create just 1000 gallons (24 barrels) of Whiskey. The result? Aromas of caramel and vanilla lead to maple syrup, vanilla, cinnamon, leather & tobacco. This whiskey is lush, with a full mouthfeel and lingering finish. Aged 6 years in new American White Oak + 8 years in stainless. It’s the last of the Pilsner Whiskey. A knockout the likes of which you aren’t going to encounter anywhere else.

TITLE: Charbay S Aged Hop-Flavored Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In February 2011, Marko (distiller) became intrigued by Bear Republic's Big Bear Stout - a beer that you can really sink your teeth into. The bold, roasty, caramel malt flavor is balanced by Centennial and Cascade hops. "It's extremely complex. Single malts only use a single malt—this Stout has over five different malts, as well as adjuncts and several different hop varieties. All of these qualities come through into an extremely complex whiskey," explains Marko. Alcohol 49.5% | 99 Proof | 90 points, Whisky Advocate

TITLE: Charles & Charles Art Den Hoed Vineyard Riesling
DESCRIPTION: Think Spice. Because of Riesling’s sweetness and acidity, it makes the perfect accompaniment to spicy food. Strong Indian and Asian spices are a perfect match with Riesling. A classic pairing with Riesling is spiced duck leg.

TITLE: Charles & Charles Columbia Valley Cabernet Sauvignon Blend
DESCRIPTION: Blend: 72% Cabernet Sauvignon, 28% Syrah Pair with Lamb, Cheese (Cheddar), Chocolate

TITLE: Charles & Charles Rose
DESCRIPTION: Offers bouquets of delicate strawberry, watermelon, and floral notes. On the palate, taste bright red berry fruit, minerality, lively acidity, and a crisp finish. Drink it with barbecue, burgers, grilled fish, pork, fried chicken, boiled crawfish, salads, and po-boye.

TITLE: Charles & Charles Rose
DESCRIPTION: Offers bouquets of delicate strawberry, watermelon, and floral notes. On the palate, taste bright red berry fruit, minerality, lively acidity, and a crisp finish. Drink it with barbecue, burgers, grilled fish, pork, fried chicken, boiled crawfish, salads, and po-boye.

TITLE: Charles de Fere Cuvee Jean Louis Blanc de Blancs Brut
DESCRIPTION: Charles de Fère wines are crafted in Burgundy at the Boisset family’s state-of-the-art sparkling wine facility. Enjoy as an aperetif or with oysters

TITLE: Charles Dufour Champagne Extra Brut Bulles de Comptoir #4 Vinorama
DESCRIPTION: The Dufour estate is located in the village of Landreville, in the Côtes des Bar. Charles Dufour learned about winemaking from his father, and then spent some time making wine in Australia and New Zealand. When he came back to Champagne, he helped convert the estate to organic viticulture, which was certified in 2010. Champagne Bulles de Comptoir # 4 Vinorama consists of an assemblage of Pinot Noir grapes, Chardonnay with a last but not least touch of Pinot Blanc, collected in 2013 from the base with the addition of "vin de reserve" of the years 2010 and 2011. No sulfites are added to this Champagne Extra Brut. Disgorged in January 2016 in limited quantities in 4 different labels. Seared scallops in truffled cream sauce, fried chicken, salads with goat cheese, smoked trout salad.

TITLE: Charles Smith Wines "Kung Fu Girl" Riesling
DESCRIPTION: 91 Points from Wine Spectator Wine Spectator "Top 100 Wine" two years in a row, "Best Value" 5th year in a row Planted in 1998 by the Jerry Milbrandt, the vineyard rows lie along a stretch of steep cliffs above the Columbia River, in an area that currently falls within the broad Columbia Valley AVA, and soon to be one of the state's newest AVA's The Ancient Lakes. A cooler site due to river influence, the soils are composed of fragmented basalt, gravel, silt, and caliche deposited during ice age floods. This site produces fruit with sublime mineral character and the acid balance that winemakers dream of. A very long, cold fermentation helped to bring out the maximum in true varietal character, similar to a classic "Mosel-style" Riesling. Both fermentation and aging occurred in 100% stainless steel. Delicious, spicy curries, Thai food or Chinese-style BBQ

TITLE: Chartreuse Green Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: Chartreuse is an herbal liqueur produced by Carthusian monks in the French Alps. With almost 400 years of history, Chartreuse is one of the oldest and most mysterious spirits still available. Only three monks from the order know the secret recipe, each hold one third of that recipe and all have taken a vow of silence, so the secret recipe is kept safely. The liqueur was originally created as an "Elixir of Long Life" in 1605 by Peres Chartreux. The formula was perfected over the years and by 1737 the liqueur was released to the world in a form that is close to what we drink today.

TITLE: Chartreuse Yellow Liqueur
Chateau Bourbon La Chapelle Medoc
DESCRIPTION: Product information Brillant ruby red color. Very fruity with a slight woody aromas which has been intensified after being aerated. It brings complexity. The attack is supple, red fruits taste are present in the mouth with a slight toasted notes. Tanins are ripe and concentrated. The wine is well-balanced. Finale is very pleasant. It can be drinked immediatly. Producer information Château Castera can look back on a rich and renowned history; its first documented historical reference dates back to the Middle Ages. The vines of Château Castera have been in existence since the 14th century, making them some of the oldest in all of the Médoc region. Located in the town of Saint Germain d’Esteuil, north of Saint Estèphe and in the heart of the Médoc, the property covers 185 hectares (462 acres), of which approximately 63 hectares (148 acres) are under vine. Today, the name Château Castera is a synonym for quality. Its distribution in countries all over the world reflects its position as a leader among the Crus Bourgeois properties.

TITLE: Chateau Brun-Despagne Heritage Bordeaux Superieur
DESCRIPTION: Brun-Despagne Héritage is one of those rare Bordeaux at the generic level in that it really over-delivers on price/quality ratio. Strict fruit selection and hand harvesting from low-yielding old vines are practices more commonly encountered at classed growth level and the rigorous quality control bears dividends here.

TITLE: Chateau Chatelier Bordeaux Superieur Rouge
DESCRIPTION: A refuge for monks in the 16th century, Chateau Chatelier vines have been in the Houbaer family since 1890. Current owner Jean-Michel Chatelier is the great-grandson on the maternal side of the family. On the slopes overlooking the Dordogne River, the vineyards face south/southeast towards the medieval town of Saint-Emilion. The sandy soils provide good drainage and keep the soil from compacting. A good, sunny exposure, meticulous canopy maintenance, and the beneficial influence of the Dordogne River ensure that the grapes ripen evenly and maintain acidity and freshness. The Chateau Chatelier Rouge and Blanc duo are always a go-to in the Polaner portfolio for their utter deliciousness and exceptional value. This is French bistro wine all the way! Dry and classic yet pliant and fresh, this is the perfect burger companion.

TITLE: Château Clos de la Cure Saint-Émilion Grand Cru
DESCRIPTION: A portion of the Clos de la Cure vines are located in a beautiful walled vineyard near the church of Saint Christophe des Bardes on the plateau of Saint Etienne de Lisse. While the average vine age is 30 years, it is believed that vines were planted on these plateaus in the Middle Ages.

TITLE: Château Clos Moulin Pontet Bordeaux Superieur
DESCRIPTION: Dark magenta with a bright sheen. Attractive notes of tart blueberries, ruby grapefruits, black plums, green peppers, leather, and turned soil. Layers of fruit on the tongue. Turns dryly tannic on the finish.

TITLE: Chateau d'Epire Savennieres Cuvee Speciale
DESCRIPTION: For years Kermit Lynch imported the only remaining chestnut-aged Savennieres. Chestnut is a neutral wood that totally respects the particular natural aromas and flavors of schist-grown Chenin Blanc in this part of the Loire Valley. It was the traditional aging vessel locally until oak came along, at which point history was roundly dismissed. KLWM, in partnership with Épiré’s owners, the Bizard family, decided to preserve this history. A few years ago we slowly began to replace the oldest barrels with acacia, the next-best thing, as all the local barrel-makers had disappeared and we found no other source—until just recently. Their first new chestnut barrel makes its debut this year. Vintage 2016 was relatively late at epire (and cool), and the resulting wine is classic Savennières: pure, racy, and grainy, the impact of epire’s unique magmatic soil palpable.

TITLE: Chateau de Briat 1994 Folle Blanche Vintage Armagnac
DESCRIPTION: Experience the depth of Château de Briat 1994 Folle Blanche Vintage Armagnac. Aged for 27 years, this 92-proof Armagnac offers complex flavors of dried fruits, honey, and a hint of spice. From the renowned Gascony region, it embodies the tradition and excellence of Château de Briat's distillation. Perfect for special occasions or as a treasured addition to any spirits collection.

TITLE: Chateau de Briat 2004 Folle Blanche Vintage Armagnac
DESCRIPTION: Discover the Château de Briat 2004 Folle Blanche Vintage Armagnac, a 17-year-old spirit showcasing the elegance of the Folle Blanche grape. Bottled at 92 proof, it offers a harmonious blend of floral and fruity notes with a smooth finish. Produced in the historic Gascony region, this Armagnac reflects the rich heritage and meticulous craftsmanship of Château de Briat. Ideal for savoring neat or as a distinguished gift for enthusiasts of fine aged spirits.

TITLE: Chateau de Coulaine Chinon Rouge
DESCRIPTION: Chateau de Coulaine is a family-owned estate rich in viticultural tradition which has been operating continuously since 1300! Since 1988, Etienne de Bonnaventure has assumed all viticulture and winemaking responsibilities and has grown the estate to its current 12 hectares, all situated on Chinon's plateaux. Planted to 100% Cabernet Franc, vineyards are organically farmed, all grapes are hand-harvested and vinification follows a non-interventionalist path. Coulaine's low yields (around 35 hl/ha) result in a deeply concentrated, savory and succulent expression of Cabernet Franc with ripe and polished tannins - a harmonious balance between the traditional and modern worlds. We adore Cabernet Franc and this is simply one of the most deliciously approachable examples we have come across!

TITLE: Chateau de Jau Le JaJa de Jau Vin de Pays d'Oc Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: 100% Sauvignon Blanc The JAJA Range is designed to be fun and youthful. Whilst meeting consumer standards in terms of quality, JAJA’s link to the renowned Château de JAU, both in terms of source of grapes, and historical winemaking, provide strength of credibility and worldwide success as a unique, innovative and artistic concept that is SO easy to remember.

TITLE: Chateau de L'Aumerade Cru Classe Cotes de Provence
DESCRIPTION: Chateau de l'Aumerade is a blend of Cinsault, Grenache and a touch of Syrah. The fruit is harvested at the beginning of September and is cold fermented to preserve all the wonderful aromas. A lovely pale pink in color, with salmon highlights, this wine has a perfumed nose of strawberries and cream, nuanced by spicy notes. The palate is soft and dry. The fresh nose is composed of citrus aromas such as orange and grapefruit complemented by a full, spicy and fleshy palate with refreshing acidity. Cinsault 50%, Grenache 40%, Syrah 10% Drink as an aperitif, or pair with summer salads and barbecues, or with Mediterranean or Asian cuisine

TITLE: Chateau de Leberon 1987 29 Year Single Cask Tenareze Armagnac
Chateau de Leberon 2001 Solera Single Cask Armagnac
Chateau de Parenchere Bordeaux Superieur
DESCRIPTION: Chateau de Parenchere, is located at the easternmost edge of the Bordeaux region in France. The original foundations of the estate were laid in 1570 by Pierre de Parenchieres, Lord of Fourgoigniere, and was renovated in 1958 by Raphael Gazaniol. Of the 378 acres on the estate, 155 are under vine. The vineyards lie on the border between the Dordogne and the Lot et Garonne departments and are classified to produce Bordeaux Superieur, Bordeaux Clairet and Bordeaux Blanc Sec. 145 acres are planted to red varietals (50% Merlot, 40% Cabernet Sauvignon, 9% Cabernet Franc and 1% Malbec) and 10 acres are planted to white varietals (70% Sauvignon Blanc, 20% Sémillon, 10% Muscadelle). The average vine age is 25 years old, but certain parcels now exceed 40 years of age. Planting density is between 3,300 and 5,700 vines per hectare and the vineyard management is very much rooted in the principles of sustainable agriculture.In January 2005, Mr. Per Landin took over as majority shareholder. Together with Jean and Julia Gazaniol, they are dedicated to proving the potential of their terroir. 70% Merlot/30% Cabernet Sauvignon. After harvesting, the fruit was scanned with an optical sorting machine and macerated for 6 - 7 days. Alcoholic fermentation takes place in cement vats at a maximum temperature of 82°F. “Micro-bullage” or micro-oxygenation was employed to maximize aromas and overall development of the wine. The wine was aged in cement vats for roughly 14 months. Dishes that go really well with Bordeaux reds are robust meat dishes especially beef and lamb. There are several dishes that are heavily based on the inclusion of a good slug of Bordeaux too such as "boeuf Bourguignon" or "coq au vin" (literally chicken cooked in wine). It's not just the diners that benefit from the grapes: it is claimed that snails (escargots) from this part of France taste so good because they feast on the grape leaves. Remember that when you tuck into a starter of snails with a glass of good Bordeaux. Other classics such as "steak tartare" and "tournedos chasseur" are also a good match for a delicious Bordeaux. Best of all is the renowned dish from that region "entrecote marchand de vin" which consists of a rib steak that is cooked in a rich gravy made from red Bordeaux wine. Camembert, Brie and Roquefort are regarded as good mates for Bordeaux because the the strong cheese balances the tannins in the wine.

TITLE: Chateau de Roquefort Corail Cotes de Provence Rose
DESCRIPTION: The parcels for the rose are always the same, but the combination is always different. 30% Grenache, 25% Syrah, 20% Cinsault. 10% Carignan, 10% Vermentino, 5% Clairette. The wine was produced through direct pressing, partially destemmed. Certain varieties went through a cold maceration for 8 to 24 hours before being pressed. Cold clarification and natural fermentation between 64 and 73F. Gravitational work in the cellar as often as possible.

TITLE: Chateau DOupia Les Heretiques Pays De Herault Carignane
DESCRIPTION: Immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of the Pays de l'Hérault with Chateau D'Oupia Les Heretiques Carignane, a red wine that epitomizes the character of the region. Crafted by Chateau D'Oupia, this Carignane is a testament to the winery's commitment to tradition and quality. The Les Heretiques expression pays homage to the heritage of the land, delivering a wine that captivates with every sip.

TITLE: Chateau Du Bois De La Salle La Croix Gamay
DESCRIPTION: Gamay is a grape variety that is most famous for producing the light, fruit-driven red wines of Beaujolais. While the variety offers fresh, red-fruit and candied aromas, it typically delivers little in the way of flavor concentration and body weight, giving light, simple wines. That said, some well-made examples can be deep and complex.

TITLE: Chateau du Vieux Moulin Corbieres
DESCRIPTION: Chateau Vieux Moulin is a domain 100% certified organic. The vineyards are located in Montbrun des Corbieres, on a hot and dry terroir. The domain is more than 2 century old and is now run by Alexandre They who took over the estate in 1998 with his wife Laurence. Alexandre is a young and visonary winemaker who distinguished himslef in the region by making authentic Corbieres wines. Alexandre and his wife beleive in growing their vineyards under the best environmental practices, preserving high level of biodyversity and preserving the natural resources. The respect of nature's systems and cycles is key in making terroir driven wines. All wines are fermented with native yeast and made with minimal intervention.

TITLE: Chateau Gaudrelle Touraine Petillant Rose
DESCRIPTION: 60% Grolleau, 40% Cabernet Franc are hand harvested for this sparkling rosé. A 20 ha estate in Touraine with 35 years old vines growing in clay siliceous soil, mostly Chenin, minimal use of pesticides. Pressed and fermented in stainless steel vats for 5 to 6 weeks. At the end of the fermentation the wine is bottled, a small dosage is added, and the 2nd fermentation begins (Champagne method). Aged 12 months in bottle. It will be perfect serving at the aperitf or with red fruits desserts.

TITLE: Chateau Guilhem Pot de Vin Rouge
DESCRIPTION: Chateau Guilhem is located in the heart of the Malepère appellation. The 92 acres large estate is led by Bertrand Gourdou, an energetic young producer that can claim over 10 years of experience in wine making. He is the 6th generation producing wine on the property. Chateau Guilhem is today the leading estate in the Malepere appellation, an AOC his grandfather helped to create by being the first in 1970 to plant Bordeaux grapes in this typical Grenache, Mourvedre, Carignan and Syrah country.Chateau Guilhem is an organic winery.

TITLE: Chateau Haut Theron Cuvee Prestige Cahors Malbec
DESCRIPTION: Dark, shiny and ruby color. Complex nose of black cherry with a hint of violet and blackberry.Earthy and rustic, while retaining some of the bright, sleek fruit Malbec is now known for. Elegant and long meaty palate with refined tannin and rich structure which stays on ripe fruit. Unlike Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec doesn’t have a super long finish. Because of this, Malbec is great with leaner red meats (ostrich anyone?). The wine does extremely well with funky flavors like blue cheese and rustic flavors like mushrooms and cumin spice.Perfect Malbec food pairing would be a black pepper buffalo burgers with blue cheese mushrooms and rosemary infused garlic kale chips. Also try with: Meat Pairings - Dark meat poultry and lean red meat. Malbec also pairs well with earthy flavors too, such as beef brisket. Duck, Chicken Leg, Lamb, Beef, Ostrich, Buffalo, Pork Shoulder Spices and Herbs - Look for spices that have earthy or smoky flavors such as: Parsley, Sumac, Thyme, Rosemary, Porcini Powder, Smoked Paprika, Black Pepper, Cumin, Coriander, Juniper Berry, Clove, Vanilla Bean, Garlic, Shallot, Green Onion, Barbecue Sauce Cheese Pairings - Look for funky and rich soft to semi-firm cow’s and goat’s milk cheeses. Vegetables & Vegetarian Fare - Mushroom, Roasted Vegetables, Green and Red Bell Pepper, Potato, Arugula, Kale, Chard, Grilled Endive, Onion, Beet, Tempeh, Lentils, Black Beans, Forbidden Rice

TITLE: Chateau L'Escart Cuvee Eden  Bordeaux Superieur
DESCRIPTION: Chateau L'Escart was built in the 18th century and is located in the little town of Saint Loubes surrounding the Dordogne river. The estate is 37 ha large and produces mostly red wine. Owner Gerard Laurent is now helped by his son Damien to manage the property. Chateau L'Escart makes two promises. First, to be passionate about its traditional agricultural heritage and second, to produce authentic wines which are drunk with the heart and the mind. The estate is certified organic.

TITLE: Chateau La Canorgue Luberon Rouge
DESCRIPTION: 60% Syrah, 30% Grenache, 10% old vine Carignan and Mourvedre

TITLE: Chateau la Grande Roche Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: 80% Cabernet, 13% Cabernet Franc, 4% Petite Verdot, 3% Merlot Traditional farming in a Bordelaise sense. Classical vertical trellis used with meticulous hand placement of the canopy to expose maximum leaf surface to nourish the developing grapes. Throughout the growing season each vine is tended to no less than 16 times. Canopy training, suckering, leaf removal and multiple green grape thinning goes on from mid- April through mid-August, all done by hand to assure accuracy and quality judgment.

TITLE: Chateau La Grolet Cotes de Bourg Bordeaux
DESCRIPTION: Chateau La Grolet Cotes de Bourg Bordeaux is a dry red wine from the Bordeaux region of France. It is a blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Cabernet Franc grapes, grown in the Cotes de Bourg appellation. This wine is produced using traditional methods, with fermentation and aging in oak barrels. The result is a wine that is fruity and flavorful, with a medium body and a pleasant acidity.

TITLE: Chateau Lamothe Miette Bordeaux Rose
DESCRIPTION: In honor of Maria's mother, nicknamed "Miette", who walks these vines and sits on the bench on the edge of the parcel. This Bordeaux rose is a pale, salmon-pink color. Fresh and lively on the nose, with intensely fruity and floral aromas. Generous and seductive on the palete, this new addition to our rose lineup is pure pleasure!

TITLE: Chateau Laubarit Entre-Deux-Mers
DESCRIPTION: Chateau Laubarit Entre-Deux-Mers is a dry white wine from the Bordeaux region of France. It is a blend of Sauvignon Blanc, Semillon, and Muscadelle grapes, grown in the Entre-Deux-Mers appellation. This wine is produced using traditional methods, with fermentation and aging in stainless steel tanks. The result is a wine that is fresh, fruity, and lively.

TITLE: Chateau Le Bergey Bordeaux
DESCRIPTION: Le Bergey is the entry level label of Château L’Escart, a Bordeaux Superior winery run by Damien Laurent, who lives on the property with his family. The property is organically farmed and managed for quality throughout every step necessary to make a fine bottle of wine. You’ve got to try this if you are a Bordeaux fan. Consistently outstanding, this is yet another strong showing from one of our most price-worthy properties. Using only vines that are a minimum 15 years of age adds a measure of concentration usually found only in wines costing considerably more. A classic with grilled or roasted lamb, this also shines with roast pork, and pairs well with a pan seared duck breast.

TITLE: Chateau Lestignac Semillon "Michel Michel"
DESCRIPTION: Chateau Lestignac is a family domaine first started in 1617 then reborn in 2009 when Mathias Marquet and his wife Camile made their own wines rather than selling grapes to negotiants as the previous few generations had. This young couple are inspired by nature and the environment, farming their 30 acres of vines organically and biodynamically with an aim to improving life in the soil and the region. Work in the cellar is equally natural: only indigenous yeasts for fermentation and no additives at all other than a minimal use of sulfur as needed.

TITLE: Chateau Maison Blanche Les Piliers de Maison Blanche Montagne Saint Emilion
DESCRIPTION: Varieties: 60% Cabernet Franc, 40% MerlotSoil Type(s): clay, limestone, sandVineyard Area: 32 ha Certified Biodynamic & Organic. The grapes are harvested by hand, mostly destemmed and ferment naturally in glass-lined cement tanks without any additives (yeast, enzymes, vitamins, tartric acid, etc.), nano-technological manipulation or temperature shock. The wine ages for twelve to eighteen months in a combination of barrels (never new) and cuves.

TITLE: Chateau Maris "Natural Selection" Cru La Liviniere Minervois Biodynamic Syrah
DESCRIPTION: A lush, plush blend of Syrah, Grenache and Carignan that does not contain a single chemical. Color:Very deep and even red and garnet appearance with hints of deep purple. Nose: Open and expressive with great complexity. There are ripe black fruits (blackcurrants, elderberries) alongside more spicy characteristics (pepper, herbs) Palate: Very attractive in the mouth with firm yet silky tannins. Aromatic, spicy with a fabulously generous weight. The finish is long and delicate. Food pairing - Game, grilled red meat with sauce, cheeses.

TITLE: Chateau Maris "Old School" Rouge
DESCRIPTION: A blend of Biodynamic young vine Syrah and Biodynamic Grenache. Old School Rouge is vinified with the sole aim of preserving the freshness of fruit that the Minervois region gives us. All the fruit is Estate grown, handpicked and ferments with natural yeast in natural concrete tanks.

TITLE: Chateau Maris Minervois "Old School" Rose
DESCRIPTION: Sourced from one of our very own seriously Old School vineyard planted in 1959 in AOC Minervois, this Rose de Presse (meaning made the proper way). It is certified Ecocert Organic NOP, certified Demeter and certified Biodyvin for good measure. It’s salmon in color but dry, crisp and refreshing. Only 488 cases were made.

TITLE: Chateau Maris Minervois Les Planels La Liviniere Syrah
DESCRIPTION: Les Planels is 100% Syrah, from the estate’s top plots, that was aged for 12 months in oak before being bottled unfined and unfiltered. Exhibits terrific aromatics of creme de cassis, raspberry liqueur, smoked beef, spice-cabinet and hints of bacon fat that carry into a full-bodied, gorgeously proportioned and balanced Syrah. With its delicate flavors, lamb is a great choice for the lighter style of Syrah. Try Lamb Shawarma or Gyros or, if you’re preparing it yourself, play with your spice rack to magnify the natural flavors in Syrah of allspice, clove, and mint. (Vegetarian option: brined and grilled eggplant)

TITLE: Chateau Massereau Bordeaux Clairet Rouge
DESCRIPTION: 100% Destemmed, 2 days maceration in cement vat at 55F (very slow ferment), then free flow of the juice (la goutte) in an underground vat. After 3 to 4 days & once ferments are going strong the wine is then racked into 3 yr old neutral barrel from the domaine (Darnajou Cooper). Bâtonage every week in the beginning, then every 2 weeks, btling March. Does not go through Malolactic fermentation, 10mg of SO2 1 month before bottling.

TITLE: Chateau Massiac Pays D'oc Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Experience the refined elegance of Chateau Massiac Pays d'Oc Sauvignon Blanc. This exquisite white wine originates from the sun-kissed vineyards of Languedoc in the Pays d'Oc IGP region, France. Crafted by the renowned Chateau Massiac, this Sauvignon Blanc is a true reflection of the region’s rich winemaking heritage. With its crisp, dry character and vibrant aromas, this wine is perfect for any occasion, offering a refreshing and sophisticated tasting experience.

TITLE: Chateau Miraval A.O.C Cotes de Provence Rose
DESCRIPTION: Miraval rosé is a wonderful blend of fruits aromas and freshness, made on an exceptional terroirs in Provence. The 2014 vintage in Provence looks very promising. The mild and humid climate allowed the wines to express their character, and gave them a wide range of aromas and a very rich complexity. Yet the climate was without respite, characterised by variable weather. A mild and wet winter followed by a hot, dry spring and a cooler summer without excessive heat, allowed the vine to develop efficiently and to finish maturing with a beautiful Indian summer in September. Thorough and precise work in the vineyard and in the cellar was more important than ever this year, and was rewarded with wines that look very auspicious.

TITLE: Chateau Miraval A.O.C Cotes de Provence Rose
DESCRIPTION: Miraval rosé is a wonderful blend of fruits aromas and freshness, made on an exceptional terroirs in Provence. The 2014 vintage in Provence looks very promising. The mild and humid climate allowed the wines to express their character, and gave them a wide range of aromas and a very rich complexity. TITLE: Chateau Moulin de Noaillac Medoc
DESCRIPTION: The estate has a history of wine production that dates to 1460. Marc Pages and his family purchased the 46 hectares of vineyards in the commune of Jau Dignac and Loirac, Medoc in 1983. The vines are an average age of 20 years and are planted on the gravel soils of the Garonne River. The wine is vinified in stainless steel and concrete and aged 12 months in French Barrique. 55% Merlot, 40% Cabernet Sauvignon, 5% Petite Verdot.

TITLE: Chateau Nicot Bordeaux Rouge
DESCRIPTION: This small and relatively unknown Bordeaux property is located at Ecoussans, a town on the right bank of the River Garonne, roughly 21 miles south of Bordeaux. For over two centuries it has been in the hands of the Dubourg family, which has a total of some 210 acres of vines covering nine Bordeaux appellations, including some just over the river at Cadillac and in Sauternes. Château Nicot is the cornerstone of the family's vineyard plantings. The property has 38 acres of vines, with an average age of 20 years, made up of two-thirds Cabernet Sauvignon and one-third Merlot.

TITLE: Chateau Pech Latt Corbieres
DESCRIPTION: This wine from the the Corbieres AOC within the Languedoc, is a fantastic value. It is made from grapes farmed Organically and carries the Ecocert for Organic origin on the label. Color: An impressive black cherry, dark red color with a delightfully clear and bright appearance. Nose: Hints of red and black berries, with-rounded tannins infused with pleasant spicy aromas. Palate: Surprisingly intense fruitiness with spices mingling harmoniously with the wine well rounded tannins. Smooth and silky, with a hint of vanilla and a long, fruity finish. It should age well, enabling the hints of spiciness to develop further. Pairs well with Grilled meats, BBQ, or steak

TITLE: Chateau Pigoudet Coteaux d'Aix en Provence Rose Classique
DESCRIPTION: Surrounded by pine trees, the slopes, which are home to the best parcels, are planted to Syrah and Cabernet Sauvignon, while the plains support Cinsault and Grenache. With soils of chalky clay, small stones and gravel, the vines are sustainably farmed with organic treatments. Producing rose wines from all four varietals, Chateau Pigoudet possesses the idea climate, complete with diurnal shifts, that allows the fruit to gradually ripen, yielding refreshing and aromatic wines. All fruit is harvested at night, pressed and left on the skins for seven days at 32F degrees. Each varietal is fermented separately, then blended for each cuvee.

TITLE: Chateau Pigoudet Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence Premiere Rose
DESCRIPTION: Chateau Pigoudet is located in the mountains of Provence, in the extreme NE quadrant of the AOC Coteaux d'Aix en Provence. Here, Pigoudet's 100 acres of vineyards sit at 400 meters, with full southern exposure, protected by the strong Mistral winds that blow from the north by Mont Vautubiere. It goes great with just about every summer dish, from steamed lobster to BBQ ribs.

TITLE: Chateau Pimpine Bordeaux
DESCRIPTION: Chateau Pimpine is located next to Chateau le Puy and the Amoreau family owns the vineyard. The winemaking at Chateau Pimpine is under the direction of Jean-Pierre Amoreau and his son Pascal. They apply the same biodynamic methodology at Pimpine with stunning results. The vineyards are located between Saint Emilion and Saint Cibard—the same plateau as Saint Emilion and Pomerol. The vineyards are 110 meters above sea level and the soil consists of clay, flint and limestone. The Chateau overlooks the Dordone Valley, once known as the “Plateau of Wonders” due to the exceptional wines produced there. Making naturally elegant, high quality Bordeaux has been a way of life for the Amoreau family for four centuries.

TITLE: Chateau Pontey Cru Bourgeois Medoc
DESCRIPTION: It matches perfectly with red meats, game and cheese

TITLE: Chateau Puybarbe Cotes de Bourg
DESCRIPTION: Chateau Puybarbe, a 33-hectare estate managed by the Orlandi family since 1952, is perched on one of the highest hills of the right bank's Côtes de Bourg appellation, in the village of Mombrier. 'Puybarbe', in fact, is the name given to one of the highest points in the locale, from which you can enjoy panoramic views of the region, and see even as far as the city of Bordeaux. The blend here is 65% Merlot and 35% Cabernet Sauvignon. Drink with roast rib of beef with all the trimmings.

TITLE: Chateau Saint-Honore Cotes de Provence Rose
DESCRIPTION: The 19th Century Chateau Saint-Honore is located in the seaside Cotes de Provence sub-appellation of La Londe east of Hyeres. The estate's 160 acres of vines thrive on forested slopes amid oaks, pines and mimosa overlooking the Mediterranean's Iles d'Or (Golden Islands); Porquerolles, Port Cros, and Le Levant. Schist and sand soils containing significant amounts of quartz dominate the Maures-Esterel coastal range. This unique terroir yields high-toned roses with floral and citrus aromas and flavors. New owners, the Fabre family, have been vignerons in Provence since 1928.

TITLE: Chateau Sainte-Marie Entre-Deux-Mers Vieilles Vignes
DESCRIPTION: 63% SAUVIGNON BLANC, 27% SEMILLON & 10% MUSCADELLE For years Stephane has advocated for natural farming and yield control in the region. This vibrant, perfumed, and beautifully balanced Entre-Deux-Mers Blanc is evidence of his commitment to these principles.

TITLE: Chateau Siran Bordeaux Superieur Saint-Jacques de Siran
DESCRIPTION: Chateau Siran Bordeaux Superieur Saint-Jacques de Siran is a dry red wine from the Bordeaux region of France. It is a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Petit Verdot grapes, grown in the Margaux appellation. This wine is produced using traditional methods, with fermentation and aging in oak barrels. The result is a wine that is complex and flavorful, with a long finish

TITLE: Chateau Teyssier St. Emilion Grand Cru
DESCRIPTION: Grand Cru - Wine has been made at the estate since the 1700’s. At one stage in the nineteenth century it was the largest estate in the neighborhood. At the time of purchase however it had been reduced to just five hectares of depleted vineyard. Since then a completely new team has transformed the wine and the estate. Renovation in every sense – estate, vineyard, winery, barrel cellar, and the fundamental approach to making wine means that Château Teyssier is widely regarded as a new-wave, modern-style wine from Saint Emilion. Most importantly the wine is now sought after by a loyal following. The blend is 85% Merlot and 15% Cabernet Franc. Being 70% Merlot, this wine matches with a wide variety of foods because of its position in the middle of the red wine spectrum. In general it pairs well with chicken and other light meats as well as lightly-spiced dark meats. With medium tannin and not too much acidity you’ll find it pairs well with many foods. Merlot doesn’t pair well with fish or leafy green vegetables unless they are braised or cooked a certain way. Also, spicy food will most likely overwhelm Merlot’s nuanced flavors.

TITLE: Chateau Tire Pe DieM Bordeaux Controlee
DESCRIPTION: Works well with picnic fare, baked chicken, grilled beef, spicy pasta dishes or with mild cheeses.

TITLE: Chatelain Desjacques Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Enjoy as an aperitif, or pair with roast chicken, seafood or goats cheese.

TITLE: Chatom Vineyards Zinfandel
DESCRIPTION: Chatom Vineyards is nestled in the breathtaking Esmeralda Valley of the Sierra Foothills in Calaveras County. The valley was originally planted with low field crops, fruits and nut trees. When Gay Callan, owner and native San Franciscan, purchased the property in 1980, her vision was to plant a vineyard. Her first varietals were then planted in 1981, totaling 21 acres of Chardonnay and Chenin Blanc. Today, the vineyard boasts 13 varietals planted on 65 acres, including Chardonnay, Semillon, Sauvignon Blanc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Zinfandel, Syrah, Sangiovese and 5 Portuguese varietals.

TITLE: Chattanooga  Whiskey Founder's 11th Anniversary Blend
DESCRIPTION: Discover the Chattanooga Whiskey Founder's 11th Anniversary Blend, a unique and exquisite addition to any whiskey collection. This remarkable blend is a fusion of house-distilled products and whiskey sourced from MGP in Lawrenceburg, Indiana. It's crafted to symbolize the company's past, present, and future, featuring the original "1816" whiskey recipe along with the signature "Barrel 91" recipe, both finished in a solera system. The 11th Anniversary Blend offers a delightful tasting experience, starting with aromas of cinnamon rolls, vanilla ice cream, and buttery seasoned oak. The palate unfolds with rich notes of pie spice and cracked pepper, leading to a long, simmering warmth. Flavors transition from earthy and gritty to a delightful mix of fruit, vanilla, and oak, ending with a slightly dry, leathery finish complemented by lingering toffee and cream soda notes.

TITLE: Chestnut Farms Bottle-In-Bond Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This BIB offers a smooth mouth feel for the 100 proof it offers. Balanced flavors of caramel, vanilla, and dark fruit. Cinnamon and oak leave a pleasant finish. On the rocks or straight, this sought-after sipper will be a joy with which to end any day. Some even call it a Blanton's "killer" - we would not go as far as that, but this is definitely a solid choice!

TITLE: Chestnut Farms Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Barton 1792 Distillery draws iron-free limestone water from the original spring and utilizes the finest corn, rye, and malted barley to produce a 6-year-old Bourbon with a complex nose, robust taste & smooth finish. Double Gold Medal - San Francisco Spirits Competition.

TITLE: Chichibu Distillery Ichiro's Malt 8 Year Old Cask No. 646 Single Malt Whiskey
Chichibu Distillery Ichiro's Malt Single Malt Whisky Cask #11048 "Year of the Tiger"
DESCRIPTION: Limited edition, single cask, single malt whisky distilled by Chichibu Distillery in Saitama, Japan, under Master Distiller, Ichiro Akuto Made from 100% malted Concerto two row barley, milled and mashed in-house Mash fermented in Mizunara washbacks for 90–100 hours Distilled in 2000-liter Forsyth copper pot stills Aged 6 years in ex-bourbon American white oak, finished 1 year in IPA beer casks Bottled at cask strength without additives or coloring Non-chill filtered; 62.1% ABV Limited release of only 251 bottles Bottled in 2021, this single cask bottling is the newest release from Chichibu Distillery’s Zodiac Series. The Tiger is the zodiac animal for the year 2022 and represents strength, bravery, confidence, and unpredictability.

TITLE: Chichibu Distillery Ichiro's Malt Single Malt Whisky Cask #2134
DESCRIPTION: Ichiro's Malt Single Malt Whisky Cask #2134 only 201 bottles available in the U.S. Bottled 2019 Aged 6 Years Alcohol by Volume 64.3% Cask Type: Ex Bourbon 8x Mizunara Washback Chill Filtration: None

TITLE: Chichibu Distillery Ichiro's Malt Single Malt Whisky Cask #2345
Chichibu Distillery Ichiro's Malt The Single Cask #708 Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Cask #708 is the second single cask release of Ichiro’s Malt. Aged in an ex-Hanyu (the extinct distillery of Ichiro’s grandfather) Hogshead barrel for 5 and a 1/2 years with an ABV of 63.1%, this whisky is rich and elegant with flavors of fig and dates, along with a touch of citrus and marmalade.

TITLE: Chichibu Distillery Ichiro's Malt The US Edition Single Malt Whisky 2022
DESCRIPTION: Chichibu distillery is a small distillery with only nine full-time employees. The distillery is owned by Venture whisky, which was founded in 2004 in Chichibu city, Saitama, just outside of Tokyo (hence its name). This particular Ichiro’s Single Malt is a limited edition "US Edition" release (there is also a "Paris edition") . As with everything else from the Chichibu distillery, it comes highly recommended

Chichibu Ichiro's Malt "On The Way" Single Malt Whisky
Chichibu Ichiro's Malt "The First" Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: 'The First' is the first single malt produced at the Chichibu Distillery, founded in 2008 by Ichiro Akuto. His family had a history of producing sake for 300 years before his grandfather tried his hand at distilling in 1946. That distillery, Hanyu, unfortunately only lasted two generations, but Ichiro is keeping the family tradition alive. The First is aged in seven ex-bourbon casks and one Japanese Mizunara oak cask. Only 2,040 bottles are available.

TITLE: Chichibu Ichiro's Port Pipe Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Chichibu distllery is a Japanese whisky distillery Founded in 2004 by Ichiro Akuto, and operational from 2008, it was the first new Japanese distillery since 1973. It is located at Chichibu, a city in Saitama Perfecture, Japan.

TITLE: Chichibu Ichiro's The Floor Malted Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The second full release (8800 bottles) from Ichiro Akuto's Chichibu distillery is The Floor Malted, distilled in 2009 from barley malted to Akuto-san's specifications during a trip to England to learn the art of floor-malting for himself. The whisky was matured in mostly bourbon casks with a few 'chibidaru' quarter casks in the mix as well.

TITLE: Chichibu Ichiro's Wine Wood Reserve Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Yet another masterpiece from the rockstar of the Japanese whisky world, Ichiro Akuto. This offering from Ichiro was aged in French wine barrels and is characterized by a complex taste and fruity top notes, bitter chocolate, and orange peel. If you are a fan of Ichiro, you will like this one!

TITLE: Chicken Cock 15 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Chicken Cock 15 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a prestigious limited edition release from the historic Chicken Cock brand. This bourbon, aged for 15 years and bottled at barrel proof, showcases the mastery of distillation and aging by Bardstown Bourbon Company under the guidance of Master Distiller Gregg Snyder. Presented in a vintage-style decanter with a metal cap, this bourbon is not only a visual delight but also a testament to the brand's dedication to quality and tradition. Only 1,350 bottles were produced, making it a rare and sought-after addition for bourbon enthusiasts.

TITLE: Chicken Cock 20 Year Old Cotton Club Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Chicken Cock 20 Year Old Cotton Club Rye Whiskey is a remarkable blend that pays homage to the brand's storied history, once the featured house whiskey at Harlem's legendary Cotton Club during Prohibition. This limited-edition Canadian Rye Whiskey, aged for two decades and bottled at 100 proof, encapsulates a unique piece of American whiskey lore. The whiskey is presented in a Prohibition-era replica apothecary-style bottle, reflecting the brand's rich heritage and the spirited times of the 1920s.

TITLE: Chicken Cock Chanticleer Cognac Finish Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Chicken Cock Chanticleer Cognac Finish Bourbon is a luxurious expression of the historic Chicken Cock brand. This limited edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon is finished in French Cognac barrels, resulting in a sophisticated and complex flavor profile. Only 32 barrels were produced, making it a rare and sought-after release. Chicken Cock Chanticleer Cognac Finish Bourbon offers a unique and refined drinking experience that celebrates the longstanding French-American friendship, making it a perfect addition for collectors and connoisseurs alike

TITLE: Chicken Cock Island Rooster Rum Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Chicken Cock Island Rooster Rum Barrel Rye is a limited edition Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey finished in Caribbean rum barrels. A trip to the Caribbean inspired this unique expression, where roosters announce the coming day. The whiskey is aged for at least four years before being finished for six months in rum casks, adding a tropical flair to the traditional rye spice.

TITLE: Chicken Cock Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Chicken Cock Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a modern revival of a historic brand renowned for its premium flavor and quality. Established in 1856, Chicken Cock was a staple at Prohibition-era speakeasies like the famous Cotton Club in Harlem. Today, it is distilled, aged, and bottled in Kentucky through a collaborative effort with Bardstown Bourbon Company, ensuring the highest quality and tradition. Chicken Cock Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a testament to the brand's storied past, offering a satisfying and traditional Kentucky bourbon experience for both collectors and casual drinkers alike​

TITLE: Chicken Cock Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The first Chicken Cock Kentucky Straight Rye in over 70 years. A rich caramel color with a hue of dark orange. A nose with pepper, a hint of cinnamon, grassiness, and sweet oak lactones. A taste that offers a tremendous complexity of spices, vanilla, butterscotch, and pepper with a hint of dryness and slight overtones of citrus and oak. Chicken Cock Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey is a noteworthy addition for rye enthusiasts, offering a vibrant and flavorful profile that harks back to its storied past.

TITLE: Chicken Cock Red Stave Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Chicken Cock Red Stave Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a unique and luxurious bourbon that celebrates the union of two iconic American industries: Kentucky bourbon and California wine. This exceptional bourbon is finished in carefully selected J. Wilkes Petite Sirah barrels, resulting in a rich and complex flavor profile that appeals to both whiskey and wine aficionados. Chicken Cock Red Stave Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a limited edition release that offers a refined and sophisticated drinking experience, making it a prized addition to any whiskey collection​.

TITLE: Chicken Cock Whiskey's Small Batch Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Chicken Cock Whiskey's Small Batch Bourbon is a testament to the rich heritage and craftsmanship of Kentucky bourbon. Originally founded in 1856 in Paris, Kentucky, Chicken Cock has a storied past that includes surviving Prohibition and a devastating fire. Revived in 2012, the brand now collaborates with Bardstown Bourbon Company to produce award-winning whiskeys. This Small Batch Bourbon is meticulously crafted from a small selection of barrels, each aged for 5 years. Bottled at 100 proof, it offers a robust and full-bodied experience, showcasing the skill and dedication that define the Chicken Cock legacy.

TITLE: Chivas Regal 12 Year Old Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Chivas Regal 12 year old is a very popular blend, particularly in America. It is of10 referenced in popular music, it was actually reputed to be a favourite drink of Jim Morrison.

TITLE: Chivas Regal 13 Years  "Manchester United" Special Edition Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This exclusive blend uses the unrivalled Chivas house style and is selectively finished in American rye casks. The first ever Scotch to be aged for 13 years by Chivas, the delicate notes of vanilla in this blend are magnified by the sweet American rye casks.

TITLE: Chivas Regal Royal Salute 21 year Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Royal Salute 21-Year-Old 80 Proof is named for the traditional 21-gun salute that has long been used across a number of cultures and countries as a sign of respect on royal occasions. This blended Scotch whisky comes from the Chivas brothers in Aberdeen, Scotland, and has been delighting connoisseurs of the spirit for years. In addition to its name coming from the salute, every bottle of Royal Salute 21-Year-Old 80 Proof whisky is aged for 21 years to provide a smooth and flavorful experience. As you sip, you will taste notes of chocolate, dried fruit, caramel, and toasted oak. A subtler layer of white raisins and cherry blossoms remains behind after you've finished your beverage. The bottles are as distinctive as the whisky inside. The vessels take nearly a week to produce and are crafted from Cornish clay with a double layer of glazing on top. Enjoy this whisky neat or with a splash of water to celebrate a special occasion.

TITLE: Chivas Regal Royal Salute 21 Years Old Lunar New Year Special Edition Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Chivas Regal Royal Salute 21 Years Old Lunar New Year Special Edition Blended Malt Scotch Whisky is a richly crafted spirit that epitomizes luxury and celebration. Created by Chivas Brothers, this premium blend uses only the finest hand-selected Scotch whiskies, matured for a minimum of 21 years. The 2023 Lunar New Year Special Edition comes in a stunning presentation box adorned with colorful symbolic elements like lanterns, firecrackers, and plum blossoms, designed in collaboration with the multi-award-winning Chinese illustrator Feifei Ruan.

TITLE: Chivas Regal Royal Salute 21 Years Old The Jodhpur Polo Edition Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Chivas Regal Royal Salute 21 Years Old The Jodhpur Polo Edition is a sumptuous whisky that intertwines the grandeur of the royal sport of polo with the exquisite art of whisky-making. This limited edition release is meticulously crafted by the Chivas Brothers, renowned for their centuries-old whisky-making expertise. Aged for 21 years, this blend encapsulates the essence of luxury, paying homage to the noble sport of polo and the rich heritage of Jodhpur, the renowned polo capital of India.

TITLE: Chivas Regal Royal Salute 21 Years Richard Quinn The Couture Collection Black Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Royal Salute is an exceptional blend of very rare whiskies was created by the Chivas Brothers, makers of Chivas Regal, to celebrate the coronation of Queen Elizabeth II in 1953. It's generally acknowledged by connoisseurs as the world's foremost super premium blended Scotch whisky. The Royal Salute 21-Year-Old Richard Quinn Edition comprises an elegant floral blend, in homage to the bold and colourful designs of Richard Quinn. Quinn graduated from London’s prestigious Central Saint Martins Arts and Design School before winning ‘British Emerging Talent – Womenswear’ at the 2018 Fashion Awards, as well as the Queen Elizabeth II Award for British Design. Riotous florals, heavy pearls and a fresh take on latex signal Richard Quinn’s distinctive signature style. In a bold statement of style and elegance, the blend is housed in a re-imagined porcelain flagon, available in black and white. The flagon is embellished with a petals and thorns motif, personally designed by Richard Quinn. The whisky was fashioned by Royal Salute Master Blender Sandy Hyslop using Richard Quinn as its core inspiration – and offers elegant floral notes with a rich and indulgent finish.

TITLE: Chivas Regal Royal Salute 21 Years Richard Quinn The Couture Collection White Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Royal Salute is an exceptional blend of very rare whiskies was created by the Chivas Brothers, makers of Chivas Regal, to celebrate the coronation of Queen Elizabeth II in 1953. It's generally acknowledged by connoisseurs as the world's foremost super premium blended Scotch whisky. The Royal Salute 21-Year-Old Richard Quinn Edition comprises an elegant floral blend, in homage to the bold and colourful designs of Richard Quinn. As consumers gradually came to prefer bottle conditioned and aged products, the ciderie responded by developing a "Cidre Bouché", which literally means "corked cider."

TITLE: Cidrerie du Leguer Cidre Granit Rose
DESCRIPTION: The Granite Rose is a drier cider with roughly 1% black currant juice added. It comes topped by a traditional Champagne cage, but the bubbles, the mousse here, is very delicate and soft – almost nonexistent, at least visually. You feel it a bit more on the palate as a textural presence. The truth is when I hear about fruit juices being added to cider I certainly have one eyebrow rise every-so-slightly in a stance of dubious questioning. However, in this case, well, damn: the rosé is delightful. Which is to say, it’s done with restraint. The black currant gives the cider a beautiful delicate rosy tinge, but also a really aromatic and mouth-watering perfume. Yet the cider, the apples, shine through, and that’s the magic. The overall impression here, as with the “Brutbrut,” is full and rounded, juicy. It begs you not just to drink it, but gulp it. The fun here is the balance, the play of sweet fruit and acidity and bitterness. Delicious. This cider is made from apples that have fallen and were allowed to further ripen in wooden crates. Cédric uses the old-school process of “keeving” to clean the musts (thus they are not filtered) and all fermentations are natural. The ciders are bottled with no sulfur.

DESCRIPTION: Clase Azul Mezcal Guerrero reveals one of Mexico's best-kept secrets: the wondrous state of Guerrero, a little-explored region that shows us yet another facet of Mexican culture. This member of the Clase Azul family was inspired by the singularity of Guerrero’s landscapes, gastronomy, art, and heritage –– but also by the strength and leadership of the women from this region. Clase Azul Mezcal Guerrero is a truly unique piece. Beyond its beautiful decanter, its majestic flavor comes from a very rare variety of agave: the papalote agave. This plant grows wild in the mountain ranges in the state of Guerrero, where both the coastal climate and the freshness of green forests come through in its flavor profile.

TITLE: Clase Azul Gold Limited Edition Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Ideal for collectors, Clase Azul Gold is an exclusive, limited-edition collection of unique art and tequila. This bottle masterfully features a combination of glass and ceramic, which Clase Azul has worked on for years. With only 6000 pieces produced, "The Gold Collection" boasts a stunning hand-crafted and hand-painted base, accurately depicting Mexico's culturally exquisite artistry! The different colors of the bottle symbolize the mix of tequila inside- a rare blend of Clase Azul Plata - with clear and crisp notes - and an extraordinary expression of Clase Azul Ultra Anejo aged for 8 years! This edition of Ultra Anejo offers rich, dark, and complex notes due to the mixed aging process - a combination of reclaimed bourbon barrels and Pedro Ximenez sherry casks. This blend of tequilas and aging creates a surprisingly smooth taste that satisfies even the most discerning palate.

TITLE: Clase Azul Plata Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Clase Azul Plata is a fresh tasting blanco tequila produced from 100% organic blue weber agave. The agave is slow cooked in traditional brick ovens for 72 hours and then distilled using a proprietary yeast developed by our master distiller. Plata is not aged and the natural colors that come from the slow cooking are filtered out prior to bottling in a stunning crystal clear bottle with blue accent at its base.

TITLE: Clase Azul Reposado Tequila
DESCRIPTION: For many years, tequila connoisseurs have praised Clase Azul Reposado for its superior taste and stunning handmade decanter. By definition, reposado translates to ”rested” or ”calm” which can certainly influence the experience of sipping this particular Clase Azul which is aged in used American oak barrels for eight months after it has gone through the distillation process. Each bottle is made with high quality white ceramic and then hand painted by artisans in our bottling facility. Attention to detail comes second to none, which is evident when admiring what is considered an iconic bottle.

In addition, the fermentation process was extended to accentuate the liquid’s citrus and fruity notes. This blend was aged for eight months in two different first-use American whiskey casks, each imparting its distinct and rich tasting notes. The decanter is painted in a distinctive cobalt blue color. Inspired by dandelion seeds being carried by the wind, its feathered motifs embody Clase Azul México's worldwide expansion. Twenty-five brushstrokes that grace the surface of the decanter have been hand-painted in platinum, one for each year of Clase Azul's history.

TITLE: Claus Preisinger "Puszta Libre!"
DESCRIPTION: 70% Zweigelt, 30% St. Laurent Claus Preisinger was born in 1980 in Eisenstadt. After attending a viticultural high school in Klosterneuburg, he gained experience abroad working in Californian vineyards, and then as a winemaker with Hans & Anita Nittnaus for the next three years. He simultaneously introduced his own first wines in 2002. In 2004 he was accepted into the renowned “Pannobile” association of wineries, and then in 2006 he converted his vineyards to biodynamic winegrowing. Claus Preisinger has obtained several accolades and top scores from wine publications. He processes grapes from around 40 ha on the north shore of Lake Neusiedl. Claus has been using ambient yeasts since 2002 as well as little to no sulfites. The preisinger wines are certified biodynamic, which Claus takes very seriously. His commitment to the environment and non-interventional winemaking shines through in the superior wines he produces.

Made from peat-malted barley brought in from Scotland, this whiskey would be a single malt Scotch if Oregon were Scotland. Production is very limited because what distillery puts in the barrel doesn’t come out for years.

TITLE: Cleto Chiarli Enrico Cialdini Lambrusco Grasparossa di Castelvetro
Cleto Chiarli Lambrusco di Sorbara Fondatore
DESCRIPTION: Grapes are sourced from the vineyards located in Sorbara. Bright violets, strawberry, raspberry and mineral with some vinegar. Cleto Chiarli is the oldest producer of Lambrusco in Emilia-Romagna. The winery was founded in 1860 by Cleto Chiarli, a restaurateur, who was already producing his own Lambrusco for customers of his restaurant. Chiarli owns seven estates, six located in the Modena and one in the Colli Bolognesi, located in Bologna. The vineyards extend throughout the fertile alluvial soils of the river Secchiaon on the plane north of Modena. Lambrusco refers to a family of similar varieties that primarily grow in Emilia-Romagna. There are several clones and sub varieties, the most common being Sobara and the red stemmed Grasparossa. Sorbara is prized for its lightness and elegance, while Grasparossa is fuller and more powerful. The wines are produced using the Charmat process where a second fermentation is conducted in pressurized stainless steel tanks. For over a century, the Chiarli name has been considered a benchmark for traditional quality Lambrusco. Dry pasta, tortellini, boiled meat and the most typical dishes of the Emilian cuisine.

TITLE: Cleto Chiarli Pruno Nero Lambrusco Grasparossa di Castelvetro
DESCRIPTION: Best slightly chilled

TITLE: Cleto Chiarli Secco "Vecchia Modena " Lambrusco di Sorbara
