TITLE: Cliff Lede Winery Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: The fruit was hand-harvested in the cool, darkness of night and arrived at the winery at dawn. The grapes were then held in controlled conditions of low oxygen and cold temperatures. Approximately half of the fruit underwent gentle, whole-cluster pressing and the remainder was destemmed and experienced between six and twelve hours of skin contact prior to pressing. The juice was fermented in 44% stainless steel tanks, 49% French, mostly neutral, oak barrels, and 7% concrete eggs. All fermentations were conducted at cold temperatures to preserve the freshness of the fruit. Upon reaching dryness, the wine was aged on its lees and underwent daily or weekly battonage. Secondary fermentation was suppressed. Go Green. Sauvignon Blanc with its herbaceous notes pairs well with similar green herbs. If it has parsley, rosemary, basil, cilantro or mint, chances are Sauvignon Blanc will make a great pairing. Meat Pairings - White meats including Chicken, Pork Chop and Turkey. Fish including Tilapia, Sea Bass, Perch, Sole, Haddock, Trout, Cod, Redfish, Halibut, Snapper, Mussels, Crab, Lobster, and Clams. Spices and Herbs - Green herbs including Parsley, Basil, Mint, Tarragon, Thyme, Fennel, Dill, Chives, and Rosemary. Spices including White Pepper, Coriander, Fennel, Turmeric, and Saffron. Cheese Pairings - Look for softer more briny and sour cheeses like Goat’s milk cheese, Yogurt, and Creme fraiche. Vegetables & Vegetarian Fare - Saute green veggies or mix vegetables in more fatty vegetarian dishes so that the acidity of the wine shines through. Here are some example dishes for inspiration: Asparagus quiche, cucumber dill yogurt salad, green hummus, white bean casserole with zucchini and white lasagna.

TITLE: Clos de l'Amandaie Pays d'Oc Chat Pitre
DESCRIPTION: Philippe Petavy’s family has been making wine for 5 generations. In 2001, he and his wife Stephanie started Clos de l’Amandaie with 8 hectares of vines in the town of Aumelas, about 25 kilometers northwest of Montpellier. By 2008, they had grown to 15 hectares and were able to begin construction on a new winery that minimizes impact on the environment. The terroir of Aulmelas is key to the success of Clos de l’Amandaie’s wines. The landscape is nestled between the foothills of the Massif Central and the sea, benefiting from altitude as well as the sea’s cooling winds. Stony limestone soils, southern aspect, and winter pruning techniques bring concentration to the wines. Aumelas was once an almond basin and Clos de l’Amandaie takes its name from that regional history. Philippe and Stephanie have been committed to organic farming and winemaking since 2002. The vines are nourished with their own compost and are treated only with small amounts of copper and sulphur when necessary. The grapes are picked by hand and the fermentation proceeds at its own pace. Very low amounts of sulphur are added at bottling, gently stabilizing the wine but also allowing the terroir to be purely expressed.

TITLE: Clos De Los Siete Mendoza Argentina Michel Rolland
DESCRIPTION: Dense, dark-berry fruits, and notes of chocolate and spice make this iconic Malbec, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Syrah blend an intriguing and exceptional wine.

TITLE: Clos Fornelli Vinu di Scimia Vin de Corse Sciaccarellu
DESCRIPTION: The name of this cuvee is inspired by the Corsican expression “Pigliassi una scimia” which translates roughly into “to become a monkey” and means to get a little buzzed (the monkey being associated with the happy drunk). Made from young vines and in a fresh style, this wine is so pleasing that winemaker Josée Vanucci kept returning to this one special tank, eventually drawing a monkey on it and naming the cuvee Vinu di Scimia.

TITLE: Clos La Soleya Trepat Cava Rose
Clos Lapeyre Jurancon Sec
DESCRIPTION: Clos Lapeyre, owned by Jean-Bernard Larrieu and his family, is located on the steep slopes of the Pyrenees in Jurançon. Farming the land since World War 1, the Larrieu family grew peaches and raised cows, eventually planting vines in the 1960s. In the 1970s, the family replanted all the vines on terraces, thereby best taking advantage of the slope, aspect, and natural drainage of the land. Larrieu captures the uniqueness of the region in his wines by committing to native varieties Gros Manseng, Petit Manseng, and Corbu and by allowing spontaneous natural yeast fermentation. The decades spent tending the land through multiple generations show clearly in the direct and natural expressions of Clos Lapeyre wines.

TITLE: Clotilde Davenne Chablis
DESCRIPTION: Clotilde Davenne Chablis 2015 100% Chardonnay from 35+ year old vines in the village of Courgis. Pure Kimmeridgean soils. Hand harvested and fermented in stainless steel. 100% malolactic fermentation and 4 months on the fine lees. Clotilde Davenne built her domaine over the last 15 years after spending 16 years as the head oenologist for the prestigious house of Jean Marc Brocard. She practices organic farming, and uses some biodynamic practices.

TITLE: Clotilde Davenne Extra Brut Cremant de Bourgogne
DESCRIPTION: Independent vigneron Clotilde Davenne built her 8.5-hectare domaine in the Yonne, parcel by parcel over the last nine years, initially while simultaneously working as the chef oenologue for the prestigious Chablis house of Jean-Marc Brocard. Her dream had always been to have her "hands on" all aspects of the production and as a grower she is now fully integrated into the life of each of her wines, from bud break to bottle. The results are soulful, expressively vibrant wines that uniquely speak of the particularity of their origin. Many come from extremely old and deep-rooted, low-yielding vines, and viticulture is practiced with great respect for the environment and no filtration is used prior to bottling.

TITLE: Clyde May's 10 Year Old Cask Strength Aged in Kentucky Whiskey Limited Release
DESCRIPTION: In 1946, before the craft whiskey boom, Clyde May revolutionized the art of whiskey-making by crafting a unique style of whiskey that resulted in unparalleled smoothness and richness. Clyde May, the Alabama born and bred moonshiner, figured much on his own, including how to keep bourbon barrels hidden from the law. He liked to use big ol’ piles of sawdust to bury his prized barrels until they were ready to tap. Kind of happy accident then, but he learned that piling saw dust on the barrels helped the maturation process. In fact, while the booze stayed hidden, it got a little toastier and more flavorful along the way.

TITLE: Clyde May's 13 Year Old Cask Strength Aged in Kentucky Whiskey Limited Release

TITLE: Clyde May's Cask Strength 12 Year Old Alabama-Style Whiskey
Clyde May's Cask Strength 8 Year Old Alabama-Style Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: After serving in World War II, legend has it that Clyde May returned to his native Alabama to raise his eight children and tend to the farm that he had purchased before the war began. Like many farmers at the time, Clyde would distill the excess grains he harvested into corn whiskey — "branch-farming," he liked to call it. From the 1950s to the 1980s, May managed to produce nearly 300 gallons of whiskey a week just southeast of Montgomery in a still that he had designed and built himself. While much of May's whiskey was sold unaged, a portion of the whiskey he produced was aged in charred oak casks into which dried apples were dropped in order to enhance the flavor.

TITLE: Clyde May's Special Reserve 6 Years Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A select reserve of brand's special stock that is nonchill filtered and aged 6 years in American Oak Barrels. Incredibly balanced with a smooth long finish. You get a generous amount of orchard fruits on the nose and clove and spice on the palate.

TITLE: Clynelish 10 yrs Highland Hogshead 86 Proof Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
Clynelish 11 yrs Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Made in 2008 at Clynelish distillery, this Highland single malt has been matured in a pair of ex-bourbon barrels for a decade, before being bottled by Signatory Vintage in March 2019, as part of its Un-Chillfiltered Collection.

TITLE: Clynelish 14 Years Old Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The name and the history of Clynelish (the first syllabe rhymes with "wine" and the second with "leash") are closely associated to the adjucent distillery, Brora. It was built to augment the capaicity of the neighbouring, century-old Brora distillery, but eventually, demand proved insufficient to sustain both in production. Brora was eventually mothballed in 1983.

TITLE: Clynelish 1996 Prima & Ultima 26 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Clynelish 1996 Prima & Ultima 26 Years Old represents a unique and experimental approach from the revered Highland distillery. Curated by master blender Dr. Emma Walker, this edition is part of the Prima & Ultima range, showcasing some of the rarest whiskies in the world. This particular Clynelish comprises two experimental casks filled in 1996, both European oak butts, one seasoned with oloroso sherry and the other with sweeter Pedro Ximénez sherry. This combination has brought a rich sweetness and darker character to the Clynelish profile, enhancing its crisp charm. A limited edition with only 889 bottles available, this whisky is a tribute to innovation and a must-have for collectors and enthusiasts.

TITLE: Clynelish 20 yrs Highland 86 Proof Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The distillery was built in 1968, adjacent to the original Clynelish distillery which was closed. Confusingly the original distillery was reopened in May 1969 and until July 1973 produced a heavily peated whisky to supply for blending; this was done to cover a shortage of Islay whisky caused by a drought on the island (while taking the Manager's Tour of the distillery in September 2015, I was told that this was due to the Caol Ila distillery being re-built from scratch, and therefore to compensate the lack of Caol Ila for blending during a couple of years). The old distillery was renamed Brora Distillery and production of a peated spirit continued until 1983. 1998 pictured.

TITLE: Clynelish Hogshead 15 yrs Highland Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Clynelish Distillery, near the town of Brora in the Scottish Highlands, was built in 1967 to replace the old Clynelish Distillery now called the Brora Distillery. The wealthy and controversial 1st Duke of Sutherland built the original distillery in 1819. The new distillery was built just across the road from the original distillery. Being three times lager than before, Clynelish created an exact replica of the stills that were in the original distillery to make sure the spirit was as close to the original spirit produced as possible. Diageo currently owns the Clynelish Distillery. Clynelish Distillery has three wash stills and three spirit stills that produce around 4,500,000 liters a year. House Style: Seaweed, spicy. Best with a roast-beef sandwich. AGED: 15 years DISTILLED ON: February 18, 1998 BOTTLE ON: September 17, 2013 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 2463 ALC: 46%

TITLE: Clynelish Hogshead 16 yrs Highland 86 Proof Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky

TITLE: Coalition Cask Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This is a masterful blend of select, old Kentucky Bourbons, all at cask strength as the name indicates. Hand-bottled and released in very small batches – it is delicious and rare. It suggests fruit over the top of the rich syrup and spices tied in with earthy bittersweetness. On the palate, it is tangy, as smooth as butter, tart, and floral. The finish is mildly sweet with a prolonged cool, woodsy aroma.

TITLE: Coalition Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This expression comes from a very particular barrel of old Kentucky bourbon and is characterized as complex and delightful. It is marked by a hint of fruit over the top of vanilla, and sweet baking spices married with fresh oak. On the palate is an initial splash of tart caramel apple, immediately followed by hints of clean honey, freshly baked bread pudding, raisin, and vanilla. The finish is dry with a lingering tease of smoke, fresh fruit, and mint. 95 Proof.

TITLE: Coalition Straight Rye Whiskey Barrel Proof
DESCRIPTION: 100% Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey Barrel Proof is a powerful unique 5-year-old Rye. An estate product from Kentucky Artisan Distillery, located in Crestwood, Kentucky, is a rare 100 percent Rye mash bill. No other grains! This is a true and intense Rye whiskey, aged for five years, with the precious grain coming from just one mile away from the distillery and elaborated using the time-honored, handcrafting techniques, including zero automation and an all-copper pot still dating back to pre-Prohibition. 108.8 Proof.

TITLE: Coalition Straight Rye Whiskey Margaux Barriques
DESCRIPTION: A new bold entry into the traditional world of Rye Whiskey - the Coalition. An estate product from Kentucky Artisan Distillery, located in Crestwood, Kentucky, is a rare 100 percent Rye mash bill. No other grains! This true and intense Rye whiskey, aged for five years, was then peacefully resting in select Margaux Barriques (wine barrels) for another nine months. The subtle influence of smooth Margaux wine notes makes for a spirit with a fiery flavor that’s as full and rich as you have ever seen. The color is dark attractive deep garnet amber. Very elegant in the mouth, great backbone, and a long, pleasantly evolving finish. 90.8 Proof.

TITLE: Coalition Straight Rye Whiskey Pauillac Barriques
DESCRIPTION: A new bold entry into the traditional world of Rye Whiskey - the Coalition. An estate product from Kentucky Artisan Distillery, located in Crestwood, Kentucky, is a rare 100 percent Rye mash bill. No other grains! This true and intense Rye whiskey, aged for five years, was then peacefully resting in select Pauillac Barriques (wine barrels) for another nine months. The peppery Pauillac reinforces the Rye's spicy character and takes it to a new level of elegance and complexity. 92.6 Proof.

TITLE: Coalition Straight Rye Whiskey Sauternes Barriques
DESCRIPTION: A new bold entry into the traditional world of Rye Whiskey - the Coalition. An estate product from Kentucky Artisan Distillery, located in Crestwood, Kentucky, is a rare 100 percent Rye mash bill. No other grains! This true and intense Rye whiskey, aged for five years, was then peacefully resting in select Sauternes Barriques (wine barrels) for another nine months. 94.2 Proof.

TITLE: Cobrafire Eau De Vie De Raisin
DESCRIPTION: Distilled to proof, e-g no water added, from a blend of 50% Baco and 50% Folle Blanche grape varieties harvested in 2017, rested in a stainless steel tank for 3 months before bottling, the juice in this bottle is highly drinkable. No additives, no coloring, no sweetener. Pure, unadulterated, unaged distillate.

TITLE: Cobrafire Evil Force Cask Strength Brandy
DESCRIPTION: Cobrafire Evil Force is a blend of full-proof single casks aged between 6 and 20 years. Distilled from 100% Folle Blanche grape and bottles at 51.7% ABV with no additives. Folle Blanche is a finicky grape to grow but it creates one of the world's most elegant distillates. When aged carefully and with respect to the spirit, it produces truly stunning results. In keeping with the theme of the brand, this product is labeled simply as "Cask Strength Brandy", despite the fact that it is, indeed, Armagnac. With Cobrafire, the distiller prefers to focus less on labels and appellations and more on the juice inside the bottle and the humans behind the product.

TITLE: Cocchi Americano Bianco Aperitivo
DESCRIPTION: Cocchi Americano Bianco Aperitivo is an iconic aperitif wine from the Asti region of Piedmont, Italy. Crafted by the renowned Giulio Cocchi Spumanti distillery, it has remained true to its original 1891 recipe. This exquisite aperitif represents a unique blend of white wine and a small quantity of alcohol infused with a selection of herbs and spices, including gentian flowers, Artemisia, Cinchona, bitter orange peel, and elderflower. The result is a harmonious balance of flavors that has made it a staple in Asti since its inception

TITLE: Cocchi Americano Rosa Aperitivo
DESCRIPTION: Product information Throughout its history, the House of Cocchi has periodically produced alternate varieties of its Americano Aperitif Wine. Here the base is of two varietals unique to the region and more often used in sparkling wines, Brachetto d'Acqui and Malvasia di Castelnuovo Don Bosco, famous for imparting notes of white rose and summer berries. These are blended with herbs, fruit and spices, most notably gentian, cinchona and citrus. Enjoy on ice with soda or tonic and a slice of lemon. Producer information In the late nineteenth century, Giulio Cocchi, a creative and curious pastry chef from Florence, moved to Asti, a small but lively town in the north west of Italy not far from Turin. There he fell in love with the daughter of the town's beloved tavern owner, where Bar Cocchi pours to this day. In Piedmont he became engulfed in the local food and beverage culture, discovering that Asti was the capital of Moscato wines. As it turns out, Guilio was inherently talented in blending wines and herbs. In 1891 Giulio Cocchi opened his own business as a distiller and sparkling wine maker in Asti. He offered a range of unusual aromatized wines and some of the world's first bottle-fermented sparkling wines, including the now renowned Asti DOCG. Barolo Chinato, his Aperitivo Americano, and a number of now DOC vermouths quickly rose to be the cream of the crop. Today Cocchi is also synonymous with highly valued sparkling wines from Piemonte. Alta Langa DOCG is a rare appellation that Cocchi produces with a minimum of 60 months on yeasts. Cocchi Asti DOCG is considered one of the best available on the market

DESCRIPTION: In the late nineteenth century, Giulio Cocchi, a creative and curious pastry chef from Florence, moved to Asti, a small but lively town in the north west of Italy not far from Turin. TITLE: Codigo Ancestral Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: Staying true to their centuries-old traditions, Codigo 1530 partnered with a small village of artisanal families who have been quietly making the finest mezcals in the world. Single-village production / sourcing from the San Juan del Rio region of Oaxaca, Mexico.

TITLE: Codorniu Anna Reserva Cava Brut Rose
DESCRIPTION: Elegance and subtlety are the main characteristics, largely dueto being composed of around 70% of the most prestigious variety for making rosé sparkling wines: pinot noir. Anna Rosé is fresh, with cherry and strawberry tones and fine bubbles.

TITLE: Cognac Park 12 Year Borderies Mizunara Oak Cogmac
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the harmonious blend of East and West with Cognac Park Mizunara Cask - 12 Year Borderies. This 84-proof Cognac is aged for 12 years and finished in Mizunara oak casks from Japan. It offers a complex profile with hints of coconut, spice, and floral undertones. Crafted by Distillerie Tessendier, it's a unique expression that elevates the traditional Cognac experience, perfect for adventurous spirits enthusiasts.

TITLE: Cognac Park Extra Cognac
DESCRIPTION: Experience the pinnacle of craftsmanship with Cognac Park Extra. Aged for an impressive 30 years, this exquisite Cognac delivers profound complexity with notes of dried fruits, cocoa, and a lingering finish. Distilled by the esteemed Distillerie Tessendier and bottled at 80 proof, it's a testament to the rich heritage of Cognac production. Perfect for the most discerning palates, it's an indulgence that embodies luxury and refinement.

TITLE: Cognac Park Limited Edition 2004 Borderies Single Cask Mizunara Japanese Oak Cask Cognac
DESCRIPTION: Explore the innovative Cognac Park Mizunara Single Cask 2004 Borderies. Aged for 17 years and finished in rare Japanese Mizunara oak casks, this 84-proof Cognac offers a unique fusion of French and Japanese craftsmanship. Expect exotic notes of sandalwood, spice, and a velvety texture. Produced by Distillerie Tessendier, it's a limited-edition release that appeals to collectors and enthusiasts of exceptional spirits.

TITLE: Cognac Park Single Vineyard Borderies Cognac
DESCRIPTION: Discover the unique character of Cognac Park Single Vineyard Borderies. Sourced exclusively from the Borderies region—the smallest and most exclusive Cognac cru—this spirit offers delicate floral aromas and a smooth palate. Bottled at 80 proof, it reflects the terroir's distinctive qualities. Crafted by Distillerie Tessendier, it's an excellent choice for those seeking a refined and authentic Cognac experience.

TITLE: Cognac Park Traditional Reserve Cognac XO
DESCRIPTION: Immerse yourself in the luxury of Cognac Park XO Traditional Reserve. This exceptional Cognac, aged for 20 years, offers a symphony of flavors including vanilla, almond, and delicate floral notes. Produced by Distillerie Tessendier in the heart of Cognac, France, and bottled at 80 proof, it's the epitome of elegance and sophistication. Ideal for savoring neat or elevating premium cocktails, it's a must-have for any Cognac aficionado seeking the finest expressions.

TITLE: Cointreau Orange Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: Cointreau Distillery was set up in 1849 by Adolphe Cointreau, a confectioner, and his brother Edouard-Jean Cointreau. Their first success was with the cherry liqueur guignolet, but they found success when they blended sweet and bitter orange peels and pure alcohol from sugar beets. The first bottles of Cointreau were sold in 1875. An estimated 13 million bottles are sold each year, in more than 150 countries. Ninety percent of production is exported.

TITLE: Cointreau Orange Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: Cointreau Distillery was set up in 1849 by Adolphe Cointreau, a confectioner, and his brother Edouard-Jean Cointreau. TITLE: Col di Luna Prosecco Brut Flora
DESCRIPTION: This prosecco is brought to us by way of a project called FUSO, dreamed up by one of our favorite importers of Italian wines (Portovino) as a way to bring the everyday wines that usually don't leave the village all the way to your glass. Col di Luna is a family winery in the Treviso region, just north of Venice, specializing in local, native grapes.

TITLE: Col di Luna Veneto Flora Rosato
DESCRIPTION: Experience the vibrant allure of Col di Luna Veneto Flora Rosato. Crafted in the scenic Veneto region of Italy, this delightful rosé wine is a creation of the esteemed Col di Luna winery. Made from a blend of carefully selected grape varieties, Flora Rosato captures the essence of the Veneto terroir with its fresh and lively character. Perfect for any occasion, this wine is a true testament to the quality and craftsmanship of Col di Luna.

TITLE: Col di Manza di Ogliano Prosecco di Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore
DESCRIPTION: From the Veneto growing region in Italy, this wine is made from 100% Prosecco grapes. Ideal for sipping on a hot evening, during romantic meetings and with light meals or desserts.

TITLE: Collaboration Bourbon finished in American Brandy Barrels
DESCRIPTION: The Collaboration series is from Kentucky's Bardstown Bourbon Company, a project done in "collaboration" with Louisville brandy specialists Copper & Kings. Using 10 year old stocks of Bourbon distilled at MGP in Indiana, BBCo finished each of the whiskies for an additional 18 months in two different types of casks: American brandy and Muscat Mistelle. Made from 75% corn, 21% rye, and 4% malted barley, the Collabor&tion expression aged in Copper & Kings American brandy barrels is bottled at cask strength of 113 proof.

TITLE: Collaboration Bourbon finished in Muscat Mistelle Barrels
DESCRIPTION: The Collaboration series is from Kentucky's Bardstown Bourbon Company, a project done in "collaboration" with Louisville brandy specialists Copper & Kings. Using 10 year old stocks of Bourbon distilled at MGP in Indiana, BBCo finished each of the whiskies for an additional 18 months in two different types of casks: American brandy and Muscat Mistelle. Made from 75% corn, 21% rye, and 4% malted barley, the Collabor&tion expression is aged in Mistelle barrels.

TITLE: Collazzi Chianti Classico I Bastioni
DESCRIPTION: In 1933 Carlo Marchi bought I Collazzi, a beautiful 960 acre Tuscan estate designed by Michelangelo. With just under 50 acres planted to vine, the heart of the estate sits on the northern border of the Chianti Classico district. Villa Collazzi is currently run by three siblings from the Marchi family – Carlo Marchi, Grazia Marchi Gazzoni Frascara and Bona Marchi Frescobaldi. They grow Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Sangiovese and produce I Bastioni, a Chianti Classico and Collazzi, a Super Tuscan blend. Their first vintage was 1999. Bastioni is the best companion of tasty, earthy food. Pairs well with pasta dishes, even more elaborate ones, as well as entrees. At its best with grilled meats.

TITLE: Collective Arts Distilling Rhubarb & Hibiscus Gin
Collegiata Montepulciano d'Abruzzo
DESCRIPTION: Collegiata takes its name from the beautiful church in the town of Sant’Angelo in the region of Abruzzo. This line features wines from various regions of Italy, from Montepulciano d’Abruzzo and nearby Frascati to Pinot Grigio delle Venezie.

TITLE: ColleStefano Marche Litrozzo Bianco
DESCRIPTION: ColleStefano Marche Litrozzo Bianco enchants with its pale straw color and inviting aromas. It is a true reflection of the winery's dedication to producing exceptional wines that celebrate the uniqueness of Marche. ColleStefano Marche Litrozzo Bianco is a versatile wine that pairs beautifully with a variety of dishes. Its vibrant acidity and citrus flavors make it an excellent companion to seafood, particularly shellfish, grilled fish, or light pasta dishes with lemon-based sauces. It also complements fresh salads, soft cheeses, and vegetable-based appetizers. For a delightful combination, enjoy it with bruschetta topped with ripe tomatoes and basil, or a seafood risotto bursting with flavors. Let ColleStefano Marche Litrozzo Bianco transport you to the picturesque vineyards of Marche with its exceptional flavors and timeless elegance.

TITLE: Combel La Serre "Pur Fruit du Causse" Cahors
DESCRIPTION: This winery, run by Jean-Pierre & Julien Ilbert, is located 15 kilometers from Cahors, on the slopes of Cournou and Rassiels. Until 2001 they mostly sold their fruit to the local co-op, and then for 7 years had a contract with Matthieu Cosse at Cosse Maisonneuve. During the first few years of this arrangement, they continued to be a polyculture farm, but in 2005 they began to focus on viticulture and started bottling and selling their wines independently. In 2012 they began converting to organic viticulture, and were certified at end of 2013. They currently have 26 hectares, planted at a density of 4,500 vines per hectare; the clay and limestone soil imparts both complexity and finesse.

TITLE: Commanderie de la Bargemone Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence Rose
DESCRIPTION: One of the top estates in the Coteaux d'Aix, a small, fine-wine district within the larger appellation of Provence, Bargemone produces the top-selling rose at HPS. With more than 160 acres under vines, 2/3 of the production is dedicated to the dry rose for which Provence is famous. Founded by Templar knights in the 13th century, the property was named "Bargemone" after the wealthy Provencal family that owned it for 200 years. It passed from their hands in the 1800's, with the vineyards finally succumbing to phylloxera, ending, temporarily, a proud 800 year tradition of winemaking. In 1973, French industrialist Jean-Pierre Rozan purchased the property, restored the Commanderie and replanted the vineyards. Production was up to 50,000 cases/year when Jean-Pierre passed away in 2006, and a controlling interest in the vineyards and winery was sold to current owners Christian and Marina Garin (both from local Provencal families).

TITLE: Compania Elaboradora de Sotol Sotol Por Siempre
DESCRIPTION: Producer information Compania Elaboradora de Sotol, a 6th generation distillery, is proud to introduce Sotol Por Siempre to the United States. An authentic spirit of Mexico, not distilled from agave, but from the native Sotol or desert spoon it shares characteristic similarities to its cousins in spirit, Tequila and Mezcal.

TITLE: Companion Wine Co. "Chill Red" North Coast
DESCRIPTION: This is a blend of Merlot and Grenache on the lighter end-- perfect for a light chill.

TITLE: Companion Wine Co. "Riesling" Can
DESCRIPTION: Kick-ass, freshy-fresh dry Riesling in a can. Organic and dry-farmed, natural ferment, not filtered, low sulfur.

TITLE: Companion Wine Co. "Savvy B" Can
DESCRIPTION: From Gina Hildebrand of Lady of the Sunshine – Two-thirds organic Sauvignon Blanc from Talley Vineyard in Edna Valley; one-third biodynamically farmed Chardonnay from a neighboring vineyard that the winemaker Gina farms herself. This is sharp and crystalline, with high-toned citrus and a piercing minerality. Say the folks at Companion Wine Co.: “Maybe the best wine we have ever been a part of canning; will probably never happen again. We count ourselves super lucky to be working with Gina!”

TITLE: Companion Wine Co. 'Skin Contact' Pinot Gris Can
DESCRIPTION: The “Gris” in Pinot Gris refers to the color of the grape skins. After foot trodding, we let the juice rest on the skins for 3 days to gain a rosy color, lush texture, and for overall deliciousness.

TITLE: Companion Wine Co. Rose Monterey County
DESCRIPTION: A half bottle can of Rose from Monterey CA made by the talented Ryan Stirm. A portion of sales goes to help protect the endangered Coho salmon.

TITLE: Compass Box "Great King Street - Artist & Glasgow Blend" Scotch Whisky Set
DESCRIPTION: Set includes: 1x 375ml Compass Box Artist Blend 1x 375ml Compass Box Glasgow Blend We have suffused Artist Blend with fruitiness and texture, seeking out fragrant malt whiskies (approximately 55% of the recipe) from the Highlands of Scotland. By combining these with Lowland grain whiskies matured in first fill ex-Bourbon barrels, Artist Blend boasts a creaminess and lushness that makes it one of the most invigorating and pleasurable styles of Scotch whisky. Like Artist Blend, Glasgow Blend boasts a high single malt content. Inclusion of malt whisky matured in Oloroso Sherry-seasoned butts, and an Islay single malt of a powerfully peaty nature, has made this a blended Scotch whisky like no other.

TITLE: Compass Box "Menagerie" Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Whisky is full of life. Scotland especially is home to many different species of spirit, from heavy to light, fruity to smoky, and pungent to ethereal. Certain whiskies taste that little bit wilder than others, and we have brought together some of these strange and beautiful creatures to create our Menagerie. We have focused on parcels of malt whisky that in addition to their fruity or spicy charms have something animalic about them just beneath the surface. This is a whisky of mossy woods as opposed to floral meadows; Menagerie is what you put into the hipflask ahead of a Tuscan truffle hunt.

TITLE: Compass Box "Orchard House" Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: All-malt and quite the all-rounder, Orchard House features some of Scotland’s fruitiest whiskies. A livelyand fragrant sipper with a light oak influence, perfect for the home bar. Natural color. Not chill-filtered.

TITLE: Compass Box "The Circle" Limited Edition Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Rosey Mitchell is the 2018 winner of The Circle, our programme designed to inspire bartenders around the world. Rosey’s prize? To create a blend with Compass Box founder John Glaser and whiskymaker Jill Boyd. Rosey wanted to make an approachable whisky to be shared with friends, something for the daytime, a whisky with brightness. She called it “sunshine in a glass.”

TITLE: Compass Box "Vellichor" Limited Edition Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: ‘Vellichor’ is a new word and refers to the aromatic atmosphere within second-hand bookshops. For this project, we have combined complex and impressively mature whiskies from renowned distilleries, as well as parcels of blends that have been aged for many years in ex-Sherry butts, to encapsulate this unique fragrance.

TITLE: Compass Box 'Great King Street' Marrying Cask Finish Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Say hello to your next house blend. Great King Street was already one of our favorite blended whiskies, especially in the under $60 price range. This expression is finished in a single sherried marrying cask and selected by folks behind Momofuku restaurants. Sweet aromas of Marzipan, vanilla bean and a hint of red fruit open up to a palate that is silky smooth with just the right decadence. Only 606 bottles produced

TITLE: Compass Box Affinity A Blend Of Scotch Whisky and Calvados
DESCRIPTION: Sometimes in life, there are two things with a shared nature, a kinship. They are somehow meant to be together, despite apparent differences. Such is the case with Scotch whisky and Calvados. Scotland and Normandy are both northern European; they share a cool, maritime climate. While one grows principally cereals, and the other is known for its apples, these agricultural products have a long history of usage together, especially in baking which invited guys behind the Compass Box brand an opportunity for a new collaboration. They have been blending Calvados with Scotch whisky at home and in the blending room for years. The flavor combination is classic: apples and spice riffing off dried fruits and vanilla. When they were able to source Calvados of the right quality, and in enough quantities, the decision was made to share their private experiments with the world. We think you’ll agree that these two spirits really do have an Affinity for one another.

TITLE: Compass Box Art & Decadence Limited Edition Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Compass Box Art & Decadence is an opulent Blended Scotch Whisky that pays homage to the aesthetic and Decadent movements of the late 19th century. Crafted by lead whisky maker James Saxon, this is a rich and potent blend, ideal for dessert pairings and indulgent moments. The blend features malt whisky from Balmenach Distillery, finished in Madeira, Sauternes, and Marsala ex-wine casks, adding succulence, preserved fruit notes, and a honeyed character. It also includes malt whisky from the Linkwood Distillery, aged in Palo Cortado sherry-seasoned butts, and malt whisky from Glen Moray Distillery, finished in Oloroso sherry-seasoned butts. Grain whisky from the now-closed Port Dundas Distillery adds silk and gloss to the blend.

TITLE: Compass Box Artist Blend Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Compass Box Artist Blend is not just a whisky; it's an homage to the artistic heart of Edinburgh, celebrating its painters, authors, chefs, and visionaries. This blend captures the essence of Scotland's capital and the rich legacy of Scotch whisky. Ideal for the discerning malt aficionados, Artist Blend brings vibrancy to every sip. Bartenders and mixologists will also find it a versatile addition to their collection.

TITLE: Compass Box Crimson Casks Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Compass Box Crimson Casks Blended Malt Scotch Whisky is a vibrant and richly layered expression from the innovative Compass Box Whisky Company. Known for pushing the boundaries of whisky blending, Compass Box has crafted Crimson Casks using a selection of malt whiskies matured in first-fill ruby Port casks, giving the whisky its deep, crimson hue and complex flavor profile. Bottled at 92 proof (46% ABV), this blended malt offers a harmonious balance of rich fruit, warm spices, and subtle oak, making it a standout in the world of Scotch whisky. Crimson Casks is perfect for those who appreciate a bold, flavorful whisky with a unique twist.

TITLE: Compass Box Delilah's Limited Edition Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Founded in 1993 by Mike Miller, Delilah's is a legendary punk rock whisky bar nestled in the Lakeview neighborhood of Chicago. The bar stocks over 400 unique types of whiskey, and is said to be "one of the most important bars in the United States," according to whisky-expert Michael Jackson. "The idea of Delilah's was simple," explains Miller. "When I was in high school, I had three records and my buddy had two and my other buddy didn't have any. So we'd go to each others' houses and play each other our records and steal booze. Delilah's is an offshoot of that." Compass Box Delilah's Limited Edition Blended Scotch Whisky is a celebration of the eponymous bar's 20th anniversary. The whisky was developed jointly by Miller and John Glaser, the founder of Compass Box Whisky Co. and one of the most progressive and innovative blenders of his generation. The whisky is a blend of single malt whiskies sourced from the cities of Alness and Longmorn (this comprises approximately 50% of the blend) , together with a single grain whisky sourced from the city of Fife (this comprises the remainder of the blend). Once the whiskies were sourced, they were aged in a mix of experimental new American oak casks and rejuvenated American oak hogsheads. "Mike wanted a Scotch whisky that, in his words, "˜thinks it"˜s a Bourbon,'" says Glaser, "so we sourced some single malts aged in new American oak hogsheads, something that"˜s very hard to find in Scotland." After the whisky had matured, it was brought to proof before being bottled without the use of chill filtration (chill filtration removes the cloudiness that is natural to whisky, but also removes the fatty acids and esters which contribute to the whisky's overall flavor and complexity). Compass Box Delilah's Limited Edition Blended Scotch Whisky has an intense yet subtly complex aroma, with touches of dried fruits and cedar spices. The aroma gives way to notes of honeyed oak, and red fruits on the palate, which are well-balanced by a creamy vanilla undertone. The finish is smooth yet bold, with a sweet caramel flavor balancing notes of cinnamon and baking spices. Only 6,400 bottles of this craft Scotch whisky, which was bottled in July 2013, will ever be produced. Pick up a limited edition Scotch today!

TITLE: Compass Box Eleuthera Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Rich, smoky-peaty, yet beguilingly drinkable vatted malt whisky. For people who love the taste of smoky and peaty whiskies. 'Eleuthera' gives you something new in this oeuvre.

TITLE: Compass Box Extinct Blends Quartet  "Delos" Limited Edition Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The second release in the limited-edition Extinct Blends Quartet series. Delos takes its name from a Greek island said to be the birthplace of the god Apollo. To recreate Asyla's "vibrancy and soothing sweetness" in the new expression, Compass Box's whisky-making team delved into some of the older and rarer liquid from their stocks. The final blend of grain and malt whiskies includes spirit from the Glen Elgin, Imperial, and Miltonduff distilleries, all aged in American oak barrels. Only 5,520 bottles are made available worldwide. Its art label features a lute player first depicted on the original Asyla label, who has been reimagined in mosaic form and her flute replaced with a lyre, an instrument classically associated with Apollo.

TITLE: Compass Box Extinct Blends Quartet "Celestial" Limited Edition Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Compass Box's "Celestial" is the culmination of the Extinct Blends Quartet, an innovative series paying homage to the legendary scotch blends of the past. With a limited global release of 5,532 bottles, this blend was crafted under the guidance of Lead Whiskymaker James Saxon and stands as a modern reimagining of peated Scotch whiskies from the 1950s and 1960s. Its creation draws inspiration from whiskies distilled at notable distilleries such as Ardbeg, Caol Ila, Pulteney, and Glen Elgin, offering a bridge to the peated profiles that defined an era of whisky craftsmanship.

TITLE: Compass Box Extinct Blends Quartet "Metropolis" Limited Edition Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Scotch whisky bottles are like glimpses into history. Beyond just single malts, blends provide insights into the production techniques and values of Scotland's past. As Scotch continuously transforms, blends encapsulate these shifts and innovations. Trends evolve, and so do the blends. The blended whiskies from the 1970s, '80s, and '90s differ significantly from the contemporary ones, even if the brand remains unchanged. Our Extinct Blends Collection revives four cherished blended Scotches from days gone by, crafted from some of our most unique and treasured whisky reserves. Suitable for a premium online store dedicated to whiskey, wine, and other fine spirits.Introducing the third offering from the Extinct Blends Quartet: Metropolis. This blend invites you to traverse the vibrant heartbeat of a bustling city across different epochs. The origins of blended Scotch trace back to the urban hubs of Glasgow and Edinburgh, where it was crafted for global cityscapes. Today, the essence of blended Scotch still pulses within the city's walls.

TITLE: Compass Box Extinct Blends Quartet "Ultramarine"Limited Edition Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A limited-edition blended whisky from creative blender Compass Box, Ultramarine was bottled in July 2022 as the first release in the Extinct Blends Quartet, a collection of four whiskies that reimagine some of the most iconic blended whiskies of yesteryear. Embracing old-school sherry character and ethereal peatiness, Ultramarine combines malt whiskies from Caol Ila and Glendullan with grain whisky from Cameronbridge and Girvan, and more. Aromas of honey, polished oak, toffee, vanilla custard and rich peat smoke fill the nose, complemented by notes of roasted pecans, raisins, Chantilly cream, stewed apples, gingerbread, dried fruit, clove and rich smoke throughout the palate and lingering in the finish.

TITLE: Compass Box Flaming Heart Blended Scotch Whisky 750ml  #6
DESCRIPTION: Compass Box Flaming Heart is a limited edition blended malt Scotch whisky in its seventh iteration. Inspired by a rock song, it is imagined as 'Metallica with a backing orchestra.' This edition blends smoke-bomb malts from Laphroaig, Caol Ila, and Talisker, combining Highland malts aged for five years in toasted French oak casks. The result is a balanced yet bold blended whisky.

TITLE: Compass Box Flaming Heart Blended Scotch Whisky 1.75L  #6
DESCRIPTION: Compass Box Flaming Heart is a limited edition blended malt Scotch whisky in its seventh iteration. Inspired by a rock song, it is imagined as 'Metallica with a backing orchestra.' This edition blends smoke-bomb malts from Laphroaig, Caol Ila, and Talisker, combining Highland malts aged for five years in toasted French oak casks. The result is a balanced yet bold blended whisky.

TITLE: Compass Box Flaming Heart Blended Scotch Whisky 750ml  #7
DESCRIPTION: Compass Box Flaming Heart is a limited edition blended malt Scotch whisky in its seventh iteration. Inspired by a rock song, it is imagined as 'Metallica with a backing orchestra.' This edition blends smoke-bomb malts from Laphroaig, Caol Ila, and Talisker, combining Highland malts aged for five years in toasted French oak casks. The result is a balanced yet bold blended whisky.

TITLE: Compass Box Glasgow Blend Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Experience the rich aromas of sherry and smoke, reminiscent of the bustling streets of Glasgow. Historically, Glaswegians have shown a preference for fuller-bodied whiskies with robust flavors. This product pays homage to that legacy. Enjoy the profound taste and a dash of Glasgow's famed humor with our label, showcasing the city's iconic Wellington statue playfully adorned with a traffic cone. A true taste and sight of Glasgow in every bottle. Glasgow Blend boasts a high single malt content. The inclusion of malt whisky matured in Oloroso Sherry-seasoned butts and an Islay single malt of a powerfully peaty nature has made this a blended Scotch whisky like no other.

TITLE: Compass Box Hedonism 2024 Limited Annual Release Blended Grain Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Compass Box's Hedonism 2024 Limited Annual Release marks a significant chapter in the brand's history, celebrating the innovative spirit and artistry of blended grain Scotch whisky. Originating from the mind of John Glaser in 2000, Hedonism transformed the landscape of Scotch whisky with its pioneering approach to blending grain whiskies. This 2024 release, crafted under the expertise of Lead Whiskymaker James Saxon, is a testament to Compass Box's commitment to excellence and innovation. Utilizing the last of their stocks of grain whiskies distilled in the 1990s, this limited edition is characterized by a mature profile, with older whiskies (vs. the "standard" Hedonism) almost entirely aged in first-fill Bourbon barrels. The profile is also a tad sweeter compared to regular Hedonism expression, which is being phased out.

TITLE: Compass Box Hedonism Blended Grain Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Experience purity, sweetness, and mesmerizing textures with our selection of mature Scottish grain whiskies. When aged to perfection in premium American oak casks, these whiskies exude vanilla notes and finish with a rich pastry cream flavor - a testament to the finest whiskies worldwide. We proudly present to you... Hedonism. While Hedonism consistently boasts a lush, soft, and creamy profile, its composition varies annually. For detailed insights into the specific blend of your Hedonism bottle, refer to the unique code on the back label and check our product details section.This is a whisky that will appeal to both the ardent whisky enthusiast and newcomers to whisky alike.

TITLE: Compass Box Hedonism The Muse Blended Grain Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A limited edition version of Compass Box's excellent Hedonism, bottled to celebrate women in whisky – and that, for the first time, the company employs more women than men. The heart of this blended grain whisky is 'the muse cask', a butt discovered by Compass Box that contained unknown, pre-blended whiskies matching the quality and flavor profile of a Hedonism whisky. It is honeyed, spicy and fruity, with a notable presence of vanilla. Try pairing it with salted caramel. Hedonism was Compass Box's inaugural bottling in 2000 and is thought to have been the first whisky with a woman on the label. The lead blender on the project was Jill Boyd, Compass Box's first female whisky blender.

TITLE: Compass Box Juveniles Limited Edition Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Compass Box Juveniles Limited Edition is a unique blend of single malt whiskies from four distilleries, each contributing to the overall character of this Scotch. Inspired by and created in collaboration with Juveniles Bistrot à Vins in Paris, this whisky represents a shared passion for quality and provenance. It is a bright, smooth blend with no smoky notes and falls within the 12 to 15-year age range.

TITLE: Compass Box Kensington Wine Market 25th Anniversary Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Five years of discussions went into the creation of this product, the first collaboration between Compass Box and Kensington Wine Market. Inspired by Flaming Heart and some of Compass Box's elegant old blends the Compass Box KWM 25th Anniversary Blend is a very special creation! Bottled at 45% the whisky is from a mixture of old grains and both spicy and smoky malts. The components were matured in First-Fill American Oak, Sherry Butts, and French Oak.

TITLE: Compass Box Myths & Legends Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Scotch whisky has a rich array of stories, myths, and legends. However, what start as myths can become received wisdom, influencing our understanding, and restricting our enjoyment. Compass Boxx folks have deployed blending to challenge assumptions, biases, and prejudices concerning Scotch in this limited edition series called Myths & Legends.

TITLE: Compass Box Myths & Legends Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Scotch whisky has a rich array of stories, myths, and legends. However, what start as myths can become received wisdom, influencing our understanding, and restricting our enjoyment. Compass Boxx folks have deployed blending to challenge assumptions, biases, and prejudices concerning Scotch in this limited edition series called Myths & Legends.

TITLE: Compass Box Myths & Legends Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Scotch whisky has a rich array of stories, myths, and legends. However, what start as myths can become received wisdom, influencing our understanding, and restricting our enjoyment. Compass Boxx folks have deployed blending to challenge assumptions, biases, and prejudices concerning Scotch in this limited edition series called Myths & Legends.

TITLE: Compass Box No Name Limited Edition Blended Malt Scotch Whisky 1
DESCRIPTION: The third installment in Compass Box’s gothic exploration of smoke, or the whiskies that shall not be named, builds upon their bewitching sequence of distillery duets. Pairing Ardbeg with Caol Ila, then Caol Ila with Talisker, blender James Saxon invited Laphroaig and Bowmore to dance for No. 3, underpinned by the familiar Compass Box foundation malts. There’s a charming balance of sweetness and peat, as the hardy coastal smokiness of Laphroaig is quelled by the ripe tropical fruitiness of Bowmore. The mouthfeel is satisfyingly creamy, with orange fondant, chocolate, honey, and apricot flavors tightly bound together by tendrils of smoke.

TITLE: Compass Box No Name Limited Edition Blended Malt Scotch Whisky 2
DESCRIPTION: The third installment in Compass Box’s gothic exploration of smoke, or the whiskies that shall not be named, builds upon their bewitching sequence of distillery duets. Pairing Ardbeg with Caol Ila, then Caol Ila with Talisker, blender James Saxon invited Laphroaig and Bowmore to dance for No. 3, underpinned by the familiar Compass Box foundation malts. TITLE: Compass Box No Name Limited Edition Blended Malt Scotch Whisky 3
DESCRIPTION: The third installment in Compass Box’s gothic exploration of smoke, or the whiskies that shall not be named, builds upon their bewitching sequence of distillery duets.
