TITLE: Compass Box Peat Monster "Arcana" Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: For those who love big, rich, peaty, and smoky malt whiskies, this is your whiskey. Bottled at 46%, The Peat Monster combines extremely smoky malt whisky from Islay with medium-peated Highland whiskies to create a balanced and approachable monster, but a monster, nonetheless. Enjoy! TastingNotesChocolate, cinnamon, and boat tar appear on the nose while the palate is fruity and compellingly waxy. A dry smoky presence steadily builds.

TITLE: Compass Box Phenomenology Limited Edition Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Inspired by phenomenological thinking, folks behind Compass Box will not provide the typical recipe information including component whiskies or any description of the aromas and flavors of the whisky on the packaging and launch materials. Instead, in celebration of the subjectivity of whisky tasting, thy are inviting consumers to first experience the whisky for themselves without preconception. Company's owned brand channels – e-newsletter, website and social media – and the launch press release will announce that they are temporarily withholding the recipe information to encourage people to draw their own conclusions, but they will share it in later in the year (date TBC) once people around the world have had the chance to try the whisky.

TITLE: Compass Box Rivals Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This is a bespoke NAS (non-age statement) bottling released by Compass Box in 2017. Made in collaboration with 2 very well known, but competing distillers/retailers (one in New York and the other in Boston). The name comes from the natural rivalry between Boston and New York, and the whisky comes from a blend of Macallan, Teaninich, the now-closed Imperial distillery, and some of the French Oak-finished Highland malt blend that was featured in Compass Box’s Flaming Heart. It's an expression to show what can happen when ‘Rivals’ work together. The blend breaks down as such: 61.8% whisky from the Macallan distillery and 27.8% whisky from Imperial (a closed distillery) both of which are matured in first-fill ex-bourbon casks. Additionally, 8.5 % of the whisky is a Highland malt whisky aged in French oak and 1.9% whisky from the Teaninich distillery aged in sherry casks. This is a limited edition with only 690 bottles produced.

TITLE: Compass Box Rogues' Banquet Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Rogues' Banquet from Compass Box is a particularly flavorsome and generous blended Scotch whisky, made with a combination of malt whiskies from Miltonduff, Clynelish, and Glen Elgin, alongside grain whisky from North British. Good few references to previous Compass Box bottlings on the label, see if you can spot them all. One to share with friends when you get a chance to enjoy their esteemed company.

TITLE: Compass Box Signature Gift Set
DESCRIPTION: The Peat Monster: You will find peatier, smokier whiskies in Scotland. But you will find no whisky quite like this in terms of class and style. Blending peated single malt whiskies from different regions of Scotland creates a style that is unique in the world of Scotch whisky. You will find a spectrum of seaside and medicinal peatiness, along with kipper-like smokiness, all surrounding a core of fruity malt whisky character. THE PEAT MONSTER is a whisky for those who love intensity, flavor and freshness, balance, and drinkability. A whisky for those who appreciate the blending of seemingly dissonant elements to create something sublime. The Spice Tree: Et voila, THE SPICE TREE was resurrected – matured using a custom-made cask with French oak for the heads and American oak for the bodies. SPICE TREE is a rich, intense malt whisky redolent of baking spices and layered with toasty oak accents that complement the underlying distillery character. The Spaniard: 48% of the whiskies have been aged in ex-Sherry casks and 25% in ex-Spanish red wine casks. You will find a whisky that is full, soft and sumptuous on the palate with flavours of citrus peel and pears poached in red wine and spices. It’s a whisky ideal for late evening sipping or stirring into a cocktail.

TITLE: Compass Box Spice Tree Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Spice Tree is matured using a custom-made cask with French oak for the heads and American oak for the bodies. It is a rich, intense malt whisky redolent of baking spices and layered with toasty oak accents that complement the underlying distillery character.

TITLE: Compass Box The Bounty Hunter Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Comprised of both single malt(s) and single grain(s) often from many different distilleries; if scotch or Irish must be aged for at least three years in oak barrels; Irish may include single pot still whiskey in the blend. Part of Compass Box now defunct bespoke program. Only 369 total bottles were produced.

TITLE: Compass Box The Double Single Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: For Double Single, instead of using many tens of component whiskies distillery had used just two – one single grain whisky and one single malt whisky (hence the name). Both are beautiful liquids in their own right, but we believe they are elevated above the sum of their parts when combined in the correct proportions. Bottled at 46% Not Chill-Filtered Limited Edition release of 5,838 bottles worldwide. Bottled March 2017.

TITLE: Compass Box The Last Vatted Malt
DESCRIPTION: Compass Box The Last Vatted Malt is a historic release marking the end of an era in Scotch whisky terminology. Bottled just before the Scotch Whisky Regulations of 2009 came into effect, this expression is the last to be legally labeled as a "Vatted Malt," a term now replaced by "Blended Malt." This whisky is a blend of 78% 26-year-old Caol Ila whisky matured in American oak hogsheads and 22% 36-year-old Glenallachie whisky aged in a first-fill sherry butt.

TITLE: Compass Box The Peat Monster Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Since 2019, The Peat Monster has donned a revamped label, an homage to a design from Marc Burckhardt, initially used for their 10th-anniversary limited release. Every bottle of The Peat Monster sold from our store from 2019 onwards showcases this distinctive artwork. Recognized as the go-to whisky for enthusiasts of bold, smoky-peaty malts, the recent iteration of The Peat Monster is matured, offering a refined taste. Based on feedback from aficionados of smoky whiskies, the new label of The Peat Monster integrates single malts that exude an aromatic and sophisticated smokiness. While maintaining the iconic peaty intensity, this rendition introduces an unprecedented depth and elegance. Experience the evolution of a celebrated classic.

TITLE: Compass Box The Peat Monster Cask Strength Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Scottish Roots, American Evolution. In honor of its 20th anniversary and recognizing the American imprint on Scotch whisky, The Peat Monster revisits its origins. Originally crafted as "Monster" for the esteemed Goldstein family at Park Avenue Liquor Shop in New York City in 2003, its immense popularity led to its rebranding as The Peat Monster, which now holds a proud position in our main selection. A nod to American whiskey traditions, The Peat Monster's maturation process is enriched using casks from the US, each utilized just once. To highlight the art of American coopering even further, the brand has finished part of the whisky used for this special Limited Edition in seasoned virgin American oak barrels, made for them in Missouri.

TITLE: Compass Box The Spaniard Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Compass Box The Spaniard gets its name from the famous West Village Bar in New York City – The Spaniard. This very limited edition whisky (only 360 bottles produced!) was created in collaboration with Mikey McFerran, co-owner of The Spaniard and comes from a mixture of first-fill and refill American Oak barrels, sherry butt and new French Oak. As usual with all Compass Box expressions, it is non-chilled filtered and does not contain any coloring additives.

TITLE: Compass Box The Story Of the Spaniard Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A sumptuous malt whisky blend showcasing whiskies aged in Spanish wine casks. The name is a nod to our founder’s chance encounter with a man in the South of Spain, where he was introduced to Sherry for the first time. Years later, John was reacquainted with Sherry through whiskies aged in former Sherry casks, known for the rich, deep flavors they provide. It's a style of whisky John has been drawn to ever since. Natural color.Not chill-filtered.

TITLE: Compass Box The Tobias & The Angel Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Released February 2019, Compass Box Tobias & The Angel is a blended malt inspired by the brand's first blended malt (called vatted malt then), Eleuthera, which was retired in 2004. Like that whisky, Tobias & The Angel blends Clynelish and Caol Ila single malts together. The Clynelish is 24 years old having aged in American oak hogsheads. It is 50.9% of the blend. The remainder from Caol Ila is "considerably older" and it too aged in American oak hogsheads. Only 2634 bottles produced.

TITLE: Complémen'Terre Muscadet Sèvre-et-Maine La Croix Moriceau
DESCRIPTION: Manuel Landron and Marion Pescheux have been making wine for a little while, traveling the new world, helping Manu's dad, the legendary Jo Landron, in Muscadet, working in Montlouis with the Jousset's… They've been around, they know what they like, and they understand how to make it. Last year, Jo decided to give Manu about 1ha of his biodynamically farmed vineyards so they can get a start, and Complémen'Terre was created. There are 5 or 6 more hectares to come, and the goal is to establish Manu and Marion as serious Muscadet makers from the new generation. All vineyards are biodynamic certified, and much like his father, Manu's wines are supremely mineral, lively, and complex. 2013 is their first vintage, and we can't wait to see what these two have in store for the future! 100% Melon de Bourgogne. Intense, mineral-driven, racy, and richly textured. Notes of peach pit, quince, candied lemon, toasted almonds, star anise, and ocean sea salt with a roundness on the palate. MMelon de Bourgogne elon de Bourgogne

TITLE: Complices de Loire Jus de Gamay
DESCRIPTION: Beaujolais might be one of the greatest food pairing wines ever - if you know the secret. Wine writer Karen Macneil said it best: “Beaujolais is the only white wine that happens to be red.” What did she mean by that? If you treat Beaujolais as you would a white wine, by serving it slightly chilled, you bring out what the wines are famous for: bright acidity. This acidity makes the wine a natural for all sorts of food pairing, from yummy cheese to cured meat to seafood and poultry. But serve it too warm (i.e. room temperature) and you’ll get less acid and fruit, and more alcohol in the aromas.

TITLE: Comtesse Marion Chardonnay
DESCRIPTION: The Vic family is a family of fifth generation wine growers situated in a 13th century Château neighboring the Mediterranean Sea. Their guiding philosophy is simple: invest the majority of their time and energy working the vineyards to develop the best quality fruit from which their wines are produced. They farm using neither pesticides nor chemical fertilizers and use only fruit grown on the estate. The Chardonnay “Comtesse de Marion” is vinified in stainless steel, temperature-controlled tanks in order to preserve the aromas and flavors achieved with the family’s dedication and commitment to the vineyard work. To further preserve the wine’s freshness and liveliness, malolactic fermentation is blocked. The result is a wine both refreshing and pleasingly round in texture, a Chardonnay that displays an altogether high level of complexity, for not a very high price. Don’t miss this terrific value! Salads, cold shellfish dishes and grilled chicken topped with peach or mango salsa.

TITLE: Condes de Albarei Rias Baixas Albarino
DESCRIPTION: Founded in 1988 (the same year the D.O. Rias Baixas was officially granted its charter), Adega Condes de Albarei is equipped with the most advanced technological equipment available. In a region where the average producer yields less than 4,000 cases annually, this winery is not only one of the largest at approximately 90,000 cases, but considered among the highest quality-producers in the entire region. Albariño wines have a roundness and great level of acidity, which allows them to pair beautifully with a wide range of cuisines. While they are exceptional with fresh fish and seafood of all kinds, they are also delicious with chicken, pork and veal dishes as well as a variety of cheeses.

TITLE: Cono Sur Organic Cabernet Sauvignon/Syrah/Carmenere Red Blend
DESCRIPTION: This Cabernet Sauvignon, Carmenere, Syrah blend, made from organically grown grapes, bears the spirit of their estate workers, pedaling their way to the vineyards each day. This blend goes well with all kinds of red meats, pate, lamb and game. It’s also a great choice to serve next to stews, casseroles and legumes.

TITLE: Conquilla Cava Brut Rose
DESCRIPTION: All-estate fruit. Maceration on the skins for about 8 hours to achieve the desired hue. After primary fermentation, a long, slow secondary fermentation at low temperature followed by twelve month’s aging sur liein bottle before disgorgement.

TITLE: Conti di Buscareto Rose Brut
DESCRIPTION: Conti di Buscareto Rosé Brut is a sparkling rosé wine from the Marche region of Italy. It is made from 100% Lacrima di Morro d'Alba grapes, which are grown in vineyards located in the S. Amico area of the region.

TITLE: Contratto Metodo Classico Brut Millesimato
DESCRIPTION: 80% Pinot Noir and 20% Chardonnay, the Brut Millesimato is very dry, with just 5 g/lt residual sugar. All of the grapes are grown in the Oltrepo Pavese and harvested towards the last week of August. After aging on the lees for more than 3 years, the bottles are riddled by hand and a small amount of dosage is added at degorgement.

TITLE: Copper & Cask 5 year Old Collaboration Single Barrel Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Copper & Cask Spirits is an independent bottler focusing on single barrel selections and cask strength releases, which so far have been relatively limited in the marketplace. With the Breaking Bourbon crew, we had the opportunity to select from a range of single barrels, including bourbons of varying mashbills and ryes, so we figured why not? The barrels offered were all distilled at Ross & Squibb Distillery (you’re probably more familiar with their former name, MGP). We taste and reject a lot of single barrels. But because we taste so many barrels, we have been finding some great “MGP” barrels in the 5-6 year range from time to time. This particular lot of options had quite a range, but we were unanimously drawn to one barrel in particular. Despite being the highest proof of the bourbons, it erred much more heavily towards the sweet side with little to no heat, drinking closer to 100 proof than its stated 117.2. A rich caramel sweetness weaved its way in, with prominent caramel sweetness complemented by other sweet dessert notes on the palate. It was the one for sure.

TITLE: Copper & Cask 6 Years Old Straight Rye Whiskey Finished In Rum, Toasted Oak And Sherry Casks
DESCRIPTION: Dive into the exceptional world of Copper & Cask with Small Batch Series 005, a meticulously crafted, limited edition whiskey. This distinctive 6-Year Straight Rye Whiskey is the result of an innovative finishing process in rum, toasted oak, and sherry casks. Origin and Process: Originating from Indiana, this whiskey begins its journey in traditional oak barrels, aging for over five years. The adventure continues as it's transferred to a trio of casks—Caribbean rum, Oloroso Sherry, and newly toasted oak—each adding its unique signature to the final blend. Proof and Alcohol Content: At 121.2 proof and 60.6% alcohol by volume, Small Batch 005 delivers a robust and deeply satisfying experience. Limited Availability: With only 1,050 bottles released, this small-batch whiskey offers a rare opportunity to experience a truly unique and meticulously crafted spirit. Ideal for collectors and connoisseurs alike, each bottle is a testament to the art of whiskey-making. Add to Your Collection: Secure your bottle of Copper & Cask Small Batch 005 and revel in the craft and creativity of this limited release. It is perfect for those who appreciate a sophisticated, layered whiskey experience.

TITLE: Copper & Cask 7 Year Cigar Blend Batch 8 Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Copper & Cask Small Batch Series is a limited edition release crafted from handpicked single barrels. Small Batch 008 features a blend of 18 seven-year bourbon barrels distilled at MGP Indiana and aged in Kentucky. This expression includes both a 21% rye and a 36% high-rye mash bill, finished in a unique combination of Armagnac, Cognac, Oloroso Sherry, and Tawny Port casks. Bottled at barrel proof and non-chill filtered, it showcases an attractive red hue with rich plum aromas. The palate is decadent, featuring notes of brandied cherries and milk chocolate. Limited Release: Only 3,000 bottles are available. Elevate your whiskey collection with this exquisite bourbon!

TITLE: Copper & Cask 7 Year Double Oak Batch 7 Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Discover the Copper & Cask Small Batch Series, featuring limited edition releases crafted from a selection of standout single barrels. Small Batch 007 is a blend of 16 seven-year bourbon barrels distilled at MGP Indiana and aged in Kentucky. This unique batch incorporates both a 21% rye and a 36% high-rye mash bill, finished in a mix of new and used charred STR barrels. Bottled at barrel proof and non-chill filtered, this bourbon boasts a rich profile with notes of exploding fruit, vanilla, burnt sugar, and leather. Limited Release: Only 2,700 bottles run. Elevate your collection with this exceptional bourbon experience!

TITLE: Copper & Cask 7 Years Old "The Prime Barrel" Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #68
DESCRIPTION: Introducing Copper & Cask 7 Years Old "The Prime Barrel" Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey, an exquisite selection from The Prime Barrel Pick #68. This release is not just another bottle; it's a symphony of flavors and a masterpiece of artistry. Exclusive Release: This particular barrel was special, initially earmarked for the distiller's reserve collection. It's a testament to quality and rarity, and only after achieving specific incentives set up by the producer was this barrel released to our collection—a true privilege for us and, now, an extraordinary opportunity for you. Unique Bottle Art: Embracing the spirit of innovation, the bottle label showcases unique commissioned NFT art representing our exclusive club. It's a fusion of tradition and technology, a piece of art that extends beyond the bottle and into the digital realm. A conversation starter and a collector's delight. Barrel Info: Proof 109.2 Mashbill 95% Rye / 5% Malted Barley Finish: Double Oak Tasting Experience: Nose: A floral bouquet of pears, peaches, and honey welcomes you, offering an enticing promise of what's to come. It's an introduction that's fragrant and inviting. Palate: Sipping reveals more of the same beautiful notes, with honeysuckle making a strong appearance and a presence of gentle spice. Though a Double Oaked Rye, you'd hardly think it, as it's masterfully crafted to hit all the right notes without being overoaked. Finish: The finish is long, warm, and inviting. A perfect conclusion to a well-balanced rye that lingers on the palate in the most delightful way. Double Oaked Excellence: This 7-year-old rye is a Double Oaked Rye that genuinely delivers. The mastery behind this expression ensures just the right balance of oak, highlighting floral tones and avoiding the trap of overoaking. It's a delicate dance of flavors that delights and satisfies. Pairing Recommendations: Enjoy this rye whiskey neat to savor its complexity fully. It can also be a fine accompaniment to soft cheeses, fresh fruits, or a delicate dessert like a honey-infused panna cotta. Copper & Cask's 7 Years Old "The Prime Barrel" Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey is exclusive, rich in flavor, and unique. From its exclusive origin to its commissioned NFT art label, it is a bottle that tells a story and delivers a tasting experience that's as exceptional as it is memorable. Take advantage of the opportunity to own and enjoy a bottle that transcends the ordinary and raises the bar on what a rye whiskey can be.

TITLE: Copper & Cask 7 Years Old Barrel Master Selection Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Toasted Barrel and Rum Cask
DESCRIPTION: Introducing Copper & Cask 7 Years Old Barrel Master Selection Straight Bourbon WhiskeyFinished in Toasted Barrel and Rum Cask (the fantastic LP-363 barrel, now called DC-363, we tasted during our virtual tasting with the brand), an exquisite selection from a hugely slept-on producer. This expression was a top 2 expression during the recent virtual tasting with the brand. After the event, we kept getting questions as to if and when this would be available. Happy to announce that the time is now!

TITLE: Copper & Cask 9 Years Old "Lights Out" Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #114
DESCRIPTION: This MGP Indiana Single Barrel Selection is not just another bourbon—it’s a discovery that embodies the best of Indiana distillation and the bold influence of Florida aging. Distilled in May 2015 and bottled in August 2024, this expression has spent over nine years maturing, much of it in the intense climate of Florida, making it a standout in the world of premium single-barrel bourbons. The Discovery: While filming an episode of The Prime Barrel Academy YouTube series, our crew stumbled upon a gem during a power outage at the Copper & Cask warehouse. Exploring the warehouse, a few members came running back excitedly, holding a sample so dark it resembled motor oil. What they found was a barrel of the famed "Florida-aged MGP juice," known for its unparalleled depth and complexity. It was a unanimous decision—we had to have this barrel. Why Florida Matters: Florida's hot and humid climate accelerates the aging process, resulting in deeper oak extraction and bold, complex flavor profiles. Unlike traditional Kentucky aging, the high temperatures in Florida enhance the interaction between the whiskey and the wood, leading to an intense concentration of rich flavors and tannins. This process gives the bourbon characteristics similar to older, double-digit-aged counterparts from Kentucky, offering a unique and mature tasting experience at just 9 years old. Distillation and Aging: Mash Bill: 75% corn, 21% rye, 4% malted barley ABV: 63.7% Distillation: MGP Indiana, May 2015 Bottling: August 2024 Barrel Aging: The majority matured in Florida’s unique climate Special Release: This half of the barrel was bottled as a single barrel, while the other half was rebarreled to create DC-768 Double Oak. Tasting Notes: Nose: Decadent aromas of cocoa powder, crème brûlée, and sweet vanilla. Palate: Vibrant flavors of orange zest and cinnamon candies, followed by deep notes of plum and fig. Finish: Long, evolving finish with burnt sugar, vanilla, and a hint of black licorice. The Prime Barrel Experience: This is not just another MGP bourbon—it’s a rare find born out of passion and serendipity. The unique Florida aging process creates a profile that’s as dark and rich as its appearance, delivering a flavor experience you won’t forget. Whether you’re a seasoned bourbon lover or new to the world of premium whiskeys, this barrel offers something truly special. Don’t miss the chance to own a piece of this exceptional bourbon history.

TITLE: Copper & Cask 9 Years Old “TerRIFFic” Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in a Second Oak Cask The Prime Barrel Pick #115
DESCRIPTION: The DC-768 Double Oak Single Barrel Bourbon is an exceptional release that combines craftsmanship, unique finishing, and a bold flavor profile. Distilled at MGP Indiana in May 2015, this bourbon spent most of its life maturing in Florida's hot and humid climate, where the accelerated aging process allowed for deep oak extraction and rich flavors. In a unique twist, half of the original barrel (MF-768) was re-barreled into a secondary cask to create this distinct Double Oak expression. The Double Oak Experiment: After starting its life in the MF-768 barrel, we wanted to push the boundaries of flavor by finishing this exceptional bourbon in a secondary cask. But not just any cask would do. We selected an empty barrel from our one-of-a-kind charity release—a 9-year-old New Riff Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon. The results exceeded our expectations. We’re thrilled with how both expressions turned out, but we want you to be the judge. Try both and decide for yourself which is your favorite. Distillation and Aging: Mash Bill: 75% corn, 21% rye, 4% malted barley ABV: 63.7% Distillation: MGP Indiana, May 2015 Aging: Majority in Florida, finished in a secondary New Riff charity barrel Bottling: August 2024, just over 9 years of aging Tasting Notes: Nose: Rich aromas of orange creamsicle, butterscotch, and sweet vanilla create a warm and inviting bouquet. Palate: Creamy crème caramel and honeycomb ice cream dominate, followed by a pop of lemon peel and rock candy brightness. Finish: A long and satisfying finish with layers of maple syrup, leather, and a subtle hint of spiced oak. Florida’s Climate Advantage: Aging in Florida’s intense heat and humidity accelerates the interaction between whiskey and wood, creating a bolder, richer flavor profile. This unique environment imparts deep vanilla, dark fruit, and spice notes that rival bourbons aged much longer in traditional Kentucky warehouses. Limited Release: This Double Oak single barrel selection is a must-have for any serious bourbon collector. With its unique finishing in our exclusive New Riff charity barrel, it delivers a distinct flavor experience that stands out from the crowd. Don’t miss your chance—quantities are extremely limited.

TITLE: Copper & Cask 9 Years Small Batch 6 Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Discover the highly anticipated follow-up to the brand's inaugural Small Batch Series release, now the brand's most coveted offering. This exceptional whiskey originates from the same lot of 2015 MGP barrels aged in Florida. For SB001, they had 21 barrels, using over half to create an 8-year bourbon. The remaining 8 barrels were held back for further aging, reaching 9 years in May 2024. These carefully selected barrels were then married and batched for SB006. Due to the limited number of barrels and increased evaporation from extended aging, only 948 bottles were produced, making this the smallest and most exclusive small batch release to date. Experience the rich history and unparalleled craftsmanship of this unique 9-year bourbon, a true collector's gem. Key Features: Origin: 2015 MGP barrels aged in Florida Aging: 9 years (May 2024) Limited Edition: Only 948 bottles produced Batch: SB006, follow-up to the acclaimed SB001 Don't miss out on this exclusive release—secure your bottle today!

TITLE: Copper Fox Rye Whiskey
Copper Sky Distillery  5 Years Old Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Copper Sky Distillery 5 Years Old Bourbon Whiskey is a testament to the rich traditions and innovative spirit of Colorado distilling. Crafted with care and aged to perfection, this bourbon is made from a classic mashbill that highlights the best qualities of American whiskey. Each bottle embodies the passion and dedication of Copper Sky Distillery, delivering a smooth and satisfying drinking experience. Aged for 5 years in charred new American oak barrels, this bourbon develops a deep and complex flavor profile. At 90 proof, it offers a balanced and approachable taste that can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in your favorite cocktail. Copper Sky Distillery's commitment to quality and craftsmanship shines through in every sip.

TITLE: Copper Sky Distillery "Buzzed LIGHT year" 19 Year Old Single Barrel Light Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #96
DESCRIPTION: You may have heard of the light whiskey category, but not everyone knows what truly defines a light whiskey. Unlike its name might suggest, "light" whiskey doesn't refer to its alcohol content or calorie count. It’s a type of whiskey distilled to a high proof, between 160 and 190, which is significantly higher than bourbon's typical 100–125 proof. This process removes many congeners, leading to a lighter taste and reduced burn, often making it similar in character to grain neutral spirits (GNS) or vodka. Light whiskey is then aged in used or uncharred new oak barrels, and sometimes it isn’t barrel-aged at all. This unique aging process, coupled with the high distillation proof, imparts a subtle, mild flavor to the whiskey. Located in Longmont, Colorado, Copper Sky Distillery has built its reputation by sourcing diverse whiskies while nurturing its own stocks. One standout product has been its aged light whiskey. When the owner personally reached out to say, "I have something very special for you," it was a call to attention. The highlight was a 19-year-old light whiskey sourced from MGP, notably older than their usual 16-17 year offerings. It features a mashbill of 99% corn and 1% malted barley, and this particular selection is bottled at a staggering 154.1 proof, also known as "hazmat" proof. We blind-tasted three samples without knowledge of their age, mashbill, or proof. The revelation of its 154.1 proof astounded us, as it was far smoother than anticipated. The whiskey offers rich notes of corn and toasted butterscotch, exploding with fruity undertones on the palate. This light whiskey isn't just enjoyable—it's a conversation starter, perfect for sharing with friends!

TITLE: Copper Sky Distillery 5 Years Old Wheat Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The nose brings subtle caramel and vanilla notes, nestled under a soft oak layer. These notes come to life on the palate, paired with a hint of earthiness and greens. Rounding off the taste is a slight buttery mint that leaves you craving the next sip. 100 Proof

TITLE: Coppersea Distillery Hudson Valley Straight Rye Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bonticou Crag Straight Single Malt Rye is made from 100% Hudson Valley rye from our own and neighboring farms. We malt the rye ourselves, kiln it to a light toast, and mash in open-top wood fermenters. As with all Coppersea spirits, we distill twice in direct-fired alembic stills. Bonticou Crag takes its name from the peak overlooking our farm, and is an encapsulation of a late-19th C style New York whisky.

TITLE: Cora Cerasuolo d'Abruzzo Rose
Cora Pinot Grigio
DESCRIPTION: Cora Pinot Grigio is gently pressed then fermented for two weeks at cool temperatures (15°- 16° C) in stainless steel tanks. The wine is then bottled in screw-cap bottles in order to maintain its fresh, bright flavors. Pairs well with grilled meats and fish, caprese salad, and light pastas.

TITLE: Corazon Blanco Single Estate Tequila
Corner Creek 10 Year Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: First age stated expression from this brand (originally founded by a retired Stitzel Weller salesman). There’s a ton of flavor here to dissect and a leads to a delicious bourbon. It is very complex with a lot to unpack.

TITLE: Corner Creek Reserve Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Corner Creek Bourbon has always been a favorite of ours. It is one of those bourbons that doesn't seem to try to make you like it, and yet you can’t help yourself but enjoy it. After all, when the current trend in bourbon is to get fancier and fancier bottles, the guys at Corner Creek decided to just use a standard wine bottle for their bourbon. In fact, we've had multiple customers confuse it for an oddly colored wine at first glance. To us, that seems like a lack of pretension which we can appreciate.

TITLE: Corner Creek Reserve Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Corner Creek Bourbon has always been a favorite of ours. It is one of those bourbons that doesn't seem to try to make you like it, and yet you can’t help yourself but enjoy it. After all, when the current trend in bourbon is to get fancier and fancier bottles, the guys at Corner Creek decided to just use a standard wine bottle for their bourbon. In fact, we've had multiple customers confuse it for an oddly colored wine at first glance. To us, that seems like a lack of pretension which we can appreciate.

TITLE: Corner Creek Select Cask & Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Corner Creek searches for the elusive few great barrels of prime aged American whiskey, and offer it to you in this limited bottling. An exceptional marriage of the finest quality grains. Aged in American oak and smoothed to perfection with Kentucky Limestone water. Corner Creek is only lightly filtered so that it retains all its complex flavor and is bottled in as natural and pure a state as possible. Few other whiskies can claim this. This 90 proof whiskey was produced under the strict supervision of our Master Distiller at Corner Creek, Bardstown, Kentucky.

TITLE: Corralejo Reposado Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Rested for 2-3 months in charred ex bourbon barrels, the agave notes still shine.

TITLE: Corsair Ryemageddon Rye Whiskey
Corte Mainente Veneto Bianco Secco IGT
DESCRIPTION: Transport yourself to the sun-kissed vineyards of Veneto with Corte Mainente Veneto Bianco Secco IGT, a dry white wine that encapsulates the essence of Italian winemaking. Crafted by the esteemed Corte Mainente winery, this IGT wine is a harmonious blend that reflects the terroir of Veneto. Immerse yourself in the crispness and vibrancy of this Bianco Secco, perfect for moments of celebration or relaxation.

TITLE: Corti Brothers Good Honest Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Good Honest Whiskey is a sourced bourbon courtesy of nearby Amador Distillery, which uses a mash bill of 70 percent corn, 21 percent rye, and 9 percent malted barley. It was distilled in spring 2012, aged for four years in American white oak that initially held whiskey, and then finished in barrels that aged a singular Amador county wine, Harbor Mission Del Sol. It’s 92 proof.

TITLE: Corti Brothers Reserve Exquisite Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The follow-up to the wildly delicious 7-year Exquisite whiskey, the Reserve is a very similar idea. This joint venture between El Dorado Hill's Dry Diggings Distillery and the famous Corti Brothers has quickly become one of the whiskey world's darlings. The hybrid style stands out, in that they finish aged Kentucky or Indiana bourbon in incredible old Mission del Sol barrels. California's answer to Portuguese Madeira, this unique dessert wine is the perfect seasoning for a whiskey barrel. We don't always love wine barrel-finished bourbon, because bourbon is so delicious and complex on its own, but after 18 months in these special barrels, this whiskey is a delectable dessert in a bottle. Think big, rich, nutty notes with nuances of caramel and chocolate. It's not sweetened, but it feels like it might be on first nosing. A truly unique addition to the California whiskey scene.

TITLE: Cortijo Rioja Tinto
DESCRIPTION: Location, Soil, Climate: The fifteen vineyard parcels that go into the making of this great expression of Rioja Alta (Zone 3) are located in two distinct towns, Briones and Arenzana, both sited at approximately 568 meters elevation. In Briones, the soils are thin red clay and sandy limestone with small particles of thin clay. In Arenzana the soils are sandy with alluvial sediment. The climate conditions of this area are very beneficial to wine growing. The average temperature from April-October is 61.5ºF with 18.3 inches of yearly rainfall. The moderately warm days and cool nights of this Continental Atlantic climate forces the grapes to ripen slowly, resulting in wines that show brighter aromas and more fruit flavors. The fresh, pure character of 'Cortijo' Tinto makes this an extremely versatile wine to pair with food. This wine pairs well with white meats like pork and chicken and flaky fish like hake, cod or flounder. This has the fruit and acidity to match with red meats, as well.

TITLE: COS Frappato
DESCRIPTION: Embark on a journey to Sicily with COS Frappato, a captivating red wine meticulously crafted by the esteemed COS winery. This Frappato is a celebration of the indigenous grape variety, showcasing the distinctive terroir of Sicily and the artistry of traditional winemaking.

TITLE: Costador Terroirs Mediterranis Catalunya Metamorphika Macabeu Brisat
DESCRIPTION: From vines around 70 years old planted on 1.5 hectares of clay, stony and calcareous soils, the grapes are hand-harvested at the end of September, intensely sorted and then de-stemmed. Maceration lasts around eight weeks before spontaneous fermentation takes place in clay amphorae (300-2500L), using indigenous yeasts, for eight weeks under temperature control. The wine is then moved to used barrels (200-600L) and allowed to complete malolactic fermentation where it rests on lees for seven months, stirring every day in the beginning with inert gas until the wine is protected. Unfiltered.

TITLE: Costador Terroirs Mediterranis Conca de Barbera Metamorphika Trepat Amphorae
DESCRIPTION: From 100% Trepat vines aged around 60 years old, planted on 1ha of stony clay soils. The grapes are hand-harvested in mid-October and undergo very strict fruit sorting in the vineyard and at the cellar. All grapes are de-stemmed and whole berries are used. Fermentation takes place for 8 weeks (minimum) in 250L clay amphorae with temperature control; no pigeage or pumping, the cap is moved once a day and only by hand, and once fermentation is complete, a second maceration with the skins lasts three months or more (including the fermentation period). The amphorae are filled to the top and are kept closed with steel tops, fixed with epoxy resins. The wine spends seven months on lees with weekly battonage with inert gas to avoid oxidation or free SO2. The wine undergoes total malolactic fermentation. Aged in 250L clay amphorae for nine months. Not Filtered. The vineyard is has been worked organically for a long time but is currently under conversion for certification. Practicing Organic and Biodynamic

TITLE: Coup de Jus Dionysus Is On Fire
DESCRIPTION: Due to several years of tough harvests, the folks from Marnes Blanches started a side project, buying organic grapes from friends who make wine in other regions, and bottling them under the Coup de Jus label. Certified organic gamay, raised in old barrels and demi-muid.

TITLE: Coup de Jus Zeus Gone Wild
DESCRIPTION: Due to several years of tough harvests, Marnes Blanches started a side project, buying organic grapes from friends who make wine in other regions, and bottling them under the Coup de Jus label. This is certified organic grenache from the south.

TITLE: Courage & Conviction Cuvée Single Cask The Prime Barrel Pick
DESCRIPTION: Courage & Conviction Cuvée Single Cask is an American Single Malt whisky, aged a minimum of four years, made from 100% malted barley, and is matured in first-fill European red wine Cuvée casks. These casks undergo 'STR' treatment, meaning 'Shave, Toast, Re-char'. This process releases beautiful sugars and aromas from the wine casks, along with additional caramel, toffee, and vanilla flavors. As our blenders taste the progress of whisky aging in Cuvée casks, a few special discoveries are hand-selected and set aside. These extraordinary casks show a range of depth and complexity, maximizing the influence of the specialty Cuvée red wine cask and Virginia’s dynamic climate. This whisky showcases its natural color and is not chill-filtered. Barrel Info: Barrel# 2300 Age: 5.33 Years Proof: 118.4 What you can expect from this expression: Nose: Delicate and gentle, despite the proof Palate: Red berries, chocolate, walnut, cinnamon bubble gum (think Trident) Finish: Long and pleasant, with notes of mulled winter wine

TITLE: Cousino-Macul Isidora Sauvignon Gris
DESCRIPTION: Isidora Goyenechea was born in 1836 to a family of prominent silver miners in northern Chile. She married Luis Cousiño in 1855, with whom she had seven children. Luis died in 1873, leaving Isidora with the challenge of raising their family and becoming steward to a group of companies ranging from coal mining to winemaking. Isidora courageously took the reins of both family and business, becoming one of the leading figures of Chilean society during the second half of the nineteenth century. Isidora's role in Cousiño-Macul's history may well be compared to that of the great "champagne widows" like Veuve Clicquot, Louise Pommery and Elisabeth "Lili" Bollinger. Her contributions to philanthropy and the development of the arts have added to her reputation as an outstanding feminine figure in the history of Chile. In an effort to convey Isidora's elegance and strength, her name and personal crest have been selected as the signature elements for this new Sauvignon Gris label. A complex wine, citric and fresh with medium body that harmonizes quite well as an aperitif or with salads. Also a great accompaniment to seafood including crab, oysters, mussels or clams and all types of fish.

TITLE: Cragganmore 12 Years Old Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The aromatics leap from the glass filling the room with the sweet scents of malt, ripe orchard fruits, creme caramel, wild flower honey, banana bread with hints of oak and smoke. Perfectly balanced with a creamy texture that gives way to a complex spice.

TITLE: Cragganmore 20 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky 2020 Special Release Edition
DESCRIPTION: A Cragganmore of this age has never been released from the distillery, making this elusive malt a much anticipated expression. This small-batch release was patiently matured over 20 years in a mix that included new fresh-charred American oak casks. Part of the Diageo Special Releases 2020 range, this expression is highly-limited.

TITLE: Craigduff Sherry 33 yrs Highland Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Craigduff is an experimental peated whisky produced at the Glen Keith distillery. This was distilled on the 4th April 1973 before a 38 year maturation period in a single refill sherry butt (number 2517). Bottled on the 8th June 2011 by Signatory for their superb Cask Strength Collection, there are just 442 numbered bottles of this stuff, all at natural cask strength. Product pictured is 36yrs not 33yrs.

TITLE: Craigellachie 13 Year old Scotch Whisky Finished in Bas-Armagnac Casks
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 93, #20 on the Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 List Master blender Stephanie Macleod is at it again with this sumptuous sipper, which is soft, sweet, and lovely. On the nose, there’s apple pie, nutmeg, cinnamon stick, vanilla extract, and cookie dough wafting from the glass. There’s also a trace of earthiness, thanks to a clean grassy note and the slightest bit of salinity. The palate is well-spiced, honeyed, and full of vanilla sweetness, with some espresso and black pepper. A delightfully rich finish offers a mouthful of baked apples and lingering spice.

TITLE: Craigellachie 13 Years Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Deep gold colour; aromas of grain, hay, pear, baked apple, almonds and clove; full, smooth with warming alcohol and flavours of malt, pear and a slight smokiness on the finish.

TITLE: Crealto Agricolae Barbera d'Asti
DESCRIPTION: 100% Barbera from a clay and limestone-gypsum vineyard with 10 year old vines, densely planted at 5000 plants per hectare. Aged 8 months in stainless steel and 2-3 months in bottle. Excellent with meats and sausage.

TITLE: Crealto Marcaleone Grignolino
DESCRIPTION: 100% Grignolino from a 2 hectare vineyard of clay and limestone-gypsum soils, with a south/southwest exposure. The vines are 50 years old. Completely organic. Spontaneous fermentation in stainless steel tanks followed by an additional 8 months in tank and 2-3 months in bottle. Ideal with rich cured meats. The tannins melt away when paired with fatty prosciutto.

TITLE: Cream of Kentucky 11.5 Years Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Cream of Kentucky 11.5 Years Old is the first release from J.W. Rutledge Distillery, founded by former Four Roses master distiller Jim Rutledge. Construction on the distillery is expected to break ground in 2019, and when construction is completed, the distillery will produce straight bourbon and rye whiskey the “old-fashioned way”. In the meantime, Jim Rutledge is sourcing and blending whiskey from other distilleries to put out new releases under the J.W. Rutledge brands, starting with Cream of Kentucky, which is a blend of 60 barrels, rumored to be Barton sourced distillate of an unspecified mash bill.

TITLE: Cream of Kentucky 13 Years Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Jim has outdone himself with the 13-year-old release. This batch makes the Cream of Kentucky moniker speak for itself. Creamy is simply the best way to describe it. It tastes like a vanilla cream cheese frosting meets a pound cake laced with cinnamon and nutmeg

TITLE: Cream of Kentucky 16 ears Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Since the relaunch of the legendary Cream of Kentucky label in 2018 the brand has been met with rave reviews from industry professionals and whiskey fans alike. The wait for the next release is now over as a new offering is scheduled to hit the shelves this winter. Joining the Cream of Kentucky family is a 16-year Kentucky Straight Bourbon. The Cream of Kentucky brand was originally introduced in 1888 by I. Trager & Co. of Cincinnati, Ohio. Just before the end of Prohibition, the brand was acquired by the famed Schenley Company and subsequently re-introduced in 1934. During this era, the brand introduced the legendary tagline, "The Heart of theRun, " which perfectly encapsulated its commitment to delivering a bourbon with a "double rich" flavor. Through the 1930s and 1940s Cream of Kentucky grew to become one of the leading bourbon brands, with renowned artist Norman Rockwell providing much of the award-winning artwork for the brand during its heyday. Today, Cream of Kentucky continues to honor its storied past, embracing the enduring legacy of "The Heart of the Run" and the double-rich flavor that defines its character, now with the added distinction of its robust 116 proof.

TITLE: Cream of Kentucky 7.5 Year Single Barrel  Bottle in Bond Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Experience the exceptional Cream of Kentucky Single Barrel Bottled-in-Bond Rye, a Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey that has garnered acclaim since the brand's 2018 relaunch. Masterfully selected by distilling icon Jim Rutledge, this release features 16 hand-picked barrels of rye, aged 7.5 years, and boasts a 100 proof for a perfect sipping experience. Distilled, aged, and bottled at the renowned Kentucky Artisan Distillery in Crestwood, this whiskey uses estate-grown Ryman rye grain, ensuring quality and authenticity. CEO Stephen Camisa of Craftsman Brands highlights the meticulous selection process, resulting in a special single-barrel offering that allows connoisseurs to savor the distinct character of each barrel. This Cream of Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey offers a rich tasting journey, beginning with a nose of red fruit and orange, transitioning to a mid-palate of vanilla, tropical fruit, and crème brulée, and finishing with a creamy mouthfeel and hints of spearmint. Limited in release, this edition of Cream of Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey is a treasure for whiskey enthusiasts, offering a unique sensory exploration in every sip

TITLE: Cream of Kentucky Bottled in Bond 6 Year Old Kentucky Straight Rye
DESCRIPTION: This unique, bottled in bond whiskey, with its roots tracing back to 1888 and a revival in 1934, has been elevated under the guidance of distilling expert Jim Rutledge. Cream of Kentucky, known for its limited availability, offers a distinctive six-year, 100-proof straight rye whiskey experience. Carefully selected by Jim Rutledge, it features a complex aroma profile, including spearmint, cinnamon, brown sugar, black pepper, floral fruitiness, and a hint of pipe tobacco. The tasting experience is rounded off with a mellow and medium-long finish, highlighting notes of black pepper, cayenne, and a subtle touch of raisin.

TITLE: Cream of Kentucky Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Originally introduced in 1888 by I. Trager & Co. and later revitalized in 1934 by the legendary Schenley Company, Cream of Kentucky quickly became one of America’s leading bourbon brands. Known for its iconic tagline, “The Heart of the Run,” and double-rich flavor, Cream of Kentucky was a favorite throughout the 1930s and 1940s, with celebrated artist Norman Rockwell even providing artwork for the brand. Crafted under the guidance of Master Distiller Jim Rutledge, the Summer 2024 release of Cream of Kentucky embodies the pinnacle of bourbon artistry. This Cask Strength expression preserves the full-bodied “double-rich” flavor that made Cream of Kentucky a household name, balancing intensity with deep, layered character. This release offers bourbon enthusiasts a rare blend of tradition, quality, and unmatched depth. Secure your bottle of Cream of Kentucky's Summer 2024 Cask Strength to experience an authentic piece of bourbon history.

TITLE: Cream of Kentucky Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1888 by I. Trager & Co., Cream of Kentucky became one of America's favorite bourbon brands, famous for its “double-rich” flavor and distinctive tagline, “The Heart of the Run.” After the Prohibition era, the renowned Schenley Company acquired the brand, reintroducing it in 1934 with marketing illustrations by the iconic artist Norman Rockwell. Through the 1930s and 1940s, Cream of Kentucky earned its place as a leading bourbon. The Summer 2024 release, crafted under the expertise of Master Distiller Jim Rutledge, preserves the legacy with a Small Batch bottling that promises the same double-rich flavor that made Cream of Kentucky legendary. With a smooth, deep character that honors tradition, this limited Small Batch bourbon is an essential addition for collectors and enthusiasts seeking a taste of classic American craftsmanship.

TITLE: Crios Malbec
DESCRIPTION: Umami lover. Unlike Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec doesn’t have a super long finish. Because of this, Malbec is great with leaner red meats (ostrich anyone?). The wine does extremely well with funky flavors like blue cheese and rustic flavors like mushrooms and cumin spice. Perfect Malbec Food Pairing: Black pepper buffalo burgers with blue cheese mushrooms and rosemary infused garlic kale chips.

TITLE: Crnko Jarenincan
DESCRIPTION: A fun field blend dominated by Mller Thurgau and Laski Rizling. Refreshing for easy quaffing, with lime and tangerine zest, lifted by lemon verbena. The components meld together, amplifying fish, salads with salty cheese, and baked appetizers

TITLE: Crosby California Merlot
DESCRIPTION: Crosby is a custom label that was created to bring varietal & vintage correct expressions to the market at reasonable prices. The wines of Crosby are often crafted from declassified grapes that otherwise would have created a wine that cost considerably more money. Crosby wines are all about great quality at a value price. With the help of experienced vineyard managers and grape growers from around California, best sources for Merlot and Cabernet are sought out in each vintage with highest level of standards in mind, to bring the best value into the market from California. Farming: sustainable Fermentation: Stainless Steel, neutral barrel Aging: 4 months Soil: Sand and loam Vine Age: variable Yeast: cultured Fined: none Filtered: light

TITLE: Crown Royal 18 Years Extra Rare Blended Canadian Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A rare blend of 3 of Crown Royal's most exceptional whiskies aged at least 18 years. Enticing notes of vanilla & stone fruit greet you on the nose, followed by the velvety body of light oak tempered by caramel spice. Delicate notes of nougat linger in the full-bodied finish.

TITLE: Crown Royal Limited Edition Blackberry Flavored Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Crown Royal Blackberry is a limited edition release that combines the well-known smoothness of Crown Royal whiskies with blackberries' rich, natural flavor. It was introduced as part of a unique lineup intended for crafting delicious cocktails like the Royal Blackberry Lemonade and Blackberry Bramble. This release offers a fresh take on traditional whiskey, appealing to those who enjoy flavored spirits.

TITLE: Crown Royal Limited Edition Canadian Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Crown Royal Limited Edition Canadian Whisky is majestically blended with select batch-distilled whiskies to create an exceptionally smooth and rich taste. The whiskies are extra-aged to perfection, ensuring the highest quality and a unique blend with more body, smoothness, and complexity. Exclusively available in Canada, Crown Royal Limited Edition is an exquisite example of the blender's craft.

TITLE: Crown Royal Noble Collection 16 Year Canadian Rye Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The first exquisite blend of Crown Royal Canadian whisky was meticulously crafted from 50 select whiskies, dressed in the finest cut glass and wrapped in purple robes, to commemorate the first grand tour of Canada by King George VI and Queen Elizabeth, in 1939. And in truly noble fashion, this bottle of Crown Royal was placed on the Royal train as a symbol of the hardworking and genuine nature of the Canadian people. Today, the legacy of Crown Royal remains how it began, the epitome of Canadian whisky, with a smooth taste and a regal style all its own.

TITLE: Crown Royal Noble Collection Barley Edition Canadian Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Crown Royal introduces the Noble Collection Barley Edition, a testament to the rich heritage and craftsmanship of Canadian Whisky. Distilled at the esteemed Crown Royal Distillery, this special edition highlights the brand's commitment to innovation and quality. This treasure is part of the illustrious Noble Collection, encased in a signature Crown Royal bottle. Renowned for its meticulous production process and exceptional blend, this whisky celebrates barley's subtle essence, offering a unique experience for connoisseurs and enthusiasts. Mashbill is 100% Barley (85% unmalted, 15% malted)

TITLE: Crown Royal Northern Harvest Rye Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Canada produces some of the best rye grains in the world thanks to its distinctive climate and Crown Royal selects the best of the best. All Crown Royal grains are certified by the #1 Canadian Western. Canadian rye grain is planted in the fall, sprouting until it’s covered by a blanket of soft winter snow. Once this snow melts, the rye completes its growth, maturing over the spring and summer. This distinctive growth cycle creates the perfect grain for a deliciously balanced whisky, extraordinarily smooth with hints of fruit, cloves and spice. 90% rye whisky. The same rye that is used to make Crown Royal DeLuxe. 45% ABV (90 proof) for more cut through in classic cocktails.

TITLE: Crown Royal Whisky Lemonade
DESCRIPTION: Crown Royal Whisky Lemonade is a refreshing and convenient ready-to-drink cocktail that combines the premium quality of Crown Royal Whisky with the zesty flavor of lemonade. Crafted by the renowned Crown Royal Distillery in Manitoba, Canada, this canned cocktail offers a perfectly balanced blend of smooth whisky and tangy lemonade, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a sophisticated yet easy-to-enjoy beverage. Whether you're relaxing at home, hosting a gathering, or on the go, Crown Royal Whisky Lemonade delivers a delicious and satisfying drink experience.

TITLE: Crown Royal Winter Wheat Blended Canadian Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The sixth expression in the Crown Royal Noble Collection, Crown Royal Winter Wheat Blended Canadian Whisky is remarkably smooth and delicious, and hand-selected from our Crown Royal reserve stock, revealing its noble roots with every sip. Winter Wheat is a rare whisky distilled from a unique mash bill of 51 percent hearty red winter wheat, 39 percent corn, and 10 percent barley specifically selected to produce an exceptional liquid. Carefully crafted for a one-of-a-kind experience and aged in charred American white oak barrels, Winter Wheat brings to life the complexity of flavors. This whisky is light-bodied and sweet up front with a nose of praline, banana bread, and toasted oak, followed by hints of creamy bread pudding and toffee on the palate. Light buttery notes bring in the finish, which is smooth and mildly warm; while lingering hints of cinnamon and toasted oak reveal themselves. Includes one 90 proof 750 mL bottle of Crown Royal Noble Collection Winter Wheat Blended Canadian Whisky.

TITLE: Crown Royal XR
DESCRIPTION: Crown Royal XR (Extra Rare) was introduced in 2006 in the US by allocation and the Canadian market (initially, only in Ontario and Alberta). Available in Quebec since January 2008. This limited-release special blend of Crown Royal is from the LaSalle distillery.

TITLE: Cruse Wine Company Cruse Tradition Sparkling Wine
DESCRIPTION: Zero dosage and made in the traditional method, this bottle is a snapshot of California in bubbles. A blend of 85% Chardonnay and 15% Pinot Noir sourced from distinctive and engaging vineyards from Santa Barbara County (29%), Mendocino County (14%), and the Sierra Foothills (56%).

TITLE: Cruse Wine Company Deming Vineyard Valdiguie Petillant Naturel
DESCRIPTION: Juice is single pressed to tank. Bottled at 20-25 grams of sugar. Fermention finishes in bottle after about one month. The wine rests in bottle for 6 months before disgorgement.

TITLE: Cruse Wine Company St. Laurent Petillant Naturel
DESCRIPTION: This Austrian variety has been grown by Dale Ricci, a longtime family friend of Michael Cruse, for about 15 years. Ricci vineyards is on the Sonoma half of Carneros and only a few miles from the San Pablo Bay. The grapes, after a few days of carbonic maceration, were gently pressed, fermented in a concrete egg, then finished fermentation in bottle. The bottles were then riddled, disgorged, topped up, and sealed by hand. This is pure fermented grape juice without any addition of sulfites, acids, sugar, or yeast.

TITLE: Cruz de Fuego Espadin Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: Cruz de Fuego Espadin is produced by Margarita Blas in Santiago Matatlan using agave Espadin. Her mezcal is traditionally produced using an underground stone horno, tahona, and copper stills. Cruz de Fuego Mezcal is operated by the mother-son duo Margarita Blas and Carlos Mendez Blas. They both live and work in Santiago Matatlan, Oaxaca and use a distillery that has copper stills. They both work out of the same palenque and follow similar traditional techniques in their mezcal production.

TITLE: Cueva De Lobos Rioja Tempranillo Joven Tinto
Cusumano Nero D'Avola Sicilia IGT
Cutty Sark 33 Years Old Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Named "Art Deco" this 33 year-old limited edition release came about as Cutty Sark continue to explore the rich history, heritage and origin of their brand. This release specifically focused on the exciting Art Deco period of the 1920s and early 1930s is the oldest whisky the brand has released. Celebrating a time when Cutty Sark found its way into America and "flourished within the emerging cocktail culture and changed the face of Scotch whisky forever". Released in 2014, this impressive release of Cutty Sark was aged for 33 years and presented in a striking Art Deco style bottle, label and case, along with two branded tumblers. The Cutty Sark blend was devised in 1923 by Berry Brothers & Rudd, the esteemed London wine-merchant. This was blended and bottled by Edrington, who owned the brand between 2010 and 2018, when they sold it on to La Martinquaise.

TITLE: Cuvee de L'Aubade Cotes De Provence Rose
CVNE Monopole Rioja Blanco
DESCRIPTION: CVNE is one of the most important wine producers of Spain, on account of its illustrious history, and its omnipresence in the contemporary Spanish wine scene. Founded by the Real de Asua brothers in 1879, it remains family-owned and family-run, with the latest generation committed more than ever to making great wine in meaningful quantities. The 3 company wineries perfectly symbolize the 3 essential principles that have always characterised the CVNE philosophy : the respect of heritage evident at the historic Haro bodegas; the embrace of new technology and innovation in the James Bond-inspired Viña Real facility; and the valorization of terroir that is Contino, Rioja's most magical vineyard site transformed into truly magical wines. Pairs well with crudite, yogurt and garlic dips. Great with tapas, stuffed mushroom caps, grilled peppers and grilled fish.

TITLE: Cynar Ricetta Originale
Cyrus Noble Small Batch Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Cyrus Noble was first crafted in 1871 and soon became the spirit of choice for miners trying to strike it rich during the San Francisco gold rush. The popularity of this whiskey soon had it in every miner’s saloon, upscale home, and bar - a fixture on the Western front. Haas Bothers of San Francisco, a retailer who’s been around 160 years and the major grocer that first put Cyrus Noble into the hands of its customers, is keeping the tradition of the 140 year recipe.

TITLE: D'Arenberg "The Stump Jump" Red Blend McLaren Vale
D'Orsaria Pinot Grigio
DESCRIPTION: Tenacious and strong-willed as the bears (orso) the family takes its name from, the Orsaria family has been crafting fine wines from the alluvial soil of the Colli Orientali Friuli, far in the eastern reaches of Italy. The bears have since moved on, as the woods they inhabited have been cleared for viticulture. The Orsarias work with both native and international varieties (notably Cabernet Franc) on their estate. The Colli Orientali del Friuli is the cooler half of the greater Friuli wine country, some which stretches into neighboring Slovenia. Farther inland, the Colli Orientali was once a rising seabed, and the marl and sandstone deposits here make excellent vineyard sites. Great with pasta, grilled fish and white meats

TITLE: d'Usse VSOP Cognac
DESCRIPTION: D'Usse Cognac is masterfully crafted at the prestigious Chateau de Cognac, one of the oldest cognac houses in France. It has a 200-year legacy in blending some of the world’s finest spirits. The Chateau’s proximity to the River Charente results in two climates within its walls: a humid cellar that results in fruity, floral notes, and a dry cellar that brings out the woody, spicy flavors of the cognac. Blending the two eaux-de-vie results in the boldness of character in D'Usse Cognac.

TITLE: d'Usse VSOP Cognac
DESCRIPTION: D'Usse Cognac is masterfully crafted at the prestigious Chateau de Cognac, one of the oldest cognac houses in France. It has a 200-year legacy in blending some of the world’s finest spirits. The Chateau’s proximity to the River Charente results in two climates within its walls: a humid cellar that results in fruity, floral notes, and a dry cellar that brings out the woody, spicy flavors of the cognac. TITLE: d'Usse XO Cognac
DESCRIPTION: D'Usse XO Cognac is handcrafted at the Chateau de Cognac SAS in France, renowned for composing fine cognacs for more than 200 years. Maître de Chai Michel Casavecchia meticulously hand-selects his finest eaux-de-vie, which are aged 10 years or more, to craft the unique blend of d'Usse XO Cognac. This uncompromising cognac delivers complex flavor notes of ripe blackberry and apricot, layered with hints of dark chocolate and walnut, culminating in an exceptionally balanced finish.

TITLE: Da Mar Prosecco
DESCRIPTION: Sustainable. 100% Glera. Extra Dry. Sourced 100% from estate vineyards planted on sedimentary, gravelly-pebbly soils that are worked with no herbicides. The clusters are gently pressed at low pressure and the must is settled in stainless steel. Fermentation in stainless steel at low temperatures and secondary fermentation by Charmat method (fermentation in tank).

TITLE: Dad's Hat Bottled In Bond Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The spirit presents sweet grain, cut grass, minty herbs, and vanilla carame notes. Rich balance through the entire mouth. Very low heat for 100 proof. Black and white pepper on the tip, dry cinnamon center, and malt edges. Graham cracker, mint, and mild orchard fruit dissolve into dark cocoa powder, black cherry, and a long, smooth, oily finish. Mashbill: 80% Rye, 5% Malted Rye, 15% Malted Barley Cooperage: McGuiness in Missouri

TITLE: Dad's Hat Pennsylvania Rye Whiskey 90 Proof
DESCRIPTION: The classic rye recipe features only rye grain and malt to deliver a pure expression of Pennsylvania Rye Whiskey. Barrel aging for at least six months in charred, new oak quarter casks allows the genuine rye flavor to evolve quickly. As a result, the small batch whiskey is ensured to reach the right balance of complexity and smoothness. The final product is a smooth spirit that delivers the up-front spice that rye is known for a while finishing with a full, round mouthfeel. Mashbill: 80% Rye, 5% Malted Rye, 15% Malted Barley Cooperage: McGuiness in Missouri Char Level: Aged in 15-gallon Char 4 barrel

TITLE: Dad's Hat Pennsylvania Rye Whiskey Maple Cask Finished
DESCRIPTION: The brand takes their used whiskey barrels, fills them with delicious maple syrup sourced from Somerset County, Pennsylvania, and allows that maple syrup to rest in those barrels for several months – picking up the wonderful essence of the whiskey flavor. In turn, these wooden barrels become saturated with the flavor of maple syrup. Then they empty the maple syrup from the barrels (and sell it), and refill the barrels with aged whiskey. They let this whiskey age another several months to absorb the natural maple flavor left behind. The brand does not add artificial flavors or chemicals to our whiskey – they only want the maple flavor to influence the whiskey, not overwhelm it. Mashbill: 80% Rye, 5% Malted Rye, 15% Malted Barley Cooperage: McGuiness in Missouri Char Level: Aged in 53-gallon Char 3 barrel

TITLE: Dad's Hat Pennsylvania Rye Whiskey Port Cask Finished
DESCRIPTION: Rich port wine flavor meets genuine rye spice as we add another unique double-finish rye to the ranks with our Port Wine Finish Rye. This rye is double finished for an additional three months in separate barrels, which previously contained port wine, made with red grapes and known for a fruity, pleasant sweetness. Mashbill: 80% Rye, 5% Malted Rye, 15% Malted Barley Cooperage: McGuiness in Missouri Char Level: Aged in 53-gallon Char 3 barrel

TITLE: Dad's Hat Pennsylvania Rye Whiskey Vermouth Cask Finished
DESCRIPTION: For their modern classic Vermouth Finish Rye, the brand selected casks previously inhabited by Quady Winery’s Vya Sweet Vermouth to create a unique double finish rye. The process takes the classic rye, already matured for at least six months, and ages for an additional three months in select vermouth barrels. The warm, balanced flavor of American vermouth coupled with our smooth, spicy rye delivers an exceptional nose with a distinctive taste and character all its own. Mashbill: 80% Rye, 5% Malted Rye, 15% Malted Barley Cooperage: McGuiness in Missouri Char Level: Aged in 53-gallon Char 3 barrel

TITLE: Dad's Hat PM Spirits Collab 7 Years Old Single Barrel Cask Strength Pennsylvania Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Dad's Hat PM Spirits Collab 7 Years Old Single Barrel Cask Strength Pennsylvania Straight Rye Whiskey is a distinguished and bold expression from the renowned Dad's Hat Pennsylvania Rye Whiskey Distillery. This limited edition release collaborates with PM Spirits, resulting in a single-barrel rye whiskey that has been aged for 7 years and bottled at cask strength. This rye whiskey showcases the rich heritage and meticulous craftsmanship of Pennsylvania's rye whiskey tradition. Bottled at a robust cask strength, typically 120 to 130 proof, this single-barrel release delivers an intense and complex flavor profile that rye enthusiasts will appreciate. Each bottle from this exclusive collaboration offers a unique and memorable drinking experience.

TITLE: Dad's Hat Straight Rye Whiskey 95 Proof
DESCRIPTION: Well-balanced, spicy rye with a rich malt edge. Deep color reminiscent of a classic Monongahela Red with a nose redolent with malt sweetness and dried fruit. Rye spice sparkles throughout yielding to a long finish with hints of vanilla, tobacco, and light wood notes. Mashbill: 80% Rye, 5% Malted Rye, 15% Malted Barley Cooperage: McGuiness in Missouri Char Level: Aged in 53-gallon Char 3 barrel

TITLE: Daddy Rack Tennessee Straight Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A unique Tennessee Straight Small Batch Whiskey made from locally-farmed corn, sour mash fermentation, and the lightly rectified copper double distillation. Filtered using the famous Lincoln County Maple Charcoal slow filtration process before maturity in American Oak barrels. Each small batch bottling comes from just 20 barrels, blending using Daddy Racks secret recipe with no coloring, caramel, or anything else added. Before resting and bottling, each batch of Daddy Rack goes through a second lighter Maple Charcoal filtration resulting in the smoothest and soothing Tennessee Straight Whiskey available on the market. What makes this bottle extra cool is that the distiller will make a donation from every bottle sold to CORE, which is the industry charity to hospitality workers with children. They have already raised over $3m this year, as of this writing!

TITLE: Dad’s Hat Cask Strength Pennsylvania Rye Whiskey “Hat Trick” The Prime Barrel Bespoke Blend #2
DESCRIPTION: This limited-edition rye whiskey from Dad's Hat is a blend of three single barrels, hand-selected by The Prime Barrel Bespoke Blending team. It is bottled at cask strength, meaning that it has not been diluted with water. This results in a bold and flavorful whiskey with a high alcohol content. The whiskey is made from a mashbill of 80% rye, 15% barley malt, and 5% rye malt. It is aged for at least four years in new, charred oak barrels. This gives the whiskey a rich and complex flavor profile, with notes of spice, fruit, and oak. On the nose, the whiskey offers aromas of ocean air, fresh-cut grass, and tootsie roll. On the palate, it is full-bodied and creamy, with notes of rye spice, cinnamon, cardamom, figs, and almond butter. The finish is long and lingering, with a warming sensation. Dad's Hat Cask Strength Pennsylvania Rye Whiskey “Hat Trick” The Prime Barrel Bespoke Blend #2 is a must-have for any rye whiskey lover. It is a unique and flavorful whiskey that is sure to impress. Proof: 129 Proof Age: a blend of three barrels, with barrel dates of 5/25/17, 5/30/17, and 8/17/17 (so 6 years of age) State of Distillation: Pennsylvania, USA (Dad's Hat) Bottling State: Pennsylvania, USA (Dad's Hat) Mashbill: 80% Rye, 15% Malted Barley, 5% Malted Rye Info: Barrel Strength, Unfiltered, No Additives, No Coloring

TITLE: Daftmill 2007 Winter Batch Release Lowland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Distilled in 2007 bottled 2020. Feast your eyes upon the 2007 Winter Batch Release of Daftmill single malt! Previous bottlings from this Lowland distillery have been much loved indeed, and we're expecting this one to be similarly adored. It was distilled from optic barley in 2007 and matured in first-fill ex-bourbon barrels, with seven of them cracked open for this particular edition in 2019. 1,785 bottles were released. 46% ABV.

TITLE: Daftmill 2009 Summer Batch Release Lowland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The new release of Daftmill's wonderful single estate Lowland Malt. Francis and Ian Cuthbert are making the most compelling malts in all of Scotland. They are the only operational farm distillery committed to using exclusively their own grown malt with whisky to sell (more distilleries in this mold are in the works, but still too young). They began production in 2005 but didn't get cranking until 2006. During the farm's quiet periods in the mid-summer and the winter they fire up the stills and make whisky from their own harvest. The purity and intensity of these whiskys is unmatched. The care and attention to detail is extraordinary. Often they produce only about 100 casks/year. That's less than a single shift's production at many large distilleries. This batch was produced by marrying four casks, all filled in June and July 2009. While previous batches in the US have been exclusively bourbon cask matured, this is the first vatting to bring sherry into the mix. It is a first fill oloroso butt and three first fill bourbon casks yielding 1680 bottles at 46%ABV and bottled exclusively for the US market.

TITLE: Dailuaine 12 yrs Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Matured in a pair of hogsheads for more than a decade, this 2007 Dailuaine was bottled in August 2019 by Signatory Vintage as part of its Un-Chillfiltered Collection

TITLE: Daina Chokarakuchi Junmai Sake
Daina Chokarakuchi Junmai Sake
Dal Maso Colli Berici Tai Rosso Montemitorio
DESCRIPTION: Producer Info: Our history starts at the end of the 19th century with great-grandfather Serafino Dal Maso in the wonderful hills of Selva di Montebello near Vicenza, in the heart of the Gambellara DOC region. This is where our family and company have always had their roots. At the end of the 1960s, our father Luigino Dal Maso made the great U-turn by following, or rather anticipating, wine market trends in the 1980s and 1990s. Indeed, he began to make an important series of investments, the acquisition of new properties in the most suitable areas in Gambellara and particularly in the Colli Berici area south west of Vicenza. He also began exporting to a number of foreign markets. Today we, his children Nicola, Silvia and Anna, run the business with the same passion and commitment, and by constantly believing in the great potential of these lands and their grapes. Our company has the very latest technology and organised, modern premises for vinification and ageing. This is how we achieve the high quality levels found in every Dal Maso wine and we welcome enthusiasts as well as expert wine tourists who visit our company. Perfect for cold weather stews, red meat, and game.

TITLE: Daldin Prosecco Valdobbiadene Brut Superiore DOCG
DESCRIPTION: Produced from selected grapes from the hills of Valdobbiadene. A sparkling wine for special occasions, ideal as an aperitif, it goes well with sea molluscs, crustaceans and refined cheeses.

TITLE: Dalmore 28 yrs Highland Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Widely recognized as one of the finest and most premium distillers in Scotland, Dalmore's reputation precedes it. It is incredibly rare to find a bottle of Dalmore at Cask Strength (particularly at a concentrated 45.0% cask strength). It is equally uncommon to experience Dalmore without the influence of Sherry Cask maturation. Here, then, after 28 years in a single Bourbon Barrel is an example that is the pinnacle of scarcity, with only 206 bottles ever produced. This specific bottling takes you on a journey - indeed an odyssey - of flavors. What would you expect from a 28 year old Dalmore? Evolving from youngish-tasting green malt, it transitions to a garden bouquet of florals, on into a Bourbon-like melding of vanilla custard, oak, leather, and caramel, then shifts slightly into a delicious savory-sweet mix of baking spices, before ending on bittersweet dark chocolate. This evolution is experienced as a perfect, continual gradient, transitioning perfectly smoothly and almost imperceptibly. It isn't until you realize how far you are from where the experience started that you realize just how long and complex the journey was.

TITLE: Dalwhinnie 15 Years Old Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: APPEARANCE Gold. NOSE A big, crisp, dry and very aromatic nose with hints of heather and peat. BODY Light to medium. PALATE Smooth, soft and lasting flavours of heather, honey sweetness and vanilla followed by deeper citrus-fruit flavours and hints of malted bread. FINISH Long, lingering, surprisingly intense finish that starts sweetly, then gives way to smoke, peat and malt.

TITLE: Dalwhinnie Distillers Edition Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky 2020
DESCRIPTION: Discover a robust, lively expression of an intricately crafted whisky with Dalwhinnie Distillers Edition 2020 Bottling Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky. Double-matured in ex-bodega Oloroso cask wood for a rich sweetness and spicy complexity, this fifteen-year-old Scotch offers an earthy aroma with hints of peat and heather. Distilled in 2005 and bottled in 2020, this limited-edition whisky boasts a big, spicy buzz with a very clear, well-defined malt flavor. A quick burst of Sherry-sweetness leads into the very dry, vanilla-dominating finish with tons of oak. Simply serve in a traditional whisky glass, neat or with a little water. Includes one 86 proof 750 mL bottle of Distillers Edition 2020 Bottling Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky.

TITLE: Dalwhinnie Distillers Edition Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky 2021
DESCRIPTION: Discover a robust, lively expression of an intricately crafted whisky with Dalwhinnie Distillers Edition 2020 Bottling Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky.
