No insecticides or pesticides, few treatments (depending on weather), small amount of organic-only fertiliser, with respect of soil and vine balance. Vigour and yield control, leaf-thinning and green harvesting to promote grape maturation. Mechanisation is possible, but manual work is preferred. Great with vegetables, summer salads, grills, Basque piperade (tomato and sweet-pepper stew).

TITLE: Domaine des Ouches Bourgueil Cuvee 20 Les Freres Gambier
DESCRIPTION: Bunches are 100% de-stemmed and transferred to stainless steel tanks. Total maceration time is 13 days, extraction by pump-over only. Natural yeast fermentation. Lasts 6 months in stainless steel tank. The wine is bottled during the spring following harvest. Often earth- filtered depending on vintage, sometimes fined with gelatin.

TITLE: Domaine des Rouet Chinon Fleurs
DESCRIPTION: 100% Cabernet Franc; Practicing Organic; The estate was founded in 1880 and today is operated by Jean-Francois Rouet, the sixth generation winemaker in his family. The vineyard is an average age of 25 years old. Mechanical harvest of younger vines and hand harvested for older vines then grapes are destemmed and pressed. Fermentation lasts for 25 days in stainless steel vats with daily racking.

TITLE: Domaine des Sables Verts Saumur Champigny Glouglou
DESCRIPTION: Explore the lively and expressive Domaine des Sables Verts Saumur Champigny Glouglou. This natural red wine is crafted in the picturesque Loire Valley, specifically within the Saumur-Champigny AOC. Produced by Domaine des Sables Verts, this wine is made from 100% Cabernet Franc grapes, reflecting the true essence of the region's terroir. Perfect for those who appreciate the authenticity and vibrancy of natural wines, this Glouglou offers a fresh and delightful drinking experience.

TITLE: Domaine des Sablonnettes "Le Bon Petit Diable" Anjou Cabernet Franc
DESCRIPTION: Christine and Joel Menard have been making wine in the heart of the Coteaux du Layon AOC for more than twenty years. They produce an outstanding array of wines from Cabernet Franc, Grolleau, Gamay and Chenin Blanc. They practice biodynamic methods in their 13 hectares of vines. Christine and Joel run their domain to very exacting standards and as a result they produce stunning, natural wines—without employing artificial yeasts. The wines from Sablonnettes are not chaptalised or filtered, these wines are vibrantly alive. Soil: Schist Age of Vines: 20 years Pruning Method: Cordon Yields: 40 hl/ha 4,000 bottles Vinification: Grapes are harvested by hand & destemmed before maceration which lasts for five days. The wine rests in tank for six months before it is bottled with 2-3gr/hl sulfites. Serve with grilled pork, beef, veal or creamy cheeses. Bright. Lively. Funky. Green olives. Ruby color. Moderate texture. Light/medium body. Versatile.

TITLE: Domaine des Sablonnettes Le P’tit Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Good with cold appetizers, vegetables, patés, young goat cheese. Shellfish, sushi, or a chicken dish.

TITLE: Domaine des Sablonnettes Les Copines Aussi
DESCRIPTION: Age of Vines: 10 to 50 years. Yields: 40 hl/ha 4,000 bottles Pruning Method: Cordon Soil: Schist Vinification Method: Grapes are harvested by hand and destemmed before maceration which lasts for five days. The wine rests in tank for six months before it is bottled without sulfites or filtration. Grilled chicken, braised rabbit, braised pork loin, hearty vegetarian dishes, savory casseroles, and creamy cheeses.

TITLE: Domaine des Sablonnettes Les Copines Aussi
DESCRIPTION: Age of Vines: 10 to 50 years. Yields: 40 hl/ha 4,000 bottles Pruning Method: Cordon Soil: Schist Vinification Method: Grapes are harvested by hand and destemmed before maceration which lasts for five days. The wine rests in tank for six months before it is bottled without sulfites or filtration. Grilled chicken, braised rabbit, braised pork loin, hearty vegetarian dishes, savory casseroles, and creamy cheeses.

TITLE: Domaine des Sablonnettes Menard Le Rouge
DESCRIPTION: Christine and Joel Menard have been making wine in the heart of the Coteaux du Layon AOC for more than twenty years. They produce an outstanding array of wines from Cabernet Franc, Grolleau, Gamay and Chenin Blanc. They practice biodynamic methods in their 13 hectares of vines. Christine and Joel run their domain to very exacting standards and as a result they produce stunning, natural wines—without employing artificial yeasts. The wines from Sablonnettes are not chaptalised or filtered, these wines are vibrantly alive.

TITLE: Domaine des Terres Blanches Les Hospices Chenin
DESCRIPTION: Celine and Benoit Blet began their domaine in 2004, taking over a pre-existing vineyard in Oiron in Deux-Sevres. They chose Oiron because of its relative value in the Loire which allows them to make the wine they truly want to make. Céline and Benoit farm organically (certified since 2010), actively compost, and promote a diverse natural grass cover between the vines. They take advantage of gravity and ambient temperature whenever possible, and limit the additions to the wines to only sulphur at bottling (and never at fermentation).

TITLE: Domaine des Terres Vivantes "La Lutine" Beaujolais-Villages Rose
DESCRIPTION: This tiny farm in the gracefully rolling hills of the Beaujolais-Village area of Charpenay resides just south of the Beaujolais crus and produces wine from organically grown grapes and bread from organically grown wheat. For both of these artisanal products, the naturally occurring ambient yeasts in the air play an integral role. No lesser role is performed by the stewards of these fields, Ludovic and Marie Gros, who with the occasional assistance of their four children (ages 10 to 18) take no short cuts in striving for the authentic traditional expression of Beaujolais. ‘La Lutine’ comes from alluvial silt and sandy soils and the fruit is bright, forward and pretty; their Beaujolais Rose also comes from these vines. Seafood such as lobster, seared salmon, tuna or duck and delicately cooked rare lamb.

TITLE: Domaine des Tourelles Bekaa Valley Rose
DESCRIPTION: 40% Cinsault, 30% Syrah, 30% Tempranillo. The 15 to 20 year old vines grow in dry-farmed, high elevation vineyards, 1,050 meters (3,445 feet) above sea level. The soil is sandy limestone. The grapes are hand-harvested in small boxes. The grapes ferment separately in stainless steel tanks. Rose “de saignee” for the Syrah and “de presse” for both Cinsault and Tempranillo. The wine is then blended, fined and filtered.

TITLE: Domaine des Vieux Pruniers Sancerre
DESCRIPTION: The Thirot-Fournier family farms 10 hectares split between Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot on the clay-limestone slopes of the Sancerre village of Bue. With a comitment to sustainability in the vineyards and purity in the cellar, the family consitently crafts a Sancerre Blanc and Rose duo that are classic, fresh, flinty and floral. Enjoy Vieux Pruniers Sancerre over the next 3-4 years with grilled salmon, fried oysters, sushi, chicken salad and goat cheese.

TITLE: Domaine Dirler-Cade Aromate Orange Wine
DESCRIPTION: This stunning orange wine comes to us from Dirler-Cadé, one of the finest domaines of Alsace. “Aromate” is a blend of 2 parcels of Muscat from Grand Cru Saering and 1 parcel of Gewurztraminer from Grand Cru Kessler.

TITLE: Domaine du Clos Roussely L'Eclos Touraine Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Domaine du Clos Roussely welcomes you to Ange in the Loir-et-Cher. After returning from New World at age 25, Vincent created the domaine which was his childhood dream. On one side, 8 hectares of vineyard had been cultivated by his grandfather 20 years earlier, and another 15 hectares surrounding an old farmhouse. He works his vineyard by respecting the the natural biodiversity and harvests by hand. The wines are both festive and surprising. He can cite "Spirit of the Clos," a selection of Sauvignon vines 45 years, "Libertine" a delight from the over-ripe Sauvignon or "Anthology of the Clos," a subtle blend of Cabernet and Cot (Malbec). L’Eclos is perfect for aperitifs, apetizers, seafood, shellfish or goat cheese.

TITLE: Domaine du Cros Marcillac Lo Sang del Pais
DESCRIPTION: For four generations, until 1982, the Domaine du Cros had just one hectare of vineyard and produced about 4000 bottles a year. Starting in 1982, the surface areas were increased . As well as buying and renting older vineyards, we planted on our best hillsides, some of which have a slope of 60 or even 65 per cent. In 1984, we created a father and son agricultural corporation on three hectares of vineyard, and we constructed a wine storehouse where we vat and rake the wine by gravity. The bottle storage room is located below the storehouse. This room is now air conditioned. From 1984 to 2012 we continued to purchase and to rent older vineyards : our surface areas has gone from three hectares to thirty hectares. The wines from our younger vineyards (over 25 years on the average) are more supple, yet solid, and represent our basic vintages. These wines have a berry (black currant, raspberry) flavour. The special vintages produced from our old vineyards (50 to 80 years and oider) are more structured, solid wines with liquorice and spice flavours. After an 18 month maturation in casks, they are bottled. Sale takes place one month after bottling. These wines are ideal for ageing ; they will reach full quality and develop their secondary flavours only after three or four years. They can also be enjoyed young because they have all the primary black currant and raspberry flavours of our grape variety .

TITLE: Domaine du Fief aux Dames Muscadet Sevre-et-Maine sur Lie
DESCRIPTION: The Fief aux Dames is a family-run vineyard in Monnières in the heart of the historic "Vignoble Nantais". The BRAUD family has run the vineyard for nearly a century through five generations. They primarily produce “Muscadet Sèvre et Maine sur Lie”. The estate produces dry white wines from a unique variety of grape: the Melon de Bourgogne. The Muscadet appellation was awarded AOC certification in 1937. Aperitif, light salad and light lunch, Oysters, seafood, fish.

TITLE: Domaine du Mortier Graviers
DESCRIPTION: Vineyard: 50-years-old vines with low yields (25 hl/ha) on gravel in the Saint Nicolas de Bourgueil AOC. Estate-owned, certified organic. Making of: The grapes are hand-harvested, destemmed and spontaneously fermented as whole berries (semi-carbonic maceration) for 20 days. Gently pressed and aged for 10 months in neutral oak vat. Bottled without fining, filtration or sulfur addition. Vin Methode Nature.

TITLE: Domaine Dupasquier Perles d'Aimavigne
DESCRIPTION: I’ve found so much to love about wines from the Savoie region in eastern France. The latest is this sparkling wine, made largely of jacquère and chardonnay, with a little altesse as well.

TITLE: Domaine Dupeuble Beaujolais
DESCRIPTION: Domaine Dupeuble Beaujolais is a classic example of this popular red wine from the Beaujolais region of France. The wine is made from Gamay grapes and is aged in stainless steel tanks to preserve its fresh fruit flavors. The wine has a deep ruby color and aromas of red fruits, spices, and flowers. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with juicy flavors of raspberries, strawberries, and cherries. The wine has a bright, refreshing finish with hints of acidity.

TITLE: Domaine Eden Santa Cruz Mountains Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: 75% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Merlot, 2% Malbec, 1.5% Petit Verdot, 1.5% Cabernet Franc Barrel Regimen - French 50%- 10 % new; American 50%- 10% new aged 24 months in barrel The heritage of Mount Eden Cabernet Sauvignon dates back to the 1890s, when the famed viticulturist Emmett Rixford of Woodside, California, obtained selected cuttings from Chateau Margaux in Bordeaux, France. Rixford planted his famous La Questa Vineyard with these selections, in the same proportions as found at Margaux. In the late 1940s Martin Ray planted his first Cabernet vineyard with cuttings from the La Questa Vineyard. The present-day Estate Cabernet Sauvignon vines were planted in the early 1980s, using cuttings taken from these vines. Yields are low, typically one to two tons per acre. Soils are very thin (1-12 inches), with a dominant base of Franciscan shale. The climate is cool, especially for Cabernet, and influenced by the vineyard’s altitude and its proximity to San Francisco bay and the Pacific Ocean. The vines are trellised in a modern fashion, which allows for a more uniform ripening. The vineyard also contains small blocks of Merlot and Cabernet Franc. The lots are fermented separately using natural fermentations and French oak. Aging this wine to maturity for two years, no fining or filtration is conducted prior to bottling, just like the Estate regimen.

TITLE: Domaine Eugene Carrel et Fils Vin de Savoie Jongieux Mondeuse
DESCRIPTION: This wine is perfect with red meats (game) and also Savoy cheeses.

TITLE: Domaine Fichet Cremant de Bourgogne
DESCRIPTION: Domaine Fichet Cremant de Bourgogne is a dry sparkling white wine from the Burgundy region of France. It is made from 100% Chardonnay grapes, which are grown in vineyards located in the Mâconnais region of the region.

TITLE: Domaine Filliatreau Saumur-Champigny
DESCRIPTION: 100% Cabernet Franc. From vines on clay-limestone soils in many different parcels, averaging 30 years old. The fruit is mostly hand-harvested, sorted in the cellar and fermented in stainless steel tank with natural yeasts, temperature control and a 10-to-14-day maceration. This entry-level Saumur-Champigny is aged in tank as well, intended to be a light, early-drinking, uncomplicated style of Cabernet Franc for the table.

TITLE: Domaine Francois Chidaine Montlouis Methode Traditionnelle Brut Nature
DESCRIPTION: Produced from Chidaine’s biodynamically farmed vineyards, no synthetique chemicals are used, only natural preparations from plants and minerals. Yields here are quite low (35 hectoliters per hectare) for sparkling wine and the finished product contains no dosage. Vine age is from 20-50 years old. 100% Chenin.

TITLE: Domaine Francois Chidaine Montlouis sur Loire Les Vendanges de Francois Chidaine Montlouis Brut Tradition
DESCRIPTION: Francois Chidaine is not only a leading natural viticulturalist and Chenin advocate, he has earned a reputation as a sparkling specialist and producer of some of the greatest value sparkling wines on the market. This new negoce bubbly is no exception.

TITLE: Domaine Francois Pinon Brut  Vouvray
DESCRIPTION: TastingNotesTiny, persistent bubbles are the first sign of this wine's refinement. It delivers the tuffeau soil savor and the quince-scented chenin of Vouvray in an extremely dry style, its laser focus softened by scents of orange blossom, honey and fresh cream. Youthful and tightly wound, this will age with grace.

TITLE: Domaine Glinavos Ioannina Paleokerisio
DESCRIPTION: A unique in its kind orange, semi-sparkling and semi-dry wine, which impresses with its distinctive and totally traditional vinification. It is produced from the indigenous white wine grape variety Debina with the addition of a small percentage of the red variety Vlahiko. It is a special type of wine, which revives the well-known traditional semi-sparkling wine of Ioannina, produced in the past by the locals. The little natural carbonate reveals the richness of flavours and aromas with a sweetness that blends in with all the other elements.

TITLE: Domaine Grand Freres Cotes du Jura Trousseau
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1976, Domaine Grand is located in the Revermont region of Jura, one of the oldest appellations in France. Hand-harvested from 40 year old vines on marlstone soil with clay and limestone. Fermented in stainless steel temperature controlled vats then aged for 8 months in 4 year old barrels. Composed entirely of Trousseau, this medium bodied red offers vibrant, peppery notes of red berries backed by delicate minerality. Bright fruit, refreshing acidity and supple tannins allow this wine to pair well with red meats, game and light cheeses.

TITLE: Domaine Gris des Bauries Les Chaix
DESCRIPTION: 12 hectare estate located Taulignan in Drôme Provençale, on the hills leading down to the Rhone Valley. A variety of soils (sandy, some clay and limestone) bring great complexity to the wines. Organic since 2010.

TITLE: Domaine Grosbois Chinon "La Cuisine de ma Mere"
DESCRIPTION: La Cuisine de ma mere, which translates to "my mother's kitchen," is the perfect complement to any dinner table!

TITLE: Domaine Guinand Saint Christol Cuvee Les Frenes
DESCRIPTION: Leaving the wine cooperative of our village in 1993, we decided to work under our own name and affix our name to the bottles. An expensive and quite difficult transition for us, but we wanted to personalize our production. In 1997, the caves beneath the 16th century family home are renovated to accommodate barrel aging and two employees are hired. By 2012 we acclimatized the cellar for better insulation and humidity, and installed solar panels.

TITLE: Domaine Guion Cuvee Domaine
DESCRIPTION: There are few properties in France that can boast such a great pioneering legacy in organic farming as Domaine Guion. In the 1950’s, the Guion family established their farm in the heart of the Bourgueil appellation, a stone’s throw from the banks of the Loire River. Since it was a polycultural estate, the family was able to live almost entirely off the land. By 1965, they began farming organically, with a holistic understanding of its effects far ahead of their time. Since taking the reins from his father in 1994, Stéphane Guion has a put a much greater emphasis on viticulture, managing 8 ½ hectares of land. Quiet and curious, he is a respected member of the vigneron community in Bourgueil and is often consulted by other growers eager to adopt organic farming practices. While Stéphane rarely appears at tastings and tradeshows, it is clear that the extra time in the vineyards and cellars is well spent. While occasionally eclipsed by its more high-profile neighbor, Chinon, the Cabernet Franc of Bourgueil is often regarded as more age-worthy. Situated on meticulously cultivated clay and limestone soils, the Guions’ vineyards range from 10-80 years old, with the younger vines designated for the “Cuvée Domaine” and the older for the “Cuvée Prestige.” Stéphane prunes the buds rather than clusters to achieve a judicious yield and hand-harvests all of his fruit. Once in the cellar, he only employs native yeasts and allows a moderate maceration of the grapes. “Cuvée Domaine” is entirely fermented and aged in tank, while “Cuvée Prestige” is allowed at least 12 months in barrel to age. Stéphane’s rare “Cuvée Deux Monts” is named for the peaks above his two vineyard parcels. In most years, the grapes from this lieu-dit, situated at the top of his two vineyards, are blended into the “Prestige,” however in exceptional years such as 2009, it stands proudly as Domaine Guion’s top-of-the-line bottling. Once the bottles are ready for aging, they are stored in a large cave shared with six other families that once served as a historic Resistance hideout during World War II.

TITLE: Domaine Haut Du Bourg Muscadet-Cotes de Grandlieu
DESCRIPTION: Located in the heart of the Muscadet appellation Côtes de Grandlieu, the Domaine du Haut Bourg was built by four generations of vignerons. The first vine was planted in 1945 and today brothers Hervé and Nicolas Choblet run their 40 hectares estate together.

TITLE: Domaine Heitz-Lochardet Cremant de Bourgogne Blanc de Blancs
Domaine Jacky Marteau Touraine Gamay Lulu
DESCRIPTION: The vines are planted on some of the finest wine-growing lands in Touraine, on the south bank of the Cher River. Rodolphe’s primary focus is getting the best quality of grapes through various techniques such as spring de-budding, de-leafing grasping through the vineyard, and green harvest for lowering yields. Semi-carbonic maceration in a vat, with the de-stemmed portion of the crop on the bottom and whole bunches on top. The wine rests on fine lees until bottling. The amazing thing about Gamay is that because of the high natural acidity paired with low tannin, the wine pairs shockingly well with a very broad array of foods. Going wrong with Gamay and food is hard. Gamay is consistently chosen as a top wine to pair with Thanksgiving dinner.

TITLE: Domaine Jean Fournier Bourgogne Côte d'Or Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Spot on, classic red Burgundy. Fresh enough to chill down a bit, but with a complexity that belies its Côte d'Or classification. We detect classic markers of Marsannay, like pure red fruit, a hint of earthiness and leather, and a supple, unfussy structure. Laurent Fournier's Côte d'Or Pinot Noir is the perfect way to get to know his work. It's from 10-50 year old vines in about eight different vineyards (including some fruit from Les Longerois). There's a minimal use of oak — the wine gets enough to breathe during élévage, but not enough to impart oaky flavors or tannins. The result is a wine that is pure and focused like his top wines, but straight up delicious from a young age too.

TITLE: Domaine Jean Pascal Aubron "Contact!" Orange Wine
DESCRIPTION: Domaine Jean Pascal Aubron Melon de Bourgogne Contact! is a unique and delicious orange wine from the Loire Valley of France. It is made from Melon de Bourgogne grapes, which are typically used to make white wine. However, for this wine, the grapes are left in contact with their skins for a period of time, which gives the wine its orange color and unique flavor profile. This wine has a hazy amber color and aromas of orange peel, apricot, and spice. On the palate, it is dry and medium-bodied, with flavors of orange, peach, and spice. The wine has a long and refreshing finish. Domaine Jean Pascal Aubron Melon de Bourgogne Contact! is a versatile wine that can be enjoyed with a variety of foods. It is particularly well-suited to grilled fish, poultry, and pork dishes. It can also be enjoyed on its own as an aperitif.

TITLE: Domaine Jean Vullien Vin de Savoie Jacquere Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Domaine Jean Vullien is run by Jean and his two sons, David and Olivier, in the Combe de Savoie where they work 69 acres of hillside vines. The domaine's holdings include all of the region's indigenous grape varietals (Jacquère, Altesse and Mondeuse) as well as Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. Though the Vulliens have been making wine for over 40 years, the family is perhaps best known as a leader in the vine nursery business, providing young vines to growers throughout France. In fact, after the Phylloxera epidemic in the 19th and early 20th centuries, about 25% of the Chardonnay used to replant Chablis came from their nursery. Enjoy as an aperitif or with fondue or mountain cheeses.

TITLE: Domaine Joblot Givry Clos Du Cellier Aux Moines 1er Cru
DESCRIPTION: Beef tenderloin, charred and served au poivre over Camembert-leek whipped potatoes with a Burgundy-black chanterelle sauce.

TITLE: Domaine Julien Cecillon Syrah Les Graviers
DESCRIPTION: 100% Syrah; ‘Les Graviers’ is a négociant blend of three vineyard sites in the Rhône. The majority of fruit comes from the southern parts of the Drôme and Ardèche, a smaller amount from vineyards around Tournon. ‘Les Graviers’ means ‘gravel,’: the winery was a former gravel warehouse, and the market square in Tournon where Julien grew up is called ‘Place des Graviers.’ The soils in this 4 ha cluster of vineyards are clay-limestone and granite with pebbles; native yeast fermentation; 70% destemmed, 30% whole-cluster in stainless steel. Élevage is between 8 to 14 months in neutral barrels. Sustainable.

TITLE: Domaine la Grange Tiphaine "Rose Rosa Rosam" Rose
Domaine La Monardiere Vacqueyras Les 2 Monardes
DESCRIPTION: 70% Grenache and 30% Syrah from vines of an average age of 40 years, planted in chalky grit and sandy clay. The fruit is hand-harvested, with rigorous sorting; 100% de-stemmed. Fermented with natural yeasts, with a maceration of 20 days with punch-downs. Aged 1 year in a combination of tanks and barrels. Bottled without fining or filtration.

TITLE: Domaine Labbe Vin de Savoie Abymes Jacquere
DESCRIPTION: Roger Labbe's Abymes is 100% Jacquère, a varietal that grows especially well in the Savoie region of France. While the appellation tolerates 10% of other grape varieties, Labbe chooses to feature the purity of this varietal in this bottling. The soil is mostly argilo/calcaire with some 2 inch stones - debris from years of avalanches from the Alps. Labbe and his team control yields by strategically de-budding vines in the spring. This labor intensive practice is rare to find at this price point. Grass grows in the rows between the vines to fertilize and oxygenate the soil - this practice also forces the vines' root systems to go deeper for nourishment and soak up the terroir of the subsoil. Vinification practices preserve both varietal typicity and freshness - the cellar temperature is controlled, and indigenous yeasts are used in fermentation. Labbe uses only non-reactive tanks and foudres for aging. Quaff this wine all on its own or enjoy with your favorite cheese and charcuterie. Especially food friendly.

TITLE: Domaine Lalande Les Hauts De Lalande Red Blend
DESCRIPTION: Only the blends of top quality varieties are used by the Haut de Lalande: merlot, cabernet, syrah, petit verdot for the reds, chardonnay viognier, chasan for the whites.

TITLE: Domaine Le Galantin Bandol Rose
DESCRIPTION: 55% Mourvedre, with the rest equally divided between Cinsault and Grenache. The grapes are hand-harvested, after which the bunches are cooled down for a two day cold soak in order to extract fruit, color and aromatics. The juice is then racked off and the grapes are pressed to stainless steel tanks. 10% of the wine is saignée, the rest come from grapes treated as for making white wine. Following a cool fermentation during which the malolactic is blocked, the wine is fined and bottled. By law, Bandol rose cannot be sold before March 1st.

TITLE: Domaine Les Chardon Touraine Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Domaine de l’Aumonier is the brand name of the estate and was founded in 1996. It is located in the village of Couffy on bank of the Cher river. It is a family business run by husband and wife, Sophie and Thierry Chardon. They cultivate 115 acres of vine averaging 25 years of age. They are farming organically since 2007. 100% Sauvignon Blanc. Grapes are grown on silex flint and tuffeau white limestone soils. Fermented with native yeast in stainless steel tank. Roast Chicken, Grilled Trout, Salmon, Bass, Roast Turkey, Salt and Pepper Tofu, Pork Chop.

TITLE: Domaine Les Genestas Cotes Du Rhone Villages
DESCRIPTION: Age of Vines: 20 to 80 years. Yields: 40 hl/ha Pruning Method: Gobelet Soil: Red clay covered in small stones. Varietals: 40% Grenache, 35% Syrah, 15% Carignan. Vinification Method: Hand Harvested. No external yeast or enzymes are employed during the winemaking process. The wine is stored in enamel-lined tanks for 10 months before it is bottled without fining or filtration. Grilled lamb, sausages, steak, chicken and pork in hearty red sauces.

TITLE: Domaine Les Roches Bleues Brouilly La Croquante
Domaine Magdalena Winery Red Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Discover the exceptional craftsmanship of Domaine Magdalena Winery with their Red Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon, a bold and expressive red wine sourced from the renowned Red Mountain region in Washington. Meticulously crafted by Domaine Magdalena, this Cabernet Sauvignon showcases the intensity and character synonymous with Red Mountain terroir.

TITLE: Domaine Martin Chavignol Sancerre
DESCRIPTION: Domaine Martin, a traditional and respected domaine located in the grand terroir of Chavignol, is owned and run by the young Pierre Martin. After working alongside his father, Yves, he started his own domaine from a scant 4 ha of vines in the best village of Sancerre, Chavignol. The vines are raised using sustainable agriculture, using absolutely no herbicides or pesticides. The soil found in these beautfiul, high altitude vineayrds are a mixture of caillottes (stony, chalky pebbles) and terres blanches (a mixture of clay and limestone). The average age of his vines are 35+ years old. All vinification is done in temperature controlled stainless steel tank, with 4-6 month aging on fine lees with minimal batonnage.

TITLE: Domaine Michel Barraud Mâcon-Villages Les Pierres-Vieilles Vignes
DESCRIPTION: Meat Pairings - Chicken Breast, Turkey Breast, Pork Loin, Halibut, Trout, Cod, Sturgeon, Oily Flaky Fish, Atlantic Salmon, Lobster, Crab, Scallops, Shrimp, Clams, Oysters (unoaked) Spices and Herbs - Tarragon, Parsley, Thyme, Lemon Zest, Marjoram, White Pepper, Shallots, Poultry Seasoning Cheese Pairings - Soft – Semi Soft Cow’s Milk Cheese and Goat Cheese. Vegetables & Vegetarian Fare - Yellow Squash, Peas, Zucchini, Asparagus, Sun Chokes, Seitan, White Mushrooms, Truffles, Chanterelles, Almonds

TITLE: Domaine Migot Brut Methode Traditionnelle
DESCRIPTION: Equally perfect for serving with hearty dishes or sipping solo

TITLE: Domaine Migot Cotes de Toul Vin Gris
Domaine Mittnacht Freres Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: A family-run estate begun in 1958, Mittnacht Freres is a domaine to watch. While relatively low on most folks’ radars,this 20-hectare estate produces expressive, beautifully made wines from traditional Alsace varietals. Run by the conscientious Christophe Mittnacht, the domaine employs organic and biodynamic practices in the vineyard, believing that biologically complex, complete soils are essential for producing original, meaningful wines. The domaine has holdings in Grand Cru Rosacker (in which Trimbach’s fabled Clos-St.-Hune is located), as well as excellent parcels between Ribeauville and Riquewihr, whose vines are the source of Mittnacht’s terrific varietally labeled wines.

TITLE: Domaine Mont de Marie Salve Ager
DESCRIPTION: The domaine Mont de Marie is the creation of Thierry Forestier, son of a wine making family in the Costieres de Nimes, who starting in 2004, has pieced together eight parcels of vineyards totaling 7.5 hectares in and around the village of Souvignargues. He has recently renovated a centuries old winery facility in the village. Souvignargues is located in the easternmost part of the Coteaux du Languedoc and is part of the sub-region known as the Terres de Sommières. Thierry Forestier has selected vineyard plots with old vines (often head-pruned) many of which are in particularly cool micro-climates. Nearly a third of his vineyards are planted to Aramon, a much neglected, historic and local grape variety. His Aramon vines are at least 100 years old. Thierry farms without the use of herbacides or insecticides, using only copper and sulphur to fight mildew. All of his vinifications are done with indigenous yeasts and without any intervention. The wines are bottled unfined and unfiltered.

TITLE: Domaine Nerantzi Koniaros
DESCRIPTION: The Nerantzis Mitropoulos family came from Thrace, the land of the wine god Dionysus. The tradition of their ancestors has shaped the lifestyle, the food habits and culture of the family. The vineyard and its wine give their life a seasonal rhythm of the stuffed grape leaves in the spring on the ripe grapes in the summer to young wine in the late autumn. The winery grows indigenous varietals such as Koniaros, Asprouda Serron, Malagousia, Pamiti, Assirtiko and more traditional varietals Merlot, Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay and Cinsault. This wine is an ideal accompaniment to red meat dishes of all kinds, strong cheeses, lamb stews.

TITLE: Domaine Nerantzi Pentapolis White Blend
DESCRIPTION: It blends very well with grilled fish (especially fatty fish), white meat and fruits. This wine should be served chilled at a temperature of This wine should be served chilled at a temperature of 10 to 12 degrees Celsius.

TITLE: Domaine Parpalhol "Petit Frenchie" Merlot
DESCRIPTION: Domaine Parpalhol "Petit Frenchie" Merlot is a delightful organic red wine from the Languedoc-Roussillon region of southern France. Crafted from hand-harvested Merlot grapes grown in clay and limestone soils, this charming wine embodies the essence of friendship, sharing, and hedonism.

TITLE: Domaine Paul Cherrier Sancerre Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Stephane Cherrier is a young and talented producer who took over the family vineyard and started the winery in 2006. It is composed of 13ha located in the area of Verdigny with 10ha of Sauvignon Blanc and 3ha of Pinot Noir. The soil is both made of clay-limestone on the plateau and white marl on the slopes. Stephane, a humble & welcoming vigneron, practices organic and minimal intervention winemaking. The wines of Stephane show ripeness and liveliness which set them apart from the massively produced wines. The whites tend to show tropical fruit with a vibrant mouthfeel while the reds are fruit forward and refreshing.

TITLE: Domaine Paul Prieur Bulles De Pinot
DESCRIPTION: Domaine Paul Prieur Bulles de Pinot is a pétillant naturel rosé wine from the Sancerre region of France. It is made from 100% Pinot Noir grapes, which are grown in vineyards located in the Les Clous area of the region.

TITLE: Domaine Pelle Menetou-Salon Morogues Sauvignon Blanc
Domaine Philemon Croix d'Azal Gaillac Rouge
DESCRIPTION: The Croix d'Azal is produced from a one hectare vineyard which Mathieu planted in 2003. The wine is made from 100% Braucol, also known in the region as Fer or Fer Servadou. The word "braucol" is from the root "brau" which in the local dialect signifies taureau, the bull. Enjoy with savory and spicy dishes like smoked pork belly or Korean barbecue.

TITLE: Domaine Pierre Richard Cremant de Jura Blanc Brut Harmonie
DESCRIPTION: 100% Chardonnay From 35 year old vines are grown on clay and limestone soils, the grapes are hand-harvested at the end of October. Primary fermentation occurs in stainless steel tanks and lasts two weeks with temperature control. The blending and bottling is done during the following year's harvest. Aged between 24-36 months on lees before bottling and disgorgement. Dosage is .4 g/cl.

TITLE: Domaine Plageoles Contre-Pied II
DESCRIPTION: Total Bottles Produced: 6000 Age of Vines: 30 years Yields: 40hl/ha Soil: Clay and limestone Varieties: Duras Vinification Method: The grapes for this wine are purchased from organic neighbors, to make a wine from duras that is totally different from the estate bottled Duras the Plageoles make. The grapes are fermented carbonically in barrel and then remain in barrel for 7-8 months of elevage. The wine is bottled unfined and unfiltered with a small addition of sulfur.

TITLE: Domaine Reine Juliette Picpoul de Pinet
DESCRIPTION: Picpoul de Pinet is in the Languedoc located on the edge of the Thau Lagoon, just inland from the Mediterranean. The grape, Picpoul Blanc, produces a crisp white wine that will make you long for a comfortable beach chair and some sand! The Picpoul de Pinet from Domaine Reine Juliette is fermented in stainless steel and released shortly after winemaking is complete in order to capture the freshness and youth of the wine. Perfect with fresh shellfish, salads with a lemony vinaigrette, or nothing at all!

TITLE: Domaine Reine Juliette Syrah Grenache Rose
DESCRIPTION: 50% Syrah, 50% grenache planted to marl and red clay soils. Fruit is 100% destemmed and sorted. Blend of free run and pneumatic press juice. Fermentation in enamel-lined cement tanks settled with cold. Short aging in bottle prior to release.

TITLE: Domaine Rimbert Le Petit Cochon Bronze Rose
Domaine Rimbert Les Travers de Marceau Saint-Chinian
DESCRIPTION: Age of Vines: 60 years (60%); 10 years (30%) Yields: 30 hl/ha Pruning Method: Gobelet et Royat Soil: Schist. Vinification Method: Grapes are hand-harvested and destemmed before they are gently pressed. Only indigenous yeasts are used, the varietals are fermented separately in tanks before the final wine is blended. The wine is bottled using gravity and undergoes a slight filtration. Serve with grilled meats, aged cheeses, hearty stews and spicy pasta dishes

TITLE: Domaine Rolet Cotes du Jura Trousseau Rose
DESCRIPTION: The estate was created by Mr. Désiré Rolet in 1942, with just 4 ha, and was taken over by his children, Eliane, Bernard, Guy and Pierre in 1958. In one generation it has developed a lot! Vines are always planted on steep slopes. They prefer to use light caterpillar machines vs. heavy tractors in order to not damage the soil, which will pass only on specific grassed pathways. Harvests are manual only, every year, with 80 people picking for 4 weeks in the vineyard to select the best grapes – the only way to produce high quality wines! It is a summer wine, to drink young and fresh, which will perfectly suit starters and light meals.

TITLE: Domaine Rolet Pere et Fils Cremant du Jura Blanc Brut
DESCRIPTION: Harvests are all hand-picked. Whole-cluster pressing and strict cut-off points between the heart of the cuvee and the pressed juice, in accordance with the traditional method used in making Crémant. Second fermentation in bottle. Maturation sur-latte for more than 21 months, followed by disgorgement, then 2 months’ rest before shipment. Elegant with a nice Body This wine is apt for every moment, from the aperitif to the end of a meal or even as an accompaniment of an evening. Best to Drink: Serve at 46 F within the next 3 years

TITLE: Domaine Rolet Pere et Fils Cremant du Jura Brut Rose
DESCRIPTION: An Estate which reflects the image of an ever-changing Jura and family enterprise, this Estate was created in the early 40's by Désiré Rolet. Today, his children have taken over and share the various responsibilities of the management of the Estate, Bernard and Guy take care of the vines and vinification; Pierre and Eliane are in charge of marketing, each one of them working with a view to the final objective of a wine-grower : the passion of obtaining, depending on the vintage the quintessence of the grappe knowing that wine starts being made in the vineyard. With modern air-conditioned wine-making plant where stainless steel vats, new barrels and oak casks are next to each other, from grape picking to bottling, we apply all of our know-how to the making of highly renowned vintages...

TITLE: Domaine Rolet Rouge Tradition Arbois Poulsard Trousseau
DESCRIPTION: A traditional light red from Arbois which brings the complexity from the soils of the hills of Montigny and Arbois made of red marls and rich gravels. Wine is fermented separately and blended after 18 months in large neutral barrels. 40% Poulsard, 30% Trousseau, and 30% Pinot Noir.

TITLE: Domaine Saint Cyr Beaujolais Chenas Les Blemonts
DESCRIPTION: Raphael Saint Cyr is the fourth generation vigneron at the Domaine de Bellevue, which was created by his great-grandfather Pierre Saint Cyr in Anse at the southern edge of the Beaujolais. When Raphael took over the winemaking in 2008, he let go of a large portion of Beaujolais vines around the winery, and acquired vines further north in the crus of Morgon, Regnié, Chénas, and Moulin-à-Vent. At the same time, he converted the entire 23 hectare domaine to certified organic viticulture, making Domaine de Bellevue the largest organic domaine in the Beaujolais. Unusual for the region, the crus are all single vineyard parcels, and the name of each terroir is listed with each wine. They are fermented in concrete tanks and then aged in used barrels for 12-18 months. La Galoche, the straight Beaujolais cuvée, is aged for 6 months in concrete tanks. All of the wines are vinified with natural yeasts. Certified Organic. 100% Gamay.Les Blemonts vineyard is located in the center of Chenas. 3.5-hectare south exposition. The vines were planted in 1920s and 1970s. Hand harvested, cold carbonic fermentation, native yeast and minimal sulfur. Aged in 50% barrels and 50% concrete tanks. Unfined and unfiltered. 1000 cases made.

TITLE: Domaine Saint Vincent Methode Champenoise Brut
DESCRIPTION: Gilbert Gruet, founder of Gruet Winery, was born in Bethon, France in 1931. He grew up in a poor family, and began working at a young age. In 1952, Gilbert Gruet, along with his wife Danielle, dreamt of producing fine quality Champagne. Gilbert followed his heart and in 1967 created the U.V.C.B. (Union Vinicole des Coteaux de Bethon), a co-op in the village of Bethon. In 1983, the Gruet Family was traveling through the southwestern part of the US, and while in New Mexico met a group of European winemakers who had successfully planted vineyards in Engle, near the town of Truth or Consequences, 170 miles south of the city of Albuquerque. After hearing of vineyards planted there as early as the 1600s, and learning about the specific climate and soil conditions of the region, the Gruet Family knew they had found what they were looking for. In 1984, Gilbert Gruet - whose Champagne house (Gruet et Fils) has produced fine Champagnes in Bethon, France since 1952 - made the decision to plant an experimental vineyard in Engle, NM. The plantings were exclusively Chardonnay and Pinot Noir grapes. Two of his four children, Laurent and Nathalie Gruet then relocated to New Mexico to begin their American winemaking adventure.

TITLE: Domaine Sainte Barbe Vire Clesse Vieilles Vignes
DESCRIPTION: The Estate, located in Viré, stretches over an area of 9 hectares. The variety of our terroirs allows us to feature 6 different Viré-Clessé wines coming from 18 specific plots. Ever since my grandfather’s days, the vineyards have been tilled and worked without the use of synthetic herbicides. In recognition of this work, we had our wines officially certified Agriculture Biologique [organic] in 2003. More than ¾ of our vineyard is over 50 years old. Hand-picking and natural vinification allow us to fully express the quality of our wines.

TITLE: Domaine Tatsis Limnio
DESCRIPTION: Domaine Tatsis Limnio is a unique and full-bodied red wine produced from the indigenous Limnio grape, an ancient variety native to Greece's Macedonia region. The Tatsis family, renowned for their dedication to organic viticulture, cultivates their Limnio grapes in biodynamic vineyards, fostering a deep connection to the terroir and preserving the grape's inherent character.

TITLE: Domaine Vincent Paris Vin de Pays Des Collines Rhodaniennes Selection Syrah
DESCRIPTION: Vincent Paris is an under the radar producer based in the northern Rhone with vineyards in Crozes-Hermitage and Cornas. With a famed uncle, Robert Michel, as one of Cornas’ best growers, Vincent worked under his uncle for a couple vintages before venturing out on his own. He has just eight hectares of vineyards and only produces 2500 cases annually. He makes both “little wines,” which include his entry level bottles. He began making these to attract new customers after consistently running out of his Cornas and St. Joseph wines. Vincent believes that keeping the forests surrounding the appellation should be wild to influence the integrity of the vineyard’s ecosystem.

TITLE: Domaine Xavier Besson Givry Rouge 1er Cru Grands Pretans
DESCRIPTION: The combination of old vines, conscientious vineyard work, and reasonable yields, all contribute to the crowd pleasing, balanced wines that Besson produces. Farming from superb vineyards like ‘Les Grands Prétans,’ Besson always provides superb Burgundy VALUE: concentrated and densely expressive with brilliant perfume, heady fruit, and a velvety mouthfeel. 100% Pinot Noir. Pinot Noir is a "cross dresser." It's a red wine that thinks it's a white because it's crisp and soft enough to go with more "white-wine dishes" than most red wines. This is why Pinot Noir may be the ultimate food wine. Here are its classic food matches: Leaner meats (veal, chicken, turkey, rabbit, any game bird, filets of beef or pork, and a well-drained duck) Smoked, wood-roasted, braised or sausage meats (with the use of beef, lamb and pork) Earthy flavors (truffles, wild mushrooms, mustards, peppercorns, coriander and horseradish) Resin-like or scented green herbs (rosemary, thyme, tarragon, oregano, summer and winter savory, chervil, mints and basils) Aromatic sweet spices (clove, cinnamon, mace, allspice and nutmeg) Sweet vegetables (tomatoes, beets, carrots, caramelized onions and bell peppers) Autumnal fruits (figs, plums, blackberry, raspberry, blueberry, currants, and black and dried cherries) Natural stocks and sauces rounded with butter Slow-cooking processes (braises and pot-at-feu) Mild or creamy cheeses (Brie, Camembert, herbed crèmes, cheddars, Havarti and jacks)

TITLE: Domaine YoYo Akoibon
DESCRIPTION: 70% Grenache Noir and 30% Mourvedre, from vines grown organically. The young vines of Mourvedre are planted in Banyuls and the Grenache on the hills of Port-Vendres, facing the sea, on soils of black shale. Manual harvest on the 9th of August 2022, with yields around 15 hl/ha. Vinification: semi-carbonic maceration in stainless steel vats for 12 days. Soft pressing, aging in barrels that have seen several wines. Bottled at the Estate without fining or filtration, just a micro-dose of sulphur.

TITLE: Domino Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Style: Rich flavors with a smooth mouth feel Aromas/Flavors: Currant, blackberry, and black cherry with notes of sweet vanilla and toast Finish: Concentrated & plush

TITLE: Dominus Estate Napa Valley
DESCRIPTION: Dominus is the proprietary red wine produced by Christian Moueix, from grapes grown on a single vineyard in the heart of the Napa Valley. The wines reflect both the California terroir and the spirit of a great Bordeaux chateau, with its attention to detail and devotion to quality in every aspect of winemaking

TITLE: Don Amado Mezcal Anejo
DESCRIPTION: In the highlands of southern Mexico, the renowned Arellanes family has been crafting one of the region’s most celebrated mezcals since the late 1700’s. Eleven generations of continual mezcal distillation with a legendary commitment to craftsmanship and experimentation have culminated in a spirit that is simultaneously complex and approachable. Don Amado is made from earthen-roasted agave hearts which are, after crushing, fermented together with their piña fibers for a rich agave character. The mash is then double-distilled in small traditional ceramic clay pots. Aged varieties are matured in American oak casks previously used for barreling Domecq brandy.

TITLE: Don Julio "Rosado" Reposado Tequila
Don Julio 1942 Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Celebrated in exclusive cocktail bars, restaurants and nightclubs, the iconic Don Julio 1942 Tequila is the choice of connoisseurs around the globe. Produced in small batches and aged for a minimum of two and a half years, Don Julio 1942 Tequila is handcrafted in tribute to the year that Don Julio Gonzalez began his tequila-making journey.

TITLE: Don Julio 1942 Ultima Reserva  Extra Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: A special 36-month aged luxury Extra Anejo Tequila that preserves Don Julio Gonzalez's Ultimate Legacy - the final agave harvest. This Ultima Reserva has been rested in oak, previously used to age bourbon, and finished in Madeira wine-seasoned casks.

TITLE: Don Julio Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Barrel aged in smaller batches for eighteen months in American white-oak barrels, Don Julio Anejo Tequila is a testament to the craft of making a superior tasting, aged tequila.

TITLE: Don Julio Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Barrel aged in smaller batches for eighteen months in American white-oak barrels, Don Julio Anejo Tequila is a testament to the craft of making a superior tasting, aged tequila.

TITLE: Don Julio Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Tequila Don Julio Blanco is the base from which all of our other variants are derived. Commonly referred to as "silver" tequila, its crisp agave flavor and hints of citrus make it an essential component to a variety of innovative drinks including margaritas. It can also be enjoyed neat or on the rocks.

TITLE: Don Julio Claro 70th Anniversary Day of the Dead Limited Edition Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Don Julio Claro 70th Anniversary Day of the Dead Limited Edition Tequila is a special release that celebrates both Don Julio's 70 years of tequila-making expertise and the vibrant tradition of Mexico's Día de los Muertos. This limited-edition tequila, aged as an Añejo and then filtered to give it the crisp clarity of a Blanco, offers a unique blend of aged depth and smooth, clean flavors. Presented in a beautifully designed bottle, this Day of the Dead edition is not only a collector’s item but also an exceptional tequila for sipping or mixing into premium cocktails.

TITLE: Don Julio Primavera Reposado Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Don Julio Primavera features a deliciously smooth expression that takes the brand’s traditional Reposado and finishes it in orange wine casks, which previously held wine made from macerated orange peels, striking the balance of citrus and honey. Featuring a flawless balance of notes, including honeyed agave, a hint of spice, and a light, citrus finish, Tequila Don Julio Primavera is best enjoyed on the rocks with an orange wheel or in our signature drink of the summer: the Primavera Sunset. Simply top Tequila Don Julio Primavera with club soda and garnish with an orange wedge – it’s the perfect cocktail for any outdoor daytime get together

TITLE: Don Julio Private Cask Reposado Tequila The Prime Barrel Pick #35
DESCRIPTION: At last, we pulled a trigger on a tequila barrel! I know this is a whiskey-first club, but if you like us, you probably dabble in other fine spirits, and The Don Julio brand has a special meaning for us - some of us spent our golden years as single guys drinking it. When the opportunity presented itself, we jumped on it. Few barrels are available nationally, so this is pretty rare.Some things to consider. Tequila Don Julio Reposado Private Cask is a limited edition barrel program where a select number of single cask barrels have been hand-selected and aged for 10 months. That is two more months than traditional Reposado, resulting in a rich and nuanced flavor that varies from barrel to barrel. It also has a higher proof than the standard edition, coming in at 85.4 proof (vs. 80 proof). Since Reposado was the first variant that Don Julio González distilled under his name, the Tequila Don Julio Reposado Private Cask program pays homage to the variant by providing tequila aficionados with a limited-edition aged Reposado never before sold. Here's what you can look forward to with this expression: Nose: butterscotch, licorice, ginger, white pepper, clove, oak Palate: cinnamon, clove, yellow plum, cucumber, mint, apricot, ginseng, mint, almonds Finish: long finish that's delicately spicy and nutty As it is a norm with all barrels we select,t $5 from each bottle sold will go to support a charity. This barrel will support the Concerns of Police Survivors Charity. They take care of families left by a line of duty deaths of Police/Corrections

TITLE: Don Julio Reposado Tequila
Don Julio Tequila Anejo Claro 70th Anniversary
DESCRIPTION: Don Julio 70 Anejo Claro Tequila is the culmination of 70 years of knowledge, expertise and innovation that brings the smoothness of a Blanco and the complexity of an Anejo together for a totally unique tequila experience. Don Julio 70 Anejo Claro Tequila is aged eighteen months in American white-oak barrels and then carefully filtered to bring out its crisp agave flavor.

TITLE: Don Papa 10 Years Philippines Rum
DESCRIPTION: Don Papa's 10 Year Old is a limited-edition small-batch rum from the Philippines. Aged in re-charred oak casks, this is big and bold with notes of dried fruit and cacao.

TITLE: Don Papa Small Batch Philippines Rum
DESCRIPTION: Made from tight grain oak, carefully chosen from the finest forests in the United States, these special barrels are seasoned, toasted and lightly charred, resulting in an uplift of fruit and vanilla notes and creating a naturally darker rum. The rum is then aged in the foothills of Mt. Kanlaon, where the hot, humid Negrense climate results in rapid maturation and an “Angel’s Share” of up to 8%.

TITLE: Dona Silvina "Fresh" Malbec
DESCRIPTION: 100% Malbec from estate-grown organic fruit from the Villa Seca vineyard in Maipu. This small, family winery farms only 15 hectares in the high altitude Lujan de Cuyos region of Mendoza. This malbec is unique as it sees no oak treatment, only 100% stainless steel tanks, and also goes through carbonic maceration. The winery Bodegas Krontiras began in 2003. Constantinos passion for wine led him back to his wife’s birthplace in Mendoza and he started in 2003 when he acquired 2 vineyards; an 8 hectare, 120 year old vineyard in the Lunlunta, Perdriel subregion of Lujan de Cuyo and then an 18 hectare vineyard which he planted in Villa Seca, Maipu. This certified organic and soon to be Demeter certified biodynamic property embraces wine as a living system. The winery was built so that it works in an ecofriendly way and fulfills Bodegas Krontiras main rule: to respect Nature from the vineyards to the final product. The current total production of the winery is under 2500cs with four wines currently being produced: Rosado, Fresh Malbec, Classic Malbec, and Reserva Malbec. The wines are all hand harvested according to Bio-dynamic philosophy using only native Yeast, and hand made by their winemaker Soledad Valdes. Unlike Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec doesn’t have a super long finish. Because of this, Malbec is great with leaner red meats (ostrich anyone?). The wine does extremely well with funky flavors like blue cheese and rustic flavors like mushrooms and cumin spice. Meat Pairings - Dark meat poultry and lean red meat. Malbec also pairs well with earthy flavors too, such as beef brisket. Duck, Chicken Leg, Lamb, Beef, Ostrich, Buffalo, Pork Shoulder Spices and Herbs - Look for spices that have earthy or smoky flavors such as: Parsley, Sumac, Thyme, Rosemary, Porcini Powder, Smoked Paprika, Black Pepper, Cumin, Coriander, Juniper Berry, Clove, Vanilla Bean, Garlic, Shallot, Green Onion, Barbecue Sauce Cheese Pairings - Look for funky and rich soft to semi-firm cow’s and goat’s milk cheeses. Vegetables & Vegetarian Fare - Mushroom, Roasted Vegetables, Green and Red Bell Pepper, Potato, Arugula, Kale, Chard, Grilled Endive, Onion, Beet, Tempeh, Lentils, Black Beans, Forbidden Rice

TITLE: Donelli Lambrusco Reggiano
DESCRIPTION: A true representation of Modena, Donelli Lambrusco Reggiano is packaged in the unique Scaglietti bottle, designed by renowned Ferrari designer Sergio Scaglietti. This sparkling half-dry red is vinified in stainless steel tanks, followed by maceration at a controlled temperature. The Charmat method is then implemented to slowly develop the froth. The wine is the ideal accompaniment to tortellini, stuffed pasta, and boiled or roast meats. Serve chilled.

TITLE: Dos Artes X Mala Vida Limited Edition Extra Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Mala Vida and Dos Artes joined to create one of the rarest, most exquisite tequila bottles on the market. Mala Vida x Dos Artes Extra Añejo Black is filled with Dos Artes Extra Anejo Tequila, making it one of the smoothest, most delicious tequilas money can buy. On top of that, this tequila is featured in a beautiful black limited edition skull bottle, a bottle that is sure to turn heads and impress any tequila enthusiast or simply your friends on the weekend. This bottle alone, empty, has high resale value, a true diamond in the world of tequila enthusiasts. Aging: 5 years Barrel: Aged in both French Oak and White American Oak NOM: 1480 (Previously 1466) Region: Jalisco (Los Valles) Agave Region: Jalisco (Tequila Valley), Single Estate Agave Type: Tequilana Weber Cooking: Stone/Brick Ovens Extraction: Roller Mill Distillation: 2x Distilled Still: Stainless Pot with Copper Coll Purity: 100% Blue Agave Alc. Vol: 40% ABV (80-proof)

TITLE: Dos Hombres Tobala Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: The bold notes in Dos Hombres Tobala Mezcal taste come from the Copal trees in the region which impregnate and perfume the soil where Tobala agaves are grown. Copal is a sacred tree which resin is used by people of the village to purify and bless the environment. Tobala agaves for this batch were carefully grown for almost 25 years, harvested and hand selected by our Maestro, Gregorio Velasco. Considered a sacred plant, each bottle of Tobala has hints of plums, chocolate and local lily flower

TITLE: Dos Maderas 5+3 Years Cask and Barrel Rum
DESCRIPTION: Dos Maderas is the world’s only double cask aged rum, an innovative two-step aging process to create a distinctively rich and smooth taste.

TITLE: Dos Minas Torrontes
DESCRIPTION: Dos Minas (“two chicks”) in Argentine slang, are two highly regarded females in the wine industry. Both are aligned in the belief that Torrontés is a wonderfully aromatic, food-friendly wine that is among the best of what Argentina has to offer to the world. Torrontes grows especially well in Cafayate, near Salta, due to sandy soils and a longer, cooler summer than in Mendoza. The vineyards in Cafayate are about 1,750m above sea level and the vines are 45-years old in an area called “El Retiro”. The vines are trained in the Pergola method, which is the traditional way for all Torrontes vines to be trained. Pair this beauty with Thai chicken thighs with green garlic, sashimi with jalapeno zest, and grilled shrimp and guacamole rolled in fresh soft corn tortillas.

TITLE: Double Eagle Very Rare 20 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey 2024
DESCRIPTION: Double Eagle Very Rare 20 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a truly exceptional and luxurious offering from the esteemed Buffalo Trace Distillery. Aged for an extraordinary 20 years, this bourbon is a rare masterpiece that exemplifies the pinnacle of American whiskey craftsmanship. Bottled at 90 proof, Double Eagle Very Rare delivers an unparalleled experience with its deep, complex flavors and sophisticated character. This bourbon is presented in an elegant crystal decanter and a silver presentation box, making it as visually stunning as it is delightful to the palate. Each bottle is individually numbered, highlighting its exclusivity and the meticulous care taken in its production.

TITLE: Douglas Green Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: For over 70 years, the personal touch of Douglas Green has lived in the eponymous range of wines made with the same intuition that began this progressive wine brand in 1942. Today this tradition has kept the wines at the forefront of modern red and white wine styles enjoyed in South Africa and exported to more than 50 countries around the world. This sturdy cab would pair beautifully with grilled meat, say a grass-fed rib eye rubbed with ground porcini mushrooms. We would also like it with a plate of lush, strongly flavored cheeses, like a creamy Morbier and a fine funky blue.

TITLE: Dr. Loosen "Dr.L" Riesling Sparkling
DESCRIPTION: The Dr. Loosen estate has been in the same family for over 200 years. When Ernst Loosen assumed ownership in 1988, he realized that with ungrafted vines averaging 60 years old in some of Germany’s best-rated vineyards, he had the raw materials to create stunningly intense, world-class wines. To achieve this, Ernst dramatically restricts crop size, prohibits chemical fertilization, insists on very strict fruit selection, and employs gentle cellar practices that allow the wine to develop its full potential with a minimum of handling.

TITLE: Dr. Loosen Riesling
DESCRIPTION: The Dr. Loosen estate has been in the same family for over 200 years. When Ernst Loosen (pronounced "loh-zen") assumed ownership in 1988, he realized that with ungrafted vines averaging more than 60 years old in some of Germany's best-rated vineyards, he had the raw materials to create stunningly intense, world-class wines. To achieve this, Ernst dramatically reduced crop size and stopped all chemical fertilization, preferring only moderate use of organic fertilizers. He insisted on fully mature fruit that had been very strictly selected. He also turned to gentler cellar practices that would allow the wines to develop their full potential with a minimum of handling and technological meddling. Ernst's focus is on the clear expression of terroir from each of the distinctive vineyards owned by the estate. All of Dr. Loosen's six major vineyards were designated as "Erste Lage" (equivalent to Grand Cru) in the 1868 Prussian classification of Mosel vineyards. Riesling is an exceptionally versatile wine for food pairing because of its balance of sugar and acidity. It can be paired with cuisines as varied as European, Mexican, Middle Eastern, Asian and Fusion.

TITLE: Drew Family Cellars Anderson Valley Pinot Noir Gatekeepers
DESCRIPTION: The Gatekeeper is an entry point into our Pinot Noirs but certainly not an entry level wine. There is immense flexibility in being able to bring together several lots in our cellar to make an appellation blend. This approach allows several sites and clones to coalesce for a layered expression of coastal Mendocino. The three appellations represented in this year’s Gatekeeper include Anderson Valley, Yorkville Highlands and the Mendocino Ridge. The cool forested hills of Anderson Valley, the mineral laden soils of the Yorkville Highlands and the coastal windswept high hills of Mendocino Ridge all combine for a chiseled, medium bodied, energetic wine . Dark stone fruits, dried floral notes along with loamy forest understory. An unfurling story here.

TITLE: Drifter Cocktail Co. Nitro Espresso Martini
DESCRIPTION: Mixed By Craig Schoettler, Las Vegas, NV, USA Craig Schoettler is a cocktail connoisseur utilizing a fusion of culinary expertise from some of the top restaurants in the country with his mixology masterpieces from top Las Vegas hotspot menus. Attracted to palate-pleasing experiences, Craig’s Nitro Espresso Martini is a nod to a classic nightcap cocktail with notes of rich chocolate, chestnuts and cold brew with a buttery smooth oat milk finish. Drifter Craft Cocktails pairs the world's best spirit-makers with top international bartenders to bring you high-quality, naturally flavored cocktails. The result is premium new twists on global classics, in a can and on the go. DESCRIPTION: Drifter Craft Cocktails Nordic Gin & Tonic is a premium canned cocktail that brings the sophisticated and refreshing flavors of a classic gin and tonic to your fingertips. TITLE: Drumshanbo Gunpowder Sardinian Citrus Irish Gin
DESCRIPTION: The latest release from The Shed Distillery: an Irish gin with an exotic twist! This gin is distilled with more than 12 oriental botanicals, gunpowder tea, and a hint of Sardinian citrus--one of the rarest citrus fruits in the world found only on the island of Sardinia. The mix of botanicals and gunpowder tea gives this gin a uniquely fragrant, almost exotic aroma. Flavours are a delightful meld of orange and grapefruit, which leads to a mysterious finish. Best enjoyed in a smooth, refreshing cocktail or on its own with a generous wedge of fresh red grapefruit.

TITLE: Drumshanbo Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: After decades of consolidation, Ireland is experiencing a craft whiskey renaissance. Founded in 2014, The Shed Distillery delivers the first whiskey from the western province of Connacht in over a century. Polished creamy sweetness and aromatic spices herald this striking dram, which has been triple-distilled and then matured in first-fill bourbon and oloroso sherry casks. Aromas of caramel, brioche, satsuma, and dried apricot draw you in, ushering in a luscious palate of pear, apple, and freewheeling spices bolstered by dried citrus, lime, and toasted coconut.

TITLE: Due North Rum
Dufftown 15 yrs Speyside Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Founded as “Dufftown-Glenlivet Distillery,” this Speyside distillery is currently owned by Diageo. Once used as a mill, the building was converted in 1896, and today the distillery operates six stills and has a capacity of 4,000,000 liters per year. AGED: 15 years DISTILLED ON: December 9, 1997 BOTTLE ON: January 14, 2013 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 19487 ALC: 46%

TITLE: Duke Grand Cru Double Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In the pursuit of finding the perfect balance and expression, Duke Grand Cru Kentucky Reserve Rye whiskey exquisitely marries the classic and powerful flavors of aged Kentucky rye with the finest French Oak Grand Cru wine barrels in the world. Each barrel represents a very key element to the evolution of flavor. The tight grains found in French Oak, originating from centuries-old forests, combined with the perfect level of toasting ultimately provides a canvas rarely explored. At the precise moment, the rye is then moved to rest in a second French oak wine barrel, which has been graced by both a world-class Cabernet and our 9-year-old Kentucky Straight bourbon. This secondary finish rounds out the velvety profile of the rye. Mashbill: 95% Rye, 5% malted barley Finished in: French oak, single-use, French Oak second bourbon finish

TITLE: Duke Grand Cru Founder's Reserve Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In the pursuit of finding the perfect balance and expression, Duke Grand Cru Kentucky Reserve Bourbon exquisitely marries the classic and bold flavors of aged Kentucky bourbon with the finest French Oak Grand Cru wine barrels in the World. Meticulously crafted, a rare 9 yr. old selection of our Kentucky Straight bourbon then delicately rests in these barrels until a unique and graceful balance is found. Not all barrels are created equal, so our master blender has sought out the rarest and finest French Oak barrels to honor and enhance the great flavors of our aged bourbon. These barrels have gracefully aged some of the most stunning 98-100 point scoring single-vineyard California Cult Cabernets. Barrels represent a very key element to the evolution of flavor. The age, tight grains found in the French Oak, originating from centuries-old forests, and, the perfect level of toasting ultimately provides a canvas rarely explored.

TITLE: Duke Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Crafted by Masters, and inspired by rare bottles unearthed and preserved for over 50 years from the collection of John Wayne. Meticulously blended to replicate and honor the tasting notes and profile preferred by John Wayne using his original recipe from 1962 and his private collection to guide flavor and aromatics. A proprietorial mash bill of predominately American bent corn with additions of rye with sixth-row barley. Distilled and aged in Kentucky the old fashioned way, in small batches and aged in heavily charred new and hand built American Oak barrels. A unique blend of 88 proof, aged a minimum of 5 years in barrels hand selected for perfection. MASH BILL 75% American dent corn 13% Rye 12% Sixth-row barley Distilled and bottled in Owensboro, KY at O.Z. Tyler Distillery, KY-11. Blending and Distillation by Founder Chris Radomski and Master Distiller Jacob Call. TASTING NOTES Opens with subtle charred oak, roasted nuts, hints of vanilla, caramel, and nutmeg. Mid-palate provides warm pepper spice and toasted nuts, finishing with a deeply satisfying robust sweetness in perfect combination.

TITLE: Durigutti Mendoza Malbec
DESCRIPTION: Their standard Malbec bottling, Durigutti's Malbec "Clasico" represents what the brothers do best: combine elegance with rusticity. While this is in many ways due to the two differing backgrounds the brothers bring to the table, it is also largely due to the fruit. High altitude fruit from La Consulta adds structure, depth, and power, while bright fruit from Vistalba adds brightness and supple texture. Fermented by native yeast fermentation and aged in new American oak for 12 months. Unfined and unfiltered. A terrific everyday drinker!

TITLE: E J Curley Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: E.J. Curley Single Barrel Bourbon stands out for its masterfully hand-selected barrels, each chosen to represent the most unique characteristics of the E.J. Curley brand. This premium bourbon is crafted to offer an elevated tasting experience. This single-barrel bourbon, part of the E.J. Curley lineup, reflects the brand's commitment to quality and uniqueness. The meticulous selection of barrels indicates a premium and carefully crafted bourbon is likely to appeal to those who appreciate the subtleties of single-barrel expressions. E.J. Curley & Co. has a rich history dating back to 1867 and is known for its skill in creating handcrafted small-batch and single-barrel bourbon expressions. The modern E.J. Curley brand honors its historical roots while bringing expertly crafted bourbon to today's market.

TITLE: E J Curley Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: E.J. Curley Small Batch Bourbon is a well-balanced blend that showcases a harmonious interplay of unique flavors. It is known for its distinctive tasting notes that include wild honeysuckle, magnolia, and earthy tobacco. This bourbon is crafted to provide a perfect pour every time, catering to a wide range of palates. 95. Proof

TITLE: Eagle Rare 10 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Buffalo Trace, who makes this 10-year-old whisky, was named Distiller of the Year by Whiskey Magazine in 2005 and 2007 and by the Wine Enthusiast in 2006. Paul Pacult of The Spirit Journal gave it four stars and said: "Easily one of the most tactile yet assertive and expressive bourbons I've tasted in the last two years; fasten your seatbelts."
