TITLE: Four Roses Small Batch Kentucky Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Marrying, or mingling, multiple Bourbon recipes is an art in itself. Four original and limited Bourbons have been expertly selected by the Master Distiller at the peak of maturation to create a perfectly balanced small batch Bourbon that rewards you with a mellow symphony of rich, spicy flavors along with sweet, fruity aromas and hints of sweet oak and caramel. Finishes soft, smooth and pleasantly long. 90 proof. 45% alcohol/volume. Best enjoyed straight up, on the rocks, or with a splash.

TITLE: Four Roses Super Premium Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This bourbon is one of two Four Roses products that are sold only in Japan, with the other being Four Roses Black Label. Four Roses Super Premium is a completely different product than what you can buy in the U.S. While it uses the same traditional Four Roses recipes, the percentages are different than what you will find in a Four Roses Yellow or Four Roses Small Batch in the U.S. It’s rumored that Super Premium uses several of the recipes, and 80% of the Bourbon must have been aged a minimum of 8 years while 20% aged 10 years or greater. The bourbon is dumped from the barrel at the Four Roses distillery in Kentucky and then sent over to Kirin in Japan for bottling and distribution. Additionally, while this is an export-only bourbon, it is bottled at 750ml versus the standard 700ml that many other export-only bourbons are bottled at, including Four Roses Black Label. The bottle contains the classic embossed Four Roses flower symbol that can be found on other bottlings. However, the symbol itself is made of a light metal versus glass. Incidentally, this bourbon is also sometimes referred to as Four Roses “Platinum.”

TITLE: Four Roses Ten Recipe Bourbon Tasting Set
DESCRIPTION: This exclusive and limited offering is a real treat for Four Roses enthusiasts and a fantastic chance for bourbon and whiskey aficionados. For the first time outside the Kentucky distillery, a complete set of all ten Four Roses Bourbon recipes is accessible without the need for extensive bottle hunting. These 50 ml samples are presented at a strong 104 proof and are non-chill filtered. The package includes a link to a guided tasting video featuring Four Roses Master Distiller Brent Elliot. Four Roses is known for its unique approach to bourbon, creating ten distinct "recipes." These recipes are characterized by their mash bill and the specific yeast strain used during fermentation. Each recipe is identified by a code: O __ S __ In this code, the first and third letters are fixed, while the second and fourth letters vary. The "O" represents the Four Roses Distillery in Lawrenceburg, KY (originally Old Prentice), and the "S" signifies Straight whiskey. The second letter, either "B" or "E", indicates the mash bill – "B" for a high-rye content (60% corn, 35% rye, 5% malted barley) and "E" for a lower rye content (70% corn, 20% rye, 5% malted barley). The final letter, which can be F, K, O, Q, or V, denotes one of the five yeast strains used, each contributing distinct flavors to the whiskey. The standard single barrel from the distillery is the OBSV recipe, while the small batch combines OBSO, OBSK, OESO, and OESK. The "O" in all Four Roses recipe codes pays homage to the distillery's history under Seagram's ownership, who operated multiple distilleries. A perfect example of an outstanding Four Roses recipe is our 16-year-old OESV charity barrel selection.

TITLE: Four Roses Yellow Label Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A worldwide favorite, especially when creating mixed drinks with a sophisticated, contemporary flair. Hints of pear and apple complement floral aromas and mix with a taste of honey and spice. Smooth and mellow with a unique, long and soft finish. 80 proof. 40% alcohol/volume.

TITLE: Foursquare Distillery 12 years Single Blended Rum Exceptional Cask Selection Mark XVII
DESCRIPTION: Single blended rum, consisting of both artisanal pot and traditional twin column Coffey distilled molasses rums. 2009 has been aged for 12-years, entirely in Ex-Bourbon casks, bottled at Cask Strength at 60% ABV. No color, no sugar, no additives, no filtration. A rich and assertive character with notes of dark cherries, cranberry, orange peel, caramelized pineapple, and dried peach

TITLE: Foursquare Distillery 14 Years "Sovereignty" Single Blended Rum Exceptional Cask Selection Mark XIX
DESCRIPTION: A blend of two distinct single blended rums, both 14 years of age. One aged 14 years, entirely in Ex-Bourbon Barrels, and a second double-maturation, aged 3 years in Ex-Bourbon barrels then 11 additional years in Ex-Sherry Casks. Bottled at 62% ABV – 124 Proof. No color, no sugar, no additives, no filtration.

TITLE: Foursquare Distillery Dominus Single Blended Rum
Foursquare Distillery Exceptional Cask Selection 2004 Single Blended Rum
DESCRIPTION: Foursquare Distillery is owned by the Seale family who have five generations of rum-making expertise dating back to 1820. The family itself can trace its roots on the island back to the 1650s. Being wholly family owned means we are free to pursue a perfectionist agenda compared to most Caribbean rum distilleries which are beholden to the major spirit companies. We invest more time and more money than other distilleries because we believe it makes a difference to the taste.

TITLE: Foursquare Distillery Mark IX "Empery" 14 Year Old Single Blended Rum
DESCRIPTION: Single Blended Rum, a blend of two 14-year-old rums. One aged for 14 years in Ex-Bourbon barrels, another a double maturation – 10 years in Ex-Bourbon barrels then transferred to Ex-Oloroso Sherry barrels for 4 years. Bottled at 56% ABV.

TITLE: Foursquare Distillery Mark VII "Premise" Single Blended Rum
Foursquare Distillery Mark X "2007" 12 Year Old Exceptional Cask Selection Single Blended Rum
DESCRIPTION: Single Blended Rum, Aged for 12 years in a combination of first, second and third fill Ex-Bourbon barrels, bottled at 59% ABV.

TITLE: Foursquare Distillery Mark XI "Sagacity" 12 Year Old Exceptional Cask Selection Single Blended Rum
DESCRIPTION: This Single Blended Rum is crafted from both artisanal pot and traditional twin column Coffey distilled molasses rums, both 12 years of age. One rum has been aged for 12 years entirely in ex-Bourbon barrels, the other for 12 years entirely in ex-Madeira casks. Bottled at 48% ABV - 96 Proof. No sugar added. No flavor additives. Foursquare Rum Distillery is located on a former sugar plantation that dates back to approximately 1720, within the tiny Caribbean island of Barbados. The distillery was re-opened by the Seale family in 1996, distilling operations and blending are currently directed by Richard Seale, 4th Generation Trader/Distiller of R.L. Seale & Co. Exceptional Cask Selections represent the unique, and rare offerings of Foursquare that Richard has hand-selected, his personal aging experiments only released when he feels they are of exceptional quality. These are one-of-a-kind expressions, available for a limited time, and showcasing truly unique approaches to both rum blending and maturation. All of the Exceptional Cask Selections have been matured in Barbados in a tropical climate - accelerating multiple aspects of the maturation process, in many cases aging 2-3x faster than if in Europe or a more temperate climate

TITLE: Foursquare Distillery Mark XII "Nobiliary" 14 Year Old Exceptional Cask Selection Single Blended Rum
DESCRIPTION: Single Blended Rum, Aged for 14 years entirely in Ex-Bourbon barrels. Bottled at 62% ABV. Cask Strength. No Color. No Sugar. No Additives. No Filtration.

TITLE: Foursquare Distillery Mark XIII "2008" 12 Year Old Exceptional Cask Selection Single Blended Rum
DESCRIPTION: Single Blended Rum, Aged for 12 years in a combination of first, second and third fill Ex-Bourbon barrels, bottled at 60% ABV. No Color. No Sugar. No Additives. No Filtration

TITLE: Foursquare Distillery Mark XVI "Shibboleth" 16 Year Old Exceptional Cask Selection Single Blended Rum
DESCRIPTION: A Single Blended Rum, Aged for 16 years in Ex-Bourbon Barrels – all aging on-site in Barbados. Bottled at 56% ABV – 112 Proof. No color, no sugar, no additives, no filtration.

TITLE: Foursquare Distillery Mark XVIII "Indelible" 11 Years Single Blended Rum
DESCRIPTION: A blend of two distinct single blended rums, both 11 years of age. One aged 11 years, entirely in Ex-Bourbon Barrels, and a second, double-maturation, aged 5 years in Ex-Zinfandel then 6 additional years in Ex-Bourbon Barrels. Bottled at 48% ABV – 96 Proof. No sugar, no flavor additives, no filtration.

TITLE: Foursquare Distillery Zinfandel Cask Single Blend Rum
DESCRIPTION: Foursquare Distillery is owned by the Seale family who have five generations of rum-making expertise dating back to 1820. The family itself can trace its roots on the island back to the 1650s. Being wholly family owned means we are free to pursue a perfectionist agenda compared to most Caribbean rum distilleries which are beholden to the major spirit companies. We invest more time and more money than other distilleries because we believe it makes a difference to the taste.

TITLE: Foursquare Distillery"Probitas" White Blended Rum
DESCRIPTION: A blend of pot and column still rum from two powerhouse distilleries, Foursquare in Barbados and Hampden Estate in Jamaica, blended by Richard Seale. In total three rums are included, a two year tropically aged Foursquare pot still rum (lending a bit of color), an unaged Foursquare coffey column still rum, and an unaged Hampden Estate pot still rum. The Hampden marque used is OWH, a low ester marquee. 47% ABV.

TITLE: Foursquare Rum Distillery Exceptional Cask Selection "Touchstone" Single Blended Rum "Mark XXII"
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the unparalleled craftsmanship of Foursquare Rum Distillery with the Exceptional Cask Selection 'Touchstone' Single Blended Rum. This exquisite rum, carefully curated by Foursquare, is a true touchstone in the world of rum aficionados. Distilled in Barbados, it reflects the mastery of single blended rum, offering a sensory journey through the rich and nuanced flavors of the Caribbean.

TITLE: Fox Brook Winery Merlot
DESCRIPTION: This medium-bodied Merlot tastes of jammy berries, with touches of vanilla, choco- late, and spice, and has a lingering finish. Pair this wine with roasted lamb, spaghetti Bolognese and grilled vegetables.

TITLE: Fox Run Vineyards Finger Lakes Lemberger
DESCRIPTION: Pair with lamb dishes and grilled meats

TITLE: Foxglove Paso Robles Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: 94% Cabernet Sauvignon, 4% Petit Verdot, 2% Cabernet Franc. The Foxglove Cabernet over delivers for the price point.

TITLE: Foxglove Paso Robles Zinfandel
DESCRIPTION: 94% Cabernet Sauvignon, 4% Petit Verdot, 2% Cabernet Franc. The Foxglove Cabernet over delivers for the price point.

TITLE: Foxglove San Luis Obispo County Chardonnay
DESCRIPTION: Foxglove San Luis Obispo County Chardonnay is a delicious and refreshing wine from the Central Coast of California. It is made from 100% Chardonnay grapes, which are known for their versatility and ability to produce a variety of wine styles. This wine has a pale yellow color and aromas of apple, pear, and citrus fruit. On the palate, it is dry and medium-bodied, with flavors of apple, pear, peach, and lemon. The wine has a bright and refreshing acidity. Foxglove San Luis Obispo County Chardonnay is a versatile wine that can be enjoyed on its own or paired with a variety of foods. It is particularly well-suited to seafood, poultry, and pork dishes. It can also be enjoyed as an aperitif.

TITLE: Franchere Wine Company "For Heaven's Sake Don't Move Here" Orange Wine
DESCRIPTION: This is my orange wine, and it’s an ironically-named tribute to explorers and immigrants. Vitis vinifera is, of course, not native to this hemisphere, and in the long view of things, so few of us are. But as we put down roots we adapt to our new home, and ideally harmonize with it, rather than bend it to our will. I cofermented 85% Pinot gris and 15% Grüner veltliner with 10 days of skin contact in an open-topped fermentor. Following a gentle press in a basket press, the wine aged for 7 months in older, used French oak. The wine is totally dry and it completed malolactic conversion.

TITLE: Francis Ford Coppola Sofia Blanc De Blancs White Blend
DESCRIPTION: When his daughter was a little girl, Francis Coppola made her a promise that he would someday make a sparkling wine and name it after her. Today, this Blanc de Blancs is one of our most popular offerings, a favorite for parties and weddings. Fruity and refreshing, Sofia Blanc de Blancs is a rare blend of Pinot Blanc, Muscat, and Riesling. Mellow flavors of apples and pears are topped by a hint of citrus and honeysuckle. Elegant in character, this wine is lightly textured and vibrant through the finish.

TITLE: Francis Ford Coppola Sofia Blanc De Blancs White Blend
DESCRIPTION: When his daughter was a little girl, Francis Coppola made her a promise that he would someday make a sparkling wine and name it after her. Today, this Blanc de Blancs is one of our most popular offerings, a favorite for parties and weddings. Fruity and refreshing, Sofia Blanc de Blancs is a rare blend of Pinot Blanc, Muscat, and Riesling. Mellow flavors of apples and pears are topped by a hint of citrus and honeysuckle. Elegant in character, this wine is lightly textured and vibrant through the finish.

TITLE: Franck Givaudin Irancy
DESCRIPTION: Franck Givaudin is the 5th generation of his family to run this vineyard. Irancy is a small sheltered valley up near Chablis in northern Burgundy. All the grapes from Franck Givaudin's estate are organically grown, hand-harvested, and fermented with natural yeast. 100% Pinot Noir from a 9 hectare vineyard of 30-year old vines grown on mainly limestone soils. Hand-harvested and fermented with native yeast. Fermentation lasts for 8-10 weeks and then 15% of the wine is aged in barrique for 1 year. Pair with lean meats, charcuterie, cheeses, and soups with a tomato base.

TITLE: Francois Cazin Cheverny Rose
DESCRIPTION: Pinot Noir/Gamay. Cazin’s signature wine may be his extraordinary Romorantin from the Cour-Cheverny appellation. But he also grows some black fruit, from which he makes a beautiful red Cheverny, as well as this direct-press rose.

TITLE: Francois Cazin Le Petit Chambord Rouge Cheverny
DESCRIPTION: Francois Cazin tends vines of considerable age and the resulting yields are well below average in any given year. His Cheverny is fresh and floral, with appley-texture and crisp acidity. The flavors are sleek and precise. Since 1997, the wine has been bottled unfiltered by gravity. His wines have consistently been the top pick of the vintage at the annual Loire Valley wine show in Angers. This varietal, with its high acidity and minerality, is angular and rough in mediocre vintages. But when it achieves high ripeness, the wine has astonishing grapey, apricot and roasted nuts flavors, kept fresh and lively by good acidity.

TITLE: Francois Chidaine Touraine Rouge
DESCRIPTION: Embark on a journey through the Loire Valley with Francois Chidaine Touraine Rouge, a distinguished French red wine crafted by the talented Francois Chidaine. This red blend, featuring the finesse of Pinot Noir and the depth of Côt (Malbec), showcases the unique terroir of the Touraine region.

TITLE: Francois de Nicolay "Objectif bulles" Petillant Naturel
DESCRIPTION: Francois de Nicolay, who manages Chandon de Briailles along with his sister Claude, started this tiny negociant project in 2000 with the aim of producing as pure an expression of Burgundy as possible. Having seen the benefits of biodynamic viticulture at his family domaine he wanted to produce his own line of naturally made Burgundy, sourcing only from biodynamic and organic vineyards owned by friends, and imparting minimal influence in the cellar. The wines are made using only native yeasts, neutral barrels, and no added sulfur.

TITLE: Francois Ducrot "Auguste" Orange
Francois Montand Brut Rose
DESCRIPTION: Francois Montand, a descendent of a long line of winemakers from Champagne, moved to the Jura region in the 1940s and began making sparkling wines according to the traditional Champagne method. He soon became regarded as a Jura specialist and was instrumental in the creation of the Cremant du Jura AOC. Today, Francois Montand wines are still produced in the Jura region with strict adherence to Methode Traditionnelle, and a rigorous selection of the best grapes to offer fresh and fruity quality sparkling wine for the pleasure of all. The majority of the fruit comes from west facing slopes located in "Revermont" or "Bon-Pays" area of the Jura with additional vineyard sources in the south of France. The soils are mostly clay with limestone with a subsoil of marl. Really well made in the classic Champagne Method. Aged horizontally at least for 9 months. Serve the Francois Montand Brut Rose as an aperitif, with a truffle risotto, risotto ai funghi or as a dessert wine. Serving temperature: 43 to 46°F.

TITLE: Francois Pinon Brut Rose Petillant Naturel
DESCRIPTION: 50% Côt (Malbec)/50% Grolleau. This sparkling methode ancestrale rose is Pinon's only non-Chenin wine, made from black grapes planted by François Pinon's father in order to supply their workers with red wine. There is only 1 hectare, so production is small. Two weeks into its fermentation with natural yeasts in vat, the wine is bottled and finshes in about two more weeks. The bottles are disgorged in April after the vintage and receive no dosage.

TITLE: Frank August Case Study: 03 Winter Cover Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Frank August Case Study: 03 Winter Cover Rye Whiskey is a unique and limited-edition release from the Frank August Case Study series. Designed to explore the nuanced flavors that rye whiskey can offer, this expression focuses on the seasonality of winter, offering a robust, warming profile that is perfect for cooler months. Bottled at approximately 100 proof, this rye whiskey delivers a complex and bold flavor experience with spice, sweetness, and depth. Each Case Study release brings a new perspective on whiskey-making, and the Winter Cover Rye is a testament to Frank August’s commitment to craftsmanship and innovation in whiskey.

TITLE: Frank August Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Frank August Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a refined and distinguished expression from the Frank August Distillery. This single-barrel bourbon is meticulously crafted and selected to showcase the unique characteristics of each barrel. Aged to perfection in new American oak barrels, it offers a rich and complex flavor profile that bourbon enthusiasts will appreciate. Bottled at 123.8 proof, Frank August Single Barrel Bourbon delivers a robust and balanced experience, perfect for sipping neat, on the rocks, or in classic bourbon cocktails. Each bottle represents the dedication to quality and craftsmanship that defines Frank August Distillery.

TITLE: Frank August Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Frank August Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a meticulously crafted expression from the Frank August Distillery. This small batch bourbon is carefully blended to highlight the unique characteristics of each barrel, creating a harmonious and balanced flavor profile. Aged in new American oak barrels, this bourbon embodies the rich heritage and craftsmanship of Kentucky bourbon-making. Bottled at 100 proof, Frank August Small Batch Bourbon delivers a smooth and robust experience, making it perfect for sipping neat, on the rocks, or in your favorite bourbon cocktails. This bourbon is a testament to the dedication and expertise of Frank August Distillery.

TITLE: Frank Cornelissen Susucaru Terre Siciliane Rosato
DESCRIPTION: Frank Cornelissen is the owner of 12 hectares of vines high up on Mount Etna. Frank has been involved in wine his entire life. He is the son of a wine broker in Belgium and so has had the opportunity to be around wine on a professional level from a very young age. There are a lot of details in his winemaking that affect the way that the wines end up, but for him it all starts in the vineyards. Frank isn't Sicilian so choosing Mount Etna was decision and not just happenstance. He chose Mount Etna for a few reasons, but the first was the soil. He feels that volcanic soils have a significant voice and, in concert with Etna's primary variety Nerello Mascalese, he could make a wine of great complexity and distinction. In the winery his work follows the same philosophy of using what nature provides him. There are no yeasts, sulfites, or anything else added to the wines. The idea is to have wines that taste of grapes and terroir.

TITLE: Frank Cornelissen Terre Siciliane Susucaru Rosso
DESCRIPTION: Frank Cornelissen is the owner of 12 hectares of vines high up on Mount Etna. Frank has been involved in wine his entire life. He is the son of a wine broker in Belgium and so has had the opportunity to be around wine on a professional level from a very young age. The idea is to have wines that taste of grapes and terroir.

TITLE: Fratelli Antonio & Raimondo Piemonte Barbera
DESCRIPTION: Fratelli Antonio & Raimondo Piemonte Barbera 2022 is a full-bodied, flavorful red wine made from Barbera grapes grown in the Piedmont region of Italy. The wine has a deep ruby color and aromas of ripe red fruits, spices, and tobacco. On the palate, it is rich and concentrated, with flavors of blackberries, cherries, and plums. The wine has a long, lingering finish with hints of acidity and tannins.

TITLE: Fratelli Serio And Battista Borgogno Barolo Nebbiolo
DESCRIPTION: Vinification and ageing: maceration for 8-10 days in large oak casks, with frequent replacement and turning. Following a second fermentation called the maloactic, the wine is ready for ageing in large oak casks, three years for Barolo Vintage and minimun five years for Barolo Riserva. After bottling, the wine is allowed a further 6 months ageing in horizontal racks. An elegant partner for roasts, game, stews, and well aged cheeses.

TITLE: Free Delivery
DESCRIPTION: Free Delivery

TITLE: Freelander District One Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Freelander District One Cabernet Sauvignon is a robust and expressive red wine from California's Central Coast. Crafted from select sustainably farmed vineyards throughout the state, this Cabernet Sauvignon showcases the region's diverse terroir and warm sunshine. Aged for 10 months in a combination of French and American oak, the wine reveals rich layers of flavor and complexity.

TITLE: Freschello Red
DESCRIPTION: One of Italy's top selling wines for over ten years. Excellent as an aperitif and complimentary to a variety of dishes.

TITLE: Frey Ranch "Freytastic Four" Four Grain Cask Strength Bourbon The Prime Barrel Pick #109
DESCRIPTION: Celebrate with us as Frey Ranch marks 10 years of distilling! The Prime Barrel is proud to join in the celebration with the release of our first Frey Ranch single barrel bourbon. Our journey began last summer during a virtual tasting with Colby and Ashley Frey, where they guided us through their distillery. We were inspired to plan a trip to Fallon, NV, to select a barrel of our own. Ultimately, seven Prime Barrel members journeyed across the high desert, located 75 miles east of Reno. The Frey family has been farming this land for over 165 years. Today, 100% of the grain they grow goes into whiskey production. They handle every aspect, including malting their own grain in custom-built drums fabricated locally. After an insightful tour of the farm and distillery, we entered the tasting room to select our barrel, joined by Ashley Frey and Master Distiller Russell Wedlake. Together, they hand-selected six exceptional barrels for us to taste blind. Choosing one was challenging; Barrel 2 and Barrel 5 emerged as the top contenders. Barrel 2 showcased fruity notes, while Barrel 5 was a spice bomb. Ultimately, we selected Barrel 2 for its well-rounded profile, featuring a velvety and creamy mouthfeel at 123.26 proof. Details: Barrel #2383 Mashbill: 66.6% corn, 11.4% winter rye, 10% winter wheat, 12% barley Age: 5 Years, 7 Months, 18.5 Days Proof: 123.26 Cooperage: ISC Warehouse: F Location: 30F3 Tasting Notes: Nose: Sweet hay, honey, slight herbal scents Palate: Butterscotch blends with toffee and Werther’s candy, with a fruity flourish Finish: Medium-long fade with smoked honey and black pepper Ordering Options: Bundle with Selected Regular Frey Ranch Expressions and SAVE! $10 OFF when purchased as a bundle. Bundle with a 12 oz Barrel-Aged Whole Bean Coffee Pack (aged in our Frey Ranch barrel) - coffee ships free when purchased with a single barrel expression. Standalone Expression The barrel-aged coffee can also be purchased separately, with a $5 shipping fee for one or more 12 oz bags. Frey Ranch is gradually expanding distribution, but single barrels remain a rarity. Don’t miss this opportunity to add a farm-to-glass Frey Ranch single-barrel bourbon to your collection! Secure your bottle today and experience the essence of Frey Ranch!

TITLE: Frey Ranch Bottled-in-Bond Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Frey Ranch Bottled-in-Bond Rye is a premium expression from the Frey Ranch Distillery in the heart of Nevada. This rye whiskey is crafted under the strict standards of the Bottled-in-Bond Act, ensuring it is produced in a single distillation season by one distiller at one distillery, aged for a minimum of four years, and bottled at 100 proof. Made from 100% estate-grown grains, this rye showcases the quality and dedication of Frey Ranch’s grain-to-glass approach. The result is a bold, complex whiskey with a rich, spicy character perfect for rye enthusiasts seeking a robust and authentic experience.

TITLE: Frey Ranch Farm Strength Uncut: Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Frey Ranch Farm Strength Uncut Bourbon Whiskey is a robust and full-bodied expression that showcases the pure essence of Nevada’s Frey Ranch Distillery. This uncut and unfiltered bourbon is bottled at cask strength, typically ranging between 120 and 125 proof, offering an intense and authentic bourbon experience straight from the barrel. Made from 100% estate-grown grains, Frey Ranch Farm Strength Bourbon is crafted with meticulous care, ensuring every bottle reflects the dedication and expertise of this grain-to-glass distillery. This whiskey is perfect for bourbon enthusiasts who appreciate bold flavors and a powerful, yet balanced, drinking experience.

TITLE: Frey Ranch Four Grain Single Barrel Cask Strength Bourbon The Prime Barrel x R-Bourbon Pick
DESCRIPTION: Rich cola, cherries, cocoa, beautiful pepper spice, and heavy caramel on the nose. It’s big, fat, rich. Rich on the palate again, lovely and deep. Heavy cola, sweet oak. caramel candies, brulee and brioche. Delighted to find Frey’s typical grain note absent, replaced with buttercream, brulee caramelized sugar and barrel char. Long finish, rich and heavy with cola, caramelized sugar, tobacco, and toffee.

TITLE: Frey Ranch Four Grain Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Frey Ranch Four Grain Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a distinctive and carefully crafted spirit from Frey Ranch Distillery in Nevada. As a true grain-to-glass operation, Frey Ranch grows, malts, and distills all the grains used in this bourbon on their family farm, ensuring the quality and consistency that sets it apart. This bourbon is made from a unique mashbill of four grains—corn, winter cereal rye, winter wheat, and two-row barley—each contributing its character to the whiskey. Aged for five years and bottled at 90-proof, Frey Ranch Four Grain Bourbon offers a rich and balanced flavor profile that reflects the craftsmanship and dedication of its producers.

TITLE: Frisk Prickly Alpine Valleys Riesling
DESCRIPTION: Frisk Prickly Alpine Valleys Riesling is a zippy, refreshing, dry wine with a hint of sweetness. It's made from Riesling grapes grown in the cool-climate Alpine Valleys region of Victoria, Australia. The wine has aromas of lime sorbet, rose petals, and fennel. On the palate, it's light-bodied with crisp acidity and flavors of citrus fruits, white peach, and honeydew melon. The finish is clean and refreshing, with a lingering minerality and floral notes.

TITLE: Fritsch "Red Soil" Zweigelt
DESCRIPTION: Zweigelt is best served with a very slight chill to help focus the acidity. This slight chill, and having the bottle sitting in a bucket of ice next to you, is the perfect image of summertime relaxation. The brightness inherent in these wines are a perfect counter to the richness and fat of many grilled foods — it cuts richness like a sharp knife. Conversely, with a salad and a small cut of lean meat, it handles itself with respect and never overpowers the food. Is this the ultimate pairing wine? In this case, yes. Zweigelt allows you to bring something new to the next neighborhood barbecue. People will ask what it is, especially after tasting it and realizing just how much they love it.

TITLE: Fritsch Zweigelt Rose
DESCRIPTION: This wine is best served with a very slight chill to help focus the acidity. This slight chill, and having the bottle sitting in a bucket of ice next to you, is the perfect image of summertime relaxation. The brightness of the wine is a perfect counter to the richness and fat of many grilled foods — it cuts richness like a sharp knife. Conversely, with a salad and a small cut of lean meat, it handles itself with respect and never overpowers the food.

TITLE: Fritz Muller Perlwein Muller-Thurgau Dry Rheinhessen
DESCRIPTION: Fresh, fruity and exhilarating, the semi-sparkling "Fritz" is created from the traditional German Müller-Thurgau grape. The German answer to Prosecco, it tingles terrifically, and is a smash hit for the price. Müller-Thurgau wines pair well with light dishes, such as vegetable dishes (especially asparagus) and salads.

TITLE: From the Tank Coteaux du Pont du Gard Vin Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Great for serving by the glass, for parties, picnics, or for people who want only a glass of wine a day. The conservation is much longer then bottles once they are opened & it is light to carry. The box also has a much smaller carbon footprint than bottles because it is so light to ship. Seafood dishes, hearty garden salads, grilled vegetables, soft ripened cheeses or simply by itself.

TITLE: From the Tank Coteaux du Pont du Gard Vin Rose
DESCRIPTION: Varietals: Grenache (80%) and Syrah (20%) Soil: Old terrace (sandstone) Pruning Method: Gobelet & Royat Age of Vines: 21 yr. old Syrah, 40 yr. old Grenache. Yields: 50 hl/ha Vinification: This rosé was racked by bleeding by opening the base of the vat while the wine is still light in color. Traditional vinification without clusters, aged in concrete vat with minimum sulfur.

TITLE: From the Tank Cotes du Rhone Vin Rouge
Frontera Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot
DESCRIPTION: Cabernet Sauvignon & Merlot blend.

TITLE: Fuenteseca Cosecha Huerta Singular Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Fuenteseca Cosecha Tequila explores the dynamics of a single-site spirit, embracing terroir as a concept and celebrating the uniqueness of micro-harvested agave. (45.7% ABV) Made entirely from a single orchard of agave grown at 5,250’ elevation, Enrique Fonseca realized upon harvesting in 2013 that these agave were too dynamic to mix with others for a larger production. Instead, he separated the El Maguey field plants, slowly baked them at low pressure, and double-distilled the spirit in a copper alembic pot still. He then rested the tequila for three years to achieve complete rested oxygenation before finally bottling the small quantity in the Fall of 2016.

TITLE: Fuenteseca Tequila 11 Year Old Reserva Extra Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Distilled in late winter of 2006 with two-thirds of the expression made in a double-copper column still with plates removed to achieve a lower distillation proof and the remaining third made in an alembic pot still. One third of this lot was then laid into in American white oak previously used to age California red wine, and the remaining two-thirds was barreled in used dark French Oak. The casks were then rested for the full 11 years at 3,800′ elevation in a cool-climate subterranean barrel room, with the upper-most portion of the room opened to allow for soft air circulation in order to create a drier aging environment.

TITLE: Fuenteseca Tequila 15 Year Old Reserva Extra Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: The Atotonilco highland agave used in the lot were harvested late into the Spring, just before the arrival of 1998’s summer rains. It was laid into barrel in August of that summer and spent the next 15 years stored in a dry, earthen-floor aging room in the town of Atotonilco el Alto. Because the agave used here had lower sugar content resultant of the prior year’s El Niño storms (which had water-logged the plants), a delightful faint sweetness is restored by aging nearly entirely in American white oak. A scant 3% of the lot was laid into French Oak, in order to contribute a subtle dark oak tannin complexity. Dry and complex, master distiller Enrique Fonseca has released this selection at 43% ABV as the optimal proof for this intriguing 15 year tequila.

TITLE: Fuenteseca Tequila 18 Year Old Reserve Extra Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: This lot was distilled in September 1995, and consisted of 75% tequila distilled in copper column stills and 25% tequila distilled in copper alembic stills. The entire run was laid into 180L Canadian white oak casks previously used to age Canadian rye whiskey, at a warehouse located at 4,600’ in the town of Atotonilco el Alto, Jalisco. The casks remained there for six years. In 2001, the tequilas were extracted from their casks, blended together and re-barreled, with 47% returned to Canadian white oak casks and the remaining 53% going into 220L European dark oak barrels previously used to age California red wine. The refilled casks were then moved from Atotonilco el Alto to a hillside facility El Chapingo, with its cooler, breezier climate, and left to age for an additional twelve years.

TITLE: Fuenteseca Tequila 21 Year Old Reserva Extra Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Seeking to create the world’s longest-aged tequila, master distiller Enrique Fonseca distilled this lot in copper double-column stills in order to achieve a leaner structure without too many agave vegetable fats, which could breakdown over the foreseen ensuing decades. From mostly 1984 plantings, these agave were harvested in late 1993, distilled just barely into the new year, and laid into barrel in February of 1994. The casks were stored for 10 years in a dry, earthen-floor aging room in the town of Atotonilco el Alto, before being designated as worthy of a longer aging, and moved to a higher, cooler climate of Chapingo, Jalisco, which sits on the slope above Atotonilco el Alto. The barrels rested in Chapingo for an entire additional 11 years before finally being bottled in 2014. All but one barrel was 180L Canadian white oak previously used for aging Canadian rye whiskey. The remaining barrel had been used to age a California white wine.

TITLE: Fuenteseca Tequila 7 Year Old Reserva Extra Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Enrique Fonseca distilled this expression in early Spring of 2010, with three-quarters of the bottling made in a double-copper column still with removed plates to achieve a lower distillation proof and the remaining quarter made in an alembic pot still. Half of the run was then stored in American white oak previously used to age California red wine, and the remaining half barreled in used dark French Oak. The casks were then stored for 7 years at 3,800′ elevation in a cool-climate subterranean barrel room.

TITLE: Fuenteseca Tequila 8 Years Old Reserva Extra Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Master Distiller Enrique Fonseca distilled this selection in late Spring of 2008, with three-quarters of the expression made in a double-copper column still with plates removed to achieve a lower distillation proof, and the remaining quarter made in an alembic pot still. One-quarter of the distillate was then laid in American white oak previously used to age California red wine, and three-quarters was aged in used dark French Oak. The casks were stored for the full 8 years in a damp-climate cellar used in the early 1900s as a water cistern, to slowly settle the spirit in a colder environment with reduced wood interaction.

TITLE: Fuji Single Grain Japanese Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In creating this dram, Fuji master blender Jota Tanaka blends four styles of whisky, all produced and aged at Fuji Gotemba Distillery located at the base of Mount Fuji. The nose is delicate and softly sweet, calling to mind honey grahams, molasses, malt, a zip of lemon meringue, and baking spice. The richly textured palate is loaded with vanilla icing and marshmallow sweetness, malt, caramel, and dried mango, but there’s a complexity aided by bursts of black pepper and jalapeño. The peppery spice, as does sweet vanilla cream, follows through on the finish.

TITLE: Fukano 10 Year Old  Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This exceptional offering from the premier producer of malted rice whisky in Japan reaches new levels of elegance. Aged for ten long years in toasted brandy puncheons, the oak still takes a backseat to the exceptionally smooth and fruit-forward spirit. Nonetheless, we're reaching the upper limits of what we've experienced in terms of aging this type of spirit and it retains plenty of texture without exhibiting any overt rice or sake flavors. Instead, expect complex aromatics with strong citrus and subtle vanilla quality. Hints of white rose, acacia, citrus oil, and mint. On the palate, it's very round and soft, discarding the youthfulness on the nose for some gorgeous exotic spice and marmalade notes. Definitely one of the most interesting of the rice whiskey we've come across yet. We're very happy to see older age statements starting to creep their way out of this idiosyncratic distillery.

TITLE: Fukano 14 Year Old Single Cask Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Fukano Whisky 14yr Single Cask is a whisky unique onto its own. 4 special single casks were chosen to represent this unique whisky matured in new Oak casks.

TITLE: Fukano 16 Year Old First-Fill Sherry Cask Matured Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This is the oldest age stated release for the category leader for this new wave of Japanese Whisky from the south. Some purists cry foul because these are distilled from fermented rice and CANNOT be called whisky in Japan, but the products meet the definition of whisky in the United States and so here we are. This distillery also has a long tradition of aging their spirits in a combination of unusual cask types from new and used American oak to brandy puncheons and of course massive sherry butts. There's no question they had something special in mind when they filled this first fill butt more than a decade and a half ago. Sure they had no idea it would end up being sold in the US as whisky, but that doesn't make it any less special. Massive sherry nose and mahogany color give you an idea of what's to come. Dried fruits, pipe tobacco, spice box, oolong tea and caramelized sugar. Deep rich and textured. Easily the most intensely sherried expression we've seen from the excellent Fukano distillery.

Fukano Distillery Japanese Whisky Limited Edition 2021

This Fukano stands out with its ethereal fruity delights, resulting from meticulous vigilance to preserve the spirit’s subtle nature. Aromas of sugared plums and mulberry with undertones of baking spice and root vegetables transition to a palate of cherry blossom, honeysuckle, toasted macadamia nut, and orchard fruit with a finish of plantain and white chocolate-covered cherry. TITLE: Fukano Vault 1 Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Comprised of some fo the rarer whisky stocks at the distillery, everything for Vault 1 has been aged from 3-11yrs and then in some cases rested in tanks for 16yrs. Vault 1 is full of nuance and myriad subtle flavors ranging from the spicy to the savory, all emanating from a core of honey-coated grain. Available in very limited quantities.

TITLE: Fukano Vault 2 Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Rounder, darker and more oak-driven than Vault 1 and in some ways more akin to an American Whiskey. the flavors easily play off each other until they resolve into a sweet harmony of freshly peeled orange, vanilla, salted caramels, and bittersweet dark chocolate.

TITLE: G.D. Vajra Barolo Albe
DESCRIPTION: Aldo Vaira's wines are characterised by pristine flavours and clearly defined perfumes. These characters are attributable to the position of his vineyards at about 400 metres above sea level in the village of Vergne in the commune of Barolo. G.D. Vajra was established in 1972 and named after Aldo's father, Giuseppe Domenico. Aldo has been gradually increasing the area under vine to 60 hectares, of which 10 are Nebbiolo for Barolo, located in such strategic spots as Bricco delle Viole, Fossati, La Volta and Coste di Vergne. A traditionalist, Aldo adheres to old-style winemaking methods, though blends these with new techniques, such as temperature controlled fermentation, to produce such superbly elegant wines. Garlicky Grilled Beef Tenderloin with Herbs, Pasta with Robiola and Truffles, Salt-Crusted Prime Rib Roast

TITLE: G.H. Mumm Champagne Brut Grand Cordon
DESCRIPTION: Mumm Grand Cordon’s revolutionary bottle honours the past in a future-forward spirit: the iconic red ribbon is molded directly in the glass achieving a technical feat. Epitome of the House’s signature style, Mumm Grand Cordon expresses all the nuances of the Pinot Noir grape variety from the Champagne region of France. They are sourced from more than 100 crus for a bold, rich wine that subtly balances the power and structure of Pinot Noir with the elegance and minerality of Chardonnay and the fruitiness of Meunier. A portion of the reserve wines in this cuvée are aged in oakvats bringing even greater aromatic complexity. Toasting milestones, personal achievements or simply celebrating friendship with an improvised get-together, the exceptional fresh intensity of Mumm Grand Cordon champagne evokes the exhilaration of life’s most unforgettable moments.

TITLE: G4 de Madera Reposado Tequila Dia de los Muertos 2024 Limited Release
DESCRIPTION: G4 de Madera Reposado Tequila Día de los Muertos 2024 Limited Release is a special edition tequila crafted by the renowned El Pandillo distillery (NOM 1579) in Jalisco, Mexico. Aged for 10 months in specially selected wooden casks, this reposado offers a unique twist on the traditional aging process, resulting in a rich and layered flavor profile. Created to celebrate Día de los Muertos, this limited release captures the spirit of the holiday with its vibrant packaging and deep, earthy character. Perfect for sipping or as a luxurious addition to premium cocktails, G4 de Madera Reposado is a tribute to Mexican craftsmanship and tradition.

TITLE: G4 Tequila Premium Blanco High Proof Tequila
DESCRIPTION: G4 Tequila Premium Blanco High Proof Tequila is a standout spirit crafted in the heart of Jalisco, Mexico, by the esteemed El Pandillo distillery (NOM 1579). Bottled at an impressive 100 proof, this high-proof blanco tequila delivers a bold and intense flavor profile that showcases the pure essence of 100% blue Weber agave. Utilizing traditional production methods, including slow-cooking the agave in brick ovens and distilling in copper pot stills, G4 Tequila Premium Blanco High Proof offers a robust and vibrant taste experience. Perfect for enthusiasts seeking a stronger, more pronounced tequila or for elevating premium cocktails, this tequila embodies the craftsmanship and heritage of Mexican tequila making.

TITLE: G4 Tequila Premium Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: The purest expression of Blue Weber agave, our Blanco is authentic and approachable with a delicate minerality and gentle aroma derived from agave and spring water from our own farm, collected rainwater, and our Grandfather’s yeast. These are the only ingredients in G4.

TITLE: G4 Tequila Premium Reposado Tequila
DESCRIPTION: G4 Tequila Premium Reposado is a meticulously crafted reposado tequila from Distilería el Pandillo in the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. Aged for 6 months in American oak barrels, this premium reposado captures the perfect balance between bright agave character and gentle oak influence, adding layers of complexity and warmth. Master Distiller Felipe Camarena combines traditional methods and sustainable practices, including using a blend of natural rainwater and spring water in production. The result is a rich, smooth tequila with deep, nuanced flavors, ideal for sipping neat, over ice, or elevating your favorite tequila cocktails.

TITLE: Galactic Wines Vinho Rose
DESCRIPTION: Beautifully distinct yet fresh rosé created in an unorthodox way, namely by an infusion of red grapes in white must. Delicious with mussels and rich salads. In other words: good company on a balmy summer evening. Make sure to drink the bottle before the mosquitoes show up.

TITLE: Game Of Thrones "House Baratheon" Royal Lochnagar 12-Year-Old Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This rampant stag-adorned bottle of golden delight coming from the Highlands and celebrating House Baratheon is a rich and oaky Spirit worthy of a royal family. While Robert Baratheon would probably go on a bender with it, Royal Lochnagar was granted a Royal Warrant back in 1848 when Queen Victoria and Prince Albert visited the distillery. No boar-related stories, but Vicky obviously loved the Scotch. This 12-year-old is a lovely balance of fruits and spices and if you respect the Stag's banner, you'll enjoy it neat.

TITLE: Game of Thrones "House Greyjoy" Talisker Select Reserve Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: House Greyjoy rules the Iron Islands and worships the Drowned God. Talisker was a natural pair for House Greyjoy as this single malt is distilled on the shores of the Isle of Skye, one of the most remote and rugged areas of Scotland. The layered flavors and signature maritime character of Talisker Select Reserve are the result of its wave-battered shores. This liquid is an intense smoky single malt Scotch with spicy, powerful and sweet elements combined with maritime flavors. Dry Sichuan peppery smoke and dark chocolate on the nose. On the palate the salted caramel with chili flakes explode into a smoky fruit cake of spice and the finish is long and complex with a lasting character of leather. These iconic whiskies serve as must-have collectibles for Game of Thrones and whisky adorers.

TITLE: Game Of Thrones "House Lannister" Lagavulin 9-Year-Old Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This is fourth bottling in Diageo´s new series for the Game of Thrones Single Malt Scotch Whisky Collection, featuring eight Scotch whiskies paired with one of the iconic Houses of Westeros, as well as the “Night’s Watch”

TITLE: Game of Thrones "House Stark" Dalwhinnie Winter's Frost
DESCRIPTION: Dalwhinnie Winter's Frost House Stark is one of eight single malts Scotch whiskies made to commemorate the eighth and final season of Game of Thrones. This no-age statement single malt features the sigil for House Stark - a direwolf.

TITLE: Game of Thrones "House Targaryen" Cardhu Gold Reserve Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Cardhu Gold Reserve House Targaryen is one of eight single malts Scotch whiskies made to commemorate the eighth and final season of Game of Thrones. This no-age statement single malt bears the sigil of House Targaryen - a three-headed dragon.

TITLE: Game of Thrones "House Tully" Singleton of Glendullan Select
DESCRIPTION: The Singleton of Glendullan Select House Tully is one of eight single malts Scotch whiskies made to commemorate the eighth and final season of Game of Thrones. This no-age statement single malt bears the sigil of House Tully - a jumping trout.

TITLE: Game of Thrones "House Tyrell" Clynelish Reserve Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Clynelish Reserve House Tyrell is one of eight single malts Scotch whiskies made to commemorate the eighth and final season of Game of Thrones. This no-age-statement single malt bears the sigil of House Tyrell - a rose. House Tyrell of Highgarden rules over the Reach, the lush and fertile region of Westeros. Like the Reach, Clynelish is positioned among green pastures and rolling hills, with scenic views of the North Sea. is vibrant, golden Scotch is light and floral, like House Tyrell, it's not to be underestimated with its underlying complex combination of Highland and maritime qualities. Bursting with fresh tropical fruits like papaya and mango that subsides into a creamy vanilla character. The finish is slightly maritime in quality with a delicate floral note.

TITLE: Game Of Thrones "Six Kingdoms" Mortlach 15 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Inspired by the series finale of HBO®’s iconic series, DIAGEO and HBO are proud to introduce the ninth and final bottling in the Game of Thrones Limited Edition Single Malt Scotch Whisky Collection, a rare malt that pays tribute to the three-eyed raven and the fate of Westeros, whose long-held Seven Kingdoms ultimately became six at the conclusion of the show’s climatic battle for the Iron Throne. The bottling, a Mortlach Single Malt Scotch Whisky that has been aged for 15 years, is presented in a metallic gold canister that features a powerful image of the three-eyed raven. The Six Kingdoms packaging pays homage to the last Greenseer, whose ability to see beyond the constraints of time and unravel the intricate stories that held the tapestry of Westeros together proved to be his ultimate power. Much like the Six Kingdoms and its leader, the Mortlach Distillery is built on the site of a historic battle and is the first to legitimately rule over Dufftown’s whisky trade. Influenced by its own collection of historical figures, the Mortlach’s signature method to distill the liquid exactly 2.81 times is a complex process as unique as the Three-Eyed Raven character.

TITLE: Game Of Thrones "The Night's Watch" Oban Bay Reserve Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Celebrating the legacy of Game of Thrones, the "Night's Watch" Oban Bay Reserve embodies the steadfast and resilient spirit of the Night's Watch. Distilled in the coastal haven of Oban at the gateway to the Isles and Western Highlands, this limited edition single malt scotch whisky captures the essence of the watchmen's vigil. With a proof of 86, this non-age-statement expression reflects the unique character of Oban's storied distillery, offering a deep dive into Scotland's whisky-making prowess. NOTE: Bottle doe NOT come with a tube

TITLE: Game of Thrones Limited Edition Single Malt Scotch Whisky Set (9 Bottles)
DESCRIPTION: Send a raven— Scotch has officially entered the realm. In collaboration with HBO®, DIAGEO is unveiling the new White Walker by Johnnie Walker Blended Scotch Whisky and The Game of Thrones Single Malt Scotch Whisky Collection. The limited-edition whiskies are inspired by the iconic characters and the creative world of Westeros and beyond and are here to tide fans over during their wait for the eighth and final season. Even the most revered Maester couldn't have predicted a collaboration of this monumental proportion. Set includes: Game of Thrones House Tully – Singleton of Glendullan Select; ABV 40% Game of Thrones House Stark – Dalwhinnie Winter's Frost; ABV 43% Game of Thrones House Targaryen – Cardhu Gold Reserve; ABV 40% Game of Thrones House Lannister – Lagavulin 9-Year-Old; ABV 46% Game of Thrones The Night's Watch – Oban Bay Reserve; ABV 43% Game of Thrones House Greyjoy – Talisker Select Reserve; ABV 45.8% Game of Thrones House Baratheon – Royal Lochnagar 12-Year-Old; ABV 40% Game of Thrones House Tyrell – Clynelish Reserve; ABV 51.2% Game Of Thrones "Six Kingdoms" Mortlach 15 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky, ABV 46%

TITLE: Garofoli Serra del Conte Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi DOC
DESCRIPTION: The Serra del Conte Verdicchio is a very fresh wine that is meant to be consumed young. Its high minerality, together with great texture and bright acidity make it incredibly versatile & food-friendly. The fruit for this wine comes from the hills around Castelli di Jesi, in an area described as the classic zone. The fruit undergoes a cold settling of the must, followed by fermentation at controlled temperatures and maturation in stainless steel. Verdicchio is always a citrusy and high acid white wine, which makes it one of the world's great fish wines. It is particularly good with raw fish preparations such as sushi and is sublime with crudo, the Marche's raw fish specialty. Try with: Light Fish Olives Japanese cuisine Foods cooked via Raw Served Cold dishes

TITLE: Garrison Brothers "Arthur Shelby" Single Barrel Cask Strength Texas Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #48
DESCRIPTION: Age: 4 years Mashbill: 74% food-grade white corn, 15% soft red winter wheat & 11% barley Proof: 131 Proof Nose: toasted oak, malt, graham cracker, tangerine, dried mango, vanilla, Dominican cigarPalate: oak, maple syrup, citrus pith, dried cherries, thymeFinish: long, spicy finish with notes of cinnamon and corianderThe sticker theme for the duo of Garrison Bros barrels is admittedly a bit of a reach. One of our favorite shows of all time is "Peaky Blinders" (available on Netflix). The main protagonist in the show is Tommy Shelby, the Irish mob boss. In the show, his family owns a pub called the "Garrison." He also has a brother (his right hand) in the show named Arthur Shelby. Whiskey plays a prominent role in the show, so with so many parallels, we wanted to pay homage to the show we loved watching over the years. As usual, parts of the proceeds will go to support a charity. This time, we will donate to GOOD BOURBON FOR A GOOD CAUSE organization. In association with the distilled spirits community, the organization is the beneficiary of marketing and promotional events for philanthropic purposes. Funds from GOOD BOURBON FOR A GOOD CAUSE are distributed to charitable organizations primarily, but not exclusively, in Blanco and Gillespie counties of Texas and to charitable organizations that serve current and former American military personnel. For more details (and to make a donation), visit their page: https://www.goodbourbonforagoodcause.com/

TITLE: Garrison Brothers "Hye Noon" Single Barrel Cask Strength Texas Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #4
DESCRIPTION: The Prime Barrel Selection #4. This particular barrel was hands down the winner amongst other barrels were picking from. This is a very bold, complex whiskey and we are thrilled to offer it to you. This pick has a good, strong nose. A bit hot, but expected at 131 Proof. Mashbill is very corn heavy, and you get that immediately on the nose. Furthermore, you'll get cereal notes, burnt orange, spice, coriander, and even honey plus brown sugar. The palate is distinct and flavorful. A full spectrum of baking spices in cinnamon, nutmeg, coriander on display here. Burnt orange spice is typical of Garrison whiskeys, and it's very present in this offering as well. The finish is infinite. It's strong but has a good character and a very memorable aftertaste. When we added a few drops of water, it opened up nicely and the hotness subsided. Would be a pleasure to drink on the rocks as well as neat for folks that enjoy high-proof expressions.

TITLE: Garrison Brothers "Polly Gray" 5 Year Old Single Barrel Cask Strength Texas Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #80
DESCRIPTION: Texas summers truly enhance these whiskeys. They're incredibly dark, reminiscent of light coffee, and surprisingly drinkable below their proof. Nose: A delightful blend of bright fruit, including dates and cooked apples, mixed with a robust spice blend. You'll detect cinnamon and nutmeg, complemented by oak, creating a mulled wine-like aroma. Palate: A rich, viscous texture that coats the mouth like velvet. It's like Christmas in a glass – think spiced cookies with a hint of molasses and compost topping. The palate also offers stewed fruits and dates, with a touch of fruit cake and classic Christmas spices, including a hint of star anise. Finish: The finish brings darker flavors to the forefront, such as tobacco and green matcha tea, along with lingering spices. Age: 5 years Mashbill: 74% food-grade white corn, 15% soft red winter wheat & 11% barley Proof: 126.8 Proof Barrel #12434 New American Oak Kelvin Cooperage Char 4

TITLE: Garrison Brothers Balmorhea 2024
DESCRIPTION: Garrison Brothers Balmorhea 2024 Edition is a remarkable wheated bourbon crafted in the heart of Texas Hill Country. This limited-release bourbon is twice barreled, first aged for four years in new American white oak barrels and then transferred to a second new American white oak barrel for an additional year. Bottled at a robust 115 proof, it embodies the distillery's commitment to excellence and innovation. The Balmorhea 2024 Edition offers whiskey enthusiasts a rich and complex flavor profile that showcases the unique terroir of Texas and the meticulous craftsmanship of Garrison Brothers Distillery.

TITLE: Garrison Brothers Cowboy Texas Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Garrison Brothers Cowboy Texas Straight Bourbon Whiskey is an exceptional, cask-strength bourbon from the Garrison Brothers Distillery, located deep in the heart of Texas. This limited-edition release is bottled uncut and unfiltered, offering an unparalleled and bold drinking experience. Each bottle of Cowboy Bourbon is hand-selected from some of the oldest and finest barrels in the distillery’s inventory, typically aged between 5 and 6 years, and is bottled straight from the barrel. With its high proof and robust flavor profile, this whiskey is a true testament to Garrison Brothers' dedication to quality and craftsmanship. Perfect for collectors and bourbon enthusiasts, Cowboy Bourbon delivers a rich and unforgettable experience.

TITLE: Garrison Brothers Distillery Laguna Madre Texas Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Garrison Brothers Laguna Madre is a limited release, highly sought-after bourbon whiskey. For the lucky few able to get their hands on a bottle, treasure it and enjoy it with the ones you love on the most special occasions. After all, it took us eight years to make – our oldest bourbon to date. Intense A&W Root Beer meets Dublin Dr. Pepper. Vanilla bean. Hazelnut. Saltwater taffy. Hershey’s Kisses. Frosty white chocolate and “ADULTS ONLY” Almond Joy candy bar finish. Pucker up. 101 proof.

TITLE: Garrison Brothers Distillery Single Barrel Texas Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Single barrel bourbon (selected by Master Distiller Dennis Todd) from Garrison Brothers, the first legal whiskey distillery in Texas. Their previous releases, at the time of writing, have all scored over 90 points in Jim Murray's Whisky Bible, indeed, their first 3 year old Cowboy Bourbon scored 96!

TITLE: Garrison Brothers Guadalupe Texas Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished In a Port Cask
DESCRIPTION: Aged four years in toasted and charred white American oak barrels and an additional two years in beautiful port casks imported from Portugal, Guadalupe is the same award-winning Garrison Brothers Texas Straight Bourbon you love, with a delicate, sweet Port Wine finish. Guadalupe is a sensuous, creamy liquid, exploding with unique flavors and character, making it the perfect bourbon for the connoisseur with a sophisticated palate. We like to consider Guadalupe your "dessert bourbon" and encourage you to enjoy it in the evening, paired with your favorite chocolates.

TITLE: Garrison Brothers Honey Dew Texas Honey Infused Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Award-winning Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey, infused with Burleson’s Texas Wildflower Honey, resulting in a smooth, light bourbon with a sweet honey finish. Distillery's Master Distiller transformed used bourbon barrels into small, wooden cubes that were immersed in honey. After fully absorbing it, they were placed in the belly of a stainless-steel tank, letting the bourbon soak up those delicious honey flavors every single day for seven months.

TITLE: Garrison Brothers Texas Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Garrison Brothers Distillery is a small family-owned farm and ranch, which happens to make one of the finest bourbon whiskeys in the world. The are the first new bourbon distillery in America to open its doors since before Prohibition. The are also the first legal whiskey distillery in Texas history, and producing the first bourbon whiskey anywhere made entirely from organic grain.

TITLE: Gaspard Touraine Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Rich fish (salmon, tuna, etc), Shellfish and Vegetarian

TITLE: Gatinois Champagne Grand Cru Brut Tradition
DESCRIPTION: Estate-owned Pinot Noir (majority is Petit Pinot d’Ay) and Chardonnay grown in the Grand Cru village of Ay. Most of their Pinot holdings are comprised of massale selection Petite Pinot d’Ay: a small-yielding, tiny berried clone that is unique to this village. These champagnes can stand up to many types of food...even foie gras!

TITLE: Gatto Grosso Vino Rosso
DESCRIPTION: Founded in 1971, Cantina Viticoltori Senesi Aretini is a small cooperative located between the provinces of Arezzo and Siena. Only 6 of its growers are certified organic. Viticoltori Senesi Aretini is com mitted to maximizing the ultimate expression of the terroir through its thoughtful practices in the vineyard and minimal intervention in the cellar. Winemaker Mery Ferrara produces wine in a graceful, elegant style, that respects the fresh, mineral edge that can be found in the world’s best Chianti Classico.

TITLE: Gen del Alma Gene
DESCRIPTION: Gen del Alma is a new project started in 2012 by Gerardo Michelini, of Zorzal, and his wife and winemaker Andrea Mufatto. Gerardo and Andrea have planted vines on their individually owned property adjacent to the Zorzal winery. Their focal concept is to showcase the purity, minerality, and freshness of Gualtallary terroir. Their minimal vinification process allows the fruit to shine on its own. They use concrete eggs, used barrique, and in some cases carbonic maceration in the winery. They currently produce 3 wines: a bordeaux blend, a MAL/PN partial carbonic, and a CF/CS/PN blend. The wines have received high praise from the Wine Advocate and Decanter magazine, and we believe GdA is another example of the Michelini’s taking Argentine wine to a new level.
