TITLE: Genbei Onikoroshi "4 Eyed Devil" Honjozo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Light and dry Sake with smooth taste. Seafood, Yakitori

TITLE: Gentleman's Cut Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Gentleman's Cut Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey marries tradition with a smooth and complex profile, designed to elevate any celebration. Aged between 5 to 7 years, this bourbon is finished to perfection at 90 proof, ensuring a polished sip every time. Its mash bill of 75% corn, 21% rye, and 4% malted barley introduces a seamless sip of honey, vanilla, and caramel, with spicy and earthy notes from the rye and bold cocoa and toast from the barley.

TITLE: Georgas Family Hoot Amber Wine
DESCRIPTION: Hoot amber is a skin contact Savatiano in a 1.5 liter pouch, a "bag-num". A fresh and fun natural wine, with organic certification, at an affordable price.

TITLE: George Dickel "R/Bourbon" Aged 15 Years Single Barrel Tennessee Whisky
DESCRIPTION: 15-year-old George Dickel selection by t8ke from R/Bourbon

TITLE: George Dickel "Recipe No. 12" Tennessee Sour Mash Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Our 90-proof Tennessee Whisky. We blend older whiskies to achieve deep, assertive flavors with an incredibly smooth finish. Bold and brazen, this is our Recipe No. 12. Concentrated flavors of rich oak and subtle vanilla lead to a long finish with hints of maple, butter and smoke. A whisky with enormous depth, range and personality considered by many to be the gold standard of Tennessee Whisky.

TITLE: George Dickel 15 Year Single Barrel Tennessee Whisky
DESCRIPTION: With a mash bill of 84% corn, 8% rye, and 8% malted barley, George Dickel Tennessee Single Barrel 15 Year Old spent at least 15 years in new, charred American oak. A single barrel offering, each barrel left its own unique mark on this spirit and no two bottles are exactly the same. Distilled and charcoal mellowed at the Cascade Hollow Distillery, it’s bottled by hand with little water added. Since this is a single barrel release, the proof can vary from bottle to bottle from 80 to 104.6 proof and so can the taste profile. You can expect notes of vanilla and toffee as well as rich leather, saddle oil, and wood, but also more delicate aromas of fruit and notes of lavender. Due to many years spent in new American oak, the hue is a beautiful dark, rich leather brown. Try it in a Tennessee Old Fashioned or in a classic on the rocks. 46.7% ABV.

TITLE: George Dickel 17 Year Old Cask Strength Tennessee Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: With a woody, robust profile, the newest release pays homage to the old liquid while featuring subtle contrasts that differentiate the two. This perfectly aged, cask-strength release boasts complex aromas of crème brûlée, apricots with hints of plum and juniper on the palate, and a rich cedar finish.

TITLE: George Dickel 17 yr Reserve Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Yum! There’s a bit of a disconnect between the aroma, which is very sweet and red; and the flavor, which is on the green, herbaceous side. It’s leaner and oakier than the 12, but it’s undoubtedly more mature and integrated.

TITLE: George Dickel 18 Year Old Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: George Dickel Bourbon Aged 18 Years represents a luxurious and meticulously aged spirit from the tranquil hills of Cascade Hollow. Crafted by the renowned Tennessee whiskey brand, this bourbon has been matured for 18 years in charred oak barrels within the distillery's single-story rickhouses. The extended aging process endows this bourbon with a mellow yet intricate profile, marked by profound notes of crème brulée and stone fruit. George Dickel Bourbon Aged 18 Years is a highly limited, small-batch bourbon, released as an extension of its Bourbon line, marking the brand's foray into the world of more traditional bourbon notes. Priced at a premium, this bourbon is an excellent choice for collectors and enthusiasts seeking a rare and deeply rooted heritage encapsulated in each bottle​

TITLE: George Dickel 8 Years Old Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Nicole Austin hasn’t rested on her laurels since George Dickel Bottled in Bond won Whisky of the Year in 2019, continuing to create great and affordable whiskeys at Cascade Hollow Distillery. This is notably a bourbon rather than a Tennessee whiskey, though the criteria for the two styles mostly overlap. The nose is nutty and well-spiced, with caramel corn, toasted pecans, cinnamon graham crackers, cherry tart, and butterscotch candies. There is friendliness to the palate that makes it ideal for outdoor imbibing, with notes of spearmint, mixed berries, nougat, and honey. Big spice on the finish makes this a memorable sip.

TITLE: George Dickel 9 Years Hand Selected Barrel Sour Mash Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The George Dickel Hand Selected Barrel Whiskey is a 9-year-old expression of the brand's private barrel program. Double-distilled and charcoal mellowed, this Tennessee whiskey is bottled from a single cask following maturation. It's bottled at 51.5% ABV and packaged in its own box. It can come with a customizable, vintage-inspired decanter tag and each bottle is individually barrel numbered.

TITLE: George Dickel Tabasco Barrel Finish Tennessee Whisky
DESCRIPTION: For over a century, the legacy of two Southern brands, George Dickel and McIlhenny Company’s TABASCO® Brand Pepper Sauce, have left their mark on the world and their distinct tastes in the memories of people everywhere. These two iconic brands have come together in one bottle to create George Dickel Tabasco Brand Barrel Finish, or Hot Dickel for short. Best enjoyed as a shot with celery salt on the rim, pickle juice, or an ice chaser. Damn straight, it’s Hot Dickel!

TITLE: George Dickel x Leopold Bros Collaboration Blend Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: George Dickel has teamed up with the Leopold Bros to produce an innovative rye whisky offering.The release blends George Dickel’s column still rye produced at Cascade Hallow Distillery with Leopold Bros’ Three Chamber Rye to recreate a historic style. This union between column distilled rye and Three Chamber distilled rye turns back the hands of time, returning to an era that saw heavy-bodied rye whisky served at bars and saloons throughout America. The Cascade Hollow component of this blend is a never-before released traditional column still rye.

TITLE: George Dickel-Bottled in Bond Tennessee  Whiskey
George Dickel-Bottled in Bond Tennessee  Whiskey
George Remus Repeal Reserve Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: George Remus Repeal Reserve Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a distinguished limited-release that honors the legacy of the "King of the Bootleggers," George Remus. Produced by MGP Ingredients in Lawrenceburg, Indiana, this bourbon is a masterful blend of high-rye bourbons aged between 10 and 14 years. Bottled at 101 proof, it delivers a robust and intricate flavor profile that captures the essence of Prohibition-era spirits. Each annual release showcases the distillery's dedication to crafting a whiskey that is both rich in history and complex in character

TITLE: George Remus Repeal Reserve Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: George Remus Repeal Reserve Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a distinguished limited-release that honors the legacy of the "King of the Bootleggers," George Remus. Produced by MGP Ingredients in Lawrenceburg, Indiana, this bourbon is a masterful blend of high-rye bourbons aged between 10 and 14 years. Bottled at 101 proof, it delivers a robust and intricate flavor profile that captures the essence of Prohibition-era spirits. Each annual release showcases the distillery's dedication to crafting a whiskey that is both rich in history and complex in character

TITLE: Georges Deschamps Chablis
DESCRIPTION: The Vrignaud family has been settled in the village of Fontenay-pres-Chablis for five generations. Georgse Deschamps, Guillaume's grandfather, began planting their first vines in 1er Cru Fourchaume in 1955. The 28 hectare domaine is one of a handful of family estates to produce organic wine in Chablis. The family has the utmost respect for nature and biodiversity and has always been working their land in an organic way. 2009 marks the start of organic certification but to Guillaume, organic farming goes beyond what any certification requires and is more a way of living. Guillaume aims to produce wines that reflect both their origin and climate. As a result, intervention in the cellar is very low and is often a slow process that respects the personality of the wine and the vintage.

TITLE: Gerard Boulay Sibylle Sancerre Rose
DESCRIPTION: Unlike many Sancerre Roses, Gerard harvests his Pinot specifically to make rose by direct press, then into tank. It is not a selection of young vines as he has no young Pinot vines. What makes the rose one year could make red another, and vice versa, depending on what the vintage gives. 200 cases vintage production

TITLE: Gertie & Max Gutedel Dry
DESCRIPTION: The Gutedel grape, also known as Chasselas, is a local specialty in Germany, Switzerland and Alsace. Its home turf in Germany is the tiny sub-region of Markgraflerland located within Baden, Germany's warmest growing region. It sits at the edge of the Black Forest which protects the area from inclement weather. Wine for cheeses, cream sauces, baked seafood and fondue.

TITLE: Geyerhof Sprinzenberg Riesling
DESCRIPTION: Bio-Weingut Geyerhof is a family owned winery that has been in Ilsa Maier's family since the 16th century. The 37-acre estate is located in the Krems Valley of Lower Austria near the Danube River, which provides ideal growing conditions for Riesling, Gruner Veltliner and Zweigelt. The estate vineyards grow on different soils; prehistoric stone, sandy soils and gravel soils and are located in some of the best sites in the region. In 1986, Ilse took over Geyerhof and two years later, she and her husband Josef converted to the estate to organic and entire estate is certified organic. The vineyards are dry farmed and all the fruit is hand-harvested. In the winery, the grapes are fermented using natural yeasts. Lees contact, neutral barrel aging and malolactic fermentation are carefully utilized to add complexity to the wines. Ilse Maier is one of the founding members of the Association of Female Wine Makers of Austria. Think Spice. Because of Riesling’s sweetness and acidity, it makes the perfect accompaniment to spicy food. Strong Indian and Asian spices are a perfect match with Riesling. A classic pairing with Riesling is spiced duck leg.

TITLE: Gianni Gagliardo Barolo
DESCRIPTION: A firm yet balanced Barolo made from Nebbiolo grapes sourced from proprietary vineyards in the communes of La Morra (50% of the blend), Monforte d’Alba, Serralunga, Verduno, and Barolo.

TITLE: Giffard Creme de Pamplemousse Rose Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: To craft this grapefruit liqueur, Giffard extracts the essential oils found in the peel through steam distillation. True to the fruit, the result is the bright aromatic quality and the balanced bitterness and tartness of fresh pink grapefruit.

TITLE: Giffard Creme de Peche de Vigne
DESCRIPTION: Fruit liqueur made from the maceration of vine peaches (cultivated in the Coteaux du Lyonnais orchards near Lyon). Peaches are macerated and the infusion obtained is then used for the liqueur.

TITLE: Giffard Curacao Triple Sec
DESCRIPTION: The colour is translucent and crystalline. Very pure except when we add an ice cube, it then becomes slightly opalescent. There is an explosion of aroma : fresh and candied citrus fruits (sweet and bitter oranges, grapefruit, lemon, lime, clementines). The taste is delicately sweet, enhanced by a touch of alcohol and a note of bitterness that is typical of orange and grapefruit peels. Triple Sec is not so sweet on ice but a bit stronger, with eucalyptus and orange blossom touches.

TITLE: Gift Card
Gilbert Picq & ses Fils Chablis
DESCRIPTION: VARIETALS - Chardonnay VINEYARD - From a collection of hillside vineyards averaging 20 years in age all from the commune of Chichee ORIENTATION - Multiple parcels, varied exposure SOIL - Limestone / Clay VITICULTURE - The vines are farmed using sustainable practices and the grapes are hand harvested VINIFICATION - Vinification takes place in stainless steel using natural yeasts AGING - Aged in tank

TITLE: Ginban Banshu 50 Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Light and dry sake.

TITLE: Giorgio Iannoni Sebastianini Coccorone
DESCRIPTION: GIORGIO IANNONI SEBASTIANINI-Young Giorgio after meeting Tiziano Vistalli in Montefalco decided to brake the habit of his parents to sell his healthy grapes of Sangiovese and Sagrantino di Montefalco to other winemakers and started his own wine in 2013.

TITLE: Gioventu Chianti
DESCRIPTION: Italy is a region rife with history. Thousands of years’ worth of civilization, art, and culture have thrived in the diverse natural landscape. Tradition is important in this landscape, but so is the need to move forward into the future with energy and confidence. It is with this background and this intention that Michael Schmelzer created Gioventu Chianti and Falanghina, wines that are firmly set in the Italian tradition but in a style that evokes the intention of innovation that is apparent in all of his wines.

TITLE: Girlan Sudtirol Alto Adige Pinot Grigio
DESCRIPTION: Northern Italy’s Alto Adige region continues to gain worldwide recognition for its stellar white wine contributions. Pinot Grigio has small bunches of rust-colored, almost brownish grapes; sometimes Pinot Bianco and Pinot Grigio grapes can be found on the same vineyard and belong to the same family of Burgundy Pinots. It can be enjoyed as an aperitif, and it also pairs well with asparagus, fish dishes, and white meats.

TITLE: Glen Elgin 17 yrs Speyside Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Glen Elgin is an unusually distinctive Speyside single malt from a little-known traditional distillery, that finds its home 10 miles south of where the river Lossie exits to the sea and about 40 miles east of Inverness. Founded at the end of the whisky boom in 1898, it was built and designed by the notable distillery architect Charles Doig of Elgin. Today, as the summer house martins swoop among the worm tubs at the distillery on the edge of the Royal Burgh of Elgin, little seems to have changed in over a hundred years. AGED: 17 years DISTILLED ON: November 1995 BOTTLE ON: September 2013 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 1640 ALC: 46%

TITLE: Glen Grant 18 Years Rothes Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This unrivalled single malt matures for at least 18 years in the highest quality, handpicked oak casks, which creates a radiant golden colour and seductive floral and oaky aroma. Deeply layered and complex, this rich and vibrant whisky delivers beautifully intricate flavours of malted caramel, vanilla, and raisins and lingers with a long, sweet, and pleasantly spicy finish.

TITLE: Glen Grant 23yrs Speyside Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Matured in a pair of ex-bourbon barrels for more than two decades, this 1995-vintage Glen Grant was bottled in February 2019 for Signatory Vintage’s Cask Strength Collection.

TITLE: Glen Grant Hogshead 13 yrs Speyside Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Glen Grant Distillery, built in 1840 by brothers, John and James Grant, is located in the heart of Speyside. The distillery is now the world’s second-largest single malt whiskey brand. AGED: 13 years DISTILLED ON: March 1997 BOTTLE ON: February 2010 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 38886 ALC: 59.3%

TITLE: Glen Grant Sherry Butt 16 yrs Highland 86 Proof Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Glen Grant Distillery, built in 1840 by brothers, John and James Grant, is located in the heart of Speyside. The distillery is now the world’s second-largest single malt whiskey brand. AGED: 16 years DISTILLED ON: March 1997 BOTTLE ON: January 2014 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 38887 ALC: 43%

TITLE: Glen Keith 20 yrs Speyside Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A small batch bottling from Signatory Vintage, marrying a pair of casks for the Un-Chillfiltered collection. The whisky was distilled at Glen Keith in 1997 and aged for 20 years in a pair of hogsheads before bottling in September 2017.

TITLE: Glen Keith Hogshead 15 yrs Speyside Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: During the 1970s, experimental Glenisla malt whisky was made at Glen Keith, destined primarily for use in the Chivas Brothers’ blends. Glenisla was made using both peated malt and peated water (the water was flavoured with smoke and then run through a still to concentrate this smokiness). AGED: 15 years DISTILLED ON: August 11, 1995 BOTTLE ON: September 8, 2011 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 171183 ALC: 46%

TITLE: Glen Ord Hogshead 12 yrs Highland Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: One of but a handful of Scotch whisky distilleries that possess onsite barley maltings, Glen Ord has a decidedly large maltings capacity of around 36,000 tonnes annually, thus it also provides malt for several other Diageo-owned distilleries. The Glen Ord distillery lies in the village of Muir of Ord to the north of Inverness. It was during the 13th century that King Alexander III gave areas of land to the Mackenzie’s of Ord. In 1820, Thomas Mackenzie inherited a plot of land and used much of it to grow barley. AGED: 12 years DISTILLED ON: February 20, 1998 BOTTLE ON: August 19, 2010 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 3477 ALC: 59.3%

TITLE: Glen Rothes 20 yrs Speyside Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Glenrothes distillery has been producing malt whiskey since 1879. The distillery’s unique bottling process focuses on the vintage of the malt, not the age, to ensure quality distilling and careful planning. Carefully selected barrels, barleys, and spring water ensure Glenrothes malts are of the highest quality and flavor. 25yrs pictured!

TITLE: Glen Rothes Bourbon 15 yrs Speyside Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Glenrothes distillery has been producing malt whiskey since 1879. The distillery’s unique bottling process focuses on the vintage of the malt, not the age, to ensure quality distilling and careful planning. Carefully selected barrels, barleys, and spring water ensure Glenrothes malts are of the highest quality and flavor. AGED: 15 years DISTILLED ON: November 19, 1999 BOTTLE ON: March 16, 2014 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 12576 ALC: 46%

TITLE: Glenburgie 25 yrs Moray Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
Glenburgie Hogshead 19 yrs Highland 86 Proof Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Designed by famous architect Charles Chree Doig as the Kilnflat Distillery in 1810, Glenburgie is one of Scotland’s oldest distilleries. The distillery renowned for its role in producing malts for the Ballantine blend, Glenburgie has been essential to creating premium blends. After Pernod Ricard bought the distillery in 2005, the distillery increased its production to over 4 million liters annually, making it one of the largest of the Pernod Chivas Bros. group’s distilleries. AGED: 19 years DISTILLED ON: June 13, 1995 BOTTLE ON: July 28, 2014 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 6459 ALC: 43%

TITLE: Glendalough 13 Year Old Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Glendalough Irish Whiskey Company was established in 2011. Set up by five Dublin and Wicklow friends whose passion for the Irish drinks industry led them to start Ireland’s first craft distillery.

TITLE: Glendalough 7 Year Old Single Malt Whiskey
Glendalough Double Barrel Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Ireland’s first craft distillery gives you a new whole new style of Irish whiskey. A single grain whiskey, aged first in American Bourbon barrels and finished in Spanish Oloroso sherry casks.

TITLE: Glendalough Poitin Sherry Cask Finish
DESCRIPTION: Poitin, (pronounced "potcheen"), is one of the oldest distilled beverages in the world. It was first made in Ireland around 584AD with expertise and reverence by Irish monks like St. Kevin. However, in 1661 it was outlawed by King Charles II, forcing poitin into the wilderness and over the next few hundred years it lived in whispered infamy, hidden in the dark cupboards of Irish households. Using the old poitin recipe passed down through generations, Glendalough has meticulously crafted this Irish mountain spirit. Glendalough starts the process by slowly fermenting the malted barley and sugar beet for over 72 hours, it is then distilled in small batches and finally the distillate is transferred in virgin Irish oak casks for aging.

TITLE: Glendullan Distillery The Singleton 15 Years Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A very well balanced whisky that is richer, rounder and sweeter than younger expressions, and also has an attractive spicy finish.

TITLE: Glendullan Distillery The Singleton 18 Years Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The driest and most mature malt in the Singleton of Glendullan stable has a clear structure yet still retains its central core of sweet fruit.

TITLE: Glenfiddich 12 Year Old "Chinese New Year Limited Edition" Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Glenfiddich 12 Year Old is the iconic and signature expression of Glenfiddich, carefully matured for 12 years in fine American Oak and European Oak casks to produce a smooth and mellow single malt with a characteristic sweet, fruit notes and a distinctively fresh nose. This special whisky is the result of Glenfiddich's unique Speyside style. Glenfiddich 12 Year Old is the world's most awarded single malt Scotch whisky, and makes a perfectly luxurious whisky gift. Enjoy the 'best dram in the valley' and give the gift of Glenfiddich 12, presented in a stunning Chinese New Year presentation box.

TITLE: Glenfiddich 12 year old Amontillado Sherry Cask Finish
DESCRIPTION: Despite making the world’s best-selling single malt from its distillery that produces 21 million liters of pure alcohol a year, Glenfiddich still innovates around its signature Glenfiddich 12 year old. After past experiments with toasted oak, peated, and American oak casks, this vibrant amontillado cask finish from malt master Brian Kinsman adds sweetness and depth to the 12 year old, to deliver shifting tones of orchard fruit, rich oak, dried fruit, and enduring spices.

TITLE: Glenfiddich 12 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Carefully matured in the finest American bourbon and Spanish sherry oak casks for at least 12 years. Married and mellowed in oak marrying tuns for complete harmony of aroma and flavour.

TITLE: Glenfiddich 14 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
Glenfiddich 15 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Exemplifying our family’s tradition of innovation, our 15 Year Old expression is created using a technique pioneered by our Malt Master and its warm, spicy flavours are transformed with the alchemy of the Solera Vat. Aged in European oak sherry casks and new oak casks, the whisky is mellowed in our unique Solera Vat, a large oak tun inspired by the sherry bodegas of Spain and Portugal. Never emptied, and kept half full of whiskies since 1998, our Solera Vat is the culmination of curious minds and the pioneering spirit of our family. It’s also the secret behind this whisky becoming the first 15 year old expression to enter the top ten best selling single malts.

TITLE: Glenfiddich 18 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The distillery uses fine Spanish Oloroso wood and American oak to mature this rich, intriguingly fruity and robust oak expression, but there are many more reasons why this expression is special. Every batch is individually numbered and carefully watched over. Each has extraordinary consistency and character from an intense marrying period, and a warming, distinguished finish. A truly exceptional single malt, the result not just of eighteen years of care and attention, but of whisky-making craft and knowledge passed down through the generations.

TITLE: Glenfiddich Cask of Dreams  Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: 11 virgin American oak casks were each taken to different cities around America to be inscribed with the dreams of the American people. These casks were then shipped back to Scotland, to Glenfiddich distillery. The Glenfiddich Cask of Dreams is a vatting of 14 to 16-year-old whisky, finished in those 11 virgin American oak casks (of dreams).

TITLE: Glenfiddich Experimental Series - Finished In India Pale Ale Casks Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Glenfiddich Finished In India Pale Ale Casks Single Malt Scotch Whisky is the first in an experimental series of whiskys produced in casks that are seasoned with India Pale Ale. The ale was made by The Speyside Craft Brewery from old Glenfiddich casks to create a unique and bold fruity flavor that is Glenfiddich Finished IPA Casks

TITLE: Glenfiddich Experimental Series - Fire & Cane Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Glenfiddich has added a new expression to its Experimental Series, unveiling Fire & Cane in mid-2018. Malt master Brian Kinsman has given some of the distillery's peated single malt a three-month finishing period in rum casks - but not just any old rum casks. He's selected rum casks from a variety of South American countries to finish this whisky, which ought to play nicely with the burly peat notes at its core.

TITLE: Glenfiddich Experimental Series - Project XX Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The second release in Glenfiddich's Experimental Series is their Project XX expression, which was made not simply by one Malt Master, but 20! 20 Malt Masters were invited to the Glenfiddich distillery and invited them to pick any expression from the thousands of casks maturing in the warehouse. The 20 chosen whiskies were then married by Malt Master Brian Kinsman to create this single malt.

TITLE: Glenfiddich Experimental Series - Winter Storm Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Another release from the Glenfiddich Experimental Series - the Winter Storm has been finished in icewine casks, inspired by Malt Master Brian Kinsman's visit to the Peller Estates winery in Canada. After 21 years of maturation (Kinsman believes that only older whiskies can stand up to the intense icewine notes), the Glenfiddich single malt is allowed a finishing period in icewine casks for up to six months before bottling.

TITLE: Glenfiddich Experimental Series Single Malt Scotch Whisky Collection
DESCRIPTION: Chance to own an instant collection of all Experimental Series releases Glenfiddich has released to date. Includes Finished in IPA Casks, Project XX, Winter Storm, and Fire & Cane releases

TITLE: Glenfiddich Grande Couronne 26 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Glenfiddich Grande Couronne 26 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a luxurious expression that combines decades of aging expertise with the art of finishing. Aged for 26 years in traditional American and European oak casks, this whisky is then finished in rare French Cognac casks, giving it a rich, opulent profile. Named "Grande Couronne," which means "great crown," this whisky reflects the pinnacle of Glenfiddich's craftsmanship and innovation, offering a smooth, complex flavor experience that is refined and indulgent. This 26-year-old single malt captivates the senses with its beautifully layered flavors and elegant finish. Bottled at 86 proof, it offers a sophisticated blend of fruit, spice, and oak, making it ideal for collectors and those looking for an unforgettable tasting experience.

TITLE: Glenfiddich Snow Phoenix Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: In 2010, twice a winter’s worth of snow fell on distillery's warehouse roofs in just a few weeks. In the most remote part of our Distillery, bearing the weight of a herd of elephants, a few collapsed. The bright winter sky poured in, and standing amongst precious casks, Glenfiddich's Malt Master was inspired to mark this moment in history. Selecting and marrying the finest Oloroso and American oak casks from warehouses struck by heavy snow, Snow Phoenix limited expression was born. Creamy and vibrant on the nose, with honey and chocolate on the palate. And sherry notes mellowing into a long finish.

TITLE: Glenglassaugh Sandend Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Discover the allure of the Highlands with Glenglassaugh Sandend Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky, a captivating expression from the esteemed Glenglassaugh Distillery. Crafted in the heart of the Highland region of Scotland, this Single Malt captures the essence of its coastal surroundings. Encased in a beautifully designed bottle, the Glenglassaugh Sandend is a testament to the distillery's commitment to quality and tradition.

TITLE: Glenglassaught 46 Year Old Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This exceptionally complex Single Malt Scotch distilled in 1975 is one of the oldest and rarest expressions from the hidden Highland gem that is Glenglassaugh which lay silent for over two decades before its reawakening in 2008. This rare whisky matured for 46 years in a single bourbon cask hand-selected by Master Blender Rachel Barrie. Each bottle has been individually hand-numbered to reflect its rarity and sealed with wax. Inspired by the distillery’s coastal location on the white sandy beach of Sandend Bay on the Highland coast of Scotland, Glenglassaugh 46 is a whisky shaped by land and sea, presenting seductive notes of tropical and summer fruit on an ocean breeze.

TITLE: Glenkinchie 12 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The flagship expression from the Glenkinchie distillery, one of the stalwarts of the Lowlands. A fantastic introduction to the region, Glenkinchie 12-Year-Old shows off the characteristic lightness and grassy elements that Lowland whiskies are known for, with nods to cooked fruit and Sauternes wine along the way. A brilliant single malt to enjoy as an aperitif on a warm evening.

TITLE: Glenkinchie Distillers Edition Single  Malt Scotch Whisky 750ml  2020
DESCRIPTION: The Glenkinchie Distillers Edition 2008 - 2020 is a special Lowlands single malt bottled in the Diageo Distillers Edition series 2020. Double Matured in bourbon barrels and Amontillado sherry casks and bottled at 43% ABV.

TITLE: Glenkinchie Distillers Edition Single  Malt Scotch Whisky 750ml  2022
DESCRIPTION: The Glenkinchie Distillers Edition 2008 - 2020 is a special Lowlands single malt bottled in the Diageo Distillers Edition series 2020. Double Matured in bourbon barrels and Amontillado sherry casks and bottled at 43% ABV.

TITLE: Glenlivet "Code" Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: “I’d like to introduce to you our latest challenge. this year’s limited edition is a labyrinth of flavours that will test the senses of even the most discerning whisky drinker. I invite you to take the ultimate test. Can you unlock the taste of The Glenlivet Code?” - Alan Winchester, Master Distiller.

TITLE: Glenlivet "Enigma" Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate 93 points - #8 TOP 20 WHISKIES OF 2019 - A riddle inside a bottle, this release follows Glenlivet’s previous mystery series bottlings Alpha, Cipher, and Code. Packaged in a jet-black bottle and box that look part Arthur C. Clarke monolith and part 3-D cryptic crossword puzzle, it’s devoid of cask information or tasting notes by design. The best solution is to open it and unlock the whisky’s secrets.

DESCRIPTION: 30th anniversary expression is packaged in a stunning gift box & includes two (2) signature tasting glasses.

TITLE: Glenlivet 9 yrs Speyside Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Glenlivet distillery is a distillery near Ballindalloch in Moray, Scotland that produces single malt Scotch whisky. It is the oldest legal distillery in the parish of Glenlivet, and the production place of the Scottish whisky of the same name. It is described in packaging and advertising as "The single malt that started it all". It was founded in 1824 and has operated almost continuously since.

TITLE: Glenlivet Sherry Hogshead 34 yrs Speyside Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A well-aged whisky from Glenlivet, bottled after 34 years in a hogshead by Signatory as part of the Cask Strength Collection. It is always a pleasure to find early 1980s Glenlivets, particularly when the classical notes of the distillery characteristic have been allowed to shine as they have been here. TITLE: Glenlossie Speyside 86 Proof Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
Glenmorangie "A Tale Of Cake" Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Some time ago, our Director of Whisky Creation, Dr. Bill, found himself musing over how some of his most joyful memories came from the cake — from the pineapple upside-down cake his daughter made for his birthday to baking with his Granny in her kitchen. He devised this whisky to conjure the magic of a cake moment, finishing his favorite Glenmorangie Single Malt in the finest Tokaji dessert wine casks. The liquid is a rich copper, but the taste is pure technicolor, luscious, sweet, and complex with multi-layered bursts of honey, white chocolate, and fruits with a lilting hint of mint. As you might expect, it tastes incredible when enjoyed with the actual cake.

TITLE: Glenmorangie "A Tale of Tokyo" Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Embark on a sensory journey with Glenmorangie A Tale of Tokyo Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky, a limited edition release that pays homage to the intersection of tradition and innovation. Crafted by the revered Glenmorangie distillery in the Highland region of Scotland, this expression is a captivating narrative of the whisky's influence in the vibrant city of Tokyo. Indulge in the artistry of single malt Scotch with this exceptional tale.

TITLE: Glenmorangie "A Tale of Winter" Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: In 1843, William Matheson founded the Glenmorangie Distillery in the Scottish Highlands. Inspired by the Distillery’s peaceful surroundings on the banks of the Dornoch Firth, he brought forth a pioneering single malt whisky wonderfully complex and exceptionally smooth. Ever since, we have pursued our craft with uncompromising dedication – endlessly creative in our quest for perfection. To this day, we honour the Distillery’s provenance in our award-winning single malt. Its pure, smooth spirit is distilled in Scotland’s tallest stills, matured in the finest casks and perfected by The Men of Tain.

TITLE: Glenmorangie 'A Tale of the Forest' Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: If you go down to the woods near Tain... you may well bump into Dr. Bill Lumsden, Head of Distilling & Whisky Creation at Glenmorangie. The intrepid Dr. Bill loves a morning woodland ramble, and on his regular adventures, he's been inspired to combine the flavors of the forest with his beloved whisky. By kilning the barley used to make this whisky with juniper, birch bark, and heather blossom, Glenmorangie has infused their single malt with the earthy, nutty, vegetal, and floral notes that you might encounter in the forest. This is a unique botanical whisky and a welcome reminder that forests are magical places.

TITLE: Glenmorangie 15 Years "The Cadboll Estate" Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Glenmorangie has been growing its own barley for years, but this U.S. exclusive marks the first release produced entirely from its estate-grown grain. Honeysuckle and jasmine waft over lemon curd and shortbread on the nose, while bright aromas of blueberry and lime stand out. The palate is malty and full: shortbread with tumbling fresh blueberries, toasted almonds, and gingery spice. It’s silky, rounded, and seamless into the finish, and beautifully transformed by a drop of water.

TITLE: Glenmorangie 18 Year Old Extremely Rare Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The 18 Years Old is a single malt Scotch whisky of serious distinction. Once it has spent fifteen years maturing in American white oak casks approximately 30% is transferred into Spanish Oloroso casks to spend a further three years maturing. Then, when both elements have reached 18 years, we blend them back together to create a whisky with a rich bouquet and full, rounded flavour. For a whisky of this age this expression has maintained, thanks to our delicate floral spirit and fine Oloroso casks, an incredible degree of vibrancy where the raisiny sweetness of the sherry has been toned down by the nuttiness of the American oak.

TITLE: Glenmorangie A Tale Of Ice Cream Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Glenmorangie A Tale Of Ice Cream Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a whimsical and limited-edition expression from Glenmorangie, known for their innovative approach to whisky-making. Inspired by the indulgent and joyful experience of ice cream, this single malt offers a rich, creamy flavor profile with playful layers of sweetness and fruit. Crafted at the Glenmorangie Distillery in the Highlands of Scotland, this whisky is bottled at 46% ABV, providing a smooth yet vibrant experience. Whether enjoyed neat, over ice, or paired with a dessert, this special release is a delightful treat for whisky lovers seeking something playful and indulgent.

TITLE: Glenmorangie Astar 2017 Scotch Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Glenmorangie Astar returns after a five-year absence. Astar is matured in custom toasted casks made from slow-growing trees on north-facing slopes in the Ozark Mountains of Missouri. The barrels harbor bourbon for four years before heading to Glenmorangie. That level of provenance doesn’t come cheap, which is why the original Astar was discontinued in 2012, just four years after its acclaimed appearance. The exquisite Glenmorangie aromas and flavors-floral, with rose hips and orange blossom-are, dialed up to new levels of intensity, while the voluptuous and sweet palate exudes harmony and balance

TITLE: Glenmorangie Highland Single Malt Grand Vintage Malt  1997
DESCRIPTION: Glenmorangie Grand Vintage 1997 is the seventh release in the limited edition The Bond House No. 1 Collection named for the brand's largest 19th century bonded warehouses. It spent about 10 years in ex-bourbon casks before a portion was transferred to Chateau Montrose red wine casks, from the Saint-Estèphe appellation of Bordeaux. Then it spent an additional period of maturation in a combination of ex-bourbon and ex-oloroso sherry casks for a total of 23 years of maturation in the distillery's Bond House No. 1. It is bottled at 43% ABV and is available as of June, 2021.

TITLE: Glenmorangie Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky Taster Gift Pack
DESCRIPTION: Glenmorangie Taster 4-pack includes 100ml of The Original, 100ml of Nectar D'Or, 100ml of Quinta Ruban and 100ml of Lasanta. Comes in giftbox. The Original - Aroma: The scent of citrus and ripening peaches is softened by the aroma of vanilla. Taste: First, vanilla is detected on the tongue before it ripples along the palate bringing a burst of flowery fruitiness. Finish: About a minute after tasting, you are left with a clean and salving aftertaste with hints of orange and peach. Nectar D'Or - Aroma: Lime and orange rind, sultanas and dates give a rich fruity flavour laced with tantalising spices of coconut and nutmeg. Taste: Ginger, nutmeg and toasted almonds bring a deep, warming taste interwoven with a syrupy lemon meringue and honeycomb middle. Finish: Long and lusciously sweet finish with lemon zest, white chocolate, vanilla and traces of ginger and nutmeg. Quinta Ruban - Aroma: Dark mint chocolate, tangerines and Seville oranges mingle with sandalwood and walnut before giving way to a spicy finish of pepper and nutmeg. Taste: Mint chocolate and walnuts envelop the palate like velvet, laying the foundations for rose, Turkish delight and sweet Seville oranges. Finish: Long lasting silky aftertaste leaving dark chocolate mints and traces of orange. Lasanta - Aroma: Warm spices mix with smooth chocolate covered raisins, honeycomb and caramel toffee. Taste: Deliciously sweet sherry flavoured sultanas, orange segments, walnuts and butterscotch combine to create complex warm spices. Finish: Long and satisfying finish with spiced orange and chocolate covered hazelnuts.

TITLE: Glenmorangie Lasanta 12 Years Highland Single Malt Scotch Wishky
DESCRIPTION: Elegant but full bodied this whisky has spent ten years maturing in American white oak ex-bourbon casks before being extra-matured for a further two years in Oloroso and PX Sherry casks from Jerez in Spain. Lasanta is Gaelic for warmth and passion, a reminder not just of the Spanish provenance of these Oloroso sherry butts, but also a reflection of this expression's lusciously soft texture and deep, enticingly sweet aroma.

TITLE: Glenmorangie Lasanta 12 Years Highland Single Malt Scotch Wishky
DESCRIPTION: Elegant but full bodied this whisky has spent ten years maturing in American white oak ex-bourbon casks before being extra-matured for a further two years in Oloroso and PX Sherry casks from Jerez in Spain. Lasanta is Gaelic for warmth and passion, a reminder not just of the Spanish provenance of these Oloroso sherry butts, but also a reflection of this expression's lusciously soft texture and deep, enticingly sweet aroma.

TITLE: Glenmorangie Quinta Ruban 12 Year Old Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The darkest and most intense whisky in the extra-matured range, Glenmorangie Quinta Ruban has spent 10 years maturing in American white oak casks, before being transferred into specially selected ruby port pipes from the Quintas or wine estates of Portugal. Extra maturation in these port pipes develops Glenmorangie Quinta Ruban into a voluptuous spirit with a complex balance of sweet and dry flavours and an intriguing contrast of smooth and crisp, cooling textures. Non chill-filtered for additional aroma and mouthfeel.

TITLE: Glenmorangie Quinta Ruban 12 Year Old Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The darkest and most intense whisky in the extra-matured range, Glenmorangie Quinta Ruban has spent 10 years maturing in American white oak casks, before being transferred into specially selected ruby port pipes from the Quintas or wine estates of Portugal. Extra maturation in these port pipes develops Glenmorangie Quinta Ruban into a voluptuous spirit with a complex balance of sweet and dry flavours and an intriguing contrast of smooth and crisp, cooling textures. Non chill-filtered for additional aroma and mouthfeel.

TITLE: Glenmorangie Quinta Ruban 14 Year Old Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
Glenmorangie The Nectar d'Or Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: It is here, in hand selected wine barriques from Sauternes: the most famous and ancient sweet wine growing region of France, that this whisky develops its rich, spicy and dessert-like flavours. Non chill-filtered for additional aroma and mouthfeel.

TITLE: Glenmorangie The Original 10 Year Old Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The original expression of our elegant, floral spirit and the real backbone of the Glenmorangie range. A ten-year-old single malt, Glenmorangie Original is produced by marrying the delicate spirit that emerges from Scotland's tallest stills, with first and second fill American white oak casks. It is here, maturing for ten long years in a range of ex-bourbon casks such as our famous slow-grown and air-dried 'designer casks' from Missouri, that our raw spirit develops a perfect balance between sweetness and complexity. Resulting in a mature spirit that is soft, mellow and creamy. Perfect for enjoying at any time.

TITLE: Glenmorangie X Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: In an effort to diversify the whisky category and offer an approachable expression to new whisky drinkers, Glenmorangie worked with bartenders to create X by Glenmorangie. This new single malt Scotch can be paired with mixers for easy cocktails. Inspired by the flavor possibilities by mixing whisky, Dr. Bill Lumsden, director of whisky creation for Glenmorangie, set out to make a sweeter style single malt, the company says. The goal was for X by Glenmorangie to fill a role in mixed drinks that only need two to four ingredients.

TITLE: Glenn's Creek OCD #5 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Finished in Honey Barrel
DESCRIPTION: Glenn's Creek OCD #5 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Finished in Honey Barrel is a unique bourbon that has undergone an innovative finishing process in a 25-gallon honey barrel. This special finish adds complex layers to the whiskey, enhancing its flavor profile with subtle sweetness and richness, making it a standout offering from Glenns Creek Distillery.

TITLE: Glenrothes 10 yrs Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
Glenrothes 23 yrs Speyside Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: It is rare to see a whisky this old from the famed Glenrothes distillery, let alone one drawn from a single cask and bottled at its natural proof. It is even rarer to find it available at anywhere near this price. The nose here may remind of a Bourbon, or at least splitting the difference between Bourbon and Scotch, with oak and caramel notes riding on malt instead of corn. The palate focuses on depth, rather than breadth, digging deep into a malt-driven profile and showing just how much there is to be explored within what malt has to offer. But it is the finish where the flavors really expose themselves, with a robust complexity evolving over a long period. That finish certainly takes the Glenrothes experience to the next level.

TITLE: Glenrothes Hogshead Cask 17 yrs Speyside Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Glenrothes distillery has been producing malt whiskey since 1879. The distillery's unique bottling process focuses on the vintage of the malt, not the age, to ensure quality distilling and careful planning. Carefully selected barrels, barleys, and spring water ensure Glenrothes malts are of the highest quality and flavor.

TITLE: Glentauchers 11 yrs Speyside Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Signatory Vintage “Glentauchers” 2009 Aged 11 years Old Distilled On: 07/05/2009 Bottled On: 18/09/2020 Matured in a 1st Fill Sherry Butt Cask No: 900308 Bottle no. 50 out of 614 Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky Cast Strength Collection 64.3% Alc. Volume

TITLE: Glentauchers 17 yrs Speyside Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Glentauchers whisky distillery was founded in 1897 by W P Lowrie, a Glasgow-based whisky trader, and James Buchanan, a renowned blender. Five years later, Lowrie experienced financial hardship and James Buchanan subsequently bought him out. The distillery was built at Tauchers Farm, four miles west of the town of Keith. The location was chosen for its proximity to a rail line and main road. Indeed, the Glentauchers distillery boasts its own railway siding. AGED: 17 years DISTILLED ON: February 6, 1996 BOTTLE ON: August 2, 2013 MATURED IN: Burbon Barrel CASK NO: 1395 ALC: 46%

TITLE: Glentauchers 20 yrs Speyside Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Glentauchers is a distillery rapidly rising in the ranks thanks to great indie bottles like this. Distilled on 23 July 1997, matured in a pair of bourbon barrels and bottled on 6 November 2017 at 20 years old.

TITLE: Glenturret Hogshead 29 yrs Highland Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Dating back to 1775, Glenturret is the oldest active distillery in Scotland. Formerly known as Hosh, the distillery was renamed in 1875. The distillery was closed and dismantled in the 1920s upon Prohibition’s enactment, remaining closed until the late 1950s. Glenturret’s claim to fame is it’s association with the Edrington Group’s Grouse blend, and today is one of the most frequented distillery’s in the industry. AGED: 29 years DISTILLED ON: July 23, 1988 BOTTLE ON: December 8, 2017 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 535 ALC: 51.2

TITLE: Godet Antarctica Icy Cognac
DESCRIPTION: Godet Antarctica Icy Cognac is a unique and innovative spirit, embodying a fusion of tradition and adventurous spirit. This cognac is a blend of Cognac Wine Eau de vie and 1% brandy, matured meticulously in century-old oak barrels so old that they have no tannin left to color the juices, resulting in a translucent, colorless eau de vie. The creation of Godet Antarctica was inspired by an extreme sailing expedition to Antarctica led by Jean-Jacques Godet, a member of the 14th generation of the Godet family, marking a significant journey both geographically and spiritually. This cognac is a tribute to the purity and power of the icy continent, and its creation has rooted Godet as a brand that cherishes history while embracing the call of adventure. The Godet Antarctica Cognac is a soft, delicate, and sensual spirit, embodying an icy coolness that sets it apart from traditional cognac offerings. It is recommended to be enjoyed chilled, most often in cocktails, or served over rocks, providing a refreshing and utterly original tasting experience.​

TITLE: Godet VSOP Cognac
DESCRIPTION: Godet Special VSOP is a Cognac that was aged 10 years in oak casks, its blend consists of Petite Champagne, Borderies and Fins Bois cognacs. This cognac offers a light woody, floral nose, tinged with hazelnuts and peach jam. The house of Godet has been run by the family for 14 generations. It is a perfect example of a cognac house that deeply believes in the tradition of this spirit and its origins.

TITLE: Gokoo Mugi Shochu
DESCRIPTION: Gokoo is shochu made from carefully selected barley. It is aged in oak barrels for 3 years and has a rich taste. Gokoo has been adopted by Japan Airlines for international executive in-flight service. Prefecture is Fukuoka.

TITLE: Golan Heights Winery Mount Hermon Red
DESCRIPTION: Discover the vibrant flavors of Israel with Golan Heights Winery Mount Hermon Red. Originating from the renowned Golan Heights region, this exquisite red blend is a testament to the winery's commitment to excellence. Crafted from a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and other classic varieties, this wine offers a harmonious and approachable profile. The unique terroir of Mount Hermon imparts distinct characteristics, resulting in a wine that is both expressive and balanced. Perfect for any occasion, Mount Hermon Red embodies the rich heritage and innovative spirit of Golan Heights Winery. This red blend from Golan Heights Winery is a perfect introduction to the wines of Israel, offering a delightful and accessible taste that will appeal to both new wine enthusiasts and seasoned connoisseurs.

TITLE: Gold Spot 9 Years 135th Anniversary Limited Edition Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Under the hustle and bustle of cobbled Dublin streets in the early 1900s, a rare whiskey was quietly making a name for itself. The simple act of marking barrels with spots of colored paint would not only signify their age potential, but would become the namesake for this coveted whiskey, bonded and bottled by The Mitchells – a seventh generation family business. This is a very limited-edition Irish whiskey that celebrates the 135th anniversary of the Mitchell & Son Family entering whiskey bonding. Needless to say, it’s the Jewel of the ‘Spot’ lineup. You’ve heard of Green Spot, Yellow Spot, Blue Spot and even on occasion, Red. But this is the gold!

TITLE: Gonc Winery Canvas Rose Pet-Nat
DESCRIPTION: Peter Gonc is a 4th generation winemaker and grape grower. His family tradition got its start in 1936 and now Peter is producing some of the most fun wines in Slovenia. Petillant Naturel AKA Pet-Nats, so dubbed by the hip wine scene of today, are the trendy new-but-old style way to make bubbles. These wines are actually made using a method that pre-dates the Champagne style – and is way cheaper to do. Much like your parents’ old band tees and bell bottom jeans, they are back, and back with a vengeance. This style of wine originated in France and is said to be the O.G. of the sparkling wine family.

TITLE: Good Intentions Wine Co "Gris Diddle Dee" Rose
DESCRIPTION: Pinot Gris grown on one of Mount Gambier's unique sites with an abundance of ancient flint rock and limestone close to the ocean from the Coola Road Vinyard . De-stemmed on skins, with some carbonic macerated for 1 week and then de-stemmed. Pressed to french oak, elevage 8 months, racked to tank and blended with Pinot Noir from our organically farmed Pinot blocks on the youngest volcanic soils of Mount Gambier.

TITLE: Good Intentions Wine Co "Relatively White"
DESCRIPTION: Sauvignon blanc grown on one of Mount Gambier's unique sites with an abundance of ancient flint rock and limestone close to the ocean. It is macerated on skins through ferment for 3 weeks before elevage in old oak on lees ranging from 8 months - 15 months.

TITLE: Good Times  Cigar Barrel Strength Single Barrel Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Mashbill: 36% rye, 60% corn, 4% malted barley Proof: 119 Age: 6.5 years Barrels used: new American oak (6 years), oloroso sherry, cognac, Armagnac (finishing barrels) Finish: 30-45 days in each barrel Filtration: Non-chill filtered About Good Times: Folks at Good Times pride themselves on producing the true essence of bourbon. They source high-quality single barrels of new bourbon and rye whiskies beginning at the 5-year mark. They take these barrels and either bottle them as-is or finish them in a wide variety of barrels that accent the true beauty of the spirit. They do not produce flavored whiskey. They make bourbons and ryes that are finished in various casks, adding layers and dimensions to the flavor profile that wouldn't otherwise be found in your typical spirits. The curation of barrels that play well with the notes found in the original spirit is their primary goal.

TITLE: Good Times Jews and Booze "AmaR'ye" Straight Rye Whiskey  Finished in Peach Brandy Barrels
DESCRIPTION: This pick by our friend from Jews & Booze is a tribute to basketball great Amar’e Stoudemire, and is called "AmaR’ye". It is a barrel of MGP straight rye with a mash bill of 95% rye and 5% malted barley that was bottled by Good Times. It was originally barreled on August 22, 2016, and aged for about 4 years, 9 months in a char #4 barrel. It was dumped from the original barrel into a barrel that previously held peach brandy on May 25, 2021. It was finished for 6 weeks and was finally dumped and bottled on July 6th. 110 Proof. **$5 from every bottle will be donated to the Amar’e Stoudemire Foundation (AmareStoudemire.com/foundation)

TITLE: Gordo Yecla Monastrell Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: A fabulous value from Patrick Mata, the 2012 Gordo is a blend of 70% Monastrell and 30% Cabernet Sauvignon from an organic vineyard planted in 1970. Aged three months in French oak, it showcases the brilliant quality of the Mourvèdre grape from this sunny appellation. The wine boasts an opaque ruby/purple color along with notes of lead pencil shavings, blackberries, black raspberries and a hint of blueberries. The sensational fruit characteristics are pure as well as vivid. This full-bodied, opulent, stunningly savory, expansively flavored 2012 can be drunk over the next 2-3 years.

TITLE: Gordon Graham Black Bottle Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A TASTE OF THE UNEXPECTEDMaster Blender, Gordon Graham, toiled night and day on his new creation. And as he poured a glass for his brothers, they were overwhelmed by what they found.The air filled with a heady blend of aromas – from fresh floral scents to the very deepest, oaky notes. All carried on spice-flecked wisps of delicate, peaty smoke.Slowly, they raised their glasses to indulge in their first sips and instantly the silky, mellow notes of fruit struck them. Perfectly balanced with the smoke-fringed flavours of sweet oak and honey; it was a sensation like no other.Sinking into the elegantly spiced finish of nutmeg, pepper and lingering smokiness, it was then the brothers knew: they had tasted their future.And so it would remain for over 130 years as Black Bottle affirmed its place in the hearts of drinkers around the world. -Distiller's Notes

TITLE: Gotham Project "Boom Box" Rose
DESCRIPTION: THE GOTHAM PROJECT is the pioneer of reusable stainless steel kegs of high quality soulful wines. Gotham is a collaboration between Charles Bieler (BIELER Pere et Fils, Charles & Charles, Three Thieves, Sombra mezcal) and Bruce Schneider (Schneider Vineyards, Schneider Selections, OBRIGADO Vinhos Portugal). In order to offer a variety of soulful options we turned to our own winemaking projects and our friends to offer a collection of authentic and exciting juice from coast to coast and around the world.

TITLE: Govone Barbera d'Alba
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the rich heritage of Italian winemaking with Govone Barbera d'Alba, a distinguished red wine from the renowned Piedmont region. Crafted by the esteemed Govone winery, this Barbera is a testament to the quality and tradition that define the wines of the region.

TITLE: Gozenshu BodaImoto Nigori Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Gozenshu Brewery (Tsuji Honten Co., Ltd.) was founded in 1804 in Katsuyama, Okayama by Yahei Tsuji, originally a mercer who ventured into brewing business.

TITLE: Gracias A Dios Agave Gin
DESCRIPTION: Gracias a Dios is a double distilled mezcal, 100% artisanal, handmade with “pinas” from espadin agave and other varieties, ground and fermented in our own palenque in Santiago Matatlan, Oaxaca, honoring fair trade with the help of maestro mezcalero Oscar Hernandez Santiago.With a strong, aromatic and balanced flavor, this spirit is the product of a 4-generation family of maestros mezcaleros, who have traditionally kept the artisan processes of making this drink.

TITLE: Graggnmore Hogshead 20 yrs Speyside Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Cragganmore distillery was founded in 1869 by John Smith, who managed The Macallan and The Glenlivet distilleries. Sited close by the main Speyside railway line and in close proximity to the elegant River Spey, the Cragganmore whisky distillery draws its water from the mineral-rich Craggan Burn, which tumbles down its namesake, the Craggan More hill. AGED: 20 years DISTILLED ON: September 30, 1985 BOTTLE ON: August 8, 2006 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 1987 ALC: 52.5%

TITLE: Graham Beck Brut
Graham Beck Brut Rose
Graham Six Grapes Reserve Porto
DESCRIPTION: Grahams Six Grapes is made from six Port-grape varieties, hence the name: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Francesa, Tinta Roriz, Tinta Barroca, Tinta Amarela and Tintao Cão. Six Grapes is bottled ready to drink after about five years of cask aging. It has a t-cap closure, which means that you don't need a corkscrew to open it and that it should stay fresh for up to two months if stored in a cool, dark place or the refrigerator. Serve it in a glass with at least a six ounce capacity so that you may appreciate the wine's aromas. Six Grapes pairs particularly well with dark chocolate, or sharp hard cheese (cheddar, especially), but is also fantastic on its own as a luscious dessert in a glass.

TITLE: Graham's Tawny 10 Years Porto
DESCRIPTION: This is rich on the nose, with candied fruit, fruitcake, toffee and maple syrup. Full-bodied and medium sweet, with a brilliant aftertaste of fruit and caramel. Lasts for minutes on your palate. 92 POINTS WINE ENTHUSIAST

TITLE: Gramercy Cellars Lower East Columbia Valley Syrah
DESCRIPTION: Master Sommelier Greg Harrington spent his career overseeing some of the most prestigious wine programs in the country. In 2004 he had a revelation about the balanced and earthy wines of the Walla Walla and he made it a goal to make wine there. This goal was realized sooner rather than later, and now Greg and his wife Pam have founded Gramercy Cellars. Their driving philosophy is to make wines that display balance, fruit and earthiness, and minimal new oak flavors. Additionally, they partner with unique, exceptional growers who share similar values, commitment to quality and dedication to sustainability.

TITLE: Gran Centenario Tequila Anejo
Gran Coramino Reposado Cristalino Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Gran Coramino Reposado is meticulously filtered for clarity and unparalleled smoothness. 100% Blue Agave.

TITLE: Gran Gala Triple Orange Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: A deep rich orange flavor is the result of artful blending of VSOP Brandy with triple orange essence from the choicest oranges from Sicily. Long a favorite of bartenders and mixologists, Imported GranGala is also a favorite of many Chefs to bring new excitement to their cuisine.

TITLE: Gran Gala Triple Orange Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: A deep rich orange flavor is the result of artful blending of VSOP Brandy with triple orange essence from the choicest oranges from Sicily. Long a favorite of bartenders and mixologists, Imported GranGala is also a favorite of many Chefs to bring new excitement to their cuisine.

TITLE: Gran Passione Veneto IGT Rosso
DESCRIPTION: Product information (60% Merlot/40% Corvina). During fermentation the must macerated on its skins and the wine was aged in oak. A deep purple color with ripe fruit aromas, spice and vanilla, the black fruit flavors merge with soft tannins and juicy acidity on the finish. Gran Passione is located in Italy's Veneto region. The winery sources fruit from its network of long-term relationships with small, high-quality growers. The Merlot and Corvino was harvested in the beginning of October from vines planted on rich alluvial soils. The wines were made in the appassimento method. Producer information Passion is a powerful feeling, a compelling emotion. "Gran Passione" is exactly this, the expression and devotion to our work that honors the tradition of our land. The Gran Passione Rosso is crafted in the tradition of “Apassimento” (to dry and shrivel), the same style as Amarone wines of the region. This technique has its roots in an ancient past dating back to the Roman era. Over the centuries, this technique of “drying” the grapes before crushing has been honed, resulting in this unique ex pression of northern Italy. Piedmonte is often called the “Burgundy of Italy” due to its reputation for many small family wineries and a focus on quality. The Gran Passione Piedmonte collection (Barbera d’Asti DOCG & Gavi DOCG) represents the diversity and quality of this north western pocket of Italy, set at the foot of the Alps. Serve this wine up with an impromptu osso bucco, stew, steaks on the grill, or mature hard cheeses like a Parmigiano-Reggiano

TITLE: Green River "Bunghole" Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel x R-Bourbon Pick
DESCRIPTION: The Sequel That Tops the Original It’s not often you can say the second time around is better than the first, but The Prime Barrel hit the jackpot with our second visit to Green River Distilling in Owensboro, KY. As impressive as our first Green River barrel was, this 6-year-old bourbon surpasses it in every way—nose, palate, and finish. Our journey began with a tour of the historic Green River Distillery, the tenth oldest in Kentucky. The rich aromas of distillation and aging whiskey filled the air as we explored, and tasting the high-proof new make bourbon straight from the four-story copper column still was a true highlight. As we entered Rickhouse B, six members of The Prime Barrel were presented with four hand-picked barrels for a blind tasting. Barrel 3 and Barrel 4 quickly rose to the top, but after careful deliberation, Barrel 3 was the unanimous winner. This extraordinary barrel is 8 months older and 13 proof points higher than our previous Green River pick, which sold out in no time. With over 50% angel share loss, this 6-year, high-rye bourbon delivers concentrated, bold flavors at a powerful 132 proof. But be warned—this is a short barrel, and quantities are extremely limited! Tasting Notes: Nose: Vanilla extract, cinnamon, white pepper, red berries, with a touch of floral notes Palate: Bold spice with brown sugar, caramel syrup, baking spices, orange zest, and a hint of charred oak Finish: Long and warm with cayenne pepper, caramel, pecan pie, baking spices, and oak char that lingers with every sip Don’t miss out on this powerhouse Green River bourbon—it’s an exclusive, limited release that won’t last long! Barrel Details: Mashbill: 70% corn, 21% rye, 9% malted barley Proof: 132 Age: 6 years Barreled Date: July 3, 2018 Bottled Date: July 24, 2024

TITLE: Green River "Green Mile" Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #89
DESCRIPTION: A team of four from The Prime Barrel, including Jake of the @coming_whiskey Instagram account known for its whiskey release updates, had a memorable day selecting a Green River barrel in Owensboro, KY. With its roots stretching back to 1885, Green River boasts the historical marker KY-DSP-10, marking it as Kentucky's tenth oldest distillery. Following various changes in name and ownership, and a prolonged closure during the bourbon downturn, the distillery was fully restored in 2014, with distillation recommencing in 2016. 2023 marked the launch of Green River's single barrel program, with fewer than 100 barrels made available. The Prime Barrel made history by selecting the first barrel for New York and being just the 69th selection overall. Our day kicked off with a comprehensive tour, highlighting the 54” column still—a central piece of their distillation process. Entering a rickhouse, we were greeted by the sight of a long table set with four freshly drawn samples, creating an idyllic backdrop for our selection process. Initial tasting was met with contemplative silence as we evaluated the samples. It quickly became clear that two samples stood out unanimously. In the blind second round, our discussions on each sample's virtues led to the unanimous selection of sample A, which, revealed post-tasting, was also our first-round favorite. We were frankly surprised at how good the juice was. For the age, this was far superior to what we had expected. In fact, it could be part of your last meal - hence the monicker "Green Mile" (we kid, of course). The experience underscored Green River's prowess at barrel proof, offering a fascinating dive into the variance among barrels distilled on the same day (6/2/18), despite many of us being new to Green River's single barrel offerings.Tasting Notes: Nose - bold traditional bourbon with honey and praline Palate - vanilla, orange zest, toffee, gingerbread, white pepper, cayenne, black walnut Finish - medium long develops sweet and spicy with burnt sugar, buttercream, pepper 119 Proof

TITLE: Green River Distilling Kentucky Straight Wheated Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Green River Kentucky Straight Wheated Bourbon Whiskey is a modern revival of a historical brand, distilled at the Green River Distilling Co. in Owensboro, Kentucky. Its reasonable pricing and approachable profile make it a good entry point for those new to wheated bourbons or looking for a gentler bourbon experience.

DESCRIPTION: Green River Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a revival of a historic brand by the Green River Distilling Company in Owensboro, Kentucky. The bourbon is produced using locally-sourced Kentucky-grown corn and follows traditional barrel aging, reflecting a commitment to quality and heritage. Its affordable pricing and approachable nature make it a good choice for those new to bourbon or looking for a versatile whiskey for various occasions

TITLE: Green River Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Green River Distilling Co. presents its Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey, a premium addition to its whiskey range. Distilled in Owensboro, Kentucky, this rye whiskey blends barrels aged between 4 and 6 years and is bottled at a robust 95 proof. TITLE: Gulp/Hablo Orange Wine
DESCRIPTION: The Parra family’s pursuit came from the devotion of the three brothers (Francisco, Javier, and Luis) to find a sense of place in their home of La Mancha. They founded their property with the conviction to organically and biodynamically farm every vine under their care. The Parra family works two large vineyards in La Mancha near the town of Las Messas (The Tables), totaling some 445 acres, or about 180 hectares. One of the vineyards is named Entresendas (Between Paths) and sits within the dried river bed. Entresendas benefits from the rich, alluvial soils, common to old river beds and perfect for the cultivation of grapes. The other vineyard is officially named Olla del Monte (Cooking Pan in the Mountain), but is known locally as the Cuesta Colorá because of the colorful scarpland soils of chalky clay covered in a fine layer of pebbles that hold the day’s heat well into the night. For the Gulp/Hablo, the extremely gulpable wines, they tapped Juan Antonio Ponce of Bodegas Ponce to make the wine. With this partnership, they were able to create a wine that beats the competition without sacrificing on quality.

TITLE: Gun Fighter 13 Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #1
DESCRIPTION: Dear fellow bourbon drinker, behold our inaugural single barrel pick! "Banksy Bananas" is us venturing out into single barrel territory, as customers such as yourself have repeatedly asked us to do. We could not be more proud of the pick. It's age, quality, and the taste is everything we like about bourbon. We firmly believe that age-wise, 12-13 year old again is a sweet spot for bourbon. Anything younger can (and does) also taste good, but it does not quite get there in terms of whiskey character and development Anything older tends to be on the woody side. So in making this pick, we wanted to stick to this specific age statement. In terms of the taste, the pick has all of the characteristics you'd expect: vanilla and honey. It also does - at least to us - have pretty awesome overtones of bananas, which is unusual for whiskey and it immediately drew us to this barrel. As for the sticker, it reflects on the banana overtones and the bourbon's Gun Fighter brand. Thank you to everyone that participated in helping us pick the label as it was a truly collaborative effort. Ok, on to the tasting notes: Gun Fighter 13 is aged for more than 13 years in new American white oak barrels and bottled at 100 proof. It has a nice dark amber color and great legs. The bourbon comes straight to the point with a sweet vanilla nose and prominent oak. The palate is warm with banana (which is awesome and unusual), honey, caramel, and buttery smooth vanilla. The finish is dry and spicy with lingering pepper and oak notes. The Prime Barrel’s Inaugural Single Barrel Selection For and exclusively at the De Wine Spot Cask #5 Barreled on December 22, 2004 Bottled on August 16, 2019 Non-Chill Filtered

TITLE: H.K. Young Bourbon Co. Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Introducing the HK Young Single Barrel "#ryeguy"—a rare, high-proof bourbon crafted for those seeking bold flavors and refined depth. Born from a passion of three friends, HK Young Bourbon celebrates the art of toasted barrel finishing, adding a signature layer of elegance and complexity to traditional Kentucky bourbon. Each HK Young release begins its journey in a high-char barrel and receives a unique finish in a toasted cooperage, a method that smooths and enriches the whiskey, elevating it with flavors reminiscent of wine-barrel aging. This special Single Barrel "#ryeguy" release stands out among HK Young’s small-batch blends. Selected for its exceptional quality, this high-rye bourbon (60% corn, 36% rye, 4% malted barley) aged for 6 years and 9 months, reaching its peak flavor at a powerful 122.4 proof. Finished in HK Young's custom Spice Toasted Barrel, "#ryeguy" captures the spice and intensity of its high-rye content while introducing a layer of smooth complexity and nuanced warmth. Tasting Notes: Nose: Spice-forward with notes of toasted oak, vanilla, and subtle caramel undertones. Palate: Bold rye spice mingles with rich caramel, dark fruit, and soft hints of cinnamon and clove from the toasted finish. Finish: Warm, lingering spice with a balanced sweetness, leaving hints of toasted oak and dark chocolate. Why It’s Special: As a single-barrel release, "#ryeguy" is a unique bourbon that won’t be replicated. The robust, high-rye mash bill and custom spice-toasted barrel make this a remarkable pour, offering a one-of-a-kind whiskey experience. With only one barrel available, this exclusive release is a must-have for collectors and enthusiasts of distinctive, robust bourbon. Secure your HK Young Single Barrel "#ryeguy" bottle now—once it’s gone, it’s gone forever!

TITLE: H.K. Young Bourbon Co. Toasted Barrel Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in HK Young Toasted Kentucky Straight Bourbon "Panacea"—a premium bourbon crafted from a shared passion for the art of whiskey finishing. HK Young is the result of three friends’ commitment to creating bourbon with depth, elegance, and sophistication, inspired by the unique character of toasted barrel finishes. Unlike standard high-char barrels, Panacea is aged in specially toasted barrels, akin to wine barrels, which lend a smoother, richer flavor profile. "Panacea" is a meticulously crafted blend of three mashbills from Bardstown Distilling Company: 60% corn/36% rye/4% malted barley, 70% corn/20% rye/10% malted barley, and 78% corn/10% rye/12% malted barley. This blend incorporates aged whiskey between six and eight years, with each sip revealing complex layers achieved through careful blending and barrel selection. Bottled at a robust 114.4 proof, Panacea offers a bold experience that balances toasted sweetness with rich, full-bodied notes. Tasting Notes: Nose: Warm vanilla and toasted oak lead, accented by hints of caramel and baking spices. Palate: Layers of dark fruit, honey, and toffee, with soft smokiness from the toasted barrels. Finish: Long and smooth with lingering warmth, showcasing notes of charred oak and sweet spice. With only 13 barrels used in this limited release, HK Young Panacea stands as a testament to the art of toasted barrel finishing. Ideal for bourbon enthusiasts looking for a unique and elevated expression, Panacea is a celebration of the craft and creativity that define HK Young bourbons.

TITLE: Habitation Velier Privateer Unaged Rum
DESCRIPTION: The beauty of this un-aged rum is breathtaking. Privateer distills rum from Guatemalan Molasses in Ipswich, Massachusetts just north of Boston. They've been at it a while and have been doing it the right way: adding no sugar and putting the straight rum on the market unfiltered, at its best. I was amazed by its layers and length. First, I was hit with fruits (from grape to apple) and had to check that I wasn't drinking an eau-de-vie. Then the sugar/molasses notes came in. There are also hints of complex confection, reminiscent of a well-aged Armagnac. Definitely a keeper and a sipper.Made from 100% single origin Guatemalan molasses, itself created from sugar cane grown in the volcanic terroirs of that country, this high congener rum was double pot distilled and bottled at a powerful 62% abv.
