Get to know the clean, balanced and exceptionally well crafted taste that has made Hakkaisan famous. Hakkaisan Shiboritate Genshu is full-bodied and lively. Nama Genshus offer the rich taste unique to a just-pressed and cask-strength, undiluted Sake. Brewed only during the coldest wintery months, this special unpasteurized Sake presents the freshest drinking pleasure of bountiful aroma and delicious flavor.

TITLE: Hakkaisan Tokubetsu Honjozo Sake
DESCRIPTION: This is Hakkaisan’s classic sake and it has a smooth and mellow taste that you will always find refreshing. You can enjoy it either warm or chilled. When gently heated, the delicate aroma is enhanced.

TITLE: Hakugyokko "Fragrant Jewel" Nama Yamahai Junmai Muroka Genshu
DESCRIPTION: A singular expression of Yamada Nishiki rice polished to 60%, Hakugyokko is a bold and rustic sake made by the time consuming hot yamahai method unique to Kidoizumi Brewery.

TITLE: Hakurakusei "Legend Of The Stars" Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: For his Junmai Daiginjo Niizawa-san has chosen to use heirloom Omachi rice milled to 40% which gives this graceful sake a slightly herbal and savory quality.

TITLE: Hakurakusei "Legend Of The Stars" Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Slightly fuller and chewier than the Hakurakusei Tokubetsu Junmai, it shares the house style: clean and zippy and remarkably food friendly. Just full enough to stand up to richer and sweeter foods like simmered Japanese nimono dishes or to cut through chicken liver mouse. And if you’ve never tried the heavenly combination of sake and caviar, this is the place to start. Made from lesser known varietal Kura no Hana rice milled to 55%.

TITLE: Hakurakusei "Legend Of The Stars" Tokubetsu Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Classic example of a modern sake style, the Hakurakusei Tokubetsu Junmai is laser focused, a clean, direct sake bursting with vitality. Particularly good with a variety of sashimi or summer salads. High quality Yamada Nishiki rice from Hyogo prefecture milled to 60%.

TITLE: Hakurosuishu "Moon Mountain's Dew" Nama Junmai Ginjo Muroka Genshu Sake
DESCRIPTION: A combination of Yamagata specialty Dewasansan sake rice with Miyama Nishiki, both milled to 60%.

TITLE: Hakushika Tanuki Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Excellent for matching with such popular Japanese favorites as sushi, teriyaki and tempura. Also excellent with yakitori grilled chicken, ramen, vegetable stir-fry, Asian noodles and spring rolls. Can be served as chilled, at room temperature, warm, or hot.

TITLE: Hakushika Tanuki Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Excellent for matching with such popular Japanese favorites as sushi, teriyaki and tempura. Also excellent with yakitori grilled chicken, ramen, vegetable stir-fry, Asian noodles and spring rolls. Can be served as chilled, at room temperature, warm, or hot.

TITLE: Hakushika Tanuki Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Excellent for matching with such popular Japanese favorites as sushi, teriyaki and tempura. Also excellent with yakitori grilled chicken, ramen, vegetable stir-fry, Asian noodles and spring rolls. Can be served as chilled, at room temperature, warm, or hot.

TITLE: Hakushu 12 Years Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Hakushu Distillery was founded half a century after Yamazaki. Keizo Saji inherited his father's vision in his quest for innovation and constructed this second Suntory distillery in 1973. Built amidst the deepest forests of Mt. Kaikomagatake in the Japanese Southern Alps, the Hakushu Distillery is without question one of the highest distilleries in the world.The majestic forest that surrounds the Hakushu Distillery shelters an abundance of plant varieties reflecting the many expressions of Japanese nature.

TITLE: Hakushu 18 Years Limited Edition Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Suntory is one of the largest makers of alcoholic beverages in the world. Its products include favorites, such as the Yamazaki and Hibiki, and of course, the Hakushu, which remains as popular as ever. This Hakushu 18-Year-Old Single Malt Japanese Whisky is made exclusively from malted barley. An awesome 18-year-old Japanese whisky from the Hakushu distillery. Milled and mashed, with water sourced from the Ojira and Jingu Rivers. A limited edition bottle, presented in a wooden box. This is a perfect addition to your whisky collection.

TITLE: Hakushu 18 Years Single Malt Japanese Whisky
Hakushu Bourbon Barrel Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This Hakushu whisky was aged entirely in first fill bourbon barrels. Being non-chill filtered, it has resulted in a great deal of creamy sweetness. This whisky was distilled at Hakushu distillery surrounded by forest at the foot of the Southern Japan Alps.

TITLE: Hakushu Distiller's Reserve Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A green and crunchy entry in the Hakushu Range, combining whisky of a wide variety of ages, from across the range of casks used by the distillery to create a gently smoky dram, packed with fruity flavor.

TITLE: Hakutsuru "Chika" Sake Cup
DESCRIPTION: Smooth and refreshing from start to finish. Light bodied and slightly dry with light aromas of honey and sugarcane, layered with roasted almond and cashews on the nose. Subtle hints of pear, grapefruit, aniseed, and dark chocolate, with a short and easy finish Delicious with ramen, sushi, pesto pasta, roasted chicken or even ricotta toast.

TITLE: Hakutsuru Excellent Paper Pack Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: A nutty style of saké that's been aged for a period of time before cartoning to add complex, earthy flavors. The resulting saké is full-bodied and will be ideal next to earthy foods such as mushroom dishes or pork with wild rice.

TITLE: Hakutsuru Plum Wine
DESCRIPTION: Using selected Japanese Plum, "Ume", Hakutsuru Plum Wine has been brewed with highly developed fermentation skills and technique. It is characterized by its refreshing semi-sweet, sour taste and well-matured aroma from plum fruit. For aperitif or dessert wine.

TITLE: Hakutsuru Sayuri Nigori Sake
DESCRIPTION: SAYURI means "a little lily", which reminds us of the delicate image of Japanese culture. In actuality, the word "yuri", or "lily", has the meaning in floral terms of "chastity" and "innocence", and "SAYURI" is also used as a name for Japanese girls and women. We created SAYURI as an embodied gracefulness of Japan. Using only selected rice and rice koji, this is pure Nigori sake brewed up carefully with the natural water of Rokko.

TITLE: Hakutsuru Sayuri Nigori Sake
DESCRIPTION: SAYURI means "a little lily", which reminds us of the delicate image of Japanese culture. In actuality, the word "yuri", or "lily", has the meaning in floral terms of "chastity" and "innocence", and "SAYURI" is also used as a name for Japanese girls and women. We created SAYURI as an embodied gracefulness of Japan. Using only selected rice and rice koji, this is pure Nigori sake brewed up carefully with the natural water of Rokko.

TITLE: Hakutsuru Sho Une Jumnai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Using only the finest rice ”Yamada-Nishiki”, and Nada’s famed natural spring water ”Miyamizu”, ”SHO-UNE” has been brewed as the Supreme of Japanese Sake. Matches dishes with a salty taste or a rich taste. Baby clams steamed in Sake, Sashimi, Japanese stew (vegetables or fish stewed with soy sauce, fish broth, Sake, etc.), Broiled fish or prawn with a salty taste.

TITLE: Hama no Imota Soju
DESCRIPTION: Made from delicious high caliber sweet potatoes (83%) and rice (17%). Fragrant shochu with pronounced aroma of sweet potato. Serving Recommendation: On-the-rocks, with water (hot or cold).

TITLE: Hampden  Estate "The Younger" 5 Years LROK Pure Single Jamaica Rum
DESCRIPTION: Hampden Estate was founded in 1753 and has been distilling rum for almost three centuries in the Trelawny Parish, historically known as the grand cru of Jamaican rum. Renowned throughout the world for its full, intensely flavorful rums, Hampden Estate has always produced quintessential, heavy pot still pure single rums, using unique methods that guarantee its remarkable aromas and truly exceptional taste. The distillery is known for producing a large variety of distillates. LROK stands for Light Rum Owen Kelly, one of several marks made at Hampden Estate, which refers to a rum with a high but easily palatable ester concentration, ranging from 200 to 400 g/hLPA. This mark created in 1952 belongs to the wedderburn category, i.e. the heavy rums. In this case the ester content is of 314,8 gr/hLPA.

TITLE: Hampden Estate "Pewee" Trelawny Endemic Bird Series Cask #289 Single Jamaican Rum
DESCRIPTION: The Hampden Estate was founded in 1753 by a Scotsman called Archibald Sterling, in the Queen of Spain valley of Jamaica’s Trelawny parish. For 250 years it remained family owned, selling rum to third-party blenders and independent bottlers. Mismanagement however meant that by 2003 it was in financial trouble, with the Jamaican government stepping in to assume ownership and some of its debt in order to preserve the jobs of its employees. They sold it in 2009 to the Hussey family’s Everglades Farms, who as first point of business began laying down the casks that would eventually become the first Hampden Estate labelled official bottling of the distillery’s rum, launched in collaboration with Velier in 2018. Famed for its heavy, ester-driven style, Hampden is joined by Worthy Park as the only two Jamaican distilleries that produce exclusively pure single rums (using only pot stills). It currently has four pot stills: two from Forsyths in Scotland, one from Vendome in Kentucky, and another from T&T Engineering in South Africa.

TITLE: Hampden Estate 2010 LROK Single Cask Jamaican Rum
DESCRIPTION: Hampden Estate has been continuously producing traditional pot still rum in the heart of Jamaica since 1753. In 2010, they began aging their own rum onsite for the first time in their history. A couple years ago they came out with their standard and overproof bottlings, both of which became instant classics. Those both were blends of various recipes, or “marques”, ranging from lighter, low ester rums to high ester flavor bombs filled with the famous Jamaican “funk”. This bottling is made from a single recipe, their “LROK” marque. This refers to rums with an ester content between 350-450 gr/hlpa, labeled "Light Rum Owen Kelly", or LROK as a shortened designation. It should be noted that this is a light rum only by Hampden Estate's standards, with an ester count far above most other rums on the market. This also represents the oldest rum yet released to be aged entirely on premise in Jamaica, at 11 years. This tropical aging delivers a more intense integration of oak and concentration of flavors compared to rums aged in Europe, with particularly high levels of evaporation.

TITLE: Hampden Estate 8 Year Pure Single Jamaican Rum
DESCRIPTION: Hampden Estate is one the oldest sugar estates in Jamaica. Renowned throughout Jamaica's rum history for its full intensely flavorful pot still rums, it continues today to be the quintessential heavy pot rum of choice throughout Europe and other parts of the world.

TITLE: Hampden Estate Great House Old Old Pure Single Jamaican Rum Distillery Edition 2020
DESCRIPTION: Hampden Estate is one the oldest sugar estates in Jamaica. Renowned throughout Jamaica's rum history for its full intensely flavorful pot still rums, it continues today to be the quintessential heavy pot rum of choice throughout Europe and other parts of the world.

TITLE: Hampden Estate Great House Old Old Pure Single Jamaican Rum Distillery Edition 2021
DESCRIPTION: Hampden Estate is one the oldest sugar estates in Jamaica. Renowned throughout Jamaica's rum history for its full intensely flavorful pot still rums, it continues today to be the quintessential heavy pot rum of choice throughout Europe and other parts of the world.

TITLE: Hampden Estate Great House Old Old Pure Single Jamaican Rum Distillery Edition 2022
DESCRIPTION: Hampden Estate is one the oldest sugar estates in Jamaica. Renowned throughout Jamaica's rum history for its full intensely flavorful pot still rums, it continues today to be the quintessential heavy pot rum of choice throughout Europe and other parts of the world.

TITLE: Hampden Estate Great House Old Old Pure Single Jamaican Rum Distillery Edition 2023
DESCRIPTION: Hampden Estate is one the oldest sugar estates in Jamaica. Renowned throughout Jamaica's rum history for its full intensely flavorful pot still rums, it continues today to be the quintessential heavy pot rum of choice throughout Europe and other parts of the world.

TITLE: Hampden Estate Habitation Velier DOK 2017 Jamaica Single Cask Rum
DESCRIPTION: 64.6% ABV / 129.2 ProofA high-ester cask strength rum that aged for 5 years at the legendary Hampden distillery in a single ex-bourbon cask number 155. This Single Cask is bottled exclusively for PM Spirits to celebrate its 10th anniversary. Only 250 bottles were produced.

TITLE: Hampden Estate Overproof Pure Single Jamaican Rum
DESCRIPTION: Hampden Estate is one the oldest sugar estates in Jamaica. Renowned throughout Jamaica's rum history for its full intensely flavorful pot still rums, it continues today to be the quintessential heavy pot rum of choice throughout Europe and other parts of the world.

TITLE: Hampden Estate Pagos Old Single Jamaican Rum
DESCRIPTION: Hampden Estate's Pagos Old Single Jamaican Rum stands out as a distinct product in their line. It is the first rum from the distillery to be aged exclusively in sherry casks, a technique more common in whisky production. This aging process allows the rum to embrace the notes of rancio typically found in Andalusian wine, without being overpowered by them. The result is a new profile of aromas, making it an appealing choice for both rum enthusiasts and fans of sherry cask single malts.

TITLE: Hampden Estate The New York Edition 2010 LROK Single Cask Jamaican Rum
DESCRIPTION: 100% Pot Still Distillation in double retort Forsyths pot still. Aged entirely for 9 years in Jamaica, bottled exclusively for the New York market. Ester content on this rum is between 350-450 esters.

TITLE: Hana Makgeolli "Hwaju" Unfiltered Rice Wine
DESCRIPTION: Stemming from the Korean root words hwa and ju, HWAJU can translate to both flower wine and fire water. Naturally fermented, unfiltered rice wine made with organic rice and infused with hydrangea and crysanthemum flowers. Inspired by the traditional herbal and flower infused sools that can only be found in Korea, the HWAJU 12 is a sayangju (4 stage fermented alcohol) and made exclusively with organic medium grain white rice, organic sweet white rice, nuruk (traditional Korean wild fermentation starter), and filtered New York water.

TITLE: Hana Makgeolli "Takju" Unfiltered Rice Wine
DESCRIPTION: Naturally fermented rice wine made with organic rice using traditional Korean brewing methodologies. Historically reserved for the noble class, YAKJU is the precious clarified portion of a brew that captures the essence of sool in its purest form.

TITLE: Hancock's President’s Reserve Single Barrel Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Every family has at least one member they don’t acknowledge publicly. For what’s said to be the mash bill number two bourbons made by Buffalo Trace, that unacknowledged member is Hancock’s President’s Reserve single barrel bourbon. Other brands of the mash bill number two family include Blanton’s, Elmer T. Lee, Rock Hill Farms, and Ancient Age. The relationship between mash bill number two bourbons and Buffalo Trace is a bit convoluted. While Age International Inc. owns the labels, Buffalo Trace makes the bourbon and distributes it in the United States. However, Buffalo Trace only acknowledges Blanton’s, Elmer T. Lee, and Ancient Age on its website. So, the scarcity of information on Hancock’s President’s Reserve should not surprise. The only information provided regarding Hancock’s is that it is named after Hancock Lee, co-founder of Leesburg, Kentucky. While Hancock’s is not a limited-release bourbon, finding it may present a challenge simply because many stores and bars are unaware of its existence. Appearance: Hancock’s Reserve appears soft amber brown in the glass with medium legs. Nose: Classic bourbon notes of vanilla, sweet corn, and a lightly toasted pecan dominate the nose. Secondary floral notes and light cedar make an appearance. Palate: Hancock’s Reserve leads off the front of the palate with warm notes of cinnamon and lighter notes of dark fruits, such as plum and cherry. In the mid-palate, the cinnamon notes turn to pepper and oak, with creamy vanilla notes balancing the slightly dry and bitter oak notes. The finish becomes slightly dry with pepper, oak notes, and light caramel. Overall, the flavor profile is pretty balanced all the way through and makes for an excellent sipping bourbon in the spirit of Blanton’s and Elmer T. Lee.

TITLE: Hand Work  Garnacha
DESCRIPTION: Hand Work is the dream of three brothers, Francisco, Javier and Luis Parra. The hope was to celebrate their home of La Mancha by raising organically and biodynamically grown grapes. When it comes to the winemaking behind Friend and Farmer, they partnered with the exceptional Juan Antonio Ponce of Bodegas Ponce. The Parra brothers work two vineyards near the town of Las Mesas. One is Entresendas (between paths) sitting in a dried river bed. These rich, alluvial soils are perfect for the cultivation of grapes reflecting light and heat and ensuring drainage. The other vineyard is Olla del Monte is perhaps easily represented by its other name: Cuesta Colorá, the colored slope. This gentle slope is covered in chalky clay and a fine layer of pebbles on the surface that capture and radiate the heat of the sun—a key benefit during the desert nights.

TITLE: Hangar 1 Rose Flavored Vodka
DESCRIPTION: INSPIRED BY FRESH INGREDIENTS BORN IN NORTHERN CALIFORNIA MEET OUR HEAD DISTILLER CALEY SHOEMAKER Caley oversees all phases of our production. Not to mention, she is one of only a handful of female distillers to lead operations for a major American spirit brand. Caley got her start in craft spirits distilling at Stranahan’s Colorado Whiskey, where she immersed herself in every aspect of the production process, from the sourcing of raw ingredients to distillation and bottling. Caley describes herself as a “spirits nerd” and is fascinated by how the chemistry of distilling affects the quality, texture and flavor of the final product. She is endlessly inspired by the area’s abundant seasonal ingredients. When she’s not visiting local farmers’ markets, Caley can be found honing her photography skills or experimenting with new recipes. INNOVATIVE FLAVORS FRESH INGREDIENTS We only source ingredients when the season is just right. It’s how we produce the freshest tasting vodka.

TITLE: Hangar One Fog Point Vodka
DESCRIPTION: The Made of California™ series embodies our Head Distiller’s ultimate creation, sustainable by nature and exquisite by taste. FOG POINT® Vodka, the first expression released in this series, is a true expression of California — distilled. To make our 2018 limited release of FOG POINT, folks at Hangar One installed their very own fog catchers around the San Francisco Bay Area to turn fog into fresh water, before blending with vodka distilled from Napa’s Pine Ridge Chenin Blanc + Viognier wine. Truly Fog to Bottle™, this revolutionary experiment yields an extraordinarily crisp and pure sipping vodka with elegant hints of pear, citrus, and honeysuckle. FOG POINT is an expression of the HANGAR 1 commitment to bringing environmentally responsible, sustainable practices to the spirits industry.

TITLE: Hangar One Vodka
DESCRIPTION: From the distiller: "Vodka From Grapes - it’s a little strange. But we couldn’t seem to find a “straight” vodka we truly liked; some were harsh; all of them lacked the depth of our flavored spirits. I knew we had to find a way to make straight vodka our way - distilling it right from whole, just-picked fruit - skin, stems, seeds, leaves and all. Enter the Viognier. We blend a Viognier eau de vie with spirit made from midwestern wheat to make a perfectly balanced, fruity, "straight" vodka. The viognier is not an easy grape. It has low and unpredictable yields and we can only pick it when it’s fully ripe - a window of a day or two. Sometimes I think we might be fixated on doing things the hard way. Probably it’s just the German way."

TITLE: Hanging Vine Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Pairs beautifully with grilled salmon, roast pork, braised chicken and Camembert.

TITLE: Hans Reisetbauer Apple in Oak Barrel
DESCRIPTION: Savor the rich flavors of Hans Reisetbauer Apple in Oak Barrel, a premium apple brandy aged for 4 years in oak barrels. This 84-proof spirit from Upper Austria harmoniously blends the crispness of apples with the warmth of oak. The aging process adds depth and complexity, making it an exceptional choice for sipping or as a luxurious addition to cocktails. Crafted by Reisetbauer Distillery, it exemplifies Austrian distillation artistry at its finest.

TITLE: Hans Reisetbauer Apricot Eau de Vie
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the vibrant flavors of Hans Reisetbauer Apricot Eau de Vie. This exquisite Austrian brandy is meticulously distilled from handpicked apricots, embodying the true spirit of Upper Austria's distillation mastery. At 82 proof, it delivers a delightful balance of sweetness and warmth. Perfect for sipping or elevating your cocktails, this eau de vie is a testament to Reisetbauer Distillery's commitment to quality and authenticity.

TITLE: Hans Reisetbauer Blue Gin
DESCRIPTION: Double distilled from estate grown Mulan winter wheat in Axberg, Upper Austria Proofed down using spring water from 27 botanicals are selected to create the exquisite flavor of Blue Gin. Botanicals: Late Harvest Juniper, lemon rind, angelica root, cilantro seeds, turmeric, licorice, cinnamon, black pepper, clove, chamomile, hops, and almond...Stylistically similar to London Dry, with more spice and vegetal notes.

TITLE: Hans Reisetbauer Carrot Eau de Vie
DESCRIPTION: Experience the unique Hans Reisetbauer Carrot Eau de Vie, a one-of-a-kind spirit distilled from organic carrots. Crafted in Upper Austria by the esteemed Reisetbauer Distillery, this 82-proof brandy offers a surprising depth of flavor with earthy and sweet notes. It's an adventurous choice for those looking to explore innovative spirits and adds an unexpected twist to classic cocktails.

TITLE: Hans Reisetbauer Ginger Eau de Vie
DESCRIPTION: Spice up your spirit collection with Hans Reisetbauer Ginger Eau de Vie. This innovative brandy distills the essence of fresh ginger, offering a zesty and invigorating profile. Produced in Upper Austria by the acclaimed Reisetbauer Distillery, it stands at 82 proof. Perfect for adding a spicy kick to cocktails or enjoying neat for its warming characteristics, it's a must-try for enthusiasts seeking something truly different.

TITLE: Hans Reisetbauer Plum Eau de Vie
DESCRIPTION: Discover the exquisite Hans Reisetbauer Plum Eau de Vie, a premium Austrian brandy crafted in the heart of Upper Austria. Distilled by the renowned Reisetbauer Distillery, this 750ml bottle captures the pure essence of ripe plums. With an 82 proof, it offers a smooth and aromatic experience, making it a perfect choice for connoisseurs seeking authentic fruit brandies. Ideal for sipping neat or as a refined addition to your favorite cocktails.

TITLE: Hans Reisetbauer Rowanberry Eau de Vie
DESCRIPTION: Uncover the rare Hans Reisetbauer Rowanberry Eau de Vie, showcasing the delicate flavors of rowanberries. Distilled in Upper Austria by Reisetbauer Distillery, this 82-proof spirit captures the subtle tartness and complexity of the berries. It's a sophisticated choice for aficionados of fine brandies and serves as an exceptional digestif or a refined ingredient in upscale mixology.

TITLE: Harahorn Norwegian Small Batch Gin
DESCRIPTION: Norway- Micro batch, London Dry style gin.

TITLE: Hard Truth Distilling Company Harvest Rye Sweet Mash Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Hard Truth Distilling Co. has partnered with Mellencamp Whiskey Co. — founded by Hud Mellencamp and Levi Collison — to release a limited series of collectible sweet mash whiskeys in support and celebration of America’s heartland farmers. Hard Truth Distilling Company's Harvest Rye Sweet Mash Rye Straight Rye Whiskey is a groundbreaking debut in the sweet mash whiskey category. This meticulously crafted spirit marks the first sweet mash whiskey brought to market by Hard Truth, showcasing a dedication to innovative distilling techniques and exceptional quality. Each batch of this exceptional whiskey begins with entirely fresh ingredients, with a mash bill comprising 94 percent rye and 6 percent malted barley, reflecting the brand's commitment to unique and bold flavors.

TITLE: Hardin Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Hardin Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold and flavorful wine from the Napa Valley region of California. It is made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, which are known for their intense flavor and structure. This wine has a deep ruby color and aromas of ripe black fruit, spice, and cedar. On the palate, it is full-bodied and tannic, with flavors of black cherry, plum, and licorice. The wine has a long and lingering finish. Hardin Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon is a versatile wine that can be enjoyed with a variety of foods. It is particularly well-suited to grilled meats, pasta dishes, and stews.

TITLE: Hardin's Creek Colonel James B. Beam Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 93, #18 on the Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 ListPart of a new limited series from James B. Beam, this whiskey was taken off the still at a lower distillation proof, highlighting the flavors formed during fermentation and proving that age isn’t everything. The nose hasnotes of green apple, honeydew, and lemon peel, as well as old-fashioned donuts and vanilla birthday cake. The palate is green and malty but in a captivating way, with matcha powder and a chocolate milkshake. A peppery, coffee-laden finish rounds out an unconventional drinking experience.

TITLE: Hardin's Creek Jacob's Well Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
Hardy's Nottage Hill Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Pinot Noir is a catch-all food pairing wine. Pinot Noir is light enough for salmon but complex enough to hold up to some richer meat including duck. In a pinch, when everyone orders a vastly different entree at a restaurant, you can usually win by picking Pinot Noir; it will make everyone happy.

TITLE: Hatozaki Finest Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Hatozaki Finest Japanese Whisky is a premium blend of whiskies, aged up to 12 years in barrel with a minimum malt whisky content of 40%.

TITLE: Havana Club Anejo Blanco Puerto Rican Rum
DESCRIPTION: Anejo Blanco is distilled and aged in Puerto Rico under the Caribbean sun for 1 year in oak barrels in which aged rums are blended together. The blend is aged for a second period in oak barrels for at least 2 months.

TITLE: Hayashi Honten One Ten Black Junmai Dai-Ginjyo Sake
DESCRIPTION: OneTen: Black - Junmai Dai Ginjyo is an exquisite sake from Japan's northern Hokkaido region, crafted with precision and dedication at the esteemed OneTen Brewery. This Junmai Daiginjo sake is the pinnacle of sake brewing, offering a luxurious experience with every sip. With a proof of 32 and a Sake Meter Value (SMV) of +5, it features a refined and well-balanced dryness that appeals to both sake aficionados and newcomers alike. The sake is made from highly polished rice, where at least 50% of each grain is milled away, resulting in a pure and elegant flavor profile that showcases the craftsmanship of its brewers.

TITLE: Hayman's London Dry Gin
DESCRIPTION: Discover the classic elegance of Hayman's London Dry Gin, crafted in the heart of London. With a family recipe dating back to 1863. Company founder James Burrough, the great grandfather of the current chairman, Christopher Hayman, created the world-renowned Beefeater Gin. All of Hayman's gins are true English gins–produced just as they would have been over 150 years ago. The defining characteristics of Hayman’s Gin include: use of three small copper-pot stills; 24-hour maceration of botanicals, for extra concentration; and the use of 10 classic botanicals - juniper, lemon, orange, cassia cinnamon, Ceylon cinnamon, nutmeg, angelica root, orris root, coriander seed and licorice root. Perfect for both classic cocktails and modern creations, Hayman's London Dry Gin is a timeless addition to any spirits collection.

TITLE: Hayman's Old Tom Gin
DESCRIPTION: Englishman John Burroughs began making gin in the 19th century at John Taylor & Co., where he most notably distilled Beefeater until the 1950s. Cousins of Burroughs, the Hayman family joined the company mid-century and eventually bought the Fine Alcohols Division (renamed Hayman's) and sold the Beefeater side. In 2007, Hayman's reintroduced the world to Old Tom Gin, the first on the market in over 60 years. Their line of gin is consistently considered one of the finest representations of old-world London styles.

TITLE: Hayman's Sloe Gin
DESCRIPTION: A traditional English liqueur made by infusing Gin with Sloe berries, a type of wild plum from the Blackthorn tree. Hayman's Sloe Gin is made from a family recipe dating back many generations. Wild English Sloe Berries are gently steeped for several months with Hayman's London Dry Gin before blending with natural sugar to create this rich liqueur. To th etaste it is a rich ruby with bittersweet berry flavors and hints of cinnamon, clove and ginger. Sloe Gin has been a popular drink from 19th century onwards as a digestive, winter warmer and as an essential bar item. Drink in classic cocktails, or with soda in a traditional fizz.

TITLE: Hazelburn Oloroso Cask 15 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky 2022
DESCRIPTION: Hailing from Campbeltown's mighty Springbank distillery, it's a 15-year-old release of the unpeated Hazelburn single malt! Distilled in December 2006, the whisky was filled into Oloroso sherry casks, where it remained until April 2022, when a total of 9,000 bottles were released.

TITLE: Heart & Hands Winery Finger Lakes Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Heart & Hands 2017 Pinot Noir is made from grapes grown on 4 vineyards inNew York’s Finger Lakes Viticultural Area, including our limestone laden Estate Vineyard: 39% Heart & Hands Estate Vineyard, Cayuga Lake; 39% Elaine's Vineyard, Seneca Lake; 11% Nutt Road Vineyard, Seneca Lake; 11% Patrician Verona Vineyard, Cayuga Lak

TITLE: Heaven Hill 17 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: The first edition of a new limited edition series, the Heaven Hill Heritage Collection will join the Parker’s Heritage Collection as an annual limited release, with the Heaven Hill Heritage Collection released in the spring and Parker’s Heritage Collection released in the fall.

TITLE: Heaven Hill 27 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Bourbon this old never tasted so good. Though some oak is present one cannot say this is an overly woody whiskey, especially given the number of years it spent in barrel. This is an investment in a bottle, something you'll want to savor a small amount at a time as bottles of it are not cheap to come by. Though a good sipper on its own, this would also work well accompanying certain desserts, and is certainly something we would consider after dinner. An American whiskey well worthy of the Heaven Hill name.

TITLE: Heaven Hill 7 Years Bottled in Bond Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Heaven Hill Bottled-in-Bond was first released in 1939 and quickly became the number-one-selling whiskey in the Commonwealth of Kentucky. Now, more than 80 years later, Heaven Hill is proud to bring you this 7-Year-Old Bottled-in-Bond small batch made from our traditional Bourbon mashbill. It is history in a bottle, a complex and delicious example of a multi-generation family commitment to whiskey craftsmanship. We call it "The Best of the Great Kentucky Bourbons," and when you taste in , we believe you will also.

TITLE: Heaven Hill Bourbon Experience 8 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This bourbon is only available at the You Do Bourbon Experience at the Heaven Hill Bourbon Experience, in Bardstown, Kentucky. It is made from Heaven Hill’s standard bourbon mash bill (78% corn, 10% rye, 12% malted barley), aged at least 8 years on the 6th floor of their warehouses, and is a small batch of 10 barrels. It’s bottled at barrel proof.The flavors are rich and savory; the mouthfeel full and the finish long. There are many similarities to Elijah Craig Barrel Proof, but the weird thing is this one tastes the same age or older, even though its age statement is 4 years younger. Now it could have older barrels in it; that we don’t know. This one also has a more “pastry” overtone to it.

TITLE: Heaven Hill Distilleries Select Stock 8 Year Rye Finished in Chinquapin Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Heaven Hill Distilleries Select Stock 8-Year Rye Finished in Chinquapin Barrels is a distinguished and complex expression from one of Kentucky's most respected distilleries. This rye whiskey, aged for 8 years and finished in Chinquapin oak barrels, showcases a unique and refined flavor profile. Bottled at 110 proof, this select stock offering exemplifies the meticulous craftsmanship and innovative spirit of Heaven Hill Distilleries. Each 750ml bottle is a testament to the distillery's dedication to producing exceptional rye whiskey that stands out for its richness and depth.

TITLE: Heaven Hill Grain To Glass Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Heaven Hill Grain To Glass Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a distinguished expression from the renowned Heaven Hill Distillery. This bourbon celebrates the journey from grain to glass, highlighting the distillery's commitment to quality and craftsmanship. Every step of the production process, from selecting the finest grains to the careful aging in new American oak barrels, is meticulously overseen to create a bourbon of exceptional character and complexity. Bottled at 107 proof, this bourbon offers a well-balanced and robust flavor profile that can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in your favorite bourbon cocktails. Heaven Hill Grain To Glass Bourbon reflects the rich heritage and dedication to excellence that Heaven Hill Distillery is known for. Distillation Year: 2017 Release Year: 2024 Corn Seed Varietal: Beck’s 6158 Rickhouse Site: Cox's Creek Rickhouse: W3 Floors: 3,4,5

TITLE: Heaven Hill Grain To Glass Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Heaven Hill Grain To Glass Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey is a premium offering from the esteemed Heaven Hill Distillery, celebrating the complete journey from grain to glass. This straight rye whiskey is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, using the finest grains and aged in new American oak barrels. The result is a rich and complex rye whiskey that embodies the heritage and craftsmanship of Kentucky whiskey-making. Bottled at 123.2 proof, Heaven Hill Grain To Glass Rye Whiskey delivers a bold and robust flavor profile that can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as the base for classic rye cocktails. This whiskey reflects Heaven Hill's dedication to producing high-quality spirits that honor tradition while offering exceptional taste. Distillation Year: 2017 Release Year: 2024 Corn Seed Varietal: Beck’s 6158 Rickhouse Site: Cox's Creek Rickhouse: W3 Floors: 3,4,5

TITLE: Heaven Hill Grain To Glass Kentucky Straight Wheated Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Heaven Hill Grain To Glass Kentucky Straight Wheated Bourbon Whiskey is a premium expression from the renowned Heaven Hill Distillery. This special release celebrates the journey from grain to glass, emphasizing the distillery's dedication to quality and craftsmanship. Made with a mashbill that includes a higher proportion of wheat, this bourbon offers a smoother and sweeter profile compared to traditional bourbons. Bottled at 121 proof, this wheated bourbon delivers a balanced and rich flavor experience that can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in your favorite bourbon cocktails. Heaven Hill Grain To Glass Wheated Bourbon exemplifies the distillery's commitment to producing exceptional spirits that honor Kentucky's rich bourbon heritage.

TITLE: Heaven Hill Heritage Collection 18 Years Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Heaven Hill Heritage Collection 18 Years Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey epitomizes the craftsmanship and tradition of Heaven Hill Distillery. This 2024 release is a masterfully aged bourbon, created from a mashbill of 78% corn, 10% rye, and 12% malted barley. Distilled in December 2005 and aged in the third floor of Rickhouse 1I, this bourbon has matured to perfection over 18 years, resulting in a complex and rich profile. Bottled at a robust 120 proof without chill filtering, this bourbon showcases the depth and character that Heaven Hill is renowned for. The limited release consists of just 133 barrels, making it a sought-after addition to any bourbon enthusiast’s collection.

TITLE: Heaven Hill Heritage Collection 20 Year Old Straight Corn Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Heaven Hill Heritage Collection 20-Year-Old Straight Kentucky Corn Whiskey was produced on 10/21/2002 and released in 2023. Distilled and bottled by Heaven Hill Distillery, Bardstown, Kentucky. With an age statement of 20 years, this release is made up of 110 barrels pulled from the third floor of Rickhouse 1K. On the nose is toasted corn and oak spices, the company reports. The palate brings aged oak and walnuts followed by a finish of wood spices with hints of corn sweetness. Mash Bill: 80% Corn, 8% Rye, 12% Malted Barley.

TITLE: Heaven HIll Select  Stock 6 Year Bourbon Finished in Used Coffee Barrels
DESCRIPTION: This limited edition of Heaven Hill Select Stock is a 6-year-old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey finished in used coffee barrels from Good Folks Coffee Company for an additional two weeks. It is full of flavor with a smooth taste and a hint of coffee finish

TITLE: Heaven HIll Select Stock 14 Year Kentucky Straight Bourbon Aged In Tapered Stave Barrels
DESCRIPTION: The 2022 release is an experiment with bourbon aged in tapered stave barrels. Just as they sound; the staves are tapered on both ends so that the barrel takes on a diamond-like shape. The experiment was to see how this unique barrel affected the bourbon’s taste.The bourbon was distilled using Heaven Hill Distillery’s standard bourbon mash bill: 78% corn, 10% rye and 12% malted barley. The barrels were aged in Rickhouse Y, which was said to be Parker Beam’s favorite warehouse. Furthermore, these barrels were aged 14 years and just 26 barrels were chosen to create the small batch.

TITLE: Heaven HIll Select Stock Bourbon Finished in Used Armagnac Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Heaven Hill Select Stock Bourbon Finished in Used Armagnac Barrels is a distinguished addition to the Barrel Finished Series, showcasing the innovation and mastery of the Heaven Hill Distillery. This Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey, artfully crafted from a blend of 7 and 12-year-old barrels, has been meticulously aged and then finished in used Armagnac barrels for a period of 4 years and 2.5 months. This additional maturation process imparts a unique and complex flavor profile that distinguishes it from other bourbons.

TITLE: Heaven HIll Select Stock Bourbon Finished in Used Brandy Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Heaven Hill Select Stock Bourbon Finished in Used Brandy Barrels is an exquisite addition to the barrel-finished series from Heaven Hill. This Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey, carefully crafted from a blend of 7 and 12-year-old barrels, undergoes a distinctive aging and finishing process, resulting in a bourbon of unparalleled quality and complexity. Heaven Hill Select Stock Bourbon Finished in Used Brandy Barrels is a bourbon that demands to be enjoyed slowly and thoughtfully, allowing the intricate flavors to develop and resonate on the palate. Whether you are a seasoned bourbon aficionado or new to the world of whiskey, this bourbon is sure to provide a delightful and satisfying tasting experience, making it a prized addition to any collection

TITLE: Heaven HIll Select Stock Bourbon Finished in Used Sherry Barrels
DESCRIPTION: The Heaven Hill Select Stock Bourbon Finished in Used Sherry Barrels is a distinguished addition to the Heaven Hill portfolio. This Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is crafted from a blend of 7 and 12-year-old barrels and then finished in used sherry barrels for an additional 4 years and 6 months. This unique finishing process imparts a rich and complex flavor profile, combining the traditional richness of bourbon with the sophisticated depth of aged sherry.

TITLE: Heaven Hill Select Stock Double Barreled Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This batch which was for 2017 was aged 4 years and then moved to a new charred oak barrel for an additional 2 years.

TITLE: Heaven's Door 10 Years Decade Series Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Introducing the limited edition Heaven’s Door Decade Series. This 10-year bourbon is the first release in a trailblazing new collection of premium whiskeys, curated out of a true labor of dedication and patience over time. Every drop of this bourbon tells a story about the importance of time, age, and maturation. Heaven’s Door invites you to be part of that story. Heaven's Door is an award-winning collection of handcrafted American whiskeys co-created with iconic musician and artist, Bob Dylan. The perfect blend of art and craft, each bottle of Heaven's Door showcases Dylan's distinctive welded iron gates that he created in his studio, Black Buffalo Ironworks.

TITLE: Heaven's Door 14 Years Limited Release Single Barrel Cask Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Caribbean Rum Casks
DESCRIPTION: Barrel: #2371 Proof: 112.2 Finish: Caribbean Rum Casks Age: 14 years

TITLE: Heaven's Door Bootleg Series Limited  Edition Bourbon  Full Set
DESCRIPTION: Each annual release features one of Dylan’s paintings on a hand-made ceramic bottle in a bespoke leather case, featuring rare and unreleased whiskeys. This is a set of all four releases to date. The 2022 release, The Bootleg Series Vol. IV features a wheated bourbon aged for 11 years, finished in Islay Scotch Casks, and then bottled at 111 proof. The ceramic bottle for Bootleg Vol. In a handmade leather journal, IV features Lighthouse in Maine, 2017, by Bob Dylan. The 2021 release, Bootleg Volume III, features a 13-year-old Kentucky Bourbon finished in Vino de Naranja casks. Bottled at cask strength with a proof of 121.2, this whiskey has a subtle sweetness from its time in orange wine casks, resulting in rich color and complex flavor. The 2020 Bootleg Series follows on the heels of last year’s 2019 release, aged 26 years old and finished in ex-Mizunara oak barrels. This particular offering received The Chairman’s Trophy and was named to the Top 100 Spirits at the Ultimate Spirits Challenge 2020. It also sold out immediately upon release. The inaugural “2019 Edition” Bootleg release features a 26-year-old whisky finished in Japanese Mizunara Oak barrels, some of the rarest and most expensive wood species worldwide. Bottled at a proof of 111.5 with a low rye mashbill, this whisky was specifically chosen for the way it would marry with the Mizunara Oak barrels, perfectly complementing the signature flavors offered from ex-bourbon barrel aging while yielding a final whisky with an exotic and unexpected flavor profile. The 2019 Edition showcases one of Bob Dylan’s well-known paintings, Train Tracks.

TITLE: Hedges C.M.S Red
DESCRIPTION: Pair it with meats: juicy steak, gamey lamb, or braised pork.

TITLE: Heights Distilling Co. Eleventh Hour Gin
DESCRIPTION: Eleventh Hour Gin is the story of a last-minute recipe creation slotted for first product release for our distillery. How did this happen? We're still wondering ourselves. It probably has to do with it being far too good not to share, and our poor impulse control when it comes to exciting spirits. We'd describe it as resonant, balanced, and more spice-forward than your typical gin. If you're someone who wants a little more from this classic spirit, you'll enjoy this fresh take.

TITLE: Heights Distilling Co. Gold Rabbit Absinthe Superieure
DESCRIPTION: Gold Rabbit Absinthe Superieure is named after its beautiful golden color and the mythical rabbit that creates elixirs on the moon. If that rabbit made absinthe, this is what it would taste like. A little more floral and citrus focused than your traditional absinthe, it's a delightful light take on a spirit with a long history of more than just 'prohibition'. Try it in the traditional preparation or in cocktails.

TITLE: Hella Bitters Citrus
DESCRIPTION: We like to call Citrus our full spectrum bitters. Rather than focus on one varietal, we decided on all the major citrus fruits: orange, grapefruit, lemon and lime. In addition, we blended a long list of exotic, savory botanicals like cardamom, caraway and coriander. The result is a fantastically full, bright and aromatic bitters recipe that tastes like summer in India.

TITLE: Hella Bitters Smoked Chili
DESCRIPTION: We searched far and wide for the right chili for our Smoked Chili bitters. Our patience paid off when we finally found Pasilia de Oaxaca, a long chili dried and smoked in Oaxaca, Mexico. It was love at first smell. Our smoked chili bitters have quickly become the rockstar of the family, earning their place in some of the world’s best mixology cocktails and with some of the best chefs.

TITLE: Hemingway Signature Edition Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Hemingway Signature Edition Rye Whiskey is a meticulously crafted spirit that honors the legacy of Ernest Hemingway. This blend of straight rye whiskeys consists of 90% six-year-old Indiana straight rye whiskey and 10% four-year-old Kentucky straight rye whiskey; all finished in rum-seasoned Oloroso Sherry casks. The whiskey is a testament to the combined expertise of three families over eight generations, resulting in a product that captures its namesake's adventurous spirit and literary prowess.

TITLE: Hendrick's Gin
DESCRIPTION: Hendrick’s is the marriage of two different spirits from two rare and unusual stills: the Bennet still and the Carter-Head still. By combining the two, we are able to create an extraordinarily smooth gin that has the required character and balance of subtle flavours.

TITLE: Hendrick's Gin
DESCRIPTION: Hendrick’s is the marriage of two different spirits from two rare and unusual stills: the Bennet still and the Carter-Head still. By combining the two, we are able to create an extraordinarily smooth gin that has the required character and balance of subtle flavours.

TITLE: Hennessy Cognac Privilege VSOP
DESCRIPTION: Hennessy Cognac Privilege VSOP is a refined and elegant expression from the renowned house of Hennessy. This VSOP (Very Superior Old Pale) cognac is crafted from a blend of over 60 eaux-de-vie, aged for a minimum of 4 years in French oak barrels. The result is a harmonious and well-balanced spirit that embodies the artistry and tradition of Hennessy. Hennessy Privilege VSOP is celebrated for its rich and complex flavor profile, making it a favorite among cognac enthusiasts and novices alike. Whether enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as the base for sophisticated cocktails, this cognac delivers a smooth and memorable drinking experience.

TITLE: Hennessy Cognac Privilege VSOP  Julien Colombier Limited Edition
DESCRIPTION: Discover the rich and storied legacy of Hennessy in a mesmerizing video tour of Chateau Bagnolet—the ancestral home of the Hennessy family. In 1765, Richard Hennessy, a retired Irish Brigade captain in the service of King Louis XV, established his own Maison (estate) in Cognac, France. From that day on, the reputation and distribution of Hennessy cognacs has extended continuously—first to Paris and the royal court, then to England, to Russia, and faraway lands. Today, nearly 250 years later, Hennessy is enjoyed on every continent. Hennessy V.S.O.P Limited Edition by Julien Colombier is a well balanced cognac, the expression of 200 years of Hennessy craft. The fruit of nature’s uncertainties, this unique blend has tamed the elements to embody the original concept of cognac. Each sip reveals new facets of its personality.

TITLE: Hennessy Cognac Privilege VSOP Maluma Limited Edition
DESCRIPTION: Hennessy invites fans to take a glimpse into the heritage and inspiration that fuels Latin Global Superstar Maluma with the release of Hennessy V.S.O.P Limited Edition by Maluma. This vibrant limited edition bottling of Hennessy V.S.O.P encapsulates his ever-evolving perspective & constant strive for reinvention. Maluma breaks ground as the first recording artist to ever collaborate with Hennessy on a limited-edition bottle, representing a testament to Hennessy's Never Stop, Never Settle brand ethos and a celebration of the impact of Latin culture on art, music, and fashion.

This exceptional blend is composed of carefully selected eaux-de-vie, some aged up to 100 years, showcasing the depth and expertise of Hennessy's master blenders. Known for its refined and complex flavor profile, Hennessy Imperial Cognac is a testament to the distillery's commitment to quality and tradition. Ideal for celebrating special moments or adding to an exclusive collection, Hennessy Imperial offers a genuinely luxurious tasting experience.

TITLE: Hennessy Paradis Cognac
DESCRIPTION: Hennessy Paradis Cognac is a luxurious and exquisite cognac crafted by the esteemed Hennessy distillery in the Cognac region of France. This remarkable blend is composed of eaux-de-vie aged up to 130 years, meticulously selected and aged to perfection in Hennessy's Paradis cellar. Named for its "paradise" where the oldest and rarest eaux-de-vie are stored, Hennessy Paradis offers an unparalleled tasting experience with its harmonious and rich flavor profile. Perfect for special occasions or as a prized addition to any collection, Hennessy Paradis Cognac embodies the pinnacle of Hennessy's craftsmanship and heritage.

TITLE: Hennessy VS Cognac Hip Hop Limited Edition by Nas
DESCRIPTION: In 2023, Hennessy V.S marks a unique cultural milestone, celebrating a half-century of Hip Hop with one of the genre's most prolific talents, Nas. A long-term friend of Hennessy, the multi-hyphenate, multi-platinum, Grammy Award winning rapper and artist captures the movement and the moment in a vibrant limited edition cognac.

TITLE: Hennessy VS Limited Edition Cognac By Felipe Pantone
DESCRIPTION: The limited-edition Hennessy V.S 750ml bottle & gift box designed by artist Felipe Pantone in his signature aesthetic is the perfect bottle to add to your collection.Hennessy is the best-selling cognac in the world and US, run by Hennessy family (8 generations) & Fillioux family master blenders (7 generations). Blended using eaux-de-vie from Cognac’s top 4 regions. Each batch of wine is double-distilled to achieve the most flavorful, elegant eaux-de-vie possible. Hennessy also possesses the finest selection of old eaux-de-vie in the world.

TITLE: Hennessy VSOP Privilege Limited Edition By Guanyu Zhang
DESCRIPTION: Hennessy V.S.O.P Privilège Limited Edition By Guanyu Zhang is a harmonious and well-structured cognac characterized buy a crescendo of aromas, a natural balance of strength and smoothness and a remarkable lasting finish. Celebrate Lunar New Year with a Limited-Edition Hennessy V.S.O.P Privilѐge bottle. With its vibrant red coloring and beautiful artwork by Guangyu Zhang, this exclusive limited-edition is the perfect addition to every collector’s cabinet.

TITLE: Hennessy White 25th Anniversary Cognac
DESCRIPTION: Hennessy White 25th Anniversary Cognac is a limited-edition cognac released to celebrate the 25th anniversary of Hennessy White. It is a blend of over 100 eaux-de-vie, aged for at least 25 years. The cognac is known for its smooth and elegant flavor, with notes of vanilla, almond, and fruit.

TITLE: Hennessy XO Cognac
DESCRIPTION: A blend of 100 eaux-de-vie, its deep amber color is a sign of its intensity. At once rich and robust, it constantly reveals layers of flavors with distinctive persistence on the palate.

TITLE: Henri Billiot Grand Cru Champagne Rose Brut
DESCRIPTION: 100% Grand Cru, particularly satisfying Pinot Noir here. Fresh, bracing red-grape Champagnes with long, swollen midpalate flavors. Just 5 hectares in size, so availability is scarce! The vineyards are spread over 18 different mid-slope parcels in Ambonnay. The position of these vineyards are considered some of the best sites in Ambonnay and expressive of the classical character of this village. All his vineyards are grand cru and Serge Billiot says that the high degree of maturity from these sites doesn’t require malolactic. That makes them very frisky and reductive when they’re first disgorged, and occasionally a Billiot bottle will show a slightly metallic aroma for the first few minutes. That’s rare and nil if you hold the wines six months after disgorgement. Halibut, squid, pork loin, spicy chicken

TITLE: Henri Perrusset Macon Farges Selection Vieilles Vignes
DESCRIPTION: Henri’s simple, yet proven methods hand-harvesting, fermentation in stainless steel tanks with indigenous yeasts, and full malolactic fermentation—result in delicious, straight forward wines that honestly reflect their terroir. Here in the southern most part of Burgundy, the soils of clay and limestone favor crisp, mineral–driven Chardonnays layered with ripe fruit, perfect for an aperitif and versatile at table with all sorts of appetizers.

TITLE: Henriet-Bazin Blanc de Blancs 1er Cru Villers-Marmery Champagne
DESCRIPTION: At Champagne Henriet-Bazin, our history begins perhaps 50 million years ago, when two species of shellfish, the Coccolites and the Belemnites, decided to settle in the warm sea that once blanketed our region of Champagne. Over the eons, nature and time transformed their remains into the profoundly deep layers of chalk and clay that bear our vines. Wind, water and ice carved our slopes and created our climats. For five generations now, our family has worked the soil, tended our vines and crafted our wines with the unwavering desire to offer cuvees to you that express the uniquely complex and delightful terroir of our Grand-Cru and Premier-Cru vineyards.

TITLE: Henriet-Bazin Champagne 1er Cru Gaston & Louis Brut Nature
Henriet-Bazin Champagne Grand Cru Brut Rose
DESCRIPTION: Fifth generation independent vigneronne Marie-Nolle Rainon-Henriet has taken the reins from her father, Daniel (who is still on the scene) at this house and, along with her husband Nicolas Rainon, she is now crafting some of the most exciting and terroir-expressive Champagnes from their 3.5 hectares of holdings in the Grand Cru villages of Verzy and Verzenay and -what may be even more exciting- their 2.5 hectares in 1er cru Villers-Marmery. Uniquely situated at the southeastern extreme of the Montagne de Reims, unlike the Grand Cru villages of Verzy and Verzenay, where younger alluvial soils are at the surface and the chalk becomes a subsoil, in Villers-Marmery the chalk is exposed, and so finely crushed and potent that it is highly influential on the wines. In fact, this is one of only a few villages in the Montagne de Reims which is AOC 1er cru for Chardonnay and not the region's predominant Pinot Noir. The Ros Brut Grand Cru is composed of 50% Chardonnay/50% Pinot Noir (19% of which is red wine), from Verzenay and Verzy. Vines planted between 1969-2006. Fermentation in enameled iron tanks with malolactic fermentation.

TITLE: Henry Mckenna 10 Years Old Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Henry McKenna Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey is matured for a minimum of forty Kentucky seasons (ten years) before each bottle is filled and labeled with its batch and bottle number. As a result of its extra-long maturation period, the bourbon has an aroma of warm spices, smoke and burnt caramel. The aroma gives way to notes of chewy leather, chili peppers and habanero, which are complemented by subtle touches of dried fruits, vanilla and cinnamon. The finish is warm and lush, with bold notes of roasted corn, cloves and woody spices. Since each bottle of McKenna's Single Barrel Bourbon is bottled from a single cask rather than being crafted from a batch of casks, however, each bottle is slightly different and entirely interesting. Henry McKenna 10 Year Old Bourbon was named one of the top 12 spirits ever tasted by Proof66, and was called "magnificent"by Jim Murray, author of the Whisky Bible. In addition, the bourbon earned a score of 90-95 points from Wine Enthusiast

TITLE: Herisson Bourgogne Passe-tout-grains Vin Rouge
Herisson Rose
DESCRIPTION: Blending of juice from maceration (Jus de Goutte) & juice from the press (Jus de Presse). Fermented in stainless steel tank. The wine then remained on the fine lees until Mid-January. Fining is done without the use of animal products (vegan friendly). After another period of resting for two weeks the wine was lightly filtered and packaged. The aim was to produce a fresh, balanced, and expressive rosé and we think the results will speak for themselves.

TITLE: Hermann J. Wiemer Dry Riesling
DESCRIPTION: Located in the heart of the Finger Lakes Wine Country, Hermann J. Wiemer Vineyard stands on the western shores of Seneca Lake. The New York State winery – producing approximately 14,000 cases each year – was designed in 1982 by an award-winning team of Cornell architects. Enclosed within the shell of a 90-year-old scissor-trussed barn, the structure accommodates a full wine production area and tasting facility. Its unique white cathedral-like interior balances the bare wooden walls and sleek Italian stainless steel tanks. Asian cuisine, Poultry, Shellfish

TITLE: Hermann J. Wiemer Seneca Lake Cuvee Brut
DESCRIPTION: Located in the heart of the Finger Lakes Wine Country, Hermann J. Wiemer Vineyard stands on the western shores of Seneca Lake. The New York State winery – producing approximately 14,000 cases each year – was designed in 1982 by an award-winning team of Cornell architects. Enclosed within the shell of a 90-year-old scissor-trussed barn, the structure accommodates a full wine production area and tasting facility. Its unique white cathedral-like interior balances the bare wooden walls and sleek Italian stainless steel tanks.

TITLE: Heron Wines California Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: This Pinot Noir is from cool climate vineyards within California. They range from the maritime side of Paso Robles to coastal Monterey vineyards and the famous Russian River. Each vineyard is picked at optimal ripeness at night and the fruit delivered to the winery cold. A balanced, food friendly, varietally correct Pinot Noir.

TITLE: Herradura Double Barrel Reposado Tequila "KING of KENTUCKY" Bourbon Barrel Finished Barrel # 2345
DESCRIPTION: For lovers of big, powerful tequilas; this "Double Barrel" offering packs a punch! Aged for 11 years in lightly charred oak barrels, then matured for an additional 7 months in a King Of Kentucky bourbon barrel. This process leads to an intense flavor profile. Not for the faint of heart.

TITLE: Herradura Silver Tequila
DESCRIPTION: This smooth, clean tequila is aged for 45 days to add a hint of color and oak to its tangy citrus character, which brings more agave flavor and unparalleled pleasure to a margarita.

TITLE: Herradura Tequila Anejo
DESCRIPTION: Color: Dark amber Aroma: Intense cooked agave and spice, toasted oak and nutty notes Taste: Very smooth with cooked agave and dried fruit Finish: Smooth, creamy finish

TITLE: Herve Souhaut Domaine Romaneaux-Destezet Syrah
DESCRIPTION: A Syrah from some of this historic estate's younger vines, still 30 year-old, augmented with grapes purchased from neighbors. Macerated at low temps for a long peroid before a wild yeast fermentation. Bottled unfiltered and unfined with a very low amount of sulfites.

TITLE: Herve Villemade Bulle Blanche
DESCRIPTION: This one is made from the very rare local grape called Menu Pineau along with equal parts of Chenin Blanc and Chardonnay for added complexity.

TITLE: Herve Villemade Cheverny Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Cheverny Blanc is a blend of Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc.

TITLE: Herve Villemade Cheverny Bovin Rouge
Herve Villemade Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Herve Villemade has been working his family's vines in Cellettes since taking over from his father in 1995. Today, the estate represents about 22 hectares of organically farmed fruit, all within the Cheverny and Cour-Cheverny AOCs.

TITLE: Hi! Prosecco
DESCRIPTION: he Hi Proseeco is made from the "glera" grape more commonly known as Prosecco and grown in the Triveneto hills. The vines are carefully managed and trained using both the double Guyot system and the Italian training system of "cordone speronato". After harvesting and gentle pressing the must is put into stainless steel tanks for the fermentation of the still wine. When ready the must is naturally decanted and then transferred into the pressure tanks for the sparkling fermentation. It stays in the tanks on the yeast for about one month before bottling until it is perfectly sparkling.

TITLE: Hibiki Harmony 100th Anniversary Edition Japanese Blended Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Hibiki Japanese Harmony 100th Anniversary Edition celebrates Suntory's centennial milestone with a limited-edition design. This blended whisky is an embodiment of Suntory's philosophy of living in harmony with people and nature. The bottle design, inspired by traditional Japanese art of Setsugekka (snow, moon, and flowers), reflects the connection of the seasons and the 24-faceted bottle represents the 24 hours of a day and the 24 Japanese seasons in a year.

TITLE: High Coast Hav
DESCRIPTION: A culture of high-quality craftsmanship, innovation, and environmental consciousness sets Nordic whiskies apart from other world whiskies. Hav, Swedish for the sea is part of High Coast’s exceptional Origins series, and its flavor shorthand is oak spice. Wood spices, peat smoke, vanilla cream, and orange peel on the nose precede a lush palate of fruit and spice displaying sweet apricot, peach, honey, and dried tropical fruits, with a lengthy, spicy finish. Matured in bourbon casks, it mingles batches of peated and unpeated spirit, with some components receiving an accelerator period in 40-liter casks coopered from Hungarian and Swedish oak.

TITLE: High N' Wicked 12 Years Old The Honorable Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished In Ex-Cabernet Barrels
DESCRIPTION: High n’ Wicked, based in Jackson, Wyoming, was formed to present and develop unique American whiskies – releasing singular expressions annually that it deems worthy of its name. “The Honorable” is its first limited edition release. A 12-year-old, 90 proof, Tennessee Straight Bourbon Whiskey finished for four months in Ex-California cabernet barrels. No Additives. Non-Chill Filtered. Origin: Tennessee Aged 12 Years: Aged in New White Oak #4 Char for 11.8 Years and Finished in Ex-California Cabernet Sauvignon Wine Barrels for 4 months. Proof: 90% Mash Bill: 84% Corn, 8% Rye, 8% Malt

TITLE: High N' Wicked 19 Year Old "Saints And Scholars" Barrel #4380 Single Malt Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Aged in ex-bourbon barrels. Released in Sept. 2022

TITLE: High West  "Gnarly Snowboard" Single Barrel Double Rye Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #10
DESCRIPTION: Part of our outstanding duo of High West picks, this expression of High West's signature Double Rye! whiskey was additionally finished in Pineau de Charentes barrel for 16 months. Pineau des Charentes, if you are curious. is a regional aperitif of western France, made in the départements of Charente, Charente-Maritime, and (to a lesser extent) Dordogne. While popular within its region of production, it is less well known in other regions of France and somewhat uncommon abroad. It is a fortified wine (mistelle or vin de liqueur), made from either fresh, unfermented grape juice or a blend of lightly fermented grape must to which a Cognac eau-de-vie is added and then matured. The result is a whiskey that is delicious, distinctive, and unique. The expression carries the traditional High West bourbon signature, but the finish gives it a character. You can expect enhanced sweetness and mouthfeel (that's coming from Pineau des Charentes influence) combined with notes of dark fruits and berries. The expression comes in at 102.8 proof. We were not planning on selecting TWO High West Barrels, but after tasting both barrels, we were blown away by the taste and uniqueness of each. It's not often when that happens, and when it does, we know that we had no choice but to get both!Each bottle is hand-numbered and includes a custom metal medallion bearing our logo. More info: Whiskey Type: Double Rye! whiskey Barrel Number: 17891 Barrel Type: Pineau de Charentes Finish Time: 16 months Proof/ABV: 102.8 / 51.4% The charity this barrel selection will be supporting is Home For Troops and donations will go towards building and donating specially adapted custom homes nationwide for severely injured post-9/11 Veterans, to enable them to rebuild their lives. Donation Amount: $5 from each bottle sold

TITLE: High West  21  Year Old Rocky Mountain Rye  Whisky
DESCRIPTION: 53% Rye, 37% Corn, 10% Malted Barley. Aged in used oak barrels, so not technically a legal “Rye.” Only 75 barrels total which were aged in the lower three tiers of the rickhouse. If there was a dessert whiskey this would be it - smooth and sweet with a hint of spice. Smooth. So smooth. We can’t say it enough. It’s hard to believe this is 92 proof. It’s also hard to believe it’s even rye and aged for 21 years in a barrel. It’s light in color and low on spice. We could drink this all day every day - I’d stock my shelves with this if we could. This is an impeccably balanced whiskey with a delicious flavor profile. We find the Sazerac 18 to be subtle - this is like an even more subtle version of that.

TITLE: High West "Big Apple" Single Barrel Straight Barreled Manhattan Finished Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #51
DESCRIPTION: High West is one of our favorite producers, and a barrel pick with them is a staple of our club. We've done two fantastic (and unique) picks with them before, and we took advantage when the opportunity presented itself again. We were given a choice between several finishes, ranging from more common finishes (cognac cask) to geeky ones (Spanish brandy and barreled Manhattan). To mitigate the risk of being swayed by knowing which finished sample we are tasting, we taste everything blind and base our selections on taste and profile alone. This is what we've done with High West samples, and out of the five we tasted (two were double ryes, and three were bourbon), two were very interesting. Different but interesting. if we call two samples we liked, Samples A and Sample B, Sample A had more of a traditional profile with a great nose, pretty tasty palate, and medium finish. Sample B was a lot more "geeky." That can sometimes be bad, as things can go far to the left. Thankfully, this was not the case with this sample, as it was unique enough to be different from anything you might already have in your bar yet still be a delicious bourbon. Sample B was also a better-balanced bourbon out of the lot. We chose Sample B for our selection due to its better overall value and uniqueness. Sample A turned out to be Cognac-finished bourbon, while Sample B was Barreled Manhattan finished (which explained its unique profile). Our selection, the American Prairie Bourbon from Hight West, was then finished for six additional months in Barreled Manhattan barrels they use to make their Barreled Manahattan Cocktails expression. Typically, Barreled Manhattan expression's wood notes play exceptionally well with rye whiskey on the palate. Notes of wood flavors gently balance the drink towards rye spiciness over the Vermouth sweetness. Add that finish to bourbon, and you get a version of BouRye. High West does not offer the barrel program at cask strength (yet), but this expression came in at 100.2 Proof, which translated well to how easily drinkable it is. Whiskey Type: American Prairie Bourbon Barrel Number: 27479 Barrel Type: Barreled Manhattan Finish Time: 6 months Proof/ABV: 100.2 / 50.1% Here's what you can expect from this barrel:Nose: Black cherry fruit leather, stewed strawberries, orange peel, molasses, cinnamon bark, sageTaste: Silky and creamy, mild tannins, honeysuckle, raw honey, candied apple, slightly herbaceous, fennelFinish: delicate, floral, cardamom, fennelThe title theme of this selection is "Big Apple," which refers to the finish (Manhattan) and our physical location. The selection also has apple notes, so the name was very apropos. As with most of our picks, we'll donate $5 from every bottle sold to HateDust Project. The organization supports education and services for children, veterans, and local communities through crowdsourced funding through sales of offbeat goods.

TITLE: High West "R/Bourbon" Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Oloroso Cask
DESCRIPTION: R/Bourbon is delighted to be releasing our first High West Selection since 2015. The first time since the program rebooted in 2019, High West single barrel selections go way back and feature a variety of interesting finishes. This particular, Oloroso finish, release is an all-star single cask, a perfect barrel to kick off 2022's High West with. Featuring custom branding for r/Bourbon, this release looks just as good as it tastes. Tasting Notes: Berries and cream, this High West takes sherry quite well. Orange marmalade, bold oak and toffee, blackberry, and date fruit combine nicely with a peppery complexity. Rich on the palate, ABV is just right. Sweet at first, fruity second, and then becoming dry and oaky with a nice tobacco finish. Complex and delightful. It's impressive how both the base whiskey and the finish each show through, neither overpowering each other and bringing tons of complexity to this single barrel.

TITLE: High West "Radical Ski" Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #9
DESCRIPTION: Part of our outstanding duo of High West picks, this expression of High West's signature American Prairie Bourbon was additionally finished in Aquavit barrel for 13 months. The result is a whiskey that is delicious, distinctive, and unique. The expression carries the traditional High West bourbon signature, but the finish gives it a character. You can expect to taste aniseed, fennel, caraway (classic tasting notes of aquavit), subtle juniper, and citrus. The expression comes in at 101.2 proof.We were not planning on selecting TWO High West Barrels, but after tasting both barrels, we were blown away by the taste and uniqueness of each. It's not often when that happens, and when it does, we know that we had no choice but to get both!Each bottle is hand-numbered and includes a custom metal medallion bearing our logo. More info: Whiskey Type: American Prairie Bourbon Barrel Number: 18404 Barrel Type: Aquavit Finish Time: 13 months Proof/ABV: 101.2 / 50.6% The charity this barrel selection will be supporting is Mission 22 and donations will go towards healing America’s veterans when they need it most — right now. They offer treatment for Post-Traumatic Stress and Traumatic Brain Injury and all of the issues veterans are facing today. Donation Amount: $5 from each bottle sold

TITLE: High West "Rendezvous Rye" A Blend of Straight Rye Whiskeys 750ml  2021
DESCRIPTION: The High West Distillery is moving one of its flagship whiskeys to a seasonal release. High West Rendezvous Rye will now be released annually as a vintage whiskey, featuring unique artwork each time. The new vintage collection debuts with artwork by American artist Ed Mell, “whose work has been collected by notable celebrities like Diane Keaton and Arnold Schwarzenegger,” according to High West. “Ed is best known for his painting of timeless Western landscapes, a perfect complement to High West’s signature spirit.” Like Midwinter Night’s Dram and other whiskeys in the High West portfolio, this batch will be present until it runs out, and next year a new artist will adorn the label. Rendezvous, which is a blend of straight rye whiskeys, is one of the longest-running officially sourced ryes in the modern whiskey landscape. The distillery began incorporating their own pot still rye into the blend several years ago, which they say “brings elements of dried fruit, leather, and candied ginger to the final product.”

TITLE: High West 14 Year Old Light Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This offering from High West is an unusual American whiskey in a number of ways. First, the mash bill is 100% corn, rather than being tempered with rye, wheat, or barley as is custom in most American whiskies. Second, during the distillation phase, the spirit is brought into the 80-95% ABV range, whereas most producers rarely break 80%. Lastly, the whiskey is aged in second-fill ex-bourbon casks, rather than new, charred American Oak. Master Distiller Brendan Coyle discovered 100 barrels of it at MGP, all of which were distilled between 1999-2001. Bottled at 46.2% ABV.

TITLE: High West A Midsummer Dessert Blend of  Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Linited edition of American Prairie expression. If you are a fan of American Prairie AND of a Midwinter Dram, you ought to try this one.

DESCRIPTION: The formula for A Midwinter Night’s Dram changes from year to year, but the 2022 release is as follows: the liquid consists of High West’s Rendezvous Rye that was finished in tawny and ruby port barrels, a blend of 80 percent rye and 20 percent malted rye distilled in-house, and 95 percent rye and 5 percent barley malt from MGP in Indiana. It’s bottled at 98.6 proof. The Encore has the same blend at its core, but this whiskey was finished in white port barrels from Portugal, an unusual cask finish for American whiskey. According to the distillery team, this type of barrel is much harder to get, and this cask finish gave the whiskey similar characteristics to brandy. This whiskey was supposed to be blended into the new A Midwinter Night’s Dram, but after tasting it, master distiller Brendan Coyle liked it so much he decided to release it on its own. Encore is bottled at 101.6 proof and is a distillery-only release.

TITLE: High West Bourye A Blend Of Straight Whiskies
DESCRIPTION: Bourye is a combination of ”Bou” for bourbon and ”rye” for..well: rye whiskey. Because combining bourbon and rye is a bit unusual, we couldn’t help thinking of the jackalope, the mythical creature native to the American West that is part rabbit and antelope. Western lore tells that when cowboys would gather by their campfires to sing at night, jackalopes would frequently be heard singing back, mimicking the voices of the cowboys. When chased, the jackalope will use its vocal abilities to elude capture. For instance, when chased by people it will call out phrases such as, ”There he goes, over there,” to throw pursuers off its track. Legend suggests the best way catch a jackalope is to lure it with whiskey, as they have a particular fondness for the brown liquid. Once intoxicated, the animal becomes slower and easier to hunt. A blend of straight Bourbon and Rye whiskeys aged from 10 to 14 years. Straight Rye Whiskey: 95% rye, 5% barley malt from MGP & 53% rye, 37% corn, 10% barley malt from Barton Distillery Straight Bourbon Whiskey: 75% corn, 21% rye, 4% barley malt from MGP TastingNotes Nose: Vanilla Butter toffee, Spiced Marzipan, Roasted Nuts, Dried Pineapple Taste: Sweet Honey Nougat, Rich Caramel, Dark Ginger Cake, Mulling Spices, Dried Stone Fruit. Finish: Long & Rich, Roasted Pecan, Molasses, and Crème Brûlée

TITLE: High West Bourye A Blend Of Straight Whiskies Old Label
DESCRIPTION: Sourced from multiple distilleries, all whiskeys are at least 9 years old. These include a 9-year-old bourbon (21% rye, 4% barley) from Indiana; a 10-year-old rye (5% barley) from MGP; a 16-year-old rye (5% barley) from MGP; and another 16-year-old rye (10% corn, 10% barley) from Barton Distillery. Proportions are not disclosed. It’s got a gorgeous nose right out of the gate as the bottle is opened — almost like a heavily spiced apple pie is baking in the next room. Nosing the glass brings out notes of scorched caramel, cloves, and some toasted cereal — though alcohol is a bit heavy on the nostrils. The body is gorgeous and so easy to fall in love with. Nice notes of cinnamon toast, mixed dried fruits, some orange peel, and lots of added baking spice (especially cloves) come rushing at you all at once. The balance between spice and sweetness is just perfect here, with just a touch of wood on the back end to provide a nod to the not unsubstantial age this whiskey has seen. While hot on the nose, the body drinks perfectly — silky with just enough power to back things up.
