TITLE: High West Campfire Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: #20 on Whisky Advocate "Top 20 Whiskies of 2017" list. Hands down, it is one of the best for the winter months. A terrific blend of bourbon, rye, and peated Scotch from High West in Utah, with a great back story to boot... During a visit to Islay, David Perkins enjoyed a breakfast at a B&B near Bruichladdich, which included a delicious syrup made from sugar and peated poured over honeydew melon. Taking this experience back to America, he blended sweet bourbon from Lawrenceburg with peaty Islay single malt, with some spicy Rye for good measure! Nose: Floral, fruity, bright and spicy. Caramel and butterscotch. Light smoke and smoldering wood from a campfire the morning after. Jasmine, chai tea, sandalwood, leather, tobacco, pine resin and toasted bread. Taste: vanilla, honey, toffee with some nice fruit and black cherries. Chai spices - nutmeg, cinnamon, and orange zest. Salty. Tobacco. Gentle smoke! Finish: Long, sweet, spicy, and smoky!

TITLE: High West Cask Strength A Blend of Straight Bourbon Whiskeys
DESCRIPTION: High West Cask Strength A Blend of Straight Bourbon Whiskeys is a bold and unfiltered bourbon crafted for enthusiasts seeking a full-flavor experience. This cask-strength blend showcases the expertise of High West Distillery in blending select straight bourbons to create a whiskey that is both complex and robust. With proof levels ranging from 120 to 132, this release offers a potent yet balanced profile that maintains smoothness and depth. Using a selection of multi-aged bourbons, each batch of this expression is blended to achieve the perfect balance of oak, spice, and sweetness, making it an exceptional addition to any bourbon lover's collection. High West’s cask strength blend celebrates the art of high-proof whiskey, perfect for sipping neat or exploring with a splash of water.

TITLE: High West Distillery 7000 Oat Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Best enjoyed where vodka is the primary ingredient, like neat, or on the rocks, or in a dry martini. That way you’ll actually be able to taste the richness we distilled into High West 7000′. How to Enjoy Best enjoyed where vodka is the primary ingredient, like neat, or on...

TITLE: High West Distillery Cask Collection Blend Of Bourbon Whiskeys Finished In Barbados Rum Barrels
DESCRIPTION: High West Cask Collection Blend of Bourbon Whiskeys Finished in Barbados Rum Barrels is a distinctive expression that showcases the innovative spirit of High West Distillery. This blend features bourbons aged between 4 to 9 years, meticulously selected and finished for 10 months in Barbados rum barrels. The rum barrel finishing imparts unique tropical notes, adding depth and complexity to the classic bourbon profile. Bottled at 100 proof, this release offers a harmonious fusion of rich bourbon character and exotic rum influences, making it a standout addition to any whiskey collection.

TITLE: High West Double Rye Barrel Select Straight Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Double Rye! is a blend of two different rye whiskeys. It is also crafted to be twice as spicy (think cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves) as your average rye whiskey.

TITLE: High West Double Rye Straight Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: High West made a momentous change to its recipe for Double Rye! this year, for the first time adding its own house-made pot still rye to a blend that was previously fully sourced from other distilleries. Apple blossom, yuzu, chamomile tea, walnut shells, pine boughs, and green-apple candy on the nose shift into an oily palate that starts off soft and then picks up speed and spice. Flavors of lemon, black pepper, walnut-and-apple chutney, dark chocolate, and a lively hit of green apple make this a satisfying pour - especially at the price. Above all, it validates High West’s skill as both blenders and distillers in their own right.

TITLE: High West Double Rye Straight Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: High West made a momentous change to its recipe for Double Rye! this year, for the first time adding its own house-made pot still rye to a blend that was previously fully sourced from other distilleries. Apple blossom, yuzu, chamomile tea, walnut shells, pine boughs, and green-apple candy on the nose shift into an oily palate that starts off soft and then picks up speed and spice. Flavors of lemon, black pepper, walnut-and-apple chutney, dark chocolate, and a lively hit of green apple make this a satisfying pour - especially at the price. Above all, it validates High West’s skill as both blenders and distillers in their own right.

TITLE: High West High Country American Single Malt 2024
DESCRIPTION: High West High Country American Single Malt is a distinctive expression that showcases the innovative spirit of High West Distillery. Crafted from 100% malted barley, this whiskey is distilled "on-the-grain," a process where the grain is left in during fermentation and distillation, imparting a robust, flavor-forward profile. Aged between 2 to 9 years in both new and used barrels, including ex-bourbon and ex-port casks, this single malt offers a complex and balanced character. Bottled at 88 proof, it delivers a harmonious blend of roasted malt, dried fruit, and subtle spice, making it a unique addition to the American single malt category.

TITLE: High West Rendezvous Rye Barrel Select Straight Whiskey
High West The Prisoner's Share Blend of Straight Whiskeys
DESCRIPTION: A distinctive blend of aged straight rye and straight bourbon whiskeys, finished in The Prisoner Red Blend wine barrels to highlight the sophisticated notes of raspberry jam, toasted mahogany, crème brûlée, black pepper, cherry cola, and French oak spice character. Decadent. Indulgent. Unforgettable.

TITLE: High West Valley Tan Utah Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: High West Valley Tan was originally made with a predominately oat mash bill but was switched to a majority wheat mash bill by edition 3, also including oat and malted barley. The move was based on a historical reference from explorer Sir Richard Burton to Utah whiskey made from wheat. It's distilled by High West themselves, as opposed to their sourced expressions. Non-chill-filtered, with no additives or flavorings, it's bottled at 43.5% ABV, and is a blend of whiskeys between one and six years old. Limited availability.

TITLE: High West Yippee Ki-Yay Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Just for fun, guys at High West Distillery put some rye whiskey into barrels originally used to age wine. When they mixed the ‘vermouth-ed’ (Vya, Madera, CA) and the ‘syrah-ed’ (Qupé Santa Maria, CA) they discovered an all-natural, not disgustingly sweet whiskey for the rest of us. Proof: Bottled at 46 %ABV/92 Proof Not chill filtered Marriage of two straight rye whiskies 95% rye, 5% barley malt mashbill (LDI now MGP) The older rye has a "barely legal" rye mashbill of 53% rye and 37% corn (Barton Distillery) Barrel type: Oak barrel that previously held Vermouth Barrel (Vya, Madera, CA), Oak barrel that previously held Qupé Syrah (Qupé Santa maria, CA) Yippee Ki-Yay is great as an aperitif on ice, neat with dessert, or on its own. Try it in a Manhattan. This stuff rocks.

TITLE: High West “Have Merci” Barrel Select Blend of Straight Bourbon Whiskeys Finished in Armagnac Barrels The Prime Barrel x R-Bourbon Pick
DESCRIPTION: This release is our first High West collab pick with T8ke since March 2022 and represents a cool combination of blending and finishing that will bring you right back to our delicious 2022 release - but better! Distilled: Various Matured: Utah (High West) Bottled: Utah (High West) Age: NAS (Blend of 6-10 Year Whiskey, Finished 11 months in Armagnac) More Info: Single Barrel, No Coloring, No Filtering, No Additives, Cask Strength, Cask Strength Rich and savory, this release from High West has lots of complexity and makes a perfect Fall pour. Rich maple on the nose with brown sugar, baking spice, honey, and loads of tobacco with the deep, brooding complexity of the Armagnac. Dark fruits, dates, plums, cola, cherry, black tea, and plenty of oak and richness. Long finish, delicious stewed fruits blend with dark cocoa, rich toffee, a hint of black tea, and more fig, date, blackberry, and icing. Gorgeously rich.

TITLE: High Wire Distilling Company  Benton's Smoked Jimmy Red Corn Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Allan Benton's smoked country hams are the stuff of legend and highly sought after by world class chefs to foodies alike. Notable for their intense, distinctive smokiness made in their slow proprietary fashion at the smokehouse in Tennessee, this incredibly special batch of corn whiskey was made by smoking heirloom Low Country Jimmy Red Corn to be distilled into a moonshine style white whiskey. Made for mixing, this will make some of the best bloody marys you've ever had, and will work wonders in drinks calling for aquavit, gins, vodkas and even as chasers and pickle-backs. Available in limited quantities.

TITLE: High Wire Distilling Company "New Southern Revival Jimmy Red" Bourbon Whiskey Finished In Peach Brandy Casks
DESCRIPTION: New Southern Revival Brand is a celebration of the diverse agricultural traditions of our region. We work with farms in the South to source only the highest quality, heirloom grains. This special spirit is made by finishing our Jimmy Red Straight Bourbon Whiskey in our own freshly dumped Peach Brandy casks. It is the perfect marriage of two SC grown spirits of which we are incredibly proud.

TITLE: High Wire Distilling Company Hat Trick Botanical Gin
DESCRIPTION: High Wire Distilling is producing a distinctive line of small batch spirits including gins, rums, whiskeys, and vodkas using premium, specialized ingredients. Scott, a Culinary Institute of an America-trained baker, applies his knowledge of artisanal grains and culinary techniques to the spirits he creates. With the main focus on local, unique ingredients, the distillery also features an apothecary area where experimental bench formulas can be set up and tested in a small-scale format. In addition to their core products, High Wire will also produce a series of special, limited edition creations only available at certain times of the year. The location for High Wire Distilling is as unique as the spirits—a rustic 6,000 square foot warehouse located on Upper King Street. Spacious with a vintage industrial feel, the Production Area features a 20ft high, barreled ceiling and a beautiful, hand-hammered, copper still as a focal point. Abundant natural light and racks of wooden barrels create an excellent atmosphere for entertaining. High Wire’s 50 person Tasting Room features warm, rough-hewn cypress walls with large windows through which one can view the distilling equipment and process. Visitors also receive a sensory education about the distilling process, ingredients, and formula creation.

TITLE: High Wire Distilling Company New Southern Revival Jimmy Red Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Distillery's flagship spirit, this bourbon is made from 100% Jimmy Red corn, a magenta-hued landrace grain grown for decades on James Island and nearly lost forever. For 6 years, folks at the distillery worked with a team of researchers and farmers to rebuild a secure seed supply for the most flavorful whiskey corn we’ve ever tasted. Aged a minimum of two years in char 3.5 American oak barrels, this bourbon is best enjoyed in a proper whiskey glass neat or with perhaps one cube of ice. 95 Proof.

TITLE: High Wire Distilling Company New Southern Revival Jimmy Red Bourbon Whiskey Finished In Oloroso Sherry Casks
DESCRIPTION: Charleston's High Wire Distilling Co. will release two special whiskey expressions: their flagship Jimmy Red Bourbon finished in Oloroso Sherry Casks and a Rye Whiskey finished in Tawny Port Barrels. This one, in particular, is Jimmy Red Bourbon Finished in Oloroso Sherry Casks, which is offered at 93 proof. To make this one-of-a-kind spirit, the distillery finished their beloved 30 month old Jimmy Red Bourbon for an additional 6 months in fresh 225L Oloroso Sherry casks. The nose is sherry-forward with nutty cashew and cinnamon spice. Tasting notes include brown sugar, maple, gingerbread, graham cracker, light baking spice, and dried fruit with a caramel finish.

TITLE: High Wire Distilling Company New Southern Revival Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This Rye Whiskey is made with a locally sourced 100% Wrens Abruzzi rye, an heirloom grain grown in the Carolinas for centuries and prized for its hardy backbone and complex nutty flavors. Distillery process' the rye in its raw (unmalted) state allowing the rich cereal sweetness of this flavorful grain to shine through. 90 Proof.

TITLE: High Wire Distilling Company New Southern Revival Rye Whiskey Finished In Tawny Port Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Charleston's High Wire Distilling Co. will release two special whiskey expressions: their flagship Jimmy Red Bourbon finished in Oloroso Sherry Casks and a Rye Whiskey finished in Tawny Port Barrels. This one, in particular, is Whiskey Finished in Tawny Port Barrels, which is offered at 90 proof. Starting with their 100% raw Abruzzi rye whiskey, the distillery finished this 18-month-old spirit for an additional 6 months in freshly dumped Tawny Port barrels. The result is a complex spirit heralding notes of florals, fruitcake, ripe cherry, rye spice, and antique wood with a long finish.

TITLE: High Wire Distilling Company Southern Amaro Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: A Southern expression of an Italian classic, our signature amaro is handcrafted from regionally grown and foraged ingredients such as Charleston black tea, yaupon holly, Dancy tangerine, and mint. Sip by itself as a digestif, or use in a riff on a classic cocktail!

TITLE: High Wire Distilling Jimmy Red 10-Year Anniversary Bottle-in-Bond Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: We are excited to carry the spanking new Single Farm Bottled In Bond Jimmy Red Bourbon Whiskey, tucked inside a commemorative 10th Anniversary package that marks the grand comeback of our cherished stoneware bottles. Distilled from the precious kernels of Jimmy Red corn nurtured at the reputable Plumfield farm in Darlington, SC by the one and only Campbell Coxe, this Bottled In Bond bourbon is a single harvest wonder, distilled in one pure, unadulterated distilling season.

TITLE: Highland Park Bourbon 15 yrs Island Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1798, Highland Park is one of the most remote Scotch whisky distilleries in the world. Located on in the Orkney islands, the distillery has been producing premiere malts for over 200 years. Its unique location allows Highland Park to produce spirits of unparalleled taste and quality. AGED: 15 years DISTILLED ON: October 15, 1999 BOTTLE ON: November 27, 2014 MATURED IN: Bourbon Barrel CASK NO: 800168 ALC: 46%

TITLE: Highland Park Cask Strength Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Highland Park Cask Strength Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a bold testament to the distillery's commitment to traditional whisky-making methods, nestled in the rugged heart of Orkney, Scotland. This cask strength expression, presented in a 750ml bottle, is unadulterated and uncompromising, offering the whisky in its purest form, direct from the barrel. Renowned for its distinctive character, this whisky encapsulates the wild essence of Orkney, with each batch reflecting the unique climatic influence on its aging process.

TITLE: Highland Park Empire State 13 Years Single Cask Series Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: NEW YORK EXCLUSIVE SINGLE CASK: UNIQUE AND HIGHLY COLLECTABLE RELEASE, NOT AVAILABLE ANYWHERE ELSE. Cask no. 6046 was hand selected by Highland Park Whisky Maker Gordon Motion for its exceptional quality. Matured in a refill Sherry Butt cask over 13 years in Orkney’s cool Northern climate and bottled at 65.8% ABV. The result is a perfectly balanced whisky with astonishing maturity and depth of flavor. Only 593 bottles produced.

TITLE: Highland Park Fire Edition 15 Year Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Highland Park Fire Edition 15 Year Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a captivating expression that embodies the fierce spirit of the Viking age. Crafted on the rugged Orkney Islands, this whisky pays homage to its Norse heritage with a bold, fiery character. Aged for 15 years in refill port wine casks, the Fire Edition showcases a unique maturation process that imbues the whisky with a rich tapestry of flavors. Bottled at 45.2% ABV, this limited edition release is a testament to Highland Park's dedication to quality and tradition.

TITLE: Highland Park Hogshead 25 yrs Island Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Highland Park is made with the same enduring belief, integrity and to the same exacting standards founded with the distillery in 1798. The established attitude at Highland Park Distillery is one of custodianship rather than management, of tradition rather than novelty. Yet innovation is welcomed when there is a genuine benefit to the whisky, not, as is often the way, to benefit efficiency or profitability. AGED: 25 years DISTILLED ON: June 1988 BOTTLE ON: May 2014 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 749 ALC: 50.7%

TITLE: Highland Park Scotch Single Malt 12 Year Viking Honour
DESCRIPTION: Highland Park’s uncompromising approach to making single malt Scotch whisky manifests itself in the rich malty tones and subtle aromatic smoke of the 12-Year-Old. Aged exclusively in the distillery’s signature sherry seasoned oak casks, this whisky has a rich, full flavor with notes of heather honey, dried fruit, winter spices, and Seville oranges, ending with a gentle smoky finish.

TITLE: Highland Park Scotch Single Malt 18 Year Viking Pride
DESCRIPTION: 18 YEAR OLD is Highland Park’s most awarded whisky for good reason. Crafted using a high proportion of first-fill sherry seasoned European oak casks, it is the perfect expression of harmony, complexity, and refinement: rich and expertly balanced with a toffee sweetness and a mouthwatering smoky finish. Highland Park 18 Year Old was named ”Best Spirit in the World” by the Spirit Journal on two separate occasions and was awarded the Chairman’s Trophy for Best Island Single Malt Scotch at the Ultimate Spirits Challenge in 2018 and again in 2019.

TITLE: Hild Elbling Sektv
DESCRIPTION: This spunky sparkler is produced by Matthias Hild, an honest and down-to-earth winemaker located in the Upper Mosel. Here, soils are mainly comprised of limestone and chalk, unlike the rest of the Mosel, which is characterized by slate. These delicious bubbles are produced in the traditional method and is aged on its lees for nine months.

TITLE: Hild Elbling Trocken
Hillrock Double Cask Bottled in Bond Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: illrock’s Double Cask Bourbon is a true Field-To-Glass® whiskey defined by the unique terroir of the Hudson Valley Hillrock Estate. This rich whiskey was handcrafted from 100% estate grain, which was sustainably grown, milled, mashed, pot distilled, aged, and hand bottled all on the Hillrock Estate. After aging in both, #3 char and #4 Char American oak casks for over five years, this Double Cask Bourbon was bottled in bond at 100 proof. This dark amber whiskey displays a complex aroma of warm gingerbread, vanilla bean, hazelnuts, and oak with hints of nutmeg and butterscotch. The palate is rich and round, with bright flavors of cinnamon and vanilla leading to honey-roasted nuts and dark chocolate. It integrates a creamy texture that is complemented by warm caramel, and the finish continues, revealing layers of buttered toffee and baking spices.

TITLE: Hillrock Estate Distillery "Winebow Cask #3" Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Winebow's (spirits wholesaler in NY) HIllrock pick. Very limited quantities are available.

TITLE: Hillrock Estate Distillery Double Cask Rye Whiskey
Hillrock Estate Distillery Port Cask Finished Double Cask Rye Whiskey
Hillrock Estate Distillery Sauternes Cask Finished Double Cask Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: One of our favs from the Hillrock Estate Distillery, New York’s first Field-To-Glass® distillery, is their Estate Rye Whiskey finished in French Sauternes casks. Continuing the commitment to create the highest quality artisanal whiskeys, Hillrock’s estate-grown and crafted, 100% rye whiskey reflects the unique terroir of the Hudson Valley and incorporates rare Premier Cru Sauternes wine casks into the aging process. Sauternes wine, known as the “nectar of the gods”, is characterized by the balance of sweetness and acidity, with a nutty flavor and notes of apricots, honey and peaches. This exceptional wine is made only in the Graves section of Bordeaux with grapes affected by Botrytis fungus – better known as the “noble rot”. Botrytis causes the grapes to become partially raisined, resulting in a concentrated and distinctive flavor profile which is renowned world-wide. In the 18th century, both Thomas Jefferson and George Washington were major Sauternes connoisseurs.

TITLE: Hillrock Estate Distillery Sauternes Cask Finished Solera Aged Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This incredibly distinctive solera-aged bourbon is aged partially in rare Premier Cru Sauternes wine casks. The nose is full of caramel, dried fruit, vanilla, oak and spice, with a light floral aroma. The palate is full-bodied with decadent notes of brown sugar, molasses, toffee, butterscotch apricots, honey, peaches, roasted corn, clove, cinnamon and a small hint of spicy rye. The finish is well-balanced.

TITLE: Hillrock Estate Distillery Single Malt Whiskey
Hillrock Estate Distillery Solera Aged "Pinot Noir Cask Finish" Bourbon Whiskey
Hillrock Estate Distillery Solera Aged Barrel Proof Breaking Bourbon "Hudson Confidential" Pick
DESCRIPTION: This barrel proof pick checks in at 117.4 proof. The nose is nicely expressive with bursts of floral aromas, dark fruit, and candied cherries notes that’s punctuated with seasoned oak. The palate is sweet to the tongue, with raspberries, apricots, and raisins. It finishes with a bump of rye spice, followed by oak and plum. Overall an excellent sipper that features a ton of flavor delivered with elegant complexity.

TITLE: Hillrock Estate Distillery Solera Aged Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: World's First Solera Aged Bourbon. "Solera" - a stack of barrels where a small portion of whiskey is removed periodically and new whiskey is added. No barrel is every fully emptied, and age and complexity gradually increase over time. Hillrock marries small barrel-aged Hillrock Estate Bourbon with mature seed bourbon before finishing in 20 year-old Oloroso Sherry casks to balance flavors and add layers of complexity….Current average age of the Hillrock Solera Bourbon is over 6 years and the rye content is approximately 37%

TITLE: Hillrock Estate Distillery Solera Aged Cabernet Cask Finish Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Today, in a 19th century Georgian mansion situated in the heart of the Hudson Valley, Master Distiller Dave Pickerell pays homage to the New York farmers who produced their whiskey from grains to glass. Pickerell, who graduated from West Point with a Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, served in the military for 11 years as a cavalry officer before receiving his Master's Degree in Chemical Engineering from the University of Louisville. Pickerell then served as Master Distiller as Maker's Mark in Loretto, Kentucky for 13 years. There, he was responsible for ensuring the quality and consistency of Maker's Mark Bourbon. A former chairman of the Kentucky Distillers Association and a member of the Distilled Spirits Council, Pickerell is an expert nonpareil in the production of whiskey. Hillrock Bourbon was named one of the Top 50 Spirits of 2013 by Wine Enthusiast (it was ranked the #2 bourbon), which gave it a score of 96 points. It also earned the SIlver Medal at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition in 2013.

TITLE: Hirsch "The Horizon" Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Hirsch "The Horizon" Straight Bourbon is a blend of two sourced straight bourbon whiskeys distilled in Lawrenceburg, Indiana (MGP). The inaugural batch AAH0320 has a make up which follows: 94% of the bourbon is made from a traditional mash bill (75% corn, 21% rye, 4% malted barley) and aged for 5 years and 4 months. The remaining 6% is a high-rye mash bill aged for 6 years and 2 months.

TITLE: Hirsch 8 Year Old  Single Barrel Straight High Rye Bourbon The Prime Barrel x R-Bourbon Pick
DESCRIPTION: It's a high rye roller all the way through, heavy on the nose with buttercream, rich caramel, and toffee, heavy tobacco, and bright pepper with a French toast note - lovely, sweet brioche notes with maple syrup layer after layer. The palate is rich and viscous, syrupy with rich oak, toffee, heavy cream, and sweet maple once more. Decadent baking spice and more oak stand tall with this release. Touch of cocoa and espresso on the finish before rich tobacco, heavy demerara, and a hint of barrel char slam on the finish. Hell of a first release for Hirsch in our program. Details: Barrel #IN22009 Age: 8 Years 9 Months Proof 113.4 Mashbill: 60% corn/36% rye/4% malted barley

TITLE: Hirsch 8 Year Old "If you Willett, it will come" Single Barrel Straight High Rye Bourbon The Prime Barrel x R-Bourbon Pick
DESCRIPTION: Introducing our second collaboration on the Hirsch Single Barrel with t8ke. This release is eagerly anticipated and requires no introduction since 92% of the blend originates from a prestigious distillery in Bardstown (the name rhymes with 'Smillett.') Barrel #GLD23021 Proof: 127.7 Blend: Ratio Age Mashbill 92% 8 years 7 months 72% corn, 13% Rye, 15% Malted Barley 8% 3 years 7 months 74% corn, 18% Rye, 8% Malted Barley Tasting Notes: Nose: Figs, apricots (like a lot of them), orange peel, brown sugar, a flash of red pepper Palate: explodes on the palate first into more apricot jam notes, then follows with allspice, red pepper. Finish: Long with KY hug

TITLE: Hirsch Selection Special Reserve 20 Year Old American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A 20-year-old American whisky from the producers of "The Best Bourbon You'll Never Taste". Distilled from bourbon mash in February 1987. Hirsch Selection is a brand of American whisky from Preiss Imports, who bottled to the original A.H. Hirsch Reserve. Next, Preiss Imports was acquired by San Francisco-based Anchor Brewers and Distillers. That company still sells bourbon under the Hirsch name, though it’s a different animal entirely—a series of bourbons sourced from undisclosed producers around the country. Making things even more confusing, Henry Preiss later reacquired the name Preiss Imports and started building an entirely new portfolio of spirits. But back when Preiss still had the Hirsch label in its portfolio, the company bottled several well-aged whiskeys under that name, including this American whiskey. Since the names Hirsch and Preiss both mean something entirely different than they did ten years ago, there’s little information available today on this whiskey, other than what’s on the bottle. To wit: it was distilled in Illinois and barreled on February 27, 1987 (at least the date is precise!). It’s made with a bourbon mash bill, matured in used cooperage for 20 years, and was bottled at 96 proof. The run was limited to 120 barrels.

TITLE: Hirsch Selection The Cask Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Cognac Cask
DESCRIPTION: The Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is an exclusive HIRSCH release finished in 30-Year-Old Hine Cognac XO barrels, in Bardstown, Kentucky. It’s rich, complex, and a well-rounded whiskey. This expression was brought from a collaboration between HIRSCH Selected Whiskeys and Hine Cognac. HINE COGNAC Internationally acclaimed for its blends, vintage and extra old cognacs, the 259-year-old cognac house takes pride in its unequalled collection of exceptional cognacs dating back to the 1800s. For HIRSCH, this was a unique collaboration with one of the most prestigious Cognac distilleries. 54 barrels of the 6-year-old bourbon were selected to finish in 30-year-old XO Hine Cognac casks for 18 months, adding the subtle yet noticeable character of Cognac to the bourbon. This unique expression has a mash bill of 72% corn, 13% rye, and 15% malted barley. On the nose, it offers notes of dusty cherry and charred citrus with a palate of overripe stone fruit, fresh raisin, soft heat, and finishes dry yet flavors continue to develop.

TITLE: Hirsch Small Batch Reserve Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: HIRSCH SMALL BATCH RESERVE is an artisanally produced, hand crafted Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey. This fine bourbon demonstrates a combination of precise distillation techniques, careful barrel selection, and patience over maturation. Bottled only when the master distiller is completely satisfied with the quality of the finished product, we proudly present this whiskey at between four and six years old.

TITLE: Hirsch The Bivouac Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Bivouac, pronounced “be∙voo∙ak,” refers to a temporary camp without a tent or cover. It alludes to a way of travel only meant for those who want to truly immerse themselves in nature. HIRSCH The Bivouac honors those adventurous spirits who are brave enough to take the road less traveled. The Bivouac combines two straight bourbons distilled in Bardstown, Kentucky - the world capital of Bourbon. The custom mashbill is inspired by A.H. Hirsch Reserve 16-year-old legendary whiskey, providing balance to this make. 95% of the blend is distilled from mashbill of 74% corn, 18% rye, 8% malted barley, aged a minimum of 3 years. The remaining 5% is distilled from a high malted barley mash 72% corn, 13% rye, 15% malted barley, aged for a least 6 years, for added complexity. Bottled at 100 proof with approximately 160 barrels bottled with every batch.

TITLE: Hirsch Vineyards Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir The Bohan-Dillon
DESCRIPTION: David Hirsch was inspired to create the Bohan-Dillon Pinot Noir as an homage to the great village wines of France: a wine full of place and personality, made with the same attention and integrity as the top wines, yet at an incredible price. In 2019, about 50% of the grapes in the Bohan-Dillon Pinot Noir came from our 30-year-old vines; the balance from our 20-year-old vines. These are serious Pinot Noir vineyards, farmed biodynamically with great care on the True Sonoma Coast. We make the Bohan-Dillon the same way we make our top wines; the only difference is a shorter time in barrel. It's in the blending that the Bohan-Dillon is differentiated from our other wines. For the Bohan, we select our most charming, silky barrels, with an emphasis on gentle tannins and exuberant fruit. The Bohan-Dillon is a wine for everyday drinking, yet also has the potential to age. It can be drunk young, guzzled at a picnic, and it pairs perfectly with pizza.

TITLE: Hit & Run Nestville 9 Year Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Hit & Run Nestville 9-Year Whiskey is a premium Slovakian whiskey from the renowned Nestville Distillery. Aged for 9 years, this whiskey reflects the distillery's dedication to craftsmanship and tradition. Bottled at 90 proof (45% ABV), it delivers a rich and complex flavor profile, balancing the smoothness of grain whiskey with the depth imparted by nearly a decade of aging in oak barrels. This whiskey offers a unique Eastern European twist on classic whiskey-making techniques, making it an intriguing option for whiskey enthusiasts and those looking to explore new regions.

TITLE: Hitorimusume Nigori Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Established in Ibaraki prefecture, 1805. Hitorimusume means "my only daughter". It pairs well with vegetables (especially asparagus) and shellfish. It also makes a nice and refreshing aperitif.

TITLE: Hitorimusume Nigori Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Established in Ibaraki prefecture, 1805. Hitorimusume means "my only daughter". It pairs well with vegetables (especially asparagus) and shellfish. It also makes a nice and refreshing aperitif.

TITLE: Hizo Otokoyama Tokubetsu Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Hizo Otokoyama Special Junmai is brewed using a blend of Hinohikari and Yumetsukushi sake brewing rice. Pairs well with hearty cuisine.

TITLE: Horse Soldier Breaking Bourbon 13 Year Barrel Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey

Aged bourbon can always be a hit or a miss, but anytime we get a chance to do a 10-13-year-old barrel, we always get excited. This age range can present some real gems, which is exactly what we ended up finding with Horse Soldier. It offers a really nice well-rounded palate with a proof that allows it to be approachable to all. Not every barrel we pick needs to be a high proof burner to be good, and this is a great example of such a barrel. For the sticker concept, we wanted to pay tribute to the background of the brand itself. In the days after the events of September 11, 2001, a group of special operations officers answered their nation’s call to defend it. These officers soon found themselves riding horseback in a Green Beret insertion in Northern Afghanistan to fight the Taliban. These men are honored at America’s Response Monument at Ground Zero and have been given the nickname Horse Soldiers. These same men banded together to create American Freedom Distillery. Forged in Honor pays tribute to this true story of acts of courage, and reminds us all that freedom should never be taken for granted. TITLE: House of Hafner Ice Wine Gewurztraminer
DESCRIPTION: Icewine (Eiswein) has to be clearly distinguished from other noble sweet wine products regarding the production method. With 25 % sugar content in the pressed must it is equal to Beerenauslese (BA) but whilst all noble sweet wines contain more or less Botrytis and are produced from shrivelled grapes, the Icewine is made from harvesting “healthy” grapes but in a frozen state. By pressing frozen grapes immediately, the frozen water is separated from the juice (must) as Ice crystals, so the high sugar concentration can be reached. (Would the same grapes not be frozen, the separated Ice would be within the must as water and the concentration would be less.) The fine balance between sweetness and acidity is the basis of the typical character of an Icewine. An essential element of a classic Icewine is a certain racy, fiery trait based on a sufficient structure of acidity. The notable difference between Icewine and traditional dessert wines is, that Icewine, produced by an expert, presents a fine fruitness from the bouquet to the end of the tasting because of the total or partial absence of noble rot (Botrytis). The typical characteristics of the grape variety should be noticeable.

TITLE: House of Hafner Icewine Chardonnay
DESCRIPTION: A royal premium wine produced under very special climatic conditions. We at Hafners, as Austria’s first producers of Ice Wine (1971) are proud to share this exquisite wine with you. These Chardonnay grapes were naturally frozen on the vine and harvested at a dawn temperature of 14° F/ - 10°. Ice Wine is one of the finest sweet wines and a rarity which cannot be produced every year. Its sweetness is due to an entirely natural unfermented grape sugar (Res. Sug. 138 G/L) 31 brix at harvest. Enjoy this wine as an aperitif (dessert) or whenever you are in the mood for a glass of Noble Sweet Wine. Comes with a gorgeous gift box. Makes for a perfect gift. Kosher for Passover

The notable difference between Icewine and traditional dessert wines is, that Icewine, produced by an expert, presents a fine fruitness from the bouquet to the end of the tasting because of the total or partial absence of noble rot (Botrytis). The typical characteristics of the grape variety should be noticeable. The production of Icewine involves a long and risky procedure. As the grapes maintain in the vineyards until it becomes frosty lower than -7°C/ 20°F, there is much damage by wind and birds (starlings going south in fall/winter) but it is even not certain that the temperature necessary for the Icewine production can be reached. The high risk involved is the reason why not all vintages result in a Icewine harvest. As Austria’s first producer of Icewine (1971) we have a lot of experience meanwhile and even had to accept complete losses of vineyards to birds and wheater. But in the positive years, mostly at night we get the chance to harvest frozen grapes below -7° C/ 20° F. Sometimes only for a few hours as the temperature goes up again in the morning. This makes a lot of helpful hands essential. Not completely frozen grapes cannot be accepted by our quality standards, nor technically as the necessary sugar concentration of 25 % would not be reached on partly frozen grapes. Alcohol: 9,6 % Vol. Sugars: 125 g/l Acidity: 7,5 g/l Kosher for Passover, Mevushal

The new I.W. The bourbon clocks in at 90 proof (45% ABV). You can expect rich oak and vanilla out front, a hint of dark fruit on the backbeat, followed by a clean and smooth finish.

They are rolling out a permanent brand line under I.W. Harper Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey, along with a limited edition release that carries the same name but with different packaging and a 15-year-old age statement. According to Diageo, both Bourbons were recently aging at their Stitzel-Weller Distillery warehouses, but the whiskies used were distilled at the New Bernheim Distillery. Their facility in Tullahoma, Tennessee bottled these Bourbons; the same place their Orphan Barrel releases have been bottled. In the mid 1990’s, I.W. Harper was pulled out of the U.S. market and offered only in Asia; primarily Japan. The brand’s history goes back to 1872 when Isaac Wolfe (I.W.) Bernheim opened his own distillery.

It has remained a premium offering in Japan all along, and if finally back on shelves in the states after a long hiatus. TITLE: Ichiro's Chichibu Distillery 2014 Single Cask #3912 Japanese Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Featured on the label is Scooby 12 yr old Great Dane mix, certified good boy, and unofficial mascot of high road spirits

TITLE: Ichiro's Malt & Grain Chichibu Blended Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A lovely blended whisky from Japan, created by Ichiro Akuto, the Japanese whisky extraordinaire. This particular gem is made with both malt and grain whisky from Japan as well as (possibly) some whisky from other countries too - the label describes it as "a worldwide blended whisky".

TITLE: Ichiro's Malt & Grain World Blended Limited Edition Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Building on the classic, white-label, Ichiro’s Malt and Grain, this gorgeous new bottle is a limited edition of the expression. Made using malt whisky from Chichibu and grain whisky from abroad, the is defined on the label as a “World Blended Whisky” The blend is 10+ year old Ichiro's malt and 10-40 years for the world whiskies (Canadian, Scotch, Irish and American) Then aged additional 3-5 years as usual 48% ABV

TITLE: Ichiro's Malt Malt & Grain Not Chill Filtered World Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Ichiro's Malt & Grain 111 Proof represents a bold shift from the classic "white label" releases by Chichibu Distillery. This unique blend introduces peated malt for the first time and is aged using a new cask selection. Bottled at 55.5% ABV, this is the highest proof for a core blend, except for distillery-exclusive expressions. Crafted exclusively for the U.S. market, this blend combines various whiskies—including Scotch, Canadian rye, American, Irish whiskey, and Japanese single malt, aged between 4 to 17 years. Maturation occurs in ex-bourbon and ex-rye barrels, with no chill filtration or artificial coloring. The distillery notes describe aromas of sweet cola, shortbread, and tobacco, leading to a palate of candied orange, dried pineapple, and gentle peat smoke, finishing with tropical fruits and a touch of sea salt.

TITLE: Ichiro’s Malt Chichibu "The First Ten" 2020 Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Ichiro Akuto is a rock star of the Japanese whisky world, and his family has been in the alcoholic beverage industry since the 1600s. Ichiro’s father ran the Hanyu distillery and experimented with whisky making until his unfortunate bankruptcy. Ichiro then founded his own Chichibu distillery, acquired the remains of the Hanyu stock, and sold it as his own. Here, we have Ichiro’s malt whisky The First Ten 2020. It was matured for 10 years until bottled in 2020. Like everything else from Ichiro, a true delight!

TITLE: Idle Hands 13 Years Old Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Made at what is now MGP Distillery, this bourbon was sourced by Proof & Wood Ventures, a company owned by Dave Schmier, the founder of Redemption Whiskey. Schmier collaborated with Rob Morton—who currently operates a hospitality company, but used to own the now-closed Idle Hands whiskey bar in New York City’s East Village—to create the bourbon from two barrels.

TITLE: Idlewild Dolcetto Fox Hill Vineyard
DESCRIPTION: Planted in the Fox Hill Vineyard in Mendocino this is a rare gem from California. The plantings were inspired by the owner, Lwell Stone who decided to follow his passion and plant what he was most interested in. many trips to Italy turned to inspiration and the wild spectrum of varieties began to take root. Dolcetto does have a serious side that when shown in balance highlights the grape's ability to be compelling.

TITLE: Idlewild Mendocino The Flower Rose
DESCRIPTION: Idlewild is the creation of Sam Bilbro. Sam comes from a long family tradition of wine. His father Chris Bilbro founded Marietta Cellars. Idlewild is about what moves Sam. Wines that are rooted in tradition but which also endeavor to create a new paradigm. His wines possess vibrant fruit character but often have savory elements and the requisite structure and acid to make them well to pair with food. They are wines of beauty and balance.

TITLE: Iichiko Sei Rin Shochu
Il Conte Montepulciano d'Abruzzo
DESCRIPTION: The brother-sister team of Carlo and Annalisa Botter are third generation winemakers in the Vento region of Italy. Their great-grandfather, Carlo Botter, began farming in the Veneto in the first part of the twentieth century and began exporting his wine outside of Italy in the 1960's. His three sons expanded their vineyard holdings to include sites in Friuli, Abuzzi, and even Sicily.

TITLE: Il Palagio "Message In A Bottle" Toscana IGT
Il Paradiso di Frassina Brunello di Montalcino DOCG ‘MozArt Wine’
DESCRIPTION: This innovative, experimental winery treated with ‘music therapy’, utilizing music to assist the vines in the creation of premium quality fruit, is the result of Giancarlo Cignozzi’s avid passion for music and wine. In 2005, no less than Amar Bose himself, the Indian-born ‘guru of sound’, founder of the homonymous Bose Corporation, came to leave his unmistakable imprint at Il Paradiso. Bose, who was personally and genuinely interested in the research, provided 80 all-weather, outdoor speakers free-of-charge and donated $100,000 each to the Universities of Florence and Pisa to continue this research. The loudspeakers are scattered throughout the vineyards (some even underground) and in the cellar and play music around the clock. In 2008, University researchers suggested that only the music of Mozart should be played, providing a single, unique musical blanket to the vines. Thus, Brunello MozArt Wine was born. A wine of particular elegance due to the cooler climate in the northern part of Montalcino, it is aged in large oak barrels and rests in the cellar, also to the comforting sound of music. 14,000 bts produced.

TITLE: Il Poggio Di Gavi
DESCRIPTION: How can a grandfathers simple pastime become a young woman’s passion and lifework? When working in the hills of Rovereto in the heart of the Gavi DOGC where sandy and clay rich soils impart remarkable attributes to the ancient Cortese grape. When winemaking tradition started in the 1950’s is passed from generation to generation and the dedication to preserve those characters of uniqueness is handed from mother to daughter. Third generation winemaker Francesca Poggio’s zeal for Gavi and oenologist Gaspare Buscemi partner to create the best quality wine from small yields.

TITLE: Ilegal Mezcal Anejo
DESCRIPTION: Ilegal Mezcal Añejo is a refined and complex spirit that exemplifies the rich traditions of mezcal production in Oaxaca, Mexico. Aged for a minimum of 13 months in American oak barrels, this mezcal offers a deep and nuanced flavor profile that is both sophisticated and smooth. Handcrafted using 100% Espadín agave, Ilegal Mezcal Añejo captures the essence of Oaxaca with its rich history and artisanal methods. Perfect for sipping neat or in elegant cocktails, this añejo mezcal delivers an unparalleled drinking experience.

TITLE: Illadelph Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Discover Illadelph Vodka, the flagship product from the women-owned craft distillery Illadelph Spirits. Crafted with organic wheat and triple distilled for unparalleled purity, this premium vodka embodies sophistication and quality. Masterfully CraftedDistilled and bottled at Philadelphia's renowned City Distilling under the expertise of Master Distiller Nick Capecci, Illadelph Vodka offers a harmonious balance of refined aroma, smooth palate, and clean finish. Artisan-Designed BottleDesigned by Luca Falso, founder of Illadelph Glass, each bottle features the classic blue Illadelph logo and is a hand-designed work of art destined to be the centerpiece of any bar. Quality and InnovationIlladelph Vodka is gluten-free and made with the highest-quality ingredients, ensuring a smooth and unforgettable drinking experience. At $25 for a 750ml bottle, it provides 'affordable luxury' for all vodka enthusiasts.

TITLE: Imperial Hogshead 19 yrs Speyside Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Imperial Distillery was a producer of single malt Scotch whisky located in Carron, Speyside operating sporadically between 1897 and 1998. The distillery was demolished in 2013. Throughout its lifetime the production of Imperial was almost exclusively used for blends, notably Teacher’s, Old Smuggler, Long John and Ballantine’s. AGED: 19 years DISTILLED ON: August 1995 BOTTLE ON: March 2015 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 50185 ALC: 46%

TITLE: Imperial Hogshead 21 yrs Speyside Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: 21 yrs Imperial Hogshead from Speyside. Destilled in 1995, bottled in 2016. 46.0% ABV Product pictured is 19yrs not 21yrs.

TITLE: Inama Carmenere Colli Berici Piu
DESCRIPTION: Più’ means ‘more’ in Italian and there’s more than just Carmenere in this typical blend from the Colli Berici, a line of gently rolling volcanic hills in Italy’s north-east. Merlot is a civilising influence, the plumy accent and refined tannins marry well with a touch of French oak. The iron-rich clay soil over a limestone base is perfect for Bordeaux varieties and Carmenere, introduced in the 19th century, suffered from amnesia for decades. Cabernet Franc it most definitely is not – the soy sauce, cocoa and grainy tannins ought to have been unmistakeable. All varieties are 100% destemmed. After 12 days' maceration in upright stainless fermenters with internal paddles the must is racked and malo occurs in steel. The wine is aged in 2nd ­fill 225l French oak barriques for 12 months. A fi­nal racking is followed by a gentle pad ­filtration before bottling. The wine is unfi­ned. At its best with local salami (sopressa, sopressa with garlic and Val Liona DOP ham) and grilled pork.

TITLE: Inchgower 11 yrs Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Matured in a pair of hogsheads for more than a decade, this 2007-vintage Inchgower single malt was bottled in March 2019 for Signatory Vintage’s Un-Chillfiltered Collection.

TITLE: Inchmurrin Refill Butt 17 yrs Highland 86 Proof Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Inchmurrin is produced at Lock Lomond, the only distillery in Scotland to produce both grain and malt whiskeys. Producing over 12 million liters of whiskey per annum, this large distillery is set in one of Scotland’s most scenic lochs. Loch Lomond produced eight single malts, which are traditionally used in blends. AGED: 17 years DISTILLED ON: November 18, 1996 BOTTLE ON: July 29, 2014 MATURED IN: Refill Butt CASK NO: 22 ALC: 43%

TITLE: Indri Diwali Collectors's Edition Single Malt Indian Whisky 2023
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the spirit of celebration with Indri Diwali Collector's Edition Single Malt Indian Whisky, a masterpiece that has garnered global acclaim by winning the 'Best in Show, Double Gold' at the Whiskies of the World Awards 2023. This peated Indian single malt, distilled from six-row barley using traditional copper pot stills and matured in PX Sherry Casks, is a testament to the exceptional craftsmanship and heritage of Indian whisky-making. The sub-tropical climate of North India lends this whisky its unique character, offering a complex bouquet of candied dried fruits, toasted nuts, subtle spices, oak, and bittersweet chocolate, making every sip a celebration of flavors

TITLE: Indri Dru Cask Strength Single Malt Indian Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Indri Dru Cask Strength Single Malt Indian Whisky is a remarkable expression from the foothills of the Himalayas in Uttarakhand, India. Crafted meticulously at the Piccadily Distillery, this exquisite whisky is aged for three years in a unique combination of barrels. At a robust 118 proof and available in a 750ml bottle, Indri Dru embodies the spirit of Indian craftsmanship in the realm of fine spirits. This single malt is a testament to the distillery's commitment to quality and innovation, offering a distinctive experience for whisky enthusiasts.

TITLE: Indri Trini The Three Wood Indian Single Malt
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 94, #17 on the Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 List This must-try Indian whisky comes from a village distillery running on renewable energy in the foothills of the Himalayas. Former Amrut master blender Surrinder Kumar demonstrates his unerring sense of balance, pace, and control over the fast-maturing single malt, which is distilled from organically grown six-row Indian barley indigenous to Rajasthan. Flavors of vanilla, citrus peel, baked peach, hazelnut, and cassis attest to the complex contributions from the first-fill bourbon, French wine, and Pedro Ximénez sherry casks.

TITLE: Inmemorial Criollas Rose Vinedo Ancestral Mendoza
DESCRIPTION: Experience the unique character of Inmemorial Criollas Rosé Viñedo Ancestral Mendoza. From the high-altitude vineyards of Uco Valley in Mendoza, Argentina, this natural rosé wine is crafted by Inmemorial with a dedication to ancestral winemaking methods. Made from a blend of Criolla grape varieties, this wine captures the essence of Mendoza's terroir with its vibrant and unfiltered charm. Perfect for those who appreciate the purity and authenticity of natural wines, Inmemorial Criollas Rosé offers a distinct and memorable tasting experience.

TITLE: Ippolito 1845 Ciro Mabilia Rose
Ironroot Harbinger Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: The flagship bourbon is a non-chill filtered, over-proof sipping bourbon that was the herald of things to come at Ironroot. It encapsulates everything that is Ironroot.116 PROOF

TITLE: Ironroot Harbinger XC
DESCRIPTION: Harbinger XC is the dead ringer of the flagship Harbinger bourbon in a softer package. Where Harbinger wants to hog all the attention, Harbinger XC wants to play nice with others. 45% ABV | 90 PROOF

TITLE: Ironstone Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: The Kautz Family grows Cabernet Sauvignon grapes in several of Lodi’s sub-appellations as well as the Calaveras County growing region of the Sierra Foothills. These different locations provide diverse soils and climate that, when combined, create a more complex wine than one region alone. The wine was aged for six months in new French oak. Cabernet Sauvignon is a classic pairing partner for a variety of roasted, broiled or barbequed beef dishes. Its magnificent flavor and structure also works well with lamb, wild game such as venison and wild boar, hearty vegetarian dishes, as well as strong cheeses.

TITLE: Isaac Bowman Port Finish Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This port barrel-finished bourbon was “modeled” after the 2016 expression, which doesn’t come as a huge surprise given the success of the 2016 limited-release. It was named for Captain Isaac Bowman, who, like his older brothers Abraham and Joseph, was an officer in the American Revolutionary War and is known for his spirit and adventure-filled life (and this ‘character’ is said to have inspired and come though in the whiskey). For anyone wary of port-finished bourbons or other whiskey becoming too sweet, this one draws on some of the boldness and character of port without becoming overly saturated. According to the distillery, some whiskey from each batch produced of the Isaac Bowman Straight Bourbon will be reserved for blending into the next batch, “to ensure consistency in flavor and color.” Could be interesting to try future batches to gauge how it may (or may not) evolve.

TITLE: Isastegi Sagardo Natural Apple Cider
DESCRIPTION: Isastegi is an old family estate located in the town of Tolosa in the Basque Country of Spain. The estate was originally covered by pastures for cattle, with only a few apple trees for the family to make a small amount of cider for itself. In 1983 they decided to switch from livestock to cider output and started selling their cider to the public. Pastures were replaced by orchards and a small part of the house became dedicated to cider production. Over the years the demand for Isastegi cider has increased and the family’s country house has adapted to the changes. Recent renovations added new state-of-the-art pressing and bottling rooms as well as a larger space for the kupelas (old, large, oak cider barrels) and the txotx (spring tasting) season visitors. The folks at Isastegi pride themselves on their local focus, supplementing their own orchards’ yields by buying all the rest of the apples that are grown locally in Tolosa, and only resorting to using apples from Galicia and France during years with insufficient harvests. Every spring the people of Tolosa gather at Isastegi to celebrate txotx season by tasting the new vintage of cider while enjoying the traditional meal of cod omelets, fried cod and grilled steak.

TITLE: Isle of Arran Lochranza Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: We are delighted to share our latest Limited Edition with you! We have the first release in The Smuggers' Series which is a trilogy of three limited edition Arran Malts which are a nod to the rich history of Whisky distillation. With the Smugglers’ Series Vol. I ‘The Illicit Stills’ distillery pays homage to their forebears with an Arran dram of robust body and a heavier peat influence more redolent of the whisky produced on the island in days gone by. The presence of the heavily peated Arran is perfectly balanced by the sweetness of older Bourbon barrels. In the background the rich and fruity influence of Port Pipes has resulted in a fresh, full bodied and complex dram evocative of our independent character. Here are some key facts about this multi-vintage release of The Arran Malt: The Smugglers’ Series pays homage to the rich history of illicit distillation on the Isle of Arran in the 18th and 19th centuries. Limited Edition of 8,700 Bottles Worldwide Bottled at Natural Cask Strength 56.4% abv. Unique release including our classic un-peated Arran Malt in combination with Arran produced from medium & heavily-peated malt. Includes some of our heavily peated Arran Malt at 50ppm and Arran Malt fully matured in Port Pipes. Non Chill Filtered & No artificial coloring. Limited Edition of 8,700 Bottles Worldwide

TITLE: Isle of Arran Smugglers Series Vol.3 - The Exciseman Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The final chapter of our Smugglers Series concludes Arran's popular series which pays tribute to the exuberant character of those striving to outwit the Government’s representatives in the pursuit of the production of the famed Arran Waters. The Madeira casks used in this final volume, are similar to the ones utilized by Arran’s illicit distillers, who often stored and transported locally produced whisky in old Madeira casks brought over from the continent by their smuggling counterparts. The Quarter Casks are a nod to the type of small casks which would have been the easiest to transport. The resulting liquid is complex, full of character and a wonderful way to end a series which has so perfectly paid tribute to the independent characters of Arran over the centuries.

TITLE: Isle of Jura 10 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A core bottling from the Isle of Jura's only distillery. This 10 year old has exhibits the distillery's classic oily, briny characteristics.

TITLE: Isle of Jura Bourbon 24 yrs Island Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Located off Scotland’s western coast on the Isle of Jura, the island’s only distillery opened in 1810. After a massive renovation in the mid-1900s, the distillery was reopened in 1963 in hopes to boost the island’s economy. AGED: 24 years DISTILLED ON: December 17, 1989 BOTTLE ON: September 17, 2014 MATURED IN: Bourbon Barrel CASK NO: 30416 ALC: 54.9%

TITLE: Isle of Jura Superstition Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: 93 Beverage Testing Institute

TITLE: Isotta Manzoni Prosecco D.O.C.
DESCRIPTION: A light and fresh Prosecco that is an exceptional value! An excellent aperitif or cocktail mixer that is also a great match for a variety of dishes.

TITLE: Itami Onigoroshi Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Itami Onigoroshi is a refined sake from Itami, the historical birthplace of sake with more than 450 years of brewing tradition. It is pleasantly aromatic and ultra-dry.

TITLE: Iuli Barbera Umberta
Iwai Tradition Whisky "Aki" Finished in Napa Wine Casks
Iwai Tradition Whisky "Fuyu" Finished in Chestnut Casks
DESCRIPTION: Limited release blended Japanese whisky from Mars Shinshu in Nagano Iwai Tradition finished in Japanese chestnut casks for 4 months. Mash bill of 70% corn and 30% malted barley aged between 2–5 years in ex-bourbon, sherry, and American oak casks before finishing Brown sugar, maple syrup, and toasted grains on the nose, gentle tannin on the mid-palate lends structure to a rich maltiness. An elegant finish lingers long with notes of cacao. 40% ABV Release of 1152 bottles Chestnuts are a favorite cold-weather food in Japan, and this limited-edition Iwai Tradition release—entitled Fuyu which means “winter” in Japanese—celebrates this savory and highly seasonal treat.

TITLE: Iwai Tradition Wine Cask Finish Sommelier Series Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Iwai Tradition finished in Brewer Clifton Pinot Noir casks. The 2 pinot barrels were shipped from Lompoc to Nagano where they finished Iwai Tradition in the casks for 10 months. 1st in Sommelier Series. 601 bottles released.

TITLE: J&B Rare Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: It brings together 42 single malt and grain whiskies and carefully blends them to create a subtle, smooth and complex flavor. At the heart are malt whiskies from Speyside; they provide the fruity, fresh quality you can taste, and also give J&B its light color. Added to that are some of the finest grain whiskies Scotland has to offer. They help reveal the individual flavors of the various malts, unveiling the smooth character of J&B Rare. The unique blend makes it perfect for mixing

TITLE: J. Rieger & Co. Midwestern Dry Gin
DESCRIPTION: Inspired by the traditional London Dry Gins that famously emphasize the spicy and aromatic character of mature Juniper Berries. By selecting only the finest botanicals from around the world, the result is bold, full-flavored Gin with layers of aroma and a complexity of flavor that makes it perfect for sipping on the rocks or ideal for creative cocktails.

TITLE: J. Wray Jamaica Gold Rum
DESCRIPTION: Created by Jamaica’s number-one rum producer J. Wray & Nephew Ltd, award-winning J.Wray Jamaica Rum represents and celebrates the inviting attitude and warm, free-spirited energy found in this Caribbean nation. This distinctive Jamaican rum unlocks a new flavor experience for rum enthusiasts.

TITLE: J.F. Hadens Small Batch Citrus Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: 100% Florida Citrus Small batch craft liqueur Crafted in the USA 40 Proof Award-winning Each bottle is Batch and Bottle numbered. Only 3000 bottles are made per batch to keep the consistency of the flavor Product of Florida - the #1 state in the USA for citrus cultivation

TITLE: J.F. Hadens Small Batch Mango Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: Mangoes used in this product are picked at the peak of ripeness – when they taste most delicious. The sunset-hued skin and sweet, succulent fruit has a fruity aroma that fills the air in our Florida bottling facility. 100% Real Mango - no artificial flavors Small batch craft liqueur Crafted in the USA 40 Proof Award-winning Each bottle is Batch and Bottle numbered. Only 3000 bottles are made per batch to keep the consistency of the flavor Product of Florida - the #1 state in the USA for Mango cultivation

TITLE: J.P. Trodden Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: From producers: "Our taste is on the nose, bold, and rich with an inviting spiciness and caramel, oak, anise and stone fruit left on the palate. Since bourbon is a uniquely American Spirit, we take pride in the fact we have sourced our equipment from the US as well. From our copper alambic pot still made in Eugene, OR, to our oak barrels from Hodgenville, Kentucky, to our glass bottles made in Tennessee. Each small batch is hand crafted, from the milling of our exceptional local grains from a small family farm in Quincy, Washington to the careful attention in aging that creates our unique Spirit."

TITLE: Jack Daniel's "Twice Barreled " Special Release Tennessee Heritage Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Jack Daniel's Twice Barreled Special Release Heritage Barrel Rye Whiskey is a part of the Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Special Release series. This limited edition whiskey has a unique profile, crafted from a mashbill of 70% rye, 18% corn, and 12% malted barley. The whiskey undergoes charcoal mellowing before its first five years of aging in handmade American white oak barrels. It then undergoes a secondary two-year aging process in signature heritage barrels, which are lightly charred and heavily toasted to add depth and complexity to the flavor. The whiskey is bottled at 100 proof, offering a balance of sweet and spicy notes. The nose of the whiskey reveals rich scents of holiday spiced raisins, toasted oak, and hints of brown sugar with honey. The classic Jack Daniel’s banana note is also faintly present. On the palate, it presents an oak-forward profile with flavors of baking spices, dry cinnamon stick, light rye spice, hints of caramel, spiced raisins, and leather. The finish carries forward with dry oak and notes of dark dry raisins, light rye bread, baking spices, dry cinnamon powder, and leather. This special release is available only in the U.S. and is a celebration of the whiskey-making traditions of Jack Daniel's Distillery and the barrel-making expertise of their cooperage. It's considered to be well-suited for enthusiasts who appreciate a complex whiskey with a unique production method.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's 10 Years Old Tennessee Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Jack Daniel's 10 Years Old Tennessee Whiskey marks a significant milestone in the distillery's history, being the first age-stated whiskey from Jack Daniel's in over a century. This exquisite spirit has been aged for 10 years, experiencing the extreme weather variations in different locations of the barrel houses. This process, along with the craftsmanship of handmade oak barrels, imbues the whiskey with an intense and unique character. Celebrate modern day whiskey while honoring a rich history with every sip of this limited edition treasure. Embrace the legacy of America's oldest registered distillery, established in 1866, with this embodiment of craftsmanship and character. This special release is a testament to the distillery's enduring innovation and commitment to quality.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's 12 Years Old Tennessee Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Jack Daniel's 12-Year-Old Tennessee Whiskey represents a rare and exceptional addition to the Jack Daniel's lineage, blending tradition with meticulous craftsmanship. This whiskey has matured for 12 years, achieving an unparalleled depth of flavor and complexity. Master Distiller Chris Fletcher has evolved the distillery's whiskey process, introducing a whiskey with a unique flavor profile that both honors the heritage of Jack Daniel's and presents a modern, world-class spirit. With the release of batches in 2023 and 2024, this whiskey offers sweet and creamy notes of pipe tobacco, seasoned oak, and butterscotch, bottled at an impressive 107 proof​.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's 125th Anniversary of the Red Dog Saloon Tennessee Sour Mash Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Mr. Jack Daniel was a savvy entrepreneur and opened two bars in Lynchburg; The White Rabbit Saloon and the Red Dog Saloon — this was pre-Prohibition — and used them as his own version of focus groups to test out new whiskey varieties and get a feel for his market’s tastes. This limited edition release like the White Rabbit Saloon releases before it celebrates the Red Dog Saloon.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Barrel Proof Single Barrel Tennessee Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Experience the unparalleled craftsmanship of Jack Daniel's with the Barrel Proof Single Barrel Tennessee Rye Whiskey, a true embodiment of Tennessee's whiskey heritage. Meticulously crafted by the iconic Jack Daniel's distillery, this single barrel release showcases the rich and robust character of Tennessee Rye, offering enthusiasts an unfiltered and undiluted expression of the distiller's art.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Bonded Tennessee Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 97, #1 on Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 ListJack Daniel’s Bonded Tennessee Whiskey is Bottled-in-Bond, aged in select barrels for added depth and character. At 100 proof, the flavor delivers layered notes of caramel, rich oak, and spice, giving way to a pleasantly lingering finish. The Bottled-In-Bond Act (1897) stipulates that the whiskey must be: From a single distillery From one distilling season Bottled at 100 proof Aged in a federally bonded warehouse for at least four years (seasons to mature)

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Bonded Tennessee Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 97, #1 on Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 ListJack Daniel’s Bonded Tennessee Whiskey is Bottled-in-Bond, aged in select barrels for added depth and character. At 100 proof, the flavor delivers layered notes of caramel, rich oak, and spice, giving way to a pleasantly lingering finish. TITLE: Jack Daniel's Coy Hill Single Barrel Special Release Tennessee Whiskey 2024
DESCRIPTION: Jack Daniel's Coy Hill Single Barrel Special Release Tennessee Whiskey 2024 is a limited-edition expression that showcases the distillery's commitment to crafting exceptional high-proof whiskeys. Aged for nearly 11 years in the highest-elevation barrelhouses on Coy Hill, this whiskey is bottled at barrel strength, with proofs ranging from 122 to 137.5. The unique aging conditions impart a rich and complex flavor profile, making it a coveted addition for collectors and enthusiasts alike. This special release is crafted from Jack Daniel's traditional mash bill of 80% corn, 12% malted barley, and 8% rye, and undergoes the signature charcoal mellowing process before aging in new, charred American white oak barrels. The result is a whiskey that balances bold flavors with smoothness, embodying the essence of Jack Daniel's craftsmanship.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Family of Brands Gift Set
DESCRIPTION: This gift set contains Jack Daniel's most prized whiskies. These whiskies are the corner stone for the Jack Daniel's range and perfect for Jack Daniel's enthusiasts.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Gold Double Barreled Tennessee Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Originally launched as a limited-edition travel-retail exclusive, Jack Daniel's No.27 Gold gained a wider release in Autumn 2015. Initially matured in virgin American white oak casks, it's been finished in maple-wood barrels and twice filtered though maple-wood charcoal, it's rich with extra notes of maple.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Legacy Edition 1  Tennessee Sour Mash Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Jack Daniel’s is known for being a well-crafted, smooth sippin’ Tennessee Whiskey. You don’t last for over 150 years if you’re not a quality product, after all. We’ve become known for something else along the way too: our iconic black and white label. But what people may not know is that the history of our label wasn’t always so black and white. Some time before 1904 our bottles were a rather unexpected shade of green with an eye-catching gold trim. And as unusual as that may seem, it’s just one of the many labels in Old No. 7’s past. You have to be patient to make whiskey, and it seems that Jack took his time landing on the tried-and-true black label we know today. This is the first in our series of Legacy Edition Bottles. Each label we release will celebrate the unique, slightly mysterious history of Old No. 7.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Legacy Edition 2 Tennessee Sour Mash Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Jack Daniel's Legacy Edition 2 is the second bottling in the limited edition legacy series. It is reminiscent of an early 1900s era design. It's anchor and rope crest and black background speak to the quiet confidence and character of the Tennessee whiskey that rests within.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Sinatra Century Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Legendary singer and all around bad ass Frank Sinatra, had he still been alive today, would be closing in on his 100th birthday this year. Jack Daniel’s, aiming to celebrate this special birthday and at the same time pay homage to one of its most famous drinkers, is set to release what has to be one of its most prestigious, and expensive, whiskies ever in the form of Sinatra Century. Jack Daniel’s Sinatra Century is an extremely limited release drawn from just 100 barrels handpicked by master distiller Jeff Arnett. It was bottled at 100 proof and only 3000 1L bottles will be produced. It is also not to be confused with the already available Sinatra Select. This special Tennessee whiskey is housed in a slick collector’s box and includes with it both a hardbound tribute book about Sinatra and the whiskey as well as “a replica of Frank’s tie clip that contains a digital, never-before-released complete concert recording of Frank at his best, onstage at The Sands Hotel and Casino in 1966. (review by thewhiskeywash.com)

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Sinatra Select Tennessee Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Jack Daniel's Sinatra Select Tennessee Whiskey is a distinguished whiskey that pays homage to Frank Sinatra, the legendary American singer and entertainer. Matured in unique "Sinatra Barrels," which have deep grooves carved into their staves, the whiskey is exposed to extra layers of toasted oak, imparting a rich amber color, bold character, and a pleasant smokiness with a smooth vanilla finish.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Barrel Proof Tennessee Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: It’s whiskey as nature intended it—bottled straight from the barrel at its full proof. Intense, smooth, and remarkably varied, Barrel Proof is bottled at anywhere from 125 to 140-proof, taking Jack’s trademark vanilla and toasted oak flavors to bold new levels.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Special Release "Heritage Barrel" Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This release celebrates the early craftsmanship of the Jack Daniel Distillery. The whiskey is from uniquely crafted heavy-toast barrels and 100 proof barrel entry proof.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Special Release Barrel Proof Tennessee Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This annual special release Single Barrel Barrel Proof Rye celebrates the early craftsmanship of the Jack Daniel Distillery, honoring a time when American whiskey was often high in rye content and offered at barrel strength. Bottled in its purest form right from the barrel and uncut at full proof, it’s packed with Jack character with our signature smooth finish. Proof will range from 125-140.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Special Release Eric Church Whiskey 2018
DESCRIPTION: Eric Church’s Single Barrel Select edition is hand-selected by Master Distiller Jeff Arnett for a one-of-a-kind whiskey based on Eric’s taste. With muted notes of vanilla and caramel with lingering toasted oak on the finish.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Single Barrel Special Release Eric Church Whiskey 2021
DESCRIPTION: Eric Church’s Single Barrel Select edition is hand-selected by Master Distiller Jeff Arnett for a one-of-a-kind whiskey based on Eric’s taste. With muted notes of vanilla and caramel with lingering toasted oak on the finish.

TITLE: Jack Daniel's Tennessee Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: 70% RYE. 100% JACK.Introducing rye whiskey made Jack’s way. Crafted with the 70-percent rye grain bill, natural spring water from Cave Spring Hollow, and Jack’s time-honored charcoal mellowing process, Jack Daniel’s Tennessee Rye is a whiskey that could only come from Lynchburg, Tennessee. Master Distiller Jeff Arnett and the whiskey makers of the Jack Daniel Distillery have created a unique rye that’s undeniably spicy and complex yet sippin’ smooth. It might be one of their first new recipes in over 150-years, but if you know Jack, you’ll know Jack Daniel’s Tennessee Rye.

DESCRIPTION: Jack Daniel’s Triple Mash is a blend of Bonded American Malt, Rye, and Tennessee Whiskeys at 100 proof. TITLE: Jack Daniel's Twice Barreled Special Release American Single Malt Whiskey Oloroso Sherry Cask Finish
DESCRIPTION: The fifth annual special release is here - Jack Daniel’s Twice Barreled 2022 Special Release American Single Malt Whiskey finished in Oloroso Sherry Casks. This year’s special release celebrates a new grain bill from the Jack Daniel Distillery - 100% malted barley. This is a one-of-a-kind experience crafted from the highest quality malted barley, charcoal mellowed, and twice barreled for a complex taste. This special release is first aged in brand new, American white oak barrels and then finished in the finest Oloroso sherry casks and bottled in its truest form, straight from the cask, with the proof ranging from 106.1-107.8.

TITLE: Jack Daniels Single Barrel Barrel Proof Tennessee Whiskey

TITLE: Jack Daniel’s "The Sting" Single Barrel Tennessee Whiskey  The Prime Barrel Pick #91
DESCRIPTION: Take a trip back the memory lane to a memorable whiskey week with our Prime Barrel members in historic Lynchburg, Tennessee. This exclusive Jack Daniels barrel selection, known affectionately as "The Sting," captures the essence of our unique experience. A Day at Jack Daniels: Our adventure began with a VIP tour across the Jack Daniels campus, where we witnessed the creation of sugar maple charcoal—a vital element in the whiskey's mellowing process. We watched the slow filtration of whiskey through 10 feet of charcoal and explored the cave spring water source vital to the distillery since 1866. The highlight of our visit was in one of the older rickhouses, where we sampled directly from the barrels, each a contender in its own right, making the selection challenging yet thrilling. The Selection - "The Sting": Chosen from three exceptional barrels, "The Sting" stood out as the oldest and most robust, delivering an intensified Jack Daniels experience. At 127.5 proof, it offers a powerful nose and palate, concluding with a long, sweet finish. The name "The Sting" humorously reflects an incident with bees during our visit, adding a personal touch to this special selection. Taste and Legacy: Every sip of "The Sting" is a taste of Jack Daniels history, enhanced by the rich stories of our Lynchburg visit. This barrel captures not just the flavor but the spirit of camaraderie and adventure that defines our group’s experience. This selection is not just about savoring a high-quality whiskey; it's about reliving an unforgettable journey with every pour. Tasting Notes: Huge banana bomb on the nose that’s loaded with honey baked peanuts, toffee, sweet cream, bananas foster and tons of creamy, delicate sweetness. Rich and sweet on the palate, bananas foster returns once again with tons of complexity and character. Honey roasted peanuts, toffee, cocoa, sweet buttercream, vanilla bean, some graham cracker and a kiss of oak. Proof is very much in check, no proof punishment here. Long finish, thick with quintessential high proof JD notes: banana cream pie, cocoa, honey roasted nuts, butterscotch and big caramel. Killer barrel.

TITLE: Jack Daniel’s Barrel Proof "As Good As It Gets" Single Barrel Tennessee Rye Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #97
DESCRIPTION: As Good as It Gets epitomizes Jack Daniel’s craftsmanship, capturing the essence of a genuinely exceptional single-barrel barrel-proof rye. This limited edition selection, aptly named for its unparalleled quality, stands out with its unique aging process and the unforgettable experience it delivers. The Story: In our quest to find the perfect Jack Daniel’s Barrel Proof Rye, we embarked on a journey that led us to a truly unique discovery. During the selection process, we were given a rare opportunity to taste a rye aging in grooved barrels, normally reserved for the legendary Jack Daniel’s Sinatra expressions. The only problem? The Sinatra Rye line doesn’t exist—at least not yet! This “forbidden barrel” was quickly taken away, but we managed to keep a small sample as a reference. Using this exceptional rye as our benchmark, we tasted numerous barrels and, to our delight, found one that surpassed even the elusive forbidden barrel. Thus, As Good as It Gets was born, a moniker that perfectly encapsulates the unparalleled quality of this selection. Tasting Notes: Nose: The aromatic journey begins with a refreshing hint of spearmint intertwined with the delightful sweetness of burnt sugar, reminiscent of the perfectly caramelized top of a crème brûlée. Subtle layers of char add a smoky depth, setting the stage for the complex flavors to come. Palate: Prepare for a rollercoaster of flavors that excite and satisfy in every sip. The bold rye spice immediately takes center stage, followed by the earthy richness of tobacco and leather. Notes of oak char and the nutty, burnt sugar essence of pecan brittle add complexity, while baking spices and a surprising hint of cotton candy bring a delightful twist. Each sip offers a new layer, making this an adventure for your taste buds. Finish: The finish is long and lingering, ensuring the experience stays with you. It’s a never-ending finale of wood char that avoids any tannic bitterness, complemented by a refreshing spearmint note that ties it all together beautifully. Details: Proof: 132.9 Barrel #: 23-23639 Warehouse Location: 17-G-07 (#2) As Good as It Gets is more than just a bottle of rye; it’s a statement of excellence and a testament to the meticulous selection process. Whether you’re a seasoned connoisseur or new to the world of fine spirits, this exceptional expression promises to deliver an unforgettable tasting experience.
