TITLE: Joseph Magnus Trio of Whiskeys
DESCRIPTION: Includes these fantastic expressions: The latest batch of Joseph Magnus Cigar Blend Joseph Magnus Straight Bourbon Murray Hill Club Bourbon

TITLE: Joshua Brook Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Distilled in Kentucky, bottled by the "Frank-Lin Distillers" in California with 40 Vol%. Frank-Lin is a family-owned company based in San Jose, which does not distill their own whiskey.

TITLE: Joto Cup Sake
DESCRIPTION: The packaging of the Joto One Cup was designed by Japanese graffiti artist Shiro and made by Marumoto Brewery, which grows Yamada Nishiki, the most famous sake rice. Some of this sake is blended into this affordable, single-serving to give it a fruitier style. This sake is bursting with hints of green grape and juicy watermelon.

TITLE: Joto Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Rich and solid, hints of fruit and light acidity in finish.

TITLE: Journee De Mistral Cotes Du Ventoux Grenache
DESCRIPTION: The spice in Grenache makes it a perfect pairing buddy to spiced and herb foods including roasted meats, vegetables and many ethnic foods. Alcohol is a solvent to capsacin, which is the heat unit in spicy foods. A high-alcohol Grenache can help reduce the burn of spicy food.

TITLE: Juggernaut Hillside Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Steep hillside vineyards present the ultimate challenge. Mountainous terrain tests both the grower and the vine. But the results can be extraordinary. Hillside vineyards have less access to water, with the rockier soil also holding fewer nutrients. These conditions stress the vines, resulting in the production of a fraction of the fruit of most vineyards. The harsh environment causes the vines to struggle, yielding fewer clusters and smaller berry size. Since most of the flavor resides in the grape skins, the result is berries that are loaded with rich, ripe, intensely concentrated flavors and complexity. Hillside vineyards are special. So is the wine that is crafted from them.

TITLE: Julien Braud Forty Ounce Muscadet Sevre-et-Maine
DESCRIPTION: The grapes are sourced from a vineyard that is in the process of converting all farming to organic practices. The soils are worked to increase the biodiversity and its aeration. Julien is also practicing ‘de-budding’ in order to control the amount of leaves and increase the aeration of grapes. There is no use of synthetic products or other chemical treatment. Some biodynamic practices are helping to increase the balance and health of the vine (not certified), and Julien is doing plant decoction to make the vines stronger. Manual harvest is done in 10-15kg basket to avoid crushing of the grapes. Sorting is done in the vineyard. Gentle press and light settling before fermentation in respect to the terroir and vintage. Fermentation starts without exogenous yeasts or enzymes. Temperatures are kept low (between 18 and 20ºC) in order to keep the wine fresh. The wines are aged on lees until they are bottled in early March.

TITLE: Junta Winery Amigo Perro Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Pair with: Cheese (especially goat cheese) Green vegetables (asparagus, zucchini, fresh peas, artichokes) Oysters Delicate fish like sole Fresh herbs Mild vinaigrettes Dishes with tangy dairy ingredients Herbal, briny sauces

TITLE: Jurgen Leiner Riesling Trocken
Juve y Camps Brut Rose
DESCRIPTION: This Rose Brut is made from 100% Pinot Noir grapes that come from the newly acquired Feixa 1 vineyard on the historic Juve y Camps estate. The free run juice undergoes a cold-soak maceration followed by fermentation in stainless steel. The resulting wine blends the traditional methods of Juve y Camps with international flair and flavor.

TITLE: Juyondai "Bessen" Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: It is not too much of an overstatement to call Takagi Shuzo one of the most influential sake breweries in the world. In 1993 fifteenth generation owner Akitsuna Takagi took over the brewery at the age of 21 when he was still a student, learning the art of brewing on the job. This was at a time when few young brewers were entering the business, and Takagi set out to make a distinctive sake, one that fruit forward and vibrant as opposed to the light and dry style that was popular at the time. The resulting brand was Juyondai, literally “fourteenth generation” in honor of Takagi’s father calling attention to the long lineage of the family. Juyondai made an immediate impact, impressing the sake world with its ripe and bold character, quickly becoming one of the most sought after sake in the world. Takagi-san’s example has inspired an entire generation of younger brewers to take over their small family businesses and develop their own unique house styles without following national trends.

TITLE: JW Kelly Straight Whiskey Single Barrel Double Oaked Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Born and raised in the scenic city of Chattanooga TN, J.W. Kelly’s Original Single Barrel Bourbon was bottled at cask strength, creating a handmade style with its own unique flavors. Reborn in 2016, this unique single barrel, coming in at 109 proof, is hand bottled and double oaked. Every barrel is selected from barrels 5-8 years old. Once the barrel has been chosen, it is then transferred into a new American oak barrel and aged for another 8-12 months. Every barrel will be different and have its own personality. The benefit of a single barrel, fantastic taste, flavors, and an amazing surprise with every glass.

TITLE: Kaatskill Mountain Spirits Co. Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Kaatskill Mountain Spirits Co. Vodka is meticulously distilled using a time-honored process, resulting in a vodka that is pure and velvety on the palate. Each sip offers a glimpse into the craftsmanship and attention to detail that goes into creating this exceptional spirit.

TITLE: Kaiyo Whisky Japanese Mizunara Oak Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Delicate nose with vanilla, ripe dried fruit and hints of cherry, with a long lingering finish

TITLE: Kakurei Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Yamada Nishiki rice milled to 48%. Excellent enjoyed on its own or to complement light seafood dishes like grilled whitefish or raw oysters.

TITLE: Kakurei Umeshu Junmai Ginjo Plum Sake
DESCRIPTION: An extremely pretty example of a style that can tend to the cloyingly sweet, this is an elegant sake based umeshu. Made by soaking locally grown Koshino Ume plums in the Kakurei Junmai Ginjo for three months then adding naturally produced rock candy to balance the tartness of the fruit, and aged for two more years to marry the flavors.

TITLE: Kan Nihonkai Hiyaoroshi Junmai Sake
Kangakoi 7 Year Single Grain Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Kangakoi is a true samurai wearing ritual armor (from "kan"-meaning perfect, complete, whole). In Japan, only the warriors of pure spirit and perfect technique may wear the traditional armour of the samurai. This single grain, Kangakoi Japanese Whisky has been stored for seven years in Spanish sherry barrels that give a rich, mellow, fruity finish as well as a very beautiful and dark amber color.. 40%alc by vol.

TITLE: Kano Shuzo Jokigen Junmai Yamahai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Using mainly Gohyakumangoku, Yamda Nishiki and Miyama Nishiki, and the clean mountain melt Hakusen no Ido (water of Mt. Hakusen) they focus on sake of good quality. They have won several gold medals in sake competitions. Fun to drink at body temperature.

TITLE: Kaori Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Yamagata Honten was Established in 1875. In Tokuyama, a historical town of Shunan, the brewer has been creating unique sake culture and sending it to the world. They have a philosophy that firmly connect with their responsibility and price as a local brewery and their passion to fulfill the human heart. Flexibility and Creativity are what Yamagata Honten distinguishes themselves from others. Their flexibility allows them to meet the customers’ varied taste and expectation as well as being creative to encapsulate human idea and passion.

TITLE: Karim Vionnet Beaujolais Villages
DESCRIPTION: Born in Lyon to Arabic heritage, Karim was adopted by a family in Morgon, eventually working for 10 years as a vineyard-hand and winemaker for such luminaries as Guy Breton and Marcel Lapierre. Technically a negociant, owning no vineyards himself, Karim is responsible for the organic farming and vinification of 5 hectares of plots around Beaujolais, most of which comprise 40- to 60-year-old vines. To ensure that his wines can be safely made with a minimum of added sulphur (1g per hl.), Karim keeps his tanks airtight during fermentation and maturation, only releasing the carbon dioxide moments before bottling. He feels that this, coupled with careful natural temperature control, preserves the fruit and purity of his Gamay grapes.

TITLE: Karine Lauverjat Pouilly-Fume
DESCRIPTION: The Lauverjat family has been growing grapes in the Loire Valley for generations in the tiny village of Sury-en-Vaux. Husband-and-wife team Christian and Karine have 12-hectares of vines in Sancerre and Pouilly-Fume.

TITLE: Karuizawa 36 Views of Tokaido Kanaya No Fuji 1999-2000 Cask Strength Japanese Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This beautiful single malt whisky from the legendary Karuizawa Distillery makes up part of the sought-after 36 views series. It was created from 1999-2000 vintage liquid and exhibits a delectable range of tasting notes, from red berries, gentle spices, and rich oak to Christmas cake and subtle layers of vanilla. It’s an exceptional whisky that is highly collectible and sought after by whisky aficionados worldwide.

TITLE: Katlyn Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon
Katoukichibee Shouten "Born Gold" Junmai Daiginjo Sake
Kavalan 15th Anniversary Vintage 2009 ex-Bourbon Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Matured in hand-selected American ex-Bourbon barrels from the distillation year of 2009, this whisky unfolds as a delightfully complex single malt. Its flavor profile is intricately layered, featuring nuanced highlights of rich vanilla, an array of luscious tropical fruits, and a subtle yet distinct hint of coconut. Aged for over fifteen years, the whisky is presented non-chill-filtered and at cask strength, perfectly preserving its full, natural flavor profile and its rich, balanced character.

TITLE: Kavalan 15th Anniversary Vintage 2009 Oloroso Sherry Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Matured in an exceptional quality Oloroso Sherry cask from Spain's Sherry Triangle and hand-selected from the 2009 distillation year, this whisky offers a smooth and rich profile with a complex character. Each sip unveils a harmonious blend of dried fruits, rich nuttiness, and a bouquet of aromatic spices, all delicately laced with gentle whispers of marzipan and vanilla. Presented non-chill-filtered and at cask strength, the whisky retains a natural flavor profile, perfectly preserving its rich and fragrant essence.

TITLE: Kavalan Concertmaster Port Cask Finish Taiwanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Using Portuguese Ruby Port wine casks as the main flavor, Kavalan Concertmaster single malt whisky is the first matured in specially selected American oak casks and then finished in port barriques. The marrying in the barriques mellows the flavors and adds indefinable smoothness to the whisky. It is rich bodied with natural sweetness and complexity.

TITLE: Kavalan Concertmaster Sherry Cask Finish Single Malt Whisky Gift Set
DESCRIPTION: The Year of the Dragon symbolizes good fortune in Eastern culture. Kavalan embraces this auspicious occasion with a first-ever zodiac-inspired gift box design. Merging zodiac elements with the essence of Kavalan Winery, this unique offering brings a New Year greeting rich in Oriental tradition. Contents of the gift box: Kavalan Concertmaster Sherry Cask Finish Single Malt Whisky 80 proof (700ml), Kavalan Podium Single Malt Whiskey 92 Proof (50ml)

TITLE: Kavalan Distillery Reserve Brandy Cask Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Discover a captivating fusion of East meets West with the Kavalan Distillery Reserve Brandy Cask Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky. Nestled in the heart of Yilan County, Taiwan, Kavalan Distillery is renowned for its exceptional single malts, often drawing inspiration from international spirit traditions. With this unique expression, Kavalan has masterfully married its meticulous distillation techniques with the rich legacy of brandy maturation. Each bottle contains a spirit that has slumbered in former brandy casks, infusing the whisky with a spectrum of opulent flavors and an unparalleled depth. On the nose, anticipate an enchanting dance of tropical fruits, reminiscent of Taiwan's lush landscapes, intertwined with hints of velvety brandied notes. The palate is a journey through layers of caramelized fruit, warm oak, and a touch of spice, culminating in a lingering finish. Limited in its release and exceptional in its character, the Kavalan Distillery Reserve Brandy Cask Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky is a testament to Kavalan's innovative spirit and dedication to crafting world-class whiskies. An experience reserved for the discerning.

TITLE: Kavalan Distillery Reserve Madeira Cask Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Aromas of Madeira cake, raisins and roasted walnuts, leather, and roasted meats with a slightly chewy, vibrant, dryish full body and a hot, engaging, long coffee gelato, soft licorice, and ripe red apple finish. A flavor-packed indulgence.

TITLE: Kavalan Distillery Reserve Madeira Cask Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Aromas of Madeira cake, raisins and roasted walnuts, leather, and roasted meats with a slightly chewy, vibrant, dryish full body and a hot, engaging, long coffee gelato, soft licorice, and ripe red apple finish. A flavor-packed indulgence.

TITLE: Kavalan Distillery Reserve Peaty Cask Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Matured in rare, special and hand-select casks. Kavalan Distillery Reserve Single Malt Whisky was originally only offered exclusively at Kavalan Distillery and showrooms in limited quantity. However, in the world of global commerce we are delighted to bring this one stateside. The first release in the collection, Kavalan Single Malt Peaty Whisky is the very first peaty whisky from Kavalan. Retaining Kavalan's trademark subtropical fruit flavors and peerless texture, it will surprise and delight whisky connoisseurs.

TITLE: Kavalan Distillery Reserve Rum Cask Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A new release by Kavalan in December 2016 to commemorate its very successful first decade in the whisky business and the inauguration of a second distillery. This is also Kavalan's first whisky aged in rum casks. The sub-tropical climate of Taiwan, and the pure glacial water from the mountains have had a unique effect on Kavalan whisky matured in these rum casks.

TITLE: Kavalan ex-Bourbon Oak Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Kavalan Ex-Bourbon Oak Single Malt Whisky is a distinguished expression from Taiwan's Kavalan Distillery. This single malt whisky is matured exclusively in first-fill bourbon barrels, which impart a rich and complex character. Taiwan's tropical climate accelerates the aging process, resulting in a whisky that is mature beyond its years.

TITLE: Kavalan ex-Sherry Oak Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Kavalan Ex-Sherry Single Malt is a prestigious whisky crafted by the renowned Kavalan Distillery in Taiwan. This whisky is matured in carefully selected ex-sherry casks, which impart rich and complex flavors. The subtropical climate of Taiwan accelerates the aging process, creating a uniquely mature whisky despite its relatively young age.

TITLE: Kavalan King Car Conductor Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Kavalan King Car Conductor Single Malt Whisky is a premium expression from the Kavalan Distillery in Taiwan. This whisky is named after the King Car Group, the conglomerate that owns the distillery, and it is designed to showcase the diverse and rich flavors that Kavalan can produce. This whisky is bottled at 46% ABV without chill filtration and offers a bold and full-bodied profile.

TITLE: Kavalan Podium Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Kavalan Podium Single Malt Whisky is an exquisite representation of Taiwanese craftsmanship from the renowned Kavalan Distillery. Matured in a unique combination of new American oak casks and the distillery's own refill casks, Podium presents a harmonious blend of tradition and innovation. This single malt whisky encapsulates the essence of Taiwan, offering a rich, woody, and fruity profile that reflects the subtropical climate of the region.

TITLE: Kavalan Sherry Cask Strength Whisky US Release
DESCRIPTION: Matured in Spanish top quality oloroso sherry casks in special editions, Kavalan Sherry is bottled by hand at the distillery, without any colouring, chill-filtration. It is a naturally smooth and rich whisky with a complex character. It is clean and complex with multi-layers of dried fruit, nuttiness and spices with some marzipan and vanilla touches to it as well. Comes with gorgeous red leather tube. This is the US release of Kavalan "Solist" Cherry Cask Single Malt Cask Strength Whisky!

TITLE: Kavalan Solist Amontillado Sherry Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Amontillado is a kind of dry sherry which is darker than Fino but lighter than Oloroso, maturing with a cap of flor and then expose to the air for further oxidation due to the loss of flor. Toasted almond and hazelnut are the classic aromas for Amontillado casks.

TITLE: Kavalan Solist FIno Sherry Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky Gift Set
DESCRIPTION: The pinnacle of Kavalan's early production - a whisky matured in Fino sherry casks, rather than the usual darker sherry styles. Rich with more fresh fruit than you might expect from a sherried whisky.

TITLE: Kavalan Solist Manzanilla Sherry Cask Strength Single Malt Taiwanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Dark mahogany color. Attractive, nutty aromas and flavors of sweet wheat crackers with fig spread, salted peanut skins, bananas foster, and barbershop and marinated pimiento with an oily, dry-yet-fruity full body and a hot, layered, long geranium bed, burnt toast with chocolate spread, and black tea with bergamot finish. Big body and pleasing salinity shine in this Taiwanese Whiskey.

TITLE: Kavalan Solist Oloroso Sherry Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Matured in Spanish top quality oloroso sherry casks in special editions, Kavalan Solist Sherry is bottled at the distillery, without any coloring or chill-filtration. It is a naturally smooth and rich whisky with a complex character. It is clean and complex with multi-layers of dried fruit, nuttiness and spices with some marzipan and vanilla touches to it as well.

TITLE: Kavalan Solist Oloroso Sherry Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky Gift Set
DESCRIPTION: Matured in Spanish top quality oloroso sherry casks in special editions, Kavalan Solist Sherry is bottled at the distillery, without any coloring or chill-filtration. It is a naturally smooth and rich whisky with a complex character. It is clean and complex with multi-layers of dried fruit, nuttiness and spices with some marzipan and vanilla touches to it as well.

TITLE: Kavalan Solist Port Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Port is a Portuguese fortified wine that is robust and sweet with a fuller and richer body. It is therefore usually served as a dessert wine or digestif. Kavalan Solist Port Cask is fully matured in Portuguese Port barriques under the subtropical climate to create the multiple fruity flavors such as plum, blueberry, blackberry, and strawberry just to name a few, with chocolate as the main background note.

TITLE: Kavalan Solist PX Sherry Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: PX Sherry is one of Kavalan whisky's classic collection. The new make spirit matured in the PX sherry casks produces our uniquely special character and flavor with classic fruity, nutty and chocolate aromas.

TITLE: Kavalan Solist Rum Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky Gift Box
DESCRIPTION: The Kavalan Solist Rum Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky is a unique expression crafted by Kavalan's Master Blender, Ian Chang. The whisky has matured in a previously held rum cask, imparting a distinct complexity, balance, and poise. This whisky offers a rich profile with a nose of butterscotch, brown sugar, orange peel, and vanilla, evolving into cherries, candied peels, and white pepper spice on the palate. Bottled at a cask strength of 57.1% ABV, it allows the addition of water to enrich the profile with dark chocolate, ginger, oak, gentle fruits, brown sugar, and creamy.Contents of the gift box: Kavalan Solist Rum Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky, 101.6 Proof (700ml), Kavalan Port Cask Single Malt Whisky 108 Proof (50ml)

TITLE: Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Vinho is fully matured in used American oak wine barrels that have been toasted and in a way that brings out fruity vanilla notes from the and wood overlaid on a delicate background of complex fruitiness. It has a complex and multi-dimensional background of pepper, spice, dates and other fruits, such as ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of citrus fruits burst.

TITLE: Kavalan Solist Vinho Barrique Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky Gift Set
DESCRIPTION: Vinho is fully matured in used American oak wine barrels that have been toasted and recharred in a way that brings out fruity vanilla notes from the whisky and wood overlaid on a delicate background of complex fruitiness. It has a complex and multi-dimensional background of pepper, spice, dates and other fruits, such as ripe melon and mango together with kiwi and a delicate blend of citrus fruits burst.

TITLE: Kavalan Triple Sherry Cask Single Malt Whisky Gift Set
DESCRIPTION: Kavalan Triple Sherry Cask Single Malt Whisky is an exceptional Taiwanese whisky, matured in a unique combination of three different sherry casks: Oloroso, Pedro Ximénez, and Moscatel. This luxurious spirit is distilled at the renowned Kavalan Distillery, nestled in the picturesque Yilan County, surrounded by the Central and Xueshan Mountains. Using volcanic rock-filtered water, rich in minerals, lends this whisky its distinctive character. The silver lines below the bottle's cork pay homage to these mountains, underlining Kavalan's deep connection to its local environment. Contents of the gift box: Kavalan Triple Sherry Cask Single Malt Whisky 80 proof (700ml), Kavalan Wine Barrel Single Malt Whiskey 108 Proof (50ml)

TITLE: Kawatsuru Sake Brewing "Crane of Paradise" Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Located on the beautiful island of Shikoku, Kawatsuru Brewery pays repect to the river crane that symbolizes longevity and good fortune. The brewery was established in 1891. The rice they uses is grown on their estate surrounding the brewery. The Toji or brew master is a woman named Miki Fujioka. She is serious, soft-spoken, and incredibly hardworking. Try with Pizza with prosciutto/speck or smoked salmon with cream cheese.

TITLE: Kelby James Russell Dry Rose
DESCRIPTION: Fresh and balanced, the medium-bodied palate is driven by red berry fruits with another sprinkling of pepper and woodsy, savory spice. A bit of red apple peeks through on the medium-short finish, which also shows a bit of river rock minerality.

TITLE: Keltis Zan Red
DESCRIPTION: Region: Bizeljsko Grape: Zametna Crnina, Kraljevina, Blaufränkisch, 20% local white grapes Vineyard Size: 5 hectares Soil: clay, limestone Average Age of Vines: 14-35 years Farming: organic Harvest: by hand Winemaking: separate, spontaneous fermentation in stainless steel with indigenous yeasts Aging: in stainless steel Fining: none Filtration: none Added S02: 5 mg/L

TITLE: Keltis Zan White
DESCRIPTION: Vineyards of the Keltis wine cellar encompass 5 hectares of land and stretch over the south and south-western positions as well as northern slopes of the Bizeljsko area. Western winds blowing from neighboring Orlica take care of the ventilation and are our natural ally in the fight against diseases. Soil composition includes marl, sandstone with quartz binder, clay, Lithuanian limestone, and limestone with the application of chert. Vine varieties: autochthonous rumeni plavec (used in sparkling wines because it gives the wine freshness and character), cabernet sauvignon, chardonnay, merlot, Pinot noir, ottonel muscat, Riesling, yellow muscat, pinot gris, and traminer.

TITLE: Kenbishi Kuromatsu Honjozo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Kenbishi is known as the first sake brewery to be branded in Japan. In days of old, Kenbishi was very popular sake enjoyed by samurai. On the eve of major military battles, a large Kenbishi barrel would be ceremoniously opened. It was believed that sake strengthened the bonds of friendship and established strong loyalty in upcoming battles. "Kuromatsu" is not just any typical Honjozo style sake. Medium dry body with beautiful fragrance and viscosity on the palate, lingering and dense. It shows the characteristics and distinctive flavor of Kenbishi.

TITLE: Kentucky Owl "St. Patrick's Limited Edition" Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Features Kentucky straight bourbons aged 4 to 11 years, with some rich caramel notes and vanilla from rare older bourbons; spice and fruit from higher rye bourbons; and sweetness and citrus from wheated bourbons. Blending collaboration between KY Owl’s John Rhea and J.J. Cory Irish Whiskey’s Louise McGuane Used barrels of this limited ed Bourbon will later age J.J. Cory Irish Whiskey 6,500 cases 100 Proof

TITLE: Kentucky Owl "The Wiseman American" Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Wiseman™ Bourbon is an artful balance of soft wheat and spicy high-rye that provides a smooth but complex bourbon designed to drink neat, on the rocks or in a cocktail, said John Rhea, Kentucky Owl Master Blender.

TITLE: Kentucky Owl 10 Years Small Batch Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Kentucky Owl Rye Batch No. 4, nicknamed “The Last Rye,” is 112.8-proof. It’s a blend of rye stocks aged 10-to-13 years that together bring a taste of rich oak, roasted almonds, caramel brittle, and spiced dark cherry. The Last Rye Batch No. 4 is the final release in this series, bottling some of the last stocks of their rye blend in inventory that have continued to mature until the blend is at its peak. It truly marks the end of an amazing journey for Kentucky Owl since the first rye release in 2017.

TITLE: Kentucky Owl 10 Years Small Batch Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey Batch#3
DESCRIPTION: Rye #3 is crafted with the same tradition and attention to detail as each of the batches of Kentucky Owl bourbon and rye that came before it. Batch #3 features citrus, orange juice, grapefruit, oak, anise, and barbeque spice on the nose. The combination of barrel sweetness, caramel candy, creamy vanilla, toffee, and hazelnut coat the palate before moving into a finish of licorice, absinthe, nutmeg, and a mild flash of cayenne pepper.

TITLE: Kentucky Owl 11 Years Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey 1
DESCRIPTION: The nose on this rye has elements of sweet pine, honey, nougat, vanilla, cloves, and lavender. Oaky undertones, subtle cedar saw dust or fresh split cedar. Rich in consistency and not forwardly spicy on the nose. It immediately coats the entire palate and nutmeg and cinnamon give way to pepper spice with vanilla on the front and anise across the middle. Subtle cinnamon spice clings to the finish

TITLE: Kentucky Owl 11 Years Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey 2
DESCRIPTION: The nose on this rye has elements of sweet pine, honey, nougat, vanilla, cloves, and lavender. Oaky undertones, subtle cedar saw dust or fresh split cedar. Rich in consistency and not forwardly spicy on the nose. It immediately coats the entire palate and nutmeg and cinnamon give way to pepper spice with vanilla on the front and anise across the middle. Subtle cinnamon spice clings to the finish

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Confiscated Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Confiscated is a well-done bourbon with a flavor profile that suggests careful blending. It has a nice flavor profile bringing more depth and complexity than average bourbon.

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Dry State Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Kentucky Owl Dry State is the biggest, boldest, and best they’ve produced yet… and that’s really saying something. The original Kentucky Owl Whiskey was made by Charles Mortimer Dedman in the late 1800s. After every drop of this “Wise Man’s Whiskey” in inventory was, ahem… "confiscated" by federal agents under mysterious circumstances at the start of Prohibition, the C.M. Dedman Distillery faded into history. But just a few years ago his great-great-grandson — Dixon Dedman — revived the brand, creating the Kentucky Owl Bourbons and Ryes as small-batch, super-premium spirit blends. Following last years enthusiastic reception of the Kentucky Owl "Confiscated" release, the good folks at Kentucky Owl Distillery have assembled another EXTREMELY limited edition in a similar vein to mark the 100th anniversary of Prohibition — which came into force in 1920 — transforming the US into a "Dry State." They have pulled a handful of their best casks and assembled them into a sweet, caramel dram worthy of such an austere event. And it is bottle just below the barrel-proof level at 57.5% ABV.

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey Aged 11 Years Finished in Bayou Mardi Gras XO Casks
DESCRIPTION: Kentucky Owl Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey Aged 11 Years Finished in Bayou Mardi Gras XO Casks is a rare and innovative expression that combines Kentucky Owl’s expert rye whiskey production with the vibrant flavors imparted by Bayou Mardi Gras XO casks. Aged for 11 years, this rye whiskey is finished in ex-rum barrels from the Bayou distillery, adding rich sweetness and complexity. Bottled at cask strength, this limited-edition release offers an extraordinary balance of spice, sweetness, and depth, making it a unique and bold choice for whiskey enthusiasts who appreciate adventurous finishes.

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Maighstir Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: The Kentucky Owl Maighstir Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a unique blend crafted by Master Blender Maureen Robinson in collaboration with John Rhea. Robinson, a veteran of the spirits conglomerate Diageo, brings her expertise from blending renowned Scotch brands like Johnnie Walker to this premium craft bourbon. The Maighstir Edition is a harmonious blend of 4, 5, 8, and 9 year-old bourbons, offering the floral and citrus notes reminiscent of Scotch, yet retaining the classic bourbon characteristics. This limited edition release is a testament to Kentucky Owl's dedication to bridging the world of bourbon and Scotch, delivering a sophisticated and nuanced experience for enthusiasts.

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Batch 1
DESCRIPTION: Released September 2014 5 Barrels reintroduced to Charred New American White Oak at 4 years old (Char 2, Char 3, Char 4, Char 5, Char 6). Bottle Release: 1250 Bottles 118.4 Proof / 59.2 % Alcohol By Volume

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Batch 10
DESCRIPTION: Kentucky whiskey brand Kentucky Owl is known in certain bourbon circles for the collectibility of this particular whiskey type. They are now onto batch 10 of this, releasing at the same time the last batch of their rye whiskey. The new Kentucky Owl Bourbon Batch No. 10 is a blend of their oldest, oakiest, and most precious barrels combined with more youthful, fruity, and spice-driven selections. It is bottled at a hearty 120.2 proof

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Batch 11
DESCRIPTION: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Batch 11 is a remarkable release from the highly esteemed Kentucky Owl brand, known for crafting limited-edition, high-proof bourbons with bold character. Batch 11 continues this legacy with a blend of well-aged bourbons, offering a rich and complex flavor profile that delivers both intensity and depth. Bottled at a 118.8, this batch is designed for bourbon enthusiasts who seek a full-bodied, flavorful experience. The result is a perfectly balanced, robust whiskey that reflects Kentucky Owl’s commitment to producing some of the finest bourbons available.

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Batch 12
DESCRIPTION: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Batch 12 is a highly anticipated release from the esteemed Kentucky Owl brand, known for crafting limited-edition, high-quality bourbons. Batch 12 continues the legacy with meticulously blended bourbon that delivers a robust and complex flavor profile. It is blended utilizing very particular well aged, bold bourbons. 7-14 year old bourbons are blended with two different 4 year old bourbons to create this unique blend.Bottled at a proof typically ranging from 115-120, this batch showcases the brand's dedication to rich, bold flavors and exceptional craftsmanship. With a blend of well-aged bourbons, Kentucky Owl Batch 12 offers a unique tasting experience, making it a sought-after release for collectors and bourbon enthusiasts alike.

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Batch 2
DESCRIPTION: Released September 2015 6 Barrels reintroduced to Charred New American White Oak at 4 years old (3 Char 4, 3 Char 5) Bottle Release: 1360 Bottles 117.2 Proof / 58.6 % Alcohol By Volume

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Batch 3
DESCRIPTION: Single Barrel (Blue Ink) Released December 2015 Reintroduced to New American White Oak at 2 years old (Char 4) Bottle Release: 206 Bottles 107.8 Proof / 53.9% Alcohol By Volume

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Batch 4
DESCRIPTION: Single Barrel (Red Ink) Released December 2015 Reintroduced to New American Whit Oak at 2 years old (Char 4) Bottle Release: 212 Bottles 116.8 Proof / 58.4 % Alcohol By Volume

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Batch 5
DESCRIPTION: Single Barrel (Green Ink) Released December 2015 Reintroduced to New American White Oak at 2 years old (Char 4) Bottle Release: 194 Bottles 108 Proof / 54 % Alcohol By Volume

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Batch 6
DESCRIPTION: 8 Barrels reintroduced to Charred New American White Oak at 2-4 years old, average age 8-11 years Bottle Release: 1634 Bottles 111.2 Proof / 55.6 % Alcohol By Volume

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Batch 7
DESCRIPTION: 15 Barrels, 4 Barrels 8-9 Years Old, Introduced To New Charred Oak At Year 2, 11 Barrels 13+ Years Old Bottles: 2,535 118 Proof / 59% Alcohol By Volume

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Batch 8
DESCRIPTION: Heavily reliant on the Char 5 and Char 6 barrels for a full-flavored, spicy bourbon. Rich in consistency, and a blast of cinnamon on the finish. Baking spices and pine across the middle. The nose reminds you of a cinnamon disk candy.

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Batch 9
DESCRIPTION: The new Kentucky Owl Bourbon Batch #9is master blender Dixon Dedman’s highest-proof batch to-date at 127.6 proof (63.8% ABV). It is made with four different distillates from four different mash bills, including a 15-year old, two different lots of 14-year old, a 12-year old, a seven-year-old and a six-year-old distillate.

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Straight Bourbon Set Batches 1-8
DESCRIPTION: Complete set of rare Kentucky Owl bourbon line. Batches 1 through 7 included. Does NOT include Kentucky Owl Rye Batches

TITLE: Kentucky Owl Takumi Limited Release Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Kentucky Owl Takumi Limited Release Bourbon Whiskey is a remarkable collaboration between Kentucky Owl and a master blender from Japan, resulting in a fusion of American and Japanese whiskey-making traditions. "Takumi" means "master" in Japanese, and this limited-edition release exemplifies the craftsmanship and artistry that both whiskey cultures bring to the table. Bottled at 100 proof, the Takumi bourbon delivers a rich and complex profile that blends Kentucky's bold flavors with the elegance and refinement of Japanese whisky. This unique release is perfect for collectors and enthusiasts who appreciate a harmonious balance of tradition and innovation in their whiskey.

TITLE: Kentucky Vintage Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Kentucky Vintage Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a classic expression from the heart of bourbon country, produced by the esteemed Willett Distillery in Kentucky. This small-batch bourbon is crafted with care, offering a smooth and balanced profile that reflects the tradition and expertise of its makers. Bottled at 90 proof, Kentucky Vintage is approachable yet full of character, making it a perfect choice for seasoned bourbon enthusiasts and those new to the spirit. Whether sipped neat, on the rocks, or in a favorite cocktail, this bourbon delivers a taste of Kentucky’s rich whiskey heritage.

TITLE: Kermit Lynch Cotes du Rhone Rouge
DESCRIPTION: At KLWM, this label retains the title of their best value in red. They offer it in the spirit of the great “bistro wines” you would drink by the carafe in Europe with simple yet satisfying food, and be swept away by the joy of it all. 60% Grenache, 20% Syrah, 16% Carignan, 3% Mourvèdre, 1% Cinsault (2010 vintage) This old-school Cotes du Rhone will be extremely flexible at the table, pairing well with just about anything.

TITLE: Kessler-Zink Riesling Halbtrocken
DESCRIPTION: Delicacy and a mineral-inflected fruitiness are the hallmarks of fine, off-dry Rieslings. Their elegant style and absolute purity of flavor make them excellent partners for modern cooking that emphasizes high-quality, fresh ingredients. Spicy Asian/fusion cuisine, smoked fish and salty cheeses are excellent matchups for these qualities of semi-dry sweet Rieslings. Pairing ideas: Lemongrass chicken, crab cakes, roasted meats with pan sauce, dishes with acidic sauces such as beurre blanc, pumpkin ravioli, roasted vegetables, white-rind soft cheeses.

TITLE: Ketel One Vodka

Here, the 4Fs – Fragrance, Flavor, Feel and Finish – help to define what makes Ketel One Vodka so unique.

TITLE: Kewin Descombes Beaujolais Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Only 3% of Beaujolais is planted to Chardonnay, making Beaujolais Blanc something you really don't see every day; and a good example of it even fewer and further between. Here's one from Keke Descombes that isn't just a good example, but a superb one.

TITLE: Ki One Virgin American Oak Korean Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The wait is over—Three Societies’ inaugural full-sized single malt whisky release has arrived! Aged entirely in new American oak, Batch 1 confidently displays the fruit- and spice-driven style of malt of Korea’s first single malt distillery. Aromas of rich oak, vanilla, passion fruit, and cinnamon with a soft, spicy palate bursting with peach, banana, and buttery caramel Single malt whiskey produced by Three Societies in Namyangju, South Korea Minimum 100-hour fermentation in stainless steel Twice distilled in Forsyths copper pot stills Non-age statement; aged 2 years and 2 months in new American oak barrels Gold medalist at the 2023 San Francisco World Spirits Competition No added coloring Non-chill filtered; 40% ABV

TITLE: Kiamichi x Willett 5 Year Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The 5-year rye whiskey is cask strength and comes in at a peppy 108 proof after the 12-barrel blend of both Willett rye mash bills is aged in 24-month cured oak barrels. On the nose, it's woody, with notes reminiscent of cologne and a subtle honey sweetness. Dive in, and the first taste plays up that honey quality, with the finish moving more in the direction of vanilla before leaving a slight, not-unpleasant oily taste and texture on the gums. Limited run of 2,780 bottles

TITLE: Kiffe Vin Rouge
Kikori Japanese Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Distilled in Japan, and made from 100% rice, Kikori Whiskey is a smooth and welcome newcomer to the whiskey category. Aged for 3+ years in American Oak, French Limousin oak and Sherry casks, Kikori is golden and pure in color with a floral and fragrant aroma and a velvety smoothness to the palate. Kikori Whiskey is pure water, quality ingredients, careful aging, meticulous blending and Japanese attention to detail-all combined to perfection. At 82 proof, Kikori delivers a distinctively different style of whiskey that is memorable, delicate and delicious.

TITLE: Kiku Masamune Futsushu Cup Sake
DESCRIPTION: This brewery has been brewing sake for nearly 400 years and is a favorite of the emperor's family.

TITLE: Kiku-Masamune Junmai Taru Sake
DESCRIPTION: This sake complements a wide array of Japanese and Western cuisine, including spicy dishes and foods with rich, full-bodied flavors.

TITLE: Kiku-Masamune Junmai Taru Sake Cup
DESCRIPTION: Before bottling, this sake is stored in casks made from high-quality Japanese cedar. The result is a sake with a crisp, dry flavor and the pleasant hint of Japanese cedar.

TITLE: Kiku-Masamune Kahogura Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Product information This brewery has been brewing sake for nearly 400 years and is a favorite of the emperor's family Their superbly balanced Junmai Daiginjo is distinguished by slight, soft sweetness and elegant fragrance; a smooth finish; and an understated, mellow aftertaste. Producer information Kiku-Masamune Sake Brewing was founded in 1659, when Japan was ruled by Ietsuna, the fourth Tokugawa shogun. The Kano family built a sake brewery at their residence and began large-scale brewing operations. Kiku-Masamune remains committed to this single-minded pursuit of dryness. Kikumasamume sake has been brewed using the same Kimoto method since the Edo period.

TITLE: Kiku-Masamune Kimoto Junmai Daiginjo Sake

TITLE: Kiku-Masamune Kimoto Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Established over 350 years ago, Kiku-Masamune takes their status as a representative brand of Authentic Dry Sake very seriously, and their mission is clear. As stated in their famous 1983 commercial, "As your eyes fall upon good food, you begin to crave Kiku-Masa. As the dryness of Kiku-Masa hits your tongue, you begin to crave good food". Their history is steeped in the image of Dry Sake one enjoys with a meal, and to that end Kiku-Masamune utilizes their multiple facilities across Japan to create the ideal sake that one will never tire of drinking. Sashimi, Vinegared Dishes or Pickles

TITLE: Kiku-Masamune Kinushiro Junmai Nigori Sake
DESCRIPTION: Smooth as silk, Kinushiro Junmai Nigori's attractive cobalt blue bottle with flowers fluttering in the background perfectly foreshadows the contents of this beverage. It has elegant flavor, velvety and creamy texture yet soft and airy on the palate.

TITLE: Kiku-Masamune Koujo Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Kiku-Masamune Koujo Junmai is something out of the ordinary in contrast to other typical junmai Sake from Kiku-Masamune brewery. Koujo Junmai is brewed using the brewer's newly invented original yeast, Kikumasa HA14. This new yeast brings out the fruity Ginjo characteristics without milling the rice to Ginjo standards.

TITLE: Kiku-Masamune Koujo Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Kiku-Masamune Koujo Junmai is something out of the ordinary in contrast to other typical junmai Sake from Kiku-Masamune brewery. TITLE: Kikuisami 36 Samurai Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Approximately 900 years ago, a family built a golden capital in the northeastern part of Japan. Their prosperity lasted 100 years until they were destroyed by the central government. In the war, 36 samurai and one princess escaped and settled in Sakata City in Yamagata Prefecture. The descendants of the 36 samurai established the coastal trade in Sakata City, the location of Kikuisami Co., Ltd. The port of Sakata grew to become one of the biggest ports in Japan in the latter half of the 17th century. The "36 SAMURAI" brand was created to honor their achievement.

TITLE: Kikusui Junmai Cup Sake
Kikusui Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: This Junmai sake has a very rich flavor. WHen you warm up this sake, its strong flavor and aroma are enhanced. If you chill this sake, you can enjoy its dryness and crisp taste.

TITLE: Kikusui Organic Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: With 130 years of history on their shoulders, the Kikusui Sake Company of Niigata prefecture built themselves up from the bottom. The name "Kikusui" is a reference to a Noh theatre play, wherein the dew (Sui) from the petals of chrysanthemums (Kiku) grant eternal life. In 2004 they established the Kikusui Sake Research Institute in an effort to both raise the bar on the quality of their offerings and wrestle with concepts such as enjoyment of sake, and sake culture. They are proud to produce "Funaguchi" - Japan's first commercially available Nama (unpasteurized) sake. Fresh Seafood, Roasted Vegetables

DESCRIPTION: With 130 years of history on their shoulders, the Kikusui Sake Company of Niigata prefecture built themselves up from the bottom. TITLE: Kikusui Perfect Snow Unfiltered Sake
DESCRIPTION: Kikusui Perfect Snow – The king of Nigori Sake. From the birthplace, Japan’s top Nigori Sake (unfiltered sake) brewer, Kikusui. Now available in the US.

TITLE: Kikusui Perfect Snow Unfiltered Sake

TITLE: Kikusui Shuzo Funaguchi Honjozo Sake Can
DESCRIPTION: Product information Funaguchi is a genuine sake (unpasteurized). It is a rich, dense sake that is absolutely delicious. With a hint of sweetness combined with being full-bodied, this all-time favorite pairs well with numerous rich dises, and especially well with spicy dishes.

TITLE: Kikusui Shuzo Funaguchi Honjozo Sake Can
DESCRIPTION: Product information Funaguchi is a genuine sake (unpasteurized). It is a rich, dense sake that is absolutely delicious. With a hint of sweetness combined with being full-bodied, this all-time favorite pairs well with numerous rich dises, and especially well with spicy dishes.

TITLE: Kikusui Shuzo Funaguchi Jukusei Ginjo Genshu Nama Sake Can
DESCRIPTION: Founded in 1881, making it a relatively young brewery, Kikusui is still run by the same family under the current 5th generation President. Over the years Kikusui has endured many trials including securing rice for brewing, labour shortages and drops in sales in the harsh post-war years. However, the biggest challenges came in the form of the Niigata Earthquake in 1964 then the Kaetsu Flood of 1966 and 1967 where for two consecutive years the brewery was destroyed and washed away. Even in the face of such adversity Kikusui has always remained committed to the pursuit of producing the highest quality Sake which people can enjoy drinking. As drinking preferences change with the times so is Kikusui developing new products so that our customers can continue to enjoy the highest quality Sake, that is both affordable and easy to drink. From humble beginnings Kikusui has remained true to their vision of creating Sake that can be enjoyed by more and more people. It will pair nicely with rich, heavy dishes, namely spicier dishes from Southeast Asia.

TITLE: Kikusui Shuzo Funaguchi Shinmai Shinshu Honjozo Sake Can
DESCRIPTION: Limited-edition, highly sought after Funaguchi series in a can. The green Funaguchi is newly brewed sake made only with newly harvested, locally grown Niigata rice. Packed with sweet, fresh rice aroma and crisp, bouncy freshness.

TITLE: Kikusui Shuzo Junmai Ginjo Hiya-Oroshi
DESCRIPTION: Elegant rich, yet mellow flavors that linger comfortably on the palate. This Junmai Ginjo is specially brewed to be enjoyed on long Autumn nights. We brew this Sake with the freshest harvest rice during the coldest winter days. It is then left in the tank to mature slowly until next Autumn and shipped without the usual 2nd pasteurization process, this is where the name, “Hiya Oroshi” or “cold shipping”, comes from. This is done to allow this Sake to maintain the superb flavor gained from the long slow maturation period.

TITLE: Kikusui Shuzo Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Special brew using 100% highly-polished Gohyakumangoku sake rice, which is fermented over a long period of time at a low temperature. You can enjoy the fragrance and rich savor special to Kikusui's pure rice sake, as well as its lightness and smoothness.

TITLE: Kikusui Shuzo Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Special brew using 100% highly-polished Gohyakumangoku sake rice, which is fermented over a long period of time at a low temperature. You can enjoy the fragrance and rich savor special to Kikusui's pure rice sake, as well as its lightness and smoothness.

TITLE: Kikusui Shuzo Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Special brew using 100% highly-polished Gohyakumangoku sake rice, which is fermented over a long period of time at a low temperature. You can enjoy the fragrance and rich savor special to Kikusui's pure rice sake, as well as its lightness and smoothness.

TITLE: Kikusui Shuzo Kunko Funaguchi Sake Can
DESCRIPTION: A premium limited edition Funaguchi. This Funaguchi is spiked with single-distilled shochu made from Kikusui Sake lees. Kunko Funaguchi Kikusi is full bodied and rich with flavor, noted with its distinctive noble aroma and Umami.

TITLE: Kilbeggan Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Among 2020's strong field of new single pot still releases, Kilbeggan bottled a gem of an Irish whiskey that sparkled brighter than them all. The already historic whiskey style achieves a powerful air of authenticity. First, it’s distilled in the oldest working pot still in Ireland, and the 19th-century Locke family recipe incorporates 2.5% oats, a common addition at the time. Melon, candied peel, nutmeg, cinnamon, and honeysuckle aromas cascade into a palate made especially lush and creamy from the oats, with citrus peel, apricot, and roasted hazelnut flavors leading to a mellow, rounded finish, adeptly exhibiting a crisp articulation of pot still spiciness throughout

TITLE: Kilkerran 12 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The original Springbank whisky has been distilled legally on the site of the present distillery since 1828, and probably illicitly since well before then! Known and loved amongst whisky enthusiasts the world over, Springbank is produced using lightly-peated barley and a unique two-and-a-half-times distillation. This gives the whisky a character all of its own, making it stand out as a must-have dram on anyone's shelf. Produced using the most traditional of production techniques, from floor malting all the way through to the bottling stage, Springbank can best be described as a "hand-made" single malt.

TITLE: Kilkerran 16 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Kilkerran 16 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a testament to traditional Campbeltown whisky-making. Produced by Glengyle Distillery, one of the few remaining in the region, this single malt captures the essence of the peninsula’s maritime influence. Matured in a combination of 96% ex-bourbon and 4% Marsala wine casks, this whisky offers a unique complexity and depth, making it the oldest release from the distillery to date. Without chill filtration or added coloring, Kilkerran 16 preserves the authentic character and rich history of Campbeltown malts.

TITLE: Kilkerran 8 Year Old Bourbon Cask Matured Scotch Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Kilkerran 8 Year Old Bourbon Cask Matured Scotch Single Malt is an exemplary offering from Glengyle Distillery, one of the oldest operating distilleries in Campbeltown, Scotland. Reflecting the traditional craftsmanship of Scottish whisky making, this single malt scotch is matured for eight years in bourbon casks, allowing the whisky to acquire unique characteristics that distinguish it among others in its category. The use of bourbon casks provides a distinctive sweet and creamy profile, adding to the complexity of the single malt. The Kilkerran 8 Year Old Bourbon Cask Matured Scotch Single Malt pairs beautifully with various dishes. Its sweet and fruity profile complements smoked or grilled seafood, and its depth and complexity make it a great companion to meaty dishes such as steak or roasted lamb. As for dessert, it pairs well with rich creamy pastries or a cheese platter with a mix of creamy and sharp cheeses. To enjoy its full range of flavors, consider savoring the Kilkerran 8 Year Old neat or with a splash of water.

TITLE: Kilkerran Cask Strenght 8 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This release is matured in sherry casks and bottled without chill-filtration to keep as much of the whisky's character intact. It's a rich and gently smoky dram, with balanced sweetness and fruit.

TITLE: Kilkerran Heavily Peated Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The most recent batch of this fully peated, cask strength whisky continues to show the potential of this still youthful distillery, with deep roots, and Campbeltown Whisky in general. Very limited edition.

TITLE: Kilkerran Heavily Peated Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The most recent batch of this fully peated, cask strength whisky continues to show the potential of this still youthful distillery, with deep roots, and Campbeltown Whisky in general. Very limited edition.

TITLE: Kilkerran Heavily Peated Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The most recent batch of this fully peated, cask strength whisky continues to show the potential of this still youthful distillery, with deep roots, and Campbeltown Whisky in general. Very limited edition.

TITLE: Kilkerran Work In Progress Bourbon Wood Scotch Single Malt
DESCRIPTION: A long-awaited ten year old release from Glengyle distillery, released as part of the Kilkerran Work in Progress series. This is the bourbon-aged expression and shows just how well the spirit is maturing. Nose: This is evidently a Campbeltown dram. The waxy, lightly smoky nose with hints of leather gives away the origin of this dram. Rich and creamy with hints of American cream soda, apricots, dark fruit and linseed. Palate: Just like previous WIPs the tangy orange and citrus marmalade notes remains. A little bit sweeter than previous WIP releases, with clear presence of apricot jam. There is a great weight of Campbeltown sea air present. Very smooth and fruity. Finish: Fresh, sweet yet dry finish. Age: 10 Year Old Proof: 108.6

TITLE: Kilkerran Work In Progress Sherry Wood Scotch Single Malt
DESCRIPTION: Nose: Who’s chocolate orange is this? Dark chocolate, marzipan, honey covered dates and strawberries build up to a very rich and sweet ginger preserve. A very complex nose that doesn’t stop developing in the glass. Palate: The honey covered dates return on the palate mixed with sultanas and black treacle fudge. This dram is as wholesome and tasty as a warm, toasted cinnamon and raisin bagel with real butter melting on top. Finish: Medium, well balanced and round finish, presence of dark chocolate but surprisingly no evidence of peat. Proof: 92

TITLE: Kiminoi "Emperor's Well" Yamahai Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: A unique Junmai Daiginjo with character and presence made from Yamada Nishiki rice milled down to 40% and fermented in the Yamahai method for body.

TITLE: Kiminoi "Emperor's Well" Yamahai Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Made from local Gohyaku Mangoku rice milled to 58% and by the traditional and time consuming Yamahai method which imparts a fuller and more complex structure and pronounced acidity.

TITLE: Kinclaith Hogshead 35 yrs Lowland Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Single malt whisky from Kinclaith is extremely rare and highly sought after. Built to provide malt whisky for the Long John blend, the distillery was only in operation for 18 years, between 1957 an 1975, before being demolished in 1982. This is a very rare Lowland single cask whisky. It was distilled on the May 28th, 1969 and matured in cask number 301446 for 35 years before bottling on April 4, 2005 by Signatory. Part of a release of just 219 cask strength decanter bottles and comes with Silent Stills Luxury Wood Gift Box Certificate. TITLE: King Of Kentucky Bourbon 2021
DESCRIPTION: 2021's release is no different than past releases in terms of Brown-Forman knocking it out of the park. The nose is the show's star, providing a depth that few bourbons can match. It’s full of rich flavors and depth that utilize every one of the 14 years the bourbon spent in a barrel to its advantage. The palate is nearly as delectable, highlighting various spices and fruits, with its 130-proof punching through and reminding you of its presence throughout. Finally, the sip ends with a dry flavor profile encapsulated with an ever-present heat. King of Kentucky 2022 comes in two different batches. The first is the regular King of Kentucky release, a 15-year-old bourbon bottled at 130.6 proof. (which is what we have) The barrels pulled for this release yielded a combined 3,500 bottles. A second batch, labeled with gold trim, marks the 5th anniversary of the revived brand. This one is 18 years old, bottled at 130.3 proof, and had a production run of just 250 or so. The bottle we have is the regular, 15-year-old version.

TITLE: Kings County Distillery "5 1/2 Wheats" Barrel Strength Wheated Bourbon The Prime Barrel Pick #7
DESCRIPTION: You could say that The Prime Barrel's 7th selection is a strategic one of sorts. Besides having made a selection with Kings County earlier this year and getting an overwhelmingly positive response to it, we already knew that the quality would be there. However, knowing that the selection will show up at our doors around Memorial Day, we wanted to pick something with a lighter profile, which would make the perfect choice for summer sipping. When Kings County Distillery informed us that they had only a couple of Wheated barrels available for selection, we jumped at the opportunity. It is essential to mention that we were making a selection out of 4 barrels that were presented to us: 3 straight bourbon barrels and one wheated. We knew we'd be biased towards wheated one, so we did this selection blind, meaning we did not know what we were tasting until we picked the winner. The 5.5 years wheated bourbon easily had the most complex yet super enjoyable profile, even at the barrel strength. It has a sweeter and smoother profile than all the straight bourbons we tasted (those were good too, by the way). For the "tater" sticker theme, we went with 9 1/2 Weeks movie parody, partially because it was set in Brooklyn and partly because of the 5 1/2 age of the barrel. The yield on this is super limited. We only have 40 750ml size bottles and 12 200ml size bottles available. Cheers, and we hope you enjoy this one over the summer!

DESCRIPTION: Discover the story behind Empire Rye, a unique nod to New York's whiskey tradition. TITLE: Kings County Distillery 6 Year Old ”Kings of New York” Barrel Strength Bourbon The Prime Barrel Pick #17
DESCRIPTION: The Prime Barrel's 17th selection this year is a fortuitous one. We've gotten into a habit of checking with our favorite producers every so often about anything special they might have up their sleeves. Having done 4(!) barrel picks with Kings County Distillery this year alone (and 5 in total), it's pretty apparent they fall into our "favorite producers" category. It's easy to see why. They are local, run by great people, use iconic packaging, and, most importantly, produce outstanding whiskey. So when we called them late in November, to our surprise, they had a lineup of barrels for us to pick from that we were not expecting. And as it is with all things that are meant to be, the process came together quickly, and the result is one fantastic selection. So what makes this selection different from other KCD selections, you ask? First off, this is a 6.5-year-old barrel-strength whiskey that came from a 53-gallon barrel. Most KCD barrels are short barrels, but not this one. That and of itself, that's not all that impressive. However, the angel share of this barrel was super high, and the barrel produced only 86 750-ml bottles bottled at eye-watering 66.9% Proof. That's coming dangerously close to the hazmat status. The mashbill of the barrel consists of 80% organic NY State corn and 20% English malted barley. Here's what you can expect from this barrel: Nose: Caramel, bitter chocolate, dried dates, pecan pralines, and sea spray. Palate: Oaky, saline, and savory upfront with subtle hints of espresso bean, burnt sugar, and cinnamon on the mid-palate. Finish: Long and spicy with lingering notes of Sichuan peppercorn. For the sticker theme, we went with a nod to the distillery's, and the county's in which it is located name (Kings) with a play on "Gangs of New York" movie (yes, that's Bill the Butcher on the sticker) that was set not far away from the distillery itself, Brooklyn's Redhook neighborhood. Taken all together - "Kings," nod to the "red" in "Redhook," and our love to the distillery ("heart") - we ended up with the Kings Of Heart card theme. We love how the sticker came out and hope you will as well. The charity this barrel selection will be supporting is the New York area food bank. We've helped several different charities that are important to our members. Given the timing, it's only appropriate we give back to the community in which we operate for this particular selection. So $5 from each bottle will go to local food banks.

The port-wine sweetness and maple-like texture stand up well to the cask-proof abv of 70%, but with water added, additional notes of cherries jubilee, brown sugar, dark chocolate, and fig present, while leather and anise predominate a lengthy finish. DESCRIPTION: Our latest release of Honey Moonshine is a collaboration with Big Dipper Apiaries, with much of the honey sourced from the Naval Cemetery Landscape right here in the Brooklyn Navy Yard. Unlike several commercial honey whiskeys on the market, ours has the real taste of organic honey infused in our sipping-friendly moonshine. We recommend shaking this bottle before consuming as the honey can concentrate toward the bottom over time. It doesn’t get any more local, collaborative, and delicious. Below are some fun facts about the honey used to make this moonshine from Danielle Knott, the owner Big Dipper Apiaries: This honey was foraged/collected by bees within a three mile radius of the Brooklyn Navy Yard, so it's considered to be hyper local. It’s a combination of mostly spring honey with some later fall honey mixed in. The floral notes of spring honey come through while the fall honey brings some golden richness, as later harvests tend to have deeper tasting notes. Danielle practices certified naturally grown beekeeping, meaning her hives are managed without the use of toxic inorganic chemicals. AKA happy and healthy bees, with no traces of inorganic compounds in the honey.

TITLE: Kings County Distillery Blender's Reserve
DESCRIPTION: This release is a 7-year straight bourbon pulled from one of every size barrel we have aging (5,10, 15, 30, and 53), showing that both large and small barrels can blend together harmoniously. Out of 51 7-year barrels in consideration, this blend of whiskey is from just five barrels and includes that last 5-gallon bourbon barrel from Kings County, making this blend irreplicable. This whiskey articulates the very best of our pot-still expression with several qualities of “super-aged” commercial offerings—those double-digit Kentucky whiskeys that are impossible to find. A nose of integrated oak, ripe vine fruits, leather, and malted vanilla opens into a layered palate of dried berry, baker’s chocolate, and winter spice, while an emerging note of tobacco leaf leads to a robust, oak-forward finish. With a small amount of water added, additional caramels and browned oak sugars emerge. Bottled at cask strength, this year’s Blender’s Reserve release is an encapsulation of Ryan and Nathan’s ongoing exploration of the complex relationship between age, cask size, and flavor profile through thoughtful blending. A total of 269 bottles were produced.

TITLE: Kings County Distillery Bottled-in-Bond 7 Years Old Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Discover the epitome of American Whiskey craftsmanship with Kings County Bottled-in-Bond 7-Year Bourbon. As one of the pioneers in the craft distilling industry, Kings County Distillery brings you a whiskey that adheres to the highest standards of the Bottled-in-Bond Act. What is Bottled-in-Bond? Bottled-in-Bond is a prestigious designation for American whiskeys and some brandies. To qualify, the whiskey must be: Distilled, aged, and bottled at one distillery. Produced by one distiller in one distilling season. Aged for a minimum of four years. Bottled at precisely 100 proof. This designation was originally introduced to protect consumers from adulterated spirits and ensures a transparent whiskey-making process. About Kings County Batch 13 Batch 13 is a meticulously crafted 7-year bourbon, featuring Kings County's signature high-malt, 2-ingredient mash bill. This extremely limited release is composed of only the finest two 53-gallon barrels from the Spring 2017 distilling season, making it the most exclusive annual Bottled-in-Bond release to date. Awards and Accolades San Francisco World Spirits Competition: Best-in-Category (Small Batch Bourbon under 5 years), Double Gold (2020 & 2017). International Whisky Competition: Best American Whisky, Best Bourbon, Best Small Batch Bourbon, Best Bourbon 4+ Years, Gold (4) 2017. ADI: Silver 2017. ACSA: Gold 2020, Bronze 2017. Great American Spirits Competition: Gold, 2020. Experience the exceptional quality and heritage of Kings County Bottled-in-Bond 7-Year Bourbon - Batch 13. Secure your bottle today and savor the taste of true American whiskey craftsmanship.

DESCRIPTION: What is Peated Bourbon? It’s bourbon whiskey that conforms to the American requirements for bourbon but is made with malted barley that has been exposed to peat smoke, a practice more common in Scotch whiskies—the malt we use for the peated bourbon was even grown and kilned in Scotland. So it’s a hybrid whiskey of the two traditions, flavorful and robust from having aged in a new barrel, with an added light smoky finish reminiscent of single-malt. If scotch and bourbon had a baby, this is what it would taste like. As far as we can tell, this was the world’s first-ever peated bourbon and will appeal to the adventurous whiskey traveler who has tried everything.

TITLE: Kings County Distillery Peated Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: If peat gives bourbon gives a little complexity to a familiar product, a hint of peat sends rye whiskey into strange and beautiful territory. This is one of the most unusual whiskeys we’ve made, with the peat showing more forward and the funky rye backbone that drinks a little like a pungent old scotch, despite being a young American whiskey.

TITLE: Kings County Distillery Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Single Malt Whiskey is made almost entirely like a single malt scotch—except that instead of being made in Scotland, it’s made here in Brooklyn. Kings County Distillery’s single malt whiskey is open-fermented off the grain from malted barley (with a hint of peat) sourced from England and Scotland. The whiskey is twice distilled in traditional Scottish pot stills, then aged in our own used bourbon barrels anywhere from 1.5 to 4 years. With a higher post-cask strength than our American-style offerings, this whiskey warranted a higher bottling strength—47%—and so it is more potent than its palate would suggest. Dry and sophisticated, it is an elegant whiskey with notes of honey, hay, burnt orange peel, and peat. It is a perfect addition to your shelves.

TITLE: Kings County Distillery Spiced “flavored” Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Winter Spice Whiskey is this year's fall seasonal release. Kings County created an infusion of baking spices associated with mulled cider, hot toddies, and winter holidays. Using cinnamon, cardamom, nutmeg, allspice, black peppercorns, clove, and star anise, this whiskey is a bold but balanced answer to some of the cinnamon-flavored offerings from bigger distilleries that aim for a broader audience. Perfect for cocktails that like a spicy cinnamon kick, this whiskey is designed for crisp, cool weather.

TITLE: Kings County Distillery Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Kings County Distillery’s Straight Bourbon is made from New York State 80% organic corn and 20% English malted barley, is twice distilled in copper pot stills and then aged in new charred oak barrels. Rich in caramel, vanilla, and holiday spice, this bottle is cited frequently in lists of best non-Kentucky bourbons. Aged for at least two years, this is a precocious whiskey, surprisingly robust for its age.

TITLE: Kings County Distillery Straight Empire Rye Whiskey 750ml  #9
DESCRIPTION: The Barrel Strength Empire Rye Batch #9 has arrived! After last year's successful release, this fan-favorite rye whiskey is back with even more complexity and depth. Crafted with in-state grown grain and distilled in New York, this Empire Rye embodies the rich heritage and bold flavors that have made this style of whiskey highly sought-after. Batch #9 has earned accolades, including Double Gold from the San Francisco World Spirits Awards and Best Rye Whiskey at Tales of the Cocktail. This barrel-strength expression offers dark fruit, fig, and date notes balanced by black pepper, maple, and clove. Empire Rye is a specific style of rye whiskey unique to New York State. It features a high rye content for those who appreciate a full-bodied, spicy whiskey. With nearly 70% of rye whiskey in the U.S. originating from a single distillery in Indiana, this Empire Rye offers a refreshing alternative, showcasing the craftsmanship and diversity of New York distillers. Available in limited quantities, this Barrel Strength Empire Rye Batch #9 is an excellent addition to any whiskey collection. Shop now to experience a bold, award-winning rye whiskey that represents the best of New York’s Empire Rye tradition.

TITLE: Kings County Distillery Strawberry Ginger Moonshine
DESCRIPTION: Kings County Distillery is New York City’s oldest and premier craft distillery. Founded in 2010, Kings County hand makes whiskey out of the 115-year-old Paymaster Building in the Brooklyn Navy Yard, using New York grain and traditional distilling equipment to make distinctive spirits. Strawberry- Ginger Moonshine is our new seasonal whiskey! To create this, our head blender, Ryan, infused two tanks of moonshine, one with halved strawberries and the other with sliced ginger, then carefully blended them together to create our lovely pink spirit.

TITLE: Kings County Distillery Whiskey Gift Set  (Empire Rye/Bottled in Bond Bourbon/Barrel Strength Bourbon)
DESCRIPTION: This natural wooden box with an image of the Kings County Distillery burned on top contains 200 ml bottles of the Bottled-In-Bond Bourbon, Empire Rye and Barrel Strength Bourbon whiskey.

TITLE: Kings County Distillery Whiskey Gift Set (Bourbon/Blended Bourbon/Single Barrel)
DESCRIPTION: This natural wooden box with an image of the Kings County Distillery burned on top contains 200 ml bottles of the Bourbon, Blended Bourbon and Single Barrel bourbon Whiskey.

TITLE: Kings County Distillery Whiskey Gift Set (Coffee Whiskey/Blended Bourbon/Bourbon)
DESCRIPTION: This natural wooden box with an image of the Kings County Distillery burned on top contains 200 ml bottles of the moonshine, bourbon, and chocolate whiskey.

TITLE: Kings County Distillery “Do The Right King” Private Barrel Bourbon The Prime Barrel Pick x Mash & Journey Pick
DESCRIPTION: Introducing "Do The Right King" Private Barrel Bourbon, an exceptional blend crafted in collaboration with the Mash & Journey Whiskey Club and The Prime Barrel. This unique selection brings together the expertise and passion of some of the most distinguished palates in the whiskey community, resulting in a bourbon that is as distinctive as it is delicious. Tasting Notes: Nose: A rich bouquet of dark fruits, complemented by notes of cinnamon and vanilla cream, invites you in. Palate: A bold explosion of flavors dominated by brown sugar and dark fruit, with traditional notes of vanilla and cream also present. Traditional whiskey enthusiasts will appreciate the deep character, while the adventurous will delight in its unique complexity. Finish: Exceptionally long, leaving a lingering impression of sweetness and spice that begs for another sip. The Selection Journey: Selected with the esteemed Mash & Journey Whiskey Club, this bourbon results from an intense and collaborative tasting session. Jason, co-founder of the club and host of the popular "Mash & Drum" YouTube channel, joined forces with The Prime Barrel members and their co-founder, Michael, along with Scott and Colin, the owner of Kings County Distillery. The panel tasted through five private blends, each with the opportunity to taste them separately and even "blend the blends" to discover the perfect harmony. This is a pioneering selection for Kings County, marking the first time they picked from a ready-made blend rather than a single barrel. The diverse palates on the panel ensured a comprehensive evaluation. While Scott leaned towards traditional, bold, oak-heavy notes, Michael, Jason, and other Prime Barrel members sought something uniquely representative of Kings County's signature style. After blind tasting and rigorous debate, they settled on a blend that stands apart from previous single barrels, delivering a rich and singularly captivating bourbon. Barrel Details: Barrel: 53 gallon Cooperage/Char: ISC #4 Warehouse: "C" Entry Proof: 116 proof Bottling Proof: 128 proof Bottling Date: 5/22/2024 Age: 5 years, 248 days Élevage Additions: 6 & 7

TITLE: Kings Ridge Pinot Gris
DESCRIPTION: The Kings Ridge Pinot Gris is to make a more richly textured white wine with lush acidity. Carefully choose vineyards in cool parts of the Willamette Valley that have significant daily temperature swings. This helps to give ripeness and concentration to the fruit while preserving freshness and vibrant acidity. The harvest of Pinot Gris vineyards in the cool early morning, and then gently press the whole clusters to coax the juice through the skins of the grapes. The Pinot Gris juice undergoes a long, cool fermentation in stainless steel tanks. The resulting wine is aged on its lees to build weight and body, and is bottled in late winter to preserve the delicate aromatics. Go fresh. Pinot Gris with its zesty and refeshing acidity pairs really well with fresh vegetables, raw fish and lighter meals. Fish and shellfish are classic pairing partners with Pinot Gris. Need some ideas? Try ceviche, sushi, moule-frites, or even light flaky tilapia with cream sauce. Pinot Gris from the US and Australia can stand up to richer dishes (like cream) because of their body and often heightened alcohol level . Try not to go too spicy with your seasonings unless you have a bottle of Alsace Pinot Gris close by. Fish & Meat Pairings - Fish including Tilapia, Scallops, Sea Bass, Perch, Sole, Haddock, Trout, Cod, Redfish, Halibut, Snapper, Mussels, Clams, Oysters. White meats including Chicken and Turkey. Cured/spiced meats made from pork and duck. Spices and Herbs - Parsley, Mint, Tarragon, Thyme, Fennel, Chives, and Spices including White Pepper, Coriander, Fennel, Turmeric, Saffron, Ginger, Cinnamon, Clove, Allspice Cheese Pairings - Look for semi-soft to firm cow’s and sheep’s milk cheeses. Gruyere, Muenster, Grana Padano Vegetables & Vegetarian Fare - Fresh vegetables and salads as well as braised and well-spiced greens. Use shallot, garlic and ginger as a flavor base. Cucumber, yellow squash, celery, onion, parsnip, jicama, kale, green apple, green melon, white beans, cauliflower, broccoli

TITLE: King’s Family Distillery Toasted Amburana Ryeconic Twice Barreled Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This is a double-oaked ryeconic aged at least 7 years that was infused with toasted amburana chips, using a mesh bag to steep the chips inside the barrel for at least two weeks before bottling.

TITLE: Kinoene Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: They have been making sake in Chiba prefecture for 300 years, combining tradition and art with technology. Kinoene Masamune participates in the community as well by contributing to tourism, and develops & sells confections and sake-related goods to enrich local culture and commerce. Sea Bream Carpaccio, Seafood Gratin, Cream Chowders, Yakitori, Boiled Peanuts.

TITLE: Kinpou Shizenshu Yamahai Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: In 1967, Niida-Honke began producing its all natural Kinpou line using 100% Shizenmai rice, cultivated on their 600 acre property without the use of any pesticides or chemical fertilizers. By 2009, 98% of the rice utilized by Niida-Honke was Shizenmai rice.

TITLE: Kintaro Mugi Roasted Barley Shochu
DESCRIPTION: A number of shochus available in the US use roasted grains to impart unique flavor characteristics. Beniotome tastes surprisingly like black (roasted) sesame ice cream (without the sugar) while Towari uses a similar approach to soba (buckwheat). Roasted sweet potato shochus also exist, but haven’t reached our shores. They’re definitely an acquired taste. Kintaro manages to do this and yet retain depth of character often lost with the overt roasted flavors. Wonderfully pairs with Yakitori and fried Chicken.

TITLE: Kirinzan "Kagayaki" Daiginjo Genshu Sake
DESCRIPTION: Elegant and delicate, the Kirinzan Daiginjo Genshu contains multitudes of flavor.

TITLE: Kirinzan "Potari Potari" Nama Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: A beautifully vibrant and rich unpasteurized ‘nama’ sake from Kirinzan, made from Gohyaku Mangoku rice polished to 55%.

TITLE: Kirinzan Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: A masterpiece of the classic Niigata “light and dry” style, the Kirinzan Junmai Daiginjo is reminiscent of a clear mountain stream, dry, intense and balanced. Locally grown Gohyaku Mangoku rice milled to 45% of original size by master brewer Yoshiaki Hasegawa.

TITLE: Kirinzan Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Chilled or warm, pair this with dishes like braised pork belly, stuffed mushrooms or a hearty nabe stew. Local Niigata Gohyaku Mangoku rice milled to 55%.

They use Gohyaku Mangoku and Koshi Ibuki sake rice polished to 65%, beyond requirements for even the premium honjozo grade. Excellent both chilled or gently warmed.
