TITLE: Klinker Brick Winery Farrah Lodi Syrah
DESCRIPTION: Steve and Lori Felton, the owner of Klinker Brick Winery are 5th generation farmers. Their vines are primarily old vine Zinfandel and are planted along the Lodi Mokelumne River region and in the Clements Foothills. For over a century, the family has sold their premium, old vine fruit to benchmark Zinfandel producers until 2000 when Steve and Lori founded Klinker Brick Winery in Lodi, CA. The 250 acre estate is planted on sandy loam soils with vines that range from 35-110 years old and are head-trained and dry farmed. The vineyards is divided into fifteen blocks, with an average yield is 2-3.5 tons per acre; the older parcels yield as little as .25 tons per acre. Steve and Lori also a small 16 acre parcel called Farrah which is planted to Syrah. Although the Feltons continue to make wine from all of the vineyard blocks, only the best fruit is used for Klinker Brick and their single vineyard wines. Estate-grown Syrah from the Farrah vineyard was aged for 15 months in French oak. Enjoy with grilled meats or mushroom risotto.

TITLE: Knob Creek "Bourbon Judge" 6 Year Old Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This is a bourbon drinker rye. From the nose, there’s a fine balance of sweetness and spice, followed by a ton of oak and caramel. Let’s not forget the pepper and a smidge of cinnamon. This pour is unique, and the nose matches the palate. The long and crisp finish will surprise you with hints of orange peel. A must-try when looking for a top-of-the-line rye whiskey!

TITLE: Knob Creek "Get Rye Tonight" 6 Year Old Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #47
DESCRIPTION: One of the barrels from our summer 2022 #barrelpickingexpedition has been truly a team effort. 7 members of the club helped with the selection, and you can see a small video of the process here. The barrel was aged for 6 years and was bottled at 115 Proof. Nose: butterscotch, cereal, orange pith, lemon verbena, vanilla Palate: pepper, dark chocolate, cinnamon, nutmeg Finish: long with notes of cinnamon and toast $5 from each bottle sold from this barrel will be donated to Food Bank For NYC charity. It's become a Christmas tradition for us to donate to a local charity working to end food poverty in our city's five boroughs since 1983.

TITLE: Knob Creek "I’m Your Bourbon Man" 9 Year Old Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #46
DESCRIPTION: One of the barrels from our summer 2022 #barrelpickingexpedition has been indeed, a team effort. Seven club members helped with the selection; you can see a small video of the process here. The barrel was aged 9 years on the 6th floor of Warehouse Z (located higher on the hill at the property) and bottled at 120 Proof. Nose: maple syrup, cherry pie, rhubarb, toasted marshmallow, cigar box Palate: cracked vanilla bean, creme brulee, toast, candied orange, dates Finish: long finish with hints of citrus and cinnamon $5 from each bottle sold from this barrel will be donated to Food Bank For NYC charity. TITLE: Knob Creek 100 Proof Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Undeniably big, full flavor that strikes your senses with a maple sugar aroma, distinctive sweetness, and a rich, woody, caramel flavor. Bottled at 100 proof, it's aged in the deepest charred American Oak barrels. Make a bolder classic cocktail or sip it neat.

TITLE: Knob Creek 100 Proof Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Undeniably big, full flavor that strikes your senses with a maple sugar aroma, distinctive sweetness, and a rich, woody, caramel flavor. Bottled at 100 proof, it's aged in the deepest charred American Oak barrels. Make a bolder classic cocktail or sip it neat.

TITLE: Knob Creek 12 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Until now, most Knob Creek has been bottled at 9 years of age or younger for good reason: There’s no guarantee that bourbon will taste good after a dozen years in the barrel—let alone great. This one is richly complex from the start: York Peppermint Pattie, raisins, baking spice, dark chocolate-covered cherries, iced tea, and tobacco barn appear on the nose, followed by a chewy, full palate laden with cinnamon, allspice, and ginger, and perfectly balanced with sweet berry cobbler, chocolate ganache, and caramel. The finish goes on and on. Add in a fair price and excellent availability as part of Knob Creek’s core lineup, and only one question remains: What are you waiting for?

TITLE: Knob Creek 15 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This latest expression, Knob Creek 15 Year Old, is a Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey that has been aged for 15 years. It has aromas of caramelized oak followed by hints of sweet vanilla and baking spices. The palate is smooth caramel and toffee notes paired with toasted oak and light leather

TITLE: Knob Creek 18 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in a premium whiskey experience with Knob Creek 18 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey. This limited-edition release celebrates uncompromising craftsmanship, embodying a rich heritage of bourbon-making at its finest. Aged for 18 long years in Kentucky rack houses, this bourbon has acquired a beautiful dark bronze color, symbolizing the maturity and complexity it has garnered over the years. Knob Creek's 18-Year-Old bourbon is a testament to patience and tradition, aged twice as long as its flagship bourbon. This extended maturation imparts deep notes of caramelized oak, enriched with sweet vanilla and a blend of baking spices, creating a full-bodied well-rounded, sophisticated, and comforting flavor profile.

TITLE: Knob Creek 2015 Belmont Stakes Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This special bottle of nine-year-old bourbon commemorates the 2015 Belmont Stakes, in which American Pharaoh has crowned the first Triple Crown winner in over 35 years. Noticeably dark color, with an aroma of oak, caramel, cherries, and sour peach candy. The palate is filled with notes of fresh toast, maple syrup, and beer nuts, and leads to a long, smooth finish with just a bit of a bite.

TITLE: Knob Creek 25th Anniversary Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: 25 years ago Jim Beam Master Distiller Booker Noe helped change the bourbon landscape with the release of Knob Creek bourbon. Knob helped usher in a small batch movement that continues to this day. To celebrate the anniversary of this important release, the folks at Beam are releasing a limited edition, unfiltered, cask strength, single barrel version of Knob Creek. It was aged for 12-13 years, and the proof ranges between 120-125. Since it's a single barrel release, there are slight nuances and variations with each barrel. The bottles arrive in a sharp, wooden box that features a unique label, including a handwritten bottling date and proof.

TITLE: Knob Creek 9 Years Single Barrel Reserve Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Knob Creek 9 Years Single Barrel Reserve is a premium expression of Kentucky Straight Bourbon, delivering a robust and deep flavor profile. Distilled and aged by Jim Beam at the Knob Creek Distillery in Clermont, Kentucky, this bourbon is renowned for its rich, full-bodied character. Aged for nine years, it is bottled at a potent 120-proof, offering an intense and rewarding sipping experience. This whiskey stands out for its unblended singularity, each bottle hailing from a handpicked barrel to ensure a unique flavor profile.

TITLE: Knob Creek Cask Strength Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This is the first Limited Edition Rye released under the Knob Creek brand. While the label does not say “straight,” Beam Suntory has confirmed that it is. While it does not technically have an age statement, the press materials indicate it is 9 years old. This is further substantiated by the label indicating it was barreled in 2009.

TITLE: Knob Creek Cask Strength Rye Whiskey 127
DESCRIPTION: This is the first Limited Edition Rye released under the Knob Creek brand. While the label does not say “straight,” Beam Suntory has confirmed that it is. While it does not technically have an age statement, the press materials indicate it is 9 years old. This is further substantiated by the label indicating it was barreled in 2009.

TITLE: Knob Creek Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Knob Creek Straight Rye Whiskey is made with a blend of the finest quality rye to create an extraordinarily smooth yet spicy finish. Knob Creek Rye is still patiently aged in the deepest charred barrels and bottled at a full 100 proof to maintain Knob Creek Bourbon’s approach to big flavor.

TITLE: Koch Espadin Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: Espadin is a work horse. It matures in a relatively short time 5-8 years, it produces a lot of sugar, and it is easily cultivated. It is so easily marked by the hands of the mezcalero that it can take on a multitude of characteristics and levels of quality. Made traditionally in Oaxaca by Pedro Hernandez, this mezcal is double-distilled in a copper still and is bottled at 94 proof.

TITLE: Koikawa Nigori Sake
DESCRIPTION: Unlike other Nigori, this special selection is lwss heavily clouded that most. The aromas of southern island fruits and flowers such as papayas and hibiscus are found within this sake. Yhis very delicate, soft balance.

TITLE: Kokken Yamahai Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Award-winning Kokken Sake Brewery is surrounded by natural forests and meadows, located in the lush and snowy Southern Aizu region of Fukushima (Japan's 3rd largest prefecture, home to a wide range of lakes, forests and mountains, giving them very large and diverse terroir for sake brewing). Utilizing the teachings of the Nanbu Brewmasters' Guild and their own local touch, they produce exclusively Tokutei Meisho-shu (Premium Grade Sake like Junmai, Daiginjo, etc.) and only use varietals of rice registered as suitable for sake brewing grown from pure water. Kokken produces many different sake (especially Junmai), but their brews are well-loved by locals and at least 60% of their sake is consumed in Fukushima. Heavy or spicy dishes that utilize fat, oil and garlic

TITLE: Komagatake "Kohiganzakura” Nature Series #2 Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The second bottling in Mars's new Nature of Shinshu range – each entry is named after the flora local to the eponymous distillery. The Kohiganzakura (means “Alpine Cherry Blossom”) honors the cherry blossom prevalent in Japan (and around the distillery itself, in particular). Bottled at 52%, it is a lightly peated single malt expression, with parts of it matured in casks that previously matured Japanese wine casks.

TITLE: Komagatake Double Cellars Single Malt Japanse Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Shinshu Mars Distillery produces some of our favorite Japanese single malts and whiskies. This Double Cellars release was distilled at the Mars Shinshu distillery before some of the whisky was sent off to mature at the company’s Tsunuki site. Comprising of whisky matured at both distilleries, the name speaks for itself. Bottled this year, this is the first Mars single malt of 2018.

TITLE: Komagatake Limited Edition Single Malt Japanese Whisky 2020
DESCRIPTION: Sandwiched between Japan’s soaring Southern Alps and the towering Central Alps, at just over 2,600 feet, Mars Shinshu is Japan’s highest whisky distillery. The Hombo family have been distilling for more than a century and they added whisky to their repertoire in 1949. Back then the distillery was located inKagoshima Prefecture on the southern most island of Kyushu. Until 1984, it was the southernmost whisky made in Japan, which ended with the Hombo clan moving the distillery to the idyllic alpine setting of Miyada village in southern Nagano Prefecture. They chose this site for its cool temps, which slowed maturation, and the plentiful, soft, granite filtered snowmelt fed aquifers. Smart choice. The whiskies are elegant, smooth and very complex.

TITLE: Komagatake Limited Edition Single Malt Japanese Whisky 2019
DESCRIPTION: Sandwiched between Japan’s soaring Southern Alps and the towering Central Alps, at just over 2,600 feet, Mars Shinshu is Japan’s highest whisky distillery. The Hombo family have been distilling for more than a century and they added whisky to their repertoire in 1949. Back then the distillery was located inKagoshima Prefecture on the southern most island of Kyushu. Until 1984, it was the southernmost whisky made in Japan, which ended with the Hombo clan moving the distillery to the idyllic alpine setting of Miyada village in southern Nagano Prefecture. They chose this site for its cool temps, which slowed maturation, and the plentiful, soft, granite filtered snowmelt fed aquifers. Smart choice. The whiskies are elegant, smooth and very complex.

TITLE: Komagatake Tsunuki Aging 2019 Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Mars Shinshu (to give it its full name) is a three-hour drive northwest towards the Southern Alps. The distillery sits at 800 meters (2625 ft) which makes it the highest distillery in Japan. Better known as Mars distillery, it opened in 1985 using stills made for a mothballed distillery called Yamananashi. The distillery then closed in 1992 and reopened again in 2011. It is now newly renovated and looking very modern and clean. Barrels are stored onsite and in other regions of Japan to help experience less fluctuation in temperature. This whisky spent most of its time maturing at the Tsunuki Distillery at the southern tip of Japan helping it to mature faster there than at the Shinshu Distillery. Three types of cask were used in maturation, ex-Bourbon American Oak, ex-Sherry European Oak and casks which contained Umeshu, a Japanese liqueur of Ume the Japanese plum. Bottled at 56% abv.

TITLE: Komagatake Tsunuki Aging 2020 Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This single malt whisky was distilled at Mars Shinshu distillery at Nagano and then aged in the stone warehouse of Mars Tsunuki distillery in Kagoshima, which is the southern most distillery in mainland of Japan. This is a vatting of whisky aged in Bourbon barrels in the warmer climate of Kagoshima (compared to the Nagano region where it is distilled).

TITLE: Komagatake “Rindo” Nature Series #1 Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Rindo, Nature of Shinshu is believed to have been vatted from single malt distilled in 2012, some of which were aged in Japanese wine casks. It is also understood to contain some 20-year-old stock. Limited to 8,200 bottles worldwide it has been bottled at 52%.

TITLE: Komagatake “Shinanotanpopo” Nature Series #3 Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The third in Mars Komagatake's Nature of Shinshu series, which focuses on botanicals local to the distillery, is Shinanotanpopo, which means 'dandelion flower' in Japanese. Shinanotanpopo is made from a blend of different casks, including ex-bourbon, sherry and white oak – some of which were over 20 years old. This is a floral dram with additional notes of red fruits and soft spices.

TITLE: Korbel California Champagne Brut
DESCRIPTION: Critical acclaim: "This is crisp and loaded with spice, offering creamy apple, citrus and anise flavors that are balanced, with a vibrant finish. Drink now. 6." - 88 Points, Wine Spectator "Another fine brut from Korbel, dry, yeasty and citrusy, just like good bubbly should be. It's a little rough and scoury in the bubbles, but at this price, a good deal." - 87 Points, Wine Enthusiast Korbel Brut - Made from Organic Grapes, pairs well with richer foods. Try it with braised chicken, a savory butternut squash soup or pastas served with a light cream sauce.

TITLE: Koshi No Iso Muroka Genshu Junmai Ginjyo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Sake of the muroka genshu variety (non-charcoal filtered, cask-strength) is typically only available to brewery staff. This muroka genshu made from Koshi No Shizuku, a crossbreed of Hyogo Kita Nishiki and Miyama Nishiki sake rice is rich and full-bodied. Because it is non-charcoal filtered, it is naturally lightly hued.

TITLE: Koshino Kanchubai "Gold Label" Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Niigata Meijo is located in Ojiya in the central region of Niigata Prefecture 150 miles north of Tokyo. It is in a fertile valley they use for rice farming surrounded by snow-covered mountains, and in winter the environment is ideal for sake production. They have produced sake for over 70 years, and they have received many awards for their characteristically beautiful, smooth, clean and clear sake. Sukiyaki, Grilled Chicken, Miso Marinades, Sashimi, Soba

TITLE: Koshino Kanchubai "Silver Label" Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Niigata Meijo is located in Ojiya in the central region of Niigata Prefecture 150 miles north of Tokyo. A fertile valley for rice farming surrounded by snow-covered mountains in winter, the environment is ideal for sake production. They have produced sake for over 70 years, and they have received many awards for their characteristically beautiful, smooth, clean and clear sake. Yakitori, Tempura, Grilled Fish, Sashimi, Soba

TITLE: Kougin No Sasayaki Ginjyo Shochu
DESCRIPTION: Kougin No Sasayaki is a ginjo mugi shochu. You’re probably more familiar with “ginjo” being used to describe sake (nihon-shu), which is the term referring to a sake polished to at least 60% of the original grain size. This shochu claims to polish to 50% of the original size, which would qualify it as a daiginjo under sake designations. However, shochu does not actually have these requirements so the polishing of the barely, presumably to get to a cleaner, more pure part of the grain, is simply a choice by the distillery to lighten up the flavors you’ll often find in barley shochu.

TITLE: Koyle Malbec Reserva
DESCRIPTION: Owners Alfonso Undurraga Mackenna and his sons Alfonso, Max and Cristobal founded Koyle in 2006. They comprise a legacy of Chilean winemaking excellence that dates back to 1885 when their descendents founded the family's eponymous winery, Undurraga. In 2006, when the family sold Undurraga the winery and vineyards which allowed Alfonso to pursue a lifelong dream – finding superior terroir from which to produce handcrafted, authentic, small production Chilean red wines. The biodynamically farmed 2,718 acre estate is located in the Los Lingues zone of Colchagua Valley, at the foothills of the Andes Mountains. Winemaker and viticulturalist Cristobal Undurraga Marimon worked for Chateau Latour and Franciscan Estates and seeks to produce wines that strike the right balance between European restraint and Chilean fruit. The winery was named after a beautiful, endangered, indigenous purple plant that the Chilean Indians called Koyle.

TITLE: Kozaemon Tokubetsu Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: The taste is light and fruity, and fragrance is refined.

TITLE: Kraken Black Spiced Rum
DESCRIPTION: Many years ago in the Caribbean islands, a ship carrying a large quantity of black spiced rum mysteriously disappeared. It is rumored that the ship was attacked by the Kraken, a legendary sea monster known for its deadly tentacles, razor sharp teeth, and insatiable appetite. Even though this story can’t be proven, the stories still remain, along with a respectful fear of the sea. The lost barrels of rum were renamed after the Kraken, to both honor and appease him.

TITLE: Krasno Goriska Brda Orange
DESCRIPTION: 40% Ribolla Gialla (Rebula), 30% Malvasia, 30% Sauvignonasse sourced only from the winery’s organic growers. The Rebula sees 10 months skins contact in large oak foudres. The Malvasia and Sauvignonasse see one month skin contact and 8 months on lees in stainless steel. Before blending the Rebula is aged in large oak for 14 months, and the Malvasia and Sauvignonasse in stainless steel for 15 months.

TITLE: Kris Artist Cuvee Delle Venezie Pinot Grigio
DESCRIPTION: KRIS Artist Cuvee takes full advantage of the “delle Venezie” designation by marrying the best fruit from the appellation’s three permitted regions. Veneto fruit provides the delicate floral notes. Grapes sourced from the southwest facing slopes of Trentino receive ample sun and contribute ripe, yet fresh, citrus. Soil from the Friuli vineyards is well drained, which helps to limit yields and intensify flavor. Light pasta dishes, grilled vegetable, tossed salads and white meat or light fish.

TITLE: Kristinus Balatonboglar "Liquid Sunshine" Amber Wine
DESCRIPTION: We cultivate our vineyards in a sustainable way with the highest respect for nature and our environment. To show the true and most beautiful face of the healthy, happy fruit and the terroir, we make all our wines with the lowest intervention possible. Through this low intervention, natural wine, we wanted to show the taste of the sun shining above our vivid vineyards and the fresh, healthy grapes - we aimed to bottle the summer. This orange wine is made from beautiful, hand-picked Chardonnay and fermented on the skin in Amphora for 24 days. After pressing, we blended it with our stunning Szürkebarát orange wine and bottled it without filtration.

TITLE: Kubota Hekiju Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Asahi Noken is an agricultural production corporation established in 1990 with a mission to preserve Japan’s regional agriculture and produce even better varieties of sake-brewing rice. With its sights set on producing the ideal sake-brewing rice for Asahi-Shuzo, Asahi Noken plays a vital role as a test-field for experiments to reduce fertilizer use and protect the environment. In 1996 Asahi Noken began research on a rice strain called Senshuraku, which had to be revived after disappearing for 30 years. Asahi Noken worked with Japan Agricultural Cooperatives (JA) and other partners to establish techniques for cultivating this strain. A number of valuable products have arisen from these rice-cultivating efforts, including ESSHU, a sake made with Senshuraku rice, and Junmai Daiginjo SENSHIN, a sake brewed using the Takanenishiki rice strain.

TITLE: Kubota Hyakuju Honjozo
DESCRIPTION: With a light body with a clean and floral aroma, Kubota Hyakuju is a perfect accompaniment to sashimi and nigiri sushi.

TITLE: Kubota x SNOW PEAK Seppou Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Jointly developed premium Sake by Snow peak, comprehensive outdoor manufacturer and Asahi Shuzo, Sake brewery aiming towards to create a new category of “Enjoy Sake in the outdoors “ It realized all the more reason for both having common environment to cherish and admire nature. In order to drink Sake with others while enjoying all four seasons, this new design integrates Sake and outdoor entertainment into creating a new communication tool. Yakitori, snacks, cheese

TITLE: Kuiper Belt Aged 8 Years Straight Kentucky Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Named for a ring of icy bodies that orbit the sun, this small-batch whiskey is aged, as the producer says, “eight earth orbits around the sun.” Look for a gentle cinnamon scent and a spicy-sweet palate. Adding water plays up the caramel note and layers on succulent toffee richness. It's robust enough to enjoy with a big cube of ice or mixed into an Old Fashioned.

TITLE: Kujira Ryukyu 20 Years Old Single Grain Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Founded in 1952, Kumesen Syuzo produces a distilled spirit known as Awamori that is made entirely with rice and is unique to the Okinawa islands of Japan. Typically aged for just a few years and consumed at lower proof, the distillery began experimenting with high proof aging in ex-bourbon casks in 1989. The result are stocks of extremely old single grain whisky.

TITLE: Kujira Ryukyu 8 Years Old Single Grain Whisky
Kunizakari Nigori Sake Cup
Kura Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Helios Distillery in Okinawa Japan has been known for producing rums and awamori for a few decades. Little does people know that they’ve been distilling their own whisky for a while and use their rum casks to finish this unique line of new blended whisky. Interesting addition to the world of Japanese whisky.

TITLE: Kurayoshi Malt 8 Year Old Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Kurayoshi 8 Year Old Malt Whisky is aged in white oak ex-bourbon barrels for over eight years. This aging process creates a more refined whisky with a depth of character, removing any unpleasant flavors, it causes the whisky to develop a ripeness and complexity in flavor. This 8-year-old malt whisky is packed with refreshing notes of citrus, and a sweet, soft, vanilla nuttiness.

TITLE: Kurayoshi Pure Malt 12 Year Old Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Even the most ardent fans of Japanese whisky would be forgiven not to have heard of the Matsui distillery. Located in Tottori, a coastal prefecture on southern Honshu mostly known for its sand dunes, it is also the location of Matsui Breweries, which makes traditional Japanese sake and shochu, as well as whisky. This bottle, the Kurayoshi Pure Malt 12-Year-Old is one of the finest things this distillery has produced.

TITLE: Kurayoshi Pure Malt 18 Year Old Whisky
DESCRIPTION: 18-year-old blended malt from the Kurayoshi range, created by the Matsui Shuzou distillery. Though not very well-known, Matsui Shuzou has created some rather marvelous expression for this series, made using malt whiskies from Scotland, transported over to Japan, blended with Japanese malt whiskies and brought down to bottling strength with volcanic-rock-filtered water. A deeply complex spirit derived from extensive aging. The sweet taste of honey, mixed with smoke, spice, and mint, lingers on the palate, carried and lifted by this 18YR whisky’s higher ABV.

TITLE: Kurayoshi Pure Malt 25 Year Old Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Kurayoshi the foothills of Mt. Daisen, here has fine water that is indispensable for whisky distilling. Kurayoshi called that "Life is good" is the origin of the word, but the annual temperature range in the Sea of Japan side is large, and the aging of whisky also advances quickly compared to the actual situation like Islay Island. It is no exaggeration to say that whiskey is made by the barrel and nature. Our distillery is not big, we have a small number of staff, however, we will continue to strive for all the staff with the desire to deliver the best whisky." Kurayoshi 25 Year Old Malt Whisky is aged in white oak ex-bourbon barrels. Kurayoshi Malt Whisky is made at the Matsui Shuzou production facility in the Tottori Prefecture, northwest of Kyoto, which was founded in 1910. In addition to whisky, Matsui Shuzou also brews sake and distills shochu, a spirit made from rice, barley, sweet potato, or other starchy ingredients inoculated with koji, the same mold used in sake production

TITLE: Kuromatsu Hakushika Snow Beauty Sake
DESCRIPTION: Excellent as an aperitif. Also a wonderful accompaniment with fine beef dishes such as Kobe beef/ wagyu steak, shabu shabu, and sukiyaki. Also excellent with mildly hot and spicy cuisine such as stir-fry dishes flavored with Asian chili sauce, bulgogi Korean barbecue, kimchi jigae (kimchi flavored stew), and Thai and Indian curries.

DESCRIPTION: Excellent as an aperitif. Also a wonderful accompaniment with fine beef dishes such as Kobe beef/ wagyu steak, shabu shabu, and sukiyaki. Also excellent with mildly hot and spicy cuisine such as stir-fry dishes flavored with Asian chili sauce, bulgogi Korean barbecue, kimchi jigae (kimchi flavored stew), and Thai and Indian curries.

TITLE: Kurosawa Junmai Kimoto Sake
DESCRIPTION: This sake boasts a natural Kimoto flavor, which is full-bodied and earthy, yet light. It is exquisitely balanced and masterfully brewed as the almighty sake. Kimoto-produced Junmai sakes, served hot, cold or at room temperature, will exhibit their true, rich qualities. Ideal for sake lovers.

TITLE: Kurosawa Nigori Sake
DESCRIPTION: Kurosawa Shuzo was established in 1858 in the village of Yachiho, which is near the luxurious resort city of Nagano in central Japan. Yachiho is surrounded by moountains such as the Asama and Yatsugatake and also the Chikuma river which is one of the longest in Japan. Kurosawa Sake Brewery has been brewing sake using the traditional had crafted method since 1858. Much-anticipated “Kurosawa Nigori (unfiltered) Sake” is finally available in the United States. The fruity nose and creamy “umami” flavor make it complement spicy foods or as a dessert.

TITLE: Kuroushi Omachi Black Bull Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: The sake has aroma of white muscat grapes and citrus fruits. Its soft acidic taste flows down the palate very smooth. It has a very elegant, long finish.

TITLE: L'Acino Chora Rosso
DESCRIPTION: A blend of Magliocco and Garnacha Nera. The discovery of a stunning, sandy coteau in 2007 inspired Antonello, Dino and Emilio to plant Magliocco and Mantonico selection massale vines—much of it in franc de pied. These young vines produce the lively, gulpable Chora wines. Fermented in stainless steel with exclusively native yeast and aged on the lees. Unfiltered and lightly sulfured at bottling, the Chora Rosso is released in Spring following harvest.

TITLE: L'Bella Valenciana Sparkling Brut
DESCRIPTION: L'Bella Valenciana Sparkling Brut is a refreshing and versatile sparkling wine from the Valencia region of Spain. Made from a blend of 50% Merseguera and 50% Malvasia grapes, this wine is characterized by its bright citrus flavors, with hints of white flowers and orchard fruits.

TITLE: L'encantada Domaine De Laoue 1999 21 Year Bas Armagnac
DESCRIPTION: This 21 year Bas Armagnac carries a 1999 vintage and was distilled from 100% Folle Blanche variety grapes, and matured in a wet cellar in new oak casks. It is bottled without coloring or filtering, at cask strength, 52.6% ABV.

TITLE: L'Encantada Renaissance Domaine Artigaux 1989
DESCRIPTION: Renaissance is the first of a new line/ special release from the becoming more popular brand L'Encantada. These barrels are the upper echelon of the orange wax Single Casks releases previously seen, representing some sort of "rebirth" or seemingly increased interest in the category of Armagnac. The bottlings are full casks being split between Europe and the US, and have somewhat atypical profiles from their respective domains, taking drinkers off the beaten path to explore these beautiful distillates.Under 200 bottles are available in the US market.Artigaux 1989 slumbered in oak for 32 years to create a complex profile full of candied fruit and flowers at a robust 52.9% abv.

TITLE: L'Encantada Tattoo Series  Grape Brandy Finished in Ex-Bourbon Casks
DESCRIPTION: A collaboration between star Armagnac bottler L'Encantada and importers of the coolest geeky liquors, PM Spirits, the Tattoo Series is Armagnac in all but official name. The use of ex-bourbon barrels for its finishing means that it loses its AOC status, but one whiff and sip of this mind-blowing elixir will render such details completely irrelevant in your mind, I assure you. It's a blend of 10 single casks from L'Encantada's stock and, with an experimental spirit behind it, is finished in ex-Weller barrels, and bottled at strength. Truly, a unique 'Brandy'.

TITLE: L'Encantada XO Bas-Armagnac 5
DESCRIPTION: L'Encantada XO Bas-Armagnac is an exquisite, handcrafted spirit produced in the renowned Bas-Armagnac region of France. L’Encantada's cellar master sourced a blend of four vintage casks ranging from 12 to 40 years old for this XO Bas-Armagnac, which Wine Enthusiast, the same guys that brought you Mic Drop bourbon, gave it 92 points. This XO Armagnac is a blend of six single vintage casks from five domains aged between 12 and 38 years. The blend was composed specifically to exhibit flavors that pair well with cigars. Domaine Du Pin 2012 Domaine Del Cassou 1986 Domaine Du Pouy 2006 Domaine Grand Môle 1990 Domaine Lassalle 1987 Domaine Lassalle 1989 Known for selecting some of the finest single casks, L'Encantada creates Armagnacs that capture the essence of the region’s unique terroir. DESCRIPTION: A NEXT GENERATION WINERY Founded in 2008, Brack Mountain Wine Company is a next generation winery focused on producing hand-crafted, premium wines sourced from the best growers, offered at a fair price. The winery is located in Sebastopol, California and our Enos Estate Vineyards and wine cave is located in the Dry Creek Valley, Healdsburg, California. TITLE: La Antigua Clasico Rioja Reserva
DESCRIPTION: Serve with strongly flavored dishes such as game, roasts, and grilled meats and vegetables.

TITLE: La Berta Solano Sangiovese di Romagna Superiore
La Biancara Garg'n'Go Veneto Frizzante
DESCRIPTION: Gambellara is ostensibly the extension of the Soave foothills in Veneto into the adjoining province of Vicenza where the wine changes its name, but not its general composition. The principal white grape is Garganega backed up with small amounts of Trebbiano. These hills are volcanic in origin, and have rich, dark mineral soils with good amounts of fine clay. They are south facing slopes that are protected from the blasts of Alpine northern winds by the southern Dolomites. The altitude here is between 150 to 250 meters.Angiolino’s estate, in the hamlet of Biancara, now covers about 9 HA. For more than 16 years now, he has plowed in his vines and not used any soil treatments, chemical or otherwise. Using biodynamic viticultural practices, Angiolino has created an organic, living soil and ecosystem for benefiting the health of the vines and their resistance to any form of malady. He is unwavering in his belief that great wines are the result of healthy, beautiful, handpicked fruit, and the only way to achieve this is through natural processes. Furthermore, he believes that the work in the cellar -- vinification, aging and bottling --must be consistent with the work in the vines and involve no additives that compromise the natural fruit material, for better or worse. The vinifications are conducted without temperature control, the addition of sulfur, enzymes or yeast and without the use of fining or filtration.

TITLE: La Bicicleta Voladora Rioja
DESCRIPTION: The Flying Bicycle is German Blanco's new project in Rioja Baja. With the help of an old friend and fellow oenologist, Javier Collio, Germán sources fruit from certified organic vineyards in the Navarra part of the appellation. The vineyards are dry-farmed and have an average age of 35 years old, grown in a mix of clay and limestone. The wine is made in a cellar in San Adrian, following the Milu philosophy: "happy wines made from happy grapes" is how he defines it. The grapes are de-stemmed and fermented in cold temperature from native yeasts. A slight maceration before the end of fermentation helps to make a delicate and fresh wine; no oak is used, and the wine stays in concrete tanks from 5 to 6 months.

TITLE: La Brune Lekker Rose
DESCRIPTION: The first Rose from vintage 2017 in the United States and the first ever release of Lekker Rose! “Lekker” has several meanings. It is a common term for anything that is delicious or particularly luscious. In South Africa, it is most often used where Americans would say cool, great or awesome! Either way, this fruity, dry rose definitely lives up to its name.

TITLE: La Civetta Prosecco Brut
La Colombina Brunello Di Montalcino
DESCRIPTION: La Colombina, which borders both the Ciacci estate and the Uccelliera estate in the warm southeastern Castelnuovo dell'Abate district of Montalcino, has been in the Caselli family for generations.

TITLE: La Divina Lambrusco Di Sorbara
DESCRIPTION: Pet Nat Lambrusco from the Carafoli family! La Divina manages to stradle the line between being fairly classic, juicy, and accesible while still having some of the subtle savory qualities and wildness you might expect from a lower intervention sparkling wine.

TITLE: La Favorita Reggiano Lambrusco Vino Frizzante Secco
DESCRIPTION: La Favorita Reggiano Lambrusco Vino Frizzante Secco is a delightful expression of the Reggiano region in Emilia-Romagna, Italy. Made from the vibrant Lambrusco grape, this sparkling red wine captures the lively spirit of Italian winemaking. Known for its light bubbles and refreshing dry character, La Favorita brings a balance of fruity aromas and earthy undertones, making it perfect for casual celebrations or pairing with a variety of foods. This bottle of Lambrusco offers the authentic Italian frizzante experience, ideal for those who enjoy a sparkling red with a crisp and refreshing finish.

TITLE: La Felce Felcebianco Vino Bianco
DESCRIPTION: Vermentino/Malvasia/Trebbiano from 3ha of vineyards with sandy topsoil. Average vine age is 40 years. Macerated for 48 hrs, aged in stainless steel. The Felcebianco (like the Felcerosso) is aged for a short time, bottled in January after harvest. It's meant to be a versatile and tasty everyday wine. 8,000 bottles made.

TITLE: La Fleur Amour Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: This Cabernet Sauvignon has an intense deep ruby color, ripe red fruits with cacao, tobacco and leather aromas, Big, rich integrated tannins.

TITLE: La Fleur Amour Chardonnay
DESCRIPTION: Wine from the Languedoc-Roussillon region is produced in the South of France, ranging from the Mediterranean coast to Provence. Chardonnay, Chenin Blanc, Picpoul, Muscat, and Mauzac are some of the most important white grapes in the region. Great with pasta, casseroles, salads, roasted vegetables

TITLE: La Fleur Amour Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Perfect as an aperitif, with fish and white meats but also with asparagus tart, grilled lobster, marinated salmon with dill, sea scallop Carpaccio with citrus fruits, Japanese cuisine. Serve: 50°F

TITLE: La Gerla Brunello di Montalcino
La Gerla Rosso di Montalcino
DESCRIPTION: 100% Sangiovese from hillside vineyards located at between 270-320 meters. The average age of the vines is 15 years old. La Gerla Rosso spends six monhts in tank, then one year in Slavonian oak (large casks of 50hl) and another six months in bottle before being released.

TITLE: La Gioiosa "et Amorosa" Prosecco di Valdobbiadene Superiore DOCG
DESCRIPTION: La Gioiosa "et Amorosa" Prosecco di Valdobbiadene Superiore DOCG is a sparkling wine from the Veneto region of Italy. It is made from 100% Glera grapes, which are grown in the Valdobbiadene area of the region. This wine is produced using the Charmat method, which involves secondary fermentation in a tank. This results in a wine that is fresh, fruity, and lively.

TITLE: La Gran Senora Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: La Gran Señora Blanco Tequila is a distinguished spirit crafted by the esteemed Camarena family at the Tequila Supremo distillery, also known as Gran Dinastía, in Arandas, Jalisco. This tequila is a tribute to Doña Elena, the family's matriarch, reflecting a legacy of over eight decades in tequila production. Made from 100% Blue Weber agave cultivated at elevations exceeding 7,000 feet in the Los Altos region, the agave is cooked in traditional brick ovens and fermented in open stainless steel tanks, ensuring a pure and authentic flavor profile. The distillery employs sustainable practices, including the Zero D process, which eliminates waste discharge, underscoring their commitment to environmental responsibility

TITLE: La Grange Bartas L'Abri Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Totally organic, no added sulfur, no oak in sight and a trim 12% alcohol and a mere 50 cases for the US – we are going to go ahead and guess that this is not from Napa. Kidding, of course, because we know where this is from, the Ardeche in Southern France. This is a home run for anyone who has sulfite concerns, anyone who likes lower alcohol levels and anyone who likes elegant wines for food pairing.Domaine Jérôme Jouret is a small family winery located on twelve hectares in the southern Ardeche. The organic ancient vines are planted on the steep and stony slopes of the Vallée de I’Ibie. Winemaker Jérôme Jouret left the local co-op in ’06 and has only made a few vintages since setting out on his own, however, the results so far have been stunning. The cooler climate of the region combined with a high elevation means that the fruit has a longer hang time on the vines, this helps create wine with pronounced aromatics and fresh flavors.

TITLE: La Gritona Reposado Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Producer Information: La Gritona Reposado is a subtle and distinctive 100% blue agave tequila distilled by Melly Cardenas at her small distillery (NOM 1533) in Valle de Guadalupe in the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico. The tequila begins with mature agave grown in the red soil of the Jalisco highlands that has been cultivated at the height of it’s sugar production and is put into our ovens within 24 hours of being cut. Our agave is baked in our thick-walled earthen ovens for 24 hours and then allowed to rest for another 24 hours before crushing. After allowing the collected liquid to naturally ferment a rate that is only dictated by the surrounding air temperature, we distill our fermented liquid twice. It is then rested in reused American whiskey barrels for 8 months before filtering and bottling. Every step of production takes place under one roof and our facility is overseen by a small staff of locals that work each process from start to finish. We currently bottle an average of 12,500 liters per batch. All of the agave remnants that are left over after production are given to local farmers to use as cattle feed. Our bottles are hand blown with recycled glass in the Guadalajara neighborhood of Tlaquepaque, an hour away from the distillery. Available in 50ml, 375ml or 750ml.

TITLE: La Junta Maule Valley Pinot Noir
La Marca Prosecco D.O.C
La Marca Prosecco D.O.C
La Nave Rioja Blanco
DESCRIPTION: La Nave Rioja Blanco is a refreshing and elegant white wine from the Rioja region of Spain. It is made from a blend of Viura and Garnacha Blanca grapes, which are grown in the Rioja Alta subregion. This wine has a pale yellow color and aromas of citrus, white flowers, and orchard fruits. On the palate, it is dry, crisp, and refreshing, with flavors of green apple, pear, and citrus. La Nave Rioja Blanco is a versatile wine that can be enjoyed on its own or paired with a variety of foods. It is a great accompaniment to seafood dishes, salads, and light fare.

TITLE: La Posta Angel Paulucci Mendoza Malbec
DESCRIPTION: Angel Paulucci invites you to climb into his 1933 Model A and weave through the Vineyards of Ugarteche. You’ll hear of his childhood in Italy and his passion for Malbec grapes. Later, over dinner, he will fill your glass. And the air, cooled by The Andes, will melt away your worries and inspire you to find your passion.

TITLE: La Rioja Alta "Vina Alberdi" Rioja Reserva
DESCRIPTION: La Rioja Alta is one of the best producers in the Rioja region of Spain. This wine is Sophia Vergas in a glass. It's sexy, spicy and delicious. Made with 100% Tempranillo, this is the best expression of a Rioja that you can find at this price point. This is a bold wine full of vanilla and baking spices. Beautiful to drink on it's own, or with a nice Spanish cheese, like Manchego.

TITLE: La Senda Bodegas y Vinedos Bierzo Vindemiatrix Tinto
DESCRIPTION: This is pure Bierzo, refreshing and engaging, powerful and crystalline, with an amazing red fruit intensity and woven flavors of earth, smoke, and spice.

TITLE: La Sueca Sangria
DESCRIPTION: 50% Garnacha, 50% Tempranillo

TITLE: La Venenosa Raicilla Sierra de Jalisco
DESCRIPTION: Raicilla (pronounced RAI-SEE-YA) is a mezcal that has been produced in the state of Jalisco for over 400 years. In the 1780’s artisans who crafted their mezcals adopted the name Raicilla to avoid a tax levied by the Spanish Crown. They convinced the tax collectors that Raicilla is not a mezcal and were able to avoid the tax. Most people have little knowledge of Raicilla because the world’s most famous mezcal, Tequila, became so popular that it overshadowed the other mezcal production in the state of Jalisco. Jalisco offers a great diversity of agave species, second only to Oaxaca. For this reason, along with diverse terroir, equipment and technique, Raicillas offer an amazing journey of flavour and history. La Venenosa Raicilla was created four years ago, by Chef Esteban Morales, to bring these hidden jewels to market. Esteban crisscrossed the state in search of the best producers in each region. The results today are 4 unique Raicillas made by 4 different Maestro Taberneros from 4 different regions of 4 different species of agave using 4 different techniques.

TITLE: La Vida al Camp Sant Sadurni D'Anoia Cava Brut
La Vis Simboli Riesling
DESCRIPTION: Riesling, a grape variety originating from the Rhine River Valley, has been cultivated for a number of decades in Valle di Cembra. On the sloping, south-facing, vineyards, the grapes, blessed by the sunlight, synthesize many aromatic molecules, which are preserved and enhanced by the fluctuations in temperature typical of the alpine valleys. Think Spice. Because of Riesling’s sweetness and acidity, it makes the perfect accompaniment to spicy food. Strong Indian and Asian spices are a perfect match with Riesling. A classic pairing with Riesling is spiced duck leg.

TITLE: Lagavulin 11 Years Offerman Edition Charred Oak Cask Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: For Nick Offerman, there is no better way to end the day than with a medium- rare rib-eyesteak and a glass of Lagavulin Single Malt Scotch Whisky. So, for this coming winter, he challenged himself to not only master the perfectly grilled steak but also create the perfect whisky to sip alongside it. After rounds and rounds of sampling and perfecting, Nick believes he has finally cracked it.Introducing, Lagavulin Offerman Edition: Charred Oak Cask. This Lagavulin Single Malt ScotchWhisky is matured for at least 11 years in heavily charred ex-bourbon and red wine barrels. Theresult is a glorious adventure in flavor with hints of round red berries, a touch of briny saltiness,notes of vanilla and Lagavulin’s signature intense peat. Best enjoyed with a grilled medium-rare rib-eye steak – or any robust meal - either neator on the rocks.

TITLE: Lagavulin 11 Years Offerman Edition Finished In Guinness Casks Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Inspired by actor and comedian Nick Offerman’s devotion to Lagavulin single malt scotch, Islay distillery Lagavulin debuted its first Offerman Edition in 2019. A second Offerman release appeared in the spring of 2021—an 11-year-old like the first, but with four months of finishing in Guinness casks. Amid a crowded field of ultra-aged, barrel-proof, and many other formidable contenders, this stout cask-finished expression emerged from the pack to become Whisky Advocate's 2021 Whisky of the Year. While the 16-year-old Lagavulin is generally considered the classic of the range, many Lagavulin fans prefer the younger expressions. The Lagavulin 12-year-old, for example, has made frequent appearances in the Diageo Special Releases annual series, and the 2017 version landed at number-four in Top 20. But could an even younger expression—and one with a simple beer cask finish to boot—possibly compare to the stately, sherried depth of the oldest Lagavulins on the shelf? The answer was a resounding yes. At first whiff, it’s Lagavulin alright—but somehow brighter and more playful. The peat smoke and maritime salinity become wrapped in the freshness of fragrant citrus, melding with honeyed vanilla and white chocolate. On the palate, a subtle backdrop of peat embers harmonizes with flavors of toffee and baked orange, leading to a nimbly smoked finish that sings with notes of coffee and chocolate, and just goes on and on. That finish truly became the clincher for our tasters. It showed that while this whisky charts its own lively course, it is anything but straightforward—and loses none of Lagavulin’s famed depth and complexity. While peated scotch devotees are among the most loyal whisky fans in the world, we recognize that peat is not always for everyone. Yet with its artfully cheerful style and an abundance of captivating flavors, we believe this whisky bridges that divide.er kick that stays in the finish until the party is over. Best enjoyed while sharing stories with your dad, simply serve neat or with a little water.

TITLE: Lagavulin 11 Years Offerman Edition Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Created in partnership with Nick Offerman, Lagavulin Offerman Edition 11 Year Old Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a woody and peaty, fruity and spicy offering. The woody, peaty notes lead from the front, gently tingling the tongue in a cha-cha before fading to reveal a veritable waltz of sweet berry and orchard fruit notes. Aged in a mix of refilled and rejuvenated American Oak barrels, this whisky demands to be served in a traditional whisky glass, neat or with a little water. Includes one 92 proof 750 mL bottle of Lagavulin Offerman Edition 11 Year Old Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky. Carrying on a 200-year-old tradition of distilling excellence, the Lagavulin distillery is said to be one of the oldest distilleries on Islay. Founded in 1816 by farmer John Johnston and later led by Peter Mackie in 1890, the name Lagavulin was to become the last word on the delicacy of Islay malts. Miles and miles of peat bog in the west of the island provide the raw material which imbues the barley with our iconic smoky flavor, and the rich peaty water from the tranquil Lochan Sholum in the hills above the distillery makes the flavors so unique. It takes time, but patience is our finest virtue and rushing good whisky is just not how we take care of things in Islay.

TITLE: Lagavulin 12 Years Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky 2020 Special Release Edition
DESCRIPTION: The 2020 edition of one of Diageo's favourite limited edition annual releases: the Lagavulin 12 Year Old as part of the yearly Special Releases. This year, they've decided to push the sweetness of the whisky, using refill-casks (hogsheads and butts) to let the distillery character shine through.

TITLE: Lagavulin 12 Years Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky 2021 Special Release Edition
DESCRIPTION: This year’s Special Releases Collection unlocks the hidden stories from each of the iconic distilleries and brings them to life via fictional mythical creatures which tie into the brand’s heritage.

TITLE: Lagavulin 12 Years Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky 2022 Special Release Edition
DESCRIPTION: The Flames of the Phoenix is an appropriate theme for the 2022 Special Release bottling of Lagavulin, as it was designed to be the most phenolic Lagavulin yet. Fans of the distillery will know that means a truly peaty customer, with lots of spice and power amplified by the virgin oak casks this heavily peated Lagavulin was aged in, alongside American oak refill casks.

TITLE: Lagavulin 16 Years Old Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Islay representative in the 'Classic Malts' series is a deep, dry and exceptionally peaty bruiser. Probably the most pungent of all Islay malts.

TITLE: Lagavulin 1997 Prima & Ultima 25 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Lagavulin 1997 Prima & Ultima 25-Year-Old is a remarkable representation of Islay malt, showcasing the mastery of Lagavulin distillery. This exceptional single malt, aged for 25 years, is the final memory of a golden year at the distillery under the custodianship of third-generation distillery manager Mike Nicolson. It epitomizes mature, rich, and well-rounded characteristics that symbolize Lagavulin's power and majesty.

TITLE: Lagavulin 25 Years Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Rare and highly sought after, this is a 25-year-old Lagavulin bottled at cask strength. The 25-year-old is fascinating in its complexity, both on the nose and palate. Aromas of new leather, tropical fruits, brittle toffee, and brine are backed by spicy peat smoke, while smoky sherry notes develop in time. It is at its best neat, with the strength being no deterrent. The palate is rich and confident, with sweet peat, brine, muted sherry, figs, mild spices, tangerines, and lemons. The finish is lengthy, with a barbecue note, malt, and lots of mild smoke. An extremely fine Lagavulin.

TITLE: Lagavulin 28 Year Old 1993 Prima & Ultima Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This 28-year-old Lagavulin has matured in American oak hogshead casks. 1013 such bottles were made available worldwide. The taste is viscously oily and rich in texture, with a beautifully balanced sweetness, then smoky and salty in taste, in which a drying, spicy warmth builds. The finish has a medium length, with more scented smoke and spice.

TITLE: Lagavulin 8 Years Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This eight-year-old is big and smoky, with sweet spice that becomes apparent with a drop of water. It's bottled at an exciting 48% abv and was matured in refill European and American oak casks.

TITLE: Lagavulin Aged 12 Years Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky Special Release 2023
DESCRIPTION: Lagavulin Aged 12 Years Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky Special Release 2023 is a smoky and peaty whisky that is sure to please fans of Islay whisky. It is aged in a combination of first-fill and refill American oak casks, which gives it a complex flavor profile with notes of smoke, peat, iodine, seaweed, and vanilla.

TITLE: Lagavulin Distillers Edition Double Matured Single Malt Islay Scotch Whisky 750ml  2020
DESCRIPTION: Aged for sixteen years and finished in sherry casks, this limited-edition whisky is one of the boldest and most intense whiskies ever made. Intense aroma of peaty smoke, wood spices, and Earl Gray tea. Notes of peat, rich smoke, and salty tang, which are balanced by subtle hints of vanilla and honeyed oak. Finish is incredible and intense, with complex notes of sweet caramel and fruits belying bolder notes of peat and smoke

TITLE: Lagavulin Distillers Edition Double Matured Single Malt Islay Scotch Whisky 750ml  2021
DESCRIPTION: Aged for sixteen years and finished in sherry casks, this limited-edition whisky is one of the boldest and most intense whiskies ever made. Intense aroma of peaty smoke, wood spices, and Earl Gray tea. Notes of peat, rich smoke, and salty tang, which are balanced by subtle hints of vanilla and honeyed oak. Finish is incredible and intense, with complex notes of sweet caramel and fruits belying bolder notes of peat and smoke

TITLE: Lagavulin Distillers Edition Double Matured Single Malt Islay Scotch Whisky 750ml  2022
DESCRIPTION: Aged for sixteen years and finished in sherry casks, this limited-edition whisky is one of the boldest and most intense whiskies ever made. Intense aroma of peaty smoke, wood spices, and Earl Gray tea. Notes of peat, rich smoke, and salty tang, which are balanced by subtle hints of vanilla and honeyed oak. Finish is incredible and intense, with complex notes of sweet caramel and fruits belying bolder notes of peat and smoke

TITLE: Lagavulin Offerman Edition: Caribbean Rum Cask Finish Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Lagavulin Offerman Edition: Caribbean Rum Cask Finish Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a distinctive collaboration between the Lagavulin distillery and actor Nick Offerman. This special edition has been aged for 11 years and uniquely finished in Caribbean rum casks. It retains the classic peaty profile of Lagavulin but introduces sweet and complex layers contributed by the rum cask finish. The whisky features a balance of smoky and sweet notes, making it a unique offering in the Lagavulin lineup. This release is a continuation of Offerman's partnership with the distillery, emphasizing his deep appreciation for the brand and its products. The whisky is bottled at 92 proof (46% ABV), ensuring a robust flavor that's best enjoyed neat to appreciate its full complexity.

TITLE: Lagrimas de Dolores Cenizo Colonial Mezcal Joven
DESCRIPTION: Cenizo is an agave indigenous to the state of Durango, and is also one of the most fibrous varietals. Ooce it is cut into smaller pieces and coked in an underground oven filled with volcanic rock and oak brush. Tahona milling is not traditional in Durango; the agave is mechanically milled then fermented in open-top pine wood tanks for a week. After fermentation, the mezcal is distilled twice – first in a larger 700L copper and steel still, then a second time in a smaller copper still.

TITLE: Lahu Getariako Txakolina
DESCRIPTION: From one of the oldest Txakoli estates in the Basque region, founded in 1925 in the Gipuzkoan municipality of Zarautz, on the slopes above the beach. This gives the vineyards the ability of soaking up all the cool breezy, salty sea air all day. 100% Hondarribi Zuri, hand harvested, and fermented in stainless steel tanks, for only a few short months.

TITLE: Laird's Applejack
DESCRIPTION: Applejack is a brandy made from fermented cider. Spirits distilled from fruit beverages are more rare these days because they cost considerably more to produce than grain-based spirits. In fact, applejack - even Laird's - is rarely 100 percent apple brandy any more. Just before aging the apple brandy in barrels, distillers now cut it with neutral grain spirits (vodka) to a strength of around 40 percent alcohol. Laird's Applejack may be the closest thing we have to a national beverage; in fact, it is United States licensed distillery No. 1, dating back to before the Revolutionary War. Serve in a wine glass or champagne flute, and top with cold ginger ale or sparkling wine. Applejack also makes a wonderful hot toddy; just add hot water and lemon, or even better, warm cider.

TITLE: Lalo Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Lalo Blanco Tequila is a premium tequila crafted with passion and tradition in the heart of Jalisco, Mexico. Named after its founder, Eduardo "Lalo" González, the grandson of Don Julio González, Lalo Blanco Tequila is made from the finest hand-selected 100% blue Weber agave. This tequila is meticulously distilled to produce a smooth and vibrant spirit that captures the true essence of agave. Free from additives and aged to perfection, Lalo Blanco Tequila is perfect for sipping neat, on the rocks, or in your favorite tequila cocktails.

TITLE: Lamadrid Estate Wines Agrelo Single Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Lamadrid Estate Wines Agrelo Single Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon is a captivating red wine born from the sun-drenched vineyards of Agrelo, Mendoza. Crafted from hand-picked, estate-grown Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, this wine embodies the elegance and complexity of Argentinian terroir.

TITLE: Lamberti Extra Dry Prosecco
Langmann Schilcher Sekt
DESCRIPTION: Founded in 1746, the Langmann winery specializes in Schilcher (Blauer Wildbacher) which is grown almost exclusively in Weststeiermark. It is one of the oldest grape varietals cultivated in Central Europe, dating back to Celtic times. A red wine varietal, Schilcher is made primarily as a rose—both still and sparkling (Sekt). Schilcher is quite fruit forward, but with a very distinct acidity; a unique terroir wine.

TITLE: Lanza Soave Classico Garganega
Laphroaig 10 Year Old Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Laphroaig 10yo is a full-bodied, smoky gem, with a residual sweetness and a hint of salt amid the seaweedy, peaty characters before a long warming finish. A classic dram.

TITLE: Laphroaig 10 Years Sherry Oak Finish Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Laphroaig® 10-Year-Old Sherry Oak Finish is a new take on the globally-adored flagship expression from Islay. The unique expression combines the unforgettable flavor of the Laphroaig Distillery's iconic 10-year-old whisky with the sweet, aromatic flavor from Oloroso Sherry casks. The marriage of casks creates rich, full-bodied flavor with notes of Manuka honey, bacon, and maple syrup alongside the classic smoke, seaweed, and hint of salt that Laphroaig is best known and loved for. It is bottled at 48% ABV and appears auburn and tawny in color.

TITLE: Laphroaig 16 Years Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Laphroaig 16 Year Old Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a limited edition release from the iconic Laphroaig Distillery. Originally launched to celebrate the distillery's 200th anniversary, it has been well-received and is periodically re-released. This expression is matured for 16 years in American oak casks, which imparts a mellow sweetness to the traditionally smoky and peaty Laphroaig character.

TITLE: Laphroaig 17 Years Old Francis Mallmann Limited Edition Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Laphroaig 17 Years Old Francis Mallmann Limited Edition Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a rare and unique collaboration with the renowned Patagonian fire chef, Francis Mallmann. This exceptional whisky, aged for 17 years, is finished in a white Madeira cask personally chosen by Mallmann during his visit to Islay. It combines the unmistakable Laphroaig smokiness with the richness of white Madeira cask, offering a unique taste experience with hidden depths. The packaging features hand-drawn sketches by Mallmann, inspired by his time on Islay and the cold smoking process synonymous with Laphroaig. This limited edition is bottled at 54.9% ABV, offering a cask-strength experience that is both peaty and profound.

TITLE: Laphroaig 17 yrs Islay Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This single-cask 1997 vintage Laphroaig has been aged for 17 years in a refill sherry hogshead, being bottled by Signatory for the Cask Strength Collection in 2015. Series: Cask Strength Collection Age: 17 Year Old Vintage: 1997 Bottling Date: January 2015 No of Bottles: 292 Country: Scotland Region: Islay Cask Number: 8366

TITLE: Laphroaig 18 Year Old Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Laphroaig 18yo was introduced in 2009 as a replacement for the old 15 year-old (Prince Chuck's sorely missed favourite whisky, lest we forget). This is a stronger, altogether gutsier affair at 48%

TITLE: Laphroaig 21 yrs "Signatory 30th Anniversary Limited Edition" 1997 Hogshead Single Malt
DESCRIPTION: 30th anniversary expression is packaged in a stunning gift box & includes two (2) signature tasting glasses.

TITLE: Laphroaig 25 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Laphroaig 25 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a prestigious expression that embodies the essence of Islay’s iconic smoky and peaty profile. Aged for a quarter of a century in a combination of American oak ex-bourbon barrels and Oloroso sherry casks, this whisky offers a harmonious blend of intense smoke, rich sweetness, and complex spice. Bottled at cask strength, typically around 97.6 proof, it delivers a robust and unforgettable experience for connoisseurs who appreciate the depth and nuance of long-aged Islay whisky. This 25-year-old single malt is a rare and limited release, showcasing the expertise of Laphroaig’s master distillers. Each sip reflects the distillery’s dedication to traditional whisky-making methods, resulting in a beautifully balanced dram that is both bold and refined.

TITLE: Laphroaig 30 Year Old "The Ian Hunter Story Book 2" Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Introducing the second release of Ian Hunter’s series: a non-chill filtered whisky with sweet sherry notes underscored by Laphroaig‘s characteristic peatiness, aged for 30 years in Spanish Oak Oloroso Sherry oaks. The second release of the Ian hunter Series is a tribute to the Icon that Ian Hunter built more than 100 years ago. Because no one thing is more important to the creation of Laphroaig than the place it comes from—Islay and the ‘hollow by the bay’ where Laphroaig first came into being. Laphroaig’s Ian Hunter Story series draws its inspiration from an icon of Islay scotch whisky. In this, the second in the series, we find a profile that’s right in sweet, smoky stone fruit, thanks to thirty years’ maturation in Spanish Oloroso casks. The second chapter in Laphroaig’s Ian Hunter Story Book matured for three decades in Spanish oak oloroso sherry casks. Typically peaty, the nose also offers notes of dates, figs, rich cigar smoke, licorice, and dark chocolate. The palate offers notes of orange peel, manuka honey, and smoked stone fruits, with waves of peat smoke in the background.

TITLE: Laphroaig Cairdeas Pedro Ximinez Cask Strength Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The 2021 release of this annual favorite is comprised of the classic heavy peated spirit from Laphroaig, this time aged in ex-Pedro Ximenez Sherry Casks and bottled as always at a natural cask strength of 58.9%abv. The whisky is brooding with a spicy nose that flirts with notes of camphor and an oily and expansive palate that really draws out some spectacular sherry flavors in a bold marriage of spirit and oak. Very limited availability.

TITLE: Laphroaig Cairdeas Port & Wine Casks Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Càirdeas is the Gaelic word for ‘friendship’. Each year, the Laphroaig distillery manager, John Campbell, crafts a limited edition Càirdeas single malt to celebrate Friends of Laphroaig and to coincide with the annual Feis Ile festive on Islay. The 2020 annual release of Laphroaig Càirdeas, Port & Wine Casks, continues Laphroaig's long history of innovation. A unique marriage of the classic Laphroaig whisky rested in second-fill Ruby Port ‘barriques’ along with whisky double matured in ex-Bourbon barrels followed by ex-red wine casks. Soft, round and warming, it’s an incredible ‘friendship’ that charts continents, styles and flavors. Aromas of dark chocolate and menthol with pink peppercorns open up to an extraordinarily complex flavor. Toasted peaches, charred marshmallows, and a hint of plum jam intertwine with Laphroaig’s iodine-rich peat smoke to create a limited edition that lingers long on the palate and the memory.

TITLE: Laphroaig Cairdeas Triple Wood Original Cask Strength Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The unique expression is a special triple maturation, first matured in ex-bourbon barrels, then in quarter casks and finally in European oak casks which previously held oloroso sherry. It is then barrier filtered and bottled at cask strength to create a punchy dram with Laphroaig’s signature richness of flavour and smoky taste.

TITLE: Laphroaig Cairdeas Warehouse 1 Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Laphroaig Cairdeas Warehouse 1 is a beautiful single malt scotch from the legendary distillery. This scotch has wonderful fresh herbal notes that accompany its smoke. A light sweetness accompanies the rosemary, sage, and thyme. Some nutty, peppery flavors are immersed in this beautiful and all-encompassingly flavor profile. Don’t be too experimental with this bottle. Single malt scotchs’ are meant to be drunk in the purest form - with a couple of ice cubes or neat!

TITLE: Laphroaig Hogshead 15 yrs Islay Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Named after the Isle of Islay’s Loch Laphroaig, this single malt whiskey distillery has been operating since its establishment in 1815. Home of the only whiskey to carry the Royal Warrant of the Prince of Wales, this esteemed distillery uses traditional methods to create it’s distinct malt. Product pictured is 1995 not 1996. AGED: 15 years DISTILLED ON: November 26, 1996 BOTTLE ON: June 7 2012 MATURED IN: Hogshead Barrel CASK NO: 8511 ALC: 54.3%

TITLE: Laphroaig Lore Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Hailing from the renowned Islay region of Scotland, Laphroaig Lore Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky is often referred to as the richest of the Laphroaig offerings. A testament to the distillery's traditions, "Lore" aptly suggests knowledge passed down through generations. This exceptional Scotch whisky is crafted from a unique combination of whiskies of varying ages, some as old as decades, from different types of casks. The complexity and depth derived from this blend celebrate the distillery's historic practices and the spirit of Islay.

TITLE: Laphroaig Scotch Single Malt Cairdeas
Laphroaig Select Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: It’s only fitting that the perfect introduction to peated whisky draws from a broad range of casks in our storehouse. Sweet and smooth, Laphroaig® Select tells our two hundred year history of passionate distilling in every dram. ​ ​ To create the Laphroaig® Select blend, our Master Distiller hand-selected whiskies aged in Oloroso sherry butts, first-fill ex-Bourbon quarter casks and Pedro Ximenez sherry hogsheads at different levels of maturation. Finished in virgin American oak barrels – a rare wood source for Scotch whisky. ​ ​ Our most laid-back expression lets our signature flavours of medicinal peat smoke and seaweed shine, leaving plenty of room for notes of red fruit, lime and a floral finish. ​

TITLE: Laphroaig The Wall Collection Aged 36 Years "Peat" by Laura Carlin Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Laphroaig The Wall Collection Aged 36 Years "Peat" by Laura Carlin is a premium expression from the iconic Islay distillery, Laphroaig. This whisky is the inaugural release in the new Wall Collection and is distinguished by its hand-painted bottle by London illustrator Laura Carlin. The paint used is the same as that which adorns the walls of Laphroaig’s Warehouse No.1, adding a unique and historical touch to each bottle. Only 200 bottles were released, making it an extremely limited and collectible item.

TITLE: Laphroaig Triple Wood Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Formerly a travel retail exclusive, the popularity of the Triple Wood has led to it being launched into the general market. The whisky starts off maturing in regular bourbon casks, before being moved to Laphroaig's bespoke quarter casks for a time. The whisky is then finished in oloroso sherry casks to gently sand off any remaining sharp edges.

TITLE: Laphroig 14 yrs Islay Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Named after the Isle of Islay’s Loch Laphroaig, this single malt whiskey distillery has been operating since its establishment in 1815. Home of the only whiskey to carry the Royal Warrant of the Prince of Wales, this esteemed distillery uses traditional methods to create it’s distinct malt. AGED: 14 years DISTILLED ON: September 22, 1998 BOTTLE ON: August 20, 2014 MATURED IN: Hogshead CASK NO: 700168 ALC: 46%

TITLE: Laplace Madiran Rouge
DESCRIPTION: VINTAGE 2017 BOTTLE SIZES 750 ML COUNTRY France REGION Southwest APPELLATION Madiran WINE TYPE Red VARIETALS Red Blend VARIETAL NOTES 70% Tannat, 30% Cabernet Franc SOIL Mixture of clay and limestone VITICULTURE Tannat and Cabernet Franc are hand-harvested because machine harvesters cannot shake these stubborn grapes off the vine VINIFICATION All parcels and grapes are vinified separately. A long maceration of about 25 days average enables an optimal extraction of fruit, tannins and color. AGING After blending, the wine aged for 15 months, half in tank with regular micro-oxygenation, and half in 400L neutral oak barrels.

TITLE: Larceny Barrel Proof Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Larceny Barrel Proof Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey C924 is an exceptional wheated bourbon crafted by the renowned Heaven Hill Distillery. This limited-release expression offers bourbon enthusiasts a chance to experience Larceny in its purest form—uncut and straight from the barrel. Bottled at barrel proof without chill filtration, it delivers a rich and full-bodied flavor profile that captures the essence of traditional Kentucky bourbon-making. The C924 batch continues the legacy of Larceny's Barrel Proof series, showcasing the distillery's commitment to quality and authenticity. With its deep amber hue and complex layers of flavor, this bourbon stands as a testament to the art of fine whiskey craftsmanship.

DESCRIPTION: Larceny Barrel Proof Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey C924 is an exceptional wheated bourbon crafted by the renowned Heaven Hill Distillery.
