TITLE: Larceny Very Special Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Larceny Very Special Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a premium expression from the acclaimed Heaven Hill Distillery. This wheated bourbon is crafted in small batches, ensuring meticulous attention to detail and consistency in every bottle. Typically aged between 6 to 12 years and bottled at 92 proof, Larceny Very Special Small Batch offers a rich and smooth tasting experience. The 750ml bottle reflects the distillery's dedication to quality and tradition, making it a perfect addition to any bourbon enthusiast's collection.

TITLE: Larmandier-Bernier Longitude 1er Cru Extra Brut Champagne
DESCRIPTION: The Larmandier cuvee known as Longitude replaces the wine previously referred to as Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut 1er Cru. The name references the fact that the vineyards are in villages that lie on the same longitudinal plane (along the fourth meridian), including Vertus, Avize, Cramant, Oger and Oiry. Longitude is also an allusion to the length and the very pure, frank and mineral style of these great terroirs, where the chalk is very close to the surface.

TITLE: Las Jaras Wines "Superbloom"
DESCRIPTION: Is it dark pink? Or is it light red? This is the fourth vintage of Superbloom, our zero-zero wine that defies categorization. You know that moment right after sunset, before the stars are out in full — what poets call the “violet hour”? That’s the moment to open this wine. Call it a nighttime rosé, if you’d like. Drink it with friends for a perfect summer apéro. Our wild idea with this wine was to co-ferment red and white Rhône varieties from a single vineyard, then to keep completely natural by adding nothing and taking nothin away in the cellar. All vintages of this wine contain about a third red and two-thirds white grapes. We call this “California Table Wine,” but don’t be fooled by the humble name. Superbloom is a complex, utterly unique wine that expresses the specialness of Love Ranch vineyard in the sierra Foothills. The red grapes give this wine a spicy nose and plenty of texture, while the white grapes add beautiful salted watermelon and rhubarb notes, plus a clean, mineral finish. Superbloom is named after the wildflowers that erupt in the desert after a wetter-than-normal rainy season. They’re a sign that winter is over and warmer, happier days are ahead. We know that spring has not yet sprung in a lot of the country — but in the meantime, you can sip Superbloom and dream of warm California nights.

TITLE: Las Jaras Wines "Waves" Botanical Spritzer
DESCRIPTION: The WAVES Botanical Spritzer is a refreshing and invigorating beverage infused with a blend of all-natural botanicals. It's made with pure spring water, organic cane sugar, and natural flavors, so it's a guilt-free way to enjoy a delicious and refreshing drink. The WAVES Botanical Spritzer has a bright and refreshing aroma, with notes of citrus, cucumber, and mint. The flavor is light and refreshing, with a subtle sweetness from the organic cane sugar. The botanicals add a complex and nuanced flavor profile, with notes of cucumber, mint, ginger, and lemon. The finish is clean and refreshing, with a lingering note of mint. WAVES Botanical Spritzer is a versatile beverage that can be enjoyed on its own or paired with a variety of foods. It's a great accompaniment to light summer dishes, such as grilled fish, salads, and sandwiches. WAVES can also be enjoyed as a refreshing drink to complement heavier meals.

TITLE: Las Jaras Wines "Waves" Mendocino County Old Vines White
DESCRIPTION: 2020 marks our second vintage of the Waves white wine. Our goal is to make a canned wine that is bursting with personality and deliciousness. This is a lightly sparkling white wine that is incredibly classy — we are so happy with it. Old vine French colombard, with its light fruitiness, takes us to our happy place.

TITLE: Las Jaras Wines "Waves" Red Mendocino County
DESCRIPTION: Red wine in a can? It seemed like a crazy idea, but we love a challenge, so we set out to make a featherlight red that is refreshing and perfect to drink ice cold. The 2020 Waves Red Wine has aromas of black plum, earth, dark cherry and violets.

TITLE: Las Jaras Wines "Waves" Rose Mendocino County
DESCRIPTION: This year we decided to extend the Waves line by adding a rosé and a red wine. Our ideal rosé for a can is light and zippy with big fruit, so we turned to zinfandel, petite sirah, and carignan — varieties that aren’t necessarily the obvious choice for a rosé, but that we never get tired of playing with and taking in unexpected directions.

TITLE: Las Jaras Wines Nouveau Old Vines Mendocino County
DESCRIPTION: Joel and Eric make beautiful wine that is food friendly, lower in alcohol, balanced, delicate and supple. The wines evoke an emotional response and reflect the unique terroir of the vineyards. Las Jaras Wines are designed to transcend the natural wine trend and focus on taking you back to California wine making reminiscent of the Old World Style, like the beautifully crafted wines of 1970s Napa. Nouveau is the first release of a vintage. The style originated out of Beaujolais, just south of Burgundy where they make wines from Gamay Noir using the technique carbonic maceration. In carbonic maceration, open top tanks that have been inertized with carbon dioxide are filled with whole cluster grapes and then sealed for a number of days. Pioneering wine chemist and natural winemaker Jules Chauvet employed the technique in the mid 20th century to make light, fruity and delicious wines. The blend is two lots of old vine Valdiguié, also known as "Napa Gamay" and a tank where we co-fermented destemmed Petite Sirah and Zinfandel.

TITLE: Las Jaras Wines Sweet Berry Wine
DESCRIPTION: Joel and Eric make beautiful wine that is food friendly, lower in alcohol, balanced, delicate and supple. The wines evoke an emotional response and reflect the unique terroir of the vineyards. Las Jaras Wines are designed to transcend the natural wine trend and focus on taking you back to California wine making reminiscent of the Old World Style, like the beautifully crafted wines of 1970s Napa. Las Jaras Wines serve two purposes: having fun and the serious business of perfect food pairing. The Rosé and Sparkling Pet-Nat are bottle popping, gulpable joy to get the party started. The Carignan, Sweet Berry Wine, and Cabernet Sauvignon offer that perfect restrained balance of alcohol, acid and tannin structure that complements the food on your plate. These wines reflect Joel and Eric’s passion and the Las Jaras Wines mission.

TITLE: Lasalde Elkartea "Balea" Unfiltered Txakoli
DESCRIPTION: 90% Hondarribi Zuri, 10% Petit Courbu Unfined and unfiltered Txakoli.

TITLE: Laterrade Domaine de Marquet 1983 Vintage Armagnac
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the Laterrade Domaine de Marquet 1983 Vintage Armagnac. Aged for 38 years, this 92-proof spirit delivers a complex palate of dried figs, vanilla, and subtle spice. Crafted in Gascony at Domaine de Marquet, it reflects Laterrade's dedication to quality and tradition. Ideal for sipping neat, it's a sophisticated choice for enthusiasts of well-aged Armagnacs and those looking to add a distinguished bottle to their collection.

TITLE: Laterrade Domaine de Massas 1989 Vintage Armagnac
DESCRIPTION: Discover the exceptional Laterrade Domaine de Massas 1989 Vintage Armagnac. Aged for 32 years, this 92-proof spirit offers complex notes of oak, vanilla, and dried fruits. Hailing from the renowned Gascony region, it's crafted by Laterrade at Domaine de Massas. This Armagnac is a testament to time-honored distillation practices and is ideal for savoring neat or gifting to connoisseurs of fine aged spirits.

TITLE: Laterrade Domaine du Priou 1995 Vintage Armagnac
DESCRIPTION: Savor the distinguished Laterrade Domaine du Priou 1995 Vintage Armagnac. This 26-year-old Armagnac from Gascony, bottled at 92 proof, delivers rich flavors of caramel, dried fruit, and a hint of spice. Produced by Laterrade at Domaine du Priou, it embodies the essence of traditional Armagnac production. Perfect for collectors and those seeking a premium aged spirit to enjoy on special occasions.

TITLE: Laura Lardy Beaujolais-Villages Gourde a Gamay
DESCRIPTION: Grape: Gamay Vineyard: granitic soils, in the Lantignié commune. Practicing organic Making of: the grapes are carbonic macerated as whole bunches, in concrete tanks with indigenous yeast. Pressed and rested for 10 months in concrete. Bottled unfined, with a small dose of SO2.

TITLE: Laurence & Remi Dufaitre Beaujolais Villages Nouveau
DESCRIPTION: Celebrate the vibrant spirit of Beaujolais with Laurence & Remi Dufaitre Beaujolais Villages Nouveau, an exciting French red wine that captures the essence of the harvest season. Crafted by the dynamic duo Laurence & Remi Dufaitre, this Nouveau wine showcases the freshness and vivacity of Gamay grapes from the prestigious Beaujolais Villages region.

TITLE: Laurent Family Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva
DESCRIPTION: Chilean wine estate by organic/biodynamic Bordeaux winemaker Gerard Laurent of Chateau L'Escart. 92% Cabernet Sauvignon/ 8% Carmenere from the Maipo Valley. Grapes are grown organically on riverbed soils of alluvial clay loam. Go Green. Sauvignon Blanc with its herbaceous notes pairs well with similar green herbs. If it has parsley, rosemary, basil, cilantro or mint, chances are Sauvignon Blanc will make a great pairing. Meat Pairings - White meats including Chicken, Pork Chop and Turkey. Fish including Tilapia, Sea Bass, Perch, Sole, Haddock, Trout, Cod, Redfish, Halibut, Snapper, Mussels, Crab, Lobster, and Clams. Spices and Herbs - Green herbs including Parsley, Basil, Mint, Tarragon, Thyme, Fennel, Dill, Chives, and Rosemary. Spices including White Pepper, Coriander, Fennel, Turmeric, and Saffron. Cheese Pairings - Look for softer more briny and sour cheeses like Goat’s milk cheese, Yogurt, and Crème fraîche. Vegetables & Vegetarian Fare - Sauté green veggies or mix vegetables in more fatty vegetarian dishes so that the acidity of the wine shines through. Here are some example dishes for inspiration: Asparagus quiche, cucumber dill yogurt salad, green hummus, white bean casserole with zucchini and white lasagna.

TITLE: Laurent Family Vineyard Clandestino
DESCRIPTION: 100% hand-harvested petit verdot grown in deep clay, alluvial and loam soil. The vines are trellised, the traditional method in the area. The wine macerates on the skins for 35 days and is then aged for 11 months in 900liter barrels. Petit Verdot is a hardy grape with a lot of tannin. That makes Petit Verdot in wine and food pairings a natural fit for rich, meat dishes, grilled steak, spicy pork, veal, lamb, all types of game and sausage.

TITLE: Laurent Family Vineyard Valle del Maipo Corrupto
DESCRIPTION: Chilean wine estate by organic/biodynamic Bordeaux winemaker Gerard Laurent of Chateau L'Escart.

TITLE: Laurent Lebled A la Votre! Ca C'est Bon!
DESCRIPTION: Whole-clusters in small crates are placed in concrete tanks, where an extended 30 day carbonic maceration occurs before pressing and racking to fiberglass. No sulfur is added to the wine at any point.

TITLE: Laurent Lebled A La Votre! On Est Su l'Sable
DESCRIPTION: This supersoif red has raspberry and herbal notes, and gentle tannins. It’s made using a long 30-day carbonic fermentation from 100% Cabernet Franc planted on pure sand from a .49 hectare parcel in Chinon blended with Cab Franc from Saint-Aignan. CHILL IT.

TITLE: Laurent Perrier Champagne Brut Cuvee Rose
DESCRIPTION: The Cuvee Rose from Laurent-Perrier is the most recognized rose champagne in the world. It is also one of the few roses still made by the saignee method. Held in an elegant bottle inspired by King Henri IV, it has been widely acknowledged for its consistent high quality for more that 40 years, and it is the benchmark for rosé champagne around the world.

TITLE: Lautrec VSOP Grande Champagne Cognac
DESCRIPTION: Lautrec Grande Champagne is the most prestigious cognac. It is carefully distilled and aged in limited quantity in the heart of cognac region. Lautrec is the world's most distinguished cognac for its fine bouquet and rich aroma.

TITLE: Laws Whiskey House "Breaking The Law: Prime Suspect" Collaboration Experiential Single Barrel Sauternes Finish Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Laws Whiskey House, otherwise known as A.D. Laws, is located in Denver, Colorado. The distillery makes bourbon, rye, and a variety of limited releases. Limited releases include their Experiential series, which is the category this Sauternes Finished Rye falls into. We tasted through some standard Laws whiskey, but as luck would have it they followed up with an option for their sauternes finished rye, and we knew immediately that it was something we wanted to try. So we sampled virtually with our friends at Breaking Bourbon and picked a winner. Laws provides a wealth of information on the label alone. This whiskey is made from an unusual 100% rye, of which 50% was raw and 50% was malted. A sour mash was used, and it was triple distilled. For the first round of aging, it went into a 53-gallon ISC brand barrel with a char #3 at 125 barrel entry proof. For the sauternes finishing, it was aged in a 225L French oak sauternes cask. The end result is a 123.1 proof sauternes finished rye whiskey with loads of depth. Since this was a joint pick with the Breaking Bourbon crew, we wanted to come up with a sticker that incorporated both names. Incorporating “Law” into the concept in some way made perfect sense, and we immediately landed on something that revolved around “Breaking the Law" and "The Prime Barrel" concepts. This also played into the unique aspect of a 100% rye whiskey finished in a Sauternes cask. Nose: Malt, dark fruit, rye spice, dates, figs, interesting, unique, and funky Palate: Cherry cobbler, leather, malty, baking chocolate, loads of depth Finish: Flash of bold spice, tobacco, oak, cherry, long & interesting

TITLE: Laws Whiskey House "Laws & Order: Calvados Case" Straight Malt Whiskey Finished in Calvados Cask The Prime Barrel Pick #63
DESCRIPTION: Talk about SPECIAL. This bottle is unique on so many levels that Super Mario would be proud. Let's count all of them: This is not a bourbon, nor is this a rye. This is a Straight Malt Whiskey Finished in Calvados Cask. If you buy your whiskey strictly on the merits of being either bourbon or rye, you are probably skipping this one. And you'd be making a mistake because it is terrific. We blindly selected this barrel with our members and unanimously voted the best barrel out of everything we tasted in that session. You can see the whole process here The bottle bears a beautiful custom front label and is a part of our club's art series. Some of them are paid member exclusive, but this one is not. We are happy to bring this one-of-a-kind bottle to our entire membership (free and premium) base. We did a virtual tasting of this barrel with our club members. It's unusual to taste an upcoming barrel before buying a full bottle, yet we made it happen. To participate in future tastings, join our Discord whiskey community. The back label of this bottle has PLETHORA of information about whiskey itself, so do check out the image of it if you are interested. As for tasting notes (provided by one of our members, @cutterandflame on Discord), here's what you can look forward to: Nose: Apple and raisins, almost freshly baked from the oven. Palate: Very malty and dusty fruit-forward dessert, with tart apples and pears cooked down but not sweet. Reminiscent of malted rye with subtle hints of spice. Finish: The finish is long and coats the mouth like that last bite of cobbler when you are sitting around the campfire. For whiskey geeks: Recipe: 99%. BARLEY MALT, 1% RYE MALT MashType: SOUR MASH; DOUBLE DISTILLED Distilled On: APRIL 12, 2015 Harvested On: JULY 6, 2022 Primary Finish: ISC 53 GAL CHAR 3 AMERICAN WHITE OAK Proof: BBL ENTRY-122.10; BBL EXIT-138.4; IN BOTTLE: 138.4 Secondary Finish: 400 LITER CALVADOS CASK Filtration: NON-CHILL FILTERED Total Production: BBL# 59; 354 BOTTLES Warehouse Location: DENVER - S. ACOMA ST. & S. CHEROKEE ST. Made With: BARLEY MALT, RYE MALT, WATER, YEAST, AMERICAN WHITE OAK, CALVADOS CASK, AND TIME... NOTHING ELSE.

TITLE: Laws Whiskey House "We Love Farmers" 7 Years Four Grain Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #82
DESCRIPTION: We're excited to announce our next drop: a fantastic 8-year-old four-grain bourbon from Laws Whiskey House. This barrel boasts a fascinating backstory. During our visit, this particular barrel stood out as the unanimous favorite amidst numerous tastings. Originally designated as a "Farmer" barrel to be returned to local grain producers, Laws was so impressed by its quality that they kept it for extended aging. However, it wasn't available for selection at first. The lingering taste, reminiscent of Stranahan's, stayed with me, leading to a successful negotiation at an industry event in NYC a few months later. Thanks to a bit of fun and persuasion, Laws agreed to release it to us. This bourbon, with a lower yield due to its age and proof of 136.8, drinks remarkably below it. It's an extraordinary find we're eager to share. Barrel Info: BBL #1093 Mashbill: Four Grain Bourbon, 60% corn, 20% wheat, 10% rye, 10% malt Cooperage type: 53 gallon new, charred American oak, char #3 from Independent Stave Co. Entry proof: 110 Harvest proof: 136.8 Age: 7 Years Tasting Notes: Signature aromas of orange blossom and peel, black tea, honey, cinnamon, and vanilla custard with a finish of sweet tobacco, baking spice, and pepper.

TITLE: Laws Whiskey House 6 Year Old San Luis Valley Bonded Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The first rye whiskey to be Bottled in Bond in Colorado history, it hails from the San Luis Valley rye grain of a single season, shaped by us as the single distiller, then aged in our federally bonded rickhouse for at least four years. COLORADO’S FIRST: Bottled in bond rye in state history MASH BILL: 95% heirloom rye, 5% heirloom barley AGED: 6+ years in new 53-gallon charred oak barrels ALC/VOL: 50%

TITLE: Laws Whiskey House Centennial Straight Wheat Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Made from a single season’s harvest of Centennial Wheat, the heirloom spring soft white varietal grown for us in the San Luis Valley, this is the first wheat whiskey to be Bottled in Bond in Colorado, which, fittingly is known as the Centennial State.

TITLE: Laws Whiskey House Four Grain Cask Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: With our fellow whiskey hunters in mind, Laws select and marry together several Four Grain Bourbon barrels to be bottled at Cask Strength, allowing the noteworthy character and concentrated flavors to come forward at high proof. MASH BILL: 60% corn, 20% heirloom wheat, 10% heirloom rye, 10% heirloom malted barley

TITLE: Laws Whiskey House Four Grain Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: After two Colorado family farms grow the heirloom varietals of wheat, barley, and rye, the distillery's labor-intensive cooking technique brings each grain’s individual character to life, while open-air sour mash adds soulful complexity. After three years in 53-gallon charred oak barrels, influenced by the high-altitude climate, an entirely novel bourbon unfolds. MASH BILL: 60% corn, 20% heirloom wheat, 10% heirloom rye, 10% heirloom malted barley AGED: 3+ years in new 53-gallon charred oak barrels ALC/VOL: 47.5%

TITLE: Laws Whiskey House Four Grain Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: After two Colorado family farms grow the heirloom varietals of wheat, barley, and rye, the distillery's labor-intensive cooking technique brings each grain’s individual character to life, while open-air sour mash adds soulful complexity. After three years in 53-gallon charred oak barrels, influenced by the high-altitude climate, an entirely novel bourbon unfolds. MASH BILL: 60% corn, 20% heirloom wheat, 10% heirloom rye, 10% heirloom malted barley AGED: 3+ years in new 53-gallon charred oak barrels ALC/VOL: 47.5%

TITLE: Laws Whiskey House Henry Road Straight Bonded Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The barley in the Malt Whiskey was literally kept from extinction. While commercial farmers found it too low yield, Wayne Cody found its unstripped flavor too glorious to let go. Today, his sons, in a field alongside Henry Road, continue to grow, as well as malt, this barley for the distillery. MASH BILL: 100% heirloom malted barley AGED: Over four years in new 53-gallon charred oak barrels ALC/VOL: 50%

TITLE: Laws Whiskey House San Luis Valley Cask Strength Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In the brand's pursuit of terroir-driven, unapologetic whiskey, they select and marry individual barrels at cask strength to fully express what initially drew them to the robust flavors of the semi-wild rye cultivated in the San Luis Valley.

TITLE: Laws Whiskey House San Luis Valley Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: 8,000 feet above sea level, in Colorado’s San Luis Valley, the Cody family has been cultivating this low yield, semi-wild rye grain since the 1930s. We fell in love with how it ferments and distills into a terroir-driven, unapologetic whiskey. MASH BILL: 100% heirloom rye. AGED: 3+ years in new 53-gallon charred oak barrels ALC/VOL: 47.5%

TITLE: Laws Whiskey House San Luis Valley Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: 8,000 feet above sea level, in Colorado’s San Luis Valley, the Cody family has been cultivating this low yield, semi-wild rye grain since the 1930s. We fell in love with how it ferments and distills into a terroir-driven, unapologetic whiskey. MASH BILL: 100% heirloom rye. AGED: 3+ years in new 53-gallon charred oak barrels ALC/VOL: 47.5%

TITLE: LDI 1988 Barrel Proof 23 Year Old Rye
DESCRIPTION: LDI 1988 Barrel Proof 23-Year-Old Rye is a rare and highly sought-after whiskey. It was distilled in 1988 by Seagram Lawrenceburg (now MGP) and bottled in 2011 by LDI. This whiskey is barrel proof, meaning that it was bottled without any added water or filtration. This gives the whiskey a rich and full-bodied flavor profile.This 1988 vintage whiskey was distilled by Seagram using a mashbill of 95% rye. It was bottled in 2011 to commemorate the LDI era, which ran from July 2007 until December 2011. Unusually labeled with "thanks for being part of the success," this was gifted to the staff prior to the takeover by MGP. Less than 300 bottles of this rye exist and it remains one of the most sought-after, known "friends & family" bottles ever released.

TITLE: Le Babbler Bordeaux Superieur
DESCRIPTION: Fun and fancy free - Le Babbler is meant to inspire one to babble on and on about anything that brings joy. The wine comes from Château Lauduc, owned by the Grandeau family for four generations. The vineyards and winery are just ten kilometers from downtown Bordeaux in the Entre-Deux-Mers region. The vines average 35 years-old and are grown in limestone clay, siliceous, and gravel soils that give the wine a lot of freshness and balance. Once harvested at their best maturity, the vinification is handled in the modern cellar with thermo-regulated stainless steel tanks used to extract soft tannins and deep color, respecting the fruits’ true expression. In the bottle, you’ll find poetry, art, and inspired conversation. 65% Merlot, 30% Cabernet Sauvignon, 5% Cabernet Franc. Bordeaux Supérieur aged for twelve months in an equal mix of stainless steel and oak barrels. Juicy blackberry and plum notes with lush, supple tannins. A classic Bordeaux for discerning babblers.

TITLE: Le Machin Wines Sta. Rita Hills Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Le Machin is a new project by Mike Roth of Lo-Fi wines. Roth continues to stay true to his roots with minimal intervention and a gentle approach to fruit and extraction. He had a chance to work with CCOF organic Pinot Noir, Syrah, and Chardonnay from the Santa Rita Hills and he scooped up the fruit and Le Machin was born. Mike Roth launched Lo-Fi Wines in 2014 with Craig Winchester while working as winemaker with Coquelicot Estate whose wines shared the Lo-Fi spirit. Roth and Winchester continue Lo-Fi Wines as a high-priority passion project and business while maintaining their winemaking “day jobs Lo-Fi is marked by easy drinking, low alcohol, neutral barrel—if any—oak, native yeasts, little or no sulfur or other interventions that hide the fruit or the vintage that spawned it. Nothing added and nothing taken away.

TITLE: Le Pavillon de Saint-Jacques Lalande de Pomerol
DESCRIPTION: 80% of Merlot, 15% of Cabernet Sauvignon, 5% of Cabernet Franc. Gonzague Maurice, the owner-winemaker, bought an estate (Chateau de Grandchamp) in Montagne-Saint-Emilion in 2005 with vineyards in Saint-Emilion, Puisseguin-Saint-Emilion and Lalande de Pomerol.The estate is 32 acres large regrouping the 4 A.O.C. The fermentation at controlled temperature takes place in cement vats where the wine will mature for 18 months. No wood for this wine, leaving space for the fruit. After a light filtration, the wine is bottled.

TITLE: Le Portier Shay VSOP Cognac
DESCRIPTION: Le Portier Shay VSOP Cognac is a luxurious blend that harmonizes tradition with modern sophistication. This timeless VSOP cognac is the result of intricate craftsmanship and centuries-old tradition. Crafted in the esteemed Charentais copper pot still and aged in French Oak barrels, Shay artfully blends the finest grapes from the Grande Champagne, Petite Champagne, and Fins Bois regions. The resulting cognac is a testament to Le Portier's commitment to excellence and tradition. Conceived by NFL Hall of Famer Shannon Sharpe in honor of his grandmother, Mary Porter, Le Portier Shay is not just a cognac; it's an embodiment of legacy, success, and the power to shape one's destiny. This award-winning cognac has garnered prestigious accolades, including Platinum at the SIP Awards, reflecting its exceptional taste, design, and concept.

TITLE: Le Rocher des Violettes  La Negrette  Montlouis-sur-Loire Sec
DESCRIPTION: • Certified organic • 100% Chenin Blanc • Vines planted in 1922 (80+ years old!) • High density plantings on a south facing slope • Topsoil only 18 inches deep, resting on dense clay and limestone • Aged in large foudré (30% new) • Powerful yet lithe, with unmistakable limestone juiciness coming through

TITLE: Le Temps Infini Malbec
DESCRIPTION: Organic practices in the vineyards which are located around Cahors, France’s natural home for Malbec. The fruit is fully destem med and crushed, followed by a slow fermentation at 20°C. The wine macerates on the skins with “pigeage” (punch-downs) for 15 days. It is then racked off the skins, followed by 8 months of aging in concrete tanks. Light filtration before filling. The goal of the winemaking is to avoid an overly intense extraction and to showcase the beautiful floral and fruit notes that Malbec achieves here in the southwest.

TITLE: Le Vigne di Alice Tajad Vino Frizzante
DESCRIPTION: Tajad’ Frizzante is an affectionate glance back to a time when wine growers in the Prosecco zone had a range of characterful, antique varieties in their vineyards. This wine is Cinzia’s homage to her grandparents, who made a similar field blend of Verdiso, Boschera, and Glera, but as a still rather than a sparkling wine. (By the way, that was the wine that Cinzia’s grandmother, Alice, served in her osteria). Brut dry and ready to please Prosecco historians and dilettantes alike.

TITLE: Ledaig 10 yrs Island Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: AGED: 10 years DISTILLED ON: November 24, 2004 BOTTLE ON: February 20, 2015 MATURED IN: 1st Fill Sherry Butt CASK NO: 900170 BOTTLE NO: of 520 Ledaig scotch comes from the Tobermory distillery, which is proudly one of Scotland’s oldest. Established in 1798, it is the only distillery on Mull. It is unique, not just because of its idyllic location, but because it produces two different, but equally alluring, single malts: the fruity, unpeated Tobermory, and the more robust and smoky Ledaig.

TITLE: Ledaig 11 yrs Island Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Ledaig scotch comes from the Tobermory distillery, which is proudly one of Scotland’s oldest. Established in 1798, it is the only distillery on Mull. It is unique, not just because of its idyllic location, but because it produces two different, but equally alluring, single malts: the fruity, unpeated Tobermory, and the more robust and smoky Ledaig.

TITLE: Legent Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Legent is more than just another bourbon. It pushes the boundaries and redefines how bourbons are created while remaining true to the core of the bourbon’s principles. It’s a collaboration as distinct as the two whiskey legends who made it. Fred Noe from the founding family of bourbon and Jim Beam’s seventh-generation Master Distiller and Shinji Fukuyo from the founding house of Japanese whisky and Suntory’s fifth-ever Chief Blender. Together they created a blend of several unique bourbons aged in newly charred white oak barrels and some extra-aged in wine and sherry casks. The result is a rounded and balanced bourbon that is layered, complex and unlike anything you’ve ever tried.

TITLE: Leipold Bacchus Kabinett Trocken
DESCRIPTION: Delight in the crisp and aromatic profile of Leipold Bacchus Kabinett Trocken. From the prestigious vineyards of Veitshöchheim in the Franconia region of Germany, this exquisite dry white wine is meticulously crafted by Weingut Leipold. Made from the Bacchus grape variety, this Kabinett Trocken showcases the vibrant character and finesse that the Franconian terroir is known for. Perfect for those who appreciate the nuances of German white wines, this Bacchus Kabinett Trocken is a refreshing and elegant choice for any occasion.

TITLE: Lejay Creme de Cassis
DESCRIPTION: In 1841, Auguste Denis Lagoute created the first Crème de Cassis in Dijon, Burgundy. The House of Lejay-Lagoute have been producing the Crème de Cassis ever since. Two varietals of fruit de Cassis or black current makes the original Cassis liqueur, Lejay - 55% Noir de Bourgogne and 45% Black Down. Both varieties are harvested once a year during summer and the traditional process begins with a slow cold maceration in their proprietary vinimatic maceration vats. The liqueur is then decanted with gravity, to preserve the fullest flavor of the fruit. Once the maceration is complete, it is blended with a small batch of au-de-vie and infused with a touch of Cassis Bourgeon Bud to enhance the natural aromas. The entire process is temperature controlled to preserve the essential elements of aroma and taste. Enjoy this cassis on it's own, in cocktails, or in desserts.

TITLE: Lena Filliatreau Saumur Blanc
DESCRIPTION: 100% Chenin Blanc. Lena comes from 35-40-year-old estate vines on limestone as well as some purchased fruit. The grapes are destemmed, pressed and fermented with natural yeasts. The wine is aged in tank on its fine lees before bottling a year after the harvest. Fredrik Filliatreau's father Paul ripped out most of the original Chenin vines back in 1990 in order to plant more Cabernet Franc. But recently they have planted 2 hectares of Chenin in the village of Breze, 10 kilometers east of Saumur. Fish and all kinds of summer salads

TITLE: Leo Steen Saini Farms Chenin Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Experience the essence of California terroir with Leo Steen Saini Farms Chenin Blanc, a captivating white wine crafted by the talented Leo Steen. Sourced from the esteemed Saini Farms, this Chenin Blanc reflects the marriage of exceptional winemaking and the unique characteristics of California's soil and climate.

TITLE: Leopold Bros 25th Anniversary "Foeder Series" Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Leopold Bros 25th Anniversary "Foeder Series" Rye Whiskey is a special limited-edition release celebrating 25 years of artisanal distilling by the esteemed Leopold Bros Distillery in Colorado. This unique rye whiskey is aged in large oak foeders, imparting a distinct character and complexity to the spirit. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, it showcases the distillery's commitment to traditional techniques and innovative aging processes. The carefully selected rye grains and extended maturation result in a rich, nuanced whiskey and full of depth, making it a true testament to Leopold Bros' dedication to excellence in craft spirits.

TITLE: Leopold Brothers 5 Years Old Bottled In Bond Maryland Style Single Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Leopold Brothers 5 Years Old Bottled In Bond Maryland Style Single Barrel Rye Whiskey is a revival of a historic American style of rye whiskey. This Maryland-style rye is crafted with a high-rye mash bill and aged for five years on earthen floors in a dunnage-style warehouse, which ensures a consistent maturation environment. Bottled at 100 proof and non-chill filtered, this rye whiskey offers a robust and flavorful experience.

TITLE: Leopold Brothers 6 Years Aged American Corn Whiskey From Mountain Corn Cask Strength Whiskey 100 Proof
DESCRIPTION: Leopold Brothers 6 Years Aged American Corn Whiskey is a cask strength expression meticulously crafted from mountain corn, highlighting the terroir of its origin. This whiskey undergoes a remarkable 6-year aging process in a traditional dunnage warehouse, resulting in a rich and complex flavor profile. Distilled, aged, and bottled by the esteemed Leopold Brothers, this whiskey embodies their commitment to quality and craftsmanship. Leopold Brothers 6 Years Aged American Corn Whiskey is a sophisticated and bold expression that showcases the distillery's dedication to traditional methods and innovative spirit, making it a must-try for whiskey enthusiasts and collectors.

TITLE: Leopold Brothers 8 Years Old Cask Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished In Three Chambers Rye Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Leopold Brothers 8 Years Old Cask Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Three Chambers Rye Barrels is a unique and luxurious expression from this family-owned distillery. This bourbon is aged for 8 years in a traditional dunnage warehouse with an earthen floor, which helps maintain a consistent maturation environment. The bourbon is then finished in barrels that previously held their signature Three Chamber Rye Whiskey, adding an extra layer of complexity and flavor.

TITLE: Leopold Brothers Three Chamber Bottle in Bond Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Leopold Bros Three Chamber Bottle in Bond Rye Whiskey is a unique and historic revival of American rye whiskey. The whiskey is crafted using a painstakingly re-engineered Three Chamber Still, a standard method over a hundred years ago but ceased production after World War II. This method, combined with the heritage grain Abruzzi rye, resurrects a heavy-bodied whiskey style that had been lost to time. This whiskey is a single-barrel offering, and was hand-selected by Todd Leopold, ensuring a rich aroma and a complex palate. The whiskey offers distinctive flavors, encapsulating the essence of an American classic.

TITLE: Les Agaves Cotes de Provence Rose
Les Jamelles Vin de Pays d'Oc Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: This is another example of the way in which Catherine Delaunay has transferred her family know-how to the South of France. This wine, which is produced in limited quantities, is quite different from preconceived ideas people generally have about Pinot Noir wines when the variety is grown away from its homeland. Serve with traditional food such as shepherd's pie, gratins, stews, grilled meats, rib of beef, steak au poivre or loin of lamb.

TITLE: Les Trois Sources Vin De Provence Rose
DESCRIPTION: Les Trois Sources Vin De Provence Rosé delights the senses with its delicate pink color and enticing aromas. It is a true reflection of the winery's commitment to quality and their passion for producing exceptional wines. Les Trois Sources Vin De Provence Rosé is a versatile wine that pairs beautifully with a variety of dishes. Its bright acidity and fruit-forward character make it an excellent companion to Mediterranean-inspired cuisine, such as grilled seafood, roasted vegetables, and fresh salads. It also complements lighter meats like roasted chicken or turkey. For a delightful combination, enjoy it alongside a selection of artisanal cheeses or a refreshing summer fruit tart. Let Les Trois Sources Vin De Provence Rosé transport you to the idyllic landscapes of Provence with its exquisite flavors and timeless charm.

TITLE: Les Vignerons Reunis Chateauneuf-du-pape
Les Vins Contes Pinot Noir Pinoir de Soif
DESCRIPTION: Olivier Lemasson is a sommelier who encountered natural wines when he worked for an early proponent of those wines, the retailer Eric Mace in Rennes, Brittany. Lemasson became passionate about these odd wines, and trained at Marcel Lapierre’s winery in Morgon, Beaujolais, first by picking grapes four years in a row, then by working for a whole year in his vines and cellar. After a brief stint as a retailer at Square Trousseau in Paris, Lemasson’s passion definitely took over, and he settled as a winemaker in Chitenay, Touraine. The story of les Vins Contes is that of a retailer meeting a winemaker. In 2002, Herve Villemade, owner of the 12 HA estate Domaine du Moulin in Cellettes (Cheverny AOC), was looking to start a negociant business (i.e. buy grapes from other growers to vinify them.) He picked Lemasson to be his partner and les Vins Contés drew from their complementary talents.

TITLE: Les Vins de Vienne Les Cranilles Cotes du Rhone
DESCRIPTION: The very old history of this vineyard dates back to the Romans who brought the vineyard to the Rhone Valley. In view of preserving the area’s diversity, its vintners have always made the most out of its mosaic of soils and climates. AOC Cotes du Rhone was created in 1937 and includes 23 grape varieties. 80% of the area’s wine production involves the regional appellation, whereas the rest is represented by the 13 crus wines and the village appellations

TITLE: Les Vins Pirouettes (Binner) Alsace Litron De David Rouge
DESCRIPTION: Fun fact: David plays classical music continuously in his cellar during vinification. Grapes: 100% Pinot Noir Vineyard: Granite, Southern exposure. Organically farmed Making of: The grapes are hand-harvested and sorted in the vineyard. The grapes are gently stomped and macerated for 10 days. Bottled unfined, unfiltered, unsulfured in the summer following the harvest.

TITLE: Les Vins Pirouettes Alsace "Saveurs de Raphael"
DESCRIPTION: Perfect with Asian food, spicy food night or a rich cheese.

TITLE: Les Vins Pirouettes by Binner & Compagnie "Le Brutal!!! de Stephane"
DESCRIPTION: Vineyard: Bildstoeckle, one of Stephane’s signature and most interesting sites. Silt on oolithic limestone. Organic and biodynamic-certified Cellar: Grapes are sorted while harvested by hand, then macerated for 15 days as whole bunches (natural carbonic maceration). Gentle pressing, elevage on lees in stainless steel tanks, for 20 months. Racked and bottled without fining, filtration or sulfur added.

TITLE: Les Vins Pirouettes by Binner & Compagnie Alsace "La Bullette" De David
DESCRIPTION: Grapes are hand-harvested, direct-pressed, and fermented with indigenous yeast and zero sulfur. The wine ferments in stainless steel tanks and spends some time on the lees before it is transferred to bottles to finish as a naturally sparkling wine with zero additions of sugar, yeast, or sulfur. The wine is unfiltered and is not disgorged. Personality: a distinct Riesling character underlined by gentle fizz.

TITLE: Les Vins Pirouettes by Binner & Compagnie Alsace Pinot Noir d'Hubert et Christian
DESCRIPTION: Vineyard: 1ha of 40yo vines on gneiss, certified organic (ECOCERT since 2014) Varieties: Pinot Noir Cellar: Grapes are hand-harvested with a first triage in the vines and second on the sorting table in the winery. After 15 days of maceration, the wine is gently pressed and aged on lees in stainless steel tank, for about one year. Bottled with zero addition of sulfur (10ppm total), unfined and unfiltered.

TITLE: Les Vins Pirouettes by Binner & Compagnie Eros De David
DESCRIPTION: Varieties: 40% Pinot Gris, 40% Riesling, 20% Sylvaner

TITLE: Les Vins Pirouettes by Binner & Compagnie Eros De Vincent
DESCRIPTION: Les Vins Pirouettes Eros De Vincent is an orange wine made from a blend of Pinot Gris, Riesling, and Sylvaner grapes grown in the Alsace region of France. The wine has a pale amber color and aromas of tangerine, tomatillo, persimmon, preserved lemon, white pepper, and coriander. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with ripe fruit flavors, acidity, and minerality. The finish is long and lingering. Orange wine is a type of white wine that is made using the same methods as red wine. The grape skins are left on during fermentation, which gives the wine its characteristic orange color and flavor profile. Orange wines are often described as being more complex and savory than traditional white wines. Les Vins Pirouettes Eros De Vincent is a delicious and refreshing orange wine that is perfect for any occasion. It is a great pairing for a variety of foods, including grilled or roasted meats, poultry, and seafood. It can also be enjoyed with cheese and charcuterie.

TITLE: Les Vins Pirouettes Orange Cubique Francois
DESCRIPTION: Les Vins Pirouettes Orange Cubique Francois is a unique and delicious orange wine from the Alsace region of France. It is made from 100% Gewürztraminer grapes, which are typically used to make white wine. However, for this wine, the grapes are left in contact with their skins for a period of time, which gives the wine its orange color and unique flavor profile. This wine has a hazy amber color and aromas of orange peel, apricot, and spice. On the palate, it is dry and medium-bodied, with flavors of orange, peach, and spice. The wine has a long and refreshing finish. Les Vins Pirouettes Orange Cubique Francois is a versatile wine that can be enjoyed with a variety of foods. It is particularly well-suited to grilled fish, poultry, and pork dishes. It can also be enjoyed on its own as an aperitif.

TITLE: Les Vins Pirouettes Ultra Violet By David
DESCRIPTION: Christian Binner started a movement of real wine in Alsace. He and his friends now make a bunch of different wines under the 'Les Vins Pirouettes' label. This is from Domaine Muller-Koeberle in Saint-Hippolyte. It is an alive red-white coferment. Grapes: Auxerrois 12.5%, Pinot blanc 20.8%, Pinot Noir 26.6%, Muscat 6.6%, Pinot Gris 16.6%, Riesling 12.5%, Gewurztraminer 4.1%

TITLE: Liberty School Paso Robles Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Varietally on target, reliable year after year, Liberty School Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay and Cuvee consistently over-deliver value wines of outstanding quality. The Hope family has been making Liberty School Cabernet Sauvignon since 1990. In 1996, when the Hopes established Treana Winery, the Liberty School brand officially became part of Hope Family Wines. Liberty School wines are made in a traditional style. Fruit driven, they are crafted to reflect true varietal character. The wines are barrel-aged, employing very little new oak. Oak is used as a building component rather than a flavoring agent. A big brand, made by a small, close family, Liberty School is the home of delicious wines that are easy to enjoy. This Cabernet pairs well with a grilled sirloin, lamb chops, or chocolate truffles.

TITLE: Lieb Cellars Bridge Lane Rose
DESCRIPTION: Lieb Cellars is an 84-acre sustainably farmed vineyard located on the North Fork of Long Island, 80 miles east of New York City. Lieb was founded in 1992 and debuted their first line of reserve wines in 1999 under the direction of Australian-born winemaker Russell Hearn, with the Pinot Blanc and the Blanc de Blancs sparkling wine quickly gaining national recognition. The next year, they opened their first tasting room on the North Fork of Long Island in Mattituck, NY. As wineries do when they become more popular, Lieb Cellars began to expand production, and, in 2004, introduced the Bridge Lane series: lighter, fruitier “every day” wines at more affordable price points. Two of the hardest cuisines to match with wine, are robust Central American dishes and flavorful curries from India and South East Asia. Dishes that use a lot of spices, peppers, and salt tend to be very busy on the palate- so we must seek a wine that will be refreshing and calming to the palate. Here is where this dry rose shines!

TITLE: Lieb Cellars Reserve Sparkling Rose
DESCRIPTION: Made with 66% Pinot Noir and 34% Chardonnay and using Methode Champenoise – the method used in the Champagne region of France – this is a bright, focused sparkler that really excels at the dinner table. Only 500 cases produced. 90 points by Wine Advocate. Platter of varied cheeses, with simply prepared Peconic Bay scallops or with fried chicken.

TITLE: Light Horse Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Leading the charge towards a better tomorrow. Forward! Jamieson Ranch Vineyards has formed the Light Horse Foundation, dedicated to helping at-risk individuals, particularly those with autism, and supporting other important humanitarian causes. A portion of profits from this brand will go to support the Light Horse Foundation.

TITLE: Lillet Blanc Aperitif
DESCRIPTION: Lillet is the only wine-based aperitif, a blend of 85% wine and 15% citrus liqueurs, produced in Bordeaux, France. The wines are carefully selected in the Podensac area and the citrus liqueurs are produced by cold macerating fruit peels in pure distilled spirits for several months. Following the Bordelaise tradition, Lillet is aged in oak so that it acquires its soft and rich character. Because it is not oxidized or aromatized with herbs like vermouths, nor artificially concentrated, Lillet is a very unique product. -baked beans -lamb chops -roasted vegetables

TITLE: Lillet Rose Aperitif
DESCRIPTION: Like Lillet Blanc, the main grape variety in Lillet Rose is Semillon. These wines are combined with natural liqueurs, handcrafted in Podensac from sweet and bitter oranges and berries. It is this meticulously balanced blend that gives Lillet Rose its delicate aromas.

TITLE: Lini 910 Labrusca Rosso
DESCRIPTION: For the production of Lini's classic Martinotti-method Lambrusco (also known as Charmat-method Lambrusco), a still Lambrusco is produced and then racked to pressurized, temperature-controlled tanks where the second fermentation is provoked. The wines are then aged on their lees until the desired complexity and nuance are achieved. Lini Lambrusco is the quintessential pairing for Emilian gastronomy. But its remarkable versatility also makes it a wonderful match for a wide variety of cuisines, including Asian, Mexican, and classic American. Many top sommeliers reach for Lini wines to pair with oysters. And many claim it's the ultimate BBQ wine.

TITLE: Linkwood 10 yrs Speyside Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Matured in a pair of hogsheads for a decade, this 2008-vintage Linkwood single malt was bottled in March 2019 for Signatory Vintage’s Un-Chillfiltered Collection.

TITLE: Linkwood 21 yrs Speyside Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: ABV: 43.0% AGE: 21 Year Old VINTAGE: 1995 CASK TYPE: Hogsheads CASK #: #5932 & #5936 BOTTLER: Signatory Vintage REGION: Speyside TYPE: Single Malt Scotch

TITLE: Linkwood 22 yrs Speyside Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This stunning Linkwood 22 Year Old was created in Speyside in 1996 and matured in a single hogshead cask before being bottled by Signatory Vintage for their Cask Strength Collection in 2019. It brings an incredible range of fruity and sweet notes together in typical Speyside fashion and is as well-balanced, smooth and delicious a whisky as you will find. As a single cask whisky of which only 250 bottles were produced, quantities are limited to act fast if you want to add this beauty to your collection!

TITLE: Linkwood 7 yrs Speyside Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A single cask Whisky from Linkwood Distillery. Distilled in 2008 and aged for 7 years in a Bourbon Barrel #800003. Only 238 bottles produced.

TITLE: Linkwood 8 yrs Speyside Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The original distillery was built in 1821 on the southern outskirts of Elgin by one Peter Brown. However, his distillery was completely demolished and rebuilt by his son William in the 1870s. A new still-house with four new stills was added in the 1970s and is now the focus of malt production – the old wash-backs are the only part of the old distillery still in use today.

TITLE: Linkwood Hogshead 20 yrs Highland 86 Proof Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Built on the outskirts of Elgin in 1821 by Peter Brown, the distillery takes its name from the nearby Brown family home, the Linkwood house. James Walker & Co. ran the distillery from 1842 until 1868 when Peter Brown died and his son, William, succeeded him. In 1872 William completely rebuilt the distillery. In 1932 Linkwood came under the ownership of SMD and subsequently Diageo. In 1962, the distillery was rebuilt once again but great care was taken so that the new stills were exact replicas of the existing ones. In 1971 a second distillery unit was installed at Linkwood that housed another four stills, with the intention of being a single make. The old side of the distillery was mothballed in 1985, however it was reopened in 1990 and continues to operate for a few months each year. 1995 pictured!

TITLE: LIOCO Indica Rose
DESCRIPTION: LIOCO is the result of a years-long conversation between Matt Licklider (a seasoned wine import specialist) and Kevin O'Connor (former wine director at Michelin Two-Star Spago-Beverly Hills) about whether California could produce a true "wine of origin." After gathering opinion on the subject from some of the world's great wine producers, they arrived at their conclusion: California can achieve a wine of origin, provided certain protocols are adhered to--both in the vineyard and in the cellar. Everything begins in the vineyard--without a compelling vineyard site, there is little chance of creating a distinctive wine. Inspired by traditional European winegrowing practices, they seek out vineyard sites with tougher soil, older vines, and some stress-producing aspect (altitude, extreme temperature, poor soil, etc). Then they simply shepherd the grapes from bud to bottle in the least intrusive way possible. This disciplined approach serves to amplify the voice of the vineyard, or the unique flavors and aromas tied inextricably to the soil. What registers is: this wine came from this place only, and could not have come from anywhere else. This is a wine of origin. Such singularity in wine is worth pursuing. It is alas what keeps their fires burning. Chips & guac, chicken wings, fish soup

TITLE: Liquid Geography Bierzo Rosado
DESCRIPTION: The Liquid Geography Mencia Rosado is a dry Rose’ wine sourced from 53-year-old vines in the region of Bierzo, northwest Spain. The vineyards practice organic farming methods. Mencia is a Red grape that is indigenous to the area, and Bierzo has a wine history that dates back to the Roman times. This Rose sees no oak and is fermented and aged in stainless steel vats. Liquid Geography is produced from vineyards owned by the Guerra winery, which farms 1/3 of all the vineyards of the Bierzo region. Out of the 3,000ha (7,413 acres) of vineyard land in Bierzo, Guerra takes care of 1,000ha (2,471 acres). However, they only make wine with the best 10% of grapes. This rigorous, selective process allows Liquid Geography to show, consistently, extraordinary quality.Producer donates 100% of Liquid Geography's profits in equal parts to the TJ Martell Foundation in its search for cancer cures; the South Bronx Educational Foundation to help children with challenging academic backgrounds; and starting in 2017, Mary's Meals for school meals in some of Producer donates 100% of Liquid Geography's profits in equal parts to the TJ Martell Foundation in its search for cancer cures; the South Bronx Educational Foundation to help children with challenging academic backgrounds; and starting in 2017, Mary's Meals for school meals in some of world's poorest countries. Pairs well with pizza and white meats.

TITLE: Lise et Bertrand Jousset Exile Rose Pet Nat
DESCRIPTION: The vineyards are spread across 25 parcels with vines ranging from 30 to 130 years for the oldest vines. The Jousset’s fundamental and profound respect for nature led them to exclude herbicides and pesticides in favor of the balance that biological diversity promises down to the microscopic level. They believe that to make an original wine it is necessary to have living soils with high microbial activity, a “living” vine, and a balanced life between plants and animals in all of the domain’s parcels.

TITLE: Listening Rock Gin
DESCRIPTION: LISTENING ROCK is a rock rumored to be located in the hills behind our farm. A place where, if you stop, you can hear the comings and goings of the Oblong Valley. This gin will hopefully entice you to sit still and listen to the world around you. Take some time to be present in the moment and appreciate nature. Every batch of our LISTENING ROCK gin has botanicals steeped in it. Brand makes the base spirit from grain grown in New York State. They are also growing as many botanicals themselves as the climate allows. They separate and individually distill four botanicals to have better control over their inclusion and representation in the gin. Finally, each batch receives its own portion of botanicals to steep overnight before being distilled the next day. Brand experimented with many different recipes before we settled on this fifth batch as the favorite.

TITLE: Litchfield Distillery 10 Years Double Barreled Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: We bottled our last barrel of this delicious bourbon and we are completely sold out at the Distillery. There may be remaining bottles at some our retail partners that carry Litchfield Distillery spirits. We recently introduced a new 5-Year Double-Barrel Bourbon that replaces this 10-year.

TITLE: Litchfield Distillery Port-Cask-Finish Bourbon Whiskey
Little Rest  American Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: We're thrilled to introduce "Little Rest" Single Malt, a name inspired by a hill close to the distillery, historically so steep it demanded an additional horse to aid carts uphill. This spot later became a quaint hamlet where horses and drivers took "a little rest." As you explore this exquisite whisky, we invite you to embrace its heritage and share a pause with your loved ones. Having been barreled in 2020, "Little Rest" finally graced our shelves in September 2023. This distiller's commitment to quality and patience is evident in every sip. Aged meticulously in Francois Freres barrels originally from Williams Selyem, this whisky promises a delightful experience for all aficionados.

TITLE: Lo-Fi Wines Cabernet Franc Rose
DESCRIPTION: Lo-Fi is a partnership between two lifelong friends who believe in hand crafted honest wines that are made for every day drinking. Wines to be enjoyed not to be collected. Easy drinking lower alcohol wines made to pair well with all types of foods, from pizza to paté. We believe in neutral barrels, native yeasts, little to no sulfur additions, and no adjustment of pH. We love whole cluster fermentation. We adore carbonic maceration . We embrace a nothing added, nothing taken away philosophy that gives birth to wines that are young, vibrant and alive. But in all reality Lo-Fi is less about what it is and more about what it is not. It is not over manipulated. It is not over extracted. It is not over ripe and it is not over priced.

TITLE: Lo-Fi Wines Santa Barbara Country Cabernet Franc Clos Mullet
DESCRIPTION: This is a single vineyard and the only vineyard that Mike Rothe actually owns. This site tends to make a little more structured/ serious cab franc than any other he works with. Hand-harvested and organically grown; 100% de-stemmed. Pumped over once daily. No sulfur used at harvest. Fermented on the native yeasts, followed by full malolactic by naturally occurring bacteria. The wine was fermented for two weeks then pressed to tank, settled, then racked to barrel the following day. Total of 20 ppm so2 added without filtration in keeping with our minimalist (lo-fi) philosophy.
