TITLE: Local Delivery
Loch Lomond 12 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A perfectly balanced single malt whisky, matured in three types of cask – bourbon, refill and re-charred. The Loch Lomond 12 year old is a perfect representation of our signature style, delivering a deep fruity character that is overlaid with a hint of peat and smoke.

TITLE: Lock Stock & Barrel 16 Year Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Lock Stock & Barrel 16 Year Straight Rye Whiskey is double distilled from a rare mash bill of 100 percent rye grain in copper pot stills with a “robust cut” selected by master distillers, unfiltered, then aged in cold weather for 16 years in newly charred American oak barrels. Explosively flavorful and intense, yet perfectly balanced, Lock Stock & Barrel is a tightly woven fabric of aromatics, with notes that suggest roasted acorns, sour grass, wild cherries, stewed blackberry, dried pear, and sassafras.

TITLE: Lock Stock & Barrel 18 Year Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Lock Stock & Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey is double distilled from a rare mash bill of 100 percent rye grain. A “robust cut” is selected by master distillers, then the unfiltered spirit is aged in new charred American Oak barrels in cold weather.

TITLE: Lock Stock & Barrel 20 Year Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Lock, Stock & Barrel 20-Year is sourced from Alberta Distillers Ltd. barrels that were hand-selected by late spirits luminary, and third-generation distiller Robert J. Cooper. It’s made from a rare mash bill of 100% rye grain in copper pot stills, and a “robust cut” is then selected and aged in cold weather in newly charred - not toasted - American oak barrels. Because American whiskeys must be aged in new charred oak barrels to be labeled bourbon or rye, they run the risk of becoming over-oaked the longer they’re aged. Lock, Stock & Barrel 20-Year avoids this result due to the cold climate, 3.5 barrel char, and lack of toasting, providing a rich and robust, yet balanced, flavor. On the nose, the whiskey gives warm spice, toffee, and bright stone fruit. To taste, it's intensely flavorful and well balanced, with a luxuriously full-bodied palate that explodes with caramel, clove, and cinnamon-like a warm spiced date cake with dried apricot, cantaloupe, and peppery rye. A long and velvety finish lingers with notes of butterscotch and a honeyed rye spice dry down. Bottled at 56% abv.

TITLE: Lock Stock & Barrel 21 Year Aged Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Straight Rye Whiskey, aged 21 yrs, 55.5% abv distilled and barreled in may 1999 cold weather matured a robust cut selected by master distillers 100 percent rye grain mashbill double distilled in copper pots aged in new charred american oak barrels

TITLE: Lombard Gold Label Blended Scotch Whisky
Lone Whisker 12 Year Old Kentucky Straight Boourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Lone Whisker is a proprietary small-batch blend of 74% corn, 21% rye and 5% malted barley. Proofed at a mouth-savory 93.8 ABV. Dried orange peel, sweet tangelo, toffee, and dark chocolate topped off with a hint of pink peppercorn

TITLE: Longmorn 13 yrs Islay Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Build on the site of an old chapel, the Longmorn distillery has been founded by John Duff and two associates, Charles Shirres and George Thomson in 1894, together with its neighbor Benriach. In the early 1970s, Longmorn merged with the distillery "The Glenlivet" to create "The Glenlivet Distillers Ltd". The distillery doubled its production capacity in 1972 and again in 1974. The number of stills went from 4 to 8. Seagram purchased the distillery in 1977. Longmorn is one of the few distilleries who never stopped production. Longmorn is part of the collection "Heritage Collection" AGED: 13 years ALC: 46%

TITLE: Longmorn Hogshead 24 yrs Speyside Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A missionary named Maernanaog, or Mo-ernin-og, had brought Christianity to the Picts of Moray during the 7th Century. A church was built just outside of Elgin, following his death in 625AD and named LannMarnoch, the Church of St Marnoch. Over the course of time, the name 'LannMarnoch' gradually became Anglicised and eventually the area was known as Longmorn. Construction began on a distillery on the site in 1893 under John Duff and Company, founders of Glenlossie in 1876.

TITLE: Lopez de Heredia Cubillo Crianza
DESCRIPTION: Tempranillo (65%), Garnacha (25%), the rest divided between Mazuelo and Graciano from the Cubillos Vineyard. Aged 3 years in barrel and 4-5 years in bottle.

TITLE: Lopez De Heredia Tondonia Rose Gran Reserva 2010
DESCRIPTION: Characteristics of the Vintage: A year officially rated as VERY GOOD. The vine year passed normally, with the exception of the abundant precipitations that took place in June. However, it did not have a negative effect in the setting of the grapes. This good fertilization and absence of spring frost was followed by a dry and hot summer, free of neither cryptogamic nor fungal diseases, which produced an abundant harvest. Besides, some ripening inequalities were observed in this harvest, which could be corrected during October, which was very appropriate regarding the climatic aspect for the realization of a calm and selective harvest. The harvest started on September 22nd and lasted until the 25th of the same month for the white varieties. For the red varieties, the harvest was re-started on October 7th in "Vina Tondonia", and the work was not stopped until its completion on October 24th. Color: Onion skin colour. Nose: Fresh and persistent.Taste: Smooth and fresh with body and complexity due to the ageing conditions.

TITLE: Lopez de Heredia Vina Tondonia Reserva
Los Caracoles Malbec Mendoza
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the robust and velvety flavors of Los Caracoles Malbec. This exceptional red wine hails from the esteemed vineyards of Uco Valley in Mendoza, Argentina. Crafted by Los Caracoles, this Malbec captures the essence of the region's terroir with its rich character and deep complexity. Perfect for those who appreciate the depth and richness of Argentine Malbec, Los Caracoles Malbec offers a memorable and sophisticated tasting experience.

TITLE: Los Chuchaquis Champelli Sparkling Wine Of Albarino
DESCRIPTION: 100% Albarino. 28% of the grape come of C5 vineyard in Santa Ynes and the remaining 72% from Rorick Heritage vineyard in Calaveras County, Sierra Foothills. The grapes were picked over several passes between the two vineyards and all the fruit was directly pressed to tank for settling. All the separate lots fermented spontaneously in tank before getting racked and blended for 2 months. A tank of chilled reserve Albarino juice was added at bottling for 2nd fermentation in bottle. No added sulfites. Unfined and unfiltered, and non-disgorged.

TITLE: Los Siete Misterios Doba-Yej-Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: Los Siete Misterios Mezcal is inspired by the habits and traditions of the Mexican culture, as well as the passion of its people who have helped to enhance our product. Driven and motivated by these qualities, they are searching to relive the past and integrate it with our present, to create a visual identity that has been theirs for centuries. It is about creating a familiarity, while hoping to transmit a modern sensibility with a strong presence, through which they all feel identified.

TITLE: Lost Lantern American Vatted Malt Edition No. 1
DESCRIPTION: Dive into the pioneering spirit of American craft distilling with Lost Lantern American Vatted Malt Edition No. 1, one of the first American blends of single malt whiskies. This release celebrates the true spirit of collaboration and innovation across the whiskey landscape. A Monument to Collaboration Lost Lantern Edition No. 1 is not just a whiskey; it's a testament to unity and craftsmanship. It was created through a unique collaboration of founders and distillers from some of the most innovative distilleries in the United States, who each contributed their finest barrels to this historic blend. Participating Distilleries: Balcones, Texas: Known for bold and intense flavors. Copperworks, Washington: Crafts spirits that reflect the maritime influence of the Pacific Northwest. Santa Fe Spirits, New Mexico: Offers whiskies that capture the essence of the Southwestern terroir. Triple Eight, Massachusetts: Specializes in artisanal spirits with a coastal character. Westward, Oregon: Renowned for robust and vibrant Pacific Northwest single malts. Virginia Distillery Co., Virginia: Produces elegantly styled and expressive whiskies. Product Details: Proof: 105, offering a bold yet balanced profile. Quantity: A limited run of 3,000 bottles. Volume: 750ml. Age: Matured for 2 years. Crafting Notes: Non-chill filtered and no color added to preserve the natural essence of the whiskey.

TITLE: Lost Lantern Boulder Colorado Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished In An Armagnac Cask
DESCRIPTION: Discover the Lost Lantern 2024 Single Cask #13, a unique collaboration with Boulder Spirits in Colorado. This distillery blends Scottish whisky-making traditions with the bold, dry environment of the Colorado Rockies, resulting in powerful and distinctive spirits. This exceptional bourbon, the brand's first-ever finished expression, features a high-malt mashbill and has been aged for 4.5 years in new American oak, followed by an additional 2.5 years in an ex-Armagnac cask. The result is a remarkable whiskey with a cask strength of 125.5 proof. Product Details: Age: 7 years Mashbill: 51% corn, 44% malted barley, 5% rye Barrel Details: New American oak, char 3, Kelvin Cooperage Barrel Entry Proof: 124 Quantity Produced: 300 bottles Format: 750ml Distillery Location: Boulder, CO Notes: Non-chill-filtered, no color added Experience the vibrant character of Lost Lantern’s Single Cask #13—limited to just 300 bottles. Grab yours before it's gone!

TITLE: Lost Lantern Brooklyn Bakery Kings County Distillery Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Kings County Distillery, the oldest distillery in New York City, creates some of the country’s most acclaimed and sought-after whiskies. The distillery brings together American and European distilling traditions and uses New York-grown grains to make whiskies that embody the essence and energy of the country’s largest city. This is a marriage of eight different barrels of 5 and 6-year-old Kings County bourbons that come together to create a powerful, sweet, and spicy straight bourbon. It has rich dark chocolate notes, with hints of pecan pie, graham cracker, blackberry cobbler, and cherry tart. It reminds us of a Brooklyn bakery on a cold winter morning… and we would know, because that's where we are from!

TITLE: Lost Lantern Corbin Cash California Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Lost Lantern brings an exclusive release from Corbin Cash Distillery in California's Central Valley, a region famed for its agricultural heritage. For over a century, the Souza family has grown premium sweet potatoes and rye, producing grain-to-glass whiskeys embody this fertile region's rich, sun-soaked bounty. This single cask bourbon is crafted from 75% yellow corn grown on a nearby farm, 15% rye, and 10% malted barley. Aged for 8 years in new American oak, this bourbon delivers bold flavors with exceptional depth. Indulge in notes of dark chocolate, fresh raspberries, white chocolate mousse, leather, and a hint of cinnamon, with a finish that is remarkably long and satisfying. Tasting Notes: Nose: Dark chocolate and white chocolate mousse with fresh raspberries. Palate: Bold and rich with hints of leather, cinnamon, and dark fruit. Finish: Extraordinarily long, carrying chocolate and spice to the very end. Product Details: Proof: 146.2 Age: 8 Years Mashbill: 75% Yellow Corn, 15% Rye, 10% Malted Barley Barrel: New American Oak, 53-gallon Exclusivity: NY Exclusive Cask for Fall 2024 Produced: Limited to 147 bottles Experience the unique character of California's Central Valley in every sip with this rare and limited bourbon, exclusively available this fall. Perfect for collectors and bourbon enthusiasts seeking a bold, memorable pour with a true farm-to-glass heritage.

TITLE: Lost Lantern Far-Flung Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Lost Lantern Far-Flung Bourbon is a unique and powerful blend of straight bourbons from four distilleries across the United States: Frey Ranch Distillery (Fallon, NV): Mashbill of 67% corn, 12% malted barley, 11% rye, and 10% wheat, aged 5 years. Watershed Distillery (Columbus, OH): Five-grain mashbill (corn, rye, wheat, malted barley, spelt), aged 7 years. Boulder Spirits (Boulder, CO): Mashbill of 51% corn, 44% malted barley, and 5% rye, aged 6 years. Still Austin Whiskey Co. (Austin, TX): Mashbill of 70% white corn, 25% Brasetto rye, 5% malted wild fire barley, aged 3 years. Each bourbon is crafted in a distinct climate, bringing its distinctive flavor profile to the blend. This bourbon is a testament to American whiskey-making's diverse and rich tradition.

TITLE: Lost Lantern Far-Flung Bourbon II
DESCRIPTION: Celebrate the diversity of American whiskey with the second edition of our Far-Flung Bourbon. This release unites rare and distinctive bourbons from across the eastern United States, presenting a symphony of flavors previously unexplored. Distilleries Contributing to This Blend: Starlight Distillery, IN: Known for balanced bourbons with a slightly spicy profile. Kings County Distillery, NY: Features prominently in urban-crafted spirits with a bold taste. Rich Grain Distilling, MS: Delivers a southern charm with varied mash bills, including wheated variations. Smooth Ambler, WV: Celebrated for its robust and flavorful rye-influenced bourbons. Wollersheim Distillery, WI: A northern approach to whiskey with unique grain selections. Product Details: Batch: FFB-2 Proof: 126.6, reflecting its cask strength nature Age Statement: Ranges from 5 to 7 years, showcasing maturity and depth Mashbills Across Distilleries: Starlight: 60% corn, 20% malted barley, 10% rye, 10% wheat Kings County: 80% corn, 20% malted barley Rich Grain: Mix of standard and wheated mashbills Smooth Ambler: 57% corn, 36% rye, 7% malted barley Wollersheim: 75% corn, 10% wheat, 15% malted barley Barrel Specifications: Starlight: New American oak, char 3 Kings County: 15 gallon, new American oak, Barrel Mill Rich Grain: 15 gallon, new American oak, Barrel Mill Smooth Ambler: New American oak, ISC, char 4 Wollersheim: New ISC Cooper’s Select, char 4 Craftsmanship: Cask strength, non-chill-filtered, no color added, ensuring a pure and unaltered tasting experience.

TITLE: Lost Lantern Far-Flung Rye
DESCRIPTION: Lost Lantern Far-Flung Rye is an exceptional blend that combines the finest rye whiskeys from various esteemed distilleries across the USA. This unique expression, curated by Lost Lantern, showcases the diverse flavors and rich heritage of American rye whiskey. Bottled at a robust 121.6 proof, Far-Flung Rye delivers an intense and complex tasting experience that rye enthusiasts will treasure. Each 750ml bottle reflects the meticulous craftsmanship and adventurous spirit of Lost Lantern, making it a distinctive addition to any collection. This special blend unites straight rye whiskies from notable distilleries across the Midwest, from Indiana to Iowa. Each whiskey, aged between four and nine years, contributes to a full-bodied and richly flavored experience.

TITLE: Lost Lantern Gentle Giant Balcones Distilling Texas Single Malt
DESCRIPTION: The brand collaborated to craft a more delicate and elegant single malt to explore a different facet of Balcones Distilling, known for its intense Texas whiskies. This expression is a harmonious blend of select casks, showcasing a softer side of the Texan pioneer. Product Details: Proof: 115.2 Quantity: Limited production of 1,100 bottles Volume: 750ml Age: 3-5 years Mashbill: 100% malted barley Barrel Entry Proof: Between 124.3 proof and 124.4 proof Distillery Location: Waco, TX Crafting Notes: Non-chill-filtered, no color added, emphasizing natural flavors. Barrel Composition: Casks 1 & 2: Initially aged 3 years and 9 months in 53-gallon apple brandy casks, then proofed slightly, rebarreled, and finished for 1 month in another apple brandy cask. Cask 3: Aged 3 years and 2 days in a 60-gallon ISC European oak cask, utilizing 36-month yard-aged staves. Cask 4: Aged 3 years and 30 days in a similar 60-gallon ISC European oak cask. Cask 5: Matured 4 years and 4 months in a 53-gallon ex-bourbon cask. Cask 6 (partial): Aged 3 years and 56 days in a 60-gallon ISC European oak cask.

TITLE: Lost Lantern J. Rieger & Co. Missouri Straight Rye Whiskey Single Cask
DESCRIPTION: Introducing the Lost Lantern Fall 2024 Exclusive Cask from J. Rieger & Co., a historic pre-prohibition brand that was revitalized in 2014 as Kansas City's first distillery in nearly a century. This hazmat proof straight rye whiskey pays homage to the brand's legacy while celebrating the vibrant culture of Kansas City. This exceptional rye, aged for 7 years in a 53-gallon new American oak barrel, is crafted from a mash bill of 96% rye and 4% malted barley. Secure your bottle of this limited-release rye whiskey, a testament to J. Rieger & Co.'s rich history and commitment to quality. Don't miss out on this exclusive offering!

TITLE: Lost Lantern Mississippi Memory Rich Grain Distilling Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Discover the legacy of Rich Grain Distilling, a distillery that thrived on Mississippi's distinctive climate until its closure in 2020. This release captures what founder David Rich envisioned: a true Mississippi bourbon that embodies the Deep South's character. Tasting Profile Nose: Aromatic notes of graham cracker, roasted corn, and toasted oak evoke the richness of Mississippi's soil. Palate: Dive into flavors of chocolate cream pie, molasses, and robust oak—each sip packed with the intensity of a hot, humid climate. Finish: The experience culminates in a rich, dense finish, leaving a lasting impression of southern warmth. Honoring a Vision This unique blend of 5 and 7-year-old bourbons from Rich Grain celebrates the distillery’s ambition to produce a spirit that's unmistakably Mississippi. It represents our first release from a 'ghost distillery'—a rare chance to taste history. Product Details: Proof: 140-proof, natural cask strength that mirrors the unbridled spirit of the region. Quantity: Limited to 500 bottles, making each one a collectible piece. Volume: 750ml Age Statement: Aged between 5 and 7 years, each batch carefully selected to showcase maturity and depth. Mashbill: A marriage of traditional and wheated mashbills, balancing complexity with smoothness. Barrel Type: Aged in 15-gallon new American oak barrels from Barrel Mill, enhancing the whiskey with intense oak flavors. Distillery Location: Originally distilled in Canton, MS. Crafting Details: Non-chill filtered and free from any color additives, preserving the natural essence of the bourbon.

TITLE: Lost Lantern Mountain Meadow St. George Spirits California Single Malt
DESCRIPTION: Kings County Distillery, the oldest distillery in New York City, creates some of the country’s most acclaimed and sought-after whiskies. The distillery brings together American and European distilling traditions and uses New York-grown grains to make whiskies that embody the essence and energy of the country’s largest city. This is a marriage of eight different barrels of 5 and 6-year-old Kings County bourbons that come together to create a powerful, sweet, and spicy straight bourbon. It has rich dark chocolate notes, with hints of pecan pie, graham cracker, blackberry cobbler, and cherry tart. It reminds us of a Brooklyn bakery on a cold winter morning… and we would know, because that's where we are from!

TITLE: Lost Lantern Soaring Spice Frey Ranch Distillery Nevada Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Lost Lantern Soaring Spice Frey Ranch Nevada Straight Bourbon is the inaugural bourbon in the Single Distillery Series from Lost Lantern, distilled at the esteemed Frey Ranch Distillery in Fallon, Nevada. Frey Ranch is celebrated for its estate distilling practices, with every grain used for its whiskies grown on the farm. This 4-year-old, non-chill filtered bourbon, bottled at 127.6 proof, is a symphony of rich, oaky, and spicy flavors with a perfect balance of sweetness. It's a limited edition with only 900 bottles produced, capturing the essence of Nevada's distinctive climate and soil in its robust flavor profile.

TITLE: Lost Peloponnese Dry White
DESCRIPTION: Discover the essence of Greece with Lost Peloponnese Dry White, a captivating wine that transports you to the sun-kissed vineyards of the Peloponnese region. Crafted by the renowned Lost winery, this dry white wine is a testament to the rich terroir and winemaking traditions of Greece. Immerse yourself in a symphony of flavors that reflect the unique characteristics of this vibrant and ancient wine region.

TITLE: Lot No. 40 Canadian Rye Whisky
Louis Roederer Cristal Brut Champagne
DESCRIPTION: The ripe 2005 grapes produced wines of a unique nature, combining wininess with long-lasting quality, elegance and consistency. It is even reminiscent of a few Burgundy-like delights.

TITLE: Louis-Antoine Luyt Pipeno "Coronel de Maule"
DESCRIPTION: Farmer: Raul Perez. 100% Pais from organic, dry-farmed bush vines 200 to 300 years old on iron-rich heavy clay soils with granite and quartz in the Coronel del Maule sub-zone of the Maule region. The bunches are harvested by hand and manually destemmed using a traditional zaranda; fermented spontaneously with indigenous yeasts in open wooden lagares; and aged briefly in in large wooden tanks called pipas (from which the name “pipeno” is derived), with part of it aged 2 months in stainless steel and clay tinajas. Perez does a saignee to concentrate the red. The wine receives a very small amount of sulfur and a gentle filtration before bottling in liters.

TITLE: Louis-Antoine Luyt Pipeno Pais Carrizal
DESCRIPTION: 100% Pais. The fruit for Carrizal is organically grown by 43-year-old Ernesto Soto in the Maule region (at the southern end of the Central Valley of Chile, 150 miles south of Santiago). His vines are 250 years old, planted on deep, sandy, decomposed-granite soils. "Pipeno” is the term for traditional huaso, or farmer, wine: all of Luyt’s are made by the farmers on their own properties with the logistical support of Louis-Antoine and his team. Each of the Luyt pipenos are all made similarly: the fruit is hand-harvested and de-stemmed; the wine is fermented with natural yeasts in traditional, open-top vats known as lagares with a relatively short maceration; and the wine is then aged briefly before bottling with a small amount of sulfur. In the case of the Carrìzal, there is a saignee or bleeding of juice to concentrate the wine; its aging is in stainless steel tanks for two months. Very similar to a gamay. Tasting Notes: Crisp bouquet of berries, wet dirt and a touch of apple. Bright, tart, light bodied with a very nice finish and plush tannins.

TITLE: Low Gap 2 Years Old California Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Low Gap is a collaboration between distiller Crispin Cain (Germain-Robin absinthe, Crispin’s Rose liqueur) and Ansley Coale of Craft Distillers. Crispin apprenticed for seven years with Hubert Germain-Robin, then founded Greenway Distillery in 2005. Crispin has been experimenting with whiskey for years. Production of Low Gap began in 2010, using space leased in the Germain-Robin distillery. The small cognac stills at Germain-Robin are superb pieces of equipment, and Crispin Cain is a master at extracting soft, clean, rich, pure, and wondrously flavorful whiskeys with them. The quality of the initial distillations was so good that it was released as a clear (unaged) whiskey, which Malt Advocate Magazine named Artisan Whiskey of 2012.

TITLE: Low Gap Whiskey Bavarian Hard Wheat Whiskey 2 Year Old
DESCRIPTION: Low Gap Whiskey is made by hand by Crispin Cain, who apprenticed with mad scientist/famous distiller Hubert Germain-Robin of Germain-Robin, a pioneering American micro-distiller who has been making great brandies since the 1980s.Low Gap is made from malted Bavarian wheat, fermented slowly, distilled twice using rigorous and painstaking craft methods, and brought to bottling proof with unfiltered rainwater. The Germain-Robin small, 420 gallon cognac still comes from the old Surrenne distillery attached to the family chateau in Triac. It is an antique, operated entirely by hand. They brought it over for small lots of varietal apples, but they have also used it for grape spirits. They didn't realize how special it was until Crispin Cain began to distill whiskey on it: the still produces beautifully round, soft, elegant and complex distillates. The whiskey is aged in a combination of new American oak, 53 gallon, former Van Winkle bourbon barrels, and 350 liter used Limousin oak barrels formerly used for Germain-Robin brandy.This whiskey is made in small quantities, and was named “Artisan Whiskey of the Year” in 2012 by the Whiskey Advocate. Fruity nose with pears and apples and a bit of wood with an oily hint. Medium bodied, smooth and round with vanilla sweetness and a touch of spice that include cinnamon and licorice and a big Cognac note. Plums, chocolate and raisins on the finish.

TITLE: Luberri Rioja Orlegi Alavesa

Utilizing whole-cluster fermentation for some of the grapes and indigenous yeasts, this is a classic, young Tempranillo from Rioja for everyday drinking. Lucky Cup Sake
DESCRIPTION: White gold color. Aromas of peaches in cream, starfruit, coconut, and almond with a supple, bright, dry thin body and a polished, brisk acacia finish. An easy-drinking sake to serve well-chilled.

TITLE: Lucky Seven 14 Years Old "What's In The Bottle?!" Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #36
DESCRIPTION: The road to this selection was long and winding, but the selection is finally here. We've tasted many prior Lucky Seven 14 yo barrels, most of which are solid. This one was by far the best yet, and it's not just a marketing thing. The aged Kentucky juice (the distillery does not disclose its sourcing) is luscious, refined, and tasty. Since the brand does not reveal much about the liquid (i.e., mashbill, distillate source, barrel char level, etc.), we could not tell you much about the provenance other than it tastes incredible - and that's all that matters. We did have a little fun playing off this fact and the brand's name with the "tater sticker" theme - you'd recognize a great movie and a famous line from it being very apropos for this bottle. What to expect from this release: Nose: baked pear, puff pastry, butter cream, leather Palate: citrus, dates, pecans, vanilla, marshmallow, all-spice, and toast Finish: long finish with hints of cinnamon and BBQ burnt ends As always, we will donate $5 from each bottle to a charity. This one will go to First Place For Youth charity. The organization is dedicated to helping foster youth achieve long-term success in adulthood. They do this by running regular Independent Living Skills Programs where youths can receive access to community resources, as well as education and career advice. First Place For Youth also runs My First Place, which provides young people with rent-free housing in shared apartments for the duration of their involvement in the charity’s educational and healthy living programs.

TITLE: Lucky Seven 14 Years Old “Drink Lucky” Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #42
DESCRIPTION: A crowd favorite is back for the second installment this year. Just as good as the first pick, it differs slightly and teethers on the border of being a true winter whiskey pick. Here's what you can expect from it: Nose: baked pear, puff pastry, butter cream, leather Palate: citrus, dates, pecans, vanilla, marshmallow, all-spice, and toast Finish: long finish with hints of cinnamon and BBQ burnt ends $5 from every bottle will be donated to the Dementia Society of America. The charity's programs bring much-needed education, local resources, and life enrichment to individuals and families impacted by Dementia

TITLE: Lucky Seven Spirits 14 Years Old The Hold Up Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Highlighting all the best characteristics from our barrel offerings, this beautiful bourbon carries subtle notes of dried plums, blueberries, and stone fruit along with earthy herbal undertones of thyme and dill. The union of these flavors results in a balanced, rich and velvety bourbon that lingers in the mouth and reveals yet more secrets with every sip.

TITLE: Lucky Seven Spirits 14 Years Old The Proprietor "R/Bourbon" Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Barrel #23 Distillation: April 27,2007 Bottling Date: August 3, 2021 Mash Bill: 74% Corn / 18% Rye / 8% Malted Barley r/Bourbon Lucky Seven "The Proprietor" 14yr Single Barrel Selection by t8ke Tasting Notes: Bold and oaky, spicy, anise forward. Bright caramel, a touch of cherry, and tobacco. Quite dark in profile: lots of nougat, caramel, cocoa, espresso, tobacco. Rich and viscous on the palate, the proof is deceptive. Dark morello cherry and cherry cordials with a bold blackberry finish.

TITLE: Lucky Seven Spirits 14 Years Old The Proprietor Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Proprietor is Lucky Seven's flagship 14-yo single barrel expression that is offered at cask strength and in limited quantities.

TITLE: Lucky Seven Spirits 15 Years Old The Proprietor Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Oldest expression from the brand's single barrel line of bourbons

TITLE: Lucky Seven Spirits 6 Years Old The Jokester Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Nothing quite brings people together like a beautifully balanced bourbon. This 6-yr carries notes of richness with deep flavor - dried fruit and toasted nuts, sultry vanilla, and a kiss of creme brulee - all this resulting in a bourbon that is light yet complex, with a depth and complexity entirely its own.

TITLE: Lucky Seven Spirits 6 Years Old The Proprietor Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Being the boss has its perks. You see, once in a while you come across a barrel so special you wouldn’t dare blend it with anything else. It rises above the rest with such character and individuality that you just have to let it be. It’s a special bottle that comes with the name The Proprietor. The brand is delighted to offer these single barrel releases at barrel strength.

TITLE: Lucky Seven Spirits 9 Year Old The Hold Up Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the award-winning concoction of Lucky Seven Spirits' The Hold Up, a 9-year Kentucky Straight Bourbon that encapsulates the audacious spirit of timeless heist narratives. Sourced from the renowned whiskey-producing region of Bardstown, Kentucky, this 100-proof bourbon is a tribute to meticulous craftsmanship and tradition. While the distillery remains undisclosed, the bourbon's captivating narrative and superior quality have garnered accolades at prestigious competitions. The Hold Up is the first expression of Lucky Seven Spirits' Sunday Shift Trilogy, promising an immersive journey through a carefully curated balance of flavors

TITLE: Lucky Seven Spirits The Frenchman Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Co-founders Michael Lahalih and John Pals have been best friends since their college years and share a common bond of bourbon and cinema. In fact, the Lucky 7 namesake is derived from the infamous Stage 7 on the Warner Brothers lot, where some of the greatest movies in cinema were filmed, such as Casablanca and My Fair Lady. The warehouse-sized stage produced so many award-winning films that the industry started calling it “Lucky Stage 7.” Be it luck, or be it magic (or maybe a bit of both) – finding a bourbon as delicious as Lucky 7, well… that’s worth celebrating. We are but Curators of Fine Spirits, carefully sourcing and then meticulously blending only the rarest bourbons. Nothing is going in to a bottle of Lucky 7 unless it is of the finest spirits you could find.

TITLE: Lucky Seven Spirits The Holiday Toast Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Appropriately named just in time for the holidays, Lucky Seven's The Holiday Toast release was aged in heavily toasted American oak barrels. This Kentucky straight bourbon clocks at mouth-watering 115 proof.

TITLE: Lucky Seven Spirits The New Yorker Amburana Cask Finish Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: After much anticipation, Lucky Seven is proud to introduce the newest member to their stellar lineup, "The New Yorker." This Expression is finished in Toasted Virgin Amburana Casks and bottled at Full Proof. Proudly blended by their famed and talented Master Blender Asley Barnes, bringing notes of freshly baked raisin oatmeal cookies.

TITLE: Lucky Seven The Frenchman Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon The Prime Barrel x R-Bourbon Pick
DESCRIPTION: Founders Michael Lahalih and John Pals have shared a deep bond since their university days, united by their love for bourbon and films. The moniker "Lucky 7" takes inspiration from the renowned Stage 7 in Hollywood, CA, which witnessed the creation of some of cinema's iconic masterpieces. This massive filming location birthed numerous celebrated movies, making it fondly dubbed the “Lucky Stage 7” by industry insiders.This is a distinct Bourbon whiskey from a single barrel, enhanced in fresh French Oak Barrels. Introducing Single Barrel #3. Now, at The Prime Barrel, we have a complex love-hate dance with bourbons finished in wine barrels. More often than not, we veer away from them, as many exhibit overpowering oak tones or present with an exceedingly dry and tannic nature. Yet, when this marriage of bourbon and wine is executed with finesse, the result can be one of the most distinct and tantalizing bourbons on the market. And that's the twist – when they're crafted just right, we at The Prime Barrel don't hesitate but leap forward to embrace them. Tasting Notes: Nose: Molasses, maple syrup, spiced cider, oak, slightly dusty (think rickhouse smell) Palate: Fresh riped fruit-forward, fresh pear, apple, apricot, spicy on the back palate Finish: long, spicy, floral at the end.

TITLE: Lucky Seven The Holiday Toast "Elf" Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon The Prime Barrel Pick #67
DESCRIPTION: Meet Lucky Seven's "The Holiday Toast 'Elf'" Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon - Prime Barrel Pick #64. At a cool 118.5 proof and aged over 5 to 6 years, this bourbon is a testament to Lucky Seven's knack for crafting something really special. The bourbon's mix of 70% Corn, 21% Rye, and 9% Malted Barley, brings out a bouquet of flavors that'll take your taste buds on a ride. The barrels, sourced from Calvin Cooperage, get a unique char treatment, only shared between Lucky Seven and Calvin. This char adds a richness to the color and flavor that'll catch your attention from the first pour. Give it a whiff and you'll catch a hint of warm caramel with a curious touch of green grass. As it hits your tongue, you'll notice a blend of maple and oak that soon gives way to a warming mix of cinnamon, gingerbread, and nutmeg. The finish? Smooth and oily with a sweet little memory of molasses and brown sugar. Lucky Seven's "The Holiday Toast" line is all about celebrating and enjoying some good ol' classics. Each of these bourbons brings its own bit of holiday joy. The Double Oaked variations take this a step further, bringing an extra dose of complexity and fun. 118.5 Proof, 5-6+ yr old Mashbill - 70% Corn 21% Rye 9% Malted Barley Sourcing - NA Cooperage - Original Barrels - NA Finishing Barrels - Calvin Cooperage Char Level - Specialty Char Level between Lucky Seven and Calvin Cooperage. What you can expect: Nose - warm caramel with a touch of green grass. Palate - maple, and oak, followed by cinnamon, gingerbread, and nutmeg Finish - oily with remnants of molasses and brown sugar.

TITLE: Luksusowa Potato Vodka
DESCRIPTION: With a name that means „luxurious” in Polish and made from selected spuds, Luksusowa is a premium potato vodka created in 1928. Using high quality ingredients and a painstaking production process has given Luksusowa its unique character.

TITLE: Lunaria Coste di Moro Montepulciano d'Abruzzo
DESCRIPTION: Lunaria Coste di Moro Montepulciano d'Abruzzo is a deep ruby red wine brimming with character and bold Italian personality. It hails from the sun-drenched vineyards of Coste di Moro in Abruzzo, meticulously crafted by Cantina Orsogna, a cooperative of dedicated growers, using organic and biodynamic practices.

TITLE: Luneta Alto Small Batch Agave Spirits
DESCRIPTION: Luneta Alto Small Batch Agave Spirits is a premium, handcrafted spirit produced in the heart of Jalisco, Mexico. Made from 100% blue Weber agave, this small batch agave spirit captures the pure and vibrant essence of the agave plant. The production process involves traditional methods, including slow cooking the agave in brick ovens and distillation in copper pot stills, ensuring a smooth and authentic flavor. Luneta Alto is perfect for sipping or as a versatile ingredient in cocktails, offering a true taste of Mexican craftsmanship and tradition.

TITLE: Luneta Chino Small Batch Agave Spirits
DESCRIPTION: Luneta Chino Small Batch Agave Spirits is a premium creation that showcases the artistry and dedication of Mexican agave spirit production. Sourced from the finest agave in Jalisco and crafted in small batches, this spirit offers a unique and refined taste experience. Luneta Chino is meticulously distilled to bring out the pure, vibrant flavors of the agave, resulting in a smooth and versatile spirit that can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in your favorite cocktails. With its exceptional quality and distinctive character, Luneta Chino Small Batch Agave Spirits is a testament to the rich heritage of Jalisco.

TITLE: Luneta Chino Small Batch Agave Spirits
DESCRIPTION: Luneta Chino Small Batch Agave Spirits is a premium creation that showcases the artistry and dedication of Mexican agave spirit production. Sourced from the finest agave in Jalisco and crafted in small batches, this spirit offers a unique and refined taste experience. Luneta Chino is meticulously distilled to bring out the pure, vibrant flavors of the agave, resulting in a smooth and versatile spirit that can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in your favorite cocktails. With its exceptional quality and distinctive character, Luneta Chino Small Batch Agave Spirits is a testament to the rich heritage of Jalisco.

TITLE: Luneta Destilado Con Te De Limon Agave Spirits with Natural Flavor
DESCRIPTION: Luneta Destilado Con Te De Limon Agave Spirits with Natural Flavor is a delightful fusion of traditional Mexican craftsmanship and refreshing natural flavors. Distilled in the heart of Jalisco, this unique spirit blends premium agave with the zesty essence of lemon tea, creating a vibrant and versatile drink. Perfect for sipping or mixing into your favorite cocktails, Luneta Destilado Con Te De Limon offers a refreshing twist on classic agave spirits. Experience the bright, citrusy notes and smooth finish that make this a standout addition to any spirits collection.

TITLE: Luneta Granalta Espadin and Tobasiche Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: Luneta Granalta Espadin and Tobasiche Mezcal is a masterful blend that showcases the rich traditions of Oaxaca's mezcal craftsmanship. Crafted by Luneta Distillery, this mezcal combines the earthy complexity of Espadin agave with the unique and aromatic characteristics of Tobasiche agave. Each bottle of Luneta Granalta is a testament to the meticulous artisanal methods used in its production, resulting in a spirit that is both robust and refined. Enjoy it neat to fully appreciate its intricate flavors or use it to elevate your favorite mezcal cocktails.

TITLE: Luneta Granalta Espadin Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: Luneta Granalta Espadin Mezcal is an exquisite spirit that reflects the rich heritage and artisanal craftsmanship of Oaxaca. Produced by the Luneta Distillery, this mezcal is made exclusively from Espadin agave, known for its robust and versatile flavor profile. Crafted using traditional methods, Luneta Granalta Espadin Mezcal delivers a beautifully balanced spirit with complex layers of flavor. Perfect for sipping neat to appreciate its depth or as a key ingredient in your favorite mezcal cocktails, this mezcal offers a genuine taste of Oaxaca's mezcal tradition.

TITLE: Luneta Papalometl Small Batch Agave Spirits
DESCRIPTION: Luneta Papalometl Small Batch Agave Spirits is a remarkable expression of Oaxaca’s rich mezcal tradition. Crafted from the rare and wild Papalometl agave, this small-batch mezcal is produced using time-honored artisanal methods at the Luneta Distillery. The result is a spirit that captures the wild complexity and depth of its unique agave variety, offering a truly unique and captivating flavor profile. Perfect for sipping neat to savor its intricate flavors, Luneta Papalometl is also an excellent choice for elevating your mezcal cocktails.

TITLE: Lusenti Colli Piacentini Pinot Nero Fiocco di Rose
DESCRIPTION: Vinification, ageing and maturation: The must remains in contact with the skins at a low temperature for a few hours, then it is separated from the skins immediately afterwards in order to obtain a rose wine with good character and excellent sapidity, lean and fresh. Second fermentation takes place in stainless steel containers. The wine is released two or three months after bottling. Suitable for all courses, raw fish, shellfish, white meat.

TITLE: Lusty Claw Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Not only one of the world’s top bourbons, Lusty Claw is one of the world’s best whiskeys. Created for connoisseurs familiar with luxury whiskeys, this enormous taste profile reaches depths of flavor found only in the rarest of spirits. Handcrafted and bottled under Master supervision gives Lusty Claw the complexity of caramel, honey, and vanilla as it coats your palate followed by a legendary finish. Lusty Claw is best served neat or with a splash of water. Type: Bourbon Whiskey Mash Type: Corn/Malted Barley Entry Proof: 62.5% Alcohol by Volume – 120 Proof Barrel Type: American Oak Maker: Independent Stave Staves: 6 months air dry Filtration: Chill Filtered Bottle Proof: 45% Alcohol by Volume – 90 Proof Color: Deep Rich Amber Small Batch Limited Release

TITLE: Lux Row Distillers 12 Years Old Double Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Lux Row Distillers has launched a new bourbon, Lux Row Distillers Double Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey, to commemorate the distillery’s grand opening last year. The new limited-edition bourbon brings together two carefully selected 12-year-old Kentucky Straight Bourbon barrels bottled together for the ultimate barrel strength taste and finish. Like the name suggests, the bourbon was aged in two different barrels — for 12 years each — allowing for an extra-aged expression highlighted by notes of caramel, vanilla, oak and tobacco. Even the proof of 118.4 is a nod to the distillery, as they opened their doors in April 2018.

TITLE: Luxardo Maraschino Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: Maraschino Luxardo is a classic. The typical straw coated bottle is by now a true icon on the mass consumption scenario. It is one of the very few liqueurs in the world produced by distillation. It is obtained from the marasca, a sour cherry variety exclusively cultivated by Luxardo. The distillate is allowed to mature for two years in Finnish ash vats (this wood does not lend its colour even after many years of maturing), and is then diluted and sugared.

TITLE: L’Encantada Domaine Cutxan 25 Years Bas Armagnac 1995
DESCRIPTION: One of the most exciting new names in Armagnac comes to us after the family has already retired from distilling - not uncommon in this category. That said there will be a steady release of the remaining casks until they are all gone, beginning with this, one of their oldest. Everything from the outset here was made with the intention of creating the absolute best brandy the familiy's terroir and savoir faire allowed. No expenses were ever too high including the stills they used to the type of rare new oak the eau de vie went into from one of France's top artisanal cooperages. They have exceeded any reasonable expectation on quality here with this exceptional Armagnac. Make sure to grab an extra bottle - one to drink now and one for the collection. Once these are gone they are never coming back.

TITLE: L’Encantada Lous Pibous 1994 26 Year Bas Armagnac
DESCRIPTION: L’Encantada has bottled this exceptional single cask of Armagnac to celebrate the 10-year anniversary of PM Spirits. Distilled at a small estate in Mauléon d’Armagnac, at Lous Pibous, this 26 year Bas Armagnac carries a 1995 vintage and was distilled from 100% Folle Blanche variety grapes, and matured in a wet cellar in new oak casks. It is bottled without coloring or filtering, at cask strength, 55.3% ABV.

TITLE: M&H Distillery "APEX" Pomegranate Wine Cask Small Batch Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This small-batch, single malt whisky was aged in ex-Bourbon casks and finished in fortified style pomegranate wine casks for a period of six months. The unique pomegranate fruit offers this whisky Its exceptional flavors. Non-chilled filter. Natural color. 60.3% alc/vol

TITLE: M&H Distillery Classic Single Malt Whisky

TITLE: Macallan "A Nights on Earth The Journey" Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky 2023
DESCRIPTION: Macallan "A Nights on Earth The Journey" Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a beautifully crafted expression from The Macallan Distillery, inspired by the festive traditions of Hogmanay, the Scottish celebration of New Year. This limited-edition release celebrates the journey of the New Year and features a stunning bottle design, making it a perfect gift for whisky enthusiasts. Bottled at 43% ABV, this single malt offers a harmonious blend of rich flavors, showcasing The Macallan’s renowned craftsmanship and dedication to producing luxurious Scotch whisky. "A Nights on Earth The Journey" is an exceptional addition to any collection and a great way to toast special moments.

TITLE: Macallan "Distill Your World - Mexico" Limited Edition Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Macallan "Distill Your World - Mexico" Limited Edition Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a unique and flavorful single malt scotch whisky that celebrates the vibrant culture of Mexico. This limited edition release is part of the Distill Your World series, which features whiskies inspired by different countries and cultures. On the nose, Macallan "Distill Your World - Mexico" offers aromas of citrus, vanilla, and oak, with a touch of spice. The palate is smooth and balanced, with flavors of vanilla, caramel, and oak. The finish is long and warming, with lingering notes of oak and spice. This whisky is perfect for sipping neat or using in cocktails. It is also a great gift for any whisky lover. For the whiskey drinker: Macallan "Distill Your World - Mexico" Limited Edition Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a must-have for any whiskey drinker who is looking for a unique and flavorful experience. It is a well-crafted single malt scotch whisky that is perfect for sipping neat or using in your favorite cocktails. If you are looking for a new scotch whisky to try, or if you are looking for a great gift for a whisky lover, Macallan "Distill Your World - Mexico" Limited Edition Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky is the perfect choice.

TITLE: Macallan "Distill Your World - New York" Limited Edition Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A unique single malt whisky created to take you on a sensorial journey through one of the world’s most iconic cities. The Macallan Distil Your World New York Limited Edition bottle The Macallan Distil Your World New York Limited Edition Pack open Distil Your World New York Limited Edition Polly Logan, The Macallan Whisky Maker, and Michelin star chef Joan Roca of the acclaimed Roca brothers immersed themselves in the iconic city of New York to distill its essence. They explored the art, creativity, and dynamic culture of the city and found inspiration for their whisky-making and gastronomic creations.

DESCRIPTION: The iconic producer of lush sherried malts delivers again. Employing the same technique of marrying whiskies aged in sherry-seasoned casks of both American and European oak that landed the 12-year-old in our 2017 Top 20 has resulted in a truly decadent dram—richly nutty and fruity, with dried apples, cherries, and prunes. The palate is wonderfully luscious, supple, and chewy, delivering mouth-coating waves of fruit that remain for minutes on end, before a long farewell of lingering, warming spice. Impressive and irresistibly good.

TITLE: Macallan 18 Years Double Cask Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Made by blending 18-year-old whisky from European and American oak casks, both of which are seasoned with sherry, this is a warming, sweet single malt and the pinnacle of Macallan's Double Cask range.

TITLE: Macallan 18 Years Old Sherry Oak Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Color: Light mahogany Nose: Dried fruits and ginger, with a hint of citrus, vanilla and cinnamon Palate: Rich dried fruits with spice, clove, orange and wood smoke Finish: Full and lingering with dried fruits and sweet toffee, ginger and a hint of wood smoke

TITLE: Macallan 18 yrs Speyside Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Signatory Vintage Cask Strength Collection has been offering single cask bottlings of the rarer variety for over 20 years. This bottle is a rare chance to taste Macallan from a single hogshead cask, bottled un-filtered at 59.3% alcohol. A taste of a world famous single malt in its original form. Product pictured is 1988 not 1997.

TITLE: Macallan AERA Royal Black
DESCRIPTION: The Macallan AERA Royal Black is an exciting Taiwanese exclusive release from Scotland’s most famous distillery. The release has been surrounded by a lot of hype, and with good reason. Aged in a combination of European and American Oak casks, this dram follows the latest Macallan trend of moving away from exclusively sherry cask matured whisky, but there is no doubt that the signature sherried style is still on full display here. The precious sherry cask oak was grown in Jerez in southern Spain and the forests in the north before being dried for four years, made into wooden barrels and then sedated for two years before being filled with Sherry. This process is carried out to strict regulations set by Macallan’s Master of Wood and it results in supreme quality casks that have dramatic effects on the distillery’s outstanding spirit.

TITLE: Macallan Amber
DESCRIPTION: The Macallan Amber forms part of the 1824 Series which exemplifies the brand's commitment to 100% natural color, present in each and every Macallan single malt. The color of each expression becomes richer as the range progresses and its flavors more intense.

TITLE: Macallan Edition (1-6) Single Malt Scotch Whisky Collection
DESCRIPTION: The Macallan Edition Series is a unique and exceptional collection of single malt Scotch whiskies that showcases the distillery's dedication to craftsmanship and innovation. Each edition in the series is crafted with a specific focus, utilizing carefully selected casks to highlight different aspects of the Macallan's renowned flavor profile. From Edition No.1 to Edition No.6, this collection offers a diverse range of rich and complex flavors, each with its own distinct character. Perfect for collectors and whisky connoisseurs, the Macallan Edition Series represents the pinnacle of Speyside whisky artistry.

TITLE: Macallan Edition No 1-6 Assortment Set Single Malt Scotch Whisky Set
DESCRIPTION: The Macallan Edition No 1-6 Assortment Set is a remarkable journey through the unique and innovative approach of Macallan's whisky making. Housed in the iconic distillery in Speyside, this collection represents a range of limited annual releases, each showcasing the distinctive creativity and evolution of the distillery. From the intricate complexity of Edition No. 1 to the natural color spectrum celebrated in Edition No. 5, this set is an exploration of flavor, craftsmanship, and design, making it a must-have for collectors and enthusiasts alike.

TITLE: Macallan Edition No. 1 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Macallan Edition No. 1 is the debut expression in the Edition Series. It celebrates The Macallan’s unparalleled oak cask management policy that oversees the entire process from wood sourcing to finished, seasoned, cask. Showcasing the influence of The Macallan’s exceptional oak casks in the flavor of the whisky, the result is a bold single malt drawn from eight of the finest European and American oak cask styles and sizes.

TITLE: Macallan Edition No. 2 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Macallan Edition No. 2 is a remarkable creation from the renowned Speyside distillery, in collaboration with the famed three brothers behind El Celler de Can Roca. This exquisite single malt, a part of the Macallan Edition series, is drawn from a careful selection of European and American oak casks, reflecting a masterful fusion of flavors and craftsmanship.

TITLE: Macallan Edition No. 3 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Inspiration and innovation lie at the heart of The Macallan and nowhere is this more evident than in The Edition Series. Edition No. 3 brings to life the flavor experience of The Macallan through aroma, calling on Master Perfumer Roja Dove's remarkable sensory knowledge and an expert sense of smell to create the third unique expression in the series. Borne of two art forms, Edition No. 3 unites the worlds of whisky and aroma to reveal the complexities of single malt character and the power of the senses in creating and experiencing The Macallan. When we experience and enjoy whisky, the power of aroma is unquestionable - and it is this power that makes the approach to Edition No. 3 truly mesmerizing. Drawn from a combination of European and American oak casks, Edition No.3 is sweet and fruity in character, balancing the heavier base recognizable in our single malts with citrus, vanilla, florals, and fresh cut oak. ABV: 48.3%

TITLE: Macallan Edition No. 4 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Macallan Edition No. 4 is a remarkable expression of craftsmanship and innovation. This exquisite single malt is a tribute to the distillery's legacy of wood and cask selection, a critical element in the art of whisky making. Edition No. 4 was aged in a unique combination of seven different cask types, showcasing European and American Oak, both refill and first fill. This intricate process results in a multifaceted flavor profile that encapsulates the essence of The Macallan's Speyside roots.

TITLE: Macallan Edition No. 5 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This bottling is designed to showcase the color of Macallan’s whisky, following Editions No 1 and No 2, focused on cask influence; Edition No 3, which explored the impact of aroma; and Edition No 4, which was focused on structure. Sarah Burgess, whisky maker for Macallan, said: ‘Whilst color development starts with mixing basic colors with precision to achieve different shades when it comes to whisky making, it is the knowledge and understanding of a specific palette of colors from the cask which is the starting point.’ Edition No 5 is said to have ‘100% natural’ color and is bottled without the use of spirit caramel. To emphasize the connection with color, the bottle’s label has been decorated with ‘a uniquely bold shade of purple’ developed by designers at the Pantone Colour Institute in New Jersey. nextSectinoColor: Sunlit barleyAroma: Vanilla and toffee with notes of oak, nutmeg and ginger and lemon basil and pear. Palate: Fresh and sweet with caramel moving into poached peaches and ripe pear. Quickly followed by a toffee sweetness with light oak spices in the form of nutmeg and hints of ginger in the background. Finish: Long and sweet.

TITLE: Macallan Edition No. 6 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Macallan Edition No.6 is a Scotch single malt whisky that’s been crafted from a combination of five American and European oak sherry seasoned cask styles. It is a non-age statement in nature and bottled at 48.6% ABV. As for this expression’s relationship to The Macallan Estate sitting on the banks of the River Spey, it was explained that it “captures the River Spey’s energy; the warm, welcoming personality of The Macallan’s Ghillie; the classic craftsmanship of Hardy; the extraordinary life of the Atlantic salmon on the beat; and the mastery of whisky-making on The Macallan Estate, which has taken place since 1824.

TITLE: Macallan Estate Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Macallan unveils its newest Scotch, the Macallan Estate, a rare single malt made from barley grown exclusively on its home turf, Easter Elchies. This barley is distilled just once a year over the course of a week and usually is reserved for the Macallan’s top whiskies.

DESCRIPTION: The Macallan Harmony Collection "Amber Meadow" Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a splendid ode to the masterful craftsmanship of The Macallan. Hailing from the heart of Speyside, this exquisite whisky is part of a series that celebrates the fusion of nature and craftsmanship. "Amber Meadow" encapsulates the serene beauty and richness of Speyside's meadows, translated through Macallan's time-honored distillation and maturation process. This expression, while carrying no age statement, is a testament to the distillery's commitment to quality and excellence, focusing on flavor profundity and cask perfection.

TITLE: Macallan Harmony Collection "Rich Cacao" Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This new sustainable release from The Macallan is the first limited edition whisky in an annual release series. A joint collaboration with the highly renowned pastry chef Jordi Roca of three Michelin star restaurants El Celler de Can Roca, this release brings the worlds of chocolate and whisky to life. The Macallan Harmony Collection Rich Cacao is presented in a 100% recyclable gift box, made using discarded husks from cacao pods. 88 Proof.

TITLE: Macallan Harmony Collection 'Intense Arabica' Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The second edition in the limited annual release series, this special single malt exudes flavors of sweet oak, tiramisu, and dark chocolate, and provides a delightful whisky and coffee pairing experience.

TITLE: Macallan James Bond 60th Anniversary Release Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The first release in the collection of six celebrates The Six Decades of Bond is now available. The collection showcases the most iconic moments from each of the six Bond decades, with individual packaging encapsulating each decade. The packaging has been color washed with a trending color from the specific decade to bring to life the inventions and innovations of James Bond throughout the years. The first decade of the Bond collection represents the 1960s, a unique era for James Bond. Sean Connery, the suave spy icon, starred in six films during this period, with George Lazenby starring in only one film, On Her Majesty’s Secret Service in 1969. Sean Connery returned triumphantly to the screen in Diamonds Are Forever in 1971. The pack design features sketches from three movies: Goldfinger (1964), Thunderball (1965), and You Only Live Twice (1967), where Bond uses Little Nellie in a combat sequence and a dummy jet pack. Like James Bond, the whiskey in this collection reflects a sense of sophistication and style that has matured over the years. The consistency of the whiskey is maintained across all six bottles.

DESCRIPTION: The Macallan Masters of Photography: Magnum Edition marks the seventh limited edition release in The Macallan Masters of Photography series. This awe-inspiring collection of images, taken by six world-renowned Magnum photographers, capture different aspects of the iconic distillery. This magnificent collectible set of images comes together as a limited edition objet d’art presented in a stunning archive style gift box. This coveted item shows history in the making against the backdrop of The Macallan’s ongoing commitment to mastery.

TITLE: Macallan Rare Cask Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky 2021
DESCRIPTION: An obsession with quality has been the hallmark of The Macallan since its founding by Alexander Reid on a plateau above the river Spey in north-east Scotland. The distillery is surrounded by a 485 acre estate with Easter Elchies House at its heart. The Macallan was one of the first distillers in Scotland to be legally licensed. Since then we have built a reputation as one of the world’s leading single malt whiskies. All of their whiskies take 100% of their colour from the wood in which they are matured. As wood is a natural product, each tree is different and in turn, imparts different flavours and colours to the whisky during maturation. The skill of the whisky makers ensures colour is as consistent as possible from bottling to bottling, through the management and selection of the casks which provide the spectrum of natural colour essential to The Macallan single malt.

TITLE: Macallan Reflexion Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Macallan REFLEXION represents the natural colour and beauty of The Macallan - a true reflection of the foremost influence of first fill sherry seasoned oak casks. This exceptional single malt has drawn its colour and flavour from maturation in smaller hogshead casks allowing a greater surface area of wood to interact with the whisky to deliver an intricate character driven by the influence of both Spanish and American oak casks. A deep red mahogany hue, taken directly from the cask, is beautifully enhanced by the angular facets of the carefully crafted decanter. The depth of colour coupled with the complex flavour of REFLEXION, derive from the casks selected for this distinctive expression by The Macallan’s Master Whisky Maker, Bob Dalgarno. Bold and full-bodied, REFLEXION is a celebration of floral and vanilla notes, punctuated with fresh apples and apricots.

TITLE: Macallan Sherry Oak 25 Years Old Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Superlative Speysider from Macallan, this astonishing 25-year-old is one of the most revered whiskeys in the world. It received a perfect 100 out of 100 score from the Beverage Testing Institute in Chicago, 1999. It also received Gold at the International Spirits Challenge.

TITLE: Macallan Sir Peter Blake Tier B Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Collaborating with Sir Peter Blake for almost four decades, the mutual regard for excellence has forged a natural partnership. The Macallan Distillery holds a deep appreciation for the time it takes to establish, nurture, and protect heritage as well as a desire to produce iconic creations and legendary pieces, and these values of timelessness are mirrored in both the character and work of renowned artist Sir Peter Blake. Both have hooked up for a couple of prior collabs over the years. For the latest collaboration, the whisky was carefully selected by Lead Whisky Maker Sarah Burgess, and the art labels that Sir Peter Blake created are of the finest caliber, uniting once again whisky making and the world of art. Each of the 13 labels represents unique stories and showcases the distillery's history, community, and the beautiful natural landscape of The Macallan Estate. The exceptional 1967 whisky was chosen for its classic yet distinctly colorful character, representative of Sir Peter Blake’s unique character and the year that his collage style transcended the art world into pop culture.

TITLE: Madame Liberte Brut
DESCRIPTION: Lady Liberty wasn't France's only gift to America: so was Methode Champenoise winemaking. Traditional exacting French techniques and the finest grapes in America produce a sparkling wine second to none. French heritage, American made. While this wine can be enjoyed by itself as an aperitif, it is also perfect with fresh oysters and other shellfish, crab cakes, ceviche and grilled sea bass. It is also delicious with lemon chicken and Thai curries. Serve with aged Gouda or other hard cheeses and as a counterpoint to soft triple creams.

TITLE: Madre Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: Madre comes from the garcia morales ranch, set in the rolling hills of the oaxacan sierra. watching over the land for centuries, the family started distilling the spirit of mezcal for the intent of personal guidance and celebration.

TITLE: Madre Tequila Blanco
DESCRIPTION: Madre Tequila Blanco is a premium tequila crafted with care and tradition in Jalisco, Mexico. Produced by Madre Distillery, this blanco tequila is made from 100% blue Weber agave, meticulously harvested and distilled to create a vibrant and smooth spirit. With no additives or aging, Madre Tequila Blanco captures the pure essence of agave, delivering a fresh and authentic taste experience. Perfect for sipping, mixing into cocktails, or enjoying with your favorite Mexican dishes, Madre Tequila Blanco embodies the spirit of Mexico.

TITLE: Maestro Dobel 50 Limited Release 1967 Extra Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: 1967 was the year of transition in many parts of the world, events that changed how art was appreciated, technological advances, major climatic events, and the beginning of social and ideological revolutions that transformed the world. For this reason, Maestro Dobel commemorates 1967 with a sublime edition that reflects the result of time and effort. Amber, coppery colors, and golden reflections reveal its passage through oak barrels, giving it density and robustness when in the glass. The notes of honey and caramel, coming from the perfect cooking of the agaves, combined with the toasting of the wood, resulting in a robust and elegant flavor worthy of a special edition of our tequila.

TITLE: Magnificent Wine Company Riesling
DESCRIPTION: The Magnificent Wine Company (HOUSE WINE & THE ORIGINALS) sources its grapes from only the (most) magnificent vineyards throughout the Columbia Valley which provides the freedom to tailor grape selection exactly to our winemaking needs ensuring that each bottle of wine is equally Magnificent from vintage to vintage.

Maison Dolin & Cie Vin de Savoie Vermouth de Chambery Dry
DESCRIPTION: Made to the same set of recipes since 1821, Dolin Vermouth de Chambéry has long been the benchmark for fine French Vermouth. Made with fine wines of the region and botanicals found in the Alpine meadows above Chambéry, together they impart a fresh and elegant nose, with a subtle and complex palate. Ideal as an aperitif or in cocktails. In the late 19th century, Dolin Vermouth de Chambéry won medals in Paris, London, St. Louis and Philadelphia and in 1932 earned Chambéry France's only Appellation d’ Origine for Vermouth.

TITLE: Maison Dudognon Cognac Selection 5 Years Old
DESCRIPTION: The Dudognon family has been growing grapes and distilling cognac since 1776. Their distillery is located in the tiny town of Lignieres- Sonneville in the famed Grande Champagne. Soils here are comprised of Champanian chalk, leading to grapes and spirit with fantastic minerality, acidity and subsequent aging potential. While many Cognacs contain permitted additives (sugar, caramel, boise), the only "additive" used in Dudognon Cognac is distilled water. - Appellation: Grande Champagne - 100% Ugni Blanc - Distilled twice at the domaine - Bottled at 5 years old - 88 proof. High proof makes it a cocktail mixer to be reckoned with.

TITLE: Maison Foucher Cuvee de Roys de Naples Cremant de Loire Brut
DESCRIPTION: A blend of half Chenin Blanc and one-quarter each Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. Still wines are assembled and bottled in early spring. Second fermention occurs in bottle with "Methode Traditionelle" (or Methode Champenoise). 24 month elevage sur latte, which is two times longer than is required by appellation laws. Finished with moderate dosage of 8-9g/l.

TITLE: Maison Loiseau Cotes Du Rhone Cuvee Prestige
DESCRIPTION: 55% Syrah, 45% Grenache One taste of this wine and you will feel like you are at the top of the dry and warm hills overlooking the Rhône River. The Cuvée Prestige is a perfect expression of that the Rhône terroir can produce. Bold enough to drink with foods brushed with heavily spiced barbecue sauces, pizzas, french onion soup, chicken, and wild boar

TITLE: Makashvili Wine Cellar Khikhvi
DESCRIPTION: Makashvili Wine Cellar is one of the oldest and most well respected estates in Georgia. The 2016 Khikhvi is produced from estate grown hand harvested grapes from the village of Kardenakhit. It is aged in Qvevri for 6 months with skins and stems.

TITLE: Maker's 46 Kentucky Bourbon Whisky
DESCRIPTION: 94 PTS BEVERAGE TESTING INSTITUTE. There has been a push by the big distilleries in the past few years to capitalize on the bourbon boom and increased interested in trying new bottles by introducing specialty versions of their power brands. Maker’s Mark has always had a “why mess with what works” kind of attitude when it comes to their bourbon but eventually they did release a premium version in the form of Maker’s 46. Rather than doing a small batch or older version of Maker’s Mark they decided to go the route of finishing with a different wood to add complexity of character.

TITLE: Maker's Mark 46 Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whisky Barrel Finished With Ten Virgin French Oak Staves
DESCRIPTION: Maker’s Mark 46 Cask Strength results from finishing Maker’s signature bourbon with ten seared virgin French oak staves.

TITLE: Maker's Mark 46 Limited Edition Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This special edition of their Wood Finishing Series celebrates the 10th anniversary of Maker's Mark 46, the brand's first innovation since its founding in 1953. Bottled at barrel strength instead of their standard 94 proof.

TITLE: Maker's Mark Affirmed Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The third bottling in Maker's Mark's Triple Crown series, Affirmed won the US race in 1978. Painted silver, profits from the original sales of the bottle were donated to the Maker's Mark Secretariat Center at the Kentucky Horse Park.

TITLE: Maker's Mark American Justify Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In the last 142 years of horse racing history, only 13 have achieved the elusive Triple Crown by winning the Kentucky Derby, the Preakness Stakes, and the Belmont Stakes. Until American Pharoah won in 2015, there had been nearly a 30-year drought dating back to 1978. Just three years later in 2018, Justify grabbed the Triple Crown again by winning all three races. If you have ever been to the Kentucky Derby there are a few things that are guaranteed to be there – horses, cigars, hats and bourbon whiskey. To celebrate Justify’s historic 2017 win, Maker’s Mark Distillery in Loretto, Kentucky is releasing Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey bottle. For this special release, the trademark Maker’s red wax has been replaced with bright green racing colors from WinStar Farm. The entire bottle will be emblazoned in colors of Justify’s green, white and black jockey silks worn in the Kentucky Derby® by Mike Smith. The commemorative bottle not only pays tribute to Justify’s stunning run but also supports charitable causes.

TITLE: Maker's Mark American Pharoah Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In 2015, American Pharoah captivated the hearts of fans worldwide by becoming the first-ever winner of horse racing’s fabled Grand Slam. By sweeping the Kentucky Derby®, the Preakness Stakes®, the Belmont Stakes® and the Breeders’ Cup® Classic, American Pharoah established himself as one of the greatest racehorses in history. That’s something we can really relate to around here. After all, no one thought you could make a bourbon both full-flavored and easy to drink. Until we did it. In honor of American Pharoah’s inspiring and exhilarating achievement, we’re proud to introduce a limited-edition American Pharoah commemorative bottle. To further mark the occasion, Maker’s Mark and the Zayat family will make a donation benefitting the Kentucky Derby Museum, a nonprofit organization with an impassioned commitment to engage, educate and excite.

TITLE: Maker's Mark Bourbon Cask Strength 750ml  108.7
Maker's Mark Bourbon Cask Strength 1.0L  108.7
Maker's Mark CATS Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The fifth and final commemorative Maker’s Mark® bourbon bottle in the series features the 2011-12 men’s basketball national championship team led by John Calipari, which brought the title home to the Bluegrass for the first time in 14 seasons.

TITLE: Maker's Mark Cellar Aged Limited Edition Bourbon 2023
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the legacy of Maker's Mark with the Cellar-Aged Limited Edition Bourbon. This distinguished release marks a significant chapter in the distillery's journey, offering a blend of 11- and 12-year-old bourbons. With proof of 115.7, the 2023 Cellar Aged release is not just about the age statement but a testament to the rich tradition and meticulous craftsmanship that goes into every bottle. The bourbon starts its journey in the distillery's traditional warehouses, maturing gracefully before being transitioned to a limestone whisky cellar for an extended aging period. This process, unique to Maker's Mark, allows the bourbon to develop a deeper, darker flavor with a restrained tannic impact, presenting a robust yet smooth profile.

DESCRIPTION: A litre bottle of Maker's Mark Kentucky straight bourbon whisky. This was released in 2013 in honour of Dan Issel, a Hall of Fame basketball player and coach who played for University of Kentucky from 1966 to 1970, and set 23 records in that time.

TITLE: Maker's Mark Denim Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Limited Edition! White wax with Denim Label Maker's Mark Bottle! The bottle was created to commemorate: The 1996 NCAANational Champions, the University of Kentucky Wildcats! The label has a denim-like pattern, white wax, and a blue label over the wax with "KENTUCKY" on one side and "1996" on the other.

TITLE: Maker's Mark Founder's Bill Sr Samuels Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The second installment in Maker's Mark "Founder's Collection" series.

TITLE: Maker's Mark Founder's Margie Samuels Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Ever wonder who came up with the idea to put the iconic dripping red wax atop the Maker’s Mark bottle? Try imagining Maker’s without it. Tough, right? Or the bottle shape, or even the name “Maker’s Mark”. We have Margie Samuels to thank for all of this. Her husband, Bill Samuels Sr. developed the whiskey (whisky per MM bottle:)), but pretty much everything else can be pointed to Margie upon their inaugural launch in 1953. To celebrate her legacy during National Women’s History Month, Maker’s Mark is releasing a commemorative bottle which supports a great cause.In a nod to Margie’s achievements and to continue encouraging female creators, a generous portion of the proceeds from each bottle sold will be donated to the Bellarmine University Rubel School of Business to fund scholarships for the school’s Women of Color Entrepreneurs – Leadership Certificate.

TITLE: Maker's Mark Greats Of The Gate Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Maker's Mark Greats of the Gate is a bourbon series that honors the greatest thoroughbreds of all time. The first bottle in the series, released in October 2024, honors Man o' War, who won 20 of 21 races in 1919 and 1920. The series is a collaboration between Maker's Mark and Keeneland, and proceeds benefit nonprofits that support Kentucky culture. Here are some details about the Maker's Mark Greats of the Gate series: Release date: The first bottle was released on October 21, 2024. Packaging: Each bottle comes in a collectible box with a Certificate of Authenticity signed by Maker's Mark's Managing Director, Shannon Arvin, President and CEO of Keeneland Race Course, and Tyler Robertson, a fine artist. Artwork: The bottles feature an illustration by Tyler Robertson with artwork in yellow and black, which are Man o' War's racing colors.
