TITLE: Mionetto Prosecco Organic
DESCRIPTION: Mionetto Prosecco Organic is made with certified organically-grown grapes. In the vineyard, the grapes are grown without synthetic chemicals and fertilizers. In the cellar, the wine is vinified separately to ensure purity. To reduce the carbon footprint of this wine even further the producers use recycled materials for the bottle, label and shipper. Mionetto Prosecco Organic is the perfect accompani- ment for seafood risotto, mussels and fish. It is also delicious as an aperitif.

TITLE: Mirabella Franciacorta Brut Blanc de Blancs
DESCRIPTION: Chardonnay 70% - Pinot Bianco At least 24 months on the yeasts in bottle and disgorgement at last months before being marketed.

TITLE: Miranda Malbec
DESCRIPTION: Miranda Malbec is the newest addition to our collection of private labels. Brimming with classic Mendoza fruit and concentration, this wine is an excellent choice for every day drinking and a versatile match to foods. It is also an outstanding value, providing the perfect balance of price and quality. This Malbec was sourced from Mendoza, Argentina, recognized as one of the world’s premium Malbec producing regions. Located in the eastern foothills of the Andes, this semi-arid region is 2-4000 feet above sea level and consists mostly of alluvial sand over clay.Appellation: 100% Mendoza, Argentina Umami lover. Unlike Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec doesn’t have a super long finish. Because of this, Malbec is great with leaner red meats (ostrich anyone?). The wine does extremely well with funky flavors like blue cheese and rustic flavors like mushrooms and cumin spice. Also try with these: Meat Pairings - Dark meat poultry and lean red meat. Malbec also pairs well with earthy flavors too, such as beef brisket. Duck, Chicken Leg, Lamb, Beef, Ostrich, Buffalo, Pork Shoulder Spices and Herbs - Look for spices that have earthy or smoky flavors such as: Parsley, Sumac, Thyme, Rosemary, Porcini Powder, Smoked Paprika, Black Pepper, Cumin, Coriander, Juniper Berry, Clove, Vanilla Bean, Garlic, Shallot, Green Onion, Barbecue Sauce Cheese Pairings - Look for funky and rich soft to semi-firm cow’s and goat’s milk cheeses. Vegetables & Vegetarian Fare - Mushroom, Roasted Vegetables, Green and Red Bell Pepper, Potato, Arugula, Kale, Chard, Grilled Endive, Onion, Beet, Tempeh, Lentils, Black Beans, Forbidden Rice

TITLE: Mirco Gianaroli La Piana Lambrusco Grasparossa di Castelvetro Secco
DESCRIPTION: Embark on a journey through the vineyards of Emilia-Romagna with Mirco Gianaroli La Piana Lambrusco Grasparossa di Castelvetro Secco, a sparkling red wine that captures the essence of Italian winemaking. Crafted by Mirco Gianaroli, this Lambrusco Grasparossa is a tribute to the rich terroir of Castelvetro. With its lively effervescence and deep red hue, this wine is an invitation to savor the joy of Italian tradition.

TITLE: Mister Sam Tribute Whiskey Batch 2  122.6 Proof
DESCRIPTION: Mister Sam Tribute Whiskey is a rare and exceptional blend of the finest Canadian and American whiskeys from Sazerac. This limited-edition whiskey pays homage to Samuel Bronfman, Seagram’s legendary master blender. Crafted by Sazerac's Master Blender Drew Mayville, a former Seagram's master blender, this blend is a nod to the rich heritage of distilling and blending artistry. Mister Sam Tribute Whiskey is a testament to the art of blending. This whiskey strikes a perfect balance between the rich profiles of aged bourbon and the brightness of younger spirits. Its complex and layered flavors make it a standout choice for whiskey connoisseurs.

TITLE: Mister Sam Tribute Whiskey Batch 3  128.8 Proof
DESCRIPTION: Mister Sam Tribute Whiskey is a rare and exceptional blend of the finest Canadian and American whiskeys from Sazerac. TITLE: Miyao Shuzo Shimeharitsuru Kin Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Its light flavor allows it to pair nicely with any food, especially with seafood and light meat.

TITLE: Miyozakura Jozo Junmai "Panda" Cup Sake
DESCRIPTION: One of the most famous cup sake as PANDA CUP, Miyozakura's newly introduced Junmai series. Prawn Tempura with salt

TITLE: Mizbasho Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Brewed using Yamada Nishiki rice milled down to 50% (Daiginjo level). Light and Smooth.

TITLE: Mizu Saga Barley Shochu
DESCRIPTION: Handcrafted in the traditional way, this classic shochu is single distilled from tasty Japanese two-rowed barley, black koji rice, and the pure, famous waters of Black Hair Mountain (Kurokami-yama). At 70 proof it is more concentrated, like shochus of old, to enhance the subtle complexities, body and finish. Enjoyed best on the rocks with a single large ice (you can try with a slice of cucumber). Or enjoy as a highball, topped with soda water and garnished cucumber slices. We also suggest mixing with fresh ruby red grapefruit juice and a splash of soda, or mixing with iced green teas.

TITLE: Mizuho Awamori Shochu
DESCRIPTION: In the distant past, when Okinawa was an independent kingdom, it was the norm to age sake. Even now, this style is considered Okinawa's treasure. In 1969, Mizuho Shuzo purchased the "Tenryuugura" - a 640000 liter underground tank that they use for this purpose. They are proud to be one of the oldest operating Sakagura in Okinawa. Pork Dishes, Fried Dishes (tofu, chicken, fish, etcetera), Pickled Vegetables, Citrus

TITLE: Mocali Brunello di Montalcino
DESCRIPTION: Mocali chose their oldest vines (31 years old) from rich, mineral soils to produce this single cru bottling of Brunello di Montalcino. Whereas their base Brunello is fermented in stainless steel with aging in large oak cask, ‘Raunate’ is vinified and aged entirely in oak. Fermentation takes place in large French oak vats. Wine then ages for one year in tonneaux followed by 24 months in smaller oak barrels before resting in bottle for 7 months prior to release.

TITLE: Moet & Chandon Champagne Ice Imperial
DESCRIPTION: Ice Imperial, the first and only champagne especially created to be enjoyed over ice. A new champagne experience combining fun, fresh and free sensations while remaining true to the Moet & Chandon style, a style distinguished by its bright fruitiness, its seductive palate and its elegant maturity.

TITLE: Moet & Chandon Champagne Imperial
DESCRIPTION: Moët Impérial is the House’s iconic champagne. Created in 1869, it embodies Moët & Chandon’s unique style, a style distinguished by its bright fruitiness, its seductive palate and its elegant maturity.

TITLE: Moet & Chandon Champagne Imperial Rose
Moet & Chandon Champagne Nectar Imperial
Moet & Chandon Champagne Nectar Imperial Rose
DESCRIPTION: Nectar Impérial Rosé is a voluptuously gourmet expression of the Moët & Chandon style, a style distinguished by its bright fruitiness, its seductive palate and its elegant maturity.

TITLE: Moissenet Bonnard "Les Maisons Dieu" Bourgogne Rouge
DESCRIPTION: This Bourgogne Rouge is Pommard in a nutshell: generously rich, masculine in structure, with brawny tannins and notes of forest floor and pinesap mingling with the darkly carameled black currant fruit.

TITLE: Moissenet Bonnard Cremant de Bourgogne Brut
DESCRIPTION: Looking for a less expensive alternative to champagne but aren't quite ready to make the move to Prosecco from Italy or Cava from Spain? Look no further than this stellar bottle from Burgundy. Produced only a few kilometers away from the exclusive Champagne region, a wine with 'Cremant' in the title must be produced in the exact same way as those produced in Champagne. An affordable way to introduce the student of wine to the great Côtes de Beaune village of Pommard is with Jean-Louis Moissenet-Bonnard's Bourgogne Rouge. Duck spring rolls or how about some fresh oysters after a long work week.

TITLE: Moissenet-Bonnard  Cuvee de l'Oncle Paul Bourgogne Rouge
DESCRIPTION: There is quite a bit of tannic grip, which requires a pot of poultry stew to soften around the edges.

TITLE: Moli dels Capellans Conca de Barbera Atrepat Aromatico
DESCRIPTION: A young unoaked red from Trepat grapes, 40% of which was fermented with the corbonic maceration method. It has some funky notes and light herbal and fruity character that is a little irreverent perhaps. The palate is light with fine tannins and high acidity which is great to have with summer foods. Fun and easy to drink. Any summer food would go great with this one: salads, grilled meats, corn dogs, etc.

TITLE: Molino A Vento Terre Siciliane Carricante
Mongarda Vino Frizzante Col Fondo
DESCRIPTION: Farra di Soligo in the lieu-dit “San Gallo,” 2.3 hectares at 350-370m above sea level, planted in 1950. Southern exposure. Trained in the traditional Sylvoz or Doppio Capovolto. Whole-cluster pressed; primary fermentation with indigenous yeasts in 30HL stainless steel vats, secondary fermentation in bottle using must from this same vineyard and vintage. Undisgorged. No residual sugar.

TITLE: Monje Tacoronte-Acentejo Hollera Maceracion Carbonica
DESCRIPTION: The landscape all around the winery is a delight to behold: vineyards, mountains, the sea and the sun. It is a perfect spot to live and nurture our wines. Built back in 1956, the winery was modernised in 1983 but still holds the original oak barrels where the traditional red wine is left to ferment and mature. Age-old practices go hand in hand with modern-day technology. Old vines, soil as volcanic as you can get, and fermented carbonically. Hollera paired fabulously with a meal of roasted pork and colorful, tangy herbal pestos.

TITLE: Monk's Road Fifth District Series Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey 15
DESCRIPTION: With the Monk’s Road Fifth District Series, we tip our hat to the historic tax district of Central Kentucky, deeply seeped in bourbon lore. With this rotating series of hand-selected spirits, we honor a long line of rotating bluegrass-inspired bourbons created with the same ingenuity and fortitude made famous by our patriarch Joseph Washington Dant. So, just this once, let’s celebrate the taxman. This first-release 6-year-old single barrel bourbon pays homage to Cold Spring Distillery, a historic distillery founded in the 1800s on land where we are currently located in southern Nelson County, Ky. The Cold Spring name harkened back to the spring where, even in the summer, the water stayed cool enough that the distillery could continue to operate.

TITLE: Monkey 47  "Bathing Ape" Edition Schwarzwald Dry Gin
DESCRIPTION: Monkey47 and A Bathing Ape (BAPE), two giants icons in the world of luxury craftsmanship within their own fields of Craft Gin and street wear fashion, have joined forces to create an exclusive capsule collection. Monkey 47’s eccentrically wunderbar jungle print fuses perfectly with BAPE’s iconic camo design to create a collection that combines the best from the urban clothing and gin art worlds.

TITLE: Monkey 47 Distiller's Cut Schwarzwald Dry Gin
DESCRIPTION: In a complex and extensive process, our Distiller's Cut is macerated once more following its initial distillation and then distilled again. After that, it's left to mature for three months in earthenware containers before being combined with soft spring water from right here in the Black Forest.

TITLE: Monkey 47 Schwarzwald Dry Gin
DESCRIPTION: Monkey 47 Schwarzwald Dry Gin is a premium gin crafted in the heart of Germany's Black Forest. Named for its unique blend of 47 botanicals, this gin offers an unparalleled depth of flavor and complexity. Distilled using traditional methods and pure Black Forest spring water, Monkey 47 combines exotic ingredients such as lingonberries and handpicked regional herbs, resulting in a gin that is both vibrant and sophisticated. Perfect for classic gin cocktails or sipping neat, Monkey 47 is a testament to the artistry of gin-making.

TITLE: Monkey Head Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Produced using 100% winter wheat distilled in the Champagne region of northern France. Treated with a special nanometric-activated charcoal which is then followed by oxygenation, giving a perfectly neutral and extremely smooth French vodka.

TITLE: Monkey Shoulder Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Monkey Shoulder is the world’s first Triple Malt, a blend of three of Speyside’s finest single malt whiskies. On its own or over ice it’s deliciously smooth and rich. However, this is a whisky that loves company and is perfectly balanced for mixing.

TITLE: Monmousseau Ammonite Vouvray Sec
DESCRIPTION: The cuvee “Ammonite”, stands for the type of fossils found there and the grapes come from a vineyard overlooking the Loire river on a granite slope. Hand harvested, the grapes are slow pressed over 4 hours releasing their natural richness. Using only indigenous yeast, a cold fermentation lasting 10 to 12 weeks takes place in 600 liters old oak barrels (averaging 40 years of age). Chateau Gaudrelle, dates from 1537, is the brand name of the estate. Owner and winemaker Alexandre Monmousseau’s family has run the estate since his grandfather purchased it in 1931 and he makes sparkling, dry and sweet wine from the Chenin Blanc grape as well as a sparkling rosé from Grolleau and Cabernet Franc. He cultivates 20 hectares of vineyards averaging 35 years in age. Château Gaudrelle is located in the heart of the Loire Valley between Tours and historic Amboise, overlooking the beautiful Loire river.

TITLE: Montalbera La Tradizione Ruche
DESCRIPTION: Italy's Piedmont region is known for complex Nebbiolo and juicy Dolcetto, but this bottling makes a strong case for the obscure Ruché grape.While red wine will often have a single berry note, this one has a whole basket of them.

TITLE: Monte Bernardi Chianti Classico Retromarcia
DESCRIPTION: Retromarcia is a Chianti Classico made from Sangiovese (100%) grapes (since 2010). A large proportion of the grapes come from vineyards consisting of shale (Galestro), limestone (Alberese) and sandstone (Arenaria-Calcare-Pietraforte), and are, on average, ten years in age. The vinification and maturation is reminiscent of a more traditional style Chianti Classico. The Italian word Retromarcia has come to mean more to us than its literal translation “to back up” or “to reverse”; ever since we arrived in Panzano, it has been our aim to produce intensely typical and expressive wines from Tuscany’s historic zone – Chianti Classico. With the name Retromarcia, we are emphasizing a return to the natural elegance and charm of Sangiovese. Grilled fish; hearty stews; pasta Bolognese; a cheese platter

TITLE: Monte Bernardi Italia Ti Adoro
DESCRIPTION: This wide-body, one liter bottle with flashy pink lettering on the label can't be taken too seriously after all. The brainchild of Michael Schmelzer of Monte Bernardi fame, Italia Ti Amo is actually a blend of red grapes from all over Italy including (but not limited to) Sangiovese from Tuscany, Montepulciano from the Marche and Nero d'Avola from Sicily. All of these grapes are organically farmed and somehow they blend together like they were meant for each other.

TITLE: Monte Falcon Bonarda
DESCRIPTION: Chicken dishes, potato salads, burgers. Also pairs wonderfully with charred meats, grilled veggies and hearty dishes with a kick.

TITLE: Monte Falcon Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Cabernet Sauvignon is one of the more complex and layered wines out there. It has higher tannins and a savory character often described as black pepper and tobacco. Because of Cab’s traits, look for foods high in fat and umami flavors for Cabernet Sauvignon food pairing. Try Cabernet Sauvignon with a charred gruyere burger, a mushroom pizza with tomato sauce or some marinated ribeye steak. To champion the fruit flavors in Cabernet Sauvignon, don’t pair it with chocolate. Instead, pair wine with braised short ribs or mushroom stroganoff. The powerful umami flavors overcome the savory quality of Cabernet Sauvignon leaving the berry flavors out in the open to shine.

TITLE: Monte Falcon Malbec
DESCRIPTION: Unlike Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec doesn’t have a super long finish. Because of this, Malbec is great with leaner red meats (ostrich anyone?). The wine does extremely well with funky flavors like blue cheese and rustic flavors like mushrooms and cumin spice.

TITLE: Monte Falcon Merlot
DESCRIPTION: Deep red in color, with burgundy and brick tones. Ripe blackberry and strawberry, together with dried fruits such as prune, fig and cherry. Smooth and soft on entering the palate, carrying through to a light, balanced finish.

TITLE: Monte Falcon Oak Aged Roble Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve
Monte Falcon Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Go Green. Sauvignon Blanc with its herbaceous notes pairs well with similar green herbs. If it has parsley, rosemary, basil, cilantro or mint, chances are Sauvignon Blanc will make a great pairing. There is also one classic pairing of Sauvignon Blanc that started in the Loire Valley. Close to Sancerre there is a goat cheese produced called Crottin de Chavignol and it has an international reputation as an outstanding stinky-creamy cheese. A bite of Crottin with a splash of Sauvignon Blanc is considered a classic perfect pairing.

TITLE: Monte Falcon Shiraz
DESCRIPTION: Ideal Pairing: Barbecue Pork. A bold wine like this can hold up to the intense flavors of slow-roasted barbecue pork. A great cut for this might be a pork shoulder where you’ll have a rich umami-driven piece of meat. Try spicing this type of meat with pepper and cumin to bring out the fruitiness in the wine. Another way is using Asian cuisine flavors, such as plum sauce, that will add to the fruitiness in the wine. (Vegetarian option: smoked seitan steaks)

TITLE: Montebello White Rum Rhum Agricole De La Guadeloupe
DESCRIPTION: Montebello White Rum Rhum Agricole De La Guadeloupe is a premium rhum agricole produced in the lush and fertile region of Basse-Terre, Guadeloupe. Crafted at the Carrere Distillery, this unaged rum is made from 100% fresh sugarcane juice, resulting in a vibrant and authentic spirit that captures the true essence of its terroir. Bottled at 100 proof, Montebello White Rum is perfect for both sipping and mixing, offering a unique and flavorful base for classic cocktails like the Ti' Punch, Daiquiri, or Mojito. Experience the rich tradition and exceptional quality of Guadeloupean rum with every sip.

TITLE: Montelvini Venegazzu Prosecco
DESCRIPTION: From the hills of Montello and Asolo comes Asolo Prosecco, the finest example of local sparkling wine, which has been awarded “denominazione di origine controllata e garantita” status. It is made from the Glera grape variety, which has rather large, wing-shaped bunches, which are loosely packed with grapes of a golden yellow color. perfect complement to shellfish and fish in general, including raw fish, and is ideal with salmon starters. It can also be pleasantly enjoyed after meals. Serve at a temperature of 6° - 8°

TITLE: Montesecondo Chianti Classico
Montesecondo Vino Frizzante Silvio Messana Ghazii
DESCRIPTION: 100% Sangiovese. From organically farmed and hand-harvested Montesecondo fruit. The whole clusters are pressed and the must fermented spontaneously in tank without sulfur. It is bottled with around 10 g/liter of sugar remaining and finishes fermenting in the bottle. The wine is not fined or filtered or ever sulfured. The name references Silvio's North African upbringing: "Ghazii" with one "i" in Arabic means "sparkling" and with the double "ii" references the nickname for anti-colonial fighters.The label--featuring "Silvio Messana" and not "Montesecondo"-- and packaging--the clear bottle with a crown cap--indicates that Ghazii is part of Silvio's newer line of wines that depart in style and, in some cases, sourcing from his core Montesecondo wines.

TITLE: MontGras Antu Ninquen Cabernet Sauvignon Carmenere Blend
DESCRIPTION: Blocks 181 and 185 in the Ninquen vineyard in Colchagua Valley, between Chile’s Coastal Range and the Andes. Soil here is rich in clay, strewn with rocks and stones. 7-year-old vines trellised using vertical shoot positioning. Grapes are handpicked at the end of April and subjected to a cold soak over 4 days. Whole berries are fermented on the skins and remain in contact with the skins for 26 days. The wine is aged 18 months in new French oak barrels before bottling. Complements red meats, poultry and hard cheeses

TITLE: Montinore Estate Willamette Valley Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1982, Montinore Estate is a 210-acre Demeter Certified Biodynamic and Stellar Certified Organic estate that lies at the northern end of the Willamette Valley appellation and along the east-facing slope of the Coastal Range foothills in Oregon. Our vineyards are planted on ideal sites for the seven grape varieties we grow, Pinot Noir, Pinot Gris, Gewurztraminer, Riesling, Muller-Thurgau, Teroldego and Lagrein. Our close attention to each step of the grape-growing and winemaking process is rooted in the belief that exceptional wine is born of a sustained marriage of soil, climate and artful stewardship. Biodynamic farming, controlled fruit yields, carefully fermented wine and estate bottling help our family-run winery offer full-flavored vintages of distinctive character and quality.

TITLE: Moon Apoge Pays d'Oc Syrah
DESCRIPTION: Grape varieties: 100% SyrahAlcohol percentage: 12,5% Total SO2: 30-40mg/L Vinification: harvest by night to prevent oxidation, avoid use of SO2, keep the freshness and protect the aromas. Temperature-controlled fermentation with natural yeasts to preserve primary aromas and enhance the fruityness of this grape variety. Certifications: ECOCERT, DEMETER, NOP, BIOSUISSE Lunar Apoge Syrah is easy drinking with a perfumed nose of raspberries, blue fruit and light herbs. Well balanced and spicy on the palate.

TITLE: Morgadio Legado del Conde Rias Baixas Albarino
DESCRIPTION: Morgadío is the easternmost inland estate in D.O. Rías Baixas, located in the subdistrict of Condado do Tea. Albariño’s revelation as one of the wine world’s noble white varieties is due in large part to work done at this property from the mid ’80s to the mid ’90s. There is no absolute right or wrong food and wine pairing, so enjoy the wine with whatever food you like. There is, however, one simple guideline: match the wine to the texture (or weight) of the food. These food-friendly wines with their intense fruit character, lively acidity, moderate alcohol and mineral overtones pair with a wide variety of foods, from their classic pairing with seafood to Asian fare or even salsa and chips. Enjoy them on their own as an apéritif, with tapas or “little plates,” or with full-course meals of veal, chicken, ham, medium-bodied cheeses, and an array of vegetable dishes.

TITLE: Mortlach Rare Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The color is golden amber and the nose is bold, highly perfumed and packed with immediate toffee, fudge, wood spice and dark dried fruit aromas - think especially of cinnamon and raisins. Underneath is a lovely aroma of stewed apples and toasted almonds along with hints of apricot jam, cocoa powder and something savoury and slightly earthy. On the palate this whisky has a wonderful velvety viscous feel and mixes sweet, fruity notes with more savoury and spicy ones. Initial flavours include cooked pears and apples, vanilla, toffee and milk chocolate. Then comes further fruitiness in the form of raisins and dried apricots, along with an increasing woody spiciness which begins to dry the palate out. This is most reminiscent of cinnamon with a pinch of nutmeg. There is also a biscuit-like note. Underneath is distinctly savoury note that adds complexity - this is difficult to define, but was reminiscent of earthy mushrooms or damp autumn leaves. Final hints of burnt orange and ginger add even more depth. The finish is long, rich and warming as the sweetness fades to leave a pleasant drying and slightly peppery spiciness.

DESCRIPTION: The ancient monastery of Muri-Gries, located just south of the Bremmer Pass in Süd Tyrol is the source for a bevy of clean, complex and classy wines made from the traditional grapes of this beautiful region. Muri-Gries remains a working Benedictine monastery, which was originally built in the late eleventh century as a fortress. In the fourteenth century, the fortress was donated to a local group of monks and converted into a monastery. Brothers of the Benedictine order arrived here from neighboring Switzerland in 1845 to take up residence in the recently abandoned site, and immediately brought their more sophisticated viticultural approach to the monastery’s wines. Muri-Gries began to produce DOC wines in 1947, and since then the monastery has won local fame for the high quality of its wines, and is now becoming well-known to Italian wine-loving insiders throughout Europe and the US

The Nana Vins et Cie Suzette pairs wonderfully with a wide variety of foods. Its crisp and fruity profile complements seafood dishes such as grilled shrimp or a delicate white fish. Light poultry dishes or pasta with creamy sauces also pair well with this wine. Its subtle floral and almond notes make it a great match for a cheese board featuring Brie, Camembert, or goat cheese. TITLE: Natalino Del Prete Negroamaro "Anne"
Nein Lives Riesling
DESCRIPTION: Nein Lives is an off-dry Riesling from Germany’s famed Mosel Valley. Each vintage has three label designs in a case. Christian Schafer, founder of Schafer-Reichart Selections, is the reason we’re able to enjoy Nein Lives today. He arrived to the U.S. in 2001 and was quickly disappointed by the lack of quality Rieslings available in this country, and quickly began working to import a handful of diverse selections made by people he’s known his entire life. Born and raised in the historic wine-producing town of Bernkastel-Kues in Germany’s Mosel Valley, Christian’s passion for wine had by then developed into a life’s work. “I have great memories of cultivating the famously steep vineyards and crafting the wine with my parents and grandparents – I have spent more than thirty years absorbing all the details of the winemaking process in and around Bernkastel-Kues.” Nein Lives Riesling grapes are sourced from the Middle Mosel along the banks of the Mosel River in the town of Piesporter. The Middle Mosel is considered the best source of diversity, complexity, and quality grapes within the Mosel Valley. There is no top soil here. Broken shale and schist cover the vineyards and impart the clean, complex mineral quality that has come to distinguish Mosel Rieslings. Riesling reflects terroir better than any other varietal in the world.

TITLE: Nelson Bros. Reserve Bourbon Whiskey

Both have carried on the legacy admirably. This one packs a punch but is soft and gentle at the same time, offering red berry and vanilla malt aromas and a palate of melted marshmallows, coconut shavings, and baked apples. TITLE: Neversink Spirits Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Neversink Spirits was founded by two long-time friends with a passion for spirits, wine, food, and nature. After years of tasting, tinkering, sipping and planning, Noah Braunstein and Yoni Rabino found a project in which their passions could be realized – and Neversink Spirits was born. Making spirits is their calling, apples their muse, and they finally found the vehicle in which to share their vision with their fans. A spirit’s quality can only be as high as the ingredients from which it’s made. When they formed a team with Camps Road Farm and Kent Falls Brewery to form a local collective known as “The Food Cycle,” they knew they had found a way to make their spirits truly unique. Working together, the partners carefully developed a growing plan for the farm, cultivating ingredients specifically designed to make exceptional spirits and beers. Being able to verify the supply chain’s provenance allows Neversink Spirits to make spirits of the highest quality, while minimizing the footprint on our planet. Waste from the brewing and distilling processes is recycled back on the farm as compost and animal feed, increasing the productivity of the farm and closing the sustainability loop. Apples are the cornerstone of Neversink Spirits’ production. In 2012, through a grassroots effort from volunteers and friends, we planted over 350 apple trees on Camps Road Farm. Spirits produced from the over 15 varieties of apples, all difficult to obtain heritage varietals that produce excellent cider and brandies, will excite the palate with new ways to experience of America’s favorite fruit. We are passionate about apples and want to share that passion with our fans.

DESCRIPTION: THE SMOOTHEST GIN & TONIC INGRIDIENTS: 2 oz New Amsterdam Gin 4 oz tonic water lime wedge INSTRUCTIONS: Fill a rocks glass with ice. Mix in gin, and then add tonic. Stir well. Garnish with a lime wedge.

TITLE: New England Barrel Company "Cheers!" 6 Years Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #59
DESCRIPTION: The New England Barrel Company was founded by James Saunders (a college friend of our very own @bdubs1313!) in 2015 and is based in Dover, NH. The company specializes in handcrafted barrels for the bourbon and whiskey industry, using traditional techniques and materials to create high-quality, authentic products. James cut hit proverbial teeth in the space by helping local stores with their barrel programs. He developed quite a palate and a reputation in bourbon circles for his ability to select "winners." Not long after he decided to ditch his IT sales job and pursue his passion - whiskey. The company sources American white oak from the forests of Missouri, Arkansas, and other states, selecting only the finest wood for their barrels. Each barrel is carefully crafted by skilled coopers who use a combination of hand tools and modern machinery to ensure precision and consistency. In addition to standard bourbon and whiskey barrels, the New England Barrel Company also produces a variety of custom barrels with unique sizes and finishes. These specialty barrels are often used for experimental aging and small-batch productions. One of the benefits of James having worked with retail shops in the past is his understanding and appreciation for small spirits shops. He tries not to flood a market with his single barrels allowing his trusted retail partners ample opportunity to serve their customers and respective local markets. For that reason, you don't see a lot of single barrels from them, but the ones you do are special. What you can expect from this release: Nose: cornbread, raisin toast, granola, and hints of honey and apricot Palate: Very dense and velvety, graham cracker, cereal grain, hints of tobacco, not overly sweet on the palate Finish: medium to long, with sweetness and hints of honey reappearing. Mashbill: 75% Corn / 21% Rye /4% Malted Barley

TITLE: New England Barrel Company 12 Years Single Barrel Rye
DESCRIPTION: New England Barrel Company 12 Years Single Barrel Rye is a masterful expression of Canadian rye whiskey, aged to perfection for 12 years. Distilled in Canada, this single barrel selection captures the essence of rye with its robust and complex flavor profile. Bottled at cask strength of 132.2 proof, it offers an intense and satisfying experience for whiskey enthusiasts. Each bottle reflects the craftsmanship and dedication of the New England Barrel Company, making it an exceptional choice for sipping neat, on the rocks, or in classic rye-forward cocktails.

TITLE: New England Barrel Company 6 Years Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey
New England Barrel Company 7 Year Old Single Barrel Wheated Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This Wheated Tennessee Bourbon was distilled at Speakeasy Distilling (TN) where it was aged for 6.5 years prior to coming to NH for just over 6 months before bottling. Bottled at cask strength and non-chill filtered this bourbon presents a well-rounded character with notes of oak, brown butter, dark brown sugar, and a finish that goes for days. Mashbill: 60% Corn, 22% Wheat, 18% malted barley

TITLE: New England Barrel Company 7yr Single Barrel Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Aged 7 years and distilled at MGPi (IN), this barrel demonstrates a well-rounded flavor and approachable flavor profile. Each pour will present with a butterscotch and creme brûlée on the nose which carries through to the palate where it is joined by vanilla bean and toasted oak. A medium-to-long finish rounds out each sip. Bottled at cask strength and non-chill filtered for your enjoyment and drinking pleasure.

TITLE: New England Barrel Company Small Batch Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: At 99-Proof (44.5% ABV.) the MGP-sourced Small Batch Bourbon brings all of the traditional bourbon flavors to the table – Vanilla, Caramel, Baking Spice, Honey – to make for a greater sipper whether neat, on the rocks, or in your favorite cocktail. ABV: 44.5%

TITLE: New England Barrel Company Small Batch Select  Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Aged 4 Years, this bourbon is sourced from the OZ Tyler/Green River Distillery in Kentucky where it spent the first 3.75 years of its life maturing into the full-bodied Bourbon that drew the brand to this particular production run. Dark Amber in color, you will find salted caramel, baked pears, or apples on the nose. The palate provides a classic bourbon profile with honey, vanilla, and toasted oak present in each sip. The long finish is where this magic happens and the tasting experience completes itself with a nice Kentucky Hug! ABV: 59.18% Color: Dark Amber Nose: Salted Caramel, Baked Pears, Caramelized Apples Palate: Classic Bourbon Profile w/ honey, vanilla, and toasted oak Finish: Medium-Long finish

Dark Amber in color, you will find salted caramel, baked pears, or apples on the nose. The palate provides a classic bourbon profile with honey, vanilla, and toasted oak present in each sip. ABV: 59.18% Color: Dark Amber Nose: Salted Caramel, Baked Pears, Caramelized Apples Palate: Classic Bourbon Profile w/ honey, vanilla, and toasted oak Finish: Medium-Long finish

TITLE: New England Barrel Company Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Stout Barrels
DESCRIPTION: NEBCo. barrels were provided to Lord Hobo Brewing Company where they proceeded to age stout for 4.5 months. NEBCo. took these barrels back the day they were emptied and immediately filled each barrel with a single barrel of bourbon. This bourbon was allowed to rest or finish for 7.5 months before being bottled at cask-strength and non-chill filtered. Mashbill: 75% Corn, 21% rye, 4% malted barley.

TITLE: New Riff 6 Years Malted Rye Kentucky Straight Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Made with 100% malted rye grain and aged six years, savory, floral fruits, powdered sugar, balanced oak, and vanilla fruits like plum skin and pear can be found on the nose, followed by spices, saltwater taffy, fruits, clove, and a toasty-malty note on the tongue.

TITLE: New Riff 8 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: New Riff 8-Year-Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a meticulously crafted expression from the acclaimed New Riff Distilling, representing the distillery's dedication to traditional bourbon-making with a modern twist. Aged for 8 years and bottled at 100 proof, this bourbon offers a rich and mature flavor profile showcasing the depth and complexity of extended aging. With a high-rye mash bill, New Riff 8-Year-Old Bourbon strikes a perfect balance between sweet and spicy notes, making it an exceptional choice for bourbon enthusiasts who appreciate a bold yet refined whiskey. This release is a testament to New Riff's commitment to quality and innovation in the heart of Kentucky’s bourbon country.

TITLE: New Riff 8 Years Rye Kentucky Straight Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: New Riff 8 Years Rye Kentucky Straight Whiskey is a distinguished release from New Riff Distilling, showcasing the bold and complex character of a well-aged rye whiskey. Aged for 8 years and bottled at 100 proof, this expression highlights the distillery’s commitment to producing high-quality, full-bodied spirits. Made from a high-rye mashbill, this whiskey offers an exceptional balance of spice, sweetness, and depth, making it a perfect choice for rye enthusiasts seeking a rich and mature whiskey. With its robust flavor profile and smooth finish, New Riff 8 Years Rye is a testament to the distillery's dedication to craft and innovation in the world of American whiskey.

TITLE: New Riff A Very Old 15 Year Old  Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: New Riff Distilling release of a 15-year-old straight bourbon whiskey, with all profits benefiting relief funds for the bar, restaurant, and service industry workers in Northern Kentucky and Greater Cincinnati. Only 900 bottles were sourced from MGP and released.

TITLE: New Riff Backsetter Bottled in Bond Peated Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Backsetters - one Bourbon and one Rye - released as a pair of absolutely unprecedented whiskeys are, like all New Riff whiskeys, crafted with the traditional, time-honored Sour Mash Kentucky Regimen. Wherein a portion of grain "backset" from a prior distillation is added to the mash of a present batch. And they utilize the exact same mash bills as New Riff's award-winning standard Bourbon and Rye recipes. What's different is exactly what they were sour mashed with. For this opening Backsetter salvo, the distillery has used backset collected from the distillation of peat-smoked malted barley, which lends a wonderfully smoky cast to the whiskeys. The resultant smoky flavor is hauntingly unique, with layers of peat enveloping spicy rich Rye and Bourbon, respectively.

TITLE: New Riff Backsetter Bottled in Bond Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Backsetters - one Bourbon and one Rye - released as a pair of absolutely unprecedented whiskeys are, like all New Riff whiskeys, crafted with the traditional, time-honored Sour Mash Kentucky Regimen. Wherein a portion of grain "backset" from a prior distillation is added to the mash of a present batch. And they utilize the exact same mash bills as New Riff's award-winning standard Bourbon and Rye recipes. What's different is exactly what they were sour mashed with. For this opening Backsetter salvo, the distillery has used backset collected from the distillation of peat-smoked malted barley, which lends a wonderfully smoky cast to the whiskeys. The resultant smoky flavor is hauntingly unique, with layers of peat enveloping spicy rich Rye and Bourbon, respectively.

TITLE: New Riff Bottled in Bond Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: New Riff Distilling’s core Bourbon expression is a genuinely high-rye, full-bodied whiskey offering savory, spicy character. Building upon America’s 1897 Bottled-in-Bond Act—already the highest quality standard for aged spirits in the world—New Riff Bourbon is Bottled In Bond Without Chill Filtration. Featuring a mash bill of non-GMO grains at 65% corn,30% rye, and 5% malted barley, it represents a new riff on Kentucky’s most hallowed whiskey traditions. Aged four years in 53-gallon toasted and charred new oak barrels, there are no shortcuts taken in our production. All New Riff whiskeys are made with the full sour mash Kentucky Regimen; all carry an age statement and are always bottled without chill filtration.

TITLE: New Riff Bottled-in Bond Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: New Riff Distilling’s core Rye whiskey is full-bodied, offering hugely spicy character. Building upon America’s 1897 Bottled-in-Bond Act—already the highest quality standard for aged spirits in the world—New Riff Rye is Bottled In Bond Without Chill Filtration. Featuring a unique mashbill of 95% rye and 5% malted rye, it represents a new riff on the hallowed local Rye whiskey traditions. Aged four years in full-size 53-gallon toasted and charred new oak barrels, there are no shortcuts taken in its traditional production. All New Riff whiskeys are made with the full sour mash Kentucky Regimen; all carry an age statement and are always bottled without chill filtration.

TITLE: New Riff Distilling  "Almost Vegas" Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #8
DESCRIPTION: The long-awaited 2021 single barrel selection (2nd from The Prime Barrel crew) is here. We were presented with four barrels to choose from. Out of the four, two were standouts - to the point where we wanted to take both, but got shut down by powers that be. So we mulled long and hard which barrel out of the two we like we want to go with. Ultimately we decided on barrel # 17-1430. To us, besides tasting fantastic, it had the "it" factor we look for in our picks. More specifically, it was the most unique barrel out of the four, from both taste and complexity vantage points. The barrel was bottled at 105.9 proof and really is best enjoyed neat, but your mileage may vary. it has floral aromas accompanied with raspberry and confectionary sugar lead to the taste of orange sherbet, oak, and red fruit gummy. For the sticker, we wanted to pay homage to the hometown of New Riff Distilling, which is Newport, KY. Newport was dubbed by some "Almost Vegas" for being home to Racing and Gaming casino, providing good folks of Kentucky and neighboring states a place to come to a casino without having to travel to Vegas. Of course, nothing IS quite Vegas itself, hence the title of the pick - "Almost Vegas." The sticker also reflects the bottle's tasting notes and has an interactive component to it as well. Scan the QR code to find out where it takes you! Lastly, the charity this barrel selection will be supporting (as suggested by folks on our IG account) is The Asperger/Autism Network: What They Do: The Asperger/Autism Network aims to assist individuals on the Autism Spectrum (plus their family members, partners, and professionals) throughout their lifetimes. The network provides a mix of in-person and virtual services such as a referral program, support network, and conferences. The Asperger/Autism Network is largely run by those on the Autism Spectrum. How Donations Help: Any donations received go to helping the network provide information, education, support, and advocacy to adults, families, friends, and professionals. Donation Amount: $5 from each bottle sold

TITLE: New Riff Distilling  "R/Bourbon" Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Barrel #7276 hand-selected by t8ke

TITLE: New Riff Distilling "Balboa Rye" Bottle in Bond Kentycky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: New Riff has done it again. They’ve managed to release yet another whiskey that’s more than deserving of two thumbs up. Balboa Rye is a very well balanced 95% rye whiskey that has a nose, palate and finish that are equally enjoyable. Although the rye spice is very noticeable on this whiskey, there are accompanying clove and nutmeg notes that really add to it. I think this is a fantastic addition to the New Riff portfolio and see this being the perfect bottle to turn quite a few folks into rye whiskey drinkers that previously weren’t into rye whiskey!

TITLE: New Riff Distilling "Barrel Brothers" Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #29
DESCRIPTION: Barrel #8146 was picked on our very first Kentucky barrel selection expedition, where selected members of our club got to participate in the selection process. This has made the whole experience a lot more memorable and productive since it was a collection of 8 unique palates agreeing on the best-tasting barrel. The sticker theme commemorates this occasion by putting crude versions of our faces onto the "Blues Brothers" inspired sticker. We think that the selection turned out great and can't wait to hear your reviews!Aroma: Overripe Banana Cinnamon Flavor: Warm Rye Bread, Nutmeg Finish: Lemon Zest While a little overdue, $5 from each bottle will support families of victims of the senseless Uvalde, TX tragedy, i.e., the Texas Elementary School Shooting Victims Fund.

TITLE: New Riff Distilling "Maltster Wheat" Bottle in Bond Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: From the very beginnings of New Riff's distillery design, we incorporated the ability to add any bag of grain into our recipes. It’s called the “auxiliary grain conveyor.” We use this grain handling feature every week when we add 50-lb bags of malted rye into our standard New Riff Rye Whiskey. But we also use it to make a new riff on classic whiskey traditions... Introducing Maltsters, a project that explores different malted grains used in a Bourbon recipe. Our distilling team delved into their background as craft brewers and pulled out of their hat a couple of magical recipes: Malted Rye Bourbon and Malted Wheat Bourbon. These unique mashbills offer bold interpretations of traditional Bourbon styles, from a refined and sophisticated rye experience to a darker and deeper version of wheated Bourbon. From the opening aroma of our Malted Wheat Bourbon, there is a shade of dark, husky grains to the whole production; yet it also drinks in a classical Bourbon fashion with plenty of oak. A splash of water releases a whiff of dark fruit. In the mouth, it enters large-scaled and full-bodied, tending to dryness. There’s plenty of oak but, behind that, lies that notion of dark (black currant?) fruit. A wood spice element tinges the finish, which grows on the taster precipitously. BOTTLED IN BOND WITHOUT CHILL FILTRATION 65% CORN, 18% BOHEMIAN FLOOR-MALTED WHEAT, 10% UNMALTED WHEAT 7% DARK WHEAT AGED AT LEAST 5 YEARS 100 PROOF

TITLE: New Riff Distilling "One of One" 9 Year Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick
DESCRIPTION: In 2022, Eastern Kentucky was hit by tornadoes and floods. The inclement weather was responsible for the rising death toll and hundreds of people missing, making rescue and recovery efforts tedious. Fortunately, our signature industry is known for stepping up in times of crisis. Kentucky distillers, private collectors, and out-of-state brands have come together again to donate exclusive private barrel experiences, rare and vintage spirits, one-of-a-kind bottles, and unique tasting and tourism offerings through a charity bourbon auction. All proceeds went directly to the State’s Official Team Eastern Kentucky Flood Relief Fund. As a club, we wanted to donate to the efforts. We decided to bid and were fortunate to win a couple of one-in-a-lifetime barrel-picking experiences, of which this was one.New Riff cracked open the warehouse and pulled out a barrel from their Batch No. 1 of New Riff Bourbon Whiskey, distilled back in June 2014. In July of 2023, our Tier 1+ members joined us for a Premium Experience, which included selecting this one-of-one 9-year-old barrel. Barrel Specs: Barrel Number: 14-0034 Entry Prood: 110 Final Proof: 113.5 Age 9 years (Fill Date 6/26/2014)

TITLE: New Riff Distilling "Ryeders On The Storm" Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #43
DESCRIPTION: This barrel #11649 is one of the few rye barrels available to our market. It was selected during our second #barrelpickingexpedition to Kentucky with club members earlier this year. We always appreciate New Riff single barrels coming in at cask strength instead of their standard bottled-in bond 100 proof. Makes the rye really stand out! The barrels we tried had a range of flavor profiles. Two were immediate favorites among the group, but the selected barrel really blew the others away in nose and palate. We brought a sample of it home and blind-tasted it against 2 other new riff rye picks. Ours was much better than the others. The biased statement, we know - but still worth mentioning :) Here's what you can look forward to: Nose: Caramel, citrus, cinnamon bark Palate: Iced cinnamon bread, rye spice, warm baking spices, and a light “grassy” note Finish: warm rye finish with a gentle, warming "Kentucky hug" Overall: The whiskey has a great balance of typical rich rye whiskey notes with just the right amount of oak influence (caramel, sweetness, and likely adds to the baking spice notes). $5 from every bottle sold will go towards supporting TheHateDust project. The project serves to support education and services for children, veterans, and local communities through crowdsourced funding through sales of offbeat goods.

TITLE: New Riff Distilling Single Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: New Riff Distilling's Single Barrel Rye expression is a full-bodied whiskey offering a vibrant, spicy character. Bottled at Barrel Proof Without Chill Filtration, and featuring a mash bill of 95% rye and 5% malted rye, this 100% rye whiskey represents a new riff on one of the most influential of modern whiskey traditions. Aged four years in 53-gallon toasted and charred new oak barrels, there are no shortcuts taken in the production. All New Riff whiskeys are made with the full sour mash Kentucky Regimen; all carry an age statement and are always bottled without chill-filtration.

TITLE: New Riff Premium Rye + Bourbon Bundle
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the exceptional flavors of New Riff with this exclusive bundle featuring three of their most aged expressions: New Riff 8 Years Rye Kentucky Straight WhiskeyExperience a bold and spicy character, harmoniously layered for a memorable sip. New Riff 8 Years Bourbon Kentucky Straight WhiskeyDelight in a beautifully balanced blend of sweet and savory notes, showcasing craftsmanship at its finest.
