Perfect for Collectors and Connoisseurs: Whether you're a seasoned whiskey drinker or a new enthusiast, this bundle offers a unique tasting journey through the rich heritage of New Riff. Secure your New Riff Aged Expressions Bundle today before it's gone!

TITLE: New Riff Ranger Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Originally available exclusively to New Riff Ranger club members. This is a four year old, high rye, sour mashed, new riff Kentucky straight bourbon, picked from the best barrels New Riff produced.

TITLE: New Riff Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: New Riff's very first Single barrel and is a heck of a product considering the age (4 years). They're definitely on the path towards greatness. A few more years in the barrel will definitely smooth it out and allow to gain some complexity. Nevertheless, tasty stuff!

TITLE: New Riff Sour Mash Kentucky Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: New Riff's Sour Mash Kentucky Single Malt Whiskey represents a bold innovation in the world of malted barley whiskeys. This unique whiskey, comprised of up to six different mashbills, undergoes slow maturation in various cask types, blending Old World inspiration with Kentucky's sour mash technique. The mashbills feature 100% Maris Otter, 100% Golden Promise, Barleywine-style, Belgian quadrupel-style, 100% Scottish peated barley malt, and 100% Chevallier Heirloom malted barley, offering a diverse and complex flavor profile. The six mashbills include: · 100% Maris Otter, a classic British ale malt· 100% Golden Promise, a classic Scotch whisky malt· Barleywine-style, after high gravity, heavy-bodied barleywine ales· Belgian quadruple-style, in the fashion of rich, mellow Trappist ales· 100% Scottish peated barley malt, heavily smoked and pungent· 100% Chevallier Heirloom malted barley, an 1820s-vintage English variety

TITLE: New Riff Winter Whiskey Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Made with Malted Oat and Chocolate Malt.
DESCRIPTION: New Riff's Winter Whiskey is a one-of-a-kind Bourbon that combines the warmth and cheer of the season with the rich flavors of chocolate oatmeal stouts. The raw and malted oats give this Bourbon a unique spicy quality that's distinct from rye, while the roasted cocoa notes of chocolate malt add a delicate dryness to the finish. Winter Whiskey is unlike anything we've ever made or tasted, and we think you'll love the three-way conversation between the dry cocoa quality, balanced oak, and oaty spice. Despite the "chocolate" in the name, it never turns cloying and is instead dusted with Belgian cocoa for a truly unforgettable experience. 100 PROOF (50% ALC/VOL)Mashbill: 65% CORN 20% MALTED OATS, 7% PALE ALE MALT, 5% STEEL CUT RAW OATS, 3% CHOCOLATE MALT

TITLE: New York Distilling Company 7 Year Heirloom Jaywalk Single Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: One notable mention in the world of heirloom rye whiskeys is the New York Distilling Company 7 Year Heirloom Jaywalk Single Barrel Rye Whiskey. Crafted from 75% Horton Rye, a grain once lost and forgotten, it has been passionately revived by the New York Distilling Company. With acres dedicated to its cultivation in Seneca Falls, New York, they've partnered with local farmers - the Peterson Family, who've been instrumental in growing this distinct rye for the distillery since its inception in 2011. This rye grain is truly special; not only is it smaller than typical rye, but it's also brimming with unique flavors. After 13 years in the making, the general public now gets to experience this fantastic expression!

TITLE: New York Distilling Company Dorothy Parker Gin
DESCRIPTION: Made by Brooklyn's NY Distilling Co and named for NY's legendary, witty poet Dorothy Parker this is a gin we would have loved to have mixed in a sour cocktail at the Algonquin Round Table.

TITLE: New York Distilling Company Perry's Tot Navy Strength Gin
DESCRIPTION: Matthew Calbraith Perry served as Commandant of the Brooklyn Navy Yard from 1841-43. As early as 1833 he was instrumental in founding its Naval Lyceum to ‘promote the diffusion of useful knowledge – and cement the link which unite professional bretheren.’ We celebrate the attitude and approach that connects the ingenuity and grit of 19th century Brooklyn with contemporary enthusiasts who continue to revive an American cocktail culture. This original Navy Strength Gin – at 57% ABV – is the historical proof at which gunpowder might still be fired should it unfortunately be soaked by spilled spirit. ‘Tot’, a British measurement for alcohol, gives nod to Navy Strengths roots. Aromatic and smooth, Perry’s is ideal for the gin aficionado.

TITLE: New York Distilling Company Ragtime Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This is distillery's first straight whiskey release. The Ragtime Rye American Straight Whiskey (90.4 proof) is made from 72% NY rye, 16% NY corn and 12% malted barley. Rye and corn was sourced from the Pedersen Farm upstate. The whiskey mash was fermented and distilled in our facility in Williamsburg, Brooklyn (405 Leonard St), where it also aged for no less than 3 years (the barrels ranged in age from 3 to 3.5 years) in 53 gallon, new, char #3, American white oak barrels (most of which came from ISC - Independent Stave Company). Also, distillery let the barrels age in a very rustic, traditional manner, with no manipulation or climate control- putting New York's seasonal pattern of long, cold winters with short, hot summers to work.

TITLE: New York State Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey Port Cask Finish
DESCRIPTION: Brooklyn Small Batch Co's first offering is a single barrel Bourbon Whiskey, matured in virgin American White Oak for approximately 6 months before being transferred to a full-size ex-Port cask for about 2 years for further finishing to impart color and flavor. Each bottle is hand labeled with its barrel & bottle number, and the closure is wax dipped to seal.

TITLE: Niepoort Douro Primata Nat'Cool
DESCRIPTION: Nat Cool, naturally cool and funky, is an innovative concept created by Niepoort with the aim of a bringing together various different producers to produce light, easy-drinking wines. The Primata is the result of Dirk Niepoort giving his cellar master Luís Pedro a “push” to make his own wine in 2016. The grapes for this wine stem from vineyards growing at an altitude of 600m in the Douro Valley, more specifically in the Tabuaço region. The character and lightness of these high-lying vineyards with their granitic slate soils as well as the structure of the Douro grape varieties combine with the “Natcool-factor” of “less if more”: minimal intervention in the vineyards as well as in the cellar. A minimalist winemaking concept where the raw material has the biggest say!

TITLE: Niepoort Nat Cool Tinto Bairrada
DESCRIPTION: The Niepoort family has been creating Port Wines since 1842. The first property in Douro was bought in 1987 and Dirk Niepoort started a new Era in the company with the creation of the first Redoma red in 1991. In the last years Niepoort took on the great challenge of interpreting other soils and climates and acquired two properties in other regions, Dao and Bairrada. Discover the Niepoort Triangle which express the different terroirs: Schist (Douro), Limestone (Bairrada) and Granite (Dao).

TITLE: Niepoort Tawny Port
DESCRIPTION: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinto Cao, Tinta Francisca, Tinta Amarela, Sousao, Tinta Roriz.

TITLE: Niepoort Vinho Verde Loureiro Docil Branco
DESCRIPTION: The Docil 2017 is the result of our search for a Vinho Verde which would reflect the region’s terroir and whose vinification would rely on the balance, structure and vibrant acidity of the Loureiro grape variety. This Loureiro comes from its traditional region, the Lima Valley, and is produced from vines growing in granitic soil. The characteristic aromatic profile of this grape shines through in the wine, with fresh floral and mineral aromas taking centre stage.

TITLE: Niepoort Vinho Verde Nat' Cool Branco
DESCRIPTION: Nat Cool is naturally “cool and funky”. It represents an innovative concept initiated by Niepoort, in which various producers came together to create light, easy-to-drink wines. In the Vinho Verde region, we produced a wine typical of the region – a wine which references the “cloudy” wines of the past which were bottled with some residual sugar and fine lees, and therefore re-fermented in the bottle. Welcome to the Nat Cool world!

TITLE: Nihon Sakari Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Based in Nada, Japan, a region famous for its history of Sake production do to its superior water and rice sources, Nihon Sakari has been producing Sake according to traditional methods for over a century. This is a smooth, balanced sake, with nutty fruit notes and subtle hints of herb and spice. It is distinctive, as interesting on its own as with food.

TITLE: Nihon Sakari Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Based in Nada, Japan, a region famous for its history of Sake production do to its superior water and rice sources, Nihon Sakari has been producing Sake according to traditional methods for over a century. This is a smooth, balanced sake, with nutty fruit notes and subtle hints of herb and spice. It is distinctive, as interesting on its own as with food.

TITLE: Nihonsakari Onikoroshi Sake Box
DESCRIPTION: For over 110 years, Nihonsakari has cultivated brewing techniques rooted in traditional sake-making processes from Nada, home of Japan's finest sake. Today we also produce natural beauty and health products, including our Komenuka Bijin line of cleansing products for skin and hair, and a natural sake that appeals to health-conscious consumers. Combining old traditional processes with a modern emphasis on health, nature and freshness, Nihonsakari is evolving as a brand name of products that are good to both our bodies and the environment. This product may or may not "slay demons" (Oni Koroshi), but still goes well with rich or fried foods and ramen.

TITLE: Niigata Meijo Koshino Kanchubai Kamenoo Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Niigata Meijo is located in Ojiya in the central region of Niigata Prefecture 150 miles north of Tokyo. It is in a fertile valley they use for rice farming surrounded by snow-covered mountains, and in winter the environment is ideal for sake production. They have produced sake for over 70 years, and they have received many awards for their characteristically beautiful, smooth, clean and clear sake. Sukiyaki, Grilled Chicken, Miso Marinades, Sashimi, Soba

TITLE: Nikka 12 Japanese Blended Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The product of two distilleries (Yoichi and Miyagikyo), The Nikka 12 is a well-balanced blend. There's green-apple freshness, rich fruitcake spiciness, butterscotch and some green-peppercorn punch. Another winner from Nikka.

TITLE: Nikka 15 year old Yoichi Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Malt whisky is distilled exclusively from barley malt and a single malt is from one specific distillery. This bold and distinctive single malt whisky was distilled and matured at the Yoichi distillery in Hokkaido, birthplace of Nikka Whisky. The Yoichi distillery continues to adhere to techniques such as the use of coal-fired pot stills, and otherwise remains loyal to the whisky-making traditions dating back to its foundation.

TITLE: Nikka Coffey Gin
DESCRIPTION: The Nikka Coffey Gin is the first gin released by the whisky powerhouse. This gin will initially be distributed exclusively in Japan. For the rest of the world, we’re here to help!

TITLE: Nikka Coffey Grain Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Crafted from a mash bill dominated by corn and filled out with malted barley, this whisky is produced in continuous distillation using a Coffey still. Released without an age statement, it's a light straw-colored whisky that defies easy categorization. It might remind you a bit of bourbon, with vanilla and oak up front, a luscious body tasting of sweet corn, hazelnut, and melon. There's a vegetal undertone and a quick, strong finish. It's unlike any other whisky you’ve tried, and absolutely mesmerizing in a whisky soda, where the flavors open up to offer grapefruit, mint, and caramel. Whisky Advocate magazine rating: 92

TITLE: NIkka Coffey Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The originality of this 100% malt expression lies in its unique distillation method. Malted barley is distilled in a “Coffey still”, a traditional continuous still which is normally used to produce grain whisky, resulting in a malt that is delightfully fruity and spicy. This whisky was previously only released as part of their single cask series. But starting 2016 in the US, Nikka has made this more widely available.

TITLE: Nikka Days Smooth and Delicate Blended Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Nikka Days has been developed for whisky lovers who appreciate fine drinks on any casual day, based on the concept "whisky for every day". Its round bottle and bright colored label visualize the taste profile of the whisky inside and enhance a vibrant mood. This whisky can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, in a simple highball or refreshing cocktail. Nikka Days will complement and elevate your day.

TITLE: Nikka Discovery Miyagikyo Aromatic Yeast Single Malt Whisky 2022
DESCRIPTION: Nikka has added two limited edition whiskies to its Discovery range for 2022, Yoichi Single Malt Aromatic Yeast and Miyagikyo Single Malt Aromatic Yeast. Last September, the Asahi-owned brand unveiled the first two expressions in the series, which focus on the diversity of ingredients available within the distillery. The Nikka Discovery 2022 expressions highlight “unique” aromas generated during fermentation. Bottled at 47% ABV,, Miyagikyo Single Malt Aromatic Yeast offers a fruitier aroma of peach and apricot.

TITLE: Nikka Discovery Yoichi Aromatic Yeast Single Malt Whisky 2022
DESCRIPTION: Nikka has added two limited edition whiskies to its Discovery range for 2022, Yoichi Single Malt Aromatic Yeast and Miyagikyo Single Malt Aromatic Yeast. Last September, the Asahi-owned brand unveiled the first two expressions in the series, which focus on the diversity of ingredients available within the distillery. The Nikka Discovery 2022 expressions highlight “unique” aromas generated during fermentation. Bottled at 48% ABV, Yoichi Single Malt Aromatic Yeast is partially made from a batch that has an estery aroma reminiscent of ginjyo sake, according to Nikka.

TITLE: Nikka From The Barrel
DESCRIPTION: For Nikka From the Barrel, it’s been a long road to Whisky of the Year 2018. This Japanese blend made its U.S. debut in 2018, but its inception dates back more than 30 years. In 1985, Nikka Whisky Distilling Company’s blending team, led by Shigeo Sato, designed this whisky using both malt and grain whiskies produced at Nikka’s Yoichi and Miyagikyo Distilleries. When taking into account the full array of casks—bourbon barrels, sherry butts, refill hogsheads, and more—over 100 different constituent whiskies are enlisted. “From the Barrel” suggests barrel proof, but that’s not the case. The blenders made a conscious decision to bottle at 51.4% (derived from 90 British Proof) to deliver maximum flavor impact. They succeeded. Notably balanced and elegant, the colorful palette of whiskies combines for the tremendous depth of flavor. Soft, sweet butterscotch and orange peel meet poached pears and stone fruits. Earthiness appears as dried autumn leaves, coffee, old oak, and tobacco. Among the tangle of spices, tasters identified chili pepper, allspice, cloves, and universally adored its ginger note. Finally, wisps of smoke and sea salt. Overall, it feels generously malty, with the grain whisky lending broad sweetness and supple mouthfeel across the long finish. Beyond its delightful flavors, Nikka From the Barrel presents some paradoxes worthy of contemplation over a glass. It is a classic, yet new to the U.S. It is typically Japanese, yet singularly magnificent. It is delightful sipped neat and also blossoms with water. Even the simple, squat bottle is in contrast to the profound complexity within. (Fortunately, the 500 ml bottle offered in other markets received a supersizing for U.S. drinkers.) The great majority of new Japanese whiskies now arriving to our shores are so rare and so expensive that they seem intended only for elite whisky lovers. Nikka From the Barrel is a consummate Japanese blend for anyone to enjoy.

TITLE: Nikka Miyagikyo 12 Years Old Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Full-bodied, fruity and complex, with some sherry character, hints of toffee and some polished malt. Deservedly popular.

TITLE: Nikka Miyagikyo Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This is a single malt from the Miyagikyo distillery, Nikka’s second distillery built in 1969. The founder Masataka Taketsuru chose this site in the mountains of Sendai to contrast with his first distillery, Yoichi, located in the coastal area. Using less peaty malt and distilled in a pot still heated by indirect steam, Miyagikyo single malt has an elegant fruitiness and a distinctive aroma with a strong Sherry cask influence.

TITLE: Nikka Non-Peated Bottled in 2021 Yoichi Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Nikka Whisky introduced its first set of releases from the “Nikka Discovery” series in the U.S. in fall 2021: Single Malt Yoichi Non-Peated and Single Malt Miyagikyo Peated. The “Nikka Discovery” series will develop distinctive limited editions over the next three years in anticipation of Nikka Whisky’s 90th Anniversary in 2024. Each year will focus on a different component of the whisky-making process that Nikka has practiced since 1934, offering an inside look at the various experiments within Nikka’s two distilleries. Designed to overturn the preconceived images of each single malt, these rare versions of Yoichi and Miyagikyo single malts are the first look showcase of “Nikka Discovery” and highlight the distillery’s diverse ingredients. Single Malt Yoichi Non-Peated (47% ABV) is comprised solely of unpeated malts as opposed to the preconceived “peaty” image of Yoichi.

TITLE: Nikka Peated Bottle in 2021 Miyagikyo Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 94, #13 on the Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 ListThe conventional understanding of Nikka’s two distilleries is that Yoichi whiskies are smoky while Miyagikyo expressions are light and fruity. Here Nikka disrupts that thinking in a marriage of peat smoke with all that Miyagikyo has to offer. The nose starts with lemon, apricot, and poached pear as the smoke gently emerges. The palate offers vanilla, caramel, and a layered subtle peat smoke that is positively ethereal. There is lots more to explore: If Nikka hoped to break the mold and venture into new spaces, it has succeeded admirably with this masterpiece. Single Malt Miyagikyo Peated (48% ABV) is crafted solely from batches of peated malts, which distinguishes it significantly from the “light and fruity" image of Miyagikyo.

TITLE: Nikka Samurai Gold & Gold Blended Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The special edition (Japanese Duty-Free exclusive) with removable samurai armor and helmet on the top of the bottle. This version is called “Shirobin” (White Bottle), though the label is all black. The design of the label is as it was back in the 1970s when Nikka first launched its Gold & Gold expression. Please note that the top part is made out of plastic, not metal. The producer has switched to a plastic top packaging a couple of years ago. This bottle doesn’t leave you indifferent. Love it or hate it, the Japanese always have something new and different up their kimono sleeve.

TITLE: Nikka Taketsuru 12 Year old Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Made from the blending of the two distilleries of Yoichi and Miyagikyo, this whisky was the pride of its creator Mastaka Taketsuru, founder of Nikka and father of Japanese whisky. This product has been discontinued and we have very limited supply of inventory left.

TITLE: Nikka Taketsuru 17 Years Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
Nikka Taketsuru 21Years  Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
Nikka Taketsuru Black Label Pure Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The originality of this 100% malt expression lies in its unique distillation method. Malted barley is distilled in a Coffey still, a traditional still which is normally used to produce grain whisky.

TITLE: Nikka Taketsuru White Label Pure Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Nikka’s signature bottling honors founder Masataka Taketsuru, who brought his whisky-making skills back from Scotland to Japan in 1920. Taketsuru’s successors have reformulated this blended malt, which fully complies with the latest definitions of Japanese whisky. The aromas create an oasis of calm with layers of gentle wood spices, smoke, vanilla pod, and lemon biscuits, while the palate carries a distinctive waxy sappiness that revels in luscious flavors of star fruit, lemon, Asian pear, peach syrup, and aromatic spice.

TITLE: Nikka Yoichi Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This is a single malt from the Yoichi distillery, Nikka’s first distillery built in 1934. The founder Masataka Taketsuru chose Yoichi in Hokkaido because of the similar environmental conditions to Scotland, where he learned whisky making.

TITLE: Nino Costa Langhe Nebbiolo
DESCRIPTION: Founded by the Costa family in 1851, this 7-hectare estate lies on a hilltop overlooking the village of Montá, to the west of the Tanaro River. This is the heart of the Roero, characterized by small, interweaving hills, yellow-ochre sandy soils full of marine fossils, and densely wooded areas dotted with vineyards. Winemaker Alessandro Costa cultivates the primary varieties of the Roero and the Langhe: Arneis, Nebbiolo, Favorita and Brachetto; parents Nino and Gemma run the azienda. Goes great with any pork or eggplant dish as well as most hard cheeses.

TITLE: Nino Negri Quadrio Valtellina Superiore
DESCRIPTION: With a dark garnet-red color, the wine shows distinctive, fine aromas of small fruits, raspberry preserves, roses and violets, with an herbal note. In the mouth, the wine has full, lively tart fruit flavors, elegant tannins and a lingering aftertaste, with traces of prunes and toasty oak.

TITLE: Nishi Shuzo Tenshi No Yuwaku Imo Shochu
DESCRIPTION: An Imo Shochu aged in Sherry Barrels and made with premium sweet potatoes and white koji. The name Tenshi no Yuwaku (Angel's Temptation) is a reference to the "Angel's Share" (the quantity of barrel stored wine or whisky that evaporates during aging, which is said to be taken by Angels). Chocolate, Fruits, Dried Fruits

TITLE: Nittnaus Manila "Rot" Blaufrankisch
DESCRIPTION: Anita and Hans are the owners of a winery at the Neusiedlersee in Burgenland, which is Austria’s center of red and sweet wines. They produce wines which are affected by terroir – authentic and full of character in opposition to oak and high alcohol styles, and they’ve embraced biodynamic agriculture in their vineyards since 2007. Their sons Andreas and Martin are gradually converting parts of the cellar to non-additive, natural wines, which represent 15% of the winery’s production.

TITLE: Nittnaus Manila "Weiss" Gruner Veltliner
DESCRIPTION: The grapes come from the Strassacker vineyard in the town of Jois which sits on the limestone rich Leithaberg mountain range. The grapes were destemmed and without being crushed, fermented in tank for 13 days. After fermentation the grapes were pressed and aged in three small barrels for 10 months. The wine was bottled without filtration or any added sulphur. Only 1, 200 bottles of this wine was made

TITLE: Noah's Mill Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Noah's Mill Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey is a distinguished spirit hailing from the historic Willett Distillery in Kentucky. Known for its robust character and complex flavor profile, this bourbon is bottled at a bold 114.3 proof, making it a favorite among connoisseurs. Despite its strength, Noah's Mill offers a remarkably smooth and balanced experience, with a rich tapestry of flavors that speaks to the art of small-batch bourbon making. Whether sipped neat or with a splash of water, this bourbon delivers a memorable drinking experience that embodies the essence of Kentucky whiskey tradition.

TITLE: Nobilo Regional Collection Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Classic Marlborough sauvignon blanc at its best. Check out the tasting notes below for more. The flavors of New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc - and this is why it is so much loved - are powerful and aromatic: citrus, gooseberry and passionfruit in spades. So you need big flavors on your plate to stand up to it. Here are top suggestions: Asian-style seafood dishes - oysters, scallops, crab, clams, lobster, prawns - any shellfish with zingy flavors or a citrus or garlic marinade or dressing. Thai food generally. A Thai green chicken curry or a Thai-style chicken salad is ace. Grilled fish especially squid or swordfish. Dishes with herbs and greens - salmon with dill, for instance, but great with recipes that contain basil, coriander, rocket and especially mint. Like lamb with salsa verde. Salads with goats cheese and feta, asparagus, avocado or grilled red peppers, fresh tomato salads or salads with fennel, mango or papaya. Dishes that don't work so well are ones with creamy sauces or cooked tomato or, more obviously, meaty dishes with gravy or dark savory sauces

TITLE: Noble Tree Wickersham Ranch Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: A beautiful, classic cool-climate, mountain-grown 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. This wine sourced entirely from our Wickersham Ranch Estate located at 2,200 feet elevation in Sonoma County.

TITLE: Nolet's Dry Gin Silver
DESCRIPTION: Eleventh generation sons, Carl Jr. and Bob Nolet, collaborated with their father Carolus Sr. to create NOLET’S Silver. NOLET’S Silver is an undeniably modern take on gin, reflecting the tastes and preferences of a new generation.

TITLE: Nomad Outland Whisky
DESCRIPTION: NOMAD is one of the most innovative whiskies currently on the market. The majority of malt whiskies are finished in sherry casks that have been sent to Scotland from Jerez. NOMAD is the first whisky in the world to be finished in the Gonzalez Byass cellars in Jerez de la Frontera, following a prior ageing in Scotland, breaking the unwritten rules of whisky. NOMAD, the first OUTLAND WHISKY on the market. A premium blended whisky produced from a unique selection of over 30 different malt and grain whiskies from Speyside, The Higlands, Scotland, each 5 to 8 years old. The resulting blend is left to mature in Scotland in sherry casks for 3 years, altogether, before being transferred to Jerez where it will be finished for a minimum of 12 months in old Pedro Ximenez casks in the San Fernando cellar of Gonzalez Byass. This double ageing, firstly in Scotland then in Jerez is unique, and makes NOMAD OUTLAND WHISKY a true rarity.

TITLE: Nortico Dry Rose Vinho Regional Minho
DESCRIPTION: Nortico Rosé is produced on the south bank of the Minho River in plots so small they are called jardins, or gardens. Soils here are granite and schist, and, though it sees a lot of rainfall (up to 2,000mm, annually) the inland area is warmer than the coast, allowing for perfect maturation and balance in the fruit. Historically, this area has been best known for reds, producing light aromatic reds locally called Palhete. This rosé evokes that style. Shellfish, seafood, and simple cheese dishes.

TITLE: Nortico Vinho Regional Minho Alvarinho
DESCRIPTION: One of the all time best summer whites is Vinho Verde from Portugal. Would pair well with grilled chicken or other lighter meats. It would also be sensational with a quiche or crab cakes as the acidity would balance out the richness of those dishes.

TITLE: Novecento Malbec
Novo Fogo Barrel Age Cachaca
DESCRIPTION: Novo Fogo, located in Morretes, Brazil is a producer of USDA certified organic cachaca distilled on the edge of an idyllic rainforest in a zero waste distillery and bottled in handmade bottles made of recycled glass. Pot distilled and aged in small, second-use American oak bourbon for a minimum of 24 months.

TITLE: NULU 5 Year Old Bourbon Whiskey Maple Barrel Finish
DESCRIPTION: Cask strength 5 yr old MGP distillate. Char level 4. Mashbill of 75% Corn, 21% rye, and 4% malted barley.

TITLE: NULU 5 Year Old Double Oaked Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: NULU Double Oaked Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey is a premium offering from Prohibition Craft Spirits. This 5.5-year-old bourbon has been double oaked, meaning it undergoes a second aging process in new toasted oak barrels, enhancing its complexity and depth of flavor. Bottled at a robust 113.2 proof, this high-rye bourbon (21% rye) offers a rich and balanced profile.

TITLE: NULU 5 Year Old Single Barrel Rye Whiskey Aged In Apple Brandy Barrels
DESCRIPTION: This 5-year-old MGP rye spent the last 9 months in a Copper & Kings Apple Brandy barrel. The apple notes really compliment the rye spice. 118 Proof. Mashbill is 95% Rye, 5% malted barley

TITLE: NULU 5 Year Old Toasted Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Nulu Rye Private Barrel is a 5-year old single barrel pick made by our local distributors. Bottled at barrel strength. Sourced MGP Rye (95% rye, most likely) The nose provides ripe berries and pencil shaving while to palate delivers dried fruit, nougat, and white chocolate. The finish has rich notes of sugar (confectionary, warm spice, and everything nice! complex judging from the first pour. However, this spirit seems like it will open nicely with oxidation.

TITLE: NULU 5 Years Sigle Barrel Bourbon Whiskey Peach Brandy Finish
DESCRIPTION: Proof: 116% Barrel: B23P Finish Duration: 10 months

TITLE: NULU 5 Years Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: NULU Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey from Prohibition Craft Spirits is 5-year old MGP distillate. After aging, this non-chill filtered bourbon is bottled at 120 proof. The barrel was picked by the distillery for distribution in NY.

TITLE: NULU 5.5 Years Old Toasted Single Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: NULU 5.5 Years Old Toasted Single Barrel Rye Whiskey is an exceptional offering from Prohibition Craft Spirits. This rye whiskey is aged for 5.5 years and finished in toasted oak barrels, enhancing its rich and complex flavor profile. This single barrel release is bottled at a robust 115 proof, ensuring a bold and intense tasting experience.

TITLE: NULU 6 Year Old Bourbon Whiskey Honey Barrel Finish
DESCRIPTION: NULU 6-Year-Old Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey Honey Barrel Finish is an exquisite expression from Prohibition Craft Spirits. This limited edition bourbon is aged for 6 years and then finished in honey barrels, previously held local honey for several months. This finishing process imparts the bourbon's unique sweetness and complexity, enhancing its overall character. MASHBILL: 60% Corn, 36% Rye, 4% Malted Barley

TITLE: NULU 6 Year Old Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey Aged In Apple Brandy Barrels
DESCRIPTION: This 5-year-old MGP bourbon spent the last 10 months in a Copper & Kings Apple Brandy barrel. It is sweet, rich, and balanced. 120 Proof. Mashbill is 75% Corn, 21% Rye, 4% barley

TITLE: NULU 6 Year Old Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey Aged In Sherry Oloroso Apple Brandy Barrels
DESCRIPTION: A new expression from NULU's Experimental Series. It's a 6-year-old MGP bourbon finished in Sherry Oloroso Apple Brandy barrels from Coopers & King. The Sherry offers brown sugar, dark fruit, and nutty flavors balanced by the bright apple notes from the brandy.

TITLE: NULU 7 Year Old Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: 7-year-old MGP bourbon picked by the head distiller (distillery pick). 124.2 Proof.

TITLE: NULU 7 Year Old Toasted Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Nulu Rye Private Barrel is a 7-year old single barrel pick made by the distillery. Bottled at barrel strength. Sourced MGP Rye with a mashbill of 95% Rye, 5% Malted Barley. Notes of cocoa, brown sugar, pepper and rye spice.

TITLE: NULU 8 Years Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: NULU 8 Years Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a distinguished and carefully crafted bourbon from Prohibition Craft Spirits. This bourbon started as a 6-year-old Kentucky straight bourbon barrel, which then spent an additional two years aging in College Station, Texas, before being returned to Kentucky for final bottling. This unique aging process enhances the complexity and depth of its flavor profile.

TITLE: NULU 9 Year Old "Magic Barrel" Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon The Prime Barrel Pick #92
DESCRIPTION: Every visit to NuLu offers a thrilling mystery of what whiskey might be waiting in the rickhouse. Will it be a superb aged bourbon straight from its original cask, or something uniquely finished? Recently, a group of veteran Prime Barrel members, along with one of our newest members, had the pleasure of exploring with Chase Hazelbaker from NuLu. He guided us through the barrel storage area, where we sampled several exciting upcoming releases at various stages of aging or finishing. The highlight of our visit was at the tasting bar, where Chase had prepared four barrels of nearly 9 1/2-year-old high rye bourbon for our selection. These sister barrels, distilled on the same day from a mashbill of 60% corn, 36% rye, and 4% malted barley, showcased their familial traits and distinct individualities. After a lively discussion, we unanimously chose barrel 4 as our standout—no surprise, as it was also the highest proof at 134.2, truly the belle of the ball. This special barrel encapsulated the unique character and spirit of our tasting experience, making it a memorable addition to our collection. Tasting Notes: Nose: Classic bourbon, vanilla, toasted coconut Palate: Rich mouthfeel, maple syrup, cola, mounds bar Finish: Long, dark maple syrup, cinnamon on the tip of the tongue, natural maple syrup from a sugar house, and the slightest hint of oak at the tail end. Proof 134.2

TITLE: NULU 9 Years Single Barrel High Malt Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: NULU 9 Years Single Barrel High Malt Bourbon Whiskey is a distinctive and limited edition release showcasing Prohibition Craft Spirits' meticulous craftsmanship. This bourbon began its journey as a 7-year-old straight bourbon barrel, aged in College Station, Texas, for two years before being returned to Kentucky for bottling. This aging process in varied climates contributes to its rich and complex flavor profile. Mashbill: 51% Corn / 49% Malted Barley

TITLE: Nulu Cask Strength Uncut Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: NULU Cask Strength Uncut Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a premium offering from Prohibition Craft Spirits, known for its bold and robust flavor profile. This uncut and non-chill filtered bourbon is a blend of 20 barrels: 14 Columbian Oak Barrels (2015, 21% Rye) 3 Speyside Short Barrels(2017, 21% Rye) 1 Kelvin Barrel (2015, 21% Rye) 1 Speyside Barrel (2016, 21% Rye) 1 ISC Barrel (2016, 21% Rye)

TITLE: NULU Double Oaked "Double Oaked Seven" Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #32
DESCRIPTION: Looking back to our first #singlebarrelexpedition in KY, this is where it all began. Prohibition Craft Distillery was the first one on our trip where things went from virtual to in-real-life. It was a place of our first in-person interaction with members of our club, and it kicked off an excellent (and fruitful) trip, as well as a great tradition of involving our members in our in-person barrel picks. We've tasted through a litany of barrels and selected the 5.5 Double Oaked high-rye (36%) bourbon expression. The C209 barrel we chose was the best-tasting one with a great nose, very balanced and rich palate, and a true "Kentucky Hug"-type finish.Here's what you can look forward to with this bottle: Nose: Toasted oak, tanning hide, cigar paper, vanilla, cherry pie, apple strudel, graham cracker Palate: Toast, banana foster, hazelnut, cinnamon Finish: All-spice and green peppercorn As usual, parts of the proceeds from every barrel we select go to support charities our Discord community suggested. This barrel will help the MS Society, also known as the National Multiple Sclerosis Society. By contributing, our club will empower those affected by MS to live their best lives while, as a society, we seek to cure this disease.

TITLE: NULU Double Oaked Single Barrel Wheated Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: 118.4 proof Barrel #W8 51%. Wheat: 45%. Barley Malt: 4%

TITLE: NULU Experimental Series 6 Year Old Rye Whiskey Finished in Honey Barrels
DESCRIPTION: NULU Experimental Series 6-Year-Old Rye Whiskey Finished in Honey Barrels is a unique and limited edition release from Prohibition Craft Spirits. This rye whiskey is aged for six years before being finished in honey barrels for a couple more months, adding a layer of sweetness and complexity to the rich rye character. This expression is part of NULU's Experimental Finish Series, showcasing innovative finishing techniques.

TITLE: NULU Experimental Series Bourbon Whiskey Finished in French Oak Barrels
DESCRIPTION: NULU Experimental Series Bourbon Whiskey Finished in French Oak Barrels is a bold and innovative expression from Prohibition Craft Spirits. This bourbon undergoes an extended aging process in new American oak barrels before being finished with French oak staves of varying toast levels. This unique finishing process enhances the bourbon’s complexity, imparting rich and diverse flavor notes.

TITLE: NULU Experimental Series Tawny Port Barrel Finish
DESCRIPTION: Nulu Experimental Bourbon Finished in Tawny Port Barrels is the latest craft bourbon innovation. Aged 5 years, with a mashbill of 60% Corn / 36 % Rye / 4% Malted barley Nulu Tawny Port Brandy Barrel Finished Bourbon is aged for 6 months in Tawny Port casks, which imparts toasted wood, spice, and tropical fruit flavors. The full-bodied texture is supported by caramel and sweetness from the corn. The alternative aging process finishes out with a long warming glow.

TITLE: NULU Experimental Series Toasted Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Maple Barrels
DESCRIPTION: 118 proof Barrel #360 Finished for 8 months

TITLE: Nulu Reserve Bourbon Whiskey Batch #9
DESCRIPTION: Nulu Reserve Bourbon Whiskey Batch #9 is a meticulously crafted bourbon from Prohibition Craft Spirits. This small-batch bourbon is a blend of 4-6-year-old bourbon sourced from MGP, known for its balanced and robust flavor profile. Non-chill filtered, this bourbon retains all the rich and nuanced flavors that bourbon enthusiasts seek.

TITLE: NULU Toasted 5 Year Old Barrel Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: NULU Toasted 5 Year Old Barrel Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a premium offering from Prohibition Craft Spirits. This bourbon is distilled by MGP and aged for five years before being finished in freshly toasted barrels for an additional 1 to 4 weeks. The finishing process adds layers of complexity and depth to the bourbon’s profile, resulting in a rich and satisfying flavor experience. Bottled at 114 proof and non-chill filtered, this single barrel bourbon is robust and full-bodied.

TITLE: NULU Toasted 5 Years Wheated Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
NULU Toasted 6 Year Old Barrel Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: NULU Toasted Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey from Prohibition Craft Spirits is 6-year old MGP distillate. Finished 1-4 weeks in the toasted barrel. The mash bill is 5% Corn, 21% Rye, and 4% Malted barley. After aging, this non-chill filtered bourbon is bottled at 122.3 proof.

TITLE: NULU Toasted French Oak Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: NULU Toasted French Oak Staves Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey is an exquisite small batch bourbon produced by Prohibition Craft Spirits. This bourbon is initially aged in new charred American oak barrels before being finished with toasted French oak staves, a process that adds layers of complexity and rich flavors. This small batch release typically includes bourbon aged between 4 and 6 years and is bottled at a robust 108 proof

TITLE: NULU Toasted Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: NULU Toasted Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey is a distinctive offering from Prohibition Craft Spirits, known for its robust flavor and meticulous craftsmanship. This bourbon undergoes an initial aging process in virgin oak barrels for 4 to 6 years before being finished in toasted barrels for 1 to 4 weeks. Bottled unfiltered at a cask strength of 118 proof, this small-batch bourbon delivers a rich and complex tasting experience.

TITLE: NULU Triple Oaked Jaqueira Barrel Finished Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #110
DESCRIPTION: Discover the extraordinary NULU Double Oaked "Jaqueira Barrel Finished" Straight Bourbon Whiskey, a unique expression that elevates your whiskey experience. When The Prime Barrel team embarked on a barrel-picking expedition, our goal was simple: seeking the best whiskey. During our visit to NULU Distillery in Kentucky, we initially set out to select a 10-year-old bourbon. However, we were captivated by three aging barrels showcasing a striking yellow hue—an unusual sight that piqued our curiosity. These barrels were crafted from Jaqueira wood, also known as jackfruit, a tropical wood renowned for its rich flavor characteristics. This high-rye bourbon underwent a meticulous aging process, starting with 4 years and 7 months in its original barrel. It was then transferred to a Char 5 oak barrel for 10 months before entering the medium-toasted Jaqueira barrel from a Brazilian cooperage. NULU initially planned to label this expression as "Triple Oaked." However, due to issues with TTB approval for the "Triple Oaked" denomination, they opted for the previously approved "Double Oak" label. This choice does not diminish the fact that this bourbon is indeed a triple-oaked expression, showcasing a complex flavor profile. After sampling this exceptional bourbon, we were instantly drawn to its complex flavor profile. Each Jaqueira finished barrel provided a unique tasting experience, with the char 5 barrel contributing richness and the Jaqueira influence, creating a delightful and vibrant palate sensation. As the first group to select a Jaquiera finished barrel from NuLu, The Prime Barrel proudly presents this innovative bourbon, which showcases the meticulous finishing methods that set it apart from traditional expressions. Tasting Notes: Nose: The initial aroma bursts with tropical fruit, especially jackfruit, followed by bright citrus notes like grapefruit. A warm pie spice blend of cinnamon and nutmeg rounds it out, with just a subtle hint of cedar lingering in the background. Palate: A lively, sweet introduction of juicy fruit greets the palate, quickly overlaid by a complex mix of spice cabinet flavors led by cinnamon. The rich sweetness of thick maple syrup and a faint touch of barrel char add depth, creating a well-rounded and layered taste. Finish: The finish is prickly and vibrant, with citrus again taking center stage. Brown sugar sweetness emerges, with a final hint of smoky barrel char, leaving a lasting, intriguing impression of this unique Double Oak Bourbon. TITLE: O'Dwyers Creek Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: O'Dwyers Creek Vineyard is situated in the wine growing region of Rapaura, Marlborough. This area is recognised as one of the premium wine regions of the world and is New Zealand's leading wine region. Awards, 2013 Vintage: Pure Gold Medal - 2014 Air New Zealand Wine Awards Pure Silver Medal - 2013 Air New Zealand Wine Awards Silver Medal - 2014 Easter Show Wine Awards Bronze Medal - 2014 Decanter World Wine Awards The flavors of New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc - and this is why it is so popular - are powerful and aromatic: citrus, gooseberry and passionfruit in spades. So you need big flavors on your plate to stand up to it. Here are the top suggestions: Asian-style seafood dishes - oysters, scallops, crab, clams, lobster, prawns - any shellfish with zingy flavors or a citrus or garlic marinade or dressing. (Big fat garlicky prawns - mmmm). Thai food generally. A Thai green chicken curry or a Thai-style chicken salad is ace. Grilled fish especially squid or swordfish. Dishes with herbs and greens - salmon with dill, for instance, but great with recipes that contain basil, coriander, rocket and especially mint. Like lamb with salsa verde. Salads with goats cheese and feta, asparagus, avocado or grilled red peppers, fresh tomato salads or salads with fennel, mango or papaya.

DESCRIPTION: New Riff Distilling opened in the spring of 2014 in Newport, Kentucky, just on the other side of the river from Cincinnati. The distillery is owned by Ken Lewis, former owner of The Party Source, a very popular and huge northern Kentucky liquor store. Like many new distilleries, to begin releasing product while their own young whiskey ages they have sourced from Midwest Grain Products (MGP) for their O.K.I. brand. As the label states, O.K.I. is “distilled in Indiana, bottled in Kentucky, and enjoyed in Ohio.” In 2018, the distillery finally deemed their own line of whiskeys of age and discontinued the O.K.I. brand.

TITLE: Oak & Eden Anthro Series Forrie Smith
DESCRIPTION: Oak & Eden Whiskey is redefining what it means to be unique in your own way with its new Anthro Series, a lineup of whiskeys crafted in collaboration with some of the country’s most notable personalities. Its lAnthro Series expression is a 116-proof bourbon whiskey finished with an American Oak spiral soaked in cold brew coffee. This special edition was produced in partnership with Forrie J. Smith, better known as Lloyd Pierce from Paramount Network’s hit TV series Yellowstone.The Anthro Series lineup is made possible by Oak & Eden’s patented process of In-Bottle Finishing, where the brand places a spiral-cut piece of oak (called a spire) into every bottle of fully aged whiskey, introducing new flavor profiles and characteristics that didn’t exist in the original aging barrel. The brands can then infuse the spire with another beverage, such as wine, rum, beer, liqueur, etc., giving the ability to customize each bottle of whiskey at a much greater level.116 Proof.

TITLE: OAX Original Tobala
OAX Orignal Arroqueno Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: OAX Original® is a collaborative artistic endeavor presenting the distinctive flavors and raw beauty of wild agave through three limited-edition expressions: Arroqueño, Tobalá, and Tepeztate. Maestro Mezcalero Enrique Hernandez Zenea crafted these unique small-batch mezcals from agave plants found in the semi-arid Central Valleys of Oaxaca. The agaves average 12 to 25 years to reach maturity. Once foraged, the hearts of the agaves are slow-cooked in the ground with oak and mesquite, stone-ground by horse, then wild yeast fermented in pine barrels before being double distilled. OAX is a multi-sensorial experience, where the bottle embodies the mezcal in touch and sight—from its raw texture recalling dirt, bricks, and adobe, to the pure volumes that define its form, size, and surfaces, as well as their interaction with light and shadows.

TITLE: Oban 14 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A bustling seaside resort has grown up around the distillery in the two centuries since it was first built in the fishing town of Oban. The West Highland malt is still produced in the same unhurried, traditional fashion and this 14 year old is a classic dram from the distillery.

TITLE: Oban 18 Years Limited Edition Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A nostalgic golden dusty aroma seduces the drinker into deep poached pear and clover honey territory with a hint of toasted walnut. As the liquid develops in the mouth, a seabreeze quality lifts the dense nectar and finishes off the experience with a slight minerality.

TITLE: Oban 1996 Prima & Ultima 26 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Oban 1996 Prima & Ultima 26 Years Old is a distinguished single malt that showcases the unique character of Oban, a distillery known for its rare and exceptional whiskies. This particular expression is aged for 26 years in refill European Oak Butts, offering a distinctively dry maritime slant to both its aroma and taste. The release is limited to 428 bottles, making it a coveted item for collectors and connoisseurs alike. The Oban 1996 Prima & Ultima is a superb example of the distillery's craftsmanship, delivering a rich and nuanced character that speaks to its storied heritage.

TITLE: Oban 21 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky

This 21-year-old cask strength whisky was matured in refill European-oak butts, giving the fruity whisky a jacket of rich sherry cask character. Only 2,860 bottles of this whisky, which was matured for 21 years and bottled at cask strength, have ever been produced.

TITLE: Oban Aged 11 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky Special Release 2023
DESCRIPTION: Oban Aged 11 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky Special Release 2023 is a vibrant and flavorful whisky that is sure to impress. It is finished in Caribbean pot still rum casks, which gives it a unique and complex profile. The whisky is full-bodied with a rich midpalate, coating mouthfeel, and long finish.

TITLE: Oban Distillers Edition Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky 2022
Oban Little Bay Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Oban 14-Year-Old hails from the westernmost mainland town in the Scottish Highlands, giving it a smooth character infused with the bold, maritime flavors of the Islands. Fine single malt whisky has been made at Oban for more than 200 years, in one of the oldest licensed distilleries in Scotland. Oban is made using only the finest barley, malted to the distillery's own particular specification. The Oban 14-YearOld is still produced in the same unhurried, traditional fashion as when the distillery was founded.

TITLE: Obtainium 15 Years "Fire Away" Single Barrel Light Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #69
DESCRIPTION: Product Description: Introducing our second Cat's Eye Obtainium 15 Years Single Barrel Light Whiskey selection, an exemplar of meticulous curation and craftsmanship. This unique expression tells a story of both tradition and innovation. Originating from Cat’s Eye Distillery, a renowned craft distillery out of Iowa, this whiskey exemplifies their "Obtainium" moniker, symbolizing their pursuit to obtain and bottle superior whiskies from around the globe. Their vast array of sourced spirits spans continents, encapsulating the essence of the US, Europe, Canada, and The Caribbean. Bit Of History: Steeped in history, the Light Whiskey category was birthed during the 60s and 70s, a challenging era for traditional American whiskies. Created in 1968, the category's unique distillation and maturation process distinguishes it from its Bourbon counterpart, employing used casks for aging and a distinct proof range during distillation. Tasting Notes: Upon the first whiff, indulge in abundant notes of rich vanilla, painting an image of creaminess. Transitioning to the palate, the experience is nothing short of dynamism. Envision a strawberry cookie amplified, inundated with luscious icing. The experience crescendos with an explosion of flavors, leading to a prolonged finish dominated by hints of delectable butterscotch. Barrel Info: Barrel # SC-00459 Proof - 137.4 Proof

TITLE: Obtainium 15 Years Single Barrel Light Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #50
DESCRIPTION: OBTAINIUM Light Whiskey came into existence in 1968 because consumers were moving away from Bourbon and into clear spirits such as vodka or gin. Light whiskey is distilled between160-190 proof. Contrast that with Bourbon or American Rye which tops out at 160 proof. It must be aged in used, charred oak barrels or new, uncharred oak. Most distilleries didn’t let it age very long. Sourced from MGP in Indiana, Light whiskey fell out of favor, and stocks were left hanging around, mostly ignored and forgotten - until now!Nose: shaved coconut, toasted almonds, vanilla, citrus, all-spicePalate: cherry pie, dried apricot, green apple, tangerine, maple syrup, dark chocolateFinish: long finish with notes of all-spice and cinnamon

TITLE: Oddero Barbera d'Alba Superiore
DESCRIPTION: Sourced from two vineyards: one in Castiglione Falletto -south-facing at 250 m in elevation and one in La Morra -southwest-facing at 280m. Hand-harvested towards the end of September from 50 year old vines in Castiglione Falletto and from 40 year old vines in La Morra. Fermentation and maceration lasting 15 days in stainless steel. 40% of the wine is aged in 50HL oak casks and 60% of the wine is aged in neutral 225L barrels. The wine is assembled in spring and then bottled in the summer. Approximately 10,000 bottles produced.

TITLE: Oddero Barolo
Ohishi Brandy Cask Japanese Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Ohishi distillery is located on the banks of the Kuma River, one Japan's fastest flowing rivers. The distillery was founded in 1872 and produces some of the most exciting whisky coming out of Japan. Ohishi grows at least 30% of the rice that they distill, and the fertile soils and exceptional growing climate make for some of the finest base ingredients available. The strain of rice is called "gohyakumanishi" (meaning "five million stones"), and an organic method of cultivation is utilized that requires the use of koi carp for weed control. The rest of the grain is procured from local farms in Kumamoto prefecture and is of the short grained Mochi variety. The grains are partially malted and then distilled on the traditional Japanese stills before being filled into ex-sherry and brandy casks and aged for a long time time in high-altitude warehouses.

TITLE: Ohishi Distillery 11 Year Old Mizunara Cask Finish Whisky
DESCRIPTION: All Ohishi whiskies are first matured in either sherry or ex-brandy casks before being bottled or going into their finishing casks. Because rice whisky is so elegant and soft, it has the ability to take on characteristics of the cask type very quickly. No whisky is released before it is ready as determined by Kazunori Oishi. Ohishi 11 year mizunara cask finish whisky was aged in ex-brandy barrels for 8 years and then finished in fresh mizunara casks for 3 years.

TITLE: Ohishi Sherry Cask Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Ohishi distillery is located on the banks of the Kuma River, one Japan's fastest flowing rivers. This cask brings in a great balanced sherry influence and definitely feels more like Scotch than our single cask from the Fukano Distillery.

TITLE: Ohishi Tokubetsu Reserve Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Ohishi Tokubetsu Reserve is the first ultra-premium release from Ohishi and it is, in a word, awesome. The Tokubetsu Reserve is a blend of first-fill sherry casks that encompass nearly three different decades of distillation. 29% of the whisky comes from 27-year-old casks, 35% comes from 10-year-old casks and 36% comes from 7-year-old casks. This is the first time anything has been released from Ohishi that has any age details on it at all. That’s neither a good thing nor a bad thing because sherried Ohishi always delivers, it’s just something worth pointing out. nextsectionTakes all the flavors of its Sherry Cask and magnifies them. Everything is richer and rounder in this one, with notes of marzipan, almonds, butterscotch, and toffee. The lightness of the spirit showcases the contribution of the sherry casks, which particularly in the 27 year-old component of the blend have had plenty of time to work their magic

TITLE: Ohmine Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: A pure scent and sweetness like puffed grains characterize "Ohmine Junmai", which was brewed in each step by the brewery's manual labor. Since it tastes so refreshing, you won't realize that it is only made from rice, and it is an excellent sake for cocktails.

TITLE: Oka Brewery Yuki no Tenshi Snow Angel Nigori Sake Cup
DESCRIPTION: A delicate, silky, unfiltered nigori sake. Off dry with a touch of sweetness but balanced at 12.5% ABV. Rich and delicious, this pairs well with big flavors: spicy foods, BBQ, curries and even ice cream.

This small batch blend has notes of crackling creme brûlée, root beer and red hots, candied bacon, a smack of leather, a whiff of tobacco and then toasted hazelnuts at the very end.

Owners Mark and Sherri Carter created the Bourbon blend from a selection of their favorite barrels. Sherri prefers aromatic and complex flavors, while Mark demands a powerful pour. The pair feels that this expression combines the best of both worlds. Coming in at 108.9 proof and 54.45% ABV, the Carters encourage bourbon lovers to drink it any way one prefers – neat, on a big rock, or even with a mixer.

DESCRIPTION: Old Carter Straight Rye Whiskey Small Batch #12 is a marvel of whiskey craftsmanship from the heart of Kentucky. This exquisite expression comes from the renowned Old Carter Whiskey Co., known for creating unique, very small-batch, straight rye and bourbon whiskies with a heartfelt approach. The Small Batch #12 is no exception; it's a heavily double-oaked delight distilled in Indiana, embodying a rich blend of 13 barrels, 11 of which were double oak matured, delivering a robust and full-bodied profile with every sip​. With a limited release of 3,210 bottles, this barrel-strength whiskey, standing at a 116 proof, is a testament to Old Carter's dedication to quality and character in each bottle. It's a non-age-stated treasure, but it's known to be aged a minimum of 7 years, ensuring a mature, well-rounded taste that's bound to captivate the senses of any rye whiskey enthusiast​.

DESCRIPTION: Old Carter Very Small Batch Barrel Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a splendid exemplification of craft and character. Bottled at barrel strength without chill filtration, each expression is a transparent portrayal of its essence, bringing you closer to the spirit of whiskey​1​.
