TITLE: Old Charter Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This NAS 80 proof whiskey has a certain balance to it that’s hard to beat (for the price?). This is NOT the same Old Charter that existed pre-2014 - Buffalo Trace has made this whiskey with a 'new' recipe. With a light body and mild flavors, this bourbon is easily enjoyed neat, on the rocks or in your favorite cocktail. An all-around solid whiskey that any bourbon drinker can appreciate. Nose: A ton of ethanol even at 80 proof; light notes of cedar, dark fruit and citrus; crème brûlée burnt sugar Palate: Watery; brown sugar sweetness that promptly leaves; an odd wet cardboard flavor. Finish: Nearly none, but what is there is very light and slightly bittersweet; an odd lingering mouthfeel that’s almost waxy.

TITLE: Old Charter Oak Canadian Oak Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: For ten years, this bourbon aged and matured in Canadian Oak barrels at Buffalo Trace Distillery. The long, cold winters and mild summers of Canada’s northern climate make Canadian Oak uniquely suited to crafting exceptional bourbon. This distinctive environment leads to a tighter-grained wood that releases more of its signature oak aromatics while allowing the spirit to be aged longer in the barrel. The finished spirit features a nose of caramel and berries, a palate of vanilla and maple syrup, and a long finish with hints of oak, chocolate and pepper. Raise a glass to the storied forests of our northern neighbors and enjoy this spirit’s journey from acorn to oak to barrel to bourbon.

TITLE: Old Charter Oak Chinkapin Oak Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This bourbon earned much of its character while aging for nine years in special barrels made from Chinkapin Oak trees. Prior to being assembled into barrels, the oak staves from these tall trees air-dried for two years, far longer than the industry-standard three months. As the bourbon matured at Buffalo Trace Distillery, the flavors from the oak became more complex, developed by the climate and changing seasons. The result is a bourbon uniquely shaped by the barrel, with notes of cherries and spearmint, a palate of fresh herbs and honey, with a finish of warm baking spices and dark chocolate.

TITLE: Old Charter Oak French Oak Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Aged twelve years at Buffalo Trace Distillery, this bourbon is rich and sweet, drawing its character from barrels made of French Oak. An oak that has long been used for aging the world’s finest wine, the tighter grain of French Oak impart more subtle flavors and a silkier texture than its American counterpart. Harvested from the forests of France, the oak barrels that aged this unique bourbon whiskey are honored with each sip. So enjoy this tribute to the French Oak and raise a glass to its storied journey from the forest, to the barrel, to bourbon.

TITLE: Old Crown The Original Sour Mash Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
Old Elk "Nooku" Bourbon Cream
DESCRIPTION: Nooku Bourbon Cream is the only spirit of its kind, made with only real bourbon and real cream. It is not considered a "cream liqueur" since the only ingredients are real bourbon blended with fresh dairy cream, with no sugar or supplemental spirits added.

TITLE: Old Elk 'Cigar Cut Island Blend' Cask Finished Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Elk 'Cigar Cut Island Blend' Cask Finished Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a distinctive and innovative offering from Colorado's esteemed Old Elk Distillery. This unique expression, presented in a 750ml bottle, is a testament to the distillery's dedication to crafting exceptional spirits. The 'Cigar Cut Island Blend' is meticulously finished in port, sauternes, sherry, and rum barrels, imparting an unparalleled depth of flavor and complexity. This bourbon is a harmonious blend that marries the bold character of American whiskey with the exotic richness of island casks, making it an exquisite choice for connoisseurs seeking a bourbon that transcends the ordinary.

TITLE: Old Elk 'Cigar Cut' Cask Finished Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Elk Distillery's 'Cigar Cut' Cask Finished Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a distinctive expression of creativity and craftsmanship. Hailing from Colorado, Old Elk Distillery is revered for its commitment to producing superior quality whiskey using traditional methods. This bourbon whiskey, specially designed to pair with a cigar, undergoes an intriguing cask finishing process that adds an extra layer of complexity to its flavor profile. It showcases Old Elk's spirit of innovation, seamlessly merging time-honored whiskey-making techniques with unique finishing methods. The Old Elk 'Cigar Cut' Cask Finished Straight Bourbon Whiskey pairs splendidly with a variety of flavorful dishes. Its rich sweetness and subtle smokiness match beautifully with smoked meats, like barbecue brisket or a well-grilled steak. Alternatively, its robust flavors can stand up to the creaminess of rich desserts, such as a pecan pie or a dark chocolate mousse. A cheese board featuring smoky gouda or sharp cheddar can also complement the bourbon’s complex profile. However, with its cigar-oriented design, this bourbon truly shines when enjoyed in a leisurely manner alongside a quality cigar, allowing the subtle tobacco notes of both to intertwine.

TITLE: Old Elk 10 Year Straight Wheat Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Elk’s 10-year Straight Wheat Whiskey is crafted with four decades of experience, passion, and zero compromises. Our Master Distiller, Greg Metze, called upon a lifetime of experience producing the finest whiskies and applied that expertise to the Straight Wheat Whiskey now held in this bottle. 10 years of aging maximizes soft red winter wheat's rich and refined attributes and draws out the complexities and subtleties that only time can develop. 110 Proof.

TITLE: Old Elk 100 Proof Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rye Whiskey. It’s a benchmark for others, but for folks at Old Elk it’s an exceptional standard that they’ve achieved. Taste this knock-out rye, made up of 95 percent rye and 5 percent malted barley, and you’ll understand. After distilling and creating over 280 million bottles of world-class rye whiskey, Greg Metze decided to put his decades of experience and passion into Old Elk’s Straight Rye Whiskey. The International Whisky Competition named it the Best American Rye Whiskey, but don’t just take their word for it, taste it for yourself. ACCOLADES: 96 Points - 2020 Ultimate Spirits Challenge Top 100 Spirits - 2020 Ultimate Spirits Challenge Best American Rye Whiskey - International Whisky Competition Gold, 95 Points - 2020 Beverage Testing Institute

TITLE: Old Elk 6 Year Old Straight Wheat Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wheat mash bills have all the same challenges of a rye and are never an easy path to take when distilling, but the distillery decided to craft Old Elk’s Straight Wheat Whiskey in the spirit of the acclaimed 95 percent rye whiskey. They applied all of their expertise and knowledge into producing another one of a kind product: a mash bill of 95 percent soft red winter wheat and five percent malted barley, aged for five years, this whiskey is a vivacious and refreshing spirit that is reinventing what it means to be a sipping whiskey. ACCOLADES: 92 Points - 2020 Ultimate Spirits Challenge Gold, 94 Points - 2020 Beverage Testing Institute Colorado Wheat Whiskey Distillery of the Year - 2020 New York Int'l Spirits Competition

TITLE: Old Elk 8 Year Wheated Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Elk’s 8-Year-Old Wheated Bourbon Straight Bourbon Whiskey is crafted with four decades of experience, passion, and zero compromises. Dedicated and built by Master Distiller Greg Metze to be an extreme Wheat Bourbon in the category with its 45% wheat content, in addition to 8 years of gentle maturity in rickhouses, this 8-year-old Wheated Bourbon whiskey surpasses the Old Elk bar to bring you the best. 110 Proof.

TITLE: Old Elk Blended Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The key to this bourbon is the high malted barley content in the mashbill. By investing in the bourbon and using four times more malted barley than traditional recipes, the distillery created a non-traditional bourbon that generates sweet and light components. The malted barley combined with the spicy essence of clove from the rye, and the classic rich bourbon character from the corn, amounts to a robust and smooth taste profile. 51% Corn, 34% Malted Barley, 15% Rye. ACCOLADES: Gold, Best Colorado Whiskey - 2020 International Whisky Competition Gold - 2018 San Francisco World Spirits Competition

TITLE: Old Elk Cask Finished Series - Armagnac
DESCRIPTION: The Straight Bourbon Whiskey finished in Armagnac barrels is a build on our award-winning flagship high-malt mash bill. Left to rest in Armagnac casks, the complex flavors meld with our high-malt mash bill, offering a rich and layered profile like nothing you have ever tasted from Old Elk Distillery. Unveil the flavor of this Armagnac Cask Finish from our Cask Finish Series. 108.5 Proof

TITLE: Old Elk Cask Finished Series - Cognac
DESCRIPTION: The Old Elk Straight Bourbon Whiskey finished in Cognac barrels is a build on our award-winning flagship high-malt mash bill. Left to rest in Cognac casks, this expressive finish enhances the robust foundation of our high-malt mash bill offering subtle spice and a rich depth of flavor. Unveil the flavor of this Cognac Cask Finish from our Cask Finish Series. 109.7 Proof

TITLE: Old Elk Cask Finished Series - Oloroso Sherry
DESCRIPTION: The Old Elk Straight Bourbon Whiskey finished in Sherry barrels is a build on our award-winning flagship high-malt mash bill. Left to rest in Oloroso Sherry casks, the rich remnants deliver a nuanced, full-bodied flavor. Unveil the flavor of this Sherry Cask Finish from our Cask Finish Series. 109.7 Proof

TITLE: Old Elk Cask Finished Series - Port
DESCRIPTION: The Old Elk Straight Bourbon Whiskey finished in Port barrels is a build on our award-winning flagship high-malt mash bill. Left to rest in Port casks, the harmonious balance of richness & complexity is like nothing you have ever tasted from Old Elk Distillery. Unveil the flavor of this Port Cask Finish from our Cask Finish Series. 108.1 Proof

TITLE: Old Elk Double Wheat Straight Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Double Wheat combines two of Old Elk’s most beloved and awarded wheater whiskeys: Old Elk Straight Wheat Whiskey and Old Elk Wheated Bourbon Straight Bourbon Whiskey. Thus creating an entirely unique pour. This is a merger for the more, yielding a higher proof (107.1) and a brighter profile whiskey in which a whole new category begs to be crafted. Mashbill: 71.5% wheat / 25% corn / 3.5% barley Old Elk Wheated Bourbon: 6 years Old Elk Wheat Whiskey 6-7-8 years

TITLE: Old Elk Four Grain Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This unique blend includes all four cereal grains—corn, wheat, barley, and rye. The result honors tradition with the straight bourbons at the heart of these bottles, while leading the palate on a rare journey of flavor born from a complete profile. Four Grain is the result of asking...what’s next? Mashbill: 51% Corn / 22.5% wheat / 19% barley / 7.5% rye Old Elk Hight-Malt Bourbon: 6-7 years Old Elk Wheated Bourbon 6 years

TITLE: Old Elk Infinity Blend Limited Release
DESCRIPTION: Infinity Blend by Old Elk, is a testament to legacy and supreme craftsmanship. Created by Master Distiller Greg Metze, Infinity Blend is the marriage of the signature Old Elk Straight Bourbon Whiskey high-malt mashbill with two classic and vintage Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskies. Utilizing 43 years of experience, Master Distiller Metze melds the rich smooth attributes of Old Elk Bourbon with exceptional maturity notes and the classic profiles of Kentucky Bourbon. This blend transcends both time and tradition. We hope you sip back, relax and enjoy this expert blend. 114.9 Proof

TITLE: Old Elk Sour Mash Reserve Small Batch Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Elk Distillery made their first splash on the booming whiskey scene with Gold recognition in the 2018 San Francisco World Spirits Competition. Following the success of that straight bourbon, Old Elk also added offerings of a straight rye whiskey, straight wheat whiskey, and straight wheat bourbon. Each of these offerings has earned some form of recognition at a variety of spirits competitions. In 2021, Old Olk added to that award-winning lineup with a Sour Mash Reserve Bourbon based on their high-malted barley bourbon mashbill (51% corn, 34% malted barley, and 15% rye). This first batch of Sour Mash Reserve was distilled in New York and is a blend of 30 barrels aged 6 years utilizing a proprietary yeast blend. The magic of this expression is in fermentation. The contrast in the flavor profile results from a change in yeast strain as well as the geographic location of the distillery.

TITLE: Old Elk Straight Rye Whiskey Finished in Rum Barrels
Old Elk Straight Wheated Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Wheaters, come gather ‘round because this one's for you. A delicious and well-balanced wheated bourbon is something every whiskey lover should get their hands on. By using their expertise in creating the delicious flagship bourbon, the distillery tweaked the recipe and upped the wheat, and kept the corn at the minimum. This wheated bourbon consists of 51 percent corn, 45 percent wheat, and four percent malted barley. The result? A liquid that allows for each ingredient to not only shine on its own but highlights what happens when success meets craft. ACCOLADES: Gold - 2020 New York Int'l Spirits Competition Gold - 2020 Beverage Testing Institute

TITLE: Old Elk “Harry Wheater” 7 Year Old Wheated Single Barrel Bourbon The Prime Barrel Pick #26
DESCRIPTION: Our first Old Elk selection seduced us by having a very similar profile to Welle 12 yo. In fact, in a blind tasting, some of us had a tough time distinguishing between the two. It stands to reason, as well, because both have wheated mashbills, and if you are a fan of wheated bourbons, this one should be right up your alley. Mashbill: 51% corn, 45% wheat, 4% malt barley. Cooperage is Speyside in KY and char level #4 121 Proof Fill Date: 4/1/2015 Mashbill is the custom wheated mashbill Greg Metze did for Old Elk while at MGP. In other words, the barrel was laid down at MGP, but it's a custom mashbill specifically for Old Elk (and now The Prime Barrel). Tasting Notes: Nose: Toffee, vanilla, plums, hibiscus Palate: Toasted hazelnuts, clove, cinnamon, vanilla, citrus Finish: Allspice and black peppercorn As suggested by our members, the pick will support Alzheimer's Association. $5 from each bottle will go directly to the charity, where good folks are accelerating global research, driving risk reduction and early detection, and maximizing quality care and support.

TITLE: Old Elk “Ron Wheatley” 8 Year Old Wheated Single Barrel Bourbon The Prime Barrel Pick #85
DESCRIPTION: Reflecting on our Colorado barrel-picking adventure, we are convinced more than ever that it was a jackpot trip. Remember the crowd-pleasers from Stranahan and Laws? Yep, those gems were unearthed there. And while we're buzzing about the upcoming Mile High treasures, let's not forget the kickoff to that memorable journey: snagging not one but two stellar barrels from Old Elk. Old Elk's got a twist in its tale. Sure, they source like many out there, mostly from MGP. But here's the kicker: they have Greg Metzke, a whiskey wizard with a four-decade legacy in distilling. Greg's stint at MGP wasn't just a gig; it was a masterclass that he's now channeling into Old Elk's core and single barrel offerings (Old Elk's mashbill was created by Greg specifically for Old Elk). In a pure Prime Barrel style move, we roped Greg into our barrel-picking squad, expanding our lineup to a formidable nine. The hunt began with a lineup of 12 barrels—bourbon, Wheated Bourbon, and rye. And guess what? We went in blind. Trying to match each sample to its mash bill was like whiskey bingo, and we were surprisingly spot-on for most! Narrowing down the field to three contenders was no small feat with so many palates at play. Cue the "spirited" debates (pun absolutely intended). Eventually, we landed on two favorites: a wheated bourbon and a rye—the latter being a delightful shocker. The team was torn, but united in excitement. Fun fact: Old Elk Rye Single Barrels are as rare as hen's teeth, tipping the scales for us to snag both barrels. Post-selection, with our spirits high (and our sobriety the opposite), we celebrated the only way we knew how—heading to a nearby bar for more drinks and a feast, all on Old Elk's dime. It was an epic experience through and through, and we can't wait for you to try them! Proof 118.8 Tasting notes: Nose: Bright and sweet Palate: Honey, vanilla, grapefruit, syrup, peanut brittle, pear, little earthy Finish - Medium long, butterscotch

TITLE: Old Elk “Ryemus Lupin” 6.5 Year Old Single Barrel Rye The Prime Barrel Pick #86
DESCRIPTION: Reflecting on our Colorado barrel-picking adventure, we are convinced it was a jackpot trip. Remember the crowd-pleasers from Stranahan and Laws? Yep, those gems were unearthed there. And while we're buzzing about the upcoming Mile High treasures, let's remember the kickoff to that memorable journey: snagging not one but two stellar barrels from Old Elk. Old Elk's got a twist in its tale. Sure, the source, like many out there, is mainly from MGP. But here's the kicker: they have Greg Metzke, a whiskey wizard with a four-decade legacy in distilling. Greg's stint at MGP wasn't just a gig; Greg Metze was the Master Distiller at MGP who created the mash bills for Old Elk. When Gre retired from MGP after over 40 years, he joined Old Elk as Master Distiller. He oversees contract distillation from his former employer and barrel maturation and blending in this role. The relationship between the two companies results in Old Elk presenting their bourbon mashbills that MGP does not produce for others. In a pure Prime Barrel style move, we roped Greg into our barrel-picking squad, expanding our lineup to a formidable nine. The hunt began with 12 barrels of bourbon,wheated bourbon, and rye. And guess what? We went blind. Trying to match each sample to its mash bill was like whiskey bingo, and we were surprisingly spot-on for most! Narrowing the field to three contenders was no small feat with so many palates at play. Cue the "spirited" debates (pun intended). Eventually, we landed on two favorites: wheat bourbon and rye—a delightful shocker. The team was torn but united in excitement. Fun fact: Old Elk Rye Single Barrels are as rare as hen's teeth, tipping the scales for us to snag both barrels. Post-selection, with our spirits high (and our sobriety the opposite), we celebrated the only way we knew—heading to a nearby bar for more drinks and a feast on Old Elk's dime. It was an epic experience through and through, and we can't wait for you to try them! Tasting notes: Do not let this bottle pass you if you are a rye drinker! We score his barrel very high for Nose, Palate, and Finish. For us, the finish on this rye scored the highest among the 12 barrels we sampled. Fabulous traditional rye nose. Fresh, s y, wonderful. The palate is bold but not in your face. A little peppermint mid-tongue, some caramel, maybe a little floral, and then a concentration of black pepper and cinnamon at the tip of the tongue. I keep going back for more. A delightful finish accentuates the palate and picks up a slight oakiness. It goes for a long time and moves around on the palate with a nice Colorado cuddle, the Fort Collins version of a Kentucky hug.

TITLE: Old Ezra 7 Years Barrel Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: 58.5% ALC/VOL • 117 PROOF Kentucky straight bourbon aged in new, charred white oak barrels for seven years and bottle it at barrel strength. Seven just became your lucky number.

TITLE: Old Fitzgerald 10-Year-Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Old Fitzgerald 10-Year-Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon is a cherished Heaven Hill Distillery offering. This exquisite whiskey is part of the Bottled-in-Bond series, signifying its adherence to one of America's oldest consumer protection laws. Crafted in Kentucky, the bourbon is aged for a precise 10 years, ensuring a rich, mature flavor profile that captivates the senses. With its delightful wheated mashbill, Old Fitzgerald offers a smooth, full-bodied taste experience. The bourbon is presented in a beautifully designed decanter, making it a lovely sip and a splendid addition to any whiskey collection. This bourbon's limited and allocated release underscores its special status among whiskey aficionados.​

TITLE: Old Fitzgerald 11-Year-Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Old Fitzgerald 11-Year-Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon is a distinguished and historic offering from the renowned Heaven Hill Distillery. This 11-year-old bourbon is part of the esteemed Old Fitzgerald Bottled-in-Bond series, reflecting a commitment to traditional craftsmanship and quality. Bottled at 100 proof, it adheres to the stringent requirements of the Bottled-in-Bond Act, ensuring a rich and authentic bourbon experience. Each 750ml bottle showcases the elegance and depth of flavor that comes with over a decade of aging, making it a prized addition for collectors and connoisseurs alike.

TITLE: Old Fitzgerald 13-Year-Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Old Fitzgerald 13-Year-Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon is a distinguished and historic offering from the renowned Heaven Hill Distillery. This 13-year-old bourbon is part of the esteemed Old Fitzgerald Bottled-in-Bond series, reflecting a commitment to traditional craftsmanship and quality. Bottled at 100 proof, it adheres to the stringent requirements of the Bottled-in-Bond Act, ensuring a rich and authentic bourbon experience. Each 750ml bottle showcases the elegance and depth of flavor that comes with over a decade of aging, making it a prized addition for collectors and connoisseurs alike.

TITLE: Old Fitzgerald 14-Year-Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: The nearly lost Old Fitz makes an appearance as a rare 14-year-old. Very limited release that is gift shop only. Don’t miss your chance to own this while available.

TITLE: Old Fitzgerald 15-Year-Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Each Spring and Fall, a new edition of the Old Fitzgerald Bottled-in-Bond decanter series is released. Bottled in an ornate decanter inspired by an original 1950’s Old Fitzgerald diamond decanter, the series reflects the traditions of both the Old Fitzgerald history tied to John E. Fitzgerald and the historic Bottled-in-Bond designation. The Old Fitzgerald line is well-known for its distilling pedigree as the brand was first registered in 1884 by S.C. Herbst, and was eventually sold to Julian P. “Pappy” Van Winkle during Prohibition. Pappy moved production of Old Fitz to his distillery where it became the first great Wheated Bourbon. In 1999, Heaven Hill bought the Old Fitzgerald brand and began distilling it at the Bernheim Distillery in Louisville.

TITLE: Old Fitzgerald 16-Year-Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Some bottles of bourbon are all about power, this is about subtle, elegant grace. The nose mixes fresh and dried fruit, with notes of dried apricots and apple peel, followed by caramel, nuts, and a faint whiff of toasted oak. The palate is similarly concentrated and complex. It has a butterscotch core, seasoned with (more) dried apples, raisins, vanilla, and black pepper. Each sip lasts an age and is an event by its own right.

TITLE: Old Fitzgerald 17 Years Old Bottled-in-Bond Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Each spring and fall, a new edition to the Old Fitzgerald Bottled-in-Bond series is released. Inspired by an original 1950's Old Fitzgerald diamond decanter, the packaging and series honor both the history of the Old Fitzgerald brand and the historic Bottled-in-Bond designation. The Old Fitzgerald line is well-known for its distilling pedigree, as the brand was first registered in 1884 and was eventually sold to "Pappy" Van Winkle during Prohibition. In 1999, Heaven Hill bought the brand and began distilling it at Bernheim Distillery in Louisville, KY. Today, in addition to our Old Fitzgerald Decanter Series, the legacy of Old Fitzgerald lives on in our other wheated Bourbons expressions: Larceny Small Batch and Larceny Barrel Proof.

TITLE: Old Fitzgerald 19 Years Old Bottled-in-Bond Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Fitzgerald 19-Year-Old Bottled-in-Bond Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a prestigious and rare release from the renowned Heaven Hill Distillery. This 19-year-old bourbon is part of the esteemed Old Fitzgerald Bottled-in-Bond series, showcasing the distillery's commitment to traditional craftsmanship and exceptional quality. Bottled at 100 proof, it adheres to the stringent requirements of the Bottled-in-Bond Act, offering a rich and authentic bourbon experience. Each 750ml bottle reflects the elegance and depth of flavor that comes with nearly two decades of aging, making it a treasured addition for collectors and connoisseurs alike.

TITLE: Old Fitzgerald 8-Year-Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Comprised of barrels produced in spring of 2013, and bottled in spring of 2021, the seventh national release ushers in the latest hallmark series to the bottled-in-bond legacy. Bottled in an ornate decanter, the spring edition denotes a green label, consistent across all spring releases. As was the case for the past editions, this edition’s tax strip, which has always been a signature of transparency on bottled-in-bond products, will disclose when the liquid was produced and bottled. It meets the strict requirements of a bottled-in-bond: the product of a single distillery from a single distilling season, aged a minimum of four years, and bottled at 100 proof or 50% alcohol by volume.

TITLE: Old Fitzgerald 9-Year-Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Earlier this year, Heaven Hill unveiled a new ongoing series of bottled in bond bourbons tied to the Old Fitzgerald brand. The first release of this, an 11-year-old expression housed in a sleek decanter, proved to be quite a popular hit at retail. The Kentucky distillery is now back with the second offering in the form of a 9-year-old bourbon. The Old Fitzgerald Bottled-in-Bond Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey, Fall 2018 edition, is, according to those behind it, comprised of whiskey from barrels produced in October of 2008. Bottled this month, it comes in the same style decanter but is denoted with a black label, which will stay consistent across all fall releases. As was the case for the spring edition, this edition’s tax strip, which has always been a signature of transparency on bottled-in-bond products, will disclose when the liquid was produced and bottled. It meets the requirements of a bottled-in-bond: the product of a single distillery from a single distilling season, aged a minimum of four years, and bottled at 100 proof or 50% alcohol by volume.

TITLE: Old Fitzgerald Very Special 12 Year Old Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Aromas of old worn leather, popcorn and breakfast cereal with more subtle notes of creamed corn, dark caramel, molasses and fudge evolving after aeration time. Entry is buttery, with flavors of sweet corn and maple; the lovely midpalate features tastes of cooking oil, lanolin, caramel, dark fudge, cocoa and brown sugar. Ends with a flourish of oaky vanilla

TITLE: Old Forester "Centurion" 100 Proof Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #90
DESCRIPTION: Crafted on the 2nd floor of Warehouse J, our Old Forester Single Barrel 100 Proof is more than a whiskey; it's a shared passion realized. This exceptional batch was selected in collaboration with six other Prime Barrel members, marking a rare communal journey into the art of bourbon perfection. The Selection Process: Selecting an Old Forester barrel is a rare opportunity, and choosing a 100-proofer is even rarer. This selection was made even more unique by being conducted in person, an experience few can claim. After experimenting with several barrel-strength batches last year, our group decided to explore the subtleties of a 100-proof this time around. This decision was driven by the rarity of 100 Proof expressions, often overshadowed by the allure of barrel-proof selections. At the distillery, we were presented with both 100-proof and cask-strength samples—the latter set aside secretly. After making our choice among the 100-proof options, we were then invited to blind taste the original cask-strength samples. Remarkably, the barrel we unanimously cherished at 100 proof was the same one we admired in its undiluted form. A VIP Experience: Adding to the excitement of our barrel pick, we were granted a rare VIP tour of the Brown-Forman cooperage. Few enthusiasts have the privilege to witness the intricate processes of barrel raising and charring up close. This experience not only deepened our appreciation for the craftsmanship behind each bottle but also enriched our connection to the Old Forester legacy. Tasting Notes: Nose: The aroma opens with a delightful 'spice box' bouquet, rich with the scent of oak and a hint of aromatic spices. Palate: True to Old Forester's character, the palate offers a spicy burst of traditional flavors including vanilla, baking spices, and a distinct note of pecan. Finish: The transition from palate to finish is seamless, with a lasting impression of seasoned oak that is both well-balanced and profound. This Old Forester Single Barrel 100 Proof is a testament to the skill of bourbon crafting and a celebration of community and shared whiskey devotion. This bottle is a collector's dream and a connoisseur's delight, perfect for savoring neat or as the cornerstone of a refined cocktail.

TITLE: Old Forester "Member's Frontier" Barrel Strength Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #81
DESCRIPTION: This Old Forester single barrel selection pays homage to the brand's storied legacy while presenting a unique flavor journey. This selection, named in honor of our community's heads-up advantage, allows premium members first access to its exquisite profile. Hence, the "Member's Frontier" name. Tasting Notes: Nose: A symphony of figs, cherries, and caramel intertwined with subtle maple syrup and nutmeg notes. Palate: The richness of figs and cherries continues, joined by apricot undertones and a hint of vanilla bean, all balanced by a pleasantly mild oakiness. Finish: Offers a satisfying medium to long duration. This barrel, a testament to Old Forester's commitment to quality since 1870, is more than just whiskey; it's a piece of history. This selection embodies the brand's tradition with a mash bill of 72% corn, 18% rye, and 10% malted barley, aged meticulously in charred oak barrels. It delivers a taste experience as if poured directly from the barrel – rich, authentic, and unadulterated. TITLE: Old Forester "Toys Not Bombs" Barrel Strength Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #22
DESCRIPTION: The 'old' in Old Forester isn't just a marketing ploy. The oldest bourbon in continuous production was first sold in 1870 (the first bourbon to be sold exclusively in a sealed bottle). It continued production through prohibition as one of only ten brands authorized for medicinal production. Founded by a former pharmaceutical salesman named George Garvin Brown, the original version of Old Forester was sold to pharmacies as a medicinal product. Named after Dr. William Forrester, who endorsed its consumption, it is said that the second "r" was dropped to avoid the appearance of a conflict of interest with the doctor. More recently, Old Forester has been doing some cool stuff. They have put out a series of bottles with interesting twists on the reliable old whiskey, changing their recipe to tweaking the aging process. For this bottle, however, all of that tweaking and post-aging blending has been stripped away, and we've got a whiskey that tastes as if you poured it directly from the barrel yourself. Almost all Brown-Forman whiskey products start from the same grain bill: 72% corn, 18% rye, and 10% malted barley. This one is no different. Once that fermented mash is distilled in their Louisville, KY plant, the spirit is socked away in charred oak barrels for four to six years (although the bottle has no age statement, it is rumored to be six years old). At 131.2 proof, the heat is certainly present but does not detract from the enjoyment of the pour. Tasting notes are as follows: Nose: Bubblegum, maple syrup, and overripe banana Palate: Banana, sea salt, dark chocolate Finish: Warm, peppery, and smokey We originally had a different idea for the "tater" sticker, but then life happened, and an unfortunate war between Russia and Ukraine broke out. Regardless of how you feel about the conflict, the least we can do is to help people in need. Having young children ourselves, it is unfamothable to think what young parents are going through. So we decided to donate the lion's share of the proceeds from the sale of this barrel to the Save the Children foundation to help save children in Ukraine.

TITLE: Old Forester 150th Anniversary Batch Proof Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: 150 barrels were set aside for Old Forester’s 150th Anniversary release and were divided into three unique batches intended to honor George Garvin Brown’s process of batching from the three original distilleries. The bourbon offers a fairly complex sip without a particular highlight of any flavor, instead of providing a wide array of flavors in relative balance. Each batch’s relatively small barrel count, its throwback amber bottle and tube, and one-off nature undoubtedly make this a collector’s item.

DESCRIPTION: Made using barrels from three different warehouses, a throwback to a pre-1870 blending technique intended to ensure consistency, this is a surprisingly light and delicate Bourbon. Gold Medal San Fran World 2016

TITLE: Old Forester 1897 Bottled in Bond Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: What is the Old Forester Whiskey Row Series? This unique series highlights bourbon history’s significant milestones and production innovations through the release of tailored expressions. What is Old Forester 1897 Bottled in Bond? Old Forester 1897 Bottled in Bond is the second expression in The Old Forester Whiskey Row Series and honors the passage of The Bottled in Bond Act of 1897 by following the guidelines of that law. To be labeled Bottled-in-Bond, the whisky had to be: From one distillation season (6 months) From one distiller From one distillery Matured in government supervised, federally-bonded warehouses Aged at least four years Bottled at 100 proof In addition, Old Forester 1897 will be lightly filtered to honor the filtration techniques of the industry at that time. How will this be different than Old Forester Signature? Old Forester Signature is a 100 proof product made with select barrels of Old Forester resulting in a rich and robust flavor profile. Old Forester 1897 Bottled in Bond will be different in the following ways: Super-Premium package cues with a parchment paper label, a thick glass base, and a cork finish It will be a small batch product (Less than 100 barrels per batch) All product will come from one distillation season (6 months) Old Forester 1897 Bottled in Bond follows all government requirements from the Bottled in Bond Act of 1897 It will be lightly filtered These differences result in a unique flavor profile

TITLE: Old Forester 1910 Old Fine Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Old Forester 1910 Old Fine Whisky is a historic first and a historical last: the final battle of the Whiskey Row series and a new kind of brand bourbon. This most recent (and final) Whiskey Row bottle, “1910 Old Fine Whisky,” pays homage to a happy distilling accident in 1910. At 93 proof, Old Forester 1910 is definitely at the right weight to challenge another Whiskey Row Series battle for supremacy.

TITLE: Old Forester 1920 Prohibition Style Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The third release in the Old Forester Whiskey Row series, this 115 proof expression “celebrates the brand’s continued distillation during Prohibition. For 13 years, the production, transport, and sale of alcohol was strictly prohibited. However, Old Forester was granted a permit to continue distilling on Louisville’s Whiskey Row. The 115 proof expression represents a barrel sample that company president Owsley Brown I would have batched at the beginning of Prohibition."

TITLE: Old Forester 1924 10 Year Old Bourbon Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Old Forester 1924 10 Year Old Whisky is a distinguished addition to the Whiskey Row Series, marking a significant milestone in Old Forester’s rich history. This limited annual release commemorates a pivotal moment during Prohibition when Old Forester was one of the few distilleries to continue operations, thanks to one of six medicinal licenses issued by the federal government. The acquisition of barrels from closed distillers in 1924 and the bottling of the liquid as Old Forester is the basis for this special release.

TITLE: Old Forester Birthday Bourbon Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey 2024
DESCRIPTION: Each year on September 2nd – in honor of the founder George Garvin Brown’s birthday – Old Forester releases a limited-edition, 12-year old vintage-dated expression. Old Forester Birthday Bourbon has become a must-have for bourbon enthusiasts who want to experience the ultimate in rare handcrafted bourbon. Since its introduction in 2002, Old Forester Birthday Bourbon has received unprecedented acclaim, with an impressive collection of national and international whiskey honors.

TITLE: Old Forester Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Forester Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is one of America's oldest bottled bourbons, boasting a rich history dating back to 1870. Crafted by the venerable Brown-Forman Distillery, it stands as a testament to premium quality and unwavering tradition. Produced in the heart of Kentucky, this bourbon represents the fine craftsmanship of American whiskey-making. With its distinct rich flavor profile and smooth finish, Old Forester has cemented its reputation not just as a staple in homes but also among connoisseurs and mixologists.

TITLE: Old Forester Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A historic recipe, acquired in 1940 by Owsley Brown I, Old Forester Rye features a mash bill of 65% Rye, 20% Malted Barley, and 15% Corn. Such a high proportion of barley allows for a fully natural fermentation process, forgoing the need for artificial enzymes commonly found in high rye mash bills. Additionally, a generous percentage of malt yields a unique floral character, balancing the sharp, brisk spice of the rye grain. Continuing our legacy of quality and consistency, Old Forester uses its own proprietary yeast strain, produces every barrel, and distills every drop. At 100 proof, Old Forester Rye plays beautifully in a cocktail but also stands up boldly on its own.

TITLE: Old Forester King Ranch Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A one-off collaborative release in association with King Ranch, the Old Forester King Ranch Edition Bourbon Whiskey is a 105-proof Kentucky Straight small batch made using heavily charred barrels filtered through King Ranch Mesquite Charcoal. Paying homage to American ranching and the spirit that defined the country's heritage, the King Ranch Edition is composed of a 72% corn, 18% rye, and 10% barley mash bill and, with its unique mesquite charcoal filtration, brings an enhanced smoky, oakiness to an otherwise classically appointed Kentucky whiskey.

TITLE: Old Forester Mint Julep
DESCRIPTION: Kentucky- The most authentic experience of the Kentucky Derby is enjoying a mint julep at the track. For generations, Louisville insiders have enjoyed mint juleps made with Louisville's Hometown Bourbon, Old Forester, which has been a part of the scene since before the first Derby.

TITLE: Old Forester Single Barrel  Kentucky Straight Barrel Strength Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: While Old Forester Single Barrels originally came bottled at a sippable 90 proof, trends for bourbon lovers as of late have looked to higher proof expressions. The distillery now is offering a choice between 100 proof and barrel strength, unfiltered bourbon, while the 90 proof option will be eliminated.

TITLE: Old Forester Single Barrel Barrel Strength Kentucky Straight Rye Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Since the release of Old Forester Rye in 2019, fans of the brand have been clamoring to try it at barrel strength, and weʼre excited to deliver. For the first time in the brandʼs 150 year history, Old Forester is elated to present this new expression, unfiltered, as a single barrel at barrel strength. As such, each barrel will have it’s own unique tasting notes and various proofs – but all distinctly Old Forester Rye. This expression, although extremely limited, will be available nationwide though not through Old Foresterʼs private By the Barrel program.

TITLE: Old Forester Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Every fingerprint is unique. The same is true for every barrel of bourbon. Old Forester Single Barrel is bottled from one individual barrel, selected from lots hand-picked by Master Taster Melissa Rift. Old Forester Single Barrel is crafted using the time-honored methods established over 140 years ago.

TITLE: Old Forester The 117 Series  Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: High Angels’ Share showcases a selection of barrels that lost exceptional volume to evaporation in the aging process, resulting in a bourbon that is rich and multidimensional, layered with dark flavor notes, dried fruits, and unexpected herbaceous qualities. Given the dense concentration of flavors in the liquid, air, water or ice cube allow this whisky to open and unveil an unorthodox character. This release examines the unfettered qualities presented in low-yield barrels, showing Old Forester consumers an unencumbered look at this specific facet of the aging process. This singular release is presented at 110 proof.

Given the dense concentration of flavors in the liquid, air, water or ice cube allow this whisky to open and unveil an unorthodox character. This release examines the unfettered qualities presented in low-yield barrels, showing Old Forester consumers an unencumbered look at this specific facet of the aging process. This singular release is presented at 110 proof.

TITLE: Old Forester The President's Choice Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The President’s Choice was historically, and is today, driven by the palate of Old Forester’s current President. Each barrel in the modern iteration is hand-selected by Campbell Brown, Old Forester president and fifth generation Brown family member, under the guidance of Master Taster, Jackie Zykan. Because The President’s Choice expressions are hand selected barrels which have showcased the exceptional character and represent the foremost quality the Old Forester brand has to offer, they are released only when such distinct barrels come of maturity and reach exceptional taste profile.

TITLE: Old Grand-Dad 114 Proof Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
Old Grand-Dad 16 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Grand-Dad 16 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a premium, limited-edition release that offers an exceptional taste of well-aged Kentucky bourbon. With 16 years of maturation in charred American oak barrels, this high-rye bourbon embodies a robust character, showcasing the spice and depth of the rye grain balanced by rich, caramel sweetness. Bottled at 100 proof, this expression is a bold, full-bodied bourbon that brings out layers of flavor honed by time. Crafted at the iconic Jim Beam Distillery, Old Grand-Dad 16 Year is a tribute to the legacy of Basil Hayden, Sr., the "Old Grand-Dad" himself, known for his high-rye bourbon recipe. This aged expression is ideal for bourbon aficionados and collectors, offering an intense and memorable tasting experience that’s steeped in Kentucky tradition.

TITLE: Old Kirk Old Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: So, what is Old Kirk? Rumor has it (although has not been definitively confirmed by us, at least) that this is not other than Willett "purple top" in disguise. Apparently, Willett allocated a barrel of whiskey to a project that did not pan out and they believed they could not release it under their own brand. So they have sold it to the highest bidder. Another clue that it might indeed be Willett's juice is that the mash bill on these is 72% corn, 13% rye, and 15% barley which is one of Willet’s mash bills. Fantastic nose, above-average taste, and a medium-long finish. Very good pour gets better as it opens up.

TITLE: Old Log Cabin Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Batch 206 is based out of Seattle, Washington, and has been around since 2012. Since then it’s become one of the top five independently owned distilleries in the state in both production and sales. 51 percent corn, 49 percent malted barley, both from Washington; aged in in New American Oak, with a #3 char, for 19 t0 26 months

TITLE: Old Louisville Whiskey 16 Years Old American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Louisville Whiskey Co. 16 Years Old American Whiskey is an extraordinary expression of Kentucky’s rich whiskey tradition. This rare and limited release has been aged for 16 years in carefully selected charred new and used American oak barrels, developing a depth and complexity that is truly remarkable. Bottled at a formidable hazmat 148 proof, this whiskey delivers an intense and unforgettable experience, showcasing the masterful craftsmanship of Old Louisville Whiskey Co. Each sip of this whiskey offers a journey through robust and intricate flavors, making it a prized addition to any collection. The high proof and extended aging process result in an expression with unparalleled character and richness, perfect for the discerning whiskey enthusiast

TITLE: Old Louisville Whiskey Bourbon Batch #4
DESCRIPTION: Old Louisville Whiskey Bourbon Batch #4 is a meticulously crafted blend from the esteemed Old Louisville Whiskey Co. This batch continues the tradition of excellence with a blend of select bourbons, each contributing unique characteristics to the final product. Bottled at cask strength, this bourbon offers a robust and complex flavor profile, making it a standout choice for bourbon enthusiasts. Batch #4 showcases the dedication and expertise of Old Louisville Whiskey Co., delivering a balanced and rich bourbon experience. Whether enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in a classic cocktail, this bourbon is sure to impress with its depth and complexity.

TITLE: Old Louisville Whiskey Single Barrel Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Old Louisville Whiskey Single Barrel Bourbon is a premium offering from Old Louisville Whiskey Co., capturing the essence of Kentucky's rich bourbon heritage. Each bottle is drawn from a single barrel, ensuring a unique and unparalleled character in every pour. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, this bourbon is aged to perfection in charred new American oak barrels, resulting in a spirit that embodies depth, complexity, and smoothness. The Old Louisville Whiskey Bourbon Single Barrel is known for its robust flavor profile and high proof, making it a favorite among bourbon enthusiasts. Whether enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in a classic cocktail, this bourbon promises an exceptional drinking experience.

TITLE: Old Louisville Whiskey Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Louisville Whiskey Straight Rye Whiskey is a bold and flavorful expression from Old Louisville Whiskey Co., reflecting the rich heritage and craftsmanship of Kentucky distilling. This straight rye whiskey, made from a high rye mashbill, is aged to perfection in charred new American oak barrels, delivering a robust and spicy character that rye enthusiasts will appreciate. Each bottle of Old Louisville Straight Rye Whiskey captures the essence of traditional rye whiskey with a modern twist. Bottled at a proof range of 90-100, this rye whiskey is versatile and can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as the base for your favorite rye whiskey cocktails.

TITLE: Old Maysville Club Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A Bottled in Bond Kentucky Straight Pure Rye Malt Whiskey Distilled and Bottled by The Pogue Family. An original brand of the H.E. Pogue Distillery founded in 1876, Old Maysville Club in its modern rendition is pure rye in the mash bill, matured for at least 4 years in 53 gallon New Charred American White Oak Barrels and a single barrel bottling at 50% ABV, just as the family formulated over 100 years ago.

TITLE: Old Medley 12 Year Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Medley Distilling Company traces its roots back to 1634 when John Medley immigrated to Maryland from England and established Medley's Neck on the banks of the Potomac River. Included in the items brought over from England was the family still. Over 150 years later, John Medley VI joined the throngs of settlers traveling west, through the Cumberland Gap and settled in Washington County, Kentucky. The family still from England also accompanied him on his journey; leading to the founding of the Medley Distillery in 1812. In 1901, Medley purchased a Distillery known as the Daviess County Distillery. This company survived Prohibition by selling bonded whiskey to the American Medicinal Spirits Company.

TITLE: Old Overholt 10 Years Cask Strength Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Old Overholt 10 Years Cask Strength Straight Rye Whiskey, a historical and prestigious offering from the Jim Beam Distillery, represents a significant milestone in the brand's rich legacy. Established in 1810, Old Overholt has undergone numerous evolutions, culminating in this remarkable expression. This whiskey showcases the exceptional aging process in the unique "elevator" barrel system of Warehouse V, ensuring consistent quality. Distilled in the autumn and winter of 2012, it matured for a minimum of 10 years before being bottled at a robust 60.5% ABV. As a limited edition, it stands as a testament to the distillery's commitment to exceptional rye whiskey crafting.

TITLE: Old Overholt 11 Years Cask Strength Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Overholt 11 Years Cask Strength Straight Rye Whiskey is a remarkable limited edition that pays homage to one of America's oldest whiskey brands, established in 1810. Distilled at the iconic Jim Beam Distillery in Kentucky, this exceptional rye whiskey has been patiently aged for 11 years, resulting in a spirit of profound depth and character. Bottled at a robust 114-proof, this cask strength release offers an unadulterated rye experience, bursting with bold spices and rich flavors. Non-chill filtered to preserve its full-bodied texture and intricate aromas. This whiskey embodies traditional craftsmanship and the enduring legacy of Old Overholt. Ideal for rye enthusiasts seeking a premium, authentic expression, this release stands as a testament to the timeless art of whiskey-making.

TITLE: Old Overholt 4 Year Old Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The signature Straight Rye Whiskey from Overholt has increased to a 4-year age statement (from 3 year old, which has been discontinued). The 4 year age statement pays homage to Overholt’s 1942 original age statement and marks a return to the liquid’s historical roots. Old Overholt 4-Year Old is bottled NCF (Non-Chill Filtered) at 86 proof (43% ABV).

TITLE: Old Overholt 4 Year Old Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The signature Straight Rye Whiskey from Overholt has increased to a 4-year age statement (from 3 year old, which has been discontinued). The 4 year age statement pays homage to Overholt’s 1942 original age statement and marks a return to the liquid’s historical roots. Old Overholt 4-Year Old is bottled NCF (Non-Chill Filtered) at 86 proof (43% ABV).

TITLE: Old Overholt 4 Years Old Monogahela Mash Non-Chill Filtered Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Discover the bold and historical character of Old Overholt 4 Years Old Monongahela Mash Non-Chill Filtered Straight Rye Whiskey. Crafted in Pennsylvania, this rye whiskey pays homage to its roots with a robust and traditional Monongahela mash bill. Aged for 4 years and non-chill filtered to preserve its full flavor profile, Old Overholt delivers a rich and complex taste experience. Whether enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in classic cocktails, this straight rye whiskey stands as a testament to Old Overholt's legacy and dedication to quality.

TITLE: Old Overholt Bonded Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This veteran rye never managed to ascend from the bottom shelf. Perhaps a new generation of enthusiasts couldn’t get behind the staid name or found the price too low to believe. But having persevered for over two centuries, Old Overholt’s time has come. This new version (indicated by its red cap) eliminates chill-filtering, resulting in greater flavor and depth. Aromas of Christmas spice cake, cinnamon, apple, and toasted grain lead to a mouthful of berry fruit, with seductive allspice, cacao, and walnut notes.

TITLE: Old Pepper Distillery "Finest Kentucky Oak" Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Pepper ‘Finest Kentucky Oak’ Straight Rye Whiskey has been selected as Best Rye Whiskey in The World at the prestigious 2018 New York World Spirits Competition in a blind tasting, beating out some of the best rye whiskeys on the market. Old Pepper ‘F.K.O.’ is composed of a straight rye whiskey given a secondary maturation in a heavily toasted and lightly charred new oak barrel made from staves of the ‘Finest Kentucky Oak’. It is bottled straight from the barrel, uncut and unfiltered, around 110 proof.

TITLE: Old Plains Raw Power Shiraz
DESCRIPTION: Shiraz is big in alcohol, so it will crush more delicate dishes. So keep it away from most white fish dishes, and instead pair it with something that is suitable for its heavy body like thick stews. Speaking of alcohol, remember that is high in alcohol is a big NO with spicy hot foods. You are just putting out that fire in your mouth with gasoline. The heavy tannins in Shiraz love the bitter nature of charred food, so this is a great wine to pair with grilled steaks, peppercorn crusted tuna, and grilled vegetables like zucchini and eggplant. In fact, the peppery nature of Shiraz makes it a great companion with anything barbecued so as long as you don’t douse your food in hot sauce.

TITLE: Old Pogue Five Fathers Pure Rye Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A limited edition Kentucky Straight Pure Rye Malt Whiskey bottled at 55% alc./vol. A peppery and caramel drink that offer the discerning patron a robust experience. Five generations after the founding of the H.E. Pogue Distillery in Maysville, Mason County, Kentucky, in 1876, the Pogue family is proud to continue the family legacy with Five Fathers. Produced using one of the Pogue family's original recipes and on the same ground as the original H.E. Pogue distillery, Five Fathers honors the tradition and heritage of its namesake.

TITLE: Old Pogue Master's Select Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A small batch, 9 year, 91 proof Kentucky straight bourbon whisky. Old Pogue was the flagship product of the original H.E. Pogue Distillery in 1876 and is also the first product released by the modern Pogue Distillery. The product was fashioned after an original bottle of Old Pogue that remained in the family for over a century. This easy-drinking bourbon can be enjoyed neat or with a small amount of ice or water.

TITLE: Old Potrero 18th Century Style Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Potrero 18th Century Style Whiskey is the re-creation of the original whiskey of America. This release was distilled in a small copper pot still at the distillery on San Francisco's Potrero Hill, from a mash of 100% rye malt. Rye was the grain of choice for America's first distillers, and using a mash of 100% rye malt produces a uniquely American whiskey. It was found that handmade oak barrels, lightly toasted in the traditional manner, impart a wonderfully subtle flavor to the 18th-century-style American whiskey. In the 18th century, barrels were made by heating the staves over a fire of oak chips, allowing them to be bent and formed into a barrel shape. During this process, the inside of the barrel would become toasted-but, not charred. For aging, several uncharred oak barrels were chosen-both new, and used-to achieve the balanced complexity that complements this whiskey's traditional heritage.

TITLE: Old Potrero Rye Straight Single Malt
DESCRIPTION: This straight rye whiskey was aged in new handmade charred oak barrels. With traditional barrel making, the cooper heats the staves over a fire of oak chips, which allows them to bend and form into the barrel. During this charring process, the inner part of the barrel becomes slightly toasted. In the early 19th century, coopers were learning that if they allowed the heat to perpetually, burn, the inside of the barrel would burst into flames and become charred. This is the traditional manner in which handmade oak barrels-charred impart rich tones and unique characteristics to the final spirit. Crafted from a mash bill of 100% malted rye. Old Potrero is bottled at 97 proof (48.5% ABV) with no age statement. This single malt has playful notes of citrus, cinnamon, and sweet candied notes.

TITLE: Old Potrero Straight Malt Whiskey Finished in Port Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Very limited-release expressions: a Straight Malt Whiskey Finished in Port Barrels. 100 percent rye mash aged in new American oak barrels and finished in port casks. No age statement. Bottled 57.3 percent alcohol by volume.

TITLE: Old Pulteney 12 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Matured wholly in air-dried, hand-selected ex-bourbon casks, the ‘unashamedly excellent’ Old Pulteney 12-years-old is the definitive expression in the Old Pulteney family.

TITLE: Old Pulteney 21 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Old Pulteney distillery in Wick is the most northerly distillery on the Scottish mainland. It is a windswept location, where the uncompromising landscape of the Highlands meets the North Sea, and the waves crash against the granite walls of the harbour. The extreme location and unique stills have resulted in a distinctive flavour, bursting with the power and subtlety of the sea. Old Pulteney is the embodiment of history, people and place: It is the Genuine Maritime Malt. Old Pulteney 21 Year Old has been voted 2012 World Whisky of the Year by the prestigious "Jim Murray's Whisky Bible." Scoring a record-equalling 97.5 points out of 100, it is only the third time that a single malt has ever won the prestigious award, and just the second Scottish distillery to do so.

TITLE: Old Rip Van Winkle 10 Year Old 107 Proof
DESCRIPTION: The Old Rip Van Winkle 10-Year-Old 107 Proof is a highly esteemed bourbon whiskey known for its rich and complex flavor profile. This bourbon is bottled at nearly barrel proof, with just a splash of Kentucky limestone water added after a decade of aging. It's part of the prestigious Van Winkle collection and is produced by Buffalo Trace Distillery. Old Rip Van Winkle 10-Year-Old is known for its enjoyable and accessible nature. It's often praised for its plush and rich texture, making it a desirable choice for seasoned whiskey enthusiasts and those new to bourbon tasting. This whiskey strikes a delicate balance between being approachable and offering a depth of flavor that keeps it interesting.

TITLE: Old Rip Van Winkle 10 Year Old 107 Proof Squat Bottle
Old Rip Van Winkle Bourbon Family Reserve 15 Year Old Pappy Van Winkle
DESCRIPTION: The Pappy Van Winkle 15-Year-Old Bourbon is a distinguished and highly sought-after whiskey, crafted following the exclusive Van Winkle family wheat recipe. This bourbon is aged for 15 years in deep-charred heavy oak barrels, resulting in a whiskey undisturbed and unhurried by time. The Van Winkle collection, which includes this 15-year expression, has garnered numerous awards, underscoring its exceptional quality.

TITLE: Old Rip Van Winkle Bourbon Family Reserve 20 Year Old Pappy Van Winkle
DESCRIPTION: Old Rip Van Winkle Bourbon Family Reserve 20-Year-Old Pappy Van Winkle is a testament to time-honored distilling craftsmanship. Aged for 20 years, this bourbon stands out with its unique aging process, making it a distinguished member of the Pappy Van Winkle collection. Its rare and rich profile has earned it accolades, including a 99 out of 100 rating by the World Spirits Championship. This bourbon, embodying the personality of its namesake - "Pappy" Van Winkle, is often compared to a fine after-dinner cognac due to its exceptional character and quality. This bourbon uses wheat as its secondary grain, along with corn and barley malt, which contributes to its unique flavor profile. It's part of the Van Winkle bourbons, known for their longer aging process and distinctive wheat-based mashbill. The 20-year aging process and 90.4 proof deliver a smooth, rich profile that has garnered high ratings and numerous awards, making it a highly sought-after bourbon in the whiskey world.

TITLE: Old Rip Van Winkle Bourbon Family Reserve 23 Year Old Pappy Van Winkle 2024
DESCRIPTION: Old Rip Van Winkle Bourbon Family Reserve 23 Year Old Pappy Van Winkle is an extraordinary expression representing American whiskey craftsmanship's pinnacle. Aged for a remarkable 23 years, this wheated bourbon is among the most sought-after releases in the world, coveted for its exceptional smoothness, depth, and character. Each bottle is part of the Van Winkle legacy, reflecting a dedication to quality, tradition, and excellence. Bottled at 95.6 proof, this bourbon delivers a rich and nuanced experience that few whiskeys can rival. Crafted at the iconic Buffalo Trace Distillery, this bourbon’s extended aging has yielded complex layers of flavor, with notes of dark fruit, caramel, and oak blending harmoniously. Known as "Pappy Van Winkle’s" finest, this 23-year expression is reserved for true collectors and connoisseurs, offering a luxurious taste of bourbon heritage.

TITLE: Old Rip Van Winkle Bourbon Special Reserve 12 Year Old Lot B
DESCRIPTION: The Old Rip Van Winkle Lot B 12 Year Old Bourbon, distilled in the heart of Kentucky, is a remarkable blend of age and proof. Described as "nectar" by some, this full-bodied whiskey is a testament to the finesse and quality of the Van Winkle bourbons. Aged for 12 years and bottled at 45.2% ABV (90.4 proof), it is revered for its elegant and refined character, showcasing a rich and deep profile that rivals the best cognacs as an after-dinner drink.

TITLE: Old Rip Van Winkle Family Reserve 13 Year Rye
DESCRIPTION: Old Rip Van Winkle Family Reserve 13 Year Rye is a rare and highly coveted expression that embodies the legendary craftsmanship of the Van Winkle family. Aged for 13 years in carefully selected American oak barrels, this rye whiskey showcases a refined depth and complexity, making it a standout choice for collectors and enthusiasts alike. Bottled at 95.6 proof, this straight rye delivers a smooth yet bold profile with layered notes that evolve beautifully on the palate. Crafted at the renowned Buffalo Trace Distillery, this release from Old Rip Van Winkle is part of a legacy known for producing some of the finest American whiskeys. The extended aging process imparts rich, spicy flavors balanced by a mellow sweetness, reflecting the dedication to quality and tradition that has made the Van Winkle name legendary.

TITLE: Old Rip Van Winkle Handmade Family Reserve 16 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: An incredibly rare offering from the Van Winkle family reserve. This was bottled in 1990 by Julian Van Winkle III. His father, Julian II, had retained an office at the old Stitzel-Weller distillery following his forced sale of it in the 1970s, but this hospitality was not extended to his son, who had to buy Hoffman distillery in 1983, renaming it Old Commonwealth. There he bottled much of the best-regarded whiskey in America, including Nathan Stone's, Very Olde St. Nick, the A.H. Hirsch Reserve, and this, the Van Winkle Family Reserve. This Van Winkle family reserve bourbon was sourced from Boone distillery, where it was barreled in 1974. It was bottled twice: this one in 19910 and then again in 1991 (17 yo version). Both were intended for the Japanese market, which was at the time more willing to pay premium prices for well-aged bourbon. Van Winkle III continued to bottle at Old Commonwealth until 2002, when thinning stocks necessitated an agreement with the Sazerac company, which warehoused his remaining barrels and produced limited quantities of Pappy Van Winkle Family Reserve on an annual basis until it finally ran out. It is now distilled at Buffalo Trace using Pappy's old recipe. These original bottles of Boone distilled Van Winkle reserves are incredibly rare and sought after in equal measure. Fun fact: Van Winkle has stated that he "got away" with using red wax here as Maker's Mark only held the trademark in the US.

TITLE: Old Soul 13 Year Old Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This is a one-time, limited, and non-chill filtered release bottled at a cask strength of 99 proof. Old Soul Straight Bourbon Whiskey 13 Year’s mash bill consists of 74% corn, 18% rye, and 8% malted barley. Although this Old Soul was not made by Cathead Distillery, the profile of this Kentucky-sourced whiskey was too unique to pass up.

TITLE: Old Soul 15 Year Old Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This is a one-time, limited, and non-chill filtered release bottled at a cask strength of 102 proof. Old Soul Straight Bourbon Whiskey 15 Year’s mash bill consists of 78.5% Corn, 13% Rye, 8.5% Malted Barley. Although this Old Soul was not made by Cathead Distillery, the profile of this Kentucky-sourced whiskey was too unique to pass up.

TITLE: Old Soul Single Barrel 109 Proof Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Soul Single Barrel 109 Proof Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a premium offering from Cathead Distillery, Mississippi's first legal distillery since Prohibition. This exceptional bourbon is selected from individual barrels, each hand-picked to ensure a unique and robust flavor profile. Aged between 4 to 5 years in charred American oak barrels, it embodies the perfect balance of tradition and innovation. Bottled at a bold 109 proof, this high rye bourbon delivers a rich and complex experience that captures the essence of Southern craftsmanship. Its deep amber hue and intricate flavors make it a standout choice for bourbon enthusiasts seeking something truly special.

TITLE: Old Soul Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Soul Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a meticulously crafted spirit from Cathead Distillery, Mississippi's first legal distillery since Prohibition. This bourbon is a blend of 4 and 5-year-old high rye bourbons distilled in Mississippi and Indiana. Bottled at 90 proof, it offers a harmonious balance of sweetness and spice, characteristic of its high rye mashbill. The careful aging process and expert blending result in a smooth and complex bourbon, appealing to both seasoned bourbon enthusiasts and newcomers alike. With its deep amber hue and rich flavor profile, Old Soul Straight Bourbon Whiskey embodies the spirit of Southern craftsmanship and tradition.

TITLE: Old Soul Tintype Series #1 Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Soul Tintype Series #1 Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a distinguished, limited-edition release from Cathead Distillery, Mississippi’s first legal distillery since Prohibition. This exceptional bourbon is part of the Tintype Series, an annual fall/winter collaboration between Cathead Distillery and the Music Maker Foundation. The series pays homage to the artistry and tradition of tintype photography while celebrating the legacy of revered blues musicians supported by the foundation. Series #1 features a striking tintype photograph of Captain Luke Mayer, a blues legend whose unfiltered artistry mirrors the bold spirit of this cask-strength whiskey. Bottled at an impressive 120.6 proof, this 7-year-old bourbon is uncut and unfiltered, embodying the raw authenticity of the Southern blues it honors. With just 16 barrels released, this is a true collector’s item that whiskey enthusiasts and music lovers alike will treasure.

TITLE: Old Soul Tintype Series #2 Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Old Soul Tintype Series #2 Straight Bourbon Whiskey is the highly anticipated second installment in the Tintype Series, an annual fall/winter release from Cathead Distillery, Mississippi’s first legal distillery since Prohibition. This unique series, created in collaboration with the Music Maker Foundation (MMF), honors the legacy of legendary blues musicians while celebrating the artistry of tintype photography. Series #2 shines a spotlight on the renowned blues artist Hermon Hitson, whose once-elusive work captivated vinyl enthusiasts. His image and artistry are immortalized on this limited-edition bourbon, crafted to embody the authenticity and depth of the blues. Bottled at 113.7 proof, this meticulously aged 8-year, 10-month bourbon comes from a rare and exclusive batch of just 20 barrels, making it a true gem for collectors and connoisseurs.

TITLE: Old Tub Bottle in Bond Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Before Jim Beam Bourbon, the Beam family made Old Tub, an unfiltered bonded bourbon. Old Tub was the foundation for what would become the world's #1 bourbon. This limited edition bottle is a tribute to that groundbreaking whiskey. Jim Beam's Old Tub is a Bottled-In-Bond, Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey. Just like the original Old Tub, it has not been carbon or chill-filtered - only quality screened to remove bits of barrel wood. It's the next best thing to thieving the barrel yourself. You may notice some haziness when you add ice. Think of it as an indicator of the true, full flavor of this bourbon. nextSectiom COLOR: Reminiscent of golden citrine gemstones with shades of honey. AROMA: Initial waves of oak, followed by ribbons of vanilla and grain. TASTE: Robust oaky notes are complemented by hints of grain and warm caramel. FINISH: The full-bodied flavor finishes clean, with a lingering warmth.

TITLE: Old Vienna Composition Ice Wine Cabernet/Merlot
DESCRIPTION: Produced from frozen grapes of Cabernet Sauvignon (30 %), Cabernet Franc (30 %) and Merlot (40 %) and is a real "masterpiece". A red (rosé colored) Icewine! (The color cannot be red, as the frozen skins contain the color which is also frozen and cannot get leached out of them.) The curious thing is, that those countries who can produce Icewine climatically, cannot grow such late-ripening grape varieties and the southern countries for Cabernet & Co. cannot produce Icewine at all. The Burgenland area is the Eldorado for a vintner, where everything can be produced from all varieties with a surpassing result! That's why this rarity is a real one - for collectors and people who like to have something very special.

TITLE: Old Vienna Composition Ice Wine Chardonnay
DESCRIPTION: Hafner proudly presents his Icewine Chardonnay; as the Hafner Family Estate has been the FIRST producer of this frosty rarity in Austria this is a very specialty of the winery

TITLE: Old Vienna Composition Ice Wine Cuvee
DESCRIPTION: Icewine (Eiswein) has to be clearly distinguished from other noble sweet wine products regarding the production method. With 25 % sugar content in the pressed must it is equal to Beerenauslese (BA) but whilst all noble sweet wines contain more or less Botrytis and are produced from shrivelled grapes, the Icewine is made from harvesting “healthy” grapes but in a frozen state. By pressing frozen grapes immediately, the frozen water is separated from the juice (must) as Ice crystals, so the high sugar concentration can be reached. (Would the same grapes not be frozen, the separated Ice would be within the must as water and the concentration would be less.) The fine balance between sweetness and acidity is the basis of the typical character of an Icewine. An essential element of a classic Icewine is a certain racy, fiery trait based on a sufficient structure of acidity. The notable difference between Icewine and traditional dessert wines is, that Icewine, produced by an expert, presents a fine fruitness from the bouquet to the end of the tasting because of the total or partial absence of noble rot (Botrytis). The typical characteristics of the grape variety should be noticeable. The production of Icewine involves a long and risky procedure. As the grapes maintain in the vineyards until it becomes frosty lower than -7°C/ 20°F, there is much damage by wind and birds (starlings going south in fall/winter) but it is even not certain that the temperature necessary for the Icewine production can be reached. The high risk involved is the reason why not all vintages result in a Icewine harvest. As Austria’s first producer of Icewine (1971) we have a lot of experience meanwhile and even had to accept complete losses of vineyards to birds and wheater. But in the positive years, mostly at night we get the chance to harvest frozen grapes below -7° C/ 20° F. Sometimes only for a few hours as the temperature goes up again in the morning. This makes a lot of helpful hands essential. Not completely frozen grapes cannot be accepted by our quality standards, nor technically as the necessary sugar concentration of 25 % would not be reached on partly frozen grapes.
