TITLE: Old W. L. Weller Original 107 Proof Bourbon Gold Vein 1975
DESCRIPTION: This is a 1975 bottling of the Old Weller Antique, their 107-proof wheated bourbon. This was produced by United Distillers using barrels of Stitzel-Weller stock, although at the time they were filled the distillery was trading by the name Old Fitzgerald. It would revert back upon its closure. William Larue Weller was born into a distilling family in Kentucky in 1825, and launched his W.L. Weller brand in 1849. Originally a rectification business (creating 'whiskey' using neutral spirit, coloring and flavorings), this all changed with the Bottled in Bond Act of 1897 and the death of Weller two years later. The company was left in the hands of the fiercely passionate Julian 'Pappy' Van Winkle I who, having steered it safely through the wreckage of National Prohibition, established Old Weller alongside the newly acquired Old Fitzgerald labels and the flagship brands for the new Stitzel-Weller distillery in 1933. It was produced there for over 60 years, eventually being sold to the Sazerac Company in 1999, who distill it at Buffalo Trace using Pappy's recipe to this day.

TITLE: Olga Raffault Chinon Rose
DESCRIPTION: It is 100% hand-harvested Cabernet Franc, 50% certified-organic estate fruit (from sandy, gravelly, flat parcels along the Vienne) and 50% from a neighbor who is in the process of converting to organic farming. Half of the fruit is pressed directly as whole clusters and the other half is saigne (bleeding of the pale juice of their red Chinon early in fermentation).Only native yeasts are used, fermentation is in stainless steel tanks.

TITLE: Olivier Minot La Boutanche Gamay
DESCRIPTION: From the celebrated Beaujolais region in France, Olivier Minot presents the La Boutanche Gamay, a charming expression of the delightful Gamay varietal. Olivier Minot, a devoted organic and natural winemaker, produces wines that reflect the fruit's purity and the terroir's uniqueness. La Boutanche Gamay, with its youthful exuberance, fruity vibrancy, and refreshing acidity, beautifully encapsulates Minot's winemaking philosophy and the rich characteristics of Beaujolais. La Boutanche Gamay from Olivier Minot pairs beautifully with various dishes due to its lively acidity and fruity freshness. It's an excellent partner for charcuterie, as the wine's acidity cuts through the meat's richness. It also pairs well with grilled or roasted chicken, as its fruitiness complements the savory flavors of the poultry. A simple, classic dish of spaghetti Bolognese or lasagna can also harmonize with the wine's character. A vegetable tart or a ratatouille can accentuate the wine's earthy and fruity tones for vegetarian options. Finally, a cheese platter featuring Camembert or Brie can artfully echo the wine's balanced and vibrant profile.

TITLE: Olivier Riviere Rayos UVA Rioja
DESCRIPTION: Rayos Uva is as pure and vibrant as Rioja can be. Made from Tempranillo, Graciano and Garnacha (in some vintages) and sourced from the sandy, gravelly and alluvial soils of Rioja Baja, it is fermented whole berry by indigenous yeasts in tank and aged for about 9 months in stainless steel, foudre and cement tanks.

TITLE: Olmeca Altos Tequila Plata
DESCRIPTION: Altos Tequila Plata is made from 100% blue agave grown in the Los Altos highlands of Mexico. Complete with herbal notes of cooked agave, our Plata is slightly citric and sweet with a fruity aroma. It's a classic tequila for the modern world.

TITLE: Ombra Prosecco "O" Brut
DESCRIPTION: This is a semi-sparkling wine obtained through natural fermentation of the Prosecco grape at moderate pressure (approx 2 atm). It is pale straw-yellow in colour with an intense, fruity bouquet and a fine perlage. A pleasantly fresh wine, lean and light in alcohol that is enjoyable on its own or with hors d'oeuvres o first courses. Prosecco comes bottled with either a cork secured with twine (a system used locally during the 1930s for bottling semi-sparkling wines) or with a "mushroom" cork secured with wire caging.

TITLE: Onabay Vineyards Blanc de Blancs Brut
DESCRIPTION: This wine is inspired by the Blanc de Blanc Champagnes of the Cote des Blancs region . By carefully selecting and hand harvesting chardonnay at their precocious vibrant stage of early ripeness, the grapes retain all of the nervous acidity and minerality made possible by the North Fork's cool maritime climate. The wine is made by the traditional, old world method of inducing a secondary fermentation in the bottle. With over 30 months en tirage (resting on its lees), this sparkling treat exudes elegant balance.

TITLE: Onabay Vineyards Cabernet Franc 'Cot-Fermented'
DESCRIPTION: All of the grapes were hand-harvested. After de-stemming, the whole berries soaked for 2 days at 58 degrees F to extract color prior to the beginning of fermentation. Following a longstanding old world tradition of fermenting different grape varieties together, Cabernet Franc (84%) and Cot (16%, aka Malbec) were co-fermented to achieve a more harmonious integration of the characteristics of each variety. The wine was aged for twelve months in seasoned French oak and bottled with minimal filtration.

TITLE: One Eight Distilling Untitled Whiskey 11
DESCRIPTION: Presenting Untitled – creative small-batch spirits from the team of One Eight Distilling. Untitled No.11, is a blend of 7 to 10 years old Bourbon finished in a combination of Cognac, Ruby Port, PX Sherry, and Oloroso Sherry casks. Hands down the boldest expression to date, this whiskey has a nose full of candied orange peel with a hint of spring campfire. Flavors are reminiscent of rum-raisin ice cream before spiced, buttery coffee cake and hints of leather emerge, leading to a finish with chocolate-toffee candy and brandied cherries. Untitled No. 13, a 10-year old high rye bourbon rested in a combination of Cognac, Spanish brandy, Amontillado, Oloroso, and Pedro Ximenez sherries. The nose on this whiskey is bright and fresh, reminiscent of expressed grapefruit peel and maple sap. The palate starts with candied orange peel before richer, fruitier notes of blackberry jam and maraschino cherries appear. The finish stays on the tongue long after swallowing with hints of chestnut honey and tiramisu.

DESCRIPTION: Presenting Untitled – creative small-batch spirits from the team of One Eight Distilling. TITLE: OOLA Distillery Waitsburg Bourbon Whiskey
Opus One Napa Valley Red 2019
DESCRIPTION: The Opus One has intense aromas of black plum, blueberry, black currant, and dried rose petals, accentuated by mineral undertones. The creamy, satiny texture is framed by ﬁne-grained tannins. The freshness and soft glow of acidity create a subtle tension with dark fruit ﬂavors, savory herbs, espresso, and cocoa. A delicate dark chocolate bitterness lingers on the ﬁnish.

TITLE: Orbis Moderandi Petillant Naturel Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: 100% Sauvignon Blanc from a stunning single vineyard within Marlborough that is bottled during fermentation (petillant naturel or “pet-nat”).

TITLE: Origen Raíz Wild Cenizo Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: Origen Raiz Cenizo is made with agave Cenizo (Durangensis) by mezcalero Ignacio Grijalva Santiago, who is also known as Don Nacho. Though originally from Oaxaca, he moved to Durango with his family to run the palenque at Rancho El Ojo. Cosme Gabriel Simental also helps with the mezcal production. There are also some bottles made by mezcalero Noe Ramirez Varela. All of the bottles and batches we’ve seen have come from Rancho El Ojo, which is full of wild agave, sotol, and nopal plants. The ranch lies just outside the Sierra de Órganos National Park, at an elevation of approximately 6,350 feet. The agave used in this mezcal are smoked in underground ovens, crushed by mule-drawn tahona, fermented in open-air oak tanks, and double distilled in copper stills.

TITLE: Oro de Lidia AnejoTequila
DESCRIPTION: The agave is carefully trimmed of its pencas (or leaves) to avoid any bitterness. Pure spring water is used throughout the natural fermentation process. The tequila is oxygenated, chilled to 4º C, then filtered through activated carbon filters before bottling, which makes it one of the smoothest tequilas on the market. The anejo is aged 1.5 years in 75% American Bourbon & 25% French Cognac barrels.

TITLE: Oro de Lidia Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Oxygenated, chilled to 4 degree centigrade, then filtered through activated carbon filters before bottling.

TITLE: Oro de Lidia Reposado Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Oro de Lidia was created for the celebration of "Fiesta Brava", the centuries-old Spanish bullfighting event. The bravest of all matadors that survives the largest, meanest, toughest bull is honored with a dance from the festival's most cherished women, Lidia. The most important traditions we honor are hard work and labor. Aged 6-12 months in medium charred American white oak and French oak barrels.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Archive Collection
DESCRIPTION: We've managed to pull together all releases ever produced in Orphan Barrel series into one ultimate gift set! With many people missing out on the 26-year-Old Blowhard and the 28-year Whoop & Holler, here's your chance to own the entire set.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Archive Collection (6 Pack Bottles) in Wooden Case
DESCRIPTION: The Orphan Barrel Archive Collection features six variants of bottlings from the larger pool of whiskeys, some of which have come and gone already in the market. More details on each selection can be found below from its creator and, as for the packaging, it consists of a custom wood finished crate with a front panel that opens and folds back to reveal the bottles. Its padded interior is stamped with various Orphan Barrel icons.Bottles in the collection: Barterhouse 20 Year — The first release of the Orphan Barrel series. Tastes like warm biscuits and buttercream, with spice and brown sugar in the finish. Old Blowhard 26 Year — The flavor of this extraordinary whiskey is exuberant and rich with undertones of smoke and honey. The finish is dry and spicy, with a hint of orange peel. Lost Prophet 22 Year — Lost Prophet is a soft-spoken whiskey with aromas of honey, apricot, and clove that reveal a silky, full-bodied taste with notes of spiced vanilla and a touch of leather, culminating in a sweet, smoky finish. Rhetoric 21 Year — Aromas of cherry, sweet tobacco, honey, and leather build upon its counterpart's oak, fruit, vanilla, and caramel with new tastes of sweet tobacco, dark chocolate, baking spices, and honey.​ Forged Oak 15 Year — Forged Oak is a statuesque whiskey with aromas of cedar, maple, and vanilla bean that give way to seasoned woody notes of cocoa and young berries, ultimately leading to a long, dry finish of black pepper. Whoop & Holler 28 Year — A previously unheard-of-age statement on any American whiskey. Said to be George Dickel stock.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Barterhouse 20 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: First in the Orphan Barrel family collection. Orphan Barrel Barterhouse 20 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is part of the Orphan Barrel project, aimed at bottling forgotten barrels of rare whiskey. Aged for two decades in American oak barrels at the renowned Stitzel-Weller Distillery, this bourbon is known for its deep complexity and richness. It is bottled at 90.2 proof, offering a balance of strength and smoothness.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Castle's Curse 14 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Orphan Barrel Castle's Curse 14 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a unique and rare find from the Teaninich Distillery. Part of Diageo's Orphan Barrel Whiskey Co., this whisky is an exceptional expression that has matured in European oak, offering an intriguing balance of age and flavor. It draws inspiration from the Scottish legend of the Kelpie, a mythical water creature, reflecting the mystical connection between water and the art of whisky making.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Copper Tongue 16 Years Cask Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: 2021 release from the Orphan Barrel Collection. Copper Tongue has a surprising mellowness uncommon of a cask strength 16-year-old bourbon. Aromas of almond and toffee give way to reveal a delicate floral perfume. The palette offers a surprising softness with juicy bursts of candied orange.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Entrapment Aged 25 Years Canadian Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Orphan Barrel Whisky Co just released Entrapment, a 25 year-old whiskey sourced from the Gimli distillery (home of Crown Royal). It is bottled at 41%.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Fable & Folly 14 Years Finest Quality Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A marriage of the remaining stocks of Barterhouse, Forged Oak, and various Rhetoric releases with aged rye and corn whiskies resulted in a masterful blend that pays homage to the original releases yet possesses a distinct profile all its own. This 14-year-old whiskey is a unique balance of age and flavor accenting the rich, creamy character of the orphaned bourbons with the spiciness of the aged rye whiskey. It begins with a burst of spice and delicately warms to a creamy richness with sweet notes of syrup and fruit.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Forager's Keep Single Malt Scotch 26 Year Old
DESCRIPTION: Perhaps the shortest-lived of all Speyside distilleries, Pittyvaich—Gaelic for ‘farmstead at the birch wood’— was the innocent victim of industry restructuring. The distillery closed in 1993 through no fault of its whisky and has long since been demolished. Its pleasing single malt has never been widely available, though it has been proven to age well as none younger than 25 years of age remains. Most closed distilleries have produced for decades, even centuries before their closure. Pittyvaich lived for a mere 18 years, making it one of the most rarely seen single malts of all. This rare, limited release Forager’s Keep 26-Year-Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky has lived longer than the distillery from which it came. It is the first of its kind for the Orphan Barrel Whiskey Co. Aromas of fruit and freshly cut, crisp red apple give way to a gentle vanilla creaminess sheltering dense, but distant orange peel for a mellow, warming taste with a hint of wood spices and a sweet finish.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Forged Oak 15 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A pillar of strength rooted in time and wisdom, Forged Oak was found while foraging through the historic Stitzel-Weller rick houses. This Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey spent 15 contemplative years in charred American white oak barrels. Forged Oak is a statuesque whiskey with aromas of cedar, maple and vanilla bean that give way to seasoned woody notes of cocoa and young berries, ultimately leading to a long, dry finish of black pepper.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Indigo's Hour 18 Year Old Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Orphan Barrel Whiskey Distilling Co. has unveiled its next release: Orphan Barrel Indigo's Hour. Orphan Barrel's Indigo's Hour is an 18-year-old bourbon featuring a high-rye mash bill. This limited edition, one-time-only batch release offers a profound depth of flavor influenced by its extended aging process in new, charred white oak barrels. It's a collector's item for bourbon enthusiasts, presenting a complex profile typical of Orphan Barrel releases. Distilled at MGP, aged at Stitzel-Weller, and bottled at Cascade Hollow. (Yes, it is NOT Dickel)

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Lost Prophet 22 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Lost Prophet is a soft spoken whiskey, with aromas of honey, apricot, and clove that reveal a silky, full-bodied taste with notes of spiced vanilla and a touch of leather, culminating in sweet smoky finish. See other bourbons in Orphan Barrel family collection.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Muckety Muck 24 Years Single Grain Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Set beside the canal on a hill overlooking the vibrant city of Glasgow, the Port Dundas Distillery was a prominent local landmark established in 1810, which gave the world two centuries of exceptional whisky. Although Port Dundas closed its doors in 2010, there are select, rare remaining stocks that allow a glimpse into the glorious past of one of Scotland’s most respected and historic distilleries. Muckety-Muck is one of those rare single grain scotches boasting 24 years of aging and is the first single grain scotch for the Orphan Barrel Whiskey Co

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Muckety Muck 25 Years Single Grain Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Although Port Dundas Distillery closed its doors in 2010, there are select, rare remaining stocks that allow a glimpse into the glorious past of one of Scotland’s most respected and historic distilleries. Muckety-Muck is one of those rare single grain scotches, now boasting 25 years of aging following the smashing success of the 24-year-old release.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Muckety Muck 26 Years Single Grain Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Orphan Barrel Muckety-Muck 26-Year-Old Single Grain Scotch Whisky boasts fresh, indulgent flavors. The new label pays homage to the piggery that once stood beside the Port Dundas Distillery, a local landmark established in 1810 that gifted two centuries of exceptional whisky before closing its doors in 2010. The select remaining stocks allow a glimpse into the glorious past of one of Scotland's most respected and historic distilleries. Enriched by 26 years of aging, this rare single-grain Scotch from the Port Dundas Distillery owns a bursting aroma of caramel, fudge & baked sugar, backed by hints of fresh fruit and berries. The light fruit flavor blends with hints of butterscotch vanilla & toasted oak, which carry through to the finish. Distilled and bottled with pride in Scotland, this whisky is best enjoyed straight, either neat or on the rocks. Includes one 92-proof 750 mL bottle of Orphan Barrel Muckety-Muck 26-Year-Old Single Grain Scotch Whisky.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Old Blowhard 26 Years Kentucky Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The most intense of the Orphan Barrel releases. Very robust, with leather, tobacco, and roasted nuts. Quite spicy and resinous too. There’s also toffee, maple syrup, and caramel.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Scarlet Shade 14 year Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Orphan Barrel Whiskey Distilling Co. has unveiled its next release: Orphan Barrel Scarlet Shade Rye. A rare and exceptional rye whiskey that has aged for 14 years in charred oak barrels is called Orphan Barrel Scarlet Shade 14-Year Rye Whiskey. With flavors of sweet vanilla buttercream, softly toasted oak, banana bread, and berries, it has a full-bodied flavor. It ends with mild warmth and sweet orange marmalade notes that fade into lingering dark chocolate. For any whiskey enthusiast, this whiskey is a necessity. A genuinely unique and one-of-a-kind whiskey is Orphan Barrel Scarlet Shade 14-Year Rye. It was distilled in Indiana, across state borders, and arrived in Kentucky, where it was expertly matured at the renowned Stitzel-Weller Distillery.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel The Gifted Horse American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Orphan Barrel Whiskey Distilling Co. has "accidentally" added a new special blend of whiskey to the family. A batch of a 17-year-old Kentucky bourbon was accidentally mixed with barrels of a much younger whiskey. This error turned out to be a blessing in disguise, as the older bourbon wasn't marred, but was transformed into something surprisingly special... which the brand calls "The Gifted Horse." Serving as the 7th addition to Orphan Barrel family collection (for those who are keeping count, Rhetoric had 20 AND 21 yo version), the new whiskey comes in at 115 proof, boasting unique tasting notes of creamy caramel, Bosc pear and fruit cake. The fruity notes become more apparent with a splash of water, says the brand.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Whoop & Holler 28-year-old American Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Orphan Barrel Whiskey Distilling Co. has unveiled its ninth release: Orphan Barrel Whoop & Holler. This is a 28-year-old charcoal-mellowed American whiskey, the company says in a press release. Whoop & Holler originates from the George Dickel Distillery in Tullahoma, Tennessee. Like other whiskeys from Orphan Barrel, it will be highly allocated with no future releases planned. The whiskey is chilled and then charcoal mellowed with Tennessee sugar maple charcoal that is burned onsite, the company says. Whoop & Holler has a mash bill of 84% corn, 8% rye, and 8% malted barley. On the nose is corn kennel, citrus peel, and honey notes, the company says, followed by an oak-forward flavor with spicy peppercorn, clove, dark chocolate and peanut shell notes.

TITLE: Orphan Barrel Woven Honor 18 Years  Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Orphan Barrel Woven Honor 18 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a rare and finely crafted expression highlighting the mastery of time-honored whisky-making traditions. As part of the renowned Orphan Barrel series, Woven Honor reflects the distillery's commitment to uncovering and bottling some of the finest whiskies in the world. Aged for 18 years in the heart of the Scottish Highlands, this single malt has developed remarkable depth, complexity, and elegance. With its long maturation period, the whisky has taken on rich layers of flavor from the oak, resulting in a beautifully balanced profile that blends sweet, fruity notes with warming spice and oak. Bottled at 92.6 proof, Woven Honor offers a smooth, luxurious drinking experience, making it an exceptional addition to any whisky collection.

TITLE: Osadia Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: -beef BBQ ribs -lamb stew -lamb chops

TITLE: Osadia Chardonnay
Osadia Merlot
DESCRIPTION: The vineyards are planted on a west-facing slope of the Coastal Range, composed of Mild Mediterranean climate with ocean influence. Fermentation between in stainless steel tanks between 26 and 28°C for 16 days, in separated lots according to their specific characteristics. In stainless steel tanks until the moment of bottling.Natural decantation and cold stabilization Coarse-earth filtration before bottling.

TITLE: Osadia Sauvignon Blanc
Otokoyama Brewery "Man's Mountain" Tokubetsu Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Established in Hokkaido, 1661. Otokoyama, the masterpiece sake of Japan, has been cherished by many historical figures in Japan since the Edo era (1603-1867). Otokoyama was served to the Tokugawa Shogun family during the Edo era and became well known as a distinguished sake. It was even painted in the Ukiyoe, a Japanese woodblock print. This acclaimed sake is made with the underground water from the perpetual snows of Mt. Daisetsuzan in the severe, cold climate of Hokkaido, at the northernmost tip of Japan.

TITLE: Otokoyama Brewery Sake Cup
DESCRIPTION: The dry, light ricey flavor dances across the pallet. It is the #1 Sake consumed in the Hachinohe area - the local favorite for everyday consumption.

TITLE: Ottin Valle d'Aosta Fumin
DESCRIPTION: Elio Ottin farms four hectares of vineyards on the hills overlooking the town of Aosta in the villages of Saint Christophe and Quart, with south-facing exposure. The dry climate of the valley and particularly of Aosta, an area subject to drought, is ideal for guaranteeing a perfect ripening of the grapes as well as favoring the health of the grapes and the balance of all the components in the wine. The aromas are exalted by the amazing exposure and by the strong temperature excursion. This is truly “viticoltura di montagna” (mountain viticulture). Most of the work is still done by hand due to the tricky formation of the hills: very steep and rocky. No pesticides or herbicides are used. Elio cultivates two biotypes of the native Fumin variety, Macillo and Femalla, in his vineyards reaching 600m asl. The dark blue-violet color and thick skin of the berries with a warm, long maceration creates a wine with an intense color, and a rich bouquet with a hint of incense.

TITLE: Otto's Constant Dream Dry Rose
DESCRIPTION: OCD is the wine that launched Communal Brands. Inspired by Melissa Saunders’ obsessive nature about wine, her friend and business partner Chris Antista, created a wine in her honor: OCD. She applied said obsessive nature to find the right juice for our eponymous brand, ultimately finding a warm connection in her husband’s native New Zealand. The wine is produced by Hunter’s, one of the oldest and very best producers in the region. Jane Hunter is a legend and an inspiration to the brand.

TITLE: Otto's Constant Dream Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: This wine is the result of a real dream of a group of friends. The label is based on an old medical drawing of the science of phrenology, which assigned personal traits to the contours of one’s skull, with areas devoted to specific temperaments and skills. Otto is singularly contoured to think about wine constantly! OCD harks from sustainably farmed and meticulously maintained vineyards in the Awatere and Wairau Valleys of Marlborough, New Zealand. Fiona’s aim is to produce wines that are fresh and approachably fruit driven, supported by balanced structural elements, mineral driven characteristics, persistent length and elegance. Sauvignon Blanc is a quintessential white wine calling for white meats (from fish and shellfish to chicken and pork). The wine's typically crisp acidic edge and moderately medium weight does not lend itself to anything beyond that (it does not "cross over" into red meats)

TITLE: Our/New York Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Our /NewYork Vodka is partly distilled, blended, hand bottled and labeled in our micro-distillery in Manhattan. We source the finest quality and most locally available rectified spirit (corn) and blend it with highly-purified and demineralized New York City water and a grain distillate that has been fermented with a proprietary yeast that we redistill and purify in our small-batch alembic copper still system in our Chelsea distillery, giving Our/NewYork it’s unique flavor and identity.

TITLE: Outer Space Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Filtered through meteorites more than 4 billion years old, this US vodka is produced from Iowa corn and gluten free. Outerspace Vodka will turn heads this holiday season with its highly distinctive packaging.

TITLE: Oze No Yukidoke Ohkarakuchi Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: This sake has a lot of umami with a crisp finish. It is an ideal match for hearty Izakaya foods.

TITLE: Oze No Yukidoke Ohkarakuchi Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: This sake has a lot of umami with a crisp finish. It is an ideal match for hearty Izakaya foods.

TITLE: Ozeki Komo Taru
DESCRIPTION: A fresh, well balanced taste that all types of sake connoisseurs appriciate.

TITLE: Pablo Del Villar Ipsum Rueda Verdejo
DESCRIPTION: Ipsum Rueda is a wine made by Bodegas Hermanos del Villar in the Rueda DO region. Ipsum means ‘itself’ in Latin. By design, Ipsum is always un-oaked to emphasize the natural flavors of the grapes. As winemaker and proprietor Pablo del Villar explains, one sixth of Rueda’s vineyards are considered the best quality terroir; all of his vineyards are within this area. At Hermanos del Villar, the focus of the wine growing and winemaking is the personality of the place rather than the personality of the winemaker. The winemaking philosophy is to let the vineyards find direct expression, showing vibrant fruit, purity and a mineral identity. You could call Pablo’s wines “crushed liquid stones.” In English, Rueda means ‘wheel,’ similar to the big wheel on the label. Pair Verdejo with food much in the same way you might a Sauvignon Blanc. Verdejo is excellent with greens dressed in vinaigrette and other sharp ingredients such as tomatoes and olives. Fish and shellfish are also natural partners.

TITLE: Paitin "Serra" Barbera d'Alba Estate Bottled
Pajot Quatre Cepages Cotes de Gascogne
DESCRIPTION: A refreshing, dry white wine from the Cotes de Gascogne made from the four main regional varieties: 35% Sauvignon, 35% Colombard, 20% Ugni-Blanc, 10% Gros-Manseng. Delightful as an aperitif and will complement summer salads and fish recipes.

TITLE: Paladar Tempranillo Finished Reposado
DESCRIPTION: Paladar Tempranillo Finished Reposado is an exquisite, limited-edition tequila that marries the rich heritage of Mexican tequila with the sophisticated influence of Spanish wine. Crafted in Jalisco, Mexico, this reposado tequila is aged for 8 months in American oak casks before being finished in Tempranillo wine casks, imparting a unique and complex flavor profile. The result is a smooth, full-bodied tequila with the warmth of oak and the subtle fruitiness of the Tempranillo wine. Ideal for sipping or adding an elevated twist to cocktails, Paladar Tempranillo Finished Reposado offers a refined and luxurious tasting experience.

TITLE: Paladar Tequila Blanco
DESCRIPTION: Paladar Tequila Blanco is a premium, unaged tequila crafted in the heart of Jalisco, Mexico. Made from 100% blue Weber agave, this blanco tequila captures the pure and vibrant essence of the agave plant. The production process involves traditional methods, including slow cooking the agave in brick ovens and distillation in copper pot stills, ensuring a smooth and authentic flavor. Paladar Tequila Blanco is perfect for sipping neat or as a versatile ingredient in your favorite cocktails, offering a true taste of Mexican craftsmanship and tradition.

TITLE: Paladar Tequila Reposado
DESCRIPTION: Paladar Tequila Reposado is a premium, handcrafted tequila produced in the renowned region of Jalisco, Mexico. Aged for 8 months in American oak casks, this reposado tequila offers a harmonious balance of rich agave flavors with the warm, complex notes imparted by the oak barrels. The result is a smooth and well-rounded tequila perfect for sipping neat or elevating your favorite cocktails. Paladar Tequila Reposado embodies the rich tradition of Mexican tequila craftsmanship, delivering a refined and authentic tasting experience.

TITLE: Pampelonne Blood Orange Spritz 4-Pack
Pampelonne Rose Lime 4-Pack
DESCRIPTION: Pampelonne Rose Lime: the perfect union of tropical fruits and zesty citrus.

TITLE: Pampero Ron Extra Anejo Aniversario Rum
DESCRIPTION: Pampero Aniversario is a striking blend of 4-6 year old rums. Maturation in whisky and bourbon barrels have given this rum a concentrated, rich flavor while rendering it delightfully smooth. Enjoy this rum straight or over ice.

TITLE: Panama-Pacific 9 Year Old Rum
DESCRIPTION: Exposicion Panama-Pacific Rum is a Spanish-style molasses-derived rum made at the Ingenio San Carlos distillery in Panama. Production of our rum begins deep in the country’s interior, in the Provencia de Herrera region, where we harvest our sugarcane only during its optimal maturity, between the months of January and May. Once harvested, we must extract the vibrant sugarcane’s succulent juices within a short twelve-hour window in order to retain their bright, fresh sweetness. The extracted cane juices are then evaporated into a rich, delicious molasses, to which we add our own special proprietary yeasts in order to ferment the sugars over two days into a low-alcohol molasses mash which will then be strengthened through distillation. In keeping with early rum production traditions originally applied in Cuba, we then distill the molasses in our historic Coffey copper column still to a slightly lower proof than is normally achieved in other distilleries, creating our rum’s signature richer, fuller flavor and character.

TITLE: Paolina Limoncello
Paolo Marcarino Zero In Condotta Piemonte Barbera d'Asti
DESCRIPTION: Extremely versatile pairing wine or superb quaffer on it’s own. Barbera D’ Asti matches especially well with meats and Cheeses. Try Italian cheeses such as Pecorino, Piave and Mascarpone.

TITLE: Paolo Marcarino Zero In Condotta Spumante Extra Dry
DESCRIPTION: Organic Wine No Sulfites Added Excellent as aperitif, this wine combines perfectly with delicate dishes and fish appetisers.

TITLE: Paolo Palumbo Rosso Vivace
DESCRIPTION: Grapes are trained using the traditional pergola system on steep volcanic slopes outside the village of Lettere, south of Naples. Grapes are vinified separately to make the base wine, blended and finished using the charmat method. The wine is off-dry, the preferred style for generations in Neapolitan homes and restaurants. Ideal with pizza Napoletana. Rosso Vivace is not DOC designated, allowing Paolo Palumbo to reduce costs by sourcing some fruit from vineyards outside the Lettere zone. Perfect pairing to margherita pizza or pork chops.

TITLE: Papas Pilar Legacy Edition 2021 Dark Rum Finish in Rye Whiskey Barrels
DESCRIPTION: In celebration of a legacy so rich and multi-faceted, Papa’s Pilar Rum is releasing the first annual Legacy Edition 2021. This commemorative dark rum blend of 9 different ultra premium rums, crafted by Papa’s Pilar Rum’s Master Blender & Distiller Ron Call, is finished in a double solera process using Rye Whiskey barrels and Amontillado Sherry casks. The dark rum blend boasts personality and creativity with a profoundly smooth and rich finish. As the first annual Legacy Edition release, the 2021 Edition will feature an authentic, pure leather retrofitted canteen wrap around the bottle honoring the bottle’s WWII canteen format – a true collector’s item. Papa Hemingway was a world-renowned author, hall-of-fame angler, big game hunter, epic storyteller and simple put, was always on the front lines of adventure. He inspires us to live a life worth narrating while making our mark. Crafted to harness his spirit of adventure and appetite for greatness, every sip of this release honors Papa’s legacy – because a life well-lived is the only life worth living.

TITLE: Paper Bag
Papras Bio Wines  Pleiades Tyrnavos
Parker Station Central Coast Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: We like to think of Pinot Noir as a catch-all food pairing wine. Pinot Noir is light enough for salmon but complex enough to hold up to some richer meat including duck. In a pinch, when everyone orders a vastly different entree at a restaurant, you can usually win by picking Pinot Noir; it will make everyone happy.

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection "Double Barreled Blend" Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey (Release #16)
DESCRIPTION: This 16th limited edition collection from Heaven Hill consists of two Kentucky straight bourbon whiskeys made with HH's traditional mash bill (78% corn, 10% rye, 12% malted barley). One, which represents 67% of the blend, was aged for 13 years before then being re-barreled into new, charred American oak barrels with a level 3 char. It finished its maturation there for four weeks. That lot was then blended with a 15 year-old bourbon which makes up the remaining 33% of the bottling. It's bottled without chill-filtration at barrel proof (132.2). Heaven Hill will donate a portion of the proceeds to support ALS research and patient care In honor of the late Master Distiller Parker Beam.

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection "Promise of Hope" Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey (Release #7)
DESCRIPTION: Those looking for some sort of statement whiskey, some sort of novelty (finishes, old old barrels, etc), are going to miss what this whiskey is all about – a simple and supremely balanced bourbon. Much like the man himself, the 2013 Parker’s is razor sharp in spots but always composed – almost elegant. This is delicious 10 year old single barrel bourbon bottled at a near perfect proof. In fact, if Heaven Hill is listening, we’d like to see the Evan Williams Single Barrel pushing closer to this proof point. Very well done! Sour Mash Manifesto Rating: 9.4 (Superb)

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection 10 Year Old Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey (Release #17)
DESCRIPTION: Parker's Heritage Collection 10 Year Old Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey is a tribute to the art of fine whiskey-making and a homage to Parker Beam's legacy at Heaven Hill. This special edition, aged for a decade, stands as a testament to the timeless craft of producing exceptional rye whiskey. Crafted in limited quantities, this rye whiskey is a rare find, offering a deep, immersive experience into the world of cask strength spirits. Parker's Heritage Collection 10-Year-Old Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey is not just a drink; it's a sensory journey through the heart of Kentucky's whiskey tradition. Each bottle captures the essence of rye whiskey at its best, making it an ideal choice for connoisseurs and collectors alike. Enjoy it neat or with a splash of water to appreciate its bold character and intricate flavors fully.

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection 10 Year Old Cognac Barrel Finish Bourbon (Release #5)
DESCRIPTION: 5th release in Parker's Heritage Collection is a 10-year-old bourbon (with rye as the small flavoring grain, not wheat) that had been finished in massive Grande Champagne Cognac barrels from Frapin Cellars in France. The bourbon used is the same recipe as Heaven Hill’s Evan Williams Single Barrel bourbon. This bourbon is aged high in the upper levels of the rickhouse where temperature exchange is greatest. Once the barrels are dumped, the bourbon was placed in the cognac barrels for another four months (the label says six but Parker confirms it was actually four) high up in the aging racks.

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection 10 Year Old Heavy Char Bourbon (Release #14)
DESCRIPTION: The 14th edition continues the interaction of barrel char across varying mashbills, this time with Heaven Hill’s traditional Bourbon mashbill of 78% corn, 12% malted barley and 10% rye. Aged in heavy char (Level 5) barrels, as opposed to the customary Level 3 for Heaven Hill, the resulting flavors carry intensified notes of the traditional Bourbon. Consisting of 102 barrels aged on the sixth floor of rickhouse Y for 10 years, the heavy char brings forth a caramel and maple sweetness, as well as slight smokiness developed after 40 Kentucky seasons in the barrel. The second heavy char edition of the series advances the study of how a more intense char allows the liquid to penetrate deeper into each barrel stave and the effects on the resulting flavor. Bottled at 120 proof (60% abv) and non-chill filtered to preserve all the flavor compounds, this Bourbon showcases the broad range of Heaven Hill Distillery’s 1.8 million barrels of aging inventory.

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection 10 Year Old Wheated Bourbon (Release #4)
DESCRIPTION: Heaven Hill has released 4th release in Parker's Heritage Collection at barrel proof and non-chill filtered, which makes this a special bottling. As in past releases, the 10-year-old Wheated Bourbon edition is being offered in very limited quantities—52 total barrels were dumped for a national release that will only yield about 4,800 750ml bottles. The barrels used for this release were pulled from the fourth, sixth and seventh floors of our Rickhouse A, where they have rested since the summer of 2000.

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection 11 Year-Old Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey (Release #11)
DESCRIPTION: 2017 release, #11 in the series

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection 13 Year Original Batch Wheat Whiskey (Release #8)
DESCRIPTION: Parker's Heritage collection is a series of rare, limited edition American Whiskeys offered as a tribute to sixth-generation Master Distiller Parker Beam for his more than five decades of crafting exceptional Whiskeys. The eighth edition of Parker’s Heritage Collection features 13-year-old straight wheat whiskey, bottled at cask strength and non-chill filtered. The barrels used for this offering were from the very first run of what later would become Bernheim Original Straight Wheat Whiskey. With a minimum of 51% soft winter wheat in the mashbill or grain recipe, Bernheim is the only straight wheat whiskey produced by a major American distiller and has been available since 2005. For this reason, this Parker’s Heritage Collection release has been dubbed “Original Batch Kentucky Straight Wheat Whiskey”.

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection 24 Year-Old Bottled-in-Bond Bourbon (Release #10)
DESCRIPTION: The uniqueness of this bottling lies not only in its age, but also in its Bottled-in-Bond designation. Bottled-in-Bonds, as they are referred, have experienced renewed interest by consumers because of the long and storied history behind such a designation. Offering the most Bottled-in-Bond labels of any distiller, Heaven Hill helped to maintain this sub-category during leaner years and, more recently, has fueled interest in it with the launch of several new Bottled-in-Bond bottlings, including the newest edition of Parker’s Heritage Collection. The 24-year-old, Bottled-in-Bond will be shipping into select markets across the country beginning in September. The 2016 edition, the tenth in the series, features two separate versions of the Bottled-in-Bond product, is the oldest Bottled-in-Bond in the world. It was produced in Fall 1990 and Spring 1991 at Heaven Hill’s distillery in Bardstown, KY, (D.S.P. KY-31), which was later destroyed in 1996 by fire along with seven rickhouses and over 90,000 barrels. The liquid is bottled by season in order to retain its Bottled-in-Bond designation. While Heaven Hill now produces its award-winning Bourbon and American Whiskey out of the Bernheim Distillery in downtown Louisville, this Parker’s Heritage Collection edition will feature the original distillery designation on the back label, making it a worthy successor to the previous nine releases.

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection 27 Year Old Small Batch Bourbon (Release #2)
DESCRIPTION: One of the most astonishing bourbons you'll ever try. One of the most extraordinary bourbons you'll ever try. It was made in memory of Parker Beam - a member of the Beam family who had been in the industry for over 50 years. John Hansell even went so far as to award this stunning 27-year-old bourbon 95 points!

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection Aged 8 Years Kentucky Straight Malt Whiskey (Release #9)
DESCRIPTION: The 2015 Parker’s Heritage Collection release from Heaven Hill Distilleries features a straight malt whiskey that was distilled back in 2006. Distilled from a mashbill that was 65% malt and 35% corn, the whiskey was created by Co-Master Distiller Craig Beam in late 2006. Denny Potter, Heaven Hill’s other Co-Master Distiller selected the 141 barrels that were used for what is the 9th version of this annual series from the 5th and 7th floors of Rickhouse Y located in Bardstown, Kentucky. The Parker’s Heritage Collection was started in 2007 but took on a new meaning in 2013 when the special whiskey’s namesake, Parker Beam, announced he had been diagnosed with ALS. Since then, each release has taken on the mission to raise money and awareness for ALS research. Close to $500,000 has already been donated to ALS research programs and $5 from every sale of this year’s release will also be given to similar charities. Parker’s Heritage Kentucky Straight Malt Whiskey is bottled at 108 proof and comes with a suggested retail price of $99.99. It’s not been through a “chill filtration” which should allow the whiskey to retain more of the natural esters and fatty acids and Heaven Hill believes will lead to a “richer mouthfeel”.

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection Barrel Finished Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey (Release #12)
DESCRIPTION: The 2018 edition showcases the versatility of Heaven Hill’s 1.4 million aging barrels, which is the world’s second-largest inventory of its kind, and will hit shelves this September. For this limited-edition, Bourbon was aged seven to eight years in the upper floors of Rickhouse Q, and then aged for an additional four months in barrels that previously held French orange curaçao liqueur. It was bottled at 110 proof (55% abv) and non-chill filtered to preserve all the flavor compounds. The orange curaçao finish lends a unique flavor that complements the Bourbon without overpowering it, creating an entirely new and elegant tasting experience.

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection Blend Of Mashbills Bourbon (Release #6)
DESCRIPTION: This is the superb 2012 release of Parker's Heritage Bourbon - a mix of some of Heaven Hill's best styles including rye- and wheat-based whiskey. The result of this is rich, buttery and full of spice.

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection Cask Strength Bourbon (Release #1)
DESCRIPTION: 1996 bourbon that has mellowed over 48 Kentucky seasons on the fifth floor of Rickhouse Y in Bardstown. The bottling was drawn from a lot of 68 carefully selected barrels, which were dumped in three "very small batches" of 22, 22, and 24 barrels each. The bourbon is then dumped at barrel-proof marking the first time that Heaven Hill has released a barrel-proof bourbon in the U.S. This cask-strength whiskey will only fill about 6,400 750 ml bottles, and the proofs of the three batches range from 122.6 to 130.9. Parker Beam personally selected these barrels for their superb nose, robust flavor and long smooth finish.

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection Golden Anniversary Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey (Release #3)
DESCRIPTION: 2009 American Whiskey of the year! Malt Advocate. John Hansell says "This is a fabulous whiskey; seamless, incredibly complex, with a perfect marriage of youth and maturity. It’s also very even-keeled throughout entirely different than last year’s equally impressive Parker’s Heritage Collection bottling, a 27-year-old, whose personality was more like an exhilarating old wooden rollercoaster ride (and also brandished more oak). The Golden Anniversary bottling shows candied citrus, nectarine, blueberry, and Sultana anchored by a nougat center and laced with honeyed vanilla and orange creamsicle. There’s a dusting of cocoa powder, brittle mint, and cinnamon, too! Tobacco leaves, polished leather, and teasing bourbon barrel char round out the palate, emerging more prominently toward its warming finish. This is a classic bourbon that’s very complex, yet very drinkable." This unbelievable whiskey is composite of bourbons from throughout Parker Beam's legendary career, that's 50 years of bourbon in one bottle, so don't miss it. (David Girard) 95 points Wine Enthusiast: "Extremely well balanced--it's complicated, but no single element stands out. Flavors are of caramel, burnt orange peel, toastiness, and oak. Medium body, silky and long finish, with the right amount of bite, lingering aniseed note. Highly versatile."

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection Heavy Char Barrels Aged 11 Years Wheat Whiskey (Release #15)
DESCRIPTION: The 15th edition of Parker's Heritage Collection features the same mashbill as Bernheim Wheat Whiskey, but aged in specialty barrels that were charred for 90 seconds, as opposed to our traditional 40 seconds. Continuing the award-winning series of heavy char releases, these "Level 5" barrels were aged for a full 11 years, where the heavier char allowed the whiskey to penetrate further into the barrel, bringing forth honey and subtle cinnamon spice. The 75 barrels reached peak maturation on the sixth floor of Rickhouse Y. It is bottled without chill filtration at 122 proof. Developed by Heaven Hill Distillery’s own Master Distillers, Wheat Whiskey is the first new style of American Whiskey to be introduced since Prohibition

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection Heavy Char Barrels Aged 8 Years Rye Whiskey (Release #13)
DESCRIPTION: The first ever Rye Whiskey of the Parker's Heritage Collection, the 13th edition consists of 75 specialty barrels that were charred for a full minute and a half, as opposed to our traditional 40 seconds. These "Level 5" barrels were aged for 8 years, 9 months on the seventh floor of Rickhouse Y. There, the heavier char allowed the whiskey to penetrate further into the barrel, extracting deep notes of spice and wood, and resulting in an elevation of the spicy, distinctive character of our traditional Rye Whiskey mashbill. It is bottled without chill filtration at 105 proof.

TITLE: Parker's Heritage Collection Set (Releases 1 - 17)
DESCRIPTION: The gang is all here!

TITLE: Partida Creus MUZ Vermouth
DESCRIPTION: A 100% certified organic vermouth made naturally by two Italians in Spain. Trained as architects, Massimo Marchiori and Antonella Gerona moved from Barcelona to Massis de Bonastre and began organically farming abandoned vineyards filled with old vines of local varieties. A blend of multiple styles of red and white wine and a mix of botanicals from a Torino based herbalist the vermut comes in at a lower abv than typical with the elevated acidity lending extra lift to the perfumed spices on the aroma and refreshing cut on the palate. An extremely drinkable everyday style of fortified wine.

TITLE: Pascal Jolivet Sancerre Rose
DESCRIPTION: The Sancerre Rose is made with 100% Pinot Noir and is a blend of direct press and "saignee" production methods. Pascal Jolivet practices a minimalist winemaking style, allowing nature to take it's course. It is produced using exclusively native yeasts, and entirely in temperature stainless steel. All parcels are vinified separately until final blending and bottling.

TITLE: Pascal Pibaleau La Perlette Sparkling Rose
DESCRIPTION: Pascal lives a biodynamic lifestyle, from tending his vines to making his wines to preparing his meals. Always curious, he loves to explore the possibilities of what off-beat varieties like old-vine Gamay, Grolleau and Cot can do in his hilly appelation, Azay-le-Rideau. He is making gorgeously pure red, white and bubbly wines from vines planted when his great-grandfather returned home after the war. Certified Biodynamic.

TITLE: Passopisciaro Sicilia Scinniri
DESCRIPTION: From winemaker Andrea Franchetti: "Mount Etna rises through layers of increasingly cold air, higher than the Dolomites. Every night this air slides along the black dust to the vineyards and subjects them to a sudden swing in temperature, which first paralyzes them at first, and then makes them distil sugars and altered, distorted aromas, deviated from what would normally come from the metabolism of a normal Sicilian plant. It's best to do one's viticulture in climatic strangeness, in a pristine and deserted place where one can find powerful images. A winemaker can court these images for years without fully understanding them; in the meantime, he transmits a completely original style to his wines".

TITLE: Patient Cottat Le Grand Caillou Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Great for quaffing at a party with canapés and appetizers. It will also embellish white fish with a light cream sauce or tuna carpaccio.

TITLE: Patron Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Patrón Añejo combines a variety of tequilas all aged in small white oak barrels for at least 12 months. Similar to winemaking, each vintage of Patrón Añejo is carefully blended to produce a smooth and sweet tasting tequila perfect for sipping. Each bottle is numbered by hand and crafted from recycled glass.

TITLE: Patron Reposado Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Patron Reposado is handcrafted from the finest 100% Weber Blue Agave and is carefully distilled in small batches at Hacienda Patrón distillery in Jalisco, Mexico. It’s then aged in a variety of barrels for three to five months.

TITLE: Patron Silver Tequila
DESCRIPTION: The perfect white spirit made from the finest Weber Blue Agave.

DESCRIPTION: The perfect white spirit made from the finest Weber Blue Agave.
