TITLE: Paul Bernard Brut
Paul Cheneau Cava Brut Rose
DESCRIPTION: Giro Ribot is Spain’s preeminent family owned and operated producer of Cava. The Giro Ribot portfolio encompasses two distinct brands; Cava Paul Cheneau and Cava Masia Parera. Giro Ribot is situated at the heart of the Appellation d’Origine Penedes. This beautiful area of Catalonnia, halfway between the cities of Barcelona and Tarragona, is bordered to the south by the Mediterranean Sea and to the north by the spectatular and remarkable solid mass of Montserrat. Brunch fare, sushi, or fruit tarts.

TITLE: Paul Jaboulet Aine Cotes du Rhone Rouge Parallele 45
DESCRIPTION: This Cotes du Rhone takes its name from the 45th North parallel which runs two kilometres from the cellars of Maison Paul Jaboulet Aine In the village of Pont de l’Isere, a monument symbolises this line with the inscription: “the South begins here”. The wine has had this name since the beginning of the 1950s. 60% Grenache ; 40% Syrah. Grilled/roasted meats, Pot au feu, Cheese

TITLE: Paul Sutton Bourbon Heritage Collection Release
DESCRIPTION: Paul Sutton Bourbon Heritage Collection Release is a highly sought-after bourbon whiskey that showcases the rich heritage of Kentucky's bourbon-making traditions. This exceptional bourbon is crafted with a high-rye mash bill, resulting in a complex and full-bodied flavor profile. With a proof of 100, this bourbon is perfect for those who appreciate a strong, bold whiskey. As part of the Heritage Collection, this release is a testament to the craftsmanship and dedication of the distillers who have perfected the art of bourbon-making over generations. The bourbon is aged to perfection, allowing the oak and vanilla notes to mature and blend harmoniously with the spicy rye flavors.

TITLE: Pavillon Deneurieux Cotes Du Rhone
Pedralonga Rias Baixas Albarino Serea
DESCRIPTION: Produced in the scenic Rias Baixas region of Spain, Pedralonga's Albariño Serea is a true testament to the region's capacity for producing high-quality Albariño. Pedralonga, known for its organic and biodynamic practices, brings forth this wine that perfectly captures the essence of its coastal terroir. With its vibrant acidity, expressive fruit character, and subtle mineral undertones, the Albariño Serea paints a delightful portrait of the Rias Baixas region. The Pedralonga Rias Baixas Albariño Serea pairs excellently with a range of dishes. Its vibrant acidity and fruity profile make it a great partner for seafood, particularly shellfish like clams, mussels, or a seafood paella. Light poultry dishes, such as grilled chicken with a zesty lemon-herb sauce, also pair well with the wine's refreshing character. For a vegetarian pairing, a summer salad featuring fresh greens, citrus, and goat cheese complements the wine's fruit-forward and crisp profile. Finally, a cheese board featuring mild cheeses, such as Brie or fresh goat cheese, harmonizes beautifully with the wine's balance of fruit and acidity.

TITLE: Peerless Double Oak Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Double Oak was born of a happy accident when a leaky barrel forced the distilling team to transfer its liquid to a new charred oak barrel. Exposure to that second barrel gave the whiskey amped-up flavors and lots more complexity. This is a bourbon that has gone into overdrive, and it handles the road just fine. Its syrupy sweet texture is checked by the oak influence, and the palate opens to flavors aplenty—dried peaches, warm apple pie, Christmas spice, gingerbread, raisin cake, chocolate, and pumpkin purée. Perfect as a holiday warmer or a backyard barbecue sipper, this is a whiskey for all seasons

TITLE: Peerless Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: #15 on Whisky Advocate "Top 20 Whiskies of 2017" list. Kentucky Peerless Distilling Co. has released their first Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey in 100 years. It’s a non-chill filtered, sweet mash rye bottled at barrel strength with no water added.

TITLE: Peerless Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: #15 on Whisky Advocate "Top 20 Whiskies of 2017" list. Kentucky Peerless Distilling Co. has released their first Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey in 100 years. It’s a non-chill filtered, sweet mash rye bottled at barrel strength with no water added.

TITLE: Peerless Small Batch Kentucky Straight  Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Kentucky Peerless Distilling Company is releasing its first bourbon in 102 years. After beginning barreling in March of 2015, the Taylor family has been patiently crafting one barrel at a time making fine rye and bourbon. Corky Taylor, fourth generation and CEO, has been breathing life back into his great-grandfather's legacy that originally started in 1889. Over 10 decades have passed since Peerless Bourbon has been sold and the Peerless four-year-old product will be the first Peerless Bourbon available without a prescription since Prohibition.

TITLE: Peg Leg Porker 12 Years Tennessee Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: If anybody should get how to source a quality whiskey, it is a good barbecue pitmaster. One of the best is said to be Carey Bringle of Peg Leg Porker out of Nashville, Tennessee. The new Peg Leg Porker Tennessee Straight Bourbon Whiskey 12-Year-Oldfollows on the heels of two previous expressions, including an 8-year-old released last year which won a gold medal at the 2016 San Francisco Spirits Competition. The latest bottling, sourced from an undisclosed distillery, was aged a dozen years in new charred oak barrels before being filtered through what’s described as Bringle’s “signature filtering technique.” As to what specifically this technique is, Bringle told us in our interview with him that the whiskey is filtered through hickory charcoal he had burned down in the same smoker where he cooks whole hogs. This is somewhat different then the more traditional Lincoln County process for Tennessee whiskey, in that Peg Leg is filtered before bottling and also that the hickory is used instead of sugar maple coal. “This 12-year old is something very special,” said Bringle in a prepared statement. “After the whiskey is taken from its barrels, it is filtered through hickory creating our signature flavor and color. We continue to grow our men’s lifestyle brand and this new premium whiskey is essential to our brand’s growth.”

TITLE: Peg Leg Porker 15 Years Limited Edition Tennessee Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The first pitmaster to start a bourbon brand, Carey Bringle is releasing the most ambitious Peg Leg Porker bourbon to date. Pitmaster Reserve is a 15-year-old Tennessee Straight Bourbon that the non-distiller producer finished through hickory charcoal to help provide its signature smokiness. The 90 proof bourbon is limited to just 2,500 bottles in total and arrives packaged in a satin-lined wooden box with a Peg Leg pig stopper.

TITLE: Peg Leg Porker 8 Year Old Tennessee Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This limited edition rye is distilled and aged in Tennessee and is a 95% Rye and 5% Malted Barley mash bill. This expression contains Peg Leg Porker's signature Hickory Charcoal finishing process after it is de-barreled. Bottled at 105 proof, the rye gives off a peppery nose with a smooth finish more reminiscent of a 90 proof.

TITLE: Peg Leg Porker 8 Years Tennessee Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Peg Leg Porker is a BBQ restaurant located in Nashville, TN owned by Pitmaster Carey Bringle who lost his leg to cancer at a young age; hence the name. Bringle says, after the whiskey is taken from its barrels, it is filtered through hickory creating the signature flavor and color. BBQ fans and bourbon fans will love this whiskey. 8+ year whiskey, 8 year age statement on the label.

TITLE: Peg Leg Porker Tennessee Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the authentic flavors of Tennessee with the Peg Leg Porker Tennessee Straight Bourbon, a signature bourbon curated by the Award-Winning Pitmaster Carey Bringle. This bourbon embodies a rich southern barbecue and whiskey tradition, uniting them in a bottle that's as charismatic as the Pitmaster himself. Peg Leg Porker Bourbon is not just a whiskey; it's a tribute to the hearty culture of Tennessee, reflecting a deep love for bourbon and its perfect pairing with BBQ. This Peg Leg Porker Bourbon, aged in virgin charred oak barrels, is a blend of 4-6 years boubrons bottled without an age statement

TITLE: Peirson Meyer Russian River Valley Pinot Noir
Pendulum Columbia Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: An ideal expression from Washington’s Columbia Valley, balanced to perfection. People. Place. Purpose. Pendulum. Pair with grilled meats, vegetables, or simply enjoy by the glass

TITLE: Penelope Architect Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Architect is the new blueprint for precision blending. The first build in this series combines our signature four grain mash bill with two styles of French oak staves. Working in collaboration with Tonnellerie Radoux of France, the market leader in oak barrel manufacturing and innovation, we selected each stave using their state-of-the-art OakScan process to construct a truly memorable flavor profile. After all, the best architecture leaves no room for error.

TITLE: Penelope Architect Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #78
DESCRIPTION: Penelope Architect Straight Bourbon is a unique four-grain bourbon finished with French Oak Staves. It features a blend of three bourbon mash bills finished with two different types of French Oak Staves, offering a delicate balance of flavors. This bourbon is aged for 5 years and typically bottled at 104 proof. However, ours was bottled at 110 proof as a private single barrel selection. It's a non-chill-filtered bourbon, showcasing a meticulous process to preserve its rich flavors and aromas. We loved this barrel from the first sip! The French oak staves weren’t in the barrel for too long, so it didn’t come across as overly done—just a subtle enhancement to an already delicious barrel. Best Architect we’ve ever tried.

TITLE: Penelope Bourbon "Simply Pe" Toasted Series Barrel Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #45
DESCRIPTION: Our first-ever Penelope barrel selection is here! The barrel we selected was a part of our second barrel-picking expedition with our fellow members earlier this year. It comes from the Penelope Toasted Series Barrel Strength Bourbon line. Bourbon clocks at 118 proof. To celebrate its "hotness," we dubbed it "Simply Pe," after a nickname of an equally hot actress bearing the same name. Barrel details: Barrel #1806 116 Proof Char Level: 5 Heavy (the highest char level there is at Penelope) Nose: Toffee, citrus, pinenuts, toasted oak, rolling tobaccoPalate: Citrus, hazelnut skin, caramelFinish: Black peppercorn, leather

TITLE: Penelope Bourbon "The Prime Cut" Toasted Series Barrel Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #56
DESCRIPTION: Premium membership exclusive. Super short yield, as this was a half barrel with a high angel share. Then the brand used some of it for its purposes. We stumbled upon it while tasting different options at their facility in the summer of 2022 and could not pass it up.Barrel 2052 Proof: 115 Nose: Campfire, burnt sugar, tanning hide, bruised green applePalate: Spicy, caramel, apple pie, clove, all-spiceFinish: Cinnamon and pink peppercorn Interested in becoming a member? Start here: https://membership.primebarrel.com

TITLE: Penelope Cooper Series Rio Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Penelope Rio is a unique offering in the Cooper Series by Penelope Bourbon, taking their straight whiskeys on a global tour with distinctive cask finishes. This bourbon features a double cask finish in American honey and Brazilian oak barrels inspired by the vibrancy of Brazil. Blending these casks results in a playful and delicious profile characterized by notes of honeysuckle, raisin, coffee cake, ripe banana, cinnamon, rum raisin ice cream, and Big Red gum. The 4-6-year-old bourbon is bottled at 98 proof, offering a rich, sweet experience with a surprisingly deep character.

TITLE: Penelope Founders Reserve 15 Year Old American Light Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Penelope Founders Reserve 15 Year Old American Light Whiskey represents a remarkable expression in the world of light whiskeys. Distilled from corn at Seagrams Indiana in 2007 or 2008 (sources vary slightly on the distillation year), this whiskey is aged in 2nd fill oak barrels. This aging process imparts unique characteristics to the whiskey, making it a noteworthy addition to any collection.

TITLE: Penelope Four Grain Barrel Strength Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Penelope Bourbon is a blend of 3 bourbon mash bills sourced from MGP Ingredients, Inc. comprised of four grains (Corn, Wheat, Rye, and Malted Barley. The Barrel Strength expression was released by popular demand for those whiskey lovers that wanted to enjoy Penelope Bourbon in its purest form.

TITLE: Penelope Four Grain Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Penelope Bourbon is a blend of 3 bourbon mash bills sourced from MGP Ingredients, Inc. comprised of four grains (Corn, Wheat, Rye, and Malted Barley. While most bourbons keep getting higher and higher in proof, Penelope is proofed down to 80 so everyone can enjoy a lighter, easy-drinking bourbon on a regular basis.

TITLE: Penelope Private Select Aged 9 Years Barrel Strength Blend of Straight Bourbon Whiskeys
DESCRIPTION: Penelope Private Select Aged 9 Years Barrel Strength is an exclusive blend of the three traditional bourbon mash bills of Penelope Bourbon, featuring a combination of Corn, Wheat, Rye, and Malted Barley. Distilled in Indiana and Kentucky and aged in charred new American oak barrels, this straight bourbon whiskey is bottled at 109 proof. It uniquely expresses Penelope Bourbon's four-grain straight bourbon whiskey, highlighting the best barrels from their inventory through a meticulous hand-selection process.

TITLE: Penelope Private Select Barrel Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Penelope Bourbon Private Select explores new and unique expressions of their signature four-grain straight bourbon whiskey. Every Private Select is an exclusive blend of the three bourbon mash bills they traditionally use. The barrels selected for Private Select are the best their inventory has to offer and go through an extensive hand-selection process – making each batch truly special and unique.

TITLE: Penelope Rose Cask Finish Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Penelope Rose Cask Finish is part of our Cooper Series (Cask Finishes) and one of our annual limited releases. We’ve married our signature four grain blend of three bourbon mash bills with hand-selected French Grenache Rose Wine Casks from the Southern Rhône region to bring together a truly unique alliance of flavor.

TITLE: Penelope Toasted Series Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Penelope Bourbon Toasted Series explores explores new and unique expressions of our signature four grain straight bourbon whiskey. After full maturation in charred new American oak barrels, we finish Penelope Bourbon in a new, freshly toasted barrel.

TITLE: Penelope Toasted Series Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Embrace the charm of Penelope Toasted Series Straight Rye Whiskey, a testament to innovation and the serendipitous beauty of toasted barrel finishes. Crafted meticulously, this 100-proof rye whiskey undergoes full maturation in charred new American oak barrels before being finished in freshly toasted barrels. The unique process imbues the whiskey with an unparalleled depth of flavor, offering a distinctive tasting experience that's both rich and complex. Celebrate the spirit of exploration with Penelope's first foray into toasted barrel finishes, a true, one-of-a-kind addition to any whiskey connoisseur's collection.

TITLE: Penelope Tokaji Cask Finish Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Tokaji Cask Finish is the latest installment in our Cooper Series which takes our straight whiskeys on a world tour, pairing Penelope with wine casks from the finest wine making regions.

TITLE: Penelope Valencia Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Vino de Naranja Casks
DESCRIPTION: Penelope Bourbon Cooper Series explores the marriage of different cask finishes with our signature four grain straight bourbon whiskey. Rich and bold on the palate, Valencia brings forward rich citrus flavors from the coasts of Spain. Valencia is finished in Vino de Naranja casks and bottled at 97 proof.

TITLE: Penley Estate "Mythology Series" Phoenix Coonawarra Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: A cool growing season and above average winter rains leading into the 2017 vintage saw the region return to what could be best described as a more traditional Coonawarra vintage. Harvest commenced late March and continued through to early May. Coonawarra has not had a vintage which commenced this late since the outstanding 2004 vintage.

TITLE: Pepperwood Grove Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: For over 20 years, we've offered an innovative collection of versatile wines that deliver an exceptional balance of quality and value, wines that are perfect for celebrating the extraordinary in every day. Pepperwood Grove embraces the négociant model of winemaking, scouring the world's best growing regions to find just the right fruit to transform into true crowd-pleasing wines. We've been recognized again and again for our efforts with Wine Enthusiast "Best Buy" awards and "Best Value" accolades from Wine Spectator

TITLE: Per Ora Prosecco
DESCRIPTION: This is classic Prosecco in a classic package made for us by our friends at Botter. It has ripe pear and green apple fruit balanced by a refreshing acidity is fully sparkling which makes it a great option for serving by the glass or even mixing into Bellinis.

TITLE: Pernod Anise Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: With over 200 years of history, Pernod is the oldest French brand of anise spirits. Famous since 1805 for its spirits with extracts of absinthe, much appreciated by artists and poets, a century later it confirmed its success with Pernod anise spirit, an aperitif based on star anise with a fresh, original flavour. Refreshing drinks with a taste full of history.

TITLE: Perrier-Jouet Champagne Grand Brut
DESCRIPTION: Perrier-Jouët Grand Brut is a melting pot of aromas and flavours – a wonderfully rounded, generous champagne whose joie de vivre makes every moment more special.

TITLE: Perrini Salento Negroamaro
DESCRIPTION: 100% Negroamaro. Perrini's Negroamarro comes from estate vines averaging 30 to 35 years old, with some getting up to 60 years, with full southern exposure on flat and slightly hilly sites. The soils are a mix of sand, limestone and clay, with a rockier nature on the slightly higher-elevation sites. The farming is certified organic. The well-ripened but not overly ripened fruit is harvested by hand into small baskets and whisked to the winery to cool down. The grapes are pressed and the juice fermented in stainless steel tanks with natural yeasts with the maceration lasting 12-14 days. The wine is aged in steel tank.

TITLE: Pessoa de Vinha Summer Wine Vinho Verde
DESCRIPTION: A blend of Alvarinho, Trajadura, Loureiro sourced from vineyards mainly in the renowned zones of Monccao and Melgacco. Classic all-tank Vinho Verde vinification.

TITLE: Pessoa de Vinha Vinho Verde
DESCRIPTION: A blend of Alvarinho, Trajadura, Loureiro sourced from vineyards mainly in the renowned zones of Moncao and Melgacco. Classic all-tank Vinho Verde vinification.

TITLE: Peter Lauer Riesling Barrel X
Peychaud's Bitters
DESCRIPTION: Peychaud's Bitters is a bitters distributed by the Sazerac Company. It was originally created around 1830 by Antoine Amédée Peychaud, a Creole apothecary from the French colony of Saint-Domingue who settled in New Orleans, Louisiana in 1795.

TITLE: Philippe Chevarin Le Decrue Rose
Philippe Chevarin Rouge Le Detour
DESCRIPTION: Starting with two hectares in 2014 Phillipe now finds himself with about five hectares of vines. Two thirds of the production grown is Melon de Bourgogne, while Gamay, Grolleau and a bit or Cabernet Sauvignon round out the lineup. The wines are bottled as Vin de France, but would fall under Muscadet-Coteaux-de-la-Loire for the white and Coteaux d'Ancenis for the reds if under the appellation system. The vines are worked organically, and in Ecocert conversion. Phillipe is the first to admit he is completely new to winemaking, and is still learning his craft. From his first vintage in 2015, he aims to make wines as simply as possible. All the wines are vinified in fiberglass tanks and go through malo. So far he has succeeded in not adding any sulfur at any point during winemaking or bottling, but is not against it if he feels the wines will benefit from it.

TITLE: Pian delle Querci Rosso di Montalcino
Piasa Sanmaurizio Moscato D'Asti D.O.C.G.
DESCRIPTION: Elevate your indulgence with Piasa Sanmaurizio Moscato D'Asti D.O.C.G., an exquisite Italian white wine originating from the prestigious Piedmont region. Meticulously crafted by Piasa Sanmaurizio, this Moscato is a delightful expression of the region's winemaking prowess, boasting the coveted D.O.C.G. designation.

TITLE: Picayune Cellars Mendocino County Hay Penny Rose
DESCRIPTION: Picayune Cellars was Started in 2011 by Jennifer Roberts and Claire Weinkauf. They arrived around the same time in the Sonoma Valley. Both share a joint passion for amazing wines and delicious food. Realizing that it often means breaking the bank in the Sonoma and Napa Valleys, they pursue the idea that with a négociant business model they can work hard to craft wines of outstanding quality that can be delivered at an exciting price point. This has been the promise of Picayune Wines since 2011. In 2016, Jennifer decided to focus on her family business and Claire bought her out. She remains a great friend and a sounding board in Picayune growth. Drink on its own or pair with a salad or grilled dish!

TITLE: Pielihueso Naranjo Los Chacayes
DESCRIPTION: This white blend from Argentina has Torrontes, Sauvignon Blanc, and Chardonnay in its makeup. They are fermented and macerated with their skins for 3 weeks; making this a complex, strongly citrus wine. Perfect for anyone who wants a slightly funky, orange wine, with lots of character.

TITLE: Pielihueso Primero Blanco Los Chacayes
DESCRIPTION: Embark on a sensory journey with Pielihueso Primero Blanco, a captivating white blend from the prestigious Los Chacayes region in Mendoza, Argentina. Crafted by the innovative Pielihueso winery, this organic wine reflects a commitment to sustainable viticulture and minimal intervention. The Primero Blanco is a unique blend of indigenous and international grape varieties, carefully selected to showcase the purity and vibrancy of the terroir. With its fresh and aromatic profile, this wine is perfect for those who appreciate the artistry of modern Argentine winemaking.

TITLE: Piero Mancini Vermentino di Gallura
DESCRIPTION: The Piero Mancini winery has been a benchmark producer of Vermentino di Gallura for over thirty years. The winery is located near the port of Olbia in the northwest of Sardegna near the chic beach resort area of the Costa Smeralda. Alessandro Mancini currently runs the winery along with his brother Antonio and sister Laura though it was their father, Piero, who founded the estate. Piero was born in the Gallura area, though after university, he moved to the south of Sardegna where he worked as a dentist. Throughout those years he maintained a foothold in the Gallura area – planting his first vineyards in the 1960’s and gaining important experience from other important wineries nearby. He eventually purchased 70 hectares of vineyards in the 1970’s. In the mid 90’s he followed his dream and retired as a dentist and moved back home full time. Though it wasn’t until 1989 that he finally opened the current winery. Today the family owns about 100 hectares split between three parcels from the heart of the Gallura zone: Balaiana, Lu Scolombrino and Montelittu. The terrain in Gallura is dominated by large outcroppings of granite which rise sporadically from the ground throughout the area. The soil itself in the vineyards is made up of that same granite, weathered and broken down into fine sand. This minerally soil helps to give the wines their fine pronounced underlying minerality. The Mancini’s vineyards range from 50 to 300 meters in elevation with varying exposures, but mostly south-facing. Vermentino, like other whites such as Assyrtico that thrive in the hot Mediterranean climate, maintains its firm acidity in the heat of coastal Sardinia. Sardinian Vermentino is one of the great wines to pair with seafood. There is enough acidity to pair with shellfish, but also enough breadth on the palate to stand up to more meaty fish, or even fish (or light meats) on the grill.

TITLE: Pierre-Olivier Bonhomme Le Telquel Rouge
DESCRIPTION: Domaine Pierre-Olivier Bonhomme is the continuation and evolution of the now defunct Puzelat-Bonhomme négociant project. In the 90's Clos du Tue-Boeuf was faced with many years of tiny crops caused by late frost, mildew, hail or general bad weather. Revenues were tight, and Thierry Puzelat, the younger of the two brothers running the estate, wanted to to expand the estate by renting or buying more vineyards. His brother Jean-Marie, in his late forties at the time, did not want to add more vineyard and cellar work to his already heavy schedule. So Thierry started a negociant business, set up a winery in the village of Monthou-sur-Bievre, and sourced excellent vineyards and vine-tenders to buy their grapes.

TITLE: Pikesville Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Pikesville Straight Rye Whiskey refuses to be forgotten. First produced in Maryland in the 1890s, the brand, along with the rest of the once-booming Maryland Rye industry, was shuttered by prohibition. The brand reemerged after prohibition and became the last standing Maryland Rye, as the rest of the industry's production had ceased. Now produced in Kentucky from extra-aged barrels stored in prime warehouse locations, Heaven Hill keeps this historic Maryland mark alive with this award-winning six year old, 110 proof offering.

TITLE: Pimm's No 1 Cup Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: Created in 1859 by James Pimm, this well-known liqueur is produced from dry gin, liqueur, fruit juices and spice. First served in Pimm's Oyster Bar in London, it became immensely popular throughout the British Empire and is currently the traditional drink of Wimbledon.

TITLE: Pine Barrens Cherrywood Smoked Single Malt American Whisky
Pine Barrens Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Pine Barrens is the first American Single Malt Whisky to be distilled on Long Island. Instead of creating whisky from a regular mash, Pine Barrens uses an actual finished 10%ABV barley wine English styled Ale Beer that has a high hop count of 70 IBU’s. The Ale beer is traditionally brewed to its perfect drinkability, double pot distilled, and finally aged in petite new American Oak casks to achieve an incredibly high quality whisky.

TITLE: Pine Ridge Chenin Blanc Viognier Blend
DESCRIPTION: A great value white, it goes well with hard cheeses or spicy Mexican dishes.

TITLE: Pinhook "Bourbon Country" Cask Strength Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Every fall Pinhook releases a new bourbon and rye, each of which is connected to a promising young thoroughbred based in Kentucky. The whiskey in each release is the best expression of our barrels at that moment in time, and we blend and proof each release to be as unique as the horse on the label. This first Cask Strength Pinhook release was bottled at 115.3 proof and has a deep and bright nose of Creme Brûlée, orange zest, and toasted coconut, which sets the stage for a rich and harmonious palate of pralines, brioche, cocoa, and candied cinnamon. This release recently won Gold at the 2019 San Francisco World Spirits Competition Corn 75 % Rye 20.5 % Malted Barley 4.5 %

TITLE: Pinhook "Bourbon Country" Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Every fall Pinhook releases a new bourbon and rye, each of which is connected to a promising young thoroughbred based in Kentucky. The whiskey in each release is the best expression of our barrels at that moment in time, and we blend and proof each release to be as unique as the horse on the label. The result is an annual vintage of Pinhook Bourbon and Pinhook Rye that become instant collectibles. And while it is impossible to know if the horse on the bottle will go all the way to the Kentucky Derby, there is no gamble on the quality of what's inside. Bourbon Country is the 8th release of bourbon (9th overall) from Pinhook. It's been aged more than 3 years at Castle and Key Distillery in Millville, KY and was blended and proofed by Marianne Barnes and Sean Josephs. Corn 75 % Rye 20.5 % Malted Barley 4.5 %

TITLE: Pinhook "Bourbon Country" True Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This first Cask Strength Pinhook release was bottle at 115.3 proof and has a deep and bright nose of Creme Brûlée, orange zest, and toasted coconut, which sets the stage for a rich and harmonious palate of pralines, brioche, cocoa, and candied cinnamon. This release recently won Gold at the 2019 San Francisco World Spirits Competition.

TITLE: Pinhook "Bourbon N Rye" Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rye 95% / Malted Barley 5%

TITLE: Pinhook "Bourbon N Rye" Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rye 95% / Malted Barley 5%

TITLE: Pinhook "Bourbon War" 5 Years Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Every year, Pinhook releases a new bourbon and rye, each connected to a promising young thoroughbred. The whiskey in each release is the best expression of our barrels at that moment in time, and we blend and proof releases to be as unique as the horse on the label. The Vertical Series is a one-time opportunity to follow a group of barrels, all filled within months of each other, as they age.

TITLE: Pinhook "Bourbondini" Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Pinhook’s 2022 flagship bourbon. Distilled at Castle & Key Distillery in Frankfort, KY; blended by Pinhook Co-Founder and Master Blender, Sean Josephs. Mash bill of 75% corn, 15% rye, and 10% malted barley. Aged over 3 years. All non-GMO and locally sourced grains; proofed with ground-fed, limestone-filtered spring water. A nose of baked peaches, orange blossom, clove, and honey transitions to a harmonious palate of vanilla bean, toasted almond, cinnamon, and butterscotch. Non-chill filtered; 50% ABV. The Pinhook ethos aims to produce the best whiskey in each and every vintage. An increase in proof from 2021 to 2022 in their flagship bourbon exemplifies this approach. 2022’s core bourbon expresses an earthiness and spice that lends great structure to either sipping or mixing.

TITLE: Pinhook "Collaboration Series" Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Inspired by the world of wines and the “winemaker’s approach to whiskey”, this bottle is a unique collaboration with Maison Noir Wines’ André Hueston Mack. Blended from the 10 Wyoming Whiskey barrels that Pinhook acquired in 2012, there were only 700 bottles of this sumptuous blend made.

TITLE: Pinhook "Collaboration Series" Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Inspired by the world of wines and the “winemaker’s approach to whiskey”, this bottle is a unique collaboration with Maison Noir Wines’ André Hueston Mack. Blended from the 10 Wyoming Whiskey barrels that Pinhook acquired in 2012, there were only 700 bottles of this sumptuous blend made.

TITLE: Pinhook "Rye Humor" Cask Strength Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Limited to a blend of only 65 barrels, this Rye Humor Cask Strength release is the first edition of barrel proof straight rye whiskey from Pinhook. Deep and dense aromas of dark chocolate, candied black licorice, and vanilla extract set the stage for robust flavors of raisins, tobacco, cinnamon stick, and sarsaparilla.

TITLE: Pinhook "Rye Humor" Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Every fall Pinhook releases a new bourbon and rye, each of which is connected to a promising young thoroughbred horse. The whiskey in each release is the best expression of our barrels at that moment in time, and we blend and proof each release to be as unique as the horse on the label. The result is an annual vintage of Pinhook Bourbon and Pinhook Rye that become instant collectibles. And while it is impossible to know if the horse on the bottle will go all the way to the Kentucky Derby, there is no gamble on the quality of what's inside. The Rye Humor release is the second edition of straight rye whiskey produced by Pinhook. The traditional mashbill has over 3 years of barrel age and was blended and proofed by Sean Josephs at Castle & Key Distillery in Frankfort, KY.

TITLE: Pinhook "Rye Humor" True Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The True Single Barrel program was created out of the belief that every Pinhook single barrel should be selected on its individuality, rather than its conformity. Each barrel is bottled at cask strength to highlight the exact expression which made the whiskey stand out of the crowd.

TITLE: PInhook 5 Year Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Discover the essence of craftsmanship with Pinhook's 2024 Vintage Cask Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey, meticulously produced at the Castle & Key Distillery in Frankfort, Kentucky. Masterfully blended by co-founder and Master Blender Sean Josephs, this exceptional bourbon showcases a unique mash bill of 75% corn, 15% rye, and 10% malted barley, using non-GMO, locally sourced grains. Aged for a minimum of five years, each batch is proofed with ground-fed, limestone-filtered spring water, enhancing its rich, natural flavors. This release replaces the annual High Proof expressions, marking a significant evolution with its five-year age statement and adjusted mash bill tailored to this vintage. Blended from a selection of 30 barrels, this cask strength bourbon is a testament to Pinhook's dedication to producing the finest whiskey each year, with blends and proofs tailored to highlight the unique qualities of the vintage.

TITLE: Pinhook 8 Year Old "Club Marzipan" Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Pinhook's 8-Year-Old Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a part of the True Single Barrel Vertical Series, which aims to showcase the evolution of bourbon aging over time, from 4 to 12 years. This 8-year variant is the 5th of 9 vintages in this unique series, embodying a significant phase in the maturation journey. Each barrel in this series is chosen for its individuality rather than conformity, making every bottle distinctive in its age and proof. The bourbon is bottled unfiltered at cask strength to preserve the essence and complexity of its character, making it a true connoisseur's delight. Barrel Info: Lot #15G27 Serial #10379 Age: 8 Years Mashbill 74% Corn, 20.5% Rye, 4.5% Malted Barley Tasting Notes: Nose: Big caramel bomb, hints of tobacco, roasted pine nuts Palate: Caramel, the explosion of spice, a secondary note of cornbread with honey butter Finish: Medium to long

TITLE: Pinhook 9 Year Old "Mash & Journey" Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Discover the 9-Year Single Barrel pick from Mash & Journey, part of Pinhook’s acclaimed Bourbon Vertical Series. This single barrel offers a vibrant tasting experience and a remarkable journey of flavors as these premium MGP barrels. Bottled at 123.3 proof and unfiltered at cask strength, this expression showcases Pinhook’s dedication to capturing the evolving nuances of age and craft. Tasting Notes: Nose: Leads off with sweet oak and cream soda. Candied orange peel also makes itself known, which leads to a slight bump of cherry cola and caramel apples with allspice and cinnamon on the backend. Palate: The experience starts on the first sip with a burst of cherry, almonds, and oak. The caramel apple hits the mid-palate, which brings you into a rich candied orange finish that lasts for days. This bourbon bridges the gap between older and newer style MGP flavor profiles. As this bourbon opens up, the sweetness, as does the spice, comes to the forefront. All-spice and a hint of cardamomround out the finish. Finish: A smooth, lasting finish with complex spice and sweetness. Crafted from MGP barrels with a mash bill of 75% corn, 20.5% rye, and 4.5% malted barley, this Pinhook release is part of a carefully monitored selection, waxed in the series’ signature gold. Limited quantities available—don’t miss the opportunity to experience this premium, expertly crafted bourbon. From Jason of Mash & Drum: "Partnering with Prime Barrel, this is the first Pinhook single barrel selection from the Mash and Journey Whisky Club. We were sent three excellent 9-year single barrels from Pinhook that ended up being a pretty tough choice. Barrel 2095 ended up being a landslide winner, which is saying a lot since our other two options were excellent. Tasting Notes: Note: It leads off with sweet oak and cream soda. Candied orange peel also makes itself to be known, which leads to a slight bump of cherry cola and caramel apples with allspice and cinnamon on the backend. Palate: The experience starts on the first sip with a burst of cherry, almonds, and oak. The caramel apple hits the mid-palate, which brings you into a rich candied orange finish that lasts for days. This bourbon bridges the gap between older and newer style MGP flavor profiles. As this bourbon opens up, the sweetness, as does the spice, comes to the forefront. All-spice and a hint of cardamomround out the finish. It's one of our favorite single barrels this year."

TITLE: Pinhook Artist Series Blended Whiskey #2  Whiskey Nicking
DESCRIPTION: Pinhook's Artist Series celebrates the individuality and artistry of each bottling by commissioning an image by a renowned artist, inspired by the whiskey and the story of how it came to be. Bourbon and rye have such distinct flavor profiles and folks at Pinhook were intrigued to experiment with blending their custom Kentucky bourbon and rye mashbills together in the hopes to find a marriage that was more than the sum of its parts. They set out to create a 6 barrel blend, but with no preconceived notion of a specific proportion of bourbon to rye or vice versa. In order to make the blending process manageable, they limited themselves to 7 barrels of bourbon and 6 barrels of rye, although even that number produced 1,716 possible combinations. After playing around with various ratios, they discovered that the most complexity and balance were found with an equal number of barrels of bourbon and rye. Once they honed in on the ideal ratio they blended numerous iterations, searching for the perfect combination of 3 and 3, and then set out to find the proof that best showcased our two favorite blends. 112 proved to be the magic number.

TITLE: Pinhook Bohemian High Proof Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Pinhooking is a term used to describe the practice of buying young, thoroughbred horses, overseeing their initial development, and then re-selling them as race-ready champions-in-training. The Pinhook brand pays tribute to this practice and the parallels between investing in a horse’s potential and that of a young whiskey. Optimism, patience, and vision are paramount when training a young horse for future victory and aging whiskey until it is ready to blossom in-glass. Every year, Pinhook releases a new batch each of bourbon & rye; the whiskey in any given release intended to be the best expression of Pinhook’s barrels at that particular moment in time. Blends and proofs change batch to batch to best highlight that release’s unique attributes and can be thought of, quite appropriately, as a whiskey vintage. The newly restored Castle & Key Distillery, in Frankfort, KY, plays home to Pinhook’s operations. Built in the late 1800’s, Castle & Key was the original residence for Old Colonel Taylor. Beginning in Spring of 2020, Pinhook’s proprietary mash bill—crafted and distilled by Castle & Key—will make its way to bottle and become available for sale.

TITLE: Pinhook Bohemian Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is proofed at 95 and has aromas of orange peel, candied pecans, clove, and wet stone. These transition to a lively palate of tropical fruit and caramel, leading to a lingering finish of almond and cinnamon. Each year, Pinhook releases a new vintage of bourbons and ryes. Every expression is the best representation of our barrels at that moment in time, and dedicated to a promising young thoroughbred. Through a combination of careful barrel selection, blending in small batches, and meticulous proofing, each Pinhook vintage has a personality as unique as the horse on the label.

TITLE: Pinhook High Proof Hard Rye Guy Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Pinhook’s high proof expression of its 2021 vintage flagship rye, “Hard Rye Guy” is a limited release that was blended and produced in one 40-barrel batch. Distilled and aged at Castle & Key in Frankfort, KY, and blended by Pinhook Co-Founder and Master Blender, Sean Josephs. Non-chill filtered; 61% ABVMashbill: 20% Corn, 60% Rye, 20% Malted barley. 122 Proof

TITLE: Pinhook Rye'd On Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Pinhook ‘Rye’d On’ marks the first whiskey to be distilled and bottled at the refurbished Castle & Key Distillery since it shuttered in 1972. It also marks Pinhook’s first release distilled in collaboration with Castle & Key and reflecting Pinhook’s new proprietary rye mash bill of 60% Rye, 20% Malted Barley, and 20% Yellow Corn. As with other Pinhook releases, ‘Rye’d On’ was blended and proofed by Master Taster, Sean Josephs to best reflect the barrels at that time, creating a rye whiskey ‘vintage’ that is not to be missed. The notable percentage of malted barley in the composition lends depth and creamy texture to a rye whiskey bursting with peach, spearmint, and cinnamon on the nose, leading to a palate of cherry and toffee. 48.5% ABV and over two years old.

DESCRIPTION: Through a partnership with Bourbon Lane Stable LLC, each unique, limited edition lot of Pinhook Bourbon will showcase one extraordinary thoroughbred’s journey. TITLE: Piper-Heidsieck Champagne Cuvee Brut
DESCRIPTION: This signature cuvee of the House is a round and vibrant non-vintage Cuvee Brut recalling the rich variety of its blend of 100 crus from across the patchwork of Champagne vineyards.

TITLE: Piritto Togarashi Umeshul
DESCRIPTION: Locally grown red chili pepper "Hime Togarashi" is blended into this Plum Sake made from local green plums and high quality Junmai sake. Yakiniku, Shrimp or Crab Shumai, Fried Crab Craw, Grilled Anago, Fried Octopus, Dashimaki Tamago, Raw Oysters, Grilled Sweet Fish "Ayu"

TITLE: Piteira Alentejo Talha Branco
DESCRIPTION: The Alentejo, in the south of Portugal, has a DOC specifically for wine made in talha, large clay "amphoras" that sit on the ground.

TITLE: Pittyvaich 1992 Prima & Ultima 30 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Pittyvaich 1992 Prima & Ultima 30 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky is an exceptional and rare expression that embodies the legacy of the Pittyvaich distillery. Matured in two Pedro Ximénez/Oloroso butts, this whisky offers a rich and nuanced character. This release marks the final Pittyvaich 30 year old, commemorating the last casks filled before the distillery closed. With only 609 bottles made, it is a highly prized item for collectors and whisky enthusiasts.

TITLE: Pittyvaich 29 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A 1989 ghost, double matured in Pedro Ximenez & Oloroso sherry seasoned casks. A ‘ghost’ or closed distillery that worked for only 18 years, before falling victim to industry consolidation in 1993, Pittyvaich has now vanished. Its dwindling stock is as rarely sighted today as the shy capercaillie found in Scottish pineforests. Only 4,976 bottles available of this extremely rare high-aged whisky.

TITLE: Plantation "Stiggins' Fancy" Pineapple Rum
DESCRIPTION: This rum was made as a collaboration of Alexandre Gabriel’s rum blending expertise as the owner of Maison Ferrand and producer of Plantation rum and spirits and cocktail historian David Wondrich. Plantation Pineapple Rum Stiggins’ Fancy is a pineapple rum created by infusing ripe Queen Victoria pineapples in rich, aged Plantation Original Dark Rum for 3 months. The pineapple rind (where the pineapple’s essential oil chiefly resides) was macerated in rum and then distilled, thus creating a bright pineapple essence to blend with the lushness of the infused Plantation rum.

TITLE: Plantation "Stiggins' Fancy" Smoky Formula Pineapple Rum
DESCRIPTION: Plantation "Stiggins' Fancy" Smoky Formula Pineapple Rum is a unique and exquisite blend that captures the essence of tropical indulgence. Inspired by the classic tale of Reverend Stiggins from Charles Dickens' "The Pickwick Papers," this rum is infused with ripe Queen Victoria pineapples and aged to perfection. The Smoky Formula adds an extra layer of complexity with a touch of peaty smokiness, creating a rich and flavorful experience. Perfect for sipping or crafting innovative cocktails, this rum brings a taste of the Caribbean with every sip.

TITLE: Plantation Extreme N.4 MMW 25 Years Old Jamaica Rum
DESCRIPTION: The new collection is the fourth Plantation Extrême series of bottlings, which have been selected by master blender Alexandre Gabriel. The “much sought after” releases are made up of “only the best barrels” selected by the Plantation team. The eight rums have been “enhanced” by Plantation’s double aging process, beginning with maturation in Bourbon casks followed by second aging for one year in Ferrand oak casks in France. Each rum’s design comes with a section of a meter-long panoramic artwork that depicts the sea voyage of rum merchants as they transport barrels from the Caribbean to Europe by sailing ships. Playboy Spirits Rare Hare 1953 17 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rare Hare “1953” Anniversary Edition is a 17-year Kentucky straight bourbon that was finished in Cognac casks from the Champagne region of France. A fitting tribute to the year Playboy was founded, “1953" straight bourbon whiskey is imbued with subtle notes of Grande Champagne and Fine Champagne grapes with hints of candied fruit and spices. Bottled at 111 proof and packaged in a sleek commemorative box, Rare Hare 1953 embodies the craftsmanship, sophistication, and passion of Playboy Spirits.

TITLE: Playboy Spirits Rare Hare 60 Years Old Lapine Petite Cognac Champagne
DESCRIPTION: Rare Hare Lapine Cognac Petite Champagne was aged for 60 Years before being bottled at 81.8 Proof (40.9% ABV). 1961 is regarded as one of the most exceptional Champagne vintages of the 20th century. In the remote village of Échebrune, nestled within the rolling hills of southwestern France, the Herbelot family of winegrowers harvested the grapes that would become this rare and exquisite cognac. Rather than sell this harvest to an established cognac house as was customary, the Herbelots reserved these coveted grapes to be distilled by their family and barreled to age for 60 years.

TITLE: Playboy Spirits Rare Hare Lucky Bastard 30 Year Single Barrel Whisky Finished in Pineau des Charentes Casks
DESCRIPTION: Playboy Spirits Rare Hare Lucky Bastard 30-Year Single Barrel Pineau des Charentes Casks is an extraordinary and luxurious expression representing fine whiskey craftsmanship's pinnacle. This limited-edition release is a blend of meticulously selected whiskies, aged for an impressive 30 years, and finished in Pineau des Charentes casks from the Cognac region of France. Bottled at 89 proof, this single barrel Canadian whiskey offers a unique and sophisticated flavor profile, enhanced by the sweet and fruity notes imparted by the French cask finish. Rare Hare Lucky Bastard celebrates luxury and rarity, making it a must-have for collectors and connoisseurs alike.

TITLE: Plymouth Gin
DESCRIPTION: The Plymouth Gin distillery (known as the Black Friars Distillery) is now the only gin distillery remaining in the town of Plymouth, England in what was once a Dominican Order monastery built in 1431. Before being a gin distillery, the building’s history was both rich and chequered. One of the oldest structures in Plymouth full stop, the building was briefly turned into a debtor’s prison after its time as a monastery. The established distilling business of Fox & Williamson began production of Plymouth Gin in 1793, although records show distilling had been going on at the site since the 1690’s onwards. Plymouth Distillery now has the accolade of being the oldest British distillery still active today in its original location

TITLE: PM Spirits Project Single Oven Tequila Blanco
DESCRIPTION: Embark on a journey of artisanal craftsmanship with PM Spirits Project Single Oven Tequila Blanco, a remarkable expression that pushes the boundaries of tequila excellence. Meticulously crafted by the PM Spirits Project, this Blanco tequila showcases the influence of a single oven in the distillation process, resulting in a spirit that captures the true essence of agave. Elevate your tequila experience with this limited edition release.

TITLE: PM Spirits VS Bas-Armagnac Brandy Overproof
DESCRIPTION: PM Spirits (the company behind very popular "Mic.Drop" bourbons) has teamed up with acclaimed producer Claire de Montesquiou of Domaine d'Espérance to craft an exclusive line of small-batch Armagnacs. Working together, the duo created a custom blend for an overproof VS offering at 51.9% ABV. As with every PM Spirits custom bottling, the label provides full transparency to the contents and creation of this one-of-a-kind bottle.This Armagnac is a blend of 7 casks, bottled at full strength in the following proportions: Cask #74: 81L, Baco, distilled 11/2005 Cask #219: 345L, Folle Blanche, distilled 11/2018 Cask #266: 235LFolle Blanche, distilled 11/2018 Cask #293: 160L, Folle Blanche, distilled 11/2018 Cask #283: 250L, Baco, distilled 11/2018 Cask #317: 250L, Baco, distilled 11/2018 Cask #303: 81L, Baco, distilled 11/2019 Bottled in January 2022. 51.9% ABV | No Additives | No Filtration

TITLE: Podere Ruggeri Corsini Barbera d'Alba
DESCRIPTION: The vineyard covers a surface of 2.2 hectares and is about 420/480 metres above sea level, facing east: the soil is clayey calcareous. The vines are vertically trellised, pruned the ‘Guyot’ way, and the density is of 5000 plants per hectare, planted in 1996, 1998 and 2000. The average final production is of about 20000 0.75lt bottles. Vinification starts after a manual harvest in crates, starting with immediate stalk removal, followed by three pump overs a day for the first week. Maceration lasts eight days. After the racking, decantering and the malolactic fermentation have occurred, the wine is then left to stand in stainless steel vats for 10-14 months, and is later bottled in autumn. Barbera d’Alba DOC is a typical Piedmontese barbera wine with a striking underlying acidity that makes it particularly enjoyable to drink, especially during its first two to three years of life, but can also be appreciated after four to six years. Ideally paired with starters and cold meats, pasta dishes with butter or cheese sauces, such as the traditional ‘plin’ ravioli, or risottos and creamy cheeses.

TITLE: Poderi Colla Roncaglie Barbaresco
DESCRIPTION: Barbaresco Roncaglie is a charming wine, both elegant and appealing, with velvety spice notes on the nose and palate and with a long finish. Excellent ageing potential. Grapes are hand-picked, destalked and crushed; the must successively macerates on the skins for approximately 12/15 days at a maximum temperature of about 30° C., and malolactic fermentation ensues, completed before winter. In the spring, the wine sojourns in oak casks for a period from 12 to 14 months. This is a fine wine for the whole meal, finding its best match in red meats and game birds.

TITLE: Poderi Dal Nespoli Adesso Cagnina Romagna Dolce
DESCRIPTION: Tasting Notes: Pleasantly sweet, Adesso’s berry aromas and flavors are impossible to resist. Low in alcohol, Adesso is a fun and easy to drink red wine for those who prefer their wines “off dry”.

TITLE: Poggio Anima Belial Toscana IGT Sangiovese
DESCRIPTION: Calling its creations “weeknight wines” belies the pedigree, power and panache behind Poggio Anima. A joint venture between Montalcino superstar Riccardo Campinoti of Le Ragnaie and Ronnie Sanders of Vine Street Imports, Poggio Anima takes a simple idea and turns it into something quite special: They source the best vineyards from existing relationships and produce single-varietal wines that beautifully express their unique regions and grapes.

TITLE: Poggio Anima Pecorino Gabriel
DESCRIPTION: Less than one kilometer from the cliffs descending into the Adriatic Sea sits a vineyard perched on a steep slope planted with Montepulciano and Pecorino. The pecorino is hand-harvested on the early side to preserve freshness and not get into the straw color/baked orchard fruits that often occur with this grape. The grapes are destemmed and then pressed to tank, preserving the skins. The skins are tossed back atop the juice and allowed to macerate for 18 hours prior to being pulled off and fermentation occurring naturally. The juice is racked off of the gross lees and left to settle for 8 months prior to bottling.

TITLE: Poggiosecco Chianti
DESCRIPTION: Making of: Once manually harvested, the grapes are gently destemmed and crushed and then undergo fermentation with indigenous yeasts. Frequent pumping for greater extraction of tannins and polyphenols. Clarification is done by decantation only, no fining product used. The wine then ages for 12 months in cement tanks and further 6 months in bottles before release.

TITLE: Point Ormond Frankland River Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Sauvignon Blanc from Frankland River. We’re down south-west of the continent in this cool climate, isolated wine region. Whites are all about high acid here, with riesling and sauvignon blanc the mainstays.

TITLE: Pol Blanc Blnc de Blancs Brut Vin Mousseaux
Pol Roger Champagne Brut Blanc de Blancs
DESCRIPTION: Pol Roger Brut Vintage relies on a majority of Pinot Noir (60%) to provide it's lush, rich body. The remainder of the blend is made of Chardonnay. Both varietals are sourced from Grand and 1er Cru vineyards in the Montagne de Reims and the Cote des Blancs.

TITLE: Poliziano Rosso di Montepulciano
DESCRIPTION: Founded in 1961 by Dino Carletti, Poliziano is located a few miles northeast of Montelpulciano, Italy. Dino’s son Frederico inherited the winery in 1982 and subsequently expanded the estate while improving overall quality. (80% Prugnolo Gentile/20% Merlot) The hand-picked fruit was harvested from a southwest facing vineyard that was planted to rich, clay soils from the Pliocene era. The grapes were fermented and macerated for 10-12 days in steel vats. 20-40% of the wine aged for eight months in neutral American oak barriques and the remainder aged in vats. Enjoy with pastas in red sauces, salmon and pork dishes.

TITLE: Pollo Creek Merlot
Poppy Monterey County Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Poppy Monterey County Pinot Noir is an expression of elegance and finesse from California's renowned Central Coast region. Crafted with cherries hand-picked from the finest vineyards, this Pinot Noir captures the essence of the cool Monterey climate with vibrant aromas and a balanced palate.

TITLE: Porcupine Ridge Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Cabernet Sauvignon is one of the more complex and layered wines out there. It has higher tannins and a savory character often described as black pepper and tobacco. Because of Cab’s traits, look for foods high in fat and umami flavors for Cabernet Sauvignon food pairing. Try Cabernet Sauvignon with a charred gruyere burger, a mushroom pizza with tomato sauce or some marinated ribeye steak. To champion the fruit flavors in Cabernet Sauvignon, don’t pair it with chocolate. Instead, pair wine with braised short ribs or mushroom stroganoff. The powerful umami flavors overcome the savory quality of Cabernet Sauvignon leaving the berry flavors out in the open to shine.

TITLE: Port Askaig Islay Single Malt Scotch Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Port Askaig is a range of Islay single malt whiskies that embodies the unique spirit of Islay and its people. Its character brings together the robust smokiness and soft fruitiness found in this beguiling island. The range has been developed to appeal to the most discerning of whisky connoisseurs while also appealing to the novice whisky drinker. We have selected exceptional casks of Islay single malt and created a range that we believe will become recognised as an Islay classic.

TITLE: Port Charlotte PAC:01 Heavily Peated 8 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This malt professes to be “heavily peated,” but fear not: peat is but a single brush stroke on a much broader canvas. Scottish grain evokes Honey Nut Cheerios and warm porridge, while the peat suggests grilled vegetables and molten campfire marshmallow. There’s briny smoke wafting from a beach bonfire, girded by bright berry and cherry fruit from time spent in red Bordeaux wine casks. Fine oak tannins meet heaps of sweet vanilla on the finish. A captivating malt that seems to have it all.

TITLE: Port Charlotte PMC:01 Heavily Peated 9 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Discover the intense and smoky world of Port Charlotte PMC:01, a masterpiece from the Bruichladdich Distillery on the legendary isle of Islay. This heavily peated single malt Scotch whisky, aged for 9 years, is a profound expression of Islay's rich peat and maritime heritage. Initially aged in first-fill bourbon barrels for 4 years before its remarkable finish in Pomerol wine casks for the next 5 years, PMC:01 presents an extraordinary fusion of flavors. With a phenol level of 40 parts per million, it promises a peat-rich experience, perfectly balanced by the sweet and complex notes from its wine cask finish​.

TITLE: Port Dundas 22 yrs Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This 22-year-old Port Dundas single grain whisky was distilled in 1996 and matured in a single hogshead until it was bottled in February 2019 for Signatory Vintage’s Cask Strength Collection.

TITLE: Portlandia Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Awards: Rating: 91 points (Gold Medal) – Beverage Testing Institute Rating: 88 points – Wine Enthusiast Rating: Outstanding – Great Northwest Wine Rating: Bronze Medal – San Francisco Chronicle 2015 Wine Competition Pinot noir is one of the most versatile red wines to match with food and a great option in a restaurant when one of you is eating meat and the other fish. There are ingredients that will pair with practically any pinot noir such as duck and mushrooms and others, like salmon or tuna, where they will depending on the way you’ve cooked them and the style of pinot you’re drinking.

TITLE: Powers Irish Whiskey Gold Label
Powers Three Swallow Release Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Three Swallow Release is a modern expression of what the original POWERS Whiskey tasted like back in the days of our John’s Lane distillery. This quintessential style of whiskey, Single Pot Still is exclusive to Ireland, and is made from a mash of malted and unmalted barley, then triple distilled in traditional copper pot stills.

TITLE: Powers Winery Columbia Valley Merlot
DESCRIPTION: Washington is known for having world class Merlot, and this bottling is no exception. Most of the components of this Merlot were fermented in stainless steel uprights with the exception of the Champoux Merlot, which was fermented in a pump under fermenter. We used PDM yeast on the Katherine Leone Merlot, Goose Ridge Merlot, Cougar Syrah, and Goose Ridge Malbec with 796 yeast used on the Champoux Merlot. All components then completed 100% malolactic fermentation in stainless steel tanks and were aged for 25 months in 2 and 3-year-old French Oak barrels.

TITLE: Pra Classico Otto Soave
DESCRIPTION: The Pra winery, although only started in the early 1980’s, has become not only one of the top producers in the Soave appellation, but one of the most important and visionary white wine makers in all of Italy (now red wine as well). The winery is run by Graziano Pra, whose family owned their vineyards for generations, but never commercialized the wines in bottles. The vineyards are situated in the heart of the appellation, in Monteforte D’Alpone. Besides Soave, the winery also produces Valpolicella and Amarone from a vineyard that he purchased and planted in 2001, and whose truly remarkable results are only now being discovered.

TITLE: Pra Morandina Amarone della Valpolicella
Pra Morandina Valpolicella
DESCRIPTION: The Pra winery, although only started in the early 1980’s, has become not only one of the top producers in the Soave appellation, but one of the most important and visionary white wine makers in all of Italy (now red wine as well). The winery is run by Graziano Prà, whose family owned their vineyards for generations, but never commercialized the wines in bottles. The vineyards are situated in the heart of the appellation, in Monteforte D’Alpone. Besides Soave, the winery also produces Valpolicella and Amarone from a vineyard that he purchased and planted in 2001, and whose truly remarkable results are only now being discovered.

TITLE: Prairie Cucumber Flavored Organic Vodka
Prairie Organic Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Prairie’s single vintage organic corn is distilled to taste, not a prescribed number of times. That’s because climate, soil, and moisture levels give each small batch its own unique character. Preserving that character takes personal attention, giving our spirits an award-winning taste that can stand on its own.

TITLE: Presqu'ile Winery Santa Maria Valley Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Comprised of 100% Presqu'ile Vineyard fruit, our 2014 rendition of this exuberant variety captures the intensity and precision that only cool climate Sauvignon Blanc can deliver. Utilizing six unique clones not widely planted in California, we find the complexity and interesting aromatics this clonal mixture provides to be utterly distinctive. Native yeast fermentation in a combination of concrete egg, stainless steel and neutral French oak, sur lie aging, and light lees stirring capture and amplify the many different facets of our site, resulting in a wild, singular expression of Sauvignon Blanc.

TITLE: Primarius Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Primarius Pinot Noir embodies sheer elegance, where delicate flavors give way to full fruit expression; providing the most pleasurable drinking experience for wine lovers. Primarius represents Oregon's finest cool climate regions and is a true reflection of the state's most famed varietal. Latin for ‘distinguished,' Primarius promises sophistication in every sip and exceeds expectations in quality, flavor and value.

TITLE: Primitivo Quiles Alicante Cono 4
DESCRIPTION: Senor Don Primitivo Quiles is one of the great figures of Spanish wine. His bodega in Monovar is the oldest in Alicante (since 1780), and probably in all the comunidad Valenciana. This Monastrell made in 80 year old Conofors (think dairy tanks but made of American Oak), this wine is filtered by gravity and, following tradition, is made in a slighty oxidative style which gives the wine its very unique character. Grilled Pork or Beef. Spanish Monastrell, known as Mourvèdre in France, has the same luscious fruit that makes Zinfandel so good with grilled pork, but with a spicy edge that arguably creates an even better match.

TITLE: Prisma Casablanca Valley Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: These 100% hand harvested, estate wines show the true expression of the cool, coastal Casablanca Valley. This collaborative project between Brazos and Grupo Belen produces vibrant and fresh wines. The estate consists of multiple vineyards including some of the regions original plantings in Casablanca by Pablo Morande in 1982. The cool misty nights, hot sunny days, and light hand of the winemaker act as a prism to convert the grape into a complex and beautiful wine.

TITLE: Prisma Valle de Casablanca Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: This hand-harvested, un-oaked, 100% Sauvignon Blanc is produced from a glend of three Casablanca Valley vineyards: El Ensueño, Belén, and El Principal. The sandy, clay soils and cool, coastal climate contribute to a bright, fresh character in the wine.

TITLE: Prisma Valle de Casablanca Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: This hand-harvested, un-oaked, 100% Sauvignon Blanc is produced from a glend of three Casablanca Valley vineyards: El Ensueño, Belén, and El Principal. The sandy, clay soils and cool, coastal climate contribute to a bright, fresh character in the wine.

TITLE: Produttori di Carema Carema Classico
Proof and Wood Crossborder Jackpot Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Proof and Wood Crossborder Jackpot Whiskey is a unique and masterful blend that combines the best of American and Canadian rye traditions. This exceptional whiskey is the result of blending 16-year-old Canadian rye with 14-year-old American rye, creating a cross-border collaboration that stands out in the world of premium spirits. Bottled at 107 proof, Crossborder Jackpot offers a complex and richly layered flavor profile, showcasing the depth and character that comes with extended aging. This whiskey is perfect for those who appreciate the boldness of rye and the artistry of a well-crafted blend.

TITLE: Proof and Wood Curated Collection 3 Barrel Blend Jamaican Pot Still 2/3 Rum
DESCRIPTION: Part of Proof and Wood’s ‘Curated Collection’ of unique and experimental batches, this pot-distilled, Jamaican rum was aged in Jamaica for two years in ex-bourbon barrels before traveling to Kentucky for a further three years in barrels that previously held rye. Hay and vanilla-softened esters precede a palate of English Breakfast tea and toasted cinnamon & clove with a hint of dehydrated strawberry on the finish. Bottled at 54% ABV, this extremely limited rum was blended from only 3 barrels and less than 100 cases were produced. 54% ABV This extremely limited rum was blended from only 3 barrels and less than 100 cases were produced

TITLE: Proof and Wood Curated Collection 8 Years Old The Stranger Polish Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This rye whiskey was distilled in Poland and aged in the US; bottled by Proof and Wood. Aged 7 years in a combination of ex-bourbon and ex-rye barrels. Small batch, blended from approximately 10 barrels. 50% ABV; Non-chill filtered. Mash bill of 100% Rye

TITLE: Proof and Wood Curated Collection Vertigo Extraordinary American Blended Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Proof & Wood Vertigo Extraordinary American Blended Whiskey is an innovative and masterfully crafted spirit that showcases the art of blending across a wide range of aged whiskeys. This extraordinary blend comprises whiskeys aged from 5 to 28 years, sourced from various distilleries across the United States, and bottled at 104 proof. Vertigo offers a rich and complex flavor profile, with each whiskey contributing its unique characteristics to create a harmonious and well-rounded blend. This whiskey is perfect for those who appreciate the depth and intricacies of blending different aged spirits, resulting in a truly extraordinary drinking experience.

TITLE: Proof and Wood Seasons 25 Year Old American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Dave Schmier of Proof and Wood rolled the dice while concocting his bottle of Seasons, part of the brand’s Curated Collection, an expression composed of a 25-year-old light whiskey with a mash bill of 99% corn and 1% rye, finished in American rye barrels for eight weeks before resting for 2 years in steel containers to stop aging. This light whiskey breaks the mold of the usual lackluster flavor associated with other varieties of light whiskey. You will be pleasantly surprised by the full-bodied vanilla cream and rich caramel goodness each sip offers. Fresh, sweet fruit is part of the mid-palate experience, which offers a delightful contrast to the finish, which sets up a long, spicy sizzle. This smooth, easy sip is perfect for the connoisseur looking for a new take on light classics.

TITLE: Proof and Wood Seasons Blended Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The corn whiskey and bourbon in this blend offer a sweet counterpoint to the musty notes of the older TN Bourbon, allowing desirable older flavors to be highlighted while balancing some of the harshness of the wood. The American light whiskey does a great job of unifying the blend, bringing lightness and fruit to the flavor profile while adding some spicy cinnamon and clove-like notes to the finish. Blended American whiskey from Proof and Wood’s Curated Collection; sourced, blended, and bottled by Proof and Wood in Bardstown, Kentucky Proof and Wood’s second release under the “Seasons” label. It features a spirit aged for an unusually long period of time (a TN Bourbon from 2003 that has endured over 72 seasons in barrel) balanced with younger whiskies. Aged 8–18 years Composed of Kentucky whiskey distilled from 99% corn in 2013, bourbon (mash bill of 75% corn, 21% rye, 4% barley) distilled in Indiana in 2015, American light whiskey distilled in Indiana in 2007, and Tennesse bourbon distilled in 2003 Finished in used American rye barrels for 8 weeks; blended and bottled in 2021 A nose of creamy vanilla with hints of mint transitions to a dynamic palate of rich brown sugar and Red Hot spice with notes of bright citrus, cherry, and crème brûlée. Cinnamon-forward baking spice lingers on the finish. 52.5% ABV

TITLE: Proof and Wood The Globe 8 Year Old Polish Rye
DESCRIPTION: The Globe 8 Year Old Polish Rye Whiskey is a meticulously crafted spirit to savor. Distilled in 2013, it has been aged for 8 years in French Oak and used Bourbon barrels before being finished in Jamaican rum casks. It is 100% rye in the mash and bottled at 99-proof, making it a robust and intense whiskey. Refined yet bold, The Globe is the perfect addition to any premium whiskey collection.

TITLE: Proper No. Twelve Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Introducing Conor McGregor’s own brand of Irish Whiskey. Distilled, aged, & bottled in Ireland, Proper No. Twelve is smooth and balanced with a fine blend of golden grain and full flavored malted barley. It’s aged a minimum of three years in bourbon barrel and offers hints of vanilla, honey-like sweetness and toasted wood. A proper salute to all, Proper No. Twelve pays homage to the founder, Conor McGregor, and his neighbourhood of Crumlin, Dublin 12. It embodies their shared spirit of brotherhood, loyalty, and hard work.

TITLE: Publioteca Vol. 2 World Whiskey Society Bourbon Set
DESCRIPTION: The Publioteca World Whiskey Society Bourbon Set pairs Jim Murray's Whiskey Bible with Kentucky Straight Bourbon from the World Whiskey Society. This unique set includes bourbon matured in newly charred oak, then finished in Japanese Mizunara Oak, previously used for aging Shochu spirits. The bourbon, crafted by Bardstown Bourbon Company, features a mash bill of 75% corn, 13% rye, and 12% malted barley. It comes with an autographed Jim Murray's Whiskey Bible 2022, making it an exceptional bourbon experience.

TITLE: Publioteca Vol. 3 World Whiskey Society Yamato Japanese Whisky Set
DESCRIPTION: The Publioteca World Whiskey Society Yamato Japanese Whiskey Set pairs Dominic Roskrow's Whiskey Japan guide with Japanese Whiskey finished in Mizunara oak barrels. The sourcing of the whiskey is not disclosed, but there are not many Japanese whiskies on the market that have been matured in Mizunara oak.

TITLE: Pueblo Viejo Blanco Tequila
Puerto Viejo Cabernet Sauvignon
Puncher's Chance 12 Years Old The D12tance Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished In Cabernet Sauvignon Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Puncher’s Chance Kentucky straight bourbon inspired by two great American traditions: whiskey and fighting for what we believe in. It takes courage and perseverance to make it to the 12th Round of a fight. That’s why it’s called “the distance” round. Many try, few succeed. Those few deserve Puncher’s Chance 12-Year-Old straight bourbon whiskey finished in Cabernet Sauvignon barrels – a bourbon crafted with heart, honor, and then aged to perfection. If you have a passion worth fighting for and can go The Distance, you’ve earned this Bourbon.

TITLE: Pure Kentucky Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Pure Kentucky Small Batch Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a bold and robust spirit crafted by the esteemed Willett Distillery in the heart of Kentucky. This small-batch bourbon is bottled at a strong 107 proof, offering a rich and intense flavor profile that reflects the distillery's commitment to quality and tradition. While the exact age is not disclosed, it is generally believed to be aged around 12 years, allowing the bourbon to develop deep, complex flavors. Pure Kentucky is perfect for those who appreciate a high-proof bourbon with character and depth, making it an excellent choice for both sipping and crafting premium cocktails.

TITLE: Puro Malbec
DESCRIPTION: 100% Malbec - 10% of proceeds go to Fulton St Fellowship This wine comes from the domaine's "youngest vines": 40+ year old Malbec grown on steep rocky hillsides covered in clay and gravel in the Cahors using environmentally conscious methods. No chemicals are used in the field, grapes are hand-harvested, native yeast fermented in stainless and cement tanks, then bottled unfined and slightly filtered with a drop of SO2 for stability.

TITLE: Purulio Vino Tinto
DESCRIPTION: Practicing Organic. The vines are between 900-1200 meters above sea level, within 3 hectares near the villages of Marchal, Beas de Guadix and Policar - all in the Alhama Valley on the north face of the Sierra Nevada. Here the climate is continental, very little rain and a high diurnal. All grapes undergo hand-harvesting and natural vinification with no added sulfites and only using indigenous yeasts. So little of each grape exists in his vineyards that they are all vinified together; de-stemmed with 5-7 days maceration and direct to press. Aged for 1 year in French oak barrique.

TITLE: Quady Vya Sweet Vermouth
DESCRIPTION: Drinking Vya Sweet Vermouth conjures a vision of holiday baking in a cozy home on a cold winter’s day. Vya Sweet is a blend including Tinta Roriz, Orange Muscat and dry white wine. It is hand infused at Quady Winery with a selection of over seventeen herbs and spices.

TITLE: Quiereme Mucho Cuishe Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: Quiereme Mucho Cuishe Mezcal is a distinguished spirit crafted with wild maguey Cuishe (agave Karwinskii), meticulously produced by maestro mezcalero Wilibaldo Rodríguez. Renowned for its organic and hand-crushed agave, Quiereme Mucho Mezcal reflects the rich heritage of Oaxaca, Mexico. The mezcal presents a crystalline appearance with a velvety mouthfeel, and is noted for its aromas of smoked agave, herbs, and cedar, making it an exceptional choice for savoring neat or as the base in sophisticated cocktails.

TITLE: Quinta Da Aveleda Vinho Verde Casal Garcia
DESCRIPTION: Opening a bottle of Casal Garcia is a fantastic way of celebrating delightful occasions and life! The beginning of the Casal Garcia brand dates back to 1939, being already at that time an innovative wine, characterized by the new techniques used by the French winemaker Eugène Hélisse. Casal Garcia is named after the land where the first grapes of this wine came from. It is the area surrounding a centuries-old house still inhabited by farmers at Quinta da Aveleda. The brand image has always been faithful to its origin. On the label, you can see the crest that has belonged to the Guedes family for many years. It symbolizes the tight connection to Aveleda's history and tradition. Its soft and fruity palate turns Casal Garcia into a young, fresh and light companion for pleasant times. It is ideal to match with fish, seafood, light simple salads or oriental dishes. In 2009 Casal Garcia celebrated its 60th birthday and in 2007 celebrated its arrival to the 60th country, and is now considered the most sold Vinho Verde in the world.
