TITLE: Quinta do Infantado Tawny Port
DESCRIPTION: Touriga Franca/Touriga Nacional/Tinta Roriz/Tinta Barroca. From exclusively Class A parcels (Serra di Cima and Serra Douro) totaling 12 hectares on poor schist soils. The fruit is hand-harvested, partly destemmed and fermented in lagar and tank; fermentation is stopped with 77-degree grape brandy. The wine is aged in very old pipas. A pipa or 'pipe" in English is the traditional 550-liter wooden cask used for aging, as well as measuring quantities of, port; it is ideal for tawnies, as oxidation is promoted by its horizontal orientation, smaller capacity and thinner staves (versus the thicker ones of the huge wooden tank called a tonel or balseiro used for ruby and vintage ports). Infantado tawny finishes at a modest 19.5% alcohol and 70 g/liter RS, considerably drier than most tawnies. The average age in bottle is 4-5 years. 20,000-25,000 numbered bottles produced annually.

TITLE: Quinta do Noval 2007 Vintage Port
DESCRIPTION: As one of the oldest port houses, Quinta do Noval is unique in that most of the ports are made from estate-grown fruit and, notably, all of the vintage Noval wines are from the single Quinta do Noval vineyard. As Robert Parker writes in his 2005 book, The World's Greatest Wine Estates: “Quinta do Noval is unusual among the great traditional Port houses in that it emphasizes the importance of the vineyard. The aim is to produce classic Vintage Ports that are harmonious and elegant expressions of Quinta do Noval's terroir. Strict selection in the vineyard, low yields, and strict selection again in the tasting room result in a small production.” Rating: Wine Advocate 94 points (Feb 2010)

TITLE: Quinta Milu Ribera del Duero
DESCRIPTION: Tempranillo pairs with all kinds of food because it’s savory. The regional Spanish cuisine includes roasted vegetables and cured meats like the lusty Jamón Iberico de Bellota. And it’s true, Tempranillo pairs very well with the local cuisine but it works well with all kinds of cuisine. Lasagna, Pizza and dishes with tomato-based sauces Grits, Polenta and dishes with corn as a major ingredient Mexican food such as tacos, nachos, burritos and chile rellenos

TITLE: Qupe Central Coast Syrah
DESCRIPTION: The cooler climate grapes lend a savory, spicy character with refreshing acidity and balanced alcohol. The warmer climate grapes give the wine a more forward fruit character and add suppleness and earlier drinkability. With its delicate flavors, lamb is a great choice for the lighter style of Syrah. Try Lamb Shawarma or Gyros or, if you’re preparing it yourself, play with your spice rack to magnify the natural flavors in Syrah of allspice, clove, and mint. (Vegetarian option: brined and grilled eggplant)

TITLE: R.H. Coutier Champagne Brut Rose
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the elegance of R.H. Coutier Champagne Brut Rosé, a captivating French sparkling wine from the esteemed Champagne region. Crafted by the renowned R.H. Coutier, this Brut Rosé is a harmonious blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, promising a celebration of flavor and finesse.

TITLE: R.L. Seale 12 Year Old Barbados Rum
Rabbit Hole Boxergrail 2021 Single Barrel Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Rye Set (6 bottles)
DESCRIPTION: This is a second Single Barrel release from the Rabbit Hole Distillery. This is a complete set of 6 bottles, each having a different design. For our second Single Barrel release, we have hand-selected casks from a limited number of Boxergrail Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey barrels. Each is a study of patience and creativity. To complement this one-of-a-kind whiskey, the packaging for each season of barrel releases will be unique and feature a different series of six original Limited Edition illustrations commissioned by the Founder, Kaveh Zamanian. The result is a true work of art inside and out that could only be bottled at cask strength.Boxergrail Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey with a sour mash rye mash bill bottled at full cask strength. The proof will vary by bottle - but will generally fall between 100 and 125.Approximately only 150-200 bottles produced at 750mL.The barrel was aged in #3, wood-fired, toasted & charred new American Oak barrels for 4+ years.

TITLE: Rabbit Hole Boxergrail Founder’s Collection Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Kaveh Zamanian, founder and whiskey maker of Rabbit Hole is proud to announce the premiere of Rabbit Hole Founder’s Collection, a new platform under which he will develop special bottlings that showcase his creativity and commitment to the artistry of whiskey making. For his first Founder’s Collection release, Kaveh unveiled a spectacular embodiment of his craft with Boxergrail Founder’s Collection Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey, a limited edition, a cask-strength expression made from the first batches of rye whiskey he ever made. For Rabbit Hole Boxergrail Founder’s Collection, carefully selected grains were prepared and fermented at ideal temperatures, distilled to their essence, aged for six years in the wood-fired, toasted and charred #3 new American oak barrels that Kaveh personally selected from the very first batches of rye he created and was harvested from just seven barrels, once they were ready to reveal their full flavor and character. This rye whiskey is 100% Kentucky-made and specifically crafted according to Kaveh’s proprietary cooking processes to create a unique and singular drinking experience. Boxergrail Founder’s Collection elevates Rabbit Hole’s award-winning Boxergrail Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey to a level of sublime. This special release showcases how cask and whiskey come together at its natural strength to create dimensional rye with an incredible spectrum of flavor. Comprised of 95% rye and 5% malted barley, Boxergrail Founder’s Collection, like all whiskies in the Rabbit Hole portfolio, has a low entry proof of 110 for deeper complexity. This cask- strength offering is 114.6 proof/57.3% ABV.

TITLE: Rabbit Hole Cavehill Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: We've got to give it to Rabbit Hole, out of the gate their whiskeys weren’t overly exciting, but as the distillery has matured, so has their approach to their whiskeys. Made in small 15 barrel batches, Cavehill with its unique mashbill (70% Corn, 10% Honey Malted Barley, 10% Malted Wheat, 10% Malted Barley) offers an interesting flavor profile in an extremely accessible and friendly sip. This is a great next step for many whiskey drinkers looking for something a touch more interesting, but fear going too far over the line. Its approachable delivery of sweet, but not-too-sweet flavors against a more traditional spice and peppery finish works well. It’s young and lacks complexity, but brings a clean and bright taste to its delivery. It's accessible in all the right ways, and while it might not immediately wow, it maintains a level of intrigue that makes it quite a bit of fun to drink.

TITLE: Rabbit Hole Founder's Collection Nevallier 16-year-old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Finiished in French Oak
DESCRIPTION: For this limited release, the distillery took an exceptional 15-year-old Kentucky Straight Bourbon and finished it for one year in new French Oak barrels sculpted by the virtuoso artisans of Tonnellerie Leroi, one of France’s most renowned cooperages. The exquisite bourbon that has emerged from these barrels is as luxurious in taste as it is in appearance.Bourbon is the quintessential American Whiskey. A storied spirit whose French roots have been strong since its inception over two centuries ago. This 16-year-old Limited Edition Rabbit Hole Founder’s Collection expression is an homage to bourbon’s French connection. Finished in new French Oak, Nevallier Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is named for the two forests in France, Nevers, and Allier, from which the distinctive wood for the barrels was sourced.

TITLE: Rabbit Hole Founder's Collection Raceking Five Grain Double Chocolate Malt Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Raceking marks the third expression of the Rabbit Hole Founder’s Collection series. Raceking was named in honor of Kentucky’s time-honored tradition of horse racing and gives a nod to Rabbit Hole’s bold and unbridled pursuit of creativity and innovation in the American whiskey space. With its one-of-a-kind mash bill, Raceking explores how malting organically expands the range of flavors in whiskey. Through proprietary malting processes, chocolate wheat from Germany and a chocolate barley from the UK achieve the aromatic top notes and rich essence of chocolate. When cooked according to Rabbit Hole’s own methods and met with aging in wood-fired, toasted, and charred new American Oak barrels, the flavors of the whiskey become intricately nuanced. In keeping with the aesthetic of Rabbit Hole Founder’s Collection, the striking presentation of Raceking consists of a linen-patterned box featuring the brand’s rabbit marque in a chocolate-brown etching surrounded by metallic mocha appointments and sophisticated racing-silk-blue accents. The color palette tastefully extends to the bottle which features embossed-glass detailing of the brand’s iconic sash label and includes a metallic-topped cork engraved with Kaveh’s family crest of “Amare et Opus,” which speaks to his motto of loving what you do.This cask-strength offering is 109.2 proof/54.6% ABV. The mash bill of Raceking is 70% Corn, 13% Rye, 10% Malted Rye, 4% Chocolate Malted Wheat, 3% Chocolate Malted Barley.

TITLE: Rabbit Hole Founder's Collection: Mizunara Cask Strength
DESCRIPTION: A rare, 15YO Kentucky Straight Bourbon finished for 1 additional year in new Japanese Mizunara oak. The oldest and most exquisite expression from the Kentucky-based Rabbit Hole distillery. A mahogany color. The nose is enticing with rich notes of banana, apple, pear, cherry, black pepper, and ming. The palate is packed with flavors of oak, spice, nutmeg, black pepper, tobacco, and cinnamon. The finish is luxurious, rich, and buttery.

TITLE: Rabbit Hole Heigold 2021 Single Barrel Cask Strength Kentucky Straight Bourbon Set (6 bottles) 2021
DESCRIPTION: This is a first Single Barrel release from the Rabbit Hole Distillery. This is a full set of 6 bottles, each having a different design. For their inaugural 2021 Single Barrel release, the distillery has hand-selected casks from an extremely limited number of Heigold Kentucky Straight Bourbon barrels. Each is a study of patience and creativity. To complement this one-of-a-kind whiskey, the packaging for each season of barrel releases is unique and features a different series of six original Limited Edition illustrations commissioned by the Founder, Kaveh Zamanian from renowned watercolorist and fashion illustrator Kasiq Jungwoo Lee. Each 6-bottle case will contain a bottle with each label design. The result is a true work of art inside and out that could only be bottled at cask strength. Heigold Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey with a high-rye mash bill bottled at full cask strength. Proof will vary by bottle - but generally falls between 100 and 125. Approximately only 150-225 bottles were produced at 750ml Barrels were aged in #3, wood-fired, toasted & charred new American Oak barrels for 4+ years. TITLE: Rabbit Hole Heigold Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rabbit Hole’s Heigold, a Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey made with a high percentage of imported German malted rye. Distilled from 70% corn, 25% malted rye, and 5% malted barley, aged for just under four years in toasted and charred new oak barrels. Strong and bold, this super-premium bourbon offers initial butterscotch and toasted malt tones before leading into a burst of refreshing citrus notes and finishing with comforting pepper spice. This straight bourbon edition is a tribute to Christian Heigold, a German who immigrated to Louisville in 1850.

DESCRIPTION: Raconteur Rye's "Brazen" stands out in the brand's exclusive collection, curated by David Jennings and The WoodWork Collective. This exceptional whiskey was distilled in Indiana, aged in Indiana and Kentucky, and carefully bottled by The WoodWork Collective in Louisville, Kentucky. Raconteur Rye is a meticulously crafted blend featuring a 95% rye, 5% malted barley mash bill, aged for 7 years. The aging process includes 9 months of finishing in a Mizunara cask, adding layers of complexity and depth. With a robust ABV of 61.37% (122.74 proof), this rye whiskey delivers bold flavors and a rich mouthfeel, perfect for those who appreciate a powerful spirit. This limited release, with only 1,000 bottles available, showcases a unique composition: 95/5 Indiana straight rye whiskey (new charred oak) 95/5 Indiana straight rye whiskey (48-month-cured toasted oak) 95/5 Indiana straight rye whiskey finished in a Mizunara cask Named "Brazen" for its unapologetically bold character, this rye offers an intensified experience of vanilla, caramel, fruit, and oak, making it a must-have for collectors and connoisseurs alike. Don't miss the chance to add this rare gem to your collection—order now while supplies last.

TITLE: Radley & Finch The Prof's Pinotage
Rafael Tirado Valle del Maule Laberinto Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: As one of ten children, Rafael Tirado has long been prepared to navigate his way through life. Over the course of his decades long career, he has made wine around the world, managed several mid-sized Chilean wineries, many of which are exported to the USA, and has become one of the most sought after wine consultants in Chile. Rafa purchased land in the Eastern Maule Valley in the front range of the Chilean Andes and planted his first estate vines in 1993 on volcanic ash over granite. He currently has five parcels totaling 18ha of vines. His vineyards are legally recognized to be located within the Colbun DO and currently is the only estate producer in the DO. Much of his vineyard is planted in various orientations, some of which are planted in the shape of a labyrinth. Rafael built a small gravity fed winery and a geothermal barrel and bottle room on the property, and currently produces estate wines under the Laberinto and Vistalago labels. We believe these wines to be some of the most classical expressions of terroir in all of Chile, and Rafael Tirado to be a beacon of Artisan Chilean Wine.

TITLE: Ramona Lemon Wine Spritz
DESCRIPTION: RAMONA was created with a rebellious spirit and an ambitious objective - to offer high-quality wine, often blended with fruit, in fun little packages. The team at Ramona celebrates organic growing practices and a belief that drinking wine can be spontaneous and portable, it need not be relegated to the dinner table. Ramona is a modern wine cooler made with organic grapes and natural fruit flavors. It comes in a 250ml recyclable aluminum slim can, because they believe that great wine comes in sassy little packages. The project is named after Jordan Salcito's youngest sister, who became obsessed with the fictional literary character Ramona Quimby when she was younger and renamed herself Ramona, refusing to answer to any other name. As 'Ramona,' Anne-Marie developed a mischievous, fun-loving alter-ego. That independent spirit informs the spirit of Ramona.usa

TITLE: Rampur Asava Cabernet Sauvignon Classic Indian Red Wine Casks Single Malt Indian Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This is the world’s first Indian wine cask-finished whisky, produced in the foothills of the Himalayas. Anup Barik, Rampur’s master distiller, is in the impeccable form here, re-casking mature whisky into Indian cabernet sauvignon barrels and monitoring them judiciously to find the perfect balance. Enticing aromas of damson, black currant, aromatic spices, vanilla essence, and pipe tobacco rise from the glass. The jammy autumnal fruits are immediate and compelling on the palate, developing red cherry, honey, peppery spice, and candied peel notes. Delectable expressions from this nation are flourishing, and with Asava, Rampur has beautifully captured the spirit of Indian whisky.

TITLE: Ranger Creek Brewing & Distilling 44 Texas Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Ranger Creek .44 Texas Rye was designed to highlight the complexity of the grain. It is a 100% rye whiskey that is aged in used bourbon barrels. The used barrels produce a more spirit-forward whiskey that allows the flavor of the grain to shine. .44 Texas Rye pours a rich gold with a nose of cinnamon, mint, and toffee. The taste is strong and compact with notes of clove and tobacco. It has a clean, warming finish with lingering notes of fresh bread crust. The whiskey opens up with two drops of water to amplify the diverse rye flavors.

TITLE: Ranger Creek Brewing & Distilling Rimfire Mesquite Smoked Texas Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The nose of Rimfire brings about sweet tropical notes of ripe mango and dried banana with a hint of vanilla. The taste is smooth and delicate with a light malty sweetness. And the finish is soft, balanced, and dry with hints of light smoke and roasted chocolate. A few drops of water help to enhance the smoke and highlight the mesquite flavor.

TITLE: Ransom Spirits Sweet Vermouth
DESCRIPTION: Ransom Wine and Spirits is a microdistillery founded in Oregon that bases its spirits on the wine grapes--something that Oregon is becoming increasingly famous for around the world. The company was founded in 1997 by Tad Seestedt with "a fistful of credit cards" and beginning with grappa, brandy, and eau d'vie. To this day the company is committed to organic and "biodynamically produced" fruits. The name "ransom" is a kind of joke to the money necessary to become a small business owner "and the amount of debt owed to banks and other loaning institutions." Ransom Sweet Vermouth claims to hearken to the French Belle Epoch. They use their own white wine including Gewurztraminer (a very sweet wine) and Riesling. They give it a solera style aging, a spice infusion, and then lightly sweetened with maple syrup and turbinado sugar.

TITLE: Ransom Spirits The Emerald 1865 Straight American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Emerald 1865 Straight American Whiskey is made from a mash of malted barley, unmalted barley, rye and oats. Once the grains have been harvested (a portion of the grains are grown organically on Seestedt's own farm), they are milled and mashed before being distilled on a handmade, direct-fired alembic pot still. Following distillation, the whiskey is matured for three years in a combination of American oak and French oak casks. Then, the whiskey is hand-bottled, waxed and labeled. Made from a rare mash of malted barley, barley grain, malted rye and rolled oats, The Emerald is a heartfelt recreation of traditional Irish whisky. Distilled using a custom, direct-fired alembic pot still, the whisky is vibrantly aromatic, creamy, rich, and intensely flavorful. This is a must-have. Only 1,440 bottles of this whiskey have ever been made. Pick one up today!

TITLE: Ransom Spirits Whipper Snapper Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Toasty brown spice aromas that suggest nutmeg, cardamom and cinnamon with a supple, dryish medium-to-full body and a peppercorn, cream, piney incense, and herbed salt accented finish.

TITLE: Rapa Nui Malbec
DESCRIPTION: Red purple color of medium intensity. Very seductive aromas of ripe plums, black fruits and violets. Soft on the palate, sweet and pleasant finish. Ideal for meats and mature cheeses. Best served at 60 to 65º F.

TITLE: Rare Character "Enigmatic Elixir" 6 year Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #57
DESCRIPTION: Rare Character squarely falls into the "If You Know, You Know" category of whiskey brands. They are purveyors of fine American whiskey focused on unique selections tailored to their customers and partners. Through unique relationships with top distillers nationwide, Rare Character has exclusive access to expressions that have never been released to the public. We connected with them about a year ago on a couple of potential selections and had a blast blind tasting through their portfolio. One of the partners also runs a whiskey bar in Venice, CA, and had us blindly comparing our selections vs Old Forester Birthday bourbons, Willett ryes, and other well-known expressions. Our selections stood up against anything we tasted that day.More on this bourbon selection then. This is a 6 years 6 month straight bourbon distilled in Indiana but aged in Kentucky at the stone warehouse at Castle & Key (originally built in 1887) where EHT Taylor barrels used to age. The aging process brought out a lot of spice heavy and complex whiskey beyond just being sweet. The whiskey has a "honeyed sweetness quality" to it. Mashbill: 75% corn / 21% rye / 4% malted barley mash bill Aged in a stone warehouse built in 1887 The most complex 21% rye mashbill we’ve had in a while Low tone spice, very dynamic, very "its own" because of its warehouse Notes of Apricot pits vs. the flesh - pure pits Compare to Old forester 1920 as you drink it

TITLE: Rare Character "Permitted Hazmat" 8 Year 11 Months  Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #94
DESCRIPTION: The brand's new burgundy top KOA series launches with a standout HAZMAT release, only the third of its kind. This release packs a punch at 140 proof, bottled and aged in Central Kentucky. While the distillate source remains confidential under an NDA, it features prominent notes of cinnamon candy, cherry cola, and brown sugar. The mashbill is 75/21/4, inviting those with whiskey knowledge to speculate about its origins. We compared this exceptional sample from the KOA barrel series against some of the most revered high-proof expressions: BTAC George T Stagg 2012 (17 yr, 142.8 proof) and 2014 (16 yr, 138.1 proof) releases, and Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Batch 6 (12 yr, 140.2 Proof). This barrel not only held its own but also tied with the hazmat GTS expression and surpassed the 2014 GTS release, ranking closely behind ECBP. This is high praise indeed, and we invite you to judge for yourselves.

TITLE: Rare Character 6 Year Straight Rye Whiskey Finished in Amburana Cask The Prime Barrel Pick #76
DESCRIPTION: Rare Character squarely falls into the "If You Know, You Know" category of whiskey brands. They are purveyors of fine American whiskey focused on unique selections tailored to their customers and partners. Through unique relationships with top distillers nationwide, Rare Character has exclusive access to expressions that have never been released to the public. Discover our latest collab with the brand - Straight Rye Whiskey Finished in Amburana Cask. This unique whiskey is a brilliant blend of traditional rye whiskey and the exotic flavors imparted by Amburana wood barrels from South America. This barrel-proof whiskey is not for the faint of heart. The mashbill comprises 51% rye, 45% corn, and 4% malted barley, while the whiskey itself has matured for 6 years and 11 months before being finished in Amburana casks. The resulting spirit is a testament to the experimental essence of Rare Character Whiskey, exploring the possibilities of American whiskey one barrel at a time. Barrel Info: Barrel #4MB-R-52 Proof: 117.5 Age: 6 years 10 months Mashbill: 51% rye, 45% corn, 4% malted barley Tasting Notes: Nose: The aroma leaps from the glass with dominant notes of cinnamon, blending well with a dessert-like quality reminiscent of rice pudding. Undertones of vanilla cream add a soft, sweet layer to the nose. Palate: The flavors on the palate mirror the nose, showcasing a robust cinnamon character and a particular cereal crunch. The warmth of the whiskey is well-pronounced, especially for those not accustomed to cask-strength spirits. Finish: The finish is spicy yet smooth, leaving a lasting impression of cinnamon warmth with every sip​. Food Pairing: Given the strong cinnamon and vanilla notes, this whiskey pairs well with desserts like apple pie or cinnamon rolls. For a savory pairing, consider dishes with a hint of sweetness or spice, like glazed ham or BBQ ribs.

TITLE: Rare Character Limited Release Kentucky Straight Bourbon 01
DESCRIPTION: Introducing Rare Character Limited Release Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey, an exclusive, limited-edition bourbon crafted for those who seek premium, small-batch whiskey. Sourced from the finest Kentucky rickhouses, this bourbon is a blend of handpicked barrels aged between 5.5 to 15 years. Its rich history and attention to detail make it an exceptional addition to any collection. Craftsmanship in Every Bottle The Rare Character Limited Release series is the result of meticulous barrel selection. Each bottle is carefully crafted, blending Kentucky-distilled straight wheated bourbon whiskey with Kentucky straight rye whiskey. This unique combination offers a rare depth and complexity that differentiates it from other bourbons. Expect bold flavors of caramel, oak, vanilla, and a touch of rye spice that will linger on your palate. Why Choose Rare Character? Small Batch Excellence: Aged to perfection in 5.5 to 15-year-old barrels, ensuring a rich and consistent flavor profile. High Proof, Big Flavor: Bottled at a robust proof (typically 100-120), this bourbon delivers a bold, yet balanced tasting experience. Award-Winning Heritage: Rare Character’s previous batches have earned accolades such as Double Gold from the San Francisco World Spirits Awards. Limited Availability: Only a select number of bottles were produced, making this release a must-have for collectors and enthusiasts alike. Perfect for Collectors The Rare Character Limited Release series isn’t just about the flavor; it’s also a collector’s dream. Each batch comes with thematic artwork, making every bottle not only a drink but also a piece of art. The carefully curated labels add a touch of exclusivity to your whiskey collection.

DESCRIPTION: Rare Character Whiskey Company's The Exceptional Series 12 Year Old Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Malt Whiskey is a unique and rare expression, embodying the brand's commitment to sourcing the most distinguished and high-quality whiskeys. This 12-year-old whiskey showcases the art of whiskey-making, offering a product that is scarce, aged to perfection, and of unparalleled quality.

TITLE: Rare Character Whiskey Company The Exceptional Series 9 Year Old Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rare Character Whiskey Company's The Exceptional Series 9 Year Old Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is part of a series dedicated to curation and exceptional craftsmanship. This series represents the brand's commitment to offering distinguished and superior quality whiskeys. Each bottle in The Exceptional Series is at least 9 years old, highlighting its rarity and embodying exceptionally rare character. Rare Character Whiskey Company sources its whiskeys from various distilleries, with this particular expression coming from Kentucky. The brand is known for its focus on unique selections tailored to its customers and partners, offering a range of single barrel selections including bourbon, rye, and whiskey.

TITLE: Rare Perfection 12 Year Old Kentucky Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rare Perfection is a boutique bourbon brand owned by Allied Lomar in California, whose other products include Very Olde St. Nick, Wattie Boone, and the Old Man Winter bottles. They have been sourcing bourbon and bottling it for several decades, and they are all easily identified by their uniform use of the same cursive script-style typeface. Company president, Marci Palatella, was Julian Van Winkle III's agent in the Japanese market for many years, and their early bottlings were contracted to him in his Old Commonwealth distillery. The Van Winkle partnership with Sazerac in the early 2000s ended this agreement; however, with the production of bottles such as this moved to Willett distillery, where they were bottled by its owners, Evan Kulsveen's Kentucky Bourbon Distillers. The stills at Willett were silent, and KBD was sourcing most of their bourbon from Heaven Hill. This likely is where this bourbon came from. This is a small batch of 12-year-old bourbon bottled by Kentucky Bourbon Distillers at Willett. Although the Willett distillery is producing its liquid again now, it was still silent from the early 1980s until 2012.

TITLE: Rare Perfection 14 Year Old Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rare Perfection 14 Year from Preservation Distillery is made from a bourbon mash bill and aged in the freezing cold warehouses of Canada. Although technically Canadian Whiskey, it was distilled from a 4-grain wheated bourbon mash bill with just a hint of rye and malted barley. According to Preservation Distillery, the cold climate where this whiskey was aged has helped create its thick buttery body without the heavy lumber notes on the finish. This is due to the wood not expanding nearly as much in the cold northern climate. Rare Perfection 14 Year is an Overproof whiskey bottled 100.7 proof.

TITLE: Rare Perfection 15 Year Old Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This lot of Rare Perfection 15-year whiskey is made from a bourbon mash bill of corn, wheat, and malted barley that was distilled in Canada. This whiskey was originally intended to be aged in a cold warehouse for a relatively short period of time, but the distillery was sold off and these barrels were forgotten in the back of the warehouse and left to age in the cold Canadian air. 15 years later these barrels were discovered, dumped, and bottled at barrel proof. Rare Perfection 15 year is a limited release that was bottled at cask strength, 119.7 proof.

TITLE: Rata Estate Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Rata Estate Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc is a pristine example of New Zealand's renowned Sauvignon Blanc from the famous Marlborough region. Crafted with precision and care, this wine delivers a vibrant, crisp, and refreshing profile that showcases the unique terroir of Marlborough. With bright tropical fruit flavors, zesty citrus, and a touch of herbaceousness, this Sauvignon Blanc is the perfect balance of elegance and intensity. Enjoy the signature vibrancy of a classic Marlborough wine with Rata Estate’s exceptional craftsmanship.

TITLE: Raventos i Blanc Conca del Riu Anoia Blanc de Blancs
DESCRIPTION: From the plots La Barbera, La Plana and El Viader which have deep calcareous soils with a sand-rich loamy texture giving freshness and elegance and El Llac, a 40 year old plot with marine fossils providing structure and complexity. Vines are handpicked and farmed biodynamically with vinification in stainless steel tanks followed by blending and secondary fermentation in bottle, aged for a minimum of 18 months. Extra Brut.

TITLE: Rebecca Creek 12 Yr Cask Strength Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This 12 Year Old Bourbon offers an exquisite and unique taste that combines the deep oak character, and savory spice of rye, with a nutty finish. This complexity has been balanced by the pure texas Hill Country limestone-filtered water, direct from Edward's Aquifer. Experience a special reserve that proves why whiskey enthusiasts pursue aged bourbon throughout the world. It is appreciated both neat and in your favorite whiskey cocktails with good company. Enjoy!

TITLE: Rebel 10 Years Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rebel 10 Year Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a meticulously crafted spirit that offers a rich tapestry of dark flavors, aged oak, and a sprig of wheat grain, differentiating it from other wheated bourbons. This whiskey is aged for 10 years in new, charred American oak barrels and is bottled at 100 proof. Lux Row Distillers sources high-quality barrels for this brand, ensuring a consistent and robust flavor profile. With each barrel bottled separately, slight variations in the bourbon are expected, adding a unique touch to every bottle.

TITLE: Rebel Distiller's Collection Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: ‘Wheated’ Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey hand-picked from extraordinary barrels by Lux Row Distillers. It is bottled at an optimal 113 proof, as determined by their Head Distiller, to achieve the smoothest taste profile for Rebel. Rebel uses the original ‘wheated’ recipe invented in 1849 from what would become the famous Stitzel-Weller Distillery.

TITLE: Rebel Wine Bandit Red Blend
DESCRIPTION: Bandit Red Blend is aged in a blend of French and American oak. Winemakers bring together 44% Zinfandel, 36% Merlot, 15% Cabernet Sauvignon and 5% Syrah to craft this easygoing wine and it is finished in a semi-dry style with enough natural residual grape sweetness to make it inviting, pleasing, and delicious. Ripe red fruit aromas and flavors with sweet, spicy oak tones. Try our versatile Red Blend with steaks on the grill or s’mores around the fire.

TITLE: Rebel Wine Bandit Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: To enhance the racy freshness of the Sauvignon Blanc grape, stainless steel tanks to craft this wine were used. The result is a wine that sings with bright herbal and citrus flavors and the zesty, mouth-watering acidity so characteristic of this varietal. Zesty and fresh, our Sauvignon Blanc zings with bright citrus aromas, framed by f lavors of tart apple, fresh green herbs, and citrus. Mouthwatering and juicy, this wine will keep everyone oming back for more with its crisp, clean finish.

TITLE: Red Line 5 Year Single Barrel Cask Strength Straight Rye
DESCRIPTION: Rye whiskey in its purest form. Red Line Cask Strength Rye beautifully showcases our signature flavor profile. Each barrel is aged in new American oak barrels and completely uncut and non-chill-filtered. Each barrel is hand selected to create product customers will enjoy. 115 Proof. 95% Rye, 5% Barely Malt mashbill

TITLE: Red Line 6 Year Old Single Barrel Toasted Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This product is made by taking our Red Line Cask Strength Straight Rye Whiskey and then aging it for an additional period in a second custom-made barrel. This second barrel is assembled from 18-month air-dried wood and then toasted, not charred as your standard bourbon barrel. This process allows the sugars in the wood to be drawn to the interior surface where the bourbon will be making contact, adding amazing flavors to the bourbon. The truly unique and delicious taste this toasted finishing process offers represents a remarkable achievement, given that it is Straight Rye Whiskey with nothing extra added except the transfer into the toasted barrel. 115 Proof. 95% Rye, 5% Barley Malt mashbill.

TITLE: Red Line 6 Year Single Barrel Cask Strength Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Bourbon in its purest form. Red Line Cask Strength Bourbon beautifully showcases our signature flavor profile. Each barrel is aged in new American oak barrels and completely uncut and non-chill-filtered. Each barrel is hand selected to ensure an enjoyable pour. 75% Corn, 21% Rye, 4% Barley Malt mashbill

TITLE: Red Line 6 Year Single Barrel Toasted Barrel Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This product is made by taking our Red Line Cask Strength Straight Bourbon and then aging it for an additional period in a second custom-made barrel. This second barrel is assembled from 18-month air-dried wood and then toasted, not charred as your normal bourbon barrel. This process allows for the sugars in the wood to be drawn to the interior surface where the bourbon will be making contact, adding amazing flavors to the bourbon. TITLE: Red Newt Cellars Gewurztraminer
DESCRIPTION: Spicy ethnic foods from around the globe are the perfect complement to these robust flavors and intense finish.

TITLE: Red Spot 15 Years Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Aged a minimum of 15 years, Red Spot Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey has made its return to the realm of Irish whiskey after a half-century. This reincarnated version is a whiskey that’s done in the triple distilled, single pot still style and aged a minimum of 15 years in a combination of casks pre-seasoned with Bourbon, Oloroso Sherry and Marsala fortified wine. For those who always wondered on the use of the word Spot, it is derived from Mitchell’s practice of marking their maturing casks of whiskey with a dab of colored paint to determine the age potential of the whiskey; with a Blue Spot, Green Spot, Yellow Spot or Red Spot indicating 7, 10, 12 or 15 years respectively.

TITLE: Red Tail Ridge Barrel Fermented Chardonnay
DESCRIPTION: Aged for 8 months in French and American barrels, and Hungarian puncheons. Located in New York's Finger Lakes region, Red Tail Ridge Winery is owned and operated by husband and wife Mike Schnelle and Nancy Irelan. As a former executive in charge of viticulture and oenology R&D at a large winery, Nancy strongly believes in sustainability. Not only is Red Tail Ridge farmed in a sustainable manner it is also the first LEED certified winery in New York. Everything at Red Tail Ridge reflects Nancy and Mike's attention to detail – the winery that they built from scratch to their limited production, premium single varietal wines. The bulk of Red Tail Ridge's production is Riesling, but Nancy and Mike have also planted several clones of Chardonnay, Pinot Noir alongside small experimental plots of Blaufrankisch, Dornfelder and Teroldego. Mike and Nancy's early efforts were duly noted by the press – they won several Gold and Silver medals, Wine Business Monthly named Red Tail Ridge one of its Hot Small Brands of 2008 and Eric Asimov the wine critic of The New York Times has lauded them for their efforts. Meat Pairings - Chicken Breast, Turkey Breast, Pork Loin, Halibut, Trout, Cod, Sturgeon, Oily Flaky Fish, Atlantic Salmon, Lobster, Crab, Scallops, Shrimp, Clams, Oysters (unoaked) Spices and Herbs - Tarragon, Parsley, Thyme, Lemon Zest, Marjoram, White Pepper, Shallots, Poultry Seasoning Cheese Pairings - Soft – Semi Soft Cow’s Milk Cheese and Goat Cheese. Vegetables & Vegetarian Fare - Yellow Squash, Peas, Zucchini, Asparagus, Sun Chokes, Seitan, White Mushrooms, Truffles, Chanterelles, Almonds

TITLE: Red Tail Ridge Good Karma Riesling
DESCRIPTION: Good Karma is a charity wine. Ten percent of the gross profit per bottle will be donated to your state’s food bank. We are proud to support the vision for a hunger-free community and happy that our regional food bank, Foodlink in Rochester, NY will assist in distributing funds from Good Karma to other food banks across the country where this wine is sold. Think Spice. Because of Riesling’s sweetness and acidity, it makes the perfect accompaniment to spicy food. Strong Indian and Asian spices are a perfect match with Riesling. A classic pairing with Riesling is spiced duck leg. Meat Pairings - Duck, Pork, Bacon, Chicken, Shrimp and Crab Spices and Herbs - Highly spiced and aromatic herbs including Cayenne Pepper, Ginger, Clove, Cinnamon, Allspice, Tumeric, Madras Curry, Sichuan Pepper, Shallots, Soy Sauce, Sesame, Marjoram, Basil, Rice Vinegar and Teriyaki Sauce. Cheese Pairings -Try it with less stinky and delicately flavored soft cow’s milk cheese and dried fruit. Vegetables & Vegetarian Fare - Roasted vegetables and veggies with natural sweetness including Coconut, Red Onion, Bell Pepper, Eggplant, Tempeh, Squash and Carrot.

TITLE: Redacted Bros. 6 Years Old Oak Cask TB/BSW Blended Scotch Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Redacted Bros. 6 Year Old Oak Cask TB/BSW Blended Scotch Whisky is a unique and flavorful blend, created by the Thompson brothers, Phil and Simon. Originally known as Thompson Bros., they are renowned for establishing one of Scotland's top whisky bars and crowdfunding their own distillery at the Dornoch Castle Hotel. Due to trademark issues in the US, the brand name has been changed to Redacted Bros. This expression celebrates sherry maturation and sherry-forward blends of the past. The whisky is a blend of carefully chosen single malts and single grains, all aged for at least 6 years before being expertly blended and rested. The specific details of the malts and grains used remain a secret, adding to the intrigue of this unique blend. Bottled at 46% ABV, this whisky offers a balance of easy-drinking quaffability and flavor-forward intensity.

TITLE: Redacted Bros. 8 Years Old Oak Cask SRV5 Blended Malt Scotch Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Redacted Bros. 8 Year Old Oak Cask SRV5 Blended Malt Scotch Whisky is a well-regarded expression crafted by the Thompson brothers, known for their expertise in the whisky industry. While specific details about the distillery and grain selection might be undisclosed, their reputation for sourcing high-quality casks is well established. This particular blend features malts sourced from North Highland, Islay, and Speyside regions, meticulously chosen for their unique character and combined to create a harmonious and complex flavor profile. Aged for a minimum of 8 years in oak casks, the whisky matures and develops rich flavors before being bottled without chill filtration or added color, ensuring authenticity and preserving its natural character.

TITLE: Redacted Bros. Organic Mediterranean Gin
DESCRIPTION: Redacted Bros. Organic Mediterranean Gin is a bright and flavorful gin, crafted using a unique blend of organic botanicals sourced from the Mediterranean region. The exact botanical recipe remains a secret, but the gin is known for its refreshing citrus notes, balanced with herbal and floral nuances. This gin is distilled at the Dornoch Distillery in Scotland, using a traditional copper pot still. The organic botanicals are carefully selected and undergo a meticulous vapor infusion process, ensuring the extraction of their essential oils and the creation of a complex and aromatic gin. Redacted Bros. Organic Mediterranean Gin is non-chill filtered and bottled at 45.7% ABV, preserving its natural character and full flavor profile.

TITLE: Redbreast 12 Years Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Redbreast is a very special whiskey within the Irish Distillers fortified as it’s the only 12 year old Pure Pot Still available. It was first launched in 1939 as the brand name given to the pot still whiskey supplied by Jameson to whiskey bonders before bottling at the distillery became the norm in 1968. Stocks of whiskey in bonders’ stores petered out, and thus Redbreast all but disappeared until its re-launch by the distillery in the 1990s as a single pot still whiskey. This pure pot still whiskey is matured for a minimum of 12 years in sherry casks and Bourbon barrels. Like all good pot still whiskeys, it is strongly flavoured and assertive, making it a rare treat for the connoisseur of fine old whiskey.

TITLE: Redbreast 15 Years Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Made from a mash of malted and unmalted barley and then triple distilled in copper pot stills, Redbreast 15 is comprised exclusively of Pot Still whiskeys matured in the finest oak casks for no less than 15 years. A careful balance of first fill and refill casks accentuates the assorted spices within Redbreast’s characteristic full and complex flavour.

TITLE: Redbreast 21 Years Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate magazine rating: 96

TITLE: Redbreast Kentucky Oak Edition  Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 96, #2 on Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 ListRedbreast’s new series champions the influence of American oak from various parts of the U.S., leaning less heavily on its signature sherried style. For this first U.S. exclusive, Irish Distillers worked with the Taylor family, renowned for their sustainable forestry practices, to select oaks from the Elk Cave Farm in Gravel Switch, Kentucky. The virgin oak cask-finished single pot still whiskey amplifies flavors of sliced almond, creamy vanilla, cinder toffee, red fruits, and oak spice, drawing inspiration from techniques developed with Irish oak for Midleton’s Dair Ghaelach series while being bottled at 101 proof to pay homage to the Bluegrass State.

TITLE: Redbreast Missouri Oak Edition Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Redbreast Missouri Oak Edition Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey is a unique and innovative expression from the renowned Midleton Distillery. This special edition showcases the traditional craftsmanship of Redbreast, combined with the unique influence of Missouri oak barrels. The use of American oak imparts distinctive flavors and complexity, resulting in a whiskey that is both rich and full of character. Bottled at 101.6 proof, this whiskey offers a robust and dynamic drinking experience. The Missouri Oak Edition is a testament to Redbreast's commitment to quality and innovation, making it a must-have for whiskey enthusiasts and collectors alike.

TITLE: Redbreast Small Batch Cask Strength Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Made from a mash of malted and unmalted barley and then triple distilled in copper pot stills, Redbreast Small Batch effortlessly delivers the unmistakable intensity of cask strength Redbreast. Initially matured in a combination of the finest American Oak Casks and Spanish Sherry Butts, these whiskeys were then re-casked into Oloroso Sherry Butts to further heighten the signature sherried Redbreast style that has been bottled exclusively for the USA. 58.7% ABV

TITLE: Redbreast Tawny Port Cask Edition Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Redbreast Tawny Port Cask Edition emerges as a distinguished member of the prestigious Redbreast family, embodying the rich tradition of Irish whiskey craftsmanship. Produced at the historic Midleton Distillery in Cork, Ireland, this limited edition single pot still whiskey showcases a remarkable journey of maturation. Initially aged in a harmonious blend of bourbon and oloroso sherry casks, it undergoes a meticulous finishing process in select tawny port casks from Portugal's esteemed Douro Valley. This unique aging process, lasting between 14 to 25 months in tawny port hogsheads, introduces a complex and layered flavor profile, enriching the whiskey with a depth of character and a tapestry of aromatic nuances.

TITLE: Redemption 10 Year Old Barrel Proof Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Redemption 10 Year Old Barrel Proof Straight Rye Whiskey is made from a mash of 95% rye and 5% malted barley, and is matured for a minimum of 10 years before being mingled and bottled from just six individual barrels. The whiskey is then bottled at barrel proof.

TITLE: Redemption High Rye Bourbon 10 Years Old Barrel Proof Bourbon Whiskey
Redemption High-Rye Bourbon
Redemption Rye 8 year old Barrel Proof Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Redemption Rye Whiskies are very sought after, and this is especially the case when it comes to their Barrel Proof 8-year Rye. It was numbers 3 on Whiskey Advocate's 2015 Top 10 Whiskies of the year. This is a 122.5 proof release.

TITLE: Redemption Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: We start with a mash-bill of 95% premium rye and age it for over two years in new charred oak barrels. Once properly aged we bottle it at a bold 92 proof - perfect to stand up on its own in any cocktail or by itself in your favorite glass.

TITLE: Redemption Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Cognac Casks 001
DESCRIPTION: Made from the brand's high-rye Bourbon recipe and finished for a year and a half in a variety of ex-Cognac casks from Maison Ferrand, made of French Oak with some casks dating back to as far as 1988. The unique finish draws out novel flavors of ripe grapes, dark plums, brown butter, chocolate chess pie, and roasted nuts. Aged for five and a half years and bottled at 99 Proof. Available in very limited quantity.

TITLE: Redemption Straight Rye Whiskey Barrel Proof
DESCRIPTION: The U.S. Government Standards require "rye whiskey" to be made from a mash of at least 51% rye grain. For Redemption Rye distillery uses a mash of 95% premium rye grain for a spicy and bold flavor and premium rye, which costs more but is well worth it, because when you use good ingredients you get good rye whiskey. The U.S. Government Standards also require that rye whiskey be aged in "new charred oak barrels" which means that new oak barrels are burned on the inside, and it's from the charred wood and the expansion and contraction of the whiskey in and through the wood of the barrel through the seasons that whiskey gets its amber color and the flavor is smoothed. Distillery bottles in small batches which allows them to leave the whiskey in the barrels longer for the most flavor and color. They empty the barrels and filter for particles, cut it down to 92 proof and bottle it immediately so that the most flavor from the barrel makes it into the bottle. Then the distillery marks each bottle with the batch and bottle number by hand. Then the bottles are packed into cases and shipped around to the country, and that's the Redemption Rye process! So enjoy this fine rye responsibly and share our pride in this great American Spirit.

TITLE: Redemption The Ancients 18 Year Old Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This is a grown-up whiskey for grown-up drinkers. Not too oaky, it delivers a lot of rye character with real gravitas. It’s a splurge, for sure, but a worthy one if you’re a serious rye devotee looking for something with big, bold, memorable flavor.

TITLE: Redemption White Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Redemption White Rye Whiskey showcases the high quality of our rye distillate. This unpaged rye has smoothness and great flavors on its own even before barrel aging. Grassy and citrus notes bolstered by a black pepper get spice that lets you know its a rye.

TITLE: Redheads Studio Yard Dog Red
DESCRIPTION: Easily gulp-able fruit power with blackcurrant crunch, firm structural tannins, and a slight touch of oak

TITLE: Redheads Studio Yard Dog White
DESCRIPTION: Yard Dog. The old faithful friend. A beloved household pet the whole family adores. The quintessential companion. The same could be said for these Aussie varietals, almost every winery owns one. It is said that the personality of a dog will reflect that of its owner and the character of a wine will reflect that of its maker. But winemakers beware! If you do not pamper the pooch you may find that the hand that feeds the dog may be bitten. Beware of the Yard Dog.

TITLE: Redwood Empire "Grizzly Beast" Bottle in Bond Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This rare whiskey was bottled under the strict tenets of the Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897. Aged in the temperate climate of the Northern California coast, the original distillate was altered only by the addition of pure water from the Russian River Valley aquifer. This is the purest expression of Redwood Empire’s craft.

TITLE: Redwood Empire "Rocket Top" Bottled in Bond Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This rare whiskey was bottled under the strict tenents of the Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897. Aged in the temperate climate of the Northern California coast, the original distillate was altered only by the addition of pure water from the Russian River Valley aquifer. This is the purest expression of Redwood Empire’s craft.

TITLE: Redwood Empire 14 Years Haystack Needle Double Barrel Bourbon Whiskey Finished in a Port Cask
DESCRIPTION: Haystack Needle is a limited-release, single-barrel offering from Redwood Empire. Select lots of 14-year-old bourbon are carefully chosen from our Sonoma County rack house and wine cask finished for additional complexity. Each barrel is individually bottled, non-chill filtered to preserve rich, natural flavors, and offered at barrel strength.

TITLE: Redwood Empire Emerald Giant Cask Strength Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Redwood Empire has taken the whisky world by storm and finally. It's been much asked for, and finally, the core releases are available at cask strength. Buy a bottle - Redwood Empire plants a tree. Crafted in Sonoma, Redwood Empire is deeply tied to the forest. The Emerald Giant is one of the world's tallest and fastest-growing trees. It is 1180 years old and stands 360 feet tall, gaining over 1500 lbs of mass yearly. The 3-5-year-old rye whiskey is equally weighty. A mashbill of 95% rye and 5% malted barley combines distillate from Indiana and Redwood Empire. It's got a great spicy and sweet aroma and a mellow mouthfeel.

TITLE: Redwood Empire Emerald Giant Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Named after the fastest-growing Redwood in the world, Emerald Giant is a fan favorite in the Rye world. We started with a mash-bill of 95% premium rye and aged it for over 3 years in new charred oak barrels. Spicy with an exceptionally smooth finish, it is a great choice in your classic whiskey cocktails. MASH BILL: 95% Rye, 5% Malt Barley AWARDS: 97 POINTS - Tasting Panel Magazine - Nov 2019 DOUBLE GOLD - Las Vegas Global Spirit Awards, '19 DOUBLE GOLD - Sunset Magazine International Spirits Competition - Nov 2019

TITLE: Redwood Empire Pipe Dream Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Named for the 14th tallest tree on the planet, Pipe Dream is our first Bourbon whiskey. Pipe Dream Bourbon is made from barrels aged between four and twelve years with a high corn mash bill. Smooth and complex, it is a true sipping whiskey. MASH BILL: 75% Corn, 21% Raw Rye, 4% Malt Barley AGE: A blend 4 to 12-year-old barrels AWARDS: 94 POINTS Tasting Panel Magazine - Nov 2020 DOUBLE GOLD SIP Awards - Aug 2020 DOUBLE GOLD San Diego Spirits Festival - Sept 2019

TITLE: Redwood Empire Pipe Dream Cask Strength Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Experience Pipe Dream straight from the barrel in this limited edition cask strength offering. Aged for a minimum of four years in the temperate climate of the Northern California coast, explore new heights of Redwood Empire’s craft. MASHBILL: 75% Corn, 21% Raw Rye, 4% Malt Barley AGE: A blend of 4 to 12-year-old barrels

TITLE: Redwood Empire Screaming Titan Wheated Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Redwood Empire Screaming Titan Wheated Bourbon Whiskey is a testament to the innovative spirit of California’s Redwood Empire Distillery. Crafted with a unique mashbill that replaces rye with wheat, this bourbon offers a smoother, softer profile while still delivering robust flavors. Aged for five years in American oak barrels, Screaming Titan Wheated Bourbon embodies the essence of the Redwood Empire with its deep, rich character and complex flavor profile. Ideal for sipping neat, on the rocks, or as the foundation of your favorite bourbon cocktails, this whiskey is a true celebration of craftsmanship and nature’s bounty.

TITLE: Redwood Empire Whiskey Lost Monarch Blended Straight Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Named after the world’s largest coastal Redwood, Lost Monarch whiskey has a name to live up to. An award winning bourbon-rye blend with an exceptional balance of sweetness and spice. The perfect choice for those who just can’t decide between rye or bourbon, we call it “the best of both worlds.” MASH BILL: 60% Rye Whiskey,(95% Rye, 5% malted Barley) 40% Bourbon Whiskey (75% Corn, 21% raw Rye, 4% malted Barley) AGE: A blend of 4 to 12-year-old Bourbon & 3 to 5-year-old Rye Whiskey AWARDS: DOUBLE GOLD: SIP Awards - Aug 2020 GOLD MEDAL: Las Vegas Global Spirit Awards, '19 94 POINTS: Cigar and Spirits Magazine, '17

TITLE: Redwood Empire Whiskey Lost Monarch Cask Strength Blend of Straight Whiskeys
DESCRIPTION: Experience Lost Monarch straight from the barrel in this limited edition cask strength offering. Aged for a minimum of four years in the temperate climate of the Northern California coast, explore new heights of Redwood Empire’s craft. BLEND: 60% Rye Whiskey (95% Rye, 5% malted Barley) and 40% Bourbon Whiskey (75% Corn, 21% raw Rye, 4% malted Barley) AGE: A blend of 4 to 12-year-old Bourbon & 3 to 5-year-old Rye Whiskey

TITLE: Regan's Orange Bitters No. 6
DESCRIPTION: In pre-Prohibition days, a cocktail, by definition, was not a cocktail if it didn’t contain bitters. Which is why mixologists who look back longingly to that golden age for inspiration are in a frenzy over Regans’ Orange Bitters No. 6, cocktails historian Gary Regan’s brand-new elixir. Like adding vinegar to temper the sweetness and round out the flavor of certain dishes, adding bitters to cocktails provides balance and complexity

TITLE: Reginato Chaman Red Blend
DESCRIPTION: The Reginato family has been growing grapes in the Uco Valley of Argentina for over 60 years. Since 2002, Luis Reginato has been making wines for some of the top wineries from Argengetina. In 2013, a new brand was born - Chaman. After seeing and tasting from vineyards across Mendoza, Luis had a vision for a great wine. He saw the grapes in his family’s vineyard – especially the Petit Verdot – and saw potential, lots of potential. The quality of the Petit Verdot was so high that when the vines matured, he decided to make it a focal point. La Consulta is a great place for these grape varieties because it is cool climate but still gets full ripening, so you get intense wines with structure and balanced acidity. A Chaman, or “Shaman” in English, is a unique person who brings guidance to the present by accessing knowledge of the past - mysterious, magical, and inspiring. Luis and his brother Pepe invite you to experience the enchantment handed down by their mentor, father, and vineyard chaman, Jose Reginato. Try with shredded beef, lamb chops with mint jelly, or grilled salmon with sage and tarragon.

TITLE: Reguta Pinot Grigio
DESCRIPTION: Ideal as an aperitif, with sea salad, main dishes of fish and in particular with rich and savory soups.

TITLE: Rei Bushido Series Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: REI pure malt, part of the Bushido whisky series, is an amazing entrance whisky into the world of high-end Japanese whiskies. It caters to all of the flavors that made Japanese whisky famous worldwide. You'll witness bursts of tropical fruit, especially pineapple, from the start, and a smooth finish with little to no burn. Awards: SIP Awards 2020: Platinum Medal

TITLE: Remi Sedes Samplemousse Rose
Remus Babe Ruth Reserve Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Remus Babe Ruth Reserve Bourbon is a special edition bourbon that pays tribute to the legendary baseball player Babe Ruth, capturing the boldness and larger-than-life character associated with "The Sultan of Swat." Produced by MGP's Ross & Squibb Distillery, this bourbon delivers a robust and complex flavor profile that echoes the spirit of American tradition and excellence. Bottled at 111 proof, Remus Babe Ruth Reserve embodies the rich history of bourbon-making with a contemporary edge, making it a perfect addition for collectors and bourbon enthusiasts alike. Blend of: 12%: 2016 BOURBON 44% RYE 70%: 2017 BOURBON 49% RYE 18%: 2018 BOURBON 36% RYE

TITLE: Remus Volstead Reserve 14 Year Old Bottled in Bond Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Better known as the source of nearly all contract bourbon on the market, MGP also produce some of their own bourbon brands in house, George Remus is one of them. The brand takes its name from the eponymous German-born American lawyer and Prohibition bootlegger. This 14-year-old is one of 6000 bottles produced to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the Volstead Act, which enshrined Prohibition in law in 1920.

TITLE: Remy Martin Carte Blanche A Baptiste Loiseau
DESCRIPTION: An exceptional blend from a single vat, hand selected by Cellar Master Baptiste Loiseau from the House reserves in Merpins - the world’s most precious Cognac Fine Champagne reserve. A blend of eaux-de-vie aged 27 years. Carte Blanche is bottled at 44.1% ABV to reserve its original attributes An exclusive edition: only 2,000 bottles available in the U.S. (9,650 worldwide) Presented in a re-edition of the original Rémy Martin bottle dating back to the end of the 19th century, each bottle is numbered and displayed in a premium gift box

TITLE: Remy Martin Cognac 1738 Accord Royal
DESCRIPTION: Produced in the heart of the Cognac region, Rémy only uses grapes grown from the Cognac Grande Champagne and Petite Champagne area for this offering. (Other Rémy products uses different growths and/or proportions of growths for each). Distilled in small classic alembic charentais copper stills the resulting eau de vie is then aged in Limousin oak in their private cellars and then is carefully blended to profile. Remy offers many different cognacs to fit ones taste and/or budget within their portfolio.Some of the other cognacs from Remy that we have reviewed are the VSOP and their 1989 vintage year release. Rémy Martin 1738 Accord Royal 2 is a lovely blend of over 240 eau de vies of cognac the minimum age is 4 years and the oldest 20 years. This makes it a bit short of an XO but on the flip side less than half the money (around $50 or so), also in its favor is that it has a higher percentage of Grande Champagne growth grapes than the VSOP. 1738 has many of the aroma and taste characteristics that whiskey lovers -be they Scotch , Bourbon or Irish enthusiasts-enjoy so it makes for a great cognac to have in your collection if you like those types of spirits also. Also if I may dare say so, it reminds us somewhat of one of our other favorite brandies , armagnac in the heavier body and lovely aromas.

TITLE: Remy Martin Cognac VSOP "Limited Edition Mixtape Volume 2"
DESCRIPTION: A limited-edition VSOP bottle inviting you to rediscover a 60’s bottle with a refined label. With its premium giftbox, inspired by the colorful graphics of the 80’s and 90’s, it pays homage to the timeless vibrance of VSOP cognac & the excellence of mixtape culture.

TITLE: Remy Martin XO Cognac Excellence
DESCRIPTION: In 1981, Cellar Master André Giraud set out to create an XO that would express the excellence of the Cognac Fine Champagne. Remy Martin XO is composed of eaux-de-vie coming exclusively from the highest-quality vineyards of Cognac, the Grande Champagne and Petite Champagne. Such eaux-de-vie offer an exceptional aging potential and are known as Cognac Fine Champagne. Remy Martin XO won a gold medal at the 2010 Spirits Business Cognac Masters (UK) and a gold medal at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition in 2014.

TITLE: Renardat-Fache Bugey Cerdon Initiale
DESCRIPTION: 96% Gamay/4% Poulsard. in 2021 we are seeing the first release of this new non-vintage wine from Renardat. It is made identically to their classic Cerdon. The certified-organic fruit is picked by hand, pressed and fermented in cold vats until it reaches about 6% alcohol. After a light filtration that leaves most of the active yeast in the unfinished wine, it is bottled and continues its fermentation, finishing at about 8% alcohol with some residual sugar (51 grams in this new current release, less than historically remaining in the classic vintage Cerdon). The wine is disgorged before release. A note on changes to the winemaking program at Renardat: this wine, "Initiale", was created so that the domaine has a year-round, fresh, bright Cerdon in good supply and of consistent character. It will become about 2/3 of the domaine's production. in the classic vintage Cerdon blend, which will still be made and released once a year, there will a higher proportion of Poulsard, given the pulling of some Gamay for the Initiale bottling, which will refine its nature a bit; it will be about 1/3 of the production. Both Cerdon wines are being finished with less sweetness than the one classic wine ever was--though with no lack of residual sugar to be sure, as it's required by the AOC and key to the wine's very nature--and the Initiale will generally have more RS than the vintage Cerdon going forward.

TITLE: Renwood California Zinfandel
DESCRIPTION: The harvest of 2011 had a cool, wet spring and cool summer providing moderate growing conditions and a crop size small enough to take advantage fo the cool weather. About mid-October a series of storms that usually stay in Washington State and Oregon decided on a not so small excursion to Northern California. These early rains made for a challenging harvest, but the dedication of growers to wait for the grapes to dry out, coupled with the winemaking team going aroud the clock when the weather was good, resulted in some really nice wines. The colors are dark, rivaling the 2010 vintage, flavors are luscious and tannins moderate. Think curry spice. Since Zinfandel leans on the sweeter side of red wine, it's a great pairing partner with spiced barbecue dishes and curry. Pro tip: Pick out the spices you taste in the wine and add them to your sauce.

TITLE: Renwood Zinfandel
DESCRIPTION: Intensely ripe cherry fruit nose with honey, and sweet notes of spice and a hint of bay leaf. On the palate, blackberry and vanilla bean, and a very complex layer of flavors with hints of Herbs de Provence. This classic Fiddletown Zinfandel offers exceptional balance.

TITLE: Representative "Elect To Enjoy" Barrel Proof Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #103
DESCRIPTION: Introducing The Prime Barrel's exclusive pick, Representative "Distinguished" Barrel Proof Straight Bourbon Whiskey, a meticulously crafted single-barrel selection aged for 4 years and 10 months. Distilled at the renowned MGP in Indiana and aged to perfection in Kentucky, this bourbon offers exceptional value at just $55 per bottle—ideal for enjoying neat or in premium cocktails. As part of Proof & Wood’s acclaimed Representative series, this expression echoes the election term of Members of the House of Representatives, aged between 4 to 5 years. The Representative has been celebrated globally, earning the prestigious title of "World’s Best Bourbon" at the 2023 World Whiskies Awards, where it stood out among 1,400 whiskeys judged by over 200 experts. Tasting Notes: Nose: Aromas of almond, maple syrup, and fresh basil. Palate: Rich flavors of vanilla, cherry, and peach, balanced with citrus and tobacco undertones, leading to sweet vanilla notes and a hint of spice. Finish: Medium length with a smooth, lingering sweetness. At 113.2 proof, this bourbon is perfect for entertaining, whether you’re hosting casual gatherings or impressing connoisseurs.

TITLE: Representative 4 Year Old Barrel Proof Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Representative 4-Year-Old Barrel Proof Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a bold and unfiltered expression reflecting Kentucky bourbon's true essence. This bourbon is aged four years and bottled at barrel proof, typically between 110 and 120 proof, depending on the barrel. The result is a robust and full-bodied whiskey showcasing the rich flavors and complexity of careful aging and minimal intervention. This bourbon is perfect for those who appreciate the raw, uncut nature of barrel-proof whiskey and the deep, complex flavors that come with it. Winner of Best Bourbon of the Year by World Whiskies Awards 2023

TITLE: Resilient 10-Year-Old Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey Release #1
DESCRIPTION: Resilient Straight Bourbon Whiskey barrels are hand-picked. Resilient hunts for barrels that are well balanced with grain and wood, barrels that really shine and present to the nose and palate. Resilient themselves find these barrels, bottle them, and bring them to market. The label is upfront and honest, with all the information you might need/want: barrel volume, the style of the oak, name of the distillery, bottling location, distillation and bottling date, and proof. In the future, labels will include mash and char levels. Each Resilient release will be series of unblended single barrels with identical mashbills, lot, age, and ABV. Product Specifics: Origin: Lawrenceburg, Indiana Elevation: 479 feet ABV: 53.5% Distillation: Column Still Varietal: 75% Corn, 21% Rye, 4% Barley Aging: 53-Gallon American Oak Barrels Age: 10 Years Old Bottled: Bardstown, Kentucky Distillery: MGP Distillery

TITLE: Resilient 14-Year-Old Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey 142
DESCRIPTION: On the nose, vanilla caramel candy and oak char with a touch of fire-roasted corn, clove, and baked peach cobbler in the distance. On the taste, baked apple and berry, dark chocolate sauce with a dose of cardamom, and clove. The finish is long and pleasant with dark cacao and vanilla fading ever so gently into oak spice. Gorgeous, gorgeous Bourbon.

DESCRIPTION: On the nose, vanilla caramel candy and oak char with a touch of fire-roasted corn, clove, and baked peach cobbler in the distance. DESCRIPTION: On the nose, vanilla caramel candy and oak char with a touch of fire-roasted corn, clove, and baked peach cobbler in the distance. TITLE: Resilient 15-Year-Old Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: On the nose, baked pear and apple in a sauce of dark chocolate and cacao nibs, vanilla toffee, cinnamon and clove. On the taste, vanilla bean, dark chocolate, baked fruit tart of apple and pear, cinnamon, and clove. The finish is lovely with sweet chocolate and vanilla flavors leading as cinnamon and oak spice fade last. A lovely sweet treat.

TITLE: Resilient 16 Year Old Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The nose is quite inviting with red berry and apple candy up front as oak spice, vanilla wafer, caramel candy, and chocolate malt provide balance. On the palate, fruit is in charge initially as spice becomes more assertive. The finish is balanced and pleasant with cardamom and peppercorn surging before giving way to red berry and apple candies in caramel, which persist for a while. A gorgeous sipper.

TITLE: Resilient 16 Year Old Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The nose is quite inviting with red berry and apple candy up front as oak spice, vanilla wafer, caramel candy, and chocolate malt provide balance.
