TITLE: Resilient 17 Years Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finishes in Madeira Barrel
DESCRIPTION: Resilient 17 Year Old Straight Bourbon Whiskey is an exceptional expression that has been finished in Madeira casks, offering a unique and exquisite taste profile. Aged for 17 years and bottled uncut at 59.04% ABV, this bourbon showcases the complexity and depth that can be achieved through extended aging and careful cask selection.

TITLE: Resilient 17 Years Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finishes in Oloroso Sherry Butt
DESCRIPTION: Resilient 17 Years Straight Bourbon Whiskey, finished in Oloroso Sherry Butts, represents a rich blend of tradition and innovation. This exceptional bourbon is aged for 17 years and finished in carefully selected Oloroso Sherry casks, offering a unique flavor profile. Bottled uncut at 120.48 proof, it is a robust and full-bodied whiskey, showcasing the craftsmanship and heritage of bourbon making.

TITLE: Resilient 17 Years Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finishes in Oloroso Sherry Cask
DESCRIPTION: Resilient 17 Year Old Straight Bourbon Whiskey is an exceptional expression that has been finished in Madeira casks, offering a unique and exquisite taste profile. Aged for 17 years and bottled uncut at 61.2% ABV, this bourbon showcases the complexity and depth that can be achieved through extended aging and careful cask selection.

TITLE: Resilient 17 Years Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finishes in Tawny Port
DESCRIPTION: The Resilient 17-Year-Old Straight Bourbon Whiskey, finished in Tawny Port casks, is a magnificent blend of traditional bourbon craftsmanship and innovative finishing techniques. Aged for 17 years, this bourbon is hand-selected from single barrels well balanced with grain and wood, then finished in Tawny Port casks. It's bottled uncut at a robust 58.35% ABV, offering whiskey connoisseurs a rich and complex experience

TITLE: Restoration Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Each batch of our Restoration Rye Whiskey is blended using a series of pods. Each pod is created by grouping barrels to create a specific sensory profile. One heck of an initial offering from the new kid on the block. A nice, flavorful, rye that’s easy to sip on its own or used to amp up a cocktail. Mashbill 17% Yellow Corn 63% Rye 20% Malted Barley

TITLE: Reunion Mendoza Malbec
DESCRIPTION: This sustainably farmed, single vineyard estate wine is composed of 100% hand harvested Malbec from the Los Sauces of Mendoza. It has a deep, concentrated red color with purple hints. Lamb, duck, and venison. Also recommended: Barbeque/Grilled, Beef/Red Meat, Mild Cheese, Pasta/Pizza, Pork ,Vegetables

TITLE: Rezzadore Tai Rosso Monte Oseliera
Rhanleigh South Africa Chenin Blanc
Rhanleigh South Africa Pinotage
DESCRIPTION: Rhanleigh Wines take their name from a beautiful thoroughbred racehorse of the same name, 1914 winner of the prestigious South African Durban July Handicap. Just like the beloved Rhanleigh, these front-running wines exemplify beauty, skill and finesse throughout the range.

TITLE: Rhanleigh South Africa Rose
DESCRIPTION: The perfect companion to lazy summer days.

TITLE: Rhum Clement Canne Bleue Rum
DESCRIPTION: Crafted from the intensely aromatic juice of one varietal sugarcane, Canne Bleue is an exceptional white rhum produced from only blue sugarcane. Clement Canne Bleue rests for just over six months in a stainless steel vat and is slowly reduced over time with distilled volcanic spring water creating a remarkable well-integrated full-bodied white Rhum Agricole, loaded with character and flavor unlike any other rum in the world.

TITLE: Rhum Damoiseau VSOP Rum
DESCRIPTION: The intense tropical humid days and temperate nights in Guadeloupe make for an aggressive aging climate for optimum wood and rhum interaction. The result is a well-balanced toasted oak and jammy preserved fruit forward flavor profile that still maintains the signature dry finish of Rhum Agricole.

TITLE: Rhum J.M Agricole  Blanc 50% Rum
DESCRIPTION: J.M Blanc 100 Proof displays the raw power of what is regarded as the best sugarcane on the island and speaks of mango, overripe bananas, and papaya. The higher proof retains more of the vibrant freshness for which rhum Agricole is praised. The rich sugarcane flavors in Rhum J.M are a result of the unique volcanic soil, tropical humidity, tremendous ventilation from the steady sea breeze onto the mountainside, and the excellent drainage on the sloping sugarcane fields.

TITLE: Rhum J.M Amber Rum
DESCRIPTION: Rhum J.M is an exquisite Rhum distilled on the Caribbean island of Martinique, located in the northeast in Macouba, the sugar cane grows on 28-degree vertical slopes in rich volcanic soil at the foot of Mount Pelee. Rhum J.M are the only distillery that uses canes cultivated and harvested from its own estate. Distilled in traditional Creole column stills.

TITLE: Rhum J.M White Rum
DESCRIPTION: The island of Martinique carries an AOC Rhum classification, the only such classification of its kind, and Rhum J.M produces among its finest rhums. The Rhum J.M estates and distillery, founded over 160 years ago by the de Médeuil family, are on the island’s northernmost tip at the base of an active volcano. The island’s intense tropical heat and humidity combined with the nutrient-rich, volcanic soil creates a microclimate yielding sugarcane of exceptional quality. Over 36-48 hours, the sugarcane juice is allowed to ferment naturally into a sugarcane “wine.” This vin de canne is distilled into Rhum Agricole in a Créole copper column. The fresh Rhum Agricole is allowed to rest in stainless steel tanks for at least three months. The rhum is then reduced to bottling strength with water from an estate spring or reduced to 60% abv. in preparation for additional years of aging in oak casks in the Rhum J.M cellars.

TITLE: Ri1 Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: (rī)1 (pronounced rye one) is different than most rye whiskeys in the respect that it is considerably lighter in all aspects. When we think of rye we typically look for a robust, rich whiskey with some spice but all of those profiles are softer in (rī)1 with the exception of the spice, which in here is slightly snappier and brighter. Traditional rye fans will probably not enjoy the (rī)1 experience, however for those used to Canadian whisky or looking for a lighter bourbon-like whiskey that retains the rich grains this is a very nice alternative. Mixing with (rī)1 is pretty easy. This whiskey fits in almost any whiskey cocktail, especially those with lighter, refreshing profiles. Those like a Whiskey Sour, New York Cocktail and Ward Eight are excellent uses for (rī)1 as sweet and sour mixers accent the whiskey's profile. On the other hand, traditional rye whiskey cocktails like the Waldorf, Vieux Carre and Colleen Bawn lack some essence compared to other ryes. Overall, (rī)1 is a great addition to the bar and a well-rounded cocktail ingredient.

TITLE: Ricard Pastis Aperitif
DESCRIPTION: Paul Ricard developed RICARD in 1932 in Marseille, France. RICARD's secret recipe, unaltered since its creation, is composed of select herbs and spices found in the Mediterranean and the Orient, including Chinese star anise, Syrian licorice, and aromatic herbs from Provence. The licorice underscores and rounds out the flavor of the star anise, giving RICARD its distinctive yellow color.

TITLE: Rickshaw California Chardonnay
DESCRIPTION: Banshee Wines is not your normal wine company. It is a band of wine industry insiders dedicated to producing benchmark wines without the cult wine prices. They specialize in finding hidden gems in other wineries' cellars and then blending those barrels to create killer wines. For every barrel they take, they pass on 15 more that don't make the cut. The secret is that today, high-end wineries can't sell all the wine they make and they don't want to lower prices because they don't want to diminish their brand. They would rather sell some of their wine to Banshee and protect their luxury prices. This is just fine by them and even better for the consumer. You'll find Banshee on some of the best restaurant lists in the world and in the cellars of the wine cognoscenti. You know, those people that tend to know these types of things. Winery’s goal is to deliver distinctive wines that beat the pants off many costing twice as much. With or without food, this wine is a study in grace as it gently peels back paper-thin layers of Chardonnay, unperverted by the ravages of oak. This crisply styled offering pairs especially well with lightly cooked shellfish, but can also provide a refreshing counterpoint to simply prepared poultry, pork and veal dishes. Consider, too, lighter pastas or rice dishes, especially those featuring shrimp or scallops. Or how about more daring matches like a salad tossed with crab, avocado and Meyer lemon dressing; or seared ahi with fresh corn and crispy pancetta?

TITLE: Rickshaw Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: RICKSHAW Pinot Noir is sourced from a variety of coastal cool-climate vineyards with a large percentage coming from the Sonoma Coast. The wine is fermented in small open top vessels and aged in a combination of new (10%), once used (15%), and neutral (75%) French Oak barrels. As always, pure Pinot flavor and exquisite balance are the goals with this wine. Butterflied lamb, chargrilled steak, venison. Dishes like cassoulet or duck with olives if they’re more rustic. Roast goose. Hare Royale as you can see from this post. Coq au vin where the sauce is made with pinot noir. Glazed ham. Roast turkey. Brie and similar cheeses. Milder blue cheeses such as Gorgonzola dolce.

TITLE: Ridge Vineyards Three Valleys Sonoma County
DESCRIPTION: Ridge Vineyards Three Valleys Sonoma County is a red wine made from a blend of Zinfandel, Petite Sirah, Carignane, Mataro, and Alicante Bouschet grapes grown in Sonoma County, California. The wine has a deep garnet color and aromas of black pepper, black cherry, and spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied with firm tannins and flavors of black fruit, spice, and earth. The finish is long and lingering.

TITLE: Riebeek Cellars Pinotage
DESCRIPTION: Nestled in the picturesque Riebeek Valley, tucked up against the slopes of the majestic Kasteelberg, lies Riebeek Cellars. This medium-sized winery on the western coast of the Cape Province of South Africa sources its grapes from the fertile Riebeek Valley and the slopes of the mountain where the climate is very similar to the Mediterranean. Through the years as vineyard practices developed, cultivars were planted in soil and at slopes best suited to them. These well-tended vineyards enable the production of high quality wines which makes Riebeek Cellars the choice of wine buyers internationally. Lovely with rare beef, barbequed lamb and casseroles. This versatile lighter style of Pinotage is also a lovely combination with spicy chicken.

TITLE: Riff Pinot Grigio
DESCRIPTION: Riff (the German word for reef) was created by one of northern Italy’s most famous wine producers, Alois Lageder. The Riff project builds on long-term partnerships with selected grape growers in Italy’s northeastern Tre Venezie region, which has long been known as one of Italy’s prime sources for elegant and refined white wines. The grapes for the Riff wines are grown in the northeastern Tre Venezie region, and more specifically in vineyards that are located in the valleys and on the slopes of the Dolomites, a part of the Italian Alps, which influence the climate and bless the area with prized alluvial soils. Just the ticket for a summertime aperitif or an ideal keep-it-coming accompaniment to all kinds of food.

TITLE: Rijckaert Les Sarres Cotes du Jura Savagnin
DESCRIPTION: This wine generally pairs well with poultry, mushrooms or mild cheese.

TITLE: Rising Tide Spirits Old Stubborn Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Rising Tide Spirits Old Stubborn Straight Bourbon Batch 2 is a premium blend crafted by master blender Ed Bley. This cask strength bourbon is a marriage of equal parts 10, 11, and 12-year-old barrels, distilled in West Virginia and bottled in Kentucky. With a robust proof of 123.8, this bourbon offers a rich and complex drinking experience that showcases the dedication and expertise behind its creation.

TITLE: Rittenhouse Straight Rye Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Color: Mahogany Aroma: Dried fruits, toffee and sweet peppers Taste: Clean, rich, cocoa, citrus, cinnamon, nutmeg and vanilla Finish: Lingering maple-like spiciness

TITLE: Rittenhouse Very Rare 21 Year Old 100 Proof Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Produced in the tradition of the classic Pennsylvania or Monongahela rye whiskeys, Rittenhouse is now enjoying a renaissance. On the other hand, its older incarnations have become hugely collectible.

TITLE: Rittenhouse Very Rare 23 Year Old 100 Proof Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Reportedly the smaller production run in the extra aged Rittenhouse series (the others were the 21 and 25-year-olds), as a point of comparison, the 21-year-old release was 32 barrels. The 23-year-old was just 25 barrels. While all three expressions were aged on the lowest floors of rickhouse OO, as single-barrel releases, each barrel release will yield a slightly different whiskey. Produced at the scenic Heaven Hill Distillery in Bardstown, home of numerous other whiskeys - mostly bourbons - the 23 Year Old comes packaged in a tall tapered, gold-printed bottle. It goes without saying that this is now extremely unusual to find.

TITLE: Rittenhouse Very Rare 25 Year Old 100 Proof Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A very rare Straight Rye Whiskey drawn from a single perfect barrel, non-chill filtered and aged for 25 years.

TITLE: Rivers Royale Grenadian Rum `
DESCRIPTION: The River Antoine estate is the oldest operational distillery in the Caribbean to still function in much the same way as it did when it began producing rum in 1785. Whereas some distilleries have been in operation longer, all have been modernized in significant ways, and most produce rum that would be unrecognizable to the stuff they produced hundreds of years ago. Even Jamaica's Hampden Estate, considered one of the world's great operating "ancient" distilleries, looks positively modern when compared to River Antoine. Perhaps the most modern piece of equipment in use is a waterwheel from 1840, used to power the crushing of sugar cane. If the river isn't flowing with enough gusto, no cane is crushed. The distillery is located on Grenada’s northeast coast near the river of the same name, and makes rum from fresh pressed sugar cane juice from the estate as well as a small amount from other local farms.

TITLE: Riverset Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The distillery ages their barrels along the winding bluffs of the Mississippi River in Memphis, Tennessee. The Delta heat and humidity provided by the long, hot summers cook those barrels low and slow like proper Memphis BBQ. This forces the whiskey deep into the oak, creating an unmistakably rich flavor. MASH BILL – 95% rye, 5% barley PROOF – 93 AGE – 4 years

TITLE: Roagna Dolcetto d'Alba
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the rich flavors of Roagna Dolcetto d'Alba, a distinguished red wine hailing from the renowned Piedmont region in Italy. Crafted by the esteemed Roagna winery, this Dolcetto showcases the winemaking expertise and commitment to quality that define the region.

TITLE: Roark Wine Co. Happy Canyon of Santa Barbara Malbec
DESCRIPTION: 85% Malbec/15% Cabernet Franc from Happy Canyon, Santa Barbara. Gently rolling hills of varied soils -- loam and clay loam with red and yellow chert and serpentine cobbles. Slightly inland on the eastern end of Santa Ynez Valley, this vineyard is exceptional for Bordeaux varieties. Native yeast, neutral oak for 1 year. Unfined, unfiltered, tiny sulphur added at bottling.

TITLE: Roberto Henriquez Molino del Ciego Valley del Itata Semillon
DESCRIPTION: 100% Semillon.

TITLE: Roberto Henriquez Pais Verde
DESCRIPTION: Embark on a journey through the vibrant landscapes of Chile with Roberto Henriquez Pais Verde, a wine that encapsulates the essence of the terroir. Crafted by the esteemed Roberto Henriquez winery, this Pais Verde is a testament to the winemaker's dedication to tradition and the unique characteristics of the Pais grape. Explore the freshness and purity of this wine, an ode to Chilean winemaking.

TITLE: Roberto Henriquez Rivera Del Notro Orange
DESCRIPTION: Experience the unique flavors of Chile with Roberto Henriquez Rivera Del Notro Orange. Crafted in the Biobío Valley, this natural orange wine showcases the dedication and expertise of Roberto Henriquez. Made from a field blend of indigenous grape varieties, this wine offers a distinct expression of the terroir, reflecting the essence of its surroundings. With minimal intervention in the cellar, each bottle encapsulates the purity and vibrancy of the fruit.

TITLE: Roberto Henriquez Rivera del Notro Valle del Bio-Bio Blanco
DESCRIPTION: Is a wine made through skin contact during three months. Wine contains two different varieties which were vinified separately. The three varieties used were Corinto, Muscat of Alexandria and semillon which corresponded to a fresh zone from Itata Valley with alcohol values of 12.3 %. Wine was processed without filtering nor stabilization.

TITLE: Roberto Henriquez Tierra de las Pumas Bio-Bio Valley Pais
DESCRIPTION: From 200+ year old vines that are believed to have descended from those brought to Mexico by Hernan Cortes in 1520, Roberto Henriquez makes some of the best Pais wines in the world. Following organic and biodynamic practices, the dry-farmed grapes are hand harvested and fermented with ambient yeast with no punch downs or pump overs to minimize extraction. The result is a wine that’s both rustic and elegant. Pairs well with soft, moldy cheeses or a mushroom parmesan Risotto.

TITLE: Rocca di Montegrossi Toscana Rosato
DESCRIPTION: Produced with Sangiovese from the San Marcellino vineyard, Rosato Rocca di Montegrossi is made by gently pressing the grapes. The must, structured and delicate at the same time, is kept in steel at a temperature below 6°C for 24 hours to allow solids to settle, and then fermented at temperatures below 16°C for about a month. The wine then rests on the lees at a temperature below 10°C for another 3-4 months to maximize its bouquet and body. The end result is a rose with delicate aromas, nice structure, acidity, fine balance, and pleasant minerality. Annual production is about 18,000 bottles.

TITLE: Rock Face Clarksburg Chenin Blanc
DESCRIPTION: A tribute to American Heritage, the package speaks to the Patriotic work of the Gold Coast pioneers, and the wine is a true example of the integrity and built-in value that Lodi has to offer. This Chenin is from a vineyard in Clarksburg from a specific old vine parcel. The vineyard is farmed sustain-ably. The wine is fermented in stainless steel and aged in neutral oak barrels. You really could be tasting a village wine from Anjou or Touraine.

TITLE: Rock Hill Farms Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon  Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rock Hill Farms Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a highly acclaimed expression from the Buffalo Trace Distillery, known for producing some of the finest bourbons in the world. Bottled at 100 proof, this single barrel bourbon offers a rich and nuanced flavor profile that reflects the meticulous craftsmanship and tradition of its distillery. Though the exact age is not specified, it is generally believed to be aged between 8 to 10 years, allowing the whiskey to develop a deep, complex character. Rock Hill Farms is a favorite among bourbon enthusiasts for its bold flavors, smooth finish, and exceptional quality, making it a must-have for any serious whiskey collection.

TITLE: Rock Town 7 Year Old "Club Marzipan" Single Barrel Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Rock Town Single Barrel Bourbon is a premium bourbon distilled, aged, and bottled at Rock Town Distillery located in Little Rock, Arkansas. The brand takes pride in its corn and wheat coming from Arkansas farmers. ALL OF IT. THIS IS RARE. The bourbon ages in air-seasoned, new, charred oak barrels for a rich and complex flavor. This bourbon is bottled at cask strength. Tasting Notes: This wheated bourbon is special. It's chocolate and pecan pie forward with hints of cinnamon, vanilla, and orange sorbet. A fantastic chocolate pudding note on the second taste, showing the development of the chocolate. In the third tasting, an orange chocolate surfaced, which is to say that the orange and chocolate I had tasted previously only married into something deeper. Slight hints of caramel, hickory and sandalwood (on the nose). Barrel Info: Picked by Fred Minnick Age: 7 Years Proof 121.6

TITLE: Rockcastle Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: RockCastle Bourbon, named for the county that is home to our limestone rich mountain spring water, is a smooth, sweet bourbon handcrafted using local Kentucky corn and wheat. This small batch spirit is bottled at barrel strength and displays distinct flavor notes of toffee, caramel and vanilla. Best served neat or in a chilled glass, this spirit is a must have for any bourbon aficionado.

TITLE: Rodell Napoleon VSOP Brandy
Rodell X.O. Expression
DESCRIPTION: 10 year Vintage

TITLE: Roe & Co Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Roe & Co is a new premium Blended Irish Whiskey, named in honour of George Roe, a true pioneer of Irish Whiskey.

TITLE: Rogue Spirits Dead Guy Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Established in 2003, Rogue Spirits creates multi-ingredient small-batch spirits, artisan distilled in traditional handcrafted copper pot stills. The majority of raw ingredients utilized in the production of Rogue Spirits, including grains, hops, and botanicals, are sourced directly from local Oregon farms. No chemicals, additives, or preservatives are used.

TITLE: Rogue Vine Pipeno Tinto De Itata Valley
DESCRIPTION: Rogue Vine Pipeno Tinto De Itata Valley enchants with its vibrant red color and captivating aromas. It is a true reflection of the winery's commitment to quality and their dedication to crafting wines that express the character of the Itata Valley. Rogue Vine Pipeno Tinto De Itata Valley is a versatile wine that pairs beautifully with a variety of dishes. Its fruit-forward character and balanced structure make it an excellent companion to grilled meats, roasted vegetables, and savory stews. It also complements aged cheeses and charcuterie boards. For a delightful combination, pair it with traditional Chilean cuisine, such as empanadas or grilled beef dishes. Let Rogue Vine Pipeno Tinto De Itata Valley transport you to the picturesque landscapes of the Itata Valley with its exceptional flavors and unique charm.

TITLE: Romio Prosecco D.O.C
DESCRIPTION: Friuli is one of the most beautiful and unique wine regions in Italy. Just as its unique geographical position at the crossroads of northeastern Italy, the Adriatic Sea, Austria and Slovenia has given this region a mixed bag of cultural influences, so has its varied terroir and terrain allowed it to cultivate an astonishing mix of grape varieties. Today Friuli is known for it's myriad of small, high quality family-run vineyards and diverse production of indigenous and International grape varietals. Ideal as an aperitif, or served with fish and light dishes.

TITLE: Ron Cartavio Anejo Superior
DESCRIPTION: This rum is ideal for fruit cocktails as daiquiris or piña colada. Rum aged to a dark golden colour and exquisite taste. Both young and old recognize its exquisite taste.

TITLE: Ron del Barrilito 2 Star Rum
DESCRIPTION: Aged for at least 3 to 5 years in vintage oak barrels. It’s great on its own but will also add exceptional flavor and character to classic cocktails.

TITLE: Ron del Barrilito 3 Star Rum
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1880 by Eng. Pedro F. Fernandez in the "Hacienda Santa Ana" at Bayamon, Puerto Rico. For over 100 years, the Fernandez family has manufactured "Ron de Barrilito" at the place of origin, using the same name, formula and aging process. This special rum is a blend of rums aged, each undisturbed, from 6 to 10 years in charred oak barrels. Enjoy its unique, smooth mellow falvor by sipping, in a snifter, or enjoy it straight, with a splash of water, over ice, before or after dinner.

TITLE: Ron del Barrilito 5 Star Rum
DESCRIPTION: The Ron Del Barrilito 5 Star is the 138-year-old Puerto Rican distillery's first special release in its history. The first edition of the new 5 Star, first released in 2018, consists of a blend of rums that aged in Oloroso casks for up to 35 years.

TITLE: Ron Zacapa Centenario Sistema Solera 23 Year Old Gran Reserva Rum
DESCRIPTION: Ron Zacapa 23 Sistema Solera Rum was first produced in 1976 to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the Guatemalan town of Zacapa. It's a rum made from raw sugarcane honey grown on the Zacapa estate high in the hills of Guatemala, extracted from the first pressing of sugarcane juice.

TITLE: Ron Zacapa Centenario Sistema Solera 23 Year Old Gran Reserva Rum
DESCRIPTION: Ron Zacapa 23 Sistema Solera Rum was first produced in 1976 to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the Guatemalan town of Zacapa. It's a rum made from raw sugarcane honey grown on the Zacapa estate high in the hills of Guatemala, extracted from the first pressing of sugarcane juice.

TITLE: Ron Zacapa Centenario XO Rum Solera Gran Reserva Especial
DESCRIPTION: Zacapa XO is a unique balance of complex aromas and flavors resulting from the exclusive blend of reserve rums. We hand select rums aged between 10 and 25 years in the “Sistema Solera.” Older and younger rums are then blended as they age in a sequence of barrels that previously stored robust American whiskeys, delicate Sherries, fine Pedro Ximénez wines and finished in French oak casks which previously aged Cognac. Zacapa XO is best enjoyed neat or on the rocks and pairs beautifully with dark chocolate and desserts.

TITLE: Ron Zacapa Edicion Negra Rum
Root:1 [The Original Ungrafted] Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Most vineyards around the world are planted on grafted rootstock, Root One wines are grown on original, ungrafted roots, producing outstanding wines with pure fruit aromas and flavors. The tannins and acidity of Cabernet Sauvignon make it a classic with red meat, especially when grilled and served with bitter vegetables, such as broccoli rabe or escarole. Cabernet Sauvignon can easily overpower lighter fare, so be sure to take the weight of the dish into consideration. Dishes to serve with Cabernet Sauvignon: Beef Filet Oscar Steak with Sauteed Mushrooms Braised Oxtail

TITLE: Roots Run Deep Winery Educated Guess Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: The Educated Guess Cabernet Sauvignon is crafted from grapes grownin the prestigious Napa Valley wine districts of Yountville, Oak Knoll, Calistoga, St. Helena, and Rutherford. Created with the philosophy that superb Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon can be affordable, this wine is indistinguishable in quality from its higher-priced Napa Valley competitors. We encourage you to taste our Cabernet Sauvignon against wines that are 2, 3, even 4 times the price and decide for yourself!

TITLE: Ross & Bee Maloof "L'eau Epicee" Sparkling Wine
DESCRIPTION: Not quite sure what to call this method of achieving bubble. Ancestral? Taking suggestions for portmanteaus of Ancestral + Champenoise + Pet Nat. Maybe, Ancestropetnoise? We essentially made three lots of still wine. Riesling from Beckenridge vineyard was pressed and fermented in neutral 500L puncheons. The gewürztraminer was split into two treatments. Some of it was direct press and fermented in stainless steel, while a little bit was pulled from our lot of fully macerated gewürztraminer from this site, which was destemmed and fermented on the skins for 20 days before being pressed off and moved into neutral french oak barrels. Once all three lots were dry (The riesling was of course the last, as it finished up in January), we blended into tank, threw in some freshly thawed riesling must that we froze at crush, stirred it up, and bottled it. A couple months later and voila! Bubbs.

TITLE: Ross & Bee Maloof "Where ya PJs at?"
DESCRIPTION: This one goes out to two of our dearest friends Paul & Stina. A fun and energetic dichotomy of bright citrus and sour cherries met by soul soothing cinnamon spice and garrigue herbs, represented by two separate vineyard sources. The Pinot Gris coming from Johan Vineyard was split into two treatments. Half of it was destemmed and fermented on the skins for 19 days, while the other half underwent full carbonic maceration for the same period of time. They were then pressed off together and moved into neutral oak, and blended back with dry Riesling from Nemarniki Vineyard. Serve chilled or at cellar temp with white za pies or with a bowl of popcorn over your favorite John Cusak movie. Ours is Grosse Point Blank.

TITLE: Ross & Bee Maloof Riesling Nemarniki Vineyard Chehalem Mountains
DESCRIPTION: Dynamite with a laser-beam. Fermented in 500L neutral French oak slow through the winter. Coming in at a whopping 10% alcohol, you can practically pour this over your head while playing basketball like those old Zima commercials. Serve with your favorite spicy pizza or umami centric Asian dishes, or by itself on a hot summer day.

TITLE: Ross & Bee Maloof Rouge de Gris Johan Vineyard Van Duzer Corridor
DESCRIPTION: “This is a brand new cuvee for us, however in a way, we have been honing in on this style for quite some time. We have made skin contact Pinot Gris for a few years now for the PJs Cuvee, as well as our WV Pinot Gris kegs. As we came to know each site’s capabilities for skin maceration, we found that the Johan vineyard fruit was perfectly built for the crunchier, more tannic light red we were looking for, and deserved to stand out on its own.” — Ross + Bee Maloof, Maloof Wines

TITLE: Rough Rider Bull Moose Three Barrel Rye Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Rough Rider Bull Moose Three Barrel Rye Whisky spends a bit of time maturing in three different specially selected casks that impart distinctive character along the way. The journey begins in New American Oak casks where the Rye Whisky takes shape with its resolute spicy sweet cinnamon flavors. When the time is right, the Rye Whisky is moved to casks that had just held Straight Bourbon, where the flavors of the Rye and Bourbon get to know each other better. When the Rye is done mingling with the Bourbon flavors, it is then moved to its final cask which had just held Pine Barrens Single Malt Whisky. This unique Three Barrel aging method provides Rough Rider Rye with a crisp fruity sweetness on the nose, followed by spice, caramel, vanilla and blackberry on the palate, lauded by a royal symphony of long, warm rye-ness, with a toasty, velvety finish.

TITLE: Rough Rider Straight Bourbon Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Rough Rider Bourbon is a high-rye, straight bourbon handcrafted by Long Island Spirits of Montauk, New York. The bourbon starts out as a highly refined mash bill, consisting of 60% corn, 35% rye, and 5% malted barley, and is then aged for several years in charred new American white oak barrels. The whisky is then finished in hand selected American oak barrels, which once held the Island’s finest wines. The wine casks that are selected for the second maturation, described by Long Island Spirits owner Richard Stabile as its exclusive method of "Reserve Aged," are chosen from the finest wineries on Long Island and are an exquisite balanced blend of award winning Merlot and Chardonnay barrels. These casks undergo a "cask finishing wash", with a very unique 180-proof brandy distilled from local Long Island Chardonnay, that tempers each wine barrel prior to filling it with the bourbon. The small batch straight bourbon mellows while acquiring its distinctive character during this delicate second maturation period, adding a layer of dark red fruit and honey notes to Rough Rider Bourbon. Each limited batch of whisky produced is meticulously handcrafted at a distillery just miles from where the Rough Riders departed.

TITLE: Roulette 4 Year Old Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Roulette is a small-batch sourced rye Whiskey from Indiana. The Mashbill is 95% Rye, 5% barley. Aged no less than 4 years and bottled at a bold and cocktail-friendly 100 Proof. Very solid rye for the price, and will enhance any rye-based cocktail.

TITLE: Roulette 4 Year Old Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Roulette is a small-batch sourced rye Whiskey from Indiana. The Mashbill is 95% Rye, 5% barley. Aged no less than 4 years and bottled at a bold and cocktail-friendly 100 Proof. Very solid rye for the price, and will enhance any rye-based cocktail.

TITLE: Rowan's Creek Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rowan's Creek Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey is a celebrated spirit produced by the renowned Willett Distillery in Kentucky. Named after the creek that runs through the distillery grounds, this bourbon embodies the essence of small-batch craftsmanship. With a proof of 100.1, Rowan's Creek offers a robust yet smooth drinking experience, showcasing the artistry of traditional bourbon making. Each bottle reflects the dedication and expertise of the Willett family, making it a prized addition to any whiskey enthusiast's collection.

TITLE: Royal Brackla 12 yrs Speyside 86 Proof Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: 12 year old Royal Brackla single malt, independently bottled by Signatory after maturing in a single refill butt. It was distilled in June 2007 and bottled at 43% in March 2018.

TITLE: Russell's Reserve 10 Years Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Master distillers and premier whiskey makers Jimmy and Eddie Russell have brought nearly 100 years of combined experience to artfully crafting Russell’s Reserve 10 Year Old Bourbon. Bottled at 90 proof, this hand selected small batch bourbon has a rich, caramel and vanilla taste and a uniquely smooth finish.

TITLE: Russell's Reserve 13 Years Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Russell’s Reserve 13 Year Old is the newest limited release from Wild Turkey/Russell’s Reserve, and let us say right off the bat: This is an absolutely beautiful bourbon. We had already been a very big fan of Wild Turkey Master’s Keep Bottled in Bond 17 Year release, but there’s some element of harmony in this Russell’s Reserve bottle that ultimately leaves us even more impressed. Everything here just clicks beautifully, in a way that is anything but common.

TITLE: Russell's Reserve 15 Years Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Russell's Reserve 15 Years Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a remarkable expression from the renowned Wild Turkey Distillery, crafted under the watchful eyes of Master Distillers Jimmy and Eddie Russell. Aged for 15 years in the finest charred new American oak barrels, this bourbon is a testament to the rich heritage and exceptional quality of Russell's Reserve. Bottled at 114.2 proof, this bourbon delivers a robust and complex flavor profile that is intense and refined. Each sip of Russell's Reserve 15-Year-Old offers a journey through deep, layered flavors, making it a prized addition to any bourbon enthusiast's collection.

TITLE: Russell's Reserve 1998 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A delicious and respectable throwback to Wild Turkey’s heydays and hopefully a sign of things to come. The Russell’s Reserve 1998 release is an extremely limited run of just 2,070 bottles. This makes it one of the smallest limited releases from a major Kentucky distillery in some time. According to Wild Turkey's press release, this bourbon was initially distilled and set aside to celebrate a future milestone for Jimmy Russell, but since this bourbon reached its peak of maturity, Jimmy’s son, Eddie Russell needed to dump the barrels or risk “less desirable flavors [taking] over.” With only 23 barrels of bourbon bottled, it’s the smallest batch ever released under Jimmy and Eddie’s watch. According to Josh Peters of The Whiskey Jug, Eddie told him that while he was checking on these barrels he noticed that they were evaporating a lot faster than expected. After pulling samples and checking with his dad, they dumped the barrels into a steel holding tank towards the end of 2014, making this officially a 15-year-old bourbon (due to distillation date).

TITLE: Russell's Reserve 2002 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This straight Bourbon from Wild Turkey is bottled at barrel proof. The luscious aroma evokes nuts, orange peel and spice. Tamed with water, the flavor remains bold, a bit drier than the aroma promises, but still echoing that orange peel and spice. The resiny midpalate is tinged with espresso, finishing with hints of cigar wrapper and sweet spices.

TITLE: Russell's Reserve 2003 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Russell's Reserve 2003 is the third release in the highly-coveted "Vintage" series from Master Distiller Eddie Russell as an homage to his father- the "Buddha of Bourbon" Jimmy Russell. The 2003 was aged to Barrel Proof perfection for a minimum of 16 years in Wild Turkey's Tyrone warehouses and marks the very last of their 107-barrel-entry-proof whiskey. Reminiscent of Wild Turkey releases from the mid-1980s to early 1990s, Eddie had a "Eureka!" moment after tasting these one-of-a-kind barrels bursting with sweet baking spices, juicy stone fruits, and butterscotch flavors.

TITLE: Russell's Reserve 6 Years Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Master distillers and premier whiskey makers Jimmy and Eddie Russell have brought nearly 100 years of combined experience to artfully crafting Russell’s Reserve 6 Year Old Rye.

TITLE: Russell's Reserve 9.5 Year Private Barrel Selection Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #98
DESCRIPTION: Picture this: a group of whiskey enthusiasts from The Prime Barrel, led by Bruce Russell, stepping into the hallowed halls of Tyrone A, the oldest rickhouse on the Wild Turkey campus. Built in 1894, this historic rickhouse is a testament to over 130 years of distillery tradition and craftsmanship. The moment you enter, the rich aromas of aging whiskey envelop you, blending with a palpable sense of history. The Quest for the Perfect Barrel: As The Prime Barrel members explored the rickhouse, Bruce Russell presented six meticulously selected barrels for their tasting journey. The excitement was tangible as they began their quest to find the perfect barrel. Each barrel had its unique story, aged to perfection in the iconic Tyrone A rickhouse. The first two barrels set an incredibly high bar with their exquisite nose, palate, and finish. Barrel 5 also stood out, making the selection process even more challenging. Ultimately, Barrels 1 and 5 were chosen for a final round of tasting and comparison. After much deliberation, Barrel 1 emerged as the standout choice. The Chosen Barrel: Filled on September 30, 2014, this exceptional 110-proof barrel aged for 9.5 years on the 4th floor of the Tyrone K Brickhouse. This location's high elevation and excellent air circulation imbued the whiskey with unparalleled depth and character. The result is a bourbon that captures the essence of Wild Turkey’s heritage and The Prime Barrel’s discerning palate. Tasting Notes: Nose: Sweet vanilla greets you warmly. Palate: The journey begins with sweet caramel, transitioning smoothly to smoky oak and rich butterscotch. Finish: A long, satisfying finish that lingers on the tongue with smoky oak and dry notes, creating a delightful experience. A Collector's Treasure: This Russell's Reserve Private Barrel is not just a bottle of whiskey; it’s a piece of history, a testament to the rich legacy of Wild Turkey and the meticulous selection process of The Prime Barrel members. With one of the highest-scoring palate and finish profiles, it is a prized addition to any collection.

TITLE: Russell's Reserve Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Russell's Reserve Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey is adored for its cinnamon, vanilla, spicy and charred flavor notes. Good substitute to the elusive Blanton's. Strong first sip that resonates into a subtle sweet cherry vanilla finish that comfortably lingers for a warm finish.

TITLE: Russell's Reserve Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
Russell's Reserve Single Rickhouse Camp Nelson C
DESCRIPTION: Inspired by the unique conditions of the rickhouses at the Wild Turkey Distilling Co, the Russell Family proudly introduces the Single Rickhouse collection, featuring a limited release of liquid from a single rickhouse. This collection explores the often unsung contributions specific resting places have on a whiskey’s final character, celebrating varied nuances of whiskey aging across these different environments.

TITLE: Russell's Reserve Single Rickhouse Camp Nelson F
DESCRIPTION: Russell's Reserve Single Rickhouse Camp Nelson F is a limited-edition bourbon whiskey that is released annually in small batches. It is aged in Rickhouse F at the Wild Turkey Distillery in Lawrenceburg, Kentucky, which is known for its hot and humid climate. This gives the whiskey a unique flavor profile that is characterized by its richness and complexity.

TITLE: Russian Standard Silver Filtered Platinum Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Like all Russian Standard vodkas, Russian Standard Platinum is made with hardy winter wheat grown on the Black Steppes of Russia and soft glacial waters of Lake Ladoga in Russia's frozen north. After being distilled multiple times and quadruple-filtered through charcoal, the spirit is then filtered through a proprietary silver filtration system that further purifies the vodka, resulting in vodka that is crisp, clean, and of unparalleled smoothness. The product is then relaxed for 48 hours before bottling. Russian Standard Platinum is perfect for sipping neat and makes the perfect martini. Gold medal winner: Beverage Testing Institute, The Spirits Business. Double Gold medal winner: International Spirits Challenge.

TITLE: Russian Standard Vodka
DESCRIPTION: While it seems only natural for Russia to enjoy a renaissance in premium vodka production (vodka is Russia’s national drink), it took an enterprising visionary to recognize Russia’s potential as the 21st century motherland of premium vodka. Roustam Tariko’s first insight was to solve a perplexing paradox: though the recognized birthplace of vodka and the largest vodka market in the world, after the fall of the communism, Russia had no premium domestic vodka brand of its own. Assuring Russia’s place as the birthplace of vodka, Roustam Tariko launched the world’s first premium Russian vodka made according to the exacting standards of chemist Dimitri Mendeleev’s 1894 formula for authentic vodka.The rest, as they say, is history. Russian Standard Original quickly became the number one selling premium vodka in the country, paving the way for the launch of super-premium Platinum and ultra-premium Imperia. Over the last 10 years, Russia has undergone a true renaissance and Russian Standard has played a pivotal role, providing Russians from all walks of life the opportunity to realize their dreams. A premier entrepreneurial company with leading businesses in spirits production and distribution, banking and insurance, Russian Standard offers more than products or services, it provides Russians with a sense of pride and personal freedom.Russian Standard Vodka’s unwavering quest for absolute authenticity has transformed the field of premium spirit production. Its $60 million state-of-the-art distillery in St. Petersburg is the most technologically advanced spirit production factory in the world, designed to meet increasing demand for the the brand around the world. Named the number one premium vodka in Russia and ranked one of the fasted growing brands in the world, Russian Standard is well on its way to achieving its long-term vision as the international leader in premium and luxury spirits

TITLE: Ruth Lewandowski Chilion Fox Hill Vineyard Cortese
DESCRIPTION: Chilion is a chance for all to see just how incredibly complex this variety is...due mainly to the extended maceration on skins which provide amplified spice, herbs, and phenolics than we're all accustomed to with this particular grape. Harvest: by hand

TITLE: RY3 "Lil Rum Ryeding Hood" Cask Strength Rum Cask Finish Rye Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #12
DESCRIPTION: The blend of three whiskies (American and Canadian rye), three mash bills, and three age statements (3YR, 4YR, and 14YR ) add up to RY3, a sumptuous and heavenly honeycombed mouthful of peach nectar and maple bran. White pepper punctuates an otherwise seamless coat of orange peel, vanilla musk, and cigar leaf. Cask strength adds a mich welcomed "oomph" and makes this whiskey one of our favorite rye sippers of the year. 124.2 Proof / 62.1% ABV. Nose: Brown sugar, molasses, orange peel, cinnamon bark, rye spice Palate: Caramel, toffee, raisins, light herbal note, a touch of honey. Not overly sweet Finish: Marzipan, burnt caramel, dark chocolate The charity this barrel selection will be supporting is the Make-A-Wish Foundation and donations will go to grant the wish of every child diagnosed with a critical illness Donation Amount: $5 from each bottle sold

TITLE: RY3 Cask Strength Cognac Cask Finish Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The blend of three whiskies (American and Canadian rye), three mash bills, and three age statements (3YR, 4YR, and 14YR ) add up to RY3. This is a seasonal, limited quantity batch of the cask strength whiskey which was then finished in a cognac cask. Really delicious offering that can be enjoyed equally any time of year!

TITLE: Ryujin Kakushi Ginjo Nama-Chozo Dragon God
DESCRIPTION: Ryujin Shuzo's underground water is very soft and feminine, lending to their brewers the power to draw out the hidden flavors in their rice. Their aim is to create flavorful, mellow, high quality sake that warms the heart upon drinking. They like to combine their traditional skills and methods with the brewer's heart. To this end, they work hard to improve their skills every day to work towards the next challenge, and brew excellent beer in the off season. Sashimi, Unagi Kabayaki, Yaki Udon, Vinegared Dishes

TITLE: Ryujin Shuzo Oze x Rose Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Ryujin Shuzo's underground water is very soft and feminine, lending to their brewers the power to draw out the hidden flavors in their rice. Their aim is to create flavorful, mellow, high quality sake that warms the heart upon drinking. They like to combine their traditional skills and methods with the brewer's heart. To this end, they work hard to improve their skills every day to work towards the next challenge, and brew excellent beer in the off season. Served primarily as an aperitif or digestif with cheese, foie gras, sushi, etc.

TITLE: S.N. Pike's Magnolia Barrel Proof Straight Wheated Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bottled-in-bond, 95% RYE, aged over four years, #4 char, proofed with Kentucky spring water. Bottled at barrel strength (125.12%) Nose: Baking spice and floral notes with vanilla and cherries rounding out the subtle notes. Palate: Rich stonefruit notes followed by caramel and citrus. Finish: Extremely smooth with cinnamon and clover.

TITLE: S.N. Pike's Magnolia Bottled-in-Bond Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: 95% Rye Whiskey is Bottled In Bond, 4+ years old, aged in white American Oak #4 char. Proofed in Kentucky spring water.

TITLE: S.N. Pike's Magnolia Straight Wheated Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The straight Bourbon is 45% wheat, aged 3+ years in white American oak barrels with a #4 char, and Proofed with Kentucky spring water.

TITLE: Sagamore 6 Year Old Barrel Select Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Since 2013, Sagamore Spirits has been hard at work restoring Maryland’s whiskey distilling tradition, crafting spicy rye cushioned with sweet corn; delicate and bold, spicy and fruity, all separately and at the same time. They were founded by Under Armour’s Kevin Plank, and are a Baltimore-based distillery that currently sources their rye whiskey from MGP while they distill and age their own stock. Unlike other “craft” distilleries that often make a range of whiskeys, Sagamore Spirit only sells rye whiskeys (albeit often with interesting finishes).

TITLE: Sagamore 7 Year Old "Nerds & Turds" Single Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The High Rye Fill Date was over 8 years ago, 8/22/14. The Low Rye Fill Date is just a hair under 8 years 12/22/14.Nose: A fantastic mature Rye spice. This is a bourbon drinker's Rye even on the nose. Notably dark in appearance. Palate: Dark Chocolate, Minty (like an Andy's Mint), with Christmas Candy vibes. Ridiculously crushable and Oily. Kira is a connoisseur of fine Ryes, and this one knocked her socks off with its darker flavor profile (chocolate notes throughout) and complexity. David and Trev agreed that you don't have to be a big Rye fan to love this - this is a bourbon drinker's Rye. Finish: A very long tingly chocolate finish. The impressive finish was a leading factor in why we selected this barrel.

TITLE: Sagamore 7 Year Old "R/Bourbon II" Single Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A follow-up to R/Bourbon's Sagamore 7yr Rye from earlier this year (2022), this release is packed with flavor.Sagamore is a favorite of mine: a perfect combination of flavor, age, and affordability. This single barrel is no different, delivering plenty of maple, a touch of cola sweetness, and a rich herbal backbone. It isn't dilly like MGP, Sagamore delivers a great, herbal character on the palate: black tea, sandalwood, orange zest, and a pinch of ango bitters. This pairs well with the middling tannins - there's plenty of oak without it drinking dry or tannic. Long finish, filled with brown sugar, orange peel, a light touch of blackberry, and a faint, subtle prickle of peppercorn.

TITLE: Sagamore 7 Year Old "R/Bourbon" Single Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The long-awaited follow-up to R/Bourbon's Sagamore 6yr Rye from 2021, this release is a full year older and packed with flavor. One of two VERY FIRST marked single barrels of 7-year rye from Sagamore Spirits in the country! This barrel (#93) turned 7 years old on December 22, 2021, and was bottled the same day. This is a single barrel of 7-year-old Maryland-style rye, made with a different blend than the standard Sagamore core lineup (80/20 vs the signature blend's 70/30). 80% is the high rye at 95 and the 20% is the low rye at 52. 110 Proof. The maple is still here in droves, it's spicy, packed with orange peel, honey, brown sugar, and toffee. Cracked peppercorns. Once again coming up short on the herbal, dilly character of other ryes, instead its all pure spice and dessert. Long, rich finish, light on ethanol, heavy on clove and honey

TITLE: Sagamore 7 Year Old Jews and Booze "The Big Lebowski" Single Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: THE VERY FIRST marked single barrel of 7-year rye from Sagamore Spirits in the country! This barrel (#90) turned 7 years old on December 22, 2021, and was bottled the same day. The pick is a tribute to the cult classic movie "The Big Lebowski". This is a single barrel of 7-year-old Maryland-style rye, made with a different blend than the standard Sagamore core lineup (80/20 vs the signature blend's 70/30). 80% is the high rye at 95 and the 20% is the low rye at 52. 110 Proof.This juice doesn’t make it in the regular lineups and is the oldest and the very first marked 7-year-old Sagamore offerings in the market. It was aged in a separate 2200 barrel rickhouse on the Sagamore farm property, separate from the regular aging barns. Each barrel is one of a kind and only around 100 barrels are available every year. $5 from every bottle will be donated to Galilee Culinary Institute.

TITLE: Sagamore 8 Year Old “The First” Prime Barrel Exclusive Single Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In the summer of 2022, eight members of our club visited the beautiful grounds of Sagamore Spirits to pick the inaugural barrel for our premium membership project. When you buy our membership, you will receive a complimentary bottle of this exclusive collaboration bottling between The Prime Barrel and Sagamore Spirits! This is a one-of-a-kind bottle for many reasons. It’s one of the very few 8-year-old Maryland-style rye expressions that was produced by the distillery. The bottle bears our club's art and is sure to spark a lot of conversations and FOMO.Here's what's inside the bottle: Nose: rye spiciness, banana, vanilla bean Palette: soft and creamy texture, a touch of tannins. Finish: quite long, rye spiciness comes back, Marshmallow Barrel Info: Barrel#: 67-14 High Rye Fill Date: 8/22/14 (80% of the blend) Low Rye Fill Date: 12/22/14 (20% of the blend) Interested in becoming a member? Start here: https://membership.primebarrel.com

TITLE: Sagamore Spirit "Peach Cobbler" Peach Mead Barrel Finish Rye The Prime Barrel x TheHateDust Pick
DESCRIPTION: I mmerse yourself in the complex journey of Sagamore Spirit Reserve Select, a meticulously crafted rye whiskey that has traversed a unique aging process. This exceptional spirit began its life aging in a barrel that previously held extra añejo tequila and was then used by Orchid Cellar to age white peach mead, adding layers of intricate flavors. Aging Process: Blended from 4-year and 6-year-old rye whiskies, this distinctive batch was finished for two additional years in the very same white peach mead barrel from Orchid Cellar Meadery in Maryland. This innovative aging strategy has woven the classic warm spices of cinnamon and nutmeg inherent in our rye with the lush, succulent tones of stone fruits. Tasting Notes: Nose: Light floral blossom and fresh citrus set the stage for a deeply aromatic experience. Palate: Rich caramel sweeps across the palate, accompanied by vibrant blackcurrant notes, creating a lush and satisfying complexity. Finish: The finish is persistent, marked by a refined spiciness that ties back to its rye roots. Spirit Highlights: At 103 proof, the Sagamore Spirit Reserve Select series epitomizes the artistry of Maryland distilling, reflecting a legacy of excellence and a relentless pursuit of quality. Each bottle from this series offers a one-of-a-kind selection, capturing the innovative essence and bold character of Sagamore Spirit. Embrace the rich history and creative prowess of Maryland's distilling with this exclusive offering, where each sip tells the story of its remarkable journey from barrel to bottle.

TITLE: Sagamore Spirit Cask Strength Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This Cask Strength Rye Whiskey is a blend of straight high-rye and low-rye mash bills aged 4 to 7 years. The 7-year-old contributes deeper chocolate, hazelnut, and molasses characteristics; the 4-year-old adds bright citrus notes and balanced spice. After our distillers select and blend these straight rye whiskies, they add just a touch of limestone-filtered water from our spring house built in 1909. Cask Strength is complex and perfectly layered, showcasing the transformational art of blending. PROOF: 112.2 (56.1% ABV) AGE: 4 - 7 Years

TITLE: Sagamore Spirit Double Oak Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: After aging our straight rye whiskey for 4 to 5 years in high-char new American oak barrels, our distillers transfer the aged whiskey into toasted wave stave barrels for an additional 18 months. The increased surface area of the low-char, medium-plus-toast staves imparts Double Oak’s delightful caramel, toffee, hazelnut, and toasted coconut. Our classic Maryland-style rye whiskey is reimagined through this innovative aging process and then proofed with limestone-filtered water from our spring house built in 1909. The final spirit is a shining example of old meeting new. PROOF: 96.6 (48.3% ABV) AGE: 4 - 5 Years

TITLE: Sagamore Spirit Reserve Series 8 Year Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A very special whiskey, a long time in the making, this 8-year-old straight rye whiskey is a testament to the power of time. Sagamore took their straight rye whiskey and aged it in new charred American white oak barrels for 8 years, creating a complex spirit. Sagamore Spirit Reserve Series celebrates the legacy of Maryland distilling, with an unyielding focus on excellence from start to finish. 57.45% ABV

TITLE: Sagamore Spirit Signature Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Sagamore Spirit Rye Whiskey is a blend of two straight rye mash bills, aged 4 to 6 years in high-char American oak barrels. The first is a high-rye, which adds notes of cinnamon and clove, and the second, a low-rye, contributes notes of caramel, honey, and citrus peel. The final spirit is proofed with limestone-filtered water from our spring house built in 1909 and represents our team’s thoughtful approach to crafting a classic Maryland-style rye whiskey. PROOF: 83 (41.5% ABV) AGE: 4 - 6 Years

TITLE: Saint Cloud 7 Year Old Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Bottled at full barrel proof, uncut and unfiltered. Since this is a single barrel bourbon, every barrel is different, encouraged to express its own unique story, and tasting notes would differ barrel to barrel.

TITLE: Saint-cosme Little James' Basket Press White Blend
DESCRIPTION: This little gem from Louis Barroul of Château Saint-Cosme is the perfect wine. A blend of Viognier, Sauvignon and Muscat d'Alexandrie, this explodes on the nose and is fresh and fruit-filled on the palate, with notes of citrus, melons and white flowers. Great with funky cheeses, morels and, believe or not--asparagus

TITLE: Saint-Hilaire Blanquette De Limoux Brut
DESCRIPTION: TastingNotesDry, toasty, smooth and clean SAINT-HILAIRE truly captivates with an attractive yeasty aroma and luscious creamy texture. The palate is light and crisp with citrus and apple flavors and the body is just hefty enough.

TITLE: Saiya Yuri Masamune "Beautiful Lily" Honjozo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Produced in Akita by the Saiya Brewery, makers of Yuki No Bosha, this is a favorite among locals of the region. Yuri is the name of the local area of Honjo-shi and Masamune is an old term for Japanese sake. This sake is mellow and rustic and has a firm structure, which makes it enjoyable at a range of temperatures, from chilled to warm. Its nutty and earthy notes are balanced by an underlying fruitiness and it complements grilled meats, stews, and fish. Best at room temperature or mildly heated; pair with grilled meats, and salty, briny flavors.

TITLE: Sam Houston 14 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Sam Houston is a 86 proof American straight whiskey made with Kentucky Bourbon. Perfectly aged in charred white oak barrels and hand selected for its exceptional characteristics and golden amber color. The flavor signature is bold and unique much like Sam Houston himself. The aroma brings to mind hints of caramel and vanilla which combine with the rich smoky texture to form a perfect union. A smooth and distinctive whiskey in honor of a distinguished man.

TITLE: Sam Houston 15 Years Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Release No. 6 of Sam Houston 15-Year-Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is the most aged bourbon offering to date from the distillery. This entire release was crafted from specific barrels in a private reserve of premium bourbon. Select barrels were sampled and ranked by a hand-chosen group of industry insiders and bourbon enthusiasts. No two batches are the same, but the taste profile captured in the barrel sampling process showcases the care and craft utilized in creating this limited and extremely rare bourbon.

TITLE: Same Day Delivery (Manhattan and Brooklyn only)
DESCRIPTION: Same Day Delivery (Manhattan and Brooklyn only)

TITLE: San Felice Campogiovanni Brunello di Montalcino
San Martino Arberesko Aglianico del Vulture
DESCRIPTION: Arberesko is the big brother to Siir. It refers to the name of the ancient Greek-Albanian population of the region who cultivated vines there in the 1400’s. 100% Aglianico from older vines, this is the perfect example of why Aglianico is often referred to as the Barolo of the South. Enjoy with hearty meat dishes, roasts, bbq and braised meat.

TITLE: Sandy Cove Sauvignon Blanc Marlborough
DESCRIPTION: Sandy Cove Sauvignon Blanc is produced exclusively for David Bowler Wine by renowned NZ winemaker, Allan Scott. Made in limited quantities, this version of New Zealand's famous wine is rounder and a bit richer than what one usually finds in New Zealand Savignon Blanc in this price range. In other word, Sandy Cove represents real value.

TITLE: Santa Cruz Mountain Vineyard Petite Sirah
DESCRIPTION: The variety known in California as Petite Sirah has its origins in France where it is called Durif. It was named after Dr. Durif who propagated it from a cross of Peloursin and Syrah in 1880. Only in the U.S. is the variety called Petite Sirah – elsewhere in the world it is called by its correct and original name Durif. Santa Cruz Mountain Vineyard has worked with this variety since 1977.The grapes for this wine come from the relatively new appellation of San Antonio Valley in southwestern Monterey County. This high valley, west of Highway 101 is well suited to slightly warmer climate grape varieties. The block that these grapes come from is on top of a well-drained, shale covered hill.We are using a relatively new approach in fermenting our Petite Sirah. The variety is famous for over-extracting tannins, often making wines of great fruit intensity, but commonly having a lot of astringency. Starting in 2005 we went to a method of whole berry fermentation of our Petite Sirah and we are very excited about the results.When the grapes are processed they are only de-stemmed, not crushed at all. We de-stem them into small, one ton lot, fermentation bins. By not crushing the berries we release fewer of the harsh tannins during fermentation.This is a wine to enjoy with hearty comfort foods like stews, roasts and rich pasta sauces. We suggest giving it some time in a decanter to wake up everything lurking inside, or cellar it for a few more years.

TITLE: Santa Helena Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Light, fresh and fruity. Clean with tons of strawberry and cherry fruit. Also, delicious chilled!

TITLE: Santa Teresa Ron Antiguo De Solera 1796 Rum
DESCRIPTION: The Ron Santa Theresa 1796 Antigua de Solero is a Venezuelan rum which can trace its ancestry back to the year of 1796 when the Santa Theresa Hacienda was created. It was of course, 200 years later that the Ron Santa Theresa 1796 was created to commemorate the bicentennial anniversary of the Hacienda. This is a true Solero rum with 4 rows of aging barrels set one atop each other. As the rum ages, a portion of the rum moves through each row until it reaches the final solero row at the bottom years later. The barrels are not emptied fully and only a portion of the rum from the previous or higher row is moved to the lower row each time. According to the Santa Theresa website, a portion of the rum reaches an age approximating 25 years before bottling.

TITLE: Santanera Abolengo Tequila Blanco
Santi Solane Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso
DESCRIPTION: Santi Valpolicella Classico Superiore is a "ripasso" method Valpolicella; meaning that following primary fermentation the wine sees a second fermentation with the addition of Amarone grapes and skins, creating a richer, more complex and more exciting final wine.

TITLE: Santo Wines Santorini Assyrtiko
DESCRIPTION: Assyrtiko's signature high acidity makes it a wonderful partner with vinaigrettes and the sharp flavors of certain vegetables. It is perhaps the ultimate partner to classic Greek salads and simple Greek tavern fare.

TITLE: Sarava Galactic Wines Vinho Branco "FML" Loureiro
DESCRIPTION: Vinho Verde as it was originally intended. Grapes from late harvests guarantee rich aromas without losing the piquant acidity. A little natural bubble ensures that the 'spirit of the wine' is preserved.

TITLE: Sartarelli Brut Spumante
DESCRIPTION: Sartarelli Brut Spumante is a quintessential Italian sparkler crafted in the Marche region, boasting the elegance and vibrancy of the Verdicchio grape. Made using the Charmat method, this wine captures the essence of Marche with its fresh and lively character.

TITLE: Satsuma Kuro Shiranami Shochu
Satsuma Mura Imo Sweet Potato Shochu
DESCRIPTION: Single-distilled on the Osumi Penninsula in Kagoshima Prefecture on the island of Kyushu. Satsuma Mura has been produced since the dawn of the Meiji Era focused only on black koji.

TITLE: Satsuma Shuzo Shiranami Kuradashi Genshu
DESCRIPTION: This Shochu is called Genshu, Undiluted Shochu. We selected top quality Genshu from the distillery and bottled it. It is the master-piece of our Shochu master brewer’s (Toji) painstaking work. No water is added to this Shochu after its distillation process. Despite of its high alcohol content compared with other Shochu, It has deep, mellow and rich flavor. Enjoy it straight, on the rocks, oyuwari or mizuwari (mix Shochu with hot water or cold water at the ratio of 5:5).

TITLE: Sauvage "Passover" Upstate Vodka
DESCRIPTION: This special batch, limited edition vodka is one of only a few handcrafted, small batch vodkas made for Passover. Like our other kosher vodka, it’s an all-natural, clean, smooth, pure vodka from apples. Every bottle contains 70-80 apples from local New York state farms.

TITLE: Sauvage Upstate Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Ready for a new vodka that just hit the market? We know what you’re thinking, what makes this particular vodka so special? What makes it unique is it is distilled from apples. Before we continue, we must stress, Upstate is in no way, shape or form, an apple-flavored vodka. It is also not an apple-infused vodka. Upstate Vodka is a small batch, craft-distilled vodka made from apples. We know you’re used to vodkas made from potatoes or grains, but we promise you will love it. Raise a glass to this latest offering from Sauvage; already known for their popular Comsi Comsa range of apple-based wines. Upstate Vodka is a craft spirit produced in small, limited batches with high-quality standards. This handmade vodka is distilled and bottled at Sauvage Winery & Farm Distillery in New York, using natural ingredients and water that is known to be the cleanest. As you can guess, the apples used to distill this innovative vodka comes from upstate New York farmers; Oneonta to be exact, where Upstate Vodka is also produced. It features a little sweet pre-taste from apples which disappears almost right away. Upstate is 90 proof and contains 45 Alc/vol, higher than the industry standard of 80 proof and 40 Alc.

TITLE: Sawanoi Daikarakuchi Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Sawanoi is true dry sake (Nihon Shudo +10 dryness) that is made using carefully selected rice nurtured amidst the natural beauty of the Okutama area.

TITLE: Sazerac Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The One and Only New Orleans Original. Sazerac Rye Whiskey symbolizes the tradition and history of New Orleans. Rye Whiskey that dates back to the 1800’s, around the time when saloons, veiled as Coffee Houses, began lining the streets of New Orleans. It was at the Sazerac Coffee House on Royal Street where local patrons were served toddies made with Rye Whiskey and Peychaud’s Bitters. The libation became known as the “Sazerac” and America’s first branded cocktail was born. This is the whiskey that started it all 95 Points, Wine Enthusiast

TITLE: Sazerac Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The One and Only New Orleans Original. Sazerac Rye Whiskey symbolizes the tradition and history of New Orleans. Rye Whiskey that dates back to the 1800’s, around the time when saloons, veiled as Coffee Houses, began lining the streets of New Orleans. It was at the Sazerac Coffee House on Royal Street where local patrons were served toddies made with Rye Whiskey and Peychaud’s Bitters.
