TITLE: Sazerac “Sazchmo - Bourbon Street” Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #23
DESCRIPTION: Our first "Baby Saz" pick is finally here! A ramped-up version of the classic Sazerac flavor profile with loads of richness and spice. It's a whiskey you'll want to keep at the ready for some smooth sippin' on a Tuesday night or making your best Manhattan. Nose: Dark cherries, clove, anise, allspice, charred oak Palate: clementine, yellow plums, dried apricot, vanilla bean, leather Finish: lingering notes of black peppercorn and mint Barrel 14-L-17-D-7-33-096 Date Filled 12/17/14 Entry Gallons 53 Entry Proof 125 Warehouse D Floor 7 Rick 20 Date Selected 10/17/2021 Date Bottled 12/01/2021 Age 6 years 11 months Char Level 4 Stave Seasoning 6 months Recipe Rye Whiskey Mash Barrel Type American Oak Cooperage Independence Stave For the "tater sticker," we paid homage to the birthplace of the Sazerac drink, New Orleans. When we think of the Big Easy, a few things come to mind - Sazerac, beignets, Mardi Gras, and jazz. When it comes to latter, the city produced legends not only in jazz but in music in general. One such legend is Louis Armstrong, aka "Satchmo." We love his music and decided to play homage to his nickname, so "Satchmo" became "Sazchmo." Crack open the bottle, play Mr. Armstrong's best hits, and it's an experience you are likely to remember for a while. As suggested by our members, the pick will support Juvenile Diabetes Research Foundation. $5 from each bottle will go directly to JDRF, where good folks are leading the fight against type 1 diabetes (T1D) by funding research, advocating for policies that accelerate access to new therapies, and providing a support network for millions people around the world impacted by T1D.

TITLE: Sazerac “Sazchmo - Jazz Seryenade” 7 Year Old Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #102
DESCRIPTION: Introducing our newest "Baby Saz" gem, a standout in the world of single barrel whiskey, masterfully crafted from the esteemed lineage of our Sazerac Rye selections at Buffalo Trace. At the unbeatable price point of just $40, you'd be hard-pressed to find a 7-year-old rye whiskey that delivers this caliber of quality and flavor anywhere else. Diving deeper into the heart and soul of New Orleans, the ambiance of this vibrant city intertwines seamlessly with the legacy of its iconic sounds. From the world-renowned bourbon streets to the vibrant parades of Mardi Gras, New Orleans celebrates its history with vivacity and flair. And emblematic of its pulsating heart is the timeless rhythm of jazz. This edition, the "Sazchmo - Jazz Seryenade," stands as a melodic tribute to the expansive realm of whiskey. Evoking the entrancing notes of a saxophone on a serene evening, this rye whiskey offers a harmonious journey, capturing the essence and spirit of a classic jazz serenade. Dive into its narrative - a tale steeped in history, fervor, and soul, all bottled up and awaiting your savor. Experience the sounds and tastes of the Big Easy with our unparalleled single-barrel whiskey. Cheers to the best value you'll find in a glass!Barrel Info: Barrel 15-K-25-T-4-24-012 Brand Sazerac Rye Date Filled 11/25/15 Entry Gallons 53 Entry Proof 125 Warehouse T Floor 4 Rick 24 Date Selected 10/26/22 Date Bottled 12/29/22 Age 7 years 1 months Char Level 4 Stave Seasoning 6 months Recipe Rye Mash Bourbon Barrel Type American Oak Cooperage Independence Stave

TITLE: Sazerac “Sazchmo - Mardi Gras” Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #24
DESCRIPTION: Our second "Baby Saz" pick comes from a sister barrel of our original/first Sazerac Rye selection. Profiles are quite different between two barrels - and certainly different from their regular expression sibling. Nose: citrus, molasses, cinnamon, pipe tobacco, leather, charred oak Palate: dried stone fruit, raisins, eucalyptus, pepper, leather, anise, toasted oak Finish: Warm and citrusy Barrel Info: Barrel 14-L-17-M-5-20-158 Date Filled 12/17/14 Entry Gallons 53 Entry Proof 125 Warehouse M Floor 5 Rick 20 Date Selected 12/8/21 Date Bottled 12/01/2021 Age 6 years 11 months Char Level 4 Stave Seasoning 6 months Recipe Rye Whiskey Mash Barrel Type American Oak Cooperage Independence Stave For the "tater sticker," we paid homage to the birthplace of the Sazerac drink, New Orleans. When we think of the Big Easy, a few things come to mind - Sazerac, beignets, Mardi Gras, and jazz. While our first selection had a Louis Armstrong-inspired sticker, this one pays homage to the greatest annual party there is, the Mardi Gars.This barrel will be supporting Shriner's Hospitals for Children. Through the generosity of donors, folks at Shriner's have been able to help more than 1.5 million children reach their potential and lead more fulfilling lives, regardless of the families ability to pay.

TITLE: Scapa 14 Year Old Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: From a tiny distillery in Orkney, Scapa is often overlooked in favor of its more famous neighbor Highland Park. This 14yo was quite a shortlived bottling - it was introduced by then-new owners Chivas Brothers to replace the old 12yo but was subsequently superseded by the now also discontinued 16-year-old bottling.

TITLE: Scapa 16 Year Old Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This item is discontinued. We might be able to source you a bottle if given 7-10 days headstart.

TITLE: Scarpetta Frico Frizzante
DESCRIPTION: Scarpetta, in Italian, is a slang expression for when one performs that motion of sopping up all of the saucy, juicy goodness left on one's plate with a piece of bread after a delicious meal. Bobby Stuckey, Master Sommelier, and his business partner Chef Lachlan Patterson are the creators of this serious yet fun label from the hills of Friuli. After working together at The French Laundry, Bobby as an M.S. and Lachlan as a chef de partie, they moved to Boulder Colorado with the dream of opening a neighborhood restaurant. One fateful trip to Friuli was enough to seal their fate. They came back to Boulder and opened Frasca Food and Wine, a restaurant dedicated to the cuisine and culture of Friuli. Always digging deeper for Friulian inspiration, Bobby and Lachlan travel to the region several times a year, even taking their entire staff along for a week of eating, wine tasting and general Friuli-worship every summer. Sunshine, good friends, and smiles.

TITLE: SCEA Matassa Coume de l'Olla
DESCRIPTION: Tom Lubbe is a New Zealander who grew up in South Africa who then ended up founding iconoclastic and influential Domaine Matassa in the Roussillon. After working in South African wineries, he landed in the Catalan village of Calce, interning at Domaine Gauby. After three years, Tom founded his own estate in the area, focusing on the traditional local varietals and some very old (60-120 year-old) vineyards. The emphasis is on Carignan, Grenache, Macabeu, and Grenache Gris. The terroir is mostly composed of schist and marl, with a small vineyard planted to granitic soil. Production and farming is all natural and biodynamic, and the vineyards are certified organic by Ecocert. The old vines and difficult terroir guarantee low yields and small production, with great emphasis on concentration and minerality.

TITLE: Schlumberger Gruner Veltliner Brut
DESCRIPTION: Schlumberger Gruner Veltliner Sparkling Wine Brut is made of a premium cuvee of typical Austrain wine of a selected single vintage year. Produced according to the Methode Traditionnelle - 2nd fermentaiton in the original bottle.

TITLE: Schplink Gruner Veltliner
DESCRIPTION: Schplink Gruner Veltliner. 3 liters of delicious boxed Gruner! Perfect for outdoors. Golser Wein was established by Harald Lehner in 1995 out of passion and persistence. His father had 15ha farmed to grapes and wheat and everything was sold in bulk. The business struggled and could not support him so after finishing school he went to work for a family wine company to gain experience producing bottled wine. His hard work earned him a 20% share of this business but when the owners divorced, they sold everything and he was left starting from scratch. At this point, Harald decided he would employ himself and be in control of his own destiny. He now owns 40 ha of vines, 20 of which are certified organic, farms another 100 ha and produces 2 million bottles per year. Harald is determined, proud, detailed oriented, and not afraid to challenge the status quo. NO ONE has been bold enough to put wine in anything other than a bottle in Austria, but not Harald. The design is equally as bold as he is, and is inspired by the 80’s, an era where Apple computers were the boxes everyone was talking about and Kraftwerk’s Computer Love album debuted.

TITLE: Schramsberg Vineyards Mirabelle Brut
DESCRIPTION: In 1965, Jack and Jamie Davies established Schramsberg Vineyards. One of the pioneers of the area, they set set out to make world-class sparkling wine on property originally owned by Jacob Schram. This 220 acre estate is located in Napa Valley's Diamond Mountain District and its caves, which were dug in the 1880's, extend over 30,000 square feet. The Schramsbergs produce limited quantities of handcrafted sparkling wines from grapes grown in their 43 acre estate vineyard and with fruit harvested from superior parcels located in cool climate, including Napa- Carneros, Sonoma-Carneros, Mendocino County and the Sonoma and Marin coastal areas. The winemakers draw from 120 vineyard blocks covering 371 acres to create 220 base wines each year. Many of Schramsberg's viticultural and winemaking practices are carried out by hand – grapes are handharvested, the bottles are stacked and riddled in underground caves by hand. The J. Schram, Schramsberg's top offering, is even hand-labeled. They are unique among California sparkling wine houses in that they barrel ferment 25% of their juice to produce rich, flavorful and complex wines. A world-class winery and recognized leader in the California wine industry, Schramsberg produces America's finest sparkling wines which have been served proudly at state functions at the White House and abroad for decades. Jack and Jamie's son Hugh now manage the winery. (60% Chardonnay/40% Pinot Noir). Vintage composition: 82% 2009, 18% aged reserve lots.

TITLE: Scopa delle Venezie Pinot Grigio
DESCRIPTION: 100% Pinot Grigio. Harvested at cool temperatures, crushed and pressed. Fermented at low temperature in stainless steel (15-17 C) for 8-12 days. Aged in steel for 3 months before bottling.

TITLE: Sean Minor 4B California Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: The Sauvignon Blanc fruit was 100% whole-cluster pressed to minimize astringency from the skins. Once settled, a portion of the juice was placed in small neutral French oak barrels, while the majority was moved to stainless steel tanks for fermentation. This combination allows the wine to develop a balanced level of crispness. The wine in barrels is sur lie aged and stirred consistently. The final blend was a combination of lots that provided a perfect balance of richness, bouquet and mouth feel.

TITLE: Seehof "Elektrisch" Riesling Kabinett
DESCRIPTION: The Seehof Elektrisch Riesling Kabinett is a refreshing and vibrant German white wine produced by the Seehof winery in Rheinhessen, Germany. It is made from 100% Riesling grapes grown in the estate's limestone-rich vineyards. The grapes are hand-harvested and gently pressed to preserve their delicate flavors and aromas. The wine is fermented in stainless steel tanks to maintain its freshness and purity.

TITLE: Seehof Pinot Noir Rose
Seehof Rheinhessen Weisserburgunder Trocken
DESCRIPTION: Light bodied but pairs lovely with green salads topped with roast chicken.

TITLE: Seehof Riesling Trocken
DESCRIPTION: The Riesling Trocken is fermented in stainless steel and ages for 4-5 months in tank before then bottling.

TITLE: Seikyo Omachi Junmai Ginjo Sake
Sekk Sato Shiki Single Grain 21 YearOld Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Sekk Sato Shiki Single Grain 21-Year-Old Whisky is an exceptional expression of Japanese whisky craftsmanship, representing over two decades of meticulous aging and care. This single-grain whisky has been aged for 21 years, allowing it to develop a rich, complex, smooth, and refined character. Bottled at 86 proof (43% ABV), Sekk Sato Shiki 21-Year-Old offers a delicate balance of flavors that reflect Japanese whisky-making's elegance and tradition. This whisky is perfect for those who appreciate the nuances of long-aged spirits and the artistry that goes into creating them.

TITLE: Sekk Sato Shiki Single Grain 41 YearOld Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Sekk Sato Shiki Single Grain 41-Year-Old Whisky is a rare and extraordinary expression showcasing Japanese whisky craftsmanship's pinnacle. Aged for an impressive 41 years, this single-grain whisky offers unparalleled depth and complexity, making it a true collector's item. Bottled at 86 proof (43% ABV), this whisky has developed a rich, nuanced character over its four decades of maturation, resulting in a sophisticated and deeply satisfying spirit. Sekk Sato Shiki, 41-Year-Old, is a testament to the artistry and patience in producing world-class aged whisky.

TITLE: Sekk Sato Shiki Single Grain Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Sekk Sato Shiki Single Grain Whisky is a refined and elegantly crafted expression from Japan, known for its meticulous approach to whisky making. This single grain whisky represents the harmony and balance that Japanese whiskies are celebrated for, offering a smooth and delicate flavor profile that appeals to both connoisseurs and newcomers alike. Bottled at 86 proof (43% ABV), Sekk Sato Shiki is a versatile whisky that can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as the foundation of sophisticated cocktails. This whisky embodies the essence of Japanese craftsmanship, with each bottle reflecting a commitment to quality and tradition.

TITLE: Sekk Sato Shiki Single Malt
DESCRIPTION: Sekk Sato Shiki Single Malt is an elegant and meticulously crafted Japanese whisky that embodies the refined artistry of single malt production. Produced by Sekk Sato, this whisky showcases the delicate balance and complexity that Japanese single malts are known for. Bottled at 86 proof (43% ABV), Sekk Sato Shiki Single Malt offers a smooth and harmonious drinking experience, making it an excellent choice for both seasoned whisky enthusiasts and those new to Japanese whisky. Each bottle reflects the tradition and dedication of its producers, resulting in a whisky that is both sophisticated and deeply satisfying.

TITLE: Sektkellerei Ohlig Rheingau Sekt Brut Weiss Latitude 50
DESCRIPTION: Produced for other growers without the means to make sparkling wines. A combination of Muller-thurgau from Weingutt Rapp in the Nahe, Silvaner from Weingut Rapp, and Pinot Blanc from Weingut Mohr in the village of Lorch (Rheingau).

TITLE: Selvagrossa Muschen Marche Rosso
DESCRIPTION: A full-bodied and structured Italian red wine made from Nebbiolo grapes by Castello di Verduno winery in Piedmont region, Italy. It has an intense ruby red color and aromas of red fruits, violets, and spices. On the palate, it is rich and complex, with flavors of red fruits, spices, and tar. The finish is long and lingering.

TITLE: SelvaRey Rum Owner's Reserve
DESCRIPTION: Owner Bruno Mars envisioned a sipping rum that would be the pinnacle of Tropical Luxury. SelvaRey's legendary Maestro Ronero, Francisco ""Don Pancho"" Fernandez hand-selected his finest vintages to create this incredible blend of rums aged between fifteen and twenty-five years.The legendary maestro ronero hand-selects the best rums, from fifteen to twenty-five-year-old vintages, to create the ultimate blend from only the most prestigious casks. Bruno Mars personally designed the label, bottle, and gift box for this prestigious spirit.

TITLE: Senator 6 Year Barrel Proof Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Senator 6-Year Barrel Proof Straight Rye Whiskey is a bold and distinguished expression that captures the essence of a well-aged rye whiskey. Crafted by the Indiana Distilling Company and bottled in Kentucky, this whiskey is aged six years to develop its complex flavor profile. Bottled at barrel proof, typically between 110 and 120 proof depending on the barrel, The Senator delivers a powerful yet balanced drinking experience that is rich and robust. This rye whiskey is perfect for those who appreciate the spiciness and depth only a barrel-proof rye can offer.

TITLE: Senkin Modern Muku Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Using the same concept as Domaine in wine, Senkin's rice is grown with the same water used to brew sake. They use ancient natural techniques from the eddo period. Scallop with grapefruit salad, mozzarella and tomato salad, insalata di mare (Italian Seafood Salad), seafood aspic, sea urchin mousse, poached white asparagus, sashimi of thinly sliced white flesh fish with ponzu, shrimp cake with lemon garnish

TITLE: Seresin Estate Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: 18 different parcels of Sauvignon Blanc and two of Semillon from different vineyard blocks were pressed and fermented separately. The wine was naturally fermented using wild yeast, and 20% of the total blend was fermented in old French oak barriques to give complexity and texture. After eight months, all the separate parcels were tasted and blended to create an interesting and elegant style.

TITLE: Sesshu Otokoyama Tokubetsu Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Sesshu Otokoyama is brewed in Itami, the birthplace of sake. It is produced from carefully selected rice and water. It is pleasant and deliciously dry.

TITLE: Setzer Gruner Veltliner
DESCRIPTION: Our village, Hohenwarth, derives its name from Hohe Warte - high observation point - and refers to our fortified Romanesque church, which was built in the 11th century at 400 metres above sea level. As all of the neighbouring regions like Kamptal and Wagram are at a significantly lower sea level, Hohenwart\'s vineyards enjoy an exceptional microclimate. Winemaking has a very long tradition in Hohenwarth and can be dated back to 1360 AD. Our winery was founded in 1705. Originally mainly used for farming - with only a few vineyards - we decided in 2001 to lease the area dedicated to farming, and to commit ourselves to winemaking only. Our vineyards and those producing the grapes we buy from other vintners are located within a two-kilometre radius of our winery. The grapes we use enjoy exactly the same basic climate, although their characteristics are more pronounced in single vineyards. In spite of a rather low level of precipitation in our area - 400 litres p.a. on average. Fish, seafood and lobster, poultry and Saumeisen - traditional Austrian sausages filled with mashed smoked pork - go nicely with this wine.

TITLE: Sextro Cask Strength Rye Purple Label
DESCRIPTION: Aged in 15-gallon new American Oak barrels, redistilled, and then aged again in the used American Oak barrels until it reaches peak flavor, the nationally acclaimed Aged Rye is made using a historically accurate 1932 recipe. Bottled at 121.2 Proof

TITLE: Sextro Rye Black Label
DESCRIPTION: Aged 18 months in 15-gallon New American Oak barrels, the nationally acclaimed Aged Rye is made using a historically accurate 1931 recipe.

TITLE: Sextro Rye Red Label
DESCRIPTION: A multiple award winner, Distillery's Private Reserve is distilled using a 100% rye grain Prohibition-era bootlegger's recipe. It is aged in two used oak barrels for at least 18 months.

TITLE: Sextro Rye White Label
DESCRIPTION: Born on a small farm in Iowa during the Prohibition ear of the early 1930s, this White Rye's award-winning recipe was originally crated by grandmother and clandestine bootlegger Lorine Sextro.

TITLE: Shata Shuzo Tengumai Umajun Junmai
DESCRIPTION: A very enjoyable dry sake from Tengumai. Full expansive flavor with a great body and enjoyable mouth feel. Light umami on the palate. this is a wonderful sake to pair with food. This subtly nuanced sake is the perfect companion to a wide variety of foods.

TITLE: Shaw Vineyard Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Go Green. Sauvignon Blanc with its herbaceous notes pairs well with similar green herbs. If it has parsley, rosemary, basil, cilantro or mint, chances are Sauvignon Blanc will make a great pairing. There is also one classic pairing of Sauvignon Blanc that started in the Loire Valley. Close to Sancerre there is a goat cheese produced called Crottin de Chavignol and it has an international reputation as an outstanding stinky-creamy cheese. A bite of Crottin with a splash of Sauvignon Blanc is considered a classic perfect pairing. Meat Pairings - White meats including Chicken, Pork Chop and Turkey. Fish including Tilapia, Sea Bass, Perch, Sole, Haddock, Trout, Cod, Redfish, Halibut, Snapper, Mussels, Crab, Lobster, and Clams. Spices and Herbs - Green herbs including Parsley, Basil, Mint, Tarragon, Thyme, Fennel, Dill, Chives, and Rosemary. Spices including White Pepper, Coriander, Fennel, Turmeric, and Saffron. Cheese Pairings - Look for softer more briny and sour cheeses like Goat’s milk cheese, Yogurt, and Crème fraîche. Vegetables & Vegetarian Fare - Sauté green veggies or mix vegetables in more fatty vegetarian dishes so that the acidity of the wine shines through. Here are some example dishes for inspiration: Asparagus quiche, cucumber dill yogurt salad, green hummus, white bean casserole with zucchini and white lasagna.

TITLE: Shebang The Whole Sixteenth Cuvee Red Wine
DESCRIPTION: The informing impulse behind Shebang is to create a wine that is long on deliciousness and low on pretense. We do this by vinifying the wines with the same care and love as the higher end Bedrock wines- picking at respectable sugar levels (not too high!), using only native yeast fermentations, and a trace of good French oak to round things out. The cuvee IX is predominately Zinfandel blended with Carignane, Petite Sirah, Mourvedre, Alicante Bouchet, Grenache, Syrah, Barbera and a touch of whites for aromatics, much of which comes from old vines.

TITLE: Shelter Winery Lovely Lilly Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Shelter Winery Lovely Lilly Pinot Noir is a delicious and versatile red wine that is perfect for any occasion. It is made from 100% Pinot Noir grapes grown in the Baden region of Germany. The wine has a light ruby color and aromas of fresh strawberries, raspberries, and cranberries. On the palate, it is dry and medium-bodied with refreshing acidity and crunchy red-fruit flavors. The finish is long and lingering.

TITLE: Shelter Winery Rose de Noir
DESCRIPTION: Shelter makes extraordinarily delicate, fragrant Pinot Noir in Baden, a region mostly known for wines that tend to be big bruisers with a lot of lumber.

TITLE: Shenk's Homestead Kentucky Sour Mash Whiskey 2024
DESCRIPTION: Both Bomberger's and Shenk's have been released once again by Michter's to honor John Shenk, the founder of the original Bomberger Distillery (later known as Michter's Distillery). If you haven't heard of Bomberger's or Shenk's, you are missing out on some amazing bourbon! New editions of the hidden gems from Michter's and yes they put their name on them this time. Great new bottle with hand numbered labels. Bomberger's stepping it up from the previous 100 Proof to a nice 108 and Shenk's up from 80 Proof to 91.2 - both adding richness and a heavier mouth coating with these releases.

Bomberger's stepping it up from the previous 100 Proof to a nice 108 and Shenk's up from 80 Proof to 91.2 - both adding richness and a heavier mouth coating with these releases.

TITLE: Shibui 18 Years Single Grain Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This limited Shibui was distilled using premium indica rice at Kumesen Distillery est. 1952. Matured 18 years in ex-fino & manzanilla sherry casks & 100% natural color. Distilled, matured & bottled exclusively in Okinawa, Japan. Notes of cherries, black licorice & milk chocolate

TITLE: Shibui 30 Years Single Grain Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This limited Shibui was distilled using premium indica rice at Masahiro Distillery est. 1883. Matured for 30 years in ex-bourbon, sherry & virgin European oak casks & 100% natural color. Distilled, matured & bottled exclusively in Okinawa, Japan.

TITLE: Shibui Pure Malt Japanese Whiskey
Shichida Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: This sake combines the sweet aroma of white flowers and white peaches. The soft sweetness of peaches lingers on the palate, followed by a refreshing acidity and a sweet , long finish with full of “Umami”

TITLE: Shichida Yamahai Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Tenzan Sake Brewery is located in Saga Prefecture, which is located in the northwestern part of the island of Kyushu. The brewery is owned by the Shichida family and was established in 1875. White fish, carpaccio, prosciutto and melon

TITLE: Shichifukujin Tokubetsu Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Sanzen Tokubetsu Junmai is brewed from 100% Bizen Omachi rice. Moderately Rice-Forward Body, Well-Balanced, and Clean Finish.

TITLE: Shimaoka Shuzo Gunma Izumi Yamahai Honjozo Sake
DESCRIPTION: This is a classic, delicious Honjozo with crimini mushroom, almonds and lilac on the nose. The first sip of his sake is full of stone fruit and pure minerality followed by notes of caramel, cocoa and almond and finishes with plenty of umami.

TITLE: Shimaoka Shuzo Gunma Izumi Yamahai Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: The alluring nose of this sake has apple, melon, rose and mushroom notes that leads to a slightly off dry, very balanced, nuanced palate of mineral and pear. The Yamahai process uses the wild, but natural, yeast and provides this sake with distinct earthy notes, raisin, brown sugar, roasted oats and a long, dry finish.

TITLE: Shinsei Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: A cool and full aroma of rice blossoms in unison. As it touches the pallet, a sensation that is mellow but yet delicate is experienced. White fish sashimi

TITLE: Shinshu Mars Distillery Iwai 45 Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This new, higher proof Iwai (pronounced EE-why) was designed for cocktails; however, it’s supple and more than capable as a neat sipper too, with pleasing aromas of honey, ripening pear, barley, exotic woods, and citrus. The palate of honey sweetness, sugar cubes, vanilla, pear, apricot, and spice bows out with honey, breakfast cereal, nougat, and white chocolate. It’s a delicious and unusual whisky from Japan, less aligned with the country’s scotch-like tradition of malts and blends and more similar to bourbon, being made mostly from corn.

TITLE: Shinshu Mars Distillery Iwai Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Kiichiro Iwai, the name sake for this Mars Whisky, was a silent pioneer of Japan whisky. This whisky is inspired by great whiskies of America. A majority of corn balanced with light malt aged in ex bourbon barrels. Ideal for daily sipping, in a mint julep or an old fashioned.

TITLE: Shinshu Mars Distillery Iwai Tradition Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This is malt driven spirit is truly a reflection of contemporary Japanese whisky. Incredibly balanced, soft and layered. A blending of sherry, bourbon and wine casks with hints delicate hints of peat make for a harmonious whisky that would make Iwai-san proud.

TITLE: Shinshu Mars Distillery Iwai Tradition Japanese Whisky Sakura Cask Finish
DESCRIPTION: For this limited edition from Mars Shinshu, Iwai Tradition is aged an additional 6 months in casks made from the Japanese Cherry Blossom Tree, the highly prized wood known as Sakura. Part of a new and ongoing series that will see four seasonal releases per year, this ‘Spring’ release was delayed in 2020 but makes the whisky no less delicious. The honey, toffee, and dark cherry notes inherent in Iwai Tradition are beautifully complemented here by the high-toned, floral characteristics imparted by the Sakura. An interesting side note: the Sakura casks (sourced from Ariake Sangyo Co., Japan’s only independent cooperage) are rectangular, reflecting the difficulty of molding this wood to traditional cask shapes. This special release, blended Japanese whisky is bottled at 40% ABV.

TITLE: Shinshu Mars Distillery Iwai Tradition Natsu Japanese Whisky Umeshu Cask Finish
Shinshu Mars Distillery Komagatake Tsunuki "The First" Aging Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Hombo Shuzo, the company behind Mars Shinshu distillery, opened a second distillery in Tsunuki, the birthplace of the Hombo family enterprise, in November of 2016. The climate at Tsunuki Distillery is drastically different from that of Mars Shinshu, as it sits at sea level and experiences higher humidity and large fluctuations in temperature. The goal of this new location was not necessary to increase production but to experiment with terroir. This bottling marks the very first single malt to be distilled at Tsunuki, produced between 2016 and 2017. Aged for just over three years in ex-bourbon barrels and sherry casks, this rich single malt exudes the enticing sweetness of vanilla and maple on the nose, leading to a fruity, pastry palate of banana crepes and apple pie and a finish of citrus, pine nut, and cinnamon. Only 1,122 bottles were produced of this highly anticipated single release, bottled at 59% ABV.

TITLE: Shinshu Mars Distillery Komagatake Yakushima Aging Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This single malt whisky exemplifies the Mars approach to experimentation, taking full advantage of Japan’s vast and varying terrain by distilling in Nagano, 2,625 feet above sea level, then transporting the whisky south for aging in Yakushima, an island 60 km off the Kagoshima mainland. Distilled in 2015 and 2016, this non-chill filtered, lightly peated single malt has aged for just over 3–4 years in primarily ex-bourbon barrels and some sherry casks. Juicy citrus on the nose gives way to vanilla custard on the palate with hints of peat; fresh orange and lemon resurface on the bright finish.

TITLE: Sho Chiku Bai "Ginjo" Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Ginjo is a special reserve connoisseur class of sake. Most sakes are brewed with rice that has been milled 30%. For our Ginjo we use rice that is polished over 50%. Additionally, we use a special strain of yeast that allows for fermentation at a cooler temperature.

TITLE: Sho Chiku Bai Classic Junmai
DESCRIPTION: The most traditional sake. In order to enjoy its traditional Junmai character in full, serving it warm is recommended. It will pair well with mildly seasoned dishes.

TITLE: Sho Chiku Bai Extra Dry
Sho Chiku Bai Extra Dry
Sho Chiku Bai Nama Organic Sake
DESCRIPTION: It's totally natural, using OCIA certified rice harvested from the Sacramento Valley with absolutely no preservatives, no alcohol, and no sulfites added. TITLE: Sho Chiku Bai Nigori Creme De Sake
DESCRIPTION: NIGORI is lightly-filtered and the sweetest of all our types of sake. It is especially delicious with very spicy foods. The bottle should be shaken each time before pouring due to the high rice content that settles in the bottom of the bottle. Nigori Crème de Sake tastes slightly drier than our Nigori Silky Mild.

TITLE: Sho Chiku Bai Nigori Sake
DESCRIPTION: Nigori is the way sake first appeared when it was brewed for the Imperial Court in Kyoto as well as for most of its 2,000-year history. It is lightly-filtered and the sweetest of all our types of sake. It is especially delicious with very spicy foods. The bottle should be shaken each time before pouring due to the high rice content that settles in the bottom of the bottle.

TITLE: Sho Chiku Bai Organic Junmai Sake
Sho Chiku Bai Shirakabe Gura Mio Sparkling Sake
DESCRIPTION: Refreshing, fruity and unique sweet aroma. Crafted in the traditional brewing style, with rice, water and Koji, Mio appeals to a wide range of tastes — a new sake for a new age.

TITLE: Sho Chiku Bai Ten Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Sho Chiku Bai TEN series is one of the top-selling retail brands in Japan. It is made utilizing a unique double-yeast fermentation system using Sho Chiku Bai's traditional Kuratsuki Kobo (house yeast) called Hanbei Kobo for a dry, clean finishe and a multiple acidity-producing yeast for complexity in flavor. The process produces a rich, soft, clean taste with complex acidity, smoothness, and umami. The sake may be enjoyed with wide variety of foods This sake is ideal for subtle, creamy foods such as steamed white rice, buttered pasta, sushi or sashimi of scallops, white shrimp, toro, poached chicken breast, and creamy cauliflower or potato soup. It will also be refreshing counterpoint to more savory dishes, such as mushroom bisque, brown rice, lightly battered tempura, or scrambled eggs.

TITLE: Sia Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: SIA Scotch Whisky is a blend of selected whiskies from Speyside, Highland, Lowlands and Islay regions of Scotland. One of the lead malts used in the blend is Teaninich. Teaninich is a very historic distillery in the Highland region dating back over 200 years–produces malt whisky of a light highland style–citrus fruit, fresh, accessible. For maturing the whisky we use a combination of refill American oak (Bourbon) and first fill American oak (Bourbon).

TITLE: Siete Leguas "Siete Decadas" Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Siete Leguas Decadas Tequila is a masterful creation that marks the pinnacle of tequila craftsmanship. This limited edition blanco tequila is a celebration of Siete Leguas' 70th anniversary, a testament to seven decades of dedication to traditional tequila making. The spirit is crafted from Agave Criollo, a variety of agave grown in the wild, yielding a smaller but richer piña. The agave is slowly cooked in small stone ovens, crushed using a traditional tahona mill, and fermented naturally, exposing the juice and agave fiber to wild yeasts in the ambient environment, surrounded by citrus and fruit trees at the Casa Siete Leguas estate.

TITLE: Siete Leguas Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Siete Leguas Blanco Tequila is an artisanal spirit crafted with precision and care, offering a true taste of Mexico's tequila-making heritage. Renowned for its full-bodied character and bright, intense silvery hues, this tequila delivers a symphony of splendid aromas and flavors, highlighting the nature of agave through its complex profile. With over 70 years of tradition, Siete Leguas distills its tequila in small batches, focusing on quality over quantity, to create a spirit that is both spirited and deeply flavorful.

TITLE: Siete Rioja Tinto
DESCRIPTION: Siete Red is created combining technology and innovation with the cultivating farms tradition of two generations, using environmentally friendly methods for producing the best wines. Vineyards are divided among several municipalities, Calahorra, Andosilla and San Adrian, all of them are in a place called “Mediterranean Rioja” with cold winters, mild and rainy springs and autumns, and hot and dry summers. The grounds have different textures, predominating limestone, sand, clay and gravel. Thus, the right combination of climate and “terroir” that featuring our location, favourable obtain elegant wines with soft tannins. Siete Red, is a Rioja young wine, balanced and full-bodied, which is obtained from a special blend of the most noble typical varieties of our land with a organic farming certified. It presents a nice cherry red colour with violet tones very clean upper middle layer. Its scent is complete, fruity and spicy tones comes bundled with clove and vanilla. It presents the acidity of the grapes used which provides a pleasant freshness and good retronasal persistence. Its passage in the mouth is soft and fleshy with very tight tannins which invites to continue drinking it. Siete Red is a cuvée made especially for Vinos de Terruños by Familia Pastor Gilabert in collaboration with Andres and Ramon Serrano brothers, pioneers in organic farming in the Rioja.

TITLE: Sikele Terre Siciliane Nero d'Avola
DESCRIPTION: In 2000, Angelo Paternò bought 60 hectares (148 acres) on a hill formerly known as Poggio dei Fossi in the southeastern Sicilian province of Siracusa near the town of Pachino. After 25 years in the business as the winemaker and technical director for the Sicilian wineries Cantine Settesoli and then Duca di Salaparuta, Angelo said that the land was one of the best viticulture areas he'd seen in Sicily. Today Angelo’s daughters, Marilina and Federica, are at the helm with Angelo still helping in the cellar. Deeply influenced by Frank Cornelissen, the guru of natural winemaking on Mount Etna, the Paternò family organically farms their land and makes wine with minimal intervention in the cellar (little to no additives, low sulfur). They respect the land and have created a polyculture to ensure ecosystem stability. Only 35 out of the 60 hectares on the property are planted with vines; the rest of the land is used for mixed farming. Grape varieties grown on the farm include Nero d'Avola, Grecanico, Muscat Blanc, Moscato Giallo, Insolia, Merlot, Tannat, Viognier, and Chardonnay. Huge concrete tanks are used for fermentation and elevage. The large concrete tanks control fermentation temperatures in the warm Mediterranean climate, thus preserving fruit and freshness.

TITLE: Silver Dollar Small Batch American Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Copper Pot Distilled in Las Vegas from only the purest ingredients then silver filtered for an incredibly smooth taste. Smooth creamy mouth feel with a water like taste. Just a hint of copper and corn sweetness, finishing smooth with no burn.

TITLE: Silver Oak Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2011
DESCRIPTION: Cabernet Sauvignon is one of the more complex and layered wines out there. It has higher tannins and a savory character often described as black pepper and tobacco. Because of Cab’s traits, look for foods high in fat and umami flavors for Cabernet Sauvignon food pairing. Try Cabernet Sauvignon with a charred gruyere burger, a mushroom pizza with tomato sauce or some marinated ribeye steak. To champion the fruit flavors in Cabernet Sauvignon, don’t pair it with chocolate. Instead, pair wine with braised short ribs or mushroom stroganoff. The powerful umami flavors overcome the savory quality of Cabernet Sauvignon leaving the berry flavors out in the open to shine.

TITLE: Single Cask Nation 11 Year Old Teaninich Distillery 1st Fill Bourbon Hogshed Cask #716153 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Single Cask Nation is the only independent bottler of Scotch Whisky based here in the US. Owned and operated by Joshua Hatton and Jason Johnstone-Yellin, the aim is to uncover the finest and rarest single casks and then bottle them at full cask strength. Though the focus is on Scotch whiskies, Single Cask Nation also bottles wonderful bourbons, rye whiskies, Indian whiskies, and even cask-aged Mezcals from some of the most famous, well-known, and respected producers in the world. Teaninich (tee-ni-nick) Distillery, located in the Northern Highlands, is owned by Diageo and known for using a distinct mashing technique, resulting in the ability to mash a wide array of barley varieties. Despite the distillery’s considerable size and quality of distillate, very little of its whisky is available as a stand-alone product. This bottling, distilled September 2009, spent 11 years maturing in a 1st-fill bourbon hogshead. It was bottled at cask strength in October 2020 at 61% ABV.

TITLE: Single Cask Nation 12 Years Old Linkwood Distillery Sherry Butt Cask #4815162342 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This cask bottling, distilled April 2009, spent 12 years maturing in a Refill Oloroso Sherry Butt. It was bottled at cask strength in May 2021 at 55.5% ABV. Cask # 4815162342 yielded 666 bottles.

TITLE: Single Cask Nation 13 Years Old Inchgower Distillery Tawny Port Hogshead Cask #668 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This Cask Bottling, Distilled July 2007, Spent 13 Years Maturing In A 2nd Fill Bourbon Hogshead And Finished In A Tawny Port Cask. It Was Bottled At Cask Strength In May 2021 At 52.8% ABV. Cask # 668 Yielded 227 Bottles.

TITLE: Single Cask Nation 16 Years Old Westport Distillery Sherry Butt Cask #2112 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This cask bottling, distilled May 2005, spent 16 years maturing in a 2nd fill Oloroso Sherry Butt. It was bottled at cask strength in May 2021 at 50.6% ABV. Cask # 2112 yielded 577 bottles.

TITLE: Single Cask Nation 20 Years Old Dumbarton Distillery Bourbon Hogshead Cask #211552 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This cask bottling, distilled November 2000, spent 20 years maturing in a Refill Bourbonn Hogshead. It was bottled at cask strength in May 2021 at 56.7% ABV. Cask # 211552 yielded 229 bottles.

TITLE: Single Cask Nation 27 Year Old Strathclyde Distillery 1st Fill Bourbon Barrel Cask # 243375 Single Grain Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Single Cask Nation is the only independent bottler of Scotch Whisky based here in the US. Owned and operated by Joshua Hatton and Jason Johnstone-Yellin, the aim is to uncover the finest and rarest single casks and then bottle them at full cask strength. Though the focus is on Scotch whiskies, Single Cask Nation also bottles wonderful bourbons, rye whiskies, Indian whiskies, and even cask-aged Mezcals from some of the most famous, well-known, and respected producers in the world. Strathclyde is Glasgow’s only grain distillery, built on the site of an old cotton mill in 1927. Strathclyde contributes grain whisky to brands such as Ballantine’s and Chivas Brothers, and while no distillery-direct bottlings are available on the market, savvy independent bottlers prize the quality of Strathclyde’s distillate. This bottling, distilled August 1993, spent 27 years maturing in a 1st-fill bourbon barrel. It was bottled at cask strength in August 2020 at 46.7% ABV.

TITLE: Single Cask Nation 3 Years Old Milk and Honey Distillery Peated Ex-Bourbon Barrel Cask #0228 Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This cask bottling, distilled September 2017, spent 3 years maturing in a 1st fill Bourbon Barrel. It was bottled at cask strength in May 2021 at 59.3% ABV. Cask # 228 yielded 201 bottles.

TITLE: Single Cask Nation Fidencio Espadin Reposado Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: Fidencio ‘Single Cask Nation’ Reposado is a cask bottling, distilled in October 2016 by Maestro Mezcalero Enrique Jiménez with maguey Espadin (agave Angustifolia) in Santiago Matatlan, Oaxaca. After distillation, it spent 10 months resting in a first fill bourbon barrel from Wild Turkey. It was bottled at cask strength in August of 2017 at 53.4% ABV. This cask #2931 yielded 252 bottles for the Single Cask Nation portfolio.

TITLE: Single Malts of Scotland Ardbeg 19 Year Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A single cask, single malt whisky selection Distilled at Ardbeg Distillery in 2001; aged 19 years Ardbeg is an Islay distillery founded officially in 1815 but distilling records at the site date from even earlier than that; known primarily for single malts aged in re-fill and ex-bourbon casks, the distillery has been experiencing increasing popularity over the last few years and bottlings are in high demand Aged for more than 10 years in a re-fill barrel and then re-casked in a single ex-bourbon barrel for a further 9 years Burning leaves and apple turnover on the nose lead to a full-bodied palate laced with barbeque smoke and tangerine rind with pine and roasted hazelnuts on the finish 51.8% ABV; only 216 bottles were produced and released exclusively in the US

TITLE: Single Malts of Scotland Ardmore 21 Year Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A single malt selection aged 21 years in a single hogshead Distilled in 1998 at Ardmore Distillery (Highlands) Ardmore serves as the signature malt in Teacher’s Blended Scotch, but its single malt is known for light peat and delicate mouthfeel (peat is sourced locally in the Highlands) Lingering peat on the palate mingles with notes of maple-cured bacon, apple cider, ripe plum, and mint with an elegant finish of green tea, cardamom, and charcoal 50.2% ABV; only 247 bottles produced, exclusive to the U.S.

TITLE: Singleton 1985 Prima & Ultima 37 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the luxurious Singleton 1985 Prima & Ultima 37 Years Old, a single malt Scotch whisky embodying the epitome of slow craftsmanship and refined taste. Originating from the prestigious Speyside region, this exquisite whiskey is a masterpiece rediscovered from the last of The Singleton of Dufftown 1985 casks. Aged patiently for 37 years in American Oak, Hogshead, each sip reveals the depth of flavor and the distillery's dedication to quality. With only 511 bottles available, this rare edition is a collector's dream and a connoisseur's delight, bottled on 21st January 2022.

TITLE: Sinpatch Vodka
DESCRIPTION: We're proud to offer SINPATCH VODKA, a spirit distilled in small batches, promising unparalleled purity. Its producers are devoted to maintaining top-tier quality, overseeing each step of the process. Impressively, they even filter the vodka through activated charcoal made from recycled oak whisky barrels. The unique fourteen-plate vodka column, complete with an unconventional reflux condenser at its apex, ensures the perfect concentration of alcohol. This methodology mirrors what a large-scale industrial producer might achieve but in a gentler manner. Whether you enjoy SINPATCH VODKA in a crisp dry martini or as the key ingredient in your beloved cocktail, we're confident it'll blend perfectly into your drink of choice.

TITLE: Sipsmith London Dry Gin
DESCRIPTION: The quintessential expression of a classic, traditional London Dry Gin. Bold, complex and aromatic – smooth enough for a Martini, yet rich and balanced, perfect for a G&T.

TITLE: SirDavis Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The inaugural launch of a partnership between Beyoncé Knowles-Carter and Moët Hennessy, SirDavis, is a twist on American rye with surprising flavor results. Moët Hennessy enlisted Dr. Bill Lumsden of its portfolio distilleries, Glenmorangie and Ardbeg, to develop the first release. Working with Knowles-Carter (the brand says she is a noted Japanese whisky drinker), Lumsden and his team settled on an Indiana-distilled straight whisky made from a mash bill of 51 percent rye and 49 percent malted barley. (The distillate comes from an unnamed Indiana-based producer, with all signs pointing to MGP.) Some non-distilling producers, including Smoke Wagon, have previously released MGP rye from that mashbill. SirDavis reps have said that moving forward, the brand has exclusivity on that and a range of similar mashbills from its partner producer. The non-age-stated rye is shipped to Texas (Knowles-Carter’s home state) and finished in Pedro Ximenez sherry casks. Blending and bottling (at 88 proof) also take place in Texas. Brand reps have confirmed that this release exceeds the minimum age requirements for straight rye (i.e., 2 years). SirDavis Rye Whiskey is a distinguished American rye whiskey embodying the robust and spicy character that enthusiasts cherish. Bottled at 100 proof, this whiskey delivers a bold and flavorful experience, showcasing the rich heritage of rye whiskey production in the United States. SirDavis Rye Whiskey is crafted to offer a well-balanced and complex flavor profile. This whiskey is perfect for those who appreciate a strong, spicy rye with a smooth finish, whether enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in a classic cocktail.

TITLE: Siro Pacenti "Vecchie Vigne" Brunello Di Montalcino
Skrewball Peanut Butter Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: On one side, you have good ol’ whiskey - a bold, loud, and strong partner-in-crime who exudes confidence. On the other, we have peanut butter - a rich, smooth, and irresistible spread that’s as dependable as they come for all your late-night cravings. Little did you know these two blend together quite phenomenally. In fact, they go together so well, they make PB&J jealous. It’s nearly impossible to just have one of this delicious treat. A night with Skrewball is bound to get a little nutty.

TITLE: SKYY Vodka
DESCRIPTION: SKYY began in 1992 the same way as most things in San Francisco — a tiny startup based on the vision of one entrepreneur and his dream to make something better. In this case, exceptionally smooth vodka. It was this exceptional smoothness that has made SKYY the leading domestic premium vodka in the U.S. But we're not stopping there. From new products and cocktails to the latest happenings, check out our social media section to see what's fresh.

James joins his peers in focusing on issues surrounding sustainability, preservation, labor practices and maintaining family-owned businesses. Slingshot reflects his ambition to preserve a vital family enterprise and practice meaningful land stewardship—both while producing unpretentious fine wine.

TITLE: Smith & Cross Navy Strength Rum
DESCRIPTION: Smith & Cross Navy Strength Rum is a robust and flavorful rum that embodies the rich tradition of Jamaican rum-making. Produced at the renowned Hampden Estate in Kingston, this navy strength rum is a blend of unaged and aged pot still rums, resulting in a complex and full-bodied spirit. Bottled at 114 proof, Smith & Cross delivers intense flavors and a powerful kick, making it an excellent choice for both sipping and cocktail mixing. This exceptional rum captures the essence of Jamaica with every sip, offering a true taste of the Caribbean.

TITLE: Smoke Wagon "Experimental Rye C Barrel" Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Smoke Wagon Experimental Rye C Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey (51% Ryw, 49% Malted Barley) is a limited-edition whiskey from Smoke Wagon Distillery in Nevada. It is made from a blend of two different rye mash bills, one with a higher rye content and one with a higher malted barley content. The whiskey is aged for 9 years in new, charred American oak barrels, which gives it a complex and flavorful flavor profile. On the nose, Smoke Wagon Experimental Rye C Barrel offers aromas of spice, oak, vanilla, and caramel. The palate is rich and full-bodied, with notes of cinnamon, rye spice, green grass, apple, and red fruits. The finish is long and lingering, with notes of oak, leather, and apple. Smoke Wagon Experimental Rye C Barrel is a unique and flavorful rye whiskey that is sure to please even the most discerning palate. It is perfect for sipping neat or on the rocks, or for using in cocktails.

The goal was to create an affordable expression that had the unique and unmistakable Smoke Wagon taste, consisting of delicate sweet notes and a rye spice finish.

DESCRIPTION: Smoke Wagon "Red White and Blue" Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a limited edition release designed to commemorate Independence Day. This special edition bourbon is made using a high-rye mash bill and aged in the hot Nevada climate, which accelerates the aging process and imparts rich, complex flavors to the whiskey. The barrels are stored on the top floors of the warehouse, where they experience greater temperature fluctuations, enhancing the interaction between the whiskey and the wood.

TITLE: Smoke Wagon 10 Year Old "Desert Jewel" Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Smoke Wagon 10-Year-Old "Desert Jewel" Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a limited-edition bourbon whiskey from Nevada H&C Distilling Company. It is made from a blend of two different bourbon mash bills, one with a higher corn content and one with a higher rye content. The whiskey is aged for a minimum of 10 years in new, charred American oak barrels, which gives it a rich and complex flavor profile. On the nose, Smoke Wagon 10-Year-Old "Desert Jewel" Straight Bourbon Whiskey offers aromas of vanilla, caramel, oak, and spice. The palate is smooth and full-bodied, with notes of vanilla, oak, cinnamon, rye spice, and fruit. The finish is long and lingering, with notes of oak, spice, and caramel. Smoke Wagon 10-Year-Old "Desert Jewel" Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a unique and flavorful bourbon whiskey that is sure to please even the most discerning palate. It is perfect for sipping neat or on the rocks, or for using in cocktails. This unique bourbon comes from their private barrel program. When they say private barrel, they mean it. They bottle the bourbon from one barrel and move to the next. Once the bottles that come from these barrels are gone, the distinct flavor profile will never be repeated. Every bottle is marked with the barrel’s warehouse number and floor location, the month and year it was barreled, and names the retailer who selected the barrel for its flavor profile. After 10 years of aging there is quite a bit of volume loss so they yield an average of 21 six-pack cases per barrel, and since they pull such a small number of barrels, these bottles are rare and limited.

TITLE: Smoke Wagon 7 Year "Seven Year Itch" Private Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey Prime Barrel Pick #95
DESCRIPTION: Private Barrels of bourbon from Smoke Wagon has not been available for a long while, so we aptly named this release "Seven Year Itch." This name highlights the rarity of this offering and refers to the age statement on this exceptional pick. We're thrilled to have secured this limited barrel for our members and community, as there aren't many of them out there. Each bottle of this exclusive release is robust 116 proof and hails from MGP Warehouse F, Floor 6. This single barrel selection from Nevada H&C Distilling Co. is the second barrel from the brand this year (the first being rye), showcasing Smoke Wagon bourbons' superior quality and craftsmanship. Aged for 7 years in meticulously chosen charred new American oak barrels, this high-rye mashbill (51% corn, 39% rye, 10% malted rye) bourbon offers a rich and complex flavor profile that bourbon enthusiasts will truly appreciate. With its unique character and depth, the 116-proof "Seven Year Itch" is a prized addition to any collection. Enjoy this cask-strength bourbon's bold and robust experience, a true testament to the art of whiskey making. Tasting Notes: Color: Golden honey Nose: Almond extract, kettle corn, mildly sweet oak Palate: Spicy honey, almond croissant, white peach, jasmine Finish: spicy honey, jasmine, almond, medium to long Barrel Info: Age: 7 Years Proof: 116 Proof Barrel #: 39-152 Location: Warehouse F, Floor 6

It greets you with a bold mix of caramel and buttercream, complemented by crisp green apple, and an impressive brioche and clove spice.Palate: The palate surprises with more oak than usual for its age. The corn element seamlessly intertwines with the rye, bringing a creamy texture, a hint of honey, and a delightful oatmeal cookie note. This combination allows the rye’s big spice to shine through.Finish: A long, rich, and punchy conclusion, dominated by rye spice. TITLE: Smoke Wagon Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Smoke Wagon Straight Bourbon Whiskey has the same 36% rye bourbon mashbill the distillery always uses and at 92.5 proof there's no need for chill filtration. TITLE: Smoke Wagon Uncut The Younger Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The journey to create Uncut the Younger began around October 2020. I tried a Straight Bourbon blend before proofing it down and I was really impressed with the flavor profile. It was fruit forward with tons of delicate candy flavors and big cinnamon spice on the finish. My original thought was to create a younger version of Uncut Unfiltered, and release it as a Rare and Limited batch. In December 2020, when the first Rare and Limiteds’ were announced, I quickly realized that a R&L would never retail for less than regular Uncut, so the idea was put on a back burner. A few months later the company that makes our clear stock bottles for Straight, informed me they were coming out with an amber version. I was interested and I knew exactly what to use those for. I let them know I wanted as many as they could get me. Releasing a Rare & Limited younger Uncut was one thing, but being able to offer an affordable cask strength bourbon that could be one of our core expressions AND a high proof lover’s daily sipper, really got me excited. I truly believe having superior and affordable bourbons is essential. Also I wanted Straight to have a cask strength sibling the way Small Batch has Uncut Unfiltered, it all just made sense. A year and a half later - Uncut the Younger, our second expression in the entry level category is finally here! Consisting mainly of 4 year 36% rye bourbon from several floors and warehouse locations. Uncut the Younger is blended to be fruit forward, with tons of candy flavor notes and finishing with some bold cinnamon spice with gentle heat. It’s non chill filtered so it’s buttery and creamy, drinking more delicately than one would think based on its proof. Hope you love drinking it as much as I loved creating it! Cheers, Aaron!

TITLE: Smooth Ambler Old Scout 7 Years Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Smooth Ambler is a grain-to-glass craft distillery, founded in 2008 in the Appalachian Hills of Greenbrier County, West Virginia, by partners TAG Galyean and John Little. They produce handcrafted small-batch spirits in a state-of-the-art stillhouse using the finest whole American grains, including corn, malted barley and wheat, milled on site and carefully combined with pure local mountain water. John Little hand-cuts each batch and is one of the few distillers to make his own NGS (neutral grain spirit) – a costly and time-consuming step which results in a distinct flavor profile that is the hallmark of Smooth Ambler spirits. Every bottle is hand-labeled, individually numbered and signed.

The result is a truly remarkable drink.

DESCRIPTION: From the distillery: "Smooth Ambler is surrounded by the things we think make great whiskey: carefully-farmed local grains, crisp high-valley mountain water, the perfect cadence of seasons to ensure mellow aging, and can-do folks who enjoy a drink, respect hard work, and value family. TITLE: Snowden Vineyards Napa Valley Rose Of Malbec Ward Eisan Vineyard

TITLE: Sommet Dore Sancerre
Sonbi Gin
DESCRIPTION: Produced in Rohnert Park, California, Sonbi is the “Western spirits” brand from Brandon Hill’s Tokki Soju. Initially launched in 2021 in Chungju, South Korea, Sonbi crafts premium, typically Western spirits with a Korean twist. Named for the virtuous scholars of the Goryeo and Joseon Dynasty who passed up positions of wealth and power to lead lives of integrity in the pursuit of knowledge, Sonbi’s labels are designed to mimic Korean currency in a playful nod to the belief that knowledge and integrity are themselves true wealth. Featuring 10 botanicals, Sonbi’s flagship Korean dry gin is a London Dry-style gin crafted to showcase its Korean-grown botanicals—most notably Schisandra berries, or five-flavor fruit, a berry known for its five different flavor components: spicy, sour, sweet, bitter, and umami. Each botanical is treated differently during the production process beginning with the juniper which undergoes an overnight maceration in 100% corn spirit. The remaining botanicals—some fresh and some dried—are added directly into the still during distillation except for the lemon peel, which is vapor distilled. Distilled through a copper continuous column still, the gin is rested for a minimum of 2 months and proofed with reverse osmosis water before bottling Premium Korean-inspired dry gin produced by Tokki Soju in Rohnert Park, California Distilled from 100% corn neutral spirit 10 botanicals include juniper, Schisandra berries, Chinese licorice, grains of paradise, cassia, green cardamom, coriander, lemon peel, orris root, and angelica root Juniper is macerated overnight; lemon peels are vapor distilled and the remaining botanicals are added to still during distillation Distilled in a copper continuous column still Rested 2 months before bottling Juniper, sansho peppercorn, lime, and cinnamon on the nose lead to a citrusy palate with a perfect balance of spice and earthy botanical notes including licorice root, angelica, and green cardamom with a zesty finish of ginger and fresh 48% ABV

TITLE: Sonoma County Distilling Co Rye Whiskey
Sonoroso Sweet Red
DESCRIPTION: Introducing Sonoroso Sweet Red, a delightful and enticing red wine hailing from the picturesque vineyards of Italy. This luscious and fruity wine is crafted from a blend of red grape varieties, carefully selected to create a harmonious and well-balanced profile. With its tempting sweetness and rich fruit flavors, Sonoroso Sweet Red is perfect for those who appreciate a touch of indulgence in their wine. It's an ideal choice for sipping on its own or pairing with a variety of desserts and savory dishes. TastingNotesNose: The nose offers an alluring bouquet of aromas, with dominant notes of ripe red berries, black cherries, and plums. As the aroma develops, subtle hints of chocolate, vanilla, and a touch of spice emerge, adding depth and complexity to the olfactory experience. Palate: On the palate, Sonoroso Sweet Red presents a lush, velvety texture with a pleasing sweetness and soft tannins. The dominant flavors of red and dark fruits are beautifully complemented by the subtle notes of chocolate, vanilla, and a hint of spice. Mid-palate, the flavors evolve to reveal a touch of blackberry jam and a whisper of licorice, creating a well-rounded and harmonious profile. Finish: The finish is long and satisfying, with the lingering sweetness of ripe fruits and a gentle hint of chocolate, vanilla, and spice, leaving behind a gratifying aftertaste that invites you to take another sip. FoodPairingSonoroso Sweet Red is a versatile wine that pairs well with a wide array of both sweet and savory dishes. Its rich fruit flavors and gentle sweetness make it an ideal companion for desserts such as chocolate lava cake, fruit tarts, or creamy panna cotta. For a savory pairing, consider pairing the wine with spicy dishes like barbecue ribs, jerk chicken, or a flavorful Thai curry. The wine's sweetness will help to balance the heat of the spices. Additionally, Sonoroso Sweet Red can be enjoyed with a selection of rich cheeses, like Gorgonzola, Stilton, or Roquefort, enhancing the flavors and textures of both the wine and the cheese.

TITLE: Sorelle Casa Secco Italian Bubbles Rosso
DESCRIPTION: Sorelle Casa Fine Wines was established by Ginevra and Olivia Casa - two sisters that grew up in Italy and developed a great passion for Prosecco. However, in August 2010, the Italian laws regarding its production changed - after decades of being able to blend other grapes with the Prosecco, the Italian government decided to make it a DOCG and required that Prosecco be produced entirely of Glera grapes. Ginevra and Olivia decided to keep the tradition of the Italian blend alive, and in early 2009 they teamed up with noted winemaker Charles Smith to create Secco Italian Bubbles.

TITLE: Spater-Veit Riesling Feinherb
DESCRIPTION: Heinz and Silvia Welter farm 7 hectares in and around the famous village of Piesport in the Mosel, mostly on steep slate slopes. The winery’s name is a combination of Silvia’s maiden name (Spater) and that of her mother (Veit), one of Piesport’s oldest winegrowing families. Heinz took over winemaking from Silvia’s father in 1988 and has continued the tradition of domaine-bottling wines from top sites such as Piesporter Goldtröpfchen, Domherr, Grafenberg and Falkenberg - all from the grand Piesport slope. The dominating feature of the Piesport vineyards is their Devonian, finely-weathered slate, which gives birth to opulent wines that are finely balanced by generous minerality and acidity. The amphitheater-shaped Piesporter Goldtröpfchen’s vineyards all enjoy southeast-to southwest-facing expositions, with deep clay and slate soils before reaching rock. “Lots of underground springs run throughout it,” says Heinz. He prefers spontaneous fermentation and all wines are fermented in stainless steel tanks before spending a short time in traditional Fuder before bottling, to help settle the wines and provide a touch of roundness. Rare for an entry-level Estate Riesling, this comes from hand-picked fruit from the Falkenberg vineyard on the steep Piesporter hillside, just above Goldtröpfchen. Value alert!

TITLE: Spey Tenne Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Latin range of SPEY Single Malts starts with the disinctive Tenné. Initially aged in Bourbon barrels, it is then finished in freshly emptied Tawny Port casks for 6 months. The wood imparts a bright, rosé hue and sweet Port warmth to the whisky. Color: Copper with rose lights Nose: A mid nose, fruity overall with a hint of faded pot-pourri. Taste: Light texture, Sweet and faintly fruity, then drying slightly. becomes sweeter with water

TITLE: Spey Trutina Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A NEW SPEY release for 2016. SPEY Trutina is one of the two latest additions to the SPEY Latin collection. SPEY has a long history in connection with Lord Byron who had a love of the Latin language. Color: Pale gold. White wine. Nose: A light nose, with an initial savoury top note on a fruity base, developing floral notes. Clean and fresh – even more so with a drop of water. Taste: Light texture. A sweet start, then considerable crisp acidity, with scented sweets. An aftertaste of white chocolate.

TITLE: Spirits of French Lick Lee W. Sinclair "Glinda" Single Barrel Bourbon The Prime Barrel Pick #111
DESCRIPTION: Dive into the storied spirit of French Lick, Indiana, with Lee W. Sinclair Four Grain Bourbon, a meticulously crafted, limited-edition bourbon from Spirits of French Lick. Named after the visionary behind the renowned West Baden Springs Hotel, this bourbon captures the essence of Indiana’s rich heritage. French Lick, famed for its mineral springs and illustrious history, now offers bourbon lovers a unique spirit that celebrates innovation while honoring tradition. The Prime Barrel Selection – Craftsmanship Meets Innovation Lee W. Sinclair Four Grain Bourbon represents Spirits of French Lick’s commitment to excellence with an exclusive mash bill of 60% corn, 17% wheat, 13% oats, and 10% caramel malted barley. Distilled with care, this bourbon enters the barrel at a low entry proof of 105, allowing flavors to develop gradually in Char #2 barrels over six and a half years. This selection comes bottled at a robust 113.7 proof, offering a rich and complex profile. Tasting Notes Nose: Discover the allure of burnt sugar and apricot, a sweet yet sophisticated introduction. Palate: The body unfolds with layers of butterscotch, caramel, and fresh apricot, delivering a smooth, buttery mouthfeel. Finish: Smoke and wood charcoal provide a lingering warmth, ending with a mellow yet satisfying touch. Aged to Perfection – Limited Availability Unlike many bourbons in this age range, Lee W. Sinclair Four Grain Bourbon reveals a depth and maturity that stands out, thanks to the expertise of Spirits of French Lick. Each sip is a journey through Indiana’s distilling heritage, reflecting the "Respect the Grain" ethos upheld by the distillery. Key Features: Mashbill: 60% corn, 17% wheat, 13% oats, and 10% caramel malted barley. Barrel #683 – selected exclusively by The Prime Barrel. Age: 6 1/2 years in Char #2 barrels for a balance of bold and smooth. Proof: 113.7, for a full-bodied, rich experience. Distilled on: 9/13/17. Why Choose Lee W. Sinclair Bourbon? Crafted for those who value tradition, innovation, and flavor, Lee W. Sinclair Four Grain Bourbon brings more than just taste to the table. It’s a story in every pour, a testament to Spirits of French Lick and their commitment to respecting the grain and honoring historic Indiana figures. Perfect for collectors and whiskey aficionados alike, this Prime Barrel selection offers a rare chance to savor Indiana's finest bourbon craftsmanship.

TITLE: Spirits of French Lick Lee W. Sinclair 4 Grain Indiana Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Lee W. Sinclair Bourbon is a 4-grain straight bourbon whiskey fermented at 85-90 degrees for four days from a mash of corn, oats, wheat, and caramel malt using two distinct yeast varieties. The first yeast pulls out the grain profile and the second yeast pulls out fruity and nutty esters for distillation. The oats add a creamy mouth-feel to the profile and a sweet aroma while caramel malt, which is typically used for brewing, ads a layer of sweetened aroma over the base of the grains. This bourbon is double pot distilled, and the cuts on the doubling run were made in a very clean manner to bring the grain and terroir out in this spirit. The emphasis is on retaining and concentrating the grain during distillation and balancing these elements with the barrel characteristics during maturation. We use number 2 charred New American Oak barrels, toasted prior to charring, and with toasted heads to provide lignin, caramel, and vanilla flavors. 90 Proof

TITLE: Spirits of French Lick Solomon Scott Bottled-In-Bond Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This rye whiskey matured at least 5 years with a mash bill of 60% rye, 35% corn, and 5% malt. The use of our "house" yeast strain and a second brandy yeast pulls forward herbal and fruity notes. The brand never sour mash their Whiskeys in the traditional manner, but this whiskey relies partially on malo-lactic fermentation to bring forth the more earthy elements as well as the creamy mouthfeel. 100% double pot distilled. Barrel entry at 105 proof. We mature in a number 2 charred oak barrel (always 53 gallons) and in a mixture of Chai cellar warehouse and Dunnage. No Chill Filtration so some cloudiness when chilled is to be expected 100 proof.

TITLE: Spirits of French Lick The Mattie Gladden Bottled In Bond Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: The brand starts with a unique mash bill of 55% Corn, 35% rye, and 10% Victory malt which they mash in using two unique yeast strains. The house strain pulls intense grain character, and a brandy yeast, which pulls fruity, herbal, spicy, and full-bodied notes. Their fermentation is completed in closed-top stainless steel fermenters and is “soured” using citric acid to adjust the pH to prime the fermentation. Fermentation is carried out at 88 degrees for four days whereupon they double pot distill the “beer” reaching an average proof of 130. They lower the proof to 105 and fill strictly 53-gallon barrels with a medium plus toasted head and number 2 char body. The number 2 char gives us toasted coconut and hazelnut alongside the slightly less stable entry proof of 105. The barrels are then matured in the dunnage adjacent to the distillery. The dunnage is a large barn with ventilation on all sides. Barrels are stacked four high and the temperature reaches about 110-115 degrees in the summertime with relatively high humidity. 100 Proof.

TITLE: Spirits of French Lick The Morning Glory Kasha Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: The Morning Glory is a Straight Bourbon Whiskey with a mashbill composed of Corn, Rye, Kasha (toasted buckwheat), Buckwheat, and Malt. The name comes from a Tavern that operated near Campbellsburg, Indiana. Some even allege that during Prohibition it operated on the second floor of the Old Clifty Mill). Aged exclusively in our Chai cellar using 53-gallon, #2 char barrels, and a 105-entry proof, as with all our spirits we do not chill filter this offering in order to leave as much of the flavor intact as possible. Like all of our Bourbons, this offering is exclusively double pot distilled and uses both our self-propagated house yeasts as well as a unique brandy yeast. The mash bill is one we worked on to “balance” for quite some time. Expect some cloudiness when chilled, it's natural.

Selected by The Prime Barrel team during an Indiana barrel-picking expedition, this non-bourbon will blow your mind with flavors unlike anything you’ve ever tasted. After sampling over 500 barrels, Whiskey Witch emerged as a standout for its one-of-a-kind profile and deeply layered complexity. An Enchanting Indiana Craft Whiskey with a Unique Twist Distilled from a carefully crafted mashbill of 51% red wheat, 24% oats, and 25% Indiana peat-smoked malted barley, Whiskey Witch brings together a tantalizing blend of flavors.
