TITLE: Spirits of French Lick William Dalton "John Lick" Single Barrel Wheated Bourbon The Prime Barrel Pick #52
DESCRIPTION: Located in West Baden Springs Indiana, Spirits of French Lick opened in April of 2016 sporting the motto, “Respect The Grain”. The distillery is an extension of the French Lick Winery which has been privately owned by the Doty family since 1995. In November 2015, Alan Bishop was recruited from Copper and Kings Distillery to be the master distiller of Spirits of French Lick. This offer came with creative control of the distillery including what equipment, methods, traditions, and techniques were going to be implemented to create a variety of spirits.Drawing from his past experience Alan created his own line of corn that was ten years in the making and comprised 150 parent varieties. In keeping with the tradition of naming seeds after songs, songwriters or musicians who inspire him, Bishop named it “Amanda Palmer”. “Amanda Palmer” is now grown on an eighteen-acre plot on the Spirits of French Lick farm, and is the basis of their bourbons. Yellow dent corn and other locally sourced grains such as oats, kasha, and buckwheat are also used in the mash bills of some of their expressions. Other distinctive practices include using double pot distilling methods, a lower temperature four-day fermentation time, lower barrel entry proofs, and usage of number 2 charred barrels with toasted staves and heads. Bishop says this barrel choice is done for two reasons: By using pot stills he is able to make more precise cuts on the heads and tails of the distillate so that impurities (such as acetaldehyde and ethyl acetate) are at a minimum going to the barrel. This makes needing a heavier char as a filtration device unnecessary. Secondly, the distillate can more easily access the toasted layers underneath the char which contains the natural wood sugars and flavors he is after. SoFL has its own grain mill with a seed cleaner to help produce a cleaner spirit, free from flavors that are not wanted. Additionally, the grains (especially corn) are milled and used daily before it oxidizes to harness the most flavor. For their mainline products, Alan uses two different yeast strains. One is a “house” strain captured from the distillery and the other is one of three brandy yeasts that pull out the fruity and herbal flavors from the grain. If after all this you assumed SoFL spirits are never chill-filtered, you’d be correct. Admittedly, we did not know much about them when the opportunity to select a barrel presented itself. After going a bit of research (outlined above), we uncovered a few interesting tidbits that got us intrigued even before we tasted through different barrels. First, the distillery uses 70% Corn, 20% Wheat, and 10% 2-row Caramel Malted Barley for their William Dalton line (named after the master distiller at the Daisy Spring Distillery who worked there during the span of over 40 years from the 1830s.). Whiskey geeks will recognize that it was inspired by the old Stitzel Weller wheated bourbon mashbill. Second, SoFL utilizes a mixture of an indoor barrel Chai (pronounced “shay”) meaning an above-ground storeroom usually associated with wine production, and Dunnage (a low-ceiling storeroom traditionally used in Scotland) for the maturation process. Their Chai room is built into the distillery itself and doesn’t have any active heating or cooling. Because it works on passive temperatures coming from the distillery, there is only a 30 to 40-degree variance in the barrel Chai throughout the year. This allows the aging process to continue all year long because it never gets too cold in order to sustain the volatility of the base grains. I can go on and on, but you get the idea. This distillery uses a lot of pre-prohibition techniques that also incorporate modern methods and experimentation.When we finally got to tasting, all that information was very evident in the spirit. Everything we tasted was pretty solid, but we liked barrel #779 the best. Here's the barrel info: Barrel: 53-gallon Char #2 New American Oak, medium toast char on the heads. Barrel Entry Proof: 105 Proof: 110.84 Age: 4.5 Years Barrel #: 779 Mash Bill: 70% Corn, 20% Wheat, 10% 2 Row Caramel Malted Barley. (Inspired by the old Stitzel Weller wheated bourbon mash bill). Here's what you can look forward to: Nose: Vanilla and mint Palate: Light caramel, hints of vanilla, peach, fresh and dried apricot, smoked spices like paprika and chipotle, soft and creamy texture Finish: medium finish, fresh and minty spiciness, subtle tannins With a couple of drops of water: opens up a fair amount on the palate, gives a lot more fruit, and also exposes some leathery notes. The bottle could benefit from some time and air to get the most out of it - it has in our tasting post-selection. Finally, we'll be donating $5 from every bottle sold to Bourbon Charity., a nonprofit organization with more than 20,000 supporters that raise money for charity. They have raised over $1.5 million and issued 100 grants to a diverse range of charitable causes ranging from children's health & well-being, to clean drinking water, to food banks, to women's initiatives, to animal welfare, to military and veterans causes, and many more. The above review was provided by one of our members, Mike Rosen. Check out Mike's bourbon blog here

TITLE: Spirits of the Apocalypse "The Walking Dead" Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: An apocalypse has swept the globe, causing the dead to rise and feed on the living. In a matter of months, society has crumbled. There is no government, no grocery stores, no mail delivery, no cable tv. Luckily, there are spirits. From the creators of The Walking Dead comes a limited-release Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey like no other. With a light caramel nose, taste of fruit, and a smooth and spicy finish, this whiskey is crafted for the living but sought out by the dead.

TITLE: Spoken West Wines Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Spoken West Wines Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold and flavorful wine from Napa Valley, California. It is made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, which are known for their intense flavor and structure. This wine has a deep ruby color and aromas of ripe black fruit, spice, and cedar. On the palate, it is full-bodied and tannic, with flavors of black cherry, plum, and licorice. The wine has a long and lingering finish. Spoken West Wines Cabernet Sauvignon is a versatile wine that can be enjoyed with a variety of foods. It is particularly well-suited to grilled meats, pasta dishes, and stews. It can also be enjoyed on its own as a digestif.

TITLE: Springbank 10 Years Old Campbeltown Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: From the heart of Campbeltown, one of Scotland's most prominent whisky-producing regions, Springbank Distillers introduces the 10 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky. This whisky is an ode to centuries-old distillation techniques and to the region's rich whisky heritage. Aged for ten years in a combination of bourbon and sherry casks, this single malt scotch boasts a unique profile that expertly melds the richness of the malt with the distinct character imparted by the oak casks. The Springbank 10 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky, with its complex flavor profile, pairs beautifully with a range of dishes. It complements hearty meat dishes, such as juicy steak or lamb chops, and its smoky notes make it a great match for smoked or grilled foods. For dessert, consider a rich chocolate cake or a cheese board with creamy to sharp cheeses, which would beautifully reflect the whisky's complexity. Alternatively, enjoy the Springbank 10 Years Old neat or on the rocks to fully appreciate its depth and balance.

TITLE: Springbank 11 Years "Local Barley" Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Springbank 11 Year Local Barley Scotch Whisky is a distinguished single malt scotch, meticulously produced using high-quality local barley and traditional distillation techniques. It captures the essence of Campbeltown, Scotland, and the long-standing heritage of the renowned Springbank distillery. Possessing a deep, intricate aroma, this whisky invites with notes of vanilla, caramel, and dried fruits. A subtle whisper of peat smoke gives a nod to its traditional roots. The taste profile is robust and layered, seamlessly blending sweetness and smokiness for a unique and sophisticated experience. Springbank 11 Year Local Barley Scotch Whisky is a tribute to time-honored craftmanship. The selection of local barley is mindfully malted and distilled in copper stills, followed by an 11-year aging period in oak casks. The result is a whisky that is smooth, multifaceted, and exuding a distinctive personality.

TITLE: Springbank 15 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Like a storm gathering off the Kintyre coast, our 15-year-old Springbank is dark and ominous, yet delicious. Best enjoyed after dinner or with your favorite cigar, this is a true classic.

TITLE: Springbank 18 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the exceptional craftsmanship of Springbank with the 18 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky, a testament to the distillery's commitment to tradition and quality. Hailing from the Campbeltown region of Scotland, this whisky has gracefully matured for 18 years, offering a sublime experience for connoisseurs. Immerse yourself in the rich heritage and nuanced flavors of this distinguished Single Malt.

TITLE: Springbank Aged 12 Years Cask Strength Campbeltown Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Aged 12 years in ex-bourbon and sherry casks, Springbank Cask Strength Single Malt Scotch Whisky delivers a unique and smooth flavor. Notes of honey, green apple, and oak can be detected in the aroma and a sweet, spicy taste can be experienced, with hints of wood, citrus, and peat smoke on the finish. Enjoy this Campbeltown whisky for a rich, balanced experience. 112.2 Proof.

TITLE: Springbank Distillery 25 Years Campbeltown Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A 25-year-old single malt Scotch whisky from the Springbank distillery, located in Scotland's Campbeltown region. They mature this expression in Sherry and bourbon casks, before allowing it to marry in refill Port casks. The 2017 edition was a release of 900 bottles.

TITLE: St Germain Elderflower Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: St. Germain was launched in 2007 by Coopers Spirit Co, a company founded 2006 and head-quartered in New York. In 2013, it was sold to Bacardi Ltd., although Robert Cooper of Cooper Spirits agreed to work with Bacardi as a "brand guardian" and spokesperson.

TITLE: St Germain Elderflower Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: St. Germain was launched in 2007 by Coopers Spirit Co, a company founded 2006 and head-quartered in New York. In 2013, it was sold to Bacardi Ltd., although Robert Cooper of Cooper Spirits agreed to work with Bacardi as a "brand guardian" and spokesperson.

TITLE: St. Agrestis Amaro
DESCRIPTION: St. Agrestis was founded in 2014 by sommeliers upon returning to New York from a three-month trip throughout Italy. The trip furthered their passion for the unique regional amari, and became the inspiration to create a regional amaro of their own. The amaro begins by individually macerating twenty organic herbs, spices, flowers, roots, seeds and citrus in a neutral base spirit. After each botanical has been perfectly extracted, the twenty tinctures are married together and transferred to ex-bourbon barrels. In barrel the amaro rests for a minimum of eight weeks before the twenty separate flavors become one unified amaro. Organic cane sugar is then added to provide roundness and balance to the bitter nature of amaro.

TITLE: St. Agrestis Amaro Soaked Cherries
DESCRIPTION: Made using sour Balaton cherries sourced from Michigan, we macerate the cherries in our beloved Amaro. Since prohibition, most cocktail cherries have been produced using a process called sugar impregnation rather than soaking cherries in spirit. St. Agrestis has implemented the traditional process of macerating the cherries to impart the herbal, bittersweet and savory amaro flavors onto the naturally tart cherries. After twelve weeks soaked in Amaro, the cherries reach their ideal flavor. With a satisfying texture and a complex rich, yet not overly sweet, sour, spiced syrup. St. Agrestis Amaro Soaked Cherries are a perfect match for a wide variety of drinks – from Manhattans to Whiskey Sours, or simply mixed with soda and bitters.

TITLE: St. Agrestis Inferno Bitter Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: St. Agrestis Inferno Bitter debuted in the St. Agrestis Negroni in 2018. This red bitter aperitivo was designed to be bitter. A combination of 17 herbs, spices, flowers, roots and citrus, this is the aperitivo that aperitivo drinkers deserve. Designed to be absolutely perfect in a negroni, with club soda or with freshly squeezed orange juice. No artificial color, all organic ingredients.

TITLE: St. Agrestis Negroni
St. Agrestis Paradiso Apertivo
DESCRIPTION: Designed around classic Italian Aperitivo culture, St. Agrestis Paradiso Aperitivo is a complex, all-natural take on more traditional Italian liqueurs. A highly versatile aperitif, Paradiso Aperitivo can be used in a wide variety of cocktails such as margaritas and paper planes, to low abv favorites like a spritz, with soda, or simply over ice with a lemon twist. Containing no artificial coloring and made with the highest quality organic ingredients and no additives, the final product is a sophisticated, less bitter sibling to St. Agrestis Inferno Bitter Aperitivo.

TITLE: St. Agrestis Phony Negroni
St. Agrestis Spritz
DESCRIPTION: St. Agrestis Spritz now available in single serve 200ml bottles. The Spritz is made with St. Agrestis Paradiso Aperitivo, designed around the spritz to be citrus driven with a notch more floral complexity and bitterness than traditional Venetian style aperitivi. This Paradiso Aperitivo is combined with white wine imported from Italy and NYC water into a pressure tank and carbonated together. The result is an elevated spritz, ready-to-drink. Sold as 2-pack!

TITLE: St. Elizabeth Allspice Dram
DESCRIPTION: Product information From its origins in the tropical hills and valleys of Jamaica, the allspice berry has for generations been prized for its exceptional tastes of clove, cinnamon, and nutmeg and a pepper note that dazzles the palate. The allspice liqueur, known in classic cocktails as "Pimento Dram," brings together the fine pot-still rum and classic allspice berries of Jamaica. Enjoy St. Elizabeth Allspice Dram in classic cocktails, Wassail and other punches, mulled wine, continental and island cuisine.

TITLE: St. George 35th Anniversary Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In celebration of 35 years at the vanguard of the American artisan distillation movement, St. George Spirits released 35th Anniversary Single Malt Whiskey. This special anniversary release is limited to only 771 hand-numbered and signed bottles—making it a collector’s item for true connoisseurs of American single malt whiskey.

TITLE: St. George Baller Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: St. George master distiller Lance Winters describes Baller as “a California take on the Japanese spin on Scotch whisky. Distillery starts with 100% American barley (predominately two-row pale malted barley, the remainder is lightly roasted). After distillation in eau de vie pot stills, the whiskey is aged 3–4 years in used bourbon casks and French oak wine casks, as well as filtered through maple charcoal. Distillery then finishes the whiskey in casks that had held house-made umeshu (a Japanese style of plum liqueur we made entirely from California-grown ume fruit).

TITLE: St. George California Agricole Rum
DESCRIPTION: Coming from California’s very own award winning St. George distillery in Alameda, this is a unique spin on the classic agricole style rums of Martinique. Distilled from 100% sugarcane (not molasses) grown outside of Brawley in the Imperial Valley of Southern California. Immediately after harvest, stalks of sugarcane are shipped up to the distillery, where they extract fresh cane juice by running the stalks by hand through a sugarcane mill. The freshly pressed, uncooked cane juice is then fermented and distilled in small batches in their 500-liter copper pot still.

TITLE: St. George Faultline Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This bottle is a part of a special collaboration between K&L Wines, Frontier Records, and St. George Spirits - three family-owned California companies with more than 30 years of experience under their respective belt. The artwork is created by another California Legend: Jaime Hernandez, author, illustrator, and co-founder of the comic book series "Love & Rockets".

TITLE: St. George Gin Combo Pack
DESCRIPTION: St George Gin 3 pack comes with their flagship Gins, the Dry Rye Gin, Terroir Gin and the original Botanivore Gin. All three are completely different and great for making the perfect cocktail.

TITLE: St. George Gin Dry Rye Reposado
DESCRIPTION: Rested in French and American oak wine casks, it has a lovely pink hue and a deep, rich flavor that we think of as an offering to the gods of gin, whiskey, and wine.

TITLE: St. George Raspberry Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: St. George Raspberry Liqueur is exquisite all on its own as a digestif—and the perfect complement to anything chocolate. (We also like to keep a bottle at the breakfast table for drizzling on waffles.)

TITLE: St. George Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: For 20 years now, St. George Single Malt Whiskey has been an American original: distilled, aged, and blended out of love for what a handcrafted single malt can be. If you’ve tried any other St. George distillate, you owe it to yourself to taste the spirit that compelled master distiller Lance Winters to start distilling in the first place.

TITLE: St. George Spiced Pear Liqueur
St. George Spirits Green Chile Vodka
DESCRIPTION: We make this vodka from variety of California-grown hot and sweet peppers (jalapenos, Serranos, habaneros, red and yellow bell peppers) that build layers of sweet, savory heat. Lime peel and fresh cilantro add even more vibrancy and depth of flavor. To make our Green Chile Vodka, we fill our 1,500-liter still with crushed jalapeno peppers, lime peel, and a non-GMO base spirit and distill this through a Carter head assembly that has been layered with fresh cilantro. We infuse the other four types of peppers (Serrano, habanero, red and yellow sweet bell peppers) separately, and then blend each infusion with the distillate of jalapenos, lime, and cilantro. We then filter to remove visible impurities before bottling—the light green tint that remains is the result of the pepper infusion we perform just prior to filtration. The sweet/savory heat makes it ideal for the best-ever Bloody Mary, a spin on a Margarita, a zesty Gimlet, or whenever you’re craving something fresh and spicy in your glass.

TITLE: St. George Spirits NOLA Coffee Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: A special cup of coffee, a legendary cafe, and two souls falling in love. St. George NOLA is head distiller Dave Smith’s homage to the chicory coffee he shared with his wife as they fell in love. Its timeless recipe marries Ethiopian coffee, roasted French chicory and Madagascar vanilla, and it’s been winning accolades for its faithful flavor since 2014.

TITLE: St. Kilda Chardonnay
DESCRIPTION: St. Kilda wines are produced by De Bortoli Wines, a third generation family wine company, based in Bilbul in the Riverina region of New South Wales. De Bortoli Wines is one of the largest privately owned companies in Australia. St. Kilda wines are produced from fruit sourced from South Eastern Australia, officially classified as a viticultural 'super zone', a area measuring 1,250 miles from the Pacific coast in Queensland to the Indian Ocean in South Australia. St. Kilda wines are youthful, fruit driven, balanced and affordable. The grapes were fermented with American and French oak staves over a two week period. Pair with light, dry white wines usually shouldn't be too heavy or overly spiced: chicken, fish, turkey, some veal dishes, mushrooms and pasta with light cream-based sauces would be good. Cooking method also matters. Think poaching, grilling or sauteing.

TITLE: St. Michael-Eppan Sauvignon Lahn
DESCRIPTION: St. Michael Eppan, the innovative Winery situated along the Wine Route, is considered one of the best wineries in South Tyrol and Italy. St. Michael Eppan Winery, with its 355 members, 350 hectares of vineyard and 2.5 million bottles sold every year, has become renowned worldwide. The "Sanct Valentin" label alone is enough to thrill wine lovers and connoisseurs.

TITLE: Stafford Hill Willamette Valley Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: The lots used for this wine are aged for 11 months in up to 15% new French oak.

TITLE: Stagg Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: An uncut and unfiltered bourbon whiskey with a renowned family name. Just like George T. Stagg Bourbon, this new whiskey is not filtered and offers all the rich and complex flavors of bourbon right from the barrel. Bottles of Stagg Jr. is limited, but several batches each year are planned. Sweet, chocolate, and brown sugar flavors mingle perfectly with the bold rye spiciness. The boundless finish lingers with hints of cherries, and smokiness.

TITLE: Standard Spirit Distillery Rye and Corn Heart Cut Moonshine
DESCRIPTION: Distilled from a high rye thin mash with local NY rye and corn in small batches at our Brooklyn distillery. Fermenting on the grain and then distilling with fresh grains suspended in the column make for a unique buttery corn and spicy rye taste that distinguishes our moonshine to rival any whiskey. Bottling only a very selective Heart Cut portion brings you face-to-face with the complex grain flavor, broad body, and smooth taste. No swill! Drink it straight or in a classic cocktail and come to know where great whiskey comes from, the finest moonshine. Best used in liquor forward cocktails, bringing out the heavy rye character.

TITLE: Standard Spirit Distillery Wormwood Agave
DESCRIPTION: Using a Whole Agave, hearts and leaves, and smoking it with pineapple and pumpkin seeds we have created something new here. An agave spirit with similarities to tequila and mezcal but distinctly wormwood influenced with a corn thin mash fermentation. There is a balance with the smoothness of a tequila and finish of smoky mezcal, the wormwood rounds out the spirit while creating a complex front, middle and finish. We brought up whole agave from Texas to make this limited release. Spicy fresh cut pepper notes come through on the nose and are balanced with a deeper smooth body and a smokier finish, a distinct variation on agave spirits.

TITLE: Standard Spirit Distillery Wormwood Gin
DESCRIPTION: An American Dry Gin single distilled with the whiskey drinker in mind. Keeping all of our spirits grain forward is a departure from most gins that are re-distilled from a neutral spirit and tend to be lighter and sharper in nature. With fresh botanicals and herbs in the column of our still, company vapor infuses a distinct botanical character along with velvety wormwood undertones for a deeper atmospheric profile of orris root and rosehip to balance down the bright juniper notes. A round body then gives way to a spicy smoked cardamom finish for a unique sipping gin with a wormwood kick. This is a gin that can be enjoyed straight or on the rocks but also gives a unique twist to classic cocktails like a Negroni or a Martinez.

TITLE: Standard Spirit Distillery Wormwood Rye
DESCRIPTION: Distilled from a high rye thin mash with local NY grains and wormwood before being stave aged in American and French oak. Different from a typical absinthe, we distill and age our wormwood rye to drink straight like a whiskey. With notes of rye spiciness and smoky oak- no water and no sugar is needed, and no anise or licorice is used. Crafted over a decade, bottling the feel of absinthe and the heart of rye. Our wormwood spirit is a complex and perfect go-to drink that redefines what wormwood spirits can be. Substitutes uniquely for classic whiskey cocktails because of the grain and oak aging.

TITLE: Standard Spirit Distillery Wormwood Rye
DESCRIPTION: Distilled from a high rye thin mash with local NY grains and wormwood before being stave aged in American and French oak. Different from a typical absinthe, we distill and age our wormwood rye to drink straight like a whiskey. With notes of rye spiciness and smoky oak- no water and no sugar is needed, and no anise or licorice is used. Crafted over a decade, bottling the feel of absinthe and the heart of rye. Our wormwood spirit is a complex and perfect go-to drink that redefines what wormwood spirits can be. Substitutes uniquely for classic whiskey cocktails because of the grain and oak aging.

TITLE: Standard Wormwood Distillery Artemisia Semi-Sweet Wermut
DESCRIPTION: Artemisia Wermut is a balanced Rose wine from the NY Finger Lakes fortified and aromatized with our unique wormwood spirit. Vapour distilled with citrus peels and baking spices, then finished with elderberry and southern wood for a structured semi-sweet vermouth.

TITLE: Starlight Cigar Batch "R/Bourbon" Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Brazilian Amburana Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Big bold, and sweet. Root beer candies meet vanilla custard, toffee, and a touch of pepper. The Amburana is unmistakable, providing black tea, cinnamon, spice drops, funky maple, and ango bitters. It's dialed back a bit, integrated more closely with the tannins and bourbon sweetness, for a much more approachable look into the world of experimental wood aging. 112.4 Proof, 3rd fill

TITLE: Starlight Cigar Batch "The Joy Of Starlight, Ep. 6" Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Brazilian Amburana Barrels The Prime Barrel Pick #64
DESCRIPTION: The highly anticipated Cigar Batch from our dear partners at Starlight Distillery has arrived. While another distillery may have coined the "Cigar Blend/Batch" term, the team at Starlight has added their unique touch to the expression by employing Amburana wood as a finishing cask. This diverges from the usual quadruple cask finish of Port, Sherry, Armagnac, and Cognac associated with most cigar blends. Starlight instead exclusively uses Amburana wood, bestowing a singular and extraordinary flavor upon the whiskey. The influence of the finishing barrels on the final product depends on how often they've been used to "finish" the bourbon. The more usage, the subtler the effect on the final taste. With the Amburana finish, the flavor impact from first-fill to subsequent uses decreases dramatically. First-fill casks are typically more flavorful and robust, so we wanted this "Cigar" expression to pair well with a quality cigar. We, therefore, waited for the opportunity to use a first-fill cask, and the resulting whiskey is truly fantastic. On the nose, notes of charred citrus peel, succulent dates, aged leather, and dried tobacco form the heart of the aroma. These deep, rustic undertones beautifully offset the zesty orange highlights punctuating the scent profile. These are hints of cinnamon stick, nuttiness, ripe apple, and malt infusion, weaving a rich sensory mosaic. Subtler nuances of grain, toffee, and light clover add an extra layer of complexity, resulting in a nose that is delightfully multifaceted and undeniably unique. On the palate, a fusion of culinary spices, tobacco leaf, and nutty undertones of sandalwood quickly take center stage. Soon, Starlight’s distinct distillate unfurls, marked by soft notes of freshly baked bread, cereal grain, and a sharp, young oak. The overall flavor profile is strikingly distinctive, demanding the drinker's attention. The taste journey surprises with subtle undertones of vanilla chai, honey, and milk chocolate. Its earthly depth, juxtaposed with the prominent tobacco leaf note, may not appeal to everyone. Still, the impressive integration of flavors and the intrigue it stirs are noteworthy.Aged for 5 years+, this barrel was bottled at 111.9 proof making it a dangerous (in a good way) sipper.

TITLE: Starlight Cigar Batch "The Joy Of Starlight, Ep. 7" Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Brazilian Amburana Rum Barrels The Prime Barrel Pick #83
DESCRIPTION: This Starlight Cigar Batch Bourbon is uniquely finished in an Amburana Rum cask. With only four barrels produced, this bourbon offers an exclusive tasting experience. This bourbon began its journey aging for four years in a new oak barrel, followed by a six-month sojourn in an Amburana rum barrel, contributing to its distinct profile. The Amburana casks have a fascinating history; initially housing bourbon for four fills, then maturing 9 and 11-year-old Barbados rum for six months and finally imparting their rich character to Starlight bourbon for another six months. The Amburana casks' sixth use delivers a nuanced influence on the nose and palate. Unlike the robust Amburana notes of the Prime Barrel's first fill Cigar Batch, this edition presents a more subdued, sophisticated touch. The Amburana's presence is elegantly balanced, enhancing rather than overpowering, with a subtle molasses undertone from the rum casks. This 117 proof 4 1/2-year-old Amburana rum finish bourbon is a testimony to Starlight's innovative spirit and commitment to crafting unique flavors. The rarity of this release, with only four barrels in existence, ensures a tasting experience that ventures into new, delightful territories.

TITLE: Starlight Cigar Batch Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Brazilian Amburana Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Unlike anything, you’ve ever tasted before. Pound cake, raisin bread, Padron 1964, creme, and nougat. The big spicy back palate, super complex. Moderate oak structure, proofed nicely. Brown sugar, toffee, and spice drop on the finish. 107.4pf, 4.5yrs

TITLE: Starlight Distillery "The Joy Of Starlight, Ep. 2" Four Grain Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #19
DESCRIPTION: Starlight Distillery is located at Huber's Orchard, Winery & Vineyards in Starlight, Indiana. Initially, they planned to be a brand distillery with the idea forming in the mid-'90s. As the story goes, they were inspired by their ancestors, who once distilled fine brandies in this area in the early 1800s. On December 7th, 2004, they released their first brandy. Starlight has since transitioned into whiskey, distilled in Huber's 80-gallon copper pot still from Germany and then transferred to 53 gallon charred, American White Oak barrels. While their whiskeys tend to be on the younger side, don't let the age fool you. This is some of the best single barrel sub-5-year-old whiskey we've tasted. Their straight bourbon is hard to dislike, containing a large mix of spice, fruitiness, and earthy notes. Each barrel is different, but we were blown away by the barrel that eventually became the "The Joy Of Starlight, Ep. 2" selection. Amazingly, it was the first barrel we tried (we selected the distillery in the summer of 2021), and we must have gone through at least six other barrels. We kept coming back to the very first one, as it was easily the tastiest one. The barrel was bottled at 112.6 Proof, which makes it equally great as a neat sipper or with a splash of water. Mashbill is 51% Corn / 20% Rye / 20% Malted Barley / 9% Wheat, and the barrel itself is a 2-year air-dry wood from the Canton Cooperage. Barrels from Canton Cooperage are expensive, because of the air-dry method they use and because of their ability to produce more fruit-forward tasting whiskeys. Here's are our tasting notes: Nose: bing cherries, cherry cola, dark chocolate, cardamom, cinnamon stick, burnt sugar, grapefruit pith Palate: new oak, baking spice, black currants, grapefruit pith, dill Finish: green peppercorn and grapefruit pith This is the first in a duo of Starlight selections we made in 2021 and launched simultaneously in 2022. The sticker's Bob Ross theme was a winner of a contest we ran and was suggested by one of our members (for which said member received a free bottle!). We think it turned out great - let us know what you think of it!The charity both Starlight selections will support is Norton's Children Hospital Foundation. It is the philanthropic arm for Norton Children’s pediatric facilities and services. The foundation raises funds exclusively for Norton Children’s Hospital, Kentucky’s only full-service, the free-standing hospital created “Just for Kids”; Norton Children’s Medical Center; and pediatric services at Norton Women’s & Children’s Hospital to support programs, equipment, new technologies, clinical research, child advocacy and health education for patients, families, medical staff and the community.

The real magic unfolds as the bourbon is artfully finished in Hungarian Tokaji barrels, infusing it with unique complexity and richness. Proof 108.8

TITLE: Starlight Distillery Applejack Brandy
DESCRIPTION: Apple brandy was one of the first distilled spirits by European colonists in North America. At Starlight Distillery we continue the tradition by pressing fresh apples that are fermented and distilled using our 80- gallon copper pot still. The Applejack brandy is then allowed to reach maturity while aging in charred American oak barrels. Apple aromas mingle with caramel and spicy oak.

TITLE: Starlight Distillery Blackberry Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: “Bramble fruits” are some of the crops grown on the Huber family farm established in 1843. We combined blackberry, one of the family favorite “brambles” with whiskey distilled in a copper pot still.

TITLE: Starlight Distillery Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Tokaji Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Starlight Distillery presents its exquisite Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey, meticulously finished in Tokaji barrels. Originating from the picturesque landscapes of Indiana, this whiskey is a testament to the distillery's commitment to sustainable craftsmanship passed down through seven generations. Each barrel selected for this bourbon begins with a blend of Starlight's unique 3-grain and 4-grain mash bills, fermented using a 100% sweet mash process. Distilled in copper pot stills, the whiskey is aged for a minimum of four years in the historic Huber's Rickhouses, nestled on the grounds of the Huber estate established in 1843. This single-barrel series epitomizes the art of fine whiskey-making, offering an uncut and unfiltered experience straight from the barrel, revealing each selection's authentic and unique flavors. The influence of Tokaji barrels introduces a distinct complexity, enhancing the depth and richness of the bourbon. Starlight Distillery's innovative approach to barrel finishing, including the use of Tokaji barrels, positions it as a leader in creating uniquely flavored whiskeys.

DESCRIPTION: Starlight Distillery is located at Huber’s Orchard, Winery & Vineyards in Starlight, Indiana. Initially, their plan was to be a brand distillery with the idea forming in the mid-’90s. As the story goes, they were inspired by their ancestors who once distilled fine brandies in this area in the early 1800s. On December 7th, 2004, they released their first brandy. TITLE: Starlight Distillery Carl T. Bottled in Bond Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Starlight Distillery’s small-batch bottled-in-bond bourbon is a unique, limited-release product. Beginning with sweet mash and distilled in our copper pot stills, this straight bourbon whiskey is aged for a minimum of 4 years in Huber’s Old Rickhouse (on the grounds of the 7th generation Huber estate, established in 1843). We then bottle at 100 proof under the Bottled-in-Bond Act of 1897.

TITLE: Starlight Distillery Carl T. Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Starlight Distillery’s Carl T Bourbon is now available! Appropriately named after the Grandfather of 6th generation co-owners Greg & Ted Huber, the Huber’s felt it only fitting to title this signature blend after their 4th generation grandfather “Carl T” who had a love for bourbon. This signature blend of bourbon is comprised of 58% corn, 27% rye, and 15% malted barley. Distilled in Huber’s 80 gallon copper pot still from Germany and then transferred to 53 gallon charred, American White Oak barrels from three different cooperage companies and four different barrel styles, continue to add quality and complexity to this signature blend.

TITLE: Starlight Distillery Double Oak Old Rickhouse Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Starlight’s rye whiskey is double-oaked in toasted barrels from Seguin Moreau and 5 year-air dried Canton Cooperage barrels, resulting in a magnificently balanced whiskey which doubles down on all the best qualities of American oak while retaining the unmistakable qualities of Indiana rye whiskey.

TITLE: Starlight Distillery Old Rickhouse Indiana Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Our Distillery and Old Rickhouse is located high upon the Knobstone Escarpment in Southern Indiana. Our small batch Rye Whiskey is aged here in new American Oak barrels displaying distinctive hints of sweet caramel and vanilla. The prominent characteristics of rye exhibiting classic spicy notes which shine through, making for a smooth finish. 92 Proof.

TITLE: Starlight Distillery Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Rum Barrel TheHateDust Pick
DESCRIPTION: Introducing the Starlight Distillery Four Square Rum Finished Barrel, a unique expression that tells a story of craftsmanship and collaboration. This barrel started as a Heaven Hill bourbon barrel before traveling to Barbados, where it aged Four Square Rum. It was then brought to Starlight Distillery in Indiana for its final transformation. About the Blend: Starlight Distillery is renowned for its exceptional finishing techniques, and this release is no exception. Known for their flawless blends, Starlight continues to impress with every barrel. As my friend Darren says, "never had a bad one," and this release proves that true once again. Tasting Experience: This bourbon finished in rum barrels offers a delightful, fruit-forward profile with a proof of 113.9. Expect vibrant notes of tropical fruit, seamlessly integrated with the rich, warm undertones of bourbon. The journey from Kentucky bourbon to Barbadian rum and finally to Indiana results in a complex and satisfying flavor experience. TITLE: Starward In Collaboration with Lagavulin Single Malt Australian Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Based in Melbourne, Australia, Starward Distillery presents a groundbreaking collaboration with the esteemed Islay-based Lagavulin Distillery, resulting in the Starward Single Malt Australian Whisky Finished in ex-Lagavulin Barrels. This limited edition release explores innovation and tradition, marrying Starward's signature Australian single malt, initially matured in red wine barrels, with the iconic peaty essence of Lagavulin through an additional 18 months of maturation in ex-Lagavulin barrels. This process imparts a unique combination of tropical and smoky notes to the whisky, creating a bold and unique tasting experience​.

TITLE: Starward Octave Barrels Single Malt Australian Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Our first ever Starward Projects release in the USA. This is a modern whisky, shaped by an icon of Australian red wine. We aged in Yalumba’s The Octavius Shiraz barrels to produce a beautifully balanced symphony of flavours.

TITLE: Starward Single Malt Whisky Nova Matured In Red Wine Barrels
DESCRIPTION: Brand's signature single malt is a deliciously balanced and bold whisky for sharing and mixing. Nova is matured exclusively in red wine barrels from wineries making great Australian shiraz, cabernets, and pinot noirs. Brand double distills this single malt whisky using Australian malted barley. Borrowing from the craft brewing scene, they ferment our barley with brewers’ yeast for an extra bold flavor. Then come the barrels. Brand goes local and source barrels from wineries in the nearby Yarra Valley and Barossa Valley, so they keep their fresh red wine flavor profile. Then, they’re lightly charred or steamed. Often, the barrels are still wet with wine when we fill them. As they fill those barrels at a lower alcohol proof than other single malts, the whisky takes in all the red wine fruit characters and tannins. Next, Melbourne’s intensely reactive climate gets to work. A far cry from the sunny Australian stereotype, the infamous ‘four seasons in a day makes Nova work hard in the barrel, extracting maximum flavor from the wood in just a short time. And it’s why we couldn’t make Nova anywhere else.

TITLE: Starward Single Malt Whisky Solera Matured In Apera Barrels
DESCRIPTION: There’s a time for tradition, and there’s a time to go rogue. Solera was the first whisky where the brand borrowed from tradition and then started asking questions. It left them with a whisky deemed world-class not just by them, but by award judges too. Solera is not only the name but also a traditional method the Spanish used to age their Sherry and keep it consistent. A fractional amount of each young cask is blended with a more mature spirit. It’s the inspiration for making our Solera, which means there’s still a touch of our first-ever cask in every bottle. The brand sources every Solera ingredient from just a day’s drive away. A quintessential grain like Australian malted barley was a no-brainer to start with. Then, for a bold, craft flavor, they ferment the barley with brewers’ yeast. Next - the barrel. The brand wanted barrels with one hell of a history. Their Apera barrels, an Aussie fortified wine similar to Sherry, have typically held spirit over decades. That’s some seriously flavorful oak. At first, maturation was a bit of trial and error. The brand was used for Scottish whiskies with age statements over a decade long. But they soon found out that wasn’t Melbourne weather’s style. The wildly varied temperature means whisky works harder in the barrel, absorbing flavor from the wood in a much shorter time. With this elemental maturation, Solera is a neat reflection of Melbourne; wild weather and all.

TITLE: Starward Wheated Single Grain "Legendary Starward" 7 Year Old Australian Single Barrel Whisky The Prime Barrel Pick #27
DESCRIPTION: Here's something you don't see every day - a 7-year-old single grain whiskey from Australia finished in PX Casks. That single grain - wheat! Starward brand is relatively new to the American market, but it's long been established in Europe and Australia. The brand is known for finishing Australian whiskey in red wine casks. While this might not be everyone's cup of tea, this expression is different in every imaginable way. Let's count them: While technically Pedro Ximenez sherry is wine, a seasoned whisky drinker knows that some world-renowned brands and expressions came from finishing bourbon/scotch in PX casks. The sherry lends sweeter notes to the whiskey, shaving off any possible rough edges. It also does not have overly tannic notes that are prevalent in other red wine finishes, and that's a good thing as far as we are concerned.100% Wheated whiskeys are a rarity in any market, and this is one of a very few that you'll come acrossStarward had about 65 barrels in the market since their single barrel program launched three years ago.Only 8 of them have been wheat, and only 4 have been finished in the PX cask.Tasting Notes: Nose: toasted nuts, dried black cherries, red apple, apricot, truffle, tangerine peel, leather, and wheat chaff Palate: almond skin, macadamia nuts, raisins, espresso, black cardamom, citrus, and sage Finish: long, spicy, and saline finish with notes of cinnamon and citrus pith The "tater" sticker was suggested by our Discord community and is a parody of a Starlord Commander from Marvel comics. $5 from each bottle will support Leukemia & Lymphoma society. The organization is dedicated to curing leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma, and other blood cancers. They are the world's largest voluntary (nonprofit) health organization dedicated to funding blood cancer research and providing education and patient services.
