DESCRIPTION: Barrel: #041 Distiller: MGP Barreled November 8th, 2014 Mashbill: 95/5 Selected by t8ke for r/bourbon Tasting Notes: Rambunctious and rye forward, this blackberry bramble meets rich honey, maple, tobacco, and pure MGP rye funk. Black pepper, black walnut bitters, and sweet and creamy creme brulee lead to a viscous mouthfeel, a long, oaky finish. This reminds me of the original Vaporwav Flav, but at pricing not seen for many moons. This rye simply doesn't back down.

TITLE: Stefan Vetter Quitte Methode Rurale
DESCRIPTION: Stefan Vetter is punk rock. He has done nothing that has even the slightest commercial logic to it. His old friend Andreas Adam (of the celebrated Mosel estate A.J. Adam) must shake his head, watching Stefan, like a wild hermit, run himself up into the terraced vineyards of Franconia. Yet from a scant few hectares of old terraced vineyards, Stefan is redefining what Sylvaner can be. These are quite simply the greatest Sylvaners I’ve ever tasted, from anywhere, ever. Stefan is at the forefront of the natural wine movement in Germany. As such, he farms both organically and biodynamically, working only old vines in steep, terraced sites. Pressing is done gently and can take four to six hours. The juice may see a short bit of skin contact, but for the most part it is just moved directly into old barrels. Stefan has bought 300 and 600-liter barrels from Stockinger. During the elevage, the wine is topped off but that’s about it. The wines are bottled without fining or filtering.

TITLE: Stefano Mancinelli Sensazioni di Frutto Lacrima di Morro d'Alba
DESCRIPTION: This wine is made from 100% Lacrima di Morro d’Alba. The grapes undergo carbonic maceration. The encuvage of the whole berry fruit takes place in special stainless steel tanks for 3 to 4 days. The wine is then racked and the berries are crushed. Both free run and pressed juice are then allowed to ferment at temperature-controlled levels. The wine is racked and placed in stainless steel holding tanks until bottled where it is aged for 3-4 months. Sustainable

TITLE: Stefano Mancinelli Senzazioni di Frutto Lacrima di Morro d'Alba
DESCRIPTION: This wine is made from 100% Lacrima di Morro d’Alba. The grapes undergo carbonic maceration. The encuvage of the whole berry fruit takes place in special stainless steel tanks for 3 to 4 days. The wine is then racked and the berries are crushed. Both free run and pressed juice are then allowed to ferment at temperature-controlled levels. The wine is racked and placed in stainless steel holding tanks until bottled where it is aged for 3-4 months. Sustainable

TITLE: Stefano Menti Garganuda Soave D.O.C.
DESCRIPTION: Producer Information: Our family run winery in Gambellara (half way between Verona and Venice) was founded at the end of XIX century, by our great-great-grandfather, Menti Giovanni, who started making wine initially only for his own consumption. Today our estate cultivates 7,5 ha of garganega and durella vines in and around the hills of Gambellara and Lessini. We work organically using biodynamic methods and produce all sorts of styles of wines from still whites to fizzy whites and sparkling wines, as well as balsamic-sweet wines from dried, raisin-like grapes. All works are managed directly by Stefano and his father Giovanni, from taking care of the vines to the bottling process. Meet Stefano Menti who, together with his dad Giovanni, manages the estate today, and find out how they use a pied de cuve to help their wines complete their fermentation.

TITLE: Stein Riesling Blauschiefer Trocken
DESCRIPTION: Indulge in the exquisite taste of Stein Riesling Blauschiefer Trocken, a premium German white wine hailing from the picturesque Mosel region. Crafted by the renowned Stein winery, this wine embodies the essence of quality and tradition.

TITLE: Stein Riesling Weihwasser Feinherb
DESCRIPTION: Quintessential Mosel Riesling, "Weihwasser" meaning Holy Water. An ode to the just off-dry wines (also known as Feinherb) as they use to come, where fermentation naturally slows or stops, with a prickle of co2.

TITLE: Stein Rose Trocken
DESCRIPTION: Stein Rosé Trocken boasts a beautiful pale pink color that captures the eye and invites you to explore its enticing flavors. With meticulous attention to detail, the winemakers have crafted a wine that balances elegance and liveliness, making it an ideal choice for any occasion. Stein Rosé Trocken pairs wonderfully with a variety of culinary delights. Its versatility makes it a fantastic companion to fresh salads, grilled vegetables, and light seafood dishes. The wine's bright acidity and fruit-forward character also make it an excellent match for charcuterie boards and soft cheeses. Embrace the versatility of Stein Rosé Trocken and let it elevate your dining experiences.

TITLE: Stellar Organics Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Pairs well with veggie burgers, Pizza, BBQ and Fajitas.

TITLE: Stellar Organics Extra Dry Sparkling Wine
DESCRIPTION: Great with spicy curries, oysters, grilled salmon and light lunches. Also complements marriage proposals, job promotions and full moons.

TITLE: Stellina di Notte Prosecco
DESCRIPTION: Harvested the Prosecco grapes from vineyards in the foothills of the Alps, in Italy’s northern Veneto region. This cool viticulture region forms an arc between the Italian Alps and the Adriatic Sea. The region’s high altitudes assure cool summers to retain the grape acidity that gives liveliness to sparkling wines, while warmth from its proximity to the Adriatic Sea assures full ripening. The Guyot-trained vines are deeply rooted in well-draining alluvial marl soils—-composed of clay, limestone and rock—that are believed to contribute to the unique minerality of Prosecco wines. Prosecco made using the Charmat sparkling wine process. First cold fermented the juice to preserve the grapes’ fruitiness and then kept the wine sur lie (on yeast) for three weeks with frequent batonnage (stirring) for rich texture on the palate. A second fermentation, with sur lie aging, developed the wine’s aromas and fine, persistent bubbles.

TITLE: Stellum "Serpens" Cask Strength Single Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: It takes a special kind of skillset to master the art of blending and sourcing the best premium Spirits around the world and the folk at Barrel Craft Spirits certainly seem to have it. Created in 2013 in Kentucky by Joe Beatrice who wanted to share his passion for unique, high-quality Spirits with the world, the BCS lads seek out the best leftovers there are and put them together to shine as their best selves. Award-winning stuff, we tell ya, with their Blended Bourbon for example single-handedly announcing the rise of the Blended Whiskey when it was awarded Double Gold at the 2020 San Francisco World Spirits Competition. The list of awards obviously doesn’t end there with Stellum Rye winning Double Gold at the 2021 San Francisco World Spirits Competition, Double Gold at the 2021 New York International Spirits Competition, Platinum Medal, and the titles of "Best Rye Whiskey" and "Best Whiskey" at the 2021 L.A. Spirits Awards and scoring 94 points at the 2021 Ultimate Spirits Challenge. In 2021, Stellum Bourbon was awarded Gold medals in the same three competitions. 118.6 Proof

TITLE: Stellum "Vega" Cask Strength Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: It takes a special kind of skillset to master the art of blending and sourcing the best premium Spirits around the world and the folk at Barrel Craft Spirits certainly seem to have it. Created in 2013 in Kentucky by Joe Beatrice who wanted to share his passion for unique, high-quality Spirits with the world, the BCS lads seek out the best leftovers there are and put them together to shine as their best selves. Award-winning stuff, we tell ya, with their Blended Bourbon for example single-handedly announcing the rise of the Blended Whiskey when it was awarded Double Gold at the 2020 San Francisco World Spirits Competition. The list of awards obviously doesn’t end there with Stellum Rye winning Double Gold at the 2021 San Francisco World Spirits Competition, Double Gold at the 2021 New York International Spirits Competition, Platinum Medal, and the titles of "Best Rye Whiskey" and "Best Whiskey" at the 2021 L.A. Spirits Awards and scoring 94 points at the 2021 Ultimate Spirits Challenge. In 2021, Stellum Bourbon was awarded Gold medals in the same three competitions. 110.1 Proof

TITLE: Stellum Black Cask Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Stellum Black Bourbon is the next step in Stellum Bourbon’s evolution. By incorporating reserve barrels from our stocks with the original Stellum Bourbon blend, we created a bourbon that delivers robust flavor alongside profound complexity. The result is an expression both entirely new and deeply familiar, with roots firmly planted in Stellum Bourbon.

TITLE: Stellum Black Cask Strength Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Stellum Black Rye is an evolution of the Stellum Rye flavor profile. Think of it as Stellum Rye in high-def. We used a meticulous blending approach to layer older reserve barrels into the original Stellum Rye blend. The result is a surprisingly mellow cask-strength rye whiskey combining iconic rye spice with a deep complexity that reveals new facets with every sip.

TITLE: Stellum Spirits Equinox Blend #1
DESCRIPTION: This inaugural release of the Stellum Black Specialty Equinox was created using Stellum Bourbon. We slowly layered in rare sets of bourbon barrels, step by step, until the evening of the Vernal Equinox, when the blend was completed in honor of the changing seasons.

TITLE: Stellum Spirits Fibonacci Rye Blend #1
DESCRIPTION: This release of Stellum Black Specialty Rye celebrates the Fibonacci sequence, a series of numbers, each the sum of the two previous numbers. Six separate rye blends were combined following this sequence. Like so many other Fibonacci presentations, the blend it produced was balanced and beautiful.

TITLE: Stellum Spirits Hunter's Moon Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This warm, oak-driven bourbon is made in preparation for winter, inspired by the Hunter’s Moon of October. It is marked by high rye spice and a robust woodiness meant for the time of year when days get shorter and the nights get longer.

TITLE: Stellum Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: From the makers of Barrell Craft Spirits, Stellum Spirits launched a blend of straights at cask strength in the bourbon and rye categories. Stellum Bourbon is bottled at 114.98 proof (57.49% ABV) . The blend is focused on a 5–6-year-old IN/KY/TN profile using 3 different Indiana mash bills and includes barrels from 4-16 years old. While sourced from N/KY/TN whiskies, it is more Indiana than any expressions from the Barrell Craft Spirits.The name "Stellum" is a derivative of the Latin word "Stella" for "Star". Stellium also has an astrological meaning of a group of planes concentrated in a house.

TITLE: Stellum Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The identity of Stellum Rye is rooted in a tried and true 95% Rye Indiana mash bill. To enhance this classic style, we incorporate small amounts more barley-forward rye and choice barrels from both Kentucky and Tennessee. This brings a full, round mouthfeel and flashes of buttery sweetness to an otherwise spicy and tightly focused Rye Whiskey.

TITLE: Stirrings Liqueur Triple Sec
Stobi Tikves Rose
DESCRIPTION: Stobi Rose is produced from the indigenous Rkatsiteli and Vranec grapes grown in the unique and ideal vineyard conditions of Macedonia's Tikves region. This brilliant rose is obtained by subjecting the grapes to the white winemaking techniques of abbreviated skin contact and cool temperature fermentation. The result is zesty, refreshing, and waiting to be discovered. Stobi Rose is perfect for nearly any occasion but makes a fantastic outdoor wine for summer drinking, or as an accompaniment to a variety of appetizers and lighter fair.

TITLE: Stolen American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: STOLEN American Whiskey begins with a mature 11-year-old whiskey. Ever insatiable, STOLEN tapped into industry experts by adding a layer of artistry rooted in extracting staves from ex-whiskey barrels and toasting them in a 360-degree rotation over an oak wood fire. Turning the staves at key points during the toast allowed STOLEN to capture richly nuanced flavors across the entire wood gradient, resulting in a smoky consistency for every barrel stave. To impart these fire roasted notes into the whiskey, STOLEN employs a secondary, barrel-finishing process where “the juice” is continually analyzed for taste and nosed for aroma until it peaks in boldness resulting in an additional layer of finished flavor complexity that differentiates STOLEN Whiskey from other traditional American whiskies and bourbons.

TITLE: Stolen Overproof Rum
DESCRIPTION: STOLEN discovered Overproof at a historic, family-run distillery in Jamaica that’s over 250 years old, renowned for making some of the best heavy pot still rums in the world. It is the last of a 6-year aged, pot still rum made using hand harvested sugar cane grown by local farmers. The sugar cane mash is fermented using a proprietary yeast strand that is cultured in outdoor wood vats. The mash ferments for seven days in a selection of the distillery’s 50 different traditional cedar tanks. Utilizing mountain rain water collected by the estate’s own rain water retention system, the rum is distilled using very old, traditional pot stills… the same as those found in Scotland to make high flavor single malt whiskies. The distilled rum is then carefully matured in ex-whiskey barrels. The result is a distinctively smooth 123 proof dark bronze rum with a flavor and profile that is nothing short of amazing. This is a very limited release. When it’s over, it’s over. And out.

TITLE: Stolen Smoked Spiced Rum (formerly coffee and cigarettes)
DESCRIPTION: Inspired by ‘Coffee and Cigarettes’, the series of short films from Jim Jarmusch, distillery set out to create a sensory experience that fuels creative conversations. The distillation and ageing process takes place in the Caribbean where the rum matures in ex-bourbon oak barrels for a minimum of two years, before it is carefully blended by hand. Then, rum was blended with natural spices and oils – a method used in our handcrafted ‘tincture’ based approach. The best tinctures of each ingredient are sourced from around the world; in this rum, distillery used Fenugreek from Morocco, Vanilla Bean from Madagascar and Arabica Coffee Beans from Colombia. This rum is versatile, and can be used in all rum cocktails, as well as rye or bourbon based classics (but best served neat).

TITLE: Stoli Limited Edition Ukrainian Relief Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Vodka drinkers continue to check labels to see where the bottle they're about to buy was made (though, in reality, a very small percentage of the vodka sold in the U.S. is made in Russia). In fact, some cities, states, and establishments stopped selling and serving Russian-made spirits when the war began. All the more reason the timing is just right for Stoli to introduce a limited-edition bottle to benefit Ukraine. Proceeds from its sale will be donated to World Central Kitchen, a nonprofit organization founded by Chef José Andrés that provides fresh, nutritious meals to refugees fleeing Ukraine and those who are staying in cities impacted by the war.

TITLE: Stolichnaya Spirit of Stonewall Limited Edition Premium Vodka
DESCRIPTION: The Spirit of Stonewall celebrates the 50th anniversary of the Stonewall Uprising, and how the bravery to take a stand has evolved into the Pride movement and celebrations of today. Through this commemorative release, Stoli supports the Stonewall Inn Gives Back Initiative and its powerful mission to eliminate the social intolerances that profoundly impact the lives of LGBTQ citizens in America and abroad. Artist Lisa Marie Thalhammer’s original label artwork, including her iconic thirteen color rainbow spectrum “LOVE”, brings to life an empowering and hopeful message of how the bravery to take a stand has evolved into the modern day Pride movement and celebration.

TITLE: Stolichnaya Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Stolichnaya is a vodka made of wheat and rya grain. A well-known Soviet brand, Stolichnaya for international distribution is bottled in Latvia using Latvian water but alcohol from a distillery in Tambov by a company chartered in Luxembourg but founded by a Russian which distributes a wide variety of Russian spirits, having purchased a number of former Soviet brands and operations. Stolichnaya for Russian distribution is manufactured in Kaliningrad by a separate Russian company.

TITLE: Store Pickup
DESCRIPTION: Store Pickup

TITLE: Straight Edge Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Straight Edge is a blend of 5, 7 and 8 year old Bourbon from Kentucky and Tennessee. The mash bill is approximately 70% corn with a balance of rye and wheat. The Bourbon was finished at our facility in the Napa Valley where it was aged in high end Napa Valley Cabernet barrels. The barrels imparted toasty vanilla and dried fruit notes while also allowing the Bourbon to soften and mellow. The spirit was aged at 124 proof and then titrated to its bottle strength of 84 proof. The water used was from high in the hills of Alexander Valley at over 2000 feet elevation. This property is rugged, remote and more importantly, the home to three aquifers that pump out pristine, crystal clear, idyllic water. The Bourbon was bottled at our facility in Napa Valley and released to the market in late 2014 with 1,800 6-packs in our initial release.

TITLE: Stranahan's "Austin''s American Grill" Single Barrel Single Malt Colorado Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Selected by an Austin restaurant, this exclusive expression is featured in their signature barrel-aged cocktails, including the Old Fashioned and Manhattan. Naturally, it's also perfectly suited for savoring neat.

TITLE: Stranahan's "Blue Peak" Colorado Straight Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Stranahan's Blue Peak is named after a 13,000-foot peak in Aspen, Colorado. The Colorado single malt is first aged for 4 years in 53-gallon new, charred American oak (char #3) in the high altitude of its Denver warehouses. Then the whiskey is further aged in foeders (large oak barrels) which are made from new American oak. Here the whiskey mingles with other single malts for several months before a portion is removed. The foeders are never emptied creating a solera system

TITLE: Stranahan's "Second Chance" Single Barrel Single Malt Colorado Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #70
DESCRIPTION: Sometimes fate smiles upon us, and we get a second chance at something truly special. That's precisely the story of our Stranahan's "Second Chance" Single Barrel American Single Malt. During our barrel-picking expedition in Colorado earlier this year (2023), we sampled Stranahan's regular portfolio. While the standard offerings were good, none truly captivated us - feeling a touch on the lighter side for our taste. That perception changed when we delved into Stranahan's single barrels. These were notably different—more flavorful, complex, and surprisingly balanced. This particular barrel—#18-1975 with a Proof of 114.16 and aged 4 years, 7 months—stood out with its rich grassy, butterscotch, and cocoa notes. A balanced whiskey that truly punches above its weight. This exceptional barrel made a lasting impression. However, our community's preference for bourbon led us to hesitancy and, subsequently, regret. Later, fate intervened. When we revisited the opportunity, we discovered another account had claimed it but was gracious enough to share this incredible find with our club. With flavors that continue to dance on our palates, this is a second chance you won't want to miss. Seize the opportunity and taste what could have been lost but is now lovingly rediscovered.

TITLE: Stranahan's Colorado Whiskey Diamond Peak
DESCRIPTION: Stranahan's Diamond Peak is selected from distillery's oldest casks by master distiller Rob Dietrich. Distillery ages the Colorado Single Malt Whiskey in #3 Char American Oak Barrels in their mile-high warehouse in Denver, Colorado. This Whiskey is non-chill filtered and cut to proof with Rocky Mountain water. Every Batch is hand bottled.

TITLE: Stranahan's Sherry Cask Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The new Stranahan’s Sherry Cask starts as the flagship American single malt whiskey that’s aged for four years in new white American oak barrels after being distilled from 100% malted barley and Rocky Mountain water. From there it is then cask finished in Spanish Oloroso sherry barrels, sourced from the Andalusia region of southern Spain. These barrels are said to have been aging wine for over 40 years, thus giving the whiskey an extra special flavor.

TITLE: Stranahan's Single Malt Colorado Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The tale of Stanahan’s Colorado Whiskey goes something like this. George Stranahan (who also owns Flying Dog brewery) had a barn that caught on fire. Jess Graber was a volunteer firefighter who responded to the fire. They decided to let it burn itself out and so while watching the fire they got to talking and discovered they both loved making alcohol. Stranahan beer and Garber was a fan of distilling. After the fire George offered Jess his other barn to setup a still and distill some of his old beer in. A while after that George gave Jess a spot by his brewery and that’s when Jess brought on Jake Norris to help with the distilling and they began distilling the Flying Dog four barley mash. In 2011 the brand was sold to Proximo spirits and the rest is history.

TITLE: Strathmill 11yrs Speyside Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
Strathmill Hogshead 16 yrs Highland 86 Proof Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Strathmill was converted into a distillery in 1891, from the Strathisla corn and flour mill, in the village of Keith. The distillery was officially known as Glenisla-Glenlivet distillery until it was bought by W & A Gilbey who also owned Glen Spey. The distillery was incorporated into IDV in 1962 and has subsequently come under theownership of Guinness UDV. 1992 16 year Highland

TITLE: Strehn "Flamingo" Blaufrankisch Rose Brut
DESCRIPTION: 100% Blaufränkisch sparkling wine from Burgenland. Crisp, dry sparkling wine, perfect for aperitif.

TITLE: Stretton's London Dry Gin
DESCRIPTION: Port Distilled. Lightly sweet nose of citrus and soft juniper. On the palate this shows a nice level of mellow sweetness and citrus character along with mellow juniper and a little spice. The finish shows a medium alcohol presence and a light bitterness, but it is not overpowering. Good value, and interesting to see a molasses based gin.

TITLE: Stuhlmuller Vineyards Chardonnay
DESCRIPTION: Starting in 1998, Fritz Stuhlmuller gives us his Estate bottled, classic California-style Chardonnay. Pair with chicken in a butter cream sauce.

TITLE: Substance Cabernet Sauvignon
DESCRIPTION: Wines of Substance was established in 2007 by Jason Huntley, Jamie Brown of Waters Winery and Greg Harrington of Gramercy Cellars. Substance offers hand crafted, single varietal releases that showcase the unique characteristics of Columbia Valley AVA. Drawing upon the periodic table of elements for graphic inspiration, they launched an award winning Web site (www.winesofsubstance.com) and an ever growing lineup of wines that offers substance and inspiration. 90-92 Points, Robert Parker's Wine Advocate. Charred burger, mushroom pizza, marinated ribeye steak, braised short ribs

TITLE: Succes Vinicola Conca de Barbera La Trompa
DESCRIPTION: Organic. 100% Trepat. 7-year-old vines on calcareous soils @ 530 meters. Destemmed and foot tread twice a day for 2-3 days in tank. Then whole berry pressed and spontaneous fermentation. Aged for 4 months and bottled without filtration. No SO2 added.

TITLE: Succes Vinicola Conca de Barbera Trepat Patxanga Rosado
DESCRIPTION: Organic. 100% Trepat sourced from 40 year-old bush-trained vines grown calcareous clay @ 400-500 m. Hand-picked at low brix and sorted, then direct pressed into stainless steel. Spontaneous fermentation and ageing in steel with zero sulfur added.

TITLE: Suehiro Densho Yamahai Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: The founder of the brewery, Inosuke, came from Shinjo family – a retainer and a renowned sake supplier forthe Lord of Aizu, Hoshina Masayuki. Later, he established cadency apart from the main line of the family and started one on his own. At the same time, he got into sake brewing business and established the brewery in 1850. Nikujaga, Egg dishes (omlet), Miso marinated grilled fish, Miso based dishes, Escargot (Bourgogne style)

TITLE: Suehiro Poochi-poochi Sake
DESCRIPTION: A deep and rich aroma is filled with hints of lemons and candy. This Sparkling sake is a refreshing dance of small bubbles with a gentle sweetness. There are lots of subtle flavors such as steamed rice, hay, citrus and absolutely no aftertaste. Extremely well balanced for an "odd" sake.

TITLE: Suerte "Lucky Break" Single Barrel Reposado Tequila The Prime Barrel Pick #106
DESCRIPTION: Experience the unique craftsmanship of Suerte Single Barrel Reposado Tequila, double distilled and aged in whiskey barrels. This higher-proof version of the brand’s reposado delivers a robust blend of oak, butterscotch, subtle plum, and roasted agave, making it the perfect tequila for whiskey drinkers. What sets Suerte apart is its commitment to tradition. Only 1% of tequila brands are labeled Tahona, and Suerte proudly stands among them. Each piña is crushed under a two-ton stone for 24 hours, slowly releasing all the sugars, resulting in a more distinctive and nuanced agave flavor—yielding a superior tequila. Crafted in Atotonilco El Alto, Suerte is infused with the natural spring water that flows through the region. With locally sourced ingredients and a commitment to sustainable production, Suerte Tequila offers exceptional quality that reflects care for the land, people, and products. Like our renowned whiskey selections, this single-barrel pick focuses on taste and quality. The whiskey barrel aging, combined with a higher proof (88 Proof), brings out bold spice and roasted agave flavors. Plus, it's 100% additive-free, ensuring an authentic tequila experience. The "Lucky Break" monicker celebrates the rare opportunity to bring this tequila to life. Tasting Notes: Nose: Whiskey barrel influence with oak, butterscotch, and a hint of plum. Palate: Rich roasted agave, layered with spice, subtle plum, and a whisper of oak. Finish: Long and smooth, with the perfect balance of agave and barrel-aged complexity. Perfect for Whiskey Lovers: This tequila carries the depth and complexity that whiskey drinkers will appreciate. Get your hands on this exclusive tequila and taste the "Lucky Break" for yourself!

TITLE: Suerte Tequila Blanco
Suerte Tequila Blanco
Suigei "Drunken Whale" Tokubetsu Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: This sake is easily paired with a range of dishes.

TITLE: Sulauze aix en Provence Rose Pomponette
DESCRIPTION: 60% Grenache, 10% Syrah, 10% Vermentino, 15% Cinsault, 5% Mourvedre

TITLE: Sulauze Super Modeste Petillant Naturel
DESCRIPTION: 100% Rolle (Vermentino)

TITLE: Sumarroca Santa Creu de Creixa
DESCRIPTION: Product information Intense, deep cherry colour with a fine, intense aroma of ripe dark fruit, such as cherries and blackberries. Hints of vanilla with a background of licorice. Full flavoured on the palate with soft, well-integrated tannin. The flavours of cherry and fruits of the forest predominate, merging well with the more balsamic nuance of licorice. Producer information The origins of the winemaking craft of these cellars lie in the village of Llimiana, in Pallars Jussà. This is where various generations of the Sumarroca family devoted themselves to growing vines, as they still do today in the county of Penedès. At the beginning of the ‘80s, this family winery moved to Penedès, where they bought the Molí Coloma estate (36 ha) at Subirats and Heretat Sabartés (25 ha) at Banyeres del Penedès. In 1983, the production facilities were located at Mas Molí Coloma, where cava and white wine production began immediately. In 1999 they purchased the former property of the Marquis of Monistrol, which came to be called the Sumarroca estate. It is 403.8 ha and is the largest estate in the region of Penedès.

TITLE: Suntory 100th Anniversary Hakushu 12 Years Old Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: 100th Anniversary Limited Edition Design. The Hakushu 12 Single Malt comprises carefully selected malt whiskies, all aged for a minimum of 12 years in various casks, created in honor of Suntory Whisky's centenary. Nestled deep in Mt. Kaikomagatake, The Hakushu Distillery draws on its unique natural surroundings. The illustration on the bottle captures the Hakushu distillery in soft hues of verdant green, representing the forest surrounding the distillery. Our blenders work with peat while softening the palate using the exceptional mountain water of the area, filtered through ancient granite rocks. This creates a fresh and gently smoky single malt whisky, a true revelation in Japanese single malts that must be experienced.

TITLE: Suntory 100th Anniversary Hakushu 18 Years Old Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This centennial release of Hakushu 18 Year Old brings a new angle to peated whisky. Matured in a variety of casks, it is a fresh and gentle single malt with a softly smoky core that brings aromas of green apples, jasmine blossom and sweet peat smoke on the nose. The palate is filled with oven-fresh cookies and vanilla notes, with waves of lingering sweet smoke on the finish.

TITLE: Suntory 100th Anniversary Yamazaki 12 Year Old Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: 100th Anniversary Limited Edition Design. The Yamazaki 12 Years Old Single Malt is comprised of meticulously selected malt whiskies, all cask-aged aged for a minimum of 12 years. This special limited-edition bottling was created in honor of Suntory Whisky's centenary. Part of the Yamazaki family, Japan’s quintessential whisky, it is made in Japan’s first and oldest malt distillery, which was founded in 1923. Yamazaki means “mountain cape,” referencing its unique geographic location – secluded amongst forest-covered mountains. The bottle design pays tribute to Yamazaki, the birthplace of Japanese Whisky, captures this legendary distillery in deep copper tones, and reminds us always to honor the distillery's past.

TITLE: Suntory Haku Vodka
DESCRIPTION: The name Haku does not merely means “white” but celebrates the origin and the craft of this Premium Japanese Vodka. The naming Haku pays tribute to its origin “Hakumai” - 100% pure Japanese white rice, and craft of mastering a “Jyunpaku” – pure and brilliant Vodka carefully filtrated through bamboo charcoal for an unparalleled soft, round and subtly sweet taste.

TITLE: Suntory Hibiki "Japanese Harmony" Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Released in March 2015 Japanese Harmony is the latest release of the famous blended Whisky brand HIBIKI. Hibiki, meaning resonance in japanese, is a blend composed with the best single malts from Yamazaki and Hakushu aged in different types of casks and grain whiskies from Chita distillery. Hibiki blended Japanese whiskey, meaning resonance in Japanese, speaks to the soul and emotions of the most discerning whisky lover. Hibiki resonates from nature, and all the subtleties found from the twenty four seasons of the old Japanese lunar calendar. Numerous types of pure single malt whiskies ageing in various types of casks, including Mizunara oak, a very rare Japanese oak, all combine to create a full orchestra of flavors and aromas.

TITLE: Suntory Hibiki Harmony Blossom 2022 Limited Edition Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Founder of Suntory, Shinjiro Torii, decided to begin whisky-making with a passionate desire to "create a perfect whisky that reflects the nature of Japan and the spirit of Japanese craftsmanship." His decision led him to embark on the difficult business of authentic domestic whisky-making that no one had ever attempted at the time. The history of Suntory whisky and the history of Japanese whisky began by the fearless challenge undertaken Torii, who embarked on whisky-making after prevailing against the opposition he faced.

TITLE: Suntory Hibiki Whisky 12 Years Old
DESCRIPTION: Suntory Hibiki contains bourbon-aged malt from Hakushu, sherry casks from Yamazaki and grain whisky from the company’s Chita distillery. Intriguingly, a portion of the whiskies used have been aged in casks that used to hold Japanese plum liqueur.

TITLE: Suntory Hibiki Whisky 17 Years Old
Suntory Hibiki Whisky 17 Years Old
Suntory Hibiki Whisky 21 Years Old
DESCRIPTION: Full of Grace. Tenderly unfolding a calm essence. Color:bronze amber Nose:cooked fruit, blackberry, ripe banana, caramel Palate:sandalwood, honeycomb, dried apricot and Mizunara (Japanese oak) Finish:long, rich and incense

TITLE: Suntory Hibiki Whisky 21 Years Old Kacho Fugetsu
DESCRIPTION: This extremely rare limited edition version of the Hibiki 21-year-old Mount Fuji ‘Kacho Fugetsu’ whisky (translating to “Beauty of Japanese Nature”) is available only at selected airports around the world, making it one of the rarest whiskies available. Hibiki Bottles have 24 facets, representing 24 seasons of the Japanese lunar calendar. The Kacho Fugetsu limited edition also showcases a beautiful gold scenic print of Mount Fuji and the surrounding nature. Hibiki, meaning ‘harmony’, is blended from Suntory’s Japanese distilleries, however, the exact makeup of the whisky is a distillery secret. The end result is a magnificently balanced sipping whisky; rich, creamy, dark cherry and caramel on the palate, soft and sweet on the finish with a touch of smoke. The Hibiki 21 year old contains a high proportion of single malt in the blend (over 50%) with most of the aged material well above the declared 21 years. Jim Murray’s Whisky Bible describes it as “…hard to raise the bar much higher than this. Stunning.” “Unbelievably balanced, and dangerously drinkable” 96 points.

TITLE: Suntory Hibiki Whisky 30 Years Old
DESCRIPTION: Hibiki 30 Year Old is a distinguished and rare blend from Suntory, showcasing the art of Japanese whisky-making. This meticulously aged whisky embodies the essence of Japanese craftsmanship and tradition, offering a depth and complexity developed over three decades. Hibiki 30 Year Old is a testament to Suntory's mastery in blending, presenting an unparalleled experience in every sip.

TITLE: Suntory Roku Gin
DESCRIPTION: Roku Gin is the first premium Japanese craft gin in the Beam Suntory’s portfolio. Meaning “six” in Japanese, Roku incorporates six traditional Japanese botanicals infused, distilled and blended by the Japanese artisans of Suntory Spirits in Osaka, Japan. With history dating back to 1899, Suntory has earned its reputation as one of Japan’s most awarded spirits producers, mastering the skill of making gin since 1936.

TITLE: Suntory Toki Whisky
DESCRIPTION: It's a concept rich in meaning the world over, but particularly in Japan where respect for tradition and reinvention sparks a powerful creative energy. Inspired by that interplay, Suntory Whisky Toki brings together old and new -the House of Suntory's proud heritage and its innovative spirit- to create blended Japanese whisky that is both groundbreaking and timeless.

TITLE: Suntory Whisky for The Peninsula 2014 Blended Sherry Cask
DESCRIPTION: This special Suntory release was bottled in honor of The Peninsula in Tokyo, one of the finest hotels in the world. This sherry-matured bottling contains whisky from Yamazaki, Hakushu, and Chita. Package contains the bottle, a gift box, and a ribbon.

TITLE: Suntory Yamazaki 12 Year Old Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: One of the first Japanese single malts to break into the UK market, Suntory's Yamazaki 12-Year-Old continues to impress with its well-balanced fruity sweetness, something that appeals to novice and experienced whisky drinkers alike.

TITLE: Suntory Yamazaki 12 Year Old Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: One of the first Japanese single malts to break into the UK market, Suntory's Yamazaki 12-Year-Old continues to impress with its well-balanced fruity sweetness, something that appeals to novice and experienced whisky drinkers alike.

TITLE: Suntory Yamazaki 12 years single malt “Watami Founder's Choice”
DESCRIPTION: Suntory Yamazaki Distillery 12 years old single malt whisky. Yamazaki was the first Japanese distillery, established in 1923. The distillery is situated in the vale of Yamazaki, being an area of dense bamboo groves at the foot of Mt. Tennozan, outside Kyoto – Japan’s ancient capital and stronghold of traditional Japanese culture. This special exclusive release single malt comprising whiskies at least 12 years old was first released in 2008. It was made for restaurant chain president Miki Watanabe who presides over the Watami chain of casual Japanese restaurants, which have now expanded across Asia, including in China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, South Korea and Cambodia. It contains more sherry cask-matured whiskies than the standard Yamazaki 12, so expect some more red fruit notes than the tropical fruit notes of the standard 12-year-old.

TITLE: Suntory Yamazaki 18 Year Old Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Suntory Yamazaki 18 Year Old Single Malt Japanese Whisky is an iconic expression from Japan’s oldest whisky distillery, the Yamazaki Distillery, renowned for its mastery in whisky making. This prestigious single malt whisky has been aged for 18 years in a combination of American, Spanish, and Japanese Mizunara oak casks, resulting in a rich and complex flavor profile that has garnered numerous awards and acclaim. Bottled at 86 proof (43% ABV), Yamazaki 18 Year Old is a whisky of exceptional depth and character, offering a perfect balance of fruit, spice, and oak. It is a must-have for serious whisky collectors and connoisseurs who appreciate the finest in Japanese whisky craftsmanship.

TITLE: Suntory Yamazaki 25 Year Old Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Suntory Yamazaki 25 Year Old Single Malt Japanese Whisky is an exquisite expression from Japan’s oldest malt distillery, embodying decades of tradition, craftsmanship, and dedication to quality. Aged for a remarkable 25 years in carefully selected sherry and American oak casks, this single malt offers unparalleled depth and complexity. Known for its elegant character and rich flavors, it is highly regarded by connoisseurs worldwide. Bottled at 86 proof, it delivers a smooth, sophisticated profile, making it a prized collector’s item and an exceptional addition to any whiskey collection. Crafted at the iconic Yamazaki Distillery, this whisky represents the pinnacle of Japanese whisky-making, blending delicate floral notes with intense layers of fruit, oak, and spice. Each sip tells the story of masterful aging, offering a luxurious experience that reflects the precision and artistry Suntory is known for.

TITLE: Suntory Yamazaki Bourbon Barrel Japanese Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A bottle of Yamazaki Bourbon Barrel from the 2013 Cask Collection, the final year of the series. Aged in 180-liter casks which used to hold bourbon and matured in a warm moist climate resulting in an elegant and sweet Japanese whisky.

TITLE: Suntory Yamazaki Distiller's Reserve
DESCRIPTION: The Suntory Yamazaki Distiller's Reserve is a flagship single malt whiskey from Japan’s first and oldest malt distillery, the Yamazaki Distillery. Established in 1923 by founder Shinjiro Torii, the Yamazaki Distillery is renowned for its range of exceptional whiskies. This Distiller's Reserve variant is a testament to the distillery's mastery in blending, combining young talent whiskey matured in Bordeaux wine casks with about 20-year-old Sherry casks whiskey and whiskey from Mizunara oak casks. The result is a whiskey that resonates with the unique qualities of Japanese oak, offering a nuanced and layered taste experience.

TITLE: Suntory Yamazaki Golden Promise Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Suntory Yamazaki Golden Promise Single Malt Japanese Whisky is a rare and exceptional expression from Japan's oldest malt whisky distillery. Crafted at the renowned Yamazaki Distillery in Osaka, this whisky showcases the distillery's dedication to traditional craftsmanship and innovation. By utilizing Golden Promise barley—a premium barley variety revered for its rich and robust flavors—this single malt offers a unique and captivating tasting experience. The Golden Promise barley imparts a distinctive character to the whisky, contributing to a creamy texture and a complex flavor profile. Matured in a combination of American oak, Spanish oak, and Japanese Mizunara oak casks, this expression embodies the harmonious balance of sweet, fruity, and spicy notes that Yamazaki whiskies are celebrated for. Bottled at 86 proof, it delivers a smooth and elegant sip that appeals to both connoisseurs and newcomers alike.

TITLE: Suntory Yamazaki Limited Edition Single Malt Whisky 2023
DESCRIPTION: The Suntory Yamazaki Limited Edition Single Malt Whisky is a distinguished expression from Japan's oldest malt distillery, Yamazaki. This limited edition whisky captures the essence of Yamazaki’s innovative spirit and meticulous craftsmanship. Aged in a combination of American, Spanish, and Japanese Mizunara oak casks, this whisky showcases the depth and complexity that Yamazaki is renowned for.

TITLE: Suntory Yamazaki Mizunara 18 Years Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Japanese Mizunara wood is a highly sought after type of oak used for aging mainly Japanese whisky. It is also an extremely difficult wood to master, as its permeable character is less than ideal for cask-making, since liquid can easily seep through the wood. One of those who seems to get it, however, is Yamazaki, which is now unveiling another Mizunara-aged whisky. The new Yamazaki Mizunara Cask 2017 was aged for 18 years exclusively in Mizunara wood. For this whisky, Suntory’s fourth Chief Blender, Shinji Fukuyo, tasted a few hundred Mizunara whiskies and made selections of varying ages, starting from 18 years old. A very small portion exceed even 50 years of maturation. This latest Mizunara aged whisky is bottled at 96 proof. The bottle label on it is 100% handcrafted mulberry Echizen paper produced via a slow process of drying on wood boards (a traditional Japanese method). The wooden box that encloses the bottle is made of cask material used in the aging of Suntory whisky. It is also said that age is the key to unlocking good flavors from this oak. With many other cask types, whisky usually reaches a maturation peak at some point. But even at 50 years and beyond, Mizunara is believed by those who use it to generally still be improving in flavor.

TITLE: Suntory Yamazaki Puncheon Cask Japanese Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The 2013 Yamazaki Puncheon release, matured in a puncheon barrel which is much larger than a hogshead cask which only hold 230 litres. A puncheon can hold 480 litres! Being so much bigger the whisky matures a lot slower due to less contact with the wood.

TITLE: Suntory Yamazaki Single Malt Japanese Whisky Sherry Cask 2016 Edition
DESCRIPTION: With the 2013 release having been named World Whisky of the Year in Jim Murray's Whisky Bible 2015, this is a hugely anticipated release of Sherried Japanese whisky. Just 5,000 of these sought-after bottles will be available worldwide.

TITLE: Suze d'Autrefois
DESCRIPTION: Suze, among the oldest liqueurs in France, is an aperitif based on yellow gentian, hand-harvested in the mountains of Auvergne. The liqueur was created in 1889 by the Parisian distiller Fernand Moureaux. Suze grew quickly in popularity, and even made it into an early Picasso—“Verre et bouteille de Suze” (1912). Today, Suze is the fifth bestselling liqueur in France. Over the years, Suze gradually took on a somewhat sweeter, less herbal profile. Suze d’Autrefois, however, is modeled on the original 1889 recipe and carries with it a touch of Belle Epoque and Jazz Age Paris.

TITLE: Sv. Vicenco Island Red Lastovo
DESCRIPTION: This small production Croatian red packs quite the punch!

TITLE: Svedka Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Svedka is a 40% ABV vodka from Sweden. It is filtered with Charcoal. The vodka is produced by Constellation Brands and imported by Spirits Marque One, LLC. The quality is amazing. Svedka is among the few upper echelon vodkas priced for the lower part of the middle shelf. We don't know what will happen between now and 2033, but we do know that Svedka is a great vodka right now. We highly suggest giving Svedka a try.

TITLE: Svöl Swedish-Style Aquavit
DESCRIPTION: Svöl Swedish-Style Aquavit is a distinctive and artisanal spirit crafted in New York, USA, by the Svöl Distillery. Inspired by traditional Scandinavian aquavit, this spirit is made with a carefully selected blend of botanicals, including caraway, dill, and citrus, delivering a complex and aromatic profile that is both bold and refreshing. Svöl Swedish-Style Aquavit honors the classic flavors of aquavit while adding a modern twist, making it perfect for sipping neat, mixing in cocktails, or enjoying as part of a Scandinavian-inspired feast. This aquavit embodies the craftsmanship and creativity of its New York roots while paying homage to its Nordic heritage.

TITLE: Sweetdram Escubac Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: Bored of saturated gin markets and thirsty for something different to drink, Sweetdram created Escubac, a truly modern liqueur, which can be sipped like a nice whisky or mixed with tonic for a refreshing alternative to your stuffy, garden-variety G&T. Distilled using 14 aromatic botanicals, including caraway, cardamom, nutmeg and citrus. Developed over 18 months at our workshop in east London and distilled by the Sweetdram team at Distillerie Combier in France, on antique copper stills. Bottled at a very sippable 34% alc/vol.

TITLE: Sweetdram Moonshine Liqueur
DESCRIPTION: The inaugural release from the limited-edition series of collaborative liqueurs. Designed at the Sweetdram workshop in East London and produced at Kings County Distillery in Brooklyn, New York. The initial concept was simple: pay tribute to Kings County and the moonshine culture they champion—so rather than mask their white whiskey with synthetic flavorings and sugar, Sweetdram tried to complement it with a botanical-led recipe, where each ingredient has a particular purpose. Very limited quantities are available!

TITLE: Sweetens Cove 13 Years Tennessee Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Football player, tennis player, sports announcer, golf course, bourbon. This odd pairing came to be when Peyton Manning, Andy Roddick, Jim Nantz, and others became co-owners of the Tennessee golf course, Sweetens Cove. The course had a tradition of offering a complimentary shot of whiskey on the first hole. The new owners decided to take the tradition to a new level by offering their own blended bourbon to golfers. After purchasing 100 barrels of 13-year-old Tennessee bourbon, they hired Marianne Eaves, former Brown-Forman blender and Castle & Key distiller to blend their new bourbon. With so much bourbon in their possession, the team decided to offer a limited 14,000 bottle release in select markets. According to the company, five batches were created, but bottles won’t feature the batch number, instead of requiring the consumer to taste the difference between batches. With this being cask strength bourbon, there is a good chance differentiating proof between batches will signify which batch is which. Out of the 100 barrels, four barrels were deemed “too special” and will be reserved for a special release in 2020. Sweetens Cove Bourbon was released exclusively in Tennessee in May before expanding to more markets starting in June.

TITLE: Sweetens Cove 22 Tennessee Blended Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Sweetens 22, a blend of Tennessee bourbon finished in Scotch casks from Speyside. Features four different Tennessee expressions, aged 10, 8, 6, and 5 years, curated by Master Blender Marianne Eaves. It is a celebration of the lineage and journey of whiskey — and golf — from Scotland to Sweetens Cove. Each bottle top features a magnetic medallion that can be used as a ball mark. Age: Blend of 10, 8, 6 and 5-Year Bourbons Source: Tennessee Finish: Speyside Scotch Casks Proof: 114 proof

TITLE: Sweetens Cove Kennessee Kentucky & Tennessee Bourbon Whiskeys Finished With Toasted Sugar Maple Wood
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 93, #11 on the Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 ListThis blend of bourbons from Kentucky and Tennessee leads with vanilla pound cake, sweet cream, and breakfast pastries, balanced by some toasted oak and earthy over-steeped tea. With each sip, it shows evolution. The sweet, vanilla-led notes continue on the palate but grow in nuttiness and fruitiness, adding peanut butter and jelly, berry compote, and baking spice. While the whiskey leads with sweetness, it’s well balanced and offsets the sweet with tannic oak and black tea with milk.

TITLE: Sweetens Cove Tennessee Blended Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Discover the latest Tennessee Treasure from Sweetens Cove Spirits: a blend of straight Tennessee bourbons aged 4, 6, and 16 years. Master Blender Marianne Eaves hand-blended this limited edition 2021 release on the heels of Sweetens Cove’s stellar 2020 debut. At 113.7 proof, it has flavors of sweet toasted oak, apple peel, and vanilla caramel, followed by subtle, robust cooperage, brown sugar, and toffee, before finishing with a kick of dried citrus fruit and honey with a hint of clove on the back of the palate. Secretly discovered and now ready to be celebrated. Volunteer to Share.

TITLE: Swick "Bring It" Red Blend
DESCRIPTION: The Bring It red blend is always a representation of the vintage as a whole at Swick Wines. The 2021 harvest brought us some amazingly complex Pinot Noir from top-notch terroir that we used the base for this wine.

TITLE: Swick "Chillable Red"
DESCRIPTION: An eclectic mix of barrels that took their sweet time to finish primary fermentation — 22 months in barrel before being blended.

TITLE: Swick "The Flood"
DESCRIPTION: An Oregon/Washington blend of 5 different grape varieties. Skin was contacted for about month on all lots. A mix of sandy and volcanic soils.

TITLE: Swick Wines "Auxerrois"
DESCRIPTION: Auxerrois grown on volcanic soils from Eola-Amity Hills in the Oregon at 600 feet elevation. Grapes are fermented wholecluster with 30 days of skin maceration using native yeast. Ferments are worked by foot one to two times a day with no temp control then aged in a 600 liter neutral French oak barrel for six months. A small sulfur addition before bottling is the only addition to this wine. No filtration.

TITLE: Swick Wines "City Pop" Petillant Naturel
DESCRIPTION: Viognier grown on sandy loam from Yakima, Washington in the Columbia Valley at 1600 feet elevation. Gewürztraminer, Riesling, Auxerrois, Pinot Gris, and Pinot Noir from different sites grown on sandy loam, volcanic soils, and marine sediment from the Willamette Valley in the Oregon at 600-1000 feet elevation. Viognier and Pinot Noir were direct pressed and fermented separately using native yeast. Gewürztraminer, Riesling, Auxerrois, and Pinot Gris were fermented separately with 14 days of skin maceration using native yeast. Ferments are worked by foot one to two times a day with no temp control. Disgorged. A small sulfur addition before bottling is the only addition to this wine. No filtration.

TITLE: Swick Wines "P Chill" Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Pinot Noir grown on sandy loam from the Willamette Valley at 600 feet elevation. Grapes were macerated for five to seven days and fermented using native yeast then aged in a 228 liter neutral French oak barrel for six months. A small sulfur addition before bottling is the only addition to this wine. No filtration. “See you at the pool.” – Joe Swick, Swick Wines

TITLE: Swick Wines "Some Told World Roll" Rose Pet-Nat
DESCRIPTION: Mourvedre and Grenache Blanc grown on sandy loam from Yakima, Washington in the Columbia Valley at 1600 feet elevation. The Mourvèdre was direct pressed and fermented separately using native yeast in stainless steel. The Grenache Blanc fermented separately with 14 days of skin maceration using native yeast then pressed into stainless steel. Disgorged. A small sulfur addition before bottling is the only addition to this wine. No filtration.

TITLE: Swick Wines Albarino
DESCRIPTION: Grapes are hand-harvested and destemmed. The wine ferments on skins for 30 days. Foot stomped 1-2 times daily. Gently pressed and then rests until spring. Bottled unfiltered, lightly sulfured.

TITLE: Swick Wines Malbec "Cinq A Six" Columbia Valley
DESCRIPTION: 100% certified organic Malbec sourced from the Conley Vineyard in Yakima, Washington. Very lightly pressed, skirting the line between red and rose.

TITLE: Swick Wines Marsanne
Swick Wines Only Zuul
DESCRIPTION: The grapes are grown in Yakima, Washington, and Salem, Oregon. Swick Wines Only Zuul is fermented spontaneously, unfined, unfiltered, low sulfites.

TITLE: Swick Wines Rose of Pinot Noir Willamette Valley
DESCRIPTION: Made with organic grapes from the exquisite Cancilla vineyard, which is nestled under big sky and pine-studded mountains in the Willamette Valley. Gently pressed to avoid any grittiness and fermented and aged in barrel until bottling.

TITLE: Swick Wines Wyd? Columbia Valley
DESCRIPTION: Chardonnay grown on sandy loam from Yakima, Washington in the Columbia Valley at 1600 feet elevation. Grapes are direct pressed and fermented with native yeast. Ferments are worked by foot one to two times a day with no temp control then aged in neutral French oak barrels for eight months. A small sulfur addition before bottling is the only addition to this wine. No filtration.

TITLE: Sylvain Bailly La Louee Sancerre Rose
DESCRIPTION: Sylvain Bailly La Louée Sancerre Rosé enchants with its delicate pink hue and enticing aromas. It is a true reflection of the winemaker's passion and expertise, and a testament to the unique qualities of the Sancerre terroir. Sylvain Bailly La Louée Sancerre Rosé is a versatile wine that pairs beautifully with a variety of dishes. Its lively acidity and fruit-forward character make it an excellent companion to seafood, particularly grilled shrimp or salmon. It also complements lighter poultry dishes and fresh salads. For a delightful combination, pair it with creamy goat cheese or a tangy goat cheese tart. Let Sylvain Bailly La Louée Sancerre Rosé elevate your dining experience with its exquisite flavors and versatility.

TITLE: Sylvain Bailly Terroirs Sancerre
DESCRIPTION: Made with spontaneous fermentation and aged on the lees. This is beautiful example of a Sancerre wine, showing minerality and restrained fruit, making it an ideal food-friendly white wine.

TITLE: Sylvain Respaut Carbo Culte
DESCRIPTION: Hand-harvested Grenache and Syrah. Carbonic maceration. No fining, no filtering, no SO2.

TITLE: Szigeti "Gustav Klimt" Blanc de Blancs Brut
DESCRIPTION: Gustav Klimt Adele Blanc de Blancs Brut produced from 100% Chardonnay, is hand-harvested from growers in Burgenland. Alcoholic fermentation with Champagne yeasts in stainless steel tanks precedes second fermentation in bottle and forty-eight months en tirage. Riddling is by gyropalette, and the dosage is with local sweet wine. The portrait of Adele Bloch-Bauer on the label is from Klimt's golden phase. The painting lives today at the Neue Galerie in New York This Blanc de Blancs Brut will accent simply prepared fish and shellfish like the way a squeeze of lemon might. The citrus character of this wine will highlight the brininess of raw oysters, sushi, or grilled prawns while its acidity and texture perfectly compliment grilled halibut with lemon beurre blanc.

TITLE: Tablas Creek Vineyard Patelin de Tablas Blanc
DESCRIPTION: The Tablas Creek Vineyard Patelin de Tablas Blanc is a blend of four white Rhône varietals: Grenache Blanc, Viognier, Roussanne, and Marsanne. The wine incorporates fruit from eight top Rhone vineyards in Paso Robles, each vineyard selected for its quality. Like many white wines from the Southern Rhône, it is based on the crisp acids and rich mouthfeel of Grenache Blanc, with Viognier added for floral, tropical aromatics, and small additions of Roussanne and Marsanne for structure. The 2012 vintage was a classic Paso Robles vintage, warm and sunny, but with above-average yields thanks to average winter rainfall and the frost-reduced 2011 crop. Despite the warm summer, ripening was slowed due to the healthy crop levels, and harvest at a normal time under ideal conditions, starting in early September and finishing in late October. All varietals for the Patelin de Tablas Blanc were whole cluster pressed, and fermented in stainless steel to emphasize the clean crisp flavors and preserve the aromatics. Only native yeasts were used. After fermentation, the wines were racked and blended, and bottled in July 2013. Best paired with: Seafood cooked with garlic and white wine Green salads with avocado and citrus dressing Lemon chicken Scallops Light-fleshed fish with tropical salsa

TITLE: Tablelands Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Pair with fish, chicken, artichoke, asparagus, herb sauces, salads dressed with light vinaigrette.

TITLE: Taconic Distillery "The Mythical Mizunara" Collaboration Dutchess Private Reserve Straight Bourbon Whiskey Mizunara Cask Finish
DESCRIPTION: There's no secret how fascinating Mizunara can be. From its debut on the whiskey scene in 2020, it reached an exciting level of hype that seemed to vanish when Mizunara barrels were revealed to be some of the whiskey's most troubling finishing casks. Expensive, difficult to work with, and prone to leaks, it's no secret many producers didn't find them to be the cash cow they hoped, especially after a leak sprung precious whiskey all over the warehouse. Taconic stuck through the issues and delivered a select few Mizu releases to the market. Bold black tea, sandalwood, pepper, and a touch of cedar join Taconic's big, bold, malty base bourbon that picks up great tannin and complexity during initial maturation. The Mizunara is distinct but not overbearing; nuanced but never overshadowed. The selection is one of two barrels picked collaboratively by The Prime Barrel & t8ke from R/Bourbon Barrel info: Mashbill: 70% Corn | 25% Rye | 5% Malted Barley Char Level: Char 3 Cooperage: Independent Stave Cooper Select Barrels Aging: 4 ½ Years Primary 6 Months Secondary in the Finishing Barrel Here's what you can look forward to with this particular selection: Nose: Toasted oak, green apple, baking spice, cinnamon, pie crust, crushed almonds, orange peel, and tobacco Palate: Peppercorn, baked red cherries, and leather Finish: Slightly smoky finish with notes of honey, coffee, and nuts

TITLE: Taconic Distillery "The Ported Paragon" Collaboration Dutchess Private Reserve Straight Bourbon Whiskey Port Barrel Finish
DESCRIPTION: Bold brown sugar and caramelized sugar sweetness meet rich baking spice and clove. Jammy undertones are immediately apparent, splitting staff with the addition of a touch of pepper and funky spice. Currant, blackberry, a touch of cherry, and cocoa mix nicely for a complex, palate-first whiskey. The proof on these always brings a satisfying palate viscosity and a long, barrel-driven finish. The selection is one of two barrels picked collaboratively by The Prime Barrel & t8ke from R/Bourbon. Barrel info: Mashbill: 70% Corn | 25% Rye | 5% Malted Barley Char Level: Char 3 Cooperage: Independent Stave Cooper Select Barrels Aging: 4 ½ Years Primary 6 Months Secondary in the Finishing Barrel

TITLE: Taconic Distillery 10th Anniversary 2024 Limited Edition Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Celebrating a decade of distillation, Taconic Distillery proudly introduces the 10th Anniversary 2024 Limited Edition Straight Bourbon. Distilled in the picturesque Hudson Valley of New York, this special release embodies the distillery's commitment to crafting fine spirits that reflect the region's natural beauty and the rugged spirit of the outdoors. Bottled at an impressive 100 proof, this bourbon has been carefully aged in new charred American Oak barrels to achieve a rich amber hue and a depth of flavor that strikes the perfect balance between the complexity imparted by the barrel and the spirit’s vibrant character.

TITLE: Taconic Distillery Barrel Strength Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This Taconic Distillery's straight bourbon whiskey bottled at barrel strength (115 proof) offers more robust flavor and is an excellent foundation for cocktails. At 57.5% abv, it still has a rather sweet nose, with corn and cereal grain, as well as vanilla. The higher proof also provides a heightened dose of caramel and butterscotch on the palate. The finish is long, bold and warm with lingering notes of spice and candied fruit. Aged a minimum of two years in New oak, char 3, Coopers Select, 53-gallon Independent Stave Company barrels.

TITLE: Taconic Distillery Cask Strength Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Even as young rye, there is a unique smoothness and sweetness to this 115 proof spirit. A touch of our limestone-rich, artisanal water imparts an extra sweet and buttery layer. Even at 115 proof, there's a velvety foundation of nutmeg and clove that help to support a bold but smooth finish. Rye lovers will appreciate the warm, spicy notes that contrast well with the mild, sweet notes on the back palate. Cask Strength is perfectly nice and neat or as a cocktail base. Aged a minimum of two years in New oak, char 3, Coope Select, 53-gallon Independent Stave Company barrels. Taconic water is brought to the surface through a rich deposit of Dolostone. Similar to limestone, Dolostone is rich in calcium carbonate and magnesium. These minerals help to impart another layer of rich butteriness found in Taconic Distillery spirits

TITLE: Taconic Distillery Double Barrel Maple Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This unique double-barrel bourbon produces just a hint of maple syrup sweetness. The result is a slightly sweet buttery flavor that is unmistakable. You can drink this bourbon nice and neat or drawn up in your favorite cold-weather cocktail. Comes in two expressions: 90 Proof and 115 Proof (cask strength).Fun fact: Double Barrel Maple Bourbon Whiskey is the product of a relationship with Catskill Mountain Sugarhouse. Guys at Taconic empty their Bourbon barrels then send them to Catskill Mountain Sugarhouse who fills them with their delicious maple syrup. After a few months of aging, they bottle the barrel-aged maple syrup. Taconic Distillery then immediately refills those same barrels with bourbon. This sweet and floral whiskey spends another few months in the barrels to become the annual release of Double Barrel Bourbon Whiskey with Maple Syrup.

TITLE: Taconic Distillery Dutchess Private Reserve American Flag Special Edition Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Adorned with a very patriotic label, this Dutchess Private Reserve bourbon offers a rather sweet nose, with corn and cereal grain, as well as vanilla. On the palate, you’ll find a bourbon made for sipping, eminently enjoyable and easygoing. Very smooth, with more vanilla, honey, and malty sweetness. The finish is pleasant and warm, lingering without overstaying its welcome. The bourbon is very consistent throughout. Add ice and the bourbon becomes chewier, with more pronounced grain flavors and a shorter, sharper finish. Made with Taconic water, which is brought to the surface through a rich deposit of Dolostone. Similar to limestone, Dolostone is rich in calcium carbonate and magnesium. These minerals help to impart another layer of rich butteriness found in their spirits. Aged a minimum of two years in New oak, char 3, Coopers Select, 53-gallon Independent Stave Company barrels.

TITLE: Taconic Distillery Dutchess Private Reserve Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This award-winning bourbon is subtle and sophisticated. A beautiful bouquet of spice and honey with gentle notes of vanilla that provide for a smooth finish.

TITLE: Taconic Distillery Dutchess Private Reserve Straight Bourbon Whiskey 2024 Holiday Edition
DESCRIPTION: Taconic Distillery presents a new seasonal edition of its award-winning Dutchess Private Reserve, just in time for the holidays. Selected from their oldest barrels, a beautiful bouquet of spice and honey with gentle notes of vanilla comes out to provide a smooth finish. Aged a minimum of 5 years in new charred American Oak barrels at 100 proof.

TITLE: Taconic Distillery Dutchess Private Reserve Straight Bourbon Whiskey Cabernet Cask Finish
DESCRIPTION: Taconic Distillery's Dutchess Private Reserve is crafted in small batches using only the finest ingredients including fresh spring water from Rolling Hills Farm in historic Hudson Valley, New York. This Dutchess Private Reserve Bourbon from Taconic finished an additional 6-months in Napa Cabernet wine casks.

TITLE: Taconic Distillery Dutchess Private Reserve Straight Bourbon Whiskey Mizunara Cask Finish
DESCRIPTION: Taconic ages their best bourbon in new American oak and then finishes it in a Mizunara cask - a unique process which takes an additional 6 months of aging. The spectacular result is a subtle and smooth bourbon, with aromas of toasted wood and nutmeg. On the palate lie flavors of sweet vanilla, caramel and baking spices with a touch more smoothness than any other bourbon out there.

TITLE: Taconic Distillery Founder's Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Named for our country's founding fathers, Taconic Distillery's Founder's Rye Whiskey is aged in virgin American white oak barrels to a golden caramel color. Rye lovers will appreciate its bold, spicy flavor with a mildly sweet finish. Delicious in cocktails and decidedly smooth when sipped neat or on the rocks.

TITLE: Taconic Distillery Founder's Rye Whiskey Madeira Cask Finish
DESCRIPTION: Named for our country's founding fathers, Taconic Distillery's Founder's Rye Whiskey is aged in virgin American white oak barrels to a golden caramel color. Rye lovers will appreciate its bold, spicy flavor with a mildly sweet finish. Delicious in cocktails and decidedly smooth when sipped neat or on the rocks. Madeira's finish gives it a unique character unlike anything else in the distillery's lineup.

TITLE: Taconic Distillery Fox and Hare Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Single barrel straight rye whiskey from the Taconic Distillery. Barreled at 125 proof.

TITLE: Taconic Distillery Rolling Hills Hazmat "Rum DMC" Single Barrel Rum The Prime Barrel Pick #99
DESCRIPTION: Introducing Taconic Distillery Rolling Hills "Rum DMC" Rum, The Prime Barrel Pick #99 – a game-changing rum that defies expectations and expands palates. While The Prime Barrel Club is known for its exceptional whiskey selections, this limited-edition rum challenges the norm, delivering a flavor profile so complex that even seasoned whiskey drinkers might mistake it for a well-aged bourbon. Aged in Upstate New York after beginning its journey in the Caribbean, this Florida Caribbean rum spent time in Taconic Distillery barrels, resulting in a 146-proof (Hazmat!) spirit that drinks smoother than its strength would suggest. Expect to find notes of maraschino cherries, pecans, and maple syrup on the nose, with hints of tropical fruits like ripe pineapple and honeydew melon, mingled with the comforting vanilla and caramel you'd associate with bourbon. On the palate, waves of flavor unfold, from baking spices to Werther's candy, with a finish that lingers for minutes, offering charred oak, charred pineapple, nutmeg, and white pepper. This rum isn't just for rum lovers – it's a whiskey drinker's rum, perfect for those who want to explore something new without straying too far from the familiar. Whether you're celebrating National Rum Day or simply looking to add something unique to your collection, "Rum DMC" is a must-try. And don’t just take our word for it – our team members who tasted it blind swore it was a bourbon with a twist, proving just how versatile and deceptive this rum can be. Grab your bottle today and experience the rum that even non-rum fans are falling in love with! Tasting Notes: Nose: Maraschino cherries, pecans, maple syrup, rosemary, plums, fresh pineapple, honeydew melon, vanilla, caramel. Palate: Baking spices, tropical fruits, Werther’s candy, sweet oak, complex and evolving flavors. Finish: Long-lasting, warming, charred oak, pineapple, nutmeg, white pepper. Celebrate National Rum Day with a bottle of "Rum DMC" – where rum meets whiskey in perfect harmony.

TITLE: Taconic Distillery Wheated Bourbon Whiskey
Taconic Distillery “Man’s Best Friend” Dutchess Private Reserve  Cognac Cask Finish Straight Bourbon The Prime Barrel Pick #15
DESCRIPTION: Taconic Distillery, located in New York's lush Hudson Valley, was established in 2013. Its founders hoped to bring the spirit of the region's hunting, fishing, and outdoor lifestyle to their entire whiskey-making process. The company calls their products "farm-to-bottle" whiskeys, utilizing locally sourced Hudson Valley grains and water from the distillery's on-premise natural spring. In the fall of 2016, Taconic finished construction and opened its new 4,200 square foot distillery, allowing them to produce, bottle, and package their whiskey in one place. Their tasting room allows visitors to sample their whiskey. Still, more interestingly, it also allows visitors to taste many other distilleries' whiskeys in hopes of providing a greater understanding of the wealth of different whiskeys on the market. About a couple of months ago, we received a call from the distillery owner who said he had a nice batch of barrels for us to taste. So we saddled up and took a drive upstate to the distillery. Upon arrival, we were given a proper tour of the distillery (check out our Instagram account for more) and then presented with a few barrels to taste. While Taconic's straight bourbon and rye whiskeys are available in cask strength varieties, our taste buds were drawn to a different selection. One of the samples we were tasting was dumped earlier that day. Inexplicably, the whiskey was cut to 90 Proof, and…was easily the best tasting one of the bunch! The cognac influence on the bourbon was subtle enough not to overpower it yet delicate enough to give it more complexity and ultimately made it a much more delicious whiskey. As with any other selections we make, taste trumps everything else. Usually, we would stay away from lower-proof stuff, but this one was a no-brainer. At 90 proof, it will make a great, easy-going sipper that will be gone before you know it. This is a 4.5 years old whiskey that was then additionally finished in the cognac cask for 8 months. Mashbill is 70% corn / 25% Rye / 5% Barley. Here's what you can expect from this selection: NOSE: Dried raisins, ripe grapes, cracked vanilla bean, toasted coconut, coconut macaroons, honey, and orange peel. PALATE: The cognac finish influence is quite prominent yet well balanced as it coats the tongue with raisins, figs, and dark berries and gradually transitions into butterscotch, cinnamon, toasted pecans, pipe tobacco, and oak. FINISH: Medium-to-long finish with lingering warmth and rich sweetness. For the sticker, we were inspired by Brandy Cask carrying Saint Bernards. As the myth goes, the brandy barrels have been tied around the necks of Saint Bernards that served as rescue dogs in the Alps. Upon finding wayward skiers, the small brandy cask offered a small solace to the rescuee while he was waiting for more support to arrive. With American foxhound being a mascot of the distillery (we some them on grounds as well!), we switched things up a bit. We used an American Foxhound on a sticker with a cognac cask around its' neck, with a beautiful foliage season Upstate NY scenery in the background. The selection's title, "Man's Best Friend," can be equally attributed to dogs and bourbon, depending on who you ask. The charity this barrel selection will be supporting is the Tunnel Towers Foundation, and donations will go to show our gratitude for the sacrifices and service of the U.S. Armed Services returning from war who have been catastrophically injured by building smart technology homes so they can regain their independence. Donation Amount: $5 from each bottle sold

TITLE: Taft Street Winery Russian River Valley Chardonnay
DESCRIPTION: 80% of the Chardonnay was barrel fermented in Damy French oak barrels. The wine was aged nine months Sur Lie and 30% of the barrel fermented wine underwent malolactic fermentation. Taft Street sourced local, well known Russian River Valley vineyards for this wine: Clone 17 from Saralee Kundee’s Catie’s Corner; Clone 4 & 809 from Hopkins Vineyards; and Clone 4 & 17 from Vino Farms’ Airport Vineyard and Art Ibleto’s Bella Sonoma vineyard. 2014 vintage conditions were similar to 2013, a long growing season with moderate weather provided added hang time for the fruit to develop ripe flavors. A mild winter and spring without frost led to crisper wines with higher acidity. The wine was aged in French oak, 10% new.

TITLE: Taiheizan Tenko Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: This is a layered and complex sake that retains the elegance of a daiginjo but can pair with a more versatile range of food.

TITLE: Taittinger Champagne Brut Cuvee Prestige
DESCRIPTION: Champagne Taittinger is one of the few remaining family owned and operated Champagne houses. The firm is distinguished for its extensive vineyard holdings of 752 acres, including prestigious Grand Cru vineyards in the Cote des Blancs and Montagne de Reims regions. Unlike most large houses, Champagne Taittinger relies primarily on estate grapes for its portfolio of Champagnes. Also unique are the higher proportion of Chardonnay in its wines that gives Taittinger its signature style, and the time devoted to aging the wines before release-most often greatly exceeding the legal requirement, in a practice that also has become a Taittinger hallmark.

TITLE: Taka Noble Arrow Tokubetsu Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Taka’s estate rice growing philosophy cultivates regionally focused sake full of tension and balance. President/Toji Takahiro Nagayama is passionate about his estate grower-producer style sake, allowing him to brew sake that represents his personality and to reach all the people who drink it. He is passionate about the concept of "terroir" and worked with Philippe Pacalet in Burgundy falling in love with Chablis in particular and the interplay of limestone and its influence on wine. With this in mind he cultivates his rice on limestone rich soils and sources limestone rich spring water to brew his sake. “Taka” is the first character of Takahiro-san’s name and means “noble.” His unwavering discipline and commitment to technical precision result in elegant but restrained sake.

TITLE: Takaisami Hiyaoroshi Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: It is earthy, mildly grassy with subtle nuances of sticky rice, salted caramel, and dried fruit.
