Talisker 10 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A classic Island dram from the Isle of Skye. Always highly rated, this was an Editor's Choice at Whisky Magazine. Lots of spice and fresh, tangy peat.

TITLE: Talisker 11 Years "2022 Special Release" Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: APPEARANCE Deep, glowing gold. BODY Medium. NOSE Maritime in feel, with light spice-prickle, the first impression suggests a beach bonfire of dry seaweed, then deep-seated notes of maritime saltiness and marine engines take over, on a base of drying fresh linen. All these scents hold together well at reduced strength. PALATE Smoothly oily in texture, while the taste is gloriously sweet throughout and smoky-spicy, with a distinct fruity hint, all of which evokes an orchard seen through smoke and sea mist. A fine salty balance in the middle leads the spiciness on into a powerful chili pepper catch as you swallow. With a drop of water, the sweet fruitiness and saltiness come into their own. FINISH Long, sustained and lightly smoky, with lingering warming spice.

TITLE: Talisker 1976 Prima & Ultima 46 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Embark on a journey through time with the Talisker 1976 Prima & Ultima, a 46-year-old Single Malt Scotch Whisky from the Isle of Skye. This historical release, the oldest from Talisker Distillery, is a testament to a once-in-a-lifetime Scottish heatwave in 1976 that intensified the copper contact during distillation, yielding an extraordinary whisky. Matured in a blend of three refill American oak hogshead and European oak butts, and finally married in European oak puncheons, only 771 bottles of this exclusive whisky were produced. This rarity represents a remarkable chapter in Talisker's storied legacy, capturing the essence of the distillery's unique character.

TITLE: Talisker 25 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Produced at the oldest distillery on the Isle of Skye, Talisker Single Malt Scotch Whisky has been made by the sea since 1830, with its smell and taste instantly connecting you to its rugged maritime home. Every sip is a taste of the Isle of Skye itself, one of the most remote, windswept yet beautiful landscapes in Scotland. A beautifully structured Talisker, this rare 25-year-old single malt has great depth and is full of vibrant but mellow character. This elegant expression of Talisker is reminiscent of much older drams. A rare limited release like Talisker 25 Year Old makes a memorable and special gift for whisky connoisseurs and lovers of smoky island single malt whiskies.

TITLE: Talisker 30 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Experience the tale told by the tides with Talisker 30 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky. This mild-mannered and more mature whisky boasts an immediately smoky taste with notes of dry, creamy oak and almond milk. Medium bodied, its finish is long and gently warming with a lingering maritime aftertaste and a white pepper tingle on the tongue. Distilled by the sea on the shores of the Isle of Skye in Scotland, centuries of local distilling tradition and the rugged environment are what make our whisky so unique. A rich and smooth Talisker should be enjoyed in a rocks glass, neat or with a little water. Includes one 97 proof 750 mL bottle of Talisker 30 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky.

TITLE: Talisker 37 Year Old 1984 Prima & Ultima Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Taken from the very last 1984 casks from Talisker, set aside and guarded for decades for their promising potential. At the time few knew of Talisker’s tempestuous maritime character, but there was something special about these 1984 casks that made the distiller set them aside. The nose gives immediate light smoky notes, joined by fine sand and seaweed drying on a hot day. The lightly oily texture is sweet and rich to start, with thunder rolling in shortly after, leaving a mighty peppery kick. It is Skye in all its elemental glory.

TITLE: Talisker 43 Years Old Xpedition Oak The Atlantic Challenge Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: In 1830, the MacAskill brothers rowed across the Atlantic from the Isle of Eigg to the formidable shores of the Isle of Skye. There they ended one adventure and began another - Talisker. The Talisker Xpedition Oak series is a new adventure entirely: a whisky shaped by nature. The series was born to celebrate wild whisky making with a collection of rare aged single malt scotches that have been shaped by the natural elements - finished in casks including staves that have been on a wilderness journey to reveal a truly rare and unique whisky. Talisker staves have travelled with renowned adventurist, James Aiken as he single-handedly traversed the same route travelled by the rowers of the exhilarating Talisker Whisky Atlantic Challenge – the premier event in ocean rowing that sees competitors race across more 3000 miles of untamed sea – from La Gomera, Canary Islands, to Antigua. After being aged for over 4 decades, the Talisker 43yr Xpedition Oak was finally finished in 10 casks, each of which included a few staves that traversed the harsh and beautiful elements of the Atlantic with wild spirit James Aiken – this is Talisker’s finest expression of Made by the Sea to date.

TITLE: Talisker Distillers Edition Single Malt Scotch Whisky 2020
DESCRIPTION: Relish the richly rewarding and deeper style of Talisker Distillers Edition 2020 Bottling Single Malt Scotch Whisky. Double-matured in ex-bodega Amoroso cask wood, this 10-year-old whisky offers a wonderful aroma of grapey sultana sweetness. Distilled in 2010 and bottled in 2020, this full-bodied Scotch features crisp peat that wafts around the sweet, roasted malt, leaving a heathland dryness alongside hints of wood and pepper. The finish is filled with deep cocoa, vanilla, and lingering, earthy peat for a sweet-dry balance. Includes one 91.6 proof 750 mL bottle of Distillers Edition 2020 Bottling Single Malt Scotch Whisky.

Distilled in 2010 and bottled in 2020, this full-bodied Scotch features crisp peat that wafts around the sweet, roasted malt, leaving a heathland dryness alongside hints of wood and pepper. The finish is filled with deep cocoa, vanilla, and lingering, earthy peat for a sweet-dry balance. Includes one 91.6 proof 750 mL bottle of Distillers Edition 2020 Bottling Single Malt Scotch Whisky.

TITLE: Tamano Hikari Hiyaoroshi Junmai Ginjo
DESCRIPTION: Hiyaoroshi from Tamanohikari Brewery is a scrumptious seasonal treat. Using 100% premium quality sake rice from Kyoto, Hiyaoroshi is aged in the coolest part of the brewery from the beginning of summer until the cooler fall season. Yakitori, Steak, Hotpot "Nabe"

TITLE: Tamanohikari Reishu Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Product information Freezer-proof packaged for sake slush. Place and decanter in freezer set at 10 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 hours. Open the package and quickly pour into a frozen decanter for a magical transformation into a sake slush. Great for cocktails. Producer information The TAMANOHIKARI brewery (now the TAMANOHIKARI Sake Brewing Corporation) was founded by Rokuzaemon Nakaya in 1673. Thanks to three centuries of customer satisfaction, it has earned a reputation as one of the top Sakemakers in Japan. The word TAMANOHIKARI was originally associated with the Hayatama Shrine which, according to legend, was dedicated to the Sun Goddess. "Tama" signifies the polished gem and the spirit of the goddess, and "Hikari" stands for "brilliance and prosperity" TAMANOHIKARI Sake first won the hearts of sophisticated gourmets of Kyoto, the city that was the capital of Japan for more than 1000 years, and now it is pleasing the palates of Sake connoisseurs all over the country.

TITLE: Tamanohikari Tokusen Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Tamano Hikari Brewery draws out the umami from their rice in this slightly acidic sake in order to best draw out the flavor of the raw ingredients. Boasts a subtle flavor and aroma, and a clean finish.

TITLE: Tamdhu Sherry Butt 8 yrs Speyside Cask Strength Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky

A dependable means of travel was, at last, brought to the area and several distilleries were built as a result. Tamdhu was one of them; founded in 1896 by a group of whisky blenders, including William Grant and Sons among others, and designed by the famed, prolific Speyside distillery architect, Charles Doig of Elgin. DESCRIPTION: Tami is made by Arianna Occhipinti in Vittoria Sicily, near the south west coast, across the island from Syracuse. Arianna Occhipinti began leaning about wine when she was a teenager, studied wine making in university, but dropped out because she disagreed with the industrial methods of her professors. 100% Nero d’Avola. While Nero is generally considered to be deeper, darker and more rustic than it’s neighbor Frappato, this is a bright and lighter style.

TITLE: Tapatio Tequila Blanco
DESCRIPTION: Don Felipe Camarena's family has been distilling tequila since the early 1800's. When the family's original distillery was destroyed and abandoned during the Mexican Revolution, Don Felipe turned to growing and selling agave plants from the highland region to other tequila producers. In 1937, Don Felipe opened La Altena Distiller in the mountainous region of Jalisco, Mexico. His passion inspired his family to continue handcrafting Tapatio, which means people or family from Gaudalaraja, so it could be enjoyed by future generations. The spirit from La Altena is the only 100% blue agave tequila double distilled at 80 proof and bottled without any additional water. The methods of production are the same as they were a century ago, with a large stone wheel (known as tahona) turned in a pit to crush the cooked agave plants. The juice and agave fibers are then mixed in a barrel by foot before fermentation and distillation. Don Felipe passed the business to his son, Felipe J. Camarena Orozco, who in turn passed it on to his daughters, Lilianna and Gabriela, and to his son, Carlos, who today, as Master Distiller, maintains the standards of excellence set down by his grandfather, Don Felipe. This classic Blanco was produced from 100% blue agave from the highlands. Using tahona in the production process increases contact of fiber with the juice which gives the tequila a stronger agave character. After distillation, the spirit rests for a few weeks in steel tanks before bottling.

TITLE: Tatenokawa "Phoenix" Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Tatenokawa Shuzo's Masashi Togami and the Grammy Award-winning French rock/pop band Phoenix decided to collaborate out of respect and gratitude to honor the late Mr. Toshiro Kuroda who spent many years working hard to promote sake in Europe. Christian Mazzalai who spearheaded the project stated that “Mr. Kuroda was a great master who taught all the beauties of life which include sake, and is still inspiring us every day. "A portion of sales from the sake will be donated to the Japanese Red Cross Society to support the progression of medical technology. Soft Shell Crab, Sukiyaki, Yuzu Tart, Foie Gras, Lightly Salted Seared Wagyu, Sichuan Style Lamb

TITLE: Tatenokawa Tatenyan Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Named after the brewer’s kitten, an easy drinking Junmai Daiginjo that is semi-dry, with a mild flavour that will pair well with many cuisines.

TITLE: Tatenokawa x Foo Fighters  Hanasho Silver Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: This Junmai Daiginjo sake was created to commemorate the 25th anniversary of the Foo Fighters and the release of their 10th album "Medicine At Midnight". This HANSHO Silver was brewed while listening to the music of the Foo Fighters. The band's rock aspect served as an inspiration to create a heavy and expressive flavor with a sharp aftertaste. It has a well-structured mouthfeel and a dignified appearance. Please enjoy it to the music of the Foo Fighters!!

TITLE: Tatenokawa x Foo Fighters Hanasho Blue Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: This Junmai Daiginjo sake was created to commemorate the 25th anniversary of the Foo Fighters and the release of their 10th album "Medicine At Midnight". This HANSHO Blue was brewed while listening to the music of the Foo Fighters. Inspired by the pop aspects of their sound, it has a gorgeous aroma and a light sweetness. Just sweet enough to drink after a long day and let the flabors wash over and into you. Please enjoy it to the music of the Foo Fighters!!

TITLE: Tateyama Tokubetsu Honjozo Sake
DESCRIPTION: This is a quality tokubetsu honjozoshu which is crisp and refreshing, and at the same time, reasonably rich, clean and elegant.

TITLE: Tavignano Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi Classico Superiore Villatorre
DESCRIPTION: Tenuta Tavignano is located in Cingoli, a small, hilltop city situated in the Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi appellation of Italy. Owners Beatrice Lucangeli and Stefano Aymerich bought this 568 acre property in 1992 and over the next three years planted 37 acres with Verdicchio, 24 acres to Montepulciano and 12 acres to Sangiovese. The vines were planted at 2,070 feet on medium textured, loose clay based soils and are farmed in a sustainable manner. Agronomist Dr. Pierluigi Lorenzetti and oenologists Dr. Pierluigi Lorenzetti and Dr. Giulio Piazzini guide the development of the wines. Pairs well with herby pasta sauces like pesto, white fish or vegetable dishes.

TITLE: Teaninich 11 yrs Unchillfiltered Signatory Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Teaninich bottlings are quite rare, because much of the whisky produced there goes into blends. They are well worth seeking out, however, just like this 10-year-old bottling from Signatory Vintage. Aged in a pair of bourbon hogsheads, this was bottled in March 2018 at a strength of 46% ABV.

TITLE: Tears of Llorona Extra Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Tears of Llorona is a rare, small-batch, extra añejo Tequila, aged five years in oak barrels that have previously held scotch, sherry, and brandy. This unique triple barreling and extra-long aging create a complex, layered fusion that is more like a cognac or a very old whiskey, yet it retains clear agave notes. Master Distiller Germán Gonzalez harvests only high altitude, late-season blue agaves from the volcanoes in Jalisco, known for their high sugar content. Germán Gonzalez is considered by aficionados and critics to be one of the best master tequileros alive. Making tequila has been a generational family passion for Germán. He was taught his craft by his father, Guillermo Gonzalez Diaz Lombardo, with whom he worked on what is now considered the first true super-premium tequila to be imported to the United States -- the Chinaco tequila from early 1990's fame --, as well as the inspiration for today's hand, crafted tequilas. Germán's father was taught by his father, and so on, going back generations. Indeed, if you go back through Germán's direct family line, you arrive at General Manuel Gonzalez, President of Mexico 1880 to 1884. In fact, General Gonzalez is one of the more compelling figures in Mexican history. His role in the events of May 5, 1862 -- yes, that's Cinco de Mayo -- are the stuff of legend and its significance to Germán and to Tears of Llorona are depicted below.

TITLE: Teeling "Blackpitts" Peated Irish Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Peated whiskey is an ancient Irish style, but it’s harder to make than you might think. Teeling’s master distiller Alex Chasko ascertained that only malt as heavily peated as Ardbeg’s would enable the peaty flavors to withstand the large fraction eliminated by triple distillation. That decision delivers a superb subtle smokiness, which when put together with bourbon and sauternes casks creates a moreish whiskey alive with orchard fruit, panna cotta, and sweet floral notes, plus tangy marmalade and peppery spice. As distillers in Ireland dig deeper into peaty whiskey, you can bet on this bottle of smoke to make your day. 6,000 bottles released for the US.

TITLE: Teeling 24 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Limited to just 5,000 bottles, the Teeling Whiskey Company is proud to introduce this special release of some of the oldest Irish Single Malt in the world. Matured initially in Bourbon casks before being given an additional maturation in ex-Sauternes wine barrels, imparting a distinctly unique flavour. Bottled at 46% with no chill filtration completing a whiskey of true character. Awarded World’s Best Irish Single Malt, 2016 at the World Whiskies Awards, this is a whiskey to savour.

TITLE: Teeling 29 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Teeling 29 Year Single Malt Irish Whiskey is a well-aged, well-crafted expression offering a wonderful blend of sweet and fruity flavors that make it perfect for slow sipping whether neat or on the rocks. Distilled in 1989 at the Cooley Distillery from a blend of malted and unmalted barley, the whiskey is initially aged in ex-rum casks for 27 long years to create its sweet and spicy character. After this initial beauty rest, it is then transferred to casks which previously held Pedro Ximénez sherry and was used in a solera to finish for two years picking up a succulent fruity taste along the way before being finally brought to proof using pure water and bottled. A limited US release of just 100 bottles, the Teeling 29 Year Single Malt Irish Whiskey is very embodiment of rarity making it a worthy addition to your prized collection. So pick up a bottle for yourself today while you still can and be a proud owner of this fine piece of Irish craftsmanship. 46% ABV or 92 Proof Aged for 27 years in ex-rum and finished for 2 years in ex-Pedro Ximénez sherry solera barrels Limited US release of only 100 bottles

TITLE: Teeling 30 Years Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Teeling Whiskey Company is proud to introduce this special release of some of the oldest Irish Single Malt in the world. Matured initially in Bourbon casks before being given an additional maturation in ex-Sauternes wine barrels, imparting a distinctly unique flavour. Limited to 4,000 bottles per batch and bottled at 46% with no chill filtration completing a whiskey of true character. Building on the major international success of the 24 Year Old Single Malt which one World’s Best Single Malt at the World Whiskies Awards 2019 and the Teeling 28 Year Old Single Malt which won World’s Best Irish Single Malt at the 2021 World Whiskies Awards, we are proud to present the Teeling 30 Year Old Single Malt.

TITLE: Teeling 34 Year Old Single Malt Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Teeling 34-Year-Old Single Malt bottling consists of some of the oldest Irish Single Malt ever bottled making this an extremely rare release of Irish Whiskey. Distilled in 1983 and aged exclusively in an ex-bourbon barrel for 34 years produced only 43 bottles at an alcohol strength of 40.7% straight out of the cask. To match its rarity, this historic bottling of Irish Whiskey produces a truly unique taste experience from its complex floral nose, to its deep layered flavors as a result of its 34-year journey and a long luxurious finish without being over-oaked. This is one of the oldest commercially available Irish whiskey on the market and is only being released in the US. Limited to 10 bottles here in Metro NY area (there are 43 bottles total), it won't ever come around again. Highlights: Consisting of one hand selected cask of some of the oldest Irish Single Malt ever bottled this is an extremely rare release of Irish Whiskey Distilled in 1983 and aged exclusively in an ex-American oak Bourbon barrel which after 34 years of maturation produced only 43 bottles and an alcohol strength of 40.9% To match its rarity this historic bottling of Irish Whiskey history captures a truly unique taste experience As a result of its 34-year journey producing a complex floral nose with deeply layered flavors and a long luxurious finish without being over oaked

TITLE: Teeling 40 Year Old Single Malt
DESCRIPTION: Experience the pinnacle of Irish whiskey craftsmanship with Teeling 40 Year Old Single Malt, one of the oldest and rarest Irish single malts ever bottled. Distilled in 1983 and aged for four decades exclusively in Ex-American oak bourbon barrels, this extraordinary whiskey captures the essence of a unique era in Irish distilling. Bottled at 42.2% ABV (84.4 Proof), this expression is a collector's dream, offering a complex floral nose and deep, layered flavors that only 40 years of aging can produce. Key Highlights: Ultra-Rare Release: With only 140 bottles available worldwide and just 10 in the U.S., this whiskey is a highly sought-after piece of Irish whiskey history. Historic Distillation: First distilled in 1983, this whiskey showcases the expertise of Teeling Distillery, a name synonymous with Irish whiskey excellence. Exquisite Aging: Aged exclusively in Ex-American oak bourbon barrels, the whiskey has developed a rich and complex profile with a floral nose and intricate flavors. Perfect for collectors and connoisseurs, Teeling 40 Year Old Single Malt is not just a whiskey—it's a journey through time, encapsulating the rich history and tradition of Irish distilling in every bottle. Secure your piece of whiskey history today.

TITLE: Teeling Single Grain Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Single Grain – Recently Awarded World’s Best Grain at the World Whiskies Awards, 2014. This award-winning addition is one of only a handful of Single Grain Bottlings in the world. It is fully matured in Californian red wine barrels resulting in an intensely fruity and beautifully amber liquid, with lush berry notes. Hand selected casks, bottled at 46% with no chill filtration to ensure all the unique flavour is captured.

TITLE: Teeling Single Malt Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Third release in the Premium range of Teeling expressions completing our full range of non aged Irish whiskeys. Made from 100% Malted Barley from a range of different ages including Malt whiskey distilled in 1991. Aim to produce the most flavoursome NA Irish Single Malt based on our innovative maturation/finishing techniques while retaining the distinctive Irish smoothness. Consists of a vatting of 5 different wine cask (Sherry, Port, Madeira, White Burgundy, Cabernet Sauvignon) finished Irish Malt whiskeys. Like all the Teeling whiskeys it is bottled at 46% with no chill filtration allowing for all the natural flavours of the whiskey to be retained

TITLE: Teeling Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This single pot still Irish whiskey from Teeling is made with a combination of malted and un-malted barley, creating a creamy texture alongside a sweet, fruity character. Aromas of vanilla, stewed apples, cinnamon, apricot yoghurt and banana milkshake fill the nose, alongside rich sherry aromas. The palate offers notes of toasted barley, salted caramel, dark fruit, winter spice and rich nuts, with hint of red apples and milk chocolate.

TITLE: Teeling Small Batch Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Our Flagship Irish whiskey and our attempt to create the most interesting Blended Irish whiskey. This small batch bottling consists of hand selected casks which are given further maturation in ex-rum barrels imparting extra character and smooth flavour unique to Irish whiskey. By bottling at 46% with no chill filtration completes an Irish whiskey of true character.

TITLE: Teeling Whiskey Wonders Of Wood Series First Edition Single Pot Still Virgin Chinkapin Oak Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 93, #19 on the Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 ListMaster distiller Alex Chasko selected wide-grain virgin Chinkapin American white oak casks to fully mature this batch of distinctive Dublin-made single pot still whiskey, with each bottle sold helping to replant native trees in County Wicklow. The fresh oak has deeply etched its character on the spirit with savory and spicy aromas of roasted sweet chestnut, marron glacé, licorice, pecan, and treacle, followed by a deliciously yielding palate of black fruits, forest honey, clove, cola, and Brazil nut.

TITLE: Teeling Wonders of Wood Second Edition Virgin Portuguese Oak Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This Irish single pot still expression from Dublin’s Teeling Whiskey leads with a densely layered nose that’s floral and fruity, with just a hint of stony minerality and earthy wood. Pineapple and mango jump out of the glass on a gust of flowery potpourri and a whisper of salty sea air. The new oak used to mature this whiskey really pops on the palate, where the balance between pepper, coriander, sweet tea, and berry compote shines through the oaky sweetness.

TITLE: Teillery Merlot
DESCRIPTION: Hand-picked grapes, short maceration and controlled fermentation in stainless steel tank at 24C to 26C. Secondary malolactic fermentation is produced in a natural way, with 6 months in stainless steel tanks. Pairs well with shell fish, oysters both raw or boiled, fish and pasta with light vegetable sauce such as Fettuccine Alfredo.

TITLE: Telmo Rodriguez Rueda Basa Blanco
DESCRIPTION: In 1996, we went to Rueda to produce a good white wine. The hills of stony, chalky soil and the native Verdejo variety of grapes were powerful attractions. In those days it was a challenge to speak of a great Spanish white wine and we were driven to reveal and celebrate this facet of our land. Since success was the only option, we decided on a simple wine. We even gave in to the temptation to work with Sauvignon grapes to make it more attractive to the English speaking market. Basa sold all around the world. We have had first-hand experience of this region, its commercial success and the dangers of this success. We will always be grateful to Basa for all it has given us. For several years now, we have been working to return to a more sober, less commercial and more original Rueda, using native varieties of grapes. We have been working for 10 years to produce a great Rueda, El Transistor, which attempts to reveal the authentic character of the best Rueda Verdejo. This work represents our dedication and commitment to this corner of Castilla.

TITLE: Temperance Trader Oregon Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Lee Madoff started House Spirits Distillery in 2004 where he helped create several popular craft spirit brands of which his namesake Medoyeff Vodka and Aviation Gin are the most successful. He was one of the founding members and first president of the Oregon Distillers Guild, America’s first craft distillers guild. In 2010, with his sights set on making a pure malt Oregon Whiskey, he started Bull Run Distillery. Small batch, high rye bourbon, 25% rye, 65% corn, 10% malted barley and the pure, raw water from the Bull Run Watershed and barrel aged for minimum of 4–6 years.

TITLE: Templeton 10 Years Anniversary Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: All bottles are sold in a commemorative box and hand-numbered. Only 6,080 bottles will be available for one-time bottling, highly allocated collector’s item.

TITLE: Templeton 4 Years Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: GOLD MEDAL 2010 SAN FRANCISCO WORLD SPIRITS TASTING. Produced in the small town of Templeton Iowa, this premium Rye whiskey made it to speakeasies from Chicago to San Francisco. So smooth you'll be wondering if your palate has been coated with velvet! On the rocks it is absolutely awesome.

TITLE: Templeton 6 Years Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Good Whiskey gets better with age. That’s why, back in 2010, we set aside a few select barrels of The Good Stuff for extra aging. Six long years later, the wait is finally over. Our release of Templeton Rye 6 marks our first new product in over a decade. Aged six years in new American oak barrels, this limited batch of Templeton Rye whiskey is 91.5 proof with an unforgettable flavor. Now there's even more to love about The Good Stuff.

TITLE: Templeton Barrel Strength Straight Rye Whiskey "2022 Edition"
Temptation Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Distilled from a mash of 75% corn, 20%rye and 5% barley this whiskey is softer than the Redemption High Rye Bourbon but still oh so delcious.

TITLE: Ten To Chi Heaven & Earth Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: The Ten To Chi Junmai Daiginjo is made with Koshi Tanrei, a local specialty sake rice that was made specifically for ginjo and daiginjo grade sake. It is only grown locally, exclusively for Niigata sake producers. This was one of the first Koshi Tanrei based sakes released in Japan.

TITLE: Tenbu Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Sake is brewed under the supervision of the 14th generation Takagi, with the soft shadow of the 14th generation sake.

TITLE: Tengumai 50 Junmai Daiginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Light and refreshing sake which goes well with many dishes.

TITLE: Tenimenti Andreucci Poggio Colombo Toscana Rosso Sangiovese
DESCRIPTION: Located in Pienza in the heart of the Tuscan wine region, this small family winery has had a vineyard in the region for over 200 hundred years. The unique wine label honors the family’s legacy by including a copy of a bill of sale from Napoleon, who the Andreucci family supplied wine to. Today, Flavio Andreucci labors to produce the best quality wine combining modern technology, superb vines and a remarkable terroir. Pairs well with: Beef Olives Caribbean cuisine Foods cooked via Braise/Soup/Stew Fatty dishes Dishes to serve with: Seared T-bone steak Gem Ribollita Whole-roasted Rockfish

TITLE: Tenimenti Ca' Bianca Barolo Nebbiolo
DESCRIPTION: Founded in the 1950’s, Ca’ Bianca is located in Alice Bel Colle in Piedmont’s viticultural district of Alto-Monferrato. Here, Pier Luigi Borgna crafts world-class, modern-styled wines from an amphitheater of 96 contiguous acres of hillside vineyards. Barbera d’Asti, which excels in this climate, is the focus as the winery puts forth three distinct cuvees each year. Ca’ Bianca also produces top-quality Barolo, charming whites from the heart of the Gavi zone between the towns of Gavi and Novi Ligure, a delicious Moscato d’Asti and Brachetto d’Acqui. Meat - Beef, game and stews such as beefsteak, lamb, veal, rabbit, wild boar and deer. Fish - It is better not to serve Barolo with fish since most fish will be completely overpowered, a light red like Bardolino would be a better candidate. Poultry - Especially wild poultry like guineafowl (in truffle sauce) and pheasant but also duck breast and foie gras. Pasta - Pasta with a strong tomato or truffle sauce. Cheeses - Old strong (crumble) cheeses like Parmigiano Reggiano, Pecorino vecchio, old Gouda and old Cheddar, blue cheeses such as Gorgonzola, Danish blue and Castelmagno as well as cheeses with a rich flavor like Fontina and Boschetto al tartufo.

TITLE: Tenimenti Spinsanti Adino Rosso Conero Doc
DESCRIPTION: Because of this wine's soft tannins and medium alcohol, it can sometimes work with spicier dishes, but is probably at its best as an accompaniment to pasta with a meat-based ragu. Pairs well with: Beef Beans/Legumes Caribbean cuisine Foods cooked via Saute Savory dishes Dishes to serve with Montepulciano: Tagliatelle Bolognese Spaghetti Alla Diavola Oven-roasted Beefsteak Tomatoes

TITLE: Tenranzan "Emperor's Mountain" Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: A true example of a ‘mountain style’ sake from one of the few prefectures of Japan that doesn’t border the ocean. Miyama Nishiki rice milled to 55% remaining. Savory and earthy to complement the hearty local cuisine famous for wild game like boar and venison.

TITLE: Tenranzan "Emperor's Mountain" Junmai Jukusei-shu Aged Sake
DESCRIPTION: Blue cheese, creamy cheeses, charcuterie, duck, sauteed pork with oyster sauce, desserts.

TITLE: Tensei Endless Summer Tokubetsu Honjozo Sake
DESCRIPTION: The more casual sibling to Tensei Song of the Sea Junmai Ginjo. Kanagawa is the shonan, or "surfer" culture of Japan, and this easy drinking, sessionable style captures that attitude perfectly.

TITLE: Tensley Santa Barbara County Syrah "Lite"
DESCRIPTION: This Syrah "Lite" comes from a Coastal vineyard in Santa Barbara from fruit that was harvested at 21 brix. And while this might seem low for most all of the producers in the Central Coast, it was our interest and Joey's willingness that put this lower alcohol, vin de pays style wine in the bottle.

TITLE: Tentaka Shuzo "Hawk In The Heavens" Tokubetsu Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Brewed with water from the area's natural underground springs which goes through triple filtration to remove any unwanted natural debris. Locally adored, Tentaka Kuni only releases 20% of its brew out of Tochigi prefecture.

TITLE: Tenuta Amalia Dolce Viola Cagnina di Romagna
DESCRIPTION: The wine is predominantly made from Refosco grapes (locally known as Cagnina, or Terrano, meaning earth), and emerges as a deep purplecolored and full-bodied red.

TITLE: Tenuta Rapitala Nadir Syrah
DESCRIPTION: The grapes are harvested mid-September. A cold, pre-maceration lasts for three days and is followed by temperature-controlled fermentation at 77°F. The result is a better extraction of aromas and tannins, which are smooth and enveloping. About 20% of the wine undergoes malolactic fermentation for four months in second passage, medium-toast French Allier barriques. The wine is then blended with the remaining lots and is aged in barriques for 12 months. In this way we produce a fragrant, fresh, fruity wine and maintain unaltered the varietal characteristics and structure and power expressed by the Syrah grown in the hot Sicilian climate.

TITLE: Tenuta San Leonardo "Vette" Vigneti delle Dolomiti Sauvignon Blanc
Tenuta Sant'Anna Prosecchini
DESCRIPTION: Harvested grapes are de-stemmed and crushed gently. The must obtained is transferred to steel vats where fermentation takes place at controlled temperatures. Then the process of transforming to sparkling wine begins: a selection of yeasts is put in the tanks which, over a period of 4 months will transform the wine into a refined sparkling wine.

TITLE: Tenute Guicciardini Strozzi Morellino di Scansano Titolato
DESCRIPTION: The Morellino ‘Titolato Strozzi’ is made with estate-owned sangiovese grapes and 10% of the local variety ciliegiolo which enhances the wine with freshness and fruity notes. The grapes are hand-picked and selected carefully in the vineyard. Vinification takes place on skins with about 10 days’ temperature controlled maceration. To preserve the fragrance of the aromas, this wine ages exclusively in the bottle. It is the perfect partner for a variety of risottos, roasted pork or steak Florentine.

TITLE: Tepache Sazon Pina Y Canela Pineapple & Cinnamon
DESCRIPTION: Pineapple and cinnamon tepache crafted by Tepache Sazón in Nayarit, Mexico Produced from hand-picked honey pineapples (piña miel), Ceylon cinnamon (canela), and piloncillo (raw, unrefined cane sugar) All ingredients are locally sourced from Nayarit and Veracruz Pineapples are washed and crushed, and the juice is fermented 2 weeks Lightly sweetened with piloncillo and fresh pineapple juice Secondary fermentation occurs in Charmat-style pressure tanks before flash pasteurization and bottling Unbridled aromas of tropical fruit and baking spice greet the nose with overripe pineapple and clove. Effervescent and vivacious with an acidic attack, the palate bursts with a flourish of freshly cut pineapple, apple cider, and grated cinnamon with a touch of salinity and doughy yeast on a dry finish 7% ABV Tepache—a fermented Mexican beverage made from a variety of fruits (most commonly pineapple), botanical herbs or spices, and unrefined cane sugar called piloncillo—is a light and refreshing way to cool down and party up! Tepache Sazón’s flagship expression of pineapple and cinnamon is sure to satisfy fans of tropical cocktails, cider, beer, and sparkling wine all year round!

TITLE: Tequila Arette Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Master distillers, Eduardo and Jaime Orendain are fifth-generation tequila producer from the town of Tequila. Eduardo is the current president of the National Chamber for the Tequila Industry (CNIT). The El Lano distilery dates back to the early 1900’s and Arette Tequila is all estate made with 100% Agave from the lowlands. The lowland Agave produces Tequila’s that exhibit complexity define with more mineral and herbal character.

TITLE: Tequila Arette Blanco Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Master distillers, Eduardo and Jaime Orendain are fifth-generation tequila producer from the town of Tequila. Eduardo is the current president of the National Chamber for the Tequila Industry (CNIT). The El Lano distilery dates back to the early 1900’s and Arette Tequila is all estate made with 100% Agave from the lowlands. The lowland Agave produces Tequila’s that exhibit complexity define with more mineral and herbal character.

TITLE: Tequila Ocho "Continental" Aged in Cognac Casks Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: This is one of three releases in the brand's 2020 Barrel Select Collection. For this series, Tequila Ocho Founders Carlos Camarena and Tomas Estes partnered with Maison Ferrand Master Blender Alexandre Gabriel. The anejo tequilas began as always with 100% blue weber agave from Los Altos, Jalisco sourced from a unique field. But instead of very used ex-bourbon barrels, Continental aged exclusively in Maison Ferrand Ambre Cognac casks.

TITLE: Tequila Ocho "La Ladera” 2021 Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Single Estate named after Don Felipe Camerena I, grandfather to the artisans who crafted this tequila. It has deep red soil, an altitude of 2,074 meters and is hilly.

TITLE: Tequila Ocho "Transatlantic" Rum and Cognac Cask Aged Tequila Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Tequila Ocho Barrel Select is a collection of some of the most prized casks, largely composed of barrels formerly containing rum and Cognac from the acclaimed Maison Ferrand. This range is a collaboration between Maison Ferrand Master Blender Alexandre Gabriel and Tequila Ocho Master Distiller Carlos Camarena. "Transatlantic" evokes images of both Caribbean rum and Cognac, the source of the barrels used for this bottling. By choosing barrels that previously housed other distillates, these flavors compliment the tequila, thus marrying the spirit of Mexico with the spirits of other regions of the world.

TITLE: Tequila Ocho "Tropical" Aged in Rum Casks Anejo Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Tequila Ocho Barrel Select is a collection of some of the most prized casks, largely composed of barrels formerly containing rum and Cognac from the acclaimed Maison Ferrand. This range is a collaboration between Maison Ferrand Master Blender Alexandre Gabriel and Tequila Ocho Master Distiller Carlos Camarena. "Tropical" elicits images of the Caribbean and South Pacific, the sources of the barrels used for this bottling. By choosing barrels that previously housed rum, these flavors compliment the tequila, thus marrying the spirit of Mexico with the spirits of other regions of the world.

TITLE: Tequila Ocho Plata Tequila 750ml  San Jeronimo 2023
DESCRIPTION: Terroir is a concept we most commonly hear when talking about wine, but it also exists within the growing of agave and the resulting tequila made from it. The elements that affect terroir include soil composition, altitude, temperatures (day and night, throughout the year), rainfall, humidity, and exposure to the sun and winds. Tequila Ocho explores terroir by producing batches from single fields or ranchos.This Plata is from the San Jeronimo rancho five miles outside the town of Arandas in the state of Jalisco.

TITLE: Tequila Ocho Plata Tequila 750ml  Portero Grande 2023
DESCRIPTION: Terroir is a concept we most commonly hear when talking about wine, but it also exists within the growing of agave and the resulting tequila made from it. The elements that affect terroir include soil composition, altitude, temperatures (day and night, throughout the year), rainfall, humidity, and exposure to the sun and winds. Tequila Ocho explores terroir by producing batches from single fields or ranchos.This Plata is from the San Jeronimo rancho five miles outside the town of Arandas in the state of Jalisco.

TITLE: Tequila Ocho Reposado "Widow Jane Barrel Select" Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Tequila Ocho Reposado Barrel Select Widow Jane 2022 Limited edition tequila aged for eight weeks and eight days in used bourbon barrels from the Brooklyn-based Widow Jane Distillery. This extraordinary single-estate, single-field spirit is the latest example of Tequila Ocho’s commitment to innovation, and to the expression of terroir in tequila, having been crafted using overripe agaves harvested exclusively from Rancho El Nacimiento, one of many fields, or ranchos, owned and operated by the family of legendary tequilero and Tequila Ocho co-founder Carlos Camarena. As with all of its tequilas, Tequila Ocho Reposado Barrel Select Widow Jane 2022 is certified 100% additive-free and is best enjoyed neat, sipped from a tequila flute.

TITLE: Tequila Ocho Reposado Tequila 2023  San Jeronimo
DESCRIPTION: Aged in ex-American Whiskey barrels for 8 weeks and 8 days. Made with 100% Blue Agave.

TITLE: Tequila Ocho Reposado Tequila 2023  Potrero Grande
DESCRIPTION: Aged in ex-American Whiskey barrels for 8 weeks and 8 days. Made with 100% Blue Agave.

TITLE: Tequila Ocho Reposado Tequila 2023  Corralillos
DESCRIPTION: Aged in ex-American Whiskey barrels for 8 weeks and 8 days. Made with 100% Blue Agave.

TITLE: Tequila Ocho Reposado Tequila 2024  Tierras Negras
DESCRIPTION: Aged in ex-American Whiskey barrels for 8 weeks and 8 days. Made with 100% Blue Agave.

TITLE: Tequila Ocho Single Estate Plata "Puntas" Overproof Distiller's Cut 2023
DESCRIPTION: Tequila Ocho Plata "Puntas" is an exemplary display of artisanal craftsmanship and tequila-making tradition. This edition is a blend of two high-proof cuts, proofed to a robust 106 proof using deep well water from the vicinity of the Tequila Ocho distillery. With agaves sourced from Rancho Mesa Colorada, this tequila showcases a terroir-driven flavor with an agave-forward profile. The overproof expression brings forth the highest concentration of agave flavors, making it a spirit that is both intense and enjoyable to sip neat.

TITLE: Tequila Ocho Single Estate Plata "Puntas" Overproof Distiller's Cut 2024
DESCRIPTION: Tequila Ocho Plata "Puntas" is an exemplary display of artisanal craftsmanship and tequila-making tradition. This edition is a blend of two high-proof cuts, proofed to a robust 106 proof using deep well water from the vicinity of the Tequila Ocho distillery. With agaves sourced from Rancho Mesa Colorada, this tequila showcases a terroir-driven flavor with an agave-forward profile. The overproof expression brings forth the highest concentration of agave flavors, making it a spirit that is both intense and enjoyable to sip neat.

TITLE: Terada Honke Katori 90 Namagenshu
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1670, Terada Honke made a decision about 30 years ago to part ways with the industrial brewing methods of postwar Japan and take sake back to its roots. 24th-generation kuramoto Terada Masaru is following in his predecessor’s footsteps, leading a brewery where the whole incredibly labor-intensive process is done by hand. The rice used is all organic, and most of it is polished far less than the average in the industry. Fermentation relies on brewery propagated kōji (a rarity) and either kimoto or bodaimoto fermentation methods, which when combined with the little-polished rice, results in tastes that are bold, full-bodied, and expressive with a signature high presence of lactic acid.

TITLE: Terada Honke Musubi Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1670, Terada Honke made a decision about 30 years ago to part ways with the industrial brewing methods of postwar Japan and take sake back to its roots. 24th-generation kuramoto Terada Masaru is following in his predecessor’s footsteps, leading a brewery where the whole incredibly labor-intensive process is done by hand. Region: ChibaRice Variety: Koshi-hikariType: hatsuga-genmai (unpolished, sprouted brown rice) muroka namagenshuPolishing Rate: 100%ABV: 11%Ingredients: rice, water, kōjiBrewing: short ferment of sprouted rice, unpasteurized, undiluted, unfilteredServing Temperature: chilled

TITLE: Teremana Tequila Blanco
DESCRIPTION: Teremana (basically, a combination of Latin and Polynesian words that means “Spirit of the Earth”) is the first spirits release from actor Dwayne Johnson and his co-founders Why we’re drinking this: Besides the celebrity angle? Teremana’s big push is for transparency — and to their credit, the back of the tequila’s label nicely lays out the agave, NOM, roasting methods, type of stills, barrels, calories, carb, sugars and some tasting notes. The low-calorie, zero-sugar, zero-carbs, gluten-free (by the way, most spirits are gluten-free unless they’re adding something artificial) designation here seems designed for the diet-conscious. Based on past interviews with everyone from Nick Jonas to Stephen Jenkins, it’s obvious that tequila remains the go-to spirit for the healthy jetset. The two tequilas here are crafted from 100% mature blue weber agave from the Highlands of Jalisco, utilizing plants that are between six and eight years old. It’s brick oven-roasted for three days, goes through an open-tank fermentation process, and is then distilled in small handmade copper pot stills. In a nice nod toward sustainability, remnant agave fibers from production are turned into a natural compost that is used as an organic fertilizer for the agave fields.

TITLE: Terenzuola Vermentino Colli di Luni
DESCRIPTION: Perfect match for raw oysters.

TITLE: Teres Antique  Vin de Pays de Mediterranee Les Secrets d'un Terroir Rose
Terre Des Oliviers Cotes De Provence Rose
Terre Des Oliviers Cotes De Provence Rose
Terre Gaie Stema Pinot Nero delle Venezie
DESCRIPTION: 100% Pinot Noir. Vine Age: 12-20 years old. Soil: volcanic. Altitude: 250 meters. Grapes are hand-harvested, destemmed, and crushed. Fermented and aged in stainless steel. The proximity to the Alps and the Adriatic allows both cool Alpine breezes and warm sea air into the vineyards which creates ideal conditions for ripening Pinot Noir.

TITLE: Terres de l'Aumonier Touraine Les Arpents
DESCRIPTION: Domaine de l'Aumonier is run by Thierry and Sopie Chardons and is situated in the village of Couffy, in the south of Touraine, on the slope of the Cher in the heart of the Loire Valley. The estate was founded in 1996 and is named after Sophie's grandfather. They began with 10 hectares of vines and have now accumulated 47 hectares total. 26 hectares are located on slopes around Couffy, on soils of clay and flint. The other 21 hectares are spread around the village of Mareuil sur Cher, on soils of chalk and clay. The estate is certified organic.

TITLE: Terres Dorees d'Folie Beaujolais Rose
DESCRIPTION: 100% Gamay. Direct-press rose from the most productive Gamay vines in Brun's estate vineyards in Charnay in the southern Beaujolais. Concrete-aged on its lees with malolactic fermentation and some stirring.

TITLE: Terroir Sonoro Cinsault El Impostor de Aguja Rose Valle del Itata
DESCRIPTION: Hand harvested, destemmed by hand with a Zaranda Native yeasts 24 hour skin contact, then pressed Cold fermentation in stainless steel No malolactic fermentation 2 months on the lees until bottled (with added must) No aging, no fining, no filtering Wine has second fermentation in bottle without disgorgement.

TITLE: Tesla Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: Tesla Mezcal is a premium, handcrafted mezcal produced in the heart of Oaxaca, Mexico. Made from 100% agave, this mezcal captures the authentic essence of traditional mezcal-making techniques, from roasting agave hearts in earthen pits to the meticulous distillation process. Produced by the Tesla Distillery, Tesla Mezcal is known for its smooth and complex flavor profile, making it an ideal choice for sipping and mixing cocktails. This mezcal embodies Oaxaca's rich cultural heritage and artisanal craftsmanship, delivering a true taste of Mexico.

TITLE: Tesla Tequila
DESCRIPTION: Introducing Tesla Tequila, an exclusive, premium 100% de agave tequila añejo aged in French oak barrels, featuring a dry fruit and light vanilla nose with a balanced cinnamon pepper finish.

TITLE: Teton Glacier Potato Vodka
DESCRIPTION: With a very light and clean nose, there are light sweet notes with very little of the solvent/citrus cleaner you get with some of the other vodkas on the market. The entry is very easy, soft and slightly sweet. The prevailing note is sugar, and more like confectioner’s sugar or sugar cookie than table sugar. There’s a slight ginger-like bite that makes us think of a gingerbread cookie at the end of the mid-palate. Teton has a nice mouth feel that isn’t too vapory. Things just sort of fade out gradually with the finish, which leaves the mouth ever so slightly cool and sweet.

TITLE: Texier Vignenvie Calico White
The Arcane Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Arcane is the most recent release from David Kyrejko, the Brooklyn distiller behind Arcane Fernet and Lone Wolf whiskey. Arcane is a highly experimental distillery using unusual processes to make imaginative spirits. Kyrejko is a one-man show and builds all of his own equipment, one of which is the “two headed monster” – a double vacuum still made almost entirely out of glass, capable of distilling spirits at much lower temperatures than a traditional alembic or pot still. Arcane's vacuum distilled beer whiskey's are definitively unique. All of the flavors and expressions of beers, distilled into a whiskey. But, this isn't just a beer flavored whiskey, this is beer whiskey. This whiskey is warm and toasty with piney notes from the hops.

TITLE: The Arran Barrel Reserve Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Scotland has hundreds of islands, many of them familiar to scotch lovers, but the one known as Arran has flown beneath the radar. This sleeper single malt has a sublime aroma of bread dough that barely hints at the lively flavors that await in the glass, which include freshly shelled almonds, sweet berries, and clover honey, plus a toasty finish with a lovely (if not overly long) chocolate note. A balanced, elegant, and flavorful whisky that’s lively on the palate, and a true bargain for the price.

TITLE: The Balvenie 12 Year Old Sweet Toast of American Oak Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A creamy, sweet single malt, The Sweet Toast of American Oak is the first whisky in the Balvenie Stories collection. Finished in heavily-toasted virgin American oak casks from Kentucky, it is even fruitier than normal. Sweet, malty aromas of fudge, citrus, and oaky vanilla mingle with spicy ginger and warm cinnamon on the nose. The palate initially offers notes of candied orange peel, vanilla toffee, and butterscotch, developing slowly into flavors of melted brown sugar, blossom honey, and rich oak spice. The Balvenie Stories collection is designed to bring to life the tales of 'character, endeavor and craft' of those at Balvenie through the generations.

TITLE: The Balvenie 12 Years First Fill Single Barrel Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A 2013 addition to The Balvenie's range, as a younger sibling to the 15 Year Old single cask. This is exclusively matured in first-fill bourbon casks and each bottle is part of a batch that is at most 300 bottles - all taken from the same cask.

TITLE: The Balvenie 16 Years French Oak Finished in Pineau Casks Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Balvenie French Oak is a vibrant single malt finished in casks previously held wine from the French Charentes vineyards. Pineau des Charentes is a fortified wine made from unfermented grape juice, to which a Cognac eau-de-vie is added and then matured. Pineau us also found as a home-made product in the neighbouring Deau-Sevres and Vendee departements. The Balvenie USA brand ambassador Lorne Cousin suggested Malt Master David C. Stewart MBE explore these casks after a trip to the region with his family where he fondly remembers sipping an aperitif. This is the first of The Balvenie finishes to explore French Oak. Pineau is akin to cognac in terms of production and flavour, allowing us to capitalise on the rise of this flavour profile and its premium credentials.

TITLE: The Balvenie 17 Years Double Wood Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: To craft The Balvenie DoubleWood 17 year old single malt whisky Malt Master David C. Stewart MBE returned to one of his most celebrated achievements – consecutive maturation in two different types of cask, a process often referred to as ‘cask finishing’. This technique is at the heart of The Balvenie DoubleWood – it sees the whisky matured first in American oak barrels, which impart soft sweet vanilla notes, before being transferred to European oak sherry casks, where the second cask ageing adds rich spicy flavours and a depth and fullness of flavour. The DoubleWood 17 year old is an elder sibling to DoubleWood 12 year old and shares its honeyed, spicy characteristics, but it is distinctly different, with deeper vanilla notes, hints of green apple, creamy toffee and a striking richness and complexity.

TITLE: The BenRiach 10 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Bottled at 43% vol, the BenRiach 10 Years Old is Classic Speyside in character. The cask formula focuses on ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks – exactly the types of wood we favour at BenRiach. This fresh, lively, fruit-laden single malt captures WARM OAK SPICES, GREEN APPLE, DRIED APRICOTS, PEACH and BANANA with subtle touches of ANISEED, LEMON ZESTand BARLEY.

TITLE: The BenRiach Curiositas 10 Years Peated Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: In the early 1970s, BenRiach returned to distilling whisky in the old, 19th century style, using malted barley smoked with Highland peat. It was a bold move which broke convention, in a Speyside whisky-making region known for crafting unpeated whiskies. The wood rich Highland peat we use to craft peated BenRiach spirit is sourced from the region’s fertile landscape, imparting sweet, smoky campfire notes into our whisky. For over four decades, we have been quietly maturing peated BenRiach spirit in our traditional, earthen floored dunnage warehouses, in an intriguing range of carefully selected casks. Historical whisky research indicates BenRiach was the first distillery within Speyside to reintroduce peated malt into its whisky making. This has led us to believe it holds the oldest maturing peated whiskies in the region, which can now be savoured by those curious to discover a new style of smoky single malt.

TITLE: The Black Tot "Last Consignment British Royal Naval "Rum
DESCRIPTION: Black Tot Last Consignment is a piece of liquid history. It was bottled from antique stone flagons containing the last stocks of Royal Navy Rum which laid untouched for over four decades. The naval blend of rums such as this one had continually evolved for over 100 years, with much of it coming from distilleries long since lost. After 239 years of tradition, the last rum ration was issued aboard ships of the British Royal Navy on the 31st July 1970 – a day forever known as Black Tot Day. For many years after this, sealed away in those antique stone flagons, the rum we now call Black Tot Last Consignment was drawn upon only for use in state occasions and royal weddings. Remarkably, after all these years, Black Tot Last Consignment is still 54.3% (95° proof), almost exactly the original Navy issuing strength. This is a historical blend that can never be recreated.

TITLE: The Black Tot 50th Anniversary Caribbean Rum Limited Edition
DESCRIPTION: To celebrate the 50th Anniversary of Black Tot Day, we have created a commemorative limited edition Black Tot blend. In this release of just 5000 bottles, you’ll find a marriage of rums from the four cornerstones of the Royal Navy blend: Jamaica, Barbados, Guyana, and Trinidad. Bottled at full Navy Issuing Strength, discover rums from demolished distilleries and ancient stills, and even the remnants of the historic Navy Rum blend itself. This rum reflects our dedication to the art of blending. With a carefully-chosen balance of rums from across these countries and distilleries, as well as a nod to the last consignment of the Navy Rum blend, Black Tot 50th Anniversary Rum is a fitting tribute to Black Tot Day, with an incredible medley of flavours and origins.

TITLE: The Black Tot Finest Caribbean Rum
DESCRIPTION: Black Tot Finest Caribbean is inspired by tradition and the motivation to blend delicious rums from around the world. Our Head Blender, Oliver Chilton, has developed a recipe featuring some of the world’s finest rums while creating a new and individual style. With nothing added or taken away, our final blend has been selected for its ability to allow the individual flavours of each rum to shine. We have balanced innovation and tradition in Black Tot Finest Caribbean - inspired by the navy rum blend of the past, but evolved to create a rum that can be enjoyed today, and tomorrow.

TITLE: The Cabinet Barrel Proof Blend of Straight Whiskeys
DESCRIPTION: The Cabinet is a limited-edition whiskey highlighting the finest of the brand's ryes and bourbons. It's part of the acclaimed DC Collection, which includes The Senator, recognized as the Best American Rye at the 2022 World Whiskies Awards, and The Representative honored as the World’s Best Bourbon at the 2023 World Whiskies Awards. The inaugural edition of The Cabinet was launched in 2022 exclusively in the Washington, DC area. This 2023 edition is now available nationwide but remains highly limited, with only about 600 six-bottle cases produced. Distillation Date and Mashbill: 2014 Rye - 95% Rye, 5% Barley 2015 Rye - 95% Rye, 5% Barley 2016 Rye - 95% Rye, 5% Barley 2017 Rye - 95% Rye, 5% Barley 2016 Bourbon - 99% Corn, 1% Barley 2017 Bourbon - 75% Corn, 21% Rye, 4% Barley

TITLE: The Classic Malts Collection (Lagavulin 16yrs/Talisker 10 yrs/Cragganmore 12 yrs) Gift Set
The Classic Malts Collection (Talisker 10 Years, Caol Ila 12 Years, Clynelish 14 Years) Gift Set
DESCRIPTION: Experience an homage to the maritime taste of the Scottish Isles with the Classic Malt Coastal Collection. This gift set features Caol Ila 12 Year Old, Clynelish 14 Year Old and Talisker 10 Year Old, with palates common to this coastal, island region. Caol Ila has a sweet start, pleasantly fragrant smokiness and a lengthy finish. Floral fragrances and maritime flavors come through with Clynelish 14 Year Old ending with a light, dry finish. Talisker 10 Year Old is a full-bodied and smoky whisky with rich dried-fruit sweetness and strong barley-malt flavors. This selection of whiskies makes an impressive gift to give to Scotch enthusiasts or to enjoy for yourself. The complex flavors of these aged whiskies call for a neat serve, with a splash of chilled water. This gift set includes one 200 mL bottle of Caol Ila 12 Year Old, one 200 mL bottle of Clynelish 14 Year Old and one 200 mL bottle of Talisker 10 Year Old.

TITLE: The Clover 4 Years Single Barrel Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This straight rye whiskey delivers an aroma with hints of spice and subtle oak. Its “high rye” grain bill was selected for its warm flavor notes of pepper and spice and its long lingering finish of caramel and a hint of cherry.

TITLE: The Clover Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The single-barrel straight bourbon presents a grain bill selected for its full-bodied and well-balanced flavor. It presents a subtle aroma of vanilla and oak. A taste of deep caramel, vanilla and a hint of citrus orange that delivers a soft lingering finish of caramel, vanilla, and light oak.

TITLE: The Clover Single Barrel Tennessee Straight Bourbon Whiskey 10 Year Old
DESCRIPTION: The single-barrel straight Tennessee bourbon is aged 10 years, producing an exceptionally rich flavor and incredibly smooth finish. With an aroma of toasted oak and a taste of caramel, forward vanilla, and a slight char, the finish is long, smooth and soft.

TITLE: The Colonel E.H. Taylor 18 Years Old Marriage Kentucky Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The latest installment in Colonel E. H. Taylor, Jr. series is an 18-year-old bourbon whiskey which is a marriage of three mashbills, two rye bourbon mashbills, and one wheated bourbon mashbill. The new Colonel E.H. Taylor, Jr. 18-Year-Old Marriage Bourbon Whiskey is a 100 proof, bottled-in-bond small batch bourbon that was put into barrels in 2002. Barrels chosen for this special batch release matured using one of three Buffalo Trace mashbill recipes; wheated bourbon, rye bourbon #1, and rye bourbon #2. The whiskey from these 18-year-old barrels was married together to make this expression. It is said this is a one-time bottling, thus making the release very limited. This bottle displays a vintage label and is offered inside a distinct canister “reminiscent of Taylor’s whiskey package from over one hundred years ago

TITLE: The Colonel E.H. Taylor Amaranth Grain of The Gods
DESCRIPTION: Buffalo Trace Distillery continues its homage to former Distillery owner Colonel E. H. Taylor, Jr. with a special release bourbon whiskey using Amaranth as the flavoring grain instead of rye. This 100 proof Bottled-In-Bond small batch bourbon was aged over a decade and is a special one-time-only release. Other grains used in this recipe are corn (Buffalo Trace Mashbill #1) and malted barley. Amaranth was originally cultivated by the Aztecs and is called “the Grain of the Gods.” It is similar to wheat but offers a complex taste with subtle flavors ranging from a nose of butterscotch and spearmint to a finish of pecans and dark berries.

TITLE: The Colonel E.H. Taylor Barrel Proof Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Crafted from hand-selected barrels, this bourbon is bottled directly from the barrel; uncut and unfiltered at more than 125 proof. It reflects the way whiskey was produced in the days before Prohibition, when Edmund Haynes Taylor, Jr. was the owner of Buffalo Trace Distillery. Drawn from barrels aged in warehouses constructed over a century ago under Taylor's watchful eye, the taste is smooth, yet powerful and uncompromising, just like its namesake.
