TITLE: The Colonel E.H. Taylor Cured Oak Straight Kentucky Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This special release gets its name from the special staves that were used for its barrels. These oak staves were allowed to dry outside in the open air for 13 months before they were used to construct the barrels. Six months is the normal dry time for staves used at Buffalo Trace who teamed up with their main cooperage partner, Independent Stave Company, in an attempt to allow the whiskey to abstract more of the flavors that are stored deep inside the oak staves. This 17-year-old, 100 proof Bourbon was aged in Warehouse C, which Taylor himself erected in 1881 on the Buffalo Trace Distillery property.

TITLE: The Colonel E.H. Taylor Four Grain Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: As the United States was recovering from the American Civil War in 1865, Col. Edmund Haynes Taylor, Jr. was ready to embark on a new business venture, having profited from the trading of grains such as corn during the war. Taylor purchased a small distillery on the banks of the Kentucky River with a vision of producing top quality whiskey distinguished from all others of that time. Taylor knew exceptional whiskey could only be crafted by using the finest ingredients, and his time selling grains during the war taught him that grains often varied tremendously from different farmers and harvests. This special edition Four Grain bourbon is crafted just as Taylor would have wanted. Using the highest quality grains and a distinct combination of corn, rye, wheat, and malted barley, to create a flavor that is sweet with hints of caramel and vanilla, yet spicy with notes of clove and pepper. After twelve years of aging, this impeccably balanced bourbon embodies the character of the man that would expect no less.

TITLE: The Colonel E.H. Taylor Old Fashioned Sour Mash Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Buffalo Trace Distillery has recreated his traditional sour mash and produced a limited edition, a one-time offering of Colonel E.H. Taylor, Jr. Old Fashioned Sour Mash Bourbon Whiskey for a true bourbon aficionado. A few years prior a gathering of Distillery retirees, a method was recounted for making “Old Fashioned Sour Mash whiskey. Edmund Hayes Taylor Jr. (EH Taylor) was known to use this technique in the late 1800s. Taylor’s technique involved allowing the mash to sour naturally for days before distillation. Distilled in 2002, and bottled in 2012, this bourbon is a modern replication of this old-fashioned method. Using Taylor’s original sourcing process, the result is a bourbon fo character and body like none other today. The combination of a rare estimated 10-year aging, winning the 2012 Gold Medal as one of the fifty best bourbons, and the extremely rare limited release makes this bottle nearly impossible to find. As the founding father of the bourbon industry, Colonel Edmund Haynes Taylor, Jr. left an indelible legacy. His dedication to distilling began at the close of the Civil War when he purchased O.F C. Distillery. There, he developed innovative techniques that are still in use today. Made by hand, this Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey has been aged inside century-old warehouses constructed by E.H. Taylor, Jr. Barrels are evaluated and selected to create a perfect blend of distinctive character that is like no other. This bourbon is a true sipping bourbon that honors the uncompromising legacy of E.H. Taylor, Jr.

TITLE: The Colonel E.H. Taylor Seasoned Wood Straight Kentucky Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In 1870, Colonel E.H. Taylor, Jr. purchased a small distillery on the banks of the Kentucky River and named it O.F.C. He embarked on a massive renovation of the distillery, investing a small fortune to enhance production methods and beautify the grounds. Taylor also introduced many innovative techniques and elevated the quality of his whiskeys above all others at that time. This bourbon embraces Taylor’s spirit of innovation. It was aged inside new oak barrels crafted from staves treated with an innovative process of bathing and natural outdoor seasoning. This technique pulled rich flavors from the wood, to make the whiskey aged inside the barrels like no other. Using a unique wheat recipe mash bill, the result is a whiskey with bright, citrus flavors followed by spicy undertones. Savor every sip of this truly unique bourbon whiskey.

TITLE: The Colonel E.H. Taylor Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Colonel E.H. Taylor, Jr. Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey is a tribute to one of the most influential figures in bourbon history. Aged for over 11 years in Warehouse C, built by Taylor in 1881, this bourbon exemplifies the quality and tradition of Buffalo Trace Distillery. Bottled-in-bond at 100 proof, it offers a well-rounded and complex flavor profile that bourbon enthusiasts will appreciate. This single barrel bourbon features a carefully selected mash bill known as Buffalo Trace's Mashbill #1, ensuring a consistent and high-quality spirit. Each bottle carries a piece of history, paying homage to Colonel Taylor's legacy and his contributions to the bourbon industry.

TITLE: The Colonel E.H. Taylor Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Col. Taylor juggernaut continues rolling from Buffalo Trace. For this sixth expression, Taylor plays it comparably simple and unchallenging: a small batch bourbon, made from batching seven-year old barrels from the hallowed sixth floor of Buffalo Trace’s brick warehouse. Like the other Col. Taylor bottlings, it’s bottled in bond at 100 proof.

TITLE: The Colonel E.H. Taylor Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Colonel E.H. Taylor Straight Rye Whiskey is a nod to one of the pioneers of the bourbon industry, Colonel Edmund Haynes Taylor Jr. This exceptional rye whiskey is made with a high proportion of rye grains and bottled in bond, maintaining the rich heritage and high standards set by Taylor himself. Unlike many rye whiskies, it does not include any corn in the mashbill, allowing the rye's bold, spicy character to shine through. Aged in hand-picked barrels, this straight rye delivers a balanced profile that’s both complex and refined. Crafted at Buffalo Trace Distillery, this whiskey is part of the coveted E.H. Taylor collection, known for its rare and highly allocated releases. With each sip, drinkers can expect a smooth yet robust experience, making it a perfect choice for those who appreciate the rich tradition of rye whiskey with modern finesse.

TITLE: The Colonel E.H. Taylor Warehouse C
DESCRIPTION: Colonel E.H Taylor Warehouse C 2021 Release (not to be confused by the original Tornado Surviving expression) - This bottled-in-bond whiskey aged for ten years in the very warehouse Colonel Taylor built over a century ago, a testament to Taylor’s enduring commitment and uncompromising passion for producing Straight Kentucky Bourbon Whiskey of topmost class. It has deep citrus and pure, spicy rye character.

TITLE: The Colonel E.H. Taylor Warehouse C Tornado Surviving Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Kentucky might be on the fringe of “Tornado Alley,” but even so, those powerful storms seem to be a fixture of life in the Bluegrass. Kentuckians received a fairly vicious reminder of that fact in early March 2012, when twisters tore through the state and left almost two dozen dead. Yet sometimes a tornado strike isn’t all bad, as Colonel E.H. Taylor, Jr. “Tornado Survivor” bourbon whiskey testifies to. The Colonel E.H. Taylor label is basically a series of Buffalo Trace limited editions (past installments include a single barrel and a 19th Century-style sour mash), named for the man who founded the Old Taylor Distillery in 1887 and is known to some as the “father of the modern bourbon industry.” 24,000 barrels of bourbon destined for a Colonel E.H. Taylor bottling were aging in Taylor’s own Warehouse C (dating to 1881) when a tornado struck the Buffalo Trace property in 2006 and ripped both it and another empty bourbon warehouse to pieces. The Taylor warehouse lost its roof and some of its walls, and while the barrels emerged from the disaster unscathed, they went on to an almost unique aging experience, as they received the full brunt of the Kentucky summer while the warehouse was painstakingly rebuilt around them. It is hard to understate just how thoroughly “cooked” the bourbon was that summer as direct exposure to the sweltering summer climate produced extreme results. The ultimate evaporation rate for the “Tornado bourbon,” as Buffalo Trace calls it, was more than doubled to an extreme “angel’s share” of 63.9%.

TITLE: The Dalmore 12 Years Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Dalmore 12 is aged for the first nine years in American white oak ex-bourbon casks before half is transferred to ex-oloroso sherry casks for the final three years. The result is a whisky with a combination of sweetness and rich, sherried flavors.

TITLE: The Dalmore 15 Years Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Easily our favorite expression in the Dalmore stable, this 15-year-old is elegant and smooth, with lip-smacking texture and the flawless balance one would expect from blending maestro Richard Paterson. Deep polished copper. Beautifully integrated aromas of stewed pear and sweet spice. Soft puffs of smoke overlay the biscuity malt. Generous in the mouth with a dried fruit and malt focus, sherry heavy but dryish overall. Excellent balance.

TITLE: The Drop Rose Can 4 Pack
DESCRIPTION: Producer Info: We’re a wine company that respects the past - the players, the style, the grapes! But the past has passed and life got fast. (The answer was never at the bottom of a bottle anyway.) So we twisted tradition, bent wine to our will, and put it in a can. Let’s forget the corkscrew without being screwed. Finally, a wine packed to keep up with us. The breaking wave on our can represents what surfers call “The Drop”; the make-or-break decision to paddle directly into a wave as it’s breaking behind you…when you’re 100% in or you wipe out…the moment when everything is possible. We are inspired by those who chase The Drop. Comes in 4 pack, 250ml each.

TITLE: The Exceptional Grain Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A blend of remarkable aged grain whiskies, including a barrel of 30-year-old from the Carsebridge Distillery, long since closed. Blended by Willie Phillips, formerly of The Macallan; finished in first-fill sherry casks. Subtle, elegant, authentically individual, with great structure. Only 1500 bottles have been released.

TITLE: The Eyrie Vineyards Trifolium
The Glen Grant 12 Years  Rothes Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Glen Grant 12 Years Rothes Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a superb expression of the renowned Glen Grant Distillery. Situated in the heart of Speyside, this whisky is aged for 12 years in carefully selected oak casks, resulting in a refined and complex character. Bottled at 86 proof, it offers a perfect balance of rich malt and fruity notes. Ideal for both newcomers and connoisseurs, The Glen Grant 12 Years is best enjoyed neat, with a splash of water, or in a sophisticated whisky cocktail.

TITLE: The Glen Grant 15 Years Rothes Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Glen Grant 15 Years Rothes Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a distinguished spirit that reflects the rich heritage and exceptional craftsmanship of The Glen Grant Distillery. Nestled in the heart of Speyside, this whisky is aged for 15 years in hand-selected oak casks, developing a complex and refined flavor profile. Bottled at 100 proof, it delivers a robust and satisfying experience for whisky enthusiasts. With its harmonious balance of rich malt and delicate fruit notes, The Glen Grant 15 Years is perfect for sipping neat, on the rocks, or as the centerpiece of an exquisite whisky cocktail.

TITLE: The GlenDronach  Cask Strength Batch #12 Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The GlenDronach Cask Strength Batch #12 Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a remarkable release from one of Scotland's renowned Highland distilleries. The GlenDronach Distillery has a history rich in tradition and innovation, creating exceptional single malt whiskies that reflect the region's unique terroir. This cask strength edition is carefully selected from individual barrels, showcasing the unfiltered and undiluted essence of The GlenDronach's esteemed character.

TITLE: The GlenDronach "Kingsman Edition" 29 Years Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky 1989 Vintage
DESCRIPTION: The GlenDronach Kingsman Edition 1989 Vintage was created by master blender Rachel Barrie in partnership with Kingsman film franchise director Matthew Vaughn. The release of the whisky follows the launch of Kingsman Edition 1991 Vintage in 2017, which marked the release of the second film in the series, Kingsman: The Golden Circle. The new expression is bottled at 50.1% ABV and made from a selection of six casks from 1989. The 29-year-old single malt was matured initially in oloroso Sherry casks followed by a final maturation in Pedro Ximénez casks from Spain.

TITLE: The Glendronach 1992 29 Year Oloroso Sherry Butt Cask
DESCRIPTION: The Glendronach Cask Bottling 1992 Cask No. 217. Each year our Master Blender specially selects a handful of individual casks from the warehouses at The GlenDronach Distillery, to be bottled as a GlenDronach Cask Bottling. With maturing whiskies dating back as far as 1968, there is an exquisite selection of barrels, hogsheads, puncheons and butts to choose from. Each Cask Bottling is bottled from a single cask which displays truly remarkable characteristics, the malt whisky contained within having developed exceptionally during the long maturation process.

TITLE: The Glendronach 1993 Master Vintage Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A rather stunning well-sherried single malt from GlenDronach. Distilled in 1993, the whisky was laid to rest in Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso sherry casks. Twenty-five glorious GlenDronach years passed, then master blender Dr. Rachel Barrie selected the casks to create this expression, which has been bottled at 48.2% ABV. The Spanish oak in which it rested has imparted a rich golden hue to the liquid - and, of course, an exceptional flavor profile.

TITLE: The GlenDronach 21 Years Old Parliament 21 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A 21-year-old Glendronach was released in 2011 and aged in a mix of sherry casks (Oloroso and sweet Pedro Ximenez dessert sherry). The result is excellent indeed. Interestingly enough, this whisky has no political associations. It is named "Parliament" after the collective term for a group of rooks - and there is a Parliament of Rooks living in the trees near GlenDronach.

TITLE: The GlenDronach 24 Years Grandeur Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Many whisky lovers know that GlenDronach is among the world's most expensive whiskey brands because they give us a kind of top quality sherried malt that only they can make. The GlenDronach Grandeur 24 Year Single Malt Scotch is the perfect embodiment of that. This limited vintage expression amazingly portrays the smooth, complex, and full-bodied malt which GlenDronach is most known for. The GlenDronach Grandeur 24-Year-Old is a full-bodied sherry whisky with the richest, most complex, and smoothest single malt taste. Its heady nose will greet you with aromas of candied fruit, nuts, orange peel, honey-drenched dates, and raisins; following through with savoury flavors of dark chocolate, sultanas, espresso, and treacle toffee, much like a delightful Christmas cake. So if you already have that burning curiosity inside you 'bout the GlenDronach Grandeur 24, there's no better solution than to taste it and find out for yourself. It's truly an excellent choice for cold nights and dreamy drinking sessions. with an alcohol content of 48.7% per bottle aged in Oloroso sherry casks from 1990, 1992, and 1993 natural antique walnut color with a golden hue

TITLE: The GlenDronach 25 Year Old 1991 "Kingsman Edition"
DESCRIPTION: Personally selected by director Matthew Vaughn to mark the release of Kingsman: The Golden Circle, this limited edition Speyside single malt from The GlenDronach Distillery was born in the same year as Kingsman agent, Gary "Eggsy" Unwin. Distilled in 1991 and matured in the finest sherry casks for more than 25 years, each one of the 2,000 bottles is hand-numbered and presented in a bespoke green display case and adorned by a gold metal Kingsman charm.

TITLE: The GlenDronach 25 Years Cask Bottling Distilled 1994 Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The GlenDronach Cask Bottling Batch 18 is a celebration of the distillery’s time-honoured mastery. Each cask individually explores the sophistication, powerful intricacy and complex layers of Spanish sherry cask maturation found in every expression of The GlenDronach. 1994 Cask #5287 is non-chill filtered and draws all its natural colour from the cask in which it rests. 638 bottles are available in USA. EXPRESSION 1994 Cask #5287, Aged 26 Years, Port Pipe Cask #325 pictured.

TITLE: The GlenDronach 27 Years Cask Bottling Distilled 1993 Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The GlenDronach Cask Bottling Batch 18 is a celebration of the distillery’s time-honoured mastery. Each cask individually explores the sophistication, powerful intricacy and complex layers of Spanish sherry cask maturation found in every expression of The GlenDronach. 1993 Cask #7102 is non-chill filtered and draws all its natural colour from the cask in which it rests. 633 bottles are available in USA. EXPRESSION 1993 Cask #7102, Aged 27 Years, OLOROSO PUNCHEON Cask #7276 pictured.

TITLE: The GlenDronach Allardice 18 Years Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The GlenDronach 18 years old has been named after the renowned founder of the distillery, James Allardice. This exceptional sherried single malt is non chill filtered and of natural colour. Matured in the finest Spanish Oloroso sherry casks and bottled at 46%, this sublime richly sherried malt is truly unforgettable.

TITLE: The GlenDronach Cask Strength Highland Single Malt Scotch Whiskey 750ml  10
DESCRIPTION: The GlenDronach Distillery has announced the tenth release of its Cask Strength Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky. This expression is a marriage of Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso sherry casks. “The GlenDronach Cask Strength Batch 10 is incredibly rich and full-bodied with the full depth of sherry cask maturation at its heart,” says Master Blender Rachel Barrie. “Presented at natural cask strength, it offers a cornucopia of flavor, from richly spiced fruitcake to dark cherry and ginger jam.” The GlenDronach Cask Strength Batch 10 is 58.6% ABV. As is the case for all The GlenDronach expressions, it develops a deep color naturally over time from the Spanish oak in which it rests.

TITLE: The GlenDronach Original 12 Years Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This superb richly sherried single malt is matured for at least 12 years in a combination of the finest Spanish Pedro Ximenez and Oloroso sherry casks. Non-chill filtered, of natural colour and bottled at 43%, the GlenDronach 12 year old Original is a sweet, creamy dram.

TITLE: The Glendronach Port Wood Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This iconic sherried single malt scotch gets an extra-generous helping of fruit from maturation in port pipes at the hands of GlenDronach master blender Rachel Barrie. The result is a decadent and chewy dram that starts off with fig, dried cherries, and glazed banana chips on the nose. The mouth-filling flavors boast rich fruit, with chocolate-covered cherry and spiced Christmas cake before a lingering finish of drying cocoa and gingersnaps. Lush, creamy, and moreish in the extreme

TITLE: The GlenDronach Revival 15 Years Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: After ceasing production in 2015, The GlenDronach Revival Aged 15 years now returns to the core range of the distillery's lineup. The expression embodies The GlenDronach's signature style of Spanish Sherry Cask maturation in fine Pedro Ximenez and Oloroso sherry casks from Andalucia, quietly growing in stature for 15 years in the darkness of our dunnage warehouses. In flavor, the expression offers sumptuous notes of dark fruits, rich chocolate, and manuka honey with an enveloping, memorable finish worthy of this monumental malt's history. This luxuriously sherried Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky is bottled at 46% ABV, non-chill filtered and natural in color.

TITLE: The Glenlivet 14 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
The Glenlivet 18 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Balanced, rich and elegant, this is a whisky for special occasions. Cask: First and Second Fill American Oak and ex-Sherry casks Fillet mignon and foie gras

TITLE: The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve Single Malt Scotch Whisky is an innovative expression from the renowned Glenlivet Distillery in Speyside, Scotland. This unique whisky is finished in Caribbean rum barrels, imparting a vibrant and tropical twist to the classic Glenlivet profile. The result is a smooth and well-balanced single malt with a rich and exotic character. Ideal for both whisky enthusiasts and newcomers, The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve offers a delightful experience whether enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or as part of a creative cocktail.

TITLE: The Glenrothes 36 Years Platinum Single Cask 1978 Speyside  Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: In artistic collaboration with The New Yorker illustrator Maddie Dai, The Glenrothes unleashes a rare, limited single malt, including a first-of-its-kind NFT providing access to exclusive, real-world experiences. With only 168 bottles available, you'll own a whisky experience like no other. Look beyond the bottle and be transported with an enchanting NFT featuring artwork that melds the iconic worlds of Scotland and New York City, as imagined by artist Maddie Dai. Plus, you’ll have the unique opportunity to attend real-life experiences across the globe, including exclusive access to tour The Glenrothes distillery (traditionally closed to the public). Like all Glenrothes Exclusive Single Cask releases, The Glenrothes 36 Year Old aged patiently at the distillery's on-site cooperage in a sherry-seasoned refill hogshead cask. The result is a delicate, balanced experience of orange zest and vanilla sweetness, light oak, and gentle spice. Immerse yourself in The Glenrothes world and celebrate the future of art collecting.

TITLE: The Glenrothes 40 Years Old 2019 Limited Release Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Glenrothes’ first-ever 40 year old single malt is a whisky that marks a moment in the history of The Glenrothes that can never be repeated. Maturing in cask since December 1978, this rare liquid began life in copper stills that Glenrothes took out of action soon after; while the current still house continues to produce The Glenrothes’ exceptional spirit to the same exacting standards, that means this particular whisky can’t be repeated. A moment in history. This 40 Year Old is the latest addition to the Soleo Collection from The Glenrothes, which was launched in 2018. An edit of six single malt whiskies, the collection is designed for the modern drinker, with every single malt celebrating a unique flavor profile, reflective of the influence of sherry seasoned oak casks and aging between 10 and 40 years. Only 594 bottles will ever be released, each individually numbered and presented in an oak box.

TITLE: The Glenturret 27 Years Highland Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: This Highland single malt from Glen Turret is aged for 27 years in oak casks. Flavors of fresh green grass, nuts, cracked pepper, and oak cask spice. A solid 27 years old Highland best sipped on.

TITLE: The Hakushu Aged 18 Years 2024 Edition Peated Malt Single Malt Japanese Whisky
DESCRIPTION: 2024 Tsukuriwake Edition of Hakushu 18 Year Old Peated Malt is a limited-edition release that showcases Suntory's mastery of blending at the renowned Hakushu distillery. This exceptional whisky honors the art of blending, enabling The House of Suntory to craft over 100 distinct malt whiskies that elevate Japanese peated malt to new heights. With its subtle herbaceous notes and refined smokiness, Hakushu 18 Year Old Peated Malt offers a refreshing and elegant drinking experience, reminiscent of a tranquil forest.

TITLE: The Herbal Elixir Vegetal de la Grande-Chartreuse
DESCRIPTION: In 1605, the Duke of Estrees entrusted the Carthusians with a manuscript bearing a mysterious recipe made up of 130 plants that could give rise to an "Elixir of long life". For more than a century and a half, the Carthusians will develop this recipe which will give birth, thanks in particular to Brother Jérôme Maubec, to a final product fixed in 1764 called "Plant Elixir of the Grande Chartreuse". It was quickly distributed as a care product to local populations, especially during the cholera crisis of 1832. Brother Charles was the first to market it in local markets, descending on a donkey from the monastery. Since 1764, the recipe for the Elixir has remained unchanged.

TITLE: The Hilhaven Lodge Straight American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Many a glass has been raised to great times and great places. But there may be no place where more glasses have been raised to more great times than at Hilhaven Lodge. Nestled deep in Beverly Hills, this private residence was built in 1927 as an escape and playground for those who lived in the spotlight. Currently owned by renowned producer and director Brett Ratner, Hilhaven Lodge and its celebrations endure to this day, as the home passes from one generation’s legendary owner to the next.

TITLE: The Justice 16 Years Barrel Proof Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The DC collection from Proof and Wood has been killing it with their last few releases. If you remember Tumbling Dice 11 year from last year, you'll know how good this will be. A blend of 16 and 17-year-old barrels from Tennessee (almost certainly George Dickel, winner of the whiskey of the year last year for their 13-year-old BIB. This is a lot of just 19 barrels. Masbill 84% Corn, 8% Rye, % Malted Barley. only 350 x 6pack cases produced.

TITLE: The Kraken "Attacks New York" Limited Edition Spiced Rum
DESCRIPTION: As dark as a New Yorkers’ sense of humor, The Kraken is a spiced Caribbean rum blended with natural flavors and caramel color. Unleashed from the depths of the ocean, it’s been sighted careening over Niagara Falls, unfurling its tentacles through the Finger Lakes, and crushing hotdog-eating contests in Coney Island. This limited edition Kraken Attacks New York bottle carries the original 94-Proof recipe.

TITLE: The Kyoto Distillery "Ki Noh Bi" Cask-Aged Japanese Gin
DESCRIPTION: KI NOH BI is an ongoing series of cask-aged expressions of The Kyoto Distillery’s classic dry gin, with each edition featuring a different cask or combination of casks that previously held a variety of spirits. The labels, which display masks used in Noh, a form of traditional Japanese theater dating back to the fourteenth century, are a nod to Number One Drinks, a company that specializes in extremely sought-after Japanese whiskies. The gin in this, the seventeenth edition of KI NOH BI, was aged in both mizunara casks and casks from the shuttered and extremely coveted Japanese whisky distillery, Karuizawa.

TITLE: The Kyoto Distillery "Ki Noh Bi" Edition G Finished in Ex-Henri Giraud Champagne Barriques Japanese Dry Gin
DESCRIPTION: The Kyoto Distillery partnered with Champagne Henri Giraud in this ground-breaking collaboration, which came about after the visit of 12th-generation owner Claude Giraud to The Kyoto Distillery. In what may be a world first, KI NO BI Kyoto Dry Gin has been aged in oak barriques sourced from the Champagne region’s Argonne Forest and previously used to mature Henri Giraud’s finest Champagnes.

TITLE: The Kyoto Distillery "Ki Noh Bi" Japanese Dry Gin
DESCRIPTION: KI NO BI (“The Beauty of the Seasons”) is inspired by tradition and is distilled, blended, and bottled in Kyoto. The gin is made in a recognizably dry style but with a distinct Japanese accent. KI NO BI Kyoto Dry Gin is created with Japanese botanicals such as yellow yuzu from the north of Kyoto Prefecture, Akamatsu wood chips (Japanese red pine), bamboo, gyokuro tea from the Uji region, and green sanshō (Japanese peppercorn) berries. Bottled at 45.7% abv, KI NO BI uses a rice spirit base and pure groundwater sourced from the famous sake-brewing district of Fushimi. Mastering the science of distillation as others have done before and the age-old art of blending, distillery separatea the botanicals in their gin into 6 Elements: Base, Citrus, Tea, Herbal, Spice and Fruity & Floral, and distill each category individually. Then they blend them in perfect harmony to create the distinctive KI NO BI flavor

TITLE: The Kyoto Distillery "Ki Noh Bi" Japanese Dry Gin
DESCRIPTION: KI NO BI (“The Beauty of the Seasons”) is inspired by tradition and is distilled, blended, and bottled in Kyoto. The gin is made in a recognizably dry style but with a distinct Japanese accent. KI NO BI Kyoto Dry Gin is created with Japanese botanicals such as yellow yuzu from the north of Kyoto Prefecture, Akamatsu wood chips (Japanese red pine), bamboo, gyokuro tea from the Uji region, and green sanshō (Japanese peppercorn) berries. Bottled at 45.7% abv, KI NO BI uses a rice spirit base and pure groundwater sourced from the famous sake-brewing district of Fushimi. Mastering the science of distillation as others have done before and the age-old art of blending, distillery separatea the botanicals in their gin into 6 Elements: Base, Citrus, Tea, Herbal, Spice and Fruity & Floral, and distill each category individually. Then they blend them in perfect harmony to create the distinctive KI NO BI flavor

TITLE: The Kyoto Distillery "Ki Noh Bi" Sei Navy Strength Gin
DESCRIPTION: This is the high-strength release of Ki No Bi gin produced at Japan's Kyoto Distillery. Made with a rice spirit and the same botanicals as the standard-strength release including yellow yuzu, Japanese cypress, green tea, bamboo and sanso berries (Japanese peppercorn), the blend has been tweaked to allow the spirit to shine at more than 54%. With a warming and spicy kick, this will make a delicious G&T.

TITLE: The Lakes Distillery Whiskymaker's Editions Rivea Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Lakes Distillery Whiskymaker's Editions Rivea Single Malt Whisky is part of a series of one-off releases that showcase the creativity and sense of adventure of the Lakes Distillery's whiskymaker. Rivêa is inspired by the Ligurian Riviera, known for its cliff-clinging seaside towns, abundant orange groves, and turquoise coves. It represents a fragrant symphony of Mediterranean coastal aromas, capturing the essence of this vibrant yet delicate region.

TITLE: The Lakes Distillery WhiskyMaker's Reserve No.4 Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The WhiskyMaker's Reserve No.4 from The Lakes Distillery is an exquisite English single malt whisky. This fourth edition in the WhiskyMaker's Reserve series is aged in a combination of Oloroso, Pedro Ximénez, and red wine casks, comprising Spanish, French, and American oak. It is bottled at 52% ABV and offers a rich and satisfying taste profile.

TITLE: The Lakes Distillery WhiskyMaker's Reserve No.5 Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Lakes is a fantastic new distillery built in England’s Lake District National Park. Set in the stunning surroundings of the Lakes District, the view is just as beautiful as the whisky! It was founded in 2011 by a consortium led by Paul Currie, co-founder of the Isle of Arran distillery, and the distillery released its first bottling in 2018. The Whiskymaker’s Reserve was launched in September 2019, and this is the fifth release in the series, matured in Oloroso, Pedro Ximénez, and Red Wine casks. It has a rich nose of dark chocolate, walnuts, apples, and buttery pastries. The palate is creamy with flavors of coffee, brown sugar, honey, and berries with a long finish of oak, dark chocolate, and toffee.

TITLE: The Lakes Distillery WhiskyMaker's Reserve No.6 Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Whiskymaker's Reserve No.6 is a masterful expression by The Lakes Distillery, matured in a selection of the finest Oloroso, PX, and red wine casks. The whisky is known for its complex and aromatic character, bringing exotic spice and delicate fragrant notes while maintaining a bold style. It's a non-chill filtered whisky, natural in color, and boasts an ABV of 52%. This edition places a focus on accentuating notes of wood spice, balanced by juicy red fruit notes.

TITLE: The Last Drop 1980 Buffalo Trace Bourbon Whiskey 1980
DESCRIPTION: Nearly extinct rare spirits are the focus of The Last Drop. And when it comes to rare bourbon, they've found another gem from the legendary Buffalo Trace Distillery. TLD's 2nd bourbon release was distilled in 1980 at what was then named the George T. Stagg Distillery, now known as Buffalo Trace. The barrels were discovered in 1998 after an inventory, and then two years later the aging process was halted as the bourbon was transferred to stainless steel vats. And while the aging stopped, the maturing of the taste profile did not, making for one of the most impressive bourbons to ever be bottled. The 40-year-old spirit is 90 proof and only 240 bottles are being released.

TITLE: The Last Drop Signature Blend Created By Drew Mayville
DESCRIPTION: THE LAST DROP ASSEMBLY was formed in 2020 and comprised some of the great blenders of our time, including Sazerac’s renowned Master Blender, Drew Mayville. The second Signature Blend is a unique blend of Kentucky Straight Whiskeys created by Drew Mayville exclusively for The Last Drop. Drawing upon his 40-year mastery in making award-winning spirits and featuring three different mashbills (wheated bourbon, rye bourbon, and straight rye), Drew has allowed each element to shine while creating a majestic whole that speaks of a lifetime of experience: a bespoke bourbon for the most discerning customers; impossible to replicate and truly remarkable. No OF BOTTLES: 1,458 (worldwide) FORMAT: individually numbered bottles (700ml + 50ml miniature) in a beautiful new packaging. ABV: 60.7% (121.4 Proof)

TITLE: The Macallan James Bond 60th Anniversary Release Decade I-VI (Full set)
DESCRIPTION: The Macallan James Bond 60th Anniversary Release Delving into the archives of James Bond, this edition honors 007 and The Macallan as contemporary pioneers, united by their roots in Scotland. The shared Scottish origin, pioneering spirit, and dedication to excellence connect The Macallan with James Bond. This unique collection presents six exclusive edition bottles, each paying tribute to one of the Six Eras of Bond. This narrative spans six decades, highlighting the groundbreaking traits of James Bond and The Macallan. Each bottle's packaging boasts a unique illustration and hue, symbolizing the specific era it celebrates. The captivating artwork unveils the creative journey behind the films by providing an intimate glimpse into the James Bond archives. ABOUT THE WHISKY This ageless single malt is crafted to embody the lasting essence of James Bond, a persona profoundly influenced by his Scottish roots. Kirsteen Campbell, The Macallan's Chief Whisky Creator, has masterfully blended a whisky that combines finesse with impressive depth and persona - mirroring Bond's character. This whisky portrays an evolving sophistication and elegance over time. It boasts a natural shade of Swiss gold and has an ABV of 43.7%, nodding to James Bond's iconic agent number, 007. The taste profile remains consistent across all six editions.

TITLE: The Macallan Time Space Mastery Single Malt Scotch Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Macallan Harmony Collection "Amber Meadow" Single Malt Scotch Whisky is a splendid ode to the masterful craftsmanship of The Macallan. Hailing from the heart of Speyside, this exquisite whisky is part of a series that celebrates the fusion of nature and craftsmanship. "Amber Meadow" encapsulates the serene beauty and richness of Speyside's meadows, translated through Macallan's time-honored distillation and maturation process. This expression, while carrying no age statement, is a testament to the distillery's commitment to quality and excellence, focusing on flavor profundity and cask perfection.

TITLE: The People's Zin
DESCRIPTION: The People’s Wine Company is a new endeavor dedicated to bringing inexpensive, well-made wines to the marketplace and to making a difference by donating a the profits to social causes related to our industry. A value wine that has values. Or like the label says: “Good Wine, Good Cause”.

TITLE: The Presidential Dram "Tater In Chief" 8 Years Old Barrel Proof Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #113
DESCRIPTION: Raise a glass to history with The Presidential Dram "Hail to the Chief" 8-Year-Old Barrel Proof Straight Bourbon, an exclusive expression crafted to commemorate each presidential election. Released only once every eight years, this rare and celebrated bourbon is a tribute to the highest office and the finest in American whiskey-making. With limited bottles available, this 2024 release is a collector’s item for bourbon aficionados and patriots alike. Selected from standout barrels in the Proof and Wood DC Collection, The Presidential Dram is aged a full 8 years in new charred American oak. Its mashbill of 99% corn and 1% rye brings forward a beautifully balanced, rich flavor profile. On the palate, experience layers of ripe fruit, lush caramel, and a warm spiciness, all leading to a long, oaky finish that captures the depth and complexity of a truly aged bourbon. This 2024 release stands at barrel proof, offering an undiluted, bold expression of bourbon that reflects the legacy and resilience of the United States. Perfect for collectors or as a statement piece in any bourbon lineup, The Presidential Dram "Hail to the Chief" is a timeless tribute to democracy and the spirit of American craftsmanship. Tasting Notes: Nose: Sweet notes of caramel, ripe orchard fruit, and a hint of vanilla Palate: Bold fruit, rich caramel, and balanced spiciness, underscored by oak Finish: Long, oaky, and slightly spicy with a lingering warmth Commemorate the presidential election in style—add this unique, limited-edition bourbon to your collection and enjoy a true American masterpiece.

DESCRIPTION: ONE TERM Min: 4 Years Distilled: 2015/2016 Lawrenceburg, IN Mashbill: 75% corn, 21% rye, 4% barley Entry proof: 120 Bottled proof: 113 - 117.6

TITLE: The Presidential Dram 8 Years Old Barrel Proof Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: TWO TERMS Min: 8 Years Distilled: 2012 Lawrenceburg, IN Mashbill: 95% rye, 5% barley Entry proof: 120 Bottled proof: 122.4 - 124

TITLE: The Presidential Dram 8 Years Old Barrel Proof Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Presidential Dram 8 Year Barrel Proof Rye Whiskey 2021, this single barrel rye is a limited-edition release from Proof & Wood. Made to celebrate the U.S. presidential election and inauguration. This straight rye whiskey is at least eight years old, which is the length of two presidential terms, bottled at 107.7 proof.

TITLE: The Prideful Goat Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This 15-Year Kentucky Bourbon Whiskey is meant to be enjoyed anywhere with anyone, or whatever your inner goat desires. And at cask strength, you are getting this Bourbon straight from the barrel unfiltered and handpicked with some help from the herd. So sit back, or don’t, and enjoy our little project. Stand tall. Stand Prideful. 115 Proof

TITLE: The Prime Barrel 9 Years Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Nine years in the making, our own bespoke 9-year-old bourbon with experimental 51% Corn / 49% malted barley (MGP distillate) is finally here. When given a chance to put our name on a bottle this tasty and unique, we could not pass it up. We could not be more proud of this selection - it fully deserves to be the first in the line of our bespoke releases. It is thought-provoking, unique, funky, tasty, and one-of-a-kind. In one phrase - The Prime Barrel. Barrel Info: Age: 9 Years Mashbill: 51% Corn, 49% Malted Barley Char Level #2 Distillery: MGP Distillery Proof: 113.5 Tasting Notes: NOSE: Molasses explodes from the glass as it sits on the table. Behind it are whiffs of burnt sugar, caramel, and sea air. PALATE: The barley in the mash shines with early notes of black tea and salty toffee. This transitions to brief bits of vanilla, maraschino cherry, and cola. The back of the palate takes a major shift towards rum-centric molasses, tropical fruit, and burnt sugar. FINISH: This one is lengthy and primarily focuses on the tropical rum flavors.

TITLE: The Prime Barrel x Coffeebar 'Ija’tz' Collab Barrel Aged Vertical Reserve Whole Bean Coffee
DESCRIPTION: Experience the unique flavor of our Guatemala Atitlan Whiskey Barrel-Aged Coffee Blend. Sourced from the Ija’tz cooperative, this premium coffee is grown at altitudes of 1700-1900 MASL and includes the exceptional Bourbon, Caturra, and Catuai varieties. This washed coffee delivers a smooth, rich profile, perfectly complementing the notes of our Frey Ranch Single Barrel Bourbon. The StoryNestled on the shores of Lake Atitlan in San Lucas Toliman, the Ija’tz cooperative supports local farmers by purchasing harvested coffee cherries at prices above the street market. This coffee has been a key component of our Feliz Holiday Blend for years but now shines as a single-origin offering. "Ija’tz" comes from the Tz’utujil language, meaning ‘seed,’ honoring its roots in Mayan culture. Using an empty barrel from our Frey Ranch Single Barrel pick, we worked with Coffeebar roasters to roast these premium Guatemala coffee beans to create this bespoke whiskey barrel-aged blend. The result is an exceptional fusion of coffee and bourbon flavors, elegantly presented in our co-branded packaging—a proud partnership between The Prime Barrel, Ija’tz, De la Gente, and Coffeebar. Taste Notes: Nose: Inviting sweetness with hints of caramel Palate: Smooth and creamy, featuring rich butterscotch and nutty undertones Finish: A gentle fade of oak and warmth from the whiskey barrel aging Indulge in the exquisite fusion of flavors and elevate your coffee experience with our Frey Ranch Barrel-Aged Guatemala Coffee Blend 12 oz bag today!

TITLE: The Samurai Blade Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Starts with smooth and soothing follow with long and mellow richness. Aroma is composed of delicate grain and floral notes on the palate.

TITLE: The Sassenach Blended Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: An excellent whisky launched by actor Sam Heughan, or as you may know him, Jamie Fraser from the hit tv series Outlander. A fine blended Scotch Whisky influenced by the beautiful landscapes of the Highlands. On the nose expect fresh notes, clementines, apricot cake, raisins caramel, and a hint of cinnamon. The palate is delightful, almonds, raisins, honey, vanilla, caramel, and some cinnamon spice. The finish is long, with notes of almonds, caramel, and soft spice Awards: - 2 x Double Gold, San Francisco World Spirits Competition - Gold, International Spirits Challenge

TITLE: The Senator "Filibuster of Flavor" 7 Year Old Barrel Proof Straight Rye Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #61
DESCRIPTION: Our first "Senate Struck" selection of Senator's rye was one of our favorite picks and the most-talked-about bottle in our community. That bottle had everything you could want in the perfect rye whiskey. So we knew the sequel needed to be equally good, if not better. Unlike our senators (and politicians), we did almost the impossible - found a barrel worthy of the successor title. This bottle is a year older, has loads of flavor, and - dare we say - it might challenge the original as the best Senator Rye yet. 119.5 ProofTasting Notes: Nose: Hint of char, freshly baked bread, butterscotch, cereal grain, orange rind, lilac, a touch of sugar cane Palate: Peppery maple bacon, smoky sweetness, Finish: medium and long, moderate heat that transitions to lingering sweetness of pancakes and syrup

TITLE: The Senator "Senate Struck" 6 Year Old Barrel Proof  Straight Rye Whiskey The Prime Barrel Pick #28
DESCRIPTION: According to folks that tried samples of this selection, this pick is more fruity than other Senators they’ve had. On the nose, you'll get dark berries along with normal rye stuff which is a cool twist. Drinks way lighter than its respectable 118.12 proof. In-depth tasting notes: Nose: Earl grey, dried apricot, black cherry, rose, sage, longan, sawdust, cinnamon Palate: Spiced apple, cinnamon, clove, nutmeg, pie crust, candied pecans Finish: Black peppercorn Barrel Info: Barrel #: 115 Wood Type: American Oak Barrel Type: 53 Gallon Age: 6 year ABV: 59.06% Proof: 118.12 Char Level: 4 The theme for this selection's "tater" sticker was suggested by our Discord whiskey community (you can join for FREE today). We think it came out pretty good, but you'd be the judge (or a senator, ha).

TITLE: The Sexton Single Malt Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Sexton Irish single malt whiskey is a non-age statement, 100% Irish malted barley offering that’s been triple distilled in copper pot stills and aged in European oak, ex-sherry butts before being bottled at 80 proof.

TITLE: The Shinobu 10 Years Mizunara Oak Finish Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
The Shinobu 15 Years Mizunara Oak Finish Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
The Single Malts of Scotland Caol Ila 10 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Distilled At Caol Ila Distillery In 2011 and aged for more than 10 Years In A Single Ex-Sherry Butt, Bottled January 2021, which yielded a total Of 612 Bottles.

TITLE: The Single Malts of Scotland Teaninich 12 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A 2008 Teaninich single malt from indie bottler Elixir Distillers, matured in a single refill hogshead for 12 years, before being bottled in December 2020 as part of its Single Malts of Scotland series. Cask #715786. 296 Bottles made. 57.7ABV%

TITLE: The Singleton Glen Ord 15 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A different take on The Singleton of Glen Ord 15 Year Old, released as part of the Diageo Special Releases 2022.

TITLE: The Singleton Luscious Nectar  12 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: Smooth, sweet, richly fruity and rounded; just the right balance of complexity with plenty of rich, sweet flavour and a clean finish.

TITLE: The Singleton of Dufftown 17 Years Single Malt Scotch Whisky 2020 Limited Edition Release
The Singleton of Dufftown 54 Years Paragon of Time Single Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The second and final bottling in the Paragon of Time collection. The oldest and rarest whiskies The Singleton has ever released. More than half a century of skilled aging embodies the Paragon of Time series’ masterful exploration of time itself. Such long-matured whiskies only attain real character and true richness through great skill and care; shaped to perfection by our slow-crafting tradition.Crafted in Dufftown in the 1960s – over half a century ago. Every process was slow; barley malted and turned by hand on the drying floor. The craftsmen of the past devoted their lives to these slow-crafting ways. Aged for 54 years, The Singleton Paragon of Time No. 2 celebrates a precious oak butt cask that was slowly hand-filled on October 31st, 1966, and sealed in time, destined to become The Singleton’s oldest ever release

TITLE: The Six Isles Blended Malt Scotch Whisky
DESCRIPTION: A superb vatted malt from Ian Macleod, Six Isles blends together six single malts, one from each of the whisky producing Scottish islands. Arran, Islay, Jura, Mull, Orkney and Skye are all represented here in this cracking blended Scotch whisky.

TITLE: The Yamazaki Islay Peated Single Malt Japanese Whisky 2024
DESCRIPTION: The Yamazaki Islay Peated Single Malt Japanese Whisky is an exceptional and innovative expression from the prestigious Yamazaki Distillery. This unique whisky combines the meticulous craftsmanship of Japanese distilling with the distinctive influence of peated malt typically associated with Islay whiskies. The result is a harmonious blend of complex flavors that embody the best of both worlds. Bottled at 96 proof, this single malt whisky delivers a robust and captivating experience. The Yamazaki Islay Peated Single Malt showcases the distillery's commitment to excellence and experimentation, offering whisky enthusiasts a rare and memorable tasting experience.

TITLE: The Yamazaki Mizunara Japanese Oak Cask 18 Years Single Malt  Japanese Whisky 2024
DESCRIPTION: The Yamazaki Mizunara Japanese Oak Cask 18 Years Single Malt Japanese Whisky 2024 Edition is a rare and exquisite expression from the esteemed Yamazaki Distillery. Aged for 18 years in precious Mizunara oak casks, this whisky offers a unique and sophisticated flavor profile that is both complex and refined. Mizunara oak, native to Japan, imparts distinctive notes of sandalwood, coconut, and oriental spices, creating a truly exceptional single malt. Bottled at 96 proof, this 2024 edition showcases the unparalleled craftsmanship and dedication to quality that Yamazaki is renowned for. Each sip of this extraordinary whisky is a journey through rich, layered flavors that reflect the harmony and elegance of Japanese whisky-making traditions.

TITLE: Thibaud Boudignon Rose de Loire
DESCRIPTION: Thibaud Boudignon farms small parcels of Chenin Blanc and Cabernet Franc with his hands, heart and inspiration. As part of a new generation of Loire vignerons, Thibaud has committed himself to crafting honest wines that embody the spirit of the region. One could say that Boudignon drinks, breathes and lives wine, as he has renovated, re-built and lives above his centuries old cellar on the outskirts of Savennieres. This ardent devotion culminates in wines that speak to both the heart and the mind; wines that at their most sublime, epitomize both precision and soul.

TITLE: Thibault Ducroux Beaujolais Nouveau
DESCRIPTION: Experience the joyous release of Thibault Ducroux Beaujolais Nouveau, a spirited French red wine that marks the celebration of the harvest season. Crafted by the talented Thibault Ducroux, this Nouveau wine captures the youthful exuberance of Gamay grapes from the heart of Beaujolais.

TITLE: Thierry Richoux Cremant de Bourgogne
DESCRIPTION: Richoux feels these north-facing high-altitude parcels are ideal for Cremant as acidity is key! This Irancy Blancs de Noirs is racy, yet full and over-delivers on every front. Exceptional value, exceptionally tasty.

TITLE: Thierry Veron Cave de la Bouquette Sancerre
DESCRIPTION: Thierry Veron began managing his family's estate upon his father's retirement in 2006. The Caves de la Bouquette, as his cellar is known, is located in the hamlet of Chavignol and sources estate-grown grapes from 5.5 hectares of vines planted in the surrounding hills. The harvest and winemaking are done by hand as has been the tradition for generations. It is perfect with oysters, shellfish and fish in sauce. It will also go particularly well with foie gras, which is quite original. Amateurs will delight in pairing it with a grilled andouillette.

TITLE: Thirteenth Colony Cask Strength Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Thirteenth Colony Cask Strength Bourbon is a bold and exceptional offering from Thirteenth Colony Distilleries in the heart of Georgia. This cask-strength bourbon is bottled straight from the barrel, typically around 135 proof, delivering a robust and intense flavor profile that bourbon enthusiasts will savor. The absence of chill filtration ensures that every drop retains its full character and complexity. Crafted with meticulous care and aged to perfection in new American oak barrels, Thirteenth Colony Cask Strength Bourbon is a testament to the distillery's dedication to quality and craftsmanship. Each bottle showcases the rich heritage and unique terroir of Georgia, offering a memorable and satisfying drinking experience.

TITLE: Thirteenth Colony Double Oaked Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Thirteenth Colony Double Oaked Bourbon is a spectacular expression from the 13th Colony Distillery in the heart of Americus, Georgia. Released as a limited edition in 2023, this 10-year-old bourbon epitomizes meticulous craftsmanship and dedication, blending traditional bourbon-making with a unique double oaking process that sets it apart. With a mash bill comprising 70% corn, 21% rye, and 9% malted barley, this bourbon is rooted in the classic bourbon tradition yet has a distinctive character unmistakably Thirteenth Colony. The double maturation process begins with aging in charred oak barrels to draw out soft, sweet oak nuances. Following this, the bourbon is finished with toasted maple wood, creating a rich, robust profile while maintaining a luxuriously smooth palate. The result is a high-proof bourbon, bottled at an impressive 136.8 proof, that doesn’t shy away from delivering a bold, full-bodied experience​. With only 3,216 bottles released, Thirteenth Colony Double Oaked Bourbon is not just a drink but a collector's item, embodying the spirit and tradition of 13th Colony Distillery. It’s a bold statement in a bottle, offering bourbon connoisseurs a chance to taste the pinnacle of bourbon craftsmanship.

TITLE: Thirteenth Colony Single Barrel Cask Strength Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This is a fantastic single-barrel rye whiskey. From smell to taste, it hits many of the notes any whiskey enthusiast would love to find in any whiskey. 13th Colony seems to have discovered a way to ensure that oak is at the forefront of their rye whiskey, and we are guessing it has to do with those wood spirals being added to it. 13th Colony sells a standard rye whiskey they call "Southern Rye." It is non-age stated (NAS), but rumored to be between 4 to 6 years old. Prior to being bottled, it's cut to 95 proof. The single barrel offerings are allowed to age even longer - usually over 8 years old.

TITLE: Thirteenth Colony Southern Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: 13th Colony Southern Bourbon is recognized for winning multiple Double-Gold awards. It boasts of a smooth, well-rounded flavor with a slightly sweet finish. Bottled at 95 proof, this unique bottle is a perfect daily sipper. 95 Proof | Aged between 4 to 6 years Medium to long finish, sweet corn cobs, leather, cinnamon, tobacco, cherry

TITLE: Thirteenth Colony Southern Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Balancing between sugary and spicy undertones, this whiskey entices whiffs of rye, apricot, and brown sugar. Thirteenth Colony Rye Whiskey, a Platinum Award recipient, impresses with its deeply rich and unique flavor, made possible by the distinctive finish from a toasted French Oak Spiral. This French Oak, renowned for maturing some of the world's most prestigious wines, presents a finer grain that lends a smoother texture than American Oak. With a mash bill heavily leaning towards rye (95%) and a maturation period extending beyond 4 years, this rye whiskey promises a zesty taste with a subtly sweet aftertaste with every sip.

TITLE: Thirteenth Colony Southern Sour Mash Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Sour Mash Bourbon Whiskey is a wheated mash bill, aged in new charred oak barrels, along with the other ABC's required to be awarded the title of bourbon, and is created with water sourced from Georgia's oldest aquifer, which is naturally filtered by the limestone and dolomite created during the Paleocene and early Miocene periods some 56 million years ago. So, look at that! Georgia heat for aging limestone filtered water. Look out, Kentucky! A new contender has entered the ring. Nose: Sweet wheat, caramel, medium oak, a hint of nuttiness, and maybe we can call it cherry. Palate: Corn, Vanilla, Caramel, the usual suspects show up, which are very pleasing Finish: This is where the money comes in—heavy oak and spice with some nuttiness and brown sugar.

TITLE: This is E11even Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Yes, the name of this wine is inspired by the movie This is Spinal Tap... The wine hails from a long-term leased vineyard that was planted back in 2009 to 5 different clones of Pinot Noir... 2A, 114, 115, 667, and 777. It is a reclaimed, hilly, gravel pit, at the southern edge of the Santa Maria Valley appellation.

TITLE: Thomas Dakin Gin
DESCRIPTION: In 1761, at the outset of the industrial revolution, thomas dakin began distilling gin in warrington in the north of england, at the age of 25. He pioneered the development and refinement of high quality English gin and his inventive and enlightened outlook created a superior quality, unrivalled gin distilling heritage and legacy. Given gin’s sordid reputation at the time, this was a highly ambitious move but Dakin had the courage of his convictions to succeed and transform the fortunes of gin from its dark past into a glorious future. Many gin makers followed Thomas Dakin but he was the man that started it all and is widely regarded as the forefather of quality English gin. Made with eleven botanicals including juniper, orange peel, English coriander, angelica, cubeb pepper and liquorice as well as "a hint of red cole" aka horseradish.

TITLE: Thomas Fogarty  Santa Cruz Mountains Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: This vintage will be remembered as somewhat of a hybrid of the two preceding years: featuring the forward fruit of 2012 and the structure of 2013. The fruit character is more red than black with balancing acid and tannin. Full of energy, the flavors and texture of this wine are unmistakably Santa Cruz Mountains in origin with cherry fruit highlighted by spice, mineral and tea accents. It should drink well over the mid term, 4-7 years at minimum.

TITLE: Thomas Goss Shiraz McLaren Vale
DESCRIPTION: Delicious with pork, wild boar, and fowl (think how delicious cranberry sauce and turkey is). Shiraz is big in alcohol, so it will crush more delicate dishes. So keep it away from most white fish dishes, and instead pair it with something that is suitable for its heavy body like thick stews. Speaking of alcohol, remember that is high in alcohol is a big NO with spicy hot foods. You are just putting out that fire in your mouth with gasoline.

TITLE: Thomas Henry Zinfandel
DESCRIPTION: Thomas Henry is named after Tom Meadowcroft’s father who was passionate about life and knew great wine didn't always have to cost a lot of money. They lived and traveled throughout Europe together by car, foot, and bicycle, sharing the lessons of life, family and friends. These wines reflect a subtle European style of winemaking, yet with the depth and energy we love in new world wine.s Thomas Henry is created for everyday enjoyment and entertaining, and delivers serious value for any wine enthusiast.

TITLE: Thomas S. Moore Kentucky Straight Bourbon Finished in Cognac Cask
DESCRIPTION: Thomas S. Moore Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Cognac Casks has an aroma of fruit and citrus that mingle with slightly herbal notes and traces of jasmine and lavender. On the palate, notes of orange, apricot and vanilla give way to earthy undertones, with a toasted oak and cedar finish.

TITLE: Thomas S. Moore Kentucky Straight Bourbon Finished in Madeira Cask
DESCRIPTION: Thomas S. Moore Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Madeira Casks has scents of oak and madeira wine, with hints of tobacco, citrus and dried fruits. The aroma follows through on the palate, adding sweetness and acidity.

TITLE: Thomas S. Moore Kentucky Straight Bourbon Finished in Merlot Casks
DESCRIPTION: Thomas S. Moore Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Merlot Casks carries aromas and flavors of fresh fruit, including plums, raspberries and dark cherries, followed by floral notes. On the finish, light tannins and toasted oak.

TITLE: Thomas S. Moore Kentucky Straight Bourbon Finished in Sherry Cask
DESCRIPTION: Thomas S. Moore Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Sherry Casks greets the nose with sweet fruit and toasted nuts, followed by figs, hints of spicy tobacco and cedar. The palate is sweet with fruits and nuts.

TITLE: Thomas S. Moore Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finish in Chardonnay Cask
DESCRIPTION: This well-aged Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey was emptied from its oak casks after many years of aging, and then refilled in Chardonnay wine casks, left to mature for several more years.

TITLE: Thomas S. Moore Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finish in Port Cask
DESCRIPTION: This well-aged Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey was emptied from its oak casks after many years of aging, and then refilled in Port wine casks, left to mature for several more years.

TITLE: Thomas S.Moore Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finish in Cabernet Sauvignon Cask
DESCRIPTION: This well-aged Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey was emptied from its oak casks after many years of aging, and then refilled in Cabernet Sauvignon wine casks, left to mature for several more years.

TITLE: Threadbare Cider and Mead Dry Hopped Cider
DESCRIPTION: It started with Whiskey. Five years ago, at our family-owned Distillery in Pittsburgh we started making seasonal whiskeys that celebrated the regions’ apple bounty. Whiskey finished with apple wood staves; Walkabout, whiskey proofed down with local apple cider. Before we knew it we were deep into apples and regional apple history, including falling in love with our quirky Pittsburgher, Johnny Appleseed Chapman. And that was before we started getting deep into the goodie box of apple yeasts and ferments, diving into Pommeau and apple brandies. At the same time we found a second barrelhouse for our burgeoning whiskey inventory and tucked behind it was a 10,000 square foot historic tannery, oozing with charm (ie construction complexities and budget overruns) that was just begging to be a ciderhouse. So here we are pumping out farmhouse, bottle conditioned, hopped, wild fermented, and barrel aged ciders.

TITLE: Three Chord  12 Year Old Twelve Bar Reserve Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: At the heart and soul of some of the greatest music ever composed is the twelve-bar blues progression. Its unique structure, tone, and character are created through each artist’s interpretation. This Three Chord Twelve Bar Reserve was created with those elements in mind. Three Chord tips its hat to the legends who mastered the twelve-bar blues and to those who continue to create. The distillery does not use water in the blending of Twelve Bar Reserve. In and out of the cask, Twelve Bar Reserve is the same 107 proof. MASH BILL: 84% Corn, 8% Rye, 8% Malted Barley.

TITLE: Three Chord Amplify Blended Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rye Whiskey tends to be drier and spicier than Bourbon. Three Chord Rye is no exception. The distillery has aged Ryes from Kentucky and Indiana to create a refined blend. The 3-year-old Rye contributes wood and spices, while the younger Rye gives us a nice, grassy character. They compliment each other perfectly! In music, to increase volume…magnify sound. In storytelling, to expand on details…heighten awareness. In whiskey, to enhance flavor…enrich the experience. MASH BILL: 95% Rye and 5% malted barley

TITLE: Three Chord Small Batch Blended Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The distillery uses the best aged White American Oak staves from the Ozarks in Missouri at the Independent Stave Company. They selected a cooperage to assemble our barrels in Louisville, Kentucky that has 55 years of time-tested coopering techniques. All Three Chord Bourbons are aged in Number 4 Char (Alligator) barrels. Water is filtered through reverse osmosis, a one-micron filter that creates the cleanest, purest water possible. The longer whiskey ages, the more the wood takes over the flavor profile. The 12-year-old whiskey in the blend helps create that smooth, refined finish. The secondary, controlled, wood-charring process reintroduces compounds that create the maple syrup, caramel and vanilla character that consumers love. This secondary char is light, called a “toast”. MASH BILL: 75% corn, 21% rye, and 4% malted barley. We are considered a medium-high rye bourbon.

TITLE: Three Chord Strange Collaboration Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This unique bourbon blend is finished in Pinot Noir barrels from the Strange Family Vineyards in Santa Rita Hills, California. Complex red fruit on the nose. Cherry, currant, fresh strawberries and raspberries. Flavor starts with notes of Pinot Noir, followed by oak, spice, and vanilla. MASH BILL: 75% Corn, 21% Rye and 4% malted barley.

TITLE: Three Chord Whiskey Drummer 15 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Three Chord states that they are first and foremost blenders. However, they recently came across a small lot of barrels and felt they should enter the bourbon community in their original form. Their Whiskey Drummer 15 Year Straight Bourbon Whiskey is non-chill filtered and bottled at barrel proof (117.9 Proof). A total of 2,500 bottles were produced from a small lot of barrels. These bottles will be released in two small batches consisting of 10 barrels each.

TITLE: Thresher Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: The Sauvignon Blanc fruit is sourced from long-term growers’ vineyards, all in Maule Valley, and the fruit is manually harvested.

TITLE: Tierra Divina Malbec Terra Rosa Ancient Vines
DESCRIPTION: When the time comes to choose a dinner wine, it's got to be Malbec. Here's why: Malbec has softer tannins compared to some of its red counterparts, like Cabernet Sauvignon, which means Malbec goes well with lean cuts of meat like flank, sirloin and skirt steak.

TITLE: Tierra Divina Reds
DESCRIPTION: This wine begins in some of the oldest vineyards in California. The Carignan vines are 130+ years old, Zinfandel is 90+ years old, and just a splash of a youngster Petite Sirah (only 50+ years old) is added for color and depth. The wine is fermented in steel, and there is a minimum use of oak in the cellar to keep the flavors and aromas pure fruit. Think curry spice. This wine contains Zinfandel, which leans on the sweeter side of red wine. Therefore, it's a great pairing partner with spiced barbecue dishes and curry. Pro tip: Pick out the spices you taste in the wine and add them to your sauce

TITLE: Tincup 10 Year Straight Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: To refresh your memory, Tincup is made in Colorado by Jess Graber, best known as the founder of Stranahan’s single malt. Tincup is a much different product: MGP-sourced bourbon that has a little bit of Stranahan’s added to the mix. This is why Tincup is labeled as “American Whiskey” and not a bourbon. The original Tincup carries no age statement, but this new expression packs a 10-year punch. It also does not include the addition of any Stranahan’s, which means that, even though it doesn’t say “bourbon” on the label, that’s basically what it is.

TITLE: Tinto de Rulo  Valle del Bio-Bio Pipeno
DESCRIPTION: Tinto de rulo is a project that brings together three friends and their families, continuing and rescuing, Chile´s old winemaking techniques. Tinto de Rulo is an artisanal wine, handmade at human scale, born of the dream of three agronomist friends from South Central Chile. They work in association with small winegrowers, using only grapes from organic vineyards established at least 70 years ago. Their philosophy is to bring out the character of each place, with neither chemical intervention nor great manipulation. Their goal is to bring all the vineyard´s characteristics to the bottle.

TITLE: Tip Top Cocktails Bee's Knees
DESCRIPTION: A Prohibition era standard that deserves wider acclaim, the Bee’s Knees is a classic for a reason. Tart lemon and floral honey balance each other, while the gin’s botanicals give it a crispness that’ll put extra spring in your step. The drink dates back to Paris in the 1920’s, but we think it deserves a proper introduction to a larger swarm of fans. After all, the phrase itself is defined as “surpassingly wonderful.”

TITLE: Tip Top Cocktails Daiquiri
DESCRIPTION: Daiquiris get a bad rap. A far cry from its unholy, frozen cousin, ours is a delicate balance of ingredients, a reminder that this Caribbean crown jewel, when done right, requires expertise of even the finest drink slingers. A tropical classic in its purest form, a precise blend of silver, Jamaican, and aged rums commingles with lime and sugar to do the proper work of chasing the scurvy right out of you.

TITLE: Tip Top Cocktails Manhattan
DESCRIPTION: Our roots are in live music – a world where experience is everything, yet delicious cocktails are often out of reach. And we believe the good things in life should be more accessible. Enlisting the help of our favorite bartender and James Beard finalist, Miles Macquarrie (Kimball House, Watchman’s Seafood & Spirits), we developed classic cocktail recipes and packaged them up to drink at any time and, just about, any place. Tip Top Proper Cocktails are always within reach, especially if a trusted bartender or fully-stocked bar are not. The Manhattan is bold and spices things up with its peppery bite. With each sip comes a little more truth and a little more confidence to speak it.

TITLE: Tip Top Cocktails Margarita
DESCRIPTION: Our roots are in live music – a world where experience is everything, yet delicious cocktails are often out of reach. And we believe the good things in life should be more accessible. Enlisting the help of our favorite bartender and James Beard finalist, Miles Macquarrie (Kimball House, Watchman’s Seafood & Spirits), we developed classic cocktail recipes and packaged them up to drink at any time and, just about, any place. Tip Top Proper Cocktails are always within reach, especially if a trusted bartender or fully-stocked bar are not. The Manhattan is bold and spices things up with its peppery bite. With each sip comes a little more truth and a little more confidence to speak it. It’s a drink that needs no introduction. After all, everyone associates something with a margarita, be it the beach, chips and salsa, or “it’s five o’clock somewhere.” Ours sports a simple mix of tequila, lime juice, and orange liqueur. It’s a return to form of sorts, a celebration of the origins of a drink that has traveled far and wide. This proper, post-Prohibition cocktail has landed in the laps of distinguished imbibers for decades—now it’s yours.

TITLE: Tip Top Cocktails Negroni
DESCRIPTION: Our roots are in live music – a world where experience is everything, yet delicious cocktails are often out of reach. And we believe the good things in life should be more accessible. It’s just that kind of drink. Bittersweet and boozy. A high wire balancing act that would only be attempted by three bold ingredients such as these. This red-hued classic is unmistakable, even at a quick glance, and especially once you’ve had your first sip.

TITLE: Tip Top Cocktails Old Fashioned
DESCRIPTION: Our roots are in live music – a world where experience is everything, yet delicious cocktails are often out of reach. And we believe the good things in life should be more accessible. Tip Top Proper Cocktails are always within reach, especially if a trusted bartender or fully-stocked bar are not. The Old Fashioned is the original cocktail. It’s as classic as it gets and, when done right, it’s the mark of a master. You want to taste the bourbon, followed by a hint of sweet orangey citrus and rounded out at the finish with the warming spice of bitters. next Section TastingNotesVanilla, citrus and caramel on the palate going into a stone fruit and spice finish.

TITLE: Tip Top Espresso Martini
DESCRIPTION: Tip Top Espresso Martini, an alluring and invigorating ready-to-drink cocktail, expertly blends the finest ingredients into a true taste sensation. Bold premium vodka, fresh-brewed espresso, and a hint of coffee liqueur meld together for a luxurious and convenient cocktail experience, perfect for at-home or on-the-go enjoyment. With a discerning eye on every detail, this pre-mixed cocktail artistically captures the sophistication of the classic Espresso Martini, while delivering a consistently exquisite taste in every can. Tip Top Espresso Martini is an ideal pick for those who treasure the craft of mixology and desire a straightforward but refined choice for their next convivial gathering or leisurely pursuit.

TITLE: Tito's Handmade Vodka
DESCRIPTION: The bottle states the following: Tito’s Handmade Vodka, Unanimous Double Gold Medal Winner of the World Spirits Competition! Distilled six times. Tito’s Handmade vodka is designed to be savored by spirit connoisseurs. It is micro-distilled in an old-dashioned pot still, just like the fine single malt scotches and high-end French cognacs. This time-honored method of distillation requires more skill and effort than modern column stills, but it;s well worth it. Our handcrafted technique offers more control over the distillation process, resulting in a spectacularly clean product of incomparable excellence. Only the heart of the run, “the nectar” is taken, leaving behind residual higher and lower alcohols. the vodka is cleansed of phenols, esters, congeners, and organic acids it filtering it through the finest activated carbon available. Critics call Tito’s “a homegrown symphonic spirit to applaud” and say, “it can go head to head with any of the world’s greats and not break a sweat!” Shake once from the freezer. It’s in the bottle, so enjoy! No sugar or gelatin added.

TITLE: Tobias Vineyards Lexi's Estate Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Tobias Vineyards Lexi's Estate Sauvignon Blanc enchants with its pale straw color and enticing aromas. It is a true reflection of the winery's commitment to producing exceptional wines that celebrate the character of California's vineyards. Tobias Vineyards Lexi's Estate Sauvignon Blanc is a versatile wine that pairs beautifully with a variety of dishes. Its bright acidity and tropical fruit flavors make it an excellent companion to seafood, particularly shellfish and grilled fish. It also complements light salads, goat cheese, and vegetable-based dishes. For a delightful combination, enjoy it with fresh ceviche, lemon-herb roasted chicken, or a summer salad with juicy mango and avocado. Let Tobias Vineyards Lexi's Estate Sauvignon Blanc transport you to the sun-drenched vineyards of California with its exceptional flavors and timeless elegance.

TITLE: Tokki ( 오미자 소주 ) Omija Soju
DESCRIPTION: This soju is only 456 bottles for the year of the Rooster. Its made from rice and a Korean berry called "Omija", which means five flavored berry. It is salty, sour, sweet, bitter, and a has spice element to it. ( 오미자 소주 )

TITLE: Tokki Rice Soju Black Label
DESCRIPTION: Tokki Soju’s Black Label soju is an expressive, full-bodied soju with a rich texture and a clean backbone. At a notably higher ABV than average soju, Black Label is poised for meaningful mixing. Enjoy it neat, over ice, with tonic water, or in a wide variety of classic and contemporary cocktails. Soju crafted by Tokki Soju in Rohnert Park, California Produced from glutinous rice locally sourced from Sacramento Valley Seven- to ten-day parallel fermentation using nuruk, a starter made from milled barley inoculated with yeast Distilled twice in a copper hybrid still Floral and fruity with custard apple, strawberries and cream, and underripe pear on the nose. The palate displays layers of rice throughout—from light and grassy tones to richer, nuttier notes—with lightly toasted almond, molasses, and a hint of roasted taro on a clean finish No sweeteners or additives 40% ABV
