TITLE: W.L. Weller CYPB Original Wheated Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Weller CYPB (Craft Your Perfect Bourbon) is a unique expression born from the collective choices of whiskey enthusiasts. This limited edition whiskey, distilled by Buffalo Trace, follows a wheated bourbon recipe, aged for eight years on the highest warehouse floors, and bottled at 95 proof. The CYPB initiative allowed enthusiasts to influence the whiskey's characteristics, resulting in a harmoniously crafted bourbon that reflects the preferences of its dedicated fans.

TITLE: W.L. Weller Full Proof Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: W.L. Weller Full Proof Straight Bourbon is a remarkable expression of the bourbon-making art. Originating from the storied Buffalo Trace Distillery, this bourbon honors the innovative spirit of William Larue Weller, who pioneered the use of wheat in bourbon mashbills. Bottled at the same 114 proof at which it entered the barrel, this non-chill filtered bourbon retains all the naturally occurring residual oils and flavors, which can lead to a cloudy appearance at colder temperatures. The whiskey's rich mouthfeel, coupled with robust notes of vanilla and oak, delivers an experience that resonates with bourbon aficionados and casual enthusiasts alike.

TITLE: W.L. Weller Old Weller Antique Original 107 Brand
DESCRIPTION: A wheated bourbon with a full-bodied flavor and a balanced palette. Old Weller Antique is bottled at 107 proof, offering a complex taste and bold finish. It’s certainly a recognizable member of the Weller label, with its own unique characteristics to compliment the high proof.

TITLE: W.L. Weller Old Weller Antique Original 107 Brand
DESCRIPTION: A wheated bourbon with a full-bodied flavor and a balanced palette. Old Weller Antique is bottled at 107 proof, offering a complex taste and bold finish. It’s certainly a recognizable member of the Weller label, with its own unique characteristics to compliment the high proof.

TITLE: W.L. Weller Old Weller Antique Original 107 Brand
DESCRIPTION: A wheated bourbon with a full-bodied flavor and a balanced palette. Old Weller Antique is bottled at 107 proof, offering a complex taste and bold finish. It’s certainly a recognizable member of the Weller label, with its own unique characteristics to compliment the high proof.

TITLE: W.L. Weller Special Reserve Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Original Wheated Bourbon Whiskey features an exceptionally smooth taste, substituting wheat for rye grain. Bottled at 90 proof, this bourbon stands out with its burnt orange color. Its softer flavor notes make this bourbon great for sipping or making cocktails.

TITLE: W.L. Weller Special Reserve Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Original Wheated Bourbon Whiskey features an exceptionally smooth taste, substituting wheat for rye grain. Bottled at 90 proof, this bourbon stands out with its burnt orange color. Its softer flavor notes make this bourbon great for sipping or making cocktails.

TITLE: W.L. Weller Special Reserve Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Original Wheated Bourbon Whiskey features an exceptionally smooth taste, substituting wheat for rye grain. Bottled at 90 proof, this bourbon stands out with its burnt orange color. Its softer flavor notes make this bourbon great for sipping or making cocktails.

TITLE: Wahaka Mezcal Ensamble Joven Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: Perhaps one of the most unique members of our line-up, Wahaka Mezcal Joven Ensamble is a pure blend of Espadin (50%), Madre Cuishe (25%), and Tobala (25%) agaves that are cooked, fermented, and distilled together. Our Ensamble is a magical mezcal that is un-aged, allowing the flavors, aroma and character of each agave to clearly present themselves. This full-bodied mezcal inherits the distinctive floral aroma of the Tobala. At first sip, our Ensamble continues to take on the characteristics of the Tobala, which then quickly transform into the earth, mineral and citrus notes found in the Madre Cuishe. Throughout the experience, the noble Espadin adds mezcal’s traditional structure of smoke balanced with sweet.

TITLE: Wahaka Mezcal Espadin Botaniko
DESCRIPTION: Wahaka Mezcal Espadin Botaniko is made by adding a bag of herbs to the copper still during the second distillation. The herbs are collected from nearby fields around San Dionisio Ocotepec. The process creates a clean mezcal, white with a hint of green. Juniper, cardammom, vainilla, cilantro seeds, lemon tea, stevia and lavender all combine to offer a touch of freshess on the nose. Slightly exotic, stylish and very florally expressive. This very elegant mezcal has an incredibly good balance and brings you to Mezcal’s next level. With this vegan “pechuga,” master distiller Alberto Morales moves his brand to the avant-garde creating a new generation of artisanal mezcales!

TITLE: Wahaka Mezcal Madre Cuishe Joven
DESCRIPTION: A wise man once said that the aroma of Madre Cuishe reminded him of the smell of fresh fallen rain. As part of our Signature Line, this unique mezcal is distilled using one of the most rare agaves, the Madre Cuishe. Perfectly un-aged, our Madre Cuishe celebrates the agave’s natural environment of volcanic terrain, dry conditions and warm temperatures. Our Madre Cuishe slowly and delicately evolves in your mouth, exposing its earth, mineral and citrus tones, first on the tip of your tongue, and then journeying to the roof of your mouth and nose.

TITLE: Wahaka Mezcal Reposado con Gusano
DESCRIPTION: Aged for up to six months in recharred, American oak barrels, Wahaka Mezcal Reposado con Gusano is the epitome of smooth with its light golden color and lustorous flavor. Our Reposado con Gusano is enhanced with the addition of the agave worm, an age-old, proven method for clarifying the radicals of the barrel while enhancing its overall flavor with notes of earth and salt. The earliest mezcaleros touted the worm’s healing and aphrodisiac properties, so you’ll not only get a glass that’s easy on the eyes and smooth on the palate, but is also guaranteed to arouse your other senses.

TITLE: Wahaka Mezcal Tobala Joven
DESCRIPTION: Master distiller, Maestro Alberto “Beto” Morales, calls the Tobala one of the most difficult agaves to work with, noting that it “will treat you the same way that you treat it.” Found exclusively on high mountain cliffs and peaks, this wild agave is not only much smaller than other agaves, its also the most difficult to find and harvest. One taste of our delicious Tobala and you’ll immediately know that this is mother nature’s way of telling you that the best things in life come from hard work. No other agave produces the variety of aromas and flavors as the Tobala, giving this mezcal an immediately distinguishable aroma and explosive taste enriched with sweet floral and herbaceous notes. The warm feeling of this mezcal is felt throughout the mouth, which reamins with you as a hint of numbness. Mezcal lovers usually keep a special bottle of Tobala hidden away for special guests and occasions because of its rarity.

TITLE: Wakatake Onikoroshi "Demon Slayer" Junmai Ginjo Sake
DESCRIPTION: Established in 1832, from Shizuoko prefecture. Located along the Ohi river, in the center of Japan, flowing to the Pacific Ocean from Japan’s southern Alps; the town of Shimada once prospered as one of the lodging towns of the 53 post stations of the Tokaido. The original Wakatake Onikoroshi sake is historically famous for having comforted many weary travelers crossing the Ohi river. For years, since the brewery’s foundation, they have lived through the rise and fall of history with the people in the town, and have enjoyed their hospitality. Although there were several breweries in the town at that time, due to its good-quality water, Ohmuraya shuzojo brewery is the only one remaining now. They continue doing their best to convey one of the most important traditional industries of Japan to the next generation. nextSectinoLight, smooth and rich. Very clean, almost watermelon-tinged nose, round and quite impressive in the mouth. Pairs well with tempura dishes and fried calamari. SMV: +2 Acidity: 1.4 Alc: 15%-16%

TITLE: Wasmund's Barrel Kit
DESCRIPTION: This is perhaps the most unique and innovative idea we've yet seen in the whiskey world. Why not sell your customers their own small barrique, equipped with spigot and cork, throw in two bottles of your fantastic unaged whiskey, and allow them to age it to their own liking? The concept is simply genius and these are going to be huge. The Copper Fox/Wasmund products are excellent and their white whiskies are perhaps their strongest suit. If you've ever wanted to learn more about how whiskey ages and how the wood influences flavor, then this is your chance to play distillery master. Why not have your own 1.5 liter barrel of whiskey around for when friends drop by? Includes: • Two-liter charred American White Oak mini-barrel • Two 750ml bottles of one of our brilliant cask strength (124 proof) spirits: Wasmund’s Single Malt Spirit OR Wasmund’s Rye Spirit • Detailed instructions and FAQ sheet • Barrelhead Club registration card

TITLE: Wasmund's Single Malt Whisky
Wassererhof Sudtirol Alto Adige Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: 100% Sauvignon from a west-facing hill in the lower Isarco Valley at 450 meters above sea level. After a soft pressing and short maceration, the wine is fermented in 80% stainless steel and 20% tonneaux. It remains on the lees for a short time before bottling. 9,000 bottles produced.

TITLE: Waterford Distillery Dunmore Single Farm Origin Irish Single Malt Whisky Edition 1.1
DESCRIPTION: At the top of John Tynan’s barley fields, within a striking circular copse of trees, is the early medieval fort that lends the townland its name – An Dún Mór, the big fort – a reminder of turbulent times of lore. Nestled between the Slieve Bloom Mountains & the Castlecomer Plateau of County Laois is this westerly-facing, lowland terroir, of limestone-derived loamy drift that harbours a compact gravelly tilth. Cask composition: 33% first fill US oak, 18% virgin US oak, 25% premium French oak and 24% Vin Doux Naturel (sweet fortified wines). Each bottle of Single Farm Origin: Dunmore Edition 1.1 has a TÉIREOIR code, which offers an unparalleled level of bottling information on the barley, maps, imagery and even audio from the farms. SINGLE FARM ORIGIN Using the world's finest barley, our Single Farm Origin series is an uber- provenance range of natural whiskies that explore Irish terroir one place, one farm, at a time. Barley-forward, terroir-driven, natural whisky. No coloring, chill-filtration or any additives whatsoever. Nose : Malty, raisins, orange chocolate, black peppercorns, citrus fruits, red currants, a nose that is like eating a light cinnamon porridge while sitting in a worn leather chair. Palate : Spice rack bomb, green apple, marzipan, lemon sherbet, liquorice, grapefruit, dark chilly chocolate, popping candy. Finish : Warm clove that tingles on your tongue and then becomes mouth-watering.

TITLE: Waterford Distillery Gaia 1.1 Organic Irish Single Malt Whisky
DESCRIPTION: The Arcadian Series represents our otherworldly garden of delights. We sought out maverick farmers, inspirational growers, iconoclasts whose ethos & way of life respects the land & the old ways in the pursuit of pure flavours over yield imperatives. Gaia, the neopagan goddess of yore, a personification of Mother Earth herself, is a fitting custodian to bring forth Ireland’s first whisky distilled from certified organic Irish barley. John Mallick, Paddy Tobin, Alan Jackson, Pat and Denis Booth, Jason Stanley and Trevor Harris rose to the challenge laid down by us to produce the first Irish-grown organic malting barley. Cask composition: 42% first fill US oak, 17% virgin US oak, 23% premium French oak and 18% Vin Doux Naturel.Each bottle of Organic GAIA Edition 1.1 has a TÉIREOIR code, which offers an unparalleled level of bottling information on the barley, maps, imagery and even audio from the farm. This is a totally natural whisky, with no colouring, chill-filtration or additives whatsoever. Nose : Orange zest, malty figs, seaweed, hay in the field after light rain, salted caramel, peppermint, rosewater, fresh dug soil. Palate : Heat and zesty pepper on the tongue, cloves, figs, oiliness that dries in the mouth, cherries, butterscotch, pears, malty, layers of spice. Finish : Long zesty oiliness that dry’s but leaves you chewing with sweetness that comes right at the end.

TITLE: Waterford Distillery Rathclogh Single Farm Origin Irish Single Malt Whisky Edition 1.1
DESCRIPTION: The strategic importance of Ráthchloch (stone fort), on the old Kilkenny to Waterford road, was equally appreciated by the Vikings adjacent Danesfort. The striking vantage point looks over Richard Raftice’s low lying land of quick-drying, shallow gravel soils deposited by ancient glacier meltwater ensuring it is an early sowing/ripening terroir. Cask composition: 31% first-fill US oak, 19% virgin US oak, 25% premium French oak and 25% Vin Doux Naturel (sweet fortified wines). Each bottle of Single Farm Origin: Rathclogh Edition 1.1 has a TÉIREOIR code, which offers an unparalleled level of bottling information on the barley, maps, imagery and even audio from the farms. SINGLE FARM ORIGIN Using the world's finest barley, our Single Farm Origin series is an uber- provenance range of natural whiskies that explore Irish terroir one place, one farm, at a time. Barley-forward, terroir-driven, natural whisky. No coloring, chill-filtration or any additives whatsoever. Nose: Fields and barnyard, black pepper, hay that’s ready to be brought in, blackcurrant jam, warm vanilla, butterscotch, honeycomb, citrus zest. Palate: Sweet stewed apple, berry compote, pepper, mince pie, black cherries, coco chocolate. Finish: Has warmth with a gentle spice that lasts with some butterscotch.

TITLE: Watershed Distillery Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Bourbon from Watershed Distillery is made in small batches using a combination of Corn, Wheat, Rye and Spelt. We double-distill our bourbon and age it in charred American oak barrels. Each bottle is hand numbered to represent the time and effort we put into our Bourbon Whiskey.

TITLE: Wathen's Barrel Proof Breaking Bourbon "Sweet & Funky" Pick
DESCRIPTION: We’ve developed a unique partnership with Breaking Bourbon crew to bring you a barrel pick of Wathen's Barrel Proof Bourbon. Our agreement ensures Breaking Bourbon crew to have final say in the barrels to be selected. The result is a unique and memorable pour that will stand out from others. Rich aromas of deliciously sweet brown sugar and caramel on the nose give way to a palate comprised of dark fruits, lightly toasted oak, caramel, and vanilla. A touch of spice comes into play on the finish, followed by a transition to lingering funky notes. It’s a unique set of flavors all wrapped up into one package, with a transition from rich, sweet aromas on the nose to an interestingly funky finish. It’s barrel proof, clocking in at 126 proof, though it doesn’t come across hot. Overall this is a unique and memorable pour that will stand out from others. It’s been lovingly nicknamed “Sweet & Funky". - Breaking Bourbon

TITLE: Wathen's Personally Selected Barrel Proof Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Charles Medley Distillery is releasing another special-release, Wathen’s Barrel Proof. Only 25 barrels of this singel-barrel Bourbon will be released, with proofs ranging from 109.6 to 118.6. Medley shared that the mash bill for these bottles uses a lower than industry standard of rye while the corn and malted barley used to round out the rest of the ingredients is a higher percentage.

TITLE: Wathen's Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wathen's Kentucky Bourbon is a premium Kentucky Bourbon created by Charles W. Medley using the same recipe and techniques that have been handed directly and unchanged through eight generations of the Wathen and Medley families. The two families combined their unwavering commitment to quality with the conditions and ingredients of the region to produce Kentucky's finest straight bourbon whiskey. Pristine water, naturally filtered through Kentucky's underground limestone deposits, is used exclusively in the 100% copper doubling process. This finest cereal grains - corn, rye, and malted barley - are selected, milled, and proportioned to exacting standards to produce a mash that awaits the magic of the fermentation process. The Medley family yeast, a zealously guarded secret handed down through eight generations, is then added to the mash. After double distilling, the whiskey is then stored in the finest charred new white oak barrels and allowed to age unhurried to its peak of flavor. Time honored tradition, hands-on expertise, and old-fashioned know-how are the final ingredients.

TITLE: Weingut Berger Gruner Veltliner
DESCRIPTION: With Erich Berger’s oversight, the winery has implemented methods to produce wines that focus on varietal character and terroir. The white wines grow on steep loess terraces which characterize the landscape of the eastern part of the Kremstal. These terraces store heat during the day and reflect it onto the vines at night producing wines with unique fruity, fresh and bright flavors. The red wines are grown at the top of the hills where more humus-rich soils dominate and give the wines length, body, spice and lush fruit. Vineyards are maintained according to the latest organic guidelines. In the winery, efforts are made to preserve the fruit character by using cultured yeast in combinations with slow fermentations that are temperature controlled. The white wines are then aged exclusively in stainless steel, while the red wines are matured in traditional oak vats.

TITLE: Weingut Beurer Rose Trocken
DESCRIPTION: Weingut Beurer Rosé Trocken is a captivating expression of the winery's dedication to quality. The grapes are carefully selected from their vineyards in Germany, where they are nurtured to perfection. The result is a wine that beautifully balances freshness, complexity, and elegance. Weingut Beurer Rosé Trocken is a versatile wine that pairs wonderfully with a range of dishes. Its bright acidity and lively fruit flavors make it an excellent companion to summer salads, grilled seafood, and light pasta dishes. It also complements soft cheeses and charcuterie, allowing you to create a delightful cheese and wine pairing experience. Let Weingut Beurer Rosé Trocken elevate your culinary adventures with its refreshing and versatile character.

TITLE: Weingut Fritz Ekkehard Huff Rheinhessen Quicksilvaner Trocken
DESCRIPTION: Discover the refined elegance of Weingut Fritz Ekkehard Huff Rheinhessen Quicksilvaner Trocken. Originating from the esteemed vineyards of Nierstein in the Rheinhessen region, this exceptional dry white wine is a testament to the dedication and expertise of Weingut Fritz Ekkehard Huff. Made from 100% Silvaner grapes, this wine captures the essence of the terroir with its fresh and vibrant character. The Quicksilvaner Trocken is an exquisite choice for those who appreciate the purity and finesse of German winemaking.

TITLE: Weingut Fuchs und Hase Pet Nat Vol 3
DESCRIPTION: Welschriesling and Riesling from clay and crystalline topsoil. Welschriesling is whole bunch pressed, Riesling grapes are added to the Welschriesling-juice and cofermented for 10 days to gain more fruit and complexity. No added sulfites.

TITLE: Weingut Furst Elbling Dry
DESCRIPTION: Elbling is a great old Germanic wine grape with a long history traceable to imperial Roman times. It used to cover much of Germany’s vineyards and was that country’s most cultivated variety until the early 20th century. Today its range is limited to the cool, steep banks of the Obermosel (southern Mosel) river valley and neighboring Luxembourg—where the Mosel discreetly becomes the Moselle. Born in shell limestone, light bodied, low alcohol, and dry as a vodka martini, Elbling is like a Teutonic answer to Muscadet. Furst Elbling Trocken is jazzy and expressive, true to the variety and exciting to drink with just 10.5% alcohol and a rapier-like 7.5g acidity. Dressed elegantly in a black and white LITER BOTTLE, it’s the quintessential summer party drink and a no-brainer by the glass. Perfect for chilled oysters, river fish, and light summery fare like salads, raw foods, fresh greens and grains.

TITLE: Weingut H&M Hofer Zweigelt
DESCRIPTION: Perfect for anything grilled. Burgers. Brats. Chicken thighs. Rib eye steaks. You name it, this wine will go well with it.

TITLE: Weingut Heinrich Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: Terrestrial love in vibrant red. What is unique to Pinot Noir among all grape varieties is its sheer beauty through its velvety pawed character right up to its supposed fragility. Weightless concentration and effortless energy, like a perpetual motion machine. Superb sound quality at low volume

TITLE: Weingut Julg Muskateller QbA
DESCRIPTION: From the southernmost village in the Pfalz, Schweigen, we bring you the wines of Weingut Jülg. In fact it's so close to the border that the top vineyard site, the Sonnenburg is actually 2/3s in France! Johannes Jülg has recently taken the reins here from his father Werner, and continues a tradition of growing with respect for nature, using green manure only for fertilization and hand harvesting. Soils are complex here and there is great diversity from site to site. Drink this wine with Thai or other Southeast Asian food where there's fish sauce, citrus, and chilies.

TITLE: Weingut Julg Pinot Noir Trocken
DESCRIPTION: In Germany, the area under Pinot Noir cultivation has grown steadily in recent years to encompass almost 12,000 hectares. That makes Germany the third largest producer of Pinot Noir in the world. As with Riesling, Pinot Noir prefers cool climates so that it has a longer maturing period to combine flavours and acidity. The resulting harmonious balance is why German wine regions are so well-suited to Pinot Noir production. The variety was brought to Germany from Burgundy already in the 14th century. Ambitious German wine-growers have elevated German Pinot Noir to the ranks of the very best red wines thanks to yield reduction, longer mash periods and masterly nurture in the large wooden or small Barrique barrels. German Pinot Noir is ideally served with ham, roast beef, hearty terrines and pies.

TITLE: Weingut Jurtschitsch Zweigelt Rose
DESCRIPTION: The grapes are harvested in late September by hand in small boxes. The grapes are destemmed and after a short maceration period— after the grape has received its classic purple onion skin color— pressed very carefully. To preserve the delicate fragrances and aromas of the grapes, the must is fermented in chilled stainless steel tanks at 18° C and then aged on its lees. Early in the spring, the wine is bottled with all of its pure Zweigelt fruitiness. Perfectly suited for the summer! Refreshing and invigorating on a sunny terrace - solo, or as an ideal pairing with antipasti, pasta, paella or white meats.

TITLE: Weingut Knauss La Boutanche Trollinger
DESCRIPTION: Andi Knauß works the steep, shell-limestone slopes of his estate vineyards as naturally as possible: chemicals are eschewed in favor of natural treatments and a healthy planting of cover crops among the vines. The same philosophy holds in the cellar: spontaneous fermentations, gravity instead of pumps, barrels selected so as not to mark the wines, and minimal use of sulfur. But what characterizes these wines and sets them apart is Andi. Far more comfortable in the vineyard than talking about his wines, with which he is never totally satisfied, Andi puts the same care into the kegs of Trollinger that he makes for local restaurants he does for the top-level “R” wines. If you need analogies, the Rieslings are closer to Montmains than they are to Mosel, but that would still miss the point. To really understand what makes these Swabian wines so special, you’ll have to try them. nextSectioThis Trollinger gives you a beautiful pleasure. Light on its feet and packed with soft red fruits, white spices, and chalky minerality.

TITLE: Weingut Müller-Ruprecht Pinot Noir Rose
DESCRIPTION: Weingut Müller-Ruprecht Pinot Noir Rosé is a beautiful expression of the classic Pinot Noir grape variety. The grapes are carefully handpicked at optimal ripeness, ensuring the wine captures the essence of the region. With its vibrant color and enticing aromas, this rosé is a delightful addition to any occasion. Enhance your dining experience by pairing Weingut Müller-Ruprecht Pinot Noir Rosé with a variety of dishes. Its versatility allows it to complement a range of flavors. Enjoy it alongside a fresh salad with grilled chicken or shrimp for a light and satisfying meal. The wine's acidity and fruitiness also make it an excellent match for grilled salmon or roasted turkey. For a delightful contrast, pair it with creamy cheeses like goat cheese or brie. Whether you're enjoying a casual picnic or a refined dinner, this rosé will elevate your food pairing choices.

TITLE: Weingut Pittnauer "Pitt Nat" Rose
DESCRIPTION: Blaufrankisch, Merlot, and Syrah. Whole bunch pressed and fermented in stainless steel tanks with final fermentation in bottle. Hand disgorged and topped off with the same wine. Organic and completely sulphur free.

TITLE: Weingut Pittnauer "Pitti" Red Blend
DESCRIPTION: Cultivated from 12-15 year-old vines planted on sandy clay, silt and limestone soils, the grapes undergo vineyard sorting followed by a 14-18 day maceration and then spontaneous fermentation in stainless steel, with natural yeasts, lasting four days. Aged for six months in stainless steel with rough filtration before bottling. 50% Zweigelt, 40% Blaufrankisch, 10% Merlot

TITLE: Weingut Schlossmuhlenhof Boden Funk Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: In 1881 a late-classical house was constructed here of sandstone from Flonheim. It remains our residence even today. Our family began selling our wines in bottles even before the Second World War. When Walter, today in semi-retirement, took over operations in 1985, he focused squarely on winegrowing. Nicolas assumed responsibility for the cellar and vineyards in 2007 after completing his studies in winegrowing. 2015 saw the sixth generation of the estate take the reins.

TITLE: Weingut Schlossmuhlenhof Landwein Rhein "Das ist keine Orange"
DESCRIPTION: 75% Muller-Thurgau, 15% Riesling, 5% St. Laurent, 5% Grauer Burgunder From 22-28 year old vines planted on 1.2 hectares of calcareous clay soils, the grapes were hand-harvested together in early October.

TITLE: Weingut Schlossmuhlenhof Landwein Rhein "Das ist Schon" White Blend
DESCRIPTION: The Scheurebe is macerated for 48 hours and both the Muller-Thurgau and Gelber Muskateller are macerated for 24 hours. Bottled January. Unfiltered.

TITLE: Weingut Schmitt Rheinhessen Frei Korper Kultur Rot
DESCRIPTION: Biancas and Daniels red 2019 FKK is first of all very friendly and easy-drinking: it smells and tastes crisp-red-fruity, rustic-rustic, of sour cherry, cranberry and raspberry, some forest fruit, sage, mint, juniper and conifers, tart and firm, with and without food. First it becomes a bit more reductive with flint and matchstick, then earthy and herbaceous and then again like an awesome cherry juice for adults. Much more than easy drinking. Nice entry Natural wine. from Schmitt winery Merlot, St. Laurent, Portuguese, Blaufränkisch, Pinot Noir and Spätburgunder. Stored in 4400 liter wooden barrels on the full lees. Bottled without filtration and without adding sulfur.

TITLE: Weingut Stefan Meyer Silvaner
DESCRIPTION: Vineyard practices are organic with cover crops planted for green manure and turned into the soil. Yields for the top wines are miniscule, so the Pinot Noir “R” 2010 for instance had its potential yield cut in half through green pruning throughout the growing season. Harvest is by hand with rigorous sorting though the low yield coupled with the generally dry conditions ensure that very little rot will need sorting out. The ferment begins spontaneously for maximum complexity.

TITLE: Weingut Wallner Eisenberg Blaufrankisch
DESCRIPTION: Amidst the idyllic wine country in Southern Burgenland is called Deusch Schutzen and the near Eisenberg. The mild Pannonian climate with no hot sun during the day and always cool nights is ideal for the growth of our wines, particularly the main towns Blaufrankisch. The protective hills with their deep, heavy clay soils and iron-shale soils on the Eisenberg leaves us here alone produce more wines: intense, fruity, earthy, spicy and minerally with a unique character. Like anywhere else in the world! Blaufrankisch are often paired with lamb dishes, grilled meats or smoked cheeses.

TITLE: Weinreich Basisrot
DESCRIPTION: Marc and Nina Weinreich took over this family estate in 2009, and immediately began elevating the viticultural practices, focusing on organic methods. In fact, the Estate just completed the process of organic certification, so starting in 2016, they will be officially certified. Weingut Weinreich is located in Bechtheim, in the Wonnegau district of the Rheinhessesn wine region. (Interestingly, Wonnegau translates to “district of delight,” while Weinreich translates to “rich with wine,” so winemaking seems a pre-determined fate for this family). The estate covers 15 hectares and produces about 8,000 cases. Soils are dominated by limestone, loess, and clay, and a little chalk. The range of wines produced is exciting and diverse, including Riesling, Pinot Gris, Silvaner and Pinot Meunier, as well as an orange Pinot Gris and a Petillant Naturel.

TITLE: Weinreich Basisweiss Grauburgunder
DESCRIPTION: 100% Grauburgunder Marc and Nina Weinreich took over this family estate in 2009, and immediately began elevating the viticultural practices, focusing on organic methods. In fact, the Estate just completed the process of organic certification, so starting in 2016, they will be officially certified. Weingut Weinreich is located in Bechtheim, in the Wonnegau district of the Rheinhessesn wine region. (Interestingly, Wonnegau translates to “district of delight,” while Weinreich translates to “rich with wine,” so winemaking seems a pre-determined fate for this family). The estate covers 15 hectares and produces about 8,000 cases. Soils are dominated by limestone, loess, and clay, and a little chalk. The range of wines produced is exciting and diverse, including Riesling, Pinot Gris, Silvaner and Pinot Meunier, as well as an orange Pinot Gris and a Petillant Naturel.

TITLE: Weinreich Heiter Bis Wolkig
DESCRIPTION: Dornfelder (50%), Kerner (50%) (a blend of red and white grapes) vinification: - 4-6 weeks fermentation on skins - 6 month maturation in 500L barrels. Alcohol by volume: 11 %. Total acid content: 6,5 g/l. Residual sugar: 0,0 g/l Summer. Winter. Rain. Snow. Whatever the season. Crack a bottle of this red and you’ll have sunshine in your pocket, not to mention your glass. When well chilled, this light Rheinhessen beauty will set your heart on fire. No coal from the Ruhr area here -- pure limestone of Rheinhessen.

TITLE: Weller Millennium Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Weller Millennium Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a rare and coveted expression from the esteemed Buffalo Trace Distillery. This wheated bourbon is aged for 12 years, offering a depth of flavor and complexity that is truly remarkable. Bottled at 90 proof, Weller Millennium showcases the distillery's dedication to crafting premium bourbon with a smooth, rich profile. Presented in an elegant 750ml bottle, this bourbon is a prized addition for collectors and enthusiasts alike.

TITLE: Weninger Ponzichter
DESCRIPTION: Wine made from grapes grown organically using natural composting techniques and special preparations of herbal sprays while following the astronomical calendar. netxSectionThis light and quaffable red wine is made from a blend of Pinot Noir and Zweigelt grown on biodynamic vineyards in Hungary and Austria. Bright red fruit and a hint of muskiness.

TITLE: Weninger Rozsa Petsovits
DESCRIPTION: A delightful and complex rosé wine produced by Weninger, a renowned winery located in the charming sub-region of Sopron in Hungary. The winery has been in the Weninger family for generations, and they are dedicated to producing high-quality wines that reflect the unique character and terroir of the region. Weninger Rozsa Petsovits is a refreshing and lively rosé, made from a blend of Kékfrankos, Zweigelt, and St. Laurent grape varieties, expertly blended to create a well-balanced and harmonious wine. The grapes are hand-harvested, fermented with native yeasts, and aged in neutral oak barrels to achieve a delicate balance of flavors. Weninger Rozsa Petsovits is a versatile wine that pairs well with a variety of foods. Its bright acidity and fruity flavors make it an excellent pairing for light and refreshing summer salads, grilled seafood, and sushi. It also pairs well with spicy dishes and rich, creamy cheeses like Brie and Camembert. Serve it chilled to bring out the wine's crisp and refreshing qualities.

TITLE: Wenzlau Vineyard Santa Rita Hills Chardonnay Estate
DESCRIPTION: This small, family vineyard is just 12 ½ planted acres (5 ½ Chardonnay, 7 Pinot Noir), yet it sits on a 100-acre parcel that runs from the Santa Ynez River up through the hills & canyons of the Santa Rita Hills. This provides the vineyard with ample untouched space for constant air circulation and natural biodiversity that we believe is extremely beneficial for growing the best quality fruit. Sandwiched between the larger Sea Smoke & Mt. Carmel Vineyards, Wenzlau Vineyard enjoys the steady ocean breeze that comes through the southwest facing canyon from the Pacific Ocean just 7 miles as the crow flies.

TITLE: Western Reserve Distillers 10 Year Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The 10 Year Barrel Proof Bourbon is a blend of carefully chosen barrels in that 10-12 year range at barrel proof. This is the same mash bill as the 8-year bourbon, and even barrel proof gives you an exceptionally smooth bourbon.

TITLE: Western Reserve Distillers 8 Year Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The 8 Year Bourbon barrels have been carefully hand-selected, harvested, and bottled with ages ranging from 9-12 years at 86 Proof (43% ABV) to bring you a truly exceptional award-winning bourbon that meets standards high enough to bear the name Western Reserve Distillers.

TITLE: Westland 5th Annual Peat Week American Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: It can’t be! But it is! Now in its fifth year, Peat Week continues to dazzle with feats of peat beyond imagination. Twirling, whirling, and curving through the air—The Greatest Smoke on Earth lands once again in January 2019. The 5th Annual Peat Week is limited to 1,083 bottles worldwide and is on limited allocation.

TITLE: Westland Distillery "Mistress Miasma"Limited Edition American Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This year’s festival bottling is marrying five new oak casks with two ex-Bourbon casks makes seven in the vatting. COOPERAGE: Two First-Fill ExBourbon and Five New American Oak MALT: Baird’s Heavily Peated Distiller’s Malt CASK MATURATION TIMES: 36–56 Months ALC./VOL: 54.4% TOTAL BOTTLED: 1,500

TITLE: Westland Distillery American Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A flagship malt is the core expression of a distillery’s house style. Westland’s American Oak is a reflection of where it is made and the collective intent of those who made it. When we founded Westland Distillery, we had a vision for an entirely new category of whiskey. Distilled from the rich, flavorful barley of Washington State and matured predominantly in new American oak casks in the steady, cool humidity of our seaside home, this whiskey is a testament to that vision. All of these choices and ingredients conspire to create an approachable, mature and uniquely American single malt that can stand with the best whiskies in the world.

TITLE: Westland Distillery Garryana American Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Westland’s Garryana series explores Quercus garryana, an oak species native to the Pacific Northwest— and its influence on whiskey’s flavor. This is Seattle, Washington-based Westland’s eighth Garryana release, and it keeps getting more graceful. The oak influence is exquisite, coaxing out notes of charcoal grill, Krispy Kreme doughnut, Honey Nut Cheerios, and a touch of salinity on the nose. A beautifully textured palate melds smoke and sweetness in superb fashion, expressing strawberry jam, burnt sugar, campfire smoke, and chocolate raspberry Ghirardelli square. Toasted marshmallows, honey, and cinnamon sweetness linger on and on throughout the finish, leaving you eager for another sip.

TITLE: Westland Distillery Garryana American Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Westland’s Garryana series explores Quercus garryana, an oak species native to the Pacific Northwest— and its influence on whiskey’s flavor. This is Seattle, Washington-based Westland’s eighth Garryana release, and it keeps getting more graceful. The oak influence is exquisite, coaxing out notes of charcoal grill, Krispy Kreme doughnut, Honey Nut Cheerios, and a touch of salinity on the nose. A beautifully textured palate melds smoke and sweetness in superb fashion, expressing strawberry jam, burnt sugar, campfire smoke, and chocolate raspberry Ghirardelli square. Toasted marshmallows, honey, and cinnamon sweetness linger on and on throughout the finish, leaving you eager for another sip.

TITLE: Westland Distillery Peated Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This Peated Malt whiskey is a variation on our house style made from a mash of peated malt that is among the smokiest in the world. We combine that with a variety of malt-focused spirits that together create a single malt whiskey that encompasses a wide spectrum of peaty and smoky flavors without dominating the palate. The peat character is sturdy enough to satisfy the cravings of those looking for a solid dose of smoke, while malt-focused mash bills contribute grainy and fruity notes that round out the whiskey. Westland’s Peated Malt is filled primarily into new American oak and 1st-fill used American oak, resulting in a multi-dimensional and balanced peated single malt whiskey.

TITLE: Westland Distillery Sherry Wood Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Westland’s Sherry Wood is a new world approach to an old world idea. For decades, the use of ex-sherry casks for whiskey maturation has been a favored technique in Scotland and beyond. In marrying the decadence of sherry with our unique grain-forward house style we create something altogether new. Like the grain we source, we hold our sherry casks to high standards of quality. These casks held some of the world’s finest Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso sherry for nearly a century and in the skilled hands of Rafael Cabello and his team at Tonelería del Sur in Montilla, Spain they have been given new life and purpose. Our long-standing partnership with his family-owned cooperage now provides us with one of the largest supplies of sherry casks in America. The nose offers an immediate richness, with honey-dipped oatmeal raisin cookies. Maple syrup follows close behind, drizzled over banana pancakes. The palate initially offers some kiwi with more maple and raisin syrup notes. Extended tastings offer a dazzling array of sweet cookies and pastries, getting darker and richer with time before eventually ceding the palate to stewed yellow fruits on the finish.

TITLE: Westland Outpost Range "Colere" Edition 1 American Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The unique landscape and climate of the Pacific Northwest create a dynamic ecosystem bursting with life and vitality. But beyond the land there are the people and their dedication to working it that makes it one of the best regions for growing barley in the world. Colere, from a Latin verb meaning to cultivate, begins to explore the thousands of new and forgotten varieties of barley, striving to capture the vibrancy and diversity of Pacific Northwest terroir through single malt whiskey.

TITLE: Westward "5 Borough Barrel" Single Barrel Cask Strength American Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: One of our distributors had the opportunity to select a single barrel of Westward Whiskey Cask Strength single malt and distribute It exclusively to five New York boroughs. They had enough individual accounts that wanted single-barrel products that justified breaking up a barrel into cases for individual sale. They usually only sell by their full barrel, but that was an exception. We were able to snag a couple of cases. Many of our members were curious about the brand, especially when the Cask Strength expression of theirs landed on the Whisky Advocate Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 list. While we have a virtual tasting with the brand in February, this is an opportunity to get a head start. Aroma: Grassy, Apricot, White Peach Palate: Baking Spices, Citrus Fruit, Clover Honey, Butterscotch Finish: Banana, Waffle Cone, Maple Barrel No. 16-221, 126 Proof

TITLE: Westward American Single Malt Pinot Noir Cask Finish
DESCRIPTION: Westward American Single Malt Pinot Noir Cask Finish, a truly elegant expression of Westward Whiskey, influenced by Oregon’s premier varietal: Pinot Noir. Created in partnership with Suzor Wines, this small batch release is s memorable sipper due to an approachable and balanced pinot noir finish.

TITLE: Westward American Single Malt Pinot Noir Cask Finish
DESCRIPTION: Westward American Single Malt Pinot Noir Cask Finish, a truly elegant expression of Westward Whiskey, influenced by Oregon’s premier varietal: Pinot Noir. Created in partnership with Suzor Wines, this small batch release is s memorable sipper due to an approachable and balanced pinot noir finish.

TITLE: Westward American Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Single Malt, reimagined. Born from the brand's love for whiskey and the desire to create something entirely new, this elevated American original demonstrates craftsmanship and creativity. The distinct, rich, and brazen Single Malt is the pinnacle of American whiskey. Created from locally malted barley, brewed for exceptional flavor, and matured to perfection in new, lightly charred American Oak barrels in Oregon, where the hot, dry summers and cool, wet winters are the ideal environment to raise a world-class whiskey.

TITLE: Westward Cask Strength American Single Malt
DESCRIPTION: Whisky Advocate Score: 94, #5 on the Top 20 Whiskies of 2022 List Founded in 2004 by Christian Krogstad, a brewer and winemaker turned distiller, Westward is a pioneer of American single malt. Despite a comparatively short history to that of Scotland, whiskeys like this have helped to prove the potential of the category. whose stature in the whiskey world continues to grow. Westward’s signature style takes the sweet, malt-driven base of traditional single malt spirit and matures it in new charred oak barrels, akin to bourbon. Bottled at cask strength, the flavor impression is of warm porridge and honey graham crackers laced with toasty oak, then a cigar wrapper and butterscotch on the finish. A satisfying American original.

TITLE: Westward Oregon Stout Cask American Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A celebration of Oregon’s legendary brewing culture, this whiskey honored state's brewing roots and grew out of the distillery's longstanding cask-trading tradition with Northwest craft beer producers. For as long as the distillery has been making whiskey, they have traded their freshly-emptied barrels with some of their brewing collaborators. Brewers, in turn, “seasoned” those barrels with Stout before returning them again. This Stout Cask Finish pushes the boundaries of flavor. It begins with the Westward American Single Malt, and is then aged for one year in Stout casks.

TITLE: Westward Oregon Stout Cask American Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A celebration of Oregon’s legendary brewing culture, this whiskey honored state's brewing roots and grew out of the distillery's longstanding cask-trading tradition with Northwest craft beer producers. TITLE: Westward Single Barrel  Cask Strength American Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This is a collaboration single barrel selection between The Prime Barrel and Breaking Bourbon.

TITLE: Westward Single Barrel Stout Cask Finsih Cask Strength American Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This is a collaboration single barrel selection between The Prime Barrel and Breaking Bourbon.

TITLE: Westward Whiskey Milestone American Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Discover the pinnacle of American whiskey with Westward Whiskey Milestone®, a groundbreaking release that redefines the art of distillation. From the heart of the American Northwest, Westward’s distillers have dedicated nearly two decades to pushing the boundaries of whiskey craftsmanship. Westward Whiskey Milestone® combines the best of Westward’s knowledge, creativity, and expertise, created using a sophisticated twenty-one barrel Solera system that holds some of the most cherished whiskies they’ve produced. This annual release is Westward’s most ambitious and exclusive whiskey, embodying a legacy of exceptional quality and innovation. The result is a full-bodied, complex whiskey that marries the richness of tradition with the forward-looking spirit of American craftsmanship. Westward Whiskey Milestone® is more than just a whiskey; it’s a celebration of heritage, creativity, and the remarkable journey of American whiskey. Secure a bottle of this limited masterpiece and experience the height of Westward’s craftsmanship firsthand.

TITLE: Westward Whisky Sample Set
DESCRIPTION: The Prime Barrel's Single Barrel whiskey club exclusive! The Westward whisky sample is set to be used in the upcoming virtual tasting. Details of the tasting are communicated via The Prime Barrel Discord whiskey community. Includes the following: 1 x 50 ml bottle of Westward American Single Malt Whiskey 1 x 50ml bottle of Westward Cask Strength American Single Malt 1 x 50ml bottle of Westward American Single Malt Pinot Noir Cask Finish 1 x 50ml bottle of Westward Oregon Stout Cask American Single Malt Whiskey

TITLE: Wheatley Craft Distilled Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Craft Distilled by Master Distiller Harlen Wheatley and his dedicated team at Buffalo Trace, Wheatley Vodka is made in small batches using Harlen’s one-of-a-kind micro-still and a unique recipe of wheat and other grains. Distilled a total of 10 times, triple filtered, and bottled at 82 proof, this artisanal vodka has a clean, crisp, and fresh taste. Harlen has always wanted to make a premium vodka, and knows from experience that wheat offers a delicate and balanced flavor profile. The wheat recipe is cooked, fermented, and distilled seven times on the micro-still before being married with a recipe made from other grains and distilled an additional three times. As Harlen describes it, "This is how vodka is supposed to taste." The nose is clean and neutral with a hint of citrus in the background. Upon tasting, it's very soft and viscous with a light sweetness on the tongue, a touch of sea salt minerality, maybe a whisper of vanilla. You'll say "Wow!" twice-- once for the low price, once (or more) for the great taste.

TITLE: Wheel Horse Cigar Blend Bourbon Whiskey Finished In Port, Cognac, Sherry & Armagnac Casks
DESCRIPTION: This Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey was matured for approximately four years in original charred oak barrels before being transferred to toasted oak barrels for finishing. It was bottled at 101 proof, non-chill filtered. The nose of this whiskey opens with notes of berries and toasty oak. Upon sipping, sweet vanilla and butter toffee flavors appear before hints of cherry and coffee cake. The finish is long and robust with notes of cinnamon, almond, and espresso.

TITLE: Wheel Horse Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Made at Green River Distilling Co. in Owensboro, Kentucky, this shows maturity far beyond its 2 to 4 years in the barrel, with a winning combination of proof and price. Root beer spice, candied pineapple, wet walnuts, clementine, and Christmas cookies on the nose. A velvety texture on the palate brings butter pecan ice cream, cinnamon toast, maple syrup, and vanilla custard. There is tremendous length on the finish, with a cola-like syrupy sweetness throughout. As debuts go, this one impresses.

TITLE: Wheel Horse Toasted Barrel Finish Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey was matured for approximately four years in original charred oak barrels before being transferred to toasted oak barrels for finishing. It was bottled at 101 proof, non-chill filtered. The nose of this whiskey opens with notes of berries and toasty oak. Upon sipping, sweet vanilla and butter toffee flavors appear before hints of cherry and coffee cake. The finish is long and robust with notes of cinnamon, almond, and espresso.

TITLE: Whiskey Baron's Old Ripy and Bond & Lillard
DESCRIPTION: The American whiskey blogosphere has been abuzz with word that Campari, the Italian drinks conglomerate that owns of Wild Turkey, would be starting a line of not-Wild Turkey whiskeys. Now Campari is poised to release the first two whiskeys in the line, dubbed Whiskey Barons, entitled Old Ripy and Bond & Lillard. The theme for Whiskey Barons is the revival of defunct brands, as well as the restoration of some Bourbon heritage. Part of the proceeds from Whiskey Barons sales will go to the restoration of the T.B. Ripy House, one of the Wild Turkey Distillery’s neighbors in Anderson County, Kentucky. T.B. Ripy was a late 19th Century Bourbon tycoon, and his mansion is locally known as “the house that Bourbon built.” Descendants of Ripy reacquired the house in 2010 with the intent of restoring it as a tourist destination, but renovation efforts reportedly stalled in 2014. As the name might imply, Old Ripy was one of the Ripy family labels, dating back to 1868. It’s reintroduction was done with the consultation of and using memorabilia provided by the Ripy family. It’s a non-chill filtered blend of 8-year-old Bourbon and other whiskeys made at Wild Turkey and bottled at 104 proof (52% ABV). Bond & Lillard is another old-timey brand with mid-19th Century origins, and in this instance, it was recreated using tasting notes from the 1904 World’s Fair, where Bond & Lillard won a Grand Prize. This expression is based on a charcoal-filtered 7-year-old Bourbon and bottled at 100 proof (50% ABV).

TITLE: WhistlePig "The Boss Hog" Single Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Each year, WhistlePig embarks on a bold journey in search of exceptional flavors, pushing boundaries and elevating rye whiskey. This eleventh release, The Boss Hog XI, brings the unparalleled influence of Rajasthan, India – the legendary "Land of Kings" – into the rye whiskey tradition. Inspired by Thandai, an elixir celebrating victory and strength, WhistlePig’s team has expertly aged Single Barrel Rye in Thandai-seasoned barrels. The result is an evocative fusion of rye’s robust character with a blend of saffron, cinnamon, cardamom, nutmeg, and black peppercorn. This unique aging process transforms the whiskey into a majestic and complex profile, a flavor tapestry of bold spice balanced by a soft, tropical sweetness. Unfiltered, bottled at proof, and crafted for the bold palate, The Boss Hog XI “Juggernaut” captures WhistlePig’s vision of power and grandeur in each sip. Tasting Notes: Nose: Rich Indian spices lead, with hints of rye, clove, and black pepper. Palate: Complex layers of overripe orchard fruits, cardamom, saffron, and fennel. Finish: A lingering softness of baking spice, sweet undertones, and tropical fruit warmth. For those who seek unparalleled whiskey experiences, The Boss Hog XI is a journey worth taking—Discover WhistlePig's latest masterpiece.

TITLE: WhistlePig "The Boss Hog" Single Barrel Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Each year, WhistlePig embarks on a bold journey in search of exceptional flavors, pushing boundaries and elevating rye whiskey. This eleventh release, The Boss Hog XI, brings the unparalleled influence of Rajasthan, India – the legendary "Land of Kings" – into the rye whiskey tradition. Inspired by Thandai, an elixir celebrating victory and strength, WhistlePig’s team has expertly aged Single Barrel Rye in Thandai-seasoned barrels. Unfiltered, bottled at proof, and crafted for the bold palate, The Boss Hog XI “Juggernaut” captures WhistlePig’s vision of power and grandeur in each sip. Finish: A lingering softness of baking spice, sweet undertones, and tropical fruit warmth.
