TITLE: Whistlepig 10 Years Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: WhistlePig ‘100/100’ is a 100-proof, 100 percent rye whiskey, aged for at least ten years through a unique double-barrel process. Imported from Canada and hand bottled in Vermont, WhistlePig is overseen by former Makers Mark master distiller David Pickerell. Unlike many rye whiskeys, WhistlePig is 100% rye and is bottled at 100 proof, making this a perfect choice for cocktails.

TITLE: WhistlePig 12 Year Old World Marriage
DESCRIPTION: A product of distillery’s experimentation process that began in 2012. Part of a wider mission to perfect highly matured rye whiskeys, distillery deliberately selected a 12-year-old rye and began aging it for an additional 2-6 weeks in rare European wine casks. These experimental finishes included PX and Oloroso Sherry, Port, Sauternes, Madeira, and a special collaboration with Pierre Ferrand Cognac. After reviewing all single the finishes, they selected the most dynamic of the bunch and released them successively in select markets with incredibly limited quantities. Those finishes were the Sauternes, Madeira and Port. As the first of the launch the Sauternes 12 Year old World Rye proudly took the 2015 Double Gold at the San Francisco Wine and Spirits Competition, and set the tone for what has been a highly successful new product launch. With Dave Pickerell as a guiding light and innovator, and after a concentrated three months conferring with top whiskey industry professionals across the country, distillery landed on what is the magnum opus of the series: The 12 Year Old World. A perfect marriage of all three single finishes in exacting proportions (63% Madeira, 30% Sauternes and 7% Port), the 12 Year highlights the bold and spicy attributes of a highly matured rye with the elegant flavors derived from each wine cask. The result is a smoothness and complexity never before seen in a whiskey. This unprecedented series of whiskeys included three major landmarks: The first American Whiskey ever finished in Sauternes The second American Whiskey finished in Madeira The first American Married Whiskey

TITLE: WhistlePig Double Malt 18 Year Old Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: WhistlePig's Double Malt, an 18-year-old straight rye whiskey is distilled from a mash bill of 79% rye, 15% malted rye, and 6% malted barley. WhistlePig Double Malt is described as an “experiment in how grain affects flavor early in the whiskey-making process, in particular, the bygone practice of malting rye.” Before industrial catalysts were introduced to increase efficiency, farmer distillers would malt a small portion of their rye harvest in order to access the grain’s starch content and set off the fermentation process. Floral, earthy flavors imparted by malted rye would add nuance to the bold, peppery spice character of classic rye whiskey. WhistlePig Double Malt 18 Year Old is bottled at 92 proof (46% ABV) and presented in a decanter that features a custom glass stopper made for WhistlePig by AO Glass in Burlington, Vermont.

TITLE: WhistlePig Farms 15 Year Old Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The new Vermont Oak barrels receive a long toast and heavy char designed to draw out a rich sweetness to complement the natural spice of aged rye. The final product mixes rye spice with wood sugar, earthy oakiness and lush citrus notes, all wrapped in a velvety smoothness unique to the finest aged spirits.

TITLE: WhistlePig Farmstock Beyond Bonded Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: WhistlePig has introduced its first-ever Bourbon Whiskey through Beyond Bonded Bourbon, portraying the epitome of a dream realized after years of meticulous endeavor. This high rye Bourbon, crafted from 100% farm whiskey, symbolizes a bold aspiration nurtured in the heart of Vermont's challenging yet rewarding agrarian landscape. Each harvest in Vermont is precious due to its short growing season and extreme temperatures, making every step from grain to glass a meaningful journey. The Beyond Bonded Bourbon is a tribute to the hearty, heirloom crop at its core and an untapped expression of the WhistlePig Farm, embodying the brand's grain-to-glass philosophy in every barrel. It's a narrative of love for whiskey making and an untempered toil of farming, encapsulated in a bottle, waiting to narrate the tales of its origin with every sip.​

TITLE: WhistlePig Farmstock Beyond Bonded Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The WhistlePig Farmstock Beyond Bonded Rye is crafted from grain to glass at the WhistlePig Farm and Distillery. It is a testament to WhistlePig's unyielding quest for crafting impeccable rye whiskeys right. This expression is part of a daring venture that commenced with a band of Rye enthusiasts finding solace in an abandoned dairy barn in Vermont's lush farm country. The Beyond Bonded Rye embodies their boldest dream, paying homage to the robust, heirloom crops at its essence. Each step of its journey, from farming in their backyard, distillation, and proofing with their well water to aging in sustainably harvested Vermont oak barrels, resonates with the pioneering spirit of WhistlePig Farm. This Straight Rye Whiskey is crafted meticulously at the WhistlePig Farm and Distillery, enshrining the wholesome essence of its origin. Every barrel of the Beyond Bonded Rye narrates a unique tale, aged gracefully for a period ranging between 4 years, 1 month, and 30 days to 5 years, 2 months, and 16 days in Vermont Estate Oak barrels. The meticulous hand bottling in March 2022 at 100 proof further accentuates its farm-to-bottle ethos, offering a genuine taste of WhistlePig's rich heritage with every sip.​

TITLE: Whistlepig Farmstock Rye Whiskey No 003
Whistlepig Piggyback Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In summer 2018, late Dave Pickerell returned to Whistlepig warehouses to realize his dream of creating the best-aged rye whiskey for your cocktail – 100% rye for full spice flavors, aged six years for unprecedented complexity, and bottled at his ideal strength. Stir or shake in good company.

TITLE: Whistlepig Piggyback Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In summer 2018, late Dave Pickerell returned to Whistlepig warehouses to realize his dream of creating the best-aged rye whiskey for your cocktail – 100% rye for full spice flavors, aged six years for unprecedented complexity, and bottled at his ideal strength. Stir or shake in good company.

TITLE: WhistlePig PiggyBank 10 Year Rye Limited Edition
DESCRIPTION: WhistlePig 10-Year 'Piggybank' Limited Edition Rye is a testament to a decade of innovation in whiskey crafting. Housed in a unique porcine decanter inspired by a 19th-century Berkshire Bitter Pig, this limited edition straight rye whiskey embodies the playful and innovative spirit of WhistlePig. Aged for 10 years and bottled at 110 proof, this wax-sealed whiskey is a collector's delight, offering a bold and rich flavor profile that reflects WhistlePig's commitment to quality and creativity.

TITLE: Whistlepig Roadstock Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: WhistlePig Whiskey will make history with the first whiskey finished on the road, traveling 6,000 miles aboard our rolling barrel warehouse. Roadstock Rye Whiskey is finished in craft wine and beer barrels from Sonoma and Los Angeles, CA, at the end of a cross-country road trip

TITLE: WhistlePig The Badonkadonk 25 Years Single Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: WhistlePig The Badonkadonk 25 Years Single Malt Whiskey is a rare and exceptional release from Vermont’s renowned WhistlePig Distillery. Aged for a full quarter of a century, this single malt whiskey represents the peak of long-aged American whiskey craftsmanship. Bottled at around 92-96 proof, the whiskey embodies a remarkable depth and complexity, developed through its extended time in oak. Each sip reveals the intricate layers of flavor achieved through careful aging, making this release a true collector’s item and a luxury for whiskey enthusiasts who appreciate finely aged, meticulously crafted whiskey.

TITLE: WhistlePig “RyederPig” Single Barrel Rye Aged 13 Years The Prime Barrel Pick #25
DESCRIPTION: Our first WhistlepIg pick is age stated as 10 yo but contains 13-yo 100% Canadian Rye. The selection was a close call between itself and the 15 yo counterpart. Both are super tasty, but we felt that folks will get a lot more value with this pick vs, a $250 bottle of 15-year-old expression. The barrel char level is #3, and the expression comes in at 117.5 proof Tasting Notes: Nose: Charred oak, raisins, stewed black cherries, dried tangerine peel, sage, black pepper, and hay Palate: Smokey, bruised golden apple, rhubarb, caramel, and coffee Finish: Lingering finish with notes of rye spice and cacao The sticker idea for the pick was provided by our Discord community and is a riff on a famous "Spiderpig" Simpson episode :) As usual, the selection will be supporting a charity. Once again, our Discord community has voted for their charity of choice, and, appropriately, we'll be donating a pig to an underprivileged family through Heifer International.

TITLE: White Girl Rose
DESCRIPTION: “Last summer, in the Hamptons, there was a rosé shortage. People were running through the streets, screaming. There was not enough rosé. They were hoarding it in their arms … and we said, ‘never again!’” That's when Instagram superstar Josh Ostrovsky (who you might know as @TheFat Jewish, or maybe just the King of Brunch. Or Whitney Jewston. Jewther Vandross?) says he got the idea for White Girl Rosé, a new wine label out this summer.

TITLE: White Nights Vodka
DESCRIPTION: Apollo White Nights Vodka was founded in 1994. The idea was to create a smooth vodka with reasonable pricing to be used at everybody’s satisfaction. It is an excellent choice for bartenders. To be consumed pure and in cocktail mixes. It has been made according a recipe created in The Republic of Russia with knowledge and tradition from the Russian art of making superb distilled products.

TITLE: White Pike Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: White Pike Whiskey is a refined spirit made of a signature blend of locally grown corn, spelt and malted wheat. Distilled with precision and aged in 18 minutes, White Pike is rich through the middle and finishes smooth, still young enough to mix in ways brown whiskeys won’t. With notes of buttered toast and warm apple pie it’s easy drinkin’ and uniquely versatile. Shoot it fast, sip it slow, or mix it with anything from pomegranate juice to pickle brine. With a backbone strong enough for traditional whiskey lovers, adventurers, and rebels alike, enjoy White Pike however you want it, as you are.

TITLE: Whitebox Cocktails "Pocket Negroni"
DESCRIPTION: Porter's Gin, Italian Bitter Aperitif, Sweet Vermouth. This bittersweet Italian classic is made of one part Porter's Gin, one part sweet vermouth and one part bitter aperitif.

TITLE: Whitebox Cocktails Pret A Boire Boulevardier
DESCRIPTION: While the negroni is famed for its crisp and bright bitterness, its darker moodier cousin is rich, complex and indulgent.

TITLE: Widow Jane  12 Years Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Widow Jane has sweet and tempting aromas of chocolate, vanilla, honey and sweet corn. The taste is a warm and flavorful medley of oak, vanilla, rye spice and pepper. It has a long and enjoyable finish with hints of chocolate, vanilla and lemon peel.

TITLE: Widow Jane 10 Years Anniversary Edition Straight Bourbon Whiskey 750ml  #1
Widow Jane 10 Years Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: As great whiskey distillers throughout the world — from Kentucky to Scotland — have long known, it takes sweet water from tough rock to make great whiskey. And, that’s what Widow Jane Whiskey is all about.

TITLE: Widow Jane 13 yrs Breaking Bourbon "Bourbon Widow" Single Barrel Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Widow Jane Distillery is located in the center of Brooklyn’s Red Hook neighborhood. While Widow Jane does distill in-house, this particular selection was from barrels sourced from MGP. With older MGP barrels seeing increasingly high demand and less availability, we jumped at the chance to select a barrel. Of the barrels offered, the flavor range was relatively tight. Each barrel was really good, offering a classic bourbon flavor profile with the right balance of oak. For this pick, it meant sussing out the slight nuances between barrels. Ultimately, we found one barrel to have a little more character, a deeper vein of oak, and slightly more intensity of sweetness. While we generally tend to lean towards a higher proof, the lower but still robust 99 Proofpoint actually works really well with this bourbon. Considering its higher age and oak influence, this results in a bourbon that favors elegance over a bombastic explosion of flavor. It’s a more classic aged bourbon experience, and one that should be savored.

TITLE: Widow Jane Aged 10 Years "You'll Never Walk Alone" Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Widow Jane Distillery's "You'll Never Walk Alone," is a limited bottling of its signature 10-year-old bourbon specifically created to raise funds to benefit the USBG National Charity Foundation and CORE: Children of Restaurant Employees. The effort intends to support hospitality workers experiencing financial distress as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic. You'll Never Walk Alone is an over-proof, distiller's choice' bottling of Widow Jane 10 Year bourbon bottled at 100 proof versus the whiskey's standard 91 proof  marking the first time the brand's signature bourbon has been made available at different proof.

TITLE: Widow Jane Black Opal 20 Year Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Mizunara Oak
DESCRIPTION: The 2024 release of Widow Jane Black Opal represents a rare discovery of Widow Jane’s oldest and most refined bourbon. Aged for two decades and meticulously finished in exclusive Mizunara oak casks, Black Opal is crafted for the discerning whiskey collector. This 20-year bourbon blend benefits from a finishing period in Mizunara oak, known for its porous structure and unique, subtle tannins. Sourced from ancient Japanese oak trees, these Mizunara barrels impart the bourbon with an intense and exotic profile. The aroma greets you with deep, layered notes of molasses, smoky frankincense, and subtle tobacco, weaving into hints of Tahitian vanilla, dried apricot, and rose hip. The taste profile unfolds with black strap molasses, walnut, poached plum, and a luxurious burnt sage undertone, finishing with brown butter smoothness. Widow Jane’s signature limestone-filtered water from Rosendale Mines of New York enriches the mouthfeel, adding depth and a lingering finish. Widow Jane Black Opal 20 Year is a limited-edition bourbon that combines rare age and finishing expertise for a truly unforgettable experience.

TITLE: Widow Jane Decadence
DESCRIPTION: A blend of straight bourbon whiskeys finished in maple syrup barrels. Features classic Widow Jane bourbons aged at least 10 years. Finished in Maple Syrup Barrels from New York’s artisanal Crown Maple® Co. Delivers a slightly sweet, creamy-rich mouth feel and lingering finish

TITLE: Widow Jane Lucky Thirteen 13 Year Old Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The whiskey aging process is influenced by time & place. Aren’t we lucky. These barrels have all been influenced by the greatly varying temperatures & humidity levels of their original source and their time in our rick house in Red Hook, Brooklyn. The different rick house positions combined with climate variations have led to subtle deviations in flavor, all coming together in a hyper small batches, little more than a handful of barrels at a time. Aged for a minimum of thirteen years, non-chill filtered & proofed with our own limestone mineral water from the Legendary Rosendale Mines of NY, Lucky Thirteen is always a way to share good fortune.

TITLE: Widow Jane Oak Aged Rye Mash Whiskey
Widow Jane Paradigm Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Paradigm Rye is for us emblematic of the trifecta arts of distilling, blending & finishing. A marriage of hand-selected straight ryes from NY, KY, and IN, finished with our unique mineral water from the legendary Rosedale mines, the Paradigm is our signature (rye) whiskey, round, creamy, spicy, and impossibly complex. Deserving of your attention neat, yet generous in a Rye Old Fashioned.

TITLE: Widow Jane Rye Mash Oak & Applewood Aged
DESCRIPTION: This artisan whisky is aged in barrels with oak and applewood staves and brought to proof with limestone water imported to Brooklyn from the Widow Jane Mine.

TITLE: Widow Jane The Vaults 14 Years A Blend of Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Widow Jane: the Vaults is a limited release of distillery's rarest & oldest bourbons. Hand-selected from their rick house, we’re quite excited to introduce distillery's most hedonistic bourbon to date. This release is a blend of 14-year-old & older bourbon whiskeys. The whiskey was finished in unique American Oak casks coopered with 8-year-old air seasoned wood (instead of the standard 1-2 years) to develop the one-of-a-kind flavor profile influenced by each season, creating a rich & distinguished whiskey. According to President & Head Distiller Lisa Wicker, "When new wood been carefully cured for an extraordinary eight years, absolutely nothing green or tannic is left. Instead, aromatic campfire from the char, vanilla, pecan, leather and sweet tobacco are brought forward to enhance similar notes already present in the whiskey."

TITLE: Widow Jane The Vaults 15 Years A Blend of Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Widow Jane The Vaults is a 2020 limited release of our rarest and oldest bourbons. Hand-selected from our rick house, this is quite simply our most hedonistic bourbon to date. The 2020 Edition of The Vaults is a marriage of fifteen year and older bourbons, painstakingly selected from our own extensive warehoused stock. Finished in unique Appalachian Oak casks, using five-year-old air seasoned wood.

TITLE: Wigle Al Centro Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Al Centro! is the whiskey version of Mezcal that is made from mesquite-smoked malt and aged in Tequila barrels for three years. It is made with three malts: mesquite-smoked malt, brewers malt and caramel malt. It is a lighter colored whiskey because it is finished in tequila barrels.

TITLE: Wigle Small Cask Series Pennsylvania Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wigle is a family owned and operated lark. The distillery became operational in December of 2011 and opened to the public in March 2012 after two years of lobbying to change the state laws to allow for an on-premise model of craft distillery to exist in Pennsylvania. In 2015 & 2016, Wigle was the most awarded craft whiskey distillery in the US by the American Craft Spirits Association and has won Best in Category Craft Rye Whiskey (2015), Best in Category Wheat Whiskey (2016), and Best in Category Genever (2016), in the same double-blind competition of hundreds of whiskeys from around the country. Wigle devotes an enormous amount of resources to innovation and makes each of its dozens of spirits, including Whiskeys, Gins, Honey Spirits and Bitters, grain-to-bottle from local, organic ingredients. Wigle never, ever purchases spirits from bulk suppliers. 200ml flask.

TITLE: Wigle Small Cask Series Pennsylvania Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wigle is a family owned and operated lark. The distillery became operational in December of 2011 and opened to the public in March 2012 after two years of lobbying to change the state laws to allow for an on-premise model of craft distillery to exist in Pennsylvania. In 2015 & 2016, Wigle was the most awarded craft whiskey distillery in the US by the American Craft Spirits Association and has won Best in Category Craft Rye Whiskey (2015), Best in Category Wheat Whiskey (2016), and Best in Category Genever (2016), in the same double-blind competition of hundreds of whiskeys from around the country. Wigle devotes an enormous amount of resources to innovation and makes each of its dozens of spirits, including Whiskeys, Gins, Honey Spirits and Bitters, grain-to-bottle from local, organic ingredients. Wigle never, ever purchases spirits from bulk suppliers. 200ml flask.

TITLE: Wigle Whiskey Organic Pennsylvania Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This Organic Rye Whiskey takes its cues from the original American Whiskey, Monongahela Rye. Western Pennsylvania produced this style of Rye for more than 100 years. They distill this approachable Rye on our traditional pot still. As you dive in, you’ll find your taste buds steeped in dried tart cherries and the aromatic skins of stone fruit and vanilla. Notes of cinnamon and clove and finally walnut, black tea, and distinctive pepper, provide this Rye structure and layers of depth. As will all spirits from this distillery, Wigle makes this spirit from scratch from regional ingredients. Hell-bent on producing the most bursting-with-terroir and inventive spirits, they mill, ferment, and pot-distill all of our products at our family-owned distillery in Pittsburgh’s Strip District.

TITLE: Wigle Whiskey Quaker Strength Oat Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wigle Whiskey crafted Wigle's Quaker Strength whiskey from oat malt and dark roast malted barley inspired by an oatmeal stout mash bill. They then aged the whiskey in new 15-gallon charred oak casks for 16 months and bottled it at 46% ABV (92 proof). Specs: Oat Malt Whiskey - approximately 57% of the mash bill is made up of Thomas Fawcett Oat Malt; The balance is made of of various levels of roasted and malted barleys, including a Black Malt, Munich Malt, Pale Malt, Caramel Malts, and Roasted Barley

TITLE: Wigle Wry Rusky Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wry Rusky is next in line in distillery's current Brewers Series. This is a collaboration with Grist House Craft Brewery in Millvale. The inspiration for this spirit is Black in the USSR, one of the Grist House’s most popular brews. Black in the USSR is a Russian Imperial Stout. First described in seventeenth century, this style of beer has come roaring back from obscurity to worldwide popularity due to the development of craft brewing culture in the United States. The definition of a Russian Imperial Stout has changed a great deal since it was originally produced in England in the 1700s. In the most basic terms, Russian Imperial Stouts are dark, high-alcohol beers that tend to express flavors on the roasty/chocolatey side of the spectrum and will often include adjuncts or botanicals to enrich the flavor. The style of beer is said to have been a favorite of Catherine the Great, Empress of Russia in the 18th Century, hence the name “Russian Imperial”. Black in the USSR is, to the extent that such a thing exists, a classic Russian Imperial Stout. It is dark, rich and smooth with a traditional flavor profile. Dark chocolate and coffee notes add a pleasantly bitter finish that compliments the creaminess of the beer. The Wry Rusky whiskey pays homage to the original Black in the USSR beer by highlighting the spicy, roasty, toasty, boozy and bold characteristics. In order to replicate the spicy and roasty notes of Black in the USSR, distillery built their mash bill around locally grown rye grain and a blend of different malts. They sourced the rye from Chatham University’s Eden Hall Campus and the malt portion of the grain bill is comprised of five different malts that lend body, sweetness, and complex roasty and bitter notes. Wry Rusky was aged in new, charred American oak barrels for over 18 months. Such an aging process reinforces the bold, roasty characteristics of the whiskey. 46% ABV (92 Proof)

TITLE: Wild Arc Farm Aurora Finger Lakes
DESCRIPTION: Wild Arc Farm Aurora Finger Lakes is a lightly sparkling wine made from Aurore and Traminette grapes grown in the Finger Lakes region of New York State. The wine has a pale yellow color and aromas of peaches, sweet tarts, and honey. On the palate, it is light-bodied with crisp acidity and flavors of citrus fruits, white peach, and honeydew melon. The finish is clean and refreshing, with a lingering minerality.

TITLE: Wild Arc Farm Piquette! Rosato Sparkling Wine
DESCRIPTION: Wild Arc is the original reviver of the ancient Piquette style, a pomace wine made from macerating pressed skins, stems and seeds with water this is an ancient beverage that makes the most of the grape harvest. A slew of varicolored hybrid grape skins from the Hudson Valley’s Amorici Vineyard along with Marquette, Noiret and Riesling skins from other New York vineyard sources. Dry with aromas of red berries, lilac and peppercorns. Wild yeasts, no filtering or fining, very low additions of sulfites being the only thing added.

TITLE: Wild Arc Farm Piquette! Skin Contact Sparkling Wine
DESCRIPTION: Wild Arc is the original reviver of the ancient Piquette style, a pomace wine made from macerating pressed skins, stems and seeds with water this is an ancient beverage that makes the most of the grape harvest. Made with skins of Chardonnay and Riesling grapes.

TITLE: Wild Common Tequila Blanco
DESCRIPTION: Embark on a journey of discovery with Wild Common Tequila Blanco, an exceptional expression that captures the untamed spirit of Mexico. Meticulously crafted by the Wild Common distillery, this Blanco tequila is a testament to the pure essence of agave, offering a sensory adventure for enthusiasts seeking authenticity and craftsmanship.

TITLE: Wild Turkey "Kentucky Spirit" Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: 101 proof (50.5% alcohol), single-barrel bourbon, with each barrel hand-selected under the watchful eye of legendary Master Distiller Jimmy Russell. Known for being fuller bodied, with rich vanilla flavors and a hint of sweetness, it's the perfect bourbon to enjoy neat.

TITLE: Wild Turkey 101 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wild Turkey 101 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a bold, full-bodied bourbon that embodies the rich tradition of Wild Turkey Distillery. Bottled at 101 proof (50.5% ABV), this classic bourbon offers a robust flavor profile, making it a favorite among whiskey enthusiasts for generations. With its high rye mashbill and extended aging process, Wild Turkey 101 delivers a perfect balance of sweet caramel, vanilla, and bold spice, making it an ideal bourbon for sipping neat, on the rocks, or in cocktails.

TITLE: Wild Turkey 101 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wild Turkey 101 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a bold, full-bodied bourbon that embodies the rich tradition of Wild Turkey Distillery. Bottled at 101 proof (50.5% ABV), this classic bourbon offers a robust flavor profile, making it a favorite among whiskey enthusiasts for generations. With its high rye mashbill and extended aging process, Wild Turkey 101 delivers a perfect balance of sweet caramel, vanilla, and bold spice, making it an ideal bourbon for sipping neat, on the rocks, or in cocktails.

TITLE: Wild Turkey 101 Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: A legendary 101 proof straight rye whiskey known for its deep golden amber color and warm, smoky flavor with a rich, balanced aroma of vanilla and spice. 101 Rye finishes long and spicy and stands up to any mixer and shines through in a classic cocktaillike the Old Fashioned.

TITLE: Wild Turkey 12-Year Old Distiller's Reserve 101 Proof Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Born from the Father& Son Distilling genius of Jimmy & Eddie Russel, Wild Turkey 12-year-Old Distiller's Reserve is Kentucky Straight Bourbon of the highest character. This special release has been carefully selected from the distiller's favorite reserve, barreled at a lower proof, and slowly matured to create a bourbon of exceptional quality. With notes of vanilla, rich caramel, hints of spice, and a long chocolate orange finish, Wild Turkey 12-Year Old Distiller's Reserve is a showcase of the world-renowned craftsmanship of Jimmy & Eddie Russel and brilliantly reveals the bold and distinctive character of Wild Turkey bourbon.

TITLE: Wild Turkey 13 Year Old Distiller's Reserve Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Created specifically for the Japanese market (where the number thirteen is lucky), the 13-year-old Distiller's Reserve is blended from barrels selected from the lower floors of the rack houses. These barrels, not subject to the heat of the upper floors, had been filled at a lower proof going into the barrel and, hence, are a lower proof coming out as well. Bottled at 45.5% ABV.

TITLE: Wild Turkey 17 Years Master's Keep Bottle in Bond Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The fifth release in the series is only the second-ever Wild Turkey bourbon to carry the bottled-in-bond label. A bourbon with that label must be the product of one single distilling season from one distillery, aged in a federally bonded warehouse and bottled at 100 proof. The distilery took the historic process and protocol of aging for four years to the next level and allowed the liquid to rest for 17 years. They aged and perfected this rare, 17-year-old bourbon in Wild Turkey’s Camp Nelson rickhouses. This expression is a nod to the past, both to their own heritage and the heritage of American whiskey-making as a craft.

TITLE: Wild Turkey American Spirit
DESCRIPTION: This a 15-year-old bonded bourbon, 100 proof, produced in small batches, and limited to 24,000 bottles worldwide

TITLE: Wild Turkey Cheesy Gold Foil
DESCRIPTION: Wild Turkey Cheesy Gold Foil is – pun intended – the gold standard for all things Wild Turkey. Or at least it was until the Russell’s ’98 and 2002 came along and dethroned it. A 12-year-old version of the reliable Wild Turkey 101 released for the American market in the mid-late 80’s through the early 90’s this bourbon delivered on its golden marketing and quickly became beloved by Wild Turkey fans.

TITLE: Wild Turkey Diamond Anniversary Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: In honor of 60 outstanding years of service, Jimmy Russell is getting some well deserved love in this fitting tribute of select barrels of old reserves ranging from 13-16 years in age, chosen and blended by his son Eddie. Find out why this has become one of the quintessential American Whiskies in the world. Whisky Advocate magazine rating: 89

TITLE: Wild Turkey Father & Son 13 Year Old Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This rare 13-year-old Wild Turkey was created by Jimmy and Eddie Russell, the only active father & son master distiller duo in the world. Jimmy Russell started working at Wild Turkey in 1954, and Eddie followed him in 1981. Together they have over a hundred years of experience making high-quality bourbon. This limited-edition Wild Turkey Bourbon was bottled in 2020 at 86 proof. The bottles saw a bit of a redesign for this release: the standard bottle made way for a dumpier 1L bottle. It also comes in a beautiful purple box instead of the usual tube.

TITLE: Wild Turkey Forgiven Blend Of Bourbon & Rye Straight Whiskies
DESCRIPTION: Stats: This is a blend of bourbon and rye straight whiskies. It is bottled at 45.5% ABV. It has a nice toffee color in the glass. The bottle is the same shape as their Rare Breed bourbon and comes in a nice embossed paper and metal tube shaped box. Nose: Initially caramel, then after a while I get a floral scent and faint black pepper. Mouth: First note from after my first sip just reads: "SPICY!" If you hold it in your mouth while trying to tease out it's flavor, it tingles. After spending a little more time with it, you are hit with cinnamon and a hint of vanilla. But this isn't an overly sweet whiskey. Finish: Tannic bitterness which fades into a peppery tingle. Batch #303

TITLE: Wild Turkey Generations Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey 2023
DESCRIPTION: Experience the legacy of the Russell family with Wild Turkey Generations Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey. This exceptional bourbon pays homage to over six decades of dedication and expertise in crafting premium spirits. With a high-proof blend of carefully selected corn, rye, and barley malt, Wild Turkey Generations delivers a robust and complex flavor profile. Each sip reveals the rich character and smooth finish that have become the hallmark of Wild Turkey. Perfect for both connoisseurs and new bourbon enthusiasts, this whiskey is a testament to tradition and quality.

TITLE: Wild Turkey Jimmy Russell 70th Anniversary Release Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wild Turkey Jimmy Russell 70th Anniversary Release Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a tribute to the legendary Wild Turkey master distiller, Jimmy Russell, celebrating his 70 years of unparalleled contributions to the whiskey world. This special release is a meticulously crafted blend of some of the distillery’s finest and most aged bourbons, bottled at a higher proof to honor the bold and rich character that Jimmy Russell has become known for. This limited-edition bourbon captures the essence of Wild Turkey’s heritage, offering a smooth and complex profile that pays homage to decades of craftsmanship and passion. Whether enjoyed neat or shared among friends, this release is a fitting tribute to a bourbon icon.

TITLE: Wild Turkey Master's Keep "Revival" Oloroso Sherry Cask Finish Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Aged 12 to 15 years in American oak, then finished in oloroso sherry barrels, this starts with a big, spicy kick, rounding into a long vanilla and caramel finish. Adding water reveals delicious, concentrated layers of spiced caramel, finishing with hints of mocha, hazelnut, lemon peel and dazzling candied ginger heat.

TITLE: Wild Turkey Master's Keep 17 Year Old Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The story behind Master’s Keep is even more interesting. In 1997, Wild Turkey was running out of space in their warehouse so they transferred the barrels to stone warehouse at the old Stone Castle Distillery. Due to some water damage the barrels were moved to a different stone warehouse on the property. Finally, the barrels were moved back to the Wild Turkey distillery in 2010. Cool story but why does any of this matter? You’ll notice the proof of Master’s Keep is 86.8. That’s because of the aging environment. Stone warehouses have far less temperature swings and as a result affect the finished product. Whisky Advocate magazine rating: 91

TITLE: Wild Turkey Master's Keep ONE
DESCRIPTION: There’s a father-son dynamic at work between Wild Turkey’s two master distillers on this release—with the patriarch Jimmy Russell preferring 8 to 10 years of aging and son Eddie favoring the older stuff. The final blend thus combines 8 to 10 year old and 14 year old bourbons, and that blend was then finished in a mix of toasted and new charred oak barrels. Refined maturity becomes apparent on the first sip. It’s creamy and well spiced, with flavors of chocolate-covered marshmallow, caramel, cotton candy, and marvelous touches of aged tobacco leaf. This is a big whiskey that carries its age with grace and balance

TITLE: Wild Turkey Master's Keep Unforgotten Blend of Kentucky Straight Bourbon & Rye Finished in Rye Casks
DESCRIPTION: Wild Turkey Master's Keep Unforgotten is a blend of 13-year-old bourbon and 8- and 9-year-old ryes, finished in rye casks. It represents the harmony between bourbon's richness and rye's spiciness, offering a complex and intriguing taste experience. Released in October 2022, this blend by Wild Turkey showcases their expertise in crafting unique and premium whiskeys. One would say, it stands taller than Russel's Reserve 13 Year Old, which is a fantastic whiskey in it's own right.

TITLE: Wild Turkey Master’s Keep "Decades"
DESCRIPTION: #3 on Whisky Advocate "Top 20 Whiskies of 2017" list. Wild Turkey Master Distiller Eddie Russell has just notched up a not-insignificant 35 years in the family business. To celebrate the momentous occasion he’s put together a rather special release, recently unveiling the Wild Turkey Master’s Keep "Decades". If the presentation of this one looks familiar, that’s because it’s the second limited release in Wild Turkey’s Master’s Keep series, the follow-up to last year’s 17-year-old. Don’t think of it as merely a follow-up to the 17-year-old Master’s Keep though, as this is an entirely different beast. Whilst this one doesn't carry a specific age statement like last year’s, the ‘Decades’ reference is a nod to the fact that it’s comprised of quality bourbons aged for between 10 to 20 years, some of the oldest to be bottled by Wild Turkey to date.

TITLE: Wild Turkey Master’s Keep Triumph 10 Years Old Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wild Turkey Master’s Keep Triumph 10 Years Old Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey is a limited-edition release from the Master’s Keep series, showcasing the legacy of rye whiskey at Wild Turkey Distillery. Aged for 10 years and bottled at a higher proof, this rye whiskey offers a deep and robust flavor profile that perfectly balances the spicy nature of rye with the smoothness that comes from a decade of maturation. This rare expression is part of Wild Turkey’s continued innovation and craftsmanship, making it a must-have for collectors and rye whiskey enthusiasts.

TITLE: Wild Turkey Rare Breed Barrel Proof Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Rare Breed Barrel Proof Bourbon was first released in 1991. Since then, there have only been 10 releases. So now you understand why it’s called “Rare Bird.” Let’s cut right to the specs. Don’t worry that there is no age statement. All the experts agree that this powerhouse Bourbon combines six, eight, and twelve-year-old top-end products. The mash bill is 75% corn, 13% rye, and 12% malted barley. And it’s bottled at cask strength! We’ve tasted it straight up, but this monster was made to stand up to ice and a splash of water and teach it who’s boss.

TITLE: Wild Turkey Rare Breed Barrel Proof Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wild Turkey Rare Breed Barrel Proof Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey is a bold and uncut expression from the Wild Turkey distillery, offering whiskey lovers a full-bodied and intense rye experience. Bottled straight from the barrel without dilution, this rare breed rye showcases the rich, spicy character that defines the rye whiskey category, while still maintaining the smoothness that Wild Turkey is known for. The high proof enhances the depth of flavors, making it an ideal choice for those who enjoy a robust, unfiltered rye whiskey that delivers both intensity and complexity in every sip.

TITLE: Wild Turkey Rye Master's Keep "Cornerstone" 109 Proof Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Master’s Keep Cornerstone Rye is the fourth release in the Master’s Keep series, and the oldest rye whiskey ever released by Wild Turkey. For this one-of-a-kind Limited Edition, Eddie Russell hand-picked and set aside a secret lot of his oldest and boldest rye whiskey barrels, all aged from 9 to 11 years, then used his nearly four decades of experience to create a perfectly balanced spirit.

TITLE: Wild Turkey Voyage Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Jamaican Rum Casks
DESCRIPTION: Wild Turkey Master's Keep Voyage is an expertly aged 10-year-old bourbon that has undergone a secondary maturation in casks that previously aged Jamaican pot still rum for 14 years. This unique whiskey, crafted by Master Distiller Eddie Russell in collaboration with Appleton Estate Master Blender Dr. Joy Spence, embodies over 80 years of combined experience in spirit-making. It features a palate of fruits, caramel, and aged oak, with a warm, long-lasting finish of chocolate and spice.

TITLE: Wilderness Trail "Where the High Rye-id Things Are" Cask Strength Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey The Prime Barrel #53
DESCRIPTION: Most of our members wanted us to bring back Wilderness” wheated bourbon expression. Like good soldiers, we tasted through 6 barrels of their wheated expression and were pretty underwhelmed. Out of 6, only 1 barrel was remotely appealing, but nothing to write home about. The other five were “meh.” Knowing that the distillery also has High Rye bourbon and Rye whiskey expressions, we asked them to taste them. Our wish was granted, and 6 more barrels were presented for our tasting pleasure. We tasted these blind with the goal of leaving there with the best-tasting liquid. The second flight was miles better than the first one. We liked almost all 6 but really were drawn to two out of those 6 (barrels 1 and 5). Both barrels had a lot going on on the palate and had a medium to long finish, but Barrel 1 had a slightly better nose and won out at the end. It turned out to be a High Rye Bourbon selection (64/24/12 mashbill). Tasting notes: Nose: candied qualities, brown sugar, a little bit of heat, roses Palette: green apple taffy, roses, after opening up lots of dried apricot. Finish: medium finish with a little bit of heat that balances out the candied qualities. Barrel Details: 110.86 proof, 64/24/12 high rye mash bill ISC Char #4 staves air cured 18-21 months $5 from each bottle will go to support hungry people in Kentucky (sadly, there are many of them, even in this day of age). God's Pantry Food Bank does a lot of good for those people. Wilderness Trail distillery is located in counties served by this organization.

TITLE: Wilderness Trail Distillery 6 Year Old Bottled In Bond Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Look for Wilderness Trail’s wheated and rye Bourbon with a silver label and a “6” on the neck tag and on the vertical label. The silver label mashbill for the wheated Bourbon is 64% corn, 24% wheat and 12% barley. For the rye Bourbon, the difference is 24% rye instead of wheat. The 6-year is deeper in character and richer in flavors found in more mature Bourbons. We hope you enjoy all the deliciousness of our Bourbons with this age statement.

TITLE: Wilderness Trail Distillery 8 Year Old Bottled In Bond Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wilderness Trail 8-Year Bourbon is a small batch, which in this case is 18-20 barrels. This bourbon is Bottled In Bond, so it's 100 proof by definition. There's definitely a noticeable difference between this 8-year-old bourbon and their regular release, which is around 5 years or so. The flavors are more mature. Notably, this bourbon changed considerably after having a day or two to open up. The fruit flavors, as well as the more mature flavors, really developed, as did more complexity. This is a very enjoyable bourbon, and worth the 8-year wait! This is Batch: LF19A 8, "wheated" mashbill

TITLE: Wilderness Trail Distillery Single Barrel Limited Release 16 yo Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: To help support the battle against cancer Wilderness Trail owners Shane Baker and Pat Heist are doubling down on the fight. About a year ago they purchased a 15-year-old barrel of Willett Distillery bourbon at Willett-To-Be-Cured, an auction for the American Cancer Society. Rather than bottling it and selling it or drinking it they decided to continue to let it age for an additional year in the barrel making this 15-year-old bourbon a 16-year-old bourbon. Super limited, one time only release.

TITLE: Wilderness Trail High Rye Small Batch Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wilderness Trail Straight Bourbon High Rye Small Batch Bottled In Bond Sweet Mash is a high-quality bourbon produced by Wilderness Trail Distillery in Danville, Kentucky. This small-batch bourbon is made using a sweet mash process, which involves using fresh yeast and a clean environment to ferment each batch, resulting in a more consistent and vibrant flavor profile. This bourbon is bottled in bond, ensuring it meets strict regulations, including being aged for at least four years and bottled at 100 proof.

TITLE: Wilderness Trail Small Batch Bottled In Bond Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wilderness Trail Straight Rye Whiskey Small Batch Bottled In Bond is a premium rye whiskey crafted with precision by Wilderness Trail Distillery in Danville, Kentucky. This small batch rye whiskey is made using a sweet mash process, ensuring a consistent and vibrant flavor profile. Distilled in a copper column still and aged in #4 char barrels, this rye whiskey is bottled at 100 proof, meeting the stringent requirements of the Bottled in Bond Act.

TITLE: Wilderness Trail Small Batch Straight Wheated Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Wilderness Trail Small Batch Straight Wheated Bourbon is a premium bourbon from Wilderness Trail Distillery in Danville, Kentucky. This Bottled in Bond bourbon is made using a sweet mash process and features a high wheat content, among the highest used in Kentucky bourbon. Aged in barrels made from 18-month air-dried staves and with a char level of #4, this bourbon is aged 5 to 6 years and bottled at 100 proof.

TITLE: Willett 3 Year Old Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Medium-bodied barrel strength whiskey; much as the 2-year expression, this drinks surprisingly elegant for a Cask Strength Rye Whiskey. There is the initial spice punch, but it dissipates rather quickly into a very enjoyable sweet/spice combination. For years, Kentucky Bourbon Distillers, run by the Kulsveen family, has been bottling fantastic whiskey under their numerous labels; Willett being just one of the expressions (along with Noah's Mill, Rowan's Creek, Johnny Drum, etc.). Willett Distillery was actually founded in the 1930s by former Bernheim superintendent Thompson Willett, but subsequent generations of the family would become disinterested in bourbon until the distillery finally closed. Evan Kulsveen, who married Willett's daughter, purchased the abandoned site in 1984 with plans to reopen his father-in-law's once-great operation. Almost thirty years later, his son Drew and son-in-law Hunter have the site refurbished and back on track.

TITLE: Willett 3 Year Old Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Medium-bodied barrel strength whiskey; much as the 2-year expression, this drinks surprisingly elegant for a Cask Strength Rye Whiskey. There is the initial spice punch, but it dissipates rather quickly into a very enjoyable sweet/spice combination. For years, Kentucky Bourbon Distillers, run by the Kulsveen family, has been bottling fantastic whiskey under their numerous labels; Willett being just one of the expressions (along with Noah's Mill, Rowan's Creek, Johnny Drum, etc.). Evan Kulsveen, who married Willett's daughter, purchased the abandoned site in 1984 with plans to reopen his father-in-law's once-great operation. Christian Wolffer possessed the vision and with the meticulous care of his professional team that built this special place - Wolffer Estate Vineyard - that was created, first and foremost, to be enjoyed by people. The original parcel of land was a potato farm with an old farmhouse in what is now the middle of the estate. Over the years as more acres were acquired, paddocks and stables were added and in 1987, the vineyard was founded. This 55-acre winery is part of a 175 acre estate with boarding stables, 30 paddocks, an indoor jumping ring, and a Grand Prix field. Both the stables and winery have a European character and these former potato fields have become the foundation for world-class wines. Wolffer Estate Vineyard is an American Winery in the Classic European Tradition.

TITLE: Wolves First Run American Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wolves is an American whiskey made in California by an equally creative group of founders, also based in California. Wolves is distilled in Sonoma County by 13th generation Master Distiller Marko Karakasevic using an old, slow, brandy still that was imported from Cognac in 1983. Marko creates a small batch (10 barrels) of distillate over 10 days, sleeping in four-hour shifts so that he alone can make each cut, selecting “the heart of hearts” for double distillation in the small still. The distillation process is far less efficient than an industry-standard column still, but the end result is whiskey with more body, flavor, and viscosity.Between each release, the Pilsner, Stout, and Rye whiskeys continue to age and change in the Oak. The Wolves team recreates the blend for each release, adjusting the percentages and proofs of the Stout, Pilsner, and Rye whiskeys to find the right balance for that particular moment in time. This process takes more than a dozen attempts and a few weeks to get right. The full blend is finally cut with the mineral-rich water from the Russian River.

Produced at the Woodford Reserve Distillery, this bourbon adheres to the strict requirements of being distilled by a single distiller in a single distillation season, aged for at least four years in a federally bonded warehouse, and bottled at 100 proof. The result is a rich and robust bourbon with the signature complexity and balance that Woodford Reserve is known for, offering a pure and unadulterated expression of their craftsmanship.

DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Brandy Cask Finish is a unique and luxurious expression from the Woodford Reserve Distillery, part of their exclusive Distillery Series. The result is a complex and sophisticated whiskey that balances the bold character of bourbon with the sweet, nuanced notes imparted by the brandy barrels. TITLE: Woodford Reserve Chocolate Malt Whisper
DESCRIPTION: 45.2% ABV, 90.4 proof. Straight bourbon made of 72% corn, 18% rye, 10% malted barley Woodford’s 2019 Master’s Collection edition was a chocolate malted rye that delivered a sip that was equal measures flavorful and unique. The company found that the bourbon they made immediately after featured a degree of chocolate malt in its flavor profile. Hence the clever name they gave this distillery-only release: Whisper. Anyone that has tasted a full-on chocolate malt whiskey knows their usual dark roasted flavor is anything but meek. One could expect a follow-up run using the same equipment would probably have some trace of that same flavor, but would ultimately be lost in the overall volume of the new batch. Except that isn’t the case with Chocolate Malt Whisper. Although it's not the onslaught of typical chocolate malt flavors to the same degree, it’s interestingly only half a step down compared to the 2019 Master’s Collection. Packing gentle yet acute roasted flavors, with chocolate, hazelnut, chestnut, and toasted oak standing out the most, the whiskey can act as a nice introduction to the world of chocolate malt whiskey for newcomers to this style. It’s more approachable than most whiskeys of its kind yet still leaves that trademark aftertaste that lingers...and lingers...and lingers. At the end of the day it's still Woodford Reserve bourbon at its core with a chocolate malt layer on top. It's definitely a fun “what-if” concept that makes you wonder if the company should grab hold of this niche whiskey style and plant its flag in it.

DESCRIPTION: Double Double Oaked is the result of finishing mature Woodford Reserve Double Oaked for an additional year in its second, heavily toasted lightly charred new oak barrel. The extra year in the barrel creates a bourbon that is distinctly spicier than its original counterpart, known for its sweeter taste and finish.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Double Oaked Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: An innovative approach to twice-barreled bourbon creates the rich and colorful flavor of Woodford Reserve Double Oaked. Uniquely matured in separate, charred oak barrels – the second barrel deeply toasted before a light charring – extracts additional soft, sweet oak character.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Five Malt
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Five Malt was released in June 2016 as part of the brand's Distillery Series, a collection of small batch expressions available for purchase at the distillery in Kentucky. Distilled from a malt mash, hence the name, the whiskey ages with "minimal wood exposure" in recycled "double-oaked barrels" for at least 6 months. It comes in 375ml bottlings, at 45.2% ABV.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Five Wood
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Five Wood is an innovative and complex expression from the renowned Woodford Reserve Distillery. This limited-edition bourbon is part of their Distillery Series and showcases a unique aging process that involves finishing the whiskey in five different types of barrels: American oak, Oloroso sherry, Ruby Port, Maple Wood, and Toasted barrels. The result is a rich, layered bourbon that offers a symphony of flavors, making it a standout for those seeking a distinctive and finely crafted whiskey. Bottled at 90.4 proof (45.2% ABV), Woodford Reserve Five Wood is a testament to the brand’s commitment to pushing the boundaries of traditional bourbon making.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Four Grain Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Four Grain Bourbon is a masterful expression that showcases the craftsmanship and innovation of the Woodford Reserve Distillery. Crafted with a unique mashbill consisting of four grains—corn, rye, wheat, and malted barley—this bourbon offers a complex and harmonious flavor profile that is both rich and balanced. Bottled at 90.4 proof (45.2% ABV), this release highlights the distinct characteristics each grain brings to the table, making it a truly exceptional bourbon for enthusiasts who appreciate a multi-dimensional whiskey. The interplay of these grains results in a bourbon that is smooth, flavorful, and perfect for sipping.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Frosty Four Wood Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: The whiskey gets its name from the fact that it touched four different kinds of wood throughout its aging and finishing cycles. The process was quite uncommon but showcases Woodford’s desire to experiment with flavors and outcomes. Master Distiller Chris Morris took a batch of fully mature Woodford Reserve bourbon, which, of course, is aged in an American Oak barrel. He then finished it in barrels made from maple wood, sherry wood, and port. The product was created for the 2012 Master’s Collection release, called Four Wood, but Morris held back a few barrels for further experimentation, and they were exposed to record-low temps during the 2013 Polar Vortex. The extreme and abnormal chill resulted in flocking, or mineral precipitation, which leads to a more fruit-forward whiskey that pops from the first taste.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Honey Barrel Finish Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Bourbon is no stranger to honey — plenty of cold-weather bourbon drinks include the sticky stuff. Woodford Reserve decided to take the partnership to the next level with Honey Barrel Finish Bourbon Whiskey. It's a blend of standard Woodford and Woodford that's been finished in honey barrels, resulting in a liquid with the color of raw honey. Floral and spice notes hit the nose before the flavor comes through with tastes of raw honey, baking spices, oak, and coconut, followed by a long, toasty finish. It's receiving a limited release for Fall 2022.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Kentucky Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Each sip of our Distiller’s Select craft bourbon contains over 200 congeners, natural color, aroma and flavor components. Enjoy the full experience.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Kentucky Derby Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This annual release celebrates the rich heritage of the Kentucky Derby, known as “The Most Exciting Two Minutes in Sports.” The 2024 commemorative bottle, marking the 150th anniversary of the Derby, features the exquisite artwork of Kentucky native Wylie Caudill. His piece, “Adorned in Roses,” vividly captures the essence of the Derby with a racing thoroughbred enveloped in vibrant red roses against a backdrop of multi-colored roses. This limited edition is not just a testament to the enduring legacy of the Kentucky Derby but also showcases the craftsmanship and spirit of Woodford Reserve. Crafted at the historic Woodford Reserve Distillery in Versailles, Kentucky, this bourbon embodies the balance of over 200 detectable flavor notes, ranging from bold grain and wood to sweet aromatics, spice, and fruit & floral notes. It’s a celebration of the meticulous care and craftsmanship that goes into every bottle, making it a collector’s item for both bourbon and racing enthusiasts

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey "2022 Holiday Edition"
Woodford Reserve Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey
Woodford Reserve Kentucky Straight Wheat Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Wheat is based on historical recipes but influenced by the iconic core Woodford Reserve Bourbon brand. With wheat as the dominant grain – at 52 percent, followed by malt (20%), corn (20%) and rye (8%) – this whiskey was created by renowned Master Distiller Chris Morris.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection Batch Proof Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection Batch Proof Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a bold and powerful expression from the esteemed Woodford Reserve Distillery, showcasing the purest form of their renowned bourbon. As part of the Master’s Collection, this limited-edition release is bottled at batch proof, meaning it is uncut and unfiltered, allowing whiskey enthusiasts to experience the full intensity and character of the bourbon straight from the barrel. Each batch proof release varies slightly in proof, typically ranging between 120 and 130, offering a unique and robust drinking experience that highlights the depth of flavor and craftsmanship inherent in Woodford Reserve’s bourbon. This is a must-try for those who appreciate a high-proof, full-bodied whiskey that captures the essence of the distillery's craft.
