TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 01 Four Grain Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This expression debuted in 2005 and marks the beginning of annual releases by Master Distiller Chris Morris for the Woodford Reserve Master's Collection. This is Four Grain Batch #1, a Kentucky-only limited release and now a collector's item. The four grains used in this bourbon are corn, malted barley, rye, and wheat. Woodford Reserve followed it up with a 2nd batch released a year later and with national distribution. It was bottled at 46.2% ABV.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 02 Sweet Mash
DESCRIPTION: Woodfords Sweet Mash is rich with loads of fruit, apple, blueberry and blackberry. Layered with a hint of maple syrup. Rye and mind round out the palate. Clean and warm with a very soft apple finish!

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 03 Sonoma-Cutrer Chardonnay Finish Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: This expression is brought to you by Chris Morris for the 2007 edition of special releases from the Woodford Reserve Master's Collection. This is the third in the collection and was made in collaboration with Brown-Forman owned Sonoma-Cutrer Vineyards in California. The distillery's bourbon was finished in the Vineyard's barrels that were previously used in the production of Chardonnay. The final product carries no official age statement and is bottled at 45.2% ABV.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 04 Seasoned Oak Finish Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Two aspects distinguish the Seasoned Oak Finish with the regular bottle of Woodford Reserve and other bourbons. The first is that being a part of the Master's Collection, it is a limited edition and is only released when the Master Distiller, Chris Morris, feels it is time, which is typically random. The second is that it is finish-aged in barrels unique to the bourbon industry. For this bottling, Woodford Reserve has taken some of their standard barrels, which they craft themselves, and season them for almost as long as the bourbon. This extra seasoning lasts for between three and five years by sitting outside and taking in the changing of the seasons. After that fully-matured Woodford Reserve is poured inside and allowed to rest longer and soak in the oak's unique characteristics. The result is the most robust bourbon that we have seen from Woodford Reserve. This is a sipping bourbon because of its unique oak flavor. That extra seasoning accents the oak and brings in anise and spices alongside a sweeter side that is reminiscent of the original bourbon. This is a whiskey connoisseur would love to explore and one that anyone can appreciate.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 05 Maple Wood Finish Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 05 Maple Wood Finish Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is an exceptional and innovative release from the Woodford Reserve Distillery, showcasing the unique influence of maple wood on bourbon. As part of the esteemed Master's Collection, this limited-edition bourbon has been finished in barrels made from sugar maple wood, imparting a distinct sweetness and complexity to the whiskey. Bottled at 94.4 proof (47.2% ABV), this expression combines the rich, full-bodied character of Woodford Reserve with the delicate nuances of maple, creating a one-of-a-kind drinking experience. Ideal for collectors and enthusiasts, this bourbon highlights the distillery’s commitment to exploring new dimensions of flavor.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 06 Rare Rye Selection Kentucky Straight Rye (2 Pack)
DESCRIPTION: The 2011 Master's Collection release from Woodford Reserve featured an interesting set of two half-bottles of rye whiskey. One of the rye whiskeys was aged in a new American oak cask (akin to how almost every other American whiskey is matured) - the other rye whiskey was aged in a cask which had previously held bourbon. Both were bottled at 46.2% ABV. The bottles are sold together.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 07 Four Wood Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Four Wood is the seventh release as part of the brand's Master's Collection. Aged in American oak and finished in a combination of barrels made from maple wood, sherry wood, and Port wood, this is a rich, nutty and spicy bourbon.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 08 Classic Malt
DESCRIPTION: Back in 2013, Woodford Reserve just did something very interesting, on the verge of awesome. For that year’s Master’s Collection release, they introduced TWO malt whiskeys – one aged in charred new oak (as is typical of bourbon), one in used (as is typical of Scotch). That’s right, these are malt whiskeys, which is highly unusual in the US and basically unheard of in Kentucky. AND they offer the chance to experience the difference that used vs. new barrels have on that malt whiskey. This listing is for the Classic Malt.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 09 Sonoma-Cutrer Pinot Noir Finish Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 09 Sonoma-Cutrer Pinot Noir Finish Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a limited-edition release that exemplifies the innovative spirit of the Woodford Reserve Distillery. This unique bourbon is part of the Master's Collection and has been finished in Sonoma-Cutrer Pinot Noir barrels, imparting a distinctive fruitiness and complexity to the classic Woodford Reserve profile. Bottled at 90.4 proof (45.2% ABV), this bourbon offers a sophisticated blend of rich bourbon character and the elegant nuances of fine Pinot Noir, making it a standout choice for collectors and enthusiasts seeking a refined and exceptional whiskey experience.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 10 1838 Style White Corn Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 10 1838 Style White Corn Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a unique and historical expression that pays homage to the original recipe used at the distillery in the 1830s. Part of the prestigious Master's Collection, this bourbon is crafted using a mashbill with white corn, giving it a distinctive flavor profile that sets it apart from traditional bourbons made with yellow corn. Bottled at 90.4 proof (45.2% ABV), this bourbon offers a smooth and nuanced taste experience that highlights the subtleties of the white corn mash. This release is a must-have for collectors and enthusiasts who appreciate the heritage and craftsmanship of Woodford Reserve.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 11 Brandy Cask Finish Kentucky Straight Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 11 Brandy Cask Finish Kentucky Straight Bourbon is a remarkable expression from the Woodford Reserve Distillery, showcasing their innovative approach to bourbon-making. As part of the prestigious Master's Collection, this limited-edition release has been finished in brandy casks, imparting a rich and fruity complexity to the classic bourbon profile. Bottled at 90.4 proof (45.2% ABV), this bourbon combines the robust flavors of Woodford Reserve with the refined sweetness and depth of brandy, creating a uniquely balanced and sophisticated whiskey. Ideal for collectors and bourbon enthusiasts, this release is a testament to the distillery's commitment to craftsmanship and creativity.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 12 Cherry Wood Smoked Barley Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Woodford Reserve Master’s Collection Cherry Wood Smoked Barley is the 12th release in the series. Cherry Wood Smoked Barley marries innovation with the bourbon industry’s historic roots by paying tribute to the craftsmanship and vision of past distillery industry leaders Oscar Pepper and James Crow, who once distilled on the current day site of the Woodford Reserve Distillery.This is one of the first Kentucky Bourbons to use malted barley exposed to cherry wood smoke. With 30% malt content, the Cherry Wood Smoked mash bill has a higher concentration of malt than a traditional bourbon.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 13 Select American Oak Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: One of two Master's Collection released in 2018, the Select American Oak features bourbon aged exclusively in oak barrels sourced from the Ozarks. The unique tight grain of the fast-growing Ozark Oak offers a nutty and sweet character that is unique to this special terroir.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 15 Oat Grain Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 15 Oat Grain Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a unique and innovative expression from the Woodford Reserve Distillery, part of their acclaimed Master's Collection. This special release features a distinctive mashbill that includes oats alongside the traditional corn, rye, and malted barley, offering a creamy texture and rich flavor profile that sets it apart from traditional bourbons. Bottled at 90.4 proof (45.2% ABV), this bourbon showcases the distillery's commitment to exploring new flavor dimensions while maintaining the classic Woodford Reserve quality. Ideal for collectors and bourbon enthusiasts, the Oat Grain Bourbon delivers a refined and elegant drinking experience.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No.17 Five Malt Stout Mash Kentucky Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 17 Five Malt Stout Mash Kentucky Malt Whiskey is a distinctive and innovative release from the Woodford Reserve Distillery, part of their acclaimed Master's Collection. This unique whiskey is crafted using a five-malt mash bill typically reserved for the production of stouts, bringing the rich, robust flavors of a malted stout beer into the world of Kentucky whiskey. Bottled at 90.4 proof (45.2% ABV), this expression offers a complex and layered flavor profile that showcases the creativity and craftsmanship of the distillery. Perfect for those seeking an exceptional and unconventional whiskey experience, the Five Malt Stout Mash is a true testament to Woodford Reserve’s commitment to pushing the boundaries of traditional whiskey-making.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No.18 Historic Barrel Entry Kentucky Malt Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Woodford County distillery in the 1830s was the site of several discoveries and innovative methods that have become industry standards for bourbon today. The Master Distiller Chris Morris and Assistant Master Distiller Elizabeth McCall have used this rich history and their own inspiration for the 2022 Master's Collection release. This edition of the Master's Collection was created using newly-distilled whiskey, which was placed in barrels at a proof of 100. The proof of the "new make" is a critical factor in the aging process, and the standard proof for barrel entry has changed over the past 200 years. This resulted in the creation of the Historic Barrel Entry, a bold and rich expression of Woodford Reserve Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No.19 Sonoma Triple Finish Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Elevate your whiskey experience with Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No.19 Sonoma Triple Finish Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey. Crafted in the heart of Kentucky, this exquisite bourbon is a testament to the artistry of Woodford Reserve. The Master's Collection No.19 features a Sonoma Triple Finish, adding layers of complexity to this exceptional spirit. Immerse yourself in the rich heritage and innovative craftsmanship of Woodford Reserve.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No.20 Madeira Cask Finish Blended with Wheat Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection No. 20 Madeira Cask Finish Blended with Wheat Whiskey is a groundbreaking release from the esteemed Woodford Reserve Distillery in Kentucky. This limited-edition whiskey is the 20th installment in the renowned Master's Collection, showcasing the distillery's commitment to innovation and craftsmanship. This unique expression is a harmonious blend of Woodford Reserve Bourbon and Wheat Whiskey, meticulously finished in Madeira casks imported from the lush vineyards of Portugal's Madeira Islands. The Madeira cask finishing imparts rich layers of flavor, adding depth and complexity to the already sophisticated profile of the blend. Bottled at 90.4 proof, this whiskey offers a symphony of sweet and spicy notes, making it a must-have for collectors and enthusiasts seeking an exceptional tasting experience. Its intricate character and smooth finish reflect the distillery's dedication to producing whiskeys that honor tradition while embracing creative experimentation

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection Very Fine Rare Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Master's Collection Very Fine Rare Bourbon is an extraordinary release from the Woodford Reserve Distillery, featuring some of the oldest and most exceptional barrels in their inventory. Part of the prestigious Master's Collection, this limited-edition bourbon offers a unique glimpse into the distillery’s aging process and the rich history of their bourbon-making. Bottled at 90.4 proof (45.2% ABV), this expression combines the depth and complexity of well-aged whiskey with the signature smoothness of Woodford Reserve, resulting in a refined and luxurious drinking experience. Ideal for collectors and bourbon enthusiasts, Very Fine Rare Bourbon is a testament to Woodford Reserve’s dedication to excellence and craftsmanship.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Master’s Collection No. 08 Straight Malt
DESCRIPTION: Back in 2013, Woodford Reserve just did something fascinating, on the verge of awesome. For that year’s Master’s Collection release, they introduced TWO malt whiskeys – one aged in charred new oak (as is typical of bourbon), one in used (as is typical of Scotch). That’s right; these are malt whiskeys, which is highly unusual in the US and unheard of in Kentucky. AND they offer the chance to experience the difference that used vs. new barrels have on that malt whiskey. This listing is for the Straight Malt.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Sweet Mash Redux Bourbon
DESCRIPTION: Sweet Mash Redux is one of two initial members of the new Woodford Reserve Distillery Series, available for purchase only at the distillery in 375ml bottles. In 2008, Woodford released Sweet Mash Finish in its Master's Collection, and Sweet Mash Redux harkens back to it. As opposed to Woodford's typical sour mash fermentation process, the spirit here begins non-soured, or "sweet", changing the base of Woodford's bourbon to its core and producing a highly different profile. Find a layered and intriguing nose with cornbread, a honeyed-floral sweetness, melon and apples. The palate is more one note after that enticing nose, offering a malty, cereal grain profile with wood and spice. Find a hot, long, dry and oaky finish which leaves the tongue tingling, with lasting notes of black pepper, rye spice and oak.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Three Grain
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Three Grain is a distinctive expression from the Woodford Reserve Distillery, showcasing the innovative blending of corn, rye, and malted barley. This unique combination provides a complex and balanced flavor profile, highlighting the nuanced contributions of each grain. Bottled at 90.4 proof (45.2% ABV), this bourbon offers a rich, layered drinking experience that is approachable and intriguing. The Three Grain Bourbon is perfect for those who appreciate the art of blending and the craftsmanship that goes into creating a well-rounded and harmonious whiskey.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Toasted Oak Oat Grain
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Toasted Oak Oat Grain is a unique and innovative expression from the esteemed Woodford Reserve Distillery, part of their Distillery Series. This limited-edition bourbon is crafted with a distinctive mashbill that includes oats alongside the traditional corn, rye, and malted barley, giving it a rich and creamy mouthfeel. The bourbon is further finished in toasted oak barrels, imparting additional flavor and complexity layers. Bottled at 90.4 proof (45.2% ABV), Woodford Reserve Toasted Oak Oat Grain offers a smooth and nuanced drinking experience, perfect for those looking to explore beyond the traditional bourbon profile.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Toasted Oak Rye
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve's Toasted Oak Rye is the second in a series of three ryes slated for release in 2017 as part of their Distillery Series. The Toasted Oak is made by finishing Woodford's Master's Collection Rye for an additional two years in fresh barrels that used to age Woodford Reserve Double Oaked bourbon.

TITLE: Woodford Reserve Wheat Whiskey Bottled In Bond
DESCRIPTION: Woodford Reserve Distillery Series is an eclectic line of one-of-a-kind expressions, pushing the creative boundaries of whiskeys to the extreme. Each selection is masterminded by Master Distiller Elizabeth McCall. This release features wheat whiskey from one distilling season, which is then aged in a bonded warehouse and bottled at 100 proof.

TITLE: Woodinville 8 Years Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Woodinville 8 Year Straight Bourbon Whiskey exemplifies the peak of craft distillation and aging, making it a standout limited-edition release from the Woodinville Whiskey Company®. Limited to just 30 barrels, this bourbon highlights the founders' commitment to creating an extraordinary, authentic grain-to-glass bourbon. This rare whiskey is rich in history and craftsmanship, making it a true collector's item for enthusiasts and connoisseurs. With a distinctive mash bill of 55% corn, 35% rye, and 10% malted barley, the foundation of this bourbon is laid with carefully chosen grains that ensure complexity and balance. Distilled with precision in Woodinville, Washington, the spirit is aged in private barrel houses, benefiting from Central Washington's dramatic temperature swings. These conditions enhance the whiskey's interaction with the oak barrels, drawing out the wood's natural flavors over eight years, resulting in a rich and nuanced profile.

TITLE: Woodinville Moscatel Finish Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Flagship 5-year straight bourbon “finished” in 10-year-old Moscatel de Setúbal pipes. This “finishing” process adds notes of dried apricot and orange peel, with a honey and toffee sweetness.

TITLE: Woodinville Port Cask Finish Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The Port finishing process adds a viscous mouthfeel with notes of candied cherry, dried plums, berries, and chocolate on top of the traditional bourbon flavor characteristics.

TITLE: Woodinville Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This whiskey is 5+ years in the making, and the first truly craft-produced Bourbon to be aged in a standard 53-gallon barrel for this length of time. 100% Mashed, Distilled, Aged, and Bottled in Washington State.

TITLE: Woodinville Straight Rye Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This 100% rye starts with pure, traditionally-grown rye cultivated exclusively on the Omlin family farm in Quincy, Washington. The grain is mashed, distilled & barreled in our Woodinville distillery – then trucked back over the Cascade Mountains to the private barrel houses, where Central Washington’s extreme temperature cycles promote the extraction of natural flavors from the oak. Prior to being coopered, the barrel wood is seasoned in open air, rain, wind, sun, and snow for eighteen months softening the wood’s harsh tannins. They are then slowly toasted and heavily charred to further enrich the wood’s desirable flavors.

TITLE: Woodinville Toasted Applewood Staves Finish Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Woodinville Toasted Applewood Staves Finish Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a unique and flavorful whiskey that is sure to please even the most discerning palate. Aged for at least five years in new American oak barrels, this bourbon is then finished in toasted applewood staves for a few additional months. This finishing process imparts delicate notes of apple, caramel, and spice to the whiskey, creating a complex and balanced flavor profile.

TITLE: World Whiskey Society 10 Year Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Port Cask Unicorn Edition
DESCRIPTION: Mash Bill: 51% Corn, 45% Wheat, 4% Barley 102 Proof. The 10-year-old bourbon originated from a distillery in Oklahoma, though the exact source is not disclosed. Presumably, a good candidate is Prairie Wolf Spirits (part of the Wander Folk Spirits family), which opened in 2012 as the first legal distillery in Oklahoma since prohibition. It’s a single barrel, or at least was finished in a single port barrel, or port “pipe” as they are referred to, which typically range from 550-650 liters in size. If the label and origin are not unique enough, the whiskey’s aroma will convince you. Exceptionally aromatic, it’s filled with sweet dark fruit scents and begs you to sip. The sip follows with similar flavors and integrates a more familiar caramel underpinning into the base. It finishes with a tapering of those flavors at a medium length. Because it is so aromatic and fruit-forward, those who don’t enjoy dark fruit may not find it as enjoyable. But for those who do, the whiskey is extremely satisfying.

TITLE: World Whiskey Society 6 Year Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Oloroso Cask Unicorn Edition
DESCRIPTION: Unicorn Edition!

TITLE: World Whiskey Society 6 Years Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Cognac Cask
DESCRIPTION: The 4th Limited Edition American Straight Bourbon Whiskey (only 600 bottles released) is finished in barrels that previously held Grand Champagne XO Cognac and traveled 4000 miles to impart their sophisticated flavor to the fine American Straight Bourbon.

TITLE: World Whiskey Society 6 Years Straight Bourbon Whiskey Finished in Tequila Cask
DESCRIPTION: The 5th Edition (limited to 600 bottles) is an American Straight Bourbon Whiskey finished in barrels that previously held Anejo Tequila and traveled 1500 miles to impart their sophisticated flavor to the fine American Straight Bourbon

TITLE: World Whiskey Society Kentucky Straight Bourbon Finished in Mizunara Oak Sochu Barrels
DESCRIPTION: This limited run of 1500 total bottles consists of Kentucky straight bourbon finished in handmade Japanese Mizunara Oak barrels that previously held premium shochu. The legendary Ariake cooperage crafted the barrels near Kyoto, Japan. Bourbon is from Bardstown Bourbon Company, one of the most technologically advanced US distilleries. Mashbill: 70% Corn, 18% Rye, 12% Malted Barley

TITLE: World Whiskey Society Reserve Collection 12-Year Kentucky Straight Bourbon Finished in Armagnac Barrels (Heaven HIll Distillate)
DESCRIPTION: In 2020, the World Whiskey Society (WWS), a non-distiller producer, began curating whiskies globally and presenting them in distinctively designed bottles. WWS distinguishes itself with its unique partnerships with leading whiskey manufacturers. For instance, their label transparently discloses the mash bill and distillery source, like this particular bottle sourced from Heaven Hill Distillery (Mash Bill: 74% Corn, 18% Rye, 8% Malted Barley), enhancing the allure of their offerings. The signature Armagnac barrel finish marks the whiskey's scent with potent apricot and grape aromas, balanced by intense chocolate and seasoned oak. The mash bill resonates with Heaven Hill's key brands, especially Elijah Craig, featuring oak, vanilla, and caramel in its flavor profile. The Armagnac touch adds an unexpected twist to the traditional bourbon taste, introducing elements both familiar and pleasantly surprising. The whiskey's impressive bottle design is undeniably unique in the market. Rather than merely re-bottling sourced whiskey, WWS took a bold step by finishing the whiskey in an unusual manner with Armagnac. While the whiskey may not be as striking as its container, its distinctive finish and the fact that it's a Heaven Hill bourbon aged in Armagnac barrels add significant value.

TITLE: World Whiskey Society Reserve Collection 15 year Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: 112 proof Bourbon, single barrel, very limited. Mash Bill: 78.5% Corn 13% Rye 8.5% Malted Barley

TITLE: Writers' Tears Double Oak Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Writers’ Tears Double Oak, is a blend of the two premium whiskey styles aged in two types of wood – American and French Oak. It is triple-distilled, non-chill filtered and bottled at 46% ABV. The new expression is made possible by a close collaboration between the Walsh family in Ireland’s County Carlow and the Legaret family in Cognac, France.

TITLE: Wyatt California Pinot Noir
DESCRIPTION: A wonderfully lush, fruit-driven Pinot Noir, full and round on the palate that finishes beautifully. It drinks well on its own and is easy to match with meat, chicken, and even some fish dishes.

TITLE: Wyoming Barrel Strength Bourbon Whiskey
Wyoming Whiskey "Steamboat" Special Edition Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Steamboat is a Special Release bottled in the summer of 2018. This straight bourbon whiskey was batched using barrels selected from the bottom ricks of the rickhouse which offer a softer, fruitier bourbon without the spice notes found in our flagship Small Batch bourbon. It is intended to appeal to whiskey drinkers who may favor a Canadian whiskey and an easy-drinking spirit. 90 proof. All grains are grown in Wyoming and are non-GMO.

TITLE: Wyoming Whiskey 10 Years Anniversary Edition Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: The brand was launched on December 1, 2012, with the debut of the flagship small batch bourbon. It started with a party on an unseasonable warm day in Kirby, and the promise that the bourbon frontier was heading west to the Rocky Mountains. Ten years changes things, whiskey for the better. In celebration of this 10-year anniversary, original Master Distiller Steve Nally and Master Blender Nancy Fraley have barrel selected and batched a rich and balanced 10-year-old bourbon worthy of the milestone.

TITLE: Wyoming Whiskey 5 Years "National Parks No. 4" Limited Edition Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Wyoming Whiskey National Parks No. 4 Limited Edition Straight Bourbon Whiskey is a 5-year-old bourbon inspired by the winding Snake River in Grand Teton National Park. It is a complex and flavorful whiskey with notes of brown sugar, orange cream, peach, lemon peel, marzipan buttercream, carrot cake, browned spices, hints of toffee and salted caramel, and a zesty orange/lemon finish with lingering oak, black pepper, and leather. This limited edition whiskey is a collaboration between Wyoming Whiskey and the Grand Teton National Park Foundation, and a portion of the proceeds from each sale will support the foundation's conservation and education efforts.

TITLE: Wyoming Whiskey Single Barrel Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: This bourbon is made from a unique mash bill of corn, wheat, and malted barley, and is aged for a minimum of five years in new, charred oak barrels. Each barrel is then hand-selected by our master distiller, and bottled at cask strength. The result is a complex and flavorful whiskey, with notes of caramel, vanilla, and toasted oak.

TITLE: X Winery North Coast Big Gun Red
DESCRIPTION: X Winery was created in 2001 along with Amicus Cellars by CEO/Winemaker Reed Renaudin. The new winery's philosophy is to use the latest winemaking research and technology and overlay it with traditional winemaking techniques to produce consumer-friendly wines at outstanding prices. Winemakers are Reed Renaudin and Gina Richmond.

TITLE: Yalumba Y Series Sauvignon Blanc
DESCRIPTION: Yalumba was founded in 1849 by Samuel Smith, British migrant and English brewer, who had brought his family to Angaston seeking a new life. After purchasing a 30-acre parcel of land just beyond the southern-eastern boundary of Angaston, Smith and his son began planting the first vines by moonlight. Samuel named his patch "Yalumba" – aboriginal for "all the land around". For more than 160 years, Australia's oldest family-owned winery has gone about the business of doing all the little things brilliantly. This philosophy has seen Yalumba grow in size, stature and success, embodying all that has made it a great Australian wine story. Go Green. Sauvignon Blanc with its herbaceous notes pairs well with similar green herbs. If it has parsley, rosemary, basil, cilantro or mint, chances are Sauvignon Blanc will make a great pairing. There is also one classic pairing of Sauvignon Blanc that started in the Loire Valley. Close to Sancerre there is a goat cheese produced called Crottin de Chavignol and it has an international reputation as an outstanding stinky-creamy cheese. A bite of Crottin with a splash of Sauvignon Blanc is considered a classic perfect pairing. Meat Pairings - White meats including Chicken, Pork Chop and Turkey. Fish including Tilapia, Sea Bass, Perch, Sole, Haddock, Trout, Cod, Redfish, Halibut, Snapper, Mussels, Crab, Lobster, and Clams. Spices and Herbs - Green herbs including Parsley, Basil, Mint, Tarragon, Thyme, Fennel, Dill, Chives, and Rosemary. Spices including White Pepper, Coriander, Fennel, Turmeric, and Saffron. Cheese Pairings - Look for softer more briny and sour cheeses like Goat’s milk cheese, Yogurt, and Crème fraîche. Vegetables & Vegetarian Fare - Sauté green veggies or mix vegetables in more fatty vegetarian dishes so that the acidity of the wine shines through. Here are some example dishes for inspiration: Asparagus quiche, cucumber dill yogurt salad, green hummus, white bean casserole with zucchini and white lasagna.

TITLE: Yamada Shoten Everlasting Roots Tokubetsu Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Mr. and Mrs. Yamada brew this sake in a classic style in the same way their ancestors handcrafted it, continuing deep-rooted traditions. This is a very small producer and their sake in Japanese is called Mukashi No Manma or "unchanged by time". The rice is a local variety and it is milled 55%.

TITLE: Yamamoto Honke Kaguyahime Junmai Sake
Yamato Mizunara Oak Cask Japanese Whisky Takeda Shingen Edition
DESCRIPTION: The Japanese public preferred a softer, smoother, less-smokey version of whisky, and their master distillers worked tirelessly to cater to the public's flavor profile. The result, a whisky that rivals even the legendary scotches because of the quality and never-before-seen flavor and finishes. Not to mention Japan made the whisky Highball famous due to the light, sweet, and floral whiskies effect on sparkling water. Yamato does just that, pairing perfectly with the traditional Japanese whisky flavor profile. You can witness a silky smooth finish, beautiful fruits, and vanillas from the start. Yamato is your entrance into the world of high-end Japanese whisky. Enjoy it neat, on the rocks, or in a highball.

TITLE: Yellow Spot 12 Years Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Aroma of red bell peppers, nutmeg, green tea and sweet peaches from the Malaga casks. Honey sweetness accented by cloves, baked apples, milk chocolate, coffee and creme brulee on the palate. Finish is dry and complex, with notes of toasted oak, red grapes and barley.

TITLE: Yellowstone 101 Aged 7 Years Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey 2019
DESCRIPTION: Yellowstone Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon, a marriage of some of the finest hand-selected bourbon available, celebrates the return of Yellowstone to the family of Limestone Branch founders Steve and Paul Beam – and the many fine bourbons to come. This is a bourbon for someone who knows bourbon and enjoys a dry, tannic oak profile. If tasted blind you would guess it was much older based on taste alone. Sharing with someone with a distinct flavor profile preference that aligns with this release is important. Lesser developed plates are likely to find it too bitter and oaky.

TITLE: Yellowstone Limited Edition Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey 2024
DESCRIPTION: Limestone Branch master distiller Stephen Beam has released this year’s Yellowstone Limited Edition Bourbon. While the 2020 Limited Edition featured a 7-year-old bourbon conditioned in Armagnac brandy casks, the 2021 Limited Edition features a 7-year-old bourbon finished in Amarone casks. Amarone is a rich, red wine that – much like bourbon – takes time and patience to craft and requires at least two years in oak casks to age. Finishing select barrels in these Amarone casks brings notes of fresh cracked pepper and tobacco, as well as hints of black cherry, fig, and dark chocolate to the classic bourbon notes of caramel, vanilla, and hints of citrus. Along with the 7-year, Beam also hand-selected a 15-year-old bourbon as part of this year’s blend. In past years, the annual Yellowstone Limited Edition bottlings have included as many as three bourbons used in a blend, incorporating bourbon aged in wine casks, re-charred wine casks, and even wine casks charred three different times.With a finish of oxidized fruit, cherry, and black currant, this bourbon is reminiscent of pre-Prohibition whiskeys. The 2021 Limited Edition will be bottled at 101 proof (50.5% ABV) and sold in custom-designed bottles featuring embossing, a high-end natural cork, and a label featuring the 2021 Yellowstone Limited Edition emblem.

TITLE: Yetti & The Kokonut "Hipster Juice"
DESCRIPTION: The name of the wine, coupled with the color, pretty much tells you everything you need to know. This is for the cool-kids and not meant to be a wine of too much thought but rather too many friends with whom this should be shared. Dave & Koen had the vision of a blank white canvas and having a lot of fun with heaps of colors. Some were painted with a brush, others by hand and a smattering of finger paints and even spray paint: Zinfandel, Doradillo, Cabernet Franc and Sémillon (of the red mutation) are the colors. Three red grapes and one weird white were handpicked across a three-week period with “high flavor x bright acid” as the common equation. The Doradillo (weird white) was picked first and fermented 1/3 whole-bunch and 1/3 whole-berry tipped atop 1/3 pressed juice. The Zinfandel came in next and fermented 100% whole-bunch in a 25hL open top fermenter for three weeks and pumped over frequently for maximum structure, then pressed to old puncheons. The Red Sémillon was fermented on skins for two weeks and then pressed to ceramic egg to finish its ultimate weirdness. The Seaview Cabernet Franc was the last to come in and was destemmed and left on skins for two days prior to being pressed and fermented in 700L French demi-muid, bringing the elegant side of this variety. The lots were blended and settled for one month before being bottled without fining or filtration and only a small dose of SO2 at bottling.

TITLE: Yeyo Tequila Blanco
DESCRIPTION: Yeyo Tequila Blanco is a premium, unaged tequila crafted in Jalisco, Mexico, by the respected Fabrica de Tequilas Finos (NOM 1472). Made from 100% blue Weber agave, this blanco tequila captures the bright and pure flavors of the agave plant, delivering a smooth and vibrant tasting experience. Produced using traditional methods, including slow-cooking the agave and distilling in stainless steel pot stills, Yeyo Tequila Blanco is ideal for sipping neat or enhancing your favorite cocktails. With its clean and refreshing profile, Yeyo Tequila Blanco represents the authentic craftsmanship and passion of Mexican tequila-making.

TITLE: Yokaichi Mugi Shochu
DESCRIPTION: Yokaichi Mugi is the finest Mugi Shochu. It is made from superior barley and combines age-old craftsmanship with modern technology. Enjoy the clean crisp taste and pleasant aroma on the rocks or straight up.

TITLE: Yomi “The Afterlife” Junmai Ginjo Sake Can
DESCRIPTION: According to Shinto mythology, Yomi means “World of Darkness” or “an Afterlife” where one goes after death. This story inspired us to craft a sake meant to be consumed each day as the sun sets when we seek refuge from our daily responsibilities and burdens and revel unchained and uninhibited. Introduced in early 2019 as the first canned saké in America, this premium-level saké is innovative, bright, refreshing and hedonistic and will complement almost any food or occasion. Both approachable and complex, Yomi is always ready to be enjoyed in your desired World of Darkness.

TITLE: Yuho Eternal Embers Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Ishikawa prefecture is home to the energetic Abare Festival, also affectionately called "Fire & Violence", where revelers playfully pay homage to the deity of destruction. Spectators watch as illuminated lantern floats and shrines are carried through the streets. Huge bonfires are set while melodies of Japanese drums, gongs, and flutes are heard throughout the festival.

TITLE: Yuki No Bosha Yamahai Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: Yuki No Bosha Yamahai Junmai is the ultimate expression of Mr. Takahashi's mastery and the practice of "hands-off" natural fermentation. Instead of raising temperature of the moto, he keeps his moto temperature considerably low. "By raising the temperature", he says, " the sake becomes 'heavy' and the moto invites the foreign microbes (including wild yeast) which contribute to the gaminess and the funky flavor profile". By keeping the temperature to minimum, and letting the saccharification to occur more gradually and naturally, he makes yamahai sake that's "un-yamahai-like" yet in some way, is more "true" to how it should taste. "True Yamahai can be tasty and rich yet clean and mellow," said Mr. Saito, the president of Saiya Brewery, in a phone interview. He likes to enjoy this sake slightly warmed when he wants to get into a calm, mellow mood. Yuki No Bosha Yamahai Junmai can be an unassuming companion to any meal and occasions, unlike "in-your-face" assertive yamahai's more commonly available. The ripe fruity notes of the sake lingers long after the last flavor of the cheese dissipates from the palate

TITLE: Yuki Otoko Junmai Sake Cup
DESCRIPTION: Aoki brewery, located on Bokushi Lane, was founded in 1717. It's wooden sign was made by famous Edo-period carver Gentaro Kumagi. 12th generation president Aoki aims for a strong stamp of savor, in contrast to the light brisk taste typical of Niigata sake. Yuki Otoko is ideally paired with pork or salmon.

TITLE: Yuki Otoko Yeti Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: A classic dry sake inspired by local lore, Yuki Otoko is the bigfoot or yeti of Japan. There are local Niigata legends that he helps travelers carry their things and guides them through mountain trails. Miyama Nishiki rice milled to 60%. On-site soft well water from an underground current originating at Makihata-yama. Yuki Otoko is ideally paired with pork or salmon.

TITLE: Yukikage Snow Shadow Tokubetsu Junmai Sake
DESCRIPTION: A blend of local rice varietals Gohyaku-Mangoku and Koshi-Ibuki both milled down to 58% then treated with the S-3 yeast to produce a mildly fragrant and clean sake with light earthy qualities. When chilled it makes a great companion for a sushi platter or gyoza dumplings, but when gently warmed it blossoms into the perfect accompaniment for yakitori, grilled salmon or roasted yellowtail.

TITLE: Yuu Baal Espadin Mezcal
DESCRIPTION: Excellent for all occasions, as an appetizer or even as a complement for some of the most diverse regional foods, national and international alike.

TITLE: Yuzu Omoi Sake
DESCRIPTION: A saké made with yuzu extracts. Yuzu is a citrus fruit that's very lemon-lime like. It's nicely sweet, excellent chilled and refreshing just as a citrus sorbet would be after a hearty meal.

TITLE: Zackariah Harris Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Zackariah Harris is made in Kentucky, where bourbon is an art form and where generations respect the hard work and time honored-traditions that make it America’s most treasured spirit. Rich, smooth and delicious, Zachariah Harris is a classic Kentucky bourbon.

TITLE: Zackariah Harris Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey
DESCRIPTION: Zackariah Harris is made in Kentucky, where bourbon is an art form and where generations respect the hard work and time honored-traditions that make it America’s most treasured spirit. Rich, smooth and delicious, Zachariah Harris is a classic Kentucky bourbon.

TITLE: Zanyko "Super 7" Junmai Daiginjo
DESCRIPTION: The Zankyo Super 7 started as a challenge from Niizawa-san and his team to push rice polishing to the absolute limit and see just how refined a sake they could make. While the threshold for getting to the highest qualification of Junmai Daiginjo/ Daiginjo is polishing away 50% of the rice, some producers have experimented with higher polishing rates, down to 40% or 35% remaining. The more you polish the more delicate the center of the rice grains get, and the danger of them cracking or burning grows higher, meaning even more time must be taken to preserve the rice. In past years this was released as “Super 8” when they were able to get enough rice down to just 8% of its original size. In 2015, after 350 hours of polishing, they surpassed themselves and made it to 7%. The result is a sake that earns the name Zankyo, literally “Reverb” or “Vibration”, with an incredibly light and delicate structure that creates delicate and fleeting textures, flavors and aromas that characterize the very best sake: always just beyond your reach.

TITLE: Zapiain Bizi Goxo Ice Cider
DESCRIPTION: As the Basque name suggests, this variety is called “Bizi” for its sharpness and “Goxo” for its sweetness. Despite calling it Dessert Cider, the sweet-sharp balance makes this product a versatile drink, and it works perfectly as an aperitif. Description: Serve in a digestive glass, at a cold temperature but without being excessive – at 10.5% vol. it does not need to be too cold (around 7-8ºC).

TITLE: Zede de Labegorce Margaux
DESCRIPTION: This second wine of Château Labegorce is a more gentle mirror to the estate wine. It has a fine use of wood, along with juicy ripe red fruits and tannins that fit well into the rounded texture. It will be ready to drink from 2016. 92 points, Wine Enthusiast.

TITLE: Zestos Rosado
DESCRIPTION: Zestos old vine is produced from Garnacha vines that were planted in 1950 in the high elevation vineyards of San Martin Valdeiglesias - northwest of Madrid. Today San Martin produces among the most floral and mineral Garnachas in all of Spain. The older the vines the better the wine. Old vines do not over produce. As a result the vines yield fully ripened grapes. Perfectly ripened grapes make wines that improve with time. ‘Zestos’ means ‘basket’ in Spanish. Not too many years ago, baskets like the ones depicted on the label were use to transport grapes from the vineyard to the wineries. Madrid has recently become the center of one of the most interesting and innovative wine regions on the Iberian Peninsula. For example, 90% of Vinos de Madrid DO wines are made from organically grown grapes. The outskirts of this storied royal city are filled with old vines Garnacha situated in high elevation vineyards that have been planted in ideal soils. Madrid is a sort of “great unknown” that is now just freshly discovered. Most consumers are unaware that Madrid makes wine and because Vinos de Madrid is not yet “on the radar” of wine consumers, it is a great source of incredible values today.

TITLE: Ziobaffa Prosecco
DESCRIPTION: This Prosecco DOC is made with 100% organic grapes Italy is famous for many fine things and Prosecco is quickly captivating enjoyers of sparkling wine all over the world as a must have. Inspired by the festive nature of pouring a glass of bubbly for our friends, we made it our mission for 2016 to add this fantastic varietal to Ziobaffa. Farmed in vineyards on the hills around Treviso area in Veneto, meeting all the EU organic criteria in Italy. It is non-GMO and it is made with the Martinotti-Charmat method. Bottled and labeled with bio-safe materials. Enjoy it as an aperitif or with hors-d’oeuvres and delicate first courses.
